job.title: Electrical Systems Specialist
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As the Electrical Systems Specialist on site, reporting directly to the Associate Director - Electrical Systems, you will work closely with the DC Operations and Development teams making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Lead high voltage switching operations across SYD3 and apply an accepted methodology to ensure the safe operation of all high-voltage equipment.
  • Engaging with our General Contractors, and our DC operations team to develop Methods of Procedures (MOPs) to ensure they meet risk mitigation and safety requirements.
  • Work with the commissioning team to deliver, technically accurate and timely projects for our customers.
  • Provide technical support for our Low Voltage equipment to our operations team.

Key focus areas include:

  • Supporting the safe operation of electrical infrastructure, including medium-voltage and low-voltage systems across the data Centre campus.
  • Performing authorized medium-voltage switching operations and assisting in low-voltage switching activities.
  • Monitoring equipment condition, identifying defects, and supporting rectification activities to maintain system reliability and compliance.

What You'll Do

  • Author high voltage switching instructions and then lead a peer review session to confirm the accuracy of the switching procedure.
  • Prepare or review MOPS (Method of Procedure) for construction based electrical integration works.
  • Review and assist in MOP preparation from other related partners. This could be either MV or LV works.
  • Lead the maintenance and inspection of the low voltage network, this includes Generators, UPS’s including DC systems and Busways.
  • Assist our commissioning team with electrical-related apparatus. This includes high voltage apparatus, kiosks, low voltage generators, or uninterruptible power supplies.
  • Assist in design reviews for new projects within SYD region
  • Have a detailed working knowledge of our low Voltage Infrastructure. This equipment will include Kiosk Transformers, low voltage generators, PTU, (uninterruptable power supplies), Busways and other low voltage equipment.
  • Assist AirTrunk’s Safety team during incident investigations, by supplying technical mentorship.

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum 5-8 years of proven experience in safely performing High Voltage switching operations and Low Voltage equipment.
  • Electrical License requirements
  • A sound technical knowledge of MV and LV systems. These could include EHV, MV, LV Generators, PTU’s (UPS’s) and Automatic transfer Switches functionality.
  • Good communication skills
  • Be able to read and interpret single line diagrams, technical diagrams / systems and be able to communicate these systems and functions to them to non-technical colleagues.
  • Be able assist our Safety team with electrical (technical or non-Technical). This could be both in reviewing an incident or site preparation.
  • Willingness to travel to AirTrunk’s other sites in Australia for support or coverage
  • Experience performing electrical switching operations, inspections, and maintenance activities in accordance with approved procedures.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer SAM - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

The ServiceNow Developer specializing in Software Asset Management (SAM) is responsible for developing and implementing software asset management solutions within the ServiceNow platform. This role involves collaborating with stakeholders to enhance software asset management processes, ensuring compliance with licensing agreements, and optimizing software usage across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Development and Configuration: Configure and maintain ServiceNow SAM Pro publisher packs
  • Integration: Integrate ServiceNow SAM Pro with SaaS publisher portals through out-of-the-box and custom integrations to improve usage data availability for license reconciliation
  • Entitlement Upload: Manage and support software entitlement uploads in ServiceNow SAM Pro, including preparing and validating entitlement data from purchase orders, contracts, publisher portals, and procurement records. Ensure accurate mapping to software models using publisher part numbers, normalized publisher/product/version/edition details, license metrics, quantities, contract references, and effective dates
  • Compliance Position Generation: Configure, execute, and troubleshoot ServiceNow SAM Pro reconciliation processes to generate accurate software compliance positions. Validate discovered installation and usage data, normalization results, software models, license metrics, allocations, downgrade/upgrade rights, and publisher-specific rules before reconciliation
  • Reporting and Analytics: Create and maintain standard and performance analytics dashboards and reports to provide insights into software asset utilization, compliance status, and optimization opportunities
  • Workflow Development: Design and develop efficient workflows that streamline processes and enhance user experience
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the technical architect and product owner to align product vision, technical feasibility, and implementation strategies
  • Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct unit testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure data quality and functionality of developed solutions
  • Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for SAM technical implementations and configurations to ensure knowledge transfer and compliance
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor the performance of SAM solutions and make recommendations for improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
  • Participation in Agile Ceremonies: Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Agile process by providing insights and feedback based on user experiences and testing outcomes
  • Adherence to Code Development Standards: Ensure that all development work adheres to established coding standards and best practices. Engage in code review processes to provide and receive constructive feedback and ensure that code quality meets organizational standards

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in ServiceNow development, and a strong command over SAMPro Module, including configurations, scripting, workflows, and tables
  • Experience with ServiceNow Discovery, Rest API’s, OOB integrations, IntegrationHub and related applications
  • Experience and command over software licensing and license compliance position creation
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., ServiceNow Certified Application Developer) are a plus

job.title: Electrical Engineering Principal - Mumbai, India - Chennai, India
job.description:
Job Description

The Electrical Engineering Principal is responsible for development and management of global standard electrical documentation which includes: electrical calculations, equipment settings and switchboard transfer programs. They review project design documentation to check compliance with global standards. They develop processes for management and distribution of the standard documentation and support technical execution across internal and external teams. The Electrical Engineering Principal effectively collaborates with design engineering, major critical equipment, commissioning, construction, global operations teams, and equipment suppliers to ensure documents and processes meet operational, and technical expectations.

Responsibilities

Standards Development Process

  • Participates in review and development of standard electrical calculations including MV and LV short circuit, selectivity and arc flash studies.
  • Manages the standard settings and calculations repository, interacting with internal teams and vendors to develop and maintain, equipment settings, and electrical sequences of operation.
  • Develops processes to track and distribute standard calculations and settings.
  • Works with the major capital equipment team to review MV and LV equipment for compliance with global standards.
  • Reviews and contributes to the development of globally standardized tools, techniques and processes for the management and reporting of the design process.
  • Works with peers in other regions to drive consistency and technical excellence.
  • Thinks and acts in a global manner, considering the applicability of any design decision, innovations or standards changes for all regions.

Project Compliance

  • Assures adherence to developed standards and policy through review of project and vendor documentation including electrical calculations, project documents and vendor submissions.
  • Contributes to creating and maintaining best in class processes and procedures.
  • Assures adherence to developed standards and policy through review of documentation.
  • Significantly contributes to creating and maintaining best in class policies and procedures.

Leadership and Communications

  • Directs external vendors per initiative such as software vendors, equipment suppliers, etc.
  • Provides executive level communication including business requirements documents and advanced technical writing
  • Liaises with global team to incorporate equipment settings and sequence of operations changes into standards
  • Predominantly peer-to-peer communication

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Maintains interpersonal relationships with internal technical staff, external design consulting partners, construction management, and commissioning teams to ensure appropriate stakeholder exposure and buy in to datacenter projects
  • Appropriately leverages the global engineering and operations teams and more senior Design staff to augment their individual technical expertise to ensure all facets of the datacenter design are adequately considered and approved
  • Manages internal and external resources via their influence and outstanding competencies

Technical Expertise

  • Significant experience developing and reviewing electrical calculations in both MV and LV systems with focus on short circuit, selectivity and arc flash calculations.
  • Experience with document management software
  • Experience with PLC and ATC programming
  • Leads internal and/or external engineering, design or construction related seminars/conferences

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in electrical system design, operations, maintenance, and project planning with emphasis on datacenter or mission critical project delivery
  • Bachelor Degree

Primary focus: Management of global electrical studies and equipment settings

Project types: New construction, phased expansion, retrofits, upgrades and acquisition conversions

Key interfaces: MEPs, global operations, major capital equipment team, equipment suppliers, construction, and commissioning teams

Core emphasis: Technical excellence, mission critical resilience, and global consistency

job.title: Director, Business Developement, Capital Markets - Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to help grow and shape our Capital Markets ecosystem, with a focus on high-frequency trading (HFT). This is a high-impact, individual contributor role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, builds trust quickly, and is energized by solving complex problems with creativity and speed.

You’ll be responsible for cultivating relationships with key players in the capital markets space, including exchanges, market participants, data providers, and technology vendors – spanning TradFi and DeFi. You’ll work cross-functionally to unlock new opportunities and help shape the future of digital infrastructure for electronic trading.

Key Responsibilities

Ecosystem Strategy & Industry Insight

  • Analyze the capital markets landscape to identify high-value use cases for Equinix-enabled infrastructure
  • Develop economic value analyses that demonstrate the incremental value of Equinix vs. traditional approaches.
  • Identify buyer profiles and key purchase criteria for HFT and related segments.
  • Collaborate with partners to co-develop integrated solutions that enhance ecosystem health.
  • Participate in industry groups to advocate Equinix capabilities and acquire industry insights

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Lead strategic engagements with exchanges, trading firms, and technology providers.
  • Partner with Sales and Solutions Architecture to unlock complex, high-impact deployments.
  • Partner with sales to support deals and deal structures.
  • Build trust-based relationships with industry leaders and innovators
  • Develop Joint Value Propositions with specialist channel partners, to extend differentiation for both parties

Innovation & Product Alignment

  • Translate customer needs into product requirements in collaboration with Product and Technical Sales teams.
  • Provide competitive intelligence and customer insights to support new service development.

Go-To-Market & Enablement

  • Design and execute go-to-market strategies tailored to capital markets.
  • Identify and prioritize routes-to-market that align with segment entry strategies.
  • Build scalable enablement programs to support field teams and partners.

Metrics & Reporting

  • Develop models to track ecosystem health, magnetism, and financial impact.
  • Report progress against strategic gates and checkpoints.

Who You Are

  • An individual who moves fast, takes initiative, and thrives in ambiguity.
  • Deeply knowledgeable about high-frequency trading, with strong relationships across the capital markets ecosystem.
  • A strategic thinker who connects dots across technology, finance, and customer needs.
  • Inclusive and collaborative, with a passion for growing the business.
  • Comfortable influencing without authority and leading cross-functional efforts.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in capital markets, trading technology, or related fields.
  • Proven track record of business development, ecosystem cultivation or similar.
  • Experience working with exchanges, trading firms, or financial infrastructure providers.
  • Strong communication, analytical, and leadership skills.

job.title: SG | Specialist, Data Centre Site Operations
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As the Specialist, Data Centre Site Operations (DCSO), you will be responsible for the following:

  • Work in rotating shifts to support large scale data centre’s 24x7 onsite operations and critical facilities.
  • Perform 24x7 monitoring of BMS systems (upstream to downstream), critical facilities equipment and other equipment associated with the data centre environment including fire safety, plumbing, mechanical, and electrical systems.
  • Act as first responders and the Level 1 escalation point for all onsite operational incidents and issues. Perform hands-on troubleshooting and ad-hoc repair of mechanical and electrical (M&E) equipment.
  • Respond and perform all remote hands requests within the Operational and Service Level Agreements.
  • Document and update accurately and promptly all relevant activities and requests on the STT GDC Web Portal ticketing system (user requests, incidents, change, problems, provisioning, etc.), ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library).
  • Ensure effective implementation of data centre safety, security and customer support policy and procedures.
  • Oversee the security operations onsite, including processes, manpower and ability to use security software systems.
  • Co-ordinate and support all internal contractors and vendors activities onsite, including reviewing of Permit-To-Work (PTW) documents, scheduling of resources, enforcement of house rules, adherence to best practices, compliance to safety procedures, etc.
  • Co-ordinate, plan and support all preventive and reactive maintenance activities with little to no disruption to STT GDC’s services.
  • Create accurate and regular reporting to internal stakeholders when necessary (incident reports, health reports, daily reports, etc.).
  • Write and update Standard Operating Procedures and Emergency Operating Procedures for DSCO related procedures and processes.
  • Provide administrative support in assets inventory and procurement of parts/equipment.
  • Knowledge of copper/fibre deployment and be willing to learn to use tester to perform cabling troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate and supervise the activities of contracted personnel providing services or performing work in the data centre. Coordinate all preventive/contracted/general maintenance, ensuring zero/minimum disruption of building services Carry out any other duties as and when assigned by the Team Leads and Management.

Requirements

  • ITE or Diploma in Computing/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related fields.
  • At least 1 year of relevant work experience in a 24x7 DC of facility operations environment, or fresh graduate with relevant qualification such building infrastructure.
  • Possess general knowledge of M&E and Network Infrastructure.
  • Meticulous team player with the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Broad knowledge in DC facilities related systems such as PDUs, UPS, DC Rectifier, Generator, DRUPs, CRAUs, Chiller, DX cooling, fire protections, etc.
  • Possess relevant facilities management and/or data centre related certifications, such as ITIL, CDCP, CDCS, etc.
  • Broad knowledge in cloud technology, network, data centre facilities, system applications and IT systems.
  • Familiar with certification standards, such as LEED Gold, BCA-IDA Green Mark Platinum, Uptime Institute Tier III, ISO 20000 / 22301 / 27001, SS564, etc.
  • Prepared to be on 24x7 standby recall to provide extra manpower coverage when necessary.

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: SG | Manager (Service Assurance), Group Data Centre Operations
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As Manager (Service Assurance), Group Data Centre Operations (GDCO), you will be part of the Service Assurance team with responsibilities across data centres in Southeast and Northeast Asia. In this role, you will drive the performance of key operational processes to achieve continuous improvement and operational excellence, manage audit programmes to ensure compliance with required certifications including security (ISMS), processes (SMS & BCMS), and energy and environmental standards, and support the deployment and adoption of IT tools and systems to enable process automation and performance reporting.

  • Plan, schedule, and conduct internal audits for ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 22301, and ISO 50001 standards, prepare audit reports and follow up with auditees to close findings.
  • Plan, schedule, and complete external audits by engaging certification bodies to achieve and maintain ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 22301, and ISO 50001 certifications.
  • Monitor and review operations processes, including incident and change management to drive continuous improvement of key KPIs.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of physical security controls and operations to maintain and enhance overall sites security posture.
  • Support the setup and maintenance of ISMS, BCMS, and SMS management systems.
  • Contribute to the documentation of key operational policies, processes, manuals, SOPs to drive alignment and consistency across countries.
  • Support the automation of operational processes and performance reporting using appropriate IT tools and systems.
  • Provide training and coaching to the data centre operations teams and auditees on audit requirements and processes.
  • Support all service assurance-related activities, initiatives, and projects.
  • Any other tasks as assigned by the Management

Requirements

  • Degree or Diploma in IT, Mechanical & Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in a Data Centre environment.
  • Experience in data centre or critical environment operations (e.g., M&E facilities, security operations) and ITSM processes (incident, change, problem management).
  • ISO Lead/Internal Auditor certification (ISO 27001, 22301, 20000-1, or 50001) with hands-on audit and certification experience.
  • Familiarity with ISMS, BCMS, SMS frameworks and ITSM/operations support tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-cultural communication skills; bilingual in English and an additional Southeast Asian language is preferred.
  • Self-driven with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver results with minimal supervision.

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: SG | Lead, Data Centre Engineering Support (DCES)
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As Lead, Data Centre Engineering Support (DCES), you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure cost efficiency, optimal performance, and alignment of energy and water optimisation initiatives with business objectives.

  • Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Mechanical, Electrical, BMS, and security systems for Singapore Data Centre operations.
  • Champion the Problem Management process and act as a rotating duty Incident Manager in accordance with ITIL framework.
  • Drive energy audits, optimisation programmes, engineering and retrofitting initiatives, as well as financial evaluation of energy efficiency measures.
  • Oversee and be accountable for the procurement of technical services and works, including contract management and administration of service agreements and renewals.
  • Act as program manager for all technical certification programmes (e.g., ANSI/TIA-942, Green Mark, ISO), from planning through to certification.
  • Collaborate with the Technology & Project Delivery team to enhance maintainability and build quality.
  • Develop, review, and validate technical policies, processes, procedures, and work instructions, including maintenance frameworks and best practices.
  • Establish frameworks to ensure full compliance with applicable Acts, regulations, standards and approved codes of practice relating to building operations.
  • Drive technical learning and development initiatives across Singapore Data Centres.
  • Support customer technical audits and provide relevant management information as required.
  • Any other duties or projects as assigned by the Management.

Requirements

  • Diploma in Mechanical & Electrical Engineering, Facilities Management or related field
  • At least 3 years of relevant work experience in managing critical facilities development or operations, as well as project management in 24x7 data centre environment
  • Strong knowledge in MEP operations and building facilities systems (e.g. switchgears, UPS, generators, CRAUs, chiller plants, etc.)
  • Experienced in leading certification programs, including ANSI/TIA-942, Uptime, BCA-IMDA Green Mark for Data Centres, SS 564, LEED and ISO.
  • Relevant certifications in energy and environmental management (e.g. SCEM, SGBC Green Mark Professional, LEED GA/AP) will be an advantage.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CDFOS, CDCS, ITIL or other related certification) are preferred.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and perform effectively under tight timelines.

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Head - Electrical Engineering
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • WTG Electrical System Architecture
  • Own the overall electrical architecture of wind turbine platforms from concept through serial production.
  • Define system/sub-system requirements, technical specifications, interfaces and design criteria.
  • Lead engineering of:

Generator and generator interfaces

  • Power converters
  • Main and auxiliary transformers
  • Pitch electrical system
  • Low-voltage and medium-voltage systems
  • Switchgear and protection systems
  • UPS and auxiliary power systems
  • Cable and harness systems
  • Earthing and lightning protection interfaces
  • Electrical panels and power distribution systems

Ensure robust electrical interfaces across converter, generator, controls, transformer, switchgear and grid connection systems.

  • Generator & Power Conversion
  • Provide technical leadership for generator selection, specification, integration and validation.
  • Lead converter architecture, sizing and performance requirements, including thermal and electrical interfaces.
  • Drive system-level optimization between generator, converter, transformer and turbine control.
  • Review component design margins, losses, efficiency, temperature rise and operating envelopes.
  • Grid Integration & Compliance
  • Lead WTG electrical engineering support for grid-code compliance and turbine-grid integration.
  • Guide power quality, reactive power, voltage/frequency response and protection philosophy.
  • Coordinate engineering inputs for electrical modelling, grid studies and compliance verification.
  • Ensure electrical design supports applicable project and market-specific grid requirements.
  • Controls, SCADA & Electrical Interfaces
  • Work closely with Controls and SCADA engineering teams to ensure complete integration of electrical equipment into the turbine control architecture.
  • Define sensors, measurements, alarms, protections, interlocks and operational sequences.
  • Lead interface management among electrical hardware, turbine controller, converter controller and SCADA.
  • Support troubleshooting of turbine-level electrical and control interactions.
  • Design Verification & Validation
  • Establish electrical DVP&R / verification and validation plans for components and turbine systems.
  • Lead design reviews, technical risk assessments and engineering sign-offs.
  • Define prototype, laboratory, bench and turbine-level validation requirements.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for electrical failures using structured methodologies such as 8D, FMEA/FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis and RCA.
  • Drive corrective and preventive engineering actions based on field and test observations.
  • Reliability & Product Performance
  • Own electrical reliability improvement across the WTG lifecycle.
  • Analyse recurring failures involving converters, generators, transformers, pitch electrical systems and other electrical components.
  • Drive improvements in thermal management, electrical protection, component life and system robustness.
  • Develop design improvements based on testing, manufacturing and field-performance feedback.
  • Certification & Engineering Compliance
  • Ensure electrical designs are compliant with applicable wind turbine certification and electrical engineering requirements.
  • Coordinate engineering activities with certification bodies and external technical agencies where required.
  • Maintain design documentation, calculations, specifications, compliance evidence and engineering change records.
  • Support WTG type certification and platform upgrades from an electrical engineering perspective.
  • Localization & Supplier Engineering
  • Drive localization and alternate-source development for critical electrical components.
  • Develop technical specifications and qualification criteria for suppliers.
  • Participate in supplier capability assessment, technical reviews and component qualification.
  • Work with Supply Chain and Quality teams on technical closure of supplier deviations and engineering changes.
  • Drive design-to-cost and value-engineering initiatives without compromising reliability or compliance.
  • Manufacturing & Service Support
  • Provide engineering support for manufacturing ramp-up and serial production.
  • Address electrical non-conformities and recurring manufacturing issues through permanent engineering solutions.
  • Support commissioning and service teams on complex turbine electrical failures and field issues.
  • Translate field lessons learned into product/design improvements.
  • Engineering Leadership
  • Build and lead a strong Electrical Engineering organization covering core electrical systems and relevant specialist competencies.
  • Establish engineering processes, design standards, review mechanisms and technical governance.
  • Mentor engineers and develop technical competency in WTG electrical technology.
  • Manage engineering priorities across new-product development, localization, cost reduction, field issues and platform improvements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and international engineering partners on technology development.

Qualifications

  • Qualification: B.E./B.Tech – Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering; M.E./M.Tech preferred.
  • Experience: 15–22 years, preferably in WTG / Wind OEM engineering.

job.title: Deputy General Manager - Endorse
job.description:
Responsibilities

Engineering Review and Finalization:

  • Review engineering schemes related to the switchyard, ensuring they meet technical and operational standards.
  • Finalize engineering schemes after thorough review, making necessary adjustments and optimizations.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to assist in quality inspections of the finalized schemes, ensuring they adhere to required standards.

Project Support:

  • Provide detailed technical specifications to the engineering team to ensure proper equipment sizing and compatibility with system requirements.
  • Support the tendering process by addressing technical queries during discussions and conducting comprehensive technical evaluations of potential vendors.
  • Review submitted schemes from Adani's side after contract awards, ensuring they align with project goals and standards.
  • Oversee the entire product preparation process, ensuring all technical requirements and specifications are met.
  • Conduct Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) to verify that the product meets all operational and safety standards before deployment.
  • Witness the commissioning of products at the site, ensuring proper installation, integration, and functionality.
  • Provide technical support to the project team during the commissioning of protection systems, ensuring all procedures are followed correctly.
  • Assist in the system charging process, verifying that all protection systems are operational and meet regulatory standards.
  • Review commissioning documents required for regulatory approvals, ensuring accuracy and completeness, and submit them to the appropriate authorities.

OEM and Maintenance Support:

  • Conduct Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to evaluate potential failure points and their impacts on the system.
  • Provide technical recommendations and corrective actions from an electrical system perspective to address identified issues.
  • Support Annual Overhaul (AOH) and Capital Overhaul (COH) processes by providing technical expertise and ensuring all protection systems are maintained and upgraded as necessary.
  • Conduct annual internal protection audits to evaluate the effectiveness of current systems and identify areas for improvement.
  • Coordinate external protection audits every five years, working with third-party auditors to ensure compliance with industry standards.
  • Manage regular system upgrades, including identifying needs, budgeting, collaborating with OEMs, and overseeing the completion of upgrades.
  • Coordinate relay settings reviews and provide recommendations based on changes in grid conditions to ensure optimal system performance.

job.title: Lead - Aocc&jcc
job.description:
Operation Management:

Oversee daily operations at the AOCC and JCC during shifts to ensure smooth functioning of airport systems, including flight operations, baggage handling, and passenger management.

Monitor and coordinate real-time operational data to maintain high On-Time Performance (OTP), proactively addressing delays or disruptions.

Oversee the allocation of airport resources such as check-in counters, boarding gates, parking stands, and conveyor belts to optimize asset utilization.

Manage Flight Information Display Systems (FIDS) to display real-time, accurate information for passengers and stakeholders.

Monitor and notify stakeholders of adverse weather warnings and implement Low Visibility Procedures (LVP) during weather disruptions to ensure safe operations.

Crisis Management and Incident Response:

Develop and implement crisis management plans to effectively respond to emergencies such as security threats, medical incidents, and operational disruptions.

Ensure the effective implementation of Low Visibility Procedures (LVP) and maintain close coordination with ATC during weather challenges.

Provide training and conduct regular drills with AOCC/JCC staff for better preparedness during emergencies.

Resource Allocation and Utilization:

Allocate and manage resources such as personnel, equipment, and technology within the AOCC to ensure optimal utilization and operational efficiency.

Monitor resource usage including ground support equipment and personnel deployment, addressing any issues related to allocation, availability, and maintenance.

Compliance and Regulatory Oversight:

Ensure strict adherence to the Operational Management Development Agreement (OMDA) and comply with guidelines from government agencies and regulatory bodies (e.g., DGCA, AAI).

Implement and monitor the Noise Abatement Plan to mitigate the environmental impact of airport operations, aligning with prescribed standards and ensuring regulatory compliance.

Documentation and Reporting:

Ensure accurate and timely documentation of all operational activities, events, and incidents to maintain an updated operational record.

Generate and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly reports related to airport performance, On-Time Performance (OTP), resource utilization, and emergency management.

Oversee the maintenance of MIS systems to ensure that operational data is captured correctly for aero invoicing and compliance audits.

Prepare comprehensive reports on disruptions, emergencies, and performance trends for internal review and management decision-making.

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead and mentor team members within the AOCC/JCC, providing guidance on best practices in airport operations, emergency response, and customer service standards.

Conduct performance evaluations and implement professional development plans for team members, ensuring adherence to industry regulations and performance benchmarks.

Stakeholder Coordination and Communication:

Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, including airlines, ground services, security, and customs, to ensure smooth operations and address any issues that arise within the AOCC.

Facilitate communication and collaboration between the AOCC and other JCC departments to resolve operational challenges, improve efficiency, and enhance passenger experience.

Process Improvement:

Support in the execution of Business Excellence programs focusing on process improvement, energy-saving initiatives, and operational efficiency during shift operations.

Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of Business Continuity Management Systems (BCMS) to ensure uninterrupted airport operations in case of emergencies.

Assist in DA-CDM (Domestic Airport Collaborative Decision Making) implementation to improve operational coordination between stakeholders and enhance On-Time Performance (OTP).

Digital Mindset:

Use real-time dashboards, data analytics, and collaborative decision-making tools to enhance operational efficiency.

Ensure accurate data capture for generating MIS reports and aero invoicing for operational reconciliation.

Monitor the use of digital platforms like A-CDM to streamline collaboration with stakeholders.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Head - AOCC/JCC

Direct Supervisors & other Department Leaders

Airport Operations Team

Air Traffic Control

Airport Security

Emergency Medical Services

Engineering & Maintenance Team

Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)

Airports Authority of India

Ministry of Civil Aviation

Airlines

Ground Handling Agencies

Service providers

Govt. agencies (CISF/ATC)

Qualifications

Educational Background:

Bachelor's Degree in Aviation Management, Business Administration, or a related field

Master's Degree in a relevant field is preferred.

Work Experience:

10+ years of relevant experience in managing operations at a control centre

job.title: Field Capability and Technology Lead
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it's easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

This role leads the transformation of Field Operations through digitisation, automation, and the development of advanced planning and orchestration capabilities to enable a modern, data-driven operating model. Working closely with Network Operations, Digital, OSS, and Field leaders, it drives the evolution of operational processes, technology platforms, workforce planning, and the establishment of a field control tower function.

The role also provides leadership across the Field Operations transformation portfolio, aligning with the Networks OSS roadmap to optimise demand management, workforce utilisation, operational resilience, and customer outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the Field Operations transformation roadmap, driving digitisation, automation, process simplification, and adoption of predictive operational capabilities.
  • Establish and mature a Field Operations Planning & Orchestration (Control Tower) capability to optimise demand management, workflow, scheduling, dispatch, and workforce utilisation.
  • Partner with Networks, OSS, Digital, and Automation teams to deliver integrated technology solutions and ensure operational requirements shape strategic roadmaps.
  • Drive systems integration across workforce, network, asset, and workflow platforms while embedding automation-first and data-driven decision-making practices.
  • Define performance frameworks, operational insights, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, scalability, and service reliability.
  • Strengthen operational resilience by supporting business continuity, incident response, workforce capacity planning, and recovery readiness across field domains.
  • Provide strategic leadership and stakeholder engagement, championing innovation, operational excellence, and alignment with broader Network Operations transformation objectives.

What You’ll Bring

  • Extensive leadership experience in telecommunications or other asset-intensive industries, with deep expertise in field and network operations.
  • Proven track record leading enterprise-scale digital transformation, automation, and operational modernisation programs.
  • Strong planning, orchestration, and systems-thinking capabilities, with experience managing complex workflows and competing priorities at scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance operational performance, customer outcomes, risk, safety, and cost considerations.
  • Significant experience in technical planning, service management, and enterprise-governed operating environments.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills across operational, technology, and leadership teams.
  • Ability to lead effectively in high-pressure, incident-driven environments, with relevant tertiary qualifications in Engineering, Technology, Business, or a related discipline desirable.

The good stuff …

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.

We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170. We’re here to help. When you contact us, please advise your preferred method of contact and we will be in touch within 48 hours. job.title: Field Service Power Generation Technician
job.description:
Diagnoses and completes less complex repairs to generators and components at the customer’s site.

We are looking for a talented Field Service Power Generation Technician/Mechanic to join our Distribution Business in (Kapolei, HI)

We offer sign-on bonus, relocation, competitive pay and benefits!

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Completing repair activities on generators or components
  • Engaging with customers in a courteous and professional manner
  • Perform maintenance/repairs utilizing diagnostic tools
  • Maintain detailed records of service
  • Adhere to Cummins Health, Safety & Environmental policies
  • Ongoing development/certifications on new and existing Cummins products
  • Maintain own tools

In order to be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Broad mechanical and electrical repair and maintenance abilities.
  • High Voltage / Low Voltage experience.
  • Capable of electrical repair and maintenance with minimal supervision – hands on exposure to working on power generation products.
  • Basic Diesel Engine experience.
  • Proficient troubleshooting and repairs of generators, transfer switches, and auxiliary components.
  • 2–4 years of experience working on diesel or natural gas generators, heavy equipment, or power generation systems.
  • Working knowledge of electrical systems (AC/DC theory, wiring diagrams, and control systems troubleshooting)
  • Ability to safely perform field service work, including use of tools, testing equipment, and adherence to safety standards (LOTO, PPE, etc.)
  • Work in secured or regulated facilities (e.g., airports, military bases, government sites) requiring badging, escorts, and strict adherence to site-specific safety/security protocols.
  • Occasional travel may be required to neighbor islands or remote locations.
  • Service generators supporting critical infrastructure, such as hospitals, data centers, hotels/resorts, military installations, and utilities where uptime is essential and response time is critical.
  • Participate in after-hours or emergency service calls during outages, storms, or grid instability to restore power quickly and safely.
  • Hours are from 7:30am-4pm. Possible overtime.

job.title: Controller - Operations Finance Manager
job.description:
We’re seeking a talented Controller - Operations Finance Manager to join our team specializing in Finance for our York, SC Cummins location.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Drive Strategic Business Decisions: Apply business and marketplace insights to identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and support decisions that advance organizational goals and performance.
  • Provide Financial Insights: Analyze financial trends, variances, opportunities, and risks to deliver actionable recommendations that improve business results and support leadership decision-making.
  • Lead Accurate Forecasting and Planning: Partner with stakeholders to develop reliable forecasts, validate assumptions, and provide forward-looking financial projections aligned with business strategy.
  • Build Strong Business Partnerships: Collaborate across functions to influence decision-making, align stakeholders, and drive solutions that support organizational objectives.
  • Ensure Financial Integrity and Compliance: Maintain the accuracy of financial data, investigate variances, implement corrective actions, and ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and policies.
  • Communicate Complex Information Effectively: Translate financial data and business insights into clear, meaningful messages tailored to different audiences, enabling informed decision-making at all levels.
  • Drive Accountability and Execution: Prioritize work, remove obstacles, and ensure commitments are met while maintaining a strong focus on results, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop Inclusive and Adaptable Relationships: Foster collaboration across diverse teams, adapt to changing business needs, manage challenges effectively, and contribute to a culture of growth, inclusion, and high performance.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Lead Plant Financial Performance: Serve as the finance leader for the York, SC and Manning, SC manufacturing sites, providing financial guidance and insights that support operational and business objectives.
  • Build Strong Partnerships and Influence Decisions: Collaborate closely with plant leadership and the North America Accounting team to achieve strategic goals, support month-end close activities, and ensure sound financial decision-making.
  • Maintain Financial Controls and Compliance: Establish and sustain a strong control environment by ensuring accurate financial reporting, conducting balance sheet reviews, and driving accountability across both sites.
  • Develop Talent and Support Growth: Coach and develop a team of four direct reports while providing financial analysis and support for Cummins Drivetrain and Braking Systems strategic initiatives that drive business performance and continuous improvement.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Accounting, Finance or related field required. Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant or similar certification required. **

Experience

Significant experience required, including managerial and budgetary experience in a small operations manufacturing or distribution center environment.

  • Responsible for the maintaining a strong control environment at York, SC and Manning, SC manufacturing sites
  • Partners with plant leadership to ensure goals and strategic objectives are met
  • Partners with NA Accounting team on closing the books and balance sheet reviews
  • Supports CDBS strategic initiatives with financial data and analysis as requested
  • Responsible for coaching and developing 4 direct reports

job.title: Engine Workshop Technician
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Applies documented procedures and policies to complete basic repairs and schedule maintenance, including preparing required parts and tools Disassemble, inspect and clean engines and /or engine components Assists with completion required documentation, such as work completed documentation, time sheets, warranty claims and quality forms, via handwritten forms or business system input screens Completes training in line with skill and business requirements Maintains work area and tools for cleanliness and proper operation Ensure adherence to all relevant Health, Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to their supervisor

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electrical Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards on working with low and/or high voltage by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; applies basic electrical theories and electronics components knowledge using appropriate tools and procedures to diagnose and repair products safely and efficiently.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Mechanical Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; applies mechanical principles and theories using appropriate tools and procedures to diagnose and repair products safely and efficiently.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

CDL and passenger endorsement not required, but appreciated

Nice to Have

  • A CDL may be required to obtain upon hire
  • Federal law requires a CDL holder to be 21 years of age or older

Must Have

  • A current valid license is required for this role
  • Must be 18 years old with 2 years driving experience
  • This role requires a 5-year motor vehicle report, free from major violations
  • This position is subject to Federal Transit Administration random and pre-employment drug testing requirements. This roll will be subject to on-going random drug and alcohol testing.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)

Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution

Locally valid driving permit (Preferred)

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Minimal level of work shop experience required

Basic level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products

Salary rate commensurate with experience. job.title: Operador Nivel I
job.description:
Resumen de trabajo:

Opera máquinas y equipos de producción conforme a los requisitos de calidad y productividad de manera segura en un entorno de fabricación con orientación directa.

Responsabilidades clave:

Salud, seguridad y medioambiente (Health, Safety & Environmental, HSE)

Detener el trabajo e informar inmediatamente cualquier peligro de lesiones importantes.

Informar cualquier lesión, enfermedad, incidente o peligro relacionados con el trabajo.

Cumplir con las normas, las políticas, los procedimientos y las reglamentaciones de HSE.

Usar el equipo de protección personal apropiado.

Promover la interdependencia al estar atentos los unos de los otros.

Corregir los peligros conforme a su control y capacidades.

Reconocer cómo su trabajo puede impactar el medio ambiente y trabajar para minimizar el impacto negativo.

Participar en la capacitación de HSE.

Calidad

Sigue cualesquiera procedimientos aplicables de trabajo estándar, documentación de procesos y de calidad

Plantea problemas para minimizar los costos y las exposiciones de calidad.

Realiza inspecciones de calidad.

Identifica y controla los materiales sin conformidad.

Entrega

Opera equipos manuales y automatizados para fabricar y ensamblar el producto con el fin de crear las características y dimensiones apropiadas necesarias para satisfacer las expectativas del cliente.

Logra los objetivo de producción.

Trabaja en el tiempo de ciclo requerido o según el estándar de ingeniería definido.

Mantiene el área de trabajo limpia y ordenada, incluyendo tareas de limpieza rutinarias y tareas de limpieza de máquinas, y realiza tareas de mantenimiento y cuidado del operador planificadas.

Permanece flexible y realiza otras tareas diversas, conforme sea necesario, para cumplir con los objetivoss de producción.

Trabaja con compañeros, oficios calificados y el personal de apoyo para mantener e identificar los equipos que requieren reparación.

Trabajo en equipo

Se comunica eficazmente con el equipo asignado y con todos los equipos de apoyo.

Completa la capacitación y el desarrollo personal de acuerdo con los requisitos comerciales.

Participa activamente en formas de mejorar la calidad, la seguridad, el proceso, el flujo de materiales y el desarrollo de los empleados. Habilidades:

Colabora - Crear asociaciones y trabajar en colaboración con otras personas para alcanzar objetivos compartidos.

Enfoque en el cliente - Cultivar relaciones sólidas con los clientes y ofrecer soluciones centradas en el cliente.

Demuestra auto-conciencia - Usar una combinación de retroalimentación y reflexión para obtener un entendimiento profundo de las fortalezas y debilidades personales.

Aprendizaje al vuelo - Aprendizaje activo a través de la experimentación al enfrentar problemas nuevos, aprendiendo tanto de los éxitos como de los fracasos.

Autodesarrollo - Buscar activamente nuevas maneras de crecer y plantearse desafíos usando canales de desarrollo tanto formales como informales.

Aspectos básicos de la salud y la seguridad - Defiende y modela conductas proactivas de salud y seguridad al identificar, informar y participar en medidas para mejorar la salud y la seguridad con el fin de crear una cultura interdependiente y contribuir a un lugar de trabajo libre de lesiones.

Valora las diferencias - Reconocer el valor que las diferentes perspectivas y culturas aportan a una organización.

job.title: Manager, Offer Lifecycle Supply Chain Design and Planning
job.description:
Job Description

Role Purpose

Lead complex, end-to-end supply chain programs across the product lifecycle, from New Product Introduction (NPI) through Product Withdrawal (PWP), ensuring seamless coordination across planning, manufacturing, procurement and key stakeholders within the electronics ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end lifecycle transitions, covering NPI, ramp-up, production transfers and product withdrawal.
  • Orchestrate multiple planning and supply chain stakeholders to ensure readiness, continuity and execution.
  • Drive supply chain planning for electronics manufacturing transfers and outsourcing initiatives, ensuring smooth transition to external manufacturing partners.
  • Support increasing NPI and PWP volumes while managing supply continuity and transition risks.
  • Contribute to supply chain readiness for strategic priorities including CRA 2027 and Power of Two acceleration.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate capacity, material, planning and supply risks across the product lifecycle.
  • Drive strong cross-functional governance, stakeholder alignment and execution of critical supply chain milestones.

Ideal Profile Senior Supply Chain/Program Management professional with strong experience in electronics manufacturing, lifecycle management, NPI, production transfers, planning and outsourced manufacturing environments, with the ability to influence and coordinate across complex global stakeholder networks.

job.title: Senior Executive, Internal Audit (IT Audit) (Based in Singapore)
job.description:
The Role

This position will be based in the Group Internal Audit team supporting IT audits and reporting to a Vice President.

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform IT audits to ensure the adequacy, efficiency and effectiveness of IT system controls and recommend improvements to address risks or weaknesses identified.
  • Assist in the development of IT audit scope, perform audits, recommend improvement areas and prepare audit reports.
  • Participate in Group-level IT projects and act as an IT risk advisory to provide consulting services on risks and controls relating to new IT system implementation and/ or major enhancements.
  • Able to work independently with general guidance on audit assignments.
  • Support the business audit team to develop / enhance data analytics or provide support in integrated business audits if required.
  • Carry out ad-hoc and special assignments/projects as and when delegated by the Management.
  • Provide ad-hoc support for IA managers if required.

Job Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, IT or Business/Accountancy.
  • 6 years of audit experiences with a minimum of 3 years of relevant IT audit experience.
  • Professional certification in CISA, CISM or CISSP would have an added advantage.
  • Experienced in review of IT application systems, operating systems and database security
  • Prior experience in reviewing network security including network infrastructure and network penetration tests would be an advantage.
  • Experience in using computer assisted audit techniques (such as ACL) and data analytics is preferred.
  • Good knowledge and understanding of MAS TRM, CSA Cyber Security Code of Practice (CCoP), cloud security and familiarity with industry security best practices.
  • Candidates with big 4 audit firms’ experience will have an added advantage.

job.title: Facility Operations Center Engineer, DCC Communities
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth! Amazon is a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers. If you'd like to help us build a place where you can find and buy anything online, this is the job for you.

The ideal candidate will need to have an understanding of data center IT Infrastructure and data center Facilities infrastructure and how the two entities co-exist. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing assistance and support to the onsite team in India.

The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels.

Qualified candidates must also have experience functioning in a large-scale data center and have demonstrated and displayed the ability to think outside of the box. This skill is essential, as the candidate will assist with aligning the Facility Operations Center with the larger objectives of other business and peer organizations.

You will need to play a role with growing the team to a standard of operational excellence in India.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think and act globally; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!

A day in the life Roles, Responsibilities and Requirements (job description is not meant to be an all-inclusive statement of every duty and responsibility required):

  • Monitors the global data center Amazon facilities infrastructure platform in india
  • Serves as a Point of Contact for internal and external teams
  • Assists with the development of communication and escalation protocols designed to improve the team’s performance
  • Contributes to outage post mortem analysis
  • Ensures records are updated in a timely manner
  • Assists with coordination and communication during emergency recovery efforts
  • Assists with the development of tools that will enhance the team’s performance
  • The ability to support a 24X7 environment in India (This is shift work which may require that you work weekends and holidays)

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
  • Experience in data center engineering or operations
  • Experience in operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
  • Bachelor's degree in enginnering or equivalent
  • 3+ years of facilities management experience
  • Knowledge of mission critical systems (data centers, hospitals, power plants, military facilities, etc.)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Senior Partner Solutions Architect, Migration & Modernization, AWS India
job.description:
This position is part of the AWS India Specialists and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams deliver the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Are you passionate about helping partners transform their migration practices using AWS Transform?

The AWS Partner Core Tech team is looking for a Senior Partner Solutions Architect to accelerate partner-led cloud migrations at scale and support a core AWS partner program - the Migration Acceleration Program (MAP)

In this role, you will work at the intersection of partner enablement, emerging AI technologies, and enterprise migration delivery. As a trusted technical consultant to partners and empowering them to build AI-native migration practices to unlock measurable customer outcomes. This is a unique opportunity to shape how AWS partners deliver end-to-end cloud transformation using MAP in the GenAI era — blending deep technical consultancy with programmatic scale.

You will work hands-on with strategic partners — collaborating directly to validate solutions, architect modernization pathways, and pioneer new delivery patterns. You will then multiply that expertise through thought leadership, technical content, enablement programs, and automation tooling across the broader partner ecosystem.

Key job responsibilities

  • Work hands-on with strategic migration partners — delivering architectural guidance, validating GenAI-powered solutions, and driving GenAI adoption to improve practice efficiency and productivity.
  • Co-create reusable artifacts that accelerate delivery across regulated and enterprise environments.
  • Provide strategic advisory on complex workload migrations and application modernization — conducting technical architecture reviews, providing needs-based support on large MAP engagements, and supporting technical qualification of partner opportunities to drive pipeline growth and measurable revenue impact
  • Design and deliver scalable enablement programs and author high-impact technical content (reference architectures, use case libraries, blogs) that drive broad partner adoption of AWS migration and modernization capabilities
  • Build agentic AI automation that streamlines internal program operations — reducing manual review and validation cycles from days to seconds
  • Travel up to 25% to deliver enablement events, facilitate migration workshops, and present at AWS partner and industry events

A day in the life

  • Collaborate with partners on solution design, architecture reviews, and technical blocker resolution for active migration engagements
  • Develop and iterate on scalable automation tooling (agentic AI agents, document processing, validation pipelines)

Author and maintain technical content — use case libraries, reference architectures, blog posts, and enablement materials

  • Review and technically validate partner migration opportunities, assessing scope, architecture, and programme eligibility
  • Prepare and deliver enablement sessions, workshops, and deep dives for partners and internal field teams

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
  • 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
  • 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • Experience architecting or deploying Cloud/Virtualization solutions in enterprise customers

This position offers the opportunity to lead a high-performing team while ensuring accurate financial reporting, compliance with accounting standards, and efficient service delivery across global operations. The role is part of the Finance organization based in Bangalore (Hebbal).

  • Build Azure- or Snowflake-based AI applications and services, including orchestration, retrieval, RAG, agent logic, APIs, evaluation and integration components.
  • Create implementation assets, including prompts, agent instructions, evaluation datasets, notebooks, application logic, automated workflows, tests and deployment assets.
  • Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to develop AI/ML solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable business value. These include predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
  • Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to build and validate machine learning and generative AI solutions using enterprise data. These include Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.

Quality, compliance and operations

  • Evaluate and test solutions for grounding, answer quality, model or agent behaviour, business value, safety, cost and operational reliability.
  • Apply the defined Responsible AI, information security, privacy, access-control and IT compliance requirements within the assigned solution scope. Work with architecture, platform, security and operations specialists where required.
  • Contribute to CI/CD, production readiness, handover and monitoring design.
  • Support incident and problem analysis related to AI solutions within the assigned scope.
  • Document AI solutions, including their logic, assumptions, limitations, test results and operational requirements.

Collaboration

  • Work as part of a multidisciplinary delivery team with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers and platform specialists.

Requirements (Mandatory)

Experience and education

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation.
  • 4–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, BI analytics or a similar data-focused role.
  • Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
  • Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level).

Technical skills

  • Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development.
  • Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation.
  • Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage.
  • General understanding of classical machine learning concepts. Hands-on experience is an advantage where relevant to the use case.
  • Working experience with version control and testing, preferably using GitHub or Azure DevOps. Exposure to CI/CD and deployment processes is an advantage.
  • Experience documenting AI solutions and understanding data quality concepts, with attention to data accuracy and consistency.

Ways of working

  • Experience working in an Agile or similar delivery setup.
  • Ability to take part in stakeholder discussions and clarify technical, data and AI-specific aspects of documented business requirements.
  • Ability to explain technical options, limitations and trade-offs, and to work effectively in a multidisciplinary delivery team.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with analysts and customers and convert documented requirements into practical AI solution components.

Nice to Have / Differentiators

  • Relevant professional certifications, particularly:Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)SnowPro Core or GenAI certificationsFabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
  • Practical experience with Snowflake AI/ML capabilities such as Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst or AI Functions.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
  • Experience using SAP and Salesforce enterprise data as inputs to AI/ML solutions.

More About Us

ABB provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.
