job.title: Head Hospitality & Healthcare- Digital & Sustainability
job.description:
"We're improving the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings, and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered optimally and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components, and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.

JOIN US! WE MAKE REAL WHAT MATTERS. THIS IS YOUR ROLE"

About the Role

As the Head of Hospitality & Healthcare - Digital & Sustainability, you will lead market development and sales growth for integrated digital, energy-efficiency and decarbonization solutions across hotels, resorts, hospitals, healthcare networks and allied facilities. You will build the vertical strategy, originate opportunities, engage senior customer stakeholders and position solutions that improve asset performance, operational resilience, energy productivity, occupant and patient comfort, and progress toward sustainability goals.

The role requires a strong blend of vertical insight, consultative selling, solution orchestration and commercial ownership. You will work across sales, engineering, service, delivery, finance, partners and product teams to convert customer priorities into scalable, outcome-led propositions.

Vertical Strategy & Market Development

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for the Hospitality and Healthcare verticals, aligned with digitalization, energy efficiency and decarbonization priorities.
  • Segment the market by customer type, portfolio size, operating model, asset maturity and sustainability ambition to prioritize high-potential accounts.
  • Build vertical-specific value propositions, use cases, account plays and repeatable commercial propositions for India.
  • Develop a strong ecosystem with consultants, operators, owners, developers, facility-management companies, ESCOs and technology partners.

Lead Generation & Pipeline Building

  • Independently identify, qualify and develop opportunities across hotel groups, resort portfolios, hospitals, diagnostic networks and healthcare campuses.
  • Create demand through strategic outreach, industry networks, executive forums, associations, events, partners, digital channels and referrals.
  • Build and maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline across new logos, portfolio expansions, modernization, lifecycle services and recurring digital business.
  • Use CRM discipline to maintain opportunity quality, forecasting accuracy, next-step visibility and sales governance.

Consultative Selling & Executive Engagement

  • Engage owners, operators, CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CIOs, sustainability leaders, engineering heads, facility leaders and clinical-infrastructure stakeholders.
  • Lead discovery to understand business priorities such as guest or patient experience, uptime, energy cost, asset reliability, compliance, standardization and operational visibility.
  • Translate operational and sustainability challenges into measurable business cases covering savings, risk reduction, lifecycle value, service outcomes and return on investment.
  • Lead customer workshops, concept presentations, solution demonstrations, site discovery and executive-level value discussions.

Solution & Business Development

  • Orchestrate integrated propositions across building and energy management, IoT-enabled asset monitoring, command centers, analytics, digital services, HVAC and chiller optimization, energy monitoring, solar, storage and other relevant sustainability solutions.
  • Co-create technically feasible and commercially viable proposals with engineering, service, delivery, finance and partner teams.
  • Develop portfolio-level approaches that can begin with pilots and scale across multiple properties, hospitals or campuses.
  • Promote lifecycle and recurring-revenue models, including software, analytics, performance services and long-term customer-success engagement.

Revenue, Commercial & Account Ownership

  • Own order intake, revenue growth, gross-margin quality and target achievement for the assigned verticals.
  • Drive opportunity strategy, stakeholder mapping, competition management, proposal quality, negotiation and deal closure.
  • Create strategic account plans for priority customers and identify cross-sell, upsell, modernization and replication opportunities.
  • Balance customer value, delivery feasibility, contractual risk, pricing discipline and long-term account potential.

Customer Success & Scale

  • Ensure effective transition from sales to delivery, with clear outcomes, responsibilities, baselines and success measures.
  • Partner with delivery and customer-success teams to track adoption, realized value, customer satisfaction and expansion potential.
  • Capture references, success stories and reusable proof points that strengthen vertical credibility and accelerate replication.
  • Use customer and market feedback to influence solution design, service models, pricing and portfolio roadmap.

Market Intelligence & Thought Leadership

  • Monitor customer investment priorities, regulations, sustainability commitments, emerging business models, technology trends and competitor activity.
  • Represent the organization in hospitality, healthcare, digital-building and sustainability forums.
  • Build credible vertical narratives around operational transparency, resilient infrastructure, autonomous operations, energy productivity and measurable outcomes.
  • Provide structured market feedback to leadership, product, marketing and strategy teams.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the vertical champion and mobilize regional sales, key-account, solution, service and partner teams around focused growth plays.
  • Establish sales cadence, opportunity reviews, account governance and clear ownership for strategic pursuits.
  • Coach teams on vertical use cases, stakeholder priorities, value articulation and consultative selling.
  • Collaborate effectively across internal and external stakeholders to deliver an integrated customer experience.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 12+ years in enterprise B2B sales, business development or vertical leadership, preferably in smart infrastructure, building technologies, digital solutions, energy services or sustainability.
  • Vertical Knowledge: Strong understanding of hospitality and/or healthcare operating environments, stakeholder priorities, asset-intensive operations and investment decision processes.
  • Sales Leadership: Demonstrated success in lead generation, consultative selling, strategic account development, complex solution sales and senior stakeholder engagement.
  • Digital & Sustainability Acumen: Ability to connect digital infrastructure, operational technology, energy performance and decarbonization outcomes to customer business priorities.
  • Commercial Capability: Strong command of business-case development, ROI and lifecycle-value articulation, pricing, negotiation, contracts and deal governance.
  • Solution Orientation: Ability to integrate multiple technologies and services into a coherent, outcome-led proposition rather than sell standalone products.
  • Tools Proficiency: Working proficiency in CRM platforms and Microsoft 365; comfort using data and dashboards for pipeline and business management.
  • Communication: Executive presence with strong presentation, facilitation, negotiation and written communication skills.
  • Mindset: Entrepreneurial, externally oriented, collaborative and accountable, with the ability to build a market while driving near-term results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Engineering or technology degree; a postgraduate qualification in business, energy, sustainability or a related field is an advantage.
  • Experience with hotel chains, hospital groups, real-estate owners, operators, consultants or facility-management ecosystems.
  • Exposure to digital building platforms, building automation, HVAC optimization, energy analytics, renewable energy, storage or performance-based solutions.
  • Experience building multi-site or portfolio-level programs and scaling pilots into repeatable business.

Success Measures

  • Qualified pipeline creation and conversion across Hospitality and Healthcare.
  • Order intake, revenue, margin quality and recurring digital or service business growth.
  • New customer acquisition and penetration of priority strategic accounts.
  • Pilot-to-scale conversion and replication across multi-site customer portfolios.
  • Customer adoption, realized value, reference creation and long-term account expansion.

job.title: Software Engineer, Google Payments, Growth
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Software Engineer on the Consumer Payments Growth team in Singapore, you will participate in the design, development, and operation of distributed backend service, platform, and application capabilities that drive user engagement across Google's global consumer payments ecosystem. You will work on the engineering workstreams for global growth initiatives, from real-time decisioning pipelines and financial rewards settlement to stateful quest engines and low-latency signal aggregation and build features on Payment surfaces to enable growth constructs. You will work closely with local and global cross-functional teams (e.g., Product Manager (PM), User Experience (UX), Data Science, Risk/Security, and engineering teams across Singapore and the US) to build resilient, highly scalable production systems.

Users come first at Google. Nowhere is this more important than on our Advertising and Commerce team: we believe that ads and commercial information can be highly useful to our users if that information is relevant to what our users wish to find or do. Advertisers worldwide use Google Ads to promote their products; publishers use AdSense to serve relevant ads on their website; and business around the world use our products (like Google Shopping, and Google Wallet) to support their online businesses and bring users into their offline stores. We are constantly innovating to deliver the most effective advertising and commerce opportunities of tomorrow.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implementation, and deployment of scalable back-end services, platform components, and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) in Java/C++ supporting real-time event streaming and growth campaigns.
  • Build high-performance communications infrastructure that delivers personalized, contextual in-app messages and lifecycle notifications across mobile, web, and checkout surfaces.
  • Architect resilient, idempotent financial settlement workflows and digital voucher vaulting systems with strict transactional consistency and anti-abuse controls.
  • Design low-latency feature stores and telemetry pipelines to support high-velocity A/B testing, counterfactual logging, and causal attribution in close partnership with data science. Implement stateful milestone quest engines and gamified reward mechanics that drive sustainable user engagement and positive unit economics.
  • Leverage modern Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted development tools and best practices to accelerate team-wide development velocity, test coverage, and code maintainability.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Site Operations Lead, Cable Landing Station
job.description:
About the job

In this role, you will serve as the primary on-site owner’s representative for Google's Cable Landing Stations. You will be directly responsible for local service assurance and safeguarding Google's infrastructure investments by overseeing service provider performance and enforcing Google's engineering and operational standards and will ensure optimal network availability and reliability. You will be a strong operational leader who ensures full compliance with standard operating procedures.

You will serve as a key on-the-ground point-of-contact for local stakeholder engagement, customs, security engagement, community relations, and direct coordination with regional governmental bodies and authorities into google as needed. You will act as the dedicated on-site executive sponsor for regulatory compliance, environmental governance, EHS, and statutory site audits, ensuring adherence to local laws and rapid resolution of official findings. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee direct local operations across the Cable Landing Station (CLS), fronthaul, and outside plant (OSP), holding third-party providers strictly to SLAs while driving rapid MTTR and long-term asset reliability (MTBF).
  • Enforce rigorous technical guidelines, SOPs, access controls, and EHS/environmental policies, executing audits and contractor background checks to maintain audit-ready facilities.
  • Maintain direct custody of critical spares, consumables, warranties, and specialized test equipment, managing end-to-end inventory tracking and timely replenishment.
  • Supervise facilities management (FM) contracts, power systems (UPS, generators, PFE), cooling, and transmission assets (SLTE) through strict preventative maintenance and continuous security oversight.
  • Travel independently and at short notice between operational locations to manage urgent incidents, including safely transporting specialized equipment and tools to sites inaccessible by public transit.

job.title: Office Administrator Team Assistant
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

We are looking for a highly organised Office Administrator & Team Assistant to support both office operations and senior leadership.

This hybrid role combines hands-on office management with high-level executive support, requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, anticipate needs, and keep the business running smoothly behind the scenes.

You will be a key enabler of productivity, ensuring an efficient workplace while supporting executives in day-to-day operations and strategic coordination.

Key Responsibilities**

Administrative Support

  • Provide proactive administrative support to C-suite executives, including travel arrangements, complex scheduling and calendar coordination, and related tasks
  • Process and reconcile expense reports (e.g. corporate credit cards) accurately and in a timely manner
  • Prepare materials, reports, and meeting summaries as required
  • Handle confidential documents and information with professionalism and discretion
  • Support internal communication and engagement initiatives as required
  • Assist with company events, all hands, and workshops where executive coordination is needed
  • Provide ad hoc project support to the leadership team and broader organisation

Office Operations & Facilities

  • Manage daily office operations to ensure a well-functioning, organised workplace
  • Welcome visitors to the office and ensure a professional front-of-house experience
  • Manage pantry supplies, consumables, and general office ordering
  • Liaise with cleaning crew and building management to ensure office upkeep and cleanliness
  • Support meeting room readiness and general office organisation
  • Coordinate onboarding logistics for new hires, including liaising with IT for equipment setup, seating arrangements, and access preparation

Skills & Experience

Required:

  • 3+ years’ experience in executive support, office administration, or similar coordination roles, in a fast-paced or high-growth environment
  • Experience supporting senior leadership or executives
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, calendar management tools and collaboration platforms (e.g., Outlook, Office Suite, Slack)
  • Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • High degree of professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment in handling confidential matters

Key Competencies

  • Reliability & Accountability: Delivers tasks accurately, on time, and independently
  • Professional Discretion: Exercises sound judgment in handling sensitive information
  • Operational Efficiency: Keeps executive schedules and administrative processes running smoothly
  • Organisation & Attention to Detail: Maintains accuracy while managing multiple priorities
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a dynamic environment and adjusts to changing needs
  • Collaboration & Communication: Builds positive working relationships across teams

Success Metrics

  • Timely and accurate completion of executive administrative tasks (e.g., expenses, bookings)
  • Smooth calendar management and travel coordination for C-suite
  • Professional and well-maintained office environment
  • Seamless onboarding logistics coordination for new hires
  • Positive feedback from leadership and internal teams regarding responsiveness and reliability

job.title: Manager, Sox Compliance
job.description:
About the Role

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

IREN is seeking an experienced Manager, SOX Compliance to join the SOX team which is responsible for overseeing and strengthening IREN’s global systems and controls to ensure accurate financial reporting and SOX compliance for business and IT processes. With a focus on safeguarding the integrity of our financial systems, as well as support in establishing and maintaining policies and procedures that help monitor an enhance the company's global control environment and support management in the identification of emerging risks, you will collaborate closely with various cross-functional teams to define, assess, and test solutions that enhance our business processes and IT systems and controls within an ever-evolving technology and regulatory landscape.

We have grown substantially since 2019, from our inception in Australia to now having several facilities across North America and being listed on NASDAQ… and we are just getting started! By joining us, you will be contributing to the future of sustainable high-performance compute and the local communities we strive to have a positive impact on.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Management Information Systems or an equivalent field such as Finance.
  • Professional certification such as CISA, CIA or CPA.
  • 5+ years of experience in SOX compliance, risk management, internal audit or external audit with a focus on business process controls or IT General Controls (ITGCs), including a minimum of 4 years working at a U.S. publicly traded company or a Big Four public accounting firm.
  • Experience identifying, designing and testing business and/or IT controls to meet compliance requirements.
  • Experience with SOX 404 and the COSO framework.
  • Experience leading SOX efforts for systems such as SAP, HiBob, etc.
  • Strong business process acumen and knowledge of standard processes and best practice, with direct experience across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Inventory and Financial Statement Close processes.
  • Experience communicating complex technical risks and control concepts to non-technical stakeholders, including executives.
  • Demonstrated leadership, project management and organizational skills.
  • Highly proficient in MS Office, specifically Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, SharePoint and Outlook.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in the end-to-end SOX program, including planning, scoping, risk assessment, maintenance of documentation used in the SOX program (e.g. risk and control matrices, process flow diagrams) controls testing, remediation, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and the external audit team to coordinate walkthroughs and control testing.
  • Evaluate IT General Controls (ITGCs), automated and manual business process controls, and interfaces in key systems (e.g. SAP, ADP).
  • Find opportunities to leverage IT solutions to automate processes and create efficiencies in financial processes and strengthen internal controls.
  • Partner with the IT organization teams to ensure alignment on SOX approach, timing, controls reliance, external audit reliance, etc.
  • Prepare and provide regular training on SOX and control requirements, risk management, and other relevant areas (e.g. management review controls, IPE procedures, etc.) to educate business process owners and reiterate the importance of compliance.
  • Provide guidance and support to control owners if they propose process or system changes (e.g. Implementation of new systems, impact assessment for changes in people, process or technology).
  • Monitor and drive timely remediation of control deficiencies and recommend enhancements to strengthen internal controls.
  • Stay current on changes in SOX requirements and leading practices, cybersecurity regulations, and IT risk management best practices.

Benefits

  • Compensation & Rewards

Competitive salary range, finalized based on experience and impact

  • Short and long-term incentive programs designed to reward both results and long term company success

Wellbeing & Benefits

  • Comprehensive extended health and dental coverage to keep you and your family supported
  • Paid vacation to recharge, travel, or simply enjoy more life outside of work

We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!

  • IREN Limited is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.
  • This job will remain posted until filled. While we appreciate all applications we receive, we are only able to contact candidates under consideration.
  • By applying for this position and submitting your resume and application materials, you consent to the processing of your personal information in accordance with our Job Applicant

job.title: Legal Administrative Assistant
job.description:
About the Role

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. IREN is seeking a Legal Administrative Assistant to provide day-to-day administrative support to the Legal team, working closely with lawyers and business stakeholders to keep the team running smoothly. The main priority of the role is managing legal billing - processing invoices, purchase orders and service entry sheets in SAP, and coordinating monthly accrual requests - with a smaller amount of billing support for Risk & Compliance. job.title: Data Platform Engineer-Fullstack
job.description:
Data Platform Engineer (Full Stack)

At Johnson Controls, you will help build the data platform behind OpenBlue, our smart-building platform. In this role, you will build the services, APIs, and user interfaces that put trusted building and energy data in the hands of the applications and people who rely on it.

Role Overview

We are looking for a full-stack Data Platform Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build data-serving APIs, platform tooling, and React front ends on the OpenBlue Data Platform (OBDP). You will work across .NET or Java back-end services and the streaming and lakehouse stack (Kafka, Flink, Spark, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake) alongside senior engineers. This is a hands-on role where you will own well-scoped features end to end, from UI to data, and take on more design ownership over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop back-end services and data-serving APIs (REST and GraphQL) in .NET (C#) or Java.
  • Build and maintain React and TypeScript front ends for platform tooling, data management, and operational views.
  • Integrate services with Kafka, Flink, and Spark pipelines and with Iceberg, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL data stores.
  • Write unit, integration, and functional tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
  • Fix production defects and support SIT, UAT, and deployments.
  • Deploy services on AKS and set up monitoring and alerting for the features you own.

How You Will Do It

  • Own the outcome with accountability by delivering well-tested features and following through on commitments.
  • Stay close to work by understanding how users and downstream applications use the data and tools you build.
  • Look for root causes, improve continuously, and raise issues with candor.
  • Work as one team by partnering with engineers, QA, UX, and product, sharing context, and asking for help early.
  • Use clear documentation and disciplined engineering practices to support consistency and handoffs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in full-stack software engineering.
  • Professional experience building front ends with React and TypeScript (or JavaScript), HTML, and CSS.
  • Professional back-end experience in .NET (C#) or Java, including REST API design.
  • Solid SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of data platforms, with exposure to at least one of Kafka, Flink, Spark, Iceberg, or Snowflake, and eagerness to learn the rest.
  • Experience with Git, code review, and agile/Jira workflows.
  • Hands-on AI-assisted development with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with a critical eye for generated code.

Nice to Have

  • GraphQL API design experience.
  • Exposure to Trino, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or HBase.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, and Helm.
  • Azure experience.
  • Experience with time-series or IoT data.
  • UI component libraries, design systems, or data visualization libraries.

job.title: Oracle Fusion PTP Procurement Functional Analyst (Fusion & EBS Techno-Functional)
job.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Oracle Fusion PTP Procurement Functional Analyst (Fusion & EBS Techno-Functional)

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 6-8 years

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Procure-to-Pay (PTP) Functional Analyst with Oracle EBS Techno-Functional expertise to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess strong functional knowledge of Oracle Fusion Procurement and PTP business processes along with hands-on techno-functional experience in Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS). The role requires collaboration with business and IT stakeholders to analyse requirements, design scalable solutions, support integrations, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across Oracle Fusion and legacy EBS environments.

Oracle DevOps Organization is supporting multiple Oracle Fusion Instances within JCI. This role will serve as the single point of contact (SPOC) for the Procurement value stream, supporting development, enhancement, integration, and production support activities across Oracle Fusion Cloud and related Oracle EBS applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, support, and enhancement of Oracle Fusion and Oracle EBS Procurement and PTP processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve system performance, business process efficiency, and solution reliability.
  • Implement DevOps best practices to streamline development, testing, deployment, and support activities.
  • Monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring high availability and minimal downtime.
  • Lead requirements gathering sessions, fit-gap workshops, and solution design discussions with business stakeholders.
  • Configure and support Oracle Fusion modules including Purchasing, Self-Service Procurement, Supplier Portal, Inventory, Order Management, and Accounts Payable.
  • Provide techno-functional support for Oracle EBS Procurement, Purchasing, iProcurement, Inventory, and Accounts Payable modules where required.
  • Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues involving Oracle Fusion, Oracle EBS, integrations, and data flows.
  • Support inbound and outbound integrations using FBDI, REST APIs, SOAP Services, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and legacy EBS interfaces.
  • Develop and analyse SQL queries for troubleshooting, data validation, reconciliation, and reporting purposes.
  • Coordinate data migration, conversion, and interface activities between Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion applications.
  • Review and support EBS customizations, extensions, reports, workflows, interfaces, and conversions (RICEW objects).
  • Lead and mentor functional and technical team members within the value stream.
  • Conduct system configurations, testing, UAT support, defect management, and end-user training.
  • Analyze Oracle Fusion enhancements, change requests, and production support activities.
  • Plan and prioritize approved backlogs with BPO/GPO teams and Oracle Solution Architects.
  • Perform capacity planning and resource management for enhancement and support activities.
  • Coordinate with other value stream leads and integration teams to address cross-functional dependencies and issues.
  • Schedule, review, and approve production deployments in collaboration with Global Release Management teams.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to reduce support tickets and optimize operational efficiency.
  • Follow JCI’s Major Incident Management process to address critical P1/P2 issues.
  • Provide KPI reporting and operational metrics to Global and Regional DevOps leadership.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills along with strong analytical abilities.
  • Self-motivated with a positive attitude and a can-do approach.

job.title: Manager -Vulnerability Management
job.description:
What you will do

The Johnson Controls Global Cyber Security (GCS) team is undergoing a transformation and expansion as Johnson Controls increases its cybersecurity resources and capabilities in order to address the ever-changing cybersecurity threat landscape.

The Sr. Vulnerability Analyst for Vulnerability Management will be responsible for overseeing and leading the vulnerability management program within the organization. This role involves identifying, evaluating, and mitigating security vulnerabilities across the company's IT infrastructure and applications. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, strong leadership skills, and a proven track record of managing vulnerability management teams and programs. This role will report to the Sr. Manager Vulnerability Management.

The candidate will be able to articulate thoughts clearly, run operations, plan initiatives, and execute with appropriate urgency. The candidate will demonstrate drive, intelligence, maturity, and energy and will be a proven change agent.

How you will do it:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive vulnerability management strategy aligned with the organization’s security objectives.
  • Lead and manage the vulnerability management team, providing guidance, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate vulnerability management processes into the overall security program.
  • Oversee regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing to identify potential security weaknesses.
  • Work closely with IT and development teams to develop and implement effective remediation plans.
  • Coordinate and/or perform regular Infrastuctural and Web Application vulnerability assessments;
  • Identify, and maintain the vulnerability management corporate platform in order to prompt identify weakness in the internal and external perimeter, including Cloud infrastructure;
  • Monitor the identified security vulnerabilities or missconfiguration and support the IT stakeholders for remediation;
  • Enforce VM processes and procedures to ensure also the right coverage and security of the Corporate Business Infrastructure and Web Applications;
  • Collaborate with GIS teams to develop or optmize automations used for vulnerability tracking and reporting;
  • Support to adopt Secutiy best practices and security standards applied by the organization.

What we look for:

Required

  • Minimum 10 years working in Information Security and Security Operations area.
  • Knowledge of industry best practices in Vulnerability Management and Compliance areas; (e.g. NIST and “CVSS - Common Vulnerability Scoring System” frameworks)
  • Experience in management and configuration of vulnerability assessment platform (e.g Rapid7 Insight VM and AppSec, Nessus, Qualys VM and WAS, Burp Suite, ZAP)
  • Experience with administration of ITSM solutions used for vulnerability tracking and reporting (Service Now SecOps VM Module/Jira)
  • Experience with OWASP Top 10 assessment and methodology and CIS hardening standard;
  • Experience with various cloud providers (Azure, Google, Amazon) and knowledge on methodology how to secure them;
  • Experience on enforcement of VM operational Security process and procedures;
  • Experience with penetration test assessment, red/blue team activities and security monitoring;
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communications skills, including the ability to communicate security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively facilitate and drive organizational change.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer security or computer science discipline;
  • Previous technical background in IT or Software development roles;
  • Experience with management of Service NOW SecOps Vulnerability Response module.

Desired Security certifications:

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)
  • CompTIA Security+
  • Qualys Certified Specialist
  • Burp Suite Certified Practitioner

job.title: Lead Engineer - Stress Analyst
job.description:
Role: Lead Engineer - Stress Analyst

Location: Hyderabad

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced FEA & Electronics Cooling Simulation Engineer responsible for performing advanced structural, dynamic, explicit, and thermal simulations to support product design, optimization, validation, and troubleshooting.

The candidate should have strong fundamentals in finite element analysis and hands-on experience with linear and nonlinear structural analysis, vibration and dynamic analysis, drop/impact simulations, and electronics cooling/thermal analysis. The role will work closely with Design, Product, Testing, Manufacturing, and Systems Engineering teams to ensure designs meet structural, durability, thermal, and performance requirements.

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

Structural FEA

  • Perform linear static analysis to evaluate stress, strain, deformation, stiffness, and load paths.
  • Conduct nonlinear analysis, including: Material nonlinearity/plasticity Geometric nonlinearity/large deformation Contact and friction Bolt/fastener and joint behavior
  • Evaluate sheet-metal, cast, welded, bolted, and structural assemblies.
  • Perform design iterations and recommend structural improvements based on simulation results.
  • Support design optimization, weight reduction, material changes, and cost-reduction/VAVE projects.

##**

Dynamic & Vibration Analysis

Perform structural dynamic analyses including:

  • Modal analysis
  • Natural frequency and mode-shape evaluation
  • Harmonic response analysis
  • Random vibration/PSD analysis
  • Shock/transient response analysis
  • Frequency-response assessments
  • Evaluate resonance risks and recommend design modifications.
  • Support simulation-to-test correlation using vibration and modal test results.

Explicit, Drop & Impact Analysis

•Perform explicit nonlinear simulations for highly transient events.

•Develop simulation methodologies for: Drop tests Impact events Shock loading Component-to-component impact Large deformation Severe contact conditions

•Evaluate plastic deformation, acceleration, stress/strain, energy balance, contact forces, and structural integrity during impact events.

•Correlate simulation results with physical drop/impact testing where data is available.

Electronics Cooling & Thermal Analysis

  • Perform electronics cooling and thermal simulations for electronic components, enclosures, and systems.
  • Evaluate: Component/junction temperatures PCB thermal performance Heat sinks Fans and forced convection Natural convection Conduction paths Airflow distribution Pressure drop Hot spots and thermal bottlenecks
  • Assess thermal-management concepts and recommend improvements to cooling architecture.
  • Map thermal or pressure loads from CFD analysis into structural FEA models where required.
  • Perform thermal-structural analysis to evaluate deformation and stresses generated by temperature distributions.

Pre/Post-Processing & Modeling

  • Develop high-quality finite element models using 1D, 2D/shell, and 3D/solid elements as appropriate.
  • Define realistic boundary conditions, contacts, joints, connectors, fasteners, materials, and loading conditions.
  • Perform mesh-quality and mesh-convergence assessments.
  • Perform CFD-to-FEA load transfer, such as: Pressure mapping Temperature mapping Spatially varying load mapping
  • Review model assumptions and ensure that simulation methodologies appropriately represent actual product behavior.

Engineering Analysis & Validation

  • Interpret analysis results and translate them into actionable design recommendations, rather than simply reporting stresses or temperatures.
  • Identify potential structural and thermal weaknesses early in the product-development cycle.
  • Define analysis assumptions, acceptance criteria, margins, and limitations.
  • Support design reviews, DFMEA, validation planning, and root-cause investigations.
  • Develop engineering reports and presentations clearly documenting: Objective Methodology Assumptions Boundary conditions Results Conclusions Recommendations
  • Collaborate with test engineers to improve CAE-to-test correlation and update simulation methodologies based on test results.

Preferred CAE Tools

  • Hands-on experience with several of the following is preferred:
  • ANSYS Mechanical
  • ANSYS LS-DYNA / LS-DYNA
  • ANSYS Fluent / Icepak
  • Altair HyperMesh
  • Altair HyperView
  • OptiStruct / Radioss
  • SpaceClaim or equivalent CAD-preparation tools
  • Experience working with CAD platforms such as Creo, NX, or SolidWorks would be beneficial.

Requirements

  • Strong fundamentals in: Solid mechanics Strength of materials Finite element methods Structural dynamics Heat transfer Contact mechanics Material plasticity
  • Understanding of metallic and polymer material behavior.
  • Good understanding of static versus dynamic loading and implicit versus explicit solution methodologies.
  • Ability to assess FEA model quality and recognize unrealistic boundary conditions, contacts, mesh behavior, or solver results.
  • Ability to troubleshoot convergence problems in nonlinear simulations.
  • Knowledge of fatigue and durability assessment is desirable.
  • Experience with scripting/automation using Python, APDL, TCL, or similar tools is an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Applied Mechanics, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Relevant hands-on experience in structural/thermal CAE and product-development environments.
  • Experience supporting simulation-driven design decisions and physical validation is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Sound engineering judgment
  • Ability to independently develop appropriate FEA methodologies
  • Ability to distinguish modeling issues from actual design problems
  • Strong communication and technical presentation skills
  • Effective collaboration with Design, Testing, Systems, Manufacturing, and Product Engineering teams
  • Ability to manage multiple simulation activities and priorities

Benefits

We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and well being programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees’ health, security, and success.

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:

  • HVAC systems and precision cooling applications

The Executive – R&D will drive new product development (NPD) and life‑cycle management (LCM) for our wiring devices portfolio within the Legrand R&D division of IN‑Novateur Electrical & Digital Systems Pvt. Ltd.

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Maximizes external supplier performance through understanding our supply network.

What You Will Do

  • Serving as focal point for suppliers, following up on requirements to minimize past due schedules.
  • Focusing on inventory management to prevent excess material within the network.
  • Reviewing and acting on schedule releases and follow up for on-time shipments.
  • Working with global purchasing buyers and purchasing analyst on problem parts.

Degree Requirement

Degree or equivalent experience desired

What You Have

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
  • Productively balances speed and accuracy.
  • Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.
  • Employs techniques for motivating employees to meet or exceed accuracy goals.

Collaborating: Knowledge of collaborative techniques; ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Demonstrates experience engendering collaborative processes that lead to problem solving and the achievement of business goals.
  • Establishes shared goals to foster collaboration.
  • Ensures that everyone can access the same data and provide input into how business is conducted.
  • Redesigns physical areas to allow for collaboration and private time.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP): Knowledge of the process, issues and considerations for systematically managing distribution of inventory for multiple plants or warehouses; ability to apply related knowledge and experience in real practice.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Works with real-time inventory software, moving supplies to where needed, when needed.
  • Interprets the impact of bottlenecks and delays on operating costs.
  • Follows processes and applies technologies for items and inventory management.
  • Works with basic distribution requirements planning (DRP) processes and operations.

Logistics Management: Knowledge of logistics and management; ability to follow proper processes and run operations for effective and efficient movement of materials and finished products.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains how improvements in logistics contribute to competitive advantage in the marketplace.
  • Identifies issues and considerations for inbound and outbound logistics.
  • Documents internal and external informative sources or proprietary materials about logistics management.

Manufacturing Application Systems: Knowledge of company and industry databases and applications used in a manufacturing environment; ability to operate, maintain and update these systems.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains general flow of information throughout the manufacturing process and the supply chain.
  • Identifies major types of applications and information systems used in manufacturing.
  • Identifies core company, proprietary and public information sources.
  • Describes the type of information maintained in manufacturing application systems and identifies its primary uses and users.

Materials Handling and Management: Knowledge of material handling and management in plants; ability to perform, monitor and improve processes related to storage, transportation and handling of raw and hazardous materials.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies key issues involved with different types of manufacturing materials.
  • Discusses considerations for physical management of major types of materials.
  • Identifies types of materials used in manufacturing flagship products or components.

Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Facilitates supplier partnering arrangements that share risk and reward.
  • Monitors supplier performance; works to resolve discrepancies between performance and agreements.
  • Develops quality standards and controls for suppliers.
  • Builds and maintains partnerships with multiple and/or large suppliers.
  • Evaluates issues and terminates supplier relationships as appropriate; works with legal departments.
  • Ensures the fulfilment of report and record-keeping requirements.

Additional Info:

0-3 years of Supply chain or Logistics Experience

Willing to work in all shifts: US, UK, AP

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management (IAM) -Sr. IT Analyst Applications to join Infrastructure Services -CAT IT Division

The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Senior Analyst is responsible for executing and supporting enterprise IAM operations, governance activities, and access management processes. The role serves as a subject matter expert for identity lifecycle management, access governance, privileged access controls, and authentication technologies while ensuring compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements.

The Senior Analyst works closely with the IAM Lead, IAM Manager, application teams, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, efficient, and scalable access management services across the enterprise.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield PSN Office , Bangalore -KA

What you will do

Execute day-to-day Identity and Access Management activities including:

  • User provisioning and deprovisioning

  • Role assignments and access modifications
  • Privileged access administration

Identity Governance & Compliance

  • Support access certification campaigns and periodic access reviews.

  • Assist with Segregation of Duties (SoD) reviews and remediation activities.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing access control evidence and documentation.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory, compliance, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Identify control weaknesses and recommend process improvements.

Technical Administration & Support

  • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
  • Directory and federation services

  • Support system integrations, role-based access models, and workflow enhancements.
  • Participate in IAM system upgrades, testing, and implementation activities.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to improve access management processes and operational efficiency.
  • Assist in developing and implementing automation solutions to reduce manual effort.
  • Support IAM transformation and modernization initiatives.
  • Contribute to the development of operational procedures, knowledge articles, and training materials.
  • Participate in establishing and tracking IAM operational metrics and KPIs.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business units, HR, IT teams, application owners, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Provide guidance to end users regarding access management procedures and requirements.
  • Communicate operational issues, risks, and recommendations to IAM leadership.
  • Support access governance awareness and adoption across the organization.

What you will have

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Information Security, or Cybersecurity.

Strong knowledge of:

  • Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
  • User Lifecycle Management
  • Access Certifications and Reviews
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Segregation of Duties (SoD)
  • Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  • Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID
  • Single Sign-On (SSO)
  • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
  • Federation and Directory Services
  • Experience supporting IAM operations within enterprise environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications such as:

  • SC-300 (Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator)
  • Security+
  • CISM
  • CIAM
  • SailPoint or Saviynt certifications

Hands-on experience with:

  • SailPoint
  • Saviynt
  • CyberArk
  • Microsoft Entra ID
  • Okta
  • Ping Identity
  • BeyondTrust
  • Experience supporting audit, risk, and compliance initiatives.
  • Experience with IAM process automation and workflow development.
  • Experience in large global enterprise environments.

Skills desired:

Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
  • Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.

  • Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
  • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
  • Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
  • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
  • Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design). Level Working Knowledge:

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.

  • Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.

  • Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
  • Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
  • Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.

  • Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
  • Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management (IAM) Lead _Lead Technology Specialist to join Infrastructure Services -CAT IT Division

The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Lead is responsible for leading the daily execution of Identity and Access Management operations while providing technical guidance and operational oversight to a team of IAM analysts and engineers. This role serves as a subject matter expert across identity governance, access administration, privileged access management, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle processes.

The IAM Lead works closely with the IAM Manager, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to ensure secure, compliant, and efficient delivery of IAM services. The position combines technical expertise, team leadership, process governance, and continuous improvement responsibilities to support enterprise cybersecurity objectives

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield PSN Office, Bangalore -KA

What you will do

IAM Operations & Service Delivery

Lead day-to-day IAM operational activities including:

  • User provisioning and deprovisioning
  • Joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) processes
  • Access requests and approvals
  • Access certifications and periodic reviews
  • Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  • Identity lifecycle management
  • Authentication and authorization services
  • Monitor IAM service queues and ensure timely processing of requests in accordance with SLAs.
  • Manage escalation and resolution of IAM-related incidents and service issues.
  • Partner with application and infrastructure teams to troubleshoot access-related challenges.
  • Ensure compliance with established access management procedures and controls.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the technical lead and subject matter expert for IAM technologies, processes, and controls.
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to IAM analysts and engineers.
  • Review and validate complex access requests, role assignments, and privileged access activities.
  • Support IAM platform administration, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Assist in evaluating and implementing IAM enhancements, upgrades, and new technologies.
  • Drive standardization of IAM processes and operational procedures.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Support access governance activities including certification campaigns, segregation of duties reviews, and audit readiness.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and audit teams to address findings and remediation activities.
  • Ensure execution of IAM controls in accordance with security policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist in maintaining IAM documentation, procedures, standards, and control evidence.
  • Identify control gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen access governance.

Continuous Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual IAM processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Support IAM modernization initiatives and strategic projects.
  • Assist in developing workflows, role models, access governance processes, and reporting capabilities.
  • Participate in defining IAM operational metrics, dashboards, and service performance indicators.
  • Recommend process improvements that enhance security, user experience, and operational effectiveness.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as a primary point of contact for IAM operational activities and escalations.
  • Collaborate with business units, application owners, HR, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
  • Communicate issues, risks, and operational status to IAM leadership.
  • Support stakeholder education and adoption of IAM policies, standards, and best practices.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day direction and work prioritization for IAM analysts and engineers.
  • Assist the IAM Manager with workload planning and resource allocation.
  • Support onboarding, training, and development of team members.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and promote technical skill development.
  • Act as a backup to the IAM Manager when required.

What you will have

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity, or Information Security.
  • 6+ years of experience leading technical teams, projects, or IAM operational functions.

Strong understanding of:

  • Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
  • User Lifecycle Management
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Access Certifications and Reviews
  • Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  • Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID
  • Single Sign-On (SSO)
  • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
  • Federation Services
  • Directory Services and Authentication Technologies
  • Experience supporting IAM operations in large enterprise environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.
  • Shift Timing:01:00-10:00PM IST

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry certifications such as Security+, SC-300, CISSP, CISM, CIAM, or other IAM-related certifications.

Hands-on experience with:

  • SailPoint
  • Saviynt
  • CyberArk
  • Microsoft Entra ID
  • Okta
  • Ping Identity
  • BeyondTrust or other PAM solutions
  • Experience with IAM automation, workflow development, and integration technologies.
  • Experience supporting audit and regulatory compliance initiatives.
  • Experience working within Agile and product-oriented operating models.
  • Experience supporting global enterprises and geographically distributed teams.

Skills desired:

Job Description

We do not just talk about progress and innovation, we make it happen with our customers and in the communities where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Senior IT Analyst Applications – Engineering Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst to join our Solar IT Solutions – ERP Team, Caterpillar IT Division, Bangalore.

The incumbent will bring strong functional expertise in Baan / Infor LN, Engineering processes, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), engineering master data and Global Trade Compliance (GTC). This role will serve as a key bridge between Engineering, Global Trade Compliance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics and IT teams, ensuring engineering product data and ERP processes effectively support global trade compliance requirements.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Baan / Infor LN engineering and manufacturing processes, including Item Master, Package Bill of Materials (BoM), Multi-Site BoM, Engineering Change Management, Windchill/PLM integration and Engineering Release-to-Production, combined with working knowledge of Global Trade Compliance requirements such as product classification, export control classification, HS/HTS codes, country of origin and trade-related product attributes.

The role requires the ability to understand how engineering decisions and product-data changes impact downstream trade compliance processes, translate regulatory and business requirements into functional ERP solutions, and drive accurate, controlled and scalable product-data processes across global operations.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore PSN Office, Karnataka, India.

What You Will Do

Engineering & Global Trade Compliance Process Expertise

  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of end-to-end Engineering-to-Global Trade Compliance processes across Baan / Infor LN and connected enterprise applications.
  • Analyse engineering product structures, item attributes and master-data dependencies that influence trade compliance processes.
  • Work with Engineering and Global Trade Compliance stakeholders to understand requirements related to: Product and commodity classification HS / HTS classification Export control classification Country of origin Trade-related engineering attributes Product structures and Bills of Materials Engineering changes Product release and lifecycle processes
  • Identify how engineering changes to products, components, materials or product structures may affect downstream compliance data and processes.
  • Define opportunities to strengthen integration, data accuracy, traceability and process standardisation between Engineering, ERP and Global Trade Compliance.

Baan / Infor LN Functional Expertise

  • Provide strong functional business-analysis expertise across Baan / Infor LN Engineering and Manufacturing processes.
  • Understand and analyse the configuration and use of: Item Master Engineering Items Engineering Bills of Material Production Bills of Material Package BoMs Multi-Site BoMs Item and Engineering attributes Engineering Change processes Routings and manufacturing structures Product release processes
  • Analyse the impact of Baan / Infor LN master-data and transactional changes on Global Trade Compliance processes.
  • Translate Engineering and Trade Compliance requirements into functional requirements and solution designs.
  • Partner with Baan / Infor LN technical teams, architects and integration teams to deliver scalable solutions.

Engineering Master Data & Trade Compliance

  • Support the definition, governance and maintenance of engineering master data required for Global Trade Compliance.
  • Analyse product, item and component data required to support trade classification and regulatory processes.
  • Work with relevant business subject-matter experts to define data requirements for areas including: HS / HTS codes Export classification Country of origin Item descriptions Product attributes Material and component information Engineering identifiers Product structures and BOMs
  • Identify gaps or inconsistencies between Engineering, ERP and Trade Compliance data.
  • Define business rules, data validation requirements and exception-handling processes.
  • Support data-quality, cleansing, conversion and migration activities associated with ERP and trade-compliance initiatives.

PLM, Windchill & ERP Integration

  • Collaborate with Engineering teams to support Windchill / PLM to Baan / Infor LN integration and Product Data Management processes.
  • Analyse Engineering Release-to-Production processes and their impact on Global Trade Compliance data.
  • Define integration requirements for engineering items, product structures, BOMs, classifications and associated product attributes.
  • Partner with technical teams to define interfaces and data flows between PLM, Baan / Infor LN, Global Trade Compliance solutions and other enterprise applications.
  • Support end-to-end business-process and integration testing.
  • Facilitate consistent product information and appropriate traceability across integrated applications.

Requirements Gathering & Business Analysis

  • Facilitate workshops with Engineering, Global Trade Compliance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and IT stakeholders.
  • Capture and document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes.
  • Gather, analyse, document and validate functional and business requirements.
  • Translate requirements into: Business Requirements Documents Functional specifications Process flows User stories Business rules Data mappings Acceptance criteria
  • Perform fit-gap and impact assessments between business requirements and existing Baan / Infor LN capabilities.
  • Identify cross-functional dependencies, risks and downstream impacts.
  • Maintain requirements traceability from design through testing and deployment.

Engineering Change & Compliance Impact Analysis

  • Evaluate how Engineering Change Requests, Engineering Change Orders and product revisions affect trade-compliance information.
  • Identify downstream impacts of item, material, BOM and engineering attribute changes.
  • Partner with Engineering and Global Trade Compliance stakeholders to define appropriate compliance review points within engineering processes.
  • Define business requirements for workflow, notifications, data validations and exceptions.
  • Support traceability between engineering changes and associated product/trade information.

Testing, Validation & Deployment

  • Support functional design reviews, configuration validation and solution testing.
  • Develop end-to-end test scenarios covering Engineering, ERP, PLM and Global Trade Compliance processes.
  • Support: Functional Testing System Integration Testing (SIT) User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Regression Testing End-to-End Process Testing
  • Validate engineering master-data flows and trade-compliance-related product information.
  • Coordinate defect analysis, prioritisation and resolution.
  • Support deployment readiness, cutover, production validation and post-go-live stabilisation.

Change Management & User Enablement

  • Support organisational change activities associated with Engineering and Global Trade Compliance transformation initiatives.
  • Develop functional documentation, process flows, standard operating procedures and training materials.
  • Conduct knowledge-transfer and end-user training sessions.
  • Support adoption of new Baan / Infor LN and Global Trade Compliance processes.
  • Help establish sustainable support processes and knowledge documentation.

Continuous Improvement

  • Analyse Engineering, ERP and Global Trade Compliance processes to identify optimisation opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to automate data validation and reduce manual intervention.
  • Recommend improvements to product-data governance, integration and compliance-related workflows.
  • Analyse recurring data and system issues and support root-cause resolution.
  • Drive standardisation of Engineering-to-Trade Compliance processes across global operations.

What You Will Have

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst or ERP Consultant supporting Baan / Infor LN, Engineering, PLM, Global Trade Compliance, Manufacturing or Supply Chain solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Strong functional experience with Baan and/or Infor LN.
  • Strong understanding of engineering master data, Item Master, BOM structures and Engineering Change Management.
  • Experience supporting PLM/ERP integration and Engineering Release-to-Production processes.
  • Experience supporting ERP implementation, enhancement or business-transformation programmes within a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience gathering complex requirements and translating them into functional ERP solutions.
  • Strong understanding of engineering data dependencies across Manufacturing, Supply Chain and downstream enterprise processes.
  • Strong analytical, communication and cross-functional stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Global Trade Compliance processes in an engineering or manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of HS/HTS classification, export-control classification and country-of-origin processes.
  • Experience with Windchill or comparable PLM platforms.
  • Experience with integration between PLM, Baan / Infor LN and Global Trade Compliance applications.
  • Experience supporting multi-site or global manufacturing ERP environments.
  • Experience with engineering master-data governance and process standardisation.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:
