job.title: Finance Manager (Sales Operations)
job.description:
Job Description

As the Sales Operations Manager, you will serve as the key driver behind sales efficiency, performance visibility, and operational excellence. You will partner closely with finance and commercial leadership to define sales targets, manage territory and quota allocations, optimize sales tech stack usage, and deliver actionable forecasting and reporting. This role bridges the gap between finance, sales strategy, execution, and analytical insight to maximize revenue growth.

1. Sales Planning & Target Setting

  • Strategic Target Setting: Partner with executive leadership to define, refine, and cascade sales targets aligned with broader corporate revenue goals.
  • Quota & Territory Management: Lead the annual quota setting process and territory allocation, ensuring fair and optimized coverage across sales tiers.
  • Commission & Incentive Structure: Collaborate with HR/Finance to design, implement, and administer competitive sales incentive plans (SIP) and commission payouts.

2. Performance Monitoring & Analytics

  • Performance Tracking: Monitor individual, team, and overall business metrics monthly, identifying pipeline bottlenecks and conversion gaps.
  • Sales Productivity Analysis: Track KPI trends—such as win/loss rates, deal velocity, average deal size, and churn—to recommend actionable performance improvements.

3. Reporting, Forecasting & Business Intelligence

  • Forecasting & Cadence: Drive weekly/monthly sales forecasting models and cadence calls with sales leadership to ensure high predictability between actuals vs. targets.
  • Dashboard Management: Build, maintain, and automate real-time executive dashboards and performance reports for both leadership and frontline reps.
  • Ad-hoc Analytics: Provide commercial insights and custom reporting to support strategic decision-making and board meetings.

4. Process Optimization & Systems Enablement

  • CRM & Tech Stack Ownership: Act as the primary administrator and advocate for the CRM and sales enablement tools; ensure data hygiene and team adoption.
  • Process Enhancement: Standardise, streamline, and document sales workflows (e.g., lead routing, approval matrix, deal desk operations) to reduce friction in the sales cycle.
  • Enablement Support: Partner with marketing and enablement teams to ensure reps are equipped with optimal tools, collateral, and system onboarding.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 3–6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or Commercial Analysis.
  • Technical Skills:

Advanced CRM expertise

  • Data & Reporting: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; proficiency in BI tools is highly regarded.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong business acumen and financial modeling capabilities.
  • Exceptional cross-functional stakeholder management (Sales, Finance, Marketing, HR).
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a process-improvement mindset.

job.title: Senior Director, Site Engineering
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Global Site Engineering Leader reporting to our VP Design and Engineering, Senior Director, (based onsite in Sydney), you will work closely with our Design and Development Teams, making an impact in several ways:

  • Lead a global team of AirTrunk’s onsite engineering during detailed design development and construction phases, through to commissioning readiness including technical coordination across CSA, MEP and Owner Supplied Equipment (OSE) and translation of design into successful site implementation.
  • Drive global consistency of construction execution, adherence to schedule, safety and quality standards (QA/QC) across all AirTrunk markets.
  • Collaborate and align with Design Management team around design intent and customer requirements and coordinate contractor designers and specialist engineers during detailed design and construction.
  • Collaborate with Operations Team in global standards for commissioning
  • Champion global standard frameworks to ensure design deliverables are coordinated, buildable, and aligned with AirTrunk standards and product requirements.
  • Drive engineering alignment between design teams, construction teams and commissioning teams.
  • Drive pre-commissioning planning and systems readiness by ensuring design, construction, testing and documentation requirements are clearly defined and integrated into the delivery programme.
  • Establish clear readiness expectations for energisation, start-up and commissioning, including system completion, safe access, controls readiness, vendor attendance and supporting documentation.
  • Drive global consistency process for review and guidance of handover strategy and documentation to Operations team in preparation for systems commissioning including test results, certificates, O&M manuals, training records and asset data,.
  • Establish a global framework where design, construction and operations lessons are learned and fed back to continuously improve AirTrunk’s design and delivery
  • Report on project status and risk to executive

Your Day to Day

  • Build, lead and mentor high performing team of site-based engineers supporting the construction delivery team tasked with the following.

Review and manage RFIs, technical submittals and engineering

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary pre-commissioning readiness reviews covering installation completion, quality records, access, temporary works, permits, energisation prerequisites and outstanding
  • Work with construction, commissioning, controls and vendor teams to define system boundaries, testing sequences, dependencies and turnover priorities.
  • Verify that required design information, approved submittals, inspection records, test packs, operating procedures and as-built documentation are available before systems are released for commissioning.
  • Track and drive closure of engineering and construction issues that may prevent safe energisation, equipment start-up, functional testing or integrated systems testing.
  • Work closely with General Contractors and trade partners to resolve technical challenges and construction interface issues.
  • Facilitate engineering workshops and BIM coordination meetings to ensure clash resolution and design integration.
  • Identify constructability risks early and implement engineering solutions to maintain schedule and quality.

Facilitate and collaborate coordination across internal stakeholders including but not limited to Design innovation, Design Management, Project Directors, Cost, Development and Operations teams. Travel regionally as needed to manage and conduct regular site inspections and engineering reviews of CSA, MEP and OSE installations.

Requirements

  • 20+ years engineering experience in large-scale infrastructure, hyperscale data centres, mission critical facilities or similar environments.
  • Strong site-based engineering experience within design and construct project
  • Proven experience managing design during construction phases on large complex
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex engineering and construction interface
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering (preferred).
  • Experience coordinating CSA, MEP and specialist systems
  • Demonstrated experience in pre-commissioning, systems completion, energisation readiness, equipment start-up and turnover of mission critical systems.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning prerequisites, system boundaries, test documentation, controls integration, vendor requirements and readiness gate
  • Familiarity with BIM-based coordination and design management tools (Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Procore or similar).
  • Strong ability to lead technical discussions with contractors, consultants and internal
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced project environments where engineering decisions directly impact delivery outcomes.

The AirTrunk Culture

job.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
The role

As a Staff SRE, you will be a technical contributor on the Digital Interconnection SRE team. You will perform DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering by setting reliability standards, lead complex designs and incident response for the applications and the infrastructure it runs on. You will work with product engineering, platform infrastructure and operations teams to make our services dependable, self-service and easy to observe.

What you will do

  • Define and run SLOs, SLIs and error budgets, and drive reliability improvements from the data.
  • Lead incident response for P0/P1 events, run blameless post-incident reviews, and follow up on corrective actions.
  • Design, build and operate Kubernetes platforms on AWS and on bare metal servers, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades and capacity planning.
  • Build and improve CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (GitHub Actions, Argo CD) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Extend our observability stack (Grafana Cloud, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo) from services down to the hardware layer.
  • Automate repetitive operational work, including with AI-assisted tooling such as our SRE Bot and MCP servers.
  • Lead production readiness reviews, resilience and chaos testing, and disaster recovery exercises.
  • Partner on security and compliance practices such as secrets management (Vault), image and dependency scanning, and identity and access.
  • Support and guide developers and contribute to the team’s technical direction.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in SRE, DevOps or infrastructure engineering, with demonstrated technical leadership.
  • Deep, hands-on Kubernetes experience in production, including cluster operations, networking and troubleshooting.
  • Strong coding or scripting skills in at least one of Python, Go or Java, plus Bash.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and GitOps (for example Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, Argo CD).
  • Strong observability skills: metrics, logs and traces, SLO-based alerting, and dashboards.
  • Experience running 24×7 production services, including on-call and incident command.
  • Solid grounding in Linux, networking (L2/L3, load balancing, service mesh) and cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working across time zones.

Nice to have

  • Istio or another service mesh, Rancher, kube-vip or similar HA tooling.
  • Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites.
  • Experience with Kafka, Cassandra, Temporal, Postgres or AuroraDB.
  • Chaos engineering experience and multi-region or active-active designs.
  • Experience applying AI or LLM tooling to operations and incident triage.

Why join us

  • Work on infrastructure and applications that underpins global digital interconnection.
  • Own meaningful technical problems, from bare metal to the various distributed systems involved that manage the application layer.
  • Join a collaborative, global team that values blameless learning, automation and clear communication.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, and room to grow.

job.title: Principal Product Manager - Conversational AI - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad influence across the company. You will own the product strategy for Equinix's conversational AI and assistant platforms — chat, voice, and agentic interfaces that employees, customers, and partners interact with directly. You will work closely with engineering and architecture teams on technical decisions while also helping executives understand business implications, investment choices, and risk.

You will serve as a conversational AI product leader across Go to Market, Operations, Product, and Corporate functions. Depending on the initiative, you may advise business leaders, partner with product and engineering teams, or directly lead product strategy and delivery for conversational experiences and the platform capabilities that power them.

The conversational AI market is changing quickly — from single-turn chatbots to multi-agent, tool-using assistants. An important part of this role is evaluating new conversational AI technologies, identifying which capabilities are relevant to Equinix, and translating them into practical product and platform investment decisions.

Responsibilities

Conversational AI, Cloud, and Data Architecture

  • Bring strong working knowledge of conversational AI, dialogue systems, agent orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise data architecture to product and platform decisions
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate large language model architectures, conversational agent design patterns (orchestrator/worker, multi-agent handoff, tool calling), cloud deployment approaches, and enterprise data pipelines
  • Participate meaningfully in technical and architecture reviews, as well as product and roadmap discussions for the conversational platform
  • Translate technical choices, constraints, and risks into clear business implications that leaders can understand and act on
  • Help ensure conversational AI products are designed for enterprise scale, security, reliability, multi-channel support (chat, voice, embedded assistants), and reuse across business functions

Conversation Design, Model Strategy, and Deployment

  • Guide decisions on prompt design, retrieval augmented generation, conversation flow and dialogue management, model customization, fine tuning, and model selection for conversational use cases
  • Help teams determine when a smaller model may provide better latency, cost, or control for real-time conversational interactions than a larger model
  • Partner with AI and machine learning engineering teams on deployment approaches for conversational agents across cloud, private infrastructure, and low-latency environments
  • Evaluate emerging approaches such as multi-agent coordination, model routing, tool/function calling, memory and context management, and hybrid model deployment for conversational systems
  • Use conversation quality metrics, containment and escalation rates, model performance data, evaluation results, user feedback, and business outcomes to guide product priorities

Platform Reliability and Responsible AI

  • Define product requirements for conversational AI system reliability, availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and incident response
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve visibility into conversational agent behavior, model performance, cost, conversation logs, and production issues
  • Establish requirements that support traceability, explainability, auditability, fairness, privacy, and regulatory compliance across conversational interactions
  • Work with Legal, Security, Privacy, and AI Governance teams to incorporate company policies and responsible AI requirements into conversational products and platforms, including data handling within chat, voice, and memory features
  • Partner with Design to create clear conversational UX that explains how AI is being used, manages user expectations, and provides appropriate review, control, hand-off to a human, and approval within the conversation itself

Product Decisions and Risk Management

  • Lead decisions involving tradeoffs among business value, delivery speed, technical complexity, cost, performance, and risk for conversational AI features
  • Establish clear and repeatable methods for evaluating major conversational AI product and architecture decisions
  • Help teams identify risks early — including hallucination, unintended actions, and improper data exposure in conversational contexts — and determine the appropriate level of governance and human oversight
  • Balance the need to deliver conversational value quickly with the requirements of security, reliability, and responsible AI

Executive and Cross Functional Leadership

  • Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Legal, Information Security, Data, Design, and business functions on the conversational AI roadmap
  • Influence decisions through expertise, clear reasoning, and strong working relationships rather than direct authority
  • Explain complex technical topics in clear language that is relevant to both technical and business audiences
  • Work with senior leaders to connect conversational AI investments to business priorities, customer value, productivity, and operational outcomes
  • Develop trusted relationships so that teams engage early when evaluating important conversational AI opportunities or decisions

Qualifications

  • Master's degree or doctorate in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or a related field
  • Experience working with models and platforms from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or the open source community, including agent frameworks and orchestration tooling
  • Experience with machine learning operations, model evaluation, AI monitoring, or conversational AI observability tools
  • Experience defining service requirements for conversational AI systems, including availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and operational support
  • Knowledge of responsible AI practices, including explainability, model documentation, evaluation, audit processes, governance, and policy implementation for conversational systems
  • Experience working with research, engineering, or innovation teams to bring conversational AI capabilities into production
  • Experience designing conversational AI user experiences that support transparency, consent, user review, and appropriate human control (e.g., escalation to a live agent)
  • Experience in data centers, cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, or enterprise technology
  • Experience building AI assistants, chatbots, voice agents, or AI-enabled conversational workflows at enterprise scale
  • Experience with business software, enterprise platforms, or products designed for developers

job.title: Vice President, Investment
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

The Vice President, Investments will play a key role within the Real Estate Investments team, responsible for originating, evaluating, underwriting, structuring and executing real estate investments and divestments across target markets and sectors.

The role will lead transactions across the full investment lifecycle, from opportunity identification and investment underwriting through due diligence, investment approval, negotiation, documentation and completion.

The successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate strong investment judgement, commercial acumen and transaction execution capabilities, with the ability to develop and articulate a clear investment thesis, critically assess key risks and return drivers, and make well-reasoned investment recommendations.

The role will contribute towards delivering attractive risk-adjusted returns in accordance with the relevant investment mandates and strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Investment Origination & Evaluation

  • Originate, evaluate and execute real estate investment opportunities in line with the relevant fund and investment strategies.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with external parties to generate investment opportunities and proprietary market insights.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of real estate markets, capital markets, sector trends and investment themes, and identify opportunities arising from changes in market fundamentals, capital flows and industry dynamics.
  • Develop clear investment theses, including the identification of key return drivers, value creation opportunities, downside risks and appropriate mitigants.

Underwriting & Investment Analysis

  • Lead the financial and commercial evaluation of investment opportunities, including financial modelling, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis, capital structure, financing assumptions, business plans and exit strategies.
  • Critically evaluate underwriting assumptions and assess the resilience of investment returns under different market and operating scenarios.
  • Apply sound investment judgement to identify the critical factors that determine investment outcomes, going beyond financial modelling to form independent and well-supported investment views.
  • Prepare and present investment recommendations and approval papers to senior management and the relevant investment committees.

Transaction Execution

  • Lead and project-manage investment and divestment processes
  • Coordinate commercial, financial, legal, tax, technical and other due diligence workstreams, working closely with internal stakeholders and external advisers.
  • Lead commercial negotiations and transaction execution, including transaction structuring, financing, documentation and completion.
  • Identify material transaction risks and work with relevant internal and external stakeholders to develop appropriate commercial, structural and contractual mitigants.

Portfolio & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Asset Management and Fund Management teams to ensure alignment between investment underwriting, asset-level business plans and fund objectives.
  • Provide an investment perspective on strategic asset and portfolio initiatives, including major capital expenditure, refinancing, recapitalisation, asset repositioning and divestments.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide guidance, coaching and mentorship to junior members of the Investments team.
  • Foster a collaborative, intellectually rigorous investment culture that encourages constructive challenge, independent thinking and disciplined decision-making.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Possess Degree in Business, Economics, Accountancy, Real Estate, Finance or equivalent.
  • Minimum 8-10 years’ experience of relevant working experience. Experience in real estate private equity investments will be an added advantage.
  • Ability to form independent investment views, challenge assumptions and exercise sound commercial and investment judgement.
  • The ability to make effective investment decisions.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills with strong presentation abilities.
  • Self-motivated team player who is meticulous, detailed oriented, organized and able to learn quickly, independently with strong analytical skills.
  • Proficient in financial modelling, market and industry research in real estate or other private equity assets.
  • Strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills.
  • Possesses strong interpersonal skills and able to interact effectively across different functions and levels.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Willing to travel frequently to key markets.

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Real Estate

PLATFORM

Investment

Process Improvement:

job.title: Assistant Manager
job.description:
OT Cybersecurity Executive

Operational Technology (OT) Security:

Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures to protect OT systems, including industrial control systems (ICS) and SCADA networks.

Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on OT systems to identify security weaknesses and recommend improvements.

Monitor OT networks and systems for signs of security breaches or anomalies, ensuring timely identification and mitigation of threats.

Collaborate with OT engineering teams to ensure secure integration of OT systems with IT infrastructure while preserving operational continuity.

Incident Response and Management:

Respond to OT cybersecurity incidents, coordinating efforts to mitigate, resolve, and document security breaches or disruptions in OT systems.

Investigate and perform root-cause analysis for OT-related cybersecurity incidents, ensuring quick recovery and restoration of services.

Develop and implement incident response protocols specifically tailored to OT environments, including communication plans, reporting mechanisms, and escalation procedures.

Collaboration with IT and OT Teams:

Work closely with IT cybersecurity teams to ensure coordination between IT and OT environments and mitigate the risk of cross-domain security breaches.

Collaborate with OT engineers, operations teams, and vendors to implement security controls that do not interfere with the operation of critical systems.

Promote awareness of cybersecurity best practices and provide guidance on securing OT systems.

Vulnerability Management:

Monitor and assess the security vulnerabilities of OT systems and coordinate patching, remediation, and mitigation efforts in line with operational needs.

Conduct risk-based prioritization of vulnerabilities within OT systems, considering the potential impact on operational continuity and safety.

Security Monitoring and Threat Intelligence:

Continuously monitor OT systems and networks for any unusual activities, security breaches, or threats using appropriate tools and techniques.

Leverage threat intelligence platforms to stay informed about the latest cyber threats targeting OT environments and recommend proactive defense measures.

Perform regular updates to OT security monitoring systems and tools to detect emerging threats.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

OT Cybersecurity Manager / Head of Cybersecurity

IT and Network Operations Teams

Engineering & Development Teams

Human Resources (HR)

Key Stakeholders - External

OT equipment and software vendors

Third-party cybersecurity service providers

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.

Certification:

Relevant certifications such Global Industrial Cyber Security Practical experience with securing industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA systems, and other OT assets and with OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, NERC CIP).

Knowledge of OT network protocols and systems, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and others commonly used in industrial environments and with security tools and technologies used in OT environments (e.g., intrusion detection systems, firewalls, SIEM).

Work Experience (Range of years):

3+ years of overall experience , with at least 1 year focused on OT or industrial control systems security.

job.title: Senior Associate Engineer, Project Delivery
job.description:

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has more than US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

We are seeking a Senior Associate Engineer, Project Delivery who will oversee the on-site construction activities related to design coordination, schedule management, quality assurance, EHS, testing, commissioning & IST activities for all mechanical equipment’s (mainly HVAC/ services and related controls for an large capacity green field data centre along with HSD , FPS & PHE system

This role will be based at site in Navi Mumbai.

Key responsibilities

  • Be a site SPOC for installation of HVAC, Chilled water piping. AHU, TFA, CRAH & CRAC, Cooling towers & associated mechanical infrastructure in coordination with respective stakeholders. Oversee HSD , FPS & PHE system.
  • Be a technical bridge between design/ consultants and contractors / vendors.
  • Review & guide contractors on schedule, sequence of construction, resource deployment etc.
  • Ensure effective coordination between various MEP contractors / vendors to avoid errors & reworks. Coordinate with electrical, BMS , ELV & civil teams to resolve interface issues.
  • Oversee and guide mechanical contractors / vendors on ensuring high quality of installations. Monitor contractor progress and prepare daily/weekly progress reports.
  • Review and provide feedback on mockups, samples, work/ method statement. Manage material deliveries, material inspection & storage at site in coordination with GC & QC team.
  • Review safety plans, work permits, and risk mitigation plans for mechanical equipment installations.
  • Assist in snagging, snag closure & handover documents
  • Review testing & commissioning results and certify for compliance.
  • Certify running bills, installation compliance to defined quality standards.
  • Travel (including out of country) for witnessing equipment factory tests and other business needs.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • Mechanical Engineering/ Diploma graduate with Minimum 8 years of onsite experience in installation, testing, commission of mechanical equipment & services with specific focus on large capacity chillers, cooling towers, AHU, Generators, piping, fire hydrant, fuel storage /distribution system, CPM, fuel automation for large data center, telecom, IT campus, industrial projects.
  • Minimum of 5 years of onsite experience in overseeing HVAC and Mechanical (HSD, Fire & PHE) activities for a data center is essential.
  • Good knowledge on the latest requirements data center / hyperscale standards is essential. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
  • Good spoken & written communications skills are essential.
  • Have good interpersonal skills with ability to engage with various stakeholders.
  • HVAC course by ASHRAE or equivalent is desirable. Proficiency in ACC Autodesk & MS Office.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, data analysis, reporting, dashboards)

job.description:
AUS | Port Melbourne | Unit H, 437-461 Plummer Street

AUS | Moorebank | Area 1A & 1B, 1 Moorebank Avenue

Full time

J0109241

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Iron Mountain is seeking a seasoned Strategic Large Deal Seller to lead and architect our highest-value enterprise transactions across Australia.

This is not a traditional cold-outbound hunting role. Instead, you will act as a consultative deal architect and pursuit leader, partnering directly with our frontline enterprise sellers once high-potential opportunities are identified. Stepping in at the critical qualification and strategy phase, you will marshal multidisciplinary teams, craft compelling financial business cases for C-level executives, and guide complex, multi-service pursuits across the line.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Complex Pursuits: Take the lead on qualified, high-value enterprise pursuits introduced by account teams. Apply disciplined qualification frameworks (such as MEDDICC) to establish win strategies, deal governance, and structured closing roadmaps.
  • Co-Sell & Orchestrate Teams: Partner shoulder-to-shoulder with frontline sellers while directing internal matrix teams including solution architects, pricing analysts, delivery leads, and legal counsel to shape unified enterprise propositions.
  • Build Executive Business Cases: Facilitate deep-dive discovery to uncover customer operational pain points, quantify total cost of ownership (TCO), and build ROI models that satisfy CFOs, CIOs, and Chief Risk Officers.
  • Structure Innovative Commercials: Design creative commercial pricing structures that balance customer affordability with long-term profitability, managing the economics of transitioning physical records estates into digital and automated environments.
  • Drive Commercial Closure: Lead commercial and contract negotiations under tight execution windows, securing operational buy-in and ensuring smooth handovers to delivery and client success teams.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of enterprise deal leadership across B2B technology services, Tier-2 managed service providers (MSPs), systems integrators, or strategic consulting.
  • Proven track record shaping, negotiating, and closing multi-million-dollar, multi-service enterprise transactions ($3M–$10M+ TCV).
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, with hands-on capability in pricing mechanics, margin structuring, and TCO/ROI business modeling.
  • Methodology expertise in MEDDICC or formal opportunity qualification frameworks.
  • Exceptional matrix leadership and EQ, with a natural ability to collaborate seamlessly with existing account owners and navigate complex enterprise procurement committees.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Business, Commerce, Law, Information Technology, or a related discipline are highly regarded.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Total Rewards: Attractive base salary, uncapped incentive/commission structure, and superannuation.
  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Hybrid working model balancing client engagement, site visits, and remote/home flexibility.
  • Continuous Growth & Development: Access to global enterprise sales frameworks, structured leadership pathways, and continuous professional learning opportunities.
  • Global Brand & Impact: The opportunity to represent an S&P 500 global leader and shape the growth of our dedicated Resources portfolio across Western Australia.
  • Employee Wellbeing & Support: Access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program (EAP), corporate wellness initiatives, and paid parental leave policies.

Category: Sales

Iron Mountain is a global leader in storage and information management services trusted by more than 225,000 organizations in 60 countries. We safeguard billions of our customers’ assets, including critical business information, highly sensitive data, and invaluable cultural and historic artifacts. Take a look at our history here.

job.description:

Responsibilities

  • Boost revenue and increase product adoption through achieving clients' objectives that are aligned with company priorities
  • Provide dedicated account management to advertisers
  • Become proficient in Meta's solutions tailored for businesses of all sizes and swiftly adapt recommendations to meet advertiser requirements
  • Develop and execute strategic plans to drive transformational advertiser growth with operational rigour

job.title: Product Quality Engineer, Hardware Infrastructure
job.description:
Meta is seeking a Product Quality Engineer responsible for developing and implementing robust manufacturing and quality processes for the next generation of disruptive AI hardware products. As the technical owner, you will take primary responsibility for specifying manufacturing and test requirements for Advanced Compute, Accelerator and GPU platforms. You will oversee end-to-end manufacturing readiness for New Product Introduction (NPI), guiding projects from prototype phase through to high-volume Mass Production (MP) launch. Working closely with external manufacturing partners and internal cross-functional groups like Design Engineering, you will define standards to ensure line readiness, facilitate smooth NPI builds, and enable scalable execution. Furthermore, you will hold responsibility for meeting core manufacturing metrics, conducting failure analysis, and executing corrective actions to maintain high efficiency and quality. This is a full time position and reports to the Manager of Product and Quality Engineering as part of the Hardware Quality Engineering team.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement manufacturing processes for Meta open compute hardware technologies by applying knowledge of product design, fabrication, assembly and testing
  • Ensure product and process quality targets are met by designing test methods, establishing standards and driving continuous improvement projects with Meta manufacturing partners and key commodity suppliers
  • Spearhead cross-functional troubleshooting across rack and system-level hardware, maintaining ownership of the Major Issue List. Execute rigorous Failure Analysis and Corrective Actions (FACA) to solve underlying technical problems and achieve quality yield goals
  • Early engagement with Meta Engineering teams to implement robust DFx requirements and ensure products meet cycle-time, cost, quality and yield targets
  • Drive the continuous evaluation and advancement of test coverage, methodologies, and infrastructure to maximize hardware reliability, performance, and scalability across the product lifecycle
  • Conduct First Article and Source Inspections reviews on Meta hardware components and assemblies
  • Create BOMs, engineering change notifications, and manufacturing process changes through product lifecycle management tools

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical, Mechanical, Material Science or equivalent
  • 10+ years of experience in manufacturing and test for Compute, Storage or Network Hardware products
  • Deep technical understanding of hardware architecture, with proven expertise in defining requirements, testing, and validating high-performance compute and GPU systems
  • Experience with manufacturing test solutions for Server & Storage hardware products
  • Experience with new product introduction and manufacturing operations
  • Knowledge of quality methodologies and tools
  • Problem solving and communication skills
  • Ability to travel internationally as required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Scripting skills in Bash, Perl, or Python
  • Knowledge of Server & Storage Hardware technologies, experience on HW AI products

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Senior Associate Specialist - Mechanical
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Associate Specialist Mechanical Engineer is a developing subject matter expert, accountable for supporting the design and construction of complex and mission critical data centers.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Contributes to solutions for mechanical problems that arise in design and operation of mission critical systems. Works with cross-functional teams to support operational objectives in mission critical systems. Contribute to troubleshooting problems and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective Action (CA) for problems affecting system performance and efficiency

  • Contribute to design and documentation, including but not limited to supporting construction drawings and commissioning test scripts.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in mechanical engineering.
  • Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:
  • Some knowledge of mechanical equipment including Air Cooled Chillers, Pumps, Water Treatment Systems, HVAC equipment, Computer Room AC Units (CRACs), Operating Building Management and Industrial PLC Control Systems, Air handling equipment, Valves, Piping, Ductwork, Storm and sanitary drains, industrial and domestic water.
  • Understanding of and familiarity with energy calculations.
  • Understanding of fluid flow and heat transfer calculations including approach temperature, small temperature difference, sensible load, latent load, NPSH, pump and fan affinity laws, pressure loss, fan and pump heat, kW/Ton, EER, IPLV, and the like.
  • Some knowledge of psychrometric calculations and develop system state points and processes including use of wet bulb temperature, dewpoint temperature, dry bulb temperature, and enthalpy.
  • Familiar with control methods and hardware including signal types, data communication protocols for Building Automation and Control networks, actuator types, failure modes, Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), and control tuning methods.
  • Knowledge of relevant building codes, standards and regulations including California Title 24, ASHRAE, ASME, Life Safety, IBC, NFPA and OSHA.

Operating engineering experience with large mechanical systems

  • Strong team player with good interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work efficiently, with good team orientation.
  • Ability to work in process-driven, high criticality environment.
  • Ability to demonstrate computing skills that show complex data trending/tracking and analysis.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or similar field required.
  • Professional Engineering certification required.
  • Required Experience:

Moderate level of experience, preferably in a data centre environment or critical environment (hospital, power plant, etc.) Experience with large scale technical operations Experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modelling Familiarity regarding ASHRAE TC 9.9 publications including PUE, ASHRAE Recommended Temperature and Humidity Limits, Data Centre Controls, Containment, etc. Proficient in MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, Outlook, and MS Project.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Production Associate - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

Operates machines and production equipment independently in accordance with quality and productivity requirements safely in a manufacturing environment and may instruct or coach others.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards.
  • Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment.
  • Promote interdependence by looking out for one another.
  • Correct hazards within your control and capabilities.
  • Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact.
  • Engage in HSE Training.

Quality

  • Follows all applicable standard work, process documentation and quality procedures such as Statistical Process Control (SPC), poka-yoke and visual standards.
  • Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures.
  • Performs quality inspections.
  • Identifies and controls non-conforming material.

Delivery

  • Fully proficient with all work processes, independently operating equipment to manufacture and assemble product in order to create the proper characteristics and dimensions necessary to meet customer expectations.
  • Instructs and coaches others and acts as an informal resource for team members with less capability.
  • Achieves production goals.
  • Works at the required cycle time or defined engineering standard.
  • Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping tasks and machine cleaning tasks and performs planned operator care and maintenance tasks.
  • Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet production goals.
  • Works with peers, skilled trades and support staff to maintain and identify equipment needing repair.

Teamwork

job.title: Technical Information Systems Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Technical Information Systems Engineer is responsible for supporting engineering information, mechanical design and drafting, technical documentation, product data, and engineering change management processes that enable engineering teams to work efficiently and effectively.

The role primarily supports mechanical design and drafting activities for engine and genset components, including 3D modeling, 2D drawing development and review, GD&T, CAD data management, and engineering information processes. The position works closely with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Engineering, and other technical stakeholders to deliver accurate engineering information, resolve technical issues, support product development, and improve engineering processes and systems.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Design & Drafting

  • Create, modify, maintain, and review 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for engine and genset components using Creo Parametric.
  • Apply established CAD and drafting practices to develop accurate, consistent, and manufacturable engineering documentation.
  • Interpret and validate engineering drawings, specifications, models, and design information.
  • Apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles to engine and genset applications.
  • Participate in drawing quality reviews and identify discrepancies, errors, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Review engineering documentation for compliance with applicable company, industry, national, and international standards, including SAE and ASME requirements.
  • Apply mechanical design and drafting principles to support engineering requirements and product development activities.

Engineering Information & Change Management

  • Manage and maintain engineering drawings, models, specifications, product information, and technical data using established processes and systems.
  • Support CAD data management through Windchill/PLM and other applicable engineering information systems.
  • Support the Engineering Change Management process, including the review, documentation, and implementation of applicable engineering changes.
  • Ensure engineering information is accurate, current, traceable, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
  • Fulfill engineering information and technical service requests in accordance with defined policies, procedures, and service expectations.
  • Document completed work, technical findings, decisions, and results to support knowledge management and effective information sharing.
  • Support Engineering Standard Work (ESW), Value Package Introduction (VPI), product change management, and technical information repositories as applicable.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Engineering, and other technical functions to understand requirements and deliver appropriate engineering information and solutions.
  • Obtain, evaluate, and incorporate inputs from technical stakeholders into engineering documentation and processes.
  • Collaborate with technical practitioners to resolve drawing, design, product information, and process-related issues.
  • Communicate technical information clearly to stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise.
  • Contribute effectively to team activities and shared engineering objectives.

Problem Solving & Process Improvement

  • Own and resolve moderately complex engineering information, design, drafting, product, or process-related issues.
  • Analyze technical problems and determine appropriate corrective actions using structured problem-solving methods.
  • Evaluate drawings, models, specifications, and technical information to identify discrepancies and potential risks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, drafting practices, information quality, and workflow efficiency.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering information systems, processes, and technical documentation.
  • Support the development and standardization of effective engineering work processes and best practices.
  • Make timely technical decisions using available information while maintaining quality and engineering standards.

Manufacturing & Product Knowledge

  • Apply knowledge of engine and genset components when developing and reviewing engineering models and drawings.
  • Consider manufacturing requirements and design intent when validating engineering documentation.
  • Apply practical understanding of manufacturing processes, particularly castings and sheet metal , when reviewing designs.
  • Support effective communication and alignment between design engineering and manufacturing teams.

Competency

Technical Competencies

  • Knowledge Management: Ensures engineering information, technical knowledge, and experience are available at the right time and through appropriate processes and tools.
  • Request Fulfillment: Manages engineering service requests efficiently and professionally through their lifecycle.
  • Requirements Elicitation: Understands, evaluates, and documents technical requirements to support appropriate engineering solutions.
  • Service Level Management: Supports delivery of engineering services in accordance with defined requirements, processes, and expectations.
  • Solution Assessment and Validation: Reviews engineering solutions and information against applicable requirements to ensure the desired outcome is achieved.
  • Troubleshooting: Diagnoses and resolves engineering information, design, drafting, and process-related issues using established standards and procedures.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaboration: Builds effective partnerships and works collaboratively with cross-functional teams to achieve shared objectives.
  • Effective Communication: Communicates technical information clearly and effectively to different audiences.
  • Decision Quality: Makes sound and timely decisions based on technical information, data, and established processes.
  • Drives Results: Consistently delivers quality results while maintaining engineering and customer expectations.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Identifies effective and efficient ways of working and contributes to continuous improvement.
  • Self-Development: Actively develops technical knowledge, engineering expertise, and professional capabilities.
  • Values Differences: Recognizes and values diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) or another relevant Engineering/STEM discipline.
  • A postgraduate/master’s degree in a relevant technical discipline may be preferred or required for select roles.
  • The position may require licensing or eligibility in accordance with applicable export control or sanctions regulations.

Skills & Experience

Required

  • 5–6 years of relevant experience in mechanical design and drafting, with strong hands-on experience using Creo Parametric.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Creo Parametric 2D and 3D modeling and drafting .
  • Strong knowledge of GD&T , particularly for engine and genset applications.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical design and engineering drafting principles.
  • Practical knowledge of engine and genset components and their applications.
  • Experience creating, interpreting, validating, and reviewing engineering drawings.
  • Experience participating in drawing quality reviews/audits and resolving drawing-related issues.
  • Working knowledge of Windchill/PLM and CAD data management systems.
  • Knowledge of engineering change management and product configuration processes.
  • Understanding of manufacturing processes, particularly castings and sheet metal .
  • Knowledge of applicable SAE, ASME, and other relevant engineering standards .
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to identify and resolve drawing, design, engineering data, and process-related issues.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools .

Preferred

  • Experience supporting engine or genset product development activities.
  • Experience working with structured engineering service, technical information, or product development environments.
  • Experience with formal drawing quality audits and engineering documentation reviews.
  • Experience supporting engineering change processes and product configuration management.
  • Exposure to Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and manufacturing considerations.
  • Experience collaborating with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Product Engineering teams.

job.title: Health, Safety and Environment Leader - Low Complexity
job.description:
Job Summary

Implement and sustain a positive health, safety and environmental culture through the application of the management systems framework in site(s) with low complexity. This includes establishing the short term and long-term strategic plan for the site to foster continual health, safety and environmental Improvement, leading programs, policies and assessments and monitoring performance to ensure compliance with Cummins internal requirements, applicable health, safety and environmental regulations and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

Builds strong relationships across functions to ensure the organization understands their roles and responsibilities and are committed to driving a positive health, safety and environmental culture. Ensures employees are consulted and given the opportunity to contribute to the development and implementation of programs, policies and procedures. Leads hazard identification, environmental aspect identification and risk assessment programs to identify strategic risk improvement opportunities and gaps in health, safety and environmental compliance obligations. Manages planning actions to set targets and objectives for the site and supervises actions through completion. Leads an effective support model throughout the site through training, skills development and internal communications. Develops and maintains support content ensuring it is up to date, controlled and available while adhering to data privacy regulations. Interfaces with external regulatory bodies as required with the support of the legal department. Leads daily health, safety and environmental operations within the site(s) providing support to solve issues, including but not limited to health, safety and environmental compliance, capital and resource management, risk reduction, incident investigation, management of change, contractor safety, emergency preparedness and response, pollution prevention and environmental sustainability. Drives improvements to health, safety and environmental performance metrics using a risk-based and data-driven approach. Adheres to Cummins internal reporting requirements through approved systems. Evaluates site health, safety and environmental data, legal compliance findings, and internal and external audit results to develop an improvement plan. Leads site(s) Health, Safety, Environmental Management Systems review annually in conformance with Cummins internal requirements. Leads work cross-functionally as required to resolve work-related incidents, non-compliances, non-conformities, corrective and preventive actions driving continual improvement within the site(s). Coaches and develops direct reports and/or cross-functional teams based on stakeholder feedback, observations and succession plan needs. Actively seeks opportunities for self-development through professional health, safety and environmental organizations, as a champion of emerging trends.

Competencies:

Builds effective teams - Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.

Courage - Stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Strategic mindset - Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.

Health, Safety and Environment Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis - Examines HSE incidents by completing quality, evidence based investigations with accurate root cause analysis, resulting in effective corrective actions, accurate reporting and avoiding repeated incidents.

Health, Safety and Environment Management Systems - Interprets and applies international standards through practical application within the operating environment to achieve and maintain an effective management system and external certification.

Influence the Health, Safety and Environmental Culture - Champions positive health and safety behaviors by influencing leaders and employees to create the right environment.

Measurement and Evaluation of Health, Safety and Environment Performance - Collects and analyzes data by creating key performance indicators to evaluate performance trends, deliver improvement goals and objectives, inform strategy and protect employees and the environment.

Risk Assessment - Evaluates hazards within the work environment by applying hazard identification and risk assessment techniques to analyze and prioritize risk, enabling a selection of control measures that reduce risk as low as reasonably practicable.

Work Related Injury and Illness Management - Communicates and documents work related injuries or illnesses through application of Cummins reporting guidelines and relevant regulations to classify and manage the event and its consequences as well as achieve regulatory compliance; cares for the affected employees by facilitating clinical treatment practices and applying case management processes to restore the employee to his/her normal condition.

job.description:
Job Summary

Diagnoses and completes less complex repairs to engines at the customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

Engages customers in a courteous and professional manner. Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs. Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete less complex repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools. Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field. Escalates unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor. Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional service opportunities with customer. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements. Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation. Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly accomplished and strategic professional for Regional EE Procurement. This role will be responsible for driving category procurement strategy, managing supplier and partner factory relationships, and ensuring timely, cost-effective sourcing of high-quality products. The incumbent will play a critical role in optimizing supplier performance, driving year-on-year productivity, and contributing to overall business growth.

  • Develop and execute a robust procurement strategy aligned with organizational goals and growth plans.
  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard a resilient, scalable, and diversified supplier base.
  • Drive category strategies to ensure competitiveness, innovation, and supply continuity.

  • Build and sustain strong partnerships with suppliers and partner factories.
  • Ensure consistent performance in terms of quality, cost, delivery, and compliance.
  • Lead supplier evaluations, negotiations, and long-term contracting strategies.

3\. Cost Optimization & Exception Management

  • Monitor market trends, commodity indices, and pricing dynamics.
  • Drive cost control initiatives and achieve year-on-year productivity and savings targets.
  • Manage supply disruptions, escalations, and exceptions to ensure business continuity.

4\. Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Establish and enforce procurement policies, processes, and governance frameworks.
  • Leverage analytics to track procurement KPIs, forecast demand, and optimize inventory.
  • Generate periodic reports with actionable insights to support continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, and Systems teams.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives aimed at reducing lead times and improving supply chain efficiency.
  • Support new product development and localization initiatives through sourcing expertise.

job.title: Critical Projects Manager, Critical Projects Implementation
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team in Amazon Data Services, India is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within live data centers in India. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager in AWS to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers in India. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities in India.

A day in the life The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system.

The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think big; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!

About the team About AWS

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors a Women's Leadership Program that supports the growth and development of female builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • 4+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
  • 3+ years of vendor management experience
  • Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of construction or project management experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will contribute to improving the cybersecurity of grid automation products, embedded systems, and industrial solutions through security assessments, threat modelling, risk analysis, vulnerability management, and compliance activities. You will support product and system/solution certification, ensuring alignment with IEC 62443 standards, the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and applicable cybersecurity regulations.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role contributes to the Electrification Business, Distribution Solutions Division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Conduct cybersecurity assessments of products, embedded systems, software, and industrial solutions to identify security gaps, evaluate risks, and recommend mitigation measures.
  • Perform threat modelling, attack-surface analysis, risk assessments, and threat mitigation planning throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Assess compliance with applicable IEC 62443 standards, including IEC 62443-3-3, IEC 62443-4-1, IEC 62443-4-2, and IEC 62443-3-2, and support compliance gap assessments and remediation plans.
  • Support product and system/solution cybersecurity certification, including pre-assessments, evidence preparation, audit coordination, and closure of non-conformities.
  • Evaluate product cybersecurity requirements under the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), monitor regulatory developments, and support compliance documentation and readiness activities.
  • Manage product vulnerabilities through identification, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, verification, and closure, including third-party component and SBOM reviews.
  • Prepare cybersecurity assessment reports, threat registers, compliance matrices, risk summaries, and technical documentation, ensuring traceability of findings and mitigation activities.

Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline, with approximately 8 years of relevant experience in product cybersecurity, security assessment, embedded systems, or industrial cybersecurity.
  • Experience in cybersecurity assessments, threat modelling, risk analysis, and mitigation planning.
  • Knowledge in IEC 62443 series, particularly product and system cybersecurity requirements, and experience supporting compliance assessments.
  • Understanding of the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), product cybersecurity obligations, and certification processes.
  • Practical experience in vulnerability management, CVE/CVSS-based risk assessment, remediation tracking, and security verification. Ability to review security architectures, technical specifications, design documents, and security testing reports.
  • Experience with SBOMs, software vulnerabilities, penetration testing, security scanning, and embedded or industrial communication technologies.
  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications or training in IEC 62443, industrial cybersecurity, product security, or risk assessment.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while making the grid more resilient. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

More about Us

The Measurement & Analytics Division is among the world’s leading manufacturers and suppliers of smart instrumentation and analyzers, working at the heart of industrial digital transformation. The Measurement & Analytics Division’s portfolio consists of analyzers measuring compositions of gases and liquids; instrumentation measuring process variables such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level; force measurement solutions measuring parameters such as flatness, thickness, and tension; and advanced digital solutions for device management, device health check and predictive maintenance. The Measurement & Analytics Division serves key industries such as oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, as well as the marine industry. The Division enables the optimization of industrial processes by providing and analyzing data collected from sensing and smart measurement devices. Parameters such as emission levels and production inputs are measured by providing ‘before’ and ‘after’ values, enabling efficient operations and environmental sustainability through measurement.
