job.title: Embedded Software Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Talent Acquisition Lead

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to successful project results in technology, software, product, and/or solution development, as well as associated Intellectual Property (IP). Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development for specific product-related issues and maintenance. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative solutions.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Design, develop and maintain embedded software using C, following coding standards and established software architecture.
  • Develop and debug software components for real-time embedded systems using RTOS concepts, including tasks, scheduling, synchronization and inter-task communication.
  • Apply sound software design principles and object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts where appropriate to build modular, reusable and maintainable code.
  • Work with Linux fundamentals, including command-line tools, process/thread concepts, build environments and basic system debugging. Participate in requirements analysis, software design, implementation, code reviews, unit testing, integration testing and release activities.
  • Diagnose software issues using debugging tools, logs, traces and target-hardware observations; perform root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
  • Integrate software with hardware peripherals, device drivers, communication interfaces and other product components.
  • Develop and execute unit, integration and regression tests, including boundary cases, error handling and timing-related scenarios.
  • Maintain technical documentation, design descriptions, test evidence and software change records in line with product development processes. Collaborate with system, hardware, verification and global engineering teams to deliver robust software on schedule.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics / Electrical / Computer Science / Embedded Systems or related field with 4–5 years of relevant experience in embedded software development for real-time or resource-constrained systems.
  • Strong hands-on programming skills in Embedded C, including pointers, memory management, data structures, bitwise operations and low-level debugging.
  • Good understanding of RTOS concepts such as task/thread scheduling, priorities, interrupts, semaphores, mutexes, queues and timing constraints.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented programming concepts, including encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism and abstraction; C++ exposure is desirable.
  • Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals, shell commands, processes, threads, file systems and software build/debug workflows.
  • Experience with embedded debugging tools, compilers, build systems, version control and source-code review practices.
  • Understanding of microcontrollers, peripheral interfaces, device drivers and hardware-software interaction, including GPIO, ADC, PWM, timers and interrupts. Familiarity with communication interfaces and protocols such as UART, SPI, I²C and Wi-Fi; TCP/IP basics are an advantage.
  • Familiarity with unit testing, integration testing, regression testing and software quality practices.

A future opportunity

This role is part of our talent pipeline, which means it’s not currently open, but we’re always looking for curious minds, bold thinkers, and people who want to make an impact.

Click Apply to express your interest and be considered for future opportunities that match your experience and aspirations.

At ABB, we welcome people from all backgrounds and believe that diverse perspectives help us build a cleaner, smarter future.

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about how we help run what runs the world.

job.title: Construction Manager – Industrial Projects (Civil)
job.description:
Looking for challenging role? If you really want to make a difference - make it with us

At Siemens Energy India Limited, we are more than just an energy technology company. We develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in Siemens Energy’s research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Siemens Energy’s global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Your new role – challenging and future-oriented

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional as Construction Manager (Civil) at Siemens Energy Real Estate Business in India. The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the business as well as you will be instrumental in strategic planning, project schedule and monitoring development. This vital position centers on maintaining tight control over project lifecycles through diligent project tracking, meticulous cash flow management, effective vendor management, and clear, consistent progress reporting. You will play a key role in communicating project status to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and accountability from inception to completion

The role reports directly to the Project Director Real Estate of Siemens Energy India Limited and is based in Navi Mumbai / Project Location.

How You’ll Make an Impact

**1. Site Management & Supervision: **- Overseeing all on-site construction activities, ensuring they align with project plans and specifications.

  • Managing site logistics, including material handling, equipment placement, and site access as per Siemens guidelines.
  • Conducting regular site inspections to monitor progress and quality.

**2. Schedule Management: **- Tracking progress against the schedule and implementing measures to address delays.

  • Coordinating activities between different works and contractors to optimize workflow.
  • Preparing and presenting regular reports to stakeholders on project status, budget, and schedule

**3. Quality Control & Assurance: **- Establishing and enforcing quality standards for all construction work.

  • Implementing inspection and testing procedures to ensure materials and workmanship meet specifications
  • Addressing and resolving any quality issues that arise.

**4. Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Management: **- Developing and enforcing a robust HSE program to ensure a safe working environment.

  • Conducting regular safety meetings, inspections, and training.
  • Investigating and reporting any incidents or near misses.
  • Proactively identifying internal and external factors that could negatively impact the project (e.g., technical challenges, resource shortages, market changes).

**5. Risk Assessment and Analysis: **- Evaluating the likelihood and impact of identified risks.

  • Developing Mitigation Strategies:
  • Creating plans to prevent, reduce, or respond to identified risks, including contingency plans.

6. Contractor and Vendor Management

- Managing relationships with subcontractors, suppliers, and other vendors.

  • Ensuring contracts are adhered to and performance expectations are met.
  • Negotiating and resolving disputes if they arise

**7. Stakeholder Management and Communication: **- Serving as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, engineers, contractors, and other key stakeholders.

  • Providing regular project updates, progress reports with the project team, and addressing concerns from contractors and key stakeholders

**8. Team Leadership & Motivation: **- Leading and motivating the project team, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.

  • Delegating tasks, providing guidance, and conducting performance reviews.

**9. Close-out and post-construction: **- Coordinating the final inspection and commissioning of the facility.

  • Ensuring all necessary documentation (as-built drawings, manuals, warranties) is provided to the client.
  • Finalizing all financial accounts, including payments to contractors and suppliers.
  • Reconciling the final budget.
  • Conducting a post-project review to identify successes, challenges, and areas for improvement.
  • Documenting lessons learned for future projects.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil engineering.
  • Advance Degree in Construction Management or PMP / equivalent project management certification shall be preferred

Minimum of 12-15 years of progressive experience in construction management, with at least 8 years specifically managing MEP works on large-scale industrial projects (e.g., manufacturing plants, data centers, power generation facilities, chemical plants).

  • Working knowledge of design and project management software such as AutoCAD, BIM and MS Project or Primavera.
  • Strong understanding of industrial mechanical systems (HVAC, piping, plumbing, fire protection), electrical systems (power distribution, control systems, instrumentation), and building automation systems.
  • Proven ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings, specifications, and project schedules
  • Strong understanding of the construction processes, PEB and large-scale industrial projects
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficient in both verbal and written communication in English for business purposes.

job.title: Digital Procurement Transformation Lead
job.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As Digital Procurement Transformation Lead, you will shape and deliver the digital and AI agenda for procurement across Grid Technologies – from our factories with repeat demand to our engineer-to-order project business in HVDC, STATCOM and grid solutions. This is a digital transformation role, not a buying role: you bring the expertise in process redesign, digital products, data, automation and AI, while our procurement process owners and category and project experts bring the business know-how, validate solutions and own the outcomes. Together, you will move procurement, engineering, projects, quality, logistics, finance, IT and suppliers onto one transparent, standard and audit-ready way of working – using the global Siemens Energy Procurement tools first and building locally only where there is a genuine gap. Your success will be measured by real adoption and value confirmed by Controlling, not by the number of tools launched.

How You'll Make an Impact**

  • Digital strategy and portfolio: Own the procurement digital roadmap for Grid Technologies – identify and prioritize pain points, automation opportunities and AI use cases by business value, feasibility and strategic fit, aligned with the global SE Procurement transformation agenda.
  • Business translation: Map end-to-end procurement processes – from bid and tender through delivery – and translate business needs into user stories, functional specifications and data requirements.
  • Product ownership and delivery: Act as digital product owner for SE Procurement tools (S/4, Ariba Guided Buying, One Supplier Portal, ORO, PIP, AI Forge), steering backlog, testing and releases with IT and the global CoE; close local gaps with low-code / no-code, Power Platform and analytics through prototypes, MVPs and scalable releases.
  • Applied AI and automation: Design, test and scale controlled AI use cases – RFQ package preparation, offer comparison, clarification lists, contract obligation extraction and a procurement knowledge assistant – with grounding, verification, logging and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Data and insight: Establish trusted supplier, material, price, contract and project data, and deliver should-cost and commodity-index analytics, spend classification, a supplier risk cockpit and management dashboards for fact-based decisions.
  • Governance and compliance: Digitize RFQ, comparative statement, QES and DOA approvals with a full audit trail, ensuring compliance with AI governance, information security, data privacy, export control and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Change, adoption and value: Lead change management and capability building through a network of digital champions, role-based training and data and AI literacy, and track adoption, quality and business value KPIs against agreed baselines.

What You Bring

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Informatics or Data / AI; a postgraduate qualification or MBA is an advantage.
  • 10+ years of experience in digital transformation, business process transformation, digital product management or enterprise systems, including at least two end-to-end programmes taken from diagnosis to go-live and sustained user adoption with measurable business value.
  • Strong digital and AI expertise, including applied Generative AI (prompt engineering, RAG concepts and responsible AI), AI agent workflows with human-in-the-loop verification, automation and process mining, low-code / no-code development, and data analytics and visualization (e.g. Power BI).
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4 and Ariba or comparable ERP and sourcing platforms, and good awareness of integration and enterprise architecture concepts such as APIs, connectors and cloud platforms.
  • Working understanding of the procurement value chain – strategic sourcing, project procurement, P2P and supplier management. Experience in procurement or supply chain digitalization is strongly preferred; deep category, negotiation or contract expertise is not required.
  • Proven product ownership and agile delivery, working with IT partners, global centers of excellence and citizen developers.
  • Strong stakeholder and change leadership – influencing without authority across global, cross-functional teams, engaging senior management, delivering training and setting up sustainable support models.
  • Experience in power transmission, EPC, heavy engineering or complex manufacturing is a plus.

Who is Siemens Energy India?

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens-energy-india.com

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by #TeamPurpleIndia. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

job.title: Technical Program Manager, Google Pay
job.description:
About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. job.title: Network Security Architect
job.description:
About the Role

Job Type: Full-time | Location: Sydney, NSW | Department: Network | Reporting to: Vice President, Network Engineering | Work Location Type: #onsite

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

We have grown substantially since 2019, from our inception in Australia to now having several facilities across North America and being listed on NASDAQ… and we are just getting started! By joining us, you will be contributing to the future of sustainable high-performance compute and the local communities we strive to have a positive impact on.

Our Network Engineering team builds the networks that power AI at scale. We design and run the high-performance fabrics that connect tens of thousands of GPUs, the backbone and WAN that link our campuses across continents, and the facilities networks that keep our data centres safe and running. Our work spans all aspects of network engineering for IREN, from the data centre and core to the WAN and peering edge.

As Network Security Architect you will set how IREN's network is secured, from the GPU fabrics inside each data centre to the WAN, peering edge and facilities networks. You will define the security architecture and standards our engineers build to, and make sure security keeps pace as we scale.

Requirements

  • Extensive experience designing security for large data centre, cloud, carrier or hyperscale networks.
  • Expert knowledge of firewalls, segmentation, zero-trust access and secure remote access.
  • A strong understanding of VXLAN, EVPN and SDN, and how to segment and secure them.
  • Broad knowledge of network platforms such as Cisco, Juniper and Arista, and their security capabilities.
  • A deep understanding of BGP, OSPF or IS-IS, and MPLS with traffic engineering, and of routing security, including BGP filtering, RPKI and DDoS protection.
  • Experience securing multi-tenant HPC and AI environments, including NVIDIA Spectrum networking, DGX clusters and cluster management such as Base Command Manager or Run:ai, and industrial or facilities (OT) networks is highly regarded.
  • Working knowledge of frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and IEC 62443.
  • Hands-on software engineering in Python or Go, with experience delivering policy-as-code and security automation, and applying AI to security.
  • Clear, persuasive communication, explaining risk and trade-offs to engineers and executives alike.

Responsibilities

  • Own the network security architecture across data centre fabrics, WAN and backbone, internet and peering edge, and facilities networks.
  • Define segmentation and zero-trust patterns, including tenant isolation for AI cloud customers and the boundaries between IT and OT networks.
  • Set security standards for firewalls, remote access, device hardening and routing security, and review designs against them.
  • Design edge protection, including DDoS mitigation, route filtering and RPKI, with our carriers and peers.
  • Define security-as-code: express policy, segmentation and compliance in code that is tested in CI/CD and enforced automatically across the network.
  • Build prototypes and reference code for security automation yourself, and set the security architecture for AI workloads and AI tooling.
  • Lead security technology selection and vendor evaluation for firewalls, access, monitoring and DDoS services.
  • Model threats for new sites and services, and turn the results into practical controls.
  • Partner with corporate security, compliance and customer teams on audits and customer security requirements.
  • Mentor engineers and act as the final security reviewer for major network changes.

Growth Opportunities

  • Define the security architecture of a network built for AI at global scale.
  • Influence security strategy, tooling and team structure as IREN grows.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary range finalized based on experience and impact
  • Short and long-term incentive programs designed to reward both results and long term company success

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

As a Senior Network Security Engineer you will protect the networks behind IREN's AI cloud. You will build and run the security controls across our data centres, WAN and edge, keep our firewalls and access paths tight, and lead the response when something looks wrong.

Requirements

  • Solid experience in network security engineering in data centre, cloud or service provider environments.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of next-generation firewalls (such as Fortinet or Palo Alto Networks), VPNs and segmentation.

job.description:

job.title: Director, Government Relations India
job.description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a senior Government Relations leader based in Gurgaon, India to represent the business across policy, regulatory, and industry forums. This role requires strong connectivity in government corridors, trusted relationships with policymakers and ministries, and the ability to influence policy discussions with credibility and sound judgment.

Role Overview

In this role, you will lead external engagement across government, industry associations, and trade bodies while advising senior leadership on public policy risks, opportunities, and positioning. You will help shape the company’s voice on manufacturing, infrastructure, sustainability, healthcare, and industrial growth, while maintaining effective relationships through changing political environments.

Reporting to the Vice President & Chief Sustainability and External Relations Officer, and Managing Director, and part of a collaborative, diverse, global team, this person will assist in the development and execution of policy campaigns, projects, and initiatives critical to the company’s success on issues including energy, environment, government contracting, government subsidies and technology development

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership, leveraging deep understanding of Johnson Controls’ businesses to anticipate policy risks, influence regulatory direction, and advance company interests. Develop and execute government relations strategies that support Johnson Controls’ business priorities in India.
  • Own the end-to-end design and execution of government affairs strategies, translating business priorities into clear policy positions, targeted advocacy campaigns, and measurable outcomes. Build and maintain strong relationships with central and state government stakeholders, ministries, regulators, and policymakers.
  • Represent the company with industry associations, chambers of commerce, and business forums such as CII, FICCI, MAIT, and similar bodies. Maintain governance, integrity, and discretion in all external engagement and advocacy activity.
  • Track legislative, regulatory, and policy developments that may affect the business, with emphasis on manufacturing, infrastructure, and industrial policy.
  • Expand the company’s influence ecosystem by participating in consultations, roundtables, industry meetings, and other public policy forums. Prepare policy briefs, background papers, presentations, and external-facing materials for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to align government engagement with business strategy, compliance expectations, and market priorities.

How You Will Do It

  • Build trust with policymakers, ministries, and industry leaders through preparation, consistency, and follow-through.
  • Stay close to the issues that matter most to the business, focusing effort on the policy priorities that create the greatest impact.
  • Approach every external engagement with accountability, integrity, and respect for compliance and stakeholder trust.
  • Use candid analysis, structured problem-solving, and continuous learning to strengthen policy positions and improve outcomes over time.
  • Work as one team with business, legal, sales, and regional partners to align advocacy, commercial priorities, and external messaging.
  • Maintain a non-partisan, steady approach that helps the company remain effective through political transitions and changing government priorities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in public policy, political science, law, business administration, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of relevant experience in government relations, public affairs, policy advocacy, or a closely related external affairs role.
  • Demonstrated track record of policy development and advocacy within a corporation, trade association, industry body, or advisory environment.
  • Deep understanding of India’s government structures, regulatory frameworks, and policy-making institutions.
  • Established relationships with policymakers, ministries, regulators, and senior external stakeholders.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to represent the company credibly with C-suite and board-level leaders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear policy briefs and presentations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with sound judgment, discretion, and a high level of professionalism.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to influence without direct authority.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with industry associations, chambers of commerce, or policy forums such as CII, FICCI, MAIT, or similar organizations.
  • Exposure to manufacturing, infrastructure, energy, sustainability, or healthcare policy.
  • Experience in government advisory, public policy consulting, or senior consulting environments.
  • Familiarity with public-private partnership initiatives and government procurement discussions.
  • Ability to manage numerous and varied priority issues at the same time
  • A self-starter who is energized by the challenge and opportunity to be an originator, creator, and driver of impactful legislative and regulatory policies
  • Building code proposals and adoptions experience a plus
  • Significant experience presenting and interacting with C-suite and Board level leaders

job.description:

job.title: Senior Engineer, Senior AI/ML Research-2
job.description:
About the role

As a Senior AI/ML Research Engineer, you will apply advanced AI/ML methods to engineering and industrial use cases. You will combine research, experimentation, evaluation, and production grade software engineering to turn promising models, methods, and existing tools into reliable, agent-accessible capabilities.

This role is ideal for a technically strong researcher and builder who can move from an engineering problem to a validated approach, then help convert that approach into a reusable production component.

What you will do

  • Apply AI/ML methods to challenging engineering and industrial use cases.
  • Research, prototype, and evaluate approaches using frontier AI models and related techniques.
  • Convert existing models, tools, and analytical capabilities into agent-accessible artifacts.
  • Translate successful experiments into reusable software and platform components.
  • Design and execute evaluation, benchmarking, and validation approaches.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, cloud architects, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Contribute to requirements, specifications, constitutions, contracts, context, and AI harnesses.
  • Use GitHub workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD practices to integrate and validate work.
  • Deploy and evaluate capabilities using GCP or comparable cloud services.
  • Communicate technical findings through internal documentation, publications, patents, or open-source contributions.

Required qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a relevant technical field.
  • Five to eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience applying AI/ML methods to engineering, manufacturing, industrial, or comparable technical use cases.
  • Experience building agentic AI systems.
  • Experience converting models and tools into agent-accessible artifacts.
  • Experience with GCP or comparable cloud platforms.
  • Experience with GitHub, CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • Evidence of technical contribution through publications, patents, or open-source work.

What success looks like

  • You deliver validated AI/ML capabilities for multiple engineering use cases.
  • You convert selected existing models and tools into reusable, agent-accessible artifacts.
  • You establish repeatable evaluation and benchmarking practices.
  • You contribute production-ready components to the shared architecture.
  • Your work demonstrates measurable value for engineering users.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Procurement Quality Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition:

Supports the resolution of quality issues and processes for the supply function in the manufacturing facility.

Responsibilities

  • Provides conclusions and recommendations for quality issues and/or continuous quality improvement projects.
  • Participates in supplier quality improvement initiatives; works with suppliers to develop and improve quality levels.
  • Ensures the reliability and quality of suppliers, implementing process controls, certification programs, evaluations, inspections, corrective actions, audits and records.
  • Identified quality problem(s) and determines a short-term action plan with the facility management and the supplier.

Degree Requirement: Preferred Bachelor’s Degree from Tier 1 college or University

Skill Descriptors:

Quality Management: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques and ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the purpose and limitations of quality management.
  • Accesses organizational resources that enable quality management.
  • Defines quality management concepts.
  • Cites examples of organizational quality management initiatives.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the importance of accuracy in own function or unit.
  • Identifies tasks or outputs that require accuracy and detail-level attention.
  • Identifies the procedures for making sure that results are mistake-free.
  • Describes consequences of errors within own unit or function.

Collaborating: Knowledge of collaborative techniques; ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Demonstrates experience participating in productive collaborative processes.
  • Under guidance, initiates collaborative meetings.
  • Assists in communicating shared goals with diverse groups and parties.
  • Helps promote collaboration across generations, functions, regions, and levels.
  • Helps solve business problems and meet business goals through collaborative processes.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Recognizes changing demands and priorities; validates changes with management.
  • Obtains information about how current assignments contribute to organizational goals.
  • Completes current work according to assigned priorities.
  • Responds to day-to-day operational priorities while still making progress on project work.
  • Performs at least 2-3 concurrent activities without reducing productivity.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Procurement Function: Knowledge of responsibilities, accountabilities, and organization of procurement function; ability to perform tasks and activities of the procurement functions or department.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies major tasks and responsibilities of a procurement function or unit.
  • Explains the basic role and contributions of the procurement or purchasing function.
  • Explains the procedures and policies in the procurement process.
  • Locates the basic tools and technologies used by procurement professionals.

Purchasing Tasks and Activities: Knowledge of policies, regulations and processes of purchasing; ability to use practices and procedures for procurement of materials, components, equipment and services.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies the basic tools used for maintaining procurement information.
  • Identifies major types of products or services purchased by the organization.
  • Explains the basic concepts and responsibilities of purchasing tasks and activities.
  • Describes established procurement processes and standards.

Additional information: This job requires 5 working days from office

Caterpillar Returnship is a 24-week company paid; office-based program designed to enable a soft launch for experienced professionals on a career break. This initiative includes, networking sessions, coaching, trainings, and a project / work scope assignment.

  • Maintains focus on the topic at hand.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
  • Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
  • Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
  • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.

  • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Data Gathering and Reporting: Knowledge of tools, techniques and processes for gathering and reporting data; ability to practice them in a particular department or division of a company.

  • Analyzes complex reports as revealed by the data.

  • Oversees multiple data-gathering and analysis initiatives.

  • Provides advice on data visualization solutions to better convey the essential information to target audience.

  • Explores new adoption scenarios of data visualization within the business unit.

Inventory Management: Knowledge of processes and methods of inventory management; ability to effectively manage organization's materials, commodities, merchandises, or products.

job.description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Work Shapes the World. Whether it be groundbreaking products, best in class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do the work that matters at Caterpillar. With a 95-year legacy of quality and innovation and 150 locations in countries around the world, your impact spans the globe.

When you join Caterpillar, you are joining a team of makers, innovators, and doers. We are the people who roll up our sleeves and do the work to build a better world. We don’t just talk about progress and innovation. We make it happen. And we are proud of that because it helps our customers build and power the world we live in – the roads, hospitals, homes and infrastructure. Without a dedicated workforce Caterpillar could not effectively meet our customer’s needs. Join us.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Analyst Applications (SAP Basis Administrator) to join our Design Eng Processes team - CAT IT Division.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.

Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST

The Senior SAP Basis Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, optimization, and strategic support of enterprise SAP environments. This role ensures SAP systems are secure, highly available, scalable, and compliant while supporting upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery, performance tuning, and cloud transformation initiatives. The position collaborates closely with Infrastructure, Security, Development, Middleware, Database, and Functional teams to deliver reliable SAP services. This is a critical role that helps ensure our end users experience a well-equipped, efficient, and simple support touchpoint. Further, this role owns the Continuous Improvement journey for the department, with programs that improve automation, monitoring, and analytic capabilities.

Job Duties:

  • Own and drive all incidents, service tasks, problem tickets and system optimization for operations portfolio, ensuring delivery against commitments, SLAs, and outcomes.
  • Establish, monitor, and continuously improve standard work; ensure progress, risks, and dependencies are communicated effectively to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Partner with business units and decision makers to support day-to-day operations, incident/problem resolution, and continuous service improvement.
  • Technical responsibilities include:
  • SAP Landscape Administration (install, configure, maintain, and support SAP ecosystem)
  • Upgrade & Patch Management
  • System Performance & Availability
  • High Availability and Disaster Recovery Services
  • Security & Compliance
  • Print Management
  • Transport Management
  • Cloud & Automation
  • Level 4 Troubleshooting/Support.
  • SAP HANA & Database administration
  • Data Lifecycle Management configuration

What You Will Have:

  • Strong functional and/or technical application design, architecture, implementation, and support knowledge.
  • Deep technical expertise across the SAP technology stack, including SAP landscape administration, HANA/database administration, upgrades and patching, performance and availability, high availability/disaster recovery, security and compliance, transport and print management, cloud and automation, data lifecycle management, and Level 4 technical support.
  • Gen AI Assisted Development or Support: Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or automated agent workflows) to accelerate application development or support, cost or effort reduction, or support optimization. Demonstrated experience with AI tools
  • A Lean or Continuous Improvement background.
  • An ability to translate between technical and business language, creating a bridge between the support organization and the Caterpillar business they serve.

Top candidates will also have:

  • Has the ability to lead, analyze and have a broader perspective on specific technology and related solutions. This requires a comprehensive understanding of application solutions, interfaces, security, data governance policies and procedures.
  • Skilled in large scale application support and development
  • Hana DBA Certification
  • Basis Administration Certification
  • Experience with SAP on Hyperscale’s, SAP Cloud Connector, SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM), SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Test Data Migration Methodologies)
  • Knowledge of automation (Python, Ansible)
  • Prior experience in driving innovation and automation
  • Extensive experience in working with cross-functional teams, along with proven history of strong job-related result's
  • Strong stakeholder management skills

Additional Duties Perform other related duties as assigned to support organizational objectives.

Education / Experience: Requires a relevant computer science master’s or graduate degree and 9-plus years of progressively complex Information Services experience, including enterprise application architecture, development, support, and modernization. Requires a general understanding of business operations, including one or more of the following: general business processes, technical infrastructure, application development and support of major projects, and engineering functional applications. The incumbent must have the ability to provide strategic direction for application and technology roadmaps, including 2–5-year plans for Information Services. Requires the ability to work with diversified departments, along with effective oral and written communication skills. The incumbent must have a strong customer focus and business knowledge.

Additional Info:

  • May require travel of up to 25%

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Java Engineer to lead the design, development, and modernization of enterprise-grade applications that support AI-driven and intelligent digital capabilities. This role involves transforming legacy systems into scalable, resilient, and production-ready solutions aligned with modern architecture principles and engineering best practices. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical expertise, ownership and drive high-quality delivery.

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of robust Java-based applications and services

  • Conduct and lead code reviews, ensuring adherence to quality, performance, and security standards

  • Proactively troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and lead production support efforts
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability

  • Contribute to technical decision-making, solution design discussions, and roadmap planning

We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Senior Metrics Analyst to lead the development, management, and optimization of IT Service Management (ITSM) reporting, analytics, and performance measurement capabilities. This role will be responsible for transforming operational data into actionable insights that drive service excellence, continual improvement, and informed decision-making across IT.

The successful candidate will partner with IT leadership, service owners, and operational teams to establish meaningful performance metrics, develop executive-level dashboards, and provide strategic recommendations that improve service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

Job Duties:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance IT Service Management (ITSM) dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reporting across Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset, and Service Level Management processes.
  • Analyse service performance data to identify trends, recurring issues, service improvement opportunities, and operational risks.
  • Design and implement metrics frameworks that align ITSM performance measurement with business objectives and service delivery goals.
  • Produce executive-level reporting and presentations that translate complex operational data into actionable business insights.
  • Monitor and report on SLA, OLA, and KPI compliance, highlighting performance gaps and recommending corrective actions.
  • Partner with IT leadership, service owners, and operational teams to establish meaningful performance metrics and reporting standards.
  • Develop predictive and trend-based analytics to support capacity planning, resource forecasting, and proactive service improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and governance of ITSM data across platforms such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management, or similar tools.
  • Create and maintain automated reporting solutions, dashboards, and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or SQL-based reporting platforms.
  • Analyze customer satisfaction (CSAT), service desk performance, and operational efficiency metrics to improve end-user experience.
  • Support Continual Service Improvement (CSI) programs by measuring outcomes and tracking benefits realization from improvement initiatives.
  • Define and document metric definitions, calculation methodologies, reporting procedures, and data standards.
  • Conduct ad hoc data analysis and provide recommendations to support strategic IT decisions and operational planning.
  • Drive the adoption of data-driven decision-making across IT operations by promoting effective use of metrics and performance insights.
  • Present findings, trends, risks, and improvement recommendations to senior management, stakeholders, and governance boards.
  • Identify opportunities for reporting automation and process optimization to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Support ITIL-aligned service management practices by ensuring metrics accurately reflect service health, quality, and business value.

Top Candidates Will Have:

  • Deep understanding of ITIL best practices and service management frameworks.
  • Experience supporting global IT operations and service delivery organizations.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to align technical metrics to business outcomes.
  • Proven track record of driving measurable improvements in service performance, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency through analytics and reporting.

Additional Duties Enable now SAP application, Product Champion.

Education / Experience:

  • ITIL Foundation Certification (required or strongly preferred).
  • Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) preferred.
  • Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Certified Analytics Professional (CAP), or equivalent analytics certification preferred.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or ServiceNow Reporting certifications preferred.
  • Total 12+ Years of IT experience. 5+ years of experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Analytics, Service Reporting, Business Intelligence, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience developing and managing enterprise-level KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting.
  • Proven experience supporting ITIL-based service management processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset, and Service Level Management.
  • Experience working with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management, or similar solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse large data sets and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

  • This role requires 5 days onsite.
  • Relocation is unavailable.

job.title: Material Availability Analyst 1
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Maximizes external supplier performance through understanding our supply network.

What You Will Do

  • Serving as focal point for suppliers, following up on requirements to minimize past due schedules.
  • Focusing on inventory management to prevent excess material within the network.
  • Reviewing and acting on schedule releases and follow up for on-time shipments.
  • Working with global purchasing buyers and purchasing analyst on problem parts.

Degree Requirement

Degree or equivalent experience desired

What You Have

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
  • Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy.
  • Productively balances speed and accuracy.
  • Implements a variety of cross-checking approaches and mechanisms.
  • Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.
  • Employs techniques for motivating employees to meet or exceed accuracy goals.

Collaborating: Knowledge of collaborative techniques; ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Demonstrates experience engendering collaborative processes that lead to problem solving and the achievement of business goals.
  • Establishes shared goals to foster collaboration.
  • Ensures that everyone can access the same data and provide input into how business is conducted.
  • Redesigns physical areas to allow for collaboration and private time.
  • Deemphasizes divides; focuses on collaboration across generations, functions, regions, and levels.
  • Implements methods for people to come together on the fly to make decisions, solve problems, and develop products/services.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP): Knowledge of the process, issues and considerations for systematically managing distribution of inventory for multiple plants or warehouses; ability to apply related knowledge and experience in real practice.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Works with real-time inventory software, moving supplies to where needed, when needed.

  • Effective collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
