job.title: VP Business Development
job.description:
About DayOne Data Centers

DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.

About the Role

You'll find and secure the land and power that DayOne's next Asia-Pacific campuses will be built on. Power is the tightest constraint in most of the region's markets, so the work starts with utilities, grid capacity and government allocation, and works back to sites that can be developed on time and on budget. You'll originate sites,lead due diligence and negotiations, and take each opportunity to investment committee with a clear recommendation. You'll work closely with Development, Legal, Finance and Commercial so that every site you secure matches what hyperscale customers need.

Land and Site Origination

  • Originate, screen and secure sites for new data center campuses working with landowners, developers, government land agencies and local partners.
  • Lead site due diligence with Development, Engineering and Legal, covering zoning, title, flood and ground conditions, and access to power, water and fiber.
  • Negotiate land acquisition, lease and option agreements, taking each site to investment committee with a clear recommendation.

Power and Critical Resources

  • Secure grid connections and power allocations with utilities and transmission operators, from first enquiry through application to capacity reservation.
  • Develop power supply options with Sustainability and Finance, including renewable power purchase agreements and on-site generation.
  • Secure the water, fiber and other infrastructure each site needs, and track resource constraints by market.

Government and Market Entry

  • Work with government agencies, economic development bodies and regulators on approvals, incentives and capacity allocation programs, alongside Corporate Affairs and Legal.
  • Assess new markets for land and power availability, regulation and cost, and recommend where DayOne should enter next.
  • Maintain a regional view of competitors' land and power positions and emerging policy constraints.

Pipeline and Handover

  • Build and manage a pipeline of sites by stage, megawatts and timing, aligned with the capacity plan and customer demand.
  • Hand secured sites to Development and Delivery with commitments, conditions and risks documented.
  • Work with Commercial and Strategic Business Development so sites match hyperscaler requirements, and join customer discussions where land and power are deciding factors.

Requirements

  • 15+ years' experience in land acquisition, site origination, power development or infrastructure business development, in data centers, utilities, energy or large-scale real estate development.
  • Personal track record securing land and power for data center campuses or comparable power-intensive developments.
  • Experience negotiating grid connections and power allocations with utilities in at least one Asia-Pacific market.
  • Experience negotiating land acquisition, lease and option agreements, and leading site due diligence.
  • Existing relationships with utilities, landowners, government authorities and developers
  • Working knowledge of the regulation, permitting and incentive regimes that affect data center development in Asia-Pacific.
  • Takes sites to approval with a clear recommendation, including recommending against sites that miss power, cost or risk thresholds.
  • Builds trust with landowners, utilities and officials, and keeps it through long, multi-stage negotiations.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, the working language across DayOne's seven markets.
  • Willing to travel regularly across the priority markets.

Nice to Have

  • Established relationships with hyperscalers and cloud providers, and experience aligning sites to their requirements.
  • Commercial experience with hyperscale customers, such as pre-leasing or build-to-suit negotiations.
  • Experience with renewable power purchase agreements or on-site generation.
  • Background at a data center developer, utility or infrastructure fund.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Electrical Project Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Snapshot

  • Lead defined project scopes and workstreams across AirTrunk’s growing India data centre portfolio, from development and procurement through construction, commissioning and handover.
  • Use strong electrical and DCS / controls capability to coordinate critical data centre systems, interfaces, testing and operational readiness.
  • Work with Development, Construction, contractors and internal functions to improve safety, programme certainty, quality, cost control and customer outcomes.

Based in India, you will report to the Project Director or Senior Project Manager and work closely with Development, Construction, Design, Project Controls, Commercial, Procurement, Commissioning, Operations and external delivery partners, making your mark in a number of ways.

What you’ll do

  • Project manage assigned scopes and workstreams through development, procurement, construction, commissioning, operational readiness and handover.
  • Own project scope, programme, budget, risks, interfaces, actions and forecast outcomes within the authority delegated to the role.
  • Coordinate with General Contractors, consultants, suppliers and internal stakeholders to achieve agreed milestones and delivery commitments.
  • Review and challenge contractor programmes, progress updates, look-ahead plans, sequencing, dependencies and recovery measures.
  • Coordinate electrical systems and interfaces, including high-voltage and low-voltage distribution, substations, generators, UPS, switchboards, protection, earthing and testing requirements.
  • Coordinate DCS / controls interfaces, including BMS, EPMS, SCADA, PLC, instrumentation, controls networks, systems integration, testing and commissioning requirements.
  • Review constructability and technical interfaces across electrical, mechanical, ICT, controls and commissioning workstreams, while maintaining clear boundaries with Design Authority responsibilities.
  • Support procurement planning and tender activities, including scope of works, equipment requirements, long-lead items, bid evaluations and recommendations.
  • Work with Project Controls and Commercial teams on cost reporting, cost to complete, cashflow, commitments, variations, claims, extensions of time and commercial exposure.
  • Lead project coordination meetings, planning workshops, constructability reviews, programme risk reviews and recovery sessions, maintaining clear decisions and actions.
  • Maintain accurate project records, reporting dashboards, risk registers, issue logs, decision registers and progress information in accordance with AirTrunk governance.
  • Identify project risks early and develop practical mitigation and recovery plans with contractors, consultants and internal project teams.
  • Support safe, high-quality delivery, including site inspections, quality assurance, testing, commissioning, operational readiness and handover to Operations.
  • Prepare concise project health reports and executive insights covering progress, critical path, cost, risk, quality, commissioning and forecast completion.
  • Travel within India and elsewhere in APAC as required for project reviews, site inspections, procurement, claims management, commissioning, close-out and handover.

What you’ll bring

You will bring a practical, technically credible and delivery-focused approach, together with:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years’ experience in project management, construction delivery, engineering or project controls within major infrastructure, mission-critical, industrial or data centre projects.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering electrical systems and coordinating DCS / controls, BMS, EPMS, SCADA, PLC or related systems interfaces.
  • Experience managing project scopes and integrated delivery activities across development, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning and handover.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, programme logic, critical path, dependencies, project risk and contractor performance.
  • Experience coordinating and constructively challenging General Contractors, specialist contractors, consultants, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Commercial awareness across scope, programme, cost, risk, variations, claims and contractual outcomes.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, influencing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly.
  • Experience working in India, or strong capability to operate effectively with Indian contractors, authorities, suppliers and project stakeholders.
  • A proactive, flexible and forward-thinking approach, with a results-focused “get things done” mindset.
  • A genuine commitment to safety, quality, integrity and AirTrunk’s values.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Associate Data Engineer - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

As a key member of the Data Team at Equinix, we are seeking a skilled GCP Data Engineer who will be responsible for end-to-end development of Data Engineering use cases, Equinix Data Lake platform and tools. You will design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and analytics solutions on Google Cloud Platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud-native data technologies and a passion for building robust, efficient data pipelines that drive business insights.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Cloud Dataflow, Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow), Dataform/dbt and Cloud Functions
  • Build real-time streaming data pipelines using Cloud Pub/Sub, Kafka and Dataflow
  • Implement automated data quality checks and monitoring across all data workflows
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost efficiency through proper resource allocation and scheduling
  • Architect and implement data lake and data warehouse solutions using Dataproc, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Cloud SQL
  • Design optimal data models, partitioning strategies, and clustering for analytical workloads
  • Manage data lifecycle policies and implement automated archival and retention strategies
  • Ensure data security, encryption, and access control across all storage layers
  • Build and optimize BigQuery datasets for analytics and reporting use cases
  • Create and maintain dimensional models and fact tables for business intelligence
  • Implement data marts and aggregation layers for improved query performance
  • Support self-service analytics through proper data cataloging and documentation
  • Having good knowledge of Dataplex and Analytics hub
  • Integrate data from various sources including databases, APIs, SaaS applications, and file systems
  • Implement change data capture (CDC) solutions for real-time data synchronization
  • Work with third-party data providers and external data feeds
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging
  • Troubleshoot data pipeline issues and implement robust error handling mechanisms
  • Maintain data lineage documentation and impact analysis capabilities

Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • GCP Services: 2+ years hands-on experience with BigQuery, Cloud Dataflow Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, Cloud Pub/Sub, Dataform/dbt and Cloud Functions
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python/Java and SQL; experience with Spark/Beam development
  • Data Technologies: Strong understanding of Apache Beam, Apache Airflow, and distributed computing concepts
  • Database Systems: Experience with both RDBMS (Cloud SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (Bigtable, Firestore) databases
  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, or similar tools

Professional Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles
  • 2+ years of specific experience with Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of data modelling techniques and dimensional modelling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE)
  • Experience with data governance and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, SOX)
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Experience with streaming technologies beyond GCP (Kafka, Spark Streaming)

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more [here](https://careers.equinix.com/equinix-ai-guidance-for-candidates).

This posting is a new position within our organization.**

job.title: Manager, Global Accounts
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As a Manager, Global Accounts, you will be responsible for managing strategic relationships with leading hyperscalers and cloud service providers across the APAC region. In this individual contributor role, you will need to have a deep understanding of the data centre and cloud ecosystem, strong sales acumen, and the ability to coordinate and drive business with both customers’ regional teams as well as STTGDC’s country sales teams to secure large-scale deals.

Account Management & Growth

  • Develop and maintain management-level relationships with key decision-makers at leading hyperscalers and cloud service providers.
  • Drive long-term strategic partnerships to expand STTGDC's presence and revenue share.

Sales & Business Development

  • Own and drive the overall sales strategy for assigned global accounts across the APAC region.
  • Develop and execute detailed account strategies to achieve and exceed business goals.
  • Identify, qualify, and close large-scale data centre deals by collaborating with customer’s regional teams.
  • Work closely with STTGDC country sales teams to ensure a coordinated approach to account strategy, deal execution, and service delivery.
  • Lead negotiation on contract terms, service descriptions, and SLA documentation to meet both client and company requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with internal teams including Operations, Finance, Legal, and Product, to align offerings with customer requirements.
  • Act as a liaison between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of contracts and service delivery.
  • Prepare and lead customer quarterly business review sessions across the APAC region.

Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Stay updated on market trends, customer expansion plans, and competitive activities in the data centre industry.
  • Provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance STTGDC's market positioning.
  • Provide customer demand insights, including new market interest, capacity purchases, competitive intelligence, as well as feedback to management and in-country teams to influence wider organizational strategies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Business Administration or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in enterprise sales, global account management, or business development within the data centre, cloud, or technology industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of the requirements of hyperscalers and cloud service providers, as well as a strong understanding of data center operations, and the broader IT infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage senior executives, procurement teams, and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work across multiple geographies, cultures, and internal teams to drive a cohesive sales strategy.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex solutions effectively.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Independent and proactive, with adaptability and a strong sense of commitment.
  • Willingness to travel as required for the role.

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
About Us

There’s something special about working for a company like Macquarie Telecom. We’re not the biggest in the industry, where you’re just a number. We’re not tiny enough that you’ve never heard of us. We’re in that sweet spot where we’re strong enough to punch above our weight. And we definitely do! Because of this, you have the opportunity to make a difference.

The Opportunity:

Join Macquarie Telecom’s Product & Engineering team as a Network & Security Engineer specialising in Fortinet platforms.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of critical network security infrastructure supporting our internal and customer services. You’ll work across a broad Fortinet portfolio, including FortiGate, Secure SD-WAN, FortiSwitch, FortiAP and FortiSASE, helping ensure our platforms remain secure, resilient and continually improving.

From complex troubleshooting and platform upgrades to security improvements and solution design, you’ll play a key role in maintaining high-performing environments and strengthening our operational capability.

Working closely with Engineering, Service Assurance, Service Delivery and customer technical teams, you’ll have the autonomy to solve challenging technical problems, drive continuous improvement and share your expertise to build a stronger engineering team.

The Opportunity:

Join Macquarie Telecom’s Product & Engineering team as a Network & Security Engineer specialising in Fortinet platforms.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of critical network security infrastructure supporting our internal and customer services. You’ll work across a broad Fortinet portfolio, including FortiGate, Secure SD-WAN, FortiSwitch, FortiAP and FortiSASE, helping ensure our platforms remain secure, resilient and continually improving.

From complex troubleshooting and platform upgrades to security improvements and solution design, you’ll play a key role in maintaining high-performing environments and strengthening our operational capability.

Working closely with Engineering, Service Assurance, Service Delivery and customer technical teams, you’ll have the autonomy to solve challenging technical problems, drive continuous improvement and share your expertise to build a stronger engineering team.

What’s in it for you?

Own critical technology: Take technical ownership of shared network security infrastructure and Fortinet platforms. Work across the Fortinet ecosystem: Apply your expertise across firewalls, SD-WAN, switching, wireless and secure access technologies. Solve complex challenges: Lead troubleshooting, root cause analysis, platform improvements and technical escalations. Make a lasting impact: Improve engineering standards, strengthen operational resilience and mentor fellow engineers. Keep evolving: Work across a diverse technology environment where security, reliability and continuous improvement matter.

About You

You’re a hands-on network security engineer who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex problems and ensuring critical infrastructure performs at its best. You combine strong technical expertise with a proactive mindset, clear communication and a commitment to delivering reliable customer outcomes.

You’ll bring:

  • Experience managing and supporting production network security infrastructure in an ISP, managed services provider or large enterprise environment.
  • A methodical approach to troubleshooting, root cause analysis, risk assessment and continuous improvement.
  • Strong ownership of incidents, changes, upgrades and technical outcomes.
  • The ability to collaborate with technical teams, vendors and customers while communicating complex issues clearly.
  • A willingness to share knowledge, mentor others and build sustainable engineering capability.

Required Skills

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on network security engineering experience.
  • Advanced FortiGate and next-generation firewall expertise, including firewall policies, IPsec VPNs, high availability and SD-WAN troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on administration of FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer and FortiAuthenticator (FAC), including logging, authentication, certificates and identity integrations.
  • Strong networking fundamentals across BGP, OSPF, IPv4/IPv6, VLANs, QoS and routing and switching.
  • Operational experience with FortiSwitch, FortiAP and FortiSASE.
  • Experience managing production infrastructure, security patching, firmware upgrades, change control, backup and recovery.
  • Strong technical documentation skills, including configuration records, operational runbooks and support procedures.
  • A degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Fortinet Certified Professional (NSE 7 or higher) in Network Security, SD-WAN and SASE, or equivalent demonstrable specialist expertise.
  • ITIL Foundation certification or practical experience with formal incident, problem and change management.

Desirable experience:

  • FortiPortal, SIEM/SOC integrations and security monitoring.
  • FortiSASE capabilities, including secure web gateway (SWG), zero-trust network access (ZTNA), CASB and secure private access.
  • Automation and configuration templates, including Jinja.
  • Multi-tenant managed security services and high-availability data centre environments.
  • Fortinet Certified Solution Specialist (FCSS) certification.

If you’re ready to take ownership of complex network security platforms and help build secure, resilient technology services, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: People & Culture Business Partner - Operations (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

About the role

The People & Culture Business Partner - Operations is the dedicated people partner to the Critical Operations workforce, supporting the safe, reliable and compliant operation of STACK's critical facilities. The role leads the full employee lifecycle for Operations, with a strong focus on industrial relations, employee relations, Award interpretation, workforce compliance and employee experience. The role works closely with operational leaders and site based teams, most of whom are covered by the Manufacturing and Associated Industries and Occupations Award or other applicable industrial instruments. The role provides practical, commercially sound and people centred advice, ensuring that people practices support both operational requirements and a positive employee experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the primary People and Culture advisor to Operations leaders on industrial relations and employee relations matters
  • Interpret and apply the Manufacturing Award and other applicable employment legislation, policies, employment contracts and industrial instruments
  • Provide advice on classifications, remuneration, overtime, allowances, rostering, hours of work, breaks, leave, consultation requirements and other Award related matters
  • Lead and manage complex employee relations matters, including performance concerns, misconduct, grievances, investigations, disciplinary processes, absenteeism and fitness for work matters
  • Ensure fair, timely, well documented and legally compliant processes, working with external legal advisors where required
  • Partner with operational leaders to understand workforce needs, business priorities and workforce risks
  • Provide practical advice and coaching to operational leaders and site managers on managing people, performance, difficult conversations, conduct, attendance and team dynamics
  • Use people data and workforce insights to identify trends and recommend actions relating to turnover, absenteeism, employee relations, performance and engagement
  • Lead, coach and develop the Recruiter Talent Acquisition team member reporting to this role
  • Lead the implementation of the company performance management framework across Operations

About you

  • Tertiary qualification in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business or a related discipline
  • 8-15 years of HR experience, preferably within a 24x7 operational, manufacturing, engineering, facilities, infrastructure, or critical environment business
  • Demonstrated experience managing industrial relations and employee relations matters in an Award covered workforce
  • Strong working knowledge of the Manufacturing Award, Fair Work Act, National Employment Standards and relevant Australian employment legislation
  • Experience advising leaders on rostering, shift work, overtime, allowances and operational workforce arrangements
  • Experience managing investigations, disciplinary matters, performance management and workplace grievances
  • Strong industrial relations judgement and sound commercial acumen
  • High level of integrity, discretion and professionalism
  • Strong written communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced, operational environment and being visible at sites

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

job.title: Senior Electrical Commissioning Manager (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

About the role

The Senior Electrical Commissioning Manager will work as part of the STACK Data Centre Melbourne team and be responsible for the management of commissioning of mission critical equipment, start-up, and testing for projects in Melbourne.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership for the planning and execution of commissioning activities, ensuring systems are delivered safely, in accordance with STACK standards and ready for operational handover.
  • Manage commissioning activities for assigned projects, including relevant design, contractual, programme and commercial interfaces, in consultation with STACK management.
  • Lead and coordinate STACK commissioning personnel allocated to assigned projects.
  • Manage and oversee Commissioning Agent (CxA) consultants for assigned projects, ensuring scope, deliverables, quality and programme obligations are achieved.
  • Support the preparation of CxA RFP documentation and participate in the procurement, evaluation and appointment of CxA consultants.
  • Work with the GC, CxA and STACK stakeholders to review commissioning programmes, identify risks and constraints, and recommend recovery or mitigation actions where required.
  • Support the development, review and approval of equipment, system, Level 4 and Level 5 test scripts, including integrated systems testing and load-bank testing activities.
  • Review CxA documentation and reports, including design reviews, load-bank plans, IST intent and methodology, interim reports and final commissioning reports.
  • Conduct commissioning-focused design reviews with STACK Engineering to confirm that systems are testable, safe, operable, maintainable and capable of meeting the required operational outcome.
  • Liaise with Operations to understand handover requirements and ensure operational readiness, documentation, training and outstanding defects are appropriately managed.

About you

  • Degree or trade qualification in electrical engineering or related discipline; equivalent experience considered.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience coordinating commissioning, technical assurance, factory testing or quality activities across projects, suppliers or technical teams.
  • 3–5 years' experience in electrical commissioning, factory testing, quality assurance or technical delivery within a mission-critical, industrial or regulated environment.
  • Experience with critical electrical infrastructure, including LV/MV switchboards, modular switch rooms, PDUs, UPS, generators, ATS/STS, protection and controls systems.
  • Experience managing or witnessing FATs, SATs, functional testing, defect close-out and supplier corrective actions.
  • Ability to interpret single-line diagrams, schematics, protection settings, ITPs, test procedures and technical specifications.
  • Sound knowledge of electrical safety, switching, test planning, commissioning risk management and quality-assurance practices.
  • Experience using commissioning management, quality or document-control systems.
  • Strong communication and reporting skills, with the ability to work across suppliers, engineering, construction, commissioning and operations teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Bluebeam and project-management software.

Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Associate Manager - Completion Engineering
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Accountabilities, Dimensions and Deliverables:

Ensure that the Completion engineering and operations are designed, planned, and carried out in a safe manner and that well objectives are achieved on time.

  • Ensure that all Completion engineering and operations are planned and performed in compliance with the approved Adani Welspun Exploration Ltd (AWEL) Policies and standards.
  • Carry out the necessary engineering analysis and studies to assure that the well completion designs achieve the well objectives in the most efficient manner whilst ensuring that the risks of unplanned release of fluids from the well are ALARP. This includes but is not limited to sand face completion concept selection, design, tubing stress analysis, torque/drag/hydraulics, completion fluids etc.
  • Assist in the preparation of Technical Scopes of Work for completion services in line with the tendering strategy.
  • Assist in compilation of technical evaluation sheets of all Completion contracts.
  • Assist in CWOP meetings and provide engineering input for operational planning.
  • Assist in maintaining computer models of present and planned data to track and predict key Completion parameters.
  • Work as company completion representative on rig and coordinate with service providers for successful execution of completion operations.
  • Compile well recaps including the Final Well Report and assist in organizing post well review meetings to ensure that key lessons learned are retained.
  • Assist in compilation of daily operational summary and maintain presentations for meetings.
  • Maintain well files and track performance in accordance with agreed formats.
  • Well versed with Completion software e.g., Landmark modules
  • Prepare well programs and technical documentation for completion operations.
  • Compile completion engineering documentation needed for partner’s reviews, well examination, handover and audit as required.
  • Coordinate with service providers for timely delivery of completion equipment and services.
  • Follow up the compliance with the statutory requirements, regulations, current norms, standards and rules.
  • Assist in carrying out risk assessment of each operation and communicate to relevant people.

Qualifications

  • Relevant degree
  • 5 – 7 years relevant industry experience
  • Must have a working knowledge HSE MS
  • Must have IWCF Well Control Certification at Supervisor Level

Must: 5 -7 years of relevant work experience in Completion well planning, designing and well operations.

Must have experience of OHGP and CHGP operations.

Excellent written and verbal communications skills

Work experience in a multicultural and changing environment

job.title: Senior Manager - Billing
job.description:
Contract Oversight and Administration:

Assist in managing the full lifecycle of contracts, from initiation to closeout, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and compliance with regulatory requirements.

Review and refine contract terms and conditions, coordinating with internal departments for necessary inputs and approvals.

Maintain and update contract databases, ensuring all modifications, amendments, and variations are properly documented.

Support contract structuring, ensuring each contract type (fixed-price, cost-reimbursable, time and materials, performance-based) is managed appropriately.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting:

Track and analyze contract performance data against key performance indicators (KPIs), providing insights to management for decision-making.

Prepare detailed reports and dashboards to monitor contract compliance, financial performance, and vendor effectiveness.

Highlight potential contractual issues and recommend corrective actions to optimize performance.

Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management:

Ensure contracts adhere to legal and regulatory requirements, company policies, and best practices.

Conduct initial risk assessments on contract terms and identify potential areas of exposure, escalating critical concerns to senior team members.

Support the implementation of risk mitigation strategies and ensure compliance with audit and regulatory expectations.

Tender and Procurement Support:

Assist in the preparation and submission of tender documents, including scope of work, evaluation criteria, and commercial terms.

Review and validate procurement documents, ensuring contract specifications align with project needs and business objectives.

Collaborate with procurement and finance teams to ensure smooth contract execution and timely payment processing.

Claim Management and Dispute Resolution:

Support the assessment, negotiation, and resolution of contract-related claims, ensuring minimal financial or operational impact.

Coordinate with legal and relevant teams to compile documentation, evaluate claim validity, and facilitate settlements.

Maintain a database of past claims to improve future contract structuring and mitigate risks.

Stakeholder Communication and Documentation:

Draft, review, and refine professional letters and official communications related to contracts, ensuring clarity and compliance with organizational standards.

Act as a liaison between internal stakeholders and external contractors, ensuring seamless communication and transparency throughout contract execution.

Assist in stakeholder meetings, documenting key discussions, and tracking action items related to contract management.

Continuous Improvement and Quality Assurance:

Support the implementation of contract performance and quality monitoring systems, ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and industry standards.

Identify opportunities for process improvement in contract administration and suggest best practices for efficiency.

Assist in the development of standardized templates, guidelines, and workflows for better contract management practices.

Team Support and Leadership:

Mentor and guide executives in contract management processes, ensuring consistency and adherence to organizational policies.

Collaborate with the Lead - Contract Management in executing workforce development initiatives and policy improvements.

Provide training sessions on contract-related policies, procedures, and compliance requirements for junior team members.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Lead - Contract Administration

Project Teams

Procurement Department

Legal Team

Finance Department

Key Stakeholders - External:

Vendors/Suppliers

Clients/Customers

Regulatory Bodies

Consultants

Auditors

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Law, Finance, or a related field.

Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP)

Certified Contract Manager (CCM)

Work Experience:

5-8 years of experience in Contracts Administration or a related field.

job.title: Manager- Estate Operations
job.description:
Strategic Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Ensures alignment of estate management operations with overall Admin strategy and objectives. Formulates estate management budgets, optimizing costs, and overseeing policy development and regular updates in line with business requirements.

Estate Operations:

Estate Event Management:

Governance and Compliance Management:

  • Ensures estate management processes comply with governance protocols and SOPs, and develops action plans to address audit findings and mitigate risks in estate operations.

Technology and Process Evolution:

  • Ensures the development of a comprehensive database to capture utility and requisition patterns. Analyses data to provide insights for process improvement and incorporates new technologies to enhance customer satisfaction and ease of service at the estates.

People Management:

  • Ensures efficient administrative staffing at the estates by managing regular and contractual employees, planning shifts, and overseeing training. Monitors attendance, reviews performance, and provides feedback to maintain a motivated team and ensure service delivery standards are met.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • GCPO
  • BU/Site Admin Heads
  • Security Heads
  • Admin Team
  • Group CPrO

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Service Partners
  • Event Management Companies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Hotel Management or relevant field

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • 10+ years of work experience with minimum 2 years in a team leading role in a similar position for mid-sized / large organization.

job.title: Manager, Critical Facilities
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge DC (Digital Edge) is a leading data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. We seek to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve.

Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy-efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed capital.

Founded in late 2019, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, with 30+ data centers in operations and under construction, and this role is an exciting opportunity to join the team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

The Manager, Critical Facilities forms part of the Data Center Operations function and is accountable for the safe, reliable, efficient and cost-effective operation of an assigned data center building of up to 30 MW capacity. Reporting to the country leader of Data Center Operations, the role is the accountable Data Center Operations leader for the assigned data center building and owns availability, safety, operational readiness, maintenance execution, contractor performance, compliance, team capability and financial performance.

The role leads the building Critical Facilities organization, integrating Lead Critical Facilities Technicians who run the 24/7 shifts, Critical Facilities Technicians who execute frontline operations, and building-focused Critical Facilities Engineers who work business hours and join the on-call roster for major incidents into one operating team with clear decision rights, escalation paths and performance expectations. Within an assigned building up to 30 MW, the team typically totals around 18 people, comprising 3 Critical Facilities Engineers, 5 Lead Critical Facilities Technicians, and 10 Critical Facilities Technicians.

The Manager works alongside location-based Reliability Engineers and Controls Engineers who support multiple buildings. Reliability Engineers retain ownership of reliability methodology, failure-mode analysis and maintenance strategy; Controls Engineers retain ownership of controls standards, configuration governance and controls-change authority. The Manager remains accountable for safe implementation and operational execution within the assigned building.

Key responsibilities

  • Own Data Center Operations performance for the assigned building, including availability, safety, capacity, operational readiness, service continuity, energy and water efficiency, compliance and cost.
  • Lead and develop the building Critical Facilities organization, with clear accountability across Lead Critical Facilities Technicians, Critical Facilities Technicians and Critical Facilities Engineers, and effective 24/7 coverage, competency, authorization and succession.
  • Govern building operating discipline and work control, giving final approval within delegated authority for MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, ERPs, switching, permits, change records and critical work, including approving the maintenance windows proposed by the Critical Maintenance Planner in Operations Support and releasing planned work.
  • Act as building-level management incident commander for major facility events, directing escalation, customer-impact prevention, recovery and corrective-action closure, mobilizing on-call and specialist engineering support.
  • Ensure preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance is safely executed to approved reliability strategies and controls standards, with complete CMMS records, maintenance evidence, post-work validation and spare-parts controls.
  • Partner with location-based Reliability and Controls Engineers to implement cross-building requirements, maintenance improvements and approved configuration changes, preserving clear ownership between building execution and specialist governance.
  • Own building contractor and service-provider governance, including scope, competence, safety, quality, contract compliance and performance, and ensure onsite activities are effectively controlled.
  • Ensure construction, commissioning, retrofit and expansion activities are safely integrated into live operations, with risks, defects and handover actions resolved before acceptance.
  • Own building operating and capital expenditure forecasts, audit readiness and performance reporting, and escalate material risks, incidents, customer impacts and compliance gaps to the country leader of Data Center Operations.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate

  • Significant leadership experience in mission-critical data center operations, critical facilities, industrial plant or comparable high-availability environments, including accountability for an operating building and shift-based technical teams of around 18 people.
  • Relevant degree or professional qualification in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, facilities management or engineering management, or equivalent practical experience. CDCP, CDCS or equivalent certification is advantageous.
  • Strong working knowledge of electrical distribution, switchgear, UPS and battery systems, generators, cooling, fire protection, BMS and EPMS, with working knowledge of reliability-centered maintenance, failure-mode analysis and controls-system governance.
  • Demonstrated experience governing maintenance, switching, operational risk, permit-to-work, lockout/tagout, change management, incident response and technical recovery in a live environment.
  • Proven ability to lead 24/7 operating teams, develop technical competence and maintain disciplined execution across employees, contractors and service providers.
  • Experience with CMMS, BMS and EPMS platforms, operational reporting, audit evidence, vendor and contract administration, expenditure control and applicable safety, environmental, information security, business continuity and ISO management systems.
  • Strong English-language verbal and written communication skills, with the judgment and executive presence to lead during incidents, produce high-quality reports and engage hyperscale customers and senior stakeholders.
  • Applicable local authorization or certification for electrical switching or mechanical services operations where mandated by regulation.

job.title: Solutions Architect, CIAM
job.description:

At Optus, millions of Australians trust us with their digital lives every day. How they register, authenticate, and manage their identity across every channel we operate is one of the most consequential engineering decisions we make. We are now looking for a Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of our next-generation Customer Identity and Access Management platform, and to shape how customers experience security for years to come.

This is a rare opportunity to own the architecture of a next-generation customer identity platform from day one. The platform decision has been made and the program is underway. You will step in as the solution architect, lead the transition from the current state, and then stay close to the platform as the technical authority shaping feature evolution, customer experience improvements, and emerging identity capabilities. If you want to make a lasting architectural mark on a platform used by millions of Australians, this is it.

Your day to day will consist of

  • Leading the solution architecture and transition delivery for Optus's next-generation CIAM platform, ensuring the selected platform is implemented to a standard that supports millions of customers across every channel at telecommunications scale.

  • Setting the enterprise standard for customer authentication including biometric, passkeys, WebAuthn and FIDO2, MFA, and social login, balancing security rigour with seamless customer experience.
  • Architecting SIM swap fraud prevention, account takeover defences, and credential stuffing protections specific to the telecommunications threat landscape.
  • Designing privacy-by-design frameworks that meet Privacy Act and Consumer Data Right obligations without compromising the customer experience.
  • Evaluating emerging identity capabilities including decentralised identity, continuous authentication, and AI-driven fraud detection, and translating research into actionable architecture decisions.
  • Collaborating across Digital, Marketing, Fraud, and IT to influence outcomes and ensure CIAM architecture integrates seamlessly with the broader Optus customer platform

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Significant experience in information security with a strong focus on customer identity, CIAM, or consumer authentication platforms at enterprise scale
  • Demonstrated ability to design and architect CIAM platforms or consumer authentication systems in complex, high-scale environments
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise CIAM platforms such as Ping Identity, Auth0, ForgeRock, Okta CIAM, or Azure AD B2C
  • Strong working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, API security, and mobile application authentication
  • Understanding of fraud prevention architecture relevant to telecommunications including SIM swap detection, account takeover prevention, credential stuffing, and bot management
  • Experience leading platform transitions and delivery programs, bringing architecture thinking through to implementation outcomes
  • A relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. **

  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).

job.title: Regulatory Readiness Program Manager, APAC
job.description:
Meta's Regulatory Readiness team ensures the company is prepared for the evolving global regulatory landscape. We monitor, prioritize, and drive action on regulatory developments that affect Meta's products and billions of users worldwide. Our regional teams combine regulatory intelligence and risk analysis with structured program management to ensure Meta anticipates and responds to regulatory change effectively.

We are seeking a Regulatory Readiness Program Manager to join our Asia-Pacific team. You will deliver regulatory risk intelligence, drive readiness programs, and coordinate cross-functional response to regulatory developments across one of the world's most dynamic and diverse regulatory environments.

You will also manage Meta's responses to regulatory inquiries and reporting obligations across APAC — working with subject matter experts across the company to transform complex regulatory questions into clear, comprehensive responses that tell Meta's compliance story.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who thrives on managing complex, time-sensitive regulatory workstreams across multiple stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Manage regulatory information responses and reporting — Own end-to-end management of responses to regulatory inquiries, statutory information requests, investigations, and consultations across APAC. Coordinate the preparation and delivery of transparency and compliance reports for the region, ensuring responses are accurate, consistent, and on-time
  • Coordinate cross-functional workstreams — Intake and triage new regulatory demands, develop response strategies, engage subject matter experts across legal, policy, and product teams, manage timelines, and drive accountability to meet regulator deadlines
  • Drive readiness programs and landscape monitoring — Track regulatory developments and emerging pressures across APAC to inform priorities. Manage regulatory readiness workstreams to prepare product and operations teams for new obligations and enforcement deadlines
  • Communicate and report — Produce polished executive communications on response status, compliance posture, and emerging risks. Distill complex regulatory issues into clear, actionable materials for diverse audiences
  • Build scalable processes — Develop and improve workflows, tools, and frameworks that enable the team to respond more efficiently and consistently as regulatory demands grow

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, regulatory affairs, public policy, compliance, risk management, or related fields
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, time-sensitive programs with multiple cross-functional stakeholders and hard deadlines
  • Experience working within the APAC regulatory landscape, with demonstrated depth in at least 2–3 key jurisdictions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to produce polished, executive-ready materials under time pressure
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to drive accountability in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of key APAC regulatory frameworks
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience with regulatory transparency or compliance reporting
  • Advanced degree in law, public policy, international relations, political science, or a related field
  • Experience working in global organizations across time zones
  • Proficiency in an APAC language in addition to English, as the role involves direct engagement with regulators and stakeholders across the Asia-Pacific region
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Background in managing relationships with regulators or government stakeholders
  • Experience in the technology sector, particularly around content regulation, data protection, AI governance, online safety, or platform accountability
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Senior Cost Manager
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Cost Manager is responsible for creating controls necessary to lead and administer the complete construction cost control systems. This will include how the company track’s budgets, commitments, expenditures, and forecasts that will ultimately be used to demonstrate competitive project delivery and establish strong benchmarks. This position will support all the data center projects across NTT GDC APAC

What we are looking for

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop control systems that will drive consistent, reliable, and accurate assessment of the financial position for all construction projects. This may include, but not limited to, early phase project budgeting, development of project cost program, cost report functionality, detailed forecasting methods, evaluation of cost changes, procedures for reviewing application for payments, and overall compliance to company financial requirements.
  • Analyzing and formulating meaningful information from large data sets using excel and other Microsoft products
  • Produce Executive level/ Management level reports necessary to share accurate financial position.
  • Manage the cost coding system within the construction team and integrate within financial systems.
  • Develop and implement key performance indicators to demonstrate current state project performance and detect potential issues.
  • Partner closely with design, engineering, and project management to plan the project and maintain control through the project life cycle.
  • Work closely with NTT GDCA suppliers to meet financial reporting requirements (commits, spends, and forecasts).
  • Develop program of internal and external benchmarks to enable project decision making.
  • Proactively manage budgets and potential impact to budgets. Includes development of budgets pre-design and maintaining those budgets through the project life cycle.
  • Identify project risks and opportunities and the potential financial impact that should be forecasted.
  • Manage project cost reports according to company requirements and provide regular updates on financial positions.
  • Manage detailed forecasting process and analyze data to support cash flow forecasting.
  • Evaluate supplier invoices and ensure proper payment methods are carried out on the project.
  • Expert managing complex and detailed spreadsheets to analyze data, identify trades, and enable decision making.
  • Ensure disciplined change management is implemented across the project. Will require cost analysis and potential auditing when variances arise.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Must possess a clear understanding of the full construction life cycle.
  • Proven capability to manage cost control systems on complex projects from pre-design through closeout.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving skills beyond estimating practice.
  • Capability to multi-task in a fast pace environment.
  • Ability to clearly set and lead meetings to develop strong project control systems.
  • Ability to be highly confidential.
  • Proficient with computers to include the utilization of Microsoft programs such as Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Strong and proven capability using excel to analyze large data sets.
  • Ability to work in a team environment.
  • Manages stress and/or fast pace effectively.
  • Excellent analytical, creative thinking, written and verbal communication skills.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • 7-10 years’ experience with construction cost management responsibilities that may include preconstruction planning, cost management strategies, cost coding structures, commits/spends/forecast processes, reviewing contractor’s cost proposals for major engineering and construction projects.
  • Experience with Construction Cost Accounting Software.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Primarily sitting with some walking, standing, and bending.
  • Able to hear and speak into a telephone.
  • Close visual work on a computer terminal.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate any required computer keyboard, mouse, and other technical instruments.
  • Able to lift and carry up to 20 lbs.

WORK CONDITIONS

  • Extensive daily usage of workstation or computer, thus must have high speed internet.
  • This role is expected to be remote with an occasional need to be on-site in a shared space. Ability to travel up to 25%.
  • Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.
  • Exposure to outdoor weather conditions.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Talent Attraction and Process Excellence Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

Cummins is seeking a dynamic and innovative Employer Branding & Process Excellence Manager to support Talent Acquisition across India and the Pacific region. This role will lead initiatives that strengthen our employer brand, enhance recruitment processes, advance technology and AI adoption, improve diversity hiring outcomes, and deliver actionable talent insights. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping the future of Talent Acquisition by driving operational excellence, innovation, and candidate experience across multiple markets.

Key Responsibilities Employer Branding & Talent Attraction

  • Develop and execute employer branding strategies across India and the Pacific region.
  • Lead recruitment marketing campaigns and talent attraction initiatives.
  • Partner with Communications, HR, and business stakeholders to strengthen Cummins' employer value proposition.
  • Manage employer brand presence across digital platforms, universities, and professional networks.
  • Develop engaging content and campaigns to enhance awareness of Cummins as an employer of choice.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Talent Acquisition processes.
  • Standardize recruitment operations and establish best practices across markets.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and stakeholder experience.
  • Support change management and adoption of new processes and ways of working.

Technology Enablement & AI Innovation

  • Lead adoption and optimization of recruiting technologies and digital solutions.
  • Partner with HR technology teams to implement enhancements and automation opportunities.
  • Identify innovative applications of AI throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
  • Support pilot programs, technology deployments, and capability-building efforts across the region.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

  • Support and advance diverse hiring strategies across India and the Pacific region.
  • Develop partnerships and sourcing channels that broaden access to diverse talent pools.
  • Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, and HR leaders to promote inclusive hiring practices.
  • Monitor hiring trends and recommend initiatives that strengthen workforce representation.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain talent acquisition dashboards, reports, and insights.
  • Analyze recruiting trends, labor market data, and talent metrics to support business decisions.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations to Talent Acquisition and business leaders.
  • Support workforce planning, forecasting, and executive reporting activities.

Stakeholder & Project Management

  • Lead cross-functional projects and Talent Acquisition initiatives.
  • Build strong partnerships with HR, Communications, Technology, and business leaders.
  • Coordinate regional and global programs that support Talent Acquisition transformation.
  • Drive communication, governance, and knowledge-sharing across the Talent Acquisition community.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, HR Operations, Process Improvement, HR Technology, or related areas.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects and change initiatives.
  • Experience working with data, analytics, and reporting tools.
  • Exposure to recruitment marketing, digital transformation, or talent technology solutions is preferred.

Skills

  • Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Experience driving process improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Curiosity and passion for emerging technologies, including AI and automation.
  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, matrixed, and global environment.

Why Join Cummins?

At Cummins, you'll have the opportunity to influence how talent is attracted, engaged, and hired across 20 countries, diverse and growing regions. You'll work at the intersection of people, technology, and innovation while helping shape the future of Talent Acquisition through transformative initiatives that create meaningful business impact.

Competencies:External Talent Sourcing - Identifies and applies appropriate candidate sourcing methodologies and tools to identify, attract and engage a diverse pool of talent in the external market.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Human Resources Consulting - Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.

Human Resources Business Process Execution - Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Interpersonal savvy - Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

Situational adaptability - Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.

Tech savvy - Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications.

Education, Licenses, Certifications: Professional certifications in project management, HR management, or directly related to the 30% or equivalent experience are preferred.

Experience: Good depth of experience in project support or management, preferably within a Talent Acquisition or HR function, demonstrating a capability in managing projects or components within larger programs.

Good to have 12+ years into the same domain.

This role operates across the India and Pacific region, partnering with global Talent Acquisition, HR Technology, Communications, and business leaders to drive strategic talent initiatives. The position is responsible for adapting global programs to regional needs, leading cross-country projects, influencing diverse stakeholder groups, and identifying innovative practices that enhance employer brand, recruiting effectiveness, technology adoption, and candidate experience across multiple markets and cultures.

Additional Job Details

The Employer Branding & Process Excellence Manager role is a strategic capability position part of the Talent Acquisition CoE transformation & GTM. The role consolidates employer branding, process excellence, AI and technology enablement, diversity hiring, and reporting responsibilities that are currently dispersed across several roles and functions. Role creates accountability, accelerates transformation initiatives, improves operational effectiveness, and supports the long-term TA CoE operating model across India & Pacific Region.

job.description:
Job Summary

Technical specialist and primary customer support contact to diagnose and execute complex repairs to generators and components at the customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

stablishes and continually develops productive customer relations and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs

Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete complex repairs at customer site.

Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on power generation products in the field

Escalates unresolved issues to product specialists / Supervisor

Coaches and develops technicians and/or apprentices and transfers knowledge and experience to others; may provide work direction; may review of repair plans, parts lists, etc

Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens.

Completes training in line with skill and business requirements

Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation

Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

job.title: Manager Manufacturing Process Quality
job.description:
Job Description

We're seeking a quality professional to drive excellence across our manufacturing operations. If you're passionate about process improvement, problem-solving, and ensuring product safety, this role offers the opportunity to make a measurable impact on customer satisfaction and operational performance.

What will you do?

  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective action initiatives to minimize quality risks in manufacturing processes
  • Execute process audits and champion quality culture to strengthen compliance and continuous improvement
  • Oversee change management for new manufacturing lines and process changes with rigorous quality oversight
  • Collaborate with procurement and operations teams to address supplier quality issues and implement solutions

What are the key skills we are looking for?

  • Quality Strategy— expert level; developing site-level quality roadmaps that align with business objectives
  • Problem Solving— advanced level; resolving complex manufacturing quality issues using structured methodologies
  • Process Auditing— advanced level; conducting thorough assessments to ensure compliance and identify improvement opportunities
  • PFMEA— advanced level; identifying and mitigating potential failure modes in manufacturing processes
  • Quality in Manufacturing and Distribution— advanced level; ensuring product integrity throughout the production lifecycle
  • Quality Management Systems— advanced level; maintaining and improving QMS frameworks to meet regulatory standards
  • Root Cause Analysis— intermediate level; investigating quality events to prevent recurrence
  • Process Control— intermediate level; monitoring and optimizing manufacturing parameters for consistent quality

  • Effective influencing skills to drive change and build quality culture across teams
