job.title: Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect, Professional Services, ProServe India
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) is looking for an experienced Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect to join our India team. As a key member of the strategic account team, you will lead technical sales engagements, shape solution architecture, and influence revenue throughout the sales cycle for some of the largest enterprises in Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail.

You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption — from migration and modernization to cloud-native applications and emerging technologies such as generative AI and agentic AI. You will create and lead the solution design that delivers each customer's business outcomes. Working as the link between ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) and our Delivery teams, you will make sure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and make the best use of ProServe and our partners. We are expanding our teams targeting Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail industry segments in India, and this is a compelling time to join and help shape how these customers build on AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead cloud solution design during pre-sales engagements: run demonstrations, conduct initial scoping, and architect scalable, secure AWS solutions across Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises.
  • Design complex AWS solutions, estimates, and proposals that deliver customer business outcomes, defining project scope and technical approaches for Statements of Work using ProServe offerings and delivery kits.
  • Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations while advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders on cloud modernization, generative AI, and agentic AI strategies.
  • Ensure smooth hand-offs to Delivery teams so that scope, architecture, and expected outcomes are fully understood at launch, and lead delivery of complex engagements as needed, including migrations, data and analytics, and application development.
  • Share knowledge across the organization through mentoring, reusable artifacts, and contributions to ProServe best practices, and represent AWS ProServe at customer events and industry conferences across India.

A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for a customer's cloud migration, then join a working session with their engineering team to refine a data warehousing solution. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder review presenting progress and recommendations to senior executives. Later, you collaborate with partners and internal teams to scope a new engagement, before wrapping up by documenting reusable patterns from a recently completed project to share across the organization.

About the team Our ProServe team in {ADDRESS} works with some of the country's largest Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises to help them realize their cloud ambitions on AWS. You will partner closely with PAEs who own the customer relationship, Delivery teams including Engagement Managers and Delivery Consultants, AWS account teams and Solutions Architects, AWS Specialists including the Generative AI Innovation Center, and AWS Partner Network (APN) partners. Together, this ecosystem turns architectures into measurable customer outcomes.

As an industry subject matter expert, you will help define cloud operating models, drive strategic enterprise transformation, and set up Cloud Centers of Excellence. We are building an inclusive team culture where knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. If you want to help shape how India's largest enterprises innovate with the cloud, we would love to hear from you.

About AWS: Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
  • 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
  • Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
  • Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
  • Experience presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments
  • Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
  • Experience communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
  • Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
  • Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
  • Experience with broad enterprise systems work including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
  • Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (like TOGAF, Zachman) and identifying the relationships between business services, information, applications and global infrastructure assets
  • Knowledge of compliance and security standards across the enterprise IT landscape
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
  • Familiarity with the Indian market, digital transformation initiatives (for example Digital India and government cloud policies) and regional compliance requirements (for example RBI, SEBI and IRDAI guidelines, and the DPDP Act)
  • Experience designing generative AI, machine learning and data analytics solutions
  • Experience with large-scale migration programs (1,000+ servers) using AWS migration tools and methods
  • Software development experience in an object-oriented language

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer, APAC Substation Design Engineering
job.description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Electrical Engineer to become part of a world class engineering team to lead the Electrical design of our Data Center Substations across our rapidly expanding Asia Pacific (APAC) portfolio.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We're looking for candidates that share our customer obsession by providing innovative solutions to enhance our market leading reliability. Technical leaders that can explain complex systems in clear and concise language. We contribute to our global body of knowledge and drive a cycle of continuous improvement at a global scale.

We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience across the project lifecycle from concept design through construction, to commissioning and handover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, consultants and contractors.

Key job responsibilities The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for the following:

  • Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
  • Work with internal teams to understand user requirements.
  • Design and manage high and medium voltage substation systems on concurrent projects across multiple geographical regions
  • Develop comprehensive electrical infrastructure designs using advanced engineering software
  • Collaborate with regional vendors, manufacturers, and utility providers to specify optimal electrical equipment
  • Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.
  • Work with local utilities to understand and define site utility requirements.
  • Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes.
  • Review and approval of equipment submittals.
  • Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.
  • Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems.
  • Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed.
  • Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.

About the team We are a global engineering team dedicated to continuous improvement and technological excellence. The APAC HV Design team thrives on challenging conventional approaches and creating scalable, efficient power infrastructure such as High Voltage Substations and Grid Connections. We value creativity, technical expertise, and a collaborative spirit that drives Amazon's mission forward.

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
  • 4+ years of commissioning experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
  • Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
  • Experience in commissioning
  • Bachelor’s degree in an electrical engineering or equivalent, including a minimum of 5 years of substation design experience.
  • 4+ years of Experience developing design documentation (plans, specifications, etc) for construction and/or permitting.
  • Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
  • Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
  • Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
  • Experience with design or construction administration of a variety of electrical distribution systems ranging from low voltage to high voltage

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer License
  • Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
  • Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
  • Professional Engineering or Architectural License
  • 3+ years of experience directly related to substation design supporting data center or mission critical facilities.
  • Solid understanding of critical data center electrical equipment.
  • Possess leadership and problem solving skills.
  • Be a motivated, highly dependable individual.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Engineering Manager- TCMS
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Engineering Manager - Traction

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead the Train Control and Management System (TCMS) engineering function for railway transportation applications for ABB India, with responsibility for technology strategy, engineering delivery, software development, system integration, product quality, and customer satisfaction.

The role will drive the development and delivery of reliable, safe, scalable, and cost-effective TCMS solutions for metro, commuter rail, EMU/MEMU, and locomotive applications, aligned with customer requirements, applicable railway standards, and ABB's global engineering processes.

The work model for the role is: #LI_Onsite

This role is contributing to the Motion business for Traction division based in Bangalore, India:

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Engineering Leadership & StrategyDefine and implement the TCMS engineering strategy in alignment with business objectives and global technology roadmaps.
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary engineering teams covering TCMS engineering, application engineering, and verification and validation.
  • Establish engineering capacity planning, resource allocation, competency development, and succession planning.
  • Drive engineering excellence, productivity, standardization, and continuous improvement across projects.
  • Build a strong technical organization with clear ownership, accountability, and performance metrics.

TCMS Product Development & System Architecture

  • Lead TCMS architecture, functional design, software development, configuration management, and system integration.
  • Ensure integration of vehicle control, propulsion, auxiliary converters, braking, train communication networks, HMI, diagnostics, passenger information, and other vehicle subsystems
  • Govern interfaces between TCMS, propulsion control unit team and with customer.
  • Drive reusable software platforms, modular architectures, product standardization, and localization initiatives.
  • Ensure appropriate cybersecurity, safety, reliability, maintainability, and lifecycle management practices.

Project Execution & Engineering Delivery

  • Take ownership of engineering deliverables, milestones, resource loading, and technical risks across multiple projects.
  • Ensure timely delivery of software releases, engineering documents, interface specifications, test procedures, and validation reports.
  • Drive resolution of critical technical issues during laboratory testing, combined system testing, vehicle integration, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
  • Coordinate with project management, Global TCMS team, sourcing, quality, service, and global engineering teams.
  • Manage engineering changes, deviations, configuration baselines, and product maturity throughout the project lifecycle.

Verification, Validation & Quality

  • Establish a robust verification and validation strategy covering unit, software integration, system integration, vehicle-level, and regression testing.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable railway standards and customer-specific requirements, including IEC 61375, IEC 62279, IEC 62425 and EN 50126/50128/50129, wherever applicable to the system and project.
  • Drive prevention, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure engineering readiness for type testing, validation, customer witness testing, and commissioning.
  • Strengthen requirements traceability, test coverage, design reviews, and release governance.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the senior engineering interface for customers, rolling stock manufacturers, system integrators, and railway authorities.
  • Lead technical reviews and resolve complex engineering issues with customers and suppliers.
  • Align engineering scope, interfaces, responsibilities, assumptions, and acceptance criteria with stakeholders.
  • Support technical proposals, tender reviews, design feasibility, risk assessment, and engineering cost optimization.
  • Develop strong collaboration between Indian engineering teams and global technology centres.

Business & Financial Performance

  • Align engineering investments, headcount, and capability development with business growth and project pipeline.
  • Drive engineering cost optimization, localization, productivity improvement, and reuse of existing platforms.
  • Support bids and order acquisition through technical strategy, solution validation, and realistic engineering estimates.
  • Monitor engineering KPIs, including on-time delivery, software release maturity, defect leakage, rework, productivity, and resource utilization.
  • Identify opportunities for new product development, technology differentiation, and expansion into emerging railway markets.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Typically, 15+ years of experience in railway engineering, TCMS, embedded systems, control systems, or rolling stock electronics.
  • Significant experience leading engineering teams and delivering complex railway projects.
  • Strong understanding of TCMS architecture, train communication networks, embedded software, system integration, verification and validation.
  • Experience in metro, EMU/MEMU, locomotive, or other rolling stock applications.
  • Familiarity with railway RAMS, software lifecycle processes, safety engineering, cybersecurity, and applicable railway standards.
  • Experience in global engineering collaboration, customer management, project execution, and cross-functional leadership.

Critical Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and technology development. Engineering organization leadership and talent development.
  • Strong system-level problem-solving and decision-making. Stakeholder management and customer orientation.
  • Business acumen, cost consciousness, and execution discipline. Ability to balance technology innovation, project delivery, quality, and profitability.

Reporting & Key Interfaces

  • Reports to: Head of Engineering / Engineering Director / relevant business engineering leader, depending on ABB's organizational structure.
  • Key interfaces: Global R&D, TCMS and propulsion engineering, project management, product management, quality, supply chain, manufacturing, service, customers, and rolling stock OEMs.

More about us

ABB Traction Division is a recognized leader in onboard propulsion technologies that drive innovation in rail, bus, and industrial vehicle electrification. A comprehensive range of high-performance and full lifecycle managed propulsion, auxiliary and energy storage solutions help improve energy efficiency and contribute to making transportation more sustainable.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Senior Global Data AI Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A

Mission of the Role

Do you enjoy turning real business challenges into working AI solutions? Would you like to do it at a global company that is changing its industry with new technology? ABB is looking for a hands-on AI/ML Engineer to join our Information Systems (IS).

This is a specialist role where you build the solutions yourself. It is not a coordination or management role. You will work with the business to understand its needs and then find the best answer. That could be a predictive model, an LLM or SLM, an AI agent, a GenAI application, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. You will take that solution from idea to production and keep it running well in operations.

If you have experience with Azure AI/ML, Snowflake, GenAI and MLOps, and you want to own solutions from start to finish across both Dev and Ops, this opportunity is for you!

Work model: Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

Responsibilities

Business understanding and solution design

  • Work with business stakeholders and Data Analysts to clarify needs, requirements, expected outcomes, success measures, data and context requirements, risks and ownership.
  • Decide which approach fits each business problem best: AI/ML, GenAI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. This includes choosing the right model type (ML, LLM, SLM), the right agent design and the right technology.
  • Design scalable solutions that follow enterprise architecture, security and governance standards, with guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and platform architects.

Build and deploy

  • Develop, validate and deploy production-ready AI/ML solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry and other approved technologies.
  • Build ML and GenAI applications, including predictive models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, AI agents, APIs, orchestration, retrieval and enterprise data integrations.
  • Build and integrate LLM-based solutions and conversational agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and, where appropriate, Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Support Copilot and other AI platforms, such as Anthropic models.
  • Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to build predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents that deliver measurable business value.
  • Build secure, reliable data ingestion and processing from Snowflake and other enterprise sources, with attention to data quality, lineage, access control and cost efficiency.
  • Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.
  • Develop reusable components and automated pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, inference, evaluation, testing, deployment and retraining, using CI/CD and version control.

Evaluate, operate and improve (DevOps / MLOps / AIOps)

  • Evaluate model accuracy, explainability, grounding, agent behaviour, safety, business value, performance, reliability and cost.
  • Set up and run MLOps/AIOps practices: monitoring, drift detection, cost monitoring, root-cause analysis, retraining and continuous improvement. You own both development and operations.
  • Contribute to production readiness, operational handover, incident and problem analysis, monitoring design and reliable day-to-day operations.
  • Apply Responsible AI, information security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, secrets management and other ABB requirements within your solution scope.

Ownership and collaboration

  • Own your deliverables end to end. Estimate effort, manage priorities, report progress and risks, and work independently within the agreed architecture and platform guardrails.
  • Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, platform specialists and domain experts.
  • Document solution logic, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results and operational requirements. Contribute reusable assets, engineering practices, knowledge sharing and mentoring.

Requirements

Education and experience

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, analytics engineering or related roles, including taking AI/ML solutions to production.
  • Experience delivering AI/ML solutions end to end: business requirements, data preparation, development, validation, deployment and monitoring.

Technical skills

  • Practical Python and SQL skills for data preparation, model development, API integration, testing and implementation.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry: pipelines, compute, environments, model deployment, endpoints, agents and evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of GenAI patterns: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, agent design and evaluation.
  • Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing.
  • Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake AI/ML tools (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors.
  • Experience analysing, modelling and integrating SAP and Salesforce data. This means understanding source data structures, business entities, relationships and transformation requirements.

Operations and governance

  • Understanding of how AI/ML solutions run in production: monitoring, reliability, performance, cost management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud security, privacy, compliance, data governance and Responsible AI principles.

Communication and language

  • Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions, explain options and trade-offs, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1).

Nice to Have / Differentiators

  • Experience with LLM frameworks such as the Azure OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent.
  • Experience with other AI platforms and models (e.g., Anthropic, SLMs).
  • Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) or Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300).
  • Snowflake certifications, such as SnowPro Core or relevant GenAI certifications.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
  • Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Streamlit or other data visualisation tools.
  • Knowledge of Azure infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: networking, VNets/private endpoints, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, containers, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
  • Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep or Terraform).
  • Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to shared engineering standards and reusable assets.

What We Offer

  • The chance to be part of a global company working on high-impact industrial projects.
  • A collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a strong development culture.
  • Room to grow on a solid technical career path at ABB.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Group Product Manager, Information and Infrastructure Protection
job.description:
About the job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In this role, you will be responsible for the direction of our endpoint protection portfolio. You will manage a team of Product Managers (PMs) based in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, fostering a culture of technical excellence and user-centricity. You will also have Individual Contributor (IC) responsibilities in key areas. You will drive the global roadmap for endpoint security, bridging the gap between customer insights and engineering. You will develop customer insights and translate them into an actionable roadmap.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Own the multi-year product strategy for enabling Endpoint Security Risk reduction goals, identifying internal and external shifts and other considerations, and translating them into a concrete, actionable roadmap.
  • Manage and coach a regional team of PMs, with responsibility including hiring, performance management, and career development, ensuring the team is motivated and aligned with Google’s security goals.
  • Serve as the site lead for PMs in APAC region, ensuring the region has a voice in global product decisions and fostering collaboration across time zones.
  • Drive the product lifecycle, from initial concept through to global launch and scaled adoption, partnering with Engineering, Technical Program Management (TPgM), and User Experience (UX) to deliver security services with minimal disruption to productivity.
  • Own the end-to-end adoption lifecycle of security policies, translating technical mandates into clear, empathetic communications and low-friction user experiences.

job.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Developer AI, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose, providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product road map. You will embed with the engineering organizations of our largest customers and take Google's developer AI Gemini Code Assist, anti-gravity Integrated Development Environment (IDE), Software Development Kit (SDK), Command Line Interface (CLI) and the agentic surfaces beneath them from the first conversation to a production-grade workflow. You will find what actually slows an engineering organization down, design the system that fixes it, and own it end-to-end like discovery, build, roll-out, hardening, and the long tail of making it reliable.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Design and deploy production-grade agentic developer workflows on Google Cloud's AI stack, executing large-scale refactors, language migrations, Specification-to-Pull Request pipelines, and automated review/incident-to-fix loops.
  • Embed with customer's staff engineers and leaders to identify core SDLC bottlenecks, such as legacy migrations, test coverage, review latency, or onboarding friction, and define success metrics.
  • Integrate Google’s agentic systems into the customer's existing ISV and tools (e.g., Teamwork Graph, GitLab, ServiceNow, Slack) leveraging MCP and A2A protocols.

job.title: Customer Engineer, Platform, FSI, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

In this role, you will partner with business teams to differentiate Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to the customers and serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans while using the business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics, etc. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to show the value of GCP portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

job.title: Staff Research Software Engineer, Google Research
job.description:
About the job

Google Research Singapore is the very latest addition to the Google Research presence around the globe. This is an incredible opportunity to be advancing the frontier of AI capabilities in Singapore. The team delivers research on algorithmic efficiency, and inference acceleration, directly impacting how next-generation AI models will be deployed to billions of people.

In this role, you will sit at the heart of advancing fundamental capabilities of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive significant benefits to humanity. You will have the chance to help build a team from the ground up. You will be pioneering AI research in Singapore, focusing on enabling the most performant, ultra-efficient and capable Generative AI Models. You will be making pioneering breakthroughs towards Computational Efficiency for serving and deployment of large-scale Generative AI Models (e.g., Large Language Models (LLMs), Diffusion Models, Generative Videos). You will be a technical leader of a small and agile team, in an extremely fast-paced environment in close collaboration with other teams at Google.**

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement novel algorithms that optimize the inference stack for LLMs to ensure the highest througput and lowest latency for billions of users including sampling techniques, speculative decoding advancements, model compression, knowledge distillation and quantization strategies.
  • Work on development and optimization of the low-level software that runs AI models efficiently. Implement and optimize custom kernels for inference, focusing on improving latency, throughput, and memory usage, across different hardware and model architectures.
  • Co-design algorithms that exploit the unique architectectural advantages of custom hardware and accelerators. Collaborate with hardware architects on next-generation systems and use a deep understanding of both model architecture and hardware to inform algorithm selection.
  • Amplify impact and influence the research ecosystem through publications and scientific dissemination.

job.title: Test Engineer
job.description:
About Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls, we’re shaping the future to create a world that’s safe, comfortable, and sustainable. Our global team creates innovative, integrated solutions making the people, facilities, and assets safe with our industry-leading security solutions. We are passionate about improving the way the world lives, works, and plays.

About Security Access Control Business

When Fortune 500 corporations, government customers, or any other enterprise applications concerned with critical security issues need a reliable solution in their day-to-day operations, often, they turn to Johnson Controls and its security and event management technologies currently installed in thousands of facilities worldwide. Johnson Controls has built a solid reputation in the security industry as an innovator of security and event management technologies. With its continuous investment in R&D, and the ability to leverage innovative technologies, Johnson Controls has reached technological excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of development of the next generation of AI-driven security solutions. Your role will have a large impact being part of a growing QA team. Technology you test and support will be used to protect people, facilities, and assets, at scale around the world. Which is pretty world-changing and exciting!

We are investing heavily for growth of our QA team and looking for change agents with big bold ideas and a highly collaborative working style. This might just be THE impactful role you have been looking for!

About the Role

As a Software QA Engineer, you will be responsible for validating the quality, reliability, and usability of Enterprise Manager, Exacq, and related ACVS solutions. You will work closely with developers, product management, and fellow QA engineers to ensure high-quality software releases.

This role requires a well-rounded QA engineer who can contribute across manual testing, automation, API testing, integration testing, and system validation. The ideal candidate is curious, eager to learn, takes ownership of assigned features, and is comfortable working in both manual and automated testing environments.

What You Will Do

  • Execute functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end -to-end testing.
  • Develop and maintain automated test cases for web, API, desktop, and mobile applications.
  • Participate in test planning, test execution, defect tracking, and release validation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and assist developers in troubleshooting issues.
  • Validate cloud services, server applications, APIs, and integrated security solutions.
  • Test integrations between video management systems, access control systems, and third- party platforms.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, test coverage, and automation efficiency.
  • Contribute to continuous improvements in QA processes and automation coverage.
  • Take ownership of assigned features and ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Create and execute test cases and test scenarios.
  • Automate repetitive test cases using Python, Robot Framework, Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools.
  • Perform API testing using Postman, Swagger, REST APIs, or similar tools.
  • Validate logs, databases, and system behavior during issue investigation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives.
  • Support both manual and automation testing activities based on project needs.
  • Collaborate effectively with development, QA, support, and product teams.
  • Utilize GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Atlassian Rovo, or similar AI tools to accelerate testing and analysis activities.

What we look for Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Software QA, Test Automation, or Software Testing.
  • Experience performing manual and automation testing.
  • Experience testing web applications, APIs, and client-server applications.
  • Knowledge of automation tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of software testing concepts, SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle.
  • Experience using Jira, Zephyr, TestRail, or similar test management tools.
  • Basic knowledge of Linux, Windows, and networking fundamentals.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD concepts.
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Exacq, Cloudvue, Enterprise Manager, VideoEdge, CCure, Kantech, or similar security platforms.
  • Experience with Access Control, Video Surveillance, Enterprise Monitoring, or Physical Security products.
  • Experience with REST APIs and microservices.
  • Knowledge of SQL and database validation.
  • Experience testing Android and iOS applications.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, or cloud-native applications.
  • Experience using GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, ports, protocols, and Wireshark.
  • Exposure to performance, scalability, and reliability testing.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong ownership and accountability.
  • Willingness to work on both manual and automation testing.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.
  • Self-motivated and proactive problem solver.
  • Ability to work beyond assigned stories when needed to help the team achieve sprint goals.
  • Strong collaboration skills and positive attitude.
  • Interest in AI-assisted engineering and continuous improvement.

Location

  • Hybrid position based in India.
  • Hyderabad or Gurgaon preferred.
  • Ability to collaborate with global teams and provide overlap with EST business hours as needed.

job.title: Senior Sustainability Analyst
job.description:
About Goodman

At Goodman, your career is more than just a job – it’s about growth, innovation, and making a lasting impact. Whether you’re building your career in property, data centres, finance, legal, or beyond, we value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about driving our business forward.

As providers of essential infrastructure for the digital economy, Goodman has been developing its data centre capability since 2005. Since then, we have grown to become a large owner of powered sites globally. Our global power bank of 5.0GW includes completed facilities, secured power and potential data centre projects across 13 major international cities. This has been built up over time through our expertise in securing land, planning and power in highly sought after locations in major global cities.

Senior Sustainability Analyst - 12-month fixed term contract

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Sustainability Analyst to take a lead role in greenhouse gas emissions accounting, climate reporting and sustainability performance across Goodman’s Australian business and property portfolio.

This is a hands-on specialist role with genuine ownership. You’ll lead the annual emissions inventory and reporting process from data collection and calculation through review, assurance, approval and disclosure, working across Sustainability, Finance, Risk, Legal, Property, Developments and other teams.

Beyond emissions reporting, you’ll contribute to climate resilience, sustainability data and governance, helping ensure our reporting is accurate, well controlled and useful for business decision-making.

What you will do

  • Lead Goodman Australia’s end-to-end greenhouse gas emissions inventory and reporting process across Scope 1, Scope 2 and relevant Scope 3 emissions.
  • Apply the GHG Protocol and relevant Australian requirements to maintain robust methodologies, boundaries, assumptions and emission factors.
  • Coordinate climate and emissions reporting requirements, including AASB S2 / ASRS, NGER where applicable, investor and partnership reporting and broader corporate commitments.
  • Own the collection, validation and reconciliation of emissions data, identifying anomalies, resolving gaps and challenging assumptions where required.
  • Maintain clear, auditable calculation models, methodologies, controls and supporting evidence.
  • Coordinate external assurance and technical advisers, managing information requests, findings and data or control improvements.
  • Translate complex emissions information into clear insights, trends and recommendations for management and governance forums.
  • Support portfolio climate risk and resilience activities including physical and transition risk assessments, scenario analysis and adaptation priorities.
  • Work with data platforms, utility providers and internal teams to continually improve sustainability data quality, controls and reporting processes.
  • Contribute to broader sustainability priorities including embodied carbon, life cycle assessments and industry or policy initiatives.

What you'll bring

You’ll be a technically strong sustainability professional who enjoys getting into the detail but can also step back and explain what the numbers mean.

Ideally, you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years’ experience in greenhouse gas accounting, climate reporting, sustainability reporting, assurance, advisory or a comparable corporate role.
  • Strong practical knowledge of the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, Scope 2 Guidance and Scope 3 Standard.
  • Experience managing a complex reporting cycle involving multiple data owners, reviewers, advisers, assurance providers and senior stakeholders.
  • Understanding of Australian climate and emissions reporting requirements, ideally including exposure to ASRS/AASB S2 and NGER.
  • Strong analytical capability across large and complex datasets, including validation, reconciliations, variance analysis and audit trails.
  • Advanced Excel skills and ideally experience with sustainability data and reporting platforms such as Envizi, Power BI or similar.
  • The ability to turn technical emissions and climate information into clear, practical insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • A relevant qualification in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, accounting, finance, data analytics or a related discipline.

Experience within property, infrastructure, the built environment or another asset-intensive sector would be valuable, as would exposure to external assurance, utility data, embodied carbon, life cycle assessment, Green Star, NABERS, GRESB or climate risk assessment.

You’re methodical, curious and comfortable taking ownership of complex work. You care about getting the detail right, but you’re equally prepared to question a methodology, challenge an assumption or follow an issue through until it is resolved. You’ll work independently while building strong relationships across the business and will be comfortable balancing technical rigour, commercial judgement and competing reporting deadlines.

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

job.title: Senior Engineer, Senior AI/ML Research-1
job.description:
About the role

As a Senior AI/ML Research Engineer, you will apply advanced AI/ML methods to engineering and industrial use cases. You will combine research, experimentation, evaluation, and production grade software engineering to turn promising models, methods, and existing tools into reliable, agent-accessible capabilities.

This role is ideal for a technically strong researcher and builder who can move from an engineering problem to a validated approach, then help convert that approach into a reusable production component.

What you will do

  • Apply AI/ML methods to challenging engineering and industrial use cases.
  • Research, prototype, and evaluate approaches using frontier AI models and related techniques.
  • Convert existing models, tools, and analytical capabilities into agent-accessible artifacts.
  • Translate successful experiments into reusable software and platform components.
  • Design and execute evaluation, benchmarking, and validation approaches.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, cloud architects, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Contribute to requirements, specifications, constitutions, contracts, context, and AI harnesses.
  • Use GitHub workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD practices to integrate and validate work.
  • Deploy and evaluate capabilities using GCP or comparable cloud services.
  • Communicate technical findings through internal documentation, publications, patents, or open-source contributions.

Required qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a relevant technical field.
  • Five to eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience applying AI/ML methods to engineering, manufacturing, industrial, or comparable technical use cases.
  • Experience building agentic AI systems.
  • Experience converting models and tools into agent-accessible artifacts.
  • Experience with GCP or comparable cloud platforms.
  • Experience with GitHub, CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • Evidence of technical contribution through publications, patents, or open-source work.

What success looks like

  • You deliver validated AI/ML capabilities for multiple engineering use cases.
  • You convert selected existing models and tools into reusable, agent-accessible artifacts.
  • You establish repeatable evaluation and benchmarking practices.
  • You contribute production-ready components to the shared architecture.
  • Your work demonstrates measurable value for engineering users.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Software Engineering Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

JOB PURPOSE

The Software Engineering Manager would provide leadership in the design, development, and deployment of Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital products within the areas of e-commerce. This position is accountable for hiring, managing, and mentoring multiple software engineers and pod leads who are transforming and building a world-class eCommerce application, in line with the CAT Digital Strategy.

We are looking for a Software Engineering Manager with expertise and passion to imagine, build and develop innovative products. This is a high growth space and a big opportunity that needs a dynamic product creator. The ideal candidate will be curious, have attention to detail, be energized by a dynamic environment, be comfortable with strategic thinking while also diving deep.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead strong development teams and build creative technology solutions that positively impact international customers, relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will identify, hire, and build world-class teams of Software Engineers to define, drive, and execute on our strategic vision. You will improve/initiate processes that allow these teams to collaborate with local as well as global teams with a high degree of efficiency. You will develop teams of highly motivated and talented individuals that can collaborate with Project Managers, Product Managers and Software Engineers across the company on a high impact initiative. You will design, build and own features and programs that will delight our dealers / customers.

This key role is expected to establish and mature product software engineering capability in India. The role will report to CAT Digital India Senior Engineering Manager.

JOB DUTIES

  • The position supports the CAT Digital strategy, recognizes the service requirements/needs of dealers and customers, corporate and business unit goals, and gives input to leadership in formulating global concepts, strategies and plans to deliver service solutions.
  • Typical internal customers include various contacts throughout Caterpillar worldwide and its subsidiaries. External contacts include various customers, dealers, and vendors throughout worldwide markets.
  • The role is responsible for the overall development life cycle of the solution and manage complex projects with significant impact.
  • Responsibilities include supervising a team and a project related to developing business and technical solutions.
  • Work with product managers in developing a strategy and road map to provide compelling capabilities that helps them succeed in their business goals.
  • Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best technical design and approach for new product development.
  • Continuously improve and drive engineering best practices around software engineering & lead the craftsmanship, resilience, and scalability of our solutions. Establish durable ways of working with product peers and other internal engineering teams.
  • Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, including outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity.
  • Project management - prioritization, planning of features, Stakeholder management and tracking of commitments. Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
  • Career management and development of direct reports: The position is responsible for all personnel issues and performance evaluation of subordinates, as well as overall employee satisfaction for the division.
  • Provides technical support, and direction to teams and pod leads. Acquires resources necessary to accomplish work on time.
  • Coordinates walkthroughs and reviews; ensures conformance to standards and adherence to design specifications.
  • The position is challenged to carefully evaluate problems and provide input into many possible solutions before selecting one option. Problems may be complex and can require developing and monetize new solutions.
  • The leader follows general policies and guidelines for projects under his/her control to ensure specific, management goals are met and desired results are achieved. Impacts key quality goals including Customer Satisfaction, Continuous Improvement, and Reoccurring Revenue, Timeliness, Accuracy, Efficiency, Cost Savings, Process Quality, etc.
  • S/he should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. S/he would need to also balance technical leadership with savvy business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.
  • Employee is also responsible for performing other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Position requires a four-year degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Fifteen + years or more of experience in designing and developing software applications in Java or Scala or at least ten years of experience in Java with master’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • Three years or more of experience in managing 8 to 14 member cross functional team.
  • Five years or more of experience in public cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure.

Top candidates will also have:

  • Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities.
  • Ability to cope with shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize, delegate responsibilities and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
  • Oversees performance of individual team members and team as whole. Identifies and addresses staff training and development needs.
  • Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
  • Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints.

Passion for technology and innovation.

  • Ability to provide guidance in applying the right architectural design pattern for the modernization of the applications by analysing the gaps between existing architecture and new business requirements.

Proven experience in many of the following:

  • Designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining software at scale.
  • Application architectural patterns, such as MVC, Microservices, Event-driven, etc.
  • Technical expertise in building a complex open-stack, microservices-based platform or product that is highly reliable, and scalable.
  • Message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Apache ActiveMQ, Kinesis.
  • Datastores such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL.
  • Developing software applications using relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Deploying software using CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GoCD, Azure Devops etc.
  • Working within an Agile framework (ideally Scrum).
  • Researching data to support design decisions.
  • Must demonstrate solid knowledge of computer science fundamentals like data structures and Algorithms.
  • Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of ecommerce platforms like HCL Commerce (WCS) Version 8.0+ or equivalent; WebSphere Commerce subsystems - Trading, Catalog Management, Order Management, Member Management Sub-system, etc
  • Must Have - Deep hands-on expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot.
  • Nice to Have - Certifications in AWS/Azure, MongoDB/Redis.
  • Nice to Have - Hands-on experience on React, Typescript, JavaScript frameworks.
  • Nice to Have – BPMN/Workflow/Rules Engine technology like Camunda, Temporal, Drools.

job.title: Inventory Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Research, develop, implement and monitor inventory management and distribution logistics systems, concepts and procedures for worldwide parts inventory and operations management.

The primary goal is to support the Product Support & Logistics (PSLD) division’s effort in achieving the inventory and customer service objectives. As an Inventory Analyst, you will have responsibility for ensuring the complete and successful testing and conversion planning of all PIC functions in dealers’ ERP conversion projects, and contribute to design, development, and deployment of the new PIC Data Analytics Suite (DAS).

What You Will Do

  • Develop automated processes to aid in data cleansing and maintenance using analytical tools (SQL, SAS, Python, PowerBI).
  • Develop and test new reporting tools, following standards and best practices.
  • Support 24x7 PIC systems for dealer order recommendations, willing to work in Europe / US time zone.
  • Performing work to achieve corporate supply chain performance targets focused on inventory reduction, increased inventory turns and improved parts availability.
  • Working effectively with diverse, multi-functional teams to apply the supply chain logistics process and leading team efforts to develop a lean parts distribution network.

Degree Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering / Math’s / Science / Commerce.
  • 2 to 3 years’ relevant experience in data analytics and visualization tools.

What You Have Business Acumen:Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Comments on the organization's business model and financial goals.
  • Communicates key considerations for business decision making process.
  • Cites examples of types of information needed to make sound business decisions.
  • Participates in business task to get things done in own unit or area.
  • Caters to key stakeholders and their priorities.

Standard Operating Procedures: Knowledge of established standard operating procedures (SOP); ability to design, implement and evaluate standard operating procedures affecting daily and strategic business operations in order to increase operational efficiency. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Compiles current research relevant to standard operating procedures.
  • Explains usage of standard operating procedures in business operations.
  • Describes main issues and considerations when using standard operating procedures.
  • Identifies key features and functions of standard operating procedures.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Problem Solving:Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Data Gathering and Reporting:Knowledge of tools, techniques and processes for gathering and reporting data; ability to practice them in a particular department or division of a company. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Detects and summarizes patterns in data and findings by producing simple reports.
  • Assesses common problems and obstacles surrounding data-gathering.
  • Customizes data fields to meet clients' needs.
  • Interprets and explains results of a data-gathering initiative.
  • Participates in projects to gather data for needs analysis.

Data Visualization: Knowledge of principles, techniques and processes of data visualization; ability to create high quality figures effectively for various business scenarios and storytelling. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Creates figures for regular data visualization tasks in an honest and compelling way.
  • Develops or uses appropriate tools and software, such as Tableau and Data wrapper, to generate different types of data visualization.
  • Follows established standards and procedures to obtain, aggregate and analyze data for visualization.
  • Outputs statistical models into charts, graphs and maps to demonstrate outliers, patterns and trends of data.
  • Employs data visualization in documents or reports to tell informative and compelling stories.

Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Tools:Knowledge of electronic data interchange tools; ability to design, implement and maintain tools and facilities in order to establish a computer-to-computer interchange of electronic data among organizations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Maps EDI data within appropriate applications; develops and test new maps.
  • Assists in the development of tools and techniques for electronic data interchange.
  • Adheres to electronic data interchange standards, policies and guidelines.
  • Operates main functions of electronic data interchange tools and facilities.
  • Compares different applications for use in different electronic data interchange situations.

Inventory Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods of inventory management; ability to effectively manage local or distributed inventories of raw materials, work-in-progress and finished goods. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows processes to take stock, release inventory or return into processing; resolves discrepancies.
  • Tracks inventory information for a specific product group or location.
  • Works with basic tasks of inventory management for a specific location.
  • Produces basic inventory management reports for senior staff to reconcile the inventory balances.
  • Performs the receiving, ticketing, checking in and distributing of inventory items for a specific location.

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of India which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Final Details:

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!
