job.title: Regional Certification Liaison 1
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Product Compliance Engineer – Genset Compliance Management

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Product Compliance Engineer to lead product safety and compliance management activities for generator set (Genset) products across countries in Rest of World (RoW - Europe, Middle-East, Africa, Asia Pacific, Australia-NZ and Latin America other than United States and Canada). This role is responsible for ensuring products meet all applicable regulatory, safety, and industry certification requirements.

The successful candidate will act as the primary interface between the engineering organization and certification agencies in respective regions that could include UL, CSA, and other recognized certification and regulatory bodies, ensuring timely certification, maintenance of approvals, and resolution of compliance-related issues. The role requires close collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Operations, Quality, and external agencies to support product development, certification, and market access objectives.

This position also requires periodic travel to test laboratories and certification facilities to witness product testing, support certification activities, and ensure compliance requirements are met. In addition, the role will be responsible for establishing and continuously improving compliance management processes and governance frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Management

  • Manage regulatory and compliance requirements for generator set products marketed in countries other than the United States and Canada.
  • Knowledgeable in applicable standards, codes, and regulations relevant to gensets and associated electrical systems.
  • Ensure products maintain compliance including new product development, product changes, and sustaining engineering activities.
  • Monitor evolving regulatory and certification requirements and assess impact on products and business operations.

Certification & Agency Management

  • Serve as the primary technical contact for certification agencies,
  • UL / CSA Group
  • EU Regulatory & Certification requirements covering the Machinery, EMC, RoHS & Noise Directives
  • Other certification, testing, and regulatory organizations as required
  • Coordinate certification projects, audits, inspections, and follow-up activities.
  • Manage certification documentation, test reports, technical files, and approval records.
  • Drive timely closure of certification findings, non-conformities, and compliance gaps.

Engineering Support

  • Provide compliance guidance to product development and engineering teams during design and development phases.
  • Review product designs, drawings, specifications, and change requests for compliance impacts.
  • Support root cause investigations and corrective actions related to compliance issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance requirements are incorporated into product designs.

Regulatory Support & Consultation

  • Respond to compliance and regulatory inquiries from:
  • Engineering teams
  • Sales and commercial teams
  • Operations and manufacturing teams
  • Quality and service organizations
  • Provide technical guidance on the application of standards and certification requirements.
  • Support customer and regulatory compliance documentation requests.

Testing & Validation

  • Coordinate compliance testing activities with internal teams and external laboratories.
  • Develop test plans and compliance validation strategies.
  • Travel to certification laboratories and test facilities to witness testing and represent the company during certification evaluations.
  • Review and approve testing documentation and certification evidence.

Process Development & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop, implement, and maintain compliance management processes, procedures, and governance models.
  • Establish compliance metrics, reporting mechanisms, and tracking tools.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve compliance efficiency, reduce certification lead times, and improve product readiness.
  • Support compliance training and awareness programs across the organization.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering / Power Generation, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Master's Degree is preferred but not required.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in product compliance, certification, regulatory engineering, or related technical roles.
  • Experience with generator sets, power generation equipment, industrial electrical products, or similar engineered products preferred.
  • Strong experience working with certification agencies and notified bodies for EU Regulatory certification. Working knowledge on RoHS, Outdoor Noise and other related EU Directives.
  • Experience managing third-party testing and certification projects.
  • Experience interpreting and applying Global product safety and compliance standards.

Technical Skills (Top Skills Required)

Regulatory & Compliance Expertise

  • Strong knowledge of RoW product compliance requirements for electrical and power generation equipment.
  • Ability to interpret and apply regulatory requirements and industry standards.

Certification Management

  • Experience coordinating certifications with:
  • UL / CSA Group
  • EU Notified Bodies

job.title: IT Techno Functional Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

This role is responsible for the delivery, support, and continuous improvement of Transportation, Procurement, and Logistics IT solutions. The incumbent partners with business stakeholders, vendors, and IT teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure technology capabilities that enable critical supply chain operations.

The position participates in all phases of the solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution delivery, testing, implementation, production support, service management, and continuous improvement. The role contributes to operational excellence through automation, AI-enabled capabilities, process optimization, and data-driven decision making to improve business outcomes, service reliability, and user experience.

What You Will Do: - Functional & Technical skills:

  • Strong knowledge of Supply Chain and Transportation Logistics, including international planning and execution, inbound and outbound transportation, multimodal operations (ocean, air, ground), freight visibility, analytics, consolidation, and network optimization.
  • Experience with transportation platforms such as Blue Yonder (JDA) Transportation Management, E2open, Infor Nexus (GT Nexus), and related logistics technologies.
  • Demonstrated Functional Analyst expertise with end-to-end product lifecycle ownership across Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
  • Partner with business, operations, and product stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze processes, define functional and non-functional requirements, and develop solution designs aligned with business objectives.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
  • Lead and support all phases of the product lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, release planning, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage and continuously improve transportation technology products through ServiceNow-based service management processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Knowledge, and Service Request Management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues within established service level agreements (SLAs), coordinating with business teams, vendors, and support partners.
  • Support and coordinate major incident management, root cause analysis, problem resolution, and corrective action planning to improve system stability, resilience, and business continuity.
  • Coordinate cybersecurity vulnerability management activities, including risk assessment, remediation planning, patch coordination, security compliance, audit support, and timely closure of application and infrastructure vulnerabilities in partnership with security, infrastructure, and vendor teams.
  • Manage application maintenance, environment management, server patching, platform upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives to maintain secure, reliable, and compliant systems.
  • Drive operational excellence through automation, AI-enabled capabilities, self-service solutions, intelligent monitoring, predictive analytics, and process optimization initiatives that improve efficiency, service quality, and user experience.
  • Measure, monitor, and improve service performance, operational processes, standards, and support effectiveness using data-driven metrics and continuous improvement practices.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive test strategies, test plans, regression suites, and validation processes to ensure solution quality and release readiness.
  • Develop and maintain deep functional, operational, and technical knowledge of transportation processes, applications, integrations, and emerging industry trends.
  • Working knowledge of modern application architecture, Java/J2EE technologies, Spring Framework, REST APIs, SQL, Oracle/Snowflake databases, OpenShift, DevOps practices, and distributed system troubleshooting.

Additional Information

Experience: 4+ years of IT experience in application development, support, services and product delivery

Education: BE / B Tech / MCA

Shift: Project dependent

  • 1 PM IST to 10 PM IST (North America & Europe Operations)
  • 7:30 AM IST to 4:30 PM IST (Asia Pacific Operations)
  • Weekend deployment activities & support (On-demand – Monthly or emergency release)

What You Have:

Operational & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Develop and maintain strong business, operational, and technical knowledge of transportation, procurement, and logistics processes and solutions.
  • Effectively manage multiple assignments, projects, support activities, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Apply analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify issues, evaluate options, and recommend solutions.
  • Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional IT teams.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrate accountability, ownership, and follow-through in assigned work and issue resolution.
  • Adapt quickly to changing business priorities, technologies, and operational requirements.
  • Demonstrate initiative, learning agility, customer focus, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Top candidate might also have

  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder (JDA) TM, E2open, Infor Nexus (GT Nexus), and related transportation technologies.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM), Microsoft Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
  • Knowledge of Java, Python, SQL, middleware technologies, APIs, and data formats such as REST, JSON, XML, and EDI.
  • Understanding of SOA, messaging, and enterprise integration concepts.
  • Experience supporting enterprise applications, incident and problem management, and production operations.
  • Knowledge of automation, AI-enabled capabilities, observability, monitoring, and cybersecurity best practices.

The successful candidate will possess strong written and verbal communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions and support. The individual should be self-motivated, accountable, and capable of working independently while effectively collaborating with global business and IT teams. Flexibility to support global operations, production deployments, critical incidents, and continuous improvement initiatives is expected.

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of India which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Final Details:

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Job Purpose

Identify, Align and establish a world-class supply base in the India region to maximize Quality, Cost, Logistics, Delivery, and Management (QCLDM) within the supply network. In addition, implement well-documented continuous quality improvement process and robust process controls at work. Ensure our supply base able to meet corporate and business unit requirements of SER (Supplier Excellence Recognition) certification levels and customer requirements for quality, cost, and delivery of purchased material.

Job Description

Caterpillar India has an exciting opportunity for a Supplier Development Engineer in our Caterpillar, Thiruvallur facility. This is an exciting Strategic Sourcing role within the Drivetrain Components division for the Casting and Machining Category, focusing primarily on suppliers in the India region and on Caterpillar Production and Service facilities worldwide.

Job Responsibilities are:

  • Supplier Evaluations and Certification: Knowledge of supplier evaluations and certification; ability to identify the methods, tools and documentation for evaluating, selecting and certifying worldclass supply base for our business.
  • Supplier Development & Process Establishment: Developing and fostering strong relationships with suppliers that will yield optimized and repeatable delivered quality. Also, will support suppliers in improving their performance through process enhancements, implementing process controls, and developing quality assurance plans to ensure sourced parts from suppliers meet all the quality requirements for the numerous sourcing projects.
  • Production Part Approval Process (PPAP): Knowledge of Production Part Approval Processes (PPAP) elements, submissions, and objectives; ability to determine whether a supplier can manufacture products that meet the quality requirements and standards of their customers consistently.
  • Coordination & Collaboration: Coordinate with engineering personnel on matters regarding Concurrent Product and Process Development (CPPD), New Product Introduction (NPI), New Source Introduction (NSI), Continuous Process Improvement (CPI) teams; prove design to production, engineering changes, deviations, supplier designs, specification approvals, meeting cost reduction goals, and participates in the Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) process with suppliers manufacturing processes.
  • Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Supports and participates in BIQ, LEAN initiatives with facilities, category teams, and suppliers. The incumbent will collaborate with Buyers to improve supplier cost, quality, and throughput.

  • Educational Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical / Manufacturing / Production / Industrial Engineering or Equivalent Qualification in Engineering
  • Work Experience: Minimum of 10 ~ 15 years, primarily on Casting, Machining & Inspection, and adequate knowledge of Foundry & Machining process, Heat Treatment, etc.,
  • Strong on Machining GD&T, Machining Processes and CMM Inspection etc.,.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, enabling effective collaboration with internal teams, stakeholders, and suppliers.

  • Strong leadership ability to influence cross-functional teams for effective planning & implementation.
  • Well-developed interpersonal skills in dealing with sensitive issues, developing others, and reaching consensus on specific actions.
  • Proficiency in data-driven decision making, with a demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret data to inform strategic decisions.
  • 6 Sigma experience with tools, techniques and/or Lean Manufacturing preferred but not essential.

Additional information:

  • Work location - Thiruvallur

job.title: Senior Manager, Marketing
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Marketing Manager, EBG Central Marketing, will lead the Enterprise Central Marketing function and provide dotted-line governance across service-line marketing activities. This role will strengthen StarHub Enterprise’s brand positioning, elevate market awareness, and ensure closer alignment between business priorities and go-to-market execution. By driving a more coordinated and commercially focused marketing agenda, the role will support Enterprise’s growth priorities across customer acquisition, retention and services adoption.

As the Enterprise business scales in the region, this role will provide both strategic and executional marketing leadership to ensure marketing plans are aligned with business priorities, measurable and commercially impactful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of structured go-to-market marketing plans across Enterprise business priorities, service lines and customer segments.
  • Establish a coordinated marketing operating rhythm across Central Marketing and service-line marketing teams to improve visibility, prioritisation and execution consistency.
  • Execute integrated marketing plans with clear objectives, target audiences, messaging, timelines, ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Strengthen marketing discipline across campaign planning, customer targeting, value proposition development, market positioning, sales enablement and performance tracking.
  • Partner with Sales and Service Lines to develop customer-centric campaigns that support pipeline generation, account engagement, customer retention and cross-sell or upsell opportunities.
  • Strengthen Enterprise’s market positioning through consistent messaging, differentiated value propositions and client-centric use cases.
  • Ensure marketing efforts are aligned to overall Enterprise growth strategy, with a focus on driving awareness, demand generation, customer engagement and service adoption.
  • Oversee Enterprise brand and communications initiatives, including executive messaging, client success stories, thought leadership content, internal communications and external-facing marketing assets.
  • Collaborate with Group Brands & Communications to ensure Enterprise messaging is aligned with overall Group brand guidelines while addressing specific B2B audience needs.
  • Lead strategy and content development for the Executive Briefing Centre, ensuring it serves as a strategic client engagement platform for strategic and key partners.
  • Develop marketing performance dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track campaign effectiveness, marketing contribution and business impact.
  • Establish clear governance for marketing planning, budget prioritisation, campaign performance reviews and service-line marketing alignment.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification would be advantageous.
  • At least 10 to 12 years of relevant B2B marketing experience, preferably within ICT and managed services.
  • Proven experience leading integrated go-to-market campaigns, enterprise marketing strategy, sales enablement, executive communications and client engagement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, account-based marketing, solution marketing, pipeline generation and customer lifecycle marketing.
  • Experience working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams in a matrixed organisation.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate business priorities into marketing plans that drive measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation and influencing skills.
  • Strong people leadership experience, with the ability to coach, mentor and develop marketing talent.
  • Comfortable operating at both strategic and executional levels, from shaping marketing strategy to driving hands-on delivery.
  • Data-driven and outcome-oriented, with experience tracking campaign performance, marketing ROI and business impact.

The Senior DevOps Engineer will be involved in the end-to-end delivery lifecycle including solution design, application development, QC testing, CI/CD automation and continuous optimization of cloud-native platforms. The candidate will need to manage Kubernetes operations, infrastructure provisioning and software upgrades to ensure systems remain reliable, secure and scalable. The candidate will be working in a team in routine on-call rotations to support day-to-day operations, incident resolution, customer care and defect fixes.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Development:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and resilient microservices using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Camel and its core Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs).
  • Implement RESTful APIs and ensure services meet performance, security, and stability requirements.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and efficient code following best practices and design patterns.

Containerization and Deployment:

  • Develop and manage services deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes, including defining Dockerfiles and Kubernetes resource configurations (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, etc.).
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) for automated build, test, and deployment.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot services running in the OpenShift environment.

Architecture and Data:

  • Contribute to the architectural design of microservices, focusing on principles like loose coupling, high cohesion, and fault tolerance.
  • Implement various data persistence technologies, including relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
  • Integrate services using messaging systems (e.g., Red Hat AMQ) where required.

Collaboration and Quality:

  • Perform code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge within the team.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and industry regulations by performing security vulnerability scans (SAST, DAST, SCA) and disaster recovery exercise.
  • Support on-call duty on shift rotation and handle production incident and root cause analysis with minimal supervision.

Knowledge Management:

  • Build technical documentation from scratch, maintaining working documents on architecture overviews, API specifications and system integrations.
  • Create and maintain operational runbooks to support the team and internal stakeholders.

AI Competency:

  • Familiar with or have experience in agentic SDLC with competencies in prompt and context engineering, agent orchestration and supervision, and AI assisted delivery.
  • Automate data gathering, pattern finding, auto fixing or self-healing with anomaly detection and analysis.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Java Expertise: Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using Java and the Spring Boot framework.
  • Microservices and API: Strong understanding of microservices architecture, principles, and best practices. Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for deployment and orchestration. Experience with OpenShift-specific features is a significant advantage.
  • Database: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Tools: Familiarity with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools.
  • Combined experience in DevOps, SRE, or Software Engineering.
  • Familiar with containerized environments, Kubernetes internals, and Helm.

  • Solid understanding of AWS core services, IAM security, and cost-optimization practices.
  • Comfortable with Linux internals, networking fundamentals, and shell scripting.

  • Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience with AIOps practices and tools is an added advantage.

job.title: Senior Staff Data Scientist - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Data Scientist designs and deploys statistical, forecasting, and machine learning solutions to solve complex business problems. This role works with cross-functional teams to build production-ready models, generate actionable insights, and improve planning and decision-making at scale.

The role requires strong expertise in statistics, time series analysis, probabilistic forecasting, machine learning, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Responsibilities

Statistical Modeling & Forecasting

  • Build and deploy statistical and probabilistic forecasting models for demand, capacity, and trend analysis
  • Apply time series methods including regression-based models, ARIMA/SARIMA, and state-space models
  • Define modeling assumptions, forecast uncertainty, and evaluation methods

Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling

  • Build and deploy machine learning models for forecasting and prediction, including regression, tree-based models, gradient boosting and neural networks
  • Select statistical or ML approaches based on accuracy, interpretability, robustness, and operational needs
  • Develop features and run experiments to improve model performance

MLOps & Production Deployment

  • Own the model lifecycle, including development, backtesting, deployment, monitoring, and retraining
  • Implement model monitoring, performance tracking, and data drift detection
  • Ensure models are versioned, reproducible, and production-ready

Data Engineering & Modeling

  • Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and hypothesis testing on large, complex datasets
  • Identify data requirements for forecasting and predictive modeling, including key inputs, data gaps, and quality needs
  • Work with big data technologies and distributed data processing to support scalable modeling
  • Partner with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, availability, and efficient data pipelines

Visualization & Insights

  • Create visualizations to communicate forecasts, trends, and model outputs
  • Translate model results into actionable insights for business and operational stakeholders

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with product managers, engineers, and business teams to define forecasting and analytics requirements
  • Communicate modeling approaches, assumptions, and results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or machine learning
  • Strong foundation in statistics and experience applying statistical methods in production
  • Proven experience with time series analysis and probabilistic forecasting
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning models such as regression, boosting, and neural networks
  • Experience owning production data science models, including deployment and monitoring
  • Experience working with large datasets and using SQL and Python for analytical and modeling workflows
  • Proficiency in Python and common DS/ML libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch/TensorFlow)
  • Experience working on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field

job.title: Specialist - Spend Analytics
job.description:
Role: Specialist - Spend Analytics

Location: Gurgaon

Full/ Part-time: Full Time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the role

The Specialist – Spend Analytics will be responsible for transforming procurement spend data into actionable cost intelligence to drive insights and strategic decision-making related to procurement and cost optimization, generating actionable intelligence for the Global and Regional supply chain teams to achieve financial goals and improve overall operational efficiency. The role combines rigorous spend analytics with deep should-cost expertise — leveraging tools such as aPriori to build fact-based cost models that challenge supplier pricing, identify savings opportunities, and support high-stakes negotiations. A working knowledge of AI and machine learning techniques for spend analytics, anomaly detection, and pattern recognition will be a strong advantage, enabling the specialist to continuously elevate the analytical maturity of the COE and deliver commercially impactful outcomes at scale.

Key Responsibilities

A. Spend Data Analysis & Interpretation

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of spend data to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies across categories and suppliers.
  • Utilize statistical techniques and data visualization tools to transform complex datasets into clear, meaningful insights for stakeholders.
  • Leverage tools such as Python, R, VBA, and advanced Excel to build scalable analytical workflows and automate repetitive data processing tasks.
  • Apply machine learning techniques to enhance spend classification, outlier detection, and predictive analytics capabilities.
  • Increase automation across key steps of the spend analysis lifecycle to improve speed, accuracy, and consistency of outputs.
  • Deliver robust, audit-ready spend analysis that supports strategic sourcing decisions at both global and regional levels.

B. Should Costing & Cost Intelligence

  • Build and validate detailed should-cost models for Build to Print categories including plastics, Sheet Metal, pressure die cast (PDC) components, machining, leveraging knowledge of raw materials, manufacturing processes, and cost drivers.
  • Maintain and continuously refine cost models using aPriori or equivalent tools to reflect current market dynamics and input cost movements.
  • Drive cost reduction initiatives through value engineering, design-to-cost analysis, and supplier negotiations.
  • Partner with engineering and commodity teams to apply should-cost outputs to RFQ benchmarking and fact-based negotiation preparation.

C. Market Intelligence & Sourcing Strategy

  • Monitor global market trends, raw material indices, supplier landscapes, and technological developments in the HVAC and related industries.
  • Leverage market intelligence to inform sourcing strategies, risk mitigation plans, and cost management decisions.
  • Identify alternative suppliers, emerging markets, and innovative manufacturing processes to enhance competitiveness.

D. Negotiation Preparation

  • Prepare structured negotiation packs for category managers, including should-cost breakdowns, market benchmarks, supplier scorecards, and price-volume analyses.
  • Conduct supplier cost walk-throughs and price justification reviews to equip sourcing teams with robust challenge frameworks.
  • Model negotiation scenarios and sensitivity analyses, including the impact of raw material price movements on target pricing.
  • Track negotiation outcomes and feed results back into cost models and spend databases to improve future analytical cycles.

E. Implementation & Value Capture

  • Drive or support the execution of initiatives generated from spend analytics, converting insights into real, measurable savings.
  • Ensure consistent tracking and reporting of value capture against identified savings pipeline.

F. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organisation — supply chain, engineering, operations, and quality — to understand spend analysis requirements and translate them into actionable insights.
  • Present findings, opportunity assessments, and recommendations in a clear and compelling manner to senior leadership.
  • Provide guidance and support in interpreting spend analytics findings and implementing recommendations across functions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops to align on category strategies, savings priorities, and data quality improvement plans.

G. Continuous Improvement & Governance

  • Drive process improvements in sourcing, RFQ management, cost analysis, and spend reporting cycles.
  • Ensure compliance with procurement policies, contracts, and ethical sourcing standards.
  • Support digitalization and analytics initiatives, including deployment of BI platforms and AI-driven spend intelligence tools, to enhance sourcing effectiveness.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited institution in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Data Science, or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years of experience in spend analytics, strategic sourcing, or cost engineering within a manufacturing or industrial procurement environment.
  • Strong understanding of part cost structures, manufacturing processes, and tooling across key direct spend categories.
  • Hands-on experience with aPriori or similar should-cost software is mandatory.
  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML techniques applied to procurement analytics is a strong plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for analytics and presentations is mandatory.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with strong interpersonal abilities for stakeholder management.
  • High learning agility, accountability, and effective collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a global environment with stakeholders located in different regions.
  • Strong attention to detail with sharp observational skills to identify issues accurately and articulate findings effectively.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.

  • Have peace of mind and body with our health insurance
  • Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
  • Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

job.title: Senior Engineering Officer
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact

  • Co-ordinate closely with INOC (Integrated Network Operation Centre) on the timely fault clearing and service restoration of access and transmission equipment in order to meet the SLA (Service Level Agreement).
  • Troubleshoot fault related to access and transmission equipment. Escalation to tier two technical support if need arises.
  • Responsible for the daily schedule preparation and timely execution of the site survey, installation (including patching work) & commissioning, testing, replacement and preventive maintenance of access and transmission equipment to meet customer and operational requirements.
  • Monitor the health and performance of the access and transmission equipment in the network and carry out remedial action accordingly.
  • Provide support for re-routing or diversion activities during cable related service incident.
  • On standby duties and silent hour recall. Work on irregular hours, such as at night and on public holiday, weekends, at very short notice when need arises.
  • Coordinate with planner and contractor on the recovery of transmission equipment including shutting down of non-working equipment.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Skills for Success

  • O Level /A level or ITE in Mechanical Engineering / Electrical engineering or equivalent. Alternatively, the candidate must have minimum three years working experience in the grade of Engineering Officer (Technician) or equivalent experience.
  • Good knowledge on telecommunications engineering and the working concepts of the transmission systems. Experience and knowledge in transmission equipment will be an added advantage, such as SDH, GPON, MD, MSAN, IAD, CE, NGCE, IPMD).
  • Good knowledge on Fiber patching, Testing, troubleshooting, and is able to use OTDR, power Meter, other fiber testing tolls to isolate the fault
  • Good interpersonal and communications skills and the ability to work as a team.
  • Able to work during non-office hours on an occasional basis and be on 24 x 7 hours standby alert for ad-hoc faults.
  • Good analytical troubleshooting skills in the area of technical fault isolation.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Business Support Engineer - AdTech
job.description:
We are looking for an engineer to play a key role in providing technical, engineering support to Meta’s Advertising partners, Customers and clients globally. You will have the opportunity to work together with a global team of Business Support Engineers who are expert in Meta’s Adtech to provide proactive and reactive support for partner issues and integrations while partnering with our broad cross functional teams to ensure a high quality for our products and satisfactory experience for our partners and customers. We work directly with Platform and Infrastructure teams to investigate and resolve issues reported by our partners, to properly assess and agree on actions to be taken for necessary fixes and continuous improvements in our products and deployments.

As a Business Support Engineer working on Ads at Meta, you will primarily support on Meta’s Ads Products but also have the opportunity to work cross-functionally in several of our key business areas across Business Messaging, Telecommunications and combine your experience with customer service skills with a product focus to ensure that key insights are communicated to our product teams. We are looking for people who have subject-matter knowledge in managing and maintaining integrations with 3rd-party services, who help foster developer/business relationships, who demonstrate critical thinking & blending systems design with business needs, and who have a desire to improve the support experience of our customers. You will understand industry trends, partner solutions/integrations and their implications for our product roadmap. You will work closely with other regional offices and partnership teams to support a broad range of partners across the globe to integrate Meta’s Business Products into their offering.

Responsibilities

  • Provide proactive and reactive engineering support for partners, independently managing complex outages to ensure high partner satisfaction
  • Troubleshoot large-scale distributed systems and partner integrations, maintaining reliable systems through thorough debugging, root-cause analysis, and follow-up improvements
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, automate repetitive tasks, and scale your impact with an 'AI native' mindset
  • Build, launch, and optimize AI solutions using Llama and other LLMs, owning the full lifecycle from prototype to production
  • Develop performance monitoring systems for partner integrations to ensure high availability; leverage metrics to proactively identify issues and drive improvements across teams
  • Provide 24/7 oncall support coverage via a rotation schedule (including weekends)
  • Collaborate with Platform and Infrastructure teams to investigate issues, align on fixes, and drive continuous product improvement
  • Create clear documentation, specs, guides, and presentations to communicate complex AI concepts to diverse audiences, scaling the team's knowledge internally and externally
  • Drive end-to-end execution, using sound judgment to manage stakeholder expectations and ensuring clear alignment. Develop and share AI/ML expertise, actively coach and mentor other engineers on technical troubleshooting and project executions
  • Proactively and independently analyze information to identify specific trends/opportunities, recommend appropriate and relevant tactical improvements, anticipate future business needs to improve the overall support experience, and share this knowledge across the team

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or site reliability engineering or support engineering
  • Proven experience in API development on cloud-based infrastructures, with the ability to debug, identify root causes, and independently resolve outages impacting Meta partners
  • Experience with the full web stack, REST APIs, Python, PHP/Hack, and JavaScript/React development, along with debugging and bug management
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning and optimization of PyTorch models and with at least one LLM, such as LLaMA, GPT, Claude, Falcon, etc
  • Experience in communicating with technical and business audiences, and writing technical documentation
  • Experience in assessing, analyzing, and resolving operational issues using data analysis (SQL)
  • Experience in managing multiple concurrent projects and driving initiatives in a cross-functional environment
  • Professional working proficiency in English is required because this role involves close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external customers whose primary business language is English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Open Source cloud stacks like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Docker containers
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Experience transforming data, model selection/training/optimization, and deployment at scale
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Hands-on experience working with large language models and AI agents
  • Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience working in engineering environments with geographically distributed, cross-cultural teams and international stakeholders
  • Experience in partner-facing or customer-centric engineering roles
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Strategic Customer Engagements, Asia Pacific and Japan, GDSP
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Deal Negotiator for the Strategic Customer Engagements (SCE) team. This is a unique opportunity to engage with AWS customers on strategic opportunities, increase the growth of AWS in the APJ region, and to establish AWS as customers' key cloud technology provider.

As a Senior Deal Negotiator, you will analyze and develop deal terms, review and simplify complex scenarios, and craft elegant deal solutions. You will work with customers and internal stakeholders to define and communicate streamlined deal workflows, build consensus, and close commercial transactions. In this customer facing role, you will focus on AWS Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs) to formulate and close PPAs, coordinate critical phases of simultaneous and multiple deal cycles, and ensure consensus with all relevant stakeholders.

You will own alignment with C-level executives, IT teams, and multiple lines of business to achieve business outcomes, increase the adoption of AWS services, and to enable private pricing, go-to-market, pan-Amazon, and other strategic relationships.

Key job responsibilities

  • Engage directly with the customer on commercial and contractual terms.
  • Close commercial transactions: brief senior management and coordinate internal and customer stakeholders.
  • Facilitate alignment and effective AWS communication. Inspire and influence internal stakeholders, experts, and other indirect resources to remove obstacles, resolve conflict for productive engagements.
  • Execute deal and competitive structures: maximize the value of opportunities consistent with AWS objectives and requirements.
  • Advise and provide thought leadership on the execution of competitive commercial, channel, and partner deal opportunities.
  • Provide expertise on deal structuring and advise key stakeholders on the impact of deal terms: provide creative solutions to the customer, the AWS sales field, and leadership.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

job.title: Data Center Electrical Facilities Technician, Electrical
job.description:
About the job

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers. You will lead and ensure the electrical system compliance including local legal and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) policies. You will ensure electrical system reliability, and lead the commissioning activities functional test and Integrated System Test (IST). You will manage and support electrical system operation, and lead the electrical system maintenance program including preparing the technical specification, procurement and maintenance vendor performance management.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain and manage data center electrical systems, including medium and low voltage, ensuring uptime through maintenance, operation, troubleshooting, repair, and execution of operational procedures, responding to work requests and providing technical ability.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for service failures, implement recovery and prevention actions, and drive improvement in site water usage effectiveness and power usage effectiveness to minimize environmental impact and enhance system reliability.
  • Lead and support the startup, commissioning, and integration of new equipment and systems into the facilities infrastructure, coordinating vendor support and participating in system design reviews for new projects and modifications.
  • Ensure compliance with all site environmental health, safety policies, and legal requirements, while developing infrastructure knowledge and providing training to the team.
  • Maintain operational availability by working 12-hour rotating shifts, including weekends and holidays.

job.title: Construction Manager (Silverdale)
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity at one of ANZ’s leading data centre developers.

  • Industry leader with strong project pipeline
  • Collaborative and Fast-Paced Environment
  • Leadership role on large NZ Data Centre Program

About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are responsive, innovative and trusted in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

Join CDC as a Construction Manager in Auckland where you'll play a key role in delivering our data centre construction project on time and within budget. You'll oversee project delivery and join a high performing client-side team delivering projects for Silverdale and Hobsonville Campuses. Working closely with the nominated PCBU and subcontractors, you'll ensure both internal and external teams collaborate effectively to deliver high-quality builds and infrastructure installations.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Oversee the flow of technical information between engineering disciplines and stakeholders in construction projects, ensuring compliance with specifications and standards
  • Manage construction contracts, including due diligence and compliance for third-party agreements, on behalf of CDC
  • Report to the Head of Construction on project progress, forecasting, budget control, procurement, and schedule updates
  • Ensure end-to-end oversight of assigned construction projects, focusing on value management, safety, structural adequacy, and verification of contracted works
  • Identify opportunities to optimise delivery, timelines, or innovation and liaise with consultants as needed
  • Conduct meetings and maintain regular communication with key stakeholders, including CDC Service Managers and Engineers, from design through to handover
  • Build strong partnerships with suppliers and vendors while collaborating with peers to enhance the function’s capability within CDC
  • Contribute to the growth of the CDC team, providing leadership, mentoring junior staff, and fostering a positive culture
  • Act as an ambassador for the company, leading and participating in team and stakeholder meetings to ensure effective engagement and communication.

About you

You have a proven experience managing large-scale, complex building projects, ideally in critical infrastructure environments like data centres or hospitals. You bring strong leadership skills, a sharp eye for detail, and the ability to identify risks and solve issues early. Your solid understanding of mechanical and electrical elements, building methods, and safety regulations helps you confidently manage projects from start to finish. You're a clear communicator, able to work effectively with stakeholders, and have a strong focus on safety, quality control, and delivering high standards in every project you take on.

  • New Zealand citizen or permanent resident with ability to obtain and maintain a NZ Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

Diversity helps us all achieve more. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success and a culture of trust and care. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. At CDC we’ve got your back. We’re dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work, giving you the confidence to achieve more.

job.title: Vice President Security Risk and Resilience (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Vice President Security Risk and Resilience leads the security, enterprise risk management, business continuity, operational resilience, crisis management and assurance functions across APAC Critical Operations. The role is accountable for protecting people, customers, assets, information and operations by establishing the governance, standards and resilience frameworks required to support a safe, secure, reliable and scalable Critical Operations organisation.

The Vice President directly leads and develops Site Security Managers across APAC, providing clear regional direction and ensuring consistent security leadership, customer service, compliance, incident response and performance standards across STACK sites.

The Vice President serves as the independent control and assurance function for APAC Critical Operations, ensuring the organisation can scale while maintaining an appropriate risk posture, regulatory compliance and operational resilience. As a core member of the APAC Critical Operations Leadership Team, the role shares accountability for customer success, operational continuity, business resilience and organisational performance.

Security is a visible leader of the customer experience. The Vice President sets the expectation that security controls, customer assurance, audits, incident handling and security-related engagements are delivered with urgency, professionalism, transparency and a strong service mindset, protecting customers and the platform while building trust and minimising unnecessary friction.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Leadership and Ways of Working

  • Lead, coach and hold accountable Site Security Managers across APAC, ensuring consistent security standards, strong customer service, effective incident response and disciplined execution across sites.
  • Act as a core member of the APAC Critical Operations Leadership Team, providing independent challenge, clear risk advice and practical solutions that enable safe and sustainable growth.
  • Partner with VP Critical Site Operations APAC so that Security, Risk & Resilience establishes the framework and provides assurance while Operations owns day-to-day execution and operational performance.
  • Partner with Customer Success to maintain customer confidence through transparent, secure and resilient operations, with joint accountability for customer trust, security-related escalations, compliance outcomes and service continuity assurance.
  • Partner with Operational Excellence to integrate risk and resilience into operational standards, playbooks, readiness frameworks and governance processes.
  • Partner with Operational Systems to set technology risk, access governance, data governance and systems resilience requirements for CMMS, DCIM, BMS, operational technology and reporting platforms.
  • Partner with Commercial, Contracts and Operations Procurement on supplier risk frameworks, critical supplier assessments, continuity requirements, security obligations and third-party assurance.
  • Partner with Engineering & Design to embed security, resilience, maintainability and continuity requirements into facility design and lifecycle planning.
  • Partner with Delivery to ensure new facilities are handed over with appropriate security readiness, resilience assessment, continuity planning and operational risk controls.
  • Communicate clearly with executives, customers and cross-functional leaders, translating security, risk and resilience issues into business impact, decisions and accountable actions.

Direct Reports

  • Provide direct leadership, performance management and capability development for Site Security Managers across APAC, ensuring consistent site execution of the Security, Risk and Resilience framework.

Competencies

  • Executive leadership across physical security, enterprise risk, operational resilience, business continuity, crisis management and assurance.
  • Strong customer-service orientation with the ability to lead security as a trusted, responsive and professional customer-facing function.
  • Sound judgement and independence in balancing customer needs, operational requirements, business growth and risk exposure.
  • Strong physical security governance capability across access control, CCTV, guarding, site security frameworks and security risk assessment.
  • Ability to lead crisis preparedness and executive response in high-consequence, 24/7 mission-critical environments.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder influence and ability to provide constructive challenge across senior leadership teams.
  • Demonstrated capability in regulatory readiness, compliance assurance, control validation and audit governance.
  • Strong third-party and supplier risk management capability, including continuity and assurance requirements.
  • Data-driven approach to security, risk and resilience reporting, metrics, trend analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to operate effectively across multiple countries, cultures, customer requirements and regulatory environments in APAC.

Success Measures

  • Security and customer outcomes will be measured through security incident frequency, security compliance scores, customer security audit results, physical security assessment scores, critical vulnerability closure rates, customer trust measures, customer audit performance, security escalation resolution and service continuity outcomes.
  • Risk performance will be measured through overall enterprise risk exposure, completion of risk treatment actions, demonstrable reduction of critical risks and timely completion of scheduled risk reviews.
  • Resilience performance will be assessed through business continuity readiness, crisis exercise performance, recovery readiness scores and the demonstrated effectiveness of continuity plans.
  • Assurance, compliance and supplier resilience will be measured through audit performance, regulatory compliance, closure of assurance findings, third-party compliance rates, critical supplier risk ratings, supplier continuity compliance, supplier recovery readiness and completion of third-party assurance activities.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Extensive senior leadership experience across security, enterprise risk, business continuity, operational resilience, crisis management and/or assurance in complex mission-critical, infrastructure or similarly high-consequence environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading regional or multi-site security, risk or resilience programs across multiple jurisdictions and stakeholder groups.
  • Proven customer-facing experience supporting security assurance, customer audits, compliance requirements, security escalations and executive customer engagement.
  • Strong experience with physical security governance, including access control, CCTV, guarding, security risk assessment and assurance programs.
  • Experience establishing enterprise or operational risk frameworks, risk registers, treatment programs, risk reporting and emerging-risk monitoring.
  • Experience designing and exercising business continuity, crisis management and emergency preparedness frameworks.
  • Experience with third-party risk, critical supplier resilience, contractual security requirements and supplier assurance.
  • Experience partnering with Operations, Customer Success, Engineering, Delivery, Commercial and technology teams to embed security and resilience into business decisions and facility lifecycle planning.

Work Environment / Conditions

  • Regional executive role supporting 24/7 mission-critical operations across APAC.
  • The role may be required to provide executive leadership and coordination during significant incidents, emergencies or crises outside standard business hours.
  • Work includes engagement with operational facilities, customer environments, security teams, leadership forums, audits and resilience exercises.

Travel Required

  • Regional travel across APAC may be required to support facilities, customer engagements, audits, assurance activities, exercises and incident or crisis response.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety, security and compliance training.
  • Ability to satisfy site and customer access requirements across relevant APAC facilities.
  • Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures, confidentiality obligations and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Legal entitlement to work in the role’s employing jurisdiction.
  • Ability to satisfy applicable pre-employment screening requirements, including right-to-work, background and reference checks.
  • Ability to meet data centre and customer security requirements, including badging, access control and any customer-mandated screening or clearance requirements.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

job.title: Engineer - Asset Commissioning
job.description:
Commissioning Plan Formulation and Project Coordination:

Develops and implements detailed commissioning plans for wind, solar, and hybrid projects, ensuring alignment with engineering specifications and regulatory standards.

Coordinates with project stakeholders to address all necessary technical aspects and comply with project requirements.

Gathers information related to connectivity, LTA/GNA, and project commissioning for efficient execution of upcoming renewable energy projects.

System Testing and Performance Validation:

Executes rigorous system testing and validation protocols to confirm that all systems meet performance specifications and function correctly under operational conditions.

Conducts power performance analysis for wind turbines and ensures the commissioning of turbines as handed over by the project team.

Ensures 100% turbine healthiness for continuous operation and addresses any discrepancies to maintain optimal performance.

Technical Issue Identification and Rectification:

Diagnoses and resolves technical issues encountered during the commissioning phase, applying advanced troubleshooting methods and collaborating with engineering teams to address root causes.

Develops and implements effective solutions to technical problems, ensuring all issues are resolved promptly to prevent disruptions.

Provides technical training to team members and supports in resolving error fault breakdowns for turbines.

Regulatory Compliance and Safety Assurance:

Ensures that all commissioning activities adhere to established industry regulations, safety standards, and project specifications, maintaining high levels of quality and compliance throughout the process.

Develops a safety culture at sites by ensuring workplace safety and adherence to SOPs, targeting zero accidents and Lost Time Injuries (LTIs).

Verifies compliance with safety protocols during construction and operation of EHV and 33KV lines.

Documentation and Reporting:

Prepares comprehensive documentation and reports on commissioning activities, including test results, performance data, and compliance verification.

Maintains detailed records of all commissioning activities, providing essential documentation for ongoing monitoring and regulatory compliance.

Prepares and submits site-wise budgets for operational and capital expenditure as per the project timeline.

Collaboration and Business Performance Monitoring:

Works closely with engineering teams to coordinate commissioning activities and address technical issues that arise, ensuring effective collaboration and problem resolution.

Monitors business performance against goals and identifies cost optimization opportunities in running projects.

Ensures timely closure of audit points and compliance with management systems, contributing to organizational transformation and change management.

CNG O&M Engineer - O4

  • Utilize diagnostic tools and techniques to monitor the condition of CNG station infrastructure, identifying maintenance needs.
  • Coordinate with contractors and service providers to carry out maintenance tasks, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs, ensuring these are readily available for review.
  • Implement best practices in maintenance management, contributing to continuous improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.

Technical Problem Solving:

  • Troubleshoot technical issues that arise during operations or maintenance activities, providing timely and effective solutions.
  • Analyze system data and performance metrics to identify potential areas for improvement and to prevent future operational disruptions.
  • Collaborate with the O&M Lead to develop and implement engineering solutions that enhance the reliability and efficiency of CNG systems.
  • Participate in technical meetings and reviews, offering insights and recommendations to optimize project outcomes.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure all maintenance and operational activities comply with safety regulations and industry standards, minimizing the risk of accidents or incidents.
  • Participate in safety audits and inspections, identifying potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks.
  • Assist in the development of safety protocols and procedures, ensuring they are adhered to by all team members and contractors.
  • Prepare safety documentation, such as risk assessments and method statements, to support safe operations and maintenance practices.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, including maintenance logs, inspection reports, and equipment manuals.
  • Provide regular updates to the O&M Lead on the status of ongoing maintenance activities and any issues encountered.
  • Assist in the preparation of operational and maintenance reports for senior management, highlighting key findings and areas for improvement.
  • Ensure that all documentation is organized, accessible, and complies with internal and external audit requirements.

Team Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with other engineers, technicians, and team members to ensure smooth execution of maintenance and operational activities.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure that project objectives and timelines are met.
  • Participate in team meetings, providing updates on engineering activities and contributing to discussions on improving operational efficiency.
  • Liaise with other departments as needed to ensure integrated and effective operations of CNG stations.

Continuous Improvement and Learning:

  • Stay informed about the latest developments in engineering practices, technologies, and industry standards relevant to CNG operations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve maintenance processes and practices, proposing and implementing changes that enhance performance.
  • Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge, ensuring continued growth within the team.
  • Share knowledge and insights with the team, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Internal Stakeholders:

  • Regional office
  • Corporate office
  • TechnoCommercial Team
  • HSE Team
  • Projects

External Stakeholders:

  • Vendors
  • Contractors
  • Local authorities
  • Regulatory bodies
  • Consultants

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

Work Experience:

4+ years of experience in gas station construction operations and maintenance

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the gas distribution, oil and energy, or utilities sectors.
