job.title: HR Systems Specialist
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the Head of Digital HR based in Singapore with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Head of HR, Japan, the HR Systems Specialist, Japan is a country-dedicated role within the global HRIS team. The role will support integration planning, the stabilisation of post-integration system requirements and the longer-term migration of Japan HR systems and data to SAP SuccessFactors. Working closely with local HR, managers, employees, global HRIS colleagues and implementation partners, the Specialist will help manage the potential coexistence of two systems for up to a year, including manual data uploads into SuccessFactors to provide visibility of HR data from acquired businesses, and will help develop and deliver a structured migration plan to SuccessFactors. Although primarily focused on Japan, the role is expected to work collaboratively across the global HRIS team, support peak periods outside the Japan scope where required and may also provide support for Korea.

Key responsibilities

  • Support the interim operation of HR data across two HR systems for up to a year, including accurate and timely manual uploads into SuccessFactors to maintain visibility of HR data from acquired businesses.
  • Develop and deliver a phased migration plan over approximately one year to move Japan HR data and processes to SuccessFactors, including data cleansing, mapping, validation, reconciliation, testing, cutover and post-go-live support.
  • Partner with local HR, managers, employees, the global HRIS team and external implementation or support partners to gather requirements, resolve issues and deliver practical, sustainable solutions.
  • Assess system integration and harmonisation requirements, dependencies and risks, and work with relevant teams to align local needs with global standards, architecture, security and data governance.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, data controls, test scripts, user guides, training materials and operational procedures in both English and Japanese.
  • Train and support local HR teams and managers in the effective use of SuccessFactors, and support employee onboarding and adoption of SuccessFactors self-service functionality.
  • Produce and maintain HR systems reports, monitor data quality and system performance, and drive issue resolution and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute actively to the global HRIS team, including supporting peak periods or priority initiatives outside Japan where required, and potentially extending system support to Korea.
  • Actively champion occupational health and safety, information security and environmental management responsibilities, and comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and organisational requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • Professional fluency in both Japanese and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to translate effectively between local and global stakeholders.
  • At least five years of HR systems experience in a multinational environment, including hands-on SAP SuccessFactors experience in Japan across multiple modules.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting HR system implementations, data migration, testing, data uploads, integrations and process harmonisation, with a clear understanding of the complexity and dependencies involved.
  • Experience training and supporting HR teams, managers and employees, with the ability to explain system processes clearly and build user confidence and adoption.
  • A collaborative, service-oriented approach and willingness to contribute beyond the Japan scope during peak periods or on global priorities; experience supporting Korea would be advantageous.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and project management skills, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and maintain close attention to data accuracy and controls.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, analytics and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with SmartRecruiters is an advantage.
  • Experience with “Company” and/or Horizon, together with experience working with TMF Payroll, would be beneficial.

job.title: Senior Manager - Product Management
job.description:
Role Overview

RE:AI is expanding its product management team and hiring an additional Associate Director to drive product commercialisation and business execution across its AI infrastructure portfolio. The role spans product commercialisation, pricing and financial management, business strategy and regional expansion, operational governance, and performance management.

Working closely with the RE:AI leadership team and cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Engineering, Finance and Strategy, the role will translate technical capabilities and market opportunities into commercially viable offerings, drive financial and operational performance, and support the scalable growth of RE:AI’s business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Management, Commercialisation & Financial Management: Drive the commercial management of RE:AI product offerings, translating technical capabilities and customer requirements into commercially viable propositions.

Pricing & Commercial Management: Develop and maintain pricing models and commercial business cases, evaluating deal economics, cost structures and profitability to support pricing decisions and commercial negotiations.

  • Productization & Go-to-Market: Define and execute productization frameworks for new AI infrastructure products and services, turning technical capabilities into commercially scalable offerings.
  • Business Strategy & Regional Expansion: Support regional growth strategies, market entry assessments, investment evaluations and strategic partnerships, including preparation of business plans, investment proposals and management presentations.
  • Business Operations & Governance: Drive operational readiness across business systems implementation, user requirements gathering, testing and rollout, billing operations, procurement, contract administration and regional entity setup. Establish, maintain and govern SOPs, processes and operational controls.
  • Business Planning & Performance Management: Coordinate capacity planning, revenue and cost forecasting, business case tracking, management reporting and regional performance monitoring. Prepare business performance analyses and management/Board approval materials.
  • Bid Support: Support complex bid and tender responses for large-scale AI infrastructure opportunities, coordinating technical, commercial, and regulatory inputs across teams.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of relevant experience across product management, commercial strategy or financial management, preferably in telecommunications, cloud infrastructure, or AI compute domains.
  • Proven success in financial modelling, business case development, pricing strategy, commercial performance management and product lifecycle management for enterprise or platform-based products.
  • Working knowledge of AI infrastructure, including GPU compute, HPC, cloud platforms and data centre economics.
  • Experience in supporting complex bids, commercial proposals and cross-functional solution development for enterprise or government clients.
  • Experience in regional business expansion, operational process development and management reporting would be advantageous.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Business preferred.

Key Attributes

  • Commercially astute with a strong understanding of financial performance metrics.
  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen and execution capabilities, able to translate business priorities into actionable plans, drive cross-functional delivery, operational effectiveness and governance.
  • Collaborative leader able to influence technical and business teams.
  • Passionate about enabling the future of AI responsibly and sustainably.

job.title: Lead Client Solutions Architect
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As the Lead Client Solutions Architect, you will be a trusted technology advisor driving technical solutioning for India-based enterprises and MEA carriers, with a strong focus on telecommunications, SD-WAN, cloud and digital transformation.

You will bridge business and technology by designing secure, scalable, resilient and cost-effective solutions across networking, cloud, security and hybrid/multi-cloud environments. Working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product and technology partners, you will help customers transform traditional enterprise networks into agile, digitally managed infrastructures.

How You will Make An Impact

  • Act as the primary trusted technical advisor for pre-sales engagements, understanding customers' networking, communications and transformation requirements.
  • Partner Sales and Account Managers in customer engagements, providing technical expertise and shaping compelling value propositions.
  • Build trusted relationships with technical stakeholders, C-level executives and technology leaders throughout the customer relationship.
  • Partner system integrators and strategic technology partners to design end-to-end network solutions.
  • Design cost-effective, secure, resilient and reliable ICT solutions across WAN, SD-WAN and managed services.
  • Develop solutions integrating cloud networking, secure connectivity and major cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud.
  • Lead solution architecture for complex tenders spanning networking, edge-to-cloud solutions and managed ICT services.
  • Translate business requirements into network architectures supporting customers' LAN/WAN transformation and digital journeys.
  • Assess customers' existing network environments, define future-state architectures and develop transformation roadmaps.
  • Engage customers on public, private, hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity architectures based on their cloud adoption strategies and technical requirements.
  • Conduct Proof-of-Concept activities to demonstrate software-defined networking capabilities and strengthen customer confidence.
  • Engage customers on emerging cloud technologies, AI, automation and modernisation trends to identify new business opportunities.
  • Lead large and complex tenders across network and data growth areas, including Singtel's software-defined networking capabilities.
  • Work across regional Sales, Pre-Sales, Product and Delivery teams to ensure seamless transition from solution design through implementation and service delivery.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation covering customer network configurations, processes and technical updates.
  • Support strategic in-country marketing initiatives as a speaker, sharing industry and technology insights to strengthen Singtel's market positioning.
  • Support post-sales optimisation by reviewing network performance and recommending improvements to increase efficiency and reduce operational overhead.
  • Support Project Managers during network deployment and provide technical guidance for post-sales queries.
  • Travel domestically and internationally as required for customer engagements and business activities.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
  • At least 15–20 years of relevant technical experience within the Communications, Network or Information Technology industry.
  • CCNA certification is required.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise network design and architecture, including the ability to assess current-state networks and define future-state transformation paths.
  • Strong knowledge of SD-WAN, SASE/SSE, WAN/LAN, cloud access, uCPE, VNF and IoT networks.
  • Strong knowledge of SASE technologies such as Zscaler and Palo Alto.
  • Experience with SD-WAN platforms such as Cisco, Fortinet and Silver Peak.
  • Knowledge of WAN connectivity, including MPLS and Internet-based networks.
  • Understanding of SIP for voice communications, SaaS and public cloud access strategies.
  • Knowledge of wireless and 5G technologies for next-generation networks.
  • Understanding of Network as a Service and software-defined cloud connectivity solutions.
  • Familiarity with IT/OT convergence in industrial environments.
  • Strong leadership, organisational, analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Strong customer engagement, presentation and communication skills.
  • Able to engage effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile or cross-functional teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.
  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively across customers, peers and internal stakeholders.
  • CCNP/CCIP, SD-WAN and cloud certifications such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud would be advantageous.
  • ITIL certification and broader IT experience across collaboration, security, servers and backup solutions would be advantageous.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

  • Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines that integrate customer behaviour, application performance, video QoE/QoS and operational telemetry from multiple digital TV and OTT data sources.
  • Develop dashboards, analytical models and customer intelligence views that provide actionable insights into service quality, customer journeys, feature adoption and usage behaviour.
  • Apply statistical analysis, AI and machine learning techniques to identify patterns, anomalies and emerging customer-impacting issues, enabling more proactive and predictive service management.
  • Correlate technical service performance with customer experience and behaviour to identify affected customer segments, support root-cause analysis and prioritise service improvements based on customer impact.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Operations teams to translate data insights into measurable improvements in customer experience, platform reliability, product features and service operations.
  • Define and continuously improve customer experience, video quality and application performance metrics, ensuring data quality, consistency and trusted reporting across stakeholders.
  • Automate data preparation, analysis and reporting workflows to improve speed, scalability and efficiency, while evaluating opportunities to apply AI to operational and customer intelligence use cases.
  • Support investigation of service incidents and production issues through data analysis, trend correlation and impact assessment, and contribute to post-incident and continuous improvement activities.
  • Ensure appropriate data governance, security and privacy practices are applied when handling customer and operational data.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, observability and digital customer experience technologies and recommend relevant improvements for the TV and OTT environment.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Statistics or a related discipline.
  • Relevant experience in data engineering, data analytics, business intelligence, customer analytics or a related technology role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL and at least one programming language commonly used for data analysis or engineering, such as Python.
  • Experience building data pipelines, integrating multiple data sources and working with structured and semi-structured data.
  • Experience with business intelligence and data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis, machine learning and practical application of AI to analytics, anomaly detection, prediction or operational intelligence.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and analytics services, preferably in AWS or a comparable public cloud environment.
  • Experience with application analytics, observability, digital experience monitoring or video/OTT QoE analytics will be an advantage.
  • Ability to translate complex datasets and technical findings into clear business and customer insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills, with a strong customer-centric mindset.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Senior Director, Internal Audit - Networks & Technology
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is focused on getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

As the Senior Director, Networks & Technology, Internal Audit, you will lead the delivery of forward-looking, risk-based assurance across Optus’ Networks, Technology, Security and Risk portfolios. You will provide strategic oversight of audit activities focused on telecommunications networks, technology infrastructure, cyber security, resilience and enterprise risk, ensuring assurance coverage remains aligned to business priorities, emerging threats and regulatory expectations. Partnering with senior executives and technical leaders, you will provide independent insight, challenge governance and control environments, and help strengthen the security, resilience and operational performance of some of Optus’ most critical business functions.

The Day to Day

  • Develop and deliver the Internal Audit strategy and annual audit plan across Networks, Technology, Security and Risk, ensuring assurance activities remain focused on the most significant current and emerging risks.
  • Provide independent assurance and oversight across telecommunications networks, cyber security, technology infrastructure, resilience, regulatory compliance and major transformation initiatives.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives and technical leaders, delivering strategic advice, risk insights and constructive challenge while preserving Internal Audit independence.
  • Identify and assess emerging technology, cyber, network and operational risks, translating complex technical issues into practical audit priorities, assurance responses and executive-level insights.
  • Lead, coach and develop high-performing audit teams, driving excellence in technical capability, audit quality, stakeholder engagement and continuous improvement across the Internal Audit function.

What You Bring

  • Extensive senior leadership experience in Internal Audit, Technology Risk, Cyber Security, Telecommunications Assurance or related risk and assurance disciplines within large, complex and highly regulated organisations.
  • Deep understanding of telecommunications networks, network architecture, technology infrastructure, cyber security, resilience, cloud environments and associated governance and control frameworks.
  • Proven ability to develop and deliver strategic risk-based assurance programs, influence executive stakeholders and provide independent challenge across highly technical and operational environments.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex network, cyber and technology risks into meaningful business, customer, resilience and regulatory outcomes.
  • Experience gained within a Big 4 consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY or KPMG) in Technology Risk, Telecommunications Advisory, Cyber Security, Internal Audit, Risk Advisory or Assurance leadership roles will be highly regarded.

The good stuff

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and outstanding shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym, and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through colleague-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network, and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon. Join us for an outstanding career opportunity!

Not every box ticked? Apply anyway. We believe the right mindset matter more than a perfect CV. We’ll back you to grow from there.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: Cybersecurity Consultant, Network Security (2 year direct contract)
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

Be a Part of Something BIG! We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Cyber Security Consultant with strong experience in cybersecurity and a solid technical foundation in network, infrastructure, and cloud security to deploy and manage cyber tools and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

Make An Impact By

  • Support the overall technical delivery of cybersecurity tools and initiatives across the organization
  • Provide guidance and support to junior team members in resolving delivery challenges and customer escalations
  • Support the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of IAM and PIAM solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (network, cloud, infrastructure) to implement security solutions and projects
  • Own and execute the technical implementation of in-scope security technologies
  • Ensure timely and effective deployment of security solutions in line with approved architectures and designs
  • Support deployment and operations of micro-segmentation solutions, including policy creation and enforcement
  • Define, implement, and manage segmentation policies to enforce least-privilege communication
  • Support design and rollout of Network Detection & Response (NDR) capabilities across enterprise infrastructure
  • Work with SOC and engineering teams to improve detection coverage and telemetry integration across NDR, SIEM, and EDR
  • Support asset discovery initiatives and validate asset inventory accuracy across environments

Ensure alignment with Zero Trust principles across network, endpoint, and identity layers

  • Support cybersecurity audits, regulatory requirements, and internal GRC processes

Maintain and update security policies, procedures, SOPs, and technical documentation

Skills For Success

  • Bachelor’s degree (or diploma with relevant experience) in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, or related roles.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts including threat landscape, risk management, incident response, and data protection.

  • Zero Trust Segmentation tools vulnerability management, and asset discovery tools.

Preferred Certifications and Skills

  • Relevant certifications (Security+, CISSP, GIAC, CCNA/CCNP Security) Networking certifications (CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent) are advantageous.
  • Palo Alto / Fortinet firewall certifications
  • Exposure to Illumio / Guardicore.
  • Exposure to cloud security in AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
  • Experience with scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell) is a plus.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage senior technical and
  • business stakeholders.

job.title: Business Support Engineer AdTech
job.description:
We are looking for an engineer to play a key role in providing technical, engineering support to Meta’s Advertising partners, Customers and clients globally. You will have the opportunity to work together with a global team of Business Support Engineers who are expert in Meta’s AdTech to provide proactive and reactive support for partner issues and integrations while partnering with our broad cross functional teams to ensure a high quality for our products and satisfactory experience for our partners and customers. We work directly with Platform and Infrastructure teams to investigate and resolve issues reported by our partners, to properly assess and agree on actions to be taken for necessary fixes and continuous improvements in our products and deployments.

As a Business Support Engineer working on Ads at Meta, you will primarily support on Meta’s Ads Products but also have the opportunity to work cross-functionally in several of our key business areas across Business Messaging, Telecommunications and combine your experience with customer service skills and a product focus to ensure that key insights are communicated to our product teams. We are looking for people who have subject-matter knowledge in managing and maintaining integrations with third-party services, who help foster developer/business relationships, who demonstrate critical thinking and blending systems design with business needs, and who have a desire to improve the support experience of our customers.

As a Business Support Engineer, you will understand industry trends, partner solutions and integrations, and their implications for our product roadmap. You will work closely with other regional offices and partnership teams to support a broad range of partners across the globe to integrate Meta’s Business Products into their offering.

Responsibilities

  • Provide proactive and reactive engineering support for partners, independently managing complex outages to ensure high partner satisfaction
  • Troubleshoot large-scale distributed systems and partner integrations, maintaining high code quality and operational standards
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, automate repetitive tasks, and scale your impact with an 'AI native' mindset
  • Develop performance monitoring systems for partner integrations to ensure high availability; leverage metrics to proactively identify issues and drive improvements across teams
  • Provide 24/7 on-call support coverage via a rotation schedule
  • Collaborate with Platform and Infrastructure teams to investigate issues, align on fixes, and drive continuous product improvements
  • Create clear documentation, specs, guides, and presentations to communicate complex AI concepts to diverse audiences, scaling the team's knowledge internally and externally
  • Drive end-to-end execution, using sound judgment to manage stakeholder expectations and ensuring clear alignment
  • Develop and share AI/ML expertise, actively coach and mentor other engineers on technical troubleshooting and project execution
  • Proactively and independently analyze information to identify specific trends/opportunities, recommend appropriate and relevant tactical improvements, anticipate future business needs to improve the overall support experience, and share this knowledge across the team

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer, support engineer, or site reliability engineer
  • Proven experience as a support engineer, service engineer, or similar role
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience in developing, deploying, and operating software in one or more public cloud infrastructures (Azure, GCP, AWS, etc.)
  • Proven experience in API development on cloud-based infrastructures
  • Proficiency in full-stack development with experience in the full web stack, SOAP, and REST API technologies and architectures
  • Experience in communicating with technical and business audiences, and in creating technical documentation
  • Experience working with IT infrastructures and network protocols across multiple layers, including familiarity with data exchange formats and protocols
  • Experience in assessing, analyzing, and resolving operational issues using data
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and driving initiatives in a cross-functional environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience with Open Source cloud stacks like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Docker containers
  • Experience transforming data, model selection/training/optimization, and deployment at scale
  • Hands-on experience working with large language models and AI agents
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience working in engineering environments with geographically distributed, cross-cultural teams and international stakeholders
  • Experience in partner-facing or customer-centric engineering roles

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

Technical specialist and primary customer support contact to diagnose and execute complex repairs to engine products at the customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

Establishes and continually develops productive customer relations and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs. Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete complex repairs at customer site. Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engines and related components in the field. Escalates unresolved issues to product specialists or supervisor. Coaches and develops technicians and/or apprentices and transfers knowledge and experience to others; may provide work direction; may review repair plans, parts lists, etc. Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional sales and service opportunities with customer. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements. Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation. Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

job.title: Product Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Engineering Manufacturing Interface (EMI) / Plant Product Engineer (PPE) acts as the technical bridge between Product Engineering and Manufacturing, supporting products throughout the development and production lifecycle. The role coordinates prototype, pilot, and production builds, ensures manufacturing readiness for new products, supports engineering changes and configuration management, and drives resolution of manufacturing and product quality issues.

The position works closely with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Suppliers, and other cross-functional teams to ensure successful product introduction, robust manufacturing processes, and continuous product and process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the technical interface between Product Engineering and Manufacturing teams for current and future products.
  • Support build events, prototype builds, pilot builds, and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities.
  • Coordinate prototype, pilot, and production builds and track actions to ensure timely execution.
  • Assess and verify manufacturing readiness for new products and engineering changes.
  • Support APQP, PPAP, production validation, and product launch activities.
  • Review, coordinate, and implement Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), and VPCRs at the plant.
  • Coordinate design changes with Product Engineering and plant teams to ensure effective implementation.
  • Create, release, maintain, and align Manufacturing Bill of Materials (MBOMs) with Engineering Bill of Materials (EBOMs).
  • Support product configuration and change management throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Investigate manufacturing, product, warranty, and field quality issues using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Lead or support root cause analysis, 8D, 7-step problem solving, and corrective/preventive action activities.
  • Support DFMEA/PFMEA, design reviews, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) , and other product quality processes.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Suppliers, Purchasing, and Customer teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Support product verification and validation activities and evaluate test results against requirements.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, waste elimination, quality improvement, and manufacturing efficiency.
  • Support warranty, reliability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain technical documentation and communicate product and manufacturing requirements effectively to stakeholders.
  • Coordinate activities across functional teams to ensure project milestones, quality expectations, and production requirements are achieved.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Engineering , or a related Engineering/STEM discipline.
  • Master's degree in a relevant engineering discipline is preferred for select roles.
  • Relevant internship, co-op, project, or early-career experience in product development, manufacturing engineering, quality, or plant engineering is preferred.

Skills & Experience

  • Understanding of product development, manufacturing engineering, plant engineering, or quality processes .
  • Knowledge of GD&T, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, Six Sigma/Lean , and structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Experience or knowledge of 8D, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and engineering problem-solving tools .
  • Understanding of EBOM, MBOM, product configuration, and change management .
  • Knowledge of CAD, PLM, and engineering change management systems.
  • Understanding of product verification, validation, and manufacturing readiness processes.
  • Ability to coordinate and manage engineering changes and implementation activities across multiple functions.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret technical and manufacturing data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Knowledge of statistical methods, process improvement, and waste reduction techniques is preferred.
  • Product knowledge of DEF dosing systems and Aftertreatment Systems is preferred.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, Suppliers, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong technical documentation and presentation skills.
  • Ability to take ownership, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results within defined timelines.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is preferred.

Willingness to learn new products, technologies, processes, and engineering systems.

job.title: Account Management Specialist - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for managing customer relationships and account strategies for less complex accounts, including regional, single-business-unit, or internal accounts. The role may also support larger and more complex accounts in partnership with senior account management leaders.

The position is responsible for driving sales of Cummins products and services to assigned business customers, expanding existing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and executing account plans aligned with business strategy and revenue objectives. The role acts as a key customer interface and advocate for the voice of the customer within Cummins.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, manage, and maintain strong business relationships with assigned accounts in alignment with the organization's sales strategy.
  • Develop and execute account strategies and sales plans to achieve revenue, growth, customer satisfaction, and business objectives.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities and support initiatives that contribute to revenue growth and cost reduction.
  • Expand sales of Cummins products and services within existing customer accounts by understanding customer requirements and identifying opportunities for growth.
  • Lead and coordinate customer communication and interfaces at appropriate stakeholder levels.
  • Negotiate and implement customer contracts within established authorization and business guidelines.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to address production, distribution, service, inventory, and delivery requirements associated with assigned accounts.
  • Act as a champion for the voice of the customer and ensure customer needs and feedback are effectively represented within the business.
  • Measure customer satisfaction, identify improvement areas, and develop action plans to strengthen the customer experience.
  • Support and drive account strategy execution by collaborating with key stakeholders across functions and business units.
  • Drive cross-business-unit account development initiatives in support of broader account strategies.
  • Lead Customer Focus Six Sigma initiatives and other improvement activities aimed at strengthening customer relationships and business performance.
  • Manage accounts receivable deliverables, including discussions and negotiations related to payment terms, as applicable.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts and track performance, progress, and forecast accuracy against business targets.
  • Monitor account performance, relationship strength, product competitiveness, quality, service, and other key factors to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Balance customer requirements with business capabilities related to inventory, service, and delivery, in collaboration with internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Use customer and market insights to support account planning, pipeline development, and long-term business growth.

Key Competencies

Customer & Relationship Management

  • Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors communication across different audiences and stakeholder levels to convey complex information clearly.
  • Integrates Customer Perspective: Uses customer insights to improve sales effectiveness, customer experience, and revenue growth.
  • Instills Trust: Builds credibility through honesty, integrity, transparency, and authentic interactions.
  • Values Differences: Recognizes and leverages diverse perspectives and experiences.

Commercial & Account Management

  • Account Planning: Defines objectives, monitors progress, and drives execution against account and business targets.
  • Developing Account Strategy: Evaluates account relationships, financial performance, product competitiveness, quality, service, barriers, customer requirements, and business capabilities to define achievable account strategies.
  • Articulates Value Proposition: Understands customer requirements and effectively communicates the value of Cummins products, solutions, and services against customer needs and competitive alternatives.
  • Pricing Strategy: Develops and supports pricing approaches by building alignment with relevant stakeholders to achieve business objectives.
  • Channel Awareness: Understands industry structure, market dynamics, and routes to market to support business growth.

Sales & Business Development

  • Sales Forecasting: Analyzes internal and external customer data and historical trends to support accurate sales forecasts and future consumption planning.
  • Sales Pipeline Management: Monitors pipeline health, prioritizes opportunities, identifies gaps, and supports actions required to achieve sales objectives.
  • Sense Making: Uses research, probing, and analysis to understand customer needs, buying behavior, and business drivers and translates insights into relevant solutions and actions.

job.title: IT Business Analyst - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Partners with business functions to define, determine, analyze, document and communicate the objectives, business requirements and priorities for information systems and solutions; works with application and technical experts on the solution design, implementation, support, maintenance and enhancement of the information systems.

Key Responsibilities

Leads the effort, working with the business, to define and document what constitutes business success for medium to large size initiatives within a single organization. Elicits, analyzes, and documents functional requirements across the five aspects (process, information, event, socio-political, and location), as appropriate for the large initiative. May either lead or work as part of a team to gather requirements. Elicits, analyzes, and documents non-functional business requirements Leads or conducts requirements management activities, as necessary, ensuring that the impact of changes are well understood and approved by the appropriate stakeholders within the organization. Leads or conducts solution assessment and validation to ensure that functional and technical specifications meet the identified business needs within the organization Reviews test plans and testing methodology to mitigate risks and participates in testing the solution to ensure the solution meets functional and non-functional requirements within the organization Conducts problem analysis as needed. Escalates complex issues for additional analysis and resolution as appropriate. Acts as a point of escalation for moderate to difficult problems. Develops positive relationships with both the business and other functions involved in downstream technical processes May coach and mentor less experienced business analysts Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.

Competencies:

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Strategic mindset - Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.

Business Analysis Planning - Identifies the activities needed to conduct business analysis considering the five business aspects, level of detail, and approach for eliciting requirements to plan for resources and techniques to document the business needs and solution characteristics.

Requirements Analysis - Evaluates relationships and interdependencies between requirements based upon their complexity and value to the business in order to determine feasibility and prioritization.

Requirements Elicitation - Discovers and documents functional and non-functional requirements using the Business Analysis Toolkit (modeling the five aspects and creating use cases) to effectively communicate the business needs and solution characteristics for solution design.

Solution Assessment and Validation - Assesses the proposed solution using the requirements traceability through the life cycle of the requirements to determine if they deliver the desired business outcome.

Solution Design - Creates and defines the solution design complete with instrumentation and measurement, using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to synthesize diagrams, models and documentation in order to build a solution that meets buildability, business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Functional Fit Analysis - Composes and decomposes a system into its component parts using procedures, tools and work aides for the purpose of studying how well the component parts were designed, purchased and configured to interact holistically to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Project Issue and Risk Management - Manages the process to identify, assess and prioritize issues and risks using recommended tools and disciplines. Drives actions to minimize, monitor and control risks and issues and to maximize the most positive outcomes possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Business Need Definition - Defines the business outcome that the proposed work will provide using the Business Analysis Toolkit (modeling the five aspects and creating use cases) to justify investment of resources (people, time, finances).

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 3-5 years of experience.

Summary

Seeking a Salesforce Functional Analyst to support the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Salesforce solutions across the EAME region. This role acts as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions that drive operational excellence, user adoption, and business value. This position will play a key role throughout the project lifecycle—from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, training, deployment, and post-go-live support. This position requires strong stakeholder management skills, hands-on Salesforce configuration experience, and a passion for enabling business transformation through digital technologies.

Key Responsible:

  • Elicit, document, and validate business requirements from regional stakeholders across EAME markets
  • Translate requirements into functional specifications and Salesforce solution designs
  • Configure Salesforce including flows, validation rules, page layouts, reports, and dashboards
  • Lead and coordinate UAT — writing test scripts, managing defect logs, and facilitating business sign-off

  • Support go-live planning, hyper-care periods, and post-deployment stabilisation
  • Manage the enhancement backlog and sprint prioritisation with the product owner

Core experience

job.title: Commissioning Engineer, India - APJC ACx
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities The responsibilities of the ACx Commissioning Engineer (CxE) include, but are not limited to, oversight and coordination of multi-discipline division of work related to pre-commissioning and commissioning of Amazon critical infrastructure construction and special projects.

  • The CxE is responsible for supporting and supervising vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems including medium and low voltage power systems, Generators, UPS, HVAC, Chilled Water Systems, Fuel Transfer Systems, BMS and EPMS systems.
  • They provides multi-discipline input into the scheduling, designing and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review all multi-discipline integrated systems testing and commissioning documents to ensure they are compliant with the basis of design, specifications and standards of the project.
  • It is the CxE's responsibility to ensure that all commissioning procedures follow the appropriate safety practices, policies and procedures. He or she enthusiastically participates in all project and company safety programs.
  • The CxE must also audit commissioning activities continuously to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements.
  • The CxE proactively informs the ACx Regional Manager and along with the ACx team to ensure that the applicable test documents are created in accordance with all commissioning requirements so that this is aligned with the global standards and practices.
  • Following the AWS project reporting format, the CxE is responsible for weekly reporting of commissioning progress and metrics for assigned project.
  • You will work with deadlines across multiple projects simultaneously, while maintaining project budgets according to financial metrics
  • Willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 50% of the time

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
AWS Professional Services experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses.

AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries.

Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support
  • Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement
  • Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption
  • Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers
  • Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption
  • Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners
  • Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment
  • In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition
  • Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise
  • Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team
  • Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales

A day in the life As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value.

  • 5+ years of working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services experience

job.title: SAP BW4HANA Solution Architect
job.description:

Your role and responsibilities

Solution Architect – SAP BW/4HANA is responsible for designing and governing end-to-end SAP BW/4HANA-based data warehousing, reporting, and planning solutions that support enterprise financial reporting, planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes. This role owns the overall data and analytics architecture, ensuring scalable data models, efficient data flows, high system performance, and strong governance aligned with business and IT standards.

The architect partners closely with Finance (FP&A) and business stakeholders to translate functional reporting and planning requirements into optimized BW/4HANA data models, data flows, and analytics solutions, while providing technical leadership across data modeling, integration, performance optimization, and security. The role also drives architectural consistency, best practices, and adoption of modern SAP data and analytics capabilities across the landscape.

The Solution Architect ensures that BW/4HANA solutions are technically robust, business-aligned, future-ready, and seamlessly integrated with S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and other enterprise systems, while maintaining data integrity, compliance, and performance at scale.

The location of the role is in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Finance, Process, Data and Systems in Bengaluru, India .

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Architect and implement advanced SAP BW/4HANA solutions, including complex data models (ADSO, CompositeProviders, InfoObjects) to support enterprise reporting and planning scenarios such as allocations, currency translation, and forecasting.
  • Own the BW/4HANA data modeling strategy, ensuring optimal layered architecture (LSA++), efficient data granularity, hierarchy design, and consistent master and transactional data across the landscape.Establish and enforce enterprise data governance frameworks within BW/4HANA, including data ownership, lifecycle management, auditability, and alignment with organizational standards.
  • Lead performance monitoring and optimization initiatives across BW/4HANA and HANA database, utilizing tools such as workload monitoring, SQL trace, and HANA Studio to identify bottlenecks and ensure scalable, high-performing solutions.Optimize BW/4HANA data flows and reporting through efficient data modeling, query design, HANA pushdown (AMDP/CDS), and transformation tuning, ensuring fast data processing and high query performance.
  • Define and implement robust security and authorization concepts in BW/4HANA, including analysis authorizations, role-based access, and data-level restrictions to meet compliance and segregation of duties requirements.Collaborate closely with Finance, FP&A, and business stakeholders to understand reporting and planning requirements, translating them into scalable BW/4HANA models and integrated SAC reporting/planning solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership and governance to development teams, ensuring adherence to BW/4HANA architecture principles, modeling standards, naming conventions, and transport management processes. Review and guide solution designs to ensure consistency, reusability, scalability, and alignment with enterprise data and analytics architecture. Stay current with SAP BW/4HANA, S/4HANA, and SAC innovations, evaluating and adopting new capabilities to enhance performance, scalability, and overall business value.
  • Qualifications for the role
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. SAP Analytics Cloud Planning and BW/4HANA certifications are preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in SAC Planning architecture and development. Proven track record of implementing large-scale planning models handling complex financial planning scenarios.
  • In-depth knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA data modeling and integration techniques. Advanced skills in SAC Data Actions, Advanced Formulas, API-based data integrations, and predictive planning scenarios. Experience in financial planning processes (Budgeting, Forecasting, Rolling Forecasts) and a solid understanding of key financial metrics.
  • Experience working on finance transformation programs involving SAC and enterprise-level ERP solutions.
  • Strong focus on continuous learning and exploring emerging technologies in the planning and analytics space.

More about us

By joining ABB as a SAP Analytics Cloud Architect, you will be instrumental in developing and maintaining a robust Planning platform that enhances financial transparency, and supports strategic decision-making across the organization.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information security, electronics, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in product cybersecurity, secure development, vulnerability management, or cybersecurity compliance.
  • Experience in product cybersecurity, including secure development, risk assessment, and the application of ISA/IEC 62443-4-1, ISA/IEC 62443-4-2, or comparable cybersecurity standards and requirements.
  • Experience in the following: software or embedded systems, firmware, Linux, networked products, industrial communications, threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, software composition analysis, attack testing, or security verification
  • Experience with the EU Cyber Resilience Act, or product cybersecurity regulations.
  • Experience with ICS, OT, embedded systems, or industrial communication protocols.
  • Scripting or automation experience using Python or a similar language.

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What you will do

HVAC Chiller Service Engineer - Troubleshooting

We are seeking an experienced HVAC Chiller Service Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing HVAC chiller systems, ensuring efficient operation and minimizing downtime. The role requires a strong technical background, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to maintenance and service.

What we look for:

  • ### Diagnose and troubleshoot issues with HVAC chiller systems, including compressors, evaporators, condensers, and associated components.
  • ### Perform routine maintenance and repairs on chillers to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
  • ### Identify and resolve mechanical and electrical faults, utilizing diagnostic tools and industry best practices.
  • ### Conduct inspections and testing of HVAC equipment to confirm system functionality and compliance with safety standards.
  • ### Provide on-site technical support to clients, including emergency repairs and troubleshooting.
  • ### Maintain accurate records of services performed, parts used, and recommendations for future maintenance.
  • ### Collaborate with other team members to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
  • ### Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and company policies.
