job.title: Senior EHS Manager
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager – EHS to lead and drive Environmental, Health & Safety programs across facilities and operations. The role requires strong expertise in industrial and facility safety, including Building Management Systems (BMS), CCTV surveillance systems, Access Control Systems (ACS), lifting operations, crane safety, contractor safety management, and compliance with applicable safety regulations and standards.

The incumbent will be responsible for developing a proactive safety culture, ensuring regulatory compliance, mitigating operational risks, and implementing best-in-class EHS practices across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

EHS Leadership & Governance

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of EHS policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Drive safety culture initiatives and ensure adherence to corporate and statutory EHS requirements.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, safety audits, and inspections.
  • Develop corrective and preventive action plans for identified hazards and incidents.

Facility & Security Systems Safety

  • Oversee safety aspects related to Building Management Systems (BMS).
  • Ensure safe operations and maintenance practices for CCTV and Access Control Systems (ACS).
  • Collaborate with Facilities, Security, and Engineering teams to identify and mitigate operational risks.
  • Review and approve safety procedures for maintenance activities involving critical infrastructure systems.

Lifting Operations & Crane Safety

  • Establish and monitor lifting plans for heavy equipment and machinery movement.
  • Ensure compliance with crane safety regulations, lifting standards, and safe work practices.
  • Review crane operations, rigging procedures, and lifting permits.
  • Conduct periodic inspections and audits of cranes, lifting tools, tackles, and associated equipment.
  • Investigate lifting-related incidents and implement corrective actions.

Contractor & Project Safety

  • Manage contractor safety programs and permit-to-work systems.
  • Conduct contractor onboarding, safety training, and performance evaluations.
  • Ensure EHS compliance during installation, relocation, and maintenance of heavy machinery and equipment.
  • Participate in project planning and execution to integrate safety requirements from design to commissioning.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with relevant EHS legislation and industry standards.
  • Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, and reporting.
  • Maintain EHS documentation, records, permits, and statutory submissions.
  • Develop emergency response and business continuity plans.

Training & Awareness

  • Conduct safety training programs covering lifting operations, work-at-height, electrical safety, fire safety, and contractor safety.
  • Drive safety campaigns, toolbox talks, and awareness initiatives across sites.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Industrial Safety, or related discipline.
  • Diploma/PG Diploma in Industrial Safety preferred.
  • Additional certifications in NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA, or equivalent are desirable.

Experience

  • 12–18 years of experience in EHS, facility safety, or industrial safety.
  • Extensive experience with: Building Management Systems (BMS)CCTV & Access Control Systems (ACS)Crane and Heavy Lifting OperationsContractor Safety ManagementRisk Assessment & Incident InvestigationFacility & Engineering Safety
  • Experience in corporate facilities, manufacturing, industrial projects, data centers, logistics, or large infrastructure environments preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of crane and lifting safety standards.
  • Expertise in hazard identification and risk management.
  • Leadership and stakeholder management skills.
  • Incident investigation and root cause analysis.
  • Regulatory compliance and audit management.
  • Excellent communication and team management skills.

job.title: Manager, Listed Funds-Investor Relations
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

You will be part of our Listed Funds-Investor Relations team and will report to Head, Listed Funds-Investor Relations.

Responsibilities

  • IR Support
  • Supports the preparation of materials in relation to the quarterly earnings, annual and interim reports, and investor presentations
  • Ensures all public disclosures comply with regulatory standards and are consistent in messaging
  • Sustainability Reporting
  • Works on annual sustainability reporting for the listed funds
  • Coordinates the information and data relevant to sustainability reporting
  • Reviews and coordinates the responses to sustainability assessments
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Responds to investor inquiries with accuracy and timeliness, balancing transparency with confidentiality and compliance
  • Coordinates non-deal roadshows, investor days, site visits, and conference participation
  • Develops and maintains a database of analysts, current and prospective investors, tracking engagement and sentiment
  • Support with IR budget planning
  • Market Intelligence and Analysis
  • Monitors industry trends, competitor performance, and macroeconomic developments that may impact the company’s valuation and investor sentiment
  • Performs peer group analysis to benchmark financial and operational performance
  • Analyses sell-side research, earnings forecasts, and consensus estimates to anticipate market expectations
  • Disclosure and Compliance
  • Ensures that all investor communications, websites and presentations comply with relevant securities laws and stock exchange requirements
  • Coordinates timely filing of regulatory documents
  • Ensures key risks arising from Investor Relations activities are proactively identified, assessed, monitored, reported and resolved, including handling complaints
  • Relationship Management
  • Builds trust and credibility with the investment community by demonstrating industry knowledge, responsiveness, and integrity
  • Internal Collaboration
  • Works closely with management, portfolio management, investment, finance, communications, and legal teams to ensure alignment of messaging and strategic objectives
  • Event Planning and Execution
  • Organizes and manages logistics for earnings calls, investor days, analyst meetings, annual general meetings, extraordinary general meetings and other investor-focused events
  • Ensures all events run smoothly, with seamless coordination of schedules, materials, and follow-up communications

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Banking & Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
  • Holder of the CFA, CAIA, or International Certificate in Investor Relations (ICIR) will be an advantage.
  • At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in Investor Relations, Marketing, or related fields.
  • Strong financial analysis and presentation skills, with the ability to interpret financial results and effectively communicate key business drivers to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Proactive and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong communication, organisational, and time management skills.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Engineering Manager, Google Photos Growth
job.description:
About the job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

The Google Photos Growth team owns driving growth and activating new users for Google Photos - the team is running many experiments to improve users' first moments with Photos and fuel our core growth metrics.

As part of a cross platform Android and iOS team, you would lead the team in shipping critical features for Growth, while working closely with cross-functional peers as well as global engineering teams. We are looking for a passionate Engineering Manager to help us build a new team in Google Photos Growth and shape the future of the team. Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client-side (web and mobile), with server-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. We are dedicated to making Google experiences centered around the user.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with cross-functional peers such as Product and UX to collaboratively define the goal and strategy for growing and activating new users on Google Photos.
  • Define and influence technical direction and long-term strategy in conjunction with peer leads, helping the team make balanced tradeoffs, and prioritize engineering excellence investments in a systemic way.
  • Manage an engineering team across Android and iOS including formal career management and coaching to help the team grow in directions that are exciting to them.

job.title: Tech Partner Lead, Google Marketing Platform (Fixed-Term Contract)

job.title: AI Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Customer Engineer (CE) with a specialty in Artificial Intelligence (AI), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of specialized workloads. You will leverage your expertise in our most strategic product areas in partnership with platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI-centered customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development. You will have excellent organizational, communication, and presentation skills, engaging with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will blend sales skills, market knowledge, and technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll be leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
  • Combine sales strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
  • Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships. Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go-To-Market team.
  • Work within Product and Engineering management systems to document, prioritize and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
  • Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.

  • Prepare Manufacturing Control Plans.

Qualifications

Functional Competencies

Understanding of product standards

Knowledge of manufacturing processes

Awareness of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, TQM, etc.

Planning and organizing skills

Product qualification, PPAP, and PFMEA tools

QUALIFICATIONS, ROLE-SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE

7+ years of relevant experience in the Quality department within the electrical switchgear/switchboard industry.

job.title: Senior Manager - Facilities and Operations
job.description:

Maintain appropriate documentation related to leases, contracts, statutory approvals, facility records, asset information, and project documentation. Assure ASC -842 financial compliance.

Prepare and maintain facility dashboards, operational metrics, budget reports, project updates, and management reviews.

Manage and develop facility teams and ensure effective coordination of activities across multiple India locations.

Support continuous improvement initiatives related to workplace operations, service quality, processes, governance, and employee experience.

Travel to Trane Technologies locations across India as required.

What you will bring:

Around 15+ years of progressive experience in Corporate Real Estate, Transactions & Strategy, Facilities Management, Workplace Operations, Infrastructure Management, or a related field.

Experience managing facilities across multiple office locations, preferably within a multinational or large corporate environment.

Good experience in commercial lease management, lease renewals, landlord coordination, Transaction management through service brokerage and lease documentation.

Hands-on experience managing office fit-out, renovation, expansion, or relocation projects.

Strong understanding of facility operations and Site services, including HVAC, electrical systems, utilities, building maintenance, and workplace services.

Experience managing facility-management agencies, consultants, contractors, landlords, and other external service providers.

Good understanding of vendor contracts, SLAs, KPIs, scorecards, and service-performance management.

Experience managing operating and capital budgets, cost tracking, forecasting, and cost-optimization initiatives.

Knowledge of applicable facility-related statutory compliance, EHS, fire & life safety, environmental requirements, and workplace standards.

Working knowledge of procurement processes, contract administration, vendor governance, and project controls.

Experience with space planning, office utilization, workplace management, and capacity planning.

Strong project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple activities and projects simultaneously.

Good analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound operational decisions.

Ability to prepare and communicate operational reports, dashboards, project updates, and management summaries.

Strong communication, coordination, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Ability to work effectively with multiple functions, business teams, and external partners.

Experience leading, coordinating, and developing facility teams across different locations.

Ability and willingness to travel across India based on operational and project requirements.

Educational Qualification

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team that cares not just about the work we do but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here—we make it happen with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world so we can all enjoy living in it.

What does it mean to live the Caterpillar Experience?

It means you play a part in building a better world. You contribute to a winning culture—a spirit of accountability—that has driven change on every continent for more than 90 years. To work with us is a commitment to improving sustainability, inventing for the digital age, and innovating to bring solutions to millions of people. Sure, you work for Caterpillar. But more importantly, you work for the good of your career, family, community, and world.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Analyst applications(Supply Chain Applications)to join our Order Fulfillment & Procurement - CAT IT Division.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN.

This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.

Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST

Provide functional and technical solutions and collaborate with a Global team. Engage with stakeholders to perform business analysis, implement IT solutions, manage code changes, and ensure alignment with technical and business objectives. This role requires collaboration with architects, developers, data scientists, and project managers to maintain efficient IT operations and enhance application performance, focusing on supply chain solutions.

What You Will Do

  • Work with a team of 8 members within the Global Team/Vendor organization, developing functional expertise and ownership for Supply Chain functional areas.
  • Actively collaborate with business stakeholders to develop and implement IT solutions, ensuring full integration with existing systems.
  • Review and approve code changes to ensure compliance with technical and organizational standards.
  • Provide development teams technical oversight, feedback, and guidance, ensuring robust and functional solutions.
  • Work closely with project managers to define timelines, manage costs, and establish project goals.
  • Partner with architects to ensure IT solutions align with business and technical objectives.
  • In collaboration with developers and data scientists, ensure timely and effective delivery of IT controls for the Supply Chain team.

What You Have:

Effective Communications:

  • Ability to collaborate with an extended professional technology network to help effectively identify, plan, and accomplish technology objectives.
  • Experience providing direction and mentoring developers and analysts across various systems/applications, technologies, services, and solutions, preferably in the Supply Chain technology domain.

Application Design, Architecture:

  • Knowledge of application design activities and deliverables; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into technical application designs.

Technical Troubleshooting:

  • Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools, and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, or application.

Problem Solving:

  • Experiencing evaluating, learning, and advising on emerging technologies and their impact on IT and the business.
  • Finds and enjoys using technology to solve business problems and deliver enterprise value!

Considerations For Top Candidates:

  • 7+ of relevant professional experience
  • Bachelor’s Degree or related certifications
  • Experienced working with technologies that include AWS – Snowflake, Hive, PySpark and Big Data
  • Additional technical experience with Neo4j graph database, integration middleware technologies, and application architecture with strong Supply Chain knowledge.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, best practices, and standards to ensure the secure design and implementation of technical solutions.

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers, who build a better world.

Here, you earn more than just an hourly wage. Because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day-one benefits (medical, dental, vision, RX, and 401K) along with the potential of an annual bonus.

Additional benefits include paid vacation days and holidays (prorated based on the hire date).

Additional Info:

  • The primary locations for this position are East Peoria, IL
  • This position may require 10% travel.
  • Sponsorship is not available.

Skill Descriptors

Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
  • Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
  • Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
  • Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
  • Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
  • Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
  • Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
  • Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
  • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
  • Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
  • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
  • Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
  • Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
  • Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
  • Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
  • Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
  • Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
  • Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
  • Provides instant support for end users of application software.
  • Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
  • Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
  • Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
  • Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
  • Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
  • Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
  • Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
  • Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
  • Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
  • Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
  • Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
  • Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
  • Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
  • Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
  • Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
  • Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
  • Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
  • Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
  • Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
  • Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Design Engineer - Electrical
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Design Engineer to join our team focused on genset applications. This role is critical in delivering high-performance, compliant, and manufacturable solutions. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in mechanical design and a collaborative mindset to work effectively with global teams.

Role Definition

Serve as a senior technical individual contributor with full accountability for the end‑to‑end electrical design and development of large (>2 MW) diesel genset packages. Lead and deliver complex, high‑impact engineering initiatives, driving technical excellence from concept definition through detailed design, rigorous validation, and successful global production release.

Responsibilities

  • Lead design and development of electrical Genset package from concept selection through detailed design, ensuring compliance with Caterpillar’s engineering standards and regional regulations.
  • Technical Expertise:Provide strong technical leadership with deep knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals, electrical architecture design using complex technical principles.
  • Manufacturing: In-depth knowledge of electrical designs (schematics, harnesses, control panels, switchgear layouts), component selection, electrical assembly practices, engineering drawings, manufacturing processes and package Bill of Material (BOM).
  • Interface & Cross Functional Collaboration:Lead interface management across global cross functional engineering teams and suppliers to ensure holistic electrical package fitment, system integration, and functional integrity throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Design Optimization:Apply engineering principles and analytical insights to optimize designs for manufacturability, performance, durability, cost effectiveness, and ease of assembly.

Experience required

  • As a Lead Engineer, you will directly conceive and provide practical product design applications using complex technical principles. Emphasis of this position is on creating concepts and directing the design and development of complex Electrical projects. Experience in Eplan, WSCAD, Creo, Creo Schematic, AutoCAD design tools, and Teamcenter is a must.
  • Prepares concept, design, development, and feasibility studies of complex engineering projects. Prepares development plans and is responsible for meeting scheduled dates. Acts as the development team leader by interacting with plant/manufacturing locations and various engineering departments.
  • Candidate will work with the Product Definition / Global Counterpart to understand the product requirements and collaborates within Engineering and other cross-functional teams to provide a solution that meets the form, fit and function. In doing so, the incumbent must have a sound knowledge on the electrical regulation and standards. Candidate will directly work with compliance and regulations team to ensure the product design meets the local regulations where the product will be destined to operate.
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on product/project needs and to complete their portions of products project to ensure development schedules are met on time. Drive standardization, modular design and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Coordinate and oversee the creation of designs and models, analytical work, drawing packages, design guides, and other engineering-related documents as needed. Candidate must be able to articulate the Bill of Material changes to incorporate the new designs.
  • Candidate is responsible for the Design Reviews of enclosure, main system, components, and sub-systems with the cross-functional teams at dedicated meetings and updating the concept or design as necessary to respond to customer specifications changes.
  • Candidate must have good communication skills to work with the Global Cross functional teams, packagers and other channel partners to ensure the projects are delivered on time, meets quality and achieves cost targets.
  • The applicant must also support Global Manufacturing facilities to address their queries on electrical design and resolve the quality issues in timely manner.
  • Candidate to have sound knowledge on the Generator, Control Systems, Power Systems, AC/DC Distribution, Alternators, Breakers, etc. are preferred. Proven knowledge of different Electrical codes (CE, UL, NEC), FMEA development and experience with diesel and alternate fuels for engines and gensets are added advantages.

Required Qualifications

  • Requires a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering / electrical & Electronics Engineering with 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Incumbent must be able to demonstrate the ability to gain a mastery of complex engineering and manufacturability concepts.
  • Must have a good electrical aptitude with ability to develop product concepts. Requires strong leadership ability and good communications skills.
  • Prior / Proven experience in containerized genset packaging industry.

_Skill Descriptors_

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Seeks discrepancies and inconsistencies in available information; explains variances.
  • Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation.
  • Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research.
  • Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action.
  • Approaches a complex problem by breaking it down into its component parts.
  • Chooses among a diverse set of analytical tools according to the nature of the situation.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
  • Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
  • Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.
  • Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.
  • Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement.
  • Maintains focus on the topic at hand.

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Clarifies and handles multiple concurrent and diverse activities.
  • Shifts focus among several efforts as required by changing priorities.
  • Addresses potential conflicts that impact current delivery commitments.
  • Works with or leads others to re-prioritize work and reschedule commitments as necessary.
  • Responds to shifting priorities while maintaining progress of regularly scheduled work.
  • Demonstrates an expectation that there will be ongoing shifts in demands and priorities.

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Advises others on the assessment and provision of all technical solutions.
  • Engages appropriate subject matter resources to effectively resolve technical issues.
  • Mentors others to enhance their technical competence and its application to achieve more effective technical solutions.
  • Coaches others in promoting, defining, analyzing, and providing superior technical solutions to business problems.
  • Provides effective solutions to moderate technical challenges through strong technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
  • Assumes accountability for personal technical performance and holds others responsible for theirs.

Computer-Aided Design & Engineering: Knowledge of tools and techniques of specialized graphics programs; ability to produce, analyze, simulate and test product design drafts.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Coaches others on orthographic, isometric and axonometric projections.
  • Presents complex products and systems graphically.
  • Performs manipulations on design objects, such as changing projections and managing drawing layers.
  • Directs the matrix computations performed to transform objects in coordinate space.
  • Consults on benefits and drawbacks of top-down design vs. bottom-up design.
  • Compares and contrasts uses of bird's-eye views and worm's-eye views.

Product Design - MFG: Knowledge of processes, approaches, tools and techniques of product design; ability to convert customer and market requirements into product design.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Develops improvement plans for senior management and evaluates the outcome of the design against the functionality.
  • Advises others on the development of multiple products and their functionality.
  • Trains others on advanced tools and approaches of product design.
  • Monitors the processes and procedures of a complex product design to ensure functional requirements are met.
  • Evaluates feedback from customers and consults on functional weaknesses.
  • Controls design and development costs of a proposed product through effective resource coordination.

Product Design and Development: Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Develops organizational standards and processes in order to maximize complex product services' efficiency and effectiveness.

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer IV - Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

The Critical Facilities Engineer IV plays a key role in maintaining the reliability, safety, and efficiency of mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role performs a broad range of maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational activities across critical facility systems, applying technical knowledge and sound judgment to resolve issues and support continuous operations.

Working as part of a collaborative team, the engineer operates with a good degree of independence, contributes to infrastructure improvements, and supports the development of less experienced team members while helping maintain high standards of safety and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on critical facility systems and equipment to support reliable and continuous data center operations.
  • Execute repairs, inspections, installations, and maintenance activities across electrical, mechanical, cooling, and supporting facility infrastructure.
  • Monitor the Building Monitoring System (BMS) and respond to alarms, applying technical knowledge and judgment to investigate and resolve issues in accordance with established procedures.
  • Operate and support critical infrastructure, including electrical power, mechanical and cooling, plumbing, fire suppression, and life-safety systems.
  • Identify equipment issues, operational risks, and potential infrastructure constraints, escalating higher-risk situations when appropriate.
  • Support energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve facility performance.
  • Carry out day-to-day operational activities with limited supervision while seeking guidance for complex or high-risk situations.

Vendor Support

  • Coordinate and oversee vendors and service providers performing maintenance and infrastructure activities within the data center.
  • Support the work approval process, including pre-work briefings, reviewing planned activities, monitoring execution, and validating completed work.
  • Ensure vendor activities are performed in accordance with site procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.
  • Work with vendors to maintain accurate technical documentation, equipment records, drawings, and asset information.

Site Administration & Incident Support

  • Prepare and maintain site documentation, permits, logs, and operational records, including Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs) and operational scripts.
  • Identify Single Points of Failure (SPOFs) and operational risks and provide recommendations to improve infrastructure resilience.
  • Respond to equipment failures, operational issues, and site incidents in accordance with established incident management procedures.
  • Support incident investigation and root cause analysis activities and contribute recommendations for corrective actions.
  • Apply strong knowledge of operational procedures and compliance requirements to support safe and effective site operations.

Work Orders & Additional Projects

  • Complete facility-related work orders and support infrastructure installations and modifications.
  • Troubleshoot facility equipment and supporting systems to identify faults and minimize downtime.
  • Support approved modifications to electrical, mechanical, cooling, and specialized systems.
  • Participate in infrastructure upgrades, lifecycle replacement programs, maintenance initiatives, and site improvement projects.
  • Recommend practical improvements that enhance infrastructure reliability, efficiency, and operational performance.

Collaboration

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve facility issues and support operational activities.
  • Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to junior team members on maintenance activities and operational procedures.
  • Communicate inventory and critical spare-part requirements to support operational readiness.
  • Work closely with senior engineers during complex maintenance activities, incidents, and infrastructure projects.
  • Contribute ideas and recommendations that improve safety, reliability, efficiency, and overall site performance.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Degree, Diploma, technical certification, or equivalent qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
  • Typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in critical facilities, data center operations, facilities maintenance, industrial facilities, building operations, or a related technical environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Good working knowledge of electrical, mechanical, cooling, or building infrastructure systems.
  • Experience performing preventive and corrective maintenance in a data center or other high-availability environment is advantageous.
  • Familiarity with BMS or facility monitoring systems, maintenance procedures, and safe work practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to identify risks, evaluate operational issues, and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.
  • Commitment to safety, operational excellence, and continuous learning.

Work Requirements

  • Ability to perform hands-on operational and maintenance tasks within a data center environment.
  • Ability to work at height and in confined or tight spaces where required.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends, night shifts, holidays, and shift-based schedules, as required to support 24x7 mission-critical data center operations.

job.title: Manager, Business Operations
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a Business Operations Manager to run the day-to-day financial operations of Keppel's Networks business. Reporting to the Financial & Investment Lead, you will own and oversee budgets, cash flow management, payments, purchase orders, billing and management reporting across active operating systems.

You will be the connective tissue between the technical, commercial, business development, procurement and corporate finance teams — ensuring that what is committed is tracked, what is invoiced is verified, what is paid is authorised, and what is reported is accurate and on time. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong financial discipline with the practicality to make processes work in a fast-moving project environment.

Key Areas of Ownership

1. Budgets and forecasting

  • Own the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts for across Networks, consolidating inputs from technical, project, commercial and operations teams.
  • Track budget vs. actuals at project and business-unit level, investigating variances and agreeing corrective actions with budget owners.
  • Support scenario planning and reforecasting when project schedules, scope or supplier terms change.

2. Cash flow and treasury operations

  • Ensure short- and medium-term cash flow forecasting across Networks entities, Projects and at operating entities, ensuring liquidity for all obligations and corporate commitments.
  • Coordinate funding requests, intercompany transfers with central finance and treasury functions.
  • Support drawdown requests and covenant/reporting obligations under project facility agreements, working with the commercial project management team to ensure lender requirements are met on time.
  • Monitor FX exposure on multi-currency supplier contracts and customer receipts, flagging hedging needs to treasury where appropriate.

3. Payments, POs and procurement operations

  • Govern the purchase order process end to end: PO raising, approvals in line with delegation of authority, goods/services receipting and closure.
  • Working with procurement and support functions, oversee and review the payments cycle — invoice verification against contracts, milestones and POs, payment approvals, and execution through banking platforms — ensuring suppliers are paid accurately and on time.
  • Working with Technical Teams, track vendor payments against contractual obligations and ensuring governance and controls, working closely with the technical teams and various workstream leads where necessary.
  • Manage customer billing operations for IRU, and O&M agreements: invoicing schedules, receipts tracking and collections follow-up.

4. SOP governance and process oversight

  • Govern the development, documentation and upkeep of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across the full Procure-to-Pay (P2P) cycle — supplier onboarding and due diligence, PO raising and approvals, goods/services receipting, invoice verification, payment authorisation and execution, and supplier master data management.
  • Govern equivalent SOPs for the customer billing (Order-to-Cash) cycle — contract-to-billing setup for IRU and O&M agreements, invoicing, receipting, credit control and collections escalation.
  • Ensure SOPs are aligned with Keppel group policies, delegation of authority and audit requirements; conduct periodic compliance reviews, track exceptions and remediate gaps.
  • Train and support budget owners, project teams and new joiners on P2P and billing processes, supporting the procurement team for process, policy creation and controls.
  • Review and update SOPs as the business scales

5. Reporting and controls

  • Produce monthly management reporting: P&L, cash flow, budget vs. actuals, committed spend, AR/AP ageing and project cost dashboards for the FC/Investment Lead and leadership.
  • Maintain and improve financial controls, approval workflows and documentation, ensuring compliance with Keppel group policies and audit requirements.
  • Support statutory audit, tax filings and entity-level compliance across all Network entities, working with finance, tax, R&C, and corporate secretarial colleagues.

6. Business operations support

  • Administer contract and document management for financial records: executed contracts, variation orders, bank guarantees and insurance certificates.
  • Drive process improvement and systems adoption, automating recurring tasks where possible.
  • Provide ad hoc analysis to the various Leads where required — cost reviews, supplier spend analysis, and support for new project setup, etc.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years' experience in business operations, financial operations, FP&A or project accounting
  • Strong working knowledge of budgeting, cash— ideally in infrastructure, telecoms, construction, marine/offshore or another capital-intensive project environment. flow forecasting, PO/payment cycles and month-end reporting.
  • Experience operating financial controls and delegation-of-authority frameworks, with a track record of accuracy and timeliness; demonstrated ability to write, implement and govern SOPs across P2P and/or billing processes.
  • Confident with ERP and procurement systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and advanced Excel; comfortable building and maintaining reporting dashboards.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple entities, currencies and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills — able to chase, challenge and support budget owners, suppliers and senior stakeholders constructively.

Join our vibrant and inclusive workforce to shape a better future for all!

#LI-AM1

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to project-financed structures: drawdowns, lender reporting, covenant compliance and multi-SPV environments.
  • Familiarity with subsea cable or telecoms commercial structures (supplier milestone contracts, IRU billing, O&M cost allocation).
  • Accounting qualification or part-qualification (ACCA, CPA, CIMA or equivalent), or a degree in finance, accounting or business.
  • Experience supporting audits and working across legal, tax and corporate secretarial functions in multiple jurisdictions.

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Connectivity

PLATFORM

Operating Division

job.title: Facilities Coordinator (Data Centre)
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia’s leading data centres.

  • Join CDC as we continue to grow in Melbourne's west
  • CDC academy training provided and ongoing growth opportunities
  • Free onsite Parking

About Us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

In this role, you will share responsibility for the effective delivery of day-to-day facilities management of CDC data centres. This includes the coordination and management of site logistics, physical security, general maintenance outside, internal and external presentation of the facilities and administration associated with assigned workflows.

This role is part of CDC’s Operations team which is the heart of CDC. Being on the ground, in the data centres every day to ensure CDC continue to be Australia’s best specialist data centre provider. This team is proud of their data centres and can’t wait to show them off to our customers.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Ensure all facilities maintenance activities adhere to approved workplans, maintaining building compliance.
  • Liaise and coordinate with contracted staff to ensure efficient and accurate works are completed, across a range of verticals (e.g. structural, plumbing, regular facilities).
  • Ensure adherence to emergency and health and safety regulations, aligned to CDC policy.
  • Manage logistics within the facility, collaborating with the operations team to enforce security protocols and standards.
  • Conduct inspections for repairs or renovations of facility structures (such as lifts, pressure vessels, fire compliance, stormwater + plumbing), coordinating access for clients, guests, contractors, and suppliers accordingly.
  • Promote and enforce safe work practices, ensure strong presentation and upkeep standards, representing the company professionally.

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy - Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About you

Ideally, you'll bring experience in facilities, property, or building operations, with exposure to base building services, planned and reactive maintenance, and contractor management. Experience with DLP (Defects Liability Period) management and coordinating building compliance and safety obligations will be highly regarded.

This role works closely with customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders, so strong communication and relationship-building skills are essential. We're seeking someone who is organised, solutions-focused, and excited by the opportunity to join a growing and dynamic team.

  • Experience in scheduling or coordinating contractors and external vendors.
  • Excellent organisational and administrative skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  • Confident in MS Office, and tech savvy in nature to pick up internal systems.
  • Demonstrated experience in Property Management, Facilities Management, Office Management or Security Management.
  • Confident communicator, with the ability to speak to stakeholders of varying seniority levels.
  • Experience in identifying and managing building defects, with a strong understanding of compliance and rectification processes is highly desirable.

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

job.title: Head of General Affairs and Real Estate
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the CEO’s office, this role sets the standard for how Digital Edge runs its offices and corporate real estate across Singapore and our regional offices. You will lead general affairs, office facilities and the lease portfolio across our office locations, and act as the Centre of Excellence for every corporate office in the group.

This role is based in Singapore with occasional travel across the region. The role will be a people manager for the Office Management team in Singapore as well as dotted line manager for the OM teams across the region and be responsible for creating a General Affairs community and supportive environment for those within the GA business Unit

Key responsibilities

  • Lead general affairs and office facilities across all Digital Edge markets, including day to day office management, workplace services and support for in-country office and administration teams
  • Own the corporate real estate and lease portfolio for offices: lease administration, renewals, rent reviews, landlord relationships and critical date tracking
  • Plan and deliver office fit outs, renovations and relocations end to end, on time and on budget
  • Partner with Finance on facilities and lease budgets, cost tracking and savings opportunities
  • Lead corporate purchasing for office goods and services, and manage facilities vendors and service contracts against agreed service levels
  • Set common standards, policies and playbooks so every office runs the same way, while respecting local requirements
  • Build a connected regional network of office and administration teams, with shared practices, cross training and cover
  • Work with HR and Health & Safety to deliver an excellent employee experience with regards to workplace services and appropriate training for office based staff
  • Act as the point of contact for workplace safety and ergonomic concerns for desk based staff
  • Support business continuity planning for corporate offices, including emergency and incident response.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • 8+ years in general affairs, facilities management, corporate real estate or corporate administration, including at least 5 years leading remote team
  • Regional or multi-country experience across Asia, ideally in a fast growing or PE-backed business
  • Hands-on lease management experience, including renewals, negotiations and landlord relations
  • A track record of delivering office fit outs, renovations or relocations end to end
  • Strong background in procurement, vendor management and contract administration
  • Experience leading teams in a matrix structure, with in-country staff who do not report to you directly
  • Commercial and detail focused, comfortable managing budgets, contracts and cost reporting
  • Clear communicator who builds trust with stakeholders across cultures and levels
  • A genuine commitment to safe and healthy workplaces
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Facilities Management, Real Estate or a related field. Professional certification in facilities or corporate real estate (for example IFMA or CoreNet) is an advantage

If you’re ready to help shape the next phase of a fast‑growing digital infrastructure platform, we’d like to hear from you!

job.title: Retail Consultant, Melton West
job.description:
Melton West, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual Retail Service Consultant to join our Melton West team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You’re confident in navigating difficult enquiries, ease tricky situations with empathy and respect, and work toward the best solution for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support one another, stay accountable, and create a customer‑first environment where everyone succeeds.

What’s in it for you?

  • $35 p/h + super + applicable loadings.
  • Phenomenal perks, including 25% off Optus products and exclusive access to unique discounts with our retail partners.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.
  • Flexible rosters that work around the life you live outside of work.

Intrigued, but not sure you tick every box? That’s completely okay! We still encourage you to apply. We all grow, learn and develop together, and this role might be the perfect next step in your career journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

As the Product Development Manager within Financial & Lifestyle Services (FLS), you will take on a Product Owner role supporting the roadmap and delivery of Singtel Protect General Insurance and Life Insurance services.

You will work alongside the Agile development team to gather requirements, prioritise tasks and manage end-to-end delivery of new features and enhancements, balancing time, cost and quality. Working across Business Owners, insurance partners, Commercial, Technical, Operations and Marketing teams, you will bring customer journeys from requirements through development, testing and successful launch.

  • Own end-to-end project delivery plans covering scope, milestones, timelines and stakeholder management across Commercial, Technical, Operations and Marketing teams.

  • Gather business and platform requirements from Business Owners and insurance partners and prioritise tasks with the Agile development squad.

  • Identify and manage project risks proactively, assess potential impact and escalate issues where necessary.
  • Manage relationships with senior internal stakeholders, external ecosystem partners, suppliers and vendors.
  • Run product operational forums and ensure timely project status updates to management.
  • Manage ongoing product development and feature implementation.
  • Co-build and maintain product technology roadmaps and strategies for the business.
  • Monitor competitor activities, market and technology trends and evolving customer needs.
  • Ensure product development plans comply with relevant legal and compliance requirements.
  • Support customer-facing teams with specialist product training through Learning & Development.
  • Ensure smooth handover to Operations following successful BRT/User Trial completion.
  • Extract key performance data to support management reporting.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Engineering or Computer Science from a reputable university.
  • More than 3 years of project management experience.
  • Experience delivering at least one complex cross-organisational technical systems integration project.
  • Strong project management capabilities.
  • Knowledge of mobile payment systems and open-loop payment processing.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team player.
  • Good presentation and analytical skills.
  • Experience in insurance products and customer buy flows would be advantageous.

Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

Be a Part of Something BIG!

The role is responsible for supporting the implementation and continuous enhancement of risk management and business continuity management (BCM) frameworks, policies and processes within Singtel Group.

The role works closely with business and functional stakeholders to identify, assess, monitor and report key risks, evaluate the adequacy of mitigation measures, and strengthen organizational resilience through effective BCM planning, testing and crisis preparedness.

The role also supports broader Group Risk & Compliance (GRC) initiatives, including risk governance, controls assurance and the promotion of a strong risk and compliance culture across the organization.

Make An Impact By

Risk Management & Governance

  • Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of enterprise risk management frameworks, policies and processes, in alignment with Group requirements.
  • Coordinate periodic risk assessments with business and functional stakeholders to identify, assess and monitor key risks, emerging threats and corresponding mitigation measures.
  • Analyse risk information, trends and key risk indicators (KRIs) to provide insights and recommendations to Management for informed decision-making.
  • Prepare and consolidate risk reports, dashboards and updates for Management and relevant risk governance committees.
  • Work with risk owners to monitor the implementation and effectiveness of risk mitigation plans, and escalate material risk exposures and control gaps where appropriate.
  • Support initiatives to strengthen risk governance, risk awareness and the integration of risk management into business processes and decision-making.

Business Continuity Management (BCM) & Operational Resilience

  • Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of the BCM framework, policies and processes to strengthen organisational resilience.
  • Coordinate Business Impact Assessments (BIAs) and Business Continuity Plan (BCP) reviews with business units to ensure that critical activities, dependencies and recovery requirements are appropriately identified and documented.
  • Work with business and technology stakeholders to align business recovery requirements, including Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs), with disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Plan and coordinate BCP testing, exercises and other resilience validation activities, and track remediation of identified gaps.
  • Support crisis management preparedness, including the maintenance of crisis management protocols, coordination of simulation exercises and follow-up on lessons learnt.
  • Assess business continuity and operational resilience risks, and recommend improvements to strengthen the organisation's ability to respond to and recover from disruptions.

Other Risk & Compliance Initiatives

  • Collaborate with business units and functional teams to identify and address cross-functional risks and control gaps, and support relevant risk and compliance reviews and assurance activities.
  • Support initiatives to strengthen risk governance, risk awareness and the integration of risk management into business processes and decision-making.
  • Undertake other GRC initiatives and projects as assigned.

Skills To Succeed

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or Law.
  • 8–10 years of relevant experience in risk management, business continuity management, operational resilience or related functions, with practical experience in both Risk and BCM.
  • Experience in conducting risk assessments, risk reporting, developing mitigation plans and implementing BCM programmes.
  • Experience in engaging and working with stakeholders across different business and functional areas.
  • Sound knowledge of enterprise risk management frameworks, risk assessment methodologies, risk reporting and key risk indicators.
  • Practical knowledge of BCM, including Business Impact Assessments (BIAs), Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), disaster recovery coordination and crisis management.
  • Ability to analyse complex risk issues, evaluate mitigation measures and provide practical recommendations.
  • Strong report writing and presentation skills.
