job.title: Territory Sales - Field Sales Account Executive
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for developing and growing business opportunities within an assigned sales territory, market segment, or channel. Builds and maintains strong customer relationships, understands customer needs and buying processes, and positions Cummins products, solutions, and services to deliver customer value and achieve business objectives.

The role involves prospecting for new opportunities, developing and executing account plans, managing the sales pipeline, achieving sales targets, maintaining accurate forecasts, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction and sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, research, and develop new business opportunities by engaging prospective customers and understanding their business needs.
  • Develop and execute account plans for key prospects and customers to drive business growth and achieve sales objectives.
  • Conduct customer meetings and face-to-face sales calls to understand customer requirements, priorities, business models, and buying processes.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term customer relationships to generate repeat business and identify future sales opportunities.
  • Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate Cummins products, solutions, and services aligned with their business requirements.
  • Articulate the value proposition and competitive advantages of Cummins solutions to support customer decision-making.
  • Conduct commercial negotiations in accordance with company guidelines, including pricing and payment terms.
  • Drive sales performance by achieving assigned sales targets and maintaining a healthy sales pipeline.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate sales forecasts and track performance against business targets.
  • Monitor pipeline health and proactively identify actions required to improve conversion and achieve sales objectives.
  • Maintain customer and sales activity information in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system as required.
  • Respond to customer concerns and queries in a timely manner and work with internal stakeholders to ensure effective resolution.
  • Support collection of accounts receivable and maintain an acceptable level of past-due accounts by collaborating with customers and relevant internal teams.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to balance inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations, as applicable.
  • Consistently follow the Cummins Sales Process, tools, systems, and initiatives that support sales effectiveness, customer satisfaction, and customer value.
  • Monitor market and channel dynamics and identify opportunities to strengthen Cummins' presence and grow the business.
  • Support special projects and other sales initiatives aligned with business requirements.

Key Competencies

  • Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and develops customer-centric solutions.
  • Business Development: Identifies and converts new business opportunities to drive growth.
  • Account Planning: Develops and executes account strategies aligned with business objectives and customer needs.
  • Sales Pipeline Management: Proactively manages the sales pipeline and prioritizes activities to achieve sales targets.
  • Sales Forecasting: Uses customer, market, and historical data to develop accurate sales forecasts and consumption projections.
  • Articulating Value Proposition: Clearly communicates the benefits and differentiated value of Cummins products, solutions, and services.
  • Negotiation Excellence: Uses effective negotiation techniques to achieve mutually beneficial commercial outcomes within company guidelines.
  • Channel Awareness: Understands industry structure, market dynamics, customer segments, and routes to market.
  • Persuasion: Uses compelling and fact-based communication to influence customer decisions and gain stakeholder commitment.
  • Communicates Effectively: Adapts communication style and content to effectively engage customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Sense Making: Uses probing, diagnostic questions and available information to understand customer needs and buying behavior and translate insights into appropriate solutions.
  • Adapts to Target Audience: Simplifies and communicates complex information effectively for different audiences.
  • Integrates Customer Perspective: Incorporates customer insights into sales strategies and solutions to improve customer experience and revenue.
  • Action Oriented: Demonstrates urgency, ownership, energy, and enthusiasm in pursuing opportunities and addressing challenges.
  • Values Differences: Recognizes and leverages diverse perspectives and experiences to achieve better business outcomes.

Qualifications

  • College, university, or equivalent degree in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline .
  • Relevant sales experience may be considered in lieu of a formal degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • May require applicable licensing or compliance requirements related to export controls or sanctions regulations, depending on the role and market.

Skills & Experience

  • Basic relevant experience in sales, business development, account management, channel sales, customer relationship management, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong customer relationship management and communication skills.
  • Ability to identify customer needs and translate them into appropriate products, solutions, or services.
  • Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of pricing, negotiations, and business profitability.
  • Ability to develop and execute account plans and manage a sales pipeline.
  • Ability to analyze customer and market information and use insights to support sales decisions.
  • Experience using CRM systems and sales tools for opportunity tracking, activity reporting, and forecasting is preferred.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external customers.
  • Strong problem-solving, influencing, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Willingness to travel to customer locations, channel partners, or assigned territories as required by the role.
  • Employee to handle Rajasthan State sales business.
  • Customer Engagement and Generating New Business opportunity through New Customers.
  • Account Receivable management for Dealers.
  • Delivery Signed AOP for assigned dealership.
  • Analyse, Monitor & Improve Dealer Parts Secondary Sales.
  • Working on PowerGen & other Sales Initiatives.

Supports sales force through reporting, system administration and internal & external data analyses by executing, supporting and improving selected activities under limited supervision.

  • System Administration:

  • Data Analyses (External & Internal):
  • Analyses external sources (e.g. Polk, Dodge, RigDig, etc.) to identify sales opportunities and forwards them to the sales team.
  • Reviews the findings from research on assigned opportunities, shares with relevant teams.
  • Compiles and qualifies competitive data, communicates to sales force per relevancy.
  • Conducts internal sales analyses (e.g. variances, projections, costing, bundling) for ad-hoc and repetitive tasks.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Develop supply chain analytics to make operational performance and trends visible. Ensure data integrity of all analytics and reports. Develop reporting capability for supply chain Key Performance Indicators. Develop basic supply chain models for scenario analysis Conduct internal and external benchmarking analysis. Provide financial analysis as required

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

​Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Analysis and Troubleshooting - Extracts, transforms, models, interprets, and presents planning data with the goal of mining useful information, troubleshooting, suggesting conclusions, and supporting value creating decision making.

Material Planning - Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Skill Set = Global perspective, Analytical and AI, leadership skills, project management skills

The Order Intake Senior Analyst is a global role high visibility role between Sales & Marketing, Supply Chain, and Finance. Identifies gaps with operational impact to AOP, forecast, and demands plans. Makes recommendations for projections.

This role analyzes demand forecasts, demonstrated demands, build plans trends, shipment trends, and related KPIs trends to create awareness of early signals and their impacts in supply chain, sales and marketing, and finance. Identifies product mix changes in demands, regional mix changes and abnormal demands. Quantifies demand changes and provides impact analysis in lead times, build plans, and revenues. Creates standard materials for demand reviews, financial reviews, and supply chain reviews. Drives escalations to proper stakeholders through the business forums (Financial reviews, Demand Reviews, Supply Chain Reviews).

Utilizes AI prompting and existing automation to perform complex analysis. Serve as gate keeper for data repositories used in multiple analysis. Manages and maintain multi year data repositories, Power BI and Dashboard landing page/repository, and ensures service level and uptime of existing BIs and datasets.

Manages several projects, applies project management principals to control schedule and scope, manages stakeholders expectations for milestones, and present project portfolio updates to managers and directors.

MUST have demonstrated experience executing/developing:

-Strong Project Management Experience (stakeholders expectations, manage timelines)

-Strong communications skills with directors and managers

-Experience identifying long term and short term trends using analytical methods

-Experience creating and managing assumptions in projections or recurring analysis

-Experience creating analytical frameworks to root cause gaps and solve problems.

  • Experience creating business analytical models and manage ambiguity

-Strong statistical experience (SPSS, Minitab, @Risk Palisade, Databricks)

-Strong skills prompting for analysis, creating trends and charts, using multiple sources, and merging analysis

-Strong skills with: Power BI and Power Queries

-Highly desired experience with Power-Automate or Copilot Studio

-Highly desired knowledge of SQL scripts and phyton

-10years of experience

-Master in Analytics, Supply Chain, Finance, AI or related field is highly desired.

job.title: JSM-Facilities Associate
job.description:
Job Summary

As part of a formal apprenticeship or regional training program, assists with facilities changes and improvements; assists with maintaining relationships with various suppliers and vendors of services provided to the facility; communicates changes and improvements to affected facility occupants. Performs activities under direct supervision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supports coordination with facilities management to schedule work and special projects for the assigned facility.
  • Assists with planning for changes and improvements; assist with schedules and implements plan.
  • Helps with developing, documenting, and reporting budgets for approval process; creates and writes purchase orders; approves payment of invoices.
  • Assists to update, edit and print CAD layouts and master plans; assist with managing floor space and office space all locations within master plan.
  • Assists with organizing installation of communications equipment with internal and external suppliers and customers.
  • Participates in improvement processes; actively participates in self-and team audits and resulting process improvements.
  • Works under close supervision according to defined facility procedures/processes.
  • Attends classes and on/off site training programs (travel if required) and makes appropriate progress necessary to build basic skills and knowledge required to pass local certification.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Emergency Preparedness - Plans, manages and supports the site’s emergency preparedness program; identifies risks and develops a risk management plan to address incidents such as power outage, flood, and fire; manages the maintenance of emergency systems for fire and flood protection; reports any system impairments.

Facilities Maintenance - Assesses the condition of the facility including its systems, structure, interiors, exteriors and grounds; manages facility operations and maintenance activities; develops and operates asset management systems for Preventative Maintenance's that uses criticality analysis, predictive tools and prioritization.

Facilities Operation - Manages occupant services (parking, janitorial services, food services, concierge, facility helpdesk, security and safety); manages the maintenance contracting process; develops and manages the facility’s operational planning requirements (temperature control, lighting, equipment replacement, water treatment and so forth).

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

Experience

Minimal or no work experience required.

  • Manage the Plant Manager’s calendar, meetings, appointments, and priorities.
  • Coordinate daily morning meetings, including collection, consolidation, and presentation of key plant data and updates.
  • Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, and supporting information for Plant Leadership meetings.
  • Coordinate meetings with Plant Leadership Team members and stakeholders across different plant locations.
  • Record meeting minutes, decisions, and action items, and follow up with respective owners for timely closure.
  • Prepare and maintain MIS, dashboards, trackers, and management reports as required.
  • Coordinate communication and information flow between the Plant Manager and key functional stakeholders.
  • Support the Plant Manager during plant visits, leadership reviews, audits, and other important meetings/events.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive business and employee information.
  • Identify opportunities to improve meeting effectiveness, reporting, and administrative processes.
  • Coordinate EEEC activities at the plant level.
  • Coordinate purchase of required materials and services for plant visits, meetings, and other important forums/events.

The responsibilities outlined above are indicative and not limited to the listed activities. Additional responsibilities may be assigned based on business and organizational requirements.

job.title: Expert, AI Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced AI Support Expert to oversee the operational support, incident management, and technical maintenance of AI/ML-driven applications built using Python and deployed across AWS and Azure cloud platforms. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, Python-based application development, AI/ML operations (MLOps), and team leadership.

This role ensures high availability, reliability, and performance of AI systems that support business-critical processes, spanning across company’s Internal and External use cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Team Management
  • Lead, mentor, and guide a team of support engineers (L1/L2/L3).
  • Foster seamless collaboration with development teams across France and India to ensure smooth handovers and operational readiness.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex issues across applications, ML models, and cloud services.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and establish best practices for operational excellence.
  • Application Support & Troubleshooting
  • Manage the full lifecycle of issues for AI use cases, serving both internal business units and external clients.
  • Provide end-to-end support for Python-based APIs, microservices, AI/ML pipelines, and data processing systems.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to Python environments, dependencies, performance bottlenecks, and integrations.
  • Maintain high availability and optimal performance of production workloads.
  • Monitoring, Incident, and AI-Native Operations
  • Champion the usage of AI-native engineering tools to automate support workflows and improve system observability.
  • Establish monitoring dashboards and alerts through Dynatrace, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or Application Insights.
  • Own the full lifecycle of incidents, from detection to root cause analysis and preventive measures.
  • Maintain and ensure adherence to SLA commitments.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5–10 years of experience supporting production systems, preferably AI/ML or data-intensive applications.
  • Hands-on experience managing support across various layers: from underlying processes to specific AI use cases and intelligent agents.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, debugging, and API frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, Django).
  • Experience with AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, SageMaker, RDS) and Azure (App Services, Functions, Azure ML, Storage, AKS).
  • Experience with AI-native engineering tools and automated agentic evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture.

Soft Skills

  • Global mindset: Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment, specifically collaborating with teams in Europe and Asia.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to handle high-pressure incidents.
  • Strong leadership, mentoring, and team management capabilities.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as AWS and Azure Administrator, or Azure/AWS Data/AI certifications.
  • Experience with MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, Sagemaker Pipelines, Azure ML Pipelines).
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps, automation, and cost optimization best practices.
  • Experience in ITIL practices for incident, problem, and change management.

What's in it for me?

  • Direct impact on organizational success through high-visibility technical support
  • Collaborative team culture that values your expertise and innovative thinking
  • Growth opportunities through exposure to cutting-edge technologies and complex challenges
  • Autonomy to set priorities and contribute to transformative service improvements

job.title: Senior Logistics and Supply Chain Specialist
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

We are seeking an experienced and highly strategic Senior Logistics and Supply Chain Specialist to lead and execute the Strategic Procurement for construction services supporting our APAC data centre development programme.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Procurement for data centre construction projects in general, and with substantial exposure but not limited to major capital equipment procurement (Genset, Chiller, CRAH, E-Module, etc).

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute end-to-end Procurement activities for data centre construction projects, including supplier selection, RFP/RFQ processes, contract negotiation, and supplier performance management.
  • Lead and execute Procurement strategies that align with project timelines, budget constraints, and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders such as Design engineering, Construction Execution, Cost and Legal, to ensure procurement requirements are clearly defined and met.
  • Manage supplier relationships to ensure delivery performance, cost competitiveness, and compliance with contractual obligations.
  • Conduct market analysis and benchmarking to identify new suppliers and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements.

Knowledge & Attributes

  • Strong commercial acumen and contract negotiation skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Proficient in procurement tools and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Coupa).
  • Good understanding and experience in negotiating construction contracts such as FIDIC, JCT, NEC, contracting strategies, and their interrelationship.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and drive data driven results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Organized, analytical, and structured with excellent communication, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of construction services procurement best practices.
  • Works well in a team environment and independently, gives and receives clear expectations well.
  • Proven experience in strategic Procurement & supplier relationship management.
  • Understanding of basic finance and accounting business structure.

Academic Qualifications & Certificates

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or Quantity Surveying.
  • MCIPS would be desirable.
  • Other languages such as Mandarin, Malay or Thai would be an advantage.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of procurement experience, professional expertise acquired, or relevant work and ideally within data centre construction or large-scale infrastructure projects
  • Job-related experience on supply chain, sourcing and procurement must be relevant for position.

Physical Requirements

  • Occasional move about inside and outside of data center / facility
  • Hot desking and flexible work place.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Occasional to perform work beyond Singapore business hours and time zones.

Work Conditions & Other Requirements

  • Occasional work onsite at a data center location.
  • Travel required 10%-15% of time.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Assistant, Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis (Based in Singapore)
job.description:
The Role

The FP&A Manager leads Group-wide forecasting, budgeting, long-range planning and Economic Value Added (“EVA”) reporting for the Group. The role delivers executive insights through complex financial modelling, large-scale data analysis and scenario simulations; oversees budgeting and planning systems (CCH Tagetik) and ensures data integrity and reporting accuracy. The role also prepares high-quality management and Board materials to support strategic and commercial decision-making.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecasts, working closely with business units to gather inputs and provide critical analysis for management decision making.
  • Independently manage assigned workstreams for monthly and quarterly forecasts, annual budgets, long-range planning, Economic Value Added (“EVA”), and ad hoc projects.
  • Develop complex financial models, manage large datasets, and translate findings into actionable insights for planning and strategic decision-making.
  • Prepare high-quality materials for Board and C-suite presentations.
  • Oversee the Group budgeting system run and provide related subject-matter expertise to internal stakeholders.
  • Drive process and system improvements, and undertake ad hoc analyses and projects as required.

Job Requirements

  • Chartered Accountant with a degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a relevant quantitative discipline, or an ACCA qualification.
  • At least 10 years of relevant experience, including four years in a managerial capacity.
  • Advanced financial modelling and analytical skills, with a proven ability to manage projects and complex datasets independently.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and hands-on experience with budgeting and planning systems such as Tagetik or BPC.
  • Experience in real estate or financial services is an advantage.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently and manage tight timelines.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, with the ability to guide junior team members.

job.title: Project Design Mechanical Engineer, Fleet Remediation Engineering
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We have an immediate opening for a Project Design Mechanical Engineer in Singapore Cluster. If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

As an Amazon Fleet Remediation Project Design Mechanical Engineer, you will lead design projects in operational data centers, that remediate issues, upgrade our existing infrastructure or add new services. You will be the 'go to' engineering resource for these projects and will provide lifecycle support from design through implementation. You will use your mechanical expertise to:

  • Own the design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions which add data center infrastructure, capacity, improve availability, and/or increase sustainability
  • Perform design and equipment submittal review for Data Centers in your region
  • Interface with internal and external data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team, field engineering, and controls engineering to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered
  • Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions
  • Act as a technical subject matter expert for your given discipline during new remediation projects
  • Support construction, commissioning, operations, and turnover

Key job responsibilities Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As a Fleet Remediation Project Design Mechanical Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale.

As an ideal candidate you:

  • Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide design and recommendations despite uncertainty
  • Are detail and data oriented with familiarity with design/construction processes
  • Have experience managing engineering projects and engineering consultants.
  • Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Commissioning, Construction and Design)
  • Manage design and as built drawings and documents
  • Prepare and present progress reports to all relevant stakeholders
  • Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close

A day in the life Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center safety, remediation projects, capacity, and availability, focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
  • Experience as a resident engineer or hands-on design consultant
  • 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
  • Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer License
  • Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
  • Knowledge of mechanical systems (Mechanical, HVAC systems, Controls)
  • Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

job.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
job.description:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.

Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

job.title: Security Engineer, Field Innovation, Security Search and Observability (SSO)
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced Security Engineer to join the Security Search and Observability organization. Our team builds and operates the detection, correlation, and vulnerability-management capabilities behind multiple security services such as AWS Security Hub, AWS CloudTrail, AWS GuardDuty, as well as our newest AI-powered offering, AWS Continuum, which manages the full lifecycle of code vulnerabilities at machine speed. If you have deep information-security expertise and enjoy working at the intersection of hands-on detection engineering and direct customer and partner engagement, this is an exciting opportunity to shape how enterprises secure their cloud and AI workloads.

This is a dual-facing role. As a field-facing security engineer for Asia-Pacific & Japan (APJ), you will work directly with customers to implement the latest features of our newest security services: leading threat-modelling sessions, performing vulnerability assessments with security agents, and guiding remediation - then channel what you learn back into the product. As a partner-facing security engineer, you will work with leading third-party security providers to identify their highest-signal findings and turn them into correlated, customer-visible detections that raise the security value of our services. Across both, you will design and implement detection content, reduce false positives at scale, and expand coverage across cloud resources, runtime, and AI/ML workloads.

The AWS Security Services team builds technologies that help customers strengthen their security posture and better meet their security requirements in the AWS Cloud. We build massively scalable, globally distributed systems that power the next generation of security services.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as the field-facing security engineer for APJ, running early-access and gated previews: including our newest AI-powered vulnerability management capabilities with customers, leading threat modelling, vulnerability assessment using security agents, and remediation guidance
  • Partner with leading third-party security providers to identify high-signal findings and turn them into correlated, high-fidelity detections that increase the security value of AWS security services
  • Work backwards from customers to shape detection coverage and influence service roadmaps, feeding field and partner insights back to science and engineering teams
  • Stay up to date with the ever-changing cloud security and threat landscape, including emerging threats targeting agentic AI and ML applications
  • Drive detection engineering best practices, including threat modelling, security-value evaluation, false-positive reduction, and coverage measurement
  • Collaborate across science, engineering, partner, and field teams, operating with flexible working hours to support global customers and distributed stakeholders

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C++ or similar object oriented language experience
  • 2+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non-internship) experience
  • 2+ years of troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non-internship) experience
  • Knowledge of industry-based security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of command line tools to troubleshoot protocols, analyze log outputs, or automate basic tasks
  • Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP(S), DNS, and TCP/IP
  • Experience with AWS products and services
  • Experience in scripting, programming, or security code reviewing in a common language, such as Python, Java, or C++
  • Experience performing security activities across one or more phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), such as security design review, threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence.

In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence.

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing.

The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested.**

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages.
  • Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases.
  • Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery.
  • Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable.
  • Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution.
  • Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.
  • Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies.**

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing, with hands-on experience in test automation.
  • Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent.
  • Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger.
  • Familiarity with SPARQL and RDF/knowledge graph concepts, including the ability to write or assess SPARQL queries for data retrieval and validation.
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.**

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to AI agents, LLM-driven applications, or AI-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.
  • Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
  • Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts.
  • Experience testing browser-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Experience or interest in Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or Knowledge Graph technologies.
  • Experience with defect and test management tools such as JIRA, X-Ray, TestRail, or Zephyr.**

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

job.title: Security Data & SIEM Engineer
job.description:
Job description

Security Data & SIEM Engineer

Johnson Controls is looking for a Security Data & SIEM Engineer to strengthen security visibility across cloud and enterprise environments. In this role, you will help design, tune, and operate the security logging and SIEM capabilities that support threat detection, investigation, and response.

Role Overview

You will own key parts of the security data pipeline, including log onboarding, normalization, detection content, alert tuning, and integrations with operational workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can work across security tooling, incident response, and cross-functional partners to improve the quality and usefulness of security telemetry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain SIEM content, including log sources, parsing, correlation rules, dashboards, alerts, and reports.
  • Ingest and normalize security events from cloud, endpoint, network, identity, and application sources.
  • Tune detections to reduce noise, improve signal quality, and support timely response.
  • Support security tooling across SIEM, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and CSPM platforms.
  • Integrate security alerts and workflows with ServiceNow, Jira, and related ticketing tools.
  • Partner with threat detection, incident response, and platform teams to investigate events and improve coverage.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks, policies, and procedures for security tooling and integrations.
  • Monitor tool health and data quality, and troubleshoot issues in ingestion, visibility, and alerting.
  • Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security best practices.
  • Mentor team members and share practical guidance on SIEM engineering and data analysis.

How You Will Do It

  • You take ownership of security outcomes with accountability, integrity, and a strong focus on safe operations.
  • You stay close to the work, remove friction for your customers, and focus on the logs, detections, and integrations that matter most.
  • You use data, feedback, and root-cause analysis to improve detection quality and make the environment better every day.
  • You collaborate across security, IT, and business teams, sharing knowledge and building trust to win as one team.
  • You validate changes carefully, document your work clearly, and keep support teams informed so the environment remains reliable and easy to operate.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5 to 10 years of experience in IT security, security operations, or security engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, or Logscale.
  • Strong understanding of log management, detection engineering, alert tuning, and security event analysis.
  • Experience onboarding and maintaining security telemetry from cloud, endpoint, network, identity, and application sources.
  • Experience with vulnerability management tools such as Qualys, Tenable.io, or Rapid7.
  • Experience with endpoint protection solutions such as CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, or SentinelOne.
  • Experience working with CSPM tools such as Palo Alto Prisma, CrowdStrike CSPM, or Sophos Cloud Optix.
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Python or PowerShell scripting experience.
  • Experience with Kubernetes security or cloud infrastructure security.
  • Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Splunk Certified User, Splunk Certified Power User, GSEC, CISSP, or CISM.
  • Experience supporting SOAR or automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with Linux, Windows, or macOS security data sources.

job.title: Project Engineer - BMS
job.description:
At Johnson Controls, we're creating smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings around the world. As a global leader in smart building technologies, building automation, HVAC solutions, energy efficiency, and decarbonisation, we help customers operate more intelligently and sustainably across some of the fastest-growing industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

With more than 140 years of innovation, Johnson Controls continues to deliver industry-leading solutions that transform the way buildings perform. Supported by cutting-edge technology, a world-class service network, and a strong commitment to sustainability, we're helping shape the future of the built environment.

Why Join Us?

  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Melbourne-based role with a mix of office, site, and customer engagement activities
  • Competitive salary package including superannuation and vehicle allowance
  • Ongoing technical training and professional development
  • Opportunity to work on complex, high-profile building automation projects across Victoria
  • Career progression within a global organisation committed to innovation and sustainability
  • Be part of a highly experienced and collaborative engineering team

The Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced BMS Project Engineer to join our Melbourne Service Team.

In this role, you will lead the delivery of Building Management System (BMS/BMCS) solutions across a diverse portfolio of commercial projects and service upgrades. You'll be responsible for designing, programming, testing, commissioning, and optimising building automation systems while providing exceptional technical expertise to both customers and internal stakeholders.

This position offers a unique blend of technical leadership, project delivery, and customer engagement, making it ideal for an experienced engineer looking to further develop their career with an industry leader.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of project design documentation, including point schedules, control schematics, equipment schedules, and technical drawings
  • Design, develop, and implement control strategies and software programming for Johnson Controls and third-party systems
  • Perform software testing, commissioning, and system validation activities
  • Design and develop graphical interfaces for new and existing BMS installations
  • Diagnose and resolve complex software, controls, and integration issues
  • Work closely with Project Managers to ensure successful project delivery, customer satisfaction, and commercial outcomes
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement and technical support
  • Support sales and tender activities by providing technical expertise and engineering input
  • Mentor and support junior engineers, technicians, and apprentices

About You

You are a customer-focused engineering professional with strong technical expertise and a passion for delivering innovative building automation solutions. You enjoy solving complex problems, building lasting relationships, and contributing to successful project outcomes.

To Be Successful, You Will Have:

  • 5+ years' experience in Building Management Systems (BMS/BMCS), Controls Engineering, or Building Automation
  • Degree qualification in Engineering or a related technical discipline
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC controls, building automation systems, and associated technologies
  • Proven experience programming, commissioning, and troubleshooting BMS platforms
  • Sound understanding of networking, IT infrastructure, and server environments
  • Experience delivering commercial building projects across installation, retrofit, upgrade, and service environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Project, and PowerPoint
  • A collaborative approach and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes

Highly Regarded

  • Experience working within commercial HVAC environments
  • Exposure to smart building technologies, analytics, IoT, and digital building solutions
  • Knowledge of open protocol systems such as BACnet, Modbus, and MQTT

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're looking to join a global leader where your expertise is valued, your ideas are encouraged, and your career can continue to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Janis Sotelo for a confidential discussion at janis.sotelo@jci.com.

JCI's Diversity & Inclusion

job.title: ME - New Product Introduction Lead
job.description:
A.

SUMMARY

OF JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the New Product Manufacturing industrialization and readiness of all new products from concept/design stage through pilot build, Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR), production launch, ramp-up and final handover to Operations.

The role ensures that every new product is manufacturable and can be launched safely and consistently while meeting quality, delivery, cost, capacity and productivity objectives. The position leads and coordinates Manufacturing Engineering (ME) and Industrial Engineering (IE) deliverables across the NPI process and supports VAVE industrialization activities.

B. PRIMARY DUTIES

Compliance, Quality & EHS: Ensure compliance with company policies, Code of Ethics, quality systems, and EHS requirements, including identification and mitigation of manufacturing safety and environmental risks.

New Product & VAVE Industrialization: Lead the manufacturing industrialization of all new products and projects from early product development through production launch, ensuring Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Capacity, and Productivity targets are achieved.

Manufacturing Feasibility & DFMA: Drive early manufacturing feasibility and DFMA reviews covering process capability, equipment, tooling, fixtures, testing, utilities, material flow, manpower, floor space, ergonomics, and capacity requirements.

Manufacturing Process Development: Define and validate the complete manufacturing process, including process flow, routing, workstation design, assembly methods, tooling, fixtures, testing, inspection requirements, Standard Work, Work Instructions, and process parameters.

Industrial Engineering & Capacity Planning: Lead cycle-time studies, takt-time analysis, capacity planning, manpower optimization, line balancing, layout, material flow, and bottleneck elimination to ensure efficient and scalable production.

Process Quality & Risk Management: Lead/review Process Flow, PFMEA, PTPR, Control Plan, process capability, part qualification, and manufacturing risk mitigation to ensure robust processes and product quality before production release.

Equipment, Tooling & Supplier Readiness: Ensure timely readiness, qualification, and commissioning of manufacturing equipment, tooling, fixtures, gauges, test equipment, and supplier processes required for successful product launch.

Prototype, Pilot Build & Manufacturing Readiness: Lead manufacturing activities for prototype, pilot, and pre-production builds; validate process, quality, cycle time, equipment, manpower, material, documentation, and training readiness prior to Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR) and production release.

NPI Gate Approval, Launch & Ramp-Up: Represent Manufacturing in NPI gate reviews, approve manufacturing readiness, and drive production launch, ramp-up, and stabilization until required safety, quality, delivery, cost, capacity, and productivity targets are consistently achieved.

Continuous Improvement & Operations Handover: Drive VAVE, Lean, productivity, automation, cycle-time and cost improvements; capture lessons learned and ensure structured handover to Operations, including documentation, training, process validation, capacity confirmation, and closure of launch actions.

Performance Focus

On-time manufacturing readiness and product launch

Safety and EHS compliance at launch

First-pass yield / quality performance during launch and ramp-up

Achievement of target cycle time, capacity and productivity

Closure of manufacturing risks and launch actions

Tooling/equipment readiness to project timing

Scrap, rework and manufacturing cost performance

Stable handover to Operations and sustained process capability

C.

EDUCATION

Engineering degree/diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline with relevant Experience of 6-8 Years in HVAC Domain

D. Technical Skills, knowledge and experience

Strong working knowledge of manufacturing industrialization, NPI, process development and production ramp-up.

Practical knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, process flow, standard work, cycle-time study, capacity planning, line balancing, layout and Lean manufacturing.

Ability to lead cross-functional problem solving, risk closure and manufacturing readiness reviews.

Strong communication, project coordination, data analysis and structured problem-solving skills.

Experience with chiller/HVAC, fabrication, assembly, brazing/welding, testing, supplier industrialization or similar manufacturing environments is preferred.

job.title: Senior AI Engineer , Physics AI
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Senior AI Engineer, Physics AI will build Firmus’s physics-AI capability, turning authoritative engineering inputs into qualified surrogate models and production software that accelerate AI Factory design, optimisation, simulation and operations. You will connect high-fidelity engineering analysis with fast, inspectable decision support across compute, cooling, power and infrastructure systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of scientific machine learning, numerical simulation and software delivery. Working with CFD, mechanical, electrical, controls, network, AI infrastructure and operations specialists, you will own the learned-model lifecycle and the services that make it useful. Engineering specialists retain authority over physical assumptions, solver evidence, design acceptance and protection systems.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Scientific machine learning and surrogate models

Develop and qualify surrogate models for bounded thermal, airflow, cooling and infrastructure scenarios. Start with a well-defined simulation-backed use case, selecting convolutional models, neural operators or graph-based approaches according to the data representation, fidelity and latency required. Extend to geometry-generalising approaches only when data coverage and validation justify them.

  • Engineering data and evidence

Build reproducible pipelines from Ansys Fluent and other engineering tools into model-ready datasets. Preserve geometry, mesh, equipment, boundary-condition, units and solver-version lineage, and define canonical field and graph representations with the relevant engineering owners in Engineering and Technology. Design evaluation splits that prevent leakage across related cases and test unseen operating conditions and configurations. Treat approved solver studies and measured evidence as reference inputs, not as data to be stripped of engineering context.

  • Production services and integration

Deliver tested, versioned software rather than isolated notebooks. Build training pipelines, model registry and qualification workflows, inference APIs and scenario-orchestration integrations. Own model packaging, qualification workflows, automated testing, monitoring and technical documentation in partnership with platform engineering. Deploy surrogate model endpoints through the AI & Applications inferencing platform and execute on shared GPU capacity managed by the AI & Applications scheduler. Connect model outputs to the engineering optimiser, evidence-linked design records and visualisation services, including Omniverse and OpenUSD where appropriate.

  • Qualification, uncertainty and safe use

Agree acceptance criteria with engineering owners before a model is released. Evaluate field accuracy, critical local errors, physical consistency, inference latency and performance against simpler baselines. Implement applicability-domain checks, calibrated uncertainty where supported, out-of-distribution detection and clear rejection or solver-fallback behaviour. Make every result traceable to its inputs, model version, validation evidence and limitations. Keep operational evaluation in shadow mode unless separately approved; surrogate services must not bypass independent controls or protection systems.

  • Whole-factory decision support

Integrate surrogates into scenario screening, design comparisons, commissioning rehearsal and operating-envelope studies. Work with engineering teams to assess delivered compute performance, whole-factory energy efficiency, auxiliary loads, cost and risk within explicit system boundaries. Introduce workload-intent and model-to-grid scenarios as the evidence base matures. Prioritise improvements that shorten engineering decision cycles without weakening assurance, and build reusable capability across factory configurations rather than one-off demonstrations.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

You bring deep, hands-on experience in scientific machine learning, computational engineering or simulation-led software, with a track record of taking models from research into dependable production services across multiple projects. You have technically led at least one cross-disciplinary programme spanning ML, simulation and software delivery. You are strong in Python and PyTorch, and can develop, train, profile, evaluate and deploy models on GPU infrastructure. Your experience includes surrogate modelling, neural operators, graph neural networks, reduced-order modelling, physics-informed learning or closely related methods.

You are comfortable working with simulation data, meshes, geometry, boundary conditions and numerical validation. You understand how discretisation, convergence, conservation, data coverage and measurement uncertainty affect a learned approximation. You can distinguish interpolation from unsupported extrapolation and explain when a surrogate should defer to an authoritative engineering calculation.

You have built maintainable software with APIs, containers, version control, automated tests, CI/CD and observability. You can design reproducible data and model contracts, diagnose failure modes and work constructively across engineering disciplines. A degree in engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, computational physics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical depth, provides a relevant foundation.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience with NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo or Modulus, PyTorch Geometric, graph or operator learning, uncertainty quantification and multi-GPU training is highly regarded. Familiarity with Ansys Fluent or PyFluent, OpenFOAM, ETAP or comparable engineering tools, together with CAD-to-simulation workflows, OpenUSD, Omniverse, Kubernetes or on-premises accelerated computing, would be valuable. Data-centre thermal systems, liquid cooling, electrical infrastructure or GPU/HPC experience is useful; practical scientific-ML and software-delivery evidence matters more than familiarity with every tool. Experience operating as a technical anchor across simulation, ML and software teams — setting standards, reviewing designs and mentoring engineers is expected at this level.

LOCATION

This role can be based in Singapore or Syndey, reporting to the Head of AI and Applications. The role works closely with Engineering and Technology and Operations.

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Customer Engineer Security, Google Cloud Security
job.description:
About the job

As a Security Customer Engineer you'll be the main technical advisor for enterprise customers across Australia and New Zealand on detecting, investigating, and responding to threats, from cloud workloads through to the enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC). You'll focus on three technology domains: Cloud detection and response (detecting and containing threats in real time across cloud, container, and AI workloads in multi-cloud environments), SOC transformation (modernising the SOC by bringing together SIEM, SOAR, and AI-assisted investigation), and Threat intelligence (delivering frontline threat intelligence that gives customers comprehensive visibility and context on the threats that matter most to their organization).

You'll work closely with Account Executives to change how customers think about security operations. You'll help grow our cybersecurity business by building relationships with new and existing customers. You'll guide customers through the technical side of the business cycle, including discovery, architecture, demos, proofs of value, and adoption, so they get the most value from our solutions. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Work with Google Cloud Security (including WIZ) products to demonstrate and prototype advanced integrations within complex customer and partner environments.
  • Architect and recommend comprehensive integration strategies, enterprise architectures, and AI-ready infrastructures required to successfully implement holistic Google Cloud Security (including WIZ) solutions.
  • Act as a prominent public advocate and thought leader for Google Cloud Security at customer sites, industry conferences, and events, articulating Google's goal for security in the age of AI.
  • Understand complex customer technical objections and develop AI-driven solutions to resolve blockers for enterprise accounts.
  • Advocate our dual mission of "AI for Security" and "Security for AI." Share deep security expertise to build strong technical relationships, leading technology advocacy, bid responses, and proof-of-concepts, while partnering with product management to shape the future of Google Cloud Security solutions.

job.title: Strategy and Operations Lead, APAC Go-To-Market
job.description:
About the job

The Business Strategy and Operations organization provides business critical insights using analytics, ensures cross functional alignment of goals and execution, and helps teams drive strategic partnerships and new initiatives forward. We stay focused on aligning the highest-level company priorities with effective day-to-day operations, and help evolve early stage ideas into future-growth initiatives.

In this role, you will serve as a core strategic thought partner to APAC Large Customer Sales (LCS) senior leadership, shaping the commercial direction and long-term Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for the business. Your mission is to accelerate business growth by leading high-impact initiatives, unlocking cross-sector and product growth opportunities, and driving precision commercial execution at scale.

APAC Central Operations is a team that unlocks significant business for the region, and you will be at the center of it. The pace is fast, the stakes are high and the problems are rarely tidy. You will distill a complex issue into a crisp leadership narrative, and build an enablement playbook or untangle an escalation with partners across the region.

You will thrive if you are comfortable with ambiguity, collaborative by nature, and motivated by turning complexity into clarity at pace.

The Go-to-Market Operations (GtM) team ensures Google's complex and ever-evolving Ads business runs smoothly. We are instrumental in setting go-to-market strategy, and ensuring flawless execution and operations against the strategy. We have teams embedded in each of the major Ads business areas as well as global teams that work across the business areas. Team members are analytical and strategic, with a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a strategic thought partner to APAC LCS senior leadership. Run the forums where major commercial decisions get made, including Regional SteerCos, global OpCos and Sponsor Syncs. Turn complex topics into sharp decisions and clear owners.
  • Devise APAC cross-markets and cross-channel policy strategy, effectively advocate regional needs to influence global priorities and roadmap, establish principled framework for prioritization of various market needs within APAC.
  • Shape metrics governance by defining the KPIs, dashboards and cadences that show leaders where to act.
  • Steer escalation governance end-to-end. Unblock what matters most and feed the learnings back into how we work.
  • Own policy business reviews and sales enablement. Translate fast-moving guidance into simple playbooks that help sales teams with clients.

job.description:
The Executive - Specification will be a pivotal member of the Specification department at IN‑NOVATEUR ELECTRICAL & DIGITAL SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED (NEDS). You will develop, review, and manage technical specifications for LV switchgear and related electrical/digital infrastructure, ensure compliance with codes and client requirements, and drive seamless project execution through close interaction with architects, consultants, the Project Management Consultant (PMC) and internal sales teams using Salesforce CRM.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review and update technical specifications for LV switchgear and associated digital systems.
  • Coordinate with architects, consultants and PMC to align specifications with design intent and project schedules.
  • Conduct site visits and inspections to verify compliance with specifications, standards and safety regulations.
  • Assist senior engineers in design development, value engineering and constructability reviews.
  • Support tender preparation, bid evaluation and contractor clarification processes.
  • Maintain a controlled specification database with version tracking, change logs and Salesforce CRM updates.
  • Ensure all specifications meet local codes, standards, and client requirements.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary coordination meetings and provide technical input.
  • Identify and recommend specification improvements for cost, quality and schedule benefits.
  • Prepare technical reports and documentation for internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience preparing specifications for electrical or digital projects.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of LV switchgear, power distribution and digital system fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with local building codes, standards and industry best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills for effective interaction with architects, consultants and PMC.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce CRM and MS Office; experience with specification management tools (e.g., BIM 360, SharePoint) is a plus.
  • Detail‑oriented with strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑disciplinary project environment.
  • Good command of English, both written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
