**Work Location: **Perth, Western Australia, or Adelaide, South Australia

As an Account / Business Development Manager, you will be responsible for growing CommScope's Enterprise business across Western Australia and South Australia. You will leverage existing customer and partner relationships while pursuing new opportunities to expand revenue, market share, and customer engagement

Working closely with customers, channel partners, consultants, and internal stakeholders, you will develop and execute territory strategies, identify emerging opportunities, and position CommScope's solutions to address evolving business and technology challenges. The role requires strong pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, strategic account planning, and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer outcomes while driving sustainable business growth

Key responsibilities

Manage and grow existing accounts

  • Manage an established portfolio of customers, distributors, installation partners, consultants and other channel relationships.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with key customers and partner stakeholders.
  • Understand each customer’s business, technology and product requirements, then position appropriate enterprise infrastructure solutions.
  • Develop and execute account plans that support retention, revenue growth, and stronger customer engagement.
  • Lead regular customer and partner reviews, follow through on agreed actions and maintain a high standard of service.
  • Influence purchase decisions through clear value propositions, presentations and commercially sound recommendations.

Develop new business

  • Identify, qualify and progress new opportunities across target accounts, market segments and applications.
  • Build a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, customer referrals, partner collaboration, networking, and industry engagement.
  • Develop relationships with new end users, consultants, contractors, integrators and other relevant decision makers or influencers.
  • Assess customer needs, define the opportunity, and coordinate a compelling technical and commercial response.
  • Prepare and present proposals, manage negotiations and progress opportunities through to close.
  • Identify new areas for growth by monitoring customer priorities, market activity, and competitor positioning.

Sales planning and execution

  • Create territory, account and project plans with clear priorities, actions and measures of success.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, revenue and demand forecasts in D365
  • Provide clear reporting on pipeline health, account activity, forecast position, risks and required support.
  • Coordinate internal stakeholders and resources to support customer requirements and high-quality delivery.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Proven experience in B2B account management, business development or solution sales.
  • Experience creating new business opportunities while maintaining and growing existing customer relationships.
  • Technical or commercial experience in communications, structured cabling, networking, enterprise infrastructure or an associated industry.
  • Demonstrated capability in account planning, project planning, pipeline development, forecasting and commercial negotiation.
  • Experience using D365 or a comparable CRM platform, together with strong Microsoft Office skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously and virtually, while collaborating effectively across functions and locations.
  • Ability to travel within the assigned territory as required.

Personal attributes

  • Results-focused, self-driven, energetic and enthusiastic.
  • Strong customer focus with a practical, consultative selling approach.
  • Commercially aware and confident in building trust, influencing decisions and negotiating outcomes.
  • Well organised, with strong time management and the ability to set priorities.
  • Comfortable exercising initiative and resolving moderately complex issues.
  • A collaborative team player who communicates clearly and follows through on commitments.

job.description:
About the role

As the Manager, GPS Innovation & Excellence, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Global People Services (GPS) by driving technology-enabled transformation, continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives. Working closely with global stakeholders across HR, Digital, HR Technology and HR Operations, you will lead projects that improve efficiency, enhance the employee experience and deliver measurable business outcomes. From process optimization and automation to change management and capability development, you will help identify innovative solutions that simplify how we work and enable GPS to deliver outstanding service to employees worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the delivery of Global People Services (GPS) strategy initiatives, including technology implementations, continuous improvement projects, process optimization, automation and Carrier excellence (Cx) activities that improve the efficiency, quality and employee experience of our GPS operations.
  • Partner closely with the AME GPS Hub Lead through a strategic dotted-line relationship, supporting regional continuous improvement initiatives, Kaizen activities, operational excellence programmes and capability development, while ensuring alignment with the GPS Innovation roadmap
  • Lead the planning, co-ordination and delivery of cross-functional projects, ensuring appropriate governance, stakeholder engagement and agreed deliverables are completed on time, within scope and with measurable business outcomes
  • Provide strategic recommendations to GPS Leaders on operational priorities and roadmaps
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate operational processes through the effective use of technology, improving the quality, efficiency and scalability of GPS services.
  • Analyse operational performance, customer feedback and project outcomes to identify improvement opportunities, track benefits realisation and support data-driven decision making.
  • Partner with global stakeholders such as HR Technology, Digital, Process Owners and Operational teams to translate business requirements into scalable technology-enabled solutions
  • Lead and co-ordinate the implementation of digital solutions across the GPS ecosystem, ensuring successful deployment, stakeholder engagement and operational adoption
  • Championing a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, improving colleague experience and increasing operational efficiency through data-drive decision making
  • Coordinate improvement activities including Kaizen events and RRCA investigations, ensuring actions are delivered, benefits realized and lessons learned are embedded into future ways of working
  • Lead cross-functional workshops to define future-state processes and solution design
  • Support organizational change by developing communication plans, training approaches and adoption activities that enable successful implementation of new processes and technology.
  • Determine project priorities, solution recommendations and implementation approaches with limited oversight, balancing operational requirements, customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Compliance and maintenance of the CX operating procedures and quality management systems (assessments, training, CX certification) across GPS Lead the implementation of process certification projects

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ Year experience in continuous improvement, operational excellence, project delivery or transformation
  • Strong project management, planning and organizational skills
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to interpret data and make evidence-based recommendations
  • Fluent spoken and written English, business level
  • Lean Six Sigma or equivalent Continuous Improvement qualification
  • Knowledge of Agile project delivery methodologies
  • Experience with automation, AI, Power Platform of business intelligence tools

Job Description

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Sales System Information System Specialist

Job Summary

We are seeking a Sales System Information System Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will lead solution design and end-to-end delivery of major and minor enhancements, with a primary focus on Salesforce and practical Generative AI (GenAI) solutions.

You will help transform Caterpillar’s worldwide order management capabilities for machine sales and distribution by translating business needs into secure, scalable solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders and third-party delivery partners, who perform most development, while remaining accountable for requirements, design quality, testing, release readiness and business outcomes. This role is within the Resource Industries - IT, SPPD & RISM IT Division of Caterpillar IT.

The portfolio includes corporate applications supporting worldwide order management for machine sales, product configuration, order entry and global Sales & Operations Planning. Salesforce expertise and GenAI solution experience are central to this role; familiarity with SAP, AWS and Snowflake provides useful complementary context.

This role is based at the Whitefield Office, Bangalore, India.

What you will do

Lead enhancements from discovery through deployment and post-release support, connecting business priorities with sound solution design and coordinated partner delivery.

  • Elicit requirements, analyze current and future business processes, and document user stories, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements. Conduct fit-gap analysis and maintain traceability from business needs through testing and delivery.
  • Lead business case analysis and phased product planning. Prioritize major and minor enhancements by business value, risk and dependencies, and agree scope and success measures with stakeholders.
  • Design and review Salesforce solutions, including Service Cloud case workflows, data models, access controls and integrations. Evaluate configuration versus customization and the appropriate use of Flow, Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Evaluate additional Salesforce modules such as Manufacturing Cloud and Revenue Cloud for opportunities to reduce custom solutions and lean into SaaS investment
  • Coordinate business teams and third-party delivery partners across the enhancement lifecycle. Review estimates, design proposals and implementation quality; manage dependencies, risks and decisions, and communicate delivery progress.
  • Define test strategy and coordinate functional, integration and regression testing, user acceptance testing (UAT) and defect resolution. Confirm that delivered solutions satisfy acceptance criteria, security requirements and operational needs.
  • Govern CI/CD and release activities with delivery partners, including version control, environment promotion, quality gates, deployment readiness and rollback planning. Coordinate production deployment, hypercare and transition to support.
  • Assess practical GenAI and agentic AI use cases and guide proofs of concept toward delivery where business value is demonstrated. Define evaluation criteria, data-security safeguards, responsible AI controls and human oversight with relevant stakeholders.
  • Lead solution and integration reviews across Salesforce and connected enterprise systems. Apply reusable patterns, document design trade-offs and ensure maintainability, performance and alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Maintain clear process, solution and support documentation. Enable user adoption, develop repeatable process improvements and assess post-release outcomes against agreed business measures.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of complex application and escalated business-process issues with business and delivery partners, including periodic off-shift and weekend support.
  • Perform other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

Required qualifications

  • A four-year bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, information systems, engineering, marketing, communications or a related field.
  • 10+ years of relevant IT experience, including substantial experience in systems analysis, solution design and enterprise application delivery.
  • Demonstrated Salesforce expertise, including Service Cloud case management, data modeling, security and access controls, and translating business requirements into scalable platform solutions.
  • Demonstrated practical experience designing, prototyping or delivering GenAI solutions for business use cases, beyond personal use of AI tools. Ability to assess feasibility, evaluate output quality and define data protection, responsible AI and human-review requirements.
  • Working technical knowledge of Apex, Salesforce Flow, Lightning Web Components (LWC) and API-based integrations, sufficient to evaluate solution options, review partner designs and troubleshoot issues.
  • Experience with CI/CD and release governance, including version control, environment promotion, testing and quality gates, deployment planning and rollback readiness.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead medium-to-large, multi-team delivery initiatives and own major and minor enhancements end to end, coordinating business stakeholders and third-party delivery partners.
  • Strong systems analysis skills, including requirements elicitation, process mapping, fit-gap analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria and UAT coordination, supported by sound knowledge of software design, data modeling and integration principles.
  • Ability to create clear solution artifacts and rapid proofs of concept, using prototypes, personas or journey maps where appropriate to validate business needs and design decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder facilitation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to business and technical audiences.

Preferred qualifications

  • Relevant Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer or Service Cloud Consultant.
  • Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities and Agentforce, including assessing appropriate use cases and designing controlled, measurable solutions.
  • Order management domain experience, particularly machine sales and distribution, product configuration, order entry or Sales & Operations Planning.
  • Complementary experience with Java or Python, AWS, SAP or Snowflake.
  • Knowledge of SAP Variant Configuration (SAP VC) or other complex manufacturing product configuration platforms, and enterprise integration and architecture patterns.
  • Experience applying GenAI, machine learning or other AI technologies in production, including evaluation, monitoring and operational support.
  • Experience spanning multiple business processes, organizations or IT disciplines, with strong accountability, planning, organization, teamwork and customer focus.
  • Strong interpersonal judgment in sensitive or potentially controversial situations, and the ability to manage competing priorities under time constraints.

Key competencies

  • Problem Solving (Expert): Align stakeholders on problem definitions, risks, decision criteria and alternatives; lead resolution of high-impact, cross-functional issues; coach others in evaluating options; and apply industry practices to improve outcomes.
  • Technology Advising (Extensive Experience): Advise business and technology stakeholders on products, platforms and solution options; explain trade-offs and business impacts; evaluate emerging technologies; and coach others in effective technology consultation.
  • Application Design and Architecture (Expert): Lead the design of complex, multi-technology applications; establish standards and reusable practices; evaluate design tools and techniques; and provide architecture guidance and mentoring.
  • Requirements Analysis (Expert): Lead the elicitation, analysis and documentation of functional and non-functional requirements; apply effective modeling techniques; maintain requirements integrity and traceability; and establish analysis standards and practices.
  • System and Technology Integration (Expert): Define integration strategies, interfaces, standards and plans across applications, data and technology platforms; lead complex integration efforts; and monitor relevant industry trends and practices.
  • System Testing (Expert): Define testing and quality-assurance strategies that improve coverage and throughput; lead testing across multiple initiatives; direct defect investigation and resolution; and incorporate business feedback from pilot, parallel and acceptance testing.
  • Systems Software Infrastructure (Extensive Experience): Design and guide software infrastructure, architecture and data-management practices; resolve issues across heterogeneous environments; evaluate configuration practices; and coach others on platforms and core technologies.
  • Technical Troubleshooting (Extensive Experience): Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex hardware, software, application and communication issues; prioritize response based on business impact; ensure complete corrective action; and coach others in advanced troubleshooting techniques.

What you will get

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar’s employee resource groups across the globe.
  • Career development opportunities with global prospects.

Health and Wellness

  • Medical, life and personal accident coverage.
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program.

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan.
  • Pay for performance through an annual incentive bonus plan.

Additional Information

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers)

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) Employer.

All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities - are encouraged to apply.

Level Advanced:

  • Gains agreement on the problem-solving process, risk assessment, decision points, and criteria.
  • Trains others in the process of eliciting alternatives and assessing their impact.
  • Orchestrates the resolution of high-impact and cross-functional problems.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Supervises others in advising a range of clients across a myriad of products, technologies, services and solutions in a relevant technology domain.
  • Identifies and evaluates emerging technologies and advises clients regarding their potential business impacts.

  • Leverages formal certifications in mastery of multiple areas of technology in demonstrating credibility for client consulting.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.

Level Advanced:

  • Provides insight into developing diverse and multiple requirements analyses.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

Level Advanced:

  • Consults with others on system and/or technology integration efforts.
  • Monitors system and technology integration trends and directions.
  • Plays a leadership role in defining systems integration processes and practices.
  • Designs complex interfaces, integration strategies and plans.
  • Holds an industry wide conference on system integration and migration issues, problems and considerations.
  • Demonstrates extensive experience with system and technology integration.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

Level Advanced:

  • Champions the employment of technology to maximize system test throughput and coverage.
  • Builds testing and software QA methodologies and practices for the organization.

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.

Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST

Job Description

Role focus:Hands-on delivery across Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Snowflake, SQL, and AI-enabled business solutions.

Position Summary

The IT Analyst will design, develop, enhance, and support business applications, dashboards, reporting solutions, and workflow automations for the Visualization team. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power Platform and Power BI, supported by solid Snowflake and SQL capabilities. The successful candidate will work directly with business partners and technical teams to translate requirements into secure, scalable, user-friendly, and data-driven solutions. The role will also contribute to practical AI-enabled capabilities that improve productivity, analytics, and business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and support Power Apps solutions, including Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
  • Develop workflow automation and system integration using Power Automate.
  • Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, scorecards, and operational analytics.
  • Develop efficient DAX measures and Power Query transformations and optimize report performance and usability.
  • Use Snowflake and SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data for applications and visualization solutions.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and deliver fit-for-purpose outcomes.
  • Integrate Power Platform solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, APIs, Snowflake, and other approved enterprise data sources.
  • Apply security, access control, row-level security, data privacy, governance, and application lifecycle management practices.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Create clear technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer and user support.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI, Copilot, and automation to improve business processes and analytical experiences.
  • Participate in Agile delivery, estimation, testing, release management, and continuous improvement activities.

Required Technical Competencies

Microsoft Power Platform

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power Apps, particularly Canvas Apps. Experience with Model-Driven Apps is desirable.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Power Automate, including approvals, notifications, scheduled flows, and integrations.
  • Working knowledge of Dataverse, solution packaging, environment management, connectors, and application lifecycle management.
  • Ability to design intuitive user experiences and reusable application components.

Power BI and Visualization

  • Strong hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
  • Proficiency in data modeling, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, drill-throughs, bookmarks, and report navigation.
  • Experience performance optimization, refreshing troubleshooting, gateway concepts, and row-level security.
  • Ability to apply visualization best practices and translate complex data into clear business insights.

Snowflake and SQL

  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, subqueries, common table expressions, aggregations, views, and query optimization.
  • Hands-on experience querying and validating data in Snowflake.
  • Understanding relational data models, data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, data quality, and reconciliation.

AI and Emerging Technology

  • Understanding generative AI concepts and practical enterprise use cases.
  • Experience or strong exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Snowflake Cortex, AI Builder, or AI-enabled Power Platform capabilities.
  • Ability to incorporate AI-assisted features into apps, automation, and analytics solutions where appropriate.
  • Knowledge of prompt design, responsible AI, data security, privacy, and human validation of AI-generated outputs.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's or Masters`s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Approximately 5 -7 years of relevant experience in Power Platform, business intelligence, visualization, analytics, or application development.
  • Demonstrated hands-on delivery experience in Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, SQL, and Snowflake.
  • Experience gathering requirements and delivering solutions in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting production applications, dashboards, and data solutions in an enterprise environment.

Preferred Competencies

  • Experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, REST APIs, SharePoint Online, or Teams integration.
  • Exposure to Tableau or ThoughtSpot.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable work management and CI/CD tool.
  • Understanding testing practices, source control, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and support processes.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery teams and with global stakeholders.
  • Experience in machine manufacturing or a related industrial domain is preferred.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
  • Customer-focused approach with the ability to understand business needs and recommend practical solutions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, collaborate across teams, and take ownership of deliverables.
  • Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning across Power Platform, analytics, AI, and data technologies.

Skill Descriptors

Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
  • Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.

  • Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

job.title: Associate Director, Environment, Health and Safety Data Centre Operations
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As the Associate Director, Environment, Health and Safety DC Operations, you will report directly to the Vice President, EHS and provide enterprise EHS leadership across AirTrunk’s growing data centre operating portfolio.

Partnering closely with DC Operations leadership, you will strengthen operational performance, leadership capability and Line 1 ownership while building a scalable EHS capability that safely enables the continued growth of AirTrunk’s global operating portfolio.

Serve as the senior EHS Business Partner for AirTrunk’s DC Operations business, working with leaders to strengthen frontline ownership, leadership capability and EHS performance. Lead and continually improve the EHS partnering model across the operating portfolio, with a focus on critical risk management, operational assurance and learning in live data centres.

What You'll Do

Serve as the senior EHS Business Partner for DC Operations, advising, coaching and constructively challenging senior leaders. Strengthen Line 1 ownership, leadership capability and critical risk management across live facilities, while leading a consistent EHS Business Partnering model across AirTrunk’s global portfolio. Partner with Enterprise Governance & Assurance to improve operational assurance and critical control verification.

Build EHS capability and performance across Facilities Management partners, contractors and service providers. Work with Development EHS and DC Operations to support the safe transition of new facilities and major upgrades into operations, implement EHS Operational Readiness requirements and strengthen asset handover learning. Build trusted relationships with customers and operational stakeholders, and lead significant incident response, investigation and organisational learning.

Monitor performance and emerging risks to set priorities and drive continual improvement, translating lessons and good practice into practical changes across regions and campuses. Shape the EHS operating model and capability needed for AirTrunk’s growth, supporting new markets with globally consistent but locally relevant expectations. Develop a high-performing EHS team through recruitment, coaching, succession planning and performance management, and contribute to enterprise priorities as a member of the Enterprise EHS Leadership Team.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of relevant EHS experience, including leading teams in complex, high-risk operational environments.
  • Proven ability to partner with senior leaders to strengthen business ownership, leadership capability and EHS performance.
  • Strong expertise in operational EHS, critical risk management, assurance, incident management and organisational learning.
  • Experience managing EHS across outsourced Facilities Management, service providers and complex contractor delivery models.
  • Sound understanding of business ownership, EHS partnering, governance and independent assurance.
  • Experience leading teams across multiple locations, regions and cultures, while developing high-performing teams and future leaders.
  • Strong commercial judgement and strategic mindset, balancing EHS requirements with operational, customer and business priorities.
  • Clear, influential communicator who simplifies complex issues, provides constructive challenge and builds trusted relationships; data centres, critical infrastructure, facilities management, utilities or engineering experience is highly regarded.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Ensure the availability and functionality of all C&I systems related to BTG and BOP during the respective shift.

Provide resources and guidance to contractor technicians for routine maintenance tasks.

Maintain Flue Gas Discharge (FGD) systems to ensure operational efficiency.

Coordinate with other departments to minimize delays in maintenance and operational activities.

Provide timely information to Team Leads for issue escalations to higher-ups.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Implement field related ZFO action items and AWMS for continuous improvement in maintenance practices.

Report unsafe conditions, acts, and near misses in the work area to promote a culture of safety.

Ensure compliance with safety audit observations and follow the CHETNA process diligently, particularly during startups and routine operations.

Ensure zero accidents through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.

Follow guidelines of work permit systems and ensure compliance where applicable.

Monitor compliance with environmental regulations, particularly in relation to FGD systems.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency.

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Utilize advanced technology to streamline maintenance and operational processes.

Safety

Operations & Maintenance

Stores

Key Stakeholders - External:

NA

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree.

6+ years of experience in power plant operations or maintenance, with specific exposure to BTG (Boiler, Turbine, Generator) and C&I (Control & Instrumentation) systems.

Experience in the power generation industry, particularly in thermal power plants with knowledge of DCS, FGD systems, and safety protocols.

job.description:
Railways Civil Lead - Coal Mining

Structural Maintenance:

Conduct regular inspections and assessments of railway infrastructure, including bridges, platforms, earthwork, and trackside structures, to identify defects, deterioration, and safety hazards.

Call for quotations for ongoing civil maintenance and project works as per the approved job specs. Coordinate with commercial for vendor evaluation and finalization.

Develop and implement maintenance plans and repair strategies to address structural deficiencies and ensure compliance with safety regulations and engineering standards.

Ensure that the civil projects are executed in accordance with the requirements of: T&C of the contract, Contract Quality, Environment Plan, Safety Plan and Labor Compliances

Coordinate with engineering teams and contractors to schedule and execute bridge maintenance works, including cleaning, painting, and structural repairs, while minimizing disruptions to train services.

Facilitate the drain arrangement in yard area (In-Plant Yard, Shivnagar Yard, Tarkeshwarpur Yard and Sonpur Yard)

Implement maintenance programs for station facilities, including lighting, signage, seating, etc., to enhance operational efficiency.

Vendor Management:

Monitor vendor performance regularly, including adherence to schedules, quality of work, and compliance with safety standards and contractual obligations.

Conduct daily site supervision of ongoing civil maintenance and project works. Conduct assessments to evaluate vendor performance against agreed-upon metrics and benchmarks.

Provide feedback and guidance to vendors to address performance issues and drive continuous improvement in service delivery and project outcomes.

Conduct site inspections and quality audits to verify compliance with project plans, drawings, and specifications, and identify any deviations or deficiencies.

Coordinate with vendors to schedule work activities, allocate resources, and ensure timely completion of civil and structural projects.

Ensure availability of material and equipment, to support vendor operations and optimize project efficiency.

Material Management:

Ensure availability of material, define material specifications and standards based on project requirements, engineering designs, and regulatory guidelines to ensure the quality and performance of construction materials.

Conduct inspections on incoming materials to verify compliance with specifications, standards, and quality requirements before acceptance and use in civil works.

Maintain records of material availability, stock movements, and usage rates to ensure adequate availability of materials for ongoing and future construction projects.

Track material costs, expenditures, and budget allocations for civil works projects, monitoring variances and deviations from planned budgets to identify cost-saving opportunities and manage project finances effectively.

Reports and MIS:

Prepare joint finding compliance report in collaboration with other department leads

Maintain MIS with respect to civil and structures related activities

Digitalization and Tech Initiatives:

Lead the integration of digital tools and technologies for infrastructure inspections and assessments, such as digital inspection devices and remote monitoring systems.

Implement data analytics to monitor maintenance performance, track infrastructure conditions, and predict potential issues. Develop dashboards and reports to support data-driven decision-making and optimize maintenance strategies.

Foster a culture of digital proficiency within the team by providing training and support on new technologies and tools. Encourage continuous learning and adaptation to emerging digital advancements to improve operational efficiency.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

ATMSL Head

Permanent Way Lead

Operations Lead

Signaling and Telecommunication Lead

Central Engineering team

Key Stakeholders - External

Indian Railways

Regulatory Authorities - Railways

Vendors and contractors

Contractual resources

Material providers

Emergency Services (Police, Fire, Medical)

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

B.E. / B.Tech. (Civil)

Work Experience (Range of years):

6 to 8 years

job.title: Civil Manager
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

We are seeking an experienced Civil Manager to lead civil engineering and construction activities across our data center development projects. This role is responsible for overseeing site work, grading, foundations, drainage, and infrastructure development from pre-construction through project closeout, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, and within budget.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and manage all civil engineering scope across data center construction projects, including sitework, earthwork, grading, drainage, utilities, and foundations
  • Review and approve civil design drawings, specifications, and engineering calculations prepared by consultants/contractors
  • Manage relationships with civil contractors, engineers, and subcontractors; oversee bid evaluation and contract negotiation for civil packages
  • Coordinate with architects, MEP teams, structural engineers, and project managers to ensure integrated design and construction execution
  • Oversee site inspections, quality control, and compliance with local building codes, environmental regulations, and permitting requirements
  • Manage project schedules, budgets, and change orders related to civil scope
  • Identify and mitigate risks related to soil conditions, stormwater management, erosion control, and site logistics
  • Lead a team of site engineers’/associate civil managers and provide technical mentorship
  • Liaise with local jurisdictions, utility companies, and regulatory bodies for permits and approvals
  • Ensure adherence to safety standards and company EHS policies on all job sites
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering (PE license preferred)
  • 8–12+ years of civil engineering/construction experience, with data center, mission-critical, or large-scale industrial project experience strongly preferred
  • Strong knowledge of grading, drainage, stormwater management, and site utility design
  • Experience managing contractors, consultants, and multi-disciplinary teams
  • Proficiency with civil design software (AutoCAD Civil 3D, etc.) and project management tools
  • Strong understanding of local permitting and regulatory processes
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to travel to project sites as required

job.title: Major Incident Manager
job.description:
What You'll Do

  • Govern and facilitate P1 and P2 and high-risk incidents from identification through to service restoration, ensuring timely, high-quality outcomes within defined SLAs.
  • Coordinate crisis response activities, technical and management bridges, coordinate emergency change approvals, and delivery from offshore partners during major service-impacting events.
  • Act as a key escalation point for Optus teams, suppliers and third parties, bringing the right people together to resolve complex incidents and network outages.
  • Lead clear, accurate and timely executive communications, while managing vendor engagement to support restoration and root-cause investigation.
  • Prepare monthly SLA ratification packs and post-incident reports, track MTTR and incident-quality KPIs, and drive continuous improvement across incident management practices.
  • Support Business Continuity Planning execution and global delivery centre crisis requirements, with a focus on cost-effective restoration and minimising outage-related impact.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • At least five years’ technical experience in a telecommunications network environment.
  • ITIL v3 Foundation certification or higher.
  • Proven experience managing major incidents and leading multi-party technical and management bridge calls.
  • Strong vendor and third-party management capability, with experience working across multi-vendor network environments.
  • Ability to multitask and manage multiple simultaneous critical outages, making sound decisions under pressure.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear executive-level reporting.
  • Strong stakeholder management and customer relationship skills, with a service-driven mindset focused on quality, accountability and continuous improvement.

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts.
  • Make life easier and more affordable with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional ‘Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.

  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6–8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170. job.title: Market Specialist, Indonesia
job.description:
Meta is seeking a Market Specialist with Indonesian language expertise to support risk and response management operations across Indonesian-language content and markets.

In this role, you will help identify, assess, and respond to integrity risks, policy violations, and emerging threats affecting Indonesian speaking communities on Meta's platforms.

You will apply your understanding of Indonesian cultural context, current events, and online behavior patterns to support accurate risk assessments and timely escalations, contributing to the safety and integrity of Meta's products for users across the region.

Responsibilities

  • Review and assess Indonesian language content and accounts to identify potential policy violations, integrity risks, and coordinated inauthentic behavior
  • Apply knowledge of Indonesian cultural context, political landscape, and online trends to support accurate risk classification and prioritization
  • Execute established response workflows to address identified risks in a timely and consistent manner
  • Document findings clearly and accurately to support cross-functional review and escalation processes
  • Collaborate with policy, trust and safety, and operations teams to surface patterns and emerging risks in the Indonesian language information environment
  • Provide input on Indonesian market-specific nuances to help refine risk detection criteria and response guidelines
  • Support quality assurance processes by reviewing decisions for consistency and alignment with established policy frameworks
  • Communicate findings and risk signals to relevant stakeholders in a clear and structured manner
  • Adapt to evolving risk landscapes and updated response procedures as platform policies and threat environments change

Minimum Qualifications

  • Professional working proficiency in Indonesian is required to review, interpret, and assess Indonesian language content and communications as a core function of this role
  • Experience in trust and safety, content moderation, risk operations, compliance, or a related field involving structured decision-making against defined criteria
  • Experience applying established procedures and guidelines to evaluate cases and determine appropriate actions
  • Experience documenting work clearly and communicating findings to cross-functional partners

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with the Indonesian political, media, and social media landscape and how it relates to online integrity risks
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Exposure to policy enforcement, legal compliance, or regulatory risk frameworks in a technology or platform context
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience working in a scaled operations or risk management environment with defined workflows and quality standards

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. job.title: Program Manager, Regional Regulatory Readiness
job.description:
Meta's Regulatory Readiness team ensures the company is prepared for the evolving global regulatory landscape. We monitor, prioritize, and drive action on regulatory developments that affect Meta's products and billions of users worldwide. Our regional teams combine regulatory intelligence and risk analysis with structured program management to ensure Meta anticipates and responds to regulatory change effectively.

We are seeking a Regulatory Readiness Program Manager to join our Asia-Pacific team. You will deliver regulatory risk intelligence, drive readiness programs, and coordinate cross-functional response to regulatory developments across one of the world's most dynamic and diverse regulatory environments.

You will also manage Meta's responses to regulatory inquiries and reporting obligations across APAC — working with subject matter experts across the company to transform complex regulatory questions into clear, comprehensive responses that tell Meta's compliance story.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who thrives on managing complex, time-sensitive regulatory workstreams across multiple stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Manage regulatory information responses and reporting — Own end-to-end management of responses to regulatory inquiries, statutory information requests, investigations, and consultations across APAC
  • Coordinate the preparation and delivery of transparency and compliance reports for the region, ensuring responses are accurate, consistent, and on-time
  • Coordinate cross-functional workstreams — Intake and triage new regulatory demands, develop response strategies, engage subject matter experts across legal, policy, and product teams, manage timelines, and drive accountability to meet regulator deadlines
  • Drive readiness programs and landscape monitoring — Track regulatory developments and emerging pressures across APAC to inform priorities. Manage regulatory readiness workstreams to prepare product and operations teams for new obligations and enforcement deadlines
  • Communicate and report — Produce polished executive communications on response status, compliance posture, and emerging risks
  • Distill complex regulatory issues into clear, actionable materials for diverse audiences
  • Build scalable processes — Develop and improve workflows, tools, and frameworks that enable the team to respond more efficiently and consistently as regulatory demands grow

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, regulatory affairs, public policy, compliance, risk management, or related fields
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, time-sensitive programs with multiple cross-functional stakeholders and hard deadlines
  • Experience working within the APAC regulatory landscape, with demonstrated depth in at least 2 or more key jurisdictions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with regulatory transparency or compliance reporting
  • Experience in the technology sector, particularly around content regulation, data protection, AI governance, online safety, or platform accountability
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to produce polished, executive-ready materials under time pressure
  • Knowledge of key APAC regulatory frameworks
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Advanced degree in law, public policy, international relations, political science, or a related field
  • Background in managing relationships with regulators or government stakeholders
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams with competing deadlines, including tracking deliverables, owners, and milestones to drive accountability
  • Proficiency in an APAC language in addition to English, as the role involves direct engagement with regulators and stakeholders across the Asia-Pacific region
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience working in global organizations across time zones

job.title: Specialist Data Center Operations - BMS
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The role of Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

This role designs, plans, installs, and / or maintains mechanical, electrical, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability data center environments.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Assist in scheduling and supervising vendors/subcontractors during equipment / systems maintenance and service.
  • Provides recommendation of improvements to the operations and maintenance program on an on-going basis.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Seasoned understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Seasoned proficiency of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Seasoned knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Seasoned knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.)

  • Experience required:
  • Seasoned experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Seasoned experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Seasoned experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Seasoned experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Seasoned experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: 2nd Shift Product Design Technician - Level II
job.description:
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Deliver accurate, production-ready designs by creating and maintaining high-quality drawings and CAD models that clearly communicate engineering intent, reduce ambiguity, and support successful manufacturing and assembly.
  • Improve product quality and reliability by applying Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles that ensure parts fit, function, and perform as intended across production variation.
  • Protect configuration integrity by using CAD data management and configuration control processes to ensure the correct revisions, models, and documentation are available to stakeholders at all times.
  • Drive compliance and consistency by ensuring all specifications adhere to Cummins standards as well as applicable industry, national, and international requirements, reducing risk and supporting global product development.
  • Enable engineering efficiency by processing engineering work requests accurately and promptly, helping teams move projects forward while minimizing delays and rework.
  • Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by working closely with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and other functional teams to resolve design issues, align requirements, and support program objectives.
  • Enhance drawing and model quality through active participation in Drawing Quality Reviews, identifying opportunities for improvement and preventing downstream manufacturing or service issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by helping maintain and refine design standards, best practices, and quality processes, creating long-term value through increased consistency, productivity, and engineering excellence.

To be successful, you will need to consistently demonstrate the following:

 Develop advanced CAD modeling expertise by creating accurate, standards-compliant models that effectively represent design concepts and support analyses such as Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Dimensional Variation Analysis.

 Build a deep understanding of mechanical systems so you can develop innovative, robust designs that meet customer requirements across all lifecycle stages, operating conditions, and application environments.

 Master engineering drawings, GD&T, and product specifications to clearly communicate design intent through models, bills of materials, and detailed drawings that support manufacturing and inspection.

 Become proficient in configuration and change management processes by accurately releasing, tracking, controlling, and documenting engineering changes while maintaining product data integrity throughout the product lifecycle.

 Communicate technical information effectively across functions by tailoring your message to engineers, manufacturing teams, quality teams, suppliers, and leadership to ensure alignment and efficient decision-making.

 Demonstrate strong decision quality and problem-solving skills by analyzing complex information, evaluating trade-offs, and making timely recommendations that keep projects progressing and reduce risk.

 Consistently deliver high-quality results under pressure by managing priorities, meeting commitments, and maintaining attention to detail even when faced with competing deadlines and changing requirements.

 Commit to continuous learning, collaboration, and trust-building by seeking feedback, expanding your technical knowledge, valuing diverse perspectives, and establishing credibility through integrity, accountability, and reliable performance.

High school diploma, certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience in an appropriate STEM field is required.

Regionally applicable certification or two year Associates Degree from an accredited college or university in a relevant field of study may be required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Requires some work experience and intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Creates and maintains product specifications utilizing Geometric Dimension and Tolerancing.

job.title: Reclutador
job.description:
Resumen de trabajo:

Participa en la contratación, la investigación de antecedentes y el proceso de entrevistas para cubrir las vacantes de empleo actuales o esperadas. Puede comunicarse con los postulantes y candidatos en cuanto a la consideración para el empleo y los detalles específicos de la función.

Responsabilidades clave:

Contrata, investiga antecedentes y entrevista a los postulantes internos y externos para cubrir las vacantes de empleo actuales o esperadas según las estrategias de contratación de la organización y los requisitos legislativos.

Revisa y evalúa la información del entorno del postulante en comparación con la vacante de empleo y facilita las verificaciones de referencia y de entorno y los procesos de prueba del postulante que correspondan.

Se comunica con los candidatos sobre el estado de su solicitud; puede hacer las ofertas de trabajo y prepara los procesos de trabajo administrativo de la oferta de trabajo correspondientes.

Informa a los candidatos acerca de las tareas y responsabilidades del trabajo, los programas de remuneración y beneficios, el programa y las condiciones de trabajo y las oportunidades de crecimiento profesional.

Se asegura de que los procesos de contratación de la organización se lleven a cabo de acuerdo con las políticas y los procedimientos internos correspondientes y la legislación gubernamental.

Se comunica con contactos de contratación externos para proporcionar información acerca de las oportunidades de carrera.

Es posible que deba viajar por eventos de contratación.

Organiza las entrevistas y la logística de los viajes de los postulantes seleccionados; se asocia con los ejecutivos de recursos humanos para garantizar que el proceso de entrevistas y selección se lleve a cabo sin complicaciones.

Colabora con los gerentes de contratación y demás partes interesadas clave en el proceso de contratación.

Utiliza y mantiene el sistema de seguimiento de postulantes, incluidos los informes periódicos para las partes interesadas.

Habilidades:

Orientado a la acción - Enfrentar las nuevas oportunidades y retos difíciles con sentido de urgencia, gran energía y entusiasmo.

Balancea stakeholders - Prever las necesidades de múltiples stakeholders y lograr un equilibrio entre ellos.

Comunica efectivamente - Desarrollar y generar comunicaciones multimodales que transmitan una clara comprensión de las necesidades exclusivas de diferentes audiencias.

Enfoque en el cliente - Cultivar relaciones sólidas con los clientes y ofrecer soluciones centradas en el cliente.

Calidad de las decisiones - Tomar decisiones adecuadas y oportunas que fomenten el avance de la organización.

Demuestra auto-conciencia - Usar una combinación de retroalimentación y reflexión para obtener un entendimiento profundo de las fortalezas y debilidades personales.

Astucia en las relaciones interpersonales - Relacionarse de manera abierta y cómoda con grupos diversos de personas.

Persuade - Usar argumentos convincentes para lograr el apoyo y el compromiso de los demás.

Evaluación y selección de candidatos - Define los requisitos de calificación y los criterios de selección para vacantes utilizando las herramientas de Cummins; utiliza procesos de selección objetivos que satisfacen los requisitos de cumplimiento; evalúa, valora y selecciona a candidatos en función de especificaciones laborales predeterminadas y competencias “Seleccionadas para Cummins”; mantiene una comunicación abierta con el candidato y las partes interesadas para garantizar resultados de contratación de forma oportuna.

Búsqueda de talento externo - Identifica y aplica herramientas y metodologías apropiadas de búsqueda de candidatos para identificar, atraer y contratar a talentos diversos en el mercado externo.

Ejecución de procesos de negocio de Recursos Humanos - Gestiona la ejecución de procesos de negocio de Recursos Humanos, buscando eficiencia, precisión, resultados de rendimiento de negocio positivos y agilidad operativa; integra las actividades en diferentes procesos según sea necesario; garantiza el cumplimiento con los requisitos legales y de procesos; equilibra eficazmente los requisitos de procesos con las necesidades de los líderes de negocios.

job.title: Senior Benefits, Leave & Disability Analyst
job.description:
2439349_Senior Benefits, Leave & Disability Analyst

At Cummins, we believe your passion is your power. Supercharge your career with the support of a global team that empowers you to do your best work.

We are looking for a talented Senior Benefits, Leaves & Disability Analyst to join our Total Rewards team for Cummins Services – HR Operations at Cummins Comercializadora in San Luis Potosí, SLP, Mexico.

Work Modality: Hybrid, 3 days on site, 2 days home office.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Administer disability and leave cases, including Short-Term Disability (STD), Long-Term Disability (LTD), parental leave, and other applicable leave programs, ensuring accurate and timely processing.
  • Perform and validate complex benefit and pay calculations, including disability benefits, state leave payments, parental leave payments, workers’ compensation offsets, and other payroll impacts.
  • Manage employee inquiries and escalated cases related to disability and leave programs, providing clear, empathetic, and timely guidance throughout the employee’s leave journey.
  • Review employee and case data for accuracy and completeness, including approval notifications, pay element entries, deductions, offsets, and other disability or leave-related transactions.
  • Perform first-level quality audits to identify data discrepancies, processing errors, and potential compliance risks, and coordinate corrective actions as needed.
  • Partners with the Disability team, People Support, HR, Payroll, managers, and external vendors to resolve complex disability and leave cases and ensure effective coordination across processes.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies by identifying root causes, coordinating with key stakeholders, and ensuring appropriate resolution and documentation of cases.
  • Maintain accurate case documentation and records across HR, case management, tracking, and vendor systems to support reporting, controls, and audit requirements.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts by identifying process gaps, analyzing trends, recommending solutions, and driving implementation of process enhancements to improve accuracy, efficiency, compliance and employee experience.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for disability and leave processes, providing guidance, interpreting policy and process requirements, and supporting capability building across stakeholders.

To be successful in this role, you will need the following:

  • Experience in Payroll, Benefits, Leave/Disability Administration or Total Rewards Operations, with responsibility for complex case administration and problem resolution.
  • Advanced English proficiency, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills, with the ability to perform and validate complex pay and benefit calculations.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.
  • Customer-focused mindset, with the ability to provide empathetic and solution-oriented support to employees.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with HR, Payroll, employees, managers, and external partners.
  • Demonstrate ability to efficiently manage multiple priorities and sensitive employee cases while meeting established timelines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to learn and navigate HR, case management, and vendor systems.
  • Experience analyzing data, conducting audits, and identifying trends or process improvement opportunities.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud and/or ServiceNow.
  • Working experience in U.S. disability, leave, and benefits administration.
  • Experience supporting Payroll, Benefits, or Total Rewards operations for the United States
  • Previous experience working with disability or leave management vendors, such as Unum.

Competencies:

  • Process Execution Excellence & Case Management – Accurately and efficiently administers disability and leave processes while meeting service-level expectations.
  • Data Integrity & Quality Management – Ensures high levels of data accuracy through quality reviews, audits, and effective resolution of discrepancies.
  • Compliance & Risk Management – Consistently executes processes in accordance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and established controls.
  • Employee & Customer Experience – Delivers responsive, empathetic, and solution-focused support that contributes to a positive employee experience.
  • Stakeholder Partnership & Consultation – Effectively collaborates with People Support, HR partners, Payroll, managers, and vendors to resolve issues and ensure seamless service delivery.
  • Problem Solving & Operational Improvement – Proactively identifies process gaps, resolves complex issues, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Operational Agility & Workload Management – Effectively manages multiple priorities, complex cases, and changing business needs in a high-volume environment while maintaining quality and accuracy.
  • Subject Matter Expertise & Knowledge Sharing – Serves as a trusted subject matter expert for disability and leave administration, providing guidance, training, and knowledge transfer to stakeholders and team members.

Education, Licenses, and Certifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field.

100% On-Site No
