job.title: Inspector de calidad - Nivel 2
job.description:
Resumen de trabajo:

Asegura que los productos recibidos o producidos cumplen con las especificaciones técnicas. Trabaja bajo supervisión moderada.

Responsabilidades clave:

Verifica la calidad final de los productos en la línea de producción.

Compara las características físicas de los componentes, materiales, equipos y productos con las especificaciones técnicas para identificar los defectos.

Separa los productos que no tienen la especificación técnica deseada, utilizando técnicas básicas y/o complejas de medición y equipos.

Documenta los productos que no cumplen con las especificaciones técnicas utilizando los sistemas especificados.

Capacita a otros en el uso de equipos de medición, segregación de productos que no cumplen con los requisitos y documentación.

Sigue las normas y los estándares de calidad definidos por la Empresa.

Habilidades:

Orientado a la acción - Enfrentar las nuevas oportunidades y retos difíciles con sentido de urgencia, gran energía y entusiasmo.

Colabora - Crear asociaciones y trabajar en colaboración con otras personas para alcanzar objetivos compartidos.

Comunica efectivamente - Desarrollar y generar comunicaciones multimodales que transmitan una clara comprensión de las necesidades exclusivas de diferentes audiencias.

Enfoque en el cliente - Cultivar relaciones sólidas con los clientes y ofrecer soluciones centradas en el cliente.

Calidad de las decisiones - Tomar decisiones adecuadas y oportunas que fomenten el avance de la organización.

Manejo del conflicto - Manejar las situaciones de conflicto de manera efectiva y con el mínimo de ruido.

Ingenio - Conseguir y desplegar recursos de manera eficaz y eficiente.

Ciencia de medición - Analiza los procesos de medición en toda la cadena de rastreabilidad relevante para identificar y cuantificar las fuentes de incertidumbre de medición relevantes para la ciencia de medición aplicada apropiada, "Metrología", por ejemplo, química, dimensional, eléctrica, mecánica, óptica y de radiación y física.

Gestión de proceso de calidad - Aplica de manera competente las herramientas y los métodos de calidad (p. ej., planificación avanzada de calidad del producto \[APQP\], análisis de modo de falla y efecto \[FMEA\], proceso de aprobación de piezas de producción \[PPAP\], control estadístico de procesos \[SPC\], estudios de capacidad, auditoría de procesos, inspección, prueba, etc.) para garantizar la calidad de los productos, procesos y servicios.

Valora las diferencias - Reconocer el valor que las diferentes perspectivas y culturas aportan a una organización.

Gerencia de laboratorio - Dirige recursos técnicos mientras gestiona los aspectos comerciales de un laboratorio usando medidas para controlar los aspectos técnicos y comerciales de la organización y asegurando que se cumplan los requisitos de las certificaciones y/o acreditaciones apropiadas.

Educación, licencias y certificaciones:

Diploma de preparatoria o certificado de terminación de la educación secundaria o experiencia equivalente en la medida en que dicha experiencia cumpla con las reglamentaciones aplicables.

Este cargo puede requerir licencias para cumplir con controles de exportación o regulaciones de sanciones.

Experiencia:

Requiere cierta experiencia laboral y conocimientos de Nivel Intermedio obtenidos a través de la capacitación o la experiencia en el trabajo.

Habilidades:

Colabora - Crear asociaciones y trabajar en colaboración con otras personas para alcanzar objetivos compartidos.

Comunica efectivamente - Desarrollar y generar comunicaciones multimodales que transmitan una clara comprensión de las necesidades exclusivas de diferentes audiencias.

Aspectos básicos de la salud y la seguridad - Defiende y modela conductas proactivas de salud y seguridad al identificar, informar y participar en medidas para mejorar la salud y la seguridad con el fin de crear una cultura interdependiente y contribuir a un lugar de trabajo libre de lesiones.

Interpretación del diagrama - Integra diagramas de ingeniería de equipos de fabricación y diseño de productos para respaldar el diseño y el desarrollo de un proceso de fabricación óptimo que cumpla con las especificaciones de diseño de productos.

Adquisición de equipos/capital - Selecciona equipos de fabricación que cumplan las especificaciones de fabricación de Cummins y satisfagan las necesidades del proyecto o el programa.

Diseño guiado por análisis de fabricación - Utiliza herramientas digitales para modelar y simular procesos de fabricación, equipos y desempeño para tomar decisiones basadas en datos antes de que se realicen cambios e impulsar mejoras continuas.

Conocimiento sobre fabricación - Demuestra conocimiento de fabricación al implementar correctamente cambios en los procesos, los equipos y las aplicaciones actuales para satisfacer las necesidades de la función y contribuir a la mejora continua.

Documentación de proceso - Elabora procedimientos de fabricación escritos en la secuencia adecuada que todas las partes interesadas aprobadas deben seguir correctamente para instaurar la continuidad de los procesos y la estandarización.

Diseño de accesorio y herramienta - Selecciona dispositivos de sujeción de piezas de trabajo capaces de sujetar eficazmente las piezas y los productos durante un proceso de fabricación para fijar su posición a fin de cumplir requisitos funcionales.

Valora las diferencias - Reconocer el valor que las diferentes perspectivas y culturas aportan a una organización.

Mejora continua de procesos - Reconoce áreas de mejora de un proceso al implementar adecuadamente metodologías de mejora de proceso y reducción de desperdicios a fin de disminuir el costo del proceso y mejorar la calidad de los procesos de fabricación actuales.

Proceso de la ergonomía y diseño del lugar de trabajo - Diseña, crea o adapta procesos y estaciones de trabajo al implementar controles ergonómicos a través de la aplicación de las pautas de diseño ergonómico de Cummins para reducir el riesgo y ofrecer trabajo diseñado ergonómicamente.

Resolución de problemas - Resuelve problemas y puede orientar a otras personas en la resolución eficaz de problemas mediante un proceso de análisis sistemático en el que se aprovechan las metodologías estándar de la industria para crear rastreabilidad de problemas y proteger al cliente; determina la causa asignable; implementa soluciones sólidas basadas en datos; identifica las causas de raíz sistémicas y garantiza la aplicación de medidas para evitar que vuelva a producirse el problema.

Diseño de estación de trabajo - Diseña estaciones de trabajo para operadores seguras, saludables y ergonómicas en consideración de su costo, calidad y entrega para contribuir a un entorno laboral eficiente.

Educación, licencias y certificaciones:

Es obligatorio contar con un título terciario, universitario, o un título en ciencia, tecnología, ingeniería, matemáticas (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math, STEM) o en un área relacionada, o con experiencia equivalente.

Este cargo puede requerir licencias para cumplir con controles de exportación o regulaciones de sanciones.

Experiencia:

Es obligatorio contar con una mínima experiencia laboral relevante en el sector.

100% On-Site No

job.title: Data Center Engineering Ops Engineer, DCEO
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

We are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer with experience in critical facilities management, and a result-driven individual with strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take our data center engineering operations to the next level. The DCEO Engineer is responsible for engineering operations including risk management and mitigation, planning, implementation of corrective and preventative maintenance for critical infrastructure and vendor management within our AWS Data Center environment. They are responsible for day-to-day operational excellence, maintenance of the critical infrastructure, supervising specialist vendors, acting as first responders to incidents, and becoming subject matter experts for the facility.

Key job responsibilities The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

  • Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
  • Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA’s as required.
  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
  • Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
  • Coordinate with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to execute projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
  • Review and follow the documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
  • Implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
  • Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues

A day in the life

  • Support troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
  • Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
  • Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
  • Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

About the team About AWS

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • High school or equivalent diploma
  • 2+ years of electrical or mechanical experience
  • Ability to participate in a 24 x 7 rotating shift roster

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of data center engineering experience
  • Experience leading and managing operations of critical facilities which require in-depth knowledge in electrical, mechanical, and control systems
  • Experience in management of vendors/contractors performing construction, maintenance and upgrading works in large-scale critical environment

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Strategic Accounts, Sales, APJC Strategic Enterprise Sales
job.description:
AWS is seeking an exceptional Senior Sales Business Development Leader to create our most consequential transformational opportunities across our largest enterprise accounts. This is a high-intensity, time-bound demand generation role with a singular objective: to develop $200M+ Total Contract Value (TCV) deals across a portfolio of strategically selected accounts. You will operate at the intersection of business development, executive relationship management, and cross-functional leadership, answering one question every day: what must happen today to move these opportunities forward?

Key job responsibilities

  • Own and drive a portfolio of mega-deal creation engagements across APJC’s most strategic enterprise customers.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional stakeholders across the deal development process.
  • Drive Think Big during Prospecting, Identification and Qualification stages, identifying transformational outcomes tailored to each customer’s unique business context, that helps achieve CEO / LOB CxO leader’s business transformation objectives, and for AWS unlocks deal sizes beyond what incremental consumption growth would deliver.
  • Build and own C-suite executive relationships with customer decision-makers, developing trust-based partnerships that reimagine existing relationships beyond consumption-based pricing.
  • Leading the weekly deal development cadence, run by deal execution leads, maintaining rigorous deal execution discipline..
  • Deliver monthly business reviews to APJC senior leadership with clear deal progression metrics, risk assessments, and acceleration recommendations.

About the team AWS’s APJC Strategic Enterprise Sales team serves the top strategic enterprise customers across Asia-Pacific, Japan, and Greater China. This role is central to an initiative that will drive APJC’s top-account growth rate - unlocking the next wave of growth across our most consequential customer relationships. You will report directly into APJC Strategic Enterprise Sales leadership and operate with full executive sponsorship from APJC senior leaders.

Amazon Web Services is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneer cutting-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, compute, storage, and database services that help organizations of every size transform their businesses. At AWS, you will work backwards from the customer, think big, and have the opportunity to shape the future of cloud computing across the world’s most dynamic markets.

Basic Qualifications

  • 12+ years of enterprise sales, business development, or strategic deal pursuit experience in technology or cloud services.
  • Track record of personally driving strong execution engagement to develop large deal pipeline.
  • Experience orchestrating large, cross-functional teams across deal development process.
  • Proven track record leading AI-driven transformation initiatives within 1-2 major industries
  • Experience working with C-suite executives at Fortune 500 / Nikkei 225 equivalent enterprises.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of at least 1 major industry and existing relationships across Gaming & Media, Manufacturing, Semi-Conductors, Financial Services, Telco and Conglomerates.
  • Experience with AI/ML GTM strategy, including generative AI, inference workloads, and enterprise AI transformation.
  • Familiarity with cloud service providers’ market value proposition
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Assistant Manager/Manager, Portfolio Management (Singapore)
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

You will be supporting the Portfolio Management team at CapitaLand Ascendas REIT Management Limited and report to Executive Director, Portfolio Management, Singapore.

Responsibilities

  • Support the Portfolio Manager in managing the Singapore portfolio
  • Review and evaluate leasing and capex proposals
  • Work with asset managers and leasing team to prepare asset turnaround plans
  • Evaluate and undertake feasibility studies for alternative leasing strategies which include alternative usages
  • Support to manage JV companies especially in the areas of operations, interested party issues etc
  • Support asset divestments, including undertaking financial analysis and all related workstreams

job.title: Senior ABAP Developer
job.description:

IS Manager

In this role, you will build and support the SAP ABAP solutions that run our business as one of the first developers on a new central development team. Each day, you will write production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA: reports, enhancements, interfaces, forms, and posting logic. You will work directly with the business users who depend on that code. You will also showcase your experience by taking on work across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales as priorities shift, and by bringing practical clean core judgment to our S/4HANA journey. You will learn and use the agentic AI development platforms the team is adopting, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct.

In this role, you will report to the ABAP Development Lead, work as an individual contributor, and have no people management responsibilities.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office. #LI-Hybrid

This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the ABAP Development Lead; functional consultants; the SAP BTP and integration teams; and SAP Basis.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC every week, closing your commitments on the date you gave, chasing what is blocked, and following up after go-live until the problem is really solved.
  • Bridging to S/4HANA: contributing to S/4HANA Public Cloud stabilization and Private Cloud planning using CDS, RAP and ABAP Cloud, and choosing standard extensibility over classic enhancement where it fits.
  • Working directly with the business: sitting with the people who have the problem, understanding the process and configuration behind it, and building what they actually need.
  • Working to the team standard: following coding guidelines, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, reviewing colleagues' code, and using AI-assisted development within the team's rules.

Our team dynamics

You will become part of a small, collaborative team where everyone contributes and supports one another. AI is part of how we work, and we will help you get started if you are new to it. Done means it is being used by the business, not just transported, and a straightforward “I don’t know yet” is welcome.

Qualifications for the role

  • You have more than 8 years of SAP development experience, with deep current ABAP knowledge in ECC, including enhancements, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, OData, and REST interfaces, plus performance optimization.

  • You have practical SAP S/4HANA experience, including CDS views and a solid understanding of clean core principles.
  • You enjoy working directly with business users and understanding the process and configuration behind a requirement, not only the specification.
  • You have established skills in working to a shared development standard, including code review, ABAP Test Cockpit, and transport discipline, in onshore/offshore or multi-team environments.
  • You are open to AI-assisted development and ready to learn agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct. Prior AI experience.
  • You are comfortable using English in both conversation and writing.

What's in it for you?

You will work on code that keeps a global business running and help shape how a new central team builds. You’ll have direct experience with the latest agentic AI tools for SAP development, along with guidance as you learn them. You can grow into a techno-functional or value stream role, or technical leadership, and we will support you on either path.

job.title: Senior SAP PP/MM Functional Consultant
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

IS Manager

Your role and responsibilities

In this position, you will serve as the senior owner of production planning and materials management for our SAP ECC environment. You will clear a growing PP/MM enhancement backlog and deliver production planning for the retirement of our legacy Infor manufacturing systems, KBM and LX, plant by plant. This position calls for direct execution: you build what you plan and coordinate outside consultants when in-house capacity is stretched. Here, done means the plant is planning in SAP. A signed-off blueprint, a released transport or a closed ticket is not done.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid #hybrid (minimum three days per week in the office)

This role is contributing to the Installation Products Division of the Electrification business area in North America.

Main stakeholders are plant planners, schedulers and buyers, the Operations Domain Lead and Operations Lead PP, external consulting partners, and our S/4HANA Public Cloud team in Europe

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Clearing the PP/MM backlog - owning enhancements and APTs in production planning and materials management from requirement to working solution in the plant, prioritized with the Operations Domain Lead and closed on the dates you commit.
  • Delivering production planning for the KBM/LX conversion - capturing how each plant really plans, including the spreadsheets nobody has written down and the knowledge of experts close to retirement. Then designing and configuring the SAP target, converting BOMs, routings and planning master data, and taking each plant through testing, cutover and hypercare.
  • Getting planning strategies right - MTS, MTO, ETO and CTO, variant configuration and requirements consumption designed for how each product family is actually built and sold.
  • Directing external consultants without being their manager - scoping the work, tracking progress, reviewing configuration and specifications before they go live, and closing the work properly. You own the outcome even when you do not do every part of the delivery yourself.
  • Using AI aggressively, inside and outside SAP - for analysis, configuration research, legacy data and code reading, test scenarios and documentation, including the agentic AI platforms for SAP the team is adopting - and showing the team what works.
  • Supporting the plants and S/4HANA - solving production-impacting planning issues fast, with workarounds the plant can live with while the root cause is fixed. Providing support for our S/4HANA Public Cloud operations in Europe as needed, while helping prepare our primary ECC system for the move to S/4HANA through PP/MM knowledge. All of this within change control, segregation of duties and governance, including what AI tools are allowed to see.

Our team dynamics

You will join a streamlined Operations team that follows a few simple rules. Done means in use. If you are blocked, find another route the same day, inside the rules. Go and see: the answer is usually on the shop floor or in the planner’s spreadsheet. Something small delivered this week beats something complete next quarter. AI is expected, and “I don’t know, here is how I will find out” is a good answer here. You will have no direct reports. People in this role can grow into ownership of production planning design, leadership of plant rollouts, or an Operations value stream position.

Qualifications for the role

  • You bring more than 10 years of SAP PP experience in ECC, with full-cycle configuration and support across MRP, BOMs, routings, work centers, capacity planning, and planned and production orders.
  • You have deep, practical knowledge of MTS, MTO, ETO and CTO planning strategies, including requirements consumption and sales order stock. You also bring practical variant configuration experience, including characteristics, classes, dependencies, super BOMs and routings, and sales order BOMs.
  • You have solid SAP MM as it supports manufacturing - procurement for production, special stocks, subcontracting and goods movements - and you have worked in or close to real plants, in discrete manufacturing.
  • You have demonstrated measurable production results, including cases where you turned around work that had been stalled. You have directed external consultants or partner resources and seen the work through to closure.
  • You regularly rely on AI in your current work, or can point to something you independently built or automated with it.
  • S/4HANA manufacturing experience (MRP Live, Advanced Variant Configuration, embedded PP/DS, MRP Fiori apps) is highly desired, including a Public Cloud implementation or an ECC-to-S/4HANA conversion. So is the ability to read and debug ABAP.
  • Legacy-to-SAP conversions or plant rollouts (from Infor LX/BPCS), BOM and routing data migration at scale, and APICS/ASCM (CPIM) or SAP PP/MM certifications.
  • You communicate clearly in English - clear beats polished.
  • You hold a valid work authorization for India.

With your CV, include three to five sentences on something you finished that was stuck when you picked it up: what was blocking it, what you did, and what the end state was. Add one sentence on how you use AI in your work today. We read these before your CV.

More about us

ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas&Betts), helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Division’s products are engineered to provide ease of installation and perform in demanding and harsh conditions, helping to ensure safety and continuous operation for utilities, businesses and people around the world. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty-Rap® cable ties, T&B Liquidtight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold™ reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac™ distribution connectors, Hi-Tech Valiant™ full-range current limiting fuse for fire mitigation, faulted current indicators and distribution connectors, cable accessories and apparatus with products for overhead and underground distribution. Manufacturing includes made-to-stock and custom-made solutions.

job.title: Mobile Software Engineer, Google Pay, Client Infrastructure
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. In this role, you will help to scale Google Pay India to 400M users and beyond by building a high performing, secure, and robust client foundation. You will take end-to-end ownership of the core architecture, release systems, and developer ecosystem that power our entire Flutter application.Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Design core application architectures, optimize critical app health metrics (such as Application-Not-Responding, startup latency, app size, memory usage, and frame rates), and build secure platform integration layers.
  • Build and maintain release pipelines, automated testing infrastructure, and developer tools, leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered solutions to automate diagnostics, optimize workflows, and boost overall developer velocity.
  • Collaborate with executive engineers, Product Managers, User Experience (UX), and other teams (like Photos and Gmail intelligence teams) to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Work with technologies such as Dart, Flutter, Android, iOS, Java/Kotlin, Objective-C/Swift, and build/automation tools.

job.title: Executive Assistant, Network Engineering
job.description:
About the Role

Job Type: Full-time | Location: Sydney, NSW | Department: Network | Reporting to: Vice President, Network Engineering | Work Location Type: #onsite

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

We have grown substantially since 2019, from our inception in Australia to now having several facilities across North America and being listed on NASDAQ… and we are just getting started! By joining us, you will be contributing to the future of sustainable high-performance compute and the local communities we strive to have a positive impact on. ​

Our Network Engineering team builds the networks that power AI at scale. We design and run the high-performance fabrics that connect tens of thousands of GPUs, the backbone and WAN that link our campuses across continents, and the facilities networks that keep our data centres safe and running. Our work spans all aspects of network engineering for IREN, from the data centre and core to the WAN and peering edge.

This Sydney-based role supports the VP of Network Engineering and works closely with a global team across several time zones. You will keep a fast-moving leader organised, informed and well prepared, and bring the wider Network Engineering team together through well-run workshops, team sessions and events.

Requirements

  • 5+ years' experience in an administrative support role to a corporate Senior Leader.
  • Advanced skill in professional demeanour, business etiquette, diplomacy, and discretion.
  • Strong emotional intelligence: you read the room, build trust easily and handle sensitive matters with care.
  • Detail-oriented self-starter with experience supporting senior executives or teams.
  • Strong business acumen with sound judgement, able to prioritise and make decisions effectively.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and passionate about taking on new projects and ideas.
  • Team player with a proven ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and jurisdictions.
  • Experience organising workshops, team sessions or events.
  • Excellent organisational and project management skills.
  • Solution-focused and energised by team success, able to remain positive when faced with setbacks.
  • Agile in adapting to shifting priorities.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365.

Responsibilities

  • Support the VP of Network Engineering in all aspects of their planned work.
  • Manage the leader's calendar, including scheduling meetings, appointments, travel arrangements (domestic and international), and speaking engagements.
  • Organise and prepare for meetings by gathering documents, creating agendas, taking minutes, and coordinating logistics.
  • Coordinate team activities, including workshops, team sessions, planning days and offsites, from agenda and logistics through to follow-up actions.
  • Plan and run team events and celebrations that bring a global team together.
  • Track project progress, ensuring deadlines are met, stakeholders are informed, and any issues are addressed promptly.
  • Act as a liaison between the leader, the management team and external parties, screening calls and visitors, answering inquiries with professionalism, and directing communications as needed.
  • Prioritise and relay emails and calls as necessary.
  • Prepare, reconcile, and submit expense reports.
  • Maintain records and documentation for the leader, handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • Complete various support tasks, including creating PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, reports, and agenda materials.
  • Draft, review, and send communications on behalf of the leader or members of the management team as required.
  • Provide additional support to other departments, administrators, or executives as requested.

Growth Opportunities

  • Lead team events and coordination for a growing global team.
  • Build your project management skills by owning initiatives from planning through delivery.
  • Take on further analysis opportunities, such as preparing reporting and insights for the leadership team.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary range finalized based on experience and impact
  • Short and long-term incentive programs designed to reward both results and long term company success

We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!

IREN is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. job.title: Staff Network Development Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

Job Type: Full-time | Location: Sydney, NSW | Department: Network | Reporting to: Vice President, Network Engineering | Work Location Type: #onsite

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

We have grown substantially since 2019, from our inception in Australia to now having several facilities across North America and being listed on NASDAQ… and we are just getting started! By joining us, you will be contributing to the future of sustainable high-performance compute and the local communities we strive to have a positive impact on.

Our Network Engineering team builds the networks that power AI at scale. We design and run the high-performance fabrics that connect tens of thousands of GPUs, the backbone and WAN that link our campuses across continents, and the facilities networks that keep our data centres safe and running. Our work spans all aspects of network engineering for IREN, from the data centre and core to the WAN and peering edge.

As a Staff Network Development Engineer you will set the technical direction for the software that runs IREN's network. You will architect the platforms that design, deploy, validate and operate our networks at global scale, lead the hardest engineering problems hands-on, and grow the network software capability of the team.

Requirements

  • Extensive experience as a senior or staff software, network development or site reliability engineer for large data centre, cloud or hyperscale networks.
  • Expert software engineering skills in Python or Go, with a track record of designing and delivering distributed systems, services and APIs in production.
  • Deep experience with network automation platforms, data models such as YANG, streaming telemetry and closed-loop automation.
  • Strong BGP, OSPF or IS-IS, MPLS with traffic engineering, VXLAN and EVPN knowledge, and experience with large HPC and AI networks.
  • Experience with network platforms such as Cisco, Juniper and Arista, and their programmable interfaces.
  • A clear view on applying AI and machine learning to network operations.
  • Experience with NVIDIA Spectrum networking, RoCE or InfiniBand, HPC or GPU platforms is highly regarded.
  • The credibility to set technical direction, influence across teams and coach senior engineers.

Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture and roadmap for IREN's network automation platform, from source of truth and configuration generation to deployment, validation and closed-loop remediation.
  • Design and build core services yourself, writing and reviewing production code in Python or Go.
  • Set the engineering standards for network software, including system design, testing, code review, CI/CD, release and reliability.
  • Lead the design of network telemetry, observability and analytics at scale, and use them to automate operations.
  • Lead the use of AI and machine learning in network operations, such as anomaly detection, troubleshooting assistants and automated change review.
  • Partner with network architecture, security and engineering leaders to make the network software-defined from design through operation.
  • Responsible for the safety of automated production changes, and lead incident reviews where software is involved.
  • Mentor senior engineers and grow the network software engineering capability of the team.

Growth Opportunities

  • Define how a network built for AI at global scale is run as software.
  • Influence architecture, tooling and team structure as Network Engineering grows.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary range finalized based on experience and impact
  • Short and long-term incentive programs designed to reward both results and long term company success

We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!

IREN is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We are committed to evaluating qualified applicants and do not discriminate against protected characteristics under applicable legislation. This job will remain posted until filled. While we appreciate all applications we receive, we are only able to contact candidates under consideration.

By applying for this position and submitting your resume and application materials, you consent to the processing of your personal information in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Statement available on our website at www.iren.com.

job.title: NPI Sr. Buyer
job.description:
Position Summary

The New Product Introduction (NPI) Buyer is responsible for leading procurement activities supporting the successful development and launch of new products. Acting as the primary procurement interface for Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Quality, and Suppliers, the NPI Buyer ensures supplier readiness, cost competitiveness, component availability, and risk mitigation from concept through production launch.

This role is embedded within cross-functional product development teams and is accountable for sourcing strategy execution, supplier selection, quote management, launch readiness, and commercialization of new products. The NPI Buyer plays a critical role in accelerating time-to-market while achieving quality, cost, delivery, and sustainability objectives.

Key Responsibilities

New Product Program Leadership

  • Participate as the Procurement representative on NPI program teams.
  • Support product development from concept through production launch.
  • Drive procurement activities through stage-gate milestones.
  • Ensure sourcing timelines align with engineering and launch schedules.
  • Support Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) and product revisions throughout development.

Strategic Sourcing

  • Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers for new product components and assemblies
  • Lead RFQ/RFP processes for prototype and production requirements.
  • Analyze supplier quotations and negotiate commercial terms
  • Develop sourcing recommendations based on total cost, quality, risk, capacity, and technology considerations.
  • Collaborate with Category Managers to align NPI sourcing decisions with long-term sourcing strategies.

Supplier Readiness & Launch Management

  • Assess supplier manufacturing readiness and capacity.
  • Coordinate supplier APQP and launch activities working closely with Supplier Development Team.
  • Track tooling, PPAP approvals, first article inspections, and qualification milestones.
  • Conduct supplier readiness reviews and escalate launch risks.
  • Ensure suppliers can support prototype, pilot, and production volumes.

Cost Management

  • Develop should-cost and target-cost analyses.
  • Support value engineering (VE) and value analysis (VA) initiatives.
  • Identify cost reduction opportunities early in product development.
  • Track cost performance versus program targets.
  • Support business case development and program financial reviews.

Risk Management

  • Identify supply chain risks associated with new technologies, capacity constraints, sole-source suppliers, and geopolitical factors.
  • Develop mitigation plans for launch-critical components.
  • Monitor long lead-time material requirements.
  • Drive dual-source strategies where appropriate.
  • Escalate supply continuity risks to procurement and business leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with:

  • Engineering
  • Product Management
  • Program Management
  • Manufacturing Operations
  • Quality
  • Supplier Quality Engineering
  • Planning & Logistics
  • Category Management
  • Finance

Key Deliverables

The NPI Buyer is accountable for:

  • Sourcing plans for all assigned programs
  • Supplier nomination recommendations
  • RFQ completion and analysis
  • Program BOM cost tracking
  • Supplier launch readiness reviews
  • Capacity and risk assessments
  • Tooling and PPAP status tracking
  • Procurement stage-gate approvals
  • NPI savings and cost optimization initiatives

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's Degree in:

  • Supply Chain Management
  • Business
  • Engineering
  • Operations Management
  • Related discipline

Experience

  • 5+ years of procurement, sourcing, commodity management, supply chain, or engineering experience.
  • Experience supporting product launches or new product development programs.
  • Experience working with suppliers in technical or manufacturing environments.
  • Automotive, HVAC, industrial equipment, electronics, aerospace, or other complex manufacturing experience preferred.

job.title: Business Intern, Business Analytics
job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

The position reports to the Senior Director, Services Growth & Programs, APAC and is a key contributing member who will provide exceptional support to program manage various APAC Service growth initiatives and platforms, track, analyze and communicate the performance to our internal and external stakeholders.

How you will do it:

  • Design & implementation of impactful BI dashboards using PowerBI to analyze market activities and extract leading indicators, providing critical insights that support strategic decision making & enable proactive responses to market dynamics.
  • Implement simulation models to analyze various aspects of business operations such as seasonal trends, regional & sub-regional dynamics to identify proactive actions, enable accurate revenue forecasting & operational capacity planning.
  • Utilize DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) for creating measures and understanding of data modeling concepts, data integration methods to consolidate data from various sources into PowerBI, ensuring data accuracy and reliability. Utilize SQL for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes, with the ability to perform queries and manage data effectively.

  • Support in the execution of Program Management plan, including enabling cadence planning, impact capturing & problem solving.

What we look for:

  • Able to commit to a full-time internship for 6 months preferred
  • Proficient in Microsoft Power BI, Data Modeling & Visualization, Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint
  • Familiarity with programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and manipulation, enhancing the capability to work with complex datasets.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to apply analytical thinking to dissect complex data and extract meaningful insights relevant to business objectives.
  • Detail-Oriented: Keen attention to detail to ensure the accuracy and effectiveness of data visualizations and reports.
  • Effective Communication: Strong communication skills to articulate data insights and analysis to both technical and non-technical team members.
  • Having practical skills with Salesforce platform would be a plus

job.title: Senior Enterprise Integration Developer
job.description:
Job Description

Title: Senior Enterprise Integration Developer

Exp: 5 +yrs

Role Summary

A strategic and hands-on Integration Leader responsible for driving end-to-end delivery of enterprise integration solutions. Ensures alignment with enterprise architecture, leads technical design (HLD/LLD), and builds high-performing teams while leveraging modern cloud, AI, and Copilot-enabled development capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Architecture & Delivery

  • Own and lead end-to-end integration solution design and delivery across complex enterprise programs.
  • Define and implement integration architectures, API strategies, and reusable frameworks aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Create, review, and govern High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs) ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Drive architecture governance, technical design reviews, and best practices adoption.

Azure Integration Services Implementation

  • Lead development using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, and broader Azure Integration Services.
  • Design highly resilient, secure, and scalable workflows and orchestrations.

API Management & Governance

  • Design, publish, secure, and monitor APIs via Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Drive enterprise API governance, lifecycle management, versioning, and security standards.

Messaging & Event-Driven Architecture

  • Build and implement event-driven and asynchronous architectures using Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hubs.
  • Champion loosely coupled, scalable integration patterns.

Hybrid Integration

  • Architect and implement integrations between on-premises systems and cloud platforms, ensuring seamless and reliable connectivity.

AI & Copilot-Driven Engineering

  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot (GitHub Copilot, M365 Copilot) to improve developer productivity, accelerate code development, and enhance solution quality.
  • Utilize Generative AI for:Automated code generation, refactoring, and documentation (LLDs, API specs)
  • Intelligent workflow design and optimization
  • AI-assisted debugging, testing, and root cause analysis

Integrate AI-powered services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services) within integration solutions to enable intelligent data processing and decision-making.Promote AI-first engineering practices, including prompt engineering and responsible AI usage.Monitoring, Security & Compliance

  • Implement end-to-end observability using Cribl.
  • Ensure secure data handling, compliance, and governance across integration solutions.

Technical & Team Leadership

  • Provide strong technical leadership and direction across teams.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and enforce engineering standards.
  • Mentor team members, enabling skill development in integration, cloud, and AI technologies.
  • Manage technical risks, escalations, and critical design decisions.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, business stakeholders, and vendors.
  • Align technology solutions with business goals and enterprise strategy.
  • Build and nurture a high-performing, collaborative, and innovation-driven integration team.

Required Skills

  • Experience: 9–12+ years in software engineering with strong focus on cloud and iPaaS integrations.
  • Azure Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services (AIS).
  • Development Skills: Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, XML.
  • Design Skills: Extensive experience in LLD/HLD creation, architecture design, and solution documentation.
  • API Expertise: Strong experience in API architecture, governance, and lifecycle management.
  • Integration Patterns: Expertise in event-driven, microservices, and hybrid integration architectures.
  • AI & Copilot Skills: (Good to have)Hands-on usage of GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot for development acceleration
  • Understanding of prompt engineering and AI-assisted development workflows
  • Exposure to Azure OpenAI / AI services integration

Delivery Experience: Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise integration delivery.Preferred Skills

  • Experience with MuleSoft architecture / coexistence strategies.
  • Exposure to advanced AI/ML integration use cases and intelligent automation.
  • Knowledge of data transformation standards (EDI, XML, JSON) and large-scale data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, ethics, and secure AI adoption in enterprises.

Preferred Certifications

  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
  • Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
  • DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)

job.title: Data Platform Engineering Manager
job.description:
Job description

Data Platform Engineering Manager

Johnson Controls is seeking a Data Platform Engineering Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and operations of the data platform capabilities that support analytics, reporting, telemetry, and data products across the business. This role partners closely with engineering, cloud, product, security, and analytics teams to build a reliable, scalable, and secure data foundation.

Role Overview

In this role, you will guide a team responsible for designing and operating modern data platform services, including event-driven pipelines, storage layers, governance controls, and operational monitoring. You will help shape the platform roadmap, improve engineering practices, and ensure the data environment can support both current needs and future growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, delivery, and evolution of the enterprise data platform architecture.
  • Manage a team of data platform engineers and coordinate work across engineering, cloud, analytics, and product stakeholders.
  • Define standards for data modeling, retention, partitioning, lifecycle management, access control, and data quality.
  • Oversee the development and support of event-driven data pipelines using technologies such as Kafka and cloud-native services.
  • Guide the use of storage and analytics technologies including data lake, data warehouse, columnar database, and time-series storage patterns.
  • Partner with teams using platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP to support scalable and secure data solutions.
  • Improve observability, reliability, and performance across data services and operational workflows.
  • Support CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code practices using tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate on telemetry, metadata, logs, and system health data that support dashboards, monitoring, and proactive operations.
  • Mentor engineers and strengthen team capability through coaching, code review, design review, and knowledge sharing.

How You Will Do It

  • You will own outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity, making clear decisions and following through on commitments.
  • You will stay close to the work, remove obstacles quickly, and keep priorities focused on what delivers the most value for customers and internal teams.
  • You will improve every day by using data, candid feedback, and structured problem-solving to simplify processes and strengthen the platform.
  • You will win as one team by building trust across engineering, product, cloud, security, and analytics groups and by valuing diverse perspectives.
  • You will set clear technical standards and help the team execute them consistently across design, build, and operations.
  • You will balance strategy with hands-on leadership, ensuring architecture decisions translate into reliable delivery and measurable results.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Experience leading engineering teams, with responsibility for delivery, quality, and team development.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience designing and operating cloud-native data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven data pipelines, streaming frameworks such as Kafka, and enterprise data storage patterns.
  • Hands-on understanding of data lake, data warehouse, columnar database, and time-series storage technologies.
  • Experience with data governance, security, encryption, access control, and compliance in enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD integration, and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to align technical teams and business stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with telemetry, observability, or real-time data environments such as logs, metrics, system health, or event streams.
  • Exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK.
  • Experience supporting ML or advanced analytics pipelines.
  • Background in SaaS or multi-tenant platform design.

job.title: Data Platform Engineer
job.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with 3-6 years of experience to support the design, operation, and improvement of a modern data platform. You will work with Snowflake and related data engineering tools to enable high-quality, secure, and well-governed data consumption for analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders. This is a hands-on role focused on reliability, access patterns, and platform enablement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate a secure and scalable data platform in Snowflake.
  • Support governed data consumption by implementing reliable structures, access patterns, and platform controls.
  • Collaborate with data consumers to understand needs and remove friction in how they access and use data.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines, transformations, and supporting workflows for analytics use cases.
  • Implement secure access patterns for humans, applications, and AI-driven tools.
  • Monitor platform health, troubleshoot issues, and improve performance, stability, and usability.
  • Support the Posit (RStudio) platform used by data scientists and advanced analysts.
  • Document platform processes, data workflows, and operational standards.
  • Work closely with analytics, engineering, and business teams to support data quality and platform adoption.

How You Will Do It

  • Own the outcome with accountability by delivering reliable, secure, and well-controlled platform services.
  • Stay close to the work by understanding how analysts, data scientists, and business teams actually use the platform.
  • Look for root causes, improve the platform continuously, and address issues with candor and practical problem-solving.
  • Work as one team by partnering across technical and business groups, sharing context, and building trust.
  • Balance speed and control so the platform remains useful, safe, and maintainable as demand grows.
  • Use clear documentation and disciplined operating practices to support consistency and handoffs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3-6 years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake and modern cloud data platform concepts.
  • Strong SQL skills for data manipulation, validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience building or supporting data pipelines, transformations, or analytics data models.
  • Working knowledge of data governance, secure access, and data quality practices.
  • Experience collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Posit (RStudio), Python, or other analytics development environments.
  • Exposure to Azure Data Factory, Fivetran, Snowpark, dbt, or Airflow.
  • Experience supporting workforce analytics or other business intelligence environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices, Git, or Azure DevOps.
  • Exposure to secure access patterns for application, service, or AI-based data consumption.

M3

Country

Singapore

#08-01/02, Perennial Business City, 1 Venture Avenue, Singapore 608521

Job Summary

The Sales Support Manager is responsible to supervise and oversee a team of sales support based in Singapore; ensuring exceptional service delivery, effective parts fulfilment and optimal handling of sales orders. The ideal candidate will exhibit outstanding leadership and problem-solving abilities, with a demonstrated history of improving customer service operations in a regional setting. Proficiency in export and expertise in the SAP Sales Order Module are crucial. The candidate should also be skilled in leveraging technology to boost efficiency and possess a strategic perspective to align customer service initiatives with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & People Management
  • Lead, coach, and supervise the regional Sales Support team, fostering a high-performance and customer-centric culture aligned with The Carrier Way.
  • Set clear performance expectations, provide regular feedback, and support individual development and succession planning.
  • Identify capability gaps and implement training or process improvements to enhance team effectiveness.
  • Represent Sales Support in cross-functional meetings and contribute to company-wide initiatives and strategic discussions.

  • Proactively manage and resolve issues related to part shortages, delivery discrepancies, and customer complaints.
  • Support inventory forecasting and customer blanket order management in collaboration with Planners to align stock levels with demand.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and complete documentation for all sales transactions, including quotations, invoices, credit notes, and customer correspondence, and support audit activities.
  • Customer Support & Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Operations Governance: Lead monthly operations meetings with parts and equipment sales teams to review performance, hub requirements, and operational challenges. Drive action plans and ensure follow-through.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Purchasing, Technical, and Finance teams to align customer service initiatives with business goals.
  • Shipping & Logistics: Coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, and logistics partners to ensure accurate and timely shipment of parts and equipment, resolving discrepancies proactively.
  • Credit Control: Partner with Finance to manage customer credit exposure, monitor credit limits, and support timely collections and issue resolution.
  • Performance Monitoring, Reporting & Process Improvement
  • Provide accurate and timely sales and operational reports, ensuring alignment between sales performance data and financial metrics.
  • Support Sales in managing Net Promoter Score (NPS) initiatives, analyzing feedback, and driving customer service improvement actions.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to SAP Sales Order processes, particularly for parts operations, in collaboration with IT and SAP teams.
  • Work with external consultants and internal stakeholders to design and maintain Power BI dashboards for KPIs such as order backlog, fulfilment performance, and inventory visibility.
  • Analyze performance trends and provide actionable insights to management for continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on Daily Operational Support
  • Process customer purchase orders accurately and timely into sales orders in SAP.
  • Monitor and manage open orders end-to-end, from order creation to warehouse release and final delivery to customers.
  • Provide backend sales support, including order status updates, documentation preparation, and coordination with internal teams.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers regarding order status, delivery timelines, and general enquiries.
  • Handle customer enquiries via email, phone, or meetings, including part numbers, product details, pricing, quotations, and payment terms.
  • Coordinate directly with suppliers for customer direct shipment orders.
  • Coordinate outbound shipment arrangements when required.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex customer issues, ensuring effective service recovery and stakeholder communication.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Order Processing Accuracy
  • On-Time Delivery Performance
  • Customer Response Time
  • Open Order Management
  • Customer Satisfaction / NPS
  • Service Recovery Efficiency

Requirements

  • Prior experience managing or supervising teams in a regional or cross-country setup is highly desirable.

  • Strong working knowledge of SAP Sales Order module and operational processes.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • High attention to detail, strong analytical capability, and structured problem-solving approach.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and operate effectively with minimal supervision.

job.title: Apprentice
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

Role Overview

Carrier Australia is looking for a motivated and reliable Air Conditioning Apprentice to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to learn from experienced HVAC technicians, gain practical industry experience and work towards becoming a qualified Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Technician.

You’ll combine on-the-job training with formal TAFE studies, gaining exposure to the installation, servicing, maintenance, fault finding and repair of HVAC and air conditioning systems.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with the installation, servicing and maintenance of air conditioning and HVAC equipment.
  • Learn how to fault-find and troubleshoot mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Assist with preventative maintenance and servicing.
  • Support the installation and commissioning of HVAC systems.
  • Learn to safely use hand and power tools.
  • Maintain accurate service records and documentation.
  • Follow Carrier’s health, safety, environmental and quality standards.
  • Attend TAFE and complete all required apprenticeship training and assessments.
  • Develop your technical knowledge and practical skills through hands-on experience.
  • Work professionally with customers and colleagues across a range of customer sites.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

You don't need to have extensive industry experience — we're looking for the right attitude, commitment and willingness to learn.

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Genuinely interested in building a career in Air Conditioning and Refrigeration.
  • Hands-on and enjoys working with tools and equipment.
  • Reliable, punctual and committed to completing their apprenticeship.
  • Willing to learn and take direction from experienced technicians.
  • Safety-conscious and committed to doing things the right way.
  • A good communicator who works well as part of a team.
  • Customer-focused and professional.
  • Able to demonstrate good problem-solving and attention to detail.
  • Willing to travel to customer sites as required.
  • Eligible to work in Australia.
  • Holding a current driver's licence, or willing to obtain one as required.

Why Join Carrier?

At Carrier, you'll be joining a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions while building valuable skills for a long-term career.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Complete a formal HVAC apprenticeship with TAFE support.
  • Learn from experienced and qualified technicians.
  • Gain hands-on experience across a diverse range of HVAC equipment and applications.
  • Develop highly valued technical and diagnostic skills.
  • Work with industry-leading technology and equipment.
  • Build a long-term career with a globally recognised organisation.
  • Work within a supportive team environment that values safety, quality and continuous development.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

job.title: Executive – Tool Room
job.description:
To ensure maximum availability, reliability, and performance of plastic injection moulds by effectively managing preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, spare parts planning, mould life monitoring, and technical improvements. The role will provide dedicated toolroom support for critical projects and ensure timely resolution of mould-related issues to minimize production downtime and improve tooling life.

Responsibilities

Ensure timely preventive and corrective maintenance of plastic injection moulds as per the defined maintenance plan.Attend mould breakdowns on priority and coordinate with internal and external resources to minimize production downtime.Perform systematic troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for repetitive mould failures and implement permanent corrective actions.Maintain and regularly update mould history cards, maintenance records, breakdown records, mould life data, and other relevant ISO documentation.Monitor mould life, cavity/component condition, and prepare renewal or refurbishment plans based on mould performance and production requirements.Plan, maintain, and control critical mould spare parts to ensure quick availability during breakdowns and preventive maintenance.Coordinate with external toolrooms and vendors for mould repairs, modifications, spare manufacturing, and technical improvements.Review repair requirements and technical feasibility of mould modifications in coordination with the Mould Development, Production, Process, and Quality teams.Support mould trials after major repairs, modifications, or corrective actions and ensure successful handover for production.Monitor the performance of critical moulds and identify potential risks before they result in major breakdowns or production losses.Develop contingency plans for critical and high-risk moulds to ensure production continuity during major breakdowns.Support mould improvement activities related to recurring issues such as breakage, wear, flash, leakage, sticking, scoring, gate-related issues, cooling problems, and other moulding-related concerns.Ensure proper preventive maintenance of mould systems including cores, cavities, sliders, lifters, ejector systems, guide elements, cooling circuits, hydraulic systems, and hot runner systems.Coordinate with production and moulding teams to understand mould performance issues and ensure timely technical support.Monitor mould maintenance costs, repair costs, and spare consumption and support annual budgeting and cost-control activities.Ensure compliance with ISO systems, SOPs, maintenance standards, safety requirements, and audit readiness.Maintain and improve toolroom standards through 5S, TPM, Kaizen, and continuous improvement activities.Support basic toolroom manufacturing and repair processes, including surface grinding, cylindrical grinding, milling, drilling, EDM, wire-cut EDM, fitting, polishing, and assembly.Read and understand 2D mould drawings, assembly drawings, component drawings, tolerances, GD&T, and basic engineering specifications.Support emergency and off-shift activities whenever required to restore critical moulds and ensure continuity of production.

Qualifications

Essential: DME/BE/Diploma in Tool & Die Making / CIPET/ITI (Tool & Diemaker)

job.title: Assistant Manager - R&D Switchgear Design
job.description:
Design & Development Engineer – Low Voltage Switchgear

Role Overview

The role focuses on designing and developing low voltage switchgear products, ensuring seamless transition from concept to production. The candidate will be responsible for product design, validation, testing, and continuous improvement, while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Product Design & Development

  • Design and develop concepts for plates, frames, switches, and sockets.
  • Create detailed designs of accessories in both 2D and 3D formats.
  • Develop innovative concepts and perform re-engineering of existing and new products.

Testing & Validation

  • Validate and test product samples as per defined specifications and standards.
  • Analyze test results and implement design modifications to meet functional requirements.

Process Improvement

  • Identify and implement design and process improvements to enhance productivity and efficiency.
  • Continuously work on improving existing product performance and manufacturability.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance (QA) and Manufacturing Engineering (ME) teams for product qualification.
  • Support the ME team in developing and qualifying tools and fixtures.

Vendor & Production Support

  • Ensure timely development and availability of product samples from vendors.
  • Coordinate for material availability to support new product launches and production schedules.

Training & Documentation

  • Train team members on product design, development processes, and 2D/3D design tools.
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation and reports.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in: Electrical & Electronics Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering

Experience

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in product design and development, preferably in electro-mechanical or switchgear industry.

Required Knowledge

  • Knowledge of technical documentation and electronic product testing.
  • Familiarity with standards such as BIS, IEC, and ISO.
  • Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience with design software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CATIA, etc.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong expertise in 2D/3D modelling and drafting
  • Knowledge of electro-mechanical devices
  • Product design and development expertise
  • Project management and coordination skills
  • Data analysis and reporting ability
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Innovative and creative problem-solving approach
  • Good interpersonal skills and teamwork

Key Deliverables

  • Timely development of new products from concept to production
  • Compliance with quality and industry standards
  • Continuous improvement in product design and manufacturing efficiency
  • Effective coordination with internal teams and external vendors
