job.title: Program Specialist (Program Mgmt Developer II)
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Description Summary

Critical Work Role Position Performs: BTL (Business Transformation Lead) to lead complex ERP deployments (SAP & QAD). This is more of senior program management role.

Manage all aspects of the SAP deployments including the requirements gathering, project plan, site communications, and plan execution. This includes, but not limited to:

  • Support GIS Demand management activities
  • Lead SAP related Dricefs/ MGPPs delivery
  • Lead ERP pre-assessments workshops for business to provide estimates.
  • Lead SAP & QAD related deployments globally
  • Interactions with GCIO and EMs, facility senior leaders, GIS division managers and directors on SAP transformation initiatives
  • Manage both Cat and IT vendor resources across regions
  • Mange deployment IT budget ranges from ~$1M to $10M
  • Candidate should have strong communication skills, be an innovative thinker, have strong problem-solving skills, work well in a team environment, and possess strong customer relationship and customer support skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage one’s time as well as well as being a collaborative team member
  • Ability to convert BU requirements into IT requirements. (Demand Management)
  • Ability to coordinate with vendors and other cross functional teams for support and deployment
  • Participate in project control meetings and reporting status on deployments

BACKGROUND/EXPERIENCE:

The successful candidate should be able to demonstrate the following selection criteria:

  • 10 plus years experience in SAP project delivery
  • Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) / BB certification required
  • Bachelor's Degree in appropriate field of study or equivalent work experience

Skill Descriptors

Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Develops, refines, and communicates tactical plans for own responsibilities.
  • Provides the right level of detail as input for strategic plan development.
  • Demonstrates the value and necessity of linking tactical plans to overall strategic plan.
  • Ensures attention to the detail and dependencies of existing departmental-level plans.
  • Plans for allocation of resources in line with unit goals, technical and business objectives.
  • Ensures the planning process is integrated with the overall business plan.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Seeks discrepancies and inconsistencies in available information; explains variances.
  • Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation.
  • Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research.
  • Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action.
  • Approaches a complex problem by breaking it down into its component parts.
  • Chooses among a diverse set of analytical tools according to the nature of the situation.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Knowledge of successful approaches and techniques for dealing with change; ability to adapt to a changing environment and be comfortable with change.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Creates processes with provisions to accommodate change.
  • Helps others adapt to changing environments and accept new situations.
  • Recovers from disappointments and setbacks.
  • Works effectively with unstructured teams, situations, or environments.
  • Leverages prior experience as a help towards handling changing situations.
  • Makes progress in an atmosphere of ambiguity and uncertainty.

Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Develops basic persuasive arguments.
  • Discusses organizational culture around providing input on decisions.
  • Uses active listening skills and probing techniques to surface opportunities to influence.
  • Identifies who the decision makers are and how they receive information.
  • Regularly presents ideas or suggestions to associates in persuasive terms.

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Clarifies and handles multiple concurrent and diverse activities.
  • Shifts focus among several efforts as required by changing priorities.
  • Addresses potential conflicts that impact current delivery commitments.
  • Works with or leads others to re-prioritize work and reschedule commitments as necessary.
  • Responds to shifting priorities while maintaining progress of regularly scheduled work.
  • Demonstrates an expectation that there will be ongoing shifts in demands and priorities.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Communicates to clients regarding expectations of all parties.
  • Participates in negotiating the terms of the business relationship.
  • Conducts periodic reviews of work effort, progress, issues, and successes.
  • Maintains productive, long-term relationships with clients or vendors.
  • Creates opportunities to educate support teams on client priorities.
  • Empowers others to establish collaborative, healthy relationships.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Utilizes preferred tools, techniques and methods for estimating project cost and time.
  • Plans, estimates, staffs, organizes and monitors significant projects.
  • Identifies risks and vulnerabilities; creates contingency plans.
  • Conducts regular and ad-hoc project reviews with project team, sponsors, and clients.
  • Maintains open communication among project participants and interested parties.
  • Communicates reporting requirements; creates monitoring and control mechanisms.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
  • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
  • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
  • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
  • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

You will gain exposure to real-world safety programs, participate in meaningful projects and develop valuable professional skills while supporting continuous improvement across the business.

In this role, you will assist with a variety of activities, including safety project coordination, policy and procedure development, workplace inspections, risk assessments, training administration, data analysis and reporting, compliance tracking and continuous improvement initiatives. job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

JOB PURPOSE

The Software Engineering Manager would provide leadership in the design, development, and deployment of Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital products within the areas of e-commerce. This position is accountable for hiring, managing, and mentoring multiple software engineers and pod leads who are transforming and building a world-class eCommerce application, in line with the CAT Digital Strategy.

We are looking for a Software Engineering Manager with expertise and passion to imagine, build and develop innovative products. This is a high growth space and a big opportunity that needs a dynamic product creator. The ideal candidate will be curious, have attention to detail, be energized by a dynamic environment, be comfortable with strategic thinking while also diving deep.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead strong development teams and build creative technology solutions that positively impact international customers, relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will identify, hire, and build world-class teams of Software Engineers to define, drive, and execute on our strategic vision. You will improve/initiate processes that allow these teams to collaborate with local as well as global teams with a high degree of efficiency. You will develop teams of highly motivated and talented individuals that can collaborate with Project Managers, Product Managers and Software Engineers across the company on a high impact initiative. You will design, build and own features and programs that will delight our dealers / customers.

This key role is expected to establish and mature product software engineering capability in India. The role will report to CAT Digital India Senior Engineering Manager.

JOB DUTIES

  • The position supports the CAT Digital strategy, recognizes the service requirements/needs of dealers and customers, corporate and business unit goals, and gives input to leadership in formulating global concepts, strategies and plans to deliver service solutions.
  • Typical internal customers include various contacts throughout Caterpillar worldwide and its subsidiaries. External contacts include various customers, dealers, and vendors throughout worldwide markets.
  • The role is responsible for the overall development life cycle of the solution and manage complex projects with significant impact.
  • Responsibilities include supervising a team and a project related to developing business and technical solutions.
  • Work with product managers in developing a strategy and road map to provide compelling capabilities that helps them succeed in their business goals.
  • Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best technical design and approach for new product development.
  • Continuously improve and drive engineering best practices around software engineering & lead the craftsmanship, resilience, and scalability of our solutions. Establish durable ways of working with product peers and other internal engineering teams.
  • Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, including outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity.
  • Project management - prioritization, planning of features, Stakeholder management and tracking of commitments. Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
  • Career management and development of direct reports: The position is responsible for all personnel issues and performance evaluation of subordinates, as well as overall employee satisfaction for the division.
  • Provides technical support, and direction to teams and pod leads. Acquires resources necessary to accomplish work on time.
  • Coordinates walkthroughs and reviews; ensures conformance to standards and adherence to design specifications.
  • The position is challenged to carefully evaluate problems and provide input into many possible solutions before selecting one option. Problems may be complex and can require developing and monetize new solutions.
  • The leader follows general policies and guidelines for projects under his/her control to ensure specific, management goals are met and desired results are achieved. Impacts key quality goals including Customer Satisfaction, Continuous Improvement, and Reoccurring Revenue, Timeliness, Accuracy, Efficiency, Cost Savings, Process Quality, etc.
  • S/he should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. S/he would need to also balance technical leadership with savvy business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.
  • Employee is also responsible for performing other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Position requires a four-year degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Fifteen + years or more of experience in designing and developing software applications in Java or Scala or at least ten years of experience in Java with master’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • Three years or more of experience in managing 8 to 14 member cross functional team.
  • Five years or more of experience in public cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure.

Top candidates will also have:

  • Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities.
  • Ability to cope with shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize, delegate responsibilities and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
  • Oversees performance of individual team members and team as whole. Identifies and addresses staff training and development needs.
  • Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
  • Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints.

Passion for technology and innovation.

  • Ability to provide guidance in applying the right architectural design pattern for the modernization of the applications by analysing the gaps between existing architecture and new business requirements.

Proven experience in many of the following:

  • Designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining software at scale.
  • Application architectural patterns, such as MVC, Microservices, Event-driven, etc.
  • Technical expertise in building a complex open-stack, microservices-based platform or product that is highly reliable, and scalable.
  • Message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Apache ActiveMQ, Kinesis.
  • Datastores such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL.
  • Developing software applications using relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Deploying software using CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GoCD, Azure Devops etc.
  • Working within an Agile framework (ideally Scrum).
  • Researching data to support design decisions.
  • Must demonstrate solid knowledge of computer science fundamentals like data structures and Algorithms.
  • Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of ecommerce platforms like HCL Commerce (WCS) Version 8.0+ or equivalent; WebSphere Commerce subsystems - Trading, Catalog Management, Order Management, Member Management Sub-system, etc
  • Must Have - Deep hands-on expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot.
  • Nice to Have - Certifications in AWS/Azure, MongoDB/Redis.
  • Nice to Have - Hands-on experience on React, Typescript, JavaScript frameworks.
  • Nice to Have – BPMN/Workflow/Rules Engine technology like Camunda, Temporal, Drools.

job.title: Account Manager, Inside Sales
job.description:

job.title: Director, Development & Governance
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Director, Development & Governance, reporting to the Senior Director, Development Controls, you will own the controlled Development operating framework. You will make sure the end-to-end lifecycle, standards, playbooks, templates, systems and governance records work as one clear and current way of working for Development teams.

  • Own the Development E2E Lifecycle and Knowledge Hub as the authoritative map of steps, gates, minimum inputs and deliverables.
  • Maintain controlled standards, playbooks, templates and governance processes mapped to the lifecycle and approved authorities.
  • Lead governance capability, systems adoption and portfolio information in partnership with Development teams and subject matter experts.

Your Day to Day

Lifecycle and Governance Framework

  • Own and maintain the Development E2E Lifecycle, including lifecycle stages, hard gates, minimum inputs, key deliverables and evidence expectations.
  • Maintain the Development Knowledge Hub as the controlled source for lifecycle guidance and its links to approved Level 2 standards and Level 3 playbooks, templates and checklists.
  • Map approved GMS requirements, Gold Standards, Delegations of Authority and governance controls to the lifecycle so teams can find the applicable requirement at each stage.
  • Coordinate with Project Controls & Assurance so the governance baseline can be tested consistently and assurance findings are routed to the appropriate owner.

Standards, Playbooks and Controlled Releases

  • Set requirements for ownership, technical review, approval, version control, scheduled review and publication of Development standards and playbooks.
  • Coordinate drafting and review with Principals, SMEs, Development leaders and process owners. Keep approvals, decisions and change history traceable.
  • Manage the controlled release process for approved procedures, templates, checklists and process updates, with clear communication to affected teams.
  • Partner with Continual Improvement & Change Controls to assess lessons and approved changes before they are incorporated into controlled guidance.

Systems, Information and Capability

  • Set governance requirements for Development systems, registers, information structures and workflow controls.
  • Work with IT and system owners on configuration, access, integrations and adoption while keeping process ownership with the relevant business function.
  • Lead the Development Governance pillar, including Data & Analytics, and ensure portfolio information supports governance and executive decisions.
  • Identify capability and adoption gaps and coordinate guidance, training and support with functional leaders.

Leadership and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Advise the Senior Director, Development Controls and Development leadership on governance gaps, process changes and adoption risks.
  • Work across Development, Operations, Customer teams, Commercial, Procurement, Technology and other functions where processes cross organisational boundaries.
  • Prioritise governance and system improvements against business needs, delegated authority and available capacity.

Requirements

  • Senior experience in Development governance, project controls, standards, operating systems or comparable capital delivery.
  • Experience designing lifecycle processes, controlled standards, approval pathways and document management.
  • Ability to translate policies, delegated authorities and technical standards into practical operating processes.
  • Strong change management and systems adoption skills across functions or regions.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and technical SMEs while clarifying decision rights and content ownership.
  • Clear writing and document control skills, with the ability to turn complex requirements into usable guidance.
  • Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent professional experience; experience leading multidisciplinary teams in a matrix organisation. Data centre or Development experience is desirable.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Data Center Customer Operations Engineer (Shift Work) - Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

The Customer Operations Engineer supports the delivery of customer and operational services within a mission-critical data center environment. This role performs a wide range of installation, connectivity, troubleshooting, and customer support activities while developing technical expertise across data center infrastructure and operational processes.

Working as part of a collaborative team, the engineer helps ensure customer commitments are delivered safely, accurately, and on time while maintaining high standards of service and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Queue Management / Reporting

  • Review and execute work order requests in accordance with customer commitments and service level expectations.
  • Escalate requests to appropriate teams when required and follow established escalation processes.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of work activities and customer interactions.
  • Ensure operational activities are documented appropriately in relevant systems and databases.
  • Support reporting activities and provide updates on work order status as required.

Installations

  • Perform rack-and-stack activities for customer equipment deployments.
  • Interpret installation plans and supporting documentation to ensure accurate implementation.
  • Support customer infrastructure installations, including:

Fiber trays and ladder racks

  • Customer cabinets and equipment
  • Cage mesh and overhead cable tray installations
  • Tape changes and backup support activities

Follow established procedures to ensure installations are completed safely, accurately, and efficiently. Identify and communicate concerns related to space, capacity, or infrastructure requirements.

Cross-Connect

  • Perform data center cross-connect installations, terminations, modifications, and testing activities.
  • Support cable management activities involving fiber, coaxial, and copper cabling.
  • Install and test cross-connect circuits while adhering to established operational standards.
  • Develop knowledge of advanced connectivity solutions and testing practices.

Testing / Troubleshooting

  • Perform testing and validation of customer infrastructure and connectivity services.
  • Support Layer 1 certification testing and assist with troubleshooting connectivity issues.
  • Assist with Layer 2 and Layer 3 testing activities under guidance when required.
  • Work with team members and customers to identify and resolve operational issues.
  • Escalate complex issues appropriately while supporting resolution efforts.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Support operational, logistics, and security activities when required to ensure smooth site operations.
  • Assist team members during periods of high workload or operational demand.
  • Build effective working relationships with internal teams and external partners.
  • Support service delivery objectives through collaboration and communication.

Customer Management

  • Deliver timely and accurate execution of customer requests and service orders.
  • Provide a positive customer experience through professional communication and responsive support.
  • Support customer deployments and infrastructure changes by communicating timelines and progress updates.
  • Support customer access control and escort activities in accordance with site procedures.
  • Serve as a trusted operational resource for customer requests and day-to-day support activities.

Projects

  • Support customer and internal projects in accordance with established processes and project requirements.
  • Coordinate with vendors and stakeholders to assist with project deliverables.
  • Support customer audits and operational readiness activities.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance and customer experience.

Training

  • Complete all required training and certifications in a timely manner.
  • Support onboarding activities for new team members when required.
  • Participate in knowledge-sharing activities and continuous learning opportunities to expand technical expertise.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma, technical certification, vocational qualification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 1–3 years of experience in data center operations, telecommunications, IT infrastructure, customer operations, or a related technical environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Familiarity with structured cabling, data center infrastructure, or telecommunications environments.
  • Basic understanding of networking and connectivity concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Effective problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
  • We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage applications from individuals with transferable technical skills and a willingness to learn.

Work Requirements

  • Ability to complete hands-on tasks at height or in tight spaces.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends, night shifts, holidays, and shift-based schedules as required to support 24x7 data center operations.

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer (Shift) - Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

The Critical Facilities Engineer (Shift) supports the operation, maintenance, and reliability of mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role performs a range of maintenance, monitoring, and operational activities while developing technical expertise across critical facility systems.

Working as part of a collaborative team, the engineer helps maintain safe, reliable, and efficient data center operations while building hands-on experience across electrical, mechanical, cooling, and facility systems.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on facility systems and equipment to support reliable and continuous operations.
  • Carry out repairs, inspections, installations, and maintenance activities across critical facility infrastructure in accordance with established procedures.
  • Monitor the Building Monitoring System (BMS) and respond to alarms by investigating issues and supporting resolution activities.
  • Support the operation and maintenance of critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, plumbing, fire suppression, and life-safety systems.
  • Identify equipment issues and potential operational risks and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Support energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives through maintenance activities and operational best practices.
  • Carry out day-to-day operational activities independently while seeking guidance for complex or unfamiliar situations.

Vendor Support

  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers performing maintenance and infrastructure activities within the data center.
  • Support the work approval process, including pre-work briefings, monitoring work execution, and reviewing completed work.
  • Ensure vendor activities are performed in accordance with site procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.
  • Assist with maintaining technical documentation, equipment records, and asset information.

Site Administration & Incident Support

  • Prepare and maintain site documentation, logs, and permits, including Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs) and operational scripts.
  • Identify potential infrastructure risks and Single Points of Failure (SPOFs) and communicate observations to senior team members.
  • Respond to equipment failures, operational issues, and site incidents in accordance with established procedures.
  • Support incident investigations and documentation activities to improve operational reliability.
  • Apply operating procedures and compliance requirements to support safe and effective site operations.

Work Orders & Additional Projects

  • Complete facility-related work orders and support infrastructure installation activities.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain facility equipment and supporting systems to minimize downtime.
  • Assist with approved modifications to electrical, mechanical, and facility systems.
  • Participate in infrastructure projects, maintenance programs, lifecycle replacement activities, and site improvements.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts that enhance reliability, efficiency, and operational performance.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to support operational activities and resolve facility issues.
  • Share knowledge and assist team members during maintenance activities and operational events.
  • Communicate inventory and spare-part requirements to support operational readiness.
  • Participate in training and development opportunities to expand technical capabilities and career growth.
  • Contribute ideas and recommendations that support operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Degree, Diploma, technical certification, or equivalent qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
  • Typically 1–3 years of relevant experience in critical facilities, data center operations, facilities maintenance, industrial facilities, building operations, or a related technical environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Foundational understanding of electrical, mechanical, cooling, or building systems.
  • Familiarity with preventive and corrective maintenance practices, facility monitoring systems, and safe work procedures.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Interest in developing technical expertise within a mission-critical data center environment.

Work Requirements

  • Ability to perform hands-on operational and maintenance tasks within a data center environment.
  • Ability to work at height and in confined or tight spaces where required.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends, night shifts, holidays, and shift-based schedules, as required to support 24x7 mission-critical data center operations.

job.title: Team Member - FP&A - Planning, Budgeting and Business Performance Reporting
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead monthly MIS, management reporting, and business performance reviews by ensuring timely and accurate consolidation, analysis, and presentation of financial and operational results.
  • Drive annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-range planning processes by coordinating with business stakeholders, challenging assumptions, and developing financial projections.
  • Perform detailed variance analysis of actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods to identify key business drivers, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
  • Partner with business leaders and cross-functional teams to provide financial insights, support decision-making, and improve overall business performance.
  • Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards, and analytical tools to support profitability analysis, cost management, and strategic initiatives.
  • Support preparation of leadership presentations, business review decks, board materials, and executive reporting by translating complex data into actionable insights.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation to enhance reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and governance.
  • Ensure compliance with financial controls, reporting standards, and organizational governance requirements while maintaining data integrity across planning and reporting processes.
  • Mentor junior team members by providing guidance on financial analysis, reporting processes, stakeholder management, and best practices within the FP&A function.

Participate in strategic projects, business transformation initiatives, and digital finance programs to improve organizational performance and support long-term business objectives.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration with CA/CMA/MBA (Finance) qualification preferred.
  • 3-6 years of experience in FP&A, Business Finance, Management Reporting, Budgeting, Forecasting, and Performance Management within a corporate or shared services environment.
  • Strong expertise in financial planning, variance analysis, financial modeling, business performance reviews, and management reporting, with advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP/Oracle) and reporting & analytics tools such as Power BI, SAC, Tableau, or similar platforms; exposure to automation and digital finance initiatives preferred.

Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills with the ability to independently manage deliverables, collaborate with business leaders, and drive process improvement initiatives.

job.title: Assistant Manager- C&I Maintenance
job.description:
Lead - DCS_PLC (Distributed Control System_ Programmable Logic Control)

System Reliability and Maintenance:

Ensure the availability and functioning of all control loops in auto mode, maintaining reliability of equipment protection under BTG.

Schedule and execute regular backups of DCS and PLC systems to prevent data loss.

Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of DCS and PLC hardware to minimize downtime.

Monitor system alarms daily and ensure the healthiness and redundancy of systems.

Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) for annual maintenance activities and system upgrades.

Manage the proper functioning of Operator Workstations (OWS) and Engineering Workstations (EWS).

Maintain periodical backups and availability of historian systems for data integrity and recovery.

Hardware and Software Management:

Manage the availability of DCS and PLC hardware and software, including necessary spares for emergency replacements.

Maintain up-to-date DCS and PLC licenses and manage renewals to avoid operational disruptions.

Conduct patch updates of DCS and PLC software to address vulnerabilities and enhance system performance.

Upgrade DCS and PLC systems proactively to prevent obsolescence and maintain compatibility with new technologies.

Network and Cybersecurity:

Manage the storage, backup, and restoration of systems in compliance with cybersecurity policies.

Ensure the healthiness and redundancy of the DCS and PLC network, preventing single points of failure.

Oversee the transfer of data to third-party systems, such as Pi servers, ensuring secure and reliable communication.

Review and strengthen network security measures to protect against cyber threats and unauthorized access.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Promote the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols.

Implement risk management practices to mitigate potential hazards and ensure operational continuity.

Develop and maintain emergency response plans to address potential incidents swiftly and effectively.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes.

Provide support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability.

Implement field related ZFO action items and AWMS for continuous improvement in maintenance practices.

.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency.

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Drive the implementation of digital transformation initiatives.

Analyse data trends and system performance to identify opportunities for automation and digitization enhancements.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Environment & Sustainability

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Key Stakeholders - External:

Vendor

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree.

Work Experience (Range of years):

4+ years of experience in industrial automation, specifically with DCS and PLC systems.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the power generation, petrochemical, oil and gas, or heavy industrial sectors.

job.title: Security Officer
job.description:
Asset Protection and Loss Reduction:

Ensure the implementation of effective security measures to protect assets and minimize losses across plant operations.

Foster a culture of safety and security by conducting regular audits and assessments to identify vulnerabilities and address them promptly.

Collaborate with the Head Office team to build security capabilities and enhance operational efficiency.

Safeguard company assets through strict monitoring of unsafe acts and conditions, implementing proactive measures to avert and reduce incidents.

Strengthening Security Setup:

Oversee the establishment and maintenance of robust security protocols and systems at the plant.

Implement and monitor adherence to approved budgets for manpower deployment, ensuring resource optimization.

Ensure no additional security manpower deployment at existing O&M sites after completion of physical security measures.

Develop security parameters and implement them at the site in consultation with Cluster Security Head.

Crisis Management and Safety Initiatives:

Develop and maintain a comprehensive crisis management plan, ensuring readiness for potential security incidents.

Ensure 100% Security compliance at the main gate of all sites, conducting regular training sessions and mock drills to prepare personnel for emergency situations.

Ensure no accidents or incidents occur at the site while adhering to Security requirements.

Financial Performance Management:

Strive for a 5% reduction in security operational expenditure through effective resource management and proactive risk mitigation strategies.

Monitor vendor performance, ensuring timely submission of invoices and payments while adhering to approved budgets.

Ensure retention of key talent among operational management personnel (OMPs) while providing additional responsibilities.

Training and Capability Building:

Ensure all OMPs receive an average of three days of training annually to enhance their security awareness and response capabilities.(Training Calender of OMPs share to VSH Office)

Conduct security awareness sessions & Briefings to improve the effectiveness of newly joined OMPs and monitor their efficiency.

Implement a minimum of one technology initiative at the sites (Budgetory support from Business) to enhance security measures.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting:

Maintain oversight of security operations, ensuring 100% compliance with established Security and operational protocols.

Prepare and present performance reports to senior management, highlighting achievements, challenges, and areas for improvement.

Regularly liaise with police and civil authorities for smooth functioning of Site and ensure compliance with audit points.

I&V Development:

Drive a performance driven culture by implementing effective I&V mechanism for reduction of theft cases.

Strategic Planning and Implementation:

Create a long-term strategy for security, focusing on technology initiatives, analytics, and business processes.

Ensure continuous optimization drives at sites to balance operational efficiency and loss reduction, targeting a 5% optimization of OPEX in FY.

Coordinate with project teams to ensure timely completion of automation projects and the development of basic security infrastructure at sites.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Chief Security Officer (CSO)

Plant Manager

Operations Team

Human Resources Team

IT Security Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

Local Law Enforcement Agencies

Security Service Providers

Regulatory Authorities

Emergency Services (Fire Department, Medical Services)

Community Leaders and Local Government Officials

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Business Administration, or a related field.

Master’s degree or postgraduate qualification in relevant fields is preferred.

Certifications such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Physical Security Professional (PSP), or Certified Fraud Examiners (CFE) are advantageous.

Strong academic foundation in security strategy, risk management, and crisis management.

Work Experience:

12-16 years of experience in security management, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role within industrial or manufacturing organizations.

Proven track record in developing and implementing security protocols, conducting risk assessments, and managing security operations.

Experience in managing budgets, cost optimization, and vendor management in security operations.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Business Development - GRP (Power Sales)
job.description:
Lead - RMDC

Long Term & Medium Term:

Monitor and manage power generation commitments and declarations as per Power Purchase Agreements (PPA) and regulatory requirements.

Coordinate with State Load Dispatch Centers (SLDC), Regional Load Dispatch Centers (RLDC), and Government bodies to receive and update requisitions and schedules.

Ensure all changes received via calls or emails are promptly uploaded to the portal and communicated to the power generation plants.

Communicate and manage any issues in power generation to buyers or power procurers in real-time.

Regularly receive availability updates from power plants and update schedules accordingly.

Monitor and ensure compliance with the Deviation Settlement Mechanism (DSM) to minimize penalties.

Coordinate and communicate effectively with stakeholders to ensure instantaneous reactions to operational changes.

Short Term:

Monitor and manage real-time changes in power generation schedules and declarations.

Ensure compliance with different regulations governing short-term and merchant transactions, including Temporary General Network Access (TGNA) and General Network Access (GNA).

Collaborate with buyers to facilitate revisions in power schedules as per regulatory requirements.

Monitor State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) portals for schedule updates and ensure accurate punching of schedules to avoid billing queries.

Facilitate and document change requests in the portal for transparent and accurate reporting.

Operational Excellence:

Provide real-time coordination and monitoring with power plants and stakeholders to ensure smooth operations.

Create comprehensive reports on all activities conducted during the night shifts to maintain operational transparency and accountability.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Short, medium and Long Term Energy Trading Team

Operations and Maintainence (O&M) Team

Key Stakeholders - External

job.title: Vice President, Physical Security
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

The Vice President of Physical Security owns physical security strategy, standards, and control assurance for Digital Edge’s 1.8GW hyperscale portfolio, setting one security standard, one incident doctrine, and one auditable evidence trail across the region. This is a single-function role, reporting directly to the Chief Data Center Operations Officer as an independent peer to Facility Operations, Engineering Operations, Infrastructure Operations, Operational Excellence & Assurance, Portfolio & Transformation, and Client Operations.

The function is platform-led with country guard-force oversight, organized into three directorates including Physical Security Operations, Security Technology & Systems, and Security Governance & Risk. These form a closed Prevent / Detect & Respond / Prove & Improve control loop, with campus-based Security Managers executing guard-force and monitoring vendor oversight locally under contract. This role retains internal command, escalation authority, and evidence ownership for every security incident, and continues to shape the operating model as the hyperscale footprint matures.

Key responsibilities

  • Own Physical Security strategy, org design, and budget across the regional footprint, including headcount planning and hiring sequencing gated to campus energization and the RFS calendar.
  • Set physical security policy and the minimum control standard, and approve access-control and surveillance standards applied consistently across every market.
  • Own the Physical Security Operations directorate, directing guard-force and outsourced security monitoring vendor governance, incident response, and investigations, while retaining internal incident declaration, dispatch, and escalation authority.
  • Own the Security Technology & Systems directorate, setting the roadmap and standards for access control, CCTV, and systems integration, and holding final technical escalation authority over design and configuration decisions.
  • Own the Security Governance & Risk directorate, maintaining the risk register, coordinating certification and customer security audits, and ensuring evidence and action closure meet hyperscale assurance expectations.
  • Through the Physical Security Operations directorate, hold the network of campus-based Security Managers accountable to central standards for local guard-force and monitoring vendor oversight.
  • Accept security readiness at handover, ensuring physical access controls, surveillance, and security SOPs/EOPs are integrated and operational before customer energization.
  • Lead executive and board-level business reviews, translating security posture, audit performance, and incident trends into strategic narratives for internal leadership and top-tier hyperscale customers.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve control effectiveness, assurance depth, and operational resilience across the full portfolio.
  • Champion organization-wide compliance with policies and procedures for information security, health & safety, environmental management, incident management, and all legal/regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • 12+ years of physical security, critical infrastructure protection, or security operations experience, including 6+ years in a senior leadership role managing managers or directors across multiple countries.
  • Direct experience owning budget, headcount planning, and org design for a security function spanning multiple countries, including a platform-plus-country operating model.
  • Proven experience governing outsourced guard-force and monitoring vendor contracts, including SLA management, escalation runbooks, and vendor performance oversight, while retaining internal incident command authority.
  • Working technical knowledge of physical security systems (access control, CCTV/video management, intrusion detection, systems integration) sufficient to set standards and hold final technical escalation authority.
  • Direct experience with security governance, risk management, and certification/audit cycles (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS), including customer-facing security assurance and audit response.
  • Demonstrated success leading physical security incident response and investigations in a high-consequence, low-tolerance environment, including evidence handling and root cause analysis.
  • Proven track record operating in hyperscale or comparable mission-critical environments, including experience with customer security audits and access control for multi-megawatt campuses.
  • Established executive presence, with a track record of engaging and influencing board-level, regulatory, and hyperscale customer stakeholders across multiple countries.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written) required to support regional stakeholders and customers.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and an operating model that will continue to evolve as the hyperscale footprint scales.
  • Willingness to travel across APAC as needed.

job.title: Senior Director, Portfolio & Transformation
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

The Senior Director of Portfolio & Transformation leads strategic planning, portfolio governance, and stage-gate assurance for Digital Edge’s data center capital improvement programs (CAPEX/OPEX) and enterprise-wide operations transformation initiatives across an 1.8GW hyperscale portfolio. Reporting directly to the Chief Data Center Operations Officer, the role bridges data center strategy with technical operational execution — governing a high-value pipeline of site expansion, facility modernization, power/cooling infrastructure upgrades, automation, and operational efficiency initiatives so that capital investment decisions deliver maximum reliability, energy efficiency, capacity scaling, and operational excellence across the regional footprint.

This is a single-function, governance and decision-support role, an independent peer to Facility Operations, Engineering Operations, Infrastructure Operations, Physical Security, Operational Excellence & Governance, and Client Operations — each of which retains delivery accountability for its own outcomes. The role owns the capital plan and the stage-gate: setting capital allocation frameworks and portfolio priorities, advising the CDCOO on program status, risk, and budget variance, and holding transformation and readiness initiatives to account for benefits realized, while technical delivery of infrastructure upgrades, modernization programs, and readiness itself remains with Engineering Operations, Facility Operations, and the accountable delivery pillars. Scope will continue to evolve as the portfolio scales, and the successful candidate should be comfortable shaping the operating model as well as running it.

Key responsibilities

Data Center Capital Improvement & Portfolio Leadership

  • Own portfolio intake, prioritization, and investment-case governance for capital improvement programs — infrastructure upgrades (HVAC, UPS, backup power, liquid cooling), facility retrofits, and capacity expansion — converting cross-pillar demand into one governed portfolio view.
  • Partner with the CDCOO and Finance to establish capital allocation frameworks and evaluate program ROI, total cost of ownership (TCO), and PUE impact.
  • Govern the CAPEX/OPEX project portfolio through the stage-gate model, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule and within budget without disruption to mission-critical availability SLAs, while technical delivery remains with Engineering Operations and Facility Operations.

Operations Transformation & Modernization

  • Mobilize strategic transformation programs that modernize data center operations, including DCIM, predictive maintenance, and energy sustainability initiatives, and hold benefits realization to account against the strategic roadmap.
  • Own organizational change management for portfolio-driven change, standardizing operational processes and embedding new infrastructure technologies into daily operations across legacy and next-generation builds.

Executive Governance & CDCOO Strategy Alignment

  • Serve as a key advisor to the CDCOO, providing data-driven updates on capital program status, risk profiles, capacity roadmaps, and budget variances.
  • Establish and facilitate the Data Center Capital & Transformation Steering Committee, aligning engineering, operations, procurement, and sustainability stakeholders.
  • Own operational readiness gate governance and handover assurance, and manage supply chain and vendor performance risk across capital programs, while readiness delivery itself remains with Engineering Operations and the accountable pillars.
  • Maintain clear interaction boundaries with peer pillars, ensuring each capability sits once with the pillar accountable for delivering it, not duplicated within the portfolio function.

Operational Metrics & Value Realization

  • Define and track portfolio and transformation metrics for uptime/availability impact, energy efficiency gains, site build cycle times, and cost-per-megawatt thereby creating one trusted control view (schedule, cost, risk, earned value) that surfaces deviations early.
  • Drive continuous improvement across the portfolio, ensuring learnings from capital deployment and site operations are integrated into future program designs.

The successful candidate:

  • 12+ years in data center operations, critical infrastructure engineering, or capital program/technical transformation leadership, including 5+ years managing managers or functional leads across multiple countries.
  • Direct experience owning a stage-gate or portfolio governance model for large-scale capital improvement portfolios ($50M+) in hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center environments.
  • Working knowledge of critical data center infrastructure — power distribution, mechanical/cooling systems, DCIM, and live-environment upgrades — sufficient to set standards without owning technical delivery.
  • Strategic financial acumen in CAPEX forecasting, TCO modeling, and vendor negotiation, with project controls experience (schedule, cost, risk, earned value).
  • Experience with change management methodology, including stakeholder engagement and change-impact assessment for cross-functional transformation programs.
  • PMP, PfMP, CDCP/CDCS, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, or equivalent portfolio/infrastructure certifications desirable.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written) and willingness to travel across APAC as needed.

job.title: Senior Vice President, Facility Operations
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

  • The Senior Vice President of Facility Operations leads Digital Edge’s largest pillar and the only function staffed to a continuous-presence (24/7) standard, running critical facility operations across a 1.8GW hyperscale portfolio. The role owns uptime, safety, and operational readiness for the region.
  • This is a single-function role, with no authority over, and no reporting line from, any other pillar. Engineering Operations, Infrastructure Operations, Physical Security, Operational Excellence & Governance, Portfolio & Transformation, and Client Operations are independent peers that report directly to the Chief Data Center Operations Officer.
  • Facility Operations is organized as eight in-country leadership roles covering China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Thailand that are tiered by operational capacity (Vice President, Senior Director, or Director). It is the only pillar with a dedicated country leadership tier, which together with its continuous-presence mandate is why the role sits at SVP level, reporting directly to the CDCOO. Scope and tier-ing will continue to evolve as markets scale; the successful candidate should be comfortable shaping the operating model as well as running it.

Key responsibilities

  • Own Facility Operations strategy, org design, and budget across the eight-market footprint, including headcount planning and hiring sequencing gated to campus energization and the RFS calendar.
  • Build and lead the tiered in-country leadership team across all eight markets.
  • Own the country tiering model, re-grading leadership levels as markets scale and keeping re-leveling decisions consistent across the portfolio.
  • Own the handover from construction/commissioning into steady-state operations, ensuring SOPs/MOPs/EOPs, qualification standards, and safety protocols are in place before energization.
  • Own uptime and shift-coverage performance across every campus, setting the standards country leaders execute against.
  • Act as the most senior escalation point and incident commander for critical facility incidents, partnering with Engineering Operations on root cause analysis.
  • Own vendor governance and critical maintenance strategy, applying one maintenance philosophy across all markets.
  • Own certification and compliance outcomes (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 45001, PCI DSS, EHS), partnering with Operational Excellence & Governance on audit readiness.
  • Lead executive and board-level business reviews, translating portfolio performance into strategic narratives for leadership and top-tier hyperscale customers.
  • Partner with Engineering Operations on PUE and energy performance targets.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and resilience across the portfolio.
  • Champion compliance with health & safety, information security, environmental, and incident management policies.

The successful candidate:

  • 15+ years of critical facility or mission-critical infrastructure experience, including 8+ years leading VP-, Senior Director-, or Director-level leaders across multiple countries.
  • Direct experience owning budget, headcount, and org design for a large, continuously growing, continuous-presence operation spanning multiple countries and leadership tiers.
  • Deep working knowledge of critical facility systems (electrical, UPS, generators, cooling, fire protection, BMS/DCIM) sufficient to set standards and hold final technical escalation authority.
  • Proven track record scaling hyperscale customer environments, including SLA/uptime commitments and multi-megawatt campus operations.
  • Experience building and leading a platform-plus-country model with tiered country leadership, holding leaders accountable to central standards.
  • Experience with certification/audit cycles (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001, PCI DSS) and incident/emergency response frameworks.
  • Established executive presence with board-level, regulatory, and hyperscale customer stakeholders.
  • Exceptional crisis management and communication skills as incident commander.
  • Data center or facilities-related certification (e.g. CDCP, CDCS) preferred.
  • Fluency in English required.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and an operating model that will continue to evolve.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across APAC.

job.title: Vice President, Operations Excellence
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

The Vice President, Operations Excellence leads Digital Edge’s independent control function for the Asia Pacific portfolio, setting how the operating pillars work and independently proving that they comply, perform and hold up under stress. Reporting to the Chief Data Center Operations Officer, the role is accountable for governance, assurance, certification and performance standards across a 1.8 GW hyperscale portfolio. Independence is the governing design principle: the function that audits compliance must not report into, or be diluted by, the operations it audits.

The role leads five accountabilities that together form a closed governance loop: ITIL Service Management, Documentation Management, Certification & Resilience, Operational Performance and Workforce Capability. The function is deliberately platform-heavy with light country execution, with in-country Operations Excellence Managers executing consistently against the global standard. The Vice President integrates these teams into one function with clear decision rights, escalation paths and performance expectations.

The Vice President works alongside Data Center Operations, Engineering Operations, Infrastructure Operations, Security Operations, Portfolio & Transformation, Client Operations and Operations Procurement, which remain independent peer functions reporting directly to the Chief Data Center Operations Officer. This is a single-function, platform-based role with no authority over, and no reporting line from, any other pillar. Scope will continue to evolve as the portfolio scales, and the successful candidate should be equally comfortable shaping the operating model and leading its execution.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the Operations Excellence strategy, organization design and budget across the platform, including headcount planning and hiring sequencing aligned to the RFS calendar.
  • Own ITIL Service Management, governing change, incident and problem management discipline platform-wide and holding in-country Operations Excellence Managers to one global process standard.
  • Own Documentation Management, controlling the policy, standards, procedure and knowledge-management library that every operating pillar draws from.
  • Own Certification & Resilience, directing ISO and SOC 2 certification, customer and regulatory audit response, corrective action closure, and business continuity and crisis management.
  • Own Operational Performance, setting governed KPI definitions, executive dashboards and vendor-performance standards, and translating data into management-review narratives and corrective actions for the Chief Data Center Operations Officer.
  • Own Workforce Capability, setting the competency framework, qualification standards and training model that determine who is authorized to operate critical infrastructure across the portfolio.
  • Retain independent evidence ownership and audit authority across every operating pillar, holding the assurance and execution boundary and representing Operations Excellence in cross-functional and executive forums with clear interaction boundaries with peer functions.
  • Lead executive, board and strategic customer reviews, translating compliance posture, audit performance, resilience testing and KPI trends into clear leadership narratives for senior leadership and top-tier hyperscale customers.
  • Champion organization-wide compliance with policies and procedures for information security, health and safety, environmental management, incident management and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • 12+ years of operations excellence, service management, compliance or quality assurance experience within data center or comparable mission-critical environments, including 6+ years leading managers across multiple countries in a platform-plus-country model.
  • Proven expertise in ITIL service management disciplines, including change, incident and problem management and the design and governance of a global change advisory process.
  • Direct experience with certification and audit cycles, including ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 45001 and SOC 2, together with hyperscale customer audits and corrective action program ownership.
  • Demonstrated experience building or leading business continuity and crisis management programs, including business impact analysis and resilience testing at scale.
  • Track record designing and governing enterprise KPI frameworks, executive dashboards and vendor-performance management programs.
  • Experience setting competency frameworks, qualification standards and learning management systems for technical or critical-infrastructure workforces.
  • Established executive presence with board-level, regulatory and hyperscale customer stakeholders on compliance and assurance matters.
  • Must have fluency in English (spoken and written).
  • Comfortable operating in an evolving operating model and willing to travel extensively across Asia Pacific

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience with open source languages such as PHP, Python, Java, or JavaScript Frameworks

job.description:
To support the fast-growing user community and the introduction of new and innovative products and services, we are continually expanding our backbone network infrastructure around the globe. We are looking for a Network Development Manager to join our APAC network infrastructure group to support our growing network footprint needs. You will lead network investments through capacity and dark fiber leases and acquisitions, network infrastructure development, and construction. You will — often working with partners and vendors — develop and implement emonstrated ongoing AI skill developmentstrategies to provide Meta with competitive economics, flexibility and scalability, reliable delivery and high availability as well as optimized operation and maintenance arrangements.

If you are passionate about network infrastructure and building and expanding global network infrastructure, please send your resume for consideration for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Develop supply strategies for capacity connecting and expanding our CDN network
  • Manage a portfolio of infrastructure suppliers globally, but with a focus on the APAC regions
  • Identify suppliers, negotiate commercial terms, and work with the engineering and legal departments to negotiate and execute supplier contracts
  • Project Management: Drive end-to-end execution of complex infrastructure projects across internal and external cross-functional stakeholders

  • Oversee the performance and management of contracts through the full lifecycle, tracking and ensuring supplier compliance with the terms and conditions of the contract, processing of supplier invoices, creation of contract variances and renegotiation as needed

Minimum Qualifications

job.title: Data Engineer, Analytics (Singapore)
job.description:
As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building large-scale data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.

In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.

You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.

Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.

Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.

Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.

Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize and own the data architecture for multiple large-scale projects, while evaluating design and operational cost-benefit tradeoffs within systems
  • Create and contribute to frameworks that improve the efficacy of logging data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights in a meaningful way
  • Define and manage Service Level Agreements for all data sets in allocated areas of ownership
  • Determine and implement the security model based on privacy requirements, confirm safeguards are followed, address data quality issues, and evolve governance processes within allocated areas of ownership
  • Design, build, and launch collections of sophisticated data models and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different products or domains
  • Solve our most challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources
  • Assist in owning existing processes running in production, optimizing complex code through advanced algorithmic concepts
  • Optimize pipelines, dashboards, frameworks, and systems to facilitate easier development of data artifacts
  • Influence product and cross-functional teams to identify data opportunities to drive impact
  • Mentor team members by giving/receiving actionable feedback

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent
  • 4+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positions
  • 4+ years of experience (or 2+ years with a Ph.D) with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in a STEM field
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

job.title: Services Project Engineer
