job.title: Delivery Consultant - AI/ML, ASEAN Professional Services
job.description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (AWS ProServe) ASEAN organization is looking for a senior, experienced, and highly motivated business-oriented AI/ML practitioner who possesses a unique balance of executive advisory capability, business acumen, and deep technical expertise across Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning, with proven experience leading large-scale cloud-based transformations and implementations.

AWS ProServe engages in a wide variety of strategic projects for customers and partners, bringing together AWS customer experience, best practices, and technical expertise to help organizations accelerate innovation and business outcomes. Our team collaborates across the broader AWS organization to provide customers access to product, engineering, service, and training teams, delivering scalable solutions and driving feature innovation across industries.

This role will focus on advising enterprise customers on how to transform business and operational outcomes through the adoption of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning on AWS. As a Consultant, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders, shape AI and cloud transformation strategies, lead complex engagements, guide architecture best practices, and oversee the successful delivery of large-scale AI/ML and GenAI implementations with customers and partners. You will also help drive thought leadership, mentor delivery teams, and influence the evolution of AWS AI/ML professional services capabilities across the region.

Key job responsibilities

  • Advise customer technologists and business leaders on the art of the possible with Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning, helping them design scalable AI solutions on AWS that deliver measurable business value
  • Discuss complex industry-specific business and technology concepts with senior customer stakeholders, particularly across FSI, Telecommunications, and Retail industries
  • Lead executive and technical workshops with customers to identify transformation opportunities and define how Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning can accelerate business outcomes
  • Drive large and complex customer engagements across pre-sales and delivery, from ideation and strategy through architecture design, scoping, execution, and successful delivery outcomes
  • Provide technical leadership and delivery oversight across customer engagements to ensure alignment on scope, architecture, deliverables, timelines, risks, and expected business outcomes
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders, guiding AI and cloud transformation initiatives while balancing business priorities, governance, scalability, and operational readiness
  • Mentor consultants and delivery teams by promoting AWS best practices, reusable patterns, and high standards of technical and delivery excellence across engagements

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 & s3)
  • Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
  • Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
  • 5+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience and the ability to think strategically about business, solutions and technical challenges.
  • A minimum of 3 years working experience in ASEAN region, and ability to travel to customer locations in ASEAN as needed for pre-sales and delivery activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of IT implementation experience
  • Experience and technical expertise (design and implementation) in cloud computing technologies
  • Experience leading the design, development and deployment of business software at scale or recent hands-on technology infrastructure, network, compute, storage, and virtualization experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Factory Field Response Technician
job.description:
Job Description

Factory Field Response Technician

Job Posting Location:

Remote, USA

Posting Start Date:

10/20/26

Req Id:

10957

Required Travel:

0 - 70%

Remote, Onsite or Hybrid?:

Remote

For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 11,000 employees worldwide, our Climate Solutions and Performance Technologies segments advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit [modine.com](https://www.modine.com/).

Position Description

The Factory Field Response Team (FFRT) Technician is responsible for supporting post-production, initial site repair, corrective repair, and field response efforts for Airedale’s Data Center vertical, with a primary focus on the Chiller product line.

The ability to respond to equipment issues and execute high-quality repairs throughout the lifecycle of Airedale chiller products is a critical component of our commitment to customer service, product reliability, and operational excellence. The FFRT Technician serves on the front lines of this effort, providing hands-on technical expertise at customer sites and working closely with Service, Technical Support, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other internal teams to resolve equipment issues efficiently and effectively.

This is a traveling field position requiring travel to customer and project locations throughout the United States, with the potential for extended assignments based on business and customer needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform post-production and initial site repairs on Airedale Data Center chillers.
  • Respond to field equipment issues requiring factory-level technical repair support.
  • Perform component replacement, rework, corrective actions, and field upgrades as directed.
  • Support warranty, quality, and product-related repair campaigns when required.
  • Work closely with Technical Support and Engineering to diagnose complex or recurring equipment issues.
  • Execute approved engineering changes and corrective actions in the field.
  • Verify repairs and confirm proper equipment operation following completion of work.
  • Document all repairs, findings, failed components, corrective actions, and equipment conditions accurately and completely.
  • Capture equipment serial numbers, photographs, measurements, operating conditions, and other information required for technical and quality analysis.
  • Provide timely feedback regarding field failures and product concerns to Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Service leadership.
  • Assist with root cause investigations by providing detailed field observations and supporting data.
  • Maintain required tools, test equipment, PPE, and company-issued equipment.
  • Follow all company, customer, and site-specific safety policies and procedures.
  • Maintain professional communication with customers, contractors, site personnel, and internal Airedale teams.
  • Support emergency or time-sensitive field response activities when required.
  • Perform other duties associated with field service, warranty, quality, and product support as assigned.

Required Education & Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; technical or trade school education preferred.
  • Previous experience in commercial or industrial HVAC/R service, commissioning, troubleshooting, or equipment repair preferred.
  • Experience with chillers, refrigeration systems, Data Center cooling equipment, or other mission-critical HVAC systems strongly preferred.
  • Strong mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, piping diagrams, technical manuals, and equipment documentation.
  • Working knowledge of refrigeration circuits, compressors, pumps, fans, valves, sensors, electrical components, and controls.
  • Ability to use diagnostic and test equipment safely and effectively.
  • EPA Universal Certification preferred or required based on assigned responsibilities.
  • Ability to work independently in the field while communicating effectively with remote technical resources.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced, customer-focused field environment.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry tools, equipment, and components associated with commercial HVAC service work.
  • Ability to climb ladders, bend, kneel, crouch, stand, and work for extended periods.
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying environmental conditions.
  • Ability to safely work around operating mechanical and electrical equipment.
  • Ability to perform work in active construction, industrial, and Data Center environments.

Why Choose Modine?

Health & Well-being:

  • Day One
  • Competitive health, dental & vision insurance coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program

After 90 days of continuous employment

  • Maternity Leave (12 weeks at 100% pay)
  • 8 weeks of short term disability leave paid at 100%
  • 4 weeks of paid parental leave paid at 100%

Paternity Leave (4 weeks at 100% pay)

Financial Benefits:

  • 401k Retirement plan and company paid match
  • Life Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Short Term Disability (company paid)
  • Long Term Disability

Work-Life Balance:

  • Competitive time-off policies
  • Tuition Reimbursement

To view full benefits information: [MyModine Benefits](https://mymodinebenefits.com/)

Modine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Modine provides a competitive benefit package, which could include paid vacation, short term disability, 401(k), health, dental, vision, life insurance, flex spending benefits, tuition reimbursement, Health Savings Account and much more. job.title: M&A Analyst, Motion Services (Europe or India)

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of Strategy, Business Development and Sustainability

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. [go.abb/motion](https://new.abb.com/about/our-businesses/motion)

Location

This role is open globally, but location is set in Europe - with a preference for Finland (Helsinki), Italy (Sesto San Giovanni), Netherlands (Rotterdam), Poland (Lodz), Spain (Madrid), Sweden (Vaesteras), UK (Warrington) - and India (Bangalore). The work model is hybrid #LI-hybrid.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will support business growth by analyzing markets, evaluating strategic opportunities, and contributing to M&A and investment activities. You will work closely with stakeholders to develop business cases, assess potential targets, and help translate strategy into actionable growth initiatives.

This role reports to Head of Strategy, Motion Services.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to strategy definition and execution through the analysis and identification of new markets, segments, or solutions.
  • Support in translating global strategies into local strategic actions and in identifying local input to global strategies coordinating both internal and external resources in the various competence areas (e.g. business plan development, strategic and financial analysis).

Qualifications

  • Additional technical education or experience with service, drives, motors, electrical equipment, automation or power conversion equipment is beneficial but not mandatory.
  • 3-5 years of experience in M&A, strategy development, investment banking or financial due diligence consultancy.
  • Strong analytical abilities and excellent understanding of financial statements analysis.

  • Good understanding of relevant markets, customers, technology, and competition.
  • Clear communication skills in internal and external discussions and executive presentations including Powerpoint and Excel modelling.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong work ethic, organizational skills and ability to multitask is crucial.

What's in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger. Guide the future. This is where innovation accelerates, industries are reimagined, and your impact powers the world ahead. Run What Runs the World.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. Manage assigned project(s) within HVAC portfolio. Serve as project manager who plan, execute and complete the medium complexity of project. Coordinate communication with sales, customer and contractors. Ensuring profitable execution, project integrity and customer satisfactions.

job.title: Agentic Data Cloud Architect, APAC, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

The Google Cloud APAC Agentic Data Cloud Architect team is a specialized team that guides customers in choosing, designing and accelerating adoption of Google Cloud’s unified Data Cloud and Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities. The team bridges the gap between our powerful platform primitives across data analytics, databases and storage, and the cohesive, high-value solutions enterprises demand. This group operates as a customer-zero laboratory. The team embeds deeply with a select group of lighthouse customers to co-develop breakthrough solutions in real-world environments. The team’s primary mandate is to translate these engagements into scalable assets, delivering validated product prototypes to engineering and repeatable go-to-market blueprints to the field.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical partner to customer Chief Technology Officers (CTOs) and chief architects, leading high-stakes workshops to align their technology roadmap with Google’s Data and AI strategy.
  • Act as principal architect for Google’s Agentic Data Cloud, setting engineering standards, winning complex workloads, and accelerating adoption across lighthouse engagements from evaluation through ramp.
  • Capture repeatable patterns to build scalable Golden Path blueprints, reference architectures, and field-ready assets that drive broad adoption across thousands of customers.
  • Synthesize customer friction points and cross-product gaps into authoritative engineering requirements to shape and protect Google's unified Data and AI narrative.
  • Mentor and guide subregional Datacloud Customer Engineers, remaining experience for critical architectures while directing the team to deliver secure, scalable solutions.

job.title: Software Engineer, Safe Coding Team
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google’s Product Security team is team of over 300 engineers in Zurich, Munich, Sunnyvale, Seattle, San Francisco and some other exciting places around the globe. Our mission is to keep Google products secure and their users safe.

Safe Coding contributes to that mission by managing some of the biggest risks in software security. We innovate at scale by making secure coding effortless, for everyone. We are bootstrapping our presence in Asia-Pacific (APAC) by establishing a brand-new Singapore hub.

In this role, you will play a massive part in establishing our engineering culture and bringing innovation to our new location.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with technical leads, product managers, and technical program managers to execute on the team's goal and bring our Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy to life.
  • Stay on the rapidly developing agentic threat landscape and boldly embrace the dynamically changing AI environment. Move fast, write exceptional code, and think outside the box to engineer new solutions to old problems.
  • Collaborate with partner teams in Google's Software Supply Chain Integrity program and engineering stakeholders to seamlessly integrate our security solutions.

At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Sr. Applications Engineer to join the Power & Thermal Management division in Tuas, Singapore (Remote). The Sr. Applications Engineer provides high-level engineering expertise, project management, and commercial support for the application of Starline high amperage busduct products across customer projects. This role leads technical strategy, mentors junior engineers, and ensures customer satisfaction throughout the sales cycle. The engineer is responsible for drafting product offers, resolving technical issues, and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of Starline products and their applications.
  • Design system layouts for busduct systems using site surveys, customer drawings, project tenders, and field input.
  • Utilize AutoCAD (mechanical and electrical) for layout and design tasks.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including catalog sheets, FAQs, technical briefs, reports, and installation instructions.
  • Provide technical and commercial support to sales teams and customers—onsite or remotely—on topics such as product estimation, RFQ support, ratings, regulatory compliance, safety, customization, troubleshooting, installation, and pricing.
  • Lead technical strategy to ensure alignment with customer needs and business objectives.
  • Drive continuous improvement in engineering processes, tools, and documentation standards.
  • Participate in customer meetings and deliver presentations on product solutions and project updates.
  • Draft technical offers for busduct products, verifying application requirements based on customer needs and installation layouts.
  • Confirm technical specifications including operating temperature, power, installation parameters, materials, and quantities.
  • Support project management throughout the entire sales cycle.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team development and knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct onsite measurements, troubleshooting, and rework as needed.
  • Serve as a technical liaison to the sales team.
  • Deliver training on busduct products to the sales network, customers, and installation contractors.
  • Support the Service Group by assisting with project management during installations.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or mechanical engineering (Electrical preferred), or 3+ years of relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical or mechanical engineering.
  • Experience with busbar/busduct systems required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and technical writing.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%, primarily within Europe with potential for international travel.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong aptitude for electrical product design and application in power distribution and busduct systems.
  • Familiarity with UL standards and certifications.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Customer-focused, dependable, and solutions-oriented.
  • Self-reliant, adaptable, and resourceful in dynamic environments.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Occasional exposure to manufacturing and construction environments; use of personal protective equipment (e.g., safety glasses, hearing protection) may be required.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 23kg occasionally.

job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

This on-premises AI Engineer role merges generative AI and mobile network operations to drive zero-touch automation, predictive maintenance and Autonomous operations objectives.

Core Responsibilities

  • GenAI & RAG: Deploy, fine-tune (LoRA/QLoRA), LangGraph, Agentic and optimize foundational models and Telecom Language Models (TLMs). Build robust RAG pipelines and autonomous workflows using telecom telemetry (PM, CM, FM, XDRs) and 3GPP documentation.
  • Predictive Analytics: Engineer time-series and deep learning models for traffic forecasting, dynamic anomaly detection, and automated root cause analysis (RCA) for network degradations.
  • MLOps & Deployment: Package models as containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes). Manage high-throughput serving runtimes (vLLM, Triton), GPU scheduling, and experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B).
  • Platform Integration & Guardrails: Interface AI workflows with enterprise OSS/BSS platforms (IBM watsonX, ServiceNow). Implement strict hallucination mitigation, output guardrails, and model drift detection.
  • Cross-Domain Collaboration: Partner with Data Engineers for telemetry ingestion and collaborate with RAN/Core/Transport specialists to validate model outputs against real-world RF behaviour.
  • CyberSecurity: Applying basic cybersecurity principles, ensuring data privacy, secure API endpoints and prompt security.

Qualifications

  • Preferably with Network Expertise: 2+ years of hands-on experience with mobile networks (4G/LTE, 5G Core architectures, RAN, IMS, Transport, Network Management etc) and Telecom Protocols (Diameter, GTP, SIP, HTTP2, SCTP, PFCP).
  • AI/ML Experience: 1–3 years in applied ML/NLP/Data Science engineering (can include production-level internships or heavy applied research).
  • Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related quantitative field.

Detail

Information

Languages & Data

Python, SQL, pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, scipy

AI/ML & NLP

PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face, PEFT/LoRA, RAG evaluation

Vector & Big Data

Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector, PySpark, Snowflake

DevOps & Serving

Git, Docker, Kubernetes, FastAPI, vLLM, MLflow, W&B

Telecom Knowledge

RAN/EPC/5GC architecture, critical KPIs (RSRP, SINR, CQI, latency), Telecom protocols

Preferred Assets

  • Experience with open-source/proprietary Telecom Language Models and datasets (3GPP, ITU).
  • Familiarity with model quantization (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF) for edge inference.
  • Exposure to real-time streaming (Kafka, Flink) and data lakehouses (Iceberg).
  • Understanding of telecom AI standardization (O-RAN, NWDAF).
  • Active public portfolio (GitHub, Hugging Face, technical blogs).

The ideal candidate is a hybrid specialist who can comfortably debate 5G protocol stacks in one breath and optimize a vector database retrieval pipeline in the next.

job.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As the Accounts Payable Specialist, you will report to the Accounts Payable Team Lead (who is based in our HQ in Australia) and work closely with the rest of the AP & Finance team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Be accountable for end-to-end AP functions for our Australian businesses.
  • Ensuring the accounts payable function runs efficiently by providing first line support to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Supporting the Australian AP & Finance team including month-end/year-end closing and other ad-hoc assignments as required.
  • Be instrumental in helping AirTrunk define leading practice.
  • As a growth position within a dynamic and entrepreneurial business, the general nature and level of work within this role is designed to progress as opportunities arise.

What You'll Do

  • End-to-end Accounts Payable functions for our Australian businesses.
  • Working alongside other Accounts Payable team members to process the group's invoices.
  • Supporting the company CAPEX processes.
  • Managing the weekly payment run processes for accounts payable and employee expenses, ensuring payments are cleared promptly.
  • Responsible for handling vendor maintenance and payment enquiries.
  • Assist in compliance with all indirect tax obligations (GST, FBT, Payroll Tax).
  • Assist in the improvement of finance processes and controls, including the development and implementation of policies and procedures.
  • Other ad hoc projects and duties as required.

What You'll Bring

  • A minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience.
  • Ability to problem solve and multi-task.
  • Strong attention to detail, highly organised, exceptional attitude.
  • Desire and ability to work in a fast-paced AP role within a dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal and strong attention to detail.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with NetSuite is a plus.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Month-End Close & Financial Governance

  • Coordinate Enterprise Mobile inputs into month-end and quarter-end closing processes, ensuring accuracy, completeness and consistency between actuals, forecasts and management reporting.

Performance Management & Sales Governance

  • Perform variance analysis, trend reviews and risk assessments against business targets and forecasts.
  • Identify performance gaps, risks and opportunities and recommend appropriate actions.

  • Partner with Business and Finance teams on sales target setting and validation.

Executive Reporting & Business Insights

  • Prepare executive-ready presentations and management reports for Trading Meetings, Business Performance Reviews (BPRs) and MC updates.
  • Translate complex financial and operational data into clear business insights and recommendations for senior management.
  • Deliver quarterly competitor and business performance insights.
  • Coordinate data extraction and analysis for business cases and ad-hoc management requests.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Finance, Statistics, Data Science or Business Analytics, with demonstrated quantitative or analytical training
  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in business planning, financial analysis, forecasting or performance management.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise business models, operational drivers and financial performance.
  • Experience linking operational activities to financial outcomes through forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis and management reporting.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and visualisation tools such as Excel, Power BI, Salesforce or Studio Analytics.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and provide actionable business recommendations.
  • Interest in exploring emerging analytical and AI-enabled tools to improve business monitoring, forecasting and insights.
  • Strong communication and writing skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to stakeholders from different backgrounds.
  • Strong stakeholder management, influencing and project management capabilities.
  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple business functions.
  • Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

  • IT exposure.

  • Organisational and process development skills.
  • Negotiation skills.

  • Translate new partner technologies into commercially viable Singtel products and managed services.
  • Drive co-innovation and joint solution development with strategic partners.

  • Manage joint business planning, roadmap alignment, commercial optimisation, sales enablement, pipeline development and joint GTM initiatives.

6. Ensuring Alignment Across Teams

  • Act as the central product owner across Singtel’s commercial, technical and operational teams.
  • Work closely with Sales, Product Specialists, Engineering, Operations, Service Delivery, Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Legal and strategic partners.
  • Establish clear product objectives, priorities, responsibilities, timelines and success measures.
  • Coordinate stakeholders throughout the complete product lifecycle.
  • Bring together capabilities across Cybersecurity, networking, mobility, cloud and managed services to develop integrated solutions.
  • Identify and resolve technical, commercial, operational and organisational dependencies.

  • Identify areas where Singtel can differentiate by combining Cybersecurity with connectivity, mobility, cloud and managed services.

  • Build trusted relationships with executives, programme sponsors, transformation leaders and governance stakeholders, providing objective challenge and commercially-focused assurance insights.
  • Deliver high-quality audit outcomes through effective planning, resource management, data analytics, continuous monitoring and evidence-based reporting to the Audit Committee and senior leadership.
  • Lead, coach and develop audit professionals while driving continuous improvement across Internal Audit methodologies, practices and transformation assurance capabilities.

What You Bring

  • Significant experience in Internal Audit, Risk, Assurance, Consulting or a related discipline, with proven expertise assessing large-scale transformation, technology, operating model and business change initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of programme governance, portfolio management, risk management, internal controls, organisational change management and benefits realisation frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess complex issues, synthesise large volumes of information and provide clear, actionable recommendations to senior executives and governance forums.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and influencing skills, with experience challenging constructively and building credibility across executive and operational leadership teams.
  • Experience gained within a Big 4 consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY or KPMG) in Transformation Assurance, Risk Advisory, Internal Audit, Program Assurance or Management Consulting will be highly regarded.

The good stuff

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and outstanding shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.

job.title: AI Data Center Development Manager
job.description:
Meta designs, builds, leases and operates innovative and efficient data centers. Locating, developing and managing this data center infrastructure the "right" way is synonymous with ensuring capacity availability, speed to market, risk management, flexibility, and capital and operational cost efficiency. Meta is seeking an experienced, organized and driven development (program) manager to join the Data Center Site Development team and help build our rapidly scaling data center portfolio.

A successful Development Manager candidate demonstrates the ability to think both analytically and strategically, to dive into the details and also assess projects from a global view, and to develop creative solutions and navigate the challenges that accompany projects of large magnitude and scale. The Development Manager is also an experienced project manager who communicates effectively, forms partnerships, and influences and drives desired outcomes with internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Site Evaluation & Selection
  • Evaluate opportunities for new data center sites, campus expansions, and strategic land acquisitions by conducting market assessments, including analysis of power availability, fiber connectivity, labor markets, land costs, tax environments, and natural hazard exposure
  • Lead the diligence and development process to vet prospective sites and assess site risks and opportunities by analyzing regional and site-specific information pertaining to:
  • Permitting and land-use data
  • Federal, state, and local tax structures, incentive programs, abatement opportunities, enterprise zone designations, and economic development agreements
  • Energy availability, cost, and reliability — including renewable energy procurement pathways, grid capacity, interconnection timelines, and utility rate structures — as well as water supply, capacity, and long-term sustainability
  • Natural hazard, floodplain, seismic, and climatological data
  • Legal, physical risk, and financial implications, including title encumbrances, easement constraints, environmental liabilities, and geotechnical conditions
  • Develop and maintain site evaluation scorecards and comparative frameworks that enable data-driven decision-making across multiple candidate locations
  • Conduct preliminary desktop and in-person site visits to validate data findings and assess physical site conditions, access, and surrounding land use compatibility
  • Regulatory & Permitting
  • Facilitate compliance efforts related to real estate, land use, and utility regulatory matters
  • Facilitate application and management of environmental permitting processes, including preparation of environmental impact assessments, stormwater management plans, wetland delineation reviews, air quality permits, noise studies, and endangered species consultations
  • Facilitate interpretation of regulations and assess their impact on Meta's data center footprint, operations, and future expansion plans
  • Monitor legislative and policy developments related to energy, water, land use, and data center operations, proactively identifying risks and opportunities for Meta's portfolio
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with all conditions of approval, permit requirements, and development agreements throughout the construction and operational lifecycle of each site
  • Utility & Infrastructure Negotiations
  • Facilitate negotiations with electric utility companies to secure reliable, cost-effective power supply agreements, including terms related to capacity, redundancy, rate structures, renewable energy commitments, interconnection timelines, and infrastructure cost-sharing
  • Facilitate negotiations with water and wastewater utility providers to establish supply agreements, secure adequate capacity for cooling and operational needs, and ensure compliance with discharge and conservation requirements
  • Maintain strong working relationships with utility planning and engineering teams to stay ahead of infrastructure constraints and future capacity limitations
  • Advocate for infrastructure improvements or upgrades necessary to support data center development, including transmission line extensions, substation upgrades, and water main improvements
  • Stakeholder coordination & communication:
  • Take the lead role in organizing cross-functional communications and tracking progress toward on-time delivery of projects by key internal and external stakeholders in support of site selection and development efforts
  • Work closely with the Site Selection Manager and other key project team members to ensure alignment among all internal stakeholders and to identify creative, efficient ways to overcome obstacles in the site development process
  • Coordinate cross-functional responses to external parties such as government authorities, utility companies, regulatory bodies, industry associations, economic development organizations, and community groups
  • Serve as the primary liaison between internal teams and external consultants (land-use attorneys, environmental engineers, civil engineers, lobbyists, and real estate brokers) to ensure deliverables are completed on time and to specification
  • Facilitate regular project status meetings, maintain action item trackers, and produce executive-level progress reports for leadership review
  • Strategy & Portfolio Management
  • Support the development of Meta's near-term and long-term data center location strategy and leased portfolio plan
  • Support the preparation of project recommendations, business cases, and investment proposals for presentation to senior management for approval
  • Support a portfolio of existing sites under construction or in operation to facilitate on-time and quality delivery
  • Track and monitor ongoing site development activities, including agreement management, milestone tracking, financial obligation compliance, and renewal/amendment negotiations
  • Maintain a comprehensive database of site-specific entitlements, permits, agreements, and regulatory commitments for all sites within the assigned portfolio
  • Process Improvement & Tools
  • Develop scalable, efficient tools and processes to improve delivery, communication, and knowledge management for data center site development activity
  • Create and maintain standardized templates, checklists, and workflows for site evaluation, permitting, and stakeholder engagement
  • Identify opportunities to leverage technology to enhance team productivity and decision-making
  • Document lessons learned from completed projects and incorporate best practices into future development activities
  • This role requires 25-50% travel

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Engineering, Computer Science, Operations or Business
  • 5+ years of experience in critical facility site development, commercial real estate development, infrastructure development, data center site selection, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in managing multiple projects and coordinating with internal staff, external consultants, vendors, and other stakeholders across multiple time zones
  • Experience with a range of project management tools and software, (e.g., Google Suite, Excel, PowerPoint, project management software, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • 7+ years of experience in critical facility site development, commercial real estate development, infrastructure development, data center site selection, or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Advanced / Master’s degree in the academic fields listed above
  • 7+ years of experience with evaluation and planning for land use diligence, power and water utilities, cooling technology, site development, entitlements, permitting

job.description:
Job Summary

Completes diagnostics, repairs and rebuilds on engine products in a service workshop under limited supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Applies documented procedures and policies to complete complex repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools Disassemble, inspect, clean and reassemble engines and /or engine components Performs preventative maintenance based on assessment of engines Assists more experienced technicians with diagnostics and development of repair plans engines in the workshop Completes required documentation, such as work completed documents, time sheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens Completes training in line with skill and business requirements Maintains work area and tools for cleanliness and proper operation Adheres to all relevant Health, Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to their supervisor

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Situational adaptability - Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)

Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution

Locally valid driving permit (Preferred)

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products

Light vehicle/heavy diesel plant/agriculture technicians as a Workshop Technician role, with the prospect of upskilling to a heavy diesel technology cert 3 qualification after 6-12 months and eventually becoming a Field Service Technician.

Job Service

Organization Cummins Inc.

Role Category On-site with Flexibility

Job Type Technician

ReqID 2440433

Relocation Package Yes

100% On-Site Yes

Due to the operational nature and specific job duties of this role, work is required to be completed 100% in person/On-site.

job.title: Rack Lifecycle Team Manager , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a hands-on, operationally focused Rack Lifecycle Team Manager to join our Infrastructure Operations team, owning the day-to-day execution of rack lifecycle operations within data center sites. This role is responsible for the full continuum of rack operations — from demand intake and rack landing, through Late Binding cabling, rack installation and handoff, to end-of-life decommissioning — at the site level. You will lead a team of data center technicians, translating organizational capacity goals into executed deliverables on the floor. As a tactical leader, you are the single accountable owner for ensuring every rack needed for customer capacity lands on time, is cabled and installed to standard, has no install blockers at handoff, and is decommissioned safely and compliantly at end-of-life. Your work directly supports AWS's ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably and at the lowest possible cost, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, security, and environmental compliance.

Key job responsibilities Rack Delivery & Installation

  • Lead planning and execution of network deployments including rack installs, structured cabling, fiber trunks, and MMR/CFA builds to meet committed customer capacity dates
  • Coordinate site readiness, RSPC readiness (Rack Space Power Cooling); ensure racks are landed, cabled, and ready for cabling patching and install per standards
  • Proactively identify and drive resolution of blockers across permits, site access, facilities, power, cross-connects, and vendor dependencies
  • Drive cross-team coordination with DCO, DCEO, LOG, security, CDP, Supply chain, Transport and GND during deployment waves, running escalation touchpoints and daily stand-ups as needed
  • Ensuring rack installations are as per MOP/SOP and documenting the handovers for later refences and improvements

Cabling Infrastructure (Late Binding)

  • Own scope for fiber/copper cabling, patching schedules, and labeling standards for the site
  • Validate OTDR/power testing and as-built documentation; ensure cabling meets quality standards and capacity requirements before handoff
  • Maintain cabling infrastructure governance including CMDB accuracy and port map integrity post-installation
  • Identify systemic cabling quality gaps and implement corrective actions to improve cycle times and first-pass quality

Supply Chain & Logistics

  • Track rack, cable, optics, and network BOM from PO to site; monitor lead times, logistics, customs clearance, and site inventory levels
  • Flag supply chain risks to schedule early and coordinate with procurement, logistics, and vendor partners on mitigation plans
  • Ensure material availability aligns with deployment timelines; maintain site-level inventory accuracy

Stakeholder Management & Blocker Removal

  • Serve as the single point of contact for internal customers, DC Ops, facilities, transport, and vendors for site-level rack lifecycle activities
  • Run daily and weekly war rooms during deployment waves; provide timely status updates and escalate blockers to senior leadership as needed
  • Build effective working relationships with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment and uninterrupted delivery execution

Rack Decommissioning (Decom)

  • Own the site-level decommission pipeline for EOL racks; coordinate with Capacity Planning, Network Operations, and DCLM/ALM teams to schedule graceful shutdowns with zero service impact
  • Lead physical decommission activities — device wipe, media destruction, cable removal, power disconnect, asset de-tagging, and rack removal — ensuring full MOP and EHS compliance
  • Track and recover reusable assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware); coordinate RMA, liquidation, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics and Environmental policies
  • Validate that reclaimed power, cooling, and U-space is accurately returned to the available pool; drive re-use to defer new builds and improve TCO
  • Ensure data hygiene post-decom including DCIM/CMDB updates, IPAM releases, port map reconciliation, and circuit/cross-connect documentation

Governance, Metrics & Reporting

  • Track and report on site-level KPIs including: racks landed vs. plan, Late Binding cabling completion %, capacity ready dates, received vs. installed cycle time, decom backlog vs. flightpath goal, and shipment achievement %
  • Define and enforce site-level policies, SOPs, and governance frameworks aligned with AWS standards and industry best practices across all rack lifecycle phases
  • Provide accurate, data-driven reporting on delivery performance, blockers, and improvement initiatives to the Cluster Manager and senior leadership
  • Champion adoption of tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) to reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and accelerate delivery cycle times

Handover & Documentation

  • Ensure clean, documented handoffs to Data Center Operations teams with updated CMDB/DCIM records, port maps, test results, and completed workflow sign-offs — with zero blockers at handoff
  • Maintain accurate and current records in DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and related systems throughout all lifecycle phases
  • Ensure all as-built documentation, cabling records, and workflow completions are captured and auditable

Team Leadership & Operations Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of data center technicians; manage staffing, scheduling, and day-to-day workforce planning for the site
  • Conduct regular team meetings, drive performance accountability, and ensure appropriate training and skill development across all lifecycle functions
  • Translate organizational goals into actionable team objectives; manage sprint planning, team output quality, and SLA compliance
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and performance management; make staffing recommendations in partnership with manager and HR
  • Foster a high-performance, inclusive, and safety-first team culture

A day in the life As the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager for your site, no two days are the same. You might start your morning reviewing the site's daily rack landing dashboard, checking in with your technicians on an active cabling wave, and triaging a supply chain delay flagged overnight. By midday, you could be on the data center floor coordinating a rack placement with facilities, validating a power sign-off checklist before a network device install, or running a decom stand-up to confirm MOP readiness for an EOL rack removal. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records following a completed handoff, reviewing your team's KPI performance ahead of a weekly operations review, or coaching a technician on structured cabling standards. Your role is tactical and hands-on — you execute with your team, remove blockers in real time, and hold the line on quality and schedule at the site level.

job.title: Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer, BOM144 DCEO
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:

Operations and Maintenance:

  • Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
  • Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
  • Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
  • Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
  • Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)

  • Health & Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
  • Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.

job.title: Senior Scale Program Strategist, Global Partner Training
job.description:
We equip diverse builders of today and tomorrow with the knowledge they need to leverage the power of the AWS Cloud. Join our dynamic, fast-growing team and help us empower our customers to build cloud skills. If you have excellent organizational and communication skills, a passion for working in a fast paced, dynamic environment and a desire to provide exceptional customer service, we’d like to speak with you! Here's your chance to join our Training & Certification team working in the highly visible role of Senior Scale Program Strategist. You will have the opportunity to define, shape, and implement programs to support the partner learning journey. You will serve as the partner creative problem solver across the AWS T&C organization.

To support the partner learning journey, you will be responsible for developing and implementing GSI-focused programs to increase the number of AWS-trained and certified partner individuals. You will transform insights into prioritized actionable programs, will drive improvements to existing programs, and define and develop tools. You’ll have global responsibility and will work with Global and Regional Partner Enablement Managers, Partner Development Managers, Partner Solution Architects, Partners and AWS Partner Network stakeholders to scale and optimize Partner training. You will also help prepare business reviews for different levels of management to confirm and reinforce overall drivers of the partner experience and provide actionable recommendations.

You should have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business challenges, and are able to build and convey compelling plans, frameworks and repeatable mechanisms. You have the ability to balance multiple projects and work within a high-growth and constantly evolving environment. You have a passion for solving complex business challenges and thrive on constantly improving the partner experience.

The Partner Program Manager is part of the GSI Segment Team which focuses on the partner learners and works backwards to meet their needs. The GSI Segment Team builds and maintains the partner learning plan, learning journey for various personas within a partner, develops programs, and manages tools to support the GSI to grow their business. The GSI Segment team support the Business Development team as they work with GSIs to grow revenue.

Key job responsibilities

  • Develop, manage, and grow Partner learning programs working across T&C and the AWS Partner Network.
  • Establish cross-functional global relationships across different T&C and field teams to represent Partners globally.
  • Evaluate effectiveness and propose adjustments to global programs to improve performance and ensure objectives are met.
  • Support the GSI teams to grow business, sales, and technical skills as partners drive revenue growth with AWS.

  • Invent new programs and mechanisms for scale while simplifying existing programs.
  • Support preparation of business reviews for various levels of management.

job.title: Partner Development Executive (Recruitment)
job.description:
Any Siemens location in

  • India

Company Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a high-impact Partner Development Executive to drive the recruitment and rapid onboarding of new strategic partners focused on expanding the footprint of Siemens Intelligence Center X and the broader Siemens Xcelerator portfolio across Asia Pacific.

Role Summary

Intelligence Center X is Siemens’ production-ready industrial AI orchestration platform that combines the Mendix low-code platform with Graph Studio (knowledge graphs and industrial ontologies) and AI Studio (from the

RapidMiner portfolio) to enable hybrid human–AI workforces and deliver measurable outcomes in PLM, MES, and industrial digital transformation.

The role focuses on identifying, attracting, qualifying, and onboarding partners with strong capabilities in AI/ML, Low-Code application development, Knowledge Graphs, and industrial software solutions (PLM/MES) to accelerate market penetration of Intelligence Center X in key Asian markets.

This is a high-impact individual-contributor role with significant autonomy, focused on net-new partner acquisition and successful activation rather than ongoing account management of existing partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partner Recruitment
  • Develop and execute a targeted recruitment plan for new partners (System Integrators, ISVs, specialist AI/ML solution providers, low-code specialists, knowledge-graph/semantic technology firms, Value-Added Resellers, and selected technology alliances) aligned to Intelligence Center X and priority Xcelerator use cases.
  • Conduct white-space analysis across APAC countries and priority verticals (automotive, electronics/semiconductor, discrete manufacturing, process industries, aerospace & defence, etc.) to identify coverage and capability gaps.
  • Proactively source and engage high-potential partners with proven strength in AI/ML platforms, low-code application development (especially Mendix or comparable platforms), knowledge graphs/ontologies/data fabrics, and industrial digital twin or PLM/MES solutions.
  • Apply rigorous qualification frameworks (capability, market reach/customer base, technical depth, commitment, and cultural fit) before progressing candidates.
  • Negotiate and close partner agreements within the Siemens partner engagement models (Sell, Service, Build), ensuring clear commercial and technical expectations.
  • Structured Partner Onboarding & Activation
  • Design and lead structured onboarding programmes (typically 30/60/90-day plans) tailored to

Intelligence Center X and related Xcelerator solutions.

  • Drive partners from contract signature to “activated” status — portal access, foundational and advanced training/certification completion, ability to deliver credible demonstrations, and logging of first qualified joint opportunities.
  • Coordinate tightly with product, technical enablement, marketing, and country sales teams to deliver specialised enablement on Graph Studio, AI Studio, Mendix agentic capabilities, industrial ontologies, and integration with Teamcenter (PLM) and Opcenter (MES).
  • Establish early co-sell motions, joint value propositions, and reference architectures so newly onboarded partners generate pipeline quickly.
  • Ecosystem Growth for Intelligence Center X
  • Build and expand a partner ecosystem specifically equipped to deliver industrial AI outcomes in Asia, directly supporting the growth of Intelligence Center X adoption and related ARR/pipeline metrics.
  • Collaborate with country channel sales leadership, vertical GTM teams, and product management to ensure recruited partners address real demand signals and strategic account needs.
  • Create joint solution packages and APPs with go-to-market plays that combine partners’ AI/ML/low-code strengths with Siemens’ digital thread capabilities
  • Cultivate the development of APPs factory approach to drive incremental revenue streams for partners and Siemens.
  • Smoothly transition successfully activated partners to ongoing partner management and enablement teams while retaining visibility on early performance.
  • Contribute market and partner insights to the broader APAC partner strategy, capacity planning, and ecosystem health reporting.
  • Market Intelligence, Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  • Maintain strong awareness of the competitive and technology landscape in industrial AI, low-code platforms, knowledge graphs, PLM, and MES across Asia.
  • Build effective internal networks across Siemens Digital Industries Software functions and country organisations.
  • Represent Siemens at partner recruitment events, industry forums, and ecosystem development activities across the region.
  • Own and report on recruitment pipeline, conversion rates, onboarding success metrics, time-to-activation, and contribution to Intelligence Center X footprint growth. Prerequisites & Required Experience

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.

EXPERIENCE

  • 8–12+ years in partner development, channel/alliance recruitment, ecosystem building, or strategic business development within enterprise or industrial software.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting and onboarding net-new partners in complex B2B software

ecosystems, ideally within Asia Pacific.

  • Strong practical domain knowledge and commercial experience in at least three of the following (ideally more):
  • AI / Machine Learning platforms and industrial AI applications
  • Low-code / no-code / agentic application development platforms (Mendix experience is a significant advantage)
  • Knowledge graphs, semantic technologies, ontologies, or industrial data fabrics
  • Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and/or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
  • Experience working with or competing against industrial digital platforms (Siemens Xcelerator

preferred; Dassault, PTC, Autodesk, Rockwell, or comparable platforms also valuable).

  • Proven ability to operate in matrix organisations, influence without direct authority, and drive results across multiple countries and functions.
  • Track record of structured partner lifecycle activities — from qualification and contracting through activation and early pipeline generation.

SKILLS

& COMPETENCIES

  • Excellent executive-level communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong market-mapping, qualification, and due-diligence capability.
  • Ability to design and execute structured onboarding and enablement programmes.
  • Cross-cultural fluency and comfort working across diverse Asian business environments.
  • Results orientation with clear ownership of recruitment pipeline and activation metrics.
  • Technical curiosity and the ability to engage credibly on industrial AI, low-code, and knowledge-graph topics.
  • Fluency in English is essential.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Asia Pacific (typically 30%).

PREFERRED / HIGHLY DESIRABLE

  • Prior experience with Siemens Digital Industries Software partner programmes or similar large

industrial software OEM ecosystems.

  • Direct exposure to SaaS/subscription models and modern partner programme design.
  • Background in manufacturing, Industry 4.0, or digital twin initiatives in Asia.
  • Familiarity with PRM platforms and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred).

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12–18 months, the role is expected to deliver a measurable pipeline of high-quality new partners that are activated and contributing to Intelligence Center X opportunities, improved coverage in priority APAC markets and verticals, and a clear acceleration of the industrial AI partner ecosystem aligned with Siemens’ Xcelerator strategy.

This position is ideal for a commercially driven, technically curious partner professional who thrives on building new ecosystem capacity rather than managing existing relationships, and who wants to play a direct role in scaling one of Siemens’ most strategic industrial AI platforms across Asia.

Why Us

We are Siemens:

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.

You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

job.description:
P IT Commodity Manager– INDIA

Job Description | Siemens Limited India & Affiliates

Location: Bengaluru / Mumbai / Pune

Siemens India seeks a technically accomplished and commercially driven leader to shape and execute its IT commodity strategy. The role combines deep enterprise IT engineering knowledge with strategic sourcing, technology vendor management and commercial leadership across Infrastructure, Hardware, Software, Cloud, Telecommunications and IT Services.

The role bridges IT and Procurement, working closely aligned with Siemens global commodity teams, India IT leadership and business stakeholders to deliver competitive, secure and scalable technology solutions. IT commodity strategy & leadership
