job.title: Business Development – Industry, Infrastructure and Construction
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to

Marketing & Sales Manager__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will help run what runs the world — taking on a strategic and technical leadership position responsible for driving growth and market presence of Low Voltage (LV) component solutions within the Industry, Infrastructure and Construction sectors nationally, working across ABB's Smart Buildings and Smart Power divisions.** *Work model - #hybrid #LI-Hybrid*

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Segment Strategy & Market Development – Developing and executing a comprehensive go-to-market strategy tailored to each segment, including identifying and prioritising key growth market (sub-)segments, conducting continuous market dynamics analysis to inform strategic focus and identify emerging opportunities, and establishing clear, measurable market development objectives aligned with divisional and corporate targets
  • Pipeline Management & Forecasting – Building and maintaining a robust, discipline-driven opportunity pipeline through implementing systematic opportunity management processes to ensure pipeline visibility and accuracy, providing reliable sales forecasts based on structured funnel management, and supporting resource allocation and strategic planning through disciplined forecast processes
  • Strategic Account Management – Cultivating and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders across the target sectors, engaging early in the design and procurement cycles to establish ABB as a preferred vendor, demonstrating technical expertise and differentiating value propositions aligned to customer requirements, and building and sustaining relationships with consultants, end-users, developers, and decision-makers
  • Ecosystem Partnership Development – Collaborating with channel partners, system integrators, switchboard builders, and contractors to broaden market reach and enhance solution delivery capabilities, ensuring technical designs comply with ABB standards and industry regulations, and leveraging partner networks to identify projects and facilitate technical support
  • Cross-Functional Coordination – Driving alignment and collaboration across internal teams, partnering with product management, marketing, and delivery teams to develop tailored technical solutions, ensuring customer requirements are integrated into proposal development and delivery planning, and supporting product positioning and promotional activities within target sectors
  • Industry Representation & Thought Leadership – Representing ABB within the industry ecosystem through active participation in relevant industry events, associations, and technical forums, positioning ABB as a solutions leader and thought partner within the segment communities, and building ABB brand visibility and credibility within the segment ecosystems

Our team dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters – because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

Qualifications for the role

  • Deep knowledge of Low Voltage electrical systems and their applications across the Industry, Infrastructure and Construction sectors
  • Proven track record in business development or technical sales, with demonstrated ability to develop and execute go-to-market strategies and drive revenue growth
  • Minimum 5+ years' experience in a business development, strategic account management or market development role within the electrical, building or construction industry
  • Excellence in stakeholder engagement and relationship management across diverse organisations including consultants, contractors, system integrators, and end-users
  • Strong understanding of market dynamics, competitive landscape and emerging technology trends within target sectors
  • Strategic thinking capability to balance short-term commercial objectives with long-term market positioning and development
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across organisational boundaries, including product management, marketing, and delivery teams
  • Tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience in the electrical or construction industry

Optional

  • Experience managing switchboard builders, system integrators, or contractor networks in a technical sales or business development environment
  • Familiarity with ABB product portfolio across the Smart Power and Smart Buildings divisions
  • Existing networks within the Industry, Infrastructure, or Construction sectors at a national level

More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected and protected. Its smart products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity and reliability of almost any operation. The Division provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. Technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices, complemented by the ABB Ability™ Energy Manager — a scalable platform helping organisations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

ABB Smart Buildings digitally transforms commercial, industrial and residential buildings for the highest comfort, efficiency, security and reliability, through safe, smart and sustainable electrical solutions, services and products, improving quality of life in the buildings of the future. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, alongside energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs, sockets and wiring accessories — accommodating single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.

job.title: E&I Engineer
job.description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls & Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems.

This is a hands-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal & Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.
  • Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms.
  • Execute and support Pre-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
  • Implement and verify Cause & Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences.
  • Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues.
  • Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution.
  • Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones.

Essential Requirements

  • Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering.
  • Minimum 5 years' hands-on PLC programming experience.
  • Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory).
  • HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent.
  • Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
  • Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP.
  • Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause & Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives.

Desirable Experience

  • Oil & Gas, Marine or Offshore projects.
  • Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety-related control systems.
  • Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511).
  • OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443).
  • Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.

What We're Looking For

A practical, hands-on Controls Engineer who can quickly understand control systems, solve automation problems, support project delivery, and work effectively with suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Travel within the UK, Turkey and Vietnam will be required for FAT, commissioning and project support activities.

job.title: Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst
job.description:

Johnson Controls creates smart, healthy, and sustainable environments. In this role, you will help strengthen Oracle Fusion technical capabilities that support reliable reporting, efficient business processes, and effective delivery across critical enterprise flows.

Role Overview

As a Senior Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst, you will lead technical development and support for Oracle Fusion ERP solutions, with a strong focus on Project to Close flows. You will partner with functional, technical, and business teams to deliver stable integrations, extensions, and reporting solutions that improve performance, simplify processes, and support end-to-end delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead development and support of Fusion extensions across Project to Close and related ERP functional flows.
  • Design, build, and maintain BIP and OTBI reports that support business and operational needs.
  • Develop and support integrations using Oracle Fusion REST and SOAP APIs.

  • Support implementation activities, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Analyze enhancements, change requests, and support issues; help manage backlog and conduct code reviews.
  • Contribute to automation, simplification, and reduction of support tickets through practical process improvements.

How You Will Do It

  • Own outcomes with accountability and integrity by delivering well-tested solutions, protecting data quality, and following disciplined change control.
  • Stay close to the business process by partnering with functional teams and understanding how each change affects users and downstream flows.
  • Improve every day through automation, root-cause analysis, simplification, and candid problem-solving.
  • Work as one team with technical and business partners to unblock issues quickly and keep delivery moving.
  • Use clear documentation, traceability, and thoughtful handoffs so support teams can sustain what you build.
  • Balance speed and quality by validating changes carefully before release and staying focused on business impact.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, or an equivalent field.
  • 4+ years of overall experience with Oracle Fusion and Oracle EBS ERP environments.
  • Proven experience delivering and supporting technical configurations and extensions in Oracle Fusion ERP.
  • Hands-on experience with BIP and OTBI reports.

  • Experience developing interfaces with Oracle Fusion REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with functional teams and business stakeholders.

Nice to Have

job.title: Staff AI Engineer, Strategic Partners, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

As a Generative AI (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within partners for our customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke and scalable agentic solutions directly with our partners, for and within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic partners, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical connector and feedback loop for the partner to Google, transforming real-world field and partner insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. You will serve as the agent engineer bridging the gap between AI prototypes and production-grade reality for our strategic AI partners and their own FDE teams. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a team lead and developer within the strategic AI partner for AI applications, working with partner’s teams to transition from rapid prototypes to production-grade, replicable agentic workflows (multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Co-build with a strategic AI partner’s own FDE teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring project success and high end-user adoption.
  • Help partners to build their own agentic delivery capabilities to set them up for long-term success, focusing on the ROI at customer engagements ensuring customer activation.
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure partner developed agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable partner and field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Analytical Lead, Planning and Measurement, Large Customer Sales
job.description:
About the job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

The Planning & Measurement team at Google is a critical part of our advertising business, ensuring that our clients understand the value and impact of their campaigns. We're searching for a passionate and experienced Analytical Lead to join our team and help drive better measurement practices across a portfolio of clients in e-commerce, gaming and travel.

In this role, you'll be a trusted advisor and consultant, working closely with both internal teams and external clients to develop and implement robust measurement strategies. You will leverage Google's cutting-edge data and technology to provide actionable insights that improve advertising effectiveness and drive business results. Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Caterpillar is seeking aSenior Tax Analystto joinour US Reporting & Analysis –Global Finance Services Division.

As a Senior Tax Analyst in the US Tax Reporting and Analysis group, you will be responsible for aspects of the U.S Consolidated Federal Income Tax return for Caterpillar Inc. and its subsidiaries. This experienced tax professional will be a valued member on a team that performs compliance and provision activities, supports special projects, and provides support for the US IRS and state income tax audits.

You will have the opportunity to expand your US direct income tax experience in multiple tax technical areas as well as having great opportunities for career progression. The role will challenge you to combine technical and business knowledge to complete a high-quality work product, adapt to a rapidly changing legislative environment by documenting compliance positions and demonstrate critical thinking skills through the implementation of controls and analysis.

  • Tax Projects: Applies tax research results to optimize enterprise tax effects. Participates on process improvement projects. Participates on teams within or outside of the US Reporting and Analysis group on Global Tax initiatives.

  • Strong conceptual understanding of US State taxation, along with hands-on experience in preparing and reviewing multiple US state retu

Skills desired:

Accuracy and Attention to Detail:Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Working Knowledge:

Effective Communications:Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.

  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.

Problem Solving:Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes problem reporting and escalation practices.

  • Identifies key aspects of problem-solving techniques used in own area.

Financial and Accounting Systems:Knowledge of functions, features and capabilities of financial and accounting systems; ability to use financial and accounting applications specific to the organization. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Implements data flows between financial and accounting systems.
  • Utilizes operating requirements for the financial environment.
  • Coordinates major system interfaces and criticalities.

Tax Management:Knowledge of tax laws, organizational tax practices, obligations; ability to manage organization tax related issues. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Collects and prepares documentation for tax filing or tax defense activities.
  • Works with applying tax law to a specific industry or line of business.
  • Interprets and explains all locally relevant tax laws.
  • Documents government regulations that deal with organizational taxes.
  • Follows tax accounting practices and explains the rationale behind these practices.

Tax Operations:Knowledge of tax practices and regulations; ability to prepare and file federal, state and local tax returns. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Utilizes basic tools to identify and gather the information necessary for preparing a tax return.

Tax Regulations:Knowledge of federal, state and local tax procedures and regulations; ability to adhere to tax regulations when filing forms as they pertain to a particular business or industry. Level Working Knowledge:

Research Analysis:Knowledge of the concepts, methodologies and methods of research analysis; ability to locate, interpret and evaluate research findings compiled and documented by others. Level Working Knowledge:

job.title: Category Manager, Data Centre
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

The Category Manager, Data Centre Construction and Fitout is responsible for developing and executing end-to-end category strategies for Data Centre Construction and Data Hall Fitout packages in Singapore and across the region. The role focuses on driving cost savings, improving sourcing efficiencies and managing supply risks while balancing business requirements and stakeholder expectations.

The Category Manager is expected to stay abreast of supply market trends and economic developments within the data centre industry and demonstrate proficiency in applying appropriate sourcing strategies and commercial levers to achieve optimal procurement outcomes.

The role works closely with Engineering, Project Delivery, Operations and Finance to achieve competitive total costs, timely contract awards, supplier reliability and sound procurement governance. Key responsibilities include managing supplier market intelligence, sourcing plans, negotiations, contract performance and lifecycle risks, leveraging data analytics and approved AI-enabled tools where appropriate.

Strategic Sourcing

  • Drive cost optimisation initiatives within the assigned category to support business requirements.
  • Develop and execute procurement category strategies for data centre construction and fitout to drive cost optimisation, sourcing efficiencies and supply risk management.
  • Proactively engage business stakeholders and Finance teams to identify sourcing and savings opportunities and leverage spend across the Group.
  • Conduct spend analysis and collaborate with key business stakeholders to develop and implement effective strategic sourcing initiatives.
  • Lead key sourcing events, develop negotiation strategies and drive cost savings through scope and technical evaluations, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis and commercial negotiations in collaboration with stakeholders and Legal teams.
  • Provide relevant market knowledge, supplier intelligence and procurement expertise to support business decisions.

Supplier Management

  • Evaluate and qualify suppliers based on technical capabilities, financial resilience, Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) standards, quality, resources and delivery capacity.
  • Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with key suppliers to identify and implement cost improvement initiatives aligned with category strategies.
  • Manage strategic supplier relationships and performance through regular supplier meetings, business reviews and performance evaluations to drive continuous improvement and deliver additional value.
  • Monitor supplier performance and provide timely feedback to ensure service quality, delivery reliability and contractual compliance.
  • Support contract administration activities, including changes, claims, liquidated damages (LDs), warranties, defects liability and contract close-out, in coordination with project and Legal teams.
  • Ensure clear coordination and accountability across General Contractors (GC), specialist contractors, customer fitout teams and owner-furnished equipment suppliers.

Governance, Process Improvement and Procurement Operations

  • Ensure procurement activities comply with established procurement policies, procedures and governance requirements.
  • Provide guidance to business users on procurement policies, processes and best practices.
  • Review existing category procurement processes and policies to identify operational challenges, bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Drive continuous improvement in procurement value and quality through data analytics, cost analysis and process reviews.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready sourcing records, contract registers, supplier risk logs and contract award justifications.
  • Support local project teams on urgent procurement packages while managing single-source procurement and contract variation risks.
  • Improve RFx templates, rate cards, market intelligence capabilities and procurement cycle times to enhance sourcing effectiveness and operational efficiency.

Category Management

  • Develop and implement innovative category management and sourcing strategies, establish cross-divisional procurement processes and optimise sourcing approaches with qualified suppliers to maximise procurement value and business outcomes.
  • Apply strong analytical capabilities to conduct detailed category and spend analysis, identify procurement opportunities and recommend cost-effective sourcing strategies.
  • Manage category performance reporting, identify issues and challenges and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with Design, Construction, Operations, Finance and Legal teams to align forecast demand, project scopes, schedules and commercial risk management.
  • Monitor and report realised savings, cost avoidance, tender cycle times, award-to-need-date adherence, supplier delivery and quality performance, contract variations and compliance.
  • Coordinate with regional category leads to align standard equipment procurement and regional agreements with local construction and fitout requirements.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to the development of repeatable specifications and procurement best practices for future projects.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying or a related field, or equivalent relevant qualifications.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in sourcing, category management, quantity surveying or construction, preferably within data centre or infrastructure projects.
  • Experience in leading supplier contract negotiations and managing commercial negotiations.
  • Proven experience in developing and implementing procurement strategies, with a demonstrated track record of delivering financial savings.
  • Experience in construction and fitout procurement.
  • Experience in reviewing project scopes and Bills of Quantities (BOQ).
  • Strong cost benchmarking, tender evaluation and quantity surveying skills.
  • Good project management and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial calculations.
  • Good presentation and Microsoft PowerPoint skills.
  • Proficiency in using e-sourcing tools such as iValua and enterprise systems such as SAP.
  • Good knowledge of procurement principles, processes and best practices.

Good to Have

  • Experience in procurement within a multinational organisation or relevant technical experience in Mechanical and Electrical (M&E) or construction works.
  • Familiarity with construction contracts, either locally or internationally.
  • Experience in a regional or global procurement role.
  • Experience as a Quantity Surveyor.
  • Experience in utilising AI tools and developing AI agents to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of work processes.

job.title: Senior Technical Engineer - Backup/Storage
job.description:
Senior Technical Engineer - Backup/Storage

Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Engineer - Backup/Storage to support our global Rubrik backup environment. You will operate, implement, and continuously improve Rubrik data protection across on-premises, datacenter, and cloud workloads, ensuring backups are reliable, secure, recoverable, and compliant with recovery objectives.

What you will do

  • Operate and support the global Rubrik environment, including Rubrik CDM clusters and Rubrik Security Cloud, covering daily health monitoring, job success, capacity, and upgrades.
  • Implement and expand Rubrik, including cluster and node deployment, workload onboarding, SLA domain design, replication, and archival.
  • Protect a wide range of workloads, including VMware vSphere, physical Windows, Linux, and AIX hosts, databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server), NAS file shares, and cloud workloads.
  • Manage SLA domains, retention, replication, and cloud archival policies aligned to business RPO and RTO requirements.
  • Troubleshoot failed backups and restores, perform root cause analysis, and work with Rubrik support on escalated cases.
  • Perform and coordinate restore testing, disaster recovery, and cyber recovery exercises, including immutable backups, anomaly detection, and ransomware recovery readiness.
  • Plan and execute Rubrik software upgrades, hardware refreshes, and capacity expansion across global sites.
  • Build backup reports and dashboards (e.g., Rubrik reports and Power BI) covering success rates, SLA compliance, capacity, and recovery readiness for the global landscape.
  • Automate routine operations and reporting using Rubrik REST APIs and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Python), and maintain infrastructure-as-code where applicable.
  • Coordinate with storage, network, virtualization, database, security, and application teams, as well as datacenter partners and third-party vendors, to deliver and support backup services.
  • Manage incidents, problems, and changes through ITSM processes (e.g., ServiceNow), and provide evidence for internal and external audits.
  • Maintain runbooks, standards, and operational documentation, and mentor other engineers on Rubrik and backup best practices.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies to improve backup performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.

What you will need

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Rubrik operations and implementation, including Rubrik CDM and SLA-based policy management.
  • Experience protecting and restoring VMware, physical servers (Windows and Linux), databases, and NAS workloads with Rubrik.
  • Strong understanding of backup and recovery concepts, including RPO and RTO, retention, replication, immutability, air-gapped copies, and the 3-2-1 rule.
  • Good understanding of storage (SAN, NAS, and object storage) and of the networking needed for backup, such as DNS, NTP, firewalls, and bandwidth planning.
  • Strong Windows and Linux administration skills and scripting experience for automation.
  • Experience with cloud archival or backup targets such as AWS S3, Azure Blob, or OCI Object Storage.
  • Strong troubleshooting, written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work with global teams and vendors.

Preferred:

  • Rubrik certifications and experience with Rubrik Security Cloud (RSC).
  • Experience with other backup platforms (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, Cohesity, NetBackup) and migrations to Rubrik.
  • Experience with Rubrik REST API, SDKs, or Terraform and Ansible automation.
  • Experience with Power BI for infrastructure and backup reporting.
  • Familiarity with recovery and resilience frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 22301) and ITIL change management.
  • Experience with ServiceNow CMDB and asset discovery tools.

job.title: Operations Readiness Data Centre Technician
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Field Service Technician – Operational Readiness is part of a Singapore-based Operations team that helps new Firmus AI Factory sites prepare for Day 2 operations. The role combines hands-on field service support, commissioning assistance from an Operations perspective, and practical training of local teams to safely operate, maintain and respond to issues at live sites.

The successful candidate will train at established Australian and Singapore sites before transitioning to support our large-scale Batam and other new sites. They will also develop first-line compute and systems support skills alongside Site Reliability Teams, and core engineering teams. This Operational Readiness Field Service Technician presents a valuable opportunity to gain immediate, first-hand experience in the deployment, setup, and commissioning of the latest GPU technologies. With exposure to projects across Australia and Southeast Asia, the role offers significant opportunities for hands-on technical learning, regional collaboration, and knowledge transfer.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational readiness and commissioning support

  • Support new site teams before go-live, identifying operational readiness gaps and raising them with the responsible teams.
  • Work alongside the Build and commissioning teams to coordinate and assist practical site activities under the direction of the responsible lead.
  • Support handover and early live operations, track outstanding issues and help establish inspections and maintenance routines.

Training and mentoring local Operations teams

  • Provide hands-on demonstrations, job shadowing and supervised practice for new Operations staff, covering routine checks, equipment care, fault response and escalation.
  • Coach staff in using operating procedures, recording work, communicating with the Global Operations Centre and completing clear shift handovers.
  • Track training progress, identify areas needing further practice and provide feedback to the responsible manager for competency assessment and sign-off.
  • Share lessons between sites and help improve training materials, checklists and runbooks.

Hands-on FST support

  • Inspect and maintain liquid cooling, mechanical, ancillary and physical compute infrastructure using approved procedures and task-specific authorisations.
  • Carry out basic fault-finding, approved resets and component replacement, escalating faults requiring specialist support.
  • Assist with server and network equipment installation, replacement, cable management, fibre hygiene and equipment checks.
  • Maintain service records, tools, spares and site housekeeping, and reinforce safe working practices.

First-line compute and systems support

  • Learn and apply server hardware diagnostics and fault response, monitoring and incident evidence collection.
  • Use approved runbooks to triage hardware, connectivity and system alerts with support from the GOC, SRE, HPC and Network teams.
  • Assist with approved firmware, configuration and recovery tasks under specialist direction, working within competence and access authority.
  • Provide backup remote and on-site support for operational teams to assist cover leave and or operational project support

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Holds a Diploma or Professional certification in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Science, Information Technology, or possess equivalent experience, with demonstrated practical aptitude
  • Experience with data centres, liquid cooling, fibre or GPU servers is highly regarded. Training and supervised practice will be provided to build competence in Firmus systems before working independently or training others.
  • Good computer skills and a willingness to learn service records, ticketing tools and first-line compute and systems support.
  • Strong work ethic, reliability and a willingness to learn and take on practical tasks. We welcome hard-working applicants from a range of backgrounds.
  • A practical mindset, attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions, work safely and ask for help when needed.
  • Clear communication, teamwork and patience when helping others learn. Willingness to develop coaching skills as experience grows.

LOCATION & TRAVELING REQUIREMENTS

  • Based in: Singapore
  • Available for regular travel and site assignments, which may involve extended periods away from the home base.
  • Able to work flexible hours, including shifts, evenings and weekends during commissioning and early operations.
  • Able to perform hands-on site duties and meet applicable travel and site access requirements.

EMPLOYMENT BASIS

Full-time

DIVERSITY

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Team Member- Environment, Health & Safety
job.description:
Responsibilities

About Business:

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

As the largest port organization for the past two decades, we offer a wide range of services including cargo handling, container terminal operations, logistics, port infrastructure development, and maintenance. Our expertise extends to multimodal transport solutions, customs clearance, port security, and environmental sustainability, positioning us as a key player in global trade and logistics.

*Key Responsibilities of Role

  • To lead and coordinate for applicable ADANI Green book procedural compliance, QHSE policy and safety regulations at site. Monitor standards, processes, communications, training and systems to ensure all responsibilities associated with HSE within ADANI are adhered to.
  • Develop & deliver H &S induction, awareness training, familiarization training and other training as mandated through ADANI HSE Guidelines and Expectations

  • Respond to any safety complaints/issues raised by employee. Establish Safety meetings at site to address the issues. Ensure safety committee agreed points are closed within timeline. Escalate the issues timely to Project Manager and Functional Head.
  • Being an active and visible member in all aspects of incident investigation including verifying root cause and implementing the recommended corrective actions
  • Plan, coordinate, arrange and participate in weekly/monthly/project related HSE performance review meetings. Updating and monitoring the safety statistics of site/Project
  • Assist Site team in conducting TPI Inspection by Competent authority of all Lifting tools and tackles used at dredging premises and in meeting the LSA and FFA compliance onboard vessel
  • Participate and support site operational team in carrying out JOB Safety Analysis/Risk Assessment of the activities
  • Being an active and visible member in all aspects of incident investigation including verifying root cause and implementing the recommended corrective actions

Monthly MIS Report

Organize and conduct safety tour/inspection with site management on every week and report through SRFA in Gensuite Provide Support and assist other dredging sites on H &S related matters.

Qualifications

Qualification

  • B.E/B. Tech/BSc./Diploma or above/equivalent in any discipline. Full Time Regular Course; UGC approved institute

Domain Qualifications

  • Diploma in Industrial Safety from RLI/CLI or ME/M Tech.(I.E/IS/HSE) or, ADIS / PDIS in industrial safety from State/Central Govt. approved institute; AICTE & NABET approved institute
  • Internal Auditor for IMS;

Work Experience:

  • 7-10 Years of experience in the field of HSE management and Implementation
  • HSE implementation in PORTS and allied sectors will be an added advantage
  • Prefers the experience in Dredging Industry.

DESIRED SKILLS

  • Good understanding of local and international EHS laws and regulations
  • Good understanding on Maritime codes and Regulations, safe practices
  • Good understanding of ISO standard and prior experience in implementing them; Internal auditor for ISO 45000

As a member of the Group Risk & Compliance (GRC) Senior Leadership Team, the incumbent will lead the Risk & Compliance function for Singtel Singapore (the "OpCo"), with a matrix reporting relationship into the OpCo's senior leadership.

The role serves as a strategic risk partner and trusted advisor to the OpCo leadership, providing independent oversight, constructive challenge and forward-looking insights to support business strategy, informed decision-making and sustainable growth.

Working closely with the OpCo leadership and the broader GRC function, the incumbent will be responsible for strengthening enterprise risk management, governance and compliance capabilities, ensuring that material risks are proactively identified, assessed and managed, and that appropriate risk mitigation measures are embedded across the business.

The incumbent will play a key role in fostering a strong risk culture, promoting clear accountability and integrating risk considerations into strategic and operational decisions. As part of the GRC Senior Leadership Team, the role will also contribute to Group-wide risk priorities, transformation initiatives and capability development, ensuring alignment between the OpCo's business objectives and the Group's overall risk appetite and governance expectations.

Make An Impact By

Strategic Risk Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the OpCo leadership on strategic, emerging and operational risks, providing independent perspectives and constructive challenge.
  • Integrate risk considerations into business strategy, major investments, transformation programmes and key management decisions.
  • Anticipate evolving risks and opportunities arising from changes in the business, technology, regulatory and external environment.
  • Balance commercial objectives with prudent risk-taking, enabling the business to pursue its strategic priorities within the Group's risk appetite.

Enterprise Risk Management & Governance

  • Lead the OpCo's enterprise risk management agenda, ensuring effective identification, assessment, prioritisation, monitoring and mitigation of material risks.
  • Strengthen risk governance, accountability and escalation mechanisms across business and functional units.
  • Provide insightful, forward-looking risk reporting and recommendations to OpCo senior management, relevant governance committees and Group GRC.
  • Promote effective risk ownership within the business and embed risk management into business planning and decision-making.

Compliance & Risk Assurance

  • Provide leadership and oversight of the OpCo's compliance obligations and Business Continuity Management (BCM) programme, working closely with Group Compliance and relevant functional specialists to strengthen compliance and operational resilience.
  • Oversee the adequacy and effectiveness of risk mitigation measures, governance processes and assurance activities.
  • Ensure material risk exposures, incidents and regulatory concerns are appropriately escalated, investigated and remediated.
  • Work collaboratively with business functions and assurance teams to address systemic issues and strengthen organisational resilience.

Leadership, Stakeholder Engagement & Group Collaboration

  • Lead, develop and inspire the OpCo Risk & Compliance team, building a high-performing, commercially aware and forward-looking function.
  • Establish strong relationships with OpCo leadership, business stakeholders and relevant Group functions.
  • Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, collaboration and proactive risk management.
  • Contribute actively to the GRC Senior Leadership Team, supporting Group-wide priorities, cross-OpCo collaboration, transformation and talent development.
  • Champion GRC's One Team approach, leveraging capabilities across the function to deliver coordinated, practical and value-adding support to stakeholders.

Skills To Succeed

  • A relevant degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline.
  • At least 10-15 years of relevant experience in enterprise risk management, internal controls, governance, compliance or related functions, including experience in leading and managing teams.
  • Leadership experience in enterprise risk management, governance, compliance or related disciplines within a complex, multi-business organisation.
  • Proven experience leading teams, driving organisational change and strengthening risk management capabilities.
  • Enterprise Risk Management: Experience in implementing and operationalising enterprise risk management frameworks, governance and emerging risks identification.
  • Compliance and Risk Assurance: Experience in compliance reviews, internal control frameworks, control effectiveness assessments, compliance monitoring and remediation of identified gaps.
  • Business Continuity Management (BCM): Experience in developing and implementing BCM frameworks and programmes, including business continuity planning, testing and strengthening organisational resilience.
  • Industry Risk Knowledge: Broad understanding of operational, technology, cyber, regulatory and emerging risks, ideally with exposure to telecommunications, technology or other highly regulated industries.

job.title: Staff Engineer, Salesforce Production Support & AI Operations - Bengaluru
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a technically strong Salesforce professional to help maintain the stability and reliability of enterprise Salesforce applications while contributing to AI Operations initiatives. This role combines hands-on production support, technical troubleshooting and incident ownership with collaboration across business and engineering teams to identify repetitive service requests and onboard suitable use cases to Equinix’s Sidekick AI platform. The role is an individual-contributor position requiring technical judgment, strong communication and a willingness to learn and work with technologies beyond Salesforce.

Responsibilities

  • Salesforce Production Support & Technical Troubleshooting
  • Own triage, investigation, escalation and resolution of Salesforce production issues; coordinate major incidents and provide timely updates to business stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot Salesforce issues involving Apex, SOQL, triggers, Salesforce Flow, debug logs, permissions, asynchronous jobs and platform limits.
  • Investigate REST/SOAP API and integration failures, data synchronisation issues and related dependencies; collaborate with engineering teams to drive issues to closure.
  • Lead root-cause analysis (RCA), identify recurring problems and follow through on corrective and preventive actions to improve platform stability and reduce repeat incidents.
  • Coordinate with vendor and managed-service support teams, monitor service-level commitments, support knowledge transfer and maintain operational runbooks and documentation.
  • Partner with Salesforce engineering, QA and other application teams on releases, hotfixes, change readiness and post-release validation as required.
  • AI Operations, Automation & Continuous Improvement
  • Work with business users and application teams to understand service requests and identify opportunities to reduce manual, repetitive work.
  • Translate suitable business use cases, such as routine access, setup or service requests, into requirements for onboarding to the Sidekick AI platform.
  • Collaborate with the AI platform team and relevant engineers to validate use cases, coordinate implementation and support adoption.
  • Identify opportunities for workflow automation and AI-assisted support; validate outcomes and follow approved security, privacy and human-review requirements.
  • Bring curiosity and a learning mindset toward AI, Agentforce and other emerging technologies. Prior Agentforce implementation experience is beneficial but not required.

Qualifications - Must Have

  • 6-12 years of relevant experience in Salesforce development, technical support or production support.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce technical knowledge, including practical Apex and SOQL skills and the ability to investigate triggers, existing Flows, debug logs and platform behaviour.
  • Experience troubleshooting APIs and integrations and coordinating resolution across multiple technical teams.
  • Experience in production support, incident management, prioritisation, root-cause analysis and service-level commitments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to understand business problems, explain technical issues clearly and provide effective stakeholder updates.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with vendor or managed-service teams and drive issues through to closure.
  • Curiosity, adaptability and willingness to learn and work with AI, automation and technologies beyond Salesforce. Prior AI or Agentforce implementation is not required.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to generative AI, AI-assisted support, Agentforce, AI agents or an automation proof of concept.
  • Experience building Salesforce Flow automations, scripts or other workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, DevOps, Git, CI/CD or Salesforce deployment tools.
  • Experience supporting multiple enterprise applications or working across technology teams.
  • Relevant Salesforce or IT service management certifications.

job.title: Senior Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Global Benefits Solutions is responsible for the strategy and design of how Equinix's benefits programs are built, configured, and delivered through technology. Sitting within the Global Benefits Centre of Excellence, this role owns the end-to-end design of how benefits interact with systems, from eligibility rules and enrollment logic to data flows and configuration standards, across a 38-country footprint.

This is not a platform management role. It is a benefits system design and strategy role. The Senior Manager defines how benefits should work within systems like Equinix Benefits, Workday, and recognition platforms, setting the design standard, driving implementation, and ensuring that what employees experience matches what was intended.

The role provides senior input into platform decisions, annual change cycles, and cross-functional technology strategy, and acts as the primary benefits design voice in all HR technology conversations.

The role requires someone who understands both the benefits landscape and the systems that enable it, someone who can translate complex program requirements into scalable, compliant system design, and who has the judgment to govern risk, challenge vendors, and make sound trade-off decisions at enterprise scale.

Reporting – Senior Director, Global Benefits, Wellbeing & Recognition

Responsibilities

Key Accountabilities

The role carries accountability across five core areas:

Benefits System Design & Configuration Standards

  • Own the strategy and design standard for how benefits programs are configured across all platforms, defining eligibility rules, enrollment logic, data flows, and end-to-end process design across all countries
  • Ensure configuration decisions are intentional, consistent, and aligned with global program design principles, not inherited defaults or regional workarounds
  • Take design ownership when new programs, plan changes, or country expansions require system configuration decisions
  • Translate benefits program requirements into clear system design specifications for HRIT, vendor, and implementation teams
  • Maintain a living design documentation library that captures configuration standards, decision rationale, and country-level variation rules

Global Benefits Platforms Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the global roadmap for benefits administration platforms, including Equinix Benefits and vendor solutions (e.g. PlanSource, Darwin, Benifex), defining priorities, sequencing, and phasing of platform enhancements, implementations, and annual change cycles
  • Balance business needs, system constraints, risk, and capacity to drive effective platform decision-making
  • Anticipate and plan for emerging technology requirements, ensuring the platforms roadmap supports future benefits strategy and global scaling needs
  • Coordinate with HRIT, People Experience, and Payroll on implementation and annual review activity, acting as the senior owner for benefits systems outcomes across regions

Governance, Risk & Release Oversight

  • Establish and oversee governance frameworks for benefits systems, including change control, release management, and risk mitigation
  • Own readiness decision-making for major releases, implementations, and annual enrollment, ensuring testing standards and controls are consistently applied across platforms
  • Proactively identify and manage system, data, and operational risks before they reach employees or create compliance exposure

Workday & HR Technology Leadership

  • Serve as the senior benefits design lead for Workday implementations, enhancements, and integrations, defining how benefits requirements are translated into system configuration, not just flagging issues after the fact
  • Partner with HRIT leadership to align benefits design requirements with the broader HR technology strategy and multi-year systems roadmap
  • Ensure data integrity, eligibility accuracy, and payroll-adjacent controls are maintained across all integrated systems

Recognition Program Oversight & Vendor Strategy

  • Own the strategy, governance, and evolution of Equinix's global recognition programs, including vendor strategy, platform design, and performance management
  • Ensure recognition platforms are designed and configured to meet program objectives, scalable globally, and operationally effective across regions
  • Own strategic vendor relationships across benefits platforms and recognition providers, setting expectations, managing escalations, and holding partners accountable for delivery
  • Act as the senior point of contact for Benefits systems matters with HR, Finance, IT, and regional leaders

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field.

  • CEBS designation or equivalent professional certification preferred

Experience

  • 15+ experience leading global HR or benefits systems programs in complex, multi-country environments, with a strong focus on system design and strategy
  • Deep expertise in benefits administration platforms and how benefits programs are configured within them, including hands-on experience with platforms such as PlanSource, Darwin, Benifex, or equivalents
  • Strong experience partnering with Workday and HRIS teams on integrations and system changes, with the ability to define and defend benefits design requirements in technical forums
  • Demonstrated experience overseeing recognition or rewards platforms, including vendor governance and program performance management
  • Proven ability to manage risk, prioritize work, and make trade-off decisions at an enterprise level, comfortable with ambiguity and competing priorities
  • Strong stakeholder influence and vendor management capability, able to hold senior partners accountable and build alignment across functions without formal authority
  • Experience working within a global COE model, balancing central design governance with the operational realities of regional deployment

Skills and Attributes

  • Strategic Design Ownership - Thinks upstream. Focused on how benefits should be designed and built to work in systems, not just whether systems are running. Brings intentionality to configuration decisions and sets a standard others can build on
  • Strong Judgment and Prioritization - Makes clear decisions in complex, high-change environments. Able to weigh risk, business need, and capacity simultaneously and land on the right call without over-engineering the analysis
  • Risk-Aware and Detail-Conscious - Balances speed with control and accuracy. Catches design and configuration issues early, and doesn't let urgency become a reason to compromise quality or governance
  • Executive Presence - Credible and confident with senior HR, IT, Finance, and vendor leadership. Communicates platform strategy and design decisions clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Technically Fluent, Strategically Minded, deep enough in the technology to challenge vendors and make sound design decisions, but able to zoom out and connect systems work to broader benefits strategy and business outcomes
  • Resilient and Decisive - Manages pressure and ambiguity without escalation dependency. Stays composed through high-stakes release cycles and competing demands, and keeps work moving

job.title: Hyperscale Customer Program Manager 4 - Singapore - Hong Kong - Sydney
job.description:
Job Summary

This is a senior, high-visibility role at the heart of Equinix’s most strategic growth engine. As a Hyperscale Customer Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of large, complex xScale deployments for some of the world’s largest cloud and AI customers, spanning multiple sites, regions and internal teams. You will be the single point of accountability for the customer programme: from contract handover and design, through construction and commissioning, to acceptance, billing and close-out. You will operate with significant autonomy, engage at executive level with customers and internal leadership, and help shape how Equinix delivers at hyperscale.

Responsibilities

Program Delivery & Execution

  • Lead large-scale, cross-functional, multi-site and cross-regional customer deployments from contract handover through to acceptance and closure.
  • Own the integrated programme schedule, deployment plans and lifecycle milestones, aligning design, construction, commissioning and ready-for-service dates.
  • Translate contract commitments (lease terms, technical specifications, delivery dates and SLAs) into a clear, baselined delivery plan.
  • Track critical-path dependencies such as permits, utility power, long-lead equipment and customer fit-out, and drive mitigation plans.
  • Identify, manage and mitigate delivery risks and in-flight changes, communicating impact clearly and early to customers and internal stakeholders.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Manage the change order process end to end: scope, impact assessment, pricing input, approval and contract alignment.
  • Track billing and rent commencement milestones so revenue is recognised on time and invoicing is accurate.
  • Support book-to-bill and backlog reporting with accurate forecast dates and delivery status.
  • Protect Equinix’s commercial position by ensuring work only proceeds against agreed scope and approved changes.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary customer interface throughout delivery, maintaining an executive-level presence and trusted-advisor relationship.
  • Run the programme governance rhythm: weekly delivery calls, monthly approval committees and executive reviews covering progress, risks, decisions and milestones.
  • Produce clear, concise executive reporting, including status dashboards, risk registers, issue notices and close-out documentation.
  • Build lasting relationships with customer stakeholders across construction, operations, procurement and leadership.

Escalations & Issue Resolution

  • Independently manage standard and mid-level escalations; partner with senior leadership on complex or contractual issues.
  • Drive resolution with professionalism and persistence, holding internal teams and vendors accountable for commitments and outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Coordinate across Sales, Legal, Design & Construction, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement and external vendors to align delivery.
  • Lead without direct authority, setting clear ownership and actions and removing blockers proactively.
  • Manage a smooth handover from construction to operations/customer, including commissioning, customer acceptance and onboarding.

Continuous Improvement

  • Capture and apply lessons learned through customer and internal debriefs to improve future deployments.
  • Contribute to standard processes, templates, tooling and governance within the global Customer Service Delivery organisation.
  • Mentor and support less experienced Customer Program Managers and contractors where needed.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 8+ years’ experience managing large, complex, customer-facing programmes in data centre, construction, technology or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Proven ability to work with minimal supervision, exercise sound judgement and own delivery outcomes end to end.
  • Experience engaging and influencing at executive level with enterprise or hyperscale customers.

job.title: Director, Security Operations - APAC
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

The Director, Security Operations, APAC leads the protection of EdgeConneX data centers across the Asia-Pacific region and supports global security standardization. The role is accountable for the continuous operation of physical and electronic security at every facility in the region, for the performance of the contracted guard force, and for the regional security team. This is a customer-facing position at sites operated for major cloud and enterprise customers, and it is expected to uphold the standard of EdgeConneX excellence.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead the APAC security operations team and direct the contracted guard force across the region.
  • Hold accountability for physical and electronic security across all APAC facilities, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and alarm response.
  • Own the full lifecycle of security vendor contracts, including scope development, tender, statement of work drafting, renewal, and post-award performance review.
  • Own regional incident response, including customer notification, internal escalation, and law enforcement engagement.
  • Direct local investigations into security incidents and support broader investigations led by other functions.
  • Support emergency response planning, drills, and activation at sites across the region.
  • Serve as the accountable regional authority for customer security escalations and as liaison to customer security teams.
  • Hold each site in compliance with customer-contracted security specifications, and support customer, third-party, and certification audits relating to EdgeConneX security.
  • Own the regional physical security operating expense budget, including monthly variance reporting.
  • Conduct and oversee site security audits and field audits of security personnel.
  • Define, write, and support the rollout, implementation, and adherence to EdgeConneX operational security standards across the region.
  • Maintain alignment between regional operations, the Global Security Operations Center, and the global security standards program.
  • Report regional security performance, risks, and recommendations to leadership.
  • Work closely with regional operations teams to deliver the security element of a world-class data center experience for customers.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise access control and video management platforms is required; experience with S2, ExacqVision, and Genetec is preferred.
  • Strong communications, both written and verbal, in leading teams and coordinating with peers and other disciplines on driving projects and issues to closure.
  • Commitment to organizational excellence and constant awareness to seek opportunities to improve processes and quality of deliverables.
  • Strong and effective collaborator across disciplines and peer groups, able to cover the full range of tasks required to get a job done.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with computer systems related to security and reporting.
  • Business fluency in English is required. Working proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Malaysia, or Japanese is an advantage.

Experience / Education

  • Minimum 10 years in physical or corporate security, including at least 5 years leading a team or a multi-site security program.
  • Experience managing security programs in a corporate, data center, law enforcement, government, or contracted security services provider environment.
  • Site security audit and project management experience.
  • Multi-country experience across Asia-Pacific, with working knowledge of private security licensing and jurisdictional security requirements in the markets in scope.
  • Experience with third-party contracts and statements of work related to physical security and manned guarding.
  • Experience providing risk and threat assessments at the strategic and tactical level, demonstrating critical thinking and exceptional judgment in information analysis and problem-solving.
  • Ability to apply security knowledge to third-party certifications such as PCI/DSS, SOC 2, and ISO 27001.
  • Experience in the data center industry.
  • Working understanding of the interface between physical security and information security, including identity and access management integration.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Industry security certification such as CPP or PSP is highly desirable

job.title: Associate, Portfolio Management
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Purpose

This is a key role within Keppel DC REIT’s Portfolio Management Department, which focuses on monitoring, analysing, forecasting and optimising asset/portfolio performance to drive long-term performance and resilience of the portfolio. The key objectives of this role will be to support and contribute to the successful delivery of consistent performance and distribution to Keppel DC REIT’s Unitholders, maximizing risk-adjusted investment returns.

The role provides opportunities for driven individuals to be exposed to and collaborate with cross-functional teams including colleagues from the asset management, investor relations and sustainability, investments and finance departments, to develop cross-functional skill sets.

Scope of Work

Portfolio reporting and analysis. Responsibilities include assisting in the

  • Preparation of quarterly board and results documents and trustee reports.
  • Preparation of monthly portfolio updates, incidents and sustainability reports.
  • Tracking and reviewing annual asset budgets (e.g. capital expenditures) and the analysis of variances against portfolio level forecasts.
  • Monitoring industry and competitor news for benchmarking and analysis.
  • Monitoring market, sustainability and Health and Safety (HSE) related news that could affect the assets under management, highlighting key topics internally where relevant.
  • Coordinating annual workplace safety visits for senior management (with the assistance of the Asset Managers).
  • Ongoing compliance with the Group’s compliance and risk management policies / processes, working with the Asset Management team to drive the target for zero control breaches/audit findings.

Sustainability initiatives which include supporting the:

  • Collation and submission of ESG benchmarking initiatives (e.g. GRESB).
  • Monitoring, reporting and review of sustainability targets.
  • Consolidation and review of efficiency metrics (e.g. PUE) and work closely with the asset and facility managers to assess and propose green initiatives (e.g. renewable energy, green rating) for implementation.
  • Preparation of sustainability reporting and monitoring measures.

Coordinating, managing, and reviewing (together with various internal stakeholders)

  • Annual assets’ valuation and hold-sell analysis
  • Annual insurance adequacy and renewal
  • Annual internal audit
  • Annual report
  • Technical audit (where relevant)

Planning the Annual Strategy meeting with the Board. Responsibilities include

  • Coordination with the various internal departments (e.g. Asset Management, Finance, Investments, and Investor Relations) for presentations.
  • Coordinating with external consultants or guest speakers on portfolio strategy or market / industry related presentations where relevant.

Supporting special projects assigned which include

  • Portfolio wide systems integration
  • Investments and divestments
  • Strategic asset management projects

Ad hoc support on portfolio related matters including

  • Q&As / presentations for investor meetings.
  • Participating in due diligence and/or acquisition support (e.g. circulars / review of announcements etc.) if needed

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Pre-requisites:

  • Possess degree in business, finance, economics or related field disciplines or equivalent
  • Minimum 1-3 years’ experience of relevant working experience, Experience in data centre or real estate investments and/or SREITs will be an added advantage. Fresh graduates with relevant internship experience and ability to demonstrate relevant skillsets may be considered.
  • Ability to multi-task and work with ambiguity at times, in a fast growing platform
  • A self-motivated team player who is meticulous, detailed oriented, organized and able to learn quickly, independently with strong analytical skills
  • A strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management skill and ability to interact well with different functions and levels.
  • Excellent written and oral communication and presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Proficient in financial modelling and analytical work
  • Interest to learn and be exposed to sustainability related requirements
  • Proficient with market and industry research

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Connectivity

PLATFORM

Fund Management

job.title: 24/7 Service Technician
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia and New Zealand's leading data centres.

  • Critical Infrastructure experience or HVAC or Electrical trades are desired
  • Tailored CDC Academy and hands-on training provided
  • 24/7 Shift - 2 days, 2 nights- 4 days off

About Us

CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand's leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities across ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

At CDC, our Service Technicians work in live data centre environments, supporting the operation of mission‑critical infrastructure.

If you’ve spent time in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, a lot of this will feel familiar. Working to procedures, taking safety seriously, and understanding the impact of your work is critical. A data centre applies those same principles to power, cooling, fire systems and monitoring, all operating continuously. The difference is the environment, the scale, and the opportunity to apply your skills in a stable, growing industry.

Data centre experience isn’t required. We welcome people from a range of hands‑on technical backgrounds and provide training and support to help you apply your existing skills in a more operational, monitoring‑focused environment.

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day:

  • Monitoring and responding to alarms and alerts across power, cooling, and fire systems
  • Performing physical inspections to ensure equipment and infrastructure are operating within defined parameters
  • Responding to faults and incidents, prioritising actions, and determining when escalation or contractor support is required
  • Carrying out operational switching and control activities to prevent unplanned outages
  • Supporting planned maintenance and monitoring contractors on site, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures and approved methods of operation
  • Documenting incidents, maintenance activities, and observations to support continuous improvement

This role works on a rotating 24/7 shift roster (2 days, 2 nights, 4 off) and suits individuals who are comfortable making decisions, following defined processes, and working calmly in high‑reliability environments.

Benefits, Training and Offerings:

Our training program provides tailored content through our CDC Academy, specifically designed for individuals starting out in this role. You'll learn hands-on by shadowing and working alongside our experienced Service Technicians, gaining essential knowledge to develop your skillset.

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy - Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You and Requirements for the Role:

You have experience working in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, or other critical infrastructure environments where safety, reliability, and process are critical.

For those currently on the tools, this role represents a move into data centre operations. Rather than performing day-to-day trade work, you'll be monitoring critical infrastructure, coordinating activities, and following established operational procedures.

The role also requires a level of computer literacy, as you'll be responsible for maintaining documentation, updating procedures, completing reports, and using site systems to support day-to-day operations.

Desirable experience:

  • A trade or technical background in Electrical, Refrigeration/HVAC, Mechanical, or a related field (highly desirable)
  • Experience working in critical or high‑availability environments with strong safety and compliance requirements
  • Exposure to monitoring or control systems such as BMS, EMS, or SCADA‑type platforms
  • Familiarity with complex infrastructure or plant equipment (e.g. HVAC systems, power systems, generators, fire systems)
  • Strong fault‑finding, problem‑solving, and situational awareness skills
  • The ability to produce clear documentation, logs, and post‑incident reports

Essential:

New Zealand Citizenship or PR with the ability to obtain a government clearance.

How to Apply:

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

Applications close for internal applicants on Friday 23rd October
