job.title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred

Job Specific Description

This role will serve as a technical specialist for cybersecurity, embedded software architecture, and Linux-based control/HMI platforms used in Cummins Power Generation products, including generator set controllers, power system controllers, connected devices, service interfaces, and next-generation embedded platforms.

The position is primarily responsible for defining and driving cybersecurity architecture, software architecture, and Embedded Linux system architecture , ensuring that products are secure, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with evolving regulatory, product, and technology requirements.

The role will lead architecture and design decisions spanning secure boot, software update, identity and access management, cryptographic services, secure communications, diagnostics, platform hardening, application isolation, logging, provisioning, and lifecycle security , while ensuring that these capabilities are integrated coherently within the overall embedded software platform.

A major focus of the position will be supporting both control platforms from traditional RTOS-based embedded systems as well Embedded Linux-based architectures , while establishing reusable software and cybersecurity foundations that can be adopted across multiple controller families and product programs.

The individual will work closely with PCRA, embedded software, controls, platform, systems engineering, validation, digital, service tools, manufacturing, and application engineering teams. Approximately 10–20% of the role will focus on system-level architecture and system integration , ensuring that cybersecurity and software platform decisions remain aligned with overall product architecture, power system behavior, external interfaces, and validation strategy.

The role is expected to provide technical leadership without direct authority , drive structured architecture decisions, establish reusable platform capabilities, identify architectural risks early, and ensure traceability from requirements through architecture, implementation, verification, and product deployment.

Key Responsibilities (Job-Specific)

  • Lead definition and evolution of embedded cybersecurity architecture for Power Generation controllers/HMI/ATS/AUX and connected embedded platforms.
  • Define cybersecurity concepts and architecture for capabilities including:
  • Secure boot and chain of trust
  • Firmware authenticity and integrity verification
  • Secure software update and rollback protection
  • Device identity and certificate management
  • Cryptographic key management and provisioning
  • Hardware-backed security and secure key storage
  • Identity, authentication, authorization, and access control
  • Secure diagnostics and service access
  • Secure communications and protocol security
  • Security logging, audit, and event management
  • Secure manufacturing and device provisioning
  • Vulnerability management and product security lifecycle
  • Secure decommissioning and credential lifecycle management
  • Develop and maintain reusable cybersecurity platform services and abstractions that can be leveraged by applications, communication stacks, service interfaces, manufacturing tools, and operating-system components.
  • Drive architecture for the use of hardware security capabilities , including secure elements, HSMs, TPMs, TrustZone-class mechanisms, MCU security peripherals, hardware crypto accelerators, protected key storage, lifecycle controls, and debug-access protection where applicable.
  • Ensure software and cybersecurity architectures support applicable security standards, regulations, and industry practices, including relevant requirements from IEC 62443, ISO/SAE 21434 where applicable, NIST guidance, EU Cyber Resilience Act, EU Machinery Regulation, UL requirements, IEC standards, and applicable IETF security standards .
  • Lead cybersecurity architecture reviews, threat modeling activities, trust-boundary definition, attack-surface analysis, and mitigation planning for embedded control platforms and associated communication interfaces.
  • Define and evolve the embedded software architecture for controller platforms, including software layering, platform services, application frameworks, middleware, hardware abstraction, runtime services, communication services, persistence, diagnostics, security services, and system management.
  • Establish clear software architecture principles for modularity, portability, testability, maintainability, scalability, fault containment, interface stability, and controlled dependency management .
  • Define reusable software architecture patterns that support deployment across multiple controller families, hardware variants, product configurations, and operating-system environments.
  • Lead architecture and migration strategies for moving selected control platforms from RTOS-based software architectures to Embedded Linux-based systems while preserving appropriate real-time, reliability, safety, and cybersecurity characteristics.
  • Define Embedded Linux platform architecture covering:
  • Boot architecture and boot-time sequencing
  • Bootloader integration
  • Secure boot
  • Kernel configuration and hardening
  • Device tree and hardware abstraction
  • System services
  • Process and service decomposition
  • Inter-process communication
  • Application isolation
  • File-system architecture
  • Persistent storage
  • Read-only and immutable system partitions where appropriate
  • Logging and diagnostics
  • Resource management
  • Network configuration
  • Security policies
  • Software update mechanisms
  • Recovery and rollback
  • Containerization or application sandboxing where appropriate
  • Establish Linux platform engineering practices for system service architecture, Yocto-based build systems, package management, software composition, configuration management, reproducible builds, SBOM generation, secure update, and platform lifecycle management .
  • Define separation between platform software, reusable middleware, cybersecurity services, product-specific applications, control applications, and external interfaces .
  • Partner with software development teams to ensure architecture decisions are implementable and provide sufficient detail through architecture specifications, reference implementations, interface definitions, design patterns, and reusable platform components.
  • Facilitate structured technical design discussions covering cybersecurity, software architecture, Linux platform architecture, and embedded communications.
  • Drive clear architectural decisions by documenting alternatives, trade-offs, constraints, rationale, risks, assumptions, and follow-up actions.
  • Establish and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and other design-governance mechanisms to improve consistency and institutionalize important technical decisions.
  • Identify architectural gaps, technical debt, security weaknesses, dependency risks, scalability limitations, and integration risks across existing and next-generation embedded platforms.
  • Define migration strategies for legacy architectures where immediate replacement is not feasible, balancing product lifecycle, business constraints, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering cost.
  • Ensure architecture supports field-serviceability, diagnostics, manufacturing, provisioning, software update, calibration, validation, and product support requirements throughout the full product lifecycle.
  • Define architecture for secure embedded communication across interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN/J1939, RS-485, USB, OPC UA, Modbus, MQTT, HTTPS/TLS, and other product-specific protocols .
  • Ensure protocol implementations use appropriate authentication, encryption, authorization, certificate handling, key management, session security, and attack-resilience mechanisms.
  • Partner with enterprise, digital, cloud, and service-tool organizations where embedded controllers interface with external services, ensuring clear security boundaries and ownership across device, edge, service tool, cloud, and enterprise systems.
  • Support architecture for secure integration with service tools, manufacturing tools, engineering tools, calibration tools, diagnostics applications, and firmware delivery systems .
  • Define software interfaces and security controls for device provisioning, firmware signing, software packaging, manufacturing personalization, key injection, certificate issuance, and field-update workflows.
  • Ensure software architectures support observability and diagnosability , including structured event logging, fault reporting, health monitoring, audit records, security events, and platform diagnostics.
  • Work with validation and cybersecurity verification teams to define architecture-driven verification strategies, including:
  • Security functional testing
  • Penetration testing
  • Fuzz testing
  • Protocol robustness testing…

job.title: Logistics Site Operations Leader
job.description:
Job Summary

Provides operations leadership for small or medium size warehouse or Distribution Center, shift or department. Manages one or multiple shifts of warehouse operations including transportation and packaging. Provide safe working environment for all Cummins and contract employees. Ensure internal and external customer requirements are met through the Cummins Operating System.

Key Responsibilities

Provides operations leadership and improvement focus for warehouse operations including transportation and packaging operations driving results, creating and monitoring measures, providing motivation, and setting expectations in safety, quality, production and cost. Communicates with customers, suppliers, shop floor, stakeholders, and staff. Leads annual operating plan, forecasts, and other measurements for Parts Distribution Center operations. Manage and develop supply chain capability; work with employees to set goals in training and development, performance, and career planning. Set the aim for the organization and ensure individual work plans are consistent with supply chain initiatives. Responsible for ensuring Cummins values are demonstrated in the site. job.title: Product Design, Product Engineer/ Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary

This product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Applies and improves processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) and tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team. Competencies:

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.

Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.

Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Skills

  • Strong understanding of ADS components like Doser, Mixers and/or fuel systems components.
  • Proficiency in 3D modeling tools (Creo) and engineering drawing standards (GD&T).
  • Knowledge of design tools and methodologies (DFMEA, DFM, DFA, DV&V).
  • Familiarity with Cummins processes (VPI, PPT, CPS) and tools (Windchill, RV&S).
  • Ability to interpret simulation results (structural and flow analysis).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes and product validation techniques.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in CES products or Fuel Systems product lines
  • 6–8 years of product design and development experience preferred.

job.description:
Job Summary

Under general supervision, uses statistical analysis, collaborative cross-functional intelligence, and validated planning parameter settings to disaggregate the demand plan and determine the optimal inventory levels. Aligns the supply plan with the demand plan and drives stability in the supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations.
  • Engages in HSE training.

Quality Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures. Performs quality checks on system planning parameters (min/max inventory level, re-order point, upper/lower tracking signals, segments, etc.) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP). Delivery

  • Performs supply and demand analysis, highlighting areas of concern for the next 12 months.
  • Assists others in gathering and compiling information through primary and secondary research.
  • Runs planning parameter setting changes in the simulation environment to analyze the impact to KPIs, and provides executive and detailed report of results.
  • Monitors signals indicating abnormal demand and/or stock levels feeding the supply schedule.
  • Makes adjustments to the planning parameter settings if approved.
  • Enters approved forecast adjustments at the detail level to align with the aggregate demand plan.
  • Takes ownership and accountability for the disaggregate demand plan, supply plan, and inventory plan that supports end Customer needs.
  • Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies.
  • Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals.

Teamwork

  • Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams.
  • Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals.
  • Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc.) projects.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

​Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

​Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Network Master Supply Planning - Uses statistical analysis and collaborates with other disciplines to provide a long term view of customers demand, and ensures the supply plan is aligned with the demand plan; balances supply and demand in a manner that achieves the financial and service objectives, while stabilizing the supply chain and optimizing the supply chain tensions.

Analyze and interpret KPIs to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Lead Six Sigma and functional process improvement teams. Liaise with functional stakeholders to mitigate mid-term supplier or customer constraints. Mentor and coach supply chain planners. Ensure common processes are being utilized and internal controls are in place Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

​Part Change Control Management - Evaluates and implements engineering change request (obsolescence, supersessions, new part release, etc.) to meet customer delivery requirements while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

Master Supply Scheduling - Establishes and maintains a valid Master Production Schedule for a family of products, which meets customer’s expectations and requirements while maximizing operational efficiency; validates procurement scheduling, production scheduling, and replenishment planning are aligned to manufacturing and assembly assets for conversion.

Material Planning - Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.

job.title: Executive - Aviation Safety
job.description:
Operational Safety Inspections:

Conduct routine safety inspections across airside operations to ensure compliance with regulatory and organizational safety protocols.

Identify hazards during inspections and coordinate with relevant teams to address and mitigate safety risks effectively.

Incident Reporting and Follow-up:

Document and report all safety-related incidents or near-misses, and support investigation processes by gathering information and preparing reports.

Follow up on reported incidents by coordinating with the Lead and other teams to implement corrective actions and prevent recurrence.

Emergency Readiness Coordination:

Assist in the preparation and execution of emergency drills, ensuring all personnel are familiar with emergency response procedures.

Review and support the update of emergency action plans based on drill outcomes, ensuring alignment with regulatory standards and operational needs.

Safety Communication and Awareness:

Conduct regular briefings and OHS training sessions with airside staff to reinforce safety protocols, ensuring all personnel understand current safety guidelines.

Distribute updated safety information and reminders, promoting a culture of continuous safety awareness among all operational teams.

Data Management and Safety Analytics:

Maintain accurate records of safety data, incidents, and inspections to support data-driven decision-making.

Perform basic analysis on safety trends to identify recurring issues and areas for improvement, providing insights to the Lead for strategic safety planning.

Conduct Safety Incident Investigations and Reporting:

Conduct thorough investigations into safety incidents, including gathering evidence, interviewing witnesses, and analyzing root causes.

Implement corrective and preventive actions to address identified safety issues and prevent recurrences, ensuring continuous improvement.

Assist in Safety Policy Implementation:

Support the implementation of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) policies and procedures across the airport, ensuring they are understood and followed by all staff.

Safety Management and Compliance:

Support the development and execution of the Safety Management Plan (SMP) as per guidelines.

Help conduct safety inspections and hazard assessments, ensuring alignment with OSHAS and SMS standards.

Support Environmental Compliance:

Assist in implementing the Environmental Management Plan by monitoring compliance activities.

Participate in environmental data collection, record-keeping, and reporting as required by ISO-14001.

Health Program Support:

Contribute to health compliance initiatives by helping document and monitor health-related activities.

Ensure health records are maintained accurately and assist with non-conformity (NC) closures.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Lead - Aviation Safety (Regional)

Airside Operations Team

Engineering and Maintenance

Security Team

Compliance Department

Ground Handling Agents

Key Stakeholders - External:

Regulatory Authorities (DGCA, BCAS)

Airport Concessionaires

Airlines

Emergency Response Agencies

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Aviation Safety, Aerospace Engineering, Safety Management, or a related field is essential.

Preferred Postgraduate degree in Aviation Safety or Safety Management.

Certification Requirements: Airport Safety and Operations Specialist (ASOS), Certified Safety Professional (CSP) , Project Management Professional (PMP), Aerodrome Safety Management System (SMS) Training by DGCA.

Work Experience:

3-5 years of experience in aviation safety, airside operations, or a similar role within the aviation industry.

job.title: Lead - Site Sales
job.description:
Responsibilities

A. Site Sales and Revenue Generation

  • Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for the assigned real estate project.
  • Manage the end-to-end sales process from initial inquiry to booking closure.
  • Engage with prospective customers visiting the project site or sales experience centre.
  • Understand customer requirements, budgets, preferences, and investment objectives.
  • Recommend suitable units based on customer requirements and available inventory.
  • Present project features, amenities, location advantages, specifications, and value propositions.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved pricing and discount guidelines.
  • Drive unit bookings, booking value, revenue generation, and inventory movement.
  • Identify and prioritize high-potential prospects to improve conversion rates.
  • Develop action plans for slow-moving units and priority inventory.

B. Lead Management and Conversion

  • Manage leads received through digital campaigns, channel partners, walk-ins, referrals, corporate outreach, and other sources.
  • Contact leads within the prescribed turnaround time.
  • Qualify prospects based on budget, location, unit preference, purchase timeline, and funding requirements.
  • Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective customers through telephone, email, messaging platforms, and meetings.
  • Update lead status, follow-up remarks, and customer interactions in the CRM system.
  • Schedule project presentations, virtual discussions, and physical site visits.
  • Maintain an active sales funnel and ensure timely movement of leads across different sales stages.
  • Re-engage inactive and previously contacted leads through structured follow-up campaigns.
  • Ensure accurate classification of leads as qualified, unqualified, follow-up, negotiation, booked, lost, or deferred.
  • Record reasons for lost or dropped leads to support conversion improvement.

C. Customer Presentation and Site Visits

  • Conduct professional project presentations for prospective customers and their families.
  • Explain unit layouts, floor plans, specifications, amenities, construction status, and possession timelines.
  • Arrange and conduct project tours, sample flat visits, and experience centre walkthroughs.
  • Explain available inventory, price options, payment plans, and applicable commercial charges.
  • Address customer queries related to the project, developer, approvals, construction progress, and buying process.
  • Ensure the project site, sample apartment, sales lounge, and customer presentation areas are prepared for scheduled visits.
  • Provide customers with approved brochures, cost sheets, layout plans, and project-related documents.
  • Ensure that only approved and updated project information is shared with customers.

D. Pricing, Inventory and Commercial Management

  • Maintain a detailed understanding of unit-wise inventory, availability, pricing, and payment plans.
  • Prepare accurate cost sheets based on unit selection and approved pricing.
  • Explain the complete price structure, including base value, floor-rise charges, preferential location charges, parking, amenities, taxes, and other applicable charges.
  • Obtain necessary approvals for discounts, offers, waivers, or commercial exceptions.
  • Ensure that commercial commitments made to customers are properly approved and documented.
  • Track booked, available, blocked, cancelled, and priority inventory.
  • Coordinate with Sales Planning and Finance teams for inventory and pricing updates.
  • Promote priority and slow-moving inventory based on business requirements.
  • Maintain confidentiality of pricing strategies, customer information, and commercial approvals.

E. Negotiation and Sales Closure

  • Handle customer objections related to pricing, location, configuration, competition, possession timelines, and payment terms.
  • Develop appropriate negotiation strategies based on customer profile and business requirements.
  • Communicate the project’s value proposition and differentiators effectively.
  • Facilitate discussions between customers and senior sales leadership where required.
  • Obtain necessary internal approval for negotiated commercial terms.
  • Encourage customers to complete booking formalities within agreed timelines.
  • Ensure that the booking amount and required documents are collected accurately.
  • Minimize booking cancellations through clear communication and transparent selling.

F. Booking and Documentation Coordination

  • Assist customers in completing booking application forms and related documentation.
  • Verify customer details, unit information, commercial terms, payment plan, and booking value before submission.
  • Coordinate with CRM, Finance, Legal, Sales Operations, and Collections teams for booking processing.
  • Ensure timely collection of booking amounts and required KYC documents.
  • Facilitate customer handover from the Sales team to the CRM or Customer Experience team.
  • Maintain records of booking forms, cost sheets, approval notes, payment details, and customer communications.
  • Support the resolution of discrepancies related to pricing, inventory, booking terms, or customer documentation.
  • Ensure customer commitments are properly captured and communicated to relevant stakeholders.

G. Channel Partner Coordination

  • Build and maintain relationships with authorized channel partners and brokers.
  • Conduct project briefings, presentations, and site familiarization sessions for channel partners.
  • Share approved project updates, inventory information, campaign details, and sales collateral.
  • Support channel partners in arranging customer meetings and site visits.
  • Track channel partner leads, visits, conversions, and booking performance.
  • Ensure channel partner leads are registered and managed according to company policy.
  • Coordinate with the Channel Sales team to resolve lead ownership or attribution issues.
  • Support channel partner activation initiatives to improve project sales.

H. Customer Relationship Management

  • Deliver a professional and customer-focused experience during every interaction.
  • Build trust through accurate, transparent, and timely communication.
  • Maintain regular contact with customers until the booking is completed and formally handed over.
  • Address customer concerns in coordination with relevant internal departments.
  • Avoid making unauthorized commitments regarding pricing, possession, specifications, or modifications.
  • Encourage customer referrals and repeat business opportunities.
  • Capture customer feedback and share relevant insights with management.
  • Ensure customer data is handled securely and confidentially.

I. Market Intelligence and Competitor Analysis

  • Monitor competing projects, pricing, offers, configurations, amenities, and sales strategies.
  • Conduct periodic competitor site visits and market surveys.
  • Track customer preferences, buying behavior, and common objections.
  • Provide management with market intelligence and competitor updates.
  • Identify emerging customer segments and potential sales opportunities.
  • Recommend changes in sales pitch, campaigns, pricing communication, or inventory positioning based on market feedback.
  • Maintain updated competitor comparison reports.

J. MIS and Sales Reporting

  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, follow-ups, site visits, negotiations, bookings, and lost opportunities.
  • Track source-wise lead quality and conversion performance.
  • Report sales funnel movement and expected closures to management.
  • Prepare sales forecasts and booking projections.
  • Update CRM records and sales trackers within prescribed timelines.
  • Participate in sales review meetings and present pipeline status.
  • Maintain accurate data for management dashboards and performance reviews.

K. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with Marketing for campaign leads, promotional activities, and customer events.
  • Work with CRM and Customer Experience teams for booking handover and customer communication.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams for payment confirmation and commercial clarification.
  • Work with Legal teams for agreement-related customer queries.
  • Coordinate with Project and Construction teams for verified project progress updates.
  • Work with Design and Sales Planning teams for unit plans, layout details, and inventory information.
  • Collaborate with Facility, Security, and Administration teams to ensure smooth customer visits.
  • Escalate critical customer issues to the appropriate authority for timely resolution.

L. Process Compliance and Governance

  • Follow approved sales processes, pricing guidelines, and delegation of authority.
  • Ensure all discounts, waivers, and special commercial terms are formally approved.
  • Comply with applicable real estate regulations and internal policies.
  • Maintain complete documentation for bookings and commercial approvals.
  • Ensure accuracy and transparency in all customer communications.
  • Support internal audits and provide required sales records.
  • Follow data privacy, customer confidentiality, and ethical selling practices.
  • Ensure that project information is communicated strictly through approved sales materials.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Real Estate, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or postgraduate qualification in Sales and Marketing is preferred.
  • Certification in real estate sales, customer relationship management, or negotiation would be an advantage.

Experience

  • 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in real estate sales, site sales, direct sales, or project sales.
  • Experience in residential, commercial, plotted development, retail, or luxury real estate sales.
  • Prior experience with a reputed real estate developer or property advisory organization is preferred.
  • Proven experience in managing customer meetings, project presentations, site visits, negotiations, and booking closures.
  • Experience in handling premium or high-value real estate customers would be an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of CRM systems, sales MIS, inventory management, and booking documentation.
  • Experience in coordinating with channel partners and internal support teams.
  • Prior experience in independently managing a project sales pipeline or mentoring junior sales executives is preferred.

job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:

  • Ensure adherence to safety protocols and regulatory standards, conducting regular audits and training to maintain a safe work environment. Proactively identify risks and implement corrective actions to ensure full compliance with safety regulations.

Production Oversight:

Quality Assurance:

Team Leadership:

Problem Solving and Troubleshooting:

  • Identify and resolve technical issues to minimize downtime, collaborate with maintenance teams for equipment reliability, and ensure continuous production flow.

Health and Environmental Compliance:

  • Ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations, promote safe work practices, and implement measures to minimize environmental impact during production.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of production activities, generate shift reports, and analyze data to track performance metrics and support decision-making processes.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, reduce costs, and improve efficiency through root cause analysis, implementing corrective actions, and participating in improvement projects.

  • Cluster Manager - Cell Process
  • Technicians and Operators within Cell Process
  • Quality Control Inspectors

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Equipment Suppliers
  • Maintenance Contractors
  • Regulatory Authorities

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • B.Tech – Electronics/Chemical / Metallurgy/ Renewable Energy
  • Desired Qualification : BE/Btech

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • Min 2 - 5 years of experience in managing backend Process activities, focusing on SPC Control, yield improvement, and process optimization.

job.title: Lead, Cyber Exposure Specialist
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

The Lead, Cyber Exposure Specialist will be responsible for developing and operating the organization’s enterprise-wide cyber exposure management strategy. This role is responsible for identifying, analysing, prioritising and reducing cybersecurity exposures across the organisation’s technology external and internal environment (on-premise, cloud, application, endpoint, network, appliances, and identity). The role extends beyond traditional vulnerability management by correlating vulnerabilities with asset criticality, attack-path exposure, threat intelligence, active exploit activity and existing security controls.

Make an Impact by

Remediation and Stakeholder Management:

  • Work with system owners, infrastructure teams, application teams and technology vendors to support timely remediation.
  • Communicate vulnerability risks and remediation requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Track vulnerability remediation against established service-level agreements and risk-based timelines.
  • Escalate critical, overdue or repeatedly recurring vulnerabilities to the appropriate management and risk forums.
  • Support exception and risk-acceptance processes when vulnerabilities cannot be remediated within the required timeframe.
  • Assess proposed compensating controls and monitor approved risk exceptions until remediation or expiry.
  • Conduct re-scans or other validation activities to confirm that vulnerabilities have been successfully remediated.
  • Maintain accurate evidence and audit trails for vulnerability identification, assignment, remediation and closure.

Cyber Exposure Management

  • Develop and continuously improve the organization’s cyber exposure management methodology, processes, standards and operating procedures.
  • Maintain a consolidated view of vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, external attack-surface exposures, identity weaknesses and other exploitable security conditions.
  • Correlate exposure information from vulnerability scanners, cloud security platforms, endpoint tools, application security testing, penetration tests, threat intelligence and attack-surface management platforms.
  • Assess exposures across:

On-premises infrastructure and data centres. ii. Public and private cloud environments. iii. Network and security devices. iv. Endpoints and servers. v. Applications, APIs and containers. vi. Identity and access-management platforms. vii. Internet-facing systems and third-party services.

  • Identify unknown, unmanaged, unscanned or incorrectly classified assets through network discovery and asset-reconciliation activities.
  • Monitor authenticated or credentialed scanning coverage and resolve scanning failures, access issues and data-quality gaps.
  • Ensure scanning and assessment activities are conducted safely and do not adversely affect production services.

Vulnerability Analysis and Prioritization:

  • Review and analyse vulnerability findings to determine validity, severity, exploitability and potential business impact.
  • Prioritise vulnerabilities using factors such as CVSS scores, known exploitation, threat intelligence, asset criticality, external exposure and compensating controls.
  • Distinguish genuine security risks from false positives, duplicate findings and informational observations.
  • Perform thematic and trending analysis to identify recurring vulnerabilities, common root causes, affected technologies and systemic control weaknesses.
  • Analyse vulnerability patterns across business units, asset groups, technology platforms and remediation teams.
  • Identify vulnerabilities that may indicate broader issues involving patching, configuration management, asset management or technology obsolescence.
  • Monitor emerging vulnerabilities, actively exploited vulnerabilities and relevant vendor security advisories.
  • Provide actionable recommendations for vulnerability remediation, mitigation or risk treatment.
  • Participate in post-incident and lessons-learned reviews to improve exposure identification and response processes

Reporting and Continuous Improvement:

  • Produce operational and executive reports covering vulnerability exposure, remediation performance, overdue items and risk trends.
  • Develop dashboards and metrics such as scan coverage, credentialed scan success, vulnerability ageing, remediation SLA compliance and recurrence rates.
  • Present thematic and trend analysis to highlight systemic security weaknesses and improvement opportunities.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring or widespread vulnerabilities.
  • Recommend improvements to scanning coverage, prioritisation models, workflows, procedures and reporting.
  • Support audits, regulatory reviews and security assessments by providing vulnerability management records and evidence.
  • Maintain vulnerability management procedures, technical standards, operational guides and knowledge articles.
  • Evaluate exposure-management technologies and support proofs of concept, product selection and implementation

Automation and Integration

  • Design and maintain automated workflows for exposure ingestion, enrichment, prioritisation, ticket creation, escalation, validation and closure.
  • Develop scripts using Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, Bash or similar languages.
  • Integrate security platforms with ServiceNow and other enterprise ITSM, CMDB, SIEM and workflow platforms using REST APIs, JSON and webhooks.
  • Automate the creation of vulnerability response items, incidents, security incidents, change requests and remediation tasks.
  • Ensure automatically generated tickets contain relevant information defined by the organization’s vulnerability prioritize framework.
  • Automate ticket assignment, reminders, escalations, rescan requests, status updates and closure following successful validation.
  • Ensure appropriate audit trail, retry mechanisms, duplicate prevention, error handling and reconciliation controls.
  • Monitor integration performance and promptly investigate failed or incomplete transactions.
  • Maintain technical documentation, API mappings, integration diagrams and operational support procedures.

AI-Enabled Exposure Management

  • Assess opportunities to use AI-assisted capabilities to analyze exposure data, identify attack relationships and improve prioritization.
  • Monitoring how frontier AI accelerates vulnerability research, exploit development and attacker operations.
  • Apply AI responsibly to support vulnerability enrichment, thematic analysis, threat correlation, remediation recommendations and reporting.
  • Validate AI-generated findings and recommendations before operational use.
  • Ensuring sensitive vulnerability and asset information is handled in accordance with the organization’s AI, data protection and security policies.
  • Work with relevant teams to manage risks arising from AI-generated code, AI agents and machine identities.

Cloud Security Posture Management

  • Experience in securing at least one major public cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Ability to identify, validate, prioritize and drive remediation of cloud misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, excessive permissions, exposed services and non-compliant resources.
  • Experience assessing cloud identity risks, including excessive privileges, inactive identities, service accounts, workload identities, access keys, and privilege-escalation paths.
  • Experience defining cloud security policies, configuration baselines, and guardrails aligned with recognized frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, NIST CSF, CSA Cloud Controls Matrix.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimally 6 years of proven experience managing zero day or critical and actively exploited vulnerabilities in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong knowledge of cyber exposure management, vulnerability management and attack-surface management principles.
  • Demonstrated experience managing zero day or critical and actively exploited vulnerabilities in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong knowledge of cyber exposure management, vulnerability management and attack-surface management principles.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Palo Alto Cortex Exposure Management, Checkpoint or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong understanding of authenticated scanning, network discovery, scan-policy configuration and vulnerability validation
  • Practical experience with scripting such as Python, workflow automation and API integration
  • One or more Industry security Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CEH, Microsoft security, Cloud security or other equivalent industry certifications
  • Practical experience implementing or operating CSPM or CNAPP solutions such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Palo Alto Prisma, Wiz, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong stakeholder management decision-making, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.

Good to have

  • Working knowledge of threat intelligence, exploit techniques, indicators of compromise and attacker tactics.
  • Experience integrating security tools with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms using APIs and webhooks.
  • Strong data-analysis and reporting skills using SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Splunk or equivalent technologies.
  • Understanding of SIEM, EDR, NDR, IDS/IPS, WAF and SOC monitoring processes.
  • Understanding of AI assisted tooling for vulnerability or exposure management.

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

Take the leap with Singtel to shape what’s next and accelerate your growth.

Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Your expertise in DevOps best practices, system resilience, modern technologies and tools, as well as application development and testing, will be instrumental in establishing and evolving Singtel’s engineering standards. You will be part of a dynamic Agile team of container, cloud, and DevOps engineers, working across business units to design, build, and deploy cloud and container platforms. Acting as a change agent, you will drive the adoption of modern engineering practices and partner with stakeholders across divisions to build and enhance Singtel’s cloud services and container ecosystem.

Make an Impact by

  • Develop, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient and reliable container and pod deployments.
  • Automate platform provisioning, configuration, and operations for AKS, EKS and OCP using tools such as terraform
  • Setting up, supporting and operating service mesh
  • Contribute to the definition of long-term strategy, roadmap, and engineering standards for container platforms, including AKS, EKS and other K8S platform
  • Demonstrate familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, including relevant services supporting containerized environments
  • Collaborate effectively within large, cross-functional teams to deliver organizational goals and platform capabilities.
  • Utilize DevOps toolchains such as Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo and Nexus Repository to support development, collaboration, and release processes.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimally 5 years of proven experience in Application Development, with 3 years of experience in implementation of DevOps and supporting container Platform.
  • Certified in Openshift Container Platform / AKS / EKS
  • Proficient in OpenShift Container Platform, AKS, EKS, Docker, Service Mesh, YAML
  • Documentation of architecture and standards.

Good to have

  • Ceritifed in Kubernetes administration / RHEL administrator / AWS / Azure
  • Proficient in Bit Bucket, Confluence, Jira, Python, Ansible, Jenkins, Terraform, Bamboo

job.title: Network Engineer, Optical Deployment
job.description:
Meta is looking for an Optical Deployment Engineer who will be responsible for the deployment and support of a large-scale global optical network. As a member of this team, you will have a unique opportunity to be involved in projects related to implementation & scaling of the optical network at Meta. A strong candidate for this role is an engineer who can adapt to changing technical requirements and evolving network architectures. An engineer with a track record of learning new technologies, identifying process improvements, and developing practical solutions to operational challenges. As an Optical Deployment Engineer, you propose new ideas, gather constructive feedback from others, and drive those ideas through to implementation.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, and support a large-scale production optical network that spans long-haul terrestrial, regional metros and subsea networks, interconnecting data centers and Points of Presence (POP) sites across all regions with a primary focus on APAC region
  • Create and maintain Engineering Design Packages for subsea, metro, regional and long-haul DWDM rings/systems
  • Generate implementation plans and provide technical leadership and guidance during deployment activities
  • Collaborate with vendors/manufacturers to evaluate new hardware/software and create optical standards for network deployment teams
  • Review Acceptance Documents provided by vendors and subcontractors deploying equipment on our network
  • Provide technical expertise to network provisioning engineers for troubleshooting out-of-service or faulty circuits
  • Plan, schedule and perform complex network migrations
  • Work closely with the cross functional teams of Network Engineers, Planners, Logistics Vendors, and Fiber Providers to ensure seamless introduction of new optical technologies into the production network
  • Proactively contribute to documentation, automation and processes as they evolve
  • This role will involve some pre-planned travel from time to time

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience deploying optical networks
  • Experience with optical network design, installation and maintenance for service providers or enterprise networks
  • Knowledge of optical theory, transport technologies and the operation of optical transport systems
  • Experience with field-based work on Subsea Deployments, POPs, ISP, data centers and central office environments
  • Experience with optical test equipment and optical troubleshooting experience using OTDR, OSA, BERT and optical power meters
  • Experience creating rack elevations and other planned/install/as-built documentation
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent deployment projects, including scheduling, prioritization, and documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Knowledge of coding in at least one language (i.e., Python), preferably for network or systems automation with knowledge of scripting languages
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Experience working in a large cross-functional global team environment
  • Knowledge of cable landing stations & data center design and operational best practices
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP protocol, network management protocol, network routing protocol (like BGP), Layer 2 concepts (e.g., STP, VLANs etc.), IPv6, and network monitoring

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Facilities Engineer - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Under minimal supervision, maintains and repairs plant equipment, buildings and grounds.

Key Responsibilities

Oversees the functioning of building systems including electrical, Heating, Ventilation, and Air Condition (HVAC), structural, mechanical, fire/life safety, etc. Leads project management and oversees contractors for complex facilities renovation projects entailing mechanical, structural, Heating, Ventilation, and Air Condition (HVAC), electrical, production floor arrangement, etc. Documents repairs and maintenance completed. Trains less experienced Facilities Engineers, technicians and line workers on complex repairs and maintenance requirements. Coaches and mentors less experienced Facilities Engineers.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Situational adaptability - Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.

Emergency Preparedness - Plans, manages and supports the site’s emergency preparedness program; identifies risks and develops a risk management plan to address incidents such as power outage, flood, and fire; manages the maintenance of emergency systems for fire and flood protection; reports any system impairments.

Environmental Stewardship and Sustainability - Develops and directs the site’s environmental stewardship using appropriate or recognized sustainability programs.

Facilities Design and Development - Plans and manages the design of facilities considering the requirements and needs of owners and occupants of the facility; manages and supports site construction activities in compliance to building standards.

Facility Technology Management - Plans, directs and manages facility management business and operational technologies; evaluates, implements and operates integrated workplace management systems; conducts assessments and collaborates on facility management technology needs analysis including audio, visual, and Information Technology capacity and phone systems.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree required.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required.

The Facility Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliable operation and maintenance of plant utilities, infrastructure, buildings, and facility services to support safe, efficient, and uninterrupted manufacturing operations. The role focuses on managing utilities such as compressed air, water, power distribution, centralized coolant systems, facility upkeep, housekeeping, gardening, and overall plant infrastructure.

Utility Management

  • Ensure the availability, reliability, and efficiency of plant utility systems including:
  • Compressed Air Systems
  • Industrial & Domestic Water Systems
  • Centralized Coolant Systems
  • DG Sets and Power Distribution Systems
  • HVAC and Ventilation Systems
  • Monitor utility consumption and drive cost optimization initiatives.
  • Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activit

Building & Infrastructure Management

  • Ensure upkeep and maintenance of plant buildings, roads, drainage systems, parking areas, and associated infrastructure.
  • Coordinate civil, electrical, and mechanical maintenance activities.
  • Manage facility expansion, renovation, and infrastructure improvement projects.
  • Ensure facilities comply with safety, statutory, and environmental requirements.

Facility Management

  • Manage day-to-day facility operations to maintain a safe, clean, and productive work environment.
  • Oversee facility-related contracts and service providers.
  • Ensure timely resolution of facility maintenance requests.
  • Maintain asset records and facility documentation.

Housekeeping & Gardening Management

  • Lead housekeeping activities to maintain world-class cleanliness standards across the facility.
  • Manage landscaping and gardening activities to enhance the plant environment.
  • Ensure contractor compliance with quality, safety, and service standards.
  • Conduct periodic audits and implement improvement actions.

Safety, Compliance & Sustainability

  • Ensure compliance with EHS, statutory, environmental, and facility management requirements.
  • Conduct safety inspections, risk assessments, and support internal/external audits (ISO, EHS, customer, and regulatory).
  • Drive energy conservation, water management, waste reduction, and sustainability initiatives.
  • Promote a safe and environmentally responsible workplace through continuous improvement and compliance monitoring.

Vendor & Contractor Management

  • Manage facility service providers, contractors, and utility vendors.
  • Monitor contractor performance, quality, cost, and adherence to safety requirements.
  • Prepare scope of work, evaluate quotations, and support procurement activities.

Job Facilities

Organization Cummins Inc.

Role Category On-site with Flexibility

100% On-Site Yes

job.description:
Job Description

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.) is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer a comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

  • Short Circuit Protection and Selectivity Concepts
  • Industrial Applications and Control Circuits

  • SLDs (Single Line Diagrams)

  • Proven experience in handling large-value tenders and techno-commercial proposals for electrical/control gear products.
  • Strong commercial acumen with understanding of pricing strategies, costing, margins, and contractual terms.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision making.
  • Effective stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination capabilities.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and customer-facing communication skills.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems, MS Excel, and tender management tools.

Job Responsibilities

job.title: Sr. Engagement Manager, AWS Professional Services India
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead and deliver complex, multi-work stream cloud transformation programs for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) APJC (ANZ, ASEAN, INDIA, Korea, Japan). In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of large and complex customer engagements, shaping cloud strategies, driving business outcomes, and acting as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders. The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams. You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple work-streams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to per-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/Gen AI to drive delivery innovation. In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%) to customer sites in APJC. You will report into the India ProServe Engagement Management Delivery Practice Manager.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own and lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-workstream cloud transformation programs, ensuring business outcomes are achieved within schedule, scope, and financial constraints.
  • Shape and validate cloud delivery strategies for complex engagements, applying frameworks such as the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well-Architected Framework (WAF), and Engagement Delivery Framework (EDF).
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, driving alignment, and building deep trusted relationships.
  • Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation plans; redirect distressed programs to delight customers.
  • Maximize engagement value by negotiating conditions of acceptance, managing scope changes, and amending contractual terms within project constraints.
  • Drive delivery excellence across engagements by defining and sharing EM best practices, creating reusable mechanisms, and establishing operational excellence.
  • Actively mentor and develop team members; perform Technical Promotion Assessments (TPAs) and coach Engagement Managers to raise the bar.
  • Participate in pre-sales activities, contributing to proposals, scoping, and business development for complex services engagements.
  • Leverage Agentic AI and GenAI to optimize delivery processes, improve team productivity, and drive innovative customer outcomes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional AWS teams including Delivery Consultants, Account Executives, Cloud Architects, and Partner teams to solution and deliver cloud programs.
