job.title: Senior Applied Scientist, (AiRES)
job.description:
AWS Support includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

Do you have proven analytical capabilities to identify business opportunities, develop advanced ML solution, Gen AI products, predictive models and optimization algorithms to help us build state of the art Support organization?

Team AiRES (Analytics, Insights, Research, Engineering and Science) is looking for a passionate Applied Scientist to deliver insights and identify opportunities through the use of statistics, machine learning, and deep learning to drive business and operational improvements. A successful candidate must be passionate about building solutions that will help drive a more efficient operations network and optimize cost. In this role, you will partner with data engineering, Tooling team, operations, Training, Customer Service, Capacity planning and finance teams, driving optimization and prediction solutions across the network.

At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. We set big goals and are looking for people who can help us reach and exceed them. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is one of the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform, offering over 200 fully featured services from data centers globally. Amazon Web Services, Inc. provides services for broad range of applications including compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), security, and application development, deployment, and management.

Key job responsibilities Team AiRES is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Senior Applied Scientist with a strong machine learning background who will be responsible for establishing scalable, efficient, automated processes for carrying out large-scale data analysis, machine-learning model development, model validation and serving customers. You will serve as a key scientific resource in full-cycle development (conception, design, implementation, testing to documentation, delivery, and maintenance).

As an Senior Applied Scientist in our team, you will be responsible for the research, design, and development of new AI technologies for personalization and will adopt or invent new machine learning and analytical techniques in the realm of recommendations and large language models. You will collaborate with scientists, engineers, and product partners locally and abroad. Your work will include inventing, experimenting with and launching new features, iterating models & stay up to date on latest enhancements in the Data Science ecosystem.

A day in the life You will collaborate closely with other Data Scientists and leverage Amazon’s heterogeneous data sources and large-scale computing resources to accelerate development of multimodal Large Language Models and Generative Artificial Intelligence solutions and will own the end to end development & deployment at scale of Generative AI and ML solutions developed by the team. Prior experience in Advanced Applied science & Engineering proficiency in deploying models & optimizing for the best optimal solution will be mandatory.

About the team Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
  • PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
  • Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
  • Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning
  • Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability
  • 4+ years of applied research experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
  • Experience in applied research

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
job.description:
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS) AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.

Key job responsibilities You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.

You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.

Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.

In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

job.title: Senior Account Executive, Energy and Local Council
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Account Executive to own the Energy and Local Council portfolio within our New Zealand Public Sector team, driving cloud adoption, digital and Agentic AI transformation across two sectors that are foundational to how New Zealand lives and works.

Energy is the backbone of New Zealand's critical infrastructure, and local councils are at the heart of community wellbeing — shaping the services and systems communities rely on every day. Your objective is to build strong, trusted relationships across both sectors and to help their leaders realise their ambition to grow, modernise and better serve New Zealanders.

You will develop deep relationships with energy and local government organisations, understand their operating environments and transformation goals, and work backwards from their needs to bring the best of AWS to the mission. You will operate with a long-term view — building and qualifying a pipeline and owning the customer's experience of AWS end to end.

The successful candidate pairs a strong sales track record with genuine curiosity for the sectors they serve, and is equally comfortable with story building and data analysis for decision making.

What Makes This Role Different

  • Support the backbone of New Zealand. You will work with the energy organisations that power the country and the councils that keep communities running — helping modernise infrastructure that New Zealanders depend on.
  • Build relationships measured in years. You will earn the trust of executives, digital and IT leaders across energy and local government through demonstrated credibility and a genuine commitment to their ambition to grow.
  • Enable community wellbeing. You will help local councils deliver better services and improve how communities operate — connecting technology directly to community outcomes.
  • Shape the future with AI and modernisation. You will help customers move legacy systems to the cloud and understand where AI and digital products create real value for the energy and local government sectors.

Key job responsibilities

  • Develop and execute account strategies that align AWS solutions with customer transformation goals across the energy and local council portfolio, driving revenue growth and consistently achieving or exceeding targets.
  • Build enduring, trusted relationships with executives, digital and IT leaders, and partners across the energy and local government sectors.
  • Support customers' modernisation to the cloud, and position AWS services — including AI and digital products — to help them grow, improve resilience and better serve their communities.
  • Work with Solutions Architects, Partner teams and AWS service teams to design solutions, lead proof-of-concepts and pilots, and articulate value in terms of community outcomes, operational efficiency and cost optimisation.
  • Develop territory plans and accurate forecasts, track pipeline and revenue, and identify emerging opportunities across New Zealand's evolving energy and local government landscape.
  • Navigate New Zealand public sector procurement, and represent AWS at relevant industry events and forums.

A day in the life Morning: Coffee with an energy provider's digital lead. You discuss modernising legacy systems to the cloud — improving the resilience of infrastructure that powers homes and businesses across the country.

Midday: Workshop with a regional council on a new digital services platform. Residents will be able to access council services online, faster and more easily than ever before.

Afternoon: Demo how AI and data can help an energy distributor forecast demand and manage the grid more efficiently — supporting the transition to renewable energy.

job.title: Snr Specialist Analytics SA – ASEAN, WWSO Data APJC
job.description:
In this role, as a Specialist Solutions Architect, you will be the analytics expert for customers across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam. You will help them build and operate analytics, search, and streaming workloads, and partner with them to design agent-ready data platforms: open, governed foundations that let AI agents search, process, and analyse data to support decision-making. The work spans the full range of modernisation, from moving on-premises Hadoop and legacy data warehouses to an open lakehouse on Apache Iceberg and S3 Tables, through to semantic search, natural language data exploration, and RAG-based insight generation.

ASEAN is one of the fastest-growing data markets in the world, and many customers are still deciding where their data platform will live. You will work with banks, telcos, retailers, public sector agencies, and digital natives as they make that decision, often in head-to-head evaluations against Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Fabric, and GCP BigQuery. Grounded in deep analytics expertise, you will bring a broad perspective that spans databases, ML, and security, and you will advise on governance and access control as much as on performance and cost.

You will build reference architectures, demos, and workshops with your own hands and scale them across six countries through account teams and partners. Partners deliver much of the analytics work in ASEAN, so enabling them to land complex platforms such as SageMaker Unified Studio is a core part of the role. You will also carry the voice of ASEAN customers back to the AWS analytics, search, streaming, and generative AI service teams to shape their roadmaps.

Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences. Every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it for ASEAN. If you see that shift as an opportunity and want to co-create new value with customers across the region, come join us and build the future together!

Key job responsibilities

  • Provide deep technical expertise in analytics, search, streaming, and governance (Redshift, Athena, EMR, Glue, Kinesis, MSK, OpenSearch, Lake Formation, DataZone, SageMaker Unified Studio, S3 Tables, QuickSight) across ASEAN's enterprise, public sector, and digital-native customers
  • Design agent-ready data platforms on open lakehouse, Iceberg, zero-ETL, RAG, and semantic search
  • Lead architecture reviews, immersion days, proofs of concept, and migrations (MAP) off Hadoop, legacy warehouses, and third-party platforms
  • Win competitive evaluations against Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Fabric, and GCP BigQuery
  • Enable partners and build repeatable assets that scale across six countries
  • Carry customer feedback and competitive signals back to service teams to shape the roadmap

A day in the life Your customers span Financial Services, Telecommunications, Retail, Public Sector, and Digital-Native companies. One morning you run an open data platform workshop in Singapore; by lunch you are designing governed data access for a Manila bank's first production agents. In the afternoon you build a RAG proof of concept with OpenSearch and Bedrock for a Jakarta retailer, then help a partner unblock a SageMaker Unified Studio rollout, before sending field feedback to the Redshift service team. You travel regularly across a region where the decisions customers make today will set their data platform for the next decade.

About the team The WWSO Data & AI team helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies. This role sits on the APJC Data team alongside Analytics, Database, and Storage Specialist SAs and GTM Specialists across five geos. In ASEAN, you work closely with the Analytics GTM Specialist, the Database and Storage Specialist SAs, the partner team, and account teams in each country to deliver holistic data outcomes. If you thrive on going deep on technology, love building for customers, and measure success by the architectures you've shaped, this is the role for you.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding experience
  • Experience defining data center system-level architecture, documenting performance and equipment requirements, creating and communicating conceptual designs, and creating and maintaining project documentation
  • Experience working with technical and business stakeholders from global cross-functional teams
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Deep hands-on experience with analytics technologies, including data warehousing (e.g. Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, Teradata), data lakes, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink), search (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch), and data governance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience and demonstrated industry leadership in the fields of database or data warehousing, data sciences and big data processing
  • AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Bachelor's degree
  • Experience designing agent-ready data platforms (open lakehouse, Iceberg, zero-ETL, RAG, semantic search)
  • Experience across multiple Southeast Asian markets and building reusable assets at scale
  • Fluency in English required; a Southeast Asian language (e.g. Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, Vietnamese) is a plus

job.title: Manager, Digital & Technology (IT Security)
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

This role is responsible for leading the organisation's cybersecurity architecture, security engineering, infrastructure security, endpoint security, application security and data protection functions. The incumbent will drive the cybersecurity technology roadmap, oversee the cybersecurity platform ecosystem, and ensure security-by-design principles are embedded across infrastructure, cloud, data, AI and application initiatives.

The role will work closely with infrastructure, cloud, network, application, data, OT and business teams to strengthen the organisation's cyber resilience, reduce cyber risk and enhance security capabilities through architecture governance, technology implementation and continuous improvement of cybersecurity controls.

In addition, the role will lead team responsible for managing cybersecurity platforms, application security, data protection and enterprise security architecture.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and execution of the organisation's cybersecurity architecture and technology roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise technology strategy.
  • Establish and maintain cybersecurity architecture standards, security patterns, technical guidelines and reference architectures.
  • Lead security architecture reviews for infrastructure, cloud, network, endpoint, application, data and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Assess emerging technologies, cybersecurity threats and new business initiatives to identify security risks and recommend appropriate controls.
  • Ensure security-by-design principles are incorporated throughout solution design, development and project delivery lifecycles.
  • Oversee security controls across enterprise infrastructure, cloud environments, networks and endpoints.
  • Lead the deployment, configuration, administration and optimisation of cybersecurity platforms across the enterprise.
  • Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of endpoint protection, hardening standards, vulnerability management and privileged access controls.
  • Lead the organisation's application security programme, including secure development practices, security assessments and remediation activities.
  • Oversee data protection controls including data classification, encryption, key management, DLP and privacy requirements.
  • Partner with development, data and business teams to embed security controls throughout the application and data lifecycle.

Requirements

  • Degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • 5 years of cybersecurity experience with at least 2 years in a leadership or managerial role.
  • Strong knowledge of:Security Architecture
  • Infrastructure & Endpoint Security
  • Cloud Security (Azure, Alibaba Cloud)
  • Application Security & Secure SDLC
  • Data Security & Privacy
  • IAM/PAM
  • Security Platforms (SIEM, EDR, DLP, Email Security, Vulnerability Management)
  • AI Security and API Security

Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls, ISO 27001 and relevant regulatory requirements.Strong stakeholder management, project delivery and vendor management experience.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer
job.description:
AI FactoryOS Operations

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system.

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against.

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability. It also builds the shared services the estate's own operation depends on, and runs them. Operating the estate every day is what shows how the platform behaves under real load and under failure, and the function works with the engineering teams that build it to turn what it finds into permanent fixes and design improvements.

Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer

Role Summary

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer runs the Kubernetes estate that every product and every tenant runs on: the platform controller layer, the virtual cluster platform tenants are provisioned onto, the Kubernetes environment baselines used across the estate, the GPU integration layer, and the automated tenant onboarding and release pipeline.

This is a hands-on senior role with deep technical expertise. This role owns the platform lifecycle execution across the fleet: keeping clusters healthy and current across the fleet, keeping tenant workloads running through upgrade and failure, and restoring control planes to service when they degrade. Automation is a first-class part of the role, in the operational tooling, guarded remediation and fleet orchestration that make estate-scale operation possible, delivered as controlled code and reviewed by AI Infrastructure where it affects service behaviour.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the reliable operation, automation and continuous improvement of the multi-tenant Kubernetes platform that Firmus' products and tenants run on, spanning every site in the estate.
  • Build the operational tooling, guarded remediation and orchestration that automate operations at fleet scale, and contribute operator and controller requirements, and code where agreed, to AI Infrastructure's platform backlog with the production evidence behind them.
  • Execute the Kubernetes cluster lifecycle across the fleet, including provisioning, patching, upgrade and decommissioning, running the deployment and upgrade mechanisms built by AI Infrastructure through the agreed staged or canary path, and holding estate version compliance and retirement coordination.
  • Operate and recover Kubernetes control planes carrying live tenant workload, including etcd state, certificate rotation, failed upgrades and corrupted resources.
  • Operate the virtual cluster platform and multi-tenant isolation patterns that tenants are provisioned onto, and the automated tenant onboarding and release pipeline that lands new tenants safely and repeatably.
  • Operate the GPU integration layer for Kubernetes (for example the NVIDIA GPU Operator), including device plugins, GPU scheduling and driver coordination.
  • Diagnose and resolve scheduling failures, CNI and CSI faults, admission rejections and resource contention from first principles, and drive continuous improvement in cluster validation, CI/CD automation, and provisioning and testing frameworks.
  • Run the Kubernetes baselines in production carrying the admission policy, workload identity and network policy content set by the Senior Platform Security Engineer, and hold the operational acceptance requirements those baselines have to meet before they enter production.
  • Provide the deepest technical expertise for Kubernetes faults across the estate, diagnosing the faults that require internals-level knowledge to root cause, and driving the permanent fix to closure through AI Infrastructure, and mentor the engineers who carry frontline diagnosis, documenting operational procedures, runbooks and performance results.
  • Lead technical recovery during major Kubernetes incidents under the incident commander, drive the changes that remove repeat causes through the problem record, and share the after-hours escalation roster for the Kubernetes estate.

Skills & Experience

Required Skills

  • Strong skills in platform and infrastructure engineering, with 8+ years of experience overall and substantial ownership of production Kubernetes platforms in a 24/7 environment.
  • Deep experience operating Kubernetes at fleet scale, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades and multi-cluster management.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes control plane internals, including etcd, the API server, controllers, schedulers, and certificate and credential rotation.
  • Strong experience writing Kubernetes controllers, operators or admission logic in a production setting.
  • Experience with multi-tenant or virtual cluster patterns (for example vCluster or equivalent), including tenant isolation at the Kubernetes layer.
  • Experience operating GPU-enabled Kubernetes, including device plugins, GPU scheduling and driver coordination (for example the NVIDIA GPU Operator).
  • Strong skills in infrastructure automation, infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices (for example OpenTofu or Terraform, Ansible, Argo CD), with change delivered through peer review, automated testing and progressive rollout.
  • Strong experience with scripting or programming for operational automation and tooling, such as Go, Python or Bash.
  • Proven ability to act as a senior escalation point in production, including major incident response, on-call participation, post-incident review, and the production of runbooks that others can execute successfully.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes security fundamentals, including admission control, workload identity and network policy.
  • Clear technical judgement and communication skills, with the ability to produce documentation, design notes and escalations that other engineers can act on.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience operating Kubernetes for GPU or HPC workloads at scale.
  • Experience with automated tenant or customer onboarding pipelines in a multi-tenant platform.
  • Experience with vendor Kubernetes distributions or reference architectures for accelerated computing.
  • Familiarity with DPU or SmartNIC-based networking as it relates to Kubernetes CNI design.
  • Experience contributing to open-source Kubernetes ecosystem projects.
  • A Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and training.

Expected Outcomes

  • Fleet-wide cluster upgrades executed through the staged path with no unplanned tenant-visible outage, and version compliance held across the estate.
  • Tenant onboarding running as a routine operation rather than a project.
  • Control plane recovery tested against live-equivalent conditions and executable by an engineer who did not write the procedure.
  • Kubernetes escalations falling as operational automation and guarded remediation take on the common faults.
  • Platform defects and operability gaps evidenced into the platform engineering backlog and closed permanently, with repeat causes falling.

**

Location & Reporting

Location: Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required.

On-call: The function runs 24/7. First line monitoring and first response sit with the operations centre. This role shares the after-hours escalation roster for its domain with the other senior engineers in the function.

job.title: Engineering Intern
job.description:
At Gordon Brothers Industries (GBI), part of the global Johnson Controls (JCI) family, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to some of Australia's most complex and technically challenging industrial refrigeration projects while building a strong foundation for a successful engineering career.

For over 100 years, GBI has delivered innovative refrigeration and cooling solutions to some of Australia's most critical industries, including food manufacturing, cold storage, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, logistics, and industrial processing.

As Australia's leading industrial refrigeration specialist, we combine deep local engineering expertise with the global strength, innovation, and career opportunities of Johnson Controls, a world leader in smart buildings, energy efficiency, industrial cooling, and sustainability.

This is more than a typical internship. You'll gain valuable hands-on experience across the full project lifecycle while working alongside experienced engineers, project managers, technicians, and industry specialists who are committed to supporting your professional growth and development.

Why Join Gordon Brothers Industries?

This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain practical engineering experience within a highly specialised industry while working on real-world projects that make a meaningful impact.

You'll gain exposure to:

  • Industrial refrigeration systems and equipment
  • Engineering design and drafting
  • Project delivery and coordination
  • Manufacturing and construction environments
  • Site inspections, testing, and commissioning activities
  • Workplace safety and engineering standards
  • Technical documentation and reporting
  • Energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives

Whether you're looking to develop your technical expertise, apply your university learning in a practical environment, or explore a career in industrial refrigeration, this role provides an excellent platform to launch your engineering career.

What We Offer

  • Hands-on industry experience on real engineering projects
  • Mentoring and guidance from experienced engineers and industry professionals
  • Exposure to a broad range of engineering disciplines and project activities
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Practical application of university knowledge
  • Potential pathways to future graduate and career opportunities within GBI and Johnson Controls

About the Role

Due to continued business growth, we are seeking a motivated Engineering Intern to join our Brunswick-based team.

Working closely with Engineers, Project Managers, and Service Teams, you will support a variety of engineering and project-related activities while developing your technical capabilities and professional skills in a dynamic industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist engineers with technical research, data collection, and basic engineering calculations.
  • Support the preparation of engineering reports, documentation, and project records.
  • Assist with updating drawings and documentation using AutoCAD and other software tools.
  • Participate in site visits and inspections to gain exposure to industrial refrigeration systems and equipment.
  • Collect, organise, and analyse information for engineering studies, proposals, and reports.
  • Assist with project administration, including document control and progress tracking.
  • Support procurement and material ordering activities.
  • Attend project meetings and assist with recording actions and meeting minutes.
  • Assist with safety documentation, risk assessments, and compliance requirements.
  • Observe and support testing and commissioning activities under supervision.
  • Provide general support across Engineering, Projects, and Service teams.
  • Contribute ideas and feedback to support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Develop an understanding of engineering standards, company procedures, and industry best practices.

About You

We're looking for an enthusiastic and motivated engineering student who is eager to learn, enjoys problem-solving, and is passionate about gaining practical industry experience in a specialised engineering environment.

Essential Requirements

  • Currently studying a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Process, Chemical, Mechatronic, or a related Engineering discipline.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A solid understanding of fundamental engineering principles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
  • A willingness to learn and contribute as part of a team.
  • Current Australian driver's licence (or ability to obtain one).
  • Full Australian working rights.

Desirable

  • Exposure to AutoCAD or similar drafting software.
  • Interest in refrigeration, manufacturing, construction, or industrial processes.
  • Previous experience in a technical, trade, engineering, or industrial environment.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

Join Gordon Brothers Industries and gain hands-on experience with Australia's leading industrial refrigeration company while building the skills, knowledge, and industry exposure needed to launch a successful engineering career.

job.title: Analyst - Customer Success

Analyst - Customer Success (Pune)

Role Overview

We are looking for an Analyst - Customer Success with around 3 to 5 years of experience to provide first-level technical support for OpenBlue Enterprise Manager.   • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

job.title: Sr. Technical Analyst
job.description:
Guidelines (not rules):

  • Accountable for the IT investments for a business unit or business function that has regional or country-level scope
  • Accountable for analyzing, designing, testing, deploying, and supporting solutions.

Sr. Technical Analyst

At Johnson Controls, this role supports a business unit or function through analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design for IT products and projects that support business objectives. You will work closely with business partners and development teams to help ensure solutions are well-defined, successfully delivered, and supported through the full lifecycle.

Role Overview

The Sr. Technical Analyst is accountable for supporting IT investments for a business unit or business function with regional or country-level scope. This role focuses on analyzing needs, gathering requirements, designing practical solutions, and collaborating with development teams to deliver reliable outcomes from analysis through deployment and support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for IT products, enhancements, and projects.
  • Translate business needs into solution designs, functional specifications, user stories, and process flows.
  • Support the analysis, design, testing, deployment, and ongoing support of solutions.
  • Work with business stakeholders to define current-state and future-state processes, gaps, and impacts.
  • Partner with development teams to clarify requirements, review solutions, and support successful delivery.
  • Coordinate and support testing activities, defect triage, and readiness for deployment.
  • Provide support for production issues and help resolve system or process-related concerns.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives and work with related applications and platforms, including ServiceMax, Salesforce, Oracle, and other enterprise systems where applicable.
  • Help ensure deliverables meet expectations for quality, reliability, performance, security, and compliance.
  • Support standardization and continuous improvement across business processes and IT solutions.

How You Will Do It

  • Own the outcome by taking accountability for clear analysis, sound design, and dependable follow-through.
  • Stay close to the work by working directly with business partners to understand needs early and remove obstacles quickly.
  • Translate complexity into clarity by turning business goals into actionable requirements, process flows, and solution details.
  • Work openly with development teams to confirm assumptions, resolve issues fast, and keep delivery aligned with expectations.
  • Improve every day by using feedback, defects, and support cases to simplify processes and strengthen solutions.
  • Win as one team by collaborating across functions, sharing knowledge, and respecting different perspectives.

Qualifications

  • University degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in technical analysis, business analysis, solution design, or a related IT role.
  • Experience gathering requirements and documenting business processes, functional needs, and solution details.
  • Experience supporting the analysis, design, testing, deployment, and support of IT solutions.
  • Experience working with development teams and business stakeholders in a collaborative delivery environment.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to manage priorities and deliver accurate work in a regional or country-level environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ServiceMax, Salesforce, Oracle, or similar enterprise applications.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional projects or multi-application environments.
  • Experience standardizing processes across lines of business or regions.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful IT investments, work across business and development teams, and see your analysis move from concept to delivery and support. You will be part of a practical, collaborative environment where your work helps shape reliable solutions for the business.

If this sounds like the right next step, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Application Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Designs, develops, builds, and implements new components, products, or technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Researching new materials and competitive products. Organizing, coordinating, and executing the building, testing, and analysis of prototypes.
  • Assisting supply specialists and buyers with supplier development and supplier performance. Overseeing the efforts of drafting and testing specialists.

Degree Requirement

Degree required： preferred major mechanical or electrical engineering

Skill Descriptors

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer SAM - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:

The ServiceNow Developer specializing in Software Asset Management (SAM) is responsible for developing and implementing software asset management solutions within the ServiceNow platform. This role involves collaborating with stakeholders to enhance software asset management processes, ensuring compliance with licensing agreements, and optimizing software usage across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Integration: Integrate ServiceNow SAM Pro with SaaS publisher portals through out-of-the-box and custom integrations to improve usage data availability for license reconciliation

  • Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct unit testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure data quality and functionality of developed solutions
  • Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for SAM technical implementations and configurations to ensure knowledge transfer and compliance
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor the performance of SAM solutions and make recommendations for improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
  • Participation in Agile Ceremonies: Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Agile process by providing insights and feedback based on user experiences and testing outcomes
  • Adherence to Code Development Standards: Ensure that all development work adheres to established coding standards and best practices. Engage in code review processes to provide and receive constructive feedback and ensure that code quality meets organizational standards

  • Experience with ServiceNow Discovery, Rest API’s, OOB integrations, IntegrationHub and related applications

job.title: Senior Software Engineer CMDB - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior CMDB Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing the enterprise Configuration Management Database (CMDB) within ServiceNow. This role ensures high-quality, reliable, and scalable configuration data that powers ITSM, ITOM, SAM, APM, and automation initiatives.

This position requires strong technical expertise, architecture thinking, and hands-on development across CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and integrations, along with ownership of data governance, health, and lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

1. CMDB Architecture & Development

  • Design and maintain CMDB data models (CSDM aligned), CI class structures, and relationships
  • Develop and enhance ServiceNow CMDB using:Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, UI Policies

Configure and maintain Discovery, Service Mapping, and CMDB Workspace Implement lifecycle states, CI governance rules, and automation

2. Discovery, Service Mapping & Integrations

  • Build and maintain Discovery patterns, schedules, probes, and MID server configurations
  • Integrate CMDB with enterprise systems (e.g., SCCM, Intune, AWS, Azure, monitoring tools)
  • Define Identification & Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules and normalization processes
  • Ensure trusted system-of-record integration and deduplication strategies

3. Data Quality & CMDB Health

  • Monitor and improve CMDB health KPIs:Completeness, correctness, compliance

Implement:

  • Data certification
  • Duplicate CI detection
  • Reconciliation automation

Conduct root cause analysis for data issues and drive corrective actions

4. Governance & Process Alignment

  • Define and enforce:

CI naming conventions

  • Data standards and policies
  • Lifecycle and ownership models

Align CMDB with ITIL processes:

  • Incident, Change, Problem, Asset lifecycle

Partner with ITSM, ITOM, SAM, APM, Security teams for cross-domain alignment

5. Automation & Innovation

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities:

CI onboarding

  • Data reconciliation
  • Service mapping enrichment
  • Now Assist for CMDB: Enable AI-driven or rule-based CMDB operations (e.g., duplicate detection, anomaly detection).
  • Predictive Intelligence & AIOps: Integrating the CMDB with ITOM Predictive Intelligence to proactively identify configuration anomalies, duplicates, and data gaps.
  • AI-Driven Service Graph Connectors: Leveraging automated data ingestion pipelines that use ML to map third-party data into the CMDB accurately.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work with:

Infrastructure teams (compute, storage, network, cloud)

  • Application owners and architects
  • Asset and procurement teams

Translate business requirements into scalable CMDB solutions Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior developers

job.title: Data Quality Analyst - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

Position Summary

The Data Quality Analyst supports the Enterprise Data and Analytics Data Governance organization in maintaining high-quality, trusted data across key systems. This role assists with data quality monitoring, issue investigation, documentation, and the execution of data governance processes. The analyst works closely with senior team members, data stewards, and data owners to ensure data quality standards are followed, and issues are resolved in a timely manner.

Responsibilities

Data Quality Governance

Purpose: Support the establishment and maintenance of Data Quality (DQ) rules, standards, and processes to ensure high-quality, trusted data across the organization.

Create and Maintain Data Quality Rules and Standards

  • Help update and maintain data quality rules (DQ FRD), metadata, and standards across data domains
  • Support senior analysts in gathering requirements from data owners and stewards

Ensure Regulatory and Organizational Compliance

  • Work with the Data Governance (DG) team and system owners to ensure rules and processes meet internal policies and standards
  • Help validate consistency of DQ rules across Source Systems (SORs)
  • Help monitor and report Data Quality Metrics and Thresholds
  • Assist data owners and stewards in defining measurable DQ metrics and thresholds
  • Help document KPIs and maintain metadata repositories

Recommend and Implement DQ Process Improvements

  • Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to streamline Data Quality workflows and improve governance maturity
  • Support Data Cleansing and Enrichment for LTC Migration
  • Assist in executing cleansing and enrichment tasks as part of the LTC Account and Contact Data Migration
  • Perform data validation, profiling, and documentation activities under guidance

Manage Change Control for DQ Rules and Business Glossary

  • Assist in managing version control for DQ rules, definitions, and glossary updates
  • Document changes and ensure proper review and approval processes are followed

Data Quality Monitoring & Reporting

  • Assist with running automated data quality checks and reviewing results
  • Support dashboard updates by providing data extracts, validation checks, and documentation
  • Monitor DQ rule results and highlight anomalies or trends to senior analysts
  • Help document and track data quality issues, remediation steps, and root-cause insights
  • Collaborate with data owners and stewards to gather information needed for issue investigation and resolution
  • Prepare initial drafts of DQ reports or summaries for review
  • Support Data quality alignment activities with the GMPO Data Quality team
  • Learn and apply data quality best practices through hands-on work and mentorship

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or related field
  • 1–2 years of experience in Data Quality, Data Analytics, or related work (internships and academic projects acceptable)
  • Basic SQL skills and willingness to grow technical proficiency
  • Familiarity with or exposure to data quality concepts, dashboards, or rule-based validations
  • Ability to analyze datasets, identify issues, and communicate findings clearly
  • Strong attention to detail, documentation skills, and eagerness to learn
  • Good communication and collaboration skills

Preferred Certifications (Nice to Have, Not Required)

  • Foundational cloud certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Digital Leader, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals)
  • Introductory SQL certifications (e.g., Microsoft DP-900, Google BigQuery SQL)
  • Entry-level Data Governance or CDMP Associate certification
  • Exposure to any data quality tools (Informatica DQ, Talend, Collibra DQ, etc.)

job.title: Lead Contract Administrator
job.description:
Oversee Contract Management:

Lead the management and oversight of entire process of contract preparation, review, and modification and ensure that all contracts are executed accurately and within the required timelines by drafting contract terms, coordinating with relevant departments for input, and ensuring that all necessary approvals are obtained before finalizing contracts.

Develop and support business plans related to contracts, focusing on efficiency and effectiveness.

Possess expertise in various contract types, including fixed-price, cost-reimbursable, time and materials, and performance-based contracts.

Apply knowledge to manage and modify contracts according to their specific structure.

Research and Analysis:

Undertake comprehensive research on market trends, best practices, and benchmarks relevant to contracts and service delivery. Oversee the preparation and processing of Non-Financial Assessments (NFA), ensuring all necessary documentation is complete and accurate.

Gather data and insights to support decision-making processes for Service Development and Contract Managers.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting:

Monitor, collate, and analyze contract performance information, producing detailed reports to track contract compliance and effectiveness.

Create and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards, presenting data in a clear and actionable format for management review and decision-making.

Prepare and submit financial documents as required by the Airports Economic Regulatory Authority (AERA), ensuring accuracy and adherence to regulatory timelines.

Regulatory Compliance and Risk Assessment:

Ensure that all contracts comply with legal and regulatory requirements, as well as company policies and procedures and monitor compliance with contractual obligations and address any issues promptly to avoid legal or financial repercussions.

Analyze risks associated with specific contract terms, providing recommendations for mitigation strategies.

Tender Management:

Assist in the preparation and submission of tenders by accurately identifying the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and defining the scope of work, ensuring clarity for potential contractors.

Manage the contractor selection process by floating tenders, facilitating negotiations with bidders, and verifying all submitted documentation for compliance ensuring selection of qualified contractors who meet project requirements effectively.

Claim Management:

Oversee the management of claims related to contracts, ensuring they are resolved in a timely and efficient manner.

Coordinate with relevant departments and legal teams to assess, negotiate, and settle claims while minimizing financial and operational impact.

Letter Writing and Communication:

Review and finalise professional letters and official communications related to contract administration.

Ensure all written communications align with organizational standards and effectively convey necessary information to internal and external stakeholders.

Maintain a strong communication channel with stakeholders to ensure transparency and clarity throughout the contract management process.

Dispute Resolution:

Monitor project activities to identify potential disputes early and facilitate open communication among stakeholders.

Lead mediation sessions, ensuring adherence to contractual terms, maintaining thorough documentation and conducting post-resolution analyses to enhance future processes.

Performance and Quality Systems:

Support the implementation of performance and quality systems across area teams, facilitating consistent monitoring and improvement of contract-related activities.

Collaborate with stakeholders to establish clear performance and quality standards, ensuring these metrics are effectively measured and adhered to, thereby promoting compliance and enhancing overall project outcomes.

Brand Protection and Image Promotion:

Promote and protect the company’s brand and image, advising colleagues on appropriate use and representation.

Ensure timely payments to contractors and vendors, maintaining positive relationships and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations.

Continuous Improvement:

Regularly assess and recommend modifications or renewals of contracts based on project requirements and performance evaluations.

Collaborate with internal teams to identify sources for labour, machinery, and materials, enhancing operational efficiency.

Team Leadership and Management:

Advise on and deliver workforce development initiatives necessary for the successful implementation of contracts.

Organize and hire relevant personnel for contract execution and devise development plans for key team members.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven expertise in contract administration within the commercial real estate industry, with a minimum of 15 years of experience.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing multiple projects in commercial construction, including hotels, malls, and multi-storied buildings.
  • Strong negotiation, conflict resolution, and relationship management skills.

Educational Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree in Business Administration or Contract Management is preferred.

Years & Type of Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in contract administration, with a focus on commercial real estate projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects in the construction of hotels, malls, and multi-storied buildings.

Domain Expertise

  • In-depth knowledge of contract management principles and practices specific to commercial real estate.
  • Expertise in handling contracts related to city-side development projects, including hotels, malls, and multi-storied buildings.

Digital & Operational Tools

  • Proficiency in contract management software such as SAP Ariba or Oracle Contract Management.
  • Familiarity with project management tools like Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project.
  • Experience with analytics platforms for tracking contract performance metrics.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Environment
job.description:
Responsibilities

Environmental Compliance & Regulatory Management

  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, and consent conditions issued by CPCB, SPCB, MoEF&CC, and other statutory authorities.
  • Monitor adherence to EC (Environmental Clearance), CTO (Consent to Operate), CTE (Consent to Establish), and other environmental permits.
  • Coordinate with regulatory agencies during inspections, audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Prepare and submit statutory environmental reports within defined timelines.

Environmental Monitoring

  • Monitor stack emissions, ambient air quality, wastewater quality, noise levels, and other environmental parameters.
  • Analyze monitoring data and recommend corrective actions to address deviations.
  • Ensure effective operation and maintenance coordination for environmental control systems such as ESPs, ETPs, STPs, DM plants, and ash handling systems.

Ash & Waste Management

  • Monitor fly ash utilization and ensure compliance with applicable fly ash notification requirements.
  • Oversee hazardous and non-hazardous waste management activities.
  • Maintain records related to waste generation, disposal, transportation, and utilization.

Sustainability & ESG Initiatives

  • Support implementation of sustainability and ESG-related initiatives at the plant.
  • Assist in preparing sustainability reports and environmental performance metrics.
  • Identify opportunities for resource conservation, waste reduction, water conservation, and carbon footprint reduction.

Audits & Documentation

  • Facilitate internal and external environmental audits.
  • Maintain environmental records, permits, licenses, monitoring reports, and compliance documentation.
  • Conduct gap assessments and implement corrective and preventive actions.

Stakeholder Management

  • Liaise with corporate environment teams, plant operations, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
  • Support environmental awareness programs and training sessions for employees and contractors.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in environmental engineering / environmental science / chemical engineering / civil engineering.
  • Master's degree in environmental engineering or environmental management will be preferred.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in Environmental Management within Thermal Power Plants, Power Generation, Energy, Cement, Steel, or Manufacturing industries.
  • Experience in handling statutory environmental compliances and regulatory interactions.
  • Knowledge of air pollution control, wastewater management, ash utilization, and environmental monitoring systems.

job.title: Manager - Utility

Utility Operations Management

job.title: Assistant Manager - Mine Operations
job.description:
1. Shift Management and Coordination

Oversee and manage all mining activities during the assigned shift, including drilling, blasting, loading, and transportation of ore.

Coordinate with the mine planning, engineering, and maintenance teams to ensure all activities are aligned with the overall mining plan and schedules.

Monitor the performance of equipment and personnel, ensuring that operations are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company standards.

2. Safety and Compliance

Enforce safety protocols and procedures during all mining operations, ensuring compliance with the Mines Act and other relevant regulations.

Conduct regular safety inspections and toolbox talks to promote a culture of safety among all shift personnel.

Ensure that all incidents, accidents, or near-misses are reported and investigated, and that corrective actions are implemented promptly.

3. Production and Performance Monitoring

Monitor production metrics during the shift, ensuring that targets are met or exceeded, and identify areas for improvement.

Ensure that ore extraction, transportation, and processing activities are carried out efficiently, minimizing downtime and maximizing productivity.

Provide regular reports on shift performance, production output, and any operational issues to the mine management team.

4. Equipment and Resource Management

Ensure that all equipment is operated and maintained properly during the shift, coordinating with maintenance teams for any repairs or servicing needed.

Manage the allocation of personnel and resources to optimize operational efficiency and ensure continuous production.

Address any equipment breakdowns or operational issues promptly to minimize impact on production.

5. Communication and Reporting

Maintain effective communication with other shift teams and management to ensure seamless transitions between shifts and alignment with overall mining objectives.

Report any significant issues, challenges, or achievements during the shift to senior management and recommend solutions as needed.

Document and report all shift activities, including production data, safety incidents, and equipment status.

Internal Stakeholders:

*HODs

*Employees

External Stakeholders:

*Relevant Authorities

*Forest Department

Qualifications

Education Qualification

Essential: B.Tech/B.E-Mining with First class Manager's Certificate - iron

Work Experience

10 to 12 years

job.title: Manager - Mechanical (Turbine)
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead preventive, predictive, breakdown, and condition-based maintenance activities of Turbine, Generator, and associated auxiliaries.
  • Ensure high availability and reliability of Steam Turbine systems, Condenser, CEP, BFP, CW Pumps, HP/LP Heaters, Deaerator, Vacuum Systems, and associated equipment.
  • Plan and execute Annual Overhauls, Unit Shutdowns, Capital Repairs, and Major Maintenance activities within approved timelines and budgets.
  • Monitor equipment health and implement reliability improvement initiatives to reduce forced outages and repetitive failures.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical equipment failures and drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
  • Develop and execute condition monitoring programs including vibration analysis, thermography, oil analysis, alignment checks, and predictive maintenance techniques.
  • Coordinate closely with Operations, Boiler, Electrical, C&I, CHP, and Engineering teams to ensure optimum unit performance.
  • Ensure effective maintenance planning and execution through SAP PM, work order management, shutdown planning, and spare parts optimization.
  • Supervise and guide maintenance engineers, supervisors, technicians, contractors, and OEM service teams.
  • Monitor and optimize maintenance costs while ensuring equipment reliability and operational safety.
  • Ensure availability and proper management of critical turbine and rotating equipment spares.
  • Drive implementation of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), TPM, Lean Maintenance, and best industry practices.
  • Ensure strict compliance with safety procedures, statutory requirements, PTW systems, LOTO procedures, and environmental standards.
  • Participate in commissioning, refurbishment, performance improvement, life assessment, and modernization projects related to turbine systems.
  • Develop team capability through technical coaching, competency development, performance management, and succession planning initiatives.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

Mandatory

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university.

Preferred

  • M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
  • MBA (Operations) or equivalent management qualification.
  • ### Experience Requirements

12-18 years of Mechanical Maintenance experience.

  • Minimum 7-10 years of dedicated Turbine Maintenance experience in Thermal Power Plants.
  • Experience in utility-scale power units of 300 MW and above.
  • Exposure to Supercritical and Subcritical Turbine technologies.
  • Hands-on expertise in Steam Turbines, Condensers, Feed Water Systems, Pumps, Rotating Equipment, and Turbine Auxiliaries.
  • Experience in major shutdowns, overhauls, refurbishment activities, and reliability enhancement programs.
  • Proven experience in team handling and contractor management.

job.title: Senior Manager, Business Systems
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the Financial Controller, this role will drive finance systems implementation, integration and process improvement initiatives across the Group, with an initial focus on ERP implementation and integration with other business systems. The role will act as the key bridge between Finance, IT, implementation partners, country teams and other business functions to ensure systems are designed around sound finance processes and meet the Group's accounting, reporting and control requirements.

This is a finance-led systems role rather than a pure IT role. The successful candidate should have a strong accounting and finance background together with hands-on ERP implementation and finance transformation experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive ERP implementation and enhancement projects from the Finance side, including requirements gathering, process design, configuration requirements, testing, implementation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Act as the key Finance representative between Finance, IT, external implementation partners, country teams and other business functions.
  • Understand and map end-to-end finance processes and translate finance requirements into system requirements.
  • Drive integration between the ERP and other systems across the Group to improve data flow and reduce manual processes and reconciliations.
  • Work with Consolidation & Group Reporting to move the Group from manual Excel-based consolidation toward a system-based consolidation process.
  • Identify opportunities to automate accounting, close, consolidation, reconciliation and financial reporting processes.
  • Ensure system design supports Group accounting policies, reporting requirements and the Group chart of accounts.
  • Lead finance UAT, issue tracking and resolution for system implementations and enhancements.
  • Support finance master data governance, including chart of accounts, legal entities, cost centers and other key finance dimensions.
  • Work closely with Internal Controls & Governance to ensure appropriate system controls, access controls, approval workflows and segregation of duties are embedded in system design.
  • Develop finance system documentation, procedures and training materials.
  • Support country finance teams through system implementation and adoption.
  • Manage and prioritize finance system enhancements and maintain a roadmap for future improvements.
  • Drive continuous improvement following implementation to ensure the intended efficiencies and benefits are realized.

The successful candidate:

  • Qualified accountant or strong accounting/finance background.
  • Approximately 7–10 years of relevant experience, including finance systems, ERP implementation or finance transformation.
  • Strong understanding of accounting processes, financial close, consolidation and financial reporting.
  • Hands-on experience implementing or significantly enhancing an ERP system.
  • NetSuite implementation experience would be highly advantageous.
  • Experience integrating ERP with other finance or operational systems.
  • Strong project management skills, including requirements gathering, UAT, issue management and implementation.
  • Ability to translate effectively between Finance requirements and technical/system teams.
  • Strong process improvement mindset with a focus on simplification and automation.
  • Hands-on and comfortable driving projects in an environment where processes and systems are still being developed.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Critical Facilities Maintenance Coordinator
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

Key Responsibilities

Helps to design, plan, install, and/or maintain mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure. Learns by providing hands on assistance with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Helps to design, plan, install, and/or maintain mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Learns by providing hands on assistance with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Supports the analysis of current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Supports with evaluating facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Learns the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Learns to repair all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Some understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Some understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Some knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Some knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Some knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Some knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field.
  • Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) preferred.
  • Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.) preferred.
  • Experience required:
  • Entry level experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Relevant demonstrated experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Relevant experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Relevant experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Entry level experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.
