job.title: Territory Sales - Field Sales Account Executive
job.description:
Job Summary

Prospects and develops new opportunities to grow the business. Develops/Executes account plans with coaching support. Achieves sales goals within the assigned sales territory, market segment or channel partners.

Key Responsibilities

Develops opportunities to increase sales by identifying, researching and contacting prospective customers. Develops and executes account plans for top prospects and conducts agreed upon face to face sales calls.

Builds positive customer relationships that enable identification of a customer’s needs, business model and buying process.

Uses understanding of customer needs and priorities to identify and offer Cummins solutions.

Gains agreement on the differential advantage of Cummins solutions by helping the customer understand and evaluate existing data and information and the value proposition.

Conducts negotiations according to company guidelines, including payment terms. Assists with collection of accounts receivables. Maintains acceptable level of past due accounts. Collaborates with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve delinquent payments.

Drives sales, achieving sales targets and ensuring customer satisfaction. Maintains and strengthens customer relationships to generate future sales and repeat business. Responds to customer concerns in a timely fashion.

Consistently uses the Cummins Sales Process as well as Cummins tools, processes, and initiatives that support sales, customer satisfaction, and customer value, e.g. Customer Relationship Management and special projects.

Reports activity via the Customer Relationship Management tool per management direction. Maintains Sales forecasts and tracks progress and accuracy against forecast

As applicable, works with internal stakeholders and customers to balance inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Persuades - Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others.

Articulating Value Proposition - Interprets internal and external customer needs based on relevant application; explains and demonstrates products, solutions, and services to distinguish strengths and weaknesses to meet customer's specific needs to differentiate against competition.

Channel Awareness - Explains and contextualizes industry structure, dynamics, and path to market in order to advance organizational goals.

Pricing Strategy - Develops prices by aligning and building consensus with key stakeholders across functions to achieve business targets.

Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

Account Planning - Identifies objectives to drive execution of business and/or account strategy by reviewing the status relative to where it needs to be and enabling tracking of progress against targets.

Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc.) in such a way that the target audience (e.g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc.) can understand, retain, and use the information

Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers' perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.

Sales Forecasting - Collects and assesses customer data from internal and external sources; compares against historical data to determine useful inputs and create a forecast of future consumption patterns.

Sales Pipeline Management - Plans proactively for successful execution of account/territory-level sales strategies and plans based on current pipeline; evaluates pipeline health (size, contents, progress); adjusts sales strategy, plans, or high impact activities accordingly; as applicable coaches sellers in order to achieve sales objectives.

Sense Making - Through a series of diagnostic and probing questions and research, develops and/or supports an intimate understanding of the customer needs, behaviors, and/or their buying journey. Synthesizes complex information from internal and external resources to deliver tailored solutions for the internal or external customer.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Required: College, university, or equivalent degree in Marketing, Sales or a related subject, or acceptable sales related work experience, or an acceptable combination of education and experience.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Basic relevant work experience preferred.

Handling key mining accounts in Jharkhand, Railways account in Bihar.

Driving retail sales in Bihar and Jharkhand.

job.title: Hyderabad Commissioning Manager, Data Center Capacity Delivery APJC
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud growing. We support all AWS data centers critical infrastructures, power and cooling equipment supporting all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety, security and quality while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning (DCCD Cx) is seeking an exceptional Commissioning Manager based in Hyderabad. As the Area Commissioning Manager, you will manage a fast-moving, high-performing team of commissioning professionals delivering data center capacity to support Amazon's growth in India.

The ideal candidate has experience managing a multi-city or international team of highly skilled professionals. They bring strong team and stakeholder management skills, along with a background in mechanical, electrical, construction, or project management. This foundation enables them to hire, develop, and lead a team that delivers world-class data centers. The candidate must think broadly to maximize operational efficiency and remain adaptable to change in support of broader business objectives.

Key job responsibilities Team Leadership & Development:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Commissioning Engineers, with broad responsibility to hire, build, and manage team performance.
  • Create a vision for the team and set priorities aligned with organisational goals.
  • Define the organisational structure to meet short-term and long-range business requirements.

Technical Expertise & Standards

  • Understand the technology and lifecycle of data center mechanical and electrical infrastructure
  • Utilise knowledge of standards, related disciplines, contractual and business acumens to develop strategies to future proof organization intent.
  • Create standards around which others will operate and build consensus across the organization.

Execution & Process Improvement

  • Identify key value drivers that contribute to commissioning success and lead the development of process improvement strategies aligned with organisational goals.
  • Fix broken processes, convert proven concepts into mechanisms, and iterate existing mechanisms to improve outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional teams in commissioning for availability and reliability-focused initiatives.

Metrics & Performance Management

  • Develop and manage metrics that quantify performance and measure the effectiveness of commissioning key value drivers.
  • Establish a cadence to inspect performance, ensure compliance, provide insights, and track improvements to success.
  • Conduct in-depth data analysis to develop cross-functional mechanisms that improve overall organisational metrics using knowledge, experience, innovation with artificial intelligence and machine learning.

Stakeholder & Financial Management

  • Align cross-functionally and influence a broad spectrum of stakeholders to deliver on the quality policy.
  • Communicate and provide guidance to Finance during the development and execution of capital and operational forecast.
  • Lead capital and operational budget and organisational planning.
  • Deliver solutions to complex problems through data analysis and forensics, communicating recommended solutions up through leadership teams.

About the team Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
  • Experience in industrial or commercial engineering or project management in Mission Critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation, or oil/gas facilities
  • 3+ years of engineering team management experience
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience setting metric driven goals to improve a department or an organization
  • Experience in cost/benefit analysis of project proposals
  • Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Business Development Manager, Enterprise Support
job.description:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses.

AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries.

Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support
  • Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement
  • Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption
  • Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers
  • Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption
  • Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners
  • Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment
  • In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition
  • Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise
  • Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team
  • Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales

A day in the life As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Key job responsibilities The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. •Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation. •Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance. •Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency. •Responsible for supporting the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling.

A day in the life •Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA). •Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management. •Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained •Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation. •Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. •Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. job.title: AWS Technical Consultant (TAM), Enterprise Support NZ
job.description:
Join AWS as we invest NZ$7.5 billion in New Zealand over the next 15 years. We're looking for a Technical Account Manager to join our Enterprise Support team and work directly with New Zealand's most ambitious Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) as they build, scale and innovate on AWS.

As a TAM in our ISV segment, you'll be the trusted technical consultant for software companies that are shaping industries across New Zealand and beyond. You'll help ISV customers architect for scale, optimise their cloud operations and accelerate their product roadmaps on AWS. Your day will involve conducting application reviews, leading operational readiness assessments, driving adoption of AWS services that unlock new capabilities and presenting insights at business reviews that influence customer strategy.

This isn't a reactive support role. It's a consulting role where you earn trust through deep technical expertise and deliver measurable impact. You'll work across the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding and migration through to optimisation and innovation, solving complex technical challenges alongside some of the sharpest engineering teams in the country.

You'll be part of a growing Enterprise Support team in New Zealand, backed by the depth of AWS's global technical community. You'll develop your skills across cloud architecture, security, cost optimisation and operational excellence while contributing to Technical Field Communities and earning AWS certifications.

If you want to work at the intersection of cloud technology and software innovation, and you're ready to have a direct impact on how New Zealand's ISVs build and grow, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to ISV customers, helping them architect, optimise and scale their software products on AWS
  • Conduct Operational Reviews, operational readiness assessments and architecture deep-dives tailored to SaaS and multi-tenant workloads
  • Drive operational excellence across customer environments by identifying risks, reducing cost and improving reliability before issues impact production
  • Lead technical discussions on incident management, trade-offs and risk mitigation, translating complex scenarios into clear recommendations for both engineering teams and senior leadership
  • Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate customer outcomes through AWS service adoption, cost optimisation and architectural improvements
  • Deliver business reviews that provide actionable insights, track progress against customer goals and strengthen the strategic relationship
  • Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services and Account Managers to deliver coordinated support across the customer lifecycle
  • Enable customer teams through targeted workshops, hands-on labs and technical enablement sessions that build lasting cloud capability
  • Lead service event reviews and pre-launch planning to ensure customers are prepared for critical launches and operational milestones
  • Engage with stakeholders across all levels, from platform engineers to CTOs, earning trust through technical depth and consistent delivery

A day in the life No two days are the same, but here's what a typical day might look like.

Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and findings across your customer portfolio, identifying any emerging risks before they become incidents. You notice one customer's database latency has been trending upward and flag it for a deeper review later in the week.

Mid-morning, you lead an Well-Architected Review with a SaaS customer who is preparing to expand into a new market. You work through their multi-tenant architecture, identify areas where they can improve resilience and reduce cost, and leave them with a prioritised set of recommendations they can action immediately.

Over lunch, you join a cross-functional call with the account team to plan an upcoming business review for one of your largest ISV customers. You pull together operational insights, service adoption trends and risk reduction metrics to ensure the review delivers real strategic value.

In the afternoon, you run a hands-on workshop with a customer's engineering team on observability best practices, helping them instrument their platform so they can detect and resolve issues faster. This is the kind of enablement that builds lasting capability and earns trust.

Later, you spend time preparing a pre-launch review for a customer about to release a major product update. You assess their architecture for readiness, review their scaling strategy and ensure their operational runbooks are solid before go-live.

Between meetings, you're contributing to your Technical Field Community, reviewing a SpecReq from a colleague and catching up with your ESM on a customer risk you've been tracking. Every day is a mix of deep technical work, strategic thinking and relationship building.

We're seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead AI transformation across APAC Data Center Planning & Delivery. You will work with business owners in each of our five verticals to turn AI capabilities into measurable improvements in planning and delivery. Business impact will guide the roadmap, from workflow changes to the products teams use every day.

You will be APAC DCPD's accountable lead for collaboration with counterparts in the Americas (AMER) and Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). Together, you will identify opportunities to reuse and scale shared AI solutions where business needs align.

Our AI solutions are already in production. You will establish and lead a central AI solutions hub for the agreed portfolio, consolidating overlapping solutions and developing reusable products. The hub combines a shared catalogue with product-lifecycle and governance mechanisms, using existing approved tools and agreed team responsibilities. It covers maintenance and enhancement priorities after rollout.

You will set change-management direction with process owners and define the mechanisms that turn approved AI capabilities into improved business outcomes. Business champions and enablement teams will deliver agreed communications, training and rollout activities. You will review results and remove barriers, using sustained use and feedback to explain where products or workflows need to improve.

Practical knowledge of AI product design and development is essential. You will guide technical decisions on data integration, model evaluation and deployment requirements, and build selected prototypes to validate approaches. You will work with senior engineering leaders across platforms to prioritise features and connectors that unblock AI development, deployment and integration. We prefer candidates who have deployed AI products for business users, especially on AWS.

You will own the regional governance framework and retain responsibility for portfolio evolution after launch. Engineering and service owners will implement, maintain and operate products under agreed responsibilities and capacity. Security and data owners retain approval authority. You will report time saved, quality and throughput improvements, and cost savings or avoidance against agreed baselines, using measures relevant to each initiative. Assess benefits alongside operating costs and the effort needed to review or correct AI outputs.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead the APAC AI transformation roadmap across five verticals. Prioritise opportunities by business value, readiness, technical feasibility, cost and risk.
  • Own APAC DCPD's collaboration with AMER and EMEA to identify opportunities for reuse and scaling of shared AI solutions.
  • Establish the central AI solutions hub using approved tools and agreed team responsibilities. Lead portfolio consolidation, maintenance, enhancement and retirement, with named owners and lifecycle commitments.
  • Set change-management direction with process owners and enablement teams. Redesign workflows and use feedback to improve business results.
  • Own regional AI governance, risk reviews and evaluation criteria. Security and data owners retain approvals. Require read-only agents by default, with human approval and audit logging for changes to systems of record.
  • Guide AI product design and build selected prototypes. Work with senior engineering leaders across platforms to prioritise features and connectors that unblock development, deployment and integration.
  • Lead cross-functional delivery, resolve dependencies and agree operational ownership. Measure time saved, quality, throughput and cost savings or avoidance against baselines, accounting for operating costs and human review effort. Recommend what to scale, improve or stop.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Google Pay, Growth and Communications
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our mission at Google Pay is to make digital finance simple, safe, and universally accessible.

Operating at an unprecedented scale, our Singapore-based team is the engine behind the growth and communications (comms) platforms. Our Comms infrastructure powers the high-throughput messaging systems required to reliably engage hundreds of millions of users. Simultaneously, under Growth, we own high-volume user acquisition channels including our core referral and reward engines that drive massive-scale traffic and generate multi-million dollar business streams.

In this role, you will lead the technical execution of growth initiatives to scale our user base. You will have true ownership of the full feature lifecycle, building solutions that span entirely from robust backend systems to seamless frontend UI components, leveraging agentic workflows and DevAI tools to accelerate delivery and productivity.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of feature design and deployment, operating seamlessly across the stack from backend infrastructure to frontend mobile and web ecosystems.
  • Mentor junior engineers on reliable, scalable, and secure designs.
  • Lead technical designs for robust backend services and data processing pipelines that support massive-scale growth experiments.
  • Ensure long-term feature reliability by building comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and automated performance tracking.
  • Contribute to engineering excellence by participating in design reviews, improving code quality, and leveraging DevAI and agentic coding workflows to accelerate end-to-end development.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

  • Support internal stakeholders with pricing, documentation, and contract-related inquiries.

Post-Sale Audit & Quality Control

  • Perform post-sale audits to validate order accuracy, pricing, contract terms, and system alignment.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies between quotes, contracts, and booked orders to ensure clean revenue reporting.
  • Proactively recommend process improvements based on audit ﬁndings to reduce errors and improve operational eiciency.

Customer Experience & Service

  • Deliver timely, accurate responses to internal and external inquiries to support a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Support CSMs in ensuring smooth hando from sales to post-sale lifecycle management.
  • Ensure all renewals and sales transactions are completed on time to support revenue targets and customer retention.

Operational Excellence

  • Support continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance scalability and eiciency.
  • Be available for extended hours and ﬂexible scheduling during quarter-end to support global teams and urgent deal activity.**

What we look for?**

  • Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of experience in Sales Administration (quoting, order management, contract processing) supporting a sales organization.
  • Experience in subscription-based, SaaS, or HaaS business models.
  • Strong understanding of contract management and revenue recognition principles.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success (CSMs), Sales, Finance, and Legal teams.
  • Proven attention to detail with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with a customer-focused mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience with Salesforce.com or similar CRM systems.
  • Proﬁciency in Microsoft Oice tools.**

Success in this role will be measured by:**

  • Renewal cycle eiciency and on-time completion rates
  • Accuracy of bookings and reduction in post-sale corrections
  • Quality of audit outcomes and compliance adherence
  • Cross-functional satisfaction (Sales, CSM, Finance)**

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. Carrier Australia is looking for a motivated and reliable Air Conditioning Apprentice to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to learn from experienced HVAC technicians, gain practical industry experience and work towards becoming a qualified Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Technician.

You’ll combine on-the-job training with formal TAFE studies, gaining exposure to the installation, servicing, maintenance, fault finding and repair of HVAC and air conditioning systems.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Eligible to work in Australia.
  • Holding a current driver's licence, or willing to obtain one as required.

Why Join Carrier?

At Carrier, you'll be joining a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions while building valuable skills for a long-term career.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Complete a formal HVAC apprenticeship with TAFE support.
  • Learn from experienced and qualified technicians.
  • Gain hands-on experience across a diverse range of HVAC equipment and applications.
  • Develop highly valued technical and diagnostic skills.
  • Work with industry-leading technology and equipment.
  • Build a long-term career with a globally recognised organisation.
  • Work within a supportive team environment that values safety, quality and continuous development.

We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

job.title: Manager, Risk & Compliance
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

To provide governance, compliance and para-legal support to the business, including the review of commercial contracts and NDAs, identification and management of contractual and compliance risks, and implementation of effective governance policies and controls, with appropriate escalation of material legal matters to Legal.

Role Purpose

The Governance & Compliance Manager supports the organisation in strengthening its governance, compliance and contractual risk management framework. The role provides para-legal and governance support for the review and administration of commercial contracts, NDAs, MOUs and other business agreements, works closely with business stakeholders to identify and address contractual and compliance risks, and escalates material or complex legal matters to Legal where appropriate.

The role also supports the implementation and monitoring of corporate governance policies, regulatory and compliance requirements, internal controls, and related governance initiatives across the organisation.

**

Key Responsibilities

1. Contract & Para-Legal Support

  • Review and provide comments on commercial contracts, NDAs, confidentiality agreements, vendor/customer agreements and other business documents based on established company policies, templates and risk parameters.
  • Identify key contractual risks, including liability, indemnity, termination, confidentiality, data protection, intellectual property, warranties and compliance obligations.
  • Support contract negotiations and coordinate proposed amendments with relevant business stakeholders.
  • Provide practical guidance to business teams on contractual requirements and obligations.
  • Maintain appropriate contract review records, approvals and supporting documentation.
  • Work closely with Legal and escalate complex, high-risk or material legal issues for formal legal advice.

2. Governance & Compliance

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of governance and compliance policies, procedures and controls.
  • Monitor adherence to internal policies, delegated authorities and corporate governance requirements.
  • Advise business teams on governance requirements and appropriate approval processes.
  • Support compliance reviews, internal assessments and remediation of identified gaps.
  • Monitor and support compliance with applicable requirements relating to areas such as anti-bribery and corruption, conflicts of interest, data protection, sanctions and trade compliance.

3. Risk & Internal Controls

  • Assist in identifying governance, contractual and compliance risks arising from business activities and transactions.
  • Work with business and functional teams to establish appropriate mitigating controls.
  • Track material compliance issues, exceptions and corrective actions through to closure.
  • Support internal and external audits and respond to governance and compliance-related information requests.

4. Business Advisory & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a governance and compliance point of contact for business teams.
  • Provide practical and commercially balanced guidance while ensuring appropriate governance and risk management.
  • Work closely with Sales, Procurement, Finance, Operations, HR, Information Security and other functions on contractual and compliance matters.
  • Conduct briefings and awareness sessions on governance, compliance and contracting requirements.

Requirements

  • Degree or diploma in Law, Legal Studies, Business, Corporate Governance, Compliance or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in governance, compliance, contract management, para-legal or corporate legal support.
  • Practical experience reviewing commercial contracts and NDAs is strongly preferred.
  • Good understanding of contractual principles and the ability to identify commercial and legal risks.
  • Familiarity with corporate governance, compliance, internal controls and risk management frameworks.
  • Strong analytical skills with good attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain contractual and compliance matters in practical business terms.
  • Able to work independently, exercise sound judgement and recognise matters requiring escalation to Legal or senior management.
  • Experience within a technology, ICT, systems integration, engineering or regional business environment would be advantageous.

Key Competencies

  • Contract review and risk identification
  • Governance and compliance
  • Para-legal support
  • Commercial awareness
  • Risk and control mindset
  • Strong judgement and attention to detail
  • Stakeholder management
  • Clear and concise drafting
  • High level of integrity and confidentiality

job.title: Operational Readiness Specialist
job.description:
• Lead the operational readiness and acceptance of major projects, ensuring a seamless transition from delivery into operations!
  • Join a passionate, high-performing organisation, during an exciting period of growth
  • Role location flexible - can be based in Sydney or Canberra

About Us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

Playing a crucial role from within our Operations Engineering team, the Operations Readiness Specialist will be responsible for supporting across assurance frameworks, audit documentation, and site best practice; ultimately ensuring consistent operational readiness across our broader organisation. Through clearly defining compliance criteria and standards, in conjunction with risk analysis and data modelling, this role will see the successful candidate driving quality uplift and reducing variability across our sites and functions.

  • Lead the operational readiness and acceptance of major projects, ensuring a seamless transition from delivery into operations.
  • Coordinate stakeholders across construction, commissioning and operational teams to drive readiness activities, manage risks and achieve key milestones.
  • Manage the Ready for Operations (RFO) process across assigned transition programs, ensuring requirements, documentation and acceptance criteria are met before handover.
  • Monitor and report on project readiness, including risks, actions, compliance obligations and operational acceptance outcomes.
  • Continuously improve operational readiness frameworks, governance processes and assurance activities to support consistent delivery across the portfolio.

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy - Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

The successful candidate will combine a demonstrated understanding of functional assurance or operational improvement from within an industrial or commercial setting (e.g. construction, building and maintenance services, data centre environments), with a proactive, solutions-focused approach to ultimately drive outcomes. If you possess experience in developing and maintaining frameworks, analysing key operational data, and effectively translating complex, technical requirements into understandable processes and terms - we'd love to hear from you!

  • Previous experience within construction, infrastructure, data centre, facilities, or trade services coordination/program management.
  • Previous experience within designing, implementing, and monitoring performance and assurance metrics.
  • Comfortability in collaborating and coaching internal stakeholders to maintain adherence to compliance requirements.
  • Data-driven, solutions-focused, with a high level of attention to detail both written and verbal.
  • Developed data analytics skillset, with proficiency in dashboard reporting and modelling tools (such as Power BI).
  • Deep understanding of compliance frameworks, audit readiness, and risk management principles.

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and encourages everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: 24/7 Service Technician (HVAC/Electrical)
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia’s leading data centres.

  • Sydney's team is expanding with a new Data Centre. Join our team as we continue to grow in 2026.
  • Critical Infrastructure experience or HVAC or Electrical trades are desired
  • Tailored CDC Academy and hands-on training provided
  • 24/7 Shift - 2 days, 2 nights- 4 days off

About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are responsive, innovative and trusted in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

At CDC, our Service Technicians work in live data centre environments, supporting the operation of mission‑critical infrastructure.

If you’ve spent time in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, a lot of this will feel familiar. Working to procedures, taking safety seriously, and understanding the impact of your work is critical. A data centre applies those same principles to power, cooling, fire systems and monitoring, all operating continuously. The difference is the environment, the scale, and the opportunity to apply your skills in a stable, growing industry.

Data centre experience isn’t required. We welcome people from a range of hands‑on technical backgrounds and provide training and support to help you apply your existing skills in a more operational, monitoring‑focused environment.

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day:

  • Monitoring and responding to alarms and alerts across power, cooling, and fire systems
  • Performing physical inspections to ensure equipment and infrastructure are operating within defined parameters
  • Responding to faults and incidents, prioritising actions, and determining when escalation or contractor support is required
  • Carrying out operational switching and control activities to prevent unplanned outages
  • Supporting planned maintenance and monitoring contractors on site, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures and approved methods of operation
  • Documenting incidents, maintenance activities, and observations to support continuous improvement

This role works on a rotating 24/7 shift roster (2 days, 2 nights, 4 off) and suits individuals who are comfortable making decisions, following defined processes, and working calmly in high‑reliability environments.

Benefits, Training and Offerings:

Our training program provides tailored content through our CDC Academy, specifically designed for individuals starting out in this role. You'll learn hands-on by shadowing and working alongside our experienced Service Technicians, gaining essential knowledge to develop your skillset.

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

You have experience working in environments where reliability, safety, and procedure matter - whether that’s through an electrical, HVAC, mechanical, or broader critical infrastructure background.

You might be a qualified electrician or HVAC technician looking to move away from a traditional tools‑based role and into operations, or someone earlier in their technical career who is curious about how large‑scale, mission‑critical environments operate.

Regardless of background, we value motivation, strong attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and develop within a growing industry.

Desirable experience:

  • A trade or technical background in Electrical, Refrigeration/HVAC, Mechanical, or a related field (highly desirable)
  • Experience working in critical or high‑availability environments with strong safety and compliance requirements
  • Exposure to monitoring or control systems such as BMS, EMS, or SCADA‑type platforms
  • Familiarity with complex infrastructure or plant equipment (e.g. HVAC systems, power systems, generators, fire systems)
  • Strong fault‑finding, problem‑solving, and situational awareness skills
  • The ability to produce clear documentation, logs, and post‑incident reports

Essential:

  • Australian citizenship and ability to obtain, an NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community, and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: Lead - Treasury
job.description:
Responsibilities

Treasury & Liquidity Management

  • Lead treasury operations, cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and fund management across the business.
  • Develop short-term and long-term cash flow plans to ensure uninterrupted business operations.
  • Drive working capital optimization initiatives and improve cash conversion cycles.
  • Monitor fund utilization, liquidity positions, borrowing costs, and treasury risk exposure.
  • Coordinate with Group Treasury for fund deployment, cash pooling, and liquidity management strategies.

Fund Raising & Project Finance

  • Lead end-to-end fund-raising activities for existing and upcoming projects.
  • Manage project financing, including lender engagement, financial closure, documentation, drawdowns, and disbursements.
  • Evaluate and implement optimal financing structures through debt, equity, structured finance, and hybrid instruments.

Banking Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, investors, and rating agencies.
  • Negotiate competitive pricing, credit facilities, banking limits, and financing terms.
  • Lead consortium banking arrangements and multi-bank financing structures.
  • Manage enhancement and renewal of working capital and project finance facilities.

Trade Finance & Banking Operations

  • Manage end-to-end trade finance transactions, including: Import & Export Letters of Credit (LCs)
  • Bank Guarantees (BGs)
  • Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs)
  • Buyers' and Suppliers' Credit

Oversee issuance, amendments, negotiations, renewals, and closure of trade finance instruments.Ensure timely settlement of import/export transactions and compliance with banking obligations.Debt Management & Compliance

  • Manage debt portfolio, including drawdowns, repayments, refinancing, interest servicing, and covenant monitoring.
  • Ensure compliance with financing agreements, lender reporting, and debt covenants.
  • Prepare CMA data, stock statements, drawing power calculations, utilization certificates, and banking MIS.
  • Ensure compliance with RBI, FEMA, banking regulations, and trade finance guidelines.
  • Monitor documentation, statutory submissions, and regulatory reporting requirements.

Forex & Risk Management

  • Manage foreign exchange exposures arising from imports, exports, borrowings, and cross-border transactions.
  • Develop and implement hedging strategies through forward contracts and other treasury products.
  • Monitor interest rate and currency risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure adherence to treasury risk management frameworks and policies.

Treasury Digitalization & Process Excellence

  • Drive treasury automation initiatives and implementation of digital banking platforms.
  • Improve treasury workflows through technology-enabled solutions and process optimization.
  • Establish treasury controls, governance frameworks, and best practices.
  • Enhance operational efficiency through dashboarding, automation, and reporting tools.

MIS & Leadership Reporting

  • Prepare treasury dashboards, cash position reports, debt reports, banking MIS, and fund utilization reports.
  • Present key treasury metrics and funding updates to senior management.
  • Provide actionable insights on liquidity, borrowing costs, treasury risks, and capital deployment.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA / FRM from a reputed institution.
  • Additional certification in Treasury, Project Finance, Financial Modelling, or Risk Management will be preferred.

Experience

  • 15-20+ years of relevant experience in Treasury, Project Finance, Corporate Finance, or Fund Raising.
  • Proven experience in large manufacturing, metals, mining, natural resources, infrastructure, power, EPC, or capital-intensive industries.
  • Extensive exposure to project funding, structured finance, lender negotiations, and debt management.
  • Experience in handling multi-bank arrangements, consortium financing, and large capital expenditure projects.

job.title: Team Lead - Insurance
job.description:
**

Responsibilities

Risk Transfer Strategy Execution & Insurance Management

  • Lead the assessment of emerging global risks, including climate-related, cyber, and geopolitical risks, to ensure the group’s insurance portfolio remains adaptive.
  • Support the Group Head in the reinsurance procurement process for high-value and complex risks, collaborating with reinsurers to secure optimal coverage for emerging risks.
  • Lead the insurance needs analysis for new assets, acquisitions, and business ventures by coordinating with business units and technical teams to assess operational risks.
  • Ensure proper coverage for all new acquisitions and ventures by engaging with local insurers and reinsurers.
  • Ensure timely endorsements for new assets or additional coverage needs, minimizing exposure to risk by guaranteeing that insurance is in place before assets become operational.

Comprehensive Insurance Renewal

  • Lead the annual insurance renewal process for all assets and liabilities, ensuring that insurance terms are reviewed and adjusted based on changes in asset values and risk profiles.
  • Collaborate with the CFO (Chief Financial Officer) and Financial Controller to ensure approval of the renewal strategy before proceeding to market, and maintain constant communication to update them on any changes.
  • Engage with the market to obtain competitive renewal terms, negotiating directly with insurers and reinsurers to achieve the best possible premium rates and coverage conditions.

Request for Proposals (RFPs) Management

  • Manage the preparation and issuance of Request for Proposals (RFPs) for various types of insurance, ensuring clear communication of the group’s requirements to insurers.
  • Lead the creation of NFAs (Notes for Approval) to ensure adherence with corporate governance standards.

Claims Management & Settlements

  • Lead the claims management process, ensuring efficient assessment, documentation, and settlement in compliance with policy terms.
  • Collaborate with third-party adjusters and surveyors to ensure accurate claims evaluation and timely settlement.
  • Lead the development of data analytics framework for forecasting claims trends, improving decision-making, and reducing the risk of future claims.
  • Lead the digitization of policy and claims documentation, ensuring all records are easily accessible and stored in a central repository.

Market Relations

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local and global insurers, reinsurers, and InsurTech companies to secure competitive quotes and favourable terms.
  • Negotiate with insurance brokers to ensure alignment between the group’s risk profile and available coverage.
  • Actively engage with facultative reinsurers when necessary, securing reinsurance policies either through direct outreach or intermediaries to cover high-value or complex risks.

Insurance Operations & Process Standardization

  • Lead the execution of standardization of insurance processes across the organization, ensuring consistency in policy procurement, claims reporting, and documentation management.
  • Supervise the development and integration of standardized insurance-related forms, ensuring compliance and efficiency across business units.

Negotiation and Finalization of Insurance Policies

  • Lead multi-round negotiations with insurers to finalize terms for both new policies and renewals, focusing on achieving the best coverage limits, deductibles, and premiums.
  • Ensure accurate communication of risk details and coverage to the insurers.

Corporate Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with insurance regulations, including SEBI, IRDAI, and regional standards, across the group’s insurance activities.
  • Lead preparation of compliance reports, including insurance certifications and auditor reports for statutory filings.
  • Work closely with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all insurance contracts align with corporate policies and regulatory standards.

Risk Identification & Business Interface

  • Lead identification of new and emerging risks across the group’s operations, ensuring effective mitigation strategies are implemented.
  • Lead the establishment of a robust third-party risk management framework, ensuring vendors, suppliers, and contractors working with the group are covered by appropriate liability insurance.
  • Collaborate with business units to update the insurance portfolio, addressing changes in the risk landscape.

Digitization and Automation

  • Lead the digitization of the insurance function, including the development of a centralized bid management system to streamline procurement and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Drive automation of insurance-related processes, including the development of a digital insurance management system to generate automated workflows for claims management, premium payments, and coverage renewals.
  • Integrate AI-driven tools for predictive risk modelling to optimize coverage, minimize premium costs, and improve operational efficiency.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

  • Align with the Group Head Insurance on market trends, pricing shifts, and underwriting criteria that could impact the group’s strategies.
  • Collaborate with internal departments (finance, legal, technical) to ensure alignment between insurance requirements and business objectives.
  • Liaise with the legal department to ensure policy interpretations are aligned with business interests.
  • Manage the interface between business units and insurers, ensuring seamless communication regarding evolving insurance needs.

People and Team Management

  • Ensure insurance team members are aligned with business strategy and insurance objectives, providing them with career development opportunities.
  • Oversee team performance, supporting continuous development and departmental excellence in line with organizational goals.
  • Cultivate an environment conducive to collaboration, enabling the team to thrive within the dynamic landscape of the energy sector.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Internal Stakeholders:

  • CFO (Chief Financial Officer)
  • Financial Controller
  • Business Unit Heads
  • Legal Team
  • ABEX Team
  • Technical Teams
  • Senior Leadership

External Stakeholders:

  • Local Insurance Companies
  • Reinsurers
  • Insurance Brokers
  • Surveyors and Loss Adjusters
  • Facultative Reinsurance Providers

Qualifications

Qualifications

B.E./ B.Tech., Additional MBA in Insurance or additional insurance qualifications preferred

Experience

Minimum 14 - 16 years of experience in corporate insurance, underwriting, or risk management roles, with significant experience in negotiating with insurers and reinsurers.

Industry Preferred:

Background in Power and Energy sector preferred with an understanding of both local and international insurance markets and the ability to engage with facultative reinsurers for complex risks.

job.title: Critical Facilities Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

This role is responsible for the hands-on operation and maintenance of critical electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems in a 24/7 data center environment. The Facility Technician will monitor and maintain power, cooling, and control systems, carry out preventive maintenance, respond to incidents and alarms, and coordinate with vendors to ensure the facility remains safe, reliable, and aligned with company standards.

This role works in rotating shifts, including nights and weekends, and will work closely with the Facilities and Data Center Operations teams, vendors, contractors, and other internal stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Monitor and maintain power, cooling, and control systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, chillers, CRAC/CRAH units, and BMS.
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and routine inspections in accordance with schedules and standard operating procedures.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and equipment anomalies, performing initial troubleshooting and escalating issues as required.
  • Coordinate with vendors and contractors during planned and unplanned work, including supervising on-site activities.
  • Record shift logs, maintenance activities, and incident reports accurately and on time.
  • Follow change management, permit-to-work, and lockout/tagout procedures for all work on critical systems.
  • Support shift handovers to ensure continuity of operations and clear communication of system status.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity.
  • Perform other facility operations and maintenance-related duties as assigned.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Refrigeration/HVAC, or a related technical field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in mechanical, electrical, or HVAC systems; experience in data center, telecom, or other critical environments is preferred.
  • Solid understanding of electrical and mechanical systems, with the ability to read technical drawings and single-line diagrams.
  • Willing to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends.
  • Physically capable of equipment handling in operational conditions.
  • Detail-oriented, responsible, with a strong safety mindset and the ability to stay calm and act quickly when handling alarms and incidents.
  • Good teamwork and communication skills.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., K3 Listrik, K3 Umum, or HVAC/refrigeration certification) and familiarity with BMS/SCADA systems are an advantage.
  • Fluent in English and proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia is preferred.

If you’re ready to help shape the next phase of a fast‑growing digital infrastructure platform, we’d like to hear from you.

job.title: IBMS Lead
job.description:

The Assistant Vice President – Data Center Automation shall be responsible for leading the execution, installation, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of all IBMS, ELV, and Building Automation Systems across multiple data center projects. The role will manage multidisciplinary engineering teams, coordinate with clients, consultants, OEMs, contractors, and vendors, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with design specifications and industry standards.

The incumbent will oversee end-to-end execution from design review through procurement support, installation, Integrated System Testing (IST), commissioning, handover, and operational readiness.

Key responsibilities

  • Project Execution & Site Leadership (Must)
  • Lead end-to-end execution of Data Center IBMS and ELV systems across multiple projects.
  • Manage complete site execution activities, installation quality, progress monitoring, and project delivery.
  • Supervise site engineers, project managers, commissioning engineers, and subcontractors.
  • Ensure adherence to project schedules, quality standards, and safety requirements.
  • Monitor construction progress and resolve technical and execution-related issues.
  • IBMS & ELV System Execution (Must)

Lead installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of:

  • Building Management System (BMS)
  • Integrated Building Management System (IBMS)
  • Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS)
  • HVAC Automation
  • Fire Alarm & Detection System
  • VESDA System
  • Access Control System
  • CCTV Surveillance System
  • Public Address System
  • Structured Cabling
  • Rodent Repellent System
  • Water Leak Detection System
  • Lighting Control System
  • PLC/SCADA Interfaces
  • Third-party system integration

Ensure seamless integration between all building services through BACnet, Modbus, OPC, and IP-based communication protocols.

  • Team Management (Must)
  • Lead and mentor Project Managers, Site Engineers, Commissioning Engineers, QA/QC Engineers, and Vendors.
  • Allocate manpower and monitor productivity across multiple projects.
  • Conduct regular technical reviews, progress meetings, and performance evaluations.
  • Drive engineering excellence and foster a collaborative work environment.
  • Client & Stakeholder Management (Must)
  • Act as the primary technical interface with clients, consultants, PMCs, and OEMs.
  • Conduct weekly and monthly project review meetings.
  • Present project progress, risk mitigation plans, and technical solutions to clients.
  • Coordinate with design consultants for timely approvals and issue resolution.
  • Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Design Review & Engineering Coordination (Must)
  • Review IFC drawings, shop drawings, and technical submittals.
  • Coordinate with MEP consultants and design teams to ensure constructability.
  • Review system architecture, network topology, control philosophy, and interface requirements.
  • Resolve design conflicts before execution.
  • Ensure compliance with project specifications, standards, and client requirements.
  • Procurement & Material Management (Must)
  • Support procurement teams in preparing BOQs, technical specifications, and vendor evaluations.
  • Review technical offers and recommend suitable OEMs.
  • Participate in material selection based on project requirements.
  • Monitor material delivery schedules and site availability.
  • Coordinate with procurement to avoid project delays.
  • Installation Quality Management
  • Monitor installation activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings and standards.
  • Conduct quality inspections and site audits.
  • Ensure proper cable routing, panel installation, network infrastructure, and field device installation.
  • Coordinate snag closure before commissioning.
  • Testing, Commissioning & IST

Lead complete testing and commissioning activities for all automation and ELV systems will be responsible for:

  • Factory Acceptance Test (FAT)
  • Site Acceptance Test (SAT)
  • Point-to-Point Verification
  • Cause & Effect Testing
  • Integrated System Testing (IST)
  • Functional Performance Testing
  • Failover Testing
  • Redundancy Validation
  • Client Witness Testing
  • Final Handover Documentation

Ensure successful integration of all systems before project handover.

  • Documentation

Review and approve:

  • Method Statements
  • Control Philosophy Documents
  • Functional Design Specifications (FDS)
  • Network Architecture Drawings
  • Shop Drawings
  • As-Built Drawings
  • Test Reports
  • Commissioning Reports
  • O&M Manuals
  • Asset Registers
  • Handover Documents
  • Vendor & Contract Management
  • Manage OEMs, System Integrators, Contractors, and Service Providers.
  • Track vendor performance against project milestones.
  • Resolve technical and commercial issues.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and SLAs.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • 15+ years of experience in Mission Critical Data Centers, Building Automation, IBMS, or ELV systems.
  • Strong experience in end-to-end execution and delivery of hyperscale or enterprise data center projects.
  • Hands-on knowledge of commissioning and Integrated System Testing (IST).
  • Experience in leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience in design review, procurement support, and construction management.
  • Knowledge of BMS, EPMS, HVAC Automation, Fire Alarm, VESDA, Access Control, CCTV, Networking, and Structured Cabling.
  • Familiarity with BACnet, Modbus, TCP/IP, OPC, and MQTT communication protocols.
  • Excellent project planning, risk management, and leadership capabilities.

This role will be project based at Project Site, Thane, Mumbai.

Construction

  • Program: phasing/staging, construction activity sequencing, contractor/subcontractor interface and coordination, detailed programming of all construction activities from commencement to completion, including daily and weekly planning.

Managing and overseeing from start to finish external underground infrastructure works, substructure (piling, footing and foundation works), superstructure (shuttering, reinforcement, post-tensioning, precast concrete, concrete place, steel structure, masonry such as blockwork, brickwork, coordination of services cast-ins, dry wall construction, DfMA installation etc.), finishes (internal walls, floors, ceiling, partitions, doors etc.,) and façade works to enclose the building.

Understanding and awareness of infrastructure and services being able to interpret and understand design, overseeing and manage the works competently.

job.title: Senior Manager, Group Sustainability (Social Impact)
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group**

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As Senior Manager, Group Sustainability, you will shape and drive Singtel Group’s social impact agenda, building strategic partnerships and programmes that harness our technology, AI capabilities and regional reach to create meaningful and measurable impact. You will also contribute to broader Group Sustainability and ESG priorities.

How You will Make An Impact

**

Social Impact Strategy & Programme Management

  • Lead Singtel Group AI Future Makers, working across operating companies (OpCos) on challenge statements, partner and start-ups engagement, pilot and scale successful initiatives across the Group and its associates.
  • Build strategic partnerships with government agencies, social service agencies, community organisations and internal business units to develop and scale programmes aligned with Singtel Group’s social impact strategy and “AI for All”.
  • Drive programme governance and impact, including setting outcomes, KPIs and budgets, tracking performance, advising senior management on priorities, investments, risks and scaling decisions, and partnering with Communications and Marketing to amplify impact.

**

Digital Citizenship & Inclusion

  • Shape Singtel’s digital citizenship strategy and develop scalable initiatives that promote responsible, safe and healthy use of digital and AI technologies, addressing emerging AI and online risks.
  • Build and manage partnerships with IMDA, TOUCH, IHLs and community organisations to advance AI and digital literacy, cyber wellness, online safety and scam awareness, particularly for vulnerable communities.

**

Stakeholder Engagement, Impact Measurement & Communications

  • Establish a consistent approach to measuring and reporting the outcomes and impact of major social programmes, using insights to inform programme design, resource allocation and management decisions.
  • Drive the Group-wide approach to employee and skills-based volunteering, developing frameworks, tools and platforms that enable consistent planning, tracking and reporting across the Group and OpCos.

**

Broader Sustainability

  • Lead or co-lead selected cross-functional ESG initiatives, translating emerging sustainability developments into strategic recommendations and practical actions for the Group.
