  • SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud-based system.
  • Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
  • This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.

  • Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.

job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Fixed Assets Team Lead ###

Team Lead-Fixed Assets.

Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences.

You will be working as Team Lead-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and will be reporting to Accounting & Reporting Manager – GA and will be a part of Bangalore, India. In this role you will be primarily responsible for End-to-End Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and Internal Audit and Process Improvements and automation Process as team leader focused on the complete, accurate, and timely completion of Fixed Assets & Reporting and related activities within the General Accounting (GA) team. Ensure compliance with internal guidelines and procedures as well as external regulatory requirements with strong understanding of USGAP and FA Module.

Fixed Asset Accounting Operations

  • Manage end-to-end fixed asset accounting processes.
  • Ensure accurate capitalization, transfers, retirements, disposals, and depreciation of assets.
  • Review and approve asset creation requests in compliance with accounting policies.
  • Maintain the fixed asset register and ensure completeness and accuracy.
  • Monitor Construction-in-Progress (CIP) accounting and capitalization activities.

Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

  • Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end fixed asset close activities.
  • Review depreciation runs and accounting entries.
  • Prepare and validate fixed asset reconciliations between subledger and general ledger.
  • Support financial statement disclosures related to Property, Plant & Equipment (PP&E).
  • Analyze asset balances and investigate significant movements.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure compliance with IFRS, US GAAP, local statutory requirements, and company accounting policies.
  • Maintain SOX/internal control documentation and evidence.
  • Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions.
  • Support internal and external audits through timely preparation of schedules and explanations.

Asset Lifecycle Management

  • Govern the complete asset lifecycle from acquisition to disposal.
  • Ensure appropriate asset classification and useful life assignment.
  • Review impairment assessments and asset write-offs.
  • Monitor leased assets and right-of-use assets where applicable.

Reconciliation & Data Quality

  • Perform periodic asset register reviews and reconciliations.
  • Resolve discrepancies between procurement, project accounting, and fixed assets records.
  • Ensure asset master data accuracy and integrity.
  • Develop and track key performance metrics related to fixed asset processes.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare management reports on capital expenditures, depreciation, asset additions, and disposals.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets.
  • Provide insights into capital investment trends and asset utilization.
  • Develop dashboards and report solutions for stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for fixed asset-related queries.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, Tax, Controllership, and Business Operations teams.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, statutory auditors, and tax advisors.
  • Provide guidance on fixed asset accounting treatments and policy interpretations.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify and drive process improvement initiatives.
  • Lead standardization and harmonization of fixed asset processes across entities.
  • Support system implementations, upgrades, and testing activities (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday, TRIRIGA).
  • Promote automation opportunities to improve efficiency and control.

SME Governance Responsibilities

  • Serve as the functional expert for fixed asset accounting.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members.
  • Provide guidance during transitions, migrations, and transformation projects.
  • Review complex accounting transactions and determine appropriate treatment.

Key Skills & Competencies:

**

  • Strong knowledge of Fixed Assets Accounting, PP&E, Depreciation, Capitalization, and Asset Retirement.
  • Experience with IFRS, US GAAP, and internal controls.
  • ERP knowledge (SAP, Oracle,).
  • Advanced Excel and reporting skills.
  • Analytical problem-solving and stakeholder management.
  • Audit support and compliance expertise.
  • A master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce (MBA/Mcom) is must.
  • Minimum 10to 12 years of experience in Fixed Assets Accounting and Record to Report GA.
  • Experience leading teams in a shared service, GBS, or multinational environment.
  • Strong knowledge of working in SAP & FA Module.

More about us

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who deliver forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operate with the highest standards

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes way beyond just Search. job.title: ServiceMax Technical Architect
job.description:
**

Job Description

Technical Architect - ServiceMax

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect - ServiceMax - with 10+ years of expertise in designing, governing, and delivering enterprise-scale ServiceMax and Salesforce solutions. This role will lead architecture strategy for global field service transformation programs, ensuring scalable, secure, integrated, and business-aligned solutions that support standardized global processes and country-specific rollout needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and delivery teams to translate field service requirements into scalable ServiceMax architecture, solution designs, and technical specifications.
  • Redesign and standardize field service processes to improve operational efficiency, technician productivity, dispatcher effectiveness, and customer experience.
  • Own end-to-end ServiceMax solution architecture, design governance, and technical decision-making across global programs, ensuring alignment with business requirements, enterprise architecture standards, and industry best practices.
  • Define the global ServiceMax template architecture and manage controlled country-specific localization, including regional process variations, deployment sequencing, training readiness, change management, and hypercare support.
  • Architect enterprise integrations between ServiceMax, Salesforce, ERP platforms, middleware, mobile applications, and enterprise data platforms using appropriate API-led and event-driven integration patterns.
  • Ensure platform capabilities and solution designs meet non-functional requirements, including scalability, performance, security, resilience, monitoring, maintainability, and supportability.
  • Define and govern end-to-end data migration strategies for ServiceMax implementations, including legacy data assessment, cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, cutover planning, and post-migration reconciliation.
  • Drive digital transformation initiatives by modernizing field service operations, enabling automation, improving technician and dispatcher experiences, and aligning ServiceMax capabilities with enterprise transformation objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership to administrators, developers, QA engineers, integration teams, and business analysts, ensuring consistent delivery standards, design quality, and adherence to best practices.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration across business, IT, integration, data, security, and regional rollout teams to align solution decisions with program priorities and stakeholder expectations.
  • Maintain a forward-looking technology roadmap for ServiceMax and related Salesforce capabilities, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, innovation, and platform optimization.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in technical architecture, solution design, and enterprise application delivery, with strong expertise in ServiceMax, Salesforce Service Cloud, and field service transformation programs.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering ServiceMax capabilities, including configuration, custom extensions, workflows, integrations, mobile enablement, and global deployment models.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Quality Engineer - IBMS, Ahmedabad (1-Year Contract Role)

Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will help ensure quality across IBMS project execution with a strong focus on IBMS, CCTV, and ACS, while working on-site in Ahmedabad. This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance.

Role Overview

As a Quality Engineer, you will support the quality assurance and quality control of IBMS installations by reviewing workmanship, verifying compliance with drawings and specifications, and coordinating with project stakeholders to close observations efficiently. You will play a key role in maintaining quality standards across site activities, inspections, and system checks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct site inspections and quality checks for IBMS installations, with emphasis on CCTV and ACS systems.
  • Verify that execution at site aligns with approved drawings, technical specifications, and project quality standards.
  • Monitor installation workmanship and identify deviations, defects, or rework requirements.
  • Coordinate with clients, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to resolve quality-related issues.
  • Support testing, inspection, and documentation activities during implementation and handover.
  • Maintain accurate quality records, site reports, and follow-up actions.
  • Track technical and operational issues through closure and support corrective actions.
  • Ensure safety and compliance requirements are followed during site activities.

How You Will Do It

  • Stay close to the site and verify work against drawings, specifications, and agreed quality standards.
  • Own issues through to closure by documenting findings, coordinating corrective actions, and confirming that rework meets expectations.
  • Work openly with clients, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to remove obstacles and keep delivery moving.
  • Use disciplined reporting and clear communication to surface risks early and improve quality every day.
  • Apply a practical, detail-focused approach to inspections, system checks, and handover support.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering, preferably in Electrical, Electronics, IT, or a related field.
  • 5 years of experience in IBMS project execution, quality checks, or site supervision.
  • Hands-on experience with IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, layouts, and specifications.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
  • Understanding of safety, compliance, and site quality practices.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to large-scale infrastructure or facility management projects.
  • Experience with additional IBMS or ELV systems such as CFS.

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to quality-focused IBMS delivery in a global company committed to smart and sustainable building solutions. You will work with a collaborative team, strengthen your technical expertise, and gain hands-on exposure to site quality execution in a performance-based contractual role.

If you are ready to bring your IBMS quality experience to a role where your work will be seen and valued, we encourage you to apply.

job.description:
What you will do

Your primary focus will be on fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and innovative environment where team members can thrive. You will manage the full talent lifecycle, including setting clear objectives, conducting performance reviews, and creating robust development and growth plans for every engineer.
  • Drive Project Execution & Excellence: You will be accountable for the team's successful delivery of engineering projects, ensuring they meet critical milestones for quality, on-time delivery, and cost. This includes leading rigorous design reviews, providing expert technical guidance, and ensuring all deliverables are of the highest quality and ready for manufacturing.
  • Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a key technical partner to other departments. You will collaborate closely with leaders in Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations to resolve technical challenges, streamline processes, and ensure seamless integration throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Advance Engineering Capabilities: You will stay at the forefront of engineering tools and methodologies, driving the adoption of best practices within your team. This includes championing process improvements, overseeing the use of CAD and PLM systems, and identifying opportunities to leverage new technologies to boost productivity and innovation.
  • Contribute to Strategic Vision: You will play a key role in shaping the future of our engineering function. By managing resources, aligning team priorities with business goals, and contributing to the technology roadmap, you will help ensure our design capabilities remain best-in-class.

What you will bring:

  • Core Engineering Design: Extensive hands-on experience in mechanical design, with demonstrated success in New Product Development (NPD), VAVE (Value Analysis/Value Engineering), and design automation. You should have a strong command of Design for X (DfX) principles, including Design for Manufacturing, Quality, Circularity, and Cost.

Your experience must include demonstrated proficiency in core HVAC or similar mechanical domains, including structural design, refrigeration system components, sheet metal fabrication, and complex piping and tubing layouts.

job.title: Senior Analyst – Threat & Vulnerability Management
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Senior Analyst – Threat & Vulnerability Management

to join Infrastructure Services -CAT IT Division

The Senior Vulnerability Management Analyst is responsible for leading the identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation governance of critical security vulnerabilities across the enterprise. This role serves as a key liaison between cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, and business teams to ensure vulnerabilities are remediated within established SLAs and organizational risk thresholds.

The Senior Analyst will leverage ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, security scanning platforms, and advanced reporting capabilities to drive accountability, improve remediation performance, identify systemic risks, and provide executive-level visibility into the organization's security posture. The role requires strong analytical, stakeholder management, and leadership communication skills, along with the ability to influence remediation outcomes across multiple technology teams.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield PSN Office , Bangalore -KA

What you will do

Vulnerability Management & Remediation Governance

  • Lead the end-to-end management of critical and high-risk vulnerabilities, ensuring remediation activities align with organizational SLAs and security policies.
  • Monitor and analyze vulnerability data from ServiceNow Vulnerability Response and vulnerability scanning platforms to identify aged, recurring, and high-impact security risks.
  • Validate vulnerability records, asset ownership mappings, assignment groups, risk scores, and remediation status.
  • Drive accountability by assigning, tracking, and escalating remediation activities across infrastructure, cloud, network, application, and endpoint teams.
  • Evaluate remediation plans, compensating controls, and exception requests to ensure appropriate risk treatment decisions.
  • Support vulnerability prioritization using CVSS scores, exploitability, threat intelligence, business criticality, and asset context.

ServiceNow Administration & Process Optimization

  • Act as a subject matter expert for ServiceNow Vulnerability Response workflows and reporting.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, workflows, reports, and KPIs to improve vulnerability management effectiveness.
  • Identify process inefficiencies and recommend automation opportunities to enhance tracking, reporting, and remediation activities.
  • Partner with platform teams to improve vulnerability response processes and governance controls.

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

  • Engage directly with technical teams, application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to obtain remediation commitments and timelines.
  • Facilitate remediation discussions, risk reviews, and vulnerability governance meetings.
  • Provide guidance to stakeholders on vulnerability remediation best practices and prioritization strategies.
  • Escalate SLA breaches, chronic offenders, and unresolved critical vulnerabilities to leadership and risk governance forums.
  • Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on vulnerability management processes and cybersecurity best practices.

Data Analytics & Risk Reporting

  • Perform advanced analysis of vulnerability trends, remediation performance, recurring findings, and ownership gaps.
  • Develop metrics and reporting related to:
  • SLA compliance
  • Vulnerability aging
  • Risk exposure trends
  • Remediation effectiveness
  • Business unit performance
  • Executive risk posture
  • Create and maintain dashboards using ServiceNow, Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.
  • Identify systemic issues and strategic improvement opportunities across security and IT operations.

Executive Communication & Leadership Reporting

  • Prepare executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, and presentations for cybersecurity and technology leadership.
  • Present vulnerability trends, key risks, remediation progress, and strategic recommendations during governance and leadership reviews.
  • Provide risk-based insights and recommendations to support decision-making and security investment priorities.
  • Communicate complex technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What you will have

  • 10–12 years of overall IT and Cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years focused on Vulnerability Management, Security Operations, Risk Management, or Cyber Defense functions.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Vulnerability Response and/or ITSM platforms.
  • Strong understanding of vulnerability management lifecycle, risk assessment methodologies, and remediation workflows.
  • Experience working with enterprise vulnerability scanning tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Wiz, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • CVSS scoring
  • Common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs)
  • Asset criticality
  • Patch management
  • Risk and exception management
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience interacting with senior leadership and presenting cybersecurity metrics and risk posture updates.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Industry certifications such as:
  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • GSEC
  • Security+
  • CRISC
  • GIAC Vulnerability Management certifications
  • Experience with cloud security platforms and cloud-native vulnerability management.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards including:
  • NIST Cybersecurity Framework
  • CIS Controls
  • ISO 27001

PCI DSS

  • Experience leading vulnerability governance programs in large enterprise environments.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Risk Management
  • Vulnerability Assessment & Prioritization
  • Executive Stakeholder Management
  • Cybersecurity Governance
  • Data Analytics & Reporting
  • ServiceNow Vulnerability Response
  • Process Improvement & Automation
  • Leadership Communication
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Mentoring & Team Development

Success Measures

  • Reduction in overdue critical and high-risk vulnerabilities.
  • Improvement in remediation SLA compliance across business units.
  • Increased visibility and accountability through executive reporting.
  • Identification and remediation of systemic vulnerability management gaps.
  • Enhanced stakeholder engagement and risk governance effectiveness.

Skills desired:

Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
  • Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
  • Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
  • Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
  • Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
  • Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
  • Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
  • Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
  • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
  • Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
  • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
  • Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
  • Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
  • Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
  • Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
  • Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design). Level Working Knowledge:

  • Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
  • Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
  • Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
  • Provides instant support for end users of application software.
  • Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
  • Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
  • Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
  • Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
  • Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
  • Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
  • Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
  • Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
  • Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
  • Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
  • Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
  • Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
  • Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
  • Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
  • Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
  • Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
  • Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
  • Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
  • Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
  • Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers)

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

job.title: Deputy Manager, HSE
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Purpose

The Deputy Manager, HSE supports the implementation and continuous improvement of Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) programmes, governance frameworks and management systems across Keppel's divisions/platform portfolios. The role partners business and operational teams to drive regulatory compliance, effective risk management, operational excellence and a positive safety culture across diverse assets, projects and operational environments.

The incumbent is expected to support HSE initiatives across multiple business segments and be adaptable to changing business priorities and deployment requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. HSE Governance and Assurance

  • Support the implementation and continual improvement of HSE policies, standards and management systems across assigned assets, operations and projects.
  • Coordinate and facilitate HSE committee meetings, management reviews and stakeholder engagements.
  • Plan and conduct workplace inspections, audits and compliance assessments to verify adherence to statutory, corporate and client requirements.
  • Monitor HSE performance indicators and assist in preparing management reports, dashboards and governance updates.

2. Risk Management and Operational Safety

  • Conduct and review risk assessments, safe work procedures and Method Statements to ensure hazards are identified and adequately controlled.
  • Support Permit-to-Work (PTW) processes and verify that critical risk activities are properly assessed and authorised.
  • Provide HSE advice and guidance to operational teams, contractors and project personnel on risk mitigation measures and safe work practices.
  • Participate in design reviews, operational readiness assessments and management of change processes where required.

3. Incident Management and Investigation

  • Support the reporting, investigation and management of incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions.
  • Facilitate root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Track and verify the completion and effectiveness of corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Share lessons learnt and promote continuous improvement across business units.

4. Contractor and Stakeholder Management

  • Support contractor pre-qualification, onboarding and performance monitoring processes.
  • Engage contractors, vendors and service providers to ensure compliance with HSE requirements.
  • Participate in site engagements, safety campaigns and leadership walkthroughs to strengthen HSE culture.

5. Regulatory Compliance and Reporting

  • Maintain HSE documentation, records and statutory submissions in accordance with legal and corporate requirements.
  • Monitor changes in HSE regulations and support the implementation of compliance measures.
  • Liaise with regulatory authorities, auditors and external stakeholders as required.

6. HSE Capability Development

  • Support the planning and delivery of HSE training, awareness programmes, emergency drills and campaigns for employees and contractors.
  • Promote proactive reporting of hazards, near misses and improvement opportunities.
  • Contribute to initiatives that enhance HSE culture, workforce competency and operational excellence.

7. General Support

  • Provide operational and administrative support for HSE programmes and strategic initiatives.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. job.title: Senior Manager (Security)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Security Strategy

► Contribute to business Security strategy and Security roadmap by providing siteperspective as per Site Security Plan.

► Align the site security strategy with the group policy

► Lead strategic initiatives aligned to business requirements at the site / plant level;Institutionalise operational excellence initiatives for the site

Security Budgeting

► Plan, prepare and monitor security budget including Capex and Opex; Finalise the budgetwith Vertical Security Head and get sanction on the same

► Monitor adherence to budgets and consult with Vertical Security Head in case of budgetshortage/ overruns

Governance

► Conduct timely reviews of all on‐going strategic initiatives at the site

► Participate in governance council meetings to suggest improvements and discuss pressingissues with key stakeholders

Intelligence & Vigilance

► Cultivate reliable sources of information with key decision makers in administrativebodies, police, local community and media to gather intelligence

Monitor and analyze daily local, national, and international news that might impact theorganization or the site

► Analyze the gathered intelligence, foresee risks, and develop mitigation plans

► Monitor the vigilance level of the site Security operations and drive alertness at all times

Security Risk Assessment

► Conduct security risk assessment and implement mitigation measures in consultation withVertical Security Head to counter threats and vulnerabilities

► Identify vulnerabilities and gaps in the established Security infrastructure, operations,systems, technologies of the site. Prioritise the gap and closed it within timeline.

► Assess the varied Security threat scenarios including product theft, vandalism, acts of

terror, pilferage, assault, unauthorized access facing the site

► Review the SRA report and ensure mitigation measures are put in place as per the findings

Security Audits

► Facilitate internal or third party security audits and conduct timely checks to ensurereliability of Security management system and submit report of audit findings to the

Corporate Team

► Review the Security audit report, analyse findings and conduct dialogue with theconcerned stakeholders for action planning and resolution; Ensure prompt closure of

open audit findings

Crisis & Incident

Management

► Design ERCP (Emergency response and control plan) plans for crises/ emergencies/incidents, to ensure business continuity and quick business recovery at the site

► Lead the implementation of the response plan during the crises/ emergencies/ incidentsand escalate to the management timely.

► Supervise efficient selection and training of staff for QRT (Quick Reaction Team)

► Revamp the response plans basis key learnings from incidents, to improve the businessreadiness to face crises and emergencies

Management and Review

► Monitor site operations and ensure adherence to established SOPs and SOGs.

► Analyse the MIS reports generated and publish reports on a weekly basis to the Site CEOand VSH

► Create security awareness and training programs for employees and community, alongwith the Site CEO

Security Control Room Operations

► Oversee end‐to‐end operations of Site Security Control Room; Lead maintenance andupgradation initiatives for the Control Room

► Monitor the operations of the Control Room and ensure proper integration with theNational Security Control Room

► Ensure the escalation of all incident and report of the group as per the Matrix

Patrolling & Surveillance

► Oversee the patrolling procedures of the site and manage exceptions

► Periodically check the data from CCTVs, sensors, and other such automation equipmentto ensure operational vigilance

Man & Vehicle Access Control

► Oversee the end‐to‐end operations of Access Control and ensure process adherence;

Manage deviations

► Oversee the end‐to‐end process of visitor access card management through theapplicable systems

Business Traffic Management

► Oversee the business traffic and material movement operations to ensure authorizationand authenticity checks are conducted as per SOPs

► Study the critical traffic blockages and suggest methods for improvement

Oversee the end‐to‐end operations of traffic management to ensure adherence toestablished traffic rules

Investigation & Due Diligence

► Conduct investigation of Security incidents including frauds, crimes, theft, pilferage,vandalizing and set in motion remedial measures

► Prepare and share investigation reports with BU team on investigations of criticalincidents

Protection

► Drive the Security systems, processes, and operations to ensure round the clockprotection to both the tangible and intangible assets as per the concept of ring security.

► Conduct security events as per the annual security plan and ensure proper securitydetailing is in place

► Channelize and coordinate traffic management to ensure least impacted route continuityfor the logistics flow

► Ensure the site/road survey conducted and then plan for Overweight and OverDimensional Consignment

PerformanceImprovement

► Define the performance metrics for evaluating Site Security domain and finalize with the Business Security Head; Lead performance review of Site Security

► Identify process gaps in the Site Security processes and lead process excellence initiativesto address the process gaps and drive efficiency

► Drive the team to champion process improvements and establish ownership of actionplans at appropriate points within Site Security

Outsourced Manpower Management

► Monitor and review the outsourced staff strength and accordingly conduct recruitment

► Oversee and evaluate performance of the third‐party security personnel services provider ensuring the deployed personnel are as per the defined parameters

► Engage periodically with the outsourced security employees to cater for their welfare

► Ensure the deployment of OMPs as per the work breakdown structure (WBS) and as their competency.

People Management

► Lead talent acquisition for all vacant positions at the site and support Vertical Security Head in talent identification and selection for critical roles

► Drive a performance driven culture – Set goals, review performance, and provide feedback to ensure a motivated and committed team

Project Management

► Identify and drive projects towards creation or improvement of security technology aids (automation systems) and infrastructure augmentation as per group security guidelines and industry standards / best practices aligned to overall group security strategy

► Implement and monitor efficient project management practices for timely execution and maximum RoI on identified projects

► Drive integration of new projects into mainstream security operations at site through processes and stakeholder buy in.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

► Bachelor’s degree in Business Management or other relevant field

► Postgraduate degree in relevant field

► Preferable to have Certifications including Certified Protection Professional (CPP) / Certified Fraud Examiners (CFE) /

Transported Asset Protection Association (TAPA) certification/ Physical Security Professional (PSP) / Industrial Security

professional certifications/ Project Management Professional (PMP) (Value Addition)

Must‐have Experiences (Major site):

► More than 12 years of experience in the field of Security and at least 5 years of experience in a leadership role in a similar position for large‐sized organization and directly report to Site Head.

► Rich experience leading Security operations of Access Control, Traffic Management, De‐risking, Infra‐structure and people protection, Fraud and misconduct investigation, Security technology solution, Security threat, Risk Assessment, Surveillance, and systems management for large sized site/ plant/ work‐unit, preferably spanning multiple geographies.

► Exposure to varied Security risk management verticals and seasoned understanding of crisis management and physical asset protection across varied businesses and geographies.

► Experience managing operational and capital expenditure budgets with exceptional planning and project management skills.

► Up to date knowledge and experience with regulatory compliance issues across varied Security sub‐domains.

► Robust understanding of investigation techniques and audit procedures.

job.title: Corporate Counsel - Commercial Contracts
job.description:
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Company

Singtel Group

Be a part of something BIG!

**

Say HELLO to BIG Possibilities with Singtel KL (Sudong MY Sdn Bhd)!

Singtel is Asia's leading communications technology group, our presence spans across 21 countries in Asia, Australia, and Africa. We thrive on innovation, digital transformation, and harnessing next-generation technology to create a more sustainable and digital future. Now, we are bringing this energy to Kuala Lumpur with the launch of our brand-new Shared Services Centre.

The Corporate Counsel - Commercial Contracts plays a strategic role in supporting Singtel’s Corporate Functions by providing end-to-end legal support across commercial contracting activities. This role involves drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts with domestic and global suppliers and partners, while working closely with Singapore-based stakeholders. You will act as a trusted legal advisor, providing pragmatic and commercially sound solutions, managing legal risks, and supporting business objectives in a fast-paced, cross-border environment.

**

Make an Impact by

  • Draft and negotiate contracts – Lead end-to-end drafting, review, and negotiation of procurement, partnership, and commercial agreements, with a particular focus on telecommunications, IT and/or procurement related transactions
  • Provide strategic legal advice – Offer practical, risk-based legal guidance on contractual, commercial, and operational matters
  • Partner with stakeholders – Work closely with business units including IT, Networks , Corporate Functions, and cross-functional teams to support business initiatives
  • Manage legal risk – Identify, assess, and mitigate legal and commercial risks in line with Singtel Group policies
  • Support global operations – Provide remote legal support to Singapore-based teams and collaborate with Group Legal
  • Maintain documentation – Ensure proper documentation, contract governance, and retention of organisational knowledge
  • Drive consistency – Apply standard processes, policies, and best practices across contract management activities
  • Resolve complex issues – Take the lead in addressing legal and commercial challenges with strong problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Build strong relationships – Develop effective working relationships with internal stakeholders across geographies

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Law and admitted to practice in Malaysia, Singapore, or the UK

Minimum of 10 years’ post‑qualification experience (PQE) gained in a reputable law firm or in‑house environment.**

Prior experience within the Technology, Media, and Telecommunications (TMT) industry will be a strong advantage.

  • Strong experience in commercial contract drafting, review, and negotiation
  • Solid understanding of corporate, commercial, and contract law
  • Experience handling cross-border contracting matters
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities effectively
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to provide pragmatic, solution-oriented advice
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
  • Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

job.title: Director, Carrier Sales
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

Be a Part of Something BIG!

We are seeking an accomplished, commercially driven Director, Carrier Sales to lead and accelerate the growth of Singtel's carrier business in Singapore and across the region. Reporting to the VP, Carrier Services, you will lead a team of Account Managers serving telecommunications carriers, global service providers, hyperscalers and service-based operators. This senior sales leadership role is accountable for revenue growth, profitability, new customer acquisition and customer excellence. You will shape regional sales execution and strengthen Singtel's position as a leading connectivity and digital infrastructure partner.

Make An Impact

Sales Leadership & Business Growth

  • Lead the Carrier Sales business with accountability for revenue, operating expenditure and EBITDA performance.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies to accelerate profitable growth, expand market share and strengthen competitive positioning.
  • Win new business and expand existing accounts across carrier, hyperscaler and global service provider segments.
  • Drive regional sales growth through new customer acquisition, commercial opportunities and strategic customer relationships.
  • Oversee carrier sales activities and business performance across Singapore, Malaysia and the Philippines.

Strategic Account & Customer Management

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key customers and decision-makers.
  • Strengthen engagement with global hyperscalers, telecommunications operators and multinational customers to drive sustainable revenue.
  • Champion customer excellence by improving responsiveness, service delivery and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive disciplined account planning, pipeline management, sales forecasting, commercial negotiations and payment collection.

Commercial & Operational Excellence

  • Optimise sales performance, cost-to-serve and operational efficiency to improve margins in a competitive market.
  • Collaborate with product, network, operations, finance and other business units to deliver compelling customer solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to grow wallet share, monetise existing accounts and introduce new services.
  • Improve sales processes and customer engagement to strengthen commercial effectiveness.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of Account Managers with clear sales goals and accountability.
  • Build sales capabilities to navigate complex multinational customer organisations and close high-value opportunities.
  • Develop talent, strengthen succession pipelines and foster an engaged, collaborative sales culture.

Skills for Success

  • Extensive experience in B2B, enterprise or carrier sales, with a proven record of delivering significant revenue growth and exceeding targets.
  • Demonstrated success leading substantial sales portfolios and high-performing sales teams, with accountability for revenue, profitability and customer growth.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

At Singtel, you will help shape the future of connectivity and digital infrastructure while working with leading telecommunications operators and global technology companies. Drive meaningful commercial impact, develop high-performing sales teams and contribute to our continued growth across Singapore and the region.

Join us and help shape the next chapter of Singtel’s carrier business.

job.title: Electronic Systems Engineer - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and supports the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and collaborates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

  • Support Transitioning PSBU products to Phase 35 software (Core 2)
  • Requires collaboration with resources in US, India, UK and China, provides great global experience.
  • Support Global VPI software development to meet T4 and StgV emissions
  • Convert PSBU owned Phase 25 and Phase 32 components to be Phase 35 compatible
  • Simulink, Matlab, C, Integrity, C2ST experience is necessary.
  • Basic Bench testing knowledge would be added advantage
  • Basic awareness about system integration of engine and its applications

**

job.title: Process Lead- Finance & Procurement Services
job.description:
Hello Visionary!

We provide extensive high-quality and cost-efficient Finance & Procurement services from purchasing to the processing of outgoing payments, Cash allocation, Fixed Assets accounting, Accounts reconciliation and Closing & Reporting. We work with a strongly integrated system and a highly automated processing environment and digital workforce.

Our customers receive innovative, easy-to-use services. We deliver maximum value to the business by driving process optimization and digitalization using our ambitious approach, and we support our customers’ current and future business requirements with the help of our high level of process and automation competency.**

Position Overview

We are looking for a GST Compliance professional with 2+ years of hands-on experience in GST compliance, e-Way Bill controls and reporting. The role requires strong working knowledge of e-Way Bill reconciliation, GST returns, Input Tax Credit (ITC), tax liability reconciliations with accounting ledgers and turnover, and effective coordination with business stakeholders. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and disciplined management of statutory timelines are essential

You’ll make a difference by:

E-Way Bill Reconciliation & Controls

  • Perform periodic reconciliation of e-Way Bill data with the Sales Register and GSTR-1 reporting available in SAP reports.
  • Identify invoice transactions where e-Way Bills were required but not generated, and e-Way Bills generated without corresponding transactions in the books/system.
  • Investigate exceptions and collaborate with business teams to obtain appropriate supporting documents.
  • Prepare monthly e-Way Bill exception reports, track open issues, and drive closure with a clear audit trail.
  • Review discrepancies in invoice number/date, document value, GSTIN, HSN, vehicle details, customer information, and place of supply.

E-Way Bill Compliance

  • Manage end-to-end e-Way Bill compliance for movement of goods.
  • Determine applicability based on transaction type, value, movement of goods, and relevant GST requirements.
  • Review e-Way Bills for accuracy and ensure correct completion of Part A and Part B.
  • Validate supplier/recipient GSTIN, document details, HSN, taxable value, dispatch/delivery location, transporter ID, vehicle number, mode of transport, distance, and other transportation details.
  • Monitor e-Way Bill validity and coordinate permitted cancellations, vehicle updates, transporter updates, and other changes.
  • Monitor duplicate, cancelled, expired, or incorrect e-Way Bills and coordinate corrective actions.

Transaction-Specific e-Way Bill Review

  • Review the transaction flow and determine the appropriate e-Way Bill treatment for:
  • Domestic sales; inter-state and intra-state movements
  • Stock/branch transfers; customer and purchase returns
  • Job-work transactions; warehouse movements
  • Imports and exports
  • Bill-to / Ship-to transactions and transporter movements
  • Delivery challan-based movements and other movements without a conventional sales invoice, where applicable**

GST Compliance

  • GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B compliance
  • GSTR-2B reconciliation and Input Tax Credit review
  • Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM)
  • Debit and Credit Notes and GST amendments
  • GST reconciliations and registrations
  • Basic understanding of blocked/ineligible ITC
  • GST documentation and record retention

E-Invoice Compliance

  • Understand e-Invoicing applicability and monitor IRN generation.
  • Review IRN and QR code-related exceptions.
  • Reconcile e-Invoice data with ERP/SAP transactions.
  • Understand the relationship between e-Invoice, GST invoice, Delivery Challan, and e-Way Bill, including supporting documentation based on the purpose of goods movement.
  • Coordinate resolution of e-Invoice errors with business and IT teams.

Your success is grounded

  • Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Taxation, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in GST / Indirect Tax compliance.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in e-Way Bill compliance and working knowledge of Indian GST provisions.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience handling large transaction volumes and GST/e-Way Bill reconciliations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, manage statutory deadlines, and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

Preferred Skill

  • SAP S/4HANA experience
  • Knowledge of e-Invoicing and IRN compliance
  • Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, multinational, or shared-services environments
  • Experience handling multi-state GST registrations
  • Advanced Excel / Power Query skills
  • Exposure to GST audits and departmental queries
  • Experience in process improvement and automation

Key Competencies

  • Strong e-Way Bill technical knowledge and GST compliance expertise
  • SAP proficiency and Excel/data-analysis skills
  • Reconciliation capability and analytical thinking
  • Problem solving and attention to detail
  • Ownership, accountability, and stakeholder management
  • Ability to work effectively under tight compliance deadlines

Join us and be yourself!

This role is based in Bangalore, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and We encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

job.title: Community Engagement Partner
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimal bureaucracy between you and the work.

Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Community Engagement Partner leads Firmus’ regional engagement strategy in their dedicated states. The role builds trusted partnerships with communities, government, industry, education providers and local organisations, connecting regional priorities with project delivery and long-term shared value. Working across the asset development lifecycle, the manager brings community insight, local knowledge and stakeholder intelligence into executive decisions, approvals, delivery planning, operational readiness and social licence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set and lead the regional engagement and partnerships strategy for Firmus projects, ensuring community priorities, regulatory commitments and business objectives are addressed through clear plans and accountable delivery.
  • Build and steward community partnerships with local and state government, industry, education and training providers, community organisations and community leaders.
  • Establish forums and collaborative initiatives that bring diverse partners together around regional opportunities, shared challenges and practical outcomes.
  • Provide senior counsel on stakeholder dynamics, community expectations, emerging issues and regional sentiment, translating intelligence into decisions, mitigations and delivery priorities.
  • Lead engagement across planning, construction and operational phases, maintaining consistency while tailoring approaches to the needs and character of each region.
  • Shape partnership investments and administer Firmus’ community grants program to strengthen local capability, workforce pathways, industry participation and enduring regional benefit.
  • Prepare executive briefings, strategic advice and decision papers that connect community perspectives, partnership intelligence and organisational priorities.
  • Represent Firmus in senior stakeholder meetings, public forums and regional networks, building confidence through clear communication, sound judgment and reliable follow-through.
  • Embed respectful, culturally informed engagement with First Nations communities and organisations, recognising the importance of Country, local knowledge and community-led priorities.
  • Develop governance, reporting and evaluation practices that demonstrate partnership value, track commitments and support continuous improvement across the engagement function.

Skills & Experience

  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in community development, communications, public policy, social planning or a related discipline, or equivalent senior-level experience.
  • At least 10 years’ relevant experience leading community engagement, strategic partnerships, stakeholder relations, regional development or corporate affairs, preferably in infrastructure, energy, construction, technology or other complex project environments.
  • A strong record of establishing and sustaining trusted partnerships across government, industry, education, community and advocacy sectors.
  • Demonstrated experience advising executives on complex stakeholder matters, emerging issues, reputation risk and community expectations.
