job.title: Principal Engineer, Observability
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

ROLE SUMMARY

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Principal Engineer, Observability to own how Firmus operations teams and customers see the AI factory as one system, from site power and cooling to the GPU and the workload running on it. You will own the telemetry standard every team emits to, the platform that collects, stores, and queries it, and the applications that operations teams and customers use. Every team should be able to build its own dashboards and alerts without waiting on yours. Every new site adds millions of samples per second, and the platform must keep up as Firmus grows to hundreds of thousands of GPUs in gigawatt-scale AI factories, without losing critical data or slowing queries.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and decisions

  • Own the architecture of the observability platform across every data centre and cloud region, from collection and transport to storage, query, alerting, and the applications on top. Set a target architecture two to three years ahead and plan the steps from today's system to it.
  • Design the platform to grow tenfold without a redesign, through sharding, retention tiers, cardinality budgets, and capacity plans. Prove the headroom with load tests before each new site goes live.
  • Design around the same repeatable unit as the estate. Each site keeps observing itself when its link to the rest of Firmus is down, one global view spans every site, and new sites come on through the site deployment kit with no local fork.
  • Own the telemetry standard: what each layer emits and how signals are named, labelled, and versioned, enforced by checks in every team's build pipeline.
  • Lead design reviews for significant changes across the teams, sign off architecture decision records, and settle technical disputes escalated by engineers. Decide at pace with incomplete information, write down the assumptions, and revisit a decision when the evidence changes.

Build and evolve

  • Write production code for the hardest parts, including collection at fleet scale, the telemetry pipeline, query performance, and the observability API and applications.
  • Make observability self-service for every team. Teams onboard a service and build their own dashboards, alerts, and SLOs as code from templates, within the telemetry and alerting standards and their own budgets for cardinality and retention, without filing a ticket.
  • Set delivery guarantees for each class of telemetry. Critical operational and customer-billable signals are never lost, and any loss elsewhere is measured and recoverable.
  • Build and own the live topology model (digital twin) of every site, hall, rack, tray, GPU, network link, and cooling loop. Keep it in step with the inventory source of truth and map every signal to it.
  • Cover all layer customers depend on, from GPU and interconnect health and network fabric events to storage performance per job and Kubernetes control-plane metrics. Run passive and active health checks that signal failing GPUs, links, and nodes for draining before customers notice.
  • Bring facilities telemetry into the same model as compute. Operations teams see power, cooling, and leak events immediately, together with the workloads they affect.
  • Serve telemetry to internal consumers, including the data platform and the intelligence platform, through stable, versioned interfaces with agreed freshness and completeness, and make it usable by AI agents for diagnosis, with scoped access and an audit trail.
  • Deliver telemetry to customers and partner platforms on open standards such as OpenTelemetry, within seconds of collection, with ready-made dashboards, query access, alerts to their own channels, and forwarding to their own tools. Each customer sees only their own tenancy, enforced at every layer.

Reliability, security, and cost

  • Set SLOs and error budgets for observability and use the budget to decide when reliability work comes first.
  • Lead the technical response to major incidents in observability and make sure every post-mortem ends with a fix that stops it happening again.
  • Set the alerting standard. Every alert is actionable, reaches the right responder, and links to a runbook. Prove detection works by injecting faults.
  • Make service-level measurement reproducible. Firmus and a customer should get the same availability from the same data.
  • Design the telemetry stores to upgrade in rolling waves with no gap in data, and keep dependencies and images patched within policy.
  • Keep Firmus' SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 controls passing at every new site.
  • Own cost at the design level, including retention, cardinality, and data volume.

Technical leadership

  • Grow engineers through mentorship, design review, and code review. Hiring and performance review sit with the Engineering Manager.
  • Set how the team uses AI to build software effectively and securely, with review gates and automated architecture checks that keep AI-generated code within the agreed design.
  • Own the technical interviews and assessments for engineers and hold every candidate to that bar.

Partnership and communication

  • Shape the observability roadmap with operations, infrastructure, facilities, and product, and have telemetry in place before each new site or product launches.
  • Agree ownership in writing at each boundary, including which team emits each signal, which team consumes it, and which team acts on it, and settle disagreements directly.
  • Work with the operations centre and the intelligence platform team to make first-level incident response and root-cause analysis faster and turn the problems they hit into product improvements.
  • Represent observability in customer briefings on telemetry, health, and how service levels are measured.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years in software, infrastructure, or platform engineering, including at least 3 years at principal level or equivalent, setting the technical direction that multiple teams delivered against. You are still hands-on and intend to stay that way.
  • Has designed a metrics, logs, and traces platform handling millions of samples per second and run it in-house on Prometheus-compatible stores such as VictoriaMetrics, Thanos, or Mimir, with high cardinality, long retention, and a global query view across more than one site. Scaled it several times over as load grew, without a redesign.
  • Has run a streaming ingestion layer for telemetry (such as Kafka or Redpanda, with Vector or the OpenTelemetry Collector) and handled consumer lag, backpressure, and broker failures without losing critical data.
  • Has defined a telemetry schema on open standards such as OpenTelemetry or OpenMetrics that other teams relied on as a contract and given those teams self-service to build their own dashboards and alerts on it.
  • Has collected telemetry from hardware or networks, not only applications, through at least one of Redfish, gNMI with OpenConfig models, or DCGM.
  • Production Kubernetes as the runtime for observability: running and upgrading stateful, high-throughput services such as Kafka or a metrics store with no data loss.
  • Strong in Go or Python, with production services, APIs, or applications that other teams or customers use.
  • Has built security into production services: access control, secrets handling, and patching, under SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent control set.
  • Has set an alerting standard across teams that cut noise and measurably reduced time to detect and time to restore, backed by SLOs and incident reviews that changed the system.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, able to explain problems, decisions, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and customers.
  • Willing to join the on-call rotation for the services you own and to travel overseas occasionally.

Bonus Points

  • Background at an AI cloud or high-performance compute provider, ideally with GPU health checks, burn-in testing, or failure prediction across a fleet.
  • Integrated facilities or operational technology telemetry, such as OPC UA, Modbus, or data from SCADA and building management systems.
  • Built a digital twin or live topology model of a physical estate from an inventory source of truth.
  • Delivered telemetry to external customers with tenant isolation and access controls.
  • Served telemetry to a data platform or to analytics and machine-learning pipelines used for incident response or root-cause analysis.
  • Wrote or extended Kubernetes operators for stateful services.
  • Led a team's use of AI-assisted and agentic engineering, measured by delivery outcomes and token cost, and kept it secure with sandboxed agents, least-privilege access, and review gates.
  • Certifications such as CKA or CKAD, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry Certified Associate, or Confluent Certified Administrator for Apache Kafka.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Singapore
  • Hybrid: 4 days in office, 1 day work from home
  • Report to: Head of Platform Engineering

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

**

job.title: Finance and Commercial Excellence Manager
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

**

Role Overview

**We are seeking a high-impact finance professional to join the Australia leadership team in a hybrid role spanning Financial Planning & Analysis and Commercial Excellence. This role is designed to strengthen financial rigor while materially improving sales effectiveness by embedding disciplined pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, and performance cadence across the sales organization.

The role partners closely with the Finance Business Partner and Sales leadership, acting as the connective tissue between financial outcomes, commercial execution, and sales predictability.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

**

  • Financial Planning & Analysis – Lead and support forecasting, budgeting, monthly close and financial planning activities, partnering with the Finance Business Partner and regional FP&A teams.
  • Financial Performance & Insights – Analyse P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, orders, backlog, pricing, costs and segment profitability to identify trends, risks and opportunities and support informed business decisions.
  • Executive & Management Reporting – Prepare accurate and insightful financial and commercial reporting, dashboards and presentations for senior leadership and regional stakeholders.
  • Finance Integration & Process Improvement – Support financial system and process integrations, including data migration, validation and harmonisation, while driving improvements in automation, reporting accuracy and efficiency.
  • Sales Pipeline & Forecast Management – Drive pipeline health, sales forecast accuracy and early identification of commercial risks and opportunities to improve revenue predictability and business performance.
  • Commercial Excellence & Sales Governance – Establish and maintain disciplined sales processes, opportunity definitions, pipeline inspection rhythms and governance aligned with regional commercial excellence standards.
  • CRM, Data & Performance Ownership – Own CRM governance, sales dashboards and commercial data quality, ensuring reliable information is available to support sales performance, forecasting and strategic decision-making.
  • Sales Performance & Commercial Execution – Partner with sales leaders to establish targets, strengthen performance review cadences and translate pipeline and backlog insights into actionable sales priorities, while leading the local execution and change management of commercial excellence initiatives.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

  • Strong FP&A and financial analysis capability, with demonstrated experience in budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, variance analysis and translating financial data into meaningful business insights.
  • Commercially focused mindset with the ability to understand key business drivers, including revenue, margin, pricing, costs, orders and backlog, and provide recommendations that support profitable growth.
  • Experience partnering with sales and commercial teams highly regarded, including exposure to CRM platforms, sales pipeline management, forecasting, sales performance metrics and commercial reporting.
  • Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, with the ability to work confidently with complex datasets, develop robust financial models and improve reporting through automation and analytical tools.
  • CPA, CFA or equivalent professional finance qualification preferred, supported by approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience across FP&A, commercial finance, business partnering or a related finance discipline.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities and confidently engage with senior finance, sales and business leaders.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better.

This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

job.title: Product Manager – Product Strategy & Growth
job.description:
Role: Product Manager – Product Strategy & Growth

Location: Bangalore

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier

**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

**

About the role: This role defines product strategy and drives business growth by translating market and stakeholder needs into actionable priorities. The Product Manager identifies growth opportunities through adoption analysis, assesses product potential, and develops commercial strategies, including pricing and offering tiers. The role oversees the product lifecycle—from roadmap prioritization and development tracking to launch and post-launch feedback—while connecting stakeholders, engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success. It also monitors competitors and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Product Strategy & Business Case

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and value proposition aligned to business objectives.
  • Build business cases covering market opportunity, customer need, competitive positioning, revenue potential, investment, and ROI.
  • Develop financial models, pricing scenarios, and commercialization strategies.
  • Present investment recommendations to leadership; track market trends and emerging technology to drive innovation.

**

2. Pricing & Commercial Strategy

  • Define pricing, packaging, and monetization models; benchmark against competitive pricing.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and business leaders to optimize commercial models.
  • Monitor profitability, ARR, margin, adoption, and customer lifetime value, and recommend pricing adjustments.

3. Roadmap & Prioritization

  • Own and maintain the product roadmap; translate opportunities into initiatives, epics, and releases.
  • Facilitate prioritization workshops balancing customer need, business value, technical feasibility, and strategy.
  • Apply prioritization frameworks based on ROI, customer impact, and market demand.
  • Drive alignment across engineering, UX, customer success, sales, and executive stakeholders.

4. Requirements Management

  • Gather, analyze, and document business and customer requirements.
  • Author PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional/non-functional specifications.
  • Work with UX and Engineering to refine solutions and validate technical feasibility.
  • Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and product reviews.

5. Launch & Adoption

  • Define launch, enablement, and adoption strategies; execute go-to-market plans with Marketing and Sales.
  • Drive onboarding, customer training, and customer success initiatives.
  • Track adoption, usage, engagement, retention, and revenue performance.
  • Identify adoption barriers, act on post-release feedback, and improve value realization.

6. Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership

  • Act as the primary point of contact for product decisions across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate consensus and decision-making across diverse groups.
  • Report roadmap progress, product performance, risks, and opportunities; influence strategy with data-driven recommendations.

7. Performance & Analytics

  • Define and track product KPIs and success metrics.
  • Measure adoption, retention, revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and ROI.
  • Maintain executive dashboards and lead periodic product performance reviews.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, or Computer Science; or an MBA with specialization in Product Management.
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or Product Strategy roles.
  • Demonstrated experience across business case development, pricing and commercialization, roadmap management, requirements documentation, and go-to-market execution.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum product development methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, financial modelling, and problem-solving capability.
  • Experience with SaaS, digital, or platform products and subscription-based business models.
  • Exposure to product analytics tooling and data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience managing products across multiple markets, segments, or channel partners.

Benefits

We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and well‑being programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees’ health, security, and success.

job.title: Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar

Your Work Shapes the World

Whether it is groundbreaking products, best-in-class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do work that matters at Caterpillar. When you join Caterpillar, you join a global team of makers, innovators and doers who turn progress and innovation into outcomes for customers and communities.

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to provide product and technical leadership for MineStar development. This role leads engineering teams responsible for developing, integrating, enhancing, maintaining and supporting mining technology solutions that deliver measurable value for customers.

The Senior Engineering Manager operates across a broader product and organisational scope than an Engineering Manager while providing direct leadership to engineering managers and supervisors in the organization. The role translates MineStar product strategy into executable engineering priorities, develops leaders and technical talent, and ensures teams deliver safe, reliable, supportable and competitive solutions.

This leader will partner closely with product management, commercial and product support organisations, process owners, suppliers, dealers and mining customers. Success requires strong engineering judgement, disciplined program execution, customer focus, global collaboration and the ability to influence complex decisions through technical and business expertise.

What You Will Do

  • Lead a portfolio of MineStar product development, integration, enhancement, maintenance work, aligning engineering outcomes with product strategy and business priorities.
  • Translate strategic direction into department objectives, roadmaps, resource plans, budgets and measurable delivery commitments across multiple teams or technical workstreams.
  • Provide leadership and performance management for engineering managers, technical leaders and product development staff. Build succession strength and a high-performing leadership pipeline.
  • Coordinate technical feasibility assessment, architecture and design optimisation, validation planning, cost and schedule management, risk assessment, mitigation and ongoing production support.
  • Own or influence engineering investment decisions and manage the research and development budget for the assigned MineStar portfolio, balancing new capability, modernisation, quality, reliability and customer support.
  • Establish governance and operating rhythms that provide stakeholders with clear visibility into scope, decisions, dependencies, risks, financial performance and delivery status.
  • Guide the resolution of complex, cross-component and field issues by bringing together internal experts, suppliers, dealers and customer teams. Ensure that lessons learned improve future product and process decisions.
  • Champion systems and software engineering discipline, technical excellence, cybersecurity, safety, quality, reliability, scalability and lifecycle support across MineStar solutions.
  • Monitor customer needs, market dynamics, competitor movement and technology developments. Recommend product, capability and engineering responses that strengthen MineStar customer value and competitive position.
  • Build strong partnerships across Caterpillar business units and functions and with external suppliers. Reconcile competing priorities and create shared accountability for outcomes.
  • Represent MineStar with customers, dealers, suppliers and senior leaders, communicating complex technical and business issues clearly and serving as a trusted engineering adviser.
  • Foster innovation, operational excellence, inclusion and continuous improvement while maintaining urgency and accountability for commitments.

Education Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or closely related technical curriculum.
  • An advanced technical or business degree is preferred.

What Skills You Will Have

Planning: Tactical and Strategic

Develops integrated plans across multiple teams; converts product strategy into sequenced engineering priorities; allocates people and funding against the highest-value outcomes; and adjusts plans using data, risks and changing business conditions.

Technical Excellence

Creates an environment that rewards technical excellence; provides recognised leadership on complex systems and software challenges; engages the appropriate subject-matter experts; and ensures decisions reflect sound architecture, engineering evidence and lifecycle considerations.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking

Frames ambiguous problems, evaluates alternatives with multiple stakeholders, distinguishes facts from assumptions, anticipates second-order effects and makes timely decisions during high-impact or customer-critical situations.

Product Design and Development

Leads cross-functional development from concept through production and support; strengthens development methods and governance; and balances customer value, speed, quality, cost, reliability and technical debt.

Customer and Market Focus

Maintains a direct understanding of mining customer needs and success criteria; responds proactively to market and competitive shifts; resolves difficult customer issues; and converts field insight into prioritised product and engineering action.

Influencing Through Expertise

Explains complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences; challenges decisions constructively with evidence; builds trust across organisational boundaries; and develops others as credible technical advisers.

Collaborating Globally

Builds networks across functions, regions, dealers, suppliers and customers; reconciles conflicting interests; uses collective expertise to solve complex problems; and creates shared ownership for business results.

People Leadership and Career Development

Develops managers and technical leaders, establishes business-driven development plans, identifies mission-critical capability gaps, supports targeted rotations and learning, and links talent decisions to long-term MineStar needs.

Program, Financial and Risk Management

Manages a portfolio of commitments, budgets, dependencies and risks; establishes transparent operating mechanisms; and intervenes early when delivery, quality, cost or customer outcomes are at risk.

Troubleshooting and Production Support

Directs the structured resolution of complex and non-recurring failures, coordinates internal and external experts, establishes mechanisms for problem tracking and organisational learning, and ensures corrective actions address root causes.

Basic Qualifications

  • Typically fifteen or more years of progressively responsible experience in engineering, software, systems or product development, including significant leadership responsibility. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
  • Demonstrated experience leading managers, technical leaders or multiple engineering teams delivering complex products or integrated systems.
  • Experience managing product development scope, schedules, budgets, risks and production-support priorities.
  • Experience working across organisational boundaries and communicating with senior leaders, customers and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based decisions and deliver outcomes through others.

Top Candidates Will Also Have

  • Experience with MineStar, mining technology, autonomy, fleet management, site systems or related digital products.
  • Experience with software-intensive and systems-of-systems product development, including cloud and on-premises deployments and integration with machine or site technology.
  • Experience implementing Gen AI development tools and practices.
  • Knowledge of Caterpillar product development and new product introduction processes, or comparable lifecycle governance in a complex industrial environment.
  • Experience modernising established products while maintaining compatibility, quality and customer continuity.
  • Demonstrated success developing engineering managers and senior technical talent across global teams.
  • Direct experience engaging mining customers, dealers, suppliers and product support organisations.

Additional Information

  • Location, relocation support and travel requirements will be confirmed for the final posting.
  • The role is expected to include regular interaction with global teams, suppliers, dealers and mining customers.
  • Final experience requirements and internal job classification should be validated with Human Resources before posting.

What You Will Get

A career with a global team whose engineering work helps customers build a better, more sustainable world, together with Caterpillar total rewards and development opportunities applicable to the position and location

Posting Dates:

October 12, 2026 - October 26, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Sustainable and scalable energy procurement is growing in focus across our business and this role will provide critical expertise and execution across Oracle Cloud data centers.

At Oracle, we are committed to maintaining 100% carbon-free electricity for our offices and public cloud offerings. Additionally, we are setting a new goal to achieve 100% carbon-free electricity for Oracle Custom AI Data Centers by 2035.

  • Create and manage requirements around energy sourcing including leveraging expertise of power markets regulation, financial modeling and analysis, managing RFPs, contract negotiations, development and execution of forward purchasing strategies

  • Support team delivering power to new DC sites including electricity supply equipment, utility tariffs, contract negotiations, financial modelling, RFPs, and supplier onboarding

Qualifications:

This team comprises experienced project managers who work collaboratively with vendors and internal teams to ensure the successful execution of complex data center construction and network projects.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to own end-to-end delivery of network and data center capacity across concurrent builds. The role comes with a high degree of personal accountability and autonomy and will require effective engagement across Design, Engineering and Operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Being the end-to-end leader in charge of the program, from shaping the approach to achieving the desired outcomes through delivery.
  • Project Planning: Develop and implement long-term strategies for data center construction and network build projects to align with organizational goals.
  • Partner with the design team to ensure design and construction are fully coordinated in advance of contracting.
  • Partner with Construction team to ensure collaboration and seamless handoff.
  • Project Management: Oversee all phases of complex data center construction projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
  • Tenant Fit Out and LV Integration: Work closely throughout design, construction, commissioning and LV fit out to fully coordinate and integrate the separate scopes of tenant fit out projects with the overall project scope.
  • Vendor Management: Select, negotiate, and manage external vendors, contractors, and suppliers to ensure project success.
  • Budget Oversight: Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring cost control.
  • Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to maintain project timelines and budgets.
  • Engage directly with Colo and LV partners' leadership and project management teams, driving accountability and improvements.
  • Engage with internal teams to deliver proper design and process documentation, execute ISP circuit contracts, and update internal tracking tools for handover to operations teams.
  • Regular project visits to ensure schedule, coordination, and quality.

Qualifications:

  • Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
  • Experience in data center construction, network build projects, and capacity delivery.
  • Strong vendor management and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to anticipate and mitigate risks to datacenter delivery.
  • High degree of personal accountability and autonomy.

job.title: Design Coordinator
job.description:
Design Coordinator - Leighton Contractors (Asia) Limited (Singapore Branch), Singapore

Job Responsibilities:

  • Review structural / Architectural design drawings and documents submitted by the consultant for constructability, compliance with project specifications and potential clashes with other disciplines. Responsible for timely scheduling and issuance of CBP drawings and rebar drawings align with project schedule and construction activities.
  • Work closely with structural consultants/architectural/M&E engineers/ BIM modellers and various subcontractors to resolve structural/technical issues and ensure smooth integration of different disciplines.
  • Provide technical support to the site team on structural-related matters, interpreting design drawings and resolving site queries. Liaise with the structural consultant to address site issues and implement design changes or clarifications as needed.
  • Maintaining proper documentation of design changes, site instructions and correspondences. Attending technical meetings and Internal / External design coordination meetings to report outcomes and ensure effective communication among project stakeholders.
  • Compiling and handing over structural as-built drawings upon project completion.

Job Requirements:

  • Diploma or Degree in Civil Engineering or related fields
  • Total Work Experience: 2-4 years
  • Drafting experience is a plus
  • Working with LTA experience: At least 1-2 years is a plus

job.title: Sustainability Director, APAC
job.description:
Sustainability Director, APAC - Vantage Data Centers APAC Pte. Ltd, Singapore

Vantage Data Centers APAC Pte. Ltd seeks a regional Sustainability Director to lead APAC sustainability programs, partnering with cross-functional teams to align global strategy with local priorities. You will guide development decisions, engage stakeholders, and drive regional implementation with the Global Sustainability COE. The role focuses on setting regional sustainability goals, roadmaps, and ensuring alignment with market conditions, regulation, and customer needs.

This is the regional anchor for Vantage's sustainability agenda in APAC: you translate a global strategy into decisions made on the ground, sitting alongside the teams choosing sites, designing and building data centres, buying equipment and running operations. Expect to advise executives, steer capital-project trade-offs and carry the company's sustainability story into customer conversations and public forums.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Advise the regional leadership team on where sustainability creates risk or opportunity
  • Sit in the rooms where site selection, design and procurement decisions get made so that sustainability is embedded at the point of decision
  • Guide cross-functional partners through the sustainability dimensions of large capital projects - energy sourcing, water strategy, embodied carbon and supply chain engagement
  • Work with a regional Sustainability Engineer on implementation and performance improvement
  • Support customer RFP responses, audits and strategic conversations with hyperscalers
  • Build regional goals and roadmaps that hold up to scrutiny
  • Feed quality data into global reporting and assurance processes
  • Build sustainability literacy across regional teams
  • Engage with local government, NGOs, and community stakeholders on sustainability matters
  • Support policy engagement alongside Public Policy colleagues
  • Manage greenwashing risk and ensure disclosure credibility

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in corporate sustainability, environmental strategy or ESG within complex multinational organisations
  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, finance, sustainability or data science
  • Demonstrated experience embedding sustainability into large capital projects - infrastructure, energy, manufacturing or real estate, ideally data centres
  • Cross-functional influence experience across engineering, construction, operations, procurement, commercial, and public policy
  • Direct experience facing customers on sustainability topics through RFP responses or audits
  • Experience with greenwashing risk and disclosure credibility

job.title: Cabling Consultant - Data Centre
job.description:
Cabling Consultant - Data Centre (Loyang / Sunview) - CBRE Pte Ltd, Singapore

Job Responsibility:

  • Take lead and manage the cabling design for client's existing and new data center. Work closely with global EDC Infrastructure Cabling Engineering team on the detailed design to ensure global consistency.
  • Prepare technical tender documents and specifications (e.g. design drawing, scope of work, cabling design criteria, tender price sheet), work with client's procurement team to issue RFP. Conduct tender interviews, issue tender queries and provide recommendation report on selecting cabling vendors.
  • Coordinate with Internal Technology teams (e.g. Telco Networking, Server, Security Firewall teams, etc) collecting cabling design requirements.
  • Project manage budget, cabling vendor, review shop drawings, procurement, delivery logistics, schedule installation and program, and witness commissioning testing and handover.
  • Project close out of cabling O&M manuals and as-built drawings.
  • Plan and manage the new cabling requirement or change requirement in existing DC.
  • Manage the cabling record (patching record, patch panel record) in existing DC operation.
  • Work with DC Operation team in managing Move and Changes in existing DC, sourcing consumables with vendors, manage material stock level based on project and operation needs.

Products familiarization:

  • Panduit Cat6A copper & fiber (OS2, OM4+) products, experience in high density fiber cassette solutions
  • Panduit / CPI Racks/cabinets, Panduit patching frames or equivalent
  • Thorough understanding on using Fluke Network Instruments (e.g. DSX-5000 or 8000 Cable Analyzer)
  • Industry best practices, including familiarization with ISO/TIA based testing standards/regimes
  • Experience in using LC, MPO/MTP interfaces for single or multimode fiber solutions
  • Experience in Cisco and Arista equipment is a plus

Requirements:

  • Data center related work experience, financial company background is a plus.
  • Good understanding of existing live data center environment and constraints.
  • AutoCAD.
  • Relevant international cabling certifications is a plus (e.g. RCDD).
  • Project Management is a plus (such as PMP)

job.title: Structured Cabling System & Fibre Technician (Data Center)
job.description:
Structured Cabling System & Fibre Technician (Data Center) - Sudlows Asia Pacific Pte Ltd, Singapore

Join the Team Building the Digital Infrastructure of Tomorrow. We're looking for an experienced SCS & Fibre Technician to become a key part of our growing team, delivering world-class network infrastructure solutions across mission-critical facilities and enterprise environments. The role provides excellent opportunities to travel across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, supporting the delivery of high-profile data centre and network infrastructure projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, terminate, and test copper (Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6a) and fibre optic cabling (single-mode and multi-mode) in data centres and office environments.
  • Comprehensive fibre optic knowledge with pre-terminated MPO plug and play and conventional and ribbon fibre systems is essential.
  • Label and document cable installations according to industry standards and company requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and repair cabling issues, including identifying faulty connections and resolving connectivity problems.
  • Perform cable routing, dressing, and patching to maintain an organised and efficient data centre or office environment.
  • Adhere to safety standards and best practices while working in high-density server and network environments.
  • Conduct cable testing using OTDR, OLTS, and cable certifiers.
  • Assist with equipment moves, additions, and changes (MACs) as required.
  • Maintain accurate records of cable infrastructure, including diagrams and labelling schemes.
  • Collaborate with other technical teams to support network and IT infrastructure needs.

Essential Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in structured cabling installation, preferably in data centre and office environments.
  • Familiarity with fibre optic and copper cabling standards (TIA/EIA, BICSI, ANSI).
  • Experience using cable testing and certification tools (Fluke testers, OTDR, etc.).
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, and network schematics.
  • Knowledge of cable management best practices, including cable tray, conduit, and raceway installation.
  • Strong attention to detail and maintaining a clean and organised workspace.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • BICSI Installer, Technician, or equivalent certification.
  • Previous experience working in live data centre environments.
  • Understanding of switches, routers, patch panels, and network hardware.
  • Experience supporting large-scale infrastructure deployments.

job.title: Data Center Security & EHS Leader
job.description:
Data Center Security & EHS Leader - TikTok Pte. Ltd., Singapore (Remote)

TikTok Pte. Ltd. is seeking a Data Centre Security & EHS Manager to provide end-to-end operational support for global data centre infrastructure. You will implement and enforce safety and security policies across the global data centre portfolio, oversee physical security and EHS operations, conduct safety program audits, and coordinate with guards, contractors, and stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead on-site security operations, acting as incident commander
  • Implement and enforce safety and security policies across the global data centre portfolio
  • Oversee physical security and EHS operations
  • Conduct safety program audits
  • Coordinate with guards, contractors, and stakeholders
  • Improve surveillance systems and security operations
  • Lead incident response and emergency preparedness
  • Develop and deliver EHS training programs
  • Maintain compliance with local regulations and international standards

job.title: Director of Construction EHS & Safety Excellence
job.description:
Director of Construction EHS & Safety Excellence - DayOne Data Centers Ltd., Singapore

DayOne Data Centers Ltd. is seeking a Director of Environmental Health and Safety to lead EHS across all construction projects. You will drive compliance with OSHA, EPA, MOM, and ISO standards, shape safety culture, and deliver training and incident investigations. Travel to multiple job sites and collaborate with project leaders to embed best practices. Frontline leadership, strategic planning, and a relentless focus on risk reduction will be essential to safeguard personnel and the environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive compliance with OSHA, EPA, MOM, and ISO standards across all construction projects
  • Shape safety culture and deliver training programs
  • Lead incident investigations and root cause analysis
  • Collaborate with project leaders to embed safety best practices
  • Develop and maintain crisis management and emergency response plans
  • Oversee environmental compliance including hazardous materials and waste disposal
  • Maintain and analyze safety metrics and KPIs

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive EHS leadership experience in construction
  • Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, or related field
  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or similar designation preferred
  • Experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001

job.title: EHS Director Construction
job.description:
EHS Director Construction - DayOne Data Centers Ltd., Singapore

Position Summary: The Director of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) is responsible for leading the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of all EHS programs across the company's construction projects. This role ensures full compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations while promoting a strong safety culture across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategic EHS plans, goals, and policies across all construction sites.
  • Develop and implement EHS standards and minimum requirements for projects.
  • Develop and implement EHS plans for projects.
  • Lead the implementation of proactive safety programs that reduce incidents, injuries, and near-misses.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, MOM, and all applicable regulations and industry standards.
  • Plan, conduct, and oversee regular job site inspections, audits, and risk assessments aligned with ISO standards and DayOne requirements.
  • Partner with Project Managers, Project Directors, and Site Superintendents to embed safety best practices from preconstruction through project closeout.
  • Lead incident investigations and root cause analysis and oversee corrective action plans and shared lessons learned.
  • Develop and manage EHS training programs and certifications for all staff and subcontractors.
  • Maintain and analyze safety metrics and KPIs, and report findings to senior leadership.
  • Oversee environmental compliance including hazardous materials, waste disposal, and stormwater management aligned with DayOne ESG and ISO 14001 requirements.
  • Champion a culture of safety leadership, accountability, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Develop and maintain crisis management and emergency response plans for all construction projects.
  • Coordinate drills and training for emergency preparedness, including fire, medical, and natural disaster scenarios.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact during EHS-related emergencies and ensure timely communication with stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with local authorities and regulatory agencies to ensure compliance with emergency protocols.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive EHS leadership experience in the construction industry.
  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP), CHST, or similar designation preferred.
  • In-depth knowledge of OSHA standards, EPA regulations, and construction safety best practices.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and team-building skills.
  • Ability to travel to multiple job sites across regions.
  • Experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 or other safety management systems.

job.title: Team Member - FP&A
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and long-term strategic plans (STRAP) for 3–5 years.
  • Define operational KPIs and ensure alignment with business objectives.
  • Drive budgetary control and accountability across departments.

  • Conduct variance analysis between actuals, budgets, and forecasts.

  • Deep understanding of profit margins, cost structures, and contribution analysis.
  • Ability to analyze complex data sets from P&L operations and communicate insights effectively.
  • Strong skills in financial modeling, Excel, and data visualization tools.

  • Relevant FP&A Experience: Minimum 5–7 years in financial planning, budgeting, and analysis.
  • Team Handling: Experience in leading small to mid-sized teams and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Core Skills:

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Variance Analysis
  • Financial Modeling
  • MIS Reporting
  • Scenario Planning & Cost Optimization

job.title: Senior Manager - MVE R&D
job.description:
Job Description

Join us as a Senior Engineer in Multi-technology Product Design, where you'll integrate software, embedded systems, electronics, and electromechanics into innovative, scalable products. This role offers the chance to optimize complex systems, ensure compliance, and mentor talented engineers in a dynamic, forward-thinking environment.

What will you do?

  • Design and develop multi-technology products integrating software, embedded systems, electronics, and electromechanics
  • Optimize system-level performance and ensure seamless interoperability across diverse technology platforms
  • Apply modeling, simulation, and prototyping techniques to enhance product efficiency, reliability, and manufacturability
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers while maintaining compliance with industry standards

It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. job.title: Data Center Technician (DCO), Data Center Operations
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.

ADSIPL offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining AWS computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective manner.

At ADSIPL, career progression is part of our environment. We want you to progress. If your career path is in Systems, Network or Database Engineering, Software Development or maybe AWS Support, Technical Operations or perhaps Project Management, we will create a development plan to enable you to succeed reaching those goals. This begins on Day One!

Key job responsibilities A Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).

Key job responsibilities A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

  • You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
  • your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
  • You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
  • You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
  • You perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
  • You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
  • You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
  • You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
  • More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
  • This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

A day in the life

  • You will support DC (Data Center) infrastructure equipment (e.g. racks, servers, networking devices, hardware components, cables, etc.),
  • You will follow the instructions ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution and perform routine operation activities on hardware, or spare parts, including rack install, server break/fix, rack decom etc.
  • You will perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
  • Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
  • You will be involved with site management and maintain tidiness in operation areas
  • Your role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Knowledge of server hardware and components
  • Knowledge of fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment and troubleshooting methodologies
  • 2+ years of data center experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a colocation data center facility
  • Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair
  • Experience in networking

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Director, Renewable Energy & CleanTech Solutions, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Vantage is seeking a commercially driven Director, Renewable Energy & CleanTech Solutions to lead the company's renewable and alternative energy strategy across the APAC region. The role is responsible for identifying, originating, negotiating and delivering innovative energy solutions that support Vantage's rapidly expanding data center platform, including utility-scale solar, wind, battery energy storage systems (BESS), fuel cells, on-site power generation, microgrids, hydrogen and other emerging technologies.

A key priority will be developing large-scale data center campuses supported by behind-the-meter energy solutions that enhance energy security, resilience, sustainability and long-term capacity availability. The Director will work closely with utilities, renewable energy developers, technology providers, infrastructure investors and government stakeholders to secure both grid-connected and independent energy solutions that enable Vantage's continued growth across Australia and APAC.

Working cross-functionally with Business Development, Site Selection, Sustainability, Construction, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Executive Leadership teams, the successful candidate will align energy strategy with Vantage's growth objectives, customer requirements and sustainability commitments. The ideal candidate combines commercial energy origination expertise with strong technical and execution capabilities, and will be measured on their ability to secure long-term power capacity, execute strategic energy transactions, build industry partnerships and deploy innovative clean energy solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Renewable Energy Strategy, Origination & Commercial Leadership
  • Develop and execute Vantage's long-term renewable energy, clean technology and power strategy across Australia and APAC, aligned to business growth and energy requirements.
  • Originate, structure, negotiate and execute complex energy transactions, including PPAs, utility supply agreements and strategic energy partnerships, to secure long-term power capacity.
  • Provide market intelligence, investment recommendations and strategic guidance on energy markets, regulatory developments, pricing trends and emerging technologies.
  • Build and present investment case for energy projects to executive leadership quantifying the cost of power, risk allocation and capital exposure
  • Campus Energy Solutions & Clean Technology Deployment
  • Lead the development of large-scale campus energy strategies incorporating behind-the-meter generation, renewable energy and alternative technologies to enhance resilience, sustainability and long-term capacity availability.
  • Evaluate and deploy solutions including utility-scale solar, wind, BESS, fuel cells, hydrogen, microgrids, on-site power generation and other emerging technologies.
  • Develop innovative energy architectures that support customer decarbonization goals, integrate distributed energy resources and reduce reliance on constrained utility infrastructure.
  • Utility, Grid & Strategic Partnership Management
  • Build and manage executive-level relationships with utilities, regulators, government agencies, renewable developers, investors and technology providers across APAC.
  • Lead engagement on grid access, transmission planning, renewable integration and utility capacity to secure power for existing and future campus developments.
  • Establish strategic partnerships and represent Vantage in key energy policy, market reform and industry initiatives to strengthen long-term energy security.
  • Project Development, Delivery & Execution
  • Lead renewable energy and clean technology projects from origination through development, construction, commissioning and commercial operation.
  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to manage permitting, approvals, utility interfaces, interconnection, project risks and successful asset handover.
  • Support customer-facing energy discussions and ensure timely delivery of energy infrastructure that enables new and expanding data center campuses.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 15+ years' experience in renewable energy, power, utilities, energy markets or related sectors.
  • Proven success developing, financing and delivering large-scale renewable projects, including wind, solar and BESS.
  • Experience structuring and executing PPAs, BTM connections, BESS, on-site generation,renewable energy procurement transactions supporting the Power team with utility supply agreements
  • Strong knowledge of behind-the-meter solutions, microgrids, energy storage, hydrogen and on-site generation.
  • Deep understanding of the overall APAC electricity market, grid connections, regulations and market dynamics.
  • Experience supporting data centers, digital infrastructure or other mission-critical developments.
  • Proven ability to build strategic partnerships with utilities, developers, regulators, investors and technology providers.
  • Strong commercial, negotiation, stakeholder management and leadership skills, with a degree in Engineering, Energy, Business, Finance or a related field.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

job.title: Associate Engineer-Electrical (Solar/BESS)
job.description:
Job Summary

The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for supporting the electrical design and engineering of utility-scale solar PV (Photovoltaic) power plants through proposal, FEED (Front-End Engineering Design), and detailed engineering stages. The role requires sound technical knowledge of solar electrical systems, design calculations, equipment selection, technical documentation, and effective coordination with designers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and review SLDs (Single-Line Diagrams), cable schedules, load lists, equipment schedules, and other electrical engineering deliverables.
  • Perform DC (Direct Current) and AC (Alternating Current) system design, including PV string and inverter configuration, cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, transformer sizing, and MV (Medium Voltage) collection-system design.
  • Prepare and review lightning-protection calculations, equipment specifications, datasheets, and BOQ/MTO (Bill of Quantities/Material Take-Off).
  • Perform solar PV system modeling, energy-yield assessment, and design optimization using PVsyst.
  • Provide technical inputs to the PVcase designer, review PVcase-based layouts and outputs, and coordinate design revisions to ensure alignment with electrical design requirements.
  • Provide design inputs to designer, review drawings, and coordinate revisions to ensure technical accuracy and consistency with project requirements.
  • Support substation and grid-interconnection engineering at the POI (Point of Interconnection).
  • Review vendor documents, technical bids, RFIs (Requests for Information), and equipment submissions.
  • Coordinate with civil, structural, SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), Protection and Control, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and resolution of project-related engineering queries.#LI-IB2

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in utility-scale solar PV power plant design and engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with PVsyst for solar PV modeling and energy-yield assessment.
  • Working knowledge of PVcase, with the ability to provide technical inputs, review outputs, and coordinate effectively with the PVcase designer.
  • Experience in DC and AC system design, MV systems, transformers, switchgear, cables, grounding/earthing, and electrical protection.
  • Familiarity with applicable IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission), IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers), NEC (National Electrical Code), NFPA (National Fire Protection Association), and utility requirements.
  • Strong technical documentation, communication, coordination, and review skills.
  • Knowledge of or exposure to ETAP (Electrical Transient Analyzer Program) for Load Flow, Short Circuit, or other applicable power-system studies would be advantageous.
  • Knowledge of or exposure to BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) applications and integration would be advantageous.

Minimum Qualifications

Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 1 year related work experience. All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

Diagnoses and completes less complex repairs and preventative maintenance activities on engines and related components at customer sites. The role is responsible for delivering timely, professional service by applying established troubleshooting procedures, specialized tools, service documentation, and safety standards. The technician works independently on routine service activities and escalates complex or unresolved issues to experienced technicians or supervisors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers in a courteous and professional manner, understand their concerns, and ensure prompt and effective resolution of service needs.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot engine-related issues using documented procedures, service publications, diagnostic software, electronic service tools, and specialized equipment.
  • Perform less complex repairs, maintenance, disassembly, assembly, inspection, and replacement of engine components in accordance with Cummins and OEM guidelines.
  • Conduct preventative maintenance activities as per defined schedules, procedures, and quality standards.
  • Identify required parts, tools, equipment, and resources before and during service activities to ensure efficient repair completion.
  • Validate completed repairs by confirming that the original customer concern has been resolved and that the product is operating as required.
  • Analyze interactions between electrical and mechanical engine systems, including fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, sensors, controls, and related components.
  • Escalate unresolved or technically complex issues to experienced Field Service Technicians or supervisors, providing clear troubleshooting history and relevant technical information.
  • Complete accurate service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality records, and service management system updates.
  • Identify additional service opportunities and communicate relevant customer needs to support service excellence and business growth.
  • Maintain service vehicles, tools, equipment, and work areas in a clean, safe, and operational condition.
  • Complete required technical and business training to continuously develop product and service capabilities.
  • Follow all applicable Health, Safety & Environmental policies, procedures, and legislation; proactively identify and report hazards, incidents, and safety concerns.

Key Competencies

  • Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and delivers timely, customer-centric service solutions.
  • Effective Communication: Communicates technical information clearly and adapts communication to different customers and stakeholders.
  • Diagnostics & Problem Solving: Translates customer complaints into structured troubleshooting plans and uses appropriate diagnostic methods to identify root causes.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understands the interaction of mechanical and electrical engine systems and applies technical information to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application: Effectively uses electronic service tools, diagnostic software, and specialized equipment to troubleshoot and maintain products.
  • Product Repair & Maintenance: Performs repairs and preventative maintenance in accordance with established procedures, quality standards, and repair guidelines.
  • Service Documentation: Accurately records customer, equipment, diagnostic, repair, and service information in the required systems.
  • Technical Escalation: Recognizes when additional technical support is required and provides complete troubleshooting information to enable efficient resolution.
  • Health & Safety: Demonstrates proactive safety behaviors and follows all applicable HSE requirements and workplace standards.
  • Manages Complexity: Effectively evaluates technical information and uses available resources to resolve service issues.
  • Self-Development: Actively develops technical and professional capabilities through training, coaching, and on-the-job learning.
  • Values Differences: Respects diverse perspectives and works effectively with customers and colleagues from different backgrounds.

Qualifications

  • Vocational diploma/certificate from a relevant technical institution.
  • Apprentice-trained Engine Technician qualification is preferred.
  • Valid local driving permit/license.
  • Any additional licenses or certifications required for the role, including those applicable to export control or sanctions compliance, as required.

Skills & Experience

  • Basic field service or equipment maintenance experience.
  • Intermediate-level knowledge of engines and related mechanical/electrical systems.
  • Hands-on experience with engine diagnostics, repair, maintenance, or troubleshooting.
  • Ability to use mechanical and electronic diagnostic tools and interpret diagnostic results.
  • Ability to read and follow technical manuals, service publications, procedures, and repair guidelines.
  • Customer service experience with the ability to interact professionally with customers at their sites.
  • Ability to accurately complete service documentation and use relevant business/service management systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Willingness and ability to work in customer locations and field environments.
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.

Candidate should have minimum 5 years of field experience.

Should have 3yrs Diploma in Electrical & Electronics

Should have basis computer knowledge ( able to work on MS office( i.e Word, Excel, Advance Excel, Power point , Power BI. Etc)

Should have good communication skill ( Verbal & written)

Should have experience on Cummins engines with good knowledge of Cummins software tools (i.e. INSITE, INPOWER, C-View Etc,)

Should have good troubleshooting skill.

Should be comfortable with travelling & relocations across India.

If you are an undergraduate IT student looking to jump start your career, we are offering a 13-month full time internship based at our Scoresby office . This is a unique opportunity to gain skills and knowledge while you are working full time commencing 27th January 2027. The primary objective for this role is to work with the Senior project manager on SAP deployment program across the SPAC region, assisting with IT project management, business readiness activities and stakeholder engagement. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a large-scale SAP transformation while working alongside experienced delivery and business teams.

In this role you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Support SAP deployment and business readiness activities across the region.
  • Maintain project trackers, action logs, and deployment documentation and follow-up actions.
  • Assist with preparation of stakeholder communications and deployment updates.
  • Support deployment planning and readiness activities leading up to go-live.

About You

To qualify for this undergraduate internship, it is essential that you:

  • Are currently studying a Bachelor degree of Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science or similar.
  • Have between 1 and 8 units of study left to complete of your undergraduate degree as of January 2027
  • Are available for the full 13 months and be willing to defer your studies for that duration.

_Note:_ _Applicants that do not meet these qualifying requirements unfortunately will not be considered._

To be successful in this role, you will possess skills/or be able to perform:

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, CoPilot and Teams.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
  • Interest in IT Project management, System implementation and business transformation.

_This is a 13-month, full time or part time, paid placement and the successful candidate will be required to defer their studies for the duration of the program._

How to apply:

  • For all applications, please submit your resume, cover letter and academic transcript via the link provided.
  • In your cover letter, please specify how many units of study you have remaining on your undergraduate degree and your motivation behind applying both to Cummins and this specific internship.

Note: We will be unable to assess your application without all of the required documents, so please ensure you attach your resume, cover letter and academic transcripts at the time of application.

job.title: Procurement Coordinator - Level III

Works independently to update procurement systems and coordinates approval and control of procurement activities. Provides support to sourcing and finance teams globally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support identification/resolution of supplier invoice and payment issues.
  • Support completion, closure, and recording activities for various contracts and other supplier documentation.
  • Prepare documentation for sourcing events.
  • Initiate/Support work delivering results in meeting cost, quality, delivery, and inventory goals.
  • Support supplier quality activities with supplier quality improvement engineers, suppliers, and category teams.
  • Liaison between procurement teams and other functions.
  • Participating in health safety and environmental awareness and improvement activities and daily tasks.
  • Perform any other tasks assigned.
  • Participate in Project teams, when necessary, to ensure effective implementation of change.
  • Communicate with the supplier and work with supplier to manage Project deliverables within agreed timelines.
  • Use common process tools and business systems to provide repeatable analytics and reporting.
  • Ensure data integrity of all procurement information as it is created and deliver ongoing improvement of existing data.
  • Identify improvements for business processes.
