Competencies:

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.

job.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS DynamoDB
job.description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Do you want to work on a product that can do the following?:

Access petabytes of data in single-digit milliseconds Replicate tables across continents Stream terabytes of data updates per hour continuously Back up hundreds of terabytes of data in seconds Encrypt petabytes of data with no performance degradation

Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service that does all this and more. DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. DynamoDB can store petabytes of customer data and handle peaks of more than 20 million requests per second.

As a fast growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world, and we continue to believe it is Day 1 for the DynamoDB business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to DynamoDB, and we are looking for a deeply technical, team-first software development engineer to push DynamoDB even further.

DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.

This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from end to end: requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language
  • 3+ years of building complex software systems experience
  • 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Software Development Manager, AWS Just Walk Out
job.description:
As part of the AWS Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Just Walk Out builds technology enables a new kind of stores with no lines and no checkout—you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!

Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you’re done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we’ll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earths’ most customer centric company and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware.

As a Software Development Manager, you will own delivery of cross functional initiatives to build new features and improve Just Walk Out experience. You will manage a team of 6-10 software development engineers to build and enhance the shopping experience in Just Walk out stores.

Key job responsibilities We are looking for an individual that thrives by creating high-bar engineering culture. You’ll be chartered with building software that deliver critical capabilities to our AWS Just Walk out business enabling bar raising customer experience, embed operational knowledge and encode best practices into everything we do. We have a team culture that encourages innovation and we expect team members and management alike to take high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. Beyond a strong engineering, data storage/modeling, visualization, and front-end background, a successful candidate will have experience successfully leading teams, developing people, and building a scalable infrastructure. We are looking for someone that is a self-starter, someone that approaches complex business questions with data and curiosity, and a person that dives below the surface to identify the root cause and "so what" rather than just superficial trends

About the team Just Walk Out (JWO) is an AWS technology that eliminates checkout lines using computer vision, sensors, & AI. JWO operates across multiple countries, spanning stadiums, airports, college campuses, & Amazon fulfillment centers. We run multiple business models - including vision-based stores & RFID checkout - & we're growing fast. As we scale into new markets & verticals, we're deploying LLMs for shopper support, building AI agents that can operate autonomously, & re-architecting our platform to serve multiple businesses across countries with varying tax, privacy, & regulatory requirements.

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications & skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive & broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing & never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products & services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity & connection. Our employee-led & company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion & empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, & passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, & other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of engineering team management experience
  • 7+ years of engineering experience
  • 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
  • Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
  • Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
  • Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
  • Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS AI and cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. job.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Principal Electrical Engineer, you will report to the Senior Director, Engineering and be based at our North Sydney headquarters. You will lead AirTrunk's electrical engineering discipline and its team of electrical Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), working across Design and Engineering, Development, Procurement, Construction and Commissioning. You will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Lead, develop and empower a high-performing team of electrical engineering SMEs, setting clear accountabilities, strengthening technical capability and building succession coverage.
  • Act as AirTrunk's senior electrical technical authority, escalation point and delegated decision maker for material electrical risks, interpretations and design decisions.
  • Own the lifecycle of global electrical engineering and construction standards and electrical Owner-Supplied Equipment (OSE) specifications, ensuring they remain current, practical, controlled and consistently adopted.
  • Forecast and allocate electrical engineering resources across the global project pipeline according to project risk, design maturity and business priority, balancing workload and continuity.
  • Provide risk-based technical direction and independent design assurance from concept through IFC, confirming compliance with AirTrunk standards without owning day-to-day project design coordination or driving the general contractor's design development.
  • Be accountable for the discipline's cost outcomes, technical compliance and engineering suitability, including safety, resilience, operability, constructability, maintainability and lifecycle value.
  • Drive global consistency, standardisation and value engineering while protecting safety, regulatory compliance, resilience, customer commitments and operational performance.
  • Turn lessons from design, delivery, commissioning and operations into improvements to standards, specifications, assurance practices and team capability.

Your Day to Day

  • Lead the electrical SME team through clear objectives, coaching, performance management, development planning, recruitment and succession management.
  • Maintain a forward electrical resource plan and assign appropriately skilled SMEs to projects and technical initiatives, resolving priority or capacity conflicts with the Senior Director, Engineering.
  • Set electrical technical direction and acceptance criteria across LV distribution systems, standby generation, UPS systems, BESS systems earthing, protection and grading, power quality, controls interfaces and electrical OSE.
  • Establish the scope, timing and depth of risk-based electrical reviews across concept, preliminary, schematic, detailed and IFC design stages, and verify that agreed actions are closed.
  • Review designs and technical submissions to confirm alignment with AirTrunk standards, approved project requirements, applicable codes and customer commitments. Design Management retains ownership of project design coordination and the project design basis, while project delivery teams and their designers remain responsible for developing the design.
  • Serve as the senior electrical escalation point and make timely, evidence-based decisions within delegated authority; clearly record the decision, rationale, risks, conditions and accountable owner.
  • Approve, reject or escalate electrical departures, waivers, interpretations, substitutions and material non-conformances in accordance with the technical authority framework and risk appetite.
  • Own and approve electrical engineering and construction standards and OSE specifications, including review cadence, change control, stakeholder consultation, release communication, implementation guidance and evidence of adoption.
  • Maintain visibility of electrical cost drivers and benchmarks, challenge unnecessary complexity and sponsor value engineering that improves capital efficiency, programme, repeatability, energy performance or lifecycle cost without weakening technical outcomes.
  • Assess the suitability of electrical designs and equipment for safety, compliance, reliability, resilience, efficiency, constructability, maintainability, operability, scalability and intended service life.
  • Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain to evaluate vendor proposals, technical deviations, equipment substitutions and quality risks, and provide senior technical input to factory acceptance testing and proof-of-concept activities.
  • Lead discipline peer reviews and resolve interfaces with mechanical, controls and automation, civil, structural, architectural, fire and commissioning teams; maintain effective alignment with the HV delivery team.
  • Champion Safety in Design and ensure material electrical hazards, assumptions, constraints and residual risks are identified, treated and communicated to the appropriate owner.
  • Provide senior technical support for significant site, commissioning and operational issues, then ensure root causes and lessons learned are reflected in standards, specifications and future project assurance.
  • Communicate complex electrical matters clearly to executives, customers, commercial teams, delivery partners and non-technical stakeholders, including recommended options and trade-offs.

Measures of Success

  • A capable, engaged electrical SME team with clear accountabilities, strong retention, effective succession coverage and demonstrable technical development.
  • Projects resourced in line with risk, design maturity and agreed priorities, with electrical reviews and technical actions completed to required stage-gate timeframes.
  • Electrical standards and OSE specifications reviewed to the approved cadence, consistently adopted across regions and improved using documented delivery and operational learning.
  • Electrical cost outcomes supported by transparent benchmarks, disciplined scope decisions and value engineering that preserves required performance and compliance.
  • Improved first-time-right design quality, with fewer repeated deviations, late changes, design-related RFIs, non-conformances and commissioning defects.
  • Material electrical risks, departures and decisions resolved or escalated promptly, with clear accountability and auditable records.
  • Electrical systems and equipment demonstrably suitable for their intended application across safety, resilience, operability, maintainability, constructability and lifecycle value.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
  • Typically 12+ years of progressive electrical engineering experience, including leadership of senior engineers or SMEs across complex, multi-project or multi-region portfolios.
  • Chartered or Professional Engineer status, or an equivalent recognized registration, is preferred.
  • Deep expertise in mission-critical electrical systems, including HV and LV distribution, generation, UPS, earthing, protection and grading, power quality and electrical controls interfaces.
  • Strong experience in data centres, mission-critical facilities, industrial infrastructure or another high-availability operating environment.
  • Demonstrated experience owning engineering standards or equipment specifications and applying technical assurance, delegated authority, configuration control and deviation governance.
  • Proven ability to plan and deploy specialist resources across competing projects while maintaining quality, responsiveness and global consistency.
  • Commercially astute, with experience evaluating discipline cost, value engineering, vendor proposals, lifecycle cost and technical trade-offs.
  • A decisive and accountable leader who can resolve ambiguity, challenge constructively and communicate complex technical matters to diverse stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally across AirTrunk's regions to support critical reviews, technical issues and team engagement.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Executive Secretary, Corporate Office
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

The Executive Secretary provides high-level, strategic secretarial and administrative support to the Corporate Office, enabling the effective management of executive priorities, stakeholder engagements, and organisational governance. The role requires exceptional discretion, executive maturity, and the ability to operate within a complex, fast-paced, and matrix environment while supporting enterprise-level decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive Office & Strategic Support

  • Provide comprehensive and proactive secretarial support to the Corporate Office, including managing a highly complex and dynamic calendar.
  • Anticipate priorities and align schedules to support strategic objectives and critical business decisions.
  • Prepare, review, and quality-check correspondence, presentations, board papers, and executive briefings to the highest standard.
  • Act as a trusted gatekeeper to the Corporate office, exercising sound judgment in prioritising requests and managing access.
  • Handle highly sensitive and confidential matters with professionalism, integrity, and discretion.

2. Stakeholder & Communication Management

  • Serve as a key liaison between the Corporate office and internal/external stakeholders, including senior management, board members, regulators, partners, and clients.
  • Facilitate clear and efficient communication flow between the Corporate office and business units.
  • Manage and coordinate high-level engagements, including leadership meetings, town halls, and external events.

4. Office & Priority Management

  • Monitor deadlines, key deliverables, and commitments arising from executive meetings and correspondence.
  • Ensure timely follow-up and coordination across multiple stakeholders to drive execution.

job.title: Mechanical Procurement Manager
job.description:
• Lead the mechanical procurement function within the CDC Data Centres team! Manage a small, high-performing team of specialists
  • Drive supplier strategy, contract negotiations, and procurement outcomes across major capital projects across AU + NZ
  • Role to be based across our Melbourne CBD office, and Western Suburbs campuses (Brooklyn + Laverton)

About Us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

As the Mechanical Procurement Manager, you will lead the procurement and commercial management of critical mechanical infrastructure supporting CDC's industry-leading data centre developments across Australia and New Zealand. You will be responsible for driving procurement strategies, managing key supplier and contractor relationships, and leading a team of Technical Commercial specialists focused on delivering best-in-class commercial outcomes across major capital projects. Working closely with Engineering, Design, Delivery and Commercial teams, you will play a key role in securing critical mechanical equipment, services and supply chain capacity to support CDC's growing development pipeline.[](https://canberradc.sharepoint.com/sites/PeopleAndCulture/P%26C/_layouts/15/Doc.aspx?sourcedoc=%7BB23C4EE4-C472-4D5B-8B81-1E0C6C94EBAC%7D&file=PD-502%20-%20Manager,%20Technical%20Commercial.docx&action=default&mobileredirect=true&DefaultItemOpen=1)

  • Lead and develop a small team responsible for the procurement and commercial management of mechanical equipment, materials and services.
  • Develop and execute procurement strategies that support project delivery, commercial outcomes and long-term operational requirements.
  • Support with tendering, supplier engagement, evaluation and contract negotiation activities.
  • Partner with engineering, design and project delivery teams to ensure procurement activities align with project schedules and technical requirements.
  • Build and manage strategic relationships with suppliers, manufacturers and contractors to secure supply chain capacity and drive performance.
  • Provide commercial leadership and recommendations on major procurement decisions, supplier selections and contract outcomes.
  • Identify and manage procurement, commercial and supply chain risks across key project packages.

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy - Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

You are a commercially minded procurement leader with experience delivering complex mechanical, building services, infrastructure or industrial projects. You combine strong technical understanding with commercial acumen and are confident managing supplier relationships, negotiating major contracts and influencing key stakeholders. You thrive in fast-paced project environments and enjoy working collaboratively to deliver practical, commercially sound outcomes.

  • Demonstrated experience in procurement, commercial management, strategic sourcing or supply chain leadership within mechanical services, construction, data centres or major capital projects.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, equipment and contractor markets.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex tendering, sourcing and contract negotiation activities.
  • The ability to build trusted relationships and influence technical, commercial and project stakeholders.
  • Experience managing high-value supplier and contractor relationships and driving performance outcomes.
  • Strong commercial, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance cost, risk, quality and delivery requirements.
  • Previous leadership experience managing and developing procurement, commercial or project teams.

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and encourages everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: Design Manager, Engineering (Australia)

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

job.title: Lead - Security Operations
job.description:
Security Strategy Implementation:

Collaborate with the CSO and Head - Security to develop, refine, and implement security strategies, policies, and frameworks in line with evolving industry standards and airport security needs.

Provide insights and data from operational activities to help shape long-term security plans and initiatives.

Lead initiatives for continuous improvement, ensuring that security systems evolve with the changing threat landscape and as per the regulation. Drive the adoption of new technologies and best practices across airports.

Operational Management: ( landside / AVSEC / Loss Prevention):

Oversee security operations across airports, ensuring that security measures are implemented across all airport sites effectively and consistently.

Ensure that effective incident response mechanisms are in place at each airport. Provide guidance and support during major security incidents or emergencies.

Regularly monitor and assess the performance of security teams at different airports, ensuring they meet performance targets and compliance standards.

Oversee security audits, both internal and external, and ensure that airports meet all regulatory compliance requirements. Address any audit findings and implement corrective actions.

Risk Assessment and Security Intelligence:

Regularly conduct security risk assessments for the network of airports. Identify emerging threats and risks, and develop strategies for mitigation.

Work closely with local, national, and international intelligence agencies to gather security-related information. Ensure the proactive management of potential security threats based on this information.

Monitor and analyze global and regional security trends to adjust security strategies accordingly. Ensure that vigilance levels are maintained high across all airport sites.

Policy Development & Compliance:

Assist CSO and Head security in Design, implement, and review security policies, procedures, and programs to safeguard people, assets, and infrastructure, ensuring compliance with local and international regulations.

Drive the implementation of AVSEC standards per ICAO Annex 17, NCASP, NCASQ BCAS, and other governing bodies, and ensure compliance with the latest aviation security practices.

Strive to continuously improve the design, operation, implementation and maintenance of ASP, AVSEC standards as established by BCAS and other regulatory authority.

Crisis & Incident Management:

Oversee and Develop, implement, and periodically update crisis management plans for all airports. Lead the response during major security breaches, emergencies, or incidents.

Ensure that crisis management training and simulations are conducted regularly across all airports. Guide Head - Security to prepare teams for a variety of emergency scenarios, ensuring readiness at all times.

Oversee recovery processes to ensure the swift restoration of normal operations following any security incidents. Develop and ensure business continuity protocols are in place across the network.

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication:

Serve as the primary liaison between security teams at different airports and other key stakeholders, including law enforcement agencies, airport management, and regulatory bodies.

Build and maintain strong relationships with regulatory bodies such as BCAS, DGCA, ICAO, and local law enforcement to ensure compliance with security regulations.

Provide regular updates to senior management and relevant stakeholders on the status of security operations, ongoing challenges, and potential risks.

Budgeting and Resource Management:

Oversee the security budget for the entire network of airports. Ensure cost-effective allocation of resources for security systems, staffing, and training.

Ensure that sufficient resources, including personnel, technology, and equipment, are available to meet operational needs at all airports.

Ensure that financial expenditures related to security operations are in line with approved budgets. Assist in the procurement process for security equipment and systems.

Security Technology & Automation Support:

Oversee the integration of advanced security technologies (CCTV, access control, surveillance systems, Screening systems etc.) across all airports. Ensure that security systems are regularly maintained and upgraded.

Champion the adoption of cutting-edge security solutions to enhance operational efficiency and response times. Drive the use of data analytics and AI for security operations where applicable.

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead, mentor, and support the security leadership team, including Head - Security at each airport. Provide guidance on handling complex security issues and promoting a culture of continuous improvement.

Ensure ongoing professional development and training programs for security staff at all levels. Promote a culture of excellence in security practices.

Establish clear performance goals, conduct regular evaluations, and provide constructive feedback to security teams across all airports.

IT and ISOC teams

Regulatory Authorities

Airport Officials

CISF

Security Contractors or Third-Party Providers

Bachelor’s degree in preferably in Security Management, Aviation Security, Criminal Justice, or a related field.

Certifications in security and crisis management, such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Fraud Examiner ( CFE)

Work Experience:

15-20 years of experience ( Depending on the site complexity/ requirement) in security operations or preferably with experience in airport security management.

In-depth knowledge of security processes and standards. Aviation security regulations, standards, and best practices, security technologies, risk assessment methodologies, and threat analysis

job.title: Senior Engineer - Cell Process
job.description:
About Business:

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Solar: Adani Solar is India's 1st and largest vertically integrated solar PV manufacturer with 4 GW cells & modules and 2 GW of ingots & wafers manufacturing capacities

Job Purpose: The job purpose of a Shift Engineer - Cluster - Diffusion in solar manufacturing is to oversee and optimize the diffusion process crucial for doping silicon wafers in solar cell production. This role ensures efficient operation, uniform doping for desired electrical properties, work on completion of already defined DOEs and report compilation of Junction depth, junction conc. and adherence to quality and safety standards, contributing to the production of high-performance solar cells.

Responsibilities

Safety and Compliance :

  • Ensure adherence to safety protocols and regulatory standards, conducting regular audits and training to maintain a safe work environment. Proactively identify risks and implement corrective actions to ensure full compliance with safety regulations.

Optimization of Process Recipe:

  • Continuously optimize process recipes for Wet-Line, Diffusion, Pre & Post Oxidation, Laser, PECVD, and Backend processes to improve efficiency and quality.

Process Optimization:

  • Optimize diffusion parameters to maximize efficiency and yield of solar cells, continually improving processes to enhance performance and reliability.

Equipment Management:

  • Manage diffusion furnaces and related equipment, ensuring proper operation, calibration, and maintenance to minimize downtime and ensure reliability.

Quality Control:

  • Conduct rigorous inspections and quality checks to maintain uniform doping and meet product specifications, implementing corrective actions as needed to uphold high-quality standards.

Troubleshooting and Problem Solving:

  • Identify and resolve technical issues during the diffusion process, employing root cause analysis and proactive measures to minimize disruptions and improve process stability.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of process parameters, production data, and quality metrics, generating reports to track performance indicators and support continuous improvement efforts.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Cluster Manager - Cell Process
  • Technicians and Operators within Cell Process
  • Quality Control Inspectors

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Equipment Suppliers
  • Maintenance Contractors
  • Regulatory Authorities

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • B.Tech – Electronics/Chemical / Metallurgy/ Renewable Energy
  • Desired Qualification : BE/B.Tech

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • Min 2 - 5 years of experience in diffusion process management, including cycle time reduction, yield enhancement, and process parameter optimization.

Certification:

job.title: Associate Engineer-Electrical (Solar/BESS)
job.description:
Job Summary

The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for supporting the electrical design and engineering of utility-scale solar PV (Photovoltaic) power plants through proposal, FEED (Front-End Engineering Design), and detailed engineering stages. The role requires sound technical knowledge of solar electrical systems, design calculations, equipment selection, technical documentation, and effective coordination with designers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and review SLDs (Single-Line Diagrams), cable schedules, load lists, equipment schedules, and other electrical engineering deliverables.
  • Perform DC (Direct Current) and AC (Alternating Current) system design, including PV string and inverter configuration, cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, transformer sizing, and MV (Medium Voltage) collection-system design.
  • Prepare and review lightning-protection calculations, equipment specifications, datasheets, and BOQ/MTO (Bill of Quantities/Material Take-Off).
  • Perform solar PV system modeling, energy-yield assessment, and design optimization using PVsyst.
  • Provide technical inputs to the PVcase designer, review PVcase-based layouts and outputs, and coordinate design revisions to ensure alignment with electrical design requirements.
  • Provide design inputs to designer, review drawings, and coordinate revisions to ensure technical accuracy and consistency with project requirements.
  • Support substation and grid-interconnection engineering at the POI (Point of Interconnection).
  • Review vendor documents, technical bids, RFIs (Requests for Information), and equipment submissions.
  • Coordinate with civil, structural, SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), Protection and Control, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and resolution of project-related engineering queries.

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in utility-scale solar PV power plant design and engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with PVsyst for solar PV modeling and energy-yield assessment.
  • Working knowledge of PVcase, with the ability to provide technical inputs, review outputs, and coordinate effectively with the PVcase designer.
  • Experience in DC and AC system design, MV systems, transformers, switchgear, cables, grounding/earthing, and electrical protection.
  • Familiarity with applicable IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission), IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers), NEC (National Electrical Code), NFPA (National Fire Protection Association), and utility requirements.
  • Strong technical documentation, communication, coordination, and review skills.
  • Knowledge of or exposure to ETAP (Electrical Transient Analyzer Program) for Load Flow, Short Circuit, or other applicable power-system studies would be advantageous.
  • Knowledge of or exposure to BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) applications and integration would be advantageous.

Minimum Qualifications

Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 1 year related work experience. All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

  • Manage data centre capacity planning (space, power, and inventory), conduct site surveys and rack audits, and maintain accurate capacity reporting.
  • Plan, procure, and implement infrastructure and network equipment, including racks, power, cabling, patch panels, and network hardware.
  • Coordinate with field teams and vendors to deliver infrastructure builds, while managing COLO space and power requests and tracking approvals.
  • Support data centre consolidation, footprint and power optimization, network expansion projects and site exit activities.
  • Prepare financial forecasts, cost estimates, purchase orders and business cases for infrastructure investments and capacity growth initiatives.

What we're looking for

Skills & Experience

  • 4-8 years of experience in a telecommunications service provider environment, with expertise in network asset planning, configuration, documentation, and inventory management.
  • Good understanding of Data Centre architecture fundamentals, including space, power, and cabling considerations.
  • Experience or exposure to infrastructure planning and capacity management, including rack, power, and cabling design, site surveys, and field implementation activities.
  • Awareness of WDM and IP networking technologies and associated network equipment.
  • Contributing to network capacity planning to ensure network reliability.
  • Proactively taking opportunities to build capability, including learning to use Network Virtualizations technologies and Automation tools to provide scalability.
  • Exposure to inventory systems such as Amdocs ARM, Siebel/XTRAC, Premise Master.
  • Maintaining accurate and comprehensive documentation of changes to the network and configurations.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis, with the ability to interpret capacity, inventory, and financial data to support planning and decision-making
  • Exposure to procurement systems SAP Ariba, and SAP ERP is desirable.

Soft Skills & Behavioural Competencies

  • Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for delivering outcomes and driving technical excellence.
  • Leadership & Influence: Ability to inspire, motivate, and guide team members toward achieving goals.
  • Communication: Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to troubleshoot complex issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Collaboration: Skilled at building relationships and working effectively across teams and stakeholders.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable managing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Proactive in identifying opportunities for process and technology enhancements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech.) in Electronics, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Certifications in Data Centre Design, Data Centre Infrastructure, Power Systems or related fields are preferred

###

What we offer you:

Looking to make a mark?

At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do. Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.

Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.

We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.

Diversity and inclusion

  • Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

Most recently we have:

  • Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
  • Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
  • Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our [DEI pages](https://www.colt.net/about/inclusion-diversity/).

Benefits

Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
  • Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
  • Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
  • Global Family Leave Policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

A global network

When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

Ability to learn quickly and address issues as they arise during normal working hours or after hours. Ability to operate in and promote a rigorous process-driven team environment Ability to logically analyze and solve problems Ability to effectively multi-task multiple projects Ability to operate Hand and Machine Tools (hammer, drill, saw, etc.) Ability to operate electrical tools such as a multi-meter or infrared camera Ability to operate a forklift Must be comfortable working in a high stress, fast paced environment with shifting priorities. Must be able to work on a shift which may require nights, holidays, and some weekends. Possess critical thinking and complex problem solving skills Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Relevant high school diploma or equivalent required Relevant advanced qualification or equivalent work related experience required Relevant certifications such as: o CPR/First Aid and NFPA70E Certified (can be gained during course of employment) o Possession of an OSHA approved forklift certification or the ability to obtain one after hire required Required Experience: Relevant demonstrated experience in a similar role gained within a data centre facilities environment Relevant demonstrated experience in a mechanical/electrical position within critical facilities (preferably a data centre, hospital, semi-conductor, or power plant) Demonstrated hands-on experience installing, maintaining, and/or troubleshooting large commercial and industrial systems including: o Chilled Water Systems o Large Centrifugal Chillers o Cooling Towers o Heat Exchangers o Water Treatment Systems o VFD’s and Pumps o HVAC equipment o CRAC/CRAH’s o Humidification Systems o Water heaters o Water/Air filters o BMS and PLC Controls o Emergency Standby Diesel Generator Systems o Fuel/Oil systems, o 480/277 and 208/120 electrical generation and distribution o Static UPS Systems o Double Interlock Pre-Action Systems

Your role at a glance

The Client Success Specialist is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for building and maintaining the client relationship to drive value for the client and increased lifetime value for the company.

This role is responsible for multiple small-to-medium scale or simple (single-service) contracts. As the primary post-sale point of contact for clients this role drives client-facing activity through the company's Client Success Management Charters of Adoption, Expansion and Renewal.

Acting as the clients’ trusted advisor they help the client realize value from their relationship with the company and ensure the client’s relationship experience is a positive one.

This role works in partnership with sales and client/service delivery management teams to deliver in-contract growth and a successful on-time renewal.

CS Management practice(including adopting standard methodologies, platforms/tools, KPIs, best practice activity, sharing experiences with the community) Responsible for Data Quality Management within interpret a client’s business strategy / plans and understand opportunities for NTT solutions/services Knowledge of NTT’s Offers and services, including the core functionality and features, linkage job.title: Supply Chain Coordinator - Level II - SHOP
job.description:
Job Summary

Under general supervision, uses statistical analysis, collaborative cross-functional intelligence, and validated planning parameter settings to disaggregate the demand plan and determine the optimal inventory levels. Aligns the supply plan with the demand plan and drives stability in the supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations.
  • Engages in HSE training.

Quality Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures. Performs quality checks on system planning parameters (min/max inventory level, re-order point, upper/lower tracking signals, segments, etc.) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP). Delivery

  • Performs supply and demand analysis, highlighting areas of concern for the next 12 months.
  • Assists others in gathering and compiling information through primary and secondary research.
  • Runs planning parameter setting changes in the simulation environment to analyze the impact to KPIs, and provides executive and detailed report of results.
  • Monitors signals indicating abnormal demand and/or stock levels feeding the supply schedule.
  • Makes adjustments to the planning parameter settings if approved.
  • Enters approved forecast adjustments at the detail level to align with the aggregate demand plan.
  • Takes ownership and accountability for the disaggregate demand plan, supply plan, and inventory plan that supports end Customer needs.
  • Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies.
  • Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals.

Teamwork

  • Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams.
  • Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals.
  • Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc.) projects.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

​Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

​Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Network Master Supply Planning - Uses statistical analysis and collaborates with other disciplines to provide a long term view of customers demand, and ensures the supply plan is aligned with the demand plan; balances supply and demand in a manner that achieves the financial and service objectives, while stabilizing the supply chain and optimizing the supply chain tensions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

job.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
job.description:
The Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for developing, analyzing, and delivering business intelligence reports and dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role gathers reporting requirements, extracts and transforms data from multiple sources, performs data quality validation, and delivers meaningful insights to key stakeholders. Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, the Business Intelligence Analyst applies analytical techniques, visualization tools, and reporting best practices to support business performance while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business reporting requirements from stakeholders.
  • Design, develop, and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and visualizations using standardized reporting practices.
  • Extract, transform, and analyze data from operational systems, databases, and enterprise data platforms to generate actionable insights.
  • Perform data validation, quality assurance, and testing to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting outputs.
  • Select appropriate analytical methods and visualization techniques to address business questions and support informed decision-making.
  • Develop interactive dashboards and data models using Power BI, including DAX calculations and performance optimization.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to retrieve, transform, and analyze structured data.
  • Work with enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, SQL Server, and SSAS models to support reporting and analytics needs.
  • Apply data mining, statistical analysis, and visualization techniques to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
  • Collaborate with senior analysts, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to understand reporting priorities and business objectives.
  • Communicate analytical findings and recommendations effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support data governance initiatives by ensuring adherence to data quality standards and reporting best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes through automation, innovation, and emerging technologies.
  • Stay current with evolving BI technologies, analytics tools, and industry best practices.
  • Demonstrate Cummins Leadership Behaviors by promoting collaboration, inclusion, continuous learning, customer focus, and accountability.

Skills and Experience

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including dashboard development, data modeling, DAX, and visualization best practices.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying, transforming, and analyzing structured data.
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, SQL Server, and SSAS.
  • Knowledge of data analytics, data mining, statistical analysis, and business intelligence methodologies.
  • Understanding of data quality, data governance, and reporting standards.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical insights clearly to diverse business audiences.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Demonstrated learning agility and adaptability to new technologies and business challenges.
  • Exposure to Python, Machine Learning, OpenAI technologies, and Microsoft Power Platform is considered an advantage.

Core Competencies

  • Business Intelligence & Data Analytics
  • Data Visualization & Storytelling
  • Power BI Development
  • SQL & Data Modeling
  • Data Mining & Statistical Analysis
  • Data Quality & Governance
  • Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
  • Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration
  • Customer Focus
  • Continuous Learning & Innovation
  • Adaptability & Agility
  • Inclusion & Valuing Differences

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent experience.

job.title: Territory Sales - Inside Sales Representative - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

As a Senior Inside Sales Representative , you will provide end-to-end sales and customer support for Cummins products and services throughout the sales cycle. The role combines direct inside sales, opportunity development, account support, quotation and RFP management, customer relationship management, sales forecasting, and coordination with internal stakeholders.

You will manage more complex customer requirements that may require adaptation, detailed research, or cross-functional coordination. The role is also expected to independently identify and develop opportunities for additional sales through repeat business, cross-selling, up-selling, and proactive customer engagement.

The position plays an important role in delivering customer satisfaction, achieving revenue and margin objectives, maintaining sales pipeline and forecast accuracy, and supporting the continued growth of the business.

Key Responsibilities

1. Direct Sales & Business Development

  • Handle inbound and unsolicited prospect enquiries and convert qualified opportunities into sales.
  • Develop new sales opportunities through telephone, digital technologies, lead follow-up, and targeted outbound/cold-calling activities.
  • Drive incremental revenue through repeat business, cross-selling, up-selling, and proactive follow-up with existing customers.
  • Conduct customer negotiations in accordance with company guidelines, commercial policies, and approved pricing parameters.
  • Achieve assigned revenue, margin, sales activity, and customer satisfaction targets.
  • Execute the sales cycle from lead identification through opportunity development, quotation, negotiation, and closure using the Cummins Sales Process.

2. Sales Support & Opportunity Management

  • Generate and deliver qualified leads to field sales representatives where appropriate.
  • Support sales teams with quotation, RFP, proposal, and other sales-cycle activities.
  • Provide timely and accurate responses to complex or escalated customer and internal enquiries, including matters requiring detailed research.
  • Analyse customer enquiries to identify recurring issues, trends, and opportunities for improved products, processes, or customer support.
  • Support more complex customer accounts and coordinate appropriate internal resources to resolve customer requirements.

3. Customer & Account Management

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships that encourage loyalty, retention, repeat business, and future sales.
  • Understand customer needs, applications, buying behaviour, and business priorities and translate these insights into appropriate Cummins solutions.
  • Support account development and account strategy by assessing customer relationships, financial considerations, product competitiveness, service requirements, quality issues, and potential barriers to growth.
  • Support new customer account creation and ensure Cummins is established as an approved supplier in accordance with company guidelines.
  • Maintain accurate customer master data and update account information in corporate systems.
  • Support accounts receivable activities as required.

4. Sales Operations, CRM & Forecasting

  • Maintain accurate sales opportunities, activities, reporting, and forecasts using Cummins systems, CRM platforms, and established sales processes.
  • Monitor pipeline health, opportunity progress, forecast accuracy, and performance against sales targets.
  • Collect and analyse relevant customer and market information to support sales forecasting and identify future consumption or demand patterns.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, procedures, tools, and customer value.
  • Ensure appropriate and consistent use of relevant sales systems, processes, and procedures across Inside Sales.
  • Evaluate results and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, revenue, customer value, and loyalty.

5. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Maintain effective communication and coordination across Sales and other functions to support customer satisfaction, sales objectives, and Cummins culture goals.
  • Coordinate input from sales teams and internal stakeholders to develop proactive customer communications.
  • Work with relevant internal stakeholders and customers, where applicable, to balance inventory, service, delivery capabilities, and customer expectations.
  • Support negotiations and commercial activities in line with company policies and guidelines.

6. Senior-Level Leadership & Development

  • Plan, prioritize, and schedule Inside Sales activities and resources to maintain continuity and quality of customer service.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to Inside Sales colleagues.
  • Support the achievement of team sales-support targets and service-level expectations.
  • Share best practices and contribute to continuous improvement across the Inside Sales function.

Core Competencies

  • Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and delivers solutions aligned to customer needs and expectations.
  • Effective Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively across different channels and adapts communication to different audiences.
  • Persuasion & Negotiation: Uses compelling, fact-based arguments to influence stakeholders, negotiate effectively, and secure commitment.
  • Planning & Alignment: Plans and prioritizes activities to meet business commitments and sales objectives.
  • Value Proposition Development: Understands customer applications and clearly communicates the strengths, benefits, and differentiation of Cummins products, solutions, and services.
  • Channel Awareness: Understands industry structure, market dynamics, customer channels, and routes to market.
  • Pricing Strategy: Works with relevant stakeholders to develop commercially appropriate pricing aligned with business and customer objectives.
  • Account Planning: Identifies account objectives, priorities, actions, and measures to drive execution against agreed targets.
  • Account Strategy Development: Assesses current account status, customer requirements, competitiveness, financial considerations, quality, service, and barriers to growth to define achievable account objectives.
  • Customer Perspective: Incorporates customer insights into sales strategies, content, solutions, and engagement approaches that improve customer value and revenue.
  • Sales Forecasting: Analyses internal and external customer data, historical trends, and market information to develop reliable sales forecasts.
  • Sales Pipeline Management: Proactively manages pipeline size, quality, progress, and conversion and adjusts sales priorities based on business requirements.
  • Sense Making & Problem Solving: Uses probing questions, research, and analysis to understand complex customer needs and translate information into practical solutions.
  • Audience Adaptability: Explains complex technical, commercial, or business information in a way that is clear and relevant to the intended audience.
  • Values Differences: Recognizes and leverages diverse perspectives, cultures, and experiences to strengthen collaboration and business outcomes.

Qualifications

  • University or college degree in Sales, Marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field , or an acceptable combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Prior professional experience in sales, inside sales, sales support, customer account management, quotation management, or a related commercial function.
  • Experience as a quote analyst or in another sales-support role is desirable.
  • Experience working with customer relationship management (CRM) systems is desirable.
  • Experience using software-based sales, business, reporting, forecasting, or customer-management tools is desirable.
  • This position may require applicable licensing or compliance requirements related to export controls or sanctions regulations.
  • Limited travel may be required depending on business and customer requirements.

Skills & Experience

Required / Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated experience in inside sales, territory sales, sales support, customer service, account management, or business development .
  • Experience managing customer enquiries and progressing opportunities through a structured sales cycle.
  • Experience with quotations, RFPs, proposals, pricing, negotiations, or order-related sales activities.
  • Experience developing new business and identifying opportunities for repeat sales, cross-selling, and up-selling.
  • Experience managing multiple customer requirements and prioritizing activities in a target-driven environment.
  • Experience working collaboratively with field sales, operations, finance, supply chain, service, and other internal functions.
  • Experience supporting sales forecasting, pipeline management, reporting, and performance tracking.
  • Experience handling complex or escalated customer issues and conducting research to determine appropriate solutions.

Key Skills

  • Consultative and solution-oriented selling
  • Customer relationship and account management
  • Lead generation and opportunity qualification
  • Telephone, email, and digital sales engagement
  • Cross-selling and up-selling
  • Commercial negotiation and persuasion
  • Quotation and RFP management
  • Sales pipeline and opportunity management
  • Sales forecasting and reporting
  • CRM and sales technology proficiency
  • Data analysis and problem solving
  • Pricing and value proposition development
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Stakeholder and cross-functional collaboration
  • Planning, prioritization, and time management
  • Ability to explain complex technical or commercial information clearly
  • Coaching and mentoring capability
  • Continuous improvement mindset

Success in the Role

Success in this role will be demonstrated through profitable sales growth, strong customer relationships, accurate forecasting and pipeline management, effective conversion of leads and opportunities, high-quality sales support, timely resolution of complex customer requirements, and effective collaboration across Cummins functions.

The successful candidate will combine commercial acumen and customer focus with the ability to independently manage sales opportunities, analyse complex requirements, influence stakeholders, and contribute to the development of both customers and the Inside Sales team.

job.description:
We are looking for a Customer Service Advisor to coordinate and schedule customer repairs for our automotive and industrial customers at our Wodonga branch.

Whether you have previous Service Advisor experience or are looking to step into the role, we are happy to train the right person!

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways

  • Act as the first point of contact for customers, providing a high level of service throughout the repair process
  • Communicate clearly with customers regarding repairs, job progress and expected timelines
  • Quote customers, plan jobs, create work orders and schedule vehicles for service
  • Check parts availability and coordinate with technicians and the Parts team to keep jobs moving
  • Process invoices, accounts and purchase orders, ensuring accurate and timely administration
  • Maintain accurate records and follow procedures within the service management system
  • Build positive relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth experience from start to finish

To be successful in this role you will need the following

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with solid IT capabilities
  • Strong customer service skills and the ability to build positive customer relationships
  • Previous Service Advisor, automotive, warranty or similar customer-facing experience is desirable
  • An understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoices and purchase orders is highly desirable
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple jobs and priorities
  • Technical experience is not essential, however an interest in the automotive, mining or industrial environment would be beneficial

Additional Information

  • Full Time / 38 Hours per week
  • Competitive Hourly Rate
  • Overtime as required – Penalty rates paid for all work above 38 hours

job.title: HR - Time and Attendance Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary

Assists in the accurate preparation, processing, and balancing of time and attendance system to support compensation processes and play a vital role in ensuring compliance with various legislations.

Key Responsibilities

Assists with the proper operation of the time and attendance system; understands time reporting rules and requirements; monitors the system for proper functioning. Initiates and monitors helpdesk inquiries; escalates for appropriate resolution

  • Troubleshoots and resolves basic issues.
  • Contributes to the timely and accurate resolution of time and attendance system issues which may include historical edits, password resets, access requests, time management reporting.
  • Serves as an internal resource on payroll and time management topics.
  • Provide superior customer service—respond courteously, accurately and in a timely fashion to time and attendance questions and requests.
  • Provides input to continuous improvement projects and initiatives; supports the development and maintenance of time and attendance process documentation.
  • Ensures data completeness and accuracy that meets pay cycle deadlines including required approvals.
  • Ensures data meets all legal, contractual, and governance requirements.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.

Human Resources Business Process Execution - Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.

Human Resources Consulting - Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.

Human Resources Data Management - Acts on people data to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance with company policy and legislative requirements.

Payroll Administration - Translates company policies, tax and legislative requirements in the delivery of accurate and timely employee payments and reporting; ensures compliance with applicable regulations and internal control procedures.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

Experience

Requires some work experience or intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

3+ years of UKG Pro WFM/ Kronos experience.

1-2 years of customer service experience for a large organization and/or in a fast-paced environment.

Proficient in Microsoft Excel.

Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

Commitment to continuous learning and understanding of work and leave regulations.

Professional attitude and strong communication skills.

Demonstrate time management and organizational skills to work efficiently while maintaining quality standards.

Able to prioritize workload and meet payroll processing deadlines.
