job.title: Solution Engineer Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for analyzing and gathering business and technical requirements to design and document fit-for-purpose solutions. Contributes to solution development, design, integration and testing, and configuration of technology solutions ensuring that delivered solutions adhere to defined architecture and security standards. Works closely with with cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners to ensure smooth execution and continuous improvement in solution performance and quality. Ensure seamless solution implementation and effective issue resolution.

Key Responsibilities

Supports the design of fit-for-purpose solutions by collaborating with stakeholders to identify integration points and ensure alignment with business processes and goals. Supports technical analysis, design and customization of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-off-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Develops and maintains technical design documents, workflows, and architecture diagrams. Assists in defining and executing the test strategy and validating solutions against business objectives. Ensures smooth interoperability by validating integrations and documenting configuration steps. Identifies and communicates potential technical dependencies and risks. Works with vendors and IT service providers to address technical issues, evaluate and improve product functionality and ensure proper configuration according to design specifications. Designs and implements data migration solutions to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Develops, designs, tests, maintains and configures solutions and systems as needed. Serves as subject matter expert and point of contact on content, processes, procedures and functionality associated with assigned applications for projects and application support (as needed). Documents recommendations to enhance business process efficiency and increase adoption of standard application features and capabilities, aligning solutions with enterprise standards. Supports continuous improvement initiatives by following established design standards and learning to identify potential enhancements in solution design or workflow efficiency. Assists technical and infrastructure groups in understanding the solution design and specifications. Works closely with IT technical service providers to ensure outsourced work packages are delivered to specifications, meeting key parameters of quality, schedule, cost, data privacy, security, performance, and scalability. Participates in formal design reviews, cybersecurity reviews and code reviews (where applicable) to ensure the detailed design specifications have been understood and coding standards and cybersecurity regulations have been adhered to by the development team(s).

  • Data Principles - Governs, models, secures, implements, and observes data flows to ensure integrity, quality, and compliance—enabling trusted, scalable, cost-conscious data use.
  • Modern Development Practices - Applies modern engineering practices and tools—such as Agile/DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure as code—to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and reduce risk across the SDLC.

job.title: Agile Coach
job.description:
Job Summary

Helps individuals and teams to adopt an agile mindset through coaching on values and principles. Evaluates the needs of teams and recommend appropriate agile frameworks to assist in team maturation. Transitions individuals and teams from a project delivery focus to a value delivery focus. Where appropriate coaches a DevOps mindset and advise on appropriate process and tool adoption to balance stability of systems with the flexibility and flow required for continuous delivery and fast feedback from the market. Works with Agile Center of Excellence and Stakeholders to enable support broader agile transformations and practice adoption.

Key Responsibilities

Teaches and mentors individuals and teams to develop an agile mindset. Evaluates and advises teams on appropriate agile frameworks and practices. Coaches and mentors Scrum Masters and Product Owners. Advises leaders on removing governance, reporting and policy impediments to an agile transformation. Develops an agile metrics and measures program to provide visibility of agility health and transformation progress. Facilitates workshops on various agile practices and techniques relating to the various roles and functions within an agile organization. Coaches the application of system thinking to identify and remove flow constraints, hand offs, wastes, and impediments. Tailors coaching for teams and individuals to help them identify gaps in performance and achieve high performance over time. Coaches leaders and stakeholders in appropriate behavior and interactions within an agile organization. Develop strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.

Competencies:

Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Agile Systems Thinking - Embraces a holistic approach to analysis that focuses on the way that a system's constituent parts interrelate and how systems work over time and within the context of larger systems to ensure the economic success of the solution.

Agile Systems Thinking - Embraces a holistic approach to analysis that focuses on the way that a system's constituent parts interrelate and how systems work over time and within the context of larger systems to ensure the economic success of the solution.

Building High Performance Teams - Identifies and applies critical skills and Lean-Agile principles and practices in the creation of high-performing Agile teams to construct high-quality, well designed technical solutions.

Continuous Delivery Pipeline - Implements the workflows, activities, and automation by providing the enterprise with the capability to shepherd a new piece of functionality all the way from ideation to an on-demand release of value to the end user.

DevOps and Release on Demand - Implements DevOps and a continuous delivery pipeline by providing the enterprise with the capability to release value, in whole or in part, at any time necessary to meet market and customer demand.

Planning and Managing Ceremonies - Plans, schedules, and leads ceremonies that create a cadence for the team to maximize productivity, promote collaboration, maintain transparency, and inspect and adapt so the team can continuously learn and improve.

Release Planning - Plans and manages the release of capabilities, features or products using inputs from the prioritized roadmap, planning, available resources and skills to communicate expected availability and releases of capability.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in business or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

ICAgile Certified Professional in Agile Coaching Certification (ICP-ACC), SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), Agile Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or Safe Scrum Master Certification (SSM) and Safe Advanced Scrum Master (SASM) certifications are preferred.

Experience

5+ years experience working directly with agile teams demonstrating knowledge and practical experience of the agile frameworks and mindsets including SAFe, Scrum, Lean, DevOps and a strong understanding of Agile Lifecycle Management / DevOps tooling.

  • Partner primarily with India-based Power Cells, product teams, and leaders to accelerate adoption of the Product & Platform Operating Model (PPOM) and strengthen product-centric ways of working.
  • Assess and advance Power Cell maturity through targeted coaching and capability development, enabling greater team effectiveness, ownership, and long-term independence.
  • Partner with Business Owners, Group Product Managers, Product Managers, and Scrum Masters to strengthen outcome management, prioritization, strategic alignment, and value realization practices.
  • Develop and scale reusable enablement assets, learning experiences, and communities of practice that increase organizational capability and support consistent adoption across global teams.
  • Support the evolution of operating model infrastructure, organizational change initiatives, and coaching approaches required to sustain growth, scale coaching impact, and reduce dependency on direct coaching support.
  • Identify and promote opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence, automation, and data-informed practices to improve productivity, decision-making, and scalability of product and platform ways of working.

job.title: Product Functional Test Mechanical Technician - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

The Product Functional Test Mechanical Technician - Level II is responsible for preparing, building, installing, and supporting test articles, test systems, and laboratory equipment used in product validation and functional testing activities. This role supports engine and component testing by performing test setup, instrumentation installation, troubleshooting, engine handling, and data collection activities while ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and engineering standards.

The position requires hands-on technical expertise in test cell operations, engine systems, laboratory equipment, and test methodologies to ensure accurate and reliable test results that support product development and validation objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Test Preparation & Execution

  • Prepare test articles, fixtures, rigs, instrumentation, and associated equipment for testing activities.
  • Install instrumentation and measurement devices in accordance with engineering standards and test requirements.
  • Conduct and support product testing in accordance with approved test procedures, methodologies, and project plans.
  • Monitor and document test execution to ensure accurate and reliable test results.
  • Support engine, subsystem, and component functional testing activities.

Engine Test Cell Operations

  • Conduct and monitor engine tests based on approved test plans and engineering requirements.
  • Perform installation, removal, assembly, and disassembly of engines and related systems within test cells.
  • Execute necessary modifications to engines and test setups to support testing objectives.
  • Support continuous test cell operations, including shift-based and 24/7 testing activities when required.
  • Maintain working knowledge of engine systems, test cell equipment, and laboratory operations.

Troubleshooting & Maintenance

  • Perform preliminary troubleshooting of engine, instrumentation, test stand, and test cell-related issues.
  • Support test stand setup, configuration, installation, and maintenance activities.
  • Maintain laboratory equipment and ensure operational readiness.
  • Participate in preventive and predictive maintenance activities to improve equipment reliability and minimize downtime.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues impacting test execution and data quality.

Data Collection & Reporting

  • Verify equipment calibration and instrumentation readiness before testing.
  • Collect, validate, and document test data in accordance with established procedures.
  • Prepare test reports, records, and documentation that clearly communicate testing methods, observations, and results.
  • Support engineers and project teams by providing accurate and reliable test information.
  • Ensure data integrity and adherence to quality requirements throughout the testing process.

Safety, Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Follow all Health, Safety, Environment (HSE), Quality Management System (QMS), and laboratory procedures.
  • Conduct risk assessments and comply with Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) and other safety requirements.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including TBWS (The Cummins Way) activities.
  • Collaborate effectively with project teams, engineers, technicians, and other stakeholders to improve testing processes and operational efficiency.

Competencies

Technical Competencies

  • Product Functional Testing
  • Engine Test Cell Operations
  • Test Setup and Configuration
  • Test Article Build and Instrumentation Installation
  • Data Acquisition and Measurement Systems
  • Data Reporting and Analysis
  • Product Function Test System Design
  • Preventive and Predictive Maintenance
  • Equipment Troubleshooting and Diagnostics
  • Data Quality Management
  • Problem Solving and Root Cause Analysis

Behavioral Competencies

  • Health and Safety Fundamentals
  • Action Oriented
  • Decision Quality
  • Drives Results
  • Manages Complexity
  • Effective Communication
  • Collaboration and Teamwork
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset
  • Accountability and Ownership
  • Values Differences

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma, Secondary Education Certificate, or equivalent experience in a relevant STEM-related field.
  • Intermediate-level technical knowledge gained through education, training, apprenticeship, or relevant work experience.

Preferred

  • Technical Diploma, Associate Degree, or equivalent certification in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Technology, or a related field.
  • Relevant regional certifications associated with testing, mechanical systems, or laboratory operations.
  • Experience in engine testing, powertrain testing, automotive testing, or product validation environments.

Skills & Experience Required

  • Hands-on experience supporting product testing, engine testing, laboratory operations, or related technical environments.
  • Strong knowledge of engine systems, components, and test cell operations.
  • Experience with test stand setup, instrumentation installation, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Familiarity with data acquisition systems, test equipment, and measurement techniques.
  • Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and laboratory quality practices.
  • Understanding of safety procedures, risk assessment processes, and LOTO requirements.
  • Experience in preventive and predictive maintenance practices.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and basic reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with AVL PUMA test cell systems is considered an advantage.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and support continuous operations when required.

Experience

  • Some relevant work experience in testing, mechanical systems, laboratory operations, manufacturing, automotive, or product validation environments.
  • Experience supporting engine testing, troubleshooting, instrumentation, and test cell operations preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work safely, follow procedures, and contribute to high-quality testing outcomes.

Job Summary

Roster : This is a 7 on 7 off roster

We are looking for a talented Diesel Technician to join our high performing team in Queensland.

This is a resident mine site technician role at Meandu mine site (Near Kingaroy QLD). In this role, you will act as technical specialist and regular customer support contact to diagnose and complete repairs to Cummins products at Meandu Mine Site.

You will make an impact in the following ways:

  • You will be required to keep the Cummins powered fleet running to perform optimum efficiency and reduce down time costs.

  • Completes training in line with skill and business requirements
  • Maintains work area and tools for cleanliness and proper operation

Additional Information

  • Day shift only
  • You will need a locally valid driving permit
  • Reporting to the Cummins Toowoomba Manager
  • You will be provided with Cummins laptop and phone also Cummins training both on line and classroom based training.

_The ideal candidate lives locally near Meandu Mine._

Experience

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Cert III or equivelant)
  • You will need basic level field service work experience
  • You will need intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with High Horsepower engine products
  • Cummins High Horse Power experience is preferred.
  • You must have the ability to work autonomously and follow all safety procedures.
  • We are looking for a can-do attitude that is willing to support Cummins and site requirements in maintaining the fleet of Haul trucks, Diggers and all auxiliary equipment.

Manages Complexity - Navigates complex and sometimes conflicting information to make effective decisions and solve problems.

Service Documentation - Accurately records service activities, technical findings, and repair outcomes in business systems.

Technical Escalation - Escalates complex technical issues effectively while maintaining thorough documentation and timely resolution.

Values Differences - Recognises and values diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to strengthen team performance and business outcomes.

job.title: Cost Champion
job.description:
Job Description

The Cost Champion is the leader responsible for embedding a cost-obsessed mindset across the full offer lifecycle. He/she will ensure cost being a central decision criterion from the value proposition to design and supply chain, with relevant governance requirement. This role contributes to drive profitable growth through innovation projects, to restore competitiveness through legacy product cost productivity, and to upgrade methods, tools and skills to make cost leadership initiative sustainable across the organization.

The position covers the full offer lifecycle, from new offer creation to legacy offers:

  • For new offers, the role ensures target cost is defined from the earliest stages, implementing Design-to-Cost methodologies as part of OLM process and stage-gate governance.
  • For legacy offers, the role ensures Divisions actively manage offer cost competitiveness, build a strong pipeline of productivity actions, including product re-design-to-cost initiatives based on margin, competitiveness and/or customer value gaps.

This role is both strategic and operational. It acts as a Design-to-Cost champion, cost workshop leader, and cost leader PMO, coordinating Divisions, hubs, and GSC to prioritize the right offers, deploy the right methods, and secure disciplined execution.

The Cost Champion acts as the central leader and animator of the Cost Officer community across Divisions. While divisional Cost Officers remain accountable for local costing activities—including cost consolidation, analysis, database integrity, and day-to-day cost monitoring within their perimeter—the Cost Champion ensures alignment with the central Product Cost Leadership strategy, common methodologies, governance expectations, and cross-divisional priorities.

  • Key Responsibilities

Drive the product cost leadership agenda across offer lifecycle (both new offers and legacy offers):

  • Act as the focal point to define, prioritize, and execute product cost action plans for assigned division(s) / hub(s), in alignment with Product Cost Leadership priorities and governance.
  • Ensure cost is on everyone’s agenda by cascading the program across all functions through communication, webinars, trainings, and business rituals. Cost needs to become everyone’s concern rather than a specialist activity.
  • Coordinate with Divisions, hubs, and GSC to ensure consistency of practice.

Lead Design-to-Cost methodologies

  • Deploy target cost calculation methodologies based on customer value, UVP, market expectations, and willingness to pay across the assigned division(s).
  • Deploy and use should-cost methodologies to provide fact-based cost transparency at system, sub-system, and component level.

job.description:

In this role you will combine technical expertise with strong project leadership skills to drive successful implementations of AWS-based solutions for our clients. You will bridge business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating technical discussions, and ensuring alignment with customer outcomes. Applying AWS frameworks like Well-Architected and Cloud Adoption Framework while demonstrating technical credibility across diverse stakeholders, you will distill customer needs into clear technical requirements, decompose complex problems, and make informed trade-off decisions considering performance, scalability, security, and business impact.

Possessing strong technology and program/project management experience, you will validate technical solutions against business goals, recognize when additional technical evaluation is needed, and manage technical risks. You will be expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, develop domain-specific expertise, and effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. As you progress, you’ll take on increasingly complex technical projects and contribute to practice-level best practices. In this role you will apply your management and leadership capabilities to successfully execute project plans, proactively identify and manage risks, resolve issues, escalate when appropriate, and drive projects to successful completion, while exceeding customer expectation

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

  • Bridging business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating engineering discussions and ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes
  • Distilling customer needs into clear technical requirements and map them to business outcomes
  • Decomposing technical problems into actionable, deliverable solutions
  • Creating and evolving team and engagement documentation; contributing to operational excellence (status updates, timesheets, reports)
  • Learning to foresee, manage, and escalate engagement risks and issues to internal stakeholders

By mid-morning, you are facilitating a sprint planning session with your delivery team, helping to clarify priorities and remove blockers. After lunch, you join a risk review with your AWS leadership to discuss an emerging scope question and propose a path forward. Later, you collaborate with a senior engagement manager to refine a delivery playbook that your team can reuse on future engagements. Throughout, you are sharpening your cloud knowledge and building the relationships that keep projects moving.

job.title: Innovation Programs Lead, APJ Innovation and Engagement
job.description:
The APJ Innovation and Engagement team is the pulse of innovation for AWS in the region. We design and deliver innovation experiences that bring Amazon's culture and technology to life — helping senior executives reimagine what's possible and chart a path from idea to production. Beyond delivery, we shape innovation strategy for APJ: identifying emerging technology trends, understanding how they intersect with customer needs across diverse markets, and translating that into experiences that drive real business outcomes. Our team works across 14 countries spanning vastly different industries, stages of cloud maturity, and competitive landscapes. We partner closely with field sales, solutions architecture, and specialist teams to activate customers and ensure every engagement moves the needle. We are builders at heart — constantly evolving our content, mechanisms, and delivery models to stay ahead of the pace of change in AI and technology innovation. We're looking for a customer-obsessed Innovation Program Lead to drive customer impact through our innovation experiences — using Amazon culture and technology to help enterprise customers discover, invent, and build their way to production. This role is about delivering tangible business outcomes, helping customers realize value from their technology and AI investments by combining the best of how Amazon innovates with the power of AWS technology. You'll facilitate executive engagements, activate customers in partnership with field sales teams, build scalable mechanisms across our top customers, and lead the development of next-generation content. The nature of innovation is ever-changing, and this role requires someone who is deeply adaptable and energized by that pace of change.

Key job responsibilities

  • Customer Impact through Business, Technology & Culture Transformation

● Lead and facilitate executive-level innovation sessions that bring Amazon's culture of innovation — Working Backwards, customer obsession, bias for action — to life for customers. Create an environment where senior leaders engage deeply with new possibilities and leave with clear business outcomes in mind. ● Apply first-principles thinking to understand customers' most pressing challenges and translate those into actionable AI-driven solution pathways. Help customers adopt Amazon's innovation methods alongside AWS technology to drive real business results. ● Own the customer journey beyond the engagement — work closely with field sales teams to activate customers, drive solution adoption, and accelerate the path from idea to measurable business outcomes in production.

● Design and implement scalable engagement frameworks. Leverage AI to streamline processes — from session preparation to insight capture — ensuring every customer interaction generates reusable learnings. ● Build the ability to scale innovation experiences across our top customers in the region, ensuring consistent quality and impact at volume while delivering business outcomes. ● Build strong operating interlocks with field sales teams, solutions architects, and partner organizations. Establish a clear operating model that makes it frictionless for account teams to activate customers into innovation experiences. ● Codify what works. Develop playbooks, templates, and tooling that enable other markets to replicate successful engagement patterns as the model expands across the region.

● Build next-generation content modules focused on generative AI, agentic systems, and applied AI — grounded in Amazon's culture of innovation and maintained as a portfolio that is modular, industry-adaptable, and technically current. ● Elevate the delivery experience — integrate AI to personalize content in real-time, generate dynamic demonstrations, and create immersive customer experiences that bring Amazon culture and technology together in a way that sets us apart in the region. ● The nature of innovation is ever-changing. Maintain a forward-looking content roadmap, monitor industry signals, competitive moves, and customer patterns — and adapt quickly to ensure our offerings remain relevant as technology evolves.

  • Consulting background with experience advising senior leaders on technology-led business transformation
  • Passion for Amazon's culture of innovation and ability to translate it into customer-facing experiences

job.description:

Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs. To learn more about AWS, visit aws.amazon.com.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

The Role

We are looking for an International Business Development Manager to join our International Business Development (IBD) team, based in Singapore, report to China & Hong Kong (CMHK) organization and focused on the Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ) region. Our mission is to accelerate CMHK customers’ global expansion — helping high-growth companies grow across borders in both directions. You will own the cross-border go-to-market bridge between customers expanding into and out of CMHK, connecting them with the right regional teams, partners, and programs to turn expansion ambitions into launched business. This is a high-ownership, result-driven role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, works comfortably across cultures and time zones, and is energized by making others successful. You will act as a single-threaded owner for cross-border growth in APJ — spotting opportunities early, orchestrating the players who can capture them, and driving momentum from first introduction through to sustained growth.

Key job responsibilities What You’ll Do

  • Own cross-border go-to-market in APJ. Act as the single-threaded owner for cross-border growth in the region — driving strategy, execution, and outcomes end-to-end rather than waiting for boundaries to be drawn. Connect customers with the right teams. Orchestrate high-quality introductions between customers and the regional account, partner, and specialist teams best placed to serve them, accelerating pipeline through relationships and trust.
  • Lead China–ASEAN / APJ collaboration. Own the region’s most active cross-border corridor, building and sustaining the relationships and cadences that move opportunities forward across markets.
  • Accelerate pipeline and drive launched business. Identify, unblock, and progress cross-border opportunities — measured by influenced pipeline and launched revenue across both expansion motions. Orchestrate events and GTM activities. Plan and run the executive engagements, customer events, and go-to-market activities that create momentum and open doors across regions.
  • Partner across a matrixed organization. Work hand-in-hand with program teams, regional sales leaders, and partners — succeeding by making others successful and strengthening ownership in the ambiguous spaces between teams.
  • Make cross-border value visible. Define and communicate a clear service model — what you offer, when to engage you, and what you deliver — so your contribution compounds into recognized business impact.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

About the team About the Team The International Business Development team drives a two-way, cross-border growth mandate. We help customers based in one market succeed as they expand into another — combining deep local relationships, cross-regional coordination, and go-to-market expertise that no single account team owns alone. The team operates across the two core motions that define cross-border growth:

  • China2Global (C2G) Outbound expansion — supporting fast-growing customers as they enter APJ market, connecting them to the regional account teams and resources that accelerate their launch and scale.
  • Global2China (G2C) — helping APJ customers land and grow in CMHK, building the local relationships and go-to-market motion that turn interest into launched business.

This APJ-based seat concentrates on the region’s highest-value cross-border flows, with a particular focus on collaboration between China and the broader ASEAN and APJ markets — the single heaviest cross-border corridor the team supports.

  • Experience in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting
  • Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
  • 3+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience

job.description:
Amazon Web Services is looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own customer success for our Amazon Connect Decisions across Asia-Pacific and Japan. As our customers in APJ scale, we need a single owner who makes sure the customers and partners we land actually succeed, realizing measurable business value, and renewing and growing over time. This role sits between deployment success prior to signature and post-sales success post-signature.

This is a regional, customer-facing role at the center of what happens after a deal is signed. You will work hand in hand with customers and our field and specialist teams across ANZ, ASEAN, India, Japan, and Korea to turn one-time launches into durable, expanding relationships. You will build the mechanisms — health scoring, adoption playbooks, renewal motions, and a voice-of-partner feedback loop — that raise the bar for how we deliver customer outcomes in the region. If you are energized by customer impact, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and motivated by building something new across a diverse set of markets, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities You will own the end-to-end deployment and post-launch journey for Amazon Connect Decisions in APJ. Day to day, that means driving adoption and value realization, keeping a close eye on customer health, stepping in early when accounts are at risk, and owning the renewal and retention motion that protects and grows recurring revenue. You will run quarterly business reviews and success reviews directly with partners, and you will be the person who translates what you learn on the ground into improvements our regional go-to-market team can act on.

Specifically, you will:

Drive activation and adoption of launched Connect Customer Decisions across APJ partners and their customers, and run structured onboarding and success plans for new feature launches.

Define and track value-realization milestones for each customer, making sure they reach first value and expansion milestones on time.

Own a regional customer health model that combines usage, sentiment, program, and delivery signals into a single view — and act on it, identifying at-risk accounts early and leading remediation with partners, specialist architects, and service teams.

Own the renewal and retention motion for partner-attached customers, running renewal forecasting, reducing churn, and surfacing expansion and cross-sell opportunities to our partner and field teams.

Coordinate success activities across ANZ, ASEAN, India, Japan, and Korea, adapting to local customer and market differences, and partner with global customer-success owners to adopt shared frameworks and share what works in APJ.

job.title: Sr. Supplier Quality Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality
job.description:
Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Reliability & Quality (IRQ) engineering team provides engineering support for our data center infrastructure mechanical and electrical equipment (Air Handling Unit, Switchgear, Breaker, Panel Board, UPS, Transformers, Generators, ATS etc.) as well as infrastructure security equipment (Cameras, Access Control, etc.) throughout their lifecycle. A critical piece of this support is ensuring the highest level of initial quality and ongoing support from our suppliers.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will ensure the highest standards of quality for AWS infrastructure equipment from supplier selection through field deployment. You will evaluate supplier capabilities through technical assessments and on-site evaluations, investigate quality issues using analytical approaches including failure mode analysis and apply engineering judgment to assess quality risks across design, manufacturing, and deployment stages. You will use critical thinking to drive field root cause analysis, identifying underlying failure mechanisms and developing effective corrective actions. Working closely with AWS Engineering teams, Procurement teams, Commissioning teams, and suppliers, you will develop data-driven insights from supplier performance metrics and field observations to drive improvements that enhance equipment quality. You will partner with engineering teams to define equipment specifications and acceptance criteria, work with suppliers to implement improvements through technical guidance and capability building, and collaborate with commissioning and operations teams to translate field performance findings into actionable quality improvements. You will also build and maintain quality roadmaps that align with AWS infrastructure goals, analyze trends across multiple equipment categories and suppliers to identify systemic quality challenges, and manage multiple concurrent quality initiatives across different regions and equipment types.

Keys to success in this role include sound judgment and excellent written/verbal communication skills.

Travel required, both international and domestic, approximately 30-50%

Key job responsibilities In this role you will:

  • Develop, implement and maintain the supplier quality roadmap across engineering and procurement teams.
  • Conduct technical investigations of equipment failures to understand root causes and prevent recurrence
  • Provide technical expertise on quality evaluation methods, testing approaches, and failure analysis techniques
  • Drive supplier and product qualification and assessment processes in support of procurement teams. This includes developing technical approaches for evaluating new equipment and suppliers entering the AWS ecosystem
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that address both immediate quality issues and long-term performance optimization
  • Develop and implement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to monitor supplier quality performance and drive accountability
  • Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

A day in the life Your day will be a dynamic blend of technical investigation, strategic problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll dive deep into equipment performance data, conduct detailed failure analyses, and develop innovative solutions that prevent future technical challenges. From remote meetings with global supplier teams to on-site technical assessments, you'll be at the forefront of maintaining AWS's infrastructure excellence.

About the team AWS Infrastructure Reliability & Quality (IRQ) engineering team provides engineering support for our data center infrastructure equipment (Air Handling Unit, Switchgear, Breaker, Panel Board, UPS, Transformers, Generators, ATS, Cameras, Access Control etc.) throughout their lifecycle. Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) team is part of the IRQ team and works on implementing proactive controls to reduce the incoming supplier quality issues.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
  • Experience in root cause analysis and troubleshooting or problem solving
  • Experience working with equipment suppliers, laboratories and manufacturing plants
  • Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in data center engineering or operations
  • Experience in manufacturing, process, or industrial engineering
  • Experience with process improvement, Kaizan, and Six Sigma, or experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
  • Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, etc.
  • 6+ years of supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Sr. Infrastructure Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Senior Infrastructure Reliability Engineer you will be proactively driving the reliability risk identification, assessment and mitigation for datacenter infrastructure equipment (Example: Busduct, Tapoff Box, MV Transformers, LV SWGR, Breakers, UPS, Power Distribution Cabinets etc.). You will also be responsible for root cause analysis of critical equipment failures and drive the continuous improvements to improve datacenter availability for AWS customers. You will work closely with both internal and outside partners including suppliers to drive key aspects of product specification, risk identification plan and execution. You must be ownership minded, independent, action and results oriented to succeed in an open collaborative environment.

The candidate should have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based approach to develop and implement both analytical and empirical approaches for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during product design, manufacture as well as deployment stages. The individual should be able to drive AWS application-specific requirements in carrying out both lifecycle environmental and operational stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical, chemical and mechanical stresses so to identify overstress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. Candidate should be capable of evaluating not only product design quality/reliability risks, but also have the skills and experiences in assessing electronics manufacture process related quality/reliability issues. Knowledge of statistical techniques and models is required to analyze test as well as field data.

At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification and the associated vendor selection and qualification requirements. The candidate will be expected to use knowledge of process capability for electronic component production as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical to quality and reliability metrics. At the system level, the individual will develop datacenter system level reliability model and related reliability quantification and risk analysis for datacenter configuration optimization. The candidate will be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and data analytics.

During sustaining stage, candidate will be responsible for monitoring product performance in the field and will be responsible to drive root cause analysis of any critical failures and the associated corrective and preventive actions. The individual should also be able to drive effective vendor auditing and quarterly review process to drive the continuous improvements of datacenter availability.

The successful candidate should be considered as an expert in the reliability engineering field and have a proven track record of success in not only product reliability leadership, as well as business negotiations and program management. Strong skill-set in problem analysis and solving as well as communication and vendor management are necessary. Candidates should also be able to travel internationally.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Executive, Asset Management
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

You will be part of the Asset Management (Commercial Management (Singapore)) – Retail & Commercial team and reporting to the Associate Director, Asset Management.

Job Responsibilities:

Budgeting, Financial & Asset Performance Analysis

  • Assist in developing and maintaining financial and asset models to evaluate and report on the performance of both retail and commercial assets, at the property and portfolio level.
  • Support the preparation of performance dashboards and management reports to provide insights and track key metrics.
  • Support the preparation and consolidation of annual budgets, reforecasts, and financial projections across the retail and commercial portfolios.

Market Research & Analysis

  • Conduct research and compile analysis on retail and commercial market trends, tenant behaviour, catchment demographics, and competitive landscapes.
  • Prepare market intelligence reports to support leasing, positioning, and investment decisions.

Asset Management Support

  • Contribute to asset management strategies for both retail and commercial properties, including performance benchmarking, positioning, tenant/trade mix (for retail), and space utilization (for commercial).
  • Assist in the planning and execution of asset enhancement initiatives tailored to the specific needs of each asset class.

Initiatives & Projects

  • Assist in the formulation and implementation of asset-specific or portfolio-wide initiatives, including leasing, marketing, digitalization, sustainability, and operational excellence projects.
  • Provide coordination and analytical support for cross-functional or ad-hoc projects.
  • Identify and propose improvements to internal processes, reporting tools, and workflows to enhance productivity, data accuracy, and stakeholder visibility.

Risk & Compliance Support

  • Facilitate risk assessments and reporting by working closely with asset managers and compliance teams to ensure alignment with internal controls and risk management frameworks.

Job Requirements

  • Good degree in Business, Real Estate, Finance, or a related field, with strong quantitative skills, a solid foundation in financial analysis, and proficiency in data analytics to support decision-making and performance evaluation.
  • Highly numerate with sharp analytical, research and problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail
  • Proactive and results driven
  • Ability to work within a team environment
  • Self-driven and able to work within tight deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • 2-3 years of work experience preferred but fresh graduates are also welcomed

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: R&D Senior Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead ###

**Your role and responsibilities:

**In this role, you will have the opportunity o contributes to the development, integration and verification of core protection products for electrical power systems, combining protection algorithms, power-system analysis, embedded product development, simulation, testing and release activities with strong technical ownership.

The work model for the role is:#LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification Business Distribution Solutions Division in Bangalore, India

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Perform simulation-based validation using power-system models and test scenarios; RTDS experience is mandatory and translate protection requirements and power-system use cases into technical specifications, algorithms, settings and implementation concepts.
  • Analyze fault behavior, relay operating characteristics, selectivity, sensitivity, stability and coordination under normal, abnormal and transient conditions
  • Own activities across the product lifecycle from requirements and design through implementation, verification, issue resolution and release.
  • Develop and enhance protection functions for MV/HV applications, including overcurrent, earth-fault, voltage/frequency, directional and other relevant protection elements.
  • Develop and execute tests covering nominal operation, fault conditions, boundary cases, failure scenarios and protection-logic interactions. Support integration of protection functions with embedded software, I/O, communication interfaces and product hardware.
  • Contribute to design reviews, verification reports, technical documentation and release readiness.

Qualifications for the role :

  • B.E./B. Tech or M.E./M. Tech in Electrical Engineering from NITs, IITs, Power Systems, Power Electronics or a closely related discipline with 3–6 years of relevant experience in power-system protection, protection relays, numerical relays, power electronics or related product development.
  • RTDS / Real-Time Digital Simulation and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing experience is a strong advantage
  • Hands-on understanding of protection functions, relay characteristics, coordination/selectivity and protection application concepts.
  • Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, ETAP, Power Factory, PSSE, or equivalent simulation/analysis tools is desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of power-system fundamentals, fault analysis, symmetrical components and protection principles.
  • Understanding of embedded product architecture; exposure to embedded C/C++ and debugging is desirable. Knowledge of IEC 61850, GOOSE and Sampled Values is an advantage.
  • Ability to interpret electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, protection settings and disturbance/waveform records.

More about us :

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

job.title: Senior Electrical Systems Engineer (BESS)
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to

Chapter Lead (ELSP Pilot)__

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. You will contribute significantly to successful project outcomes within technology, product, and solution development, including associated Intellectual Property (IP). You will act as a key point of expertise in Research & Development, troubleshooting, and product engineering support. You will also apply your deep technical knowledge to propose and implement innovative ideas that strengthen our technology roadmap.

Our product portfolio spans Battery Energy Storage Systems, and UPS systems, ranging from 150 kVA to 30+ MVA. Your focus will be on developing and enhancing Power Conditioning core technologies, driving innovation to improve performance, reduce cost, and increase operational efficiency, mainly around Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

The work model for the role is: onsite #LI-onsite

Location: Napier, New Zealand.

This role is contributing to the Critical Power product group in New Zealand.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Lead the hardware design and development of the Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and Uninterruptable Power Supply​ (UPS).
  • Contribute to the analysis and validation of low and medium-voltage energy management systems, including system protection schemes, power quality optimisation, energy storage integration, and evaluation of magnetic components.
  • Perform electrical design activities including cable and harness dimensioning, selection, routing and layout, and definition and selection of protection devices, sensors and power supplies.
  • Conduct comprehensive functional, performance, and safety testing on BESS and UPS, ensuring compliance with industry standards (IEC/UL certifications).
  • Develop, improve, and maintain accurate technical documentation including test procedures and plans, commissioning guides, user manuals, product drawings, and interface specifications for battery systems.
  • Plan and execute system commissioning activities on customer sites, including pre-commissioning inspections, power-up sequences, functional verification, performance optimization, and troubleshooting across all product lines.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose electrical faults, power quality issues, and system performance problems; develop improvement strategies and provide technical guidance to support customer applications.
  • Develop deep expertise in ABB's power conditioning portfolio (BESS and HiPerGuard) and stay current with emerging power and energy management technologies.

Qualifications for the role

  • Strong understanding of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and power converters >200kW.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience designing/maintaining power electronic systems within specialist teams; capable of leading engineering projects and guiding junior colleagues.
  • Solid understanding of three-phase systems and power electronics, including inverter and converter operating principles, practical application and integration into systems, and the ability to interpret product specifications and operate within defined performance and safety margins.
  • Knowledge of grid compliance requirements, including grid codes, power quality standards (harmonics, THD, power factor), fault ride-through, frequency and voltage regulation, and anti-islanding protection, with familiarity with relevant IEC and IEEE standards is desirable.
  • Foundational knowledge of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) principles, including conducted and radiated emissions, immunity requirements, and common mitigation techniques such as filtering and shielding, with familiarity with relevant standards.
  • Foundational knowledge of thermodynamics, including heat management and airflow optimization within electrical cabinets to ensure reliable and safe equipment operation.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD and circuit simulation tools (e.g., PSCAD, Matlab/Simulink) is a plus.
  • Understanding of control methods with ability to communicate effectively with control engineering teams to ensure seamless system integration.
  • Proven ability to apply innovative thinking and technical creativity across complex R&D assignments and challenging engineering problems.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering and/or Power Electronics Engineering; postgraduate qualifications are desirable.
  • Strong English communication skills with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multiple functions, technical domains, and multi-site engineering teams.

More about us

ABB's Critical Power product group, within the Smart Power Division, is a global leader in advanced UPS and energy storage solutions serving mission-critical applications worldwide. We protect the world's most demanding operations – from data centers and semiconductor fabrication plants to pharmaceutical manufacturing, cable production, aerospace facilities, and critical infrastructure. Our solutions enable 24/7 uptime and energy efficiency for the world's largest hyperscale data centers and enterprise customers, directly supporting the digital transformation of society.

Our engineering expertise spans over 50 years of innovation in power conversion technology. We design and deploy cutting-edge UPS systems ranging from 150 kVA to 30+ MVA, featuring advanced modular architectures and the latest energy storage technologies including traditional VRLA batteries, next-generation lithium-ion solutions, and innovative nickel-zinc battery systems. Our products achieve industry-leading efficiency exceeding 95-99%, with exceptional reliability standards including full online double-conversion architecture and redundant modular designs for mission-critical applications.

The Napier facility is home to our power electronics engineering hub and represents ABB's commitment to innovation in the Asia-Pacific region. We are actively developing next-generation technologies to support the global energy transition, including PowerExchanger grid support services that unlock revenue streams from UPS energy storage assets and enable broader renewable energy integration. Our focus on sustainability is evidenced by our comprehensive portfolio of environmentally certified solutions and our commitment to helping customers achieve their carbon reduction targets.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: AI Engineer – Physical AI & Digital Twin Systems
job.description:
Position Summary

Siemens Energy Gas Services (GS) seeks an AI Engineer to build production-grade Physical AI and Digital Twin systems for advanced manufacturing. The role centers on robot perception, reasoning, control, simulation, and deployment across cloud, edge, and real-world operations.

You will design, train, evaluate, and deploy AI models that enable autonomous and semi-autonomous robotic workflows across simulation and physical environments, owning the lifecycle from data and experimentation to inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Working at the intersection of robotics, industrial software, and AI, you will partner with product, controls, robotics, and domain teams to deliver reliable, observable, and scalable systems that improve autonomy, safety, and productivity.

How You’ll Make an Impact (key responsibilities of role)

  • Build and operate data and training pipelines for collection, labeling, augmentation, versioning, and evaluation across simulation and real-world datasets.
  • Develop and deploy AI models for robot perception, reasoning, and action, including computer vision, multimodal models, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems.
  • Apply sim-to-real methods using synthetic data, domain randomization, imitation learning, transfer learning, and benchmark-driven validation.
  • Integrate models with Digital Twin and robotics platforms such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, robot middleware, and orchestration services.
  • Deploy scalable inference and control services on cloud and edge environments using containers, Kubernetes, APIs, and event-driven workflows.
  • Establish observability for model and system performance, including experiment tracking, evaluation, drift detection, telemetry, and safe rollback mechanisms.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate industrial use cases into production-ready AI capabilities with measurable reliability and productivity impact.

What You Bring (required qualification and skill sets)

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience building, training, evaluating, and deploying AI/ML systems in production.
  • Strong Python engineering skills, including packaging, testing, APIs, and performance-oriented development; C++ is a plus for robotics integration.
  • Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and with computer vision or multimodal model development.
  • Experience with robotic AI concepts such as perception, planning support, control integration, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or Vision-Language-Action models.
  • Practical knowledge of MLOps and deployment, including experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, containers, and cloud or edge inference.
  • Experience with simulation and Digital Twin workflows, including sim-to-real validation and evaluation using telemetry, sensor, and vision data.
  • Ability to define metrics, benchmarks, and safety-minded validation processes for reliable deployment in industrial environments.

Good-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, or similar robotics simulation platforms.
  • Familiarity with world models, synthetic data generation, diffusion policy methods, or foundation-model-based robotics workflows.
  • Exposure to edge AI platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson and to latency-, compute-, or power-constrained deployment.
  • Understanding robot middleware, telemetry pipelines, and distributed or real-time robotic system architectures.
  • Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, or other safety-critical operational environments.

Key Attributes

  • Strong problem solving mindset and ability to work with team members from different domains.
  • Excellent communication skills and willingness to support others across the team.
  • Hands‑on engineering mindset with focus on practical development & deployment.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to non‑experts.
  • High ownership and accountability.
  • Comfortable working across R&D, engineering, and service organizations.

job.title: Business Program Manager
job.description:
About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Data Center Operations Business Program Manager, you will support facilities operations in Singapore and across the APAC region. In this role, you will oversee daily business operations, manage site budgets, guide procurement and supplier agreements, and direct non-critical infrastructure projects. By driving strategic initiatives, negotiating with partners, and leading cost-effective maintenance, you will ensure our data centers run safely and efficiently. You will work closely with site teams to manage vendor agreements, review financial performance, and maintain high operational standards. As a proactive problem solver, you will establish purchase orders, approve invoices, and hold contractors accountable to key performance goals. You will also develop AI skills and leverage innovative tools to enhance performance and drive operational excellence. You will help Google data centers maintain quality, delivery, and value.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare Statements of Work (SoW) for critical and non-critical facility operations agreements.
  • Obtain facilities-related vendor price quotes, negotiating, preparing purchase orders, and reviewing/approving invoices.
  • Manage facilities system operation and maintenance expenses, including forecasting and budgeting (OPEX and CAPEX).
  • Work with support service vendors to resolve conflicts and issues under the direction of the facility manager.
  • Act as the point of contact for small to medium projects as assigned by the facility manager.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

This is an opportunity to join Firmus at an exciting stage of hyper growth and help shape the teams behind some of the most important AI infrastructure projects ahead of us.

The Talent Acquisition Partner will play a key role in building the teams that enable this growth. This role will partner closely with business leaders and hiring managers across AI Infrastructure Engineering, Deployment and Operations functions to deliver high-quality hiring outcomes at speed.

This is a hands-on Talent Acquisition role with strong business ownership. You will not simply fill roles; you will become the hiring partner for critical business functions, advising hiring managers, shaping sourcing strategies, building market pipelines and ensuring delivery stays on track.

This is a one-year fixed-term full time role, with strong potential for conversion to permanent employment, subject to performance and business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Hiring Partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders across assigned portfolios.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce plans, role requirements, and hiring priorities.
  • Provide market insights, talent availability updates and hiring recommendations to support business decision-making.
  • Provide advisory insights to hiring managers on role briefing, assessment alignment, candidate experience and timely decision-making.

High-Volume Hiring Delivery

  • Manage an average of 15-20 active roles, at any given time, across AI Infrastructure Deployment & AI Factory Operations, or other assigned portfolios with business scales
  • Maintain weekly pipeline discipline across sourcing, screening, interview progress, feedback, offer and close-out.
  • Prioritise urgent and high-impact roles while keeping broader hiring activity moving.
  • Build and maintain strong shortlists against agreed timelines.

Industry Talent Mapping and Sourcing

  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies for Deployment, Operation and Project Management talent.
  • Build proactive talent pools for recurring and business-critical roles.
  • Identify relevant industry channels, competitors, networks and referral pathways.
  • Use direct sourcing, LinkedIn, referrals, applications and selective agency engagement to build candidate pipelines.

Recruitment Operations and Data Discipline

  • Maintain accurate recruitment data and pipeline updates in Greenhouse.
  • Track activity, conversion and bottlenecks across assigned roles, contribute to weekly hiring reporting and pipeline review rhythms.
  • Use recruitment data to drive outcomes, prioritise actions and identify risks
  • Participate in TA projects and process enhancements as part of the broader People and Talent team.
  • Work with the TA Coordinator on interview scheduling, reference checks, job posting, contract support and onboarding handover.

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources Management or related fields
  • Eight to ten years of experience as an advisory Talent Acquisition Partner, 360 Recruiter or similar role in a fast-paced hiring environment.
  • Proven track records in recruiting for Data Centre Infrastructure, Infrastructure deployment & Project Management, Electrical & Mechanical engineering related functions are highly desirable
  • A strong understanding of the ASEAN region is essential for this role, including in-depth knowledge of regional talent markets, talent availability and attraction, and country-specific employment laws and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong capability managing high-volume hiring while maintaining quality and stakeholder confidence.
  • Strong sourcing capability across LinkedIn, direct sourcing, referrals, talent pooling and market mapping.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, urgent roles and multiple hiring processes at once.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and candidate engagement skills.

Location & Reporting

  • Based in Singapore
  • Hybrid working mode: 4 days in the office
  • Reports directly to the Chief People Officer

Employment Basis

This is a one-year fixed term full-time role.

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.
