job.title: Project Manager, ICT
job.description:
Role Overview

The Project Manager, ICT takes full end-to-end ownership of planning, executing, and delivering complex, strategic, and medium-to-large-scale ICT projects. Acting as the central bridge between business requirements, technical delivery, and operational teams, you will define comprehensive project management plans to track progress, optimize resource utilization, manage costs, and mitigate delivery risks.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep command of industry-standard project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) across the full project lifecycle — from initiation through to closure. Operating within established organizational PMO standards and governance frameworks, you will lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, high-value technical solutions on schedule and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery & Execution Management

  • End-to-End Delivery: Drive the start-to-finish lifecycle management of high-value, strategic ICT initiatives, ensuring full alignment with business objectives and quality standards.
  • Baseline Tracking: Actively plan, track, and report on project scope, timelines, financials, milestones, and performance metrics/KPIs.
  • Concurrence & Velocity: Maintain a highly organized, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset with the capability to manage multiple concurrent projects under pressure.

2. Stakeholder Engagement & Client Management

  • Primary Point of Contact: Act as the face of the project team for clients and external partners, providing transparent status updates while championing high customer satisfaction.
  • Executive Communication: Distill project progress, complex technical issues, and risks into clear updates for senior management and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Strategic Influence: Align expectations across cross-functional business, product, and support teams to drive collaboration and minimize overall failure risks.

3. Resource Planning & Matrix Coordination

  • Utilization Optimization: Plan, monitor, and analyze resource allocation and utilization metrics to optimize future scheduling and team capacity.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Orchestrate tasks and workflows among internal teams, third-party vendors, and external partners within matrixed environments.

4. Risk, Issue & Change Governance

  • Proactive Mitigation: Anticipate, assess, and manage project risks and technical issues, implementing swift preventative actions and mitigation strategies.
  • Escalation Control: Actively manage project escalations, schedule slippages, resource shortages, and resolve team or vendor conflicts effectively.
  • Scope Governance: Strictly control scope creep and evaluate changing user requirements through formal organizational Change Control processes.

5. PMO Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Process Adherence: Ensure all project activities and artifacts strictly comply with internal corporate PMO governance standards, processes, and methodologies.
  • Documentation Excellence: Maintain accurate, thorough, and timely project documentation and health reporting.
  • Corporate Value-Add: Contribute to ongoing PMO capability developments, support pre-sales activities, assist in corporate initiatives, and mentor junior project managers.

Qualifications and Experience

1. Background & Experience Requirements

  • Professional Experience: Minimum of 8 years of dedicated project management experience specifically within ICT delivery environments.
  • Track Record: Proven success delivering medium-to-large-scale ICT projects from inception to completion.
  • Organizational Exposure: Prior experience navigating large matrix organizations or multinational corporation (MNC) environments is highly preferred.
  • Target Industries: Proven experience delivering technology solutions across sectors such as Government, Healthcare, Education, Financial Services (FSI), Hospitality/MICE, or Commercial industries.

2. Education & Professional Certifications

  • Academic Degree: An accredited University Degree in Information Technology, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related technical/business discipline. (Equivalent practical, professional experience will be evaluated and considered in lieu of a degree).
  • Mandatory Certification: Must hold at least one recognized professional project management certification: PMP, CITPM, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum (e.g., CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe).

Core Competencies and Soft Skills

  • Methodology Command: Deep understanding and practical application of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid frameworks.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving: A highly logical and analytical mindset geared toward troubleshooting, critical decision-making, and crisis management in fast-paced environments.
  • Elite Soft Skills: Exceptional interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven ability to command a room, resolve conflict, and positively influence diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders up to the executive level.

Application Note: We appreciate your interest in this role; please note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified for an interview.

job.title: Data Centre Project Manager (Loyang)
job.description:
Overview

We are seeking a Project Manager to join our team in coordinating and executing our data centre's physical and network infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will possess versatile knowledge and experience in the different aspect of a data centre. He/She will be skilled in coordinating with cross-functional teams and appointed contractors in ensuring compliance with the firm’s standards and practises, conducting site surveys, and resolving any technical issues that may arise during the project lifecycle, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and delivering projects on time and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

Responsible for overall project coordination with internal technology teams, external contractors, and Data Center service providers to deliver projects.

Design, Analysis and Requirement Gathering

§Work with Data Center service providers to understand whitespace constraints (power / coolings) and come up with the white space layouts

§Prepare the complete equipment restack plan/phasing plan co-ordinatiing with internal technology teams as well as the DC vendor

§Gather hardware BOM (model, delivery dates, etc.) from different technology teams

§Calculate/design the required rack count, power consumption, cooling, network panels, cables, etc, and work with other Data Center teams on design and construction

§Work with Sourcing, Real Estate, Legal and Finance teams on RFP’s, and provide adequate support for any DC contract amendment/renewals discussions when applicable

Implementation and Deployment

§Monitor Data Center service providers’ progress.Prepare project defect lists and follow-up accordingly

§Travel to sites to review construction progress.Work with service providers engineers to provide progress feedback to the Morgan Stanley Technical SME’s

§Centralize all installation requests for different technology teams, and raise Change Management request.When required, assist in physical racking and stacking of technology equipment (e.g. power and network cable connections, iLO configuration)

§Coordinate with all technology teams on equipment restack plan

§Work closely with different third party vendors for equipment delivery

§Coordinate and escort Telco carrier vendors for circuit installations, and witness testing.

§Coordinate and supervise patching of network cables, and witness testing

§Centralize and raise all equipment decommission and disposals requests.Follow appropriate guideline carefully, and work with disposal teams/vendors on equipment disposal, disk degaussing/shredding and document detailed records

-Documentation

§Update equipment inventory management system and rack elevations.

§Provide regular reporting on project status and meeting minutes to regional EDC team

§Obtain and collect all data necessary for management/operation report, including capacity management, financial budget forecasts, project spends, vendor coordination, patching, and project sharepoint sites

Requirements

§Experience/Knowledge:

•Min 5-7 years working experience in Data Center industry’s mission critical system, specifically in whitespace design and/or project management. •Good understanding of data center infrastructure and its resiliency design (UPS, Generator, CRAC, cabling, containment routes, etc). CDCP is a plus •Good understanding of technology hardware installation procedure •Network cable patchings and testing technique •Solid experience with Excel, Powerpoint, Microsoft Project •Project Management certification is a plus, such as PMP §Experience in datahall fitouts, testing and commissioning, handover, close out on Data Center projects

Basic knowledge of International as well as local building regulations including Workplace Safety & Health.

Able to work proactively with good communication, analytical, problem solving, and negotiation skills, in order to work with different teams across different countrie

Ability to communicate in a clear and understandable manner

Ability to organize and plan multiple projects with different end-users simultaneously.

Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment and under pressure.

job.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will report to the Principal Mechanical Engineer and be based at our North Sydney headquarters. You will be a senior discipline specialist supporting AirTrunk's global project pipeline and the continuous improvement of our mechanical global standards, reference designs and Owner-Supplied Equipment (OSE). You will work across Design and Engineering, Design and Innovation, Development, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning and Operations. You will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Provide mechanical engineering input from concept through IFC to ensure designs comply with the AirTrunk Reference Design, Global Minimum Standards - Engineering (GMS-E), approved project requirements and applicable regulations.
  • Review designs and provide clear, consistent and practical advice to consultants, AirTrunk Design Management and Site Engineering and Construction teams.
  • Work with design teams to identify and implement mechanical solutions that are safe, scalable, repeatable and adaptable across multiple regions.
  • Partner with Design and Innovation to provide a mechanical engineering lens on the development and continuous improvement of AirTrunk reference designs.
  • Be accountable for the continuous improvement and effective design implementation of assigned mechanical OSE products under the direction and approval of the Principal Mechanical Engineer.
  • Identify technical risks, non-compliances, interfaces and value opportunities early, recommending proportionate actions and escalating material decisions to the Principal Mechanical Engineer.
  • Convert lessons from design, delivery, commissioning and operations into practical improvements to global standards, reference designs, OSE products and assurance
  • Work across multiple regions and projects as required to drive global consistency in mechanical engineering and design solutions

Your Day to Day

  • Perform risk-based mechanical design reviews across concept, preliminary, schematic, detailed and IFC stages, documenting findings, actions, owners and required closure
  • Assess designs and technical submissions against the AirTrunk Reference Design, GMS-E, mechanical OSE specifications, approved project requirements, applicable codes and customer commitments.

  • Support Design Management in resolving technical issues while preserving its ownership of project design coordination and the project design Project delivery teams and their designers remain responsible for developing and coordinating the design.
  • Support design management in reviews of CFD studies against project requirements and global standards
  • Identify deviations, non-conformances, assumptions and unresolved risks; recommend technically sound resolution options and escalate departures, waivers or material decisions to the Principal Mechanical Engineer.
  • Develop scalable mechanical solutions that accommodate regional climate, water availability, regulations, supply-chain constraints and customer needs without unnecessary divergence from the global baseline.
  • Provide structured mechanical input to Design and Innovation on proposed reference design changes, supported by project evidence, technical analysis, performance data and lessons learned.
  • Drive assigned mechanical OSE improvement activities, including requirements capture, technical evaluation, product performance reviews, vendor feedback and proposed specification updates, for approval by the Principal Mechanical
  • Verify that approved mechanical OSE products and their interfaces are correctly incorporated into project designs, and support resolution of product integration
  • Provide subject matter expertise across cooling and thermal systems, ventilation, hydraulics, fuel systems, fire and life-safety interfaces, controls interfaces, water and energy performance, and associated OSE.
  • Coordinate mechanical interfaces with electrical, controls and automation, civil, structural, architectural, fire, fuel, hydraulic and commissioning teams.
  • Contribute to Safety in Design reviews and ensure material mechanical hazards, assumptions, constraints and residual risks are identified, treated and
  • Support Procurement and Supply Chain with technical review of vendor proposals, substitutions and quality risks, and participate in factory acceptance testing or proof-of-concept activities where required.
  • Support investigation and resolution of significant site, commissioning and operational issues, completing root-cause analysis and feeding agreed improvements back into future designs and global standards.
  • Identify value engineering opportunities and provide the technical analysis needed to balance capital cost, programme, energy and water performance, resilience, operability, maintainability and lifecycle value.
  • Share knowledge and mentor engineers and project stakeholders, promoting consistent interpretation and application of AirTrunk's mechanical requirements across

Measures of Success

  • Mechanical reviews and technical actions completed to agreed stage-gate timeframes with clear, useful and auditable advice.
  • Demonstrable compliance with the AirTrunk Reference Design, GMS-E and mechanical OSE specifications, with fewer repeated deviations, late changes and design-related defects.
  • Consistent mechanical guidance across consultants, projects and regions, with scalable solutions adopted where appropriate.
  • Assigned mechanical OSE products improved to the agreed plan and correctly implemented in project designs.
  • Material mechanical risks, non-compliances and departures identified early and escalated with clear options and recommendations.
  • Delivery, commissioning and operational learning incorporated into reference designs, global standards, OSE products and future project reviews.
  • Positive stakeholder feedback on technical quality, responsiveness, collaboration and practical problem solving.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
  • Typically 8+ years of progressive mechanical engineering experience across design, technical assurance, construction, commissioning or operations.
  • Chartered or Professional Engineer status, or progress towards an equivalent recognised registration, is preferred.
  • Strong experience in data centres, mission-critical facilities, industrial infrastructure or another high-availability operating environment.
  • Sound expertise in cooling and thermal systems, ventilation, hydraulics, fuel systems, fire and life-safety interfaces, controls, water and energy performance, and equipment
  • Demonstrated ability to review complex designs, interpret engineering standards and codes, identify material risks and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations.
  • Experience with mechanical equipment specifications, technical evaluation, vendor engagement, design integration and product improvement is highly regarded.
  • Ability to develop practical and scalable solutions across different climates, regions, regulatory environments and project delivery models.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of value engineering, lifecycle cost, constructability, maintainability and operational performance.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, sound judgement, collaborative working style and willingness to travel occasionally across AirTrunk's regions.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

job.title: Principal Fire & Hydraulic Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Principal Fire and Hydraulics Engineer, you will report to the Senior Director, Engineering and be based at our North Sydney headquarters. This newly created role will establish and lead AirTrunk's global fire protection and hydraulic engineering disciplines, supported by a lean team of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) scaled to business need and portfolio growth.

You will work across Design and Engineering, Design and Innovation, Development, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning and Operations. You will make an impact in an number of ways:

  • Act as AirTrunk's senior fire and hydraulics technical authority, escalation point and delegated decision maker for material risks, deviations and design decisions.
  • Own the fire and hydraulics requirements within the Global Minimum Standards - Engineering (GMS-E) and Global Minimum Standards - Construction (GMS-C), together with relevant Owner-Supplied Equipment (OSE) specifications.
  • Prioritise and allocate fire and hydraulics capability across the global project pipeline according to project risk, design maturity and business need.
  • Provide risk-based technical direction and independent design assurance from concept through IFC, confirming compliance with AirTrunk standards without owning day-to-day project design coordination or driving the general contractor's design development.
  • Be accountable for discipline cost, technical compliance and engineering suitability, including life safety, reliability, operability, maintainability and lifecycle value.
  • Drive global consistency and value engineering while protecting life safety, regulatory or FM Global compliance, customer commitments and operational performance.
  • Use delivery, commissioning, incident and operational learning to improve standards, specifications, assurance practices and team capability.

Your Day to Day

  • Own and maintain fire and hydraulics requirements within GMS-E and GMS-C, covering design criteria, performance, calculations, installation quality, inspection and testing, pre-commissioning readiness and handover; also govern relevant OSE specifications, change control and implementation guidance.
  • Set the fire systems campus approach and technical direction for fire engineering and certifying authority requirements; pre-action and wet sprinkler systems; gas suppression; dry fire detection, smoke detection and alarm systems; occupant warning systems; fire indicator panels; nitrogen generation systems; sprinkler and hydrant pumps; fire-suppression water storage; and associated controls.
  • Interpret and govern compliance with applicable fire codes, regulations, Authority Having Jurisdiction requirements, insurer requirements and FM Global standards across AirTrunk's regions.
  • Own the technical requirements for fire cause-and-effect matrices and ensure coordinated interfaces with mechanical systems, smoke control, dampers, electrical systems, BMS, controls and automation, security, access control and emergency response functions.
  • Set technical direction and design criteria for hydraulic equipment and systems, including domestic cold water, potable and non-potable water, water storage, piping and pumping, filtration and incoming water treatment, sanitary drainage, stormwater and siphonic drainage, leak detection, cross-connection control and associated water-quality requirements.
  • Define and assure hydraulic analyses and calculations, including utility water flow data and supply analysis, used-water discharge quality, water storage, pump head, stormwater and sanitary pipework sizing, rainwater storage tank sizing and system
  • Set the scope and depth of risk-based reviews from concept through IFC and review designs, calculations, cause-and-effect matrices and technical submissions for .
  • Act as the senior escalation point and delegated decision maker for material risks, departures, waivers, substitutions and non-conformances, recording decisions, rationale, conditions and accountable owners.
  • Maintain discipline cost benchmarks, challenge unnecessary complexity and assess system and equipment suitability across life safety, compliance, capacity, reliability, resilience, constructability, maintainability, operability, testability and lifecycle value.
  • Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain to evaluate vendor proposals, technical deviations, equipment substitutions and quality risks, and provide senior technical input to factory acceptance testing and proof-of-concept activities.
  • Lead discipline peer reviews and resolve interfaces with mechanical, electrical, controls and automation, civil, structural, architectural, security, commissioning and operational teams; champion Safety in Design and clear ownership of residual risks.
  • Provide senior technical support for significant site, commissioning, integrated systems testing and operational issues, and ensure root causes and lessons learned are reflected in standards, specifications and future project assurance.
  • Communicate complex fire and hydraulic matters clearly to executives, customers, authorities, insurers, commercial teams, delivery partners and non-technical stakeholders, including recommended options and trade-offs.

Measures of Success

  • A clearly established fire and hydraulics discipline with effective governance, decision rights, stakeholder interfaces and a capable, right-sized SME team aligned to business
  • Projects supported in line with risk and design maturity, with reviews, calculations and technical actions completed to required stage-gate timeframes.
  • Fire and hydraulic requirements within GMS-E and GMS-C, together with relevant OSE specifications, reviewed to the approved cadence, consistently adopted across regions and improved using documented delivery and operational learning.
  • Cost and design outcomes supported by transparent benchmarks and value engineering, with improved first-time-right quality and fewer repeated deviations, late changes, RFIs and commissioning defects.
  • Material risks and decisions resolved promptly, with systems demonstrably suitable across life safety, regulatory and FM Global compliance, reliability, operability, maintainability, testability and lifecycle value.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Fire Safety, Fire Protection, Mechanical, Hydraulic or Building Services Engineering, or a closely related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
  • Typically 12+ years of progressive fire protection and hydraulic engineering experience, including leadership across complex, multi-project or multi-region portfolios; Chartered or Professional Engineer status or relevant fire-safety accreditation is preferred.
  • Deep expertise in fire and smoke detection, alarm, occupant warning and notification systems, fire indicator panels, graphical interfaces, fire cause-and-effect development and multidisciplinary systems integration.
  • Deep expertise in wet and pre-action sprinkler systems, gaseous suppression, hydrant systems, nitrogen generation, fire-water storage, pumps and associated controls.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable fire standards, building and fire regulations, Authority Having Jurisdiction processes, insurer requirements and FM Global requirements.
  • Deep expertise in domestic cold water, potable and non-potable water, water treatment, sanitary drainage, stormwater, siphonic drainage, water storage and pumping systems, including storage, flow, pump head and pipework sizing
  • Strong experience in data centres, mission-critical facilities, industrial infrastructure or another high-availability operating environment.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing a technical function and owning engineering and construction standards, equipment specifications, technical assurance, delegated authority and deviation governance.
  • Commercially astute and decisive, with proven people leadership, resource planning, stakeholder communication and the ability to balance life safety, compliance, cost, programme and operational requirements across multiple regions; occasional overseas travel is required.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. job.title: Senior Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

APAC capacity management is a critical and complex function that optimises available space, power and cooling across data centers in the region. The Senior Manager, Capacity Management, APAC East provides strategic leadership to a team of senior members and utilises expertise to recommend and develop solutions, policies and procedures to optimise our data center capacity across Australia, Japan, Indonesia, South Korea and the Philippines.

This is a strategic role that involves managing teams across different countries in APAC East and directly contributing to supporting our sales pipeline, while balancing technical considerations to secure Availability.

Key responsibilities

People Management

  • Leads and manages a team of senior Capacity engineers across Australia and Japan
  • A strategic leader who directs the activities of a broad functional area and recommends implementing changes to methods
  • Builds a high performing team that delivers operational excellence in the day to day while also focusing on longer term, strategic initiatives around improving systems and processes in Data Center Capacity Management

Driving Strategic Programs

  • Plays a pivotal role in shaping the development of a unified, regional system for capacity management that delivers a single pane of glass visualisation for all key decision-making parameters and eventually drives greater automation in Capacity management
  • Leads and drives specific work streams related to the development of this capability, works cross functionally with development teams and technical program management functions to build and execute on a clear roadmap

Problem Solving

  • Provides direction to staff as required to analyse and resolve critical technical problems
  • Recommends methods and approaches for finding solutions to problems that deviate from established processes or operational policies
  • Identifies opportunities for process efficiency improvements and implements as appropriate
  • Makes high judgement calls by triangulating diverse sets of data and analytics
  • Works with cross-regional/global departments to identify and resolve any problems related to data center capacity
  • Supports the development of business cases that shape further investment and expansion plans by delivering capacity and load growth forecasts to inform decision making

Stakeholder Management and Interaction

  • Coordinates and leads department meetings including monthly and quarterly business reviews on key metrics and team deliverables
  • Meets monthly with country operations leaders
  • Meets monthly with country sales leaders and/or sales engineers

Data Analytics and Reporting

  • Reviews space and power inventory in the region across a portfolio of existing and new data centers
  • Drives accuracy and consistency of data related to Capacity by auditing and reviewing at regular intervals
  • Owns KPIs tied to operational efficiency, asset utilization and availability for the APAC-East region
  • Reviews required reports to approve fill rates and develop projections related to future expansions
  • Reviews and drives resolution of data quality issues related to capacity

Space/Power Management

  • Reviews the data center space and power availability on a regular basis with team leads to ensure optimal utilisation of space
  • Addresses any escalated concerns on assignment layout and seeks diverse opinions for decision making

Operations

  • Involved in resolution of operational issues that are escalated and unable to be resolved at subordinate levels

Collaboration

  • Collaborates with senior members of departments, including Finance, IT, Data Center Ops to address issues, answer questions, and develop cross functional processes
  • Ensures alignment across stakeholders on a single source of truth for available capacity that drives decision making around capacity allocation and optimization
  • Works with stakeholders across sales, tech development, program management, operations and other teams on the development of consistent global processes and tools for effective management of data center capacity in APAC East and across the region

Qualifications, key skills and attributes:

  • 7+ years' experience in leading teams across the data center or similar sector
  • 10+ years' experience in either Engineering, Project Management, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain management with a focus on continuous improvement
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to influence across a wide variety of stakeholders including senior commercial, financial and technical leaders to drive alignment and decision making at speed
  • Technical Expertise: Understanding of Data Center infrastructure, preferably an Electrical or Mechanical Engineering degree. Ability to break down complex technical topics into simple priorities and deliverables and develop executive-level presentations to simplify complexities and drive focus
  • Hands on Leadership: Leads by example, ability to dive deeper into the day to day and operational level while also taking a more strategic big picture view of long-term priorities
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to manage and analyse large sets of data, structure data appropriately, logically present frameworks and ideas for problem solving and quickly identify insight from data or guide teams on visualisation of data in the right manner to drive decision making
  • LEAN/Six Sigma can be helpful
  • The individual needs to have a strong track record of and demonstrated success in leading and developing geographically dispersed teams
  • Should be an excellent communicator and proactive collaborator who can combine commercial acumen with engineering and operational awareness

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more [here](https://careers.equinix.com/equinix-ai-guidance-for-candidates).

job.title: Commercial Analyst
job.description:
About Us

There’s something special about working for a company like Macquarie Telecom. We’re not the biggest in the industry, where you’re just a number. We’re not tiny enough that you’ve never heard of us. We’re in that sweet spot where we’re strong enough to punch above our weight. And we definitely do! Because of this, you have the opportunity to make a difference.

The Opportunity

Join Macquarie Telecom’s Commercial team as a Commercial Analyst and play a key role in shaping the commercial performance of our Telecom business.

This is more than a reporting role. You’ll own the rolling forecast and month-end close, turn financial results into meaningful commercial insight, and provide the modelling and analysis that supports decisions across pricing, products, vendors and strategic initiatives.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Product, Operations, Finance and Commercial teams to understand what is driving performance, identify risks and opportunities, and help shape what comes next.

With Macquarie Telecom investing heavily in AI and automation, you’ll also have the opportunity to apply emerging technology to improve the quality, speed and efficiency of commercial analysis — building valuable skills for a broader commercial career.

Based in Sydney, you’ll report to the Commercial Manager, with exposure to senior commercial leadership and a passionate team focused on making a difference.

The Opportunity

Join Macquarie Telecom’s Commercial team as a Commercial Analyst and play a key role in shaping the commercial performance of our Telecom business.

This is more than a reporting role. You’ll own the rolling forecast and month-end close, turn financial results into meaningful commercial insight, and provide the modelling and analysis that supports decisions across pricing, products, vendors and strategic initiatives.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Product, Operations, Finance and Commercial teams to understand what is driving performance, identify risks and opportunities, and help shape what comes next.

With Macquarie Telecom investing heavily in AI and automation, you’ll also have the opportunity to apply emerging technology to improve the quality, speed and efficiency of commercial analysis — building valuable skills for a broader commercial career.

Based in Sydney, you’ll report to the Commercial Manager, with exposure to senior commercial leadership and a passionate team focused on making a difference.

About You

  • 3–5 years’ experience in finance, commercial or analytical roles, ideally within telecommunications or a similar commercial environment
  • Strong experience across forecasting, budgeting, financial modelling and month-end
  • Commercially curious — you naturally ask why the numbers have moved and what should be done about it
  • Confident working with large datasets and translating financial information into clear, actionable insights
  • Comfortable building and reviewing business cases and constructively challenging assumptions
  • Strong stakeholder skills, with the ability to communicate financial outcomes to non-finance audiences
  • Advanced Excel modelling skills, including forecasting and scenario analysis
  • CA/CPA qualified or working towards qualification is desirable, but not essential
  • Experience with AI, automation, SQL or Power BI is advantageous
  • Someone who enjoys improving processes, learning new technology and finding better ways to work

Why Macquarie?

At Macquarie Telecom, you’ll be part of an ASX-listed Australian technology business where you can make a genuine impact.

You’ll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of finance, technology and commercial strategy, while building capability in AI and automation that will shape the future of how commercial teams operate.

If you’re looking for a role where you can go beyond the numbers, influence decisions and grow into a broader commercial career, this could be the opportunity for you.

job.title: Legal Counsel (Projects) (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Role purpose

  • This role will be based in Singapore and will support STACK Infrastructure’s APAC business across markets including Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.
  • This role will support STACK Infrastructure APAC on development, construction, procurement, long-lead equipment, operations vendor contracting and project delivery workstreams.
  • The role is intended to provide dedicated legal coverage for the project execution side of the business: building the asset, procuring the equipment and services required for the asset, and supporting the contracts needed to operate the asset once live.
  • The successful candidate will work closely with the General Counsel, development / delivery team, engineering team, procurement team, operations team, finance team, project managers and external counsel across APAC.

Key responsibilities: The role will cover:

Development and construction

  • Support legal review, drafting and negotiation of construction and delivery contracts across APAC.
  • Review and negotiate early contractor involvement agreements, advance orders, letters of intent, letters of award, GC contracts, demolition contracts, substation contracts, core & shell contracts, MEP fitout contracts, works contracts, design contracts and consultant appointments.
  • Support review of delivery-stage issues, including variations, delay, EOT, LDs, defects, payment disputes, notices, practical completion, handover, commissioning and claims avoidance.
  • Support project teams on contract interpretation and risk management during delivery.
  • Escalate material legal, commercial, delivery, claims, bankability or termination issues to the General Counsel.

Procurement and long-lead equipment

  • Support procurement and vendor contracting for long-lead equipment and OFCI procurement.
  • Review and negotiate MSAs, order forms, supply contracts, supply-and-install contracts, services contracts and vendor terms.
  • Support procurement of generators, chillers, switchgear, electrical equipment, mechanical equipment, spares, fuel and other critical data centre equipment and services.
  • Advise on title and risk transfer, delivery risk, delay remedies, warranties, defects, acceptance, testing, liquidated damages, security, insurance, liability, termination and supplier insolvency risk.
  • Maintain procurement templates, playbooks and fallback positions.

Construction ancillary and financing-related documents

  • Support review of construction ancillary documents, including tripartite deeds, cooperation deeds, insurance policies, performance bonds, parent guarantees, novation agreements, statutory declarations, completion / handover certificates and collateral warranties.
  • Support project finance flow-downs into GC, construction, procurement and operations contracts.
  • Work with the General Counsel and finance team to ensure relevant project documents are financeable and compatible with lender requirements.
  • Track key deliverables needed for financing CPs, such as executed project documents, insurance, bonds, consents, certificates and ancillary documents.

Operations vendor contracts

  • Support operations-stage vendor contracts, including critical equipment maintenance services agreements, operations services agreements, manpower services, MEP scheduled maintenance, managed services, general housekeeping, security services, cleaning services, spare parts supply, fuel supply, customer works, minor works and site services contracts.
  • Advise on service levels, KPIs, service credits, maintenance obligations, renewal / termination, vendor default, access control, safety obligations, incident support and customer-impacting operational issues.
  • Support alignment between operations vendor obligations and customer commitments, SLAs, site rules, security requirements and live-site risk.

Ideal candidate profile: We are looking for a lawyer with:

  • Approximately 8+ years’ PQE, although we are open to strong candidates outside that range.
  • Strong front-end construction, infrastructure, engineering, procurement, projects or development experience.
  • Experience with GC contracts, D&C contracts, EPC contracts, works contracts, services contracts, supply contracts, supply-and-install arrangements, consultant appointments or major procurement contracts.
  • Exposure to construction delivery issues such as variations, EOT, LDs, defects, payment, completion, handover and claims management.
  • Experience in data centres, infrastructure, industrial projects, logistics, real estate development, or major construction projects would be preferred.
  • Familiarity with project finance interface, lender requirements, direct agreements, performance bonds, insurance and bankability would be highly attractive.
  • Ability to support technical, engineering, delivery, procurement and operations teams.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation and contract interpretation skills.
  • Practical commercial judgment and ability to separate legal risk from delivery / commercial risk.
  • Ability to operate independently while escalating material deviations to the General Counsel.

Useful backgrounds to consider: Candidates may come from:

  • Construction / infrastructure / projects teams at major law firms.
  • In-house legal teams at data centre platforms, construction companies, infrastructure developers, industrial platforms, telecoms infrastructure companies, real estate developers or engineering / EPC contractors.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK Infrastructure provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

job.title: Legal Counsel (Real Assets) (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Role purpose

  • This role will be based in Singapore and will support STACK Infrastructure’s APAC business across markets including Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.
  • This role will support STACK Infrastructure APAC on site acquisition, development, power, utilities, transmission, distribution, grid connection and related infrastructure workstreams.
  • The role is intended to provide dedicated legal capability across the land / power interface, which is foundational to data centre development. It will support the business from early-stage site evaluation through due diligence, transaction structuring, acquisition documentation, power procurement, connection arrangements, approvals, and completion.
  • The successful candidate will work closely with the General Counsel, investment and acquisitions team, development team, power / utilities team, finance team, local business teams and external counsel across APAC.

Key responsibilities: The role will cover:

Site acquisition and real estate

  • Review and negotiate NDAs, LOIs, HOAs, term sheets, exclusivity arrangements, option agreements, sale and purchase agreements, contracts of sale, leases, licences and brokerage agreements.
  • Support legal due diligence on title, zoning, land use, easements, access rights, encumbrances, environmental issues, planning constraints, development approvals, utilities access and subdivision / amalgamation issues.
  • Support transaction execution, including CP structure, CP satisfaction, completion / settlement, closing mechanics, funds flow, payment mechanics, completion deliverables and post-closing obligations.
  • Coordinate with external real estate, planning, tax, foreign investment and local counsel.

Power, utilities and grid connection

  • Support power, utility, transmission and distribution workstreams for data centre developments.
  • Review and negotiate electricity design services agreements, substation construction agreements, electricity supply agreements, transmission services agreements, transmission design contracts, transmission works contracts, distribution works contracts and utility connection agreements.
  • Support the business on grid connection, power availability, capacity reservation, energisation milestones, security deposits, connection obligations, termination rights, suspension rights, fees and charges, outage / interruption rights and regulatory interface.
  • Support legal review of land / power interface issues, including easements, cable routes, substation land, access rights, utility corridors, step-in / assignment rights, third-party consents, landlord / utility / government interface.

External counsel and stakeholder management

  • Manage external counsel on local real estate, power / regulatory, foreign investment, tax / structuring, title and land / utility matters.
  • Translate local legal advice into practical commercial decision points for management.
  • Work closely with the General Counsel on escalation of material legal, commercial, regulatory, or execution risk.
  • Build and maintain templates, playbooks, and checklists for site acquisition, power and related real asset workstreams.

Background: Candidates may come from:

job.title: Project Manager – Exhibition Design Execution
job.description:
Responsibilities

1. BOQ Validation & Design-to-Execution Translation

  • Review and validate Bills of Quantities submitted by the exhibition design consultant at each design milestone (from schematic design onward) for completeness, technical accuracy, cost reasonableness and alignment with the approved design intent.
  • Identify discrepancies, scope gaps or ambiguities in BOQs and work with the design consultant to resolve these before procurement is initiated.
  • Build and maintain cost and scope benchmarks for exhibition fit-out, fabrication, AV/media, lighting and specialty finishes to sense-check BOQ submissions against market rates.

2. Procurement Coordination & Partner Onboarding

  • Act as the primary interface between the exhibition design team and internal procurement to convert validated BOQs into clearly scoped procurement packages.
  • Define technical requirements and vendor-qualification criteria for each package (artists, specialty fabricators, AV/technology vendors, content production houses, lighting specialists, etc.) in partnership with internal procurement.
  • Drive identification, evaluation and onboarding of the right partners, leveraging existing relationships with exhibition fit-out, art and specialist production vendors, and proactively scouting new or niche partners where the project calls for novel, first-of-kind execution capability — working jointly with the exhibition design consultant on this search.
  • Support commercial negotiations and contracting in coordination with procurement and legal/commercial teams.

3. Timeline & TAT Management

  • Establish and track turnaround times (TATs) for each vendor/partner package, aligning procurement and fabrication schedules with the overall project master timeline.
  • Proactively flag schedule risks arising from design changes, vendor delays or supply constraints, and drive mitigation plans jointly with the design consultant and procurement.
  • Maintain an integrated exhibition execution schedule, and report progress, risks and decisions required to project leadership.

4. On-ground Execution Supervision

  • Supervise on-site execution of exhibition fit-out, fabrication, installation and commissioning works, ensuring strict adherence to approved designs, specifications and quality standards.
  • Coordinate closely with the exhibition design consultant, execution/fabrication partners and the building construction execution team to sequence exhibition works with ongoing civil and MEP construction.
  • Conduct quality checks and inspections at key milestones, and manage snag/defect closure through to handover.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, statutory and regulatory requirements on site.

5. Stakeholder & Cross-functional Coordination

  • Serve as a key coordination point among the exhibition design consultant, internal procurement, execution partners and the building construction team to ensure integrated, conflict-free delivery.
  • Escalate risks, budget deviations and critical decisions to project leadership in a timely manner.

Prepare periodic status reports/dashboards covering BOQ validation status, procurement progress, partner onboarding, TAT adherence and on-ground execution

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture, Interior/Exhibition Design, Engineering, or a related field; a background in Project Management is an advantage.
  • 10–15 years of experience managing exhibition design and fit-out execution for museums, experience centers, flagship retail, or other large-scale cultural/experiential projects, including at least one project of comparable scale and complexity.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and validating BOQs for exhibition fit-out, fabrication, AV/media and specialty finishes.
  • An established network of, and prior working experience with, exhibition fabricators, artists, AV/technology vendors and specialist content/production houses, with the ability to identify and onboard new partners for novel or first-of-kind requirements.
  • Hands-on experience in vendor/procurement coordination, commercial negotiation and contract management.
  • Proven track record of on-ground supervision of exhibition installation and commissioning, including coordination with civil/construction teams.
  • Strong project management skills, including scheduling, budgeting and risk management.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Technical understanding of exhibition design, fabrication methods, materials, lighting and AV/technology integration.
  • Strong commercial acumen — able to scrutinize BOQs and costs, and negotiate effectively with vendors and partners.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong documentation and reporting discipline.
  • Problem-solving mindset, comfortable operating in a dynamic, evolving project environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple vendor streams simultaneously while maintaining an integrated project schedule.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work seamlessly across design, procurement and construction teams.

job.title: Senior Engineer - Compute, Container & AI Infrastructure
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

At Singtel, your work unlocks BIG Possibilities.

We are building an AI-first telco of the future — connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, digital services and next-generation technology. From everyday consumer experiences across mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services, to enterprise solutions in 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, AI, data centres and digital platforms, we create the infrastructure and experiences that power how people live, work, play and do business.

You will be part of teams shaping intelligent networks, secure digital ecosystems, sovereign AI cloud platforms, sustainable data centres and seamless customer experiences at scale. Together, we combine technology, innovation and human potential to empower every generation to thrive in a more connected, resilient and AI-enabled future.

Be part of something BIG!

As part of our Infrastructure Engineering team, you will design, operate, and enhance Singtel's enterprise AI infrastructure powered by Red Hat OpenShift AI, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps practices. You will play a critical role in enabling container and VM workloads at scale while ensuring platform reliability, performance, security, and automation.

How You Will Make an Impact:

OpenShift Container, Virtualization and RHOAI Platform Engineering

  • Administer and support enterprise Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) environments, including Openshift Virtualization, Containerization and AI variations
  • Manage platform operations including cluster health, node management, networking, storage, monitoring, logging, security, and upgrades.
  • Troubleshoot Kubernetes and OpenShift issues across large clusters, workloads, networking, and authentication layers, as well as Operators necessary to build, develop and operate the platform efficiently and reliably.
  • Support Hosted Control Plane (HyperShift) environments, including HostedCluster and NodePool lifecycle management.
  • Manage multi-cluster OpenShift environments and enterprise integrations such as DNS, identity, storage, certificate management, and security services.
  • Support OpenShift Service Mesh (Istio), OpenShift Virtualization, and other cloud-native platform capabilities.
  • Maintain operational standards, runbooks, and documentation while ensuring SLA compliance.

GitOps, DevOps & Platform Automation

  • Manage and support OpenShift GitOps (Argo CD) for platform and application deployments.
  • Implement GitOps-based deployment and configuration management practices.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines spanning source control, security scanning, container registries, and OpenShift deployments.
  • Manage Helm-based application deployments and lifecycle management.
  • Drive DevSecOps practices including vulnerability scanning, access controls, secrets management, and policy enforcement.
  • Automate platform operations using Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code principles using Ansible scripts, Powershell or Unix Bash scripts as appropriate.
  • Develop reusable deployment templates, standards, and automation frameworks.

Infrastructure & GPU Server Engineering

  • Manage enterprise x86 server infrastructure supporting OpenShift, OpenShift AI, and private cloud platforms.
  • Support NVIDIA GPU servers for AI/ML and accelerated computing workloads.
  • Perform infrastructure lifecycle management including installation, upgrades, firmware updates, capacity planning, health monitoring, maintenance, and hardware replacement.
  • Monitor and optimize server, storage, networking, and GPU performance.
  • Troubleshoot hardware and infrastructure issues across compute, storage, networking, firmware, and GPU layers.
  • Work with vendors on support, maintenance, and infrastructure refresh initiatives.
  • Support data center operations and future infrastructure expansion projects.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, or enterprise IT environments.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience managing Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform in production environments.
  • Strong background in running Kubernetes, container technologies, Linux/RHEL, and cloud-native infrastructure at scale, with a proven track record being able to troubleshoot complex container and infrastructure issues.
  • Experience with platform operations, troubleshooting, patching, upgrades, automation, and capacity planning.
  • Experience with enterprise DevOps, GitOps, CI/CD, and service management practices.
  • Hands-on experience supporting x86 servers and NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.
  • Good understanding of AI/ML workloads and concepts, including model serving, inferencing, MIG, RAG.

Technical Expertise

  • Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) and RedHat Openshift Virtualization
  • Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI)
  • Kubernetes and container technologies
  • OpenShift GitOps / Argo CD
  • NVIDIA GPU Operator and GPU-accelerated workloads
  • NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG)
  • OpenShift Networking, Security, RBAC, and Storage
  • Linux / RHEL administration and troubleshooting
  • Bare metal server and storage design, build and operations.
  • Automation using Ansible, Python, Bash, or similar technologies
  • Monitoring, logging, observability, and platform performance management

Nice to Have

job.title: Production Scheduling Coordinator - Level II
job.description:
Position Summary

The Controls Engineer (Electrical & Electronic Maintenance) & LOTO Leader is responsible for developing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing electrical, electronic, controls, and automation systems across manufacturing operations. The role provides technical expertise for PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, drives, robotics, sensors, and automated equipment to support safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing.

In addition, this role serves as the plant Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Leader and Subject Matter Expert (SME), responsible for governing hazardous energy control programs, ensuring machine safety compliance, conducting audits and risk assessments, and promoting a proactive, zero-incident safety culture.

The role also provides technical leadership, coaches and mentors less experienced Controls Engineers and maintenance personnel, and drives continuous improvement across manufacturing processes and equipment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Electrical, Electronics & Controls Engineering

  • Provide expert technical support and troubleshooting for PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, servo/VFD drives, sensors, robotics, and automated manufacturing equipment.
  • Diagnose complex electrical, electronic, and controls-related machine breakdowns and implement effective containment and permanent corrective actions.
  • Develop, modify, and maintain control systems, machine programs, electrical schematics, software, calibration files, and program version revisions.
  • Support the installation, commissioning, and technical support of PLC-based hardware and software.
  • Develop and implement bench tests and modify software and equipment to ensure sensors, actuators, and control systems function according to specifications.
  • Support and debug complex technical problems, engineering changes, and change requests.
  • Partner with production, maintenance, engineering, and cross-functional teams to support automated machining, assembly, and testing operations.

2. Equipment Reliability & Manufacturing Automation

  • Support Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), preventive maintenance, and predictive maintenance activities for electrical and control systems.
  • Analyze downtime, MTBF, MTTR, and Pareto trends to identify recurring equipment and automation failures.
  • Implement hardware, software, and logic modifications to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), cycle time, equipment availability, and reliability.
  • Implement automation improvements using available technologies, programming techniques, and appropriate materials and resources.
  • Develop and implement solutions to improve machine utilization and overall manufacturing performance.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.

3. LOTO & Hazardous Energy Control

  • Serve as the plant Champion and Subject Matter Expert for Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and hazardous energy control.
  • Develop, review, update, and validate Machine-Specific Energy Control Procedures for new, modified, and existing manufacturing equipment.
  • Lead hazardous energy risk assessments and safety reviews for equipment modifications, installations, commissioning, and maintenance activities.
  • Conduct periodic LOTO inspections, field compliance audits, and competency evaluations for authorized and affected personnel.
  • Conduct qualification and training programs for authorized LOTO employees and contractors.
  • Promote proactive safety behaviors, risk identification, reporting, and compliance with EHS standards.

4. Machine Safety, Audits & Incident Investigation

  • Verify and maintain machine safety systems including safety PLCs, interlocks, light curtains, emergency stops, and guarding systems.
  • Identify electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls-related hazards and ensure appropriate safe work practices are incorporated into daily activities.
  • Lead or participate in electrical and machine safety incident and near-miss investigations using structured root cause analysis methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa, and other RCA tools.
  • Participate in internal, external, ISO 45001, and ISO 14001 audits and support compliance with applicable electrical, machine safety, and corporate HSE requirements.
  • Champion a safe and injury-free manufacturing environment through proactive identification and mitigation of hazards.

5. Controls Engineering, Projects & Governance

  • Develop and design control systems and support new equipment installations, upgrades, and manufacturing projects.
  • Specify, review, and approve company-owned or supplier-provided controls designs for new equipment and upgrades to existing equipment.
  • Investigate project requirements and develop technical solutions considering cost, resources, personnel, safety, and environmental requirements.
  • Prepare cost estimates and compile equipment and technical information required for appropriation requests.
  • Support controls system security by reviewing and implementing appropriate security requirements for manufacturing controls and systems.
  • Manage critical electrical and automation spare parts to minimize equipment downtime and operational risks.

6. Training, Coaching & Collaboration

  • Develop and deliver technical training for maintenance and engineering teams on electrical troubleshooting, controls systems, schematic interpretation, and safe diagnostic practices.
  • Coach and mentor less experienced Controls Engineers and technical personnel.
  • Build effective partnerships with production, maintenance, engineering, EHS, suppliers, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Communicate technical information effectively to different audiences and maintain technical continuity across shifts.
  • Promote collaboration, inclusion, and the value of diverse perspectives within the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or a related STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Relevant experience in electrical, electronic, controls engineering, automation, and manufacturing maintenance.
  • Experience in an automated manufacturing, industrial, or automotive environment is preferred.
  • Experience in a technical leadership or LOTO leadership role, with demonstrated responsibility for hazardous energy control and safety compliance.
  • This position may require applicable licensing or authorization for compliance with export control or sanctions regulations.

Core Competencies

  • Collaborates – Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  • Communicates Effectively – Delivers clear and effective communication based on the needs of different audiences.
  • Health & Safety Fundamentals – Champions proactive health and safety behaviors and contributes to a safe and injury-free workplace.
  • Controls Engineering Knowledge – Applies controls hardware and software expertise to manufacturing systems and equipment.
  • Controls Networking – Implements technologies and methods to connect machines and manufacturing systems.
  • Controls Safety – Identifies controls-related hazards and incorporates safe practices into manufacturing activities.
  • Controls System Security – Supports the security of manufacturing controls and systems.
  • Electrical System Troubleshooting – Analyzes and resolves electrical control system issues.
  • Factory Automation & Control Systems – Implements automation and controls solutions to improve manufacturing processes.
  • Sensor Technology & Measurement – Applies sensor technologies and measurement techniques to support manufacturing and quality requirements.
  • Machine Programming – Develops and implements machine programs to improve equipment utilization and performance.
  • Manufacturing Knowledge – Applies manufacturing knowledge to equipment, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Values Differences – Recognizes and values different perspectives and cultures.

Skills & Experience

Controls & Automation

  • Strong knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, industrial communication networks, motor controls, servo/VFD drives, robotics, sensors, actuators, and safety circuits.
  • Hands-on experience with machine programming, controls hardware and software, and factory automation systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex electrical and controls systems and restore equipment to proper operating conditions.
  • Knowledge of controls networking and technologies used to connect machines and manufacturing systems for process optimization.
  • Understanding of sensor technology, measurement systems, and data interpretation for manufacturing and quality applications.

Electrical & Machine Safety

  • Strong understanding of electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls-related hazards in manufacturing environments.
  • Knowledge of machine safety systems, risk assessment methodologies, hazardous energy control, and LOTO requirements.
  • Ability to conduct safety reviews, audits, and compliance assessments and implement appropriate corrective actions.

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Strong structured problem-solving and root cause analysis skills, including 5 Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa, and other RCA methodologies.
  • Experience using Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, and continuous improvement techniques.
  • Ability to analyze equipment performance, downtime, MTBF, MTTR, and OEE data to identify improvement opportunities.

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders.
  • Ability to train, coach, and mentor technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and provide effective support during equipment breakdowns, projects, and process changes.
  • Demonstrates proactive health and safety behaviors and contributes to an injury-free workplace.
  • Demonstrates the ability to work effectively with diverse teams and value different perspectives.

job.title: Startup Account Manager - Greenfield, India Startups Team
job.description:
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all. We give founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With nearly two decades of experience, gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups, the AWS Startups team helps founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth, and any level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, choose to launch on AWS.

AWS continues to rapidly grow and we seek a Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth with well-funded and high-potential startups. In this fast-moving business, the core responsibility is to ensure that new and high-potential startups choose AWS as their cloud platform to transform and accelerate their business. We work backwards from the customer and partner with technical team members, business development, and stakeholders to lead scaled Go-to-Market strategies, accelerate adoption and drive customer success.

The ideal candidate has a passion to work with innovators and new technologies, has a strong sales background, and has the technical aptitude to learn and discuss the latest technologies, such as generative AI, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data services, and sustainable computing. This is a fast-paced role. We work at the speed of startup founders, are able to engage personas from developers to technical founders and CXOs. You will work along side Solution Architects and Product Specialists, Inside Sales, Business Development, and technology and services partners. You will be a self-starter, travel for in-person meetings, and attend events. You will develop and execute against a territory coverage plan and consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets and measurable business objectives.

Key job responsibilities

  • Ensure customer success with early and mid stage startups
  • Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
  • Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy
  • Meet or exceed quarterly revenue and goal targets.
  • Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
  • Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.
  • Accelerate customer adoption by engaging Founders, CxO, Board of Directors and VC influencers
  • Work with partners to extend reach & drive adoption.
  • Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.
  • Expect moderate travel.

About the team About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 7+ years of technology sales experience
  • Experience working within a high-growth, technology company
  • Experience selling cloud/AI solutions to Startups

Preferred Qualifications

  • Indepth understanding on Startup & VC Ecosystem in India
  • Startup Founder/ Startup operating experience in business development, venture capital, or in leadership roles
  • Extensive skills in leveraging tools and technology to increase efficiency in your day-to-day activities
  • Demonstrated ability to own projects and events from design to execution

job.title: Sr Partner Solutions Architect
