job.title: Sr: Migrations & Modernization SA, ASEAN
job.description:
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Migration and Modernization Solutions Architect to join our ASEAN team, based in Singapore. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise migration & transformation, modern cloud architecture, and the rapidly evolving world of AI-driven workload modernization.

As a senior member of the ASEAN Migrations and Modernization SA team, you will lead enterprise customers through the full spectrum of transformation — from migrating legacy estates to AWS, to modernizing applications and architectures to become AI-ready, and ultimately enabling agentic AI deployments that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will advise on both dimensions of AI-era modernization: using AI to accelerate and automate migration and modernization programs at scale, and modernizing architectures so they are structurally capable of running and benefiting from AI and Agentic AI workloads.

You will work across the breadth of enterprise legacy environments - monolithic applications, commercial databases, VMware estates, and aging on-premises infrastructure — defining transformation pathways that are technically sound, commercially viable, and aligned to each customer's AI ambitions. You will collaborate closely with Migration and Modernization business development teams, partner development managers, and customer solution managers to drive revenue through successful migrations and modernizations across the region.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on architecture experience with a genuine passion for the emerging AI and agentic AI landscape. They understand that every modernization decision today is an AI enablement decision — and they are able to articulate this clearly to both technical and executive audiences. Strong judgment, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to operate effectively across diverse enterprise cultures in ASEAN are essential to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities Migration Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end cloud migration strategies for enterprise customers across ASEAN with hands-on technical depth — covering infrastructure, applications, databases, mainframes, and legacy on-premises estates — evaluating both technical feasibility and commercial viability of each program to drive successful outcomes on AWS.
  • Build repeatable migration mechanisms, reference architectures, playbooks, and toolkits that systematically reduce time, cost, risk, and complexity for future engagements across the region.
  • Drive deep adoption of AWS-native migration tooling — including AWS Transform (ATX), cloud assessment platforms, and agentic discovery tools including ISV tools — with the technical credibility to guide customers through real implementation challenges, compressing migration timelines from months to wee.
  • Work with customers navigating complex multi-tower transformations: legacy application modernization, commercial software-to-open-source transitions, VMware exits, and large-scale data center consolidations.

Modernization and AI-Ready Architecture

  • Design and deliver modernization architectures that move customers from monolithic, tightly coupled systems to decoupled, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures that are structurally ready for AI and Agentic AI workloads.
  • Advise customers on the right modernization pathway for each workload — rehosting, replatforming, re-architecting, containerization, open-source migration, or managed database adoption — based on business value, complexity, and AI readiness impact.
  • Articulate why every modernization decision is an AI enablement decision — helping customers understand that architecture choices made today directly determine what AI capabilities they can unlock tomorrow.
  • Guide customers in building agentic-ready foundations: decoupled services, clean API and MCP interfaces, isolated data domains, independent deployment pipelines, and observable systems that support reliable autonomous AI agent operation.
  • Identify and address AI-on-legacy failure patterns — context overload, hallucination risk, cascading failures, and latency amplification — that emerge when Agentic AI is deployed on unmodernized infrastructure, and define the modernization path that resolves them.

AI-Driven Modernization Delivery

  • Champion the use of AI-powered tooling to execute migration and modernization programs — leveraging AWS Transform (ATX) for code transformation, automated dependency analysis, containerization, and continuous modernization at scale.
  • Apply agentic assessment capabilities — including AI-driven discovery, automated portfolio analysis, and intelligent workload classification — to significantly compress the assessment and planning phases of enterprise transformation programs.
  • Lead adoption of emerging standards and tooling in the agentic ecosystem — MCP, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, multi-agent orchestration patterns, and the Strands Agents SDK — as practical technical foundations for customer AI transformation programs.
  • Help customers build and validate their Agentic AI Readiness posture, assessing current architecture across agent platform maturity, data and knowledge infrastructure, and operational governance.

Customer Engagement and Technical Advisory

  • Customer Engagement and Technical Advisory
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with CTO, CIO, and enterprise architect stakeholders — credible on both migration strategy and AI transformation roadmap.
  • Lead hands-on discovery workshops, accelerator deliveries, architecture envisioning sessions, and multi-day modernization assessments; translate findings into prioritized transformation roadmaps with clear risk profiles and milestones.
  • Articulate ROI, TCO, and business value to executive audiences; connect modernization investment directly to AI capability and competitive agility outcomes.
  • Drive POCs through to completion and use outcomes to de-risk and accelerate broader program commitments.

Community, Enablement and Thought Leadership

job.title: Technical Sales Engineer - Data Centres
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Technical Sales Engineer – Data Centre Thermal Solutions. This role serves as the primary technical interface between Johnson Controls and key Data Centre customers across the Pacific region, with a specific focus on chilled water plants, precision cooling, and advanced thermal management solutions.

The TAM provides deep technical leadership across chiller systems, liquid cooling, and thermal plant architectures, while also taking ownership of technical pricing strategy and bid development for complex opportunities. This ensures solutions are not only technically robust but also commercially competitive and aligned with customer value expectations.

A core element of the role is supporting the Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to drive commercial growth. The TAM brings thermal engineering expertise, early-stage cooling design influence, and bid/pricing leadership that strengthens Johnson Controls’ commercial strategies and opens new business opportunities.

Operating within a matrixed organisation, the TAM aligns technical, commercial, and delivery stakeholders to ensure chiller and cooling plant solutions are positioned, designed, priced, and delivered to win in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

Trusted Technical Advisor – Thermal Systems

  • Act as the trusted advisor for data centre cooling and thermal plant solutions, with a focus on chillers, CRAH/CRAC, and liquid cooling
  • Provide guidance on cooling strategies for hyperscale and high-density environments
  • Support customers in achieving resilience, redundancy, and energy efficiency targets

​

Solution Design & Architecture Governance

  • Lead the design of chilled water systems and central plant architecture
  • Develop integrated solutions covering chillers, pumps, heat rejection, and BMS integration
  • Own system performance, efficiency (PUE), and lifecycle optimisation
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks across capacity, redundancy, and control strategies

​

Early Engagement & Cooling Design Influence

  • Influence cooling plant design, chiller selection, and system architecture at pre-RFP stage
  • Lead Johnson Controls’ contribution to Basis of Design (BoD)
  • Position high-efficiency and next-gen cooling technologies within project designs

​

Pricing, Bid Management & Commercial Ownership

  • Own the technical pricing strategy for thermal solutions, including chilled water plants and liquid cooling systems
  • Lead and coordinate end-to-end bid development, ensuring alignment between engineering, procurement, and commercial teams
  • Develop accurate cost models, equipment selections, and solution configurations that balance performance, risk, and competitiveness
  • Drive value engineering to optimise cost while maintaining technical integrity and customer requirements
  • Ensure proposals clearly articulate total cost of ownership, energy efficiency savings, and lifecycle value
  • Support commercial negotiations by providing technical justification for scope, pricing, and solution differentiation
  • Maintain governance over bid quality, margin integrity, and risk management across all submissions

​

Opportunity & Technical Sales Support

  • Partner with SAMs on major pursuits from early-stage through award
  • Develop compelling technical and commercial value propositions
  • Support high-quality proposals with cooling system design, narratives, and performance insights

​

Market & Domain Expertise – Cooling

  • Maintain deep expertise in:Chillers (air & water-cooled)
  • Free cooling and heat rejection
  • Liquid cooling (direct-to-chip, immersion)

Stay current with AI-driven high-density cooling demands and sustainability trends​

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align engineering, product, supply chain, and delivery teams
  • Support seamless handover ensuring clarity on thermal system design and performance expectations

​

Pipeline & Technical Governance

  • Build and qualify pipeline focused on cooling infrastructure opportunities
  • Ensure technical and commercial accuracy in CRM, pricing tools, and proposals
  • Maintain compliance with Johnson Controls governance standards

​

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferred) or related discipline
  • 10+ years’ experience in HVAC/chiller systems and thermal plant solutions, ideally within data centres
  • Demonstrated experience in technical sales, bid management, and pricing of complex engineered solutions
  • Strong expertise in:Chilled water systems and central plant design
  • Chiller selection and optimisation
  • Cooling strategies for high-density environments

Proven ability to develop competitive, technically sound, and commercially viable bidsExperience in cost modelling, value engineering, and margin managementStrong understanding of BMS/controls integration for thermal optimisationAbility to influence consultants and customers at early design stagesExperience operating in matrix organisations across global stakeholdersStrong communication skills translating technical solutions into commercial valueHigh discipline in CRM and pipeline management (Salesforce preferred)Self-driven, resilient, and effective in large, complex pursuit environments If you are interested in this role, please click the Apply now button.

JCI’s Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. job.title: Engineering Manager (Java, .NET, Kafka, Angular): Building Management & Controls
job.description:
Location: Pune, India

Reports to: Senior Engineering Manager Team size: 5-6 direct reports; 15-20 indirect (via leads/senior engineers) Employment type: Full-time Experience: 10+ years total

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead a team building software for building management and controls, including platforms that connect, monitor, and optimize HVAC, energy, lighting, and other building systems. You'll manage 5-6 direct reports and provide technical and delivery leadership across a broader group of 15-20 engineers, using Java, .NET, Kafka, and Angular. You'll partner with Product, Architecture, QA, and Embedded/Controls teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and grow direct reports (leads and senior engineers) and extend your influence to the wider 15-20 member team through them
  • Hire, onboard, and retain strong talent, and build a high-trust, high-performance culture in the Pune team
  • Own end-to-end delivery: roadmap planning, sprint execution, risk management, and dependency management across teams
  • Guide architecture and design across Java and .NET services, Kafka-based event streaming, and Angular front ends
  • Oversee design and operation of Kafka pipelines handling telemetry and events from building devices and controllers (topic design, partitioning, schema management, consumer lag, fault tolerance)
  • Drive integration with building automation protocols and systems (e.g., BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, OPC UA) and IoT/edge gateways
  • Ensure quality, reliability, and security for systems that interact with physical infrastructure, including alarms, scheduling, and device commissioning workflows
  • Champion engineering best practices: code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and secure coding
  • Manage technical debt, modernization, and migrations (e.g., legacy .NET to modern .NET, monolith to microservices)
  • Work with global stakeholders and distributed teams, aligning priorities across time zones
  • Report on delivery, team health, and engineering metrics to the Senior Engineering Manager and leadership

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 10+ years of total software engineering experience, with 3+ years managing engineers or leading teams
  • Experience managing or leading a team of 15-20 engineers, including through leads/managers
  • Strong hands-on background in Java (Spring / Spring Boot) and .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core)
  • Solid experience with Apache Kafka (event-driven architecture, stream processing, Kafka Connect, Schema Registry)
  • Working knowledge of Angular and modern front-end practices (TypeScript, RxJS)
  • Experience designing microservices, REST APIs, and distributed systems
  • Domain experience in building management systems (BMS/BAS), building controls, or IoT/industrial automation
  • Proven record of delivering complex projects with cross-functional and globally distributed teams
  • Strong coaching, performance management, and stakeholder communication skills

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of building protocols (BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC UA) and HVAC/energy management concepts
  • Experience with time-series data, telemetry platforms, and analytics/fault detection
  • Cloud experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP), Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases and time-series stores (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, InfluxDB, TimescaleDB)
  • Understanding of cybersecurity standards for OT/IoT environments (e.g., IEC 62443)
  • Experience with edge computing or firmware/controls team collaboration
  • Agile/Scrum experience at scale

job.title: Executive, Client Experience (Catapult)
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across 270 cities in 45 countries.

Job Description

Catapult by CapitaLand is Singapore's premier executive education and leadership development campus. More than a venue, Catapult brings together corporates, learning providers, industry partners and business leaders through executive programmes, leadership offsites, conferences, corporate events and networking experiences. Located within Rochester Commons, Catapult provides a purpose-built environment designed to support collaboration, innovation, learning and business transformation.

We are looking for a hands-on and service-oriented executive to support clients in delivering successful meetings, conferences, executive programmes and corporate events at Catapult.

The Role

The Executive, Client Experience (Catapult), plays an important role in ensuring a seamless experience for clients, participants and guests from pre-event planning through on-site support and post-event follow-up.

Reporting to the Director, Sales & Business Development, the successful candidate will work closely with clients, vendors and internal stakeholders to coordinate venue requirements, operational arrangements and service delivery, ensuring clients have the support they need to execute successful events at Catapult.

This is a highly operational and execution-focused role suited for someone who enjoys engaging clients, managing multiple projects concurrently, solving issues proactively and delivering exceptional service experiences. The successful candidate will contribute directly to client satisfaction, repeat business and Catapult's reputation as a premier destination for executive learning and corporate engagement.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Experience & Event Support

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients following booking confirmation.
  • Coordinate client requirements and event needs from planning through completion.
  • Conduct venue walkthroughs, planning meetings and pre-event briefings with clients.
  • Provide guidance on venue capabilities, facilities, processes and available service offerings.
  • Ensure client requirements are accurately documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
  • Build positive client relationships and deliver a high standard of customer service throughout the client journey.
  • Anticipate client needs and proactively address issues to ensure a seamless experience.
  • As events may be scheduled outside normal business hours, the role requires flexibility to support evening, weekend and public holiday event operations when required.

2. Venue & Operational Coordination

  • Coordinate venue preparations and operational arrangements to support client events.
  • Liaise with internal teams and service partners on room setup, catering, AV requirements, access arrangements, signage and logistics.
  • Prepare event orders, operational briefs, schedules and run sheets.
  • Ensure event spaces and facilities are ready and aligned with client requirements.
  • Monitor event-day operations and coordinate prompt resolution of operational issues.
  • Provide onsite support to clients and serve as the key liaison throughout their event.
  • Ensure service delivery standards are consistently maintained across all events and programmes.

3. Participant & Guest Experience

  • Coordinate guest arrivals, reception services and VIP support arrangements.
  • Ensure participants and guests experience a welcoming and professional environment.
  • Attend to enquiries, requests and feedback promptly and professionally.
  • Support the collection of client and participant feedback following programmes and events.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance the overall client and guest experience.

4. Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination

  • Work closely with Sales & Business Development and Marketing & Partnerships teams to ensure smooth delivery of client engagements.
  • Coordinate with external vendors, service providers and contractors to fulfil event requirements.
  • Monitor vendor performance and escalate service issues where necessary.
  • Support procurement, purchase requisitions and administrative processes where required.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders and service partners.

5. Administration & Reporting

  • Maintain event schedules, client records and operational trackers.
  • Prepare event documentation, reports and post-event summaries where required.
  • Track client feedback, service recovery actions and improvement opportunities.
  • Support invoicing, billing coordination and administrative follow-up activities.
  • Ensure records and databases are updated accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Hospitality, Events Management, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
  • 1-3 years of experience in client service, hospitality, events, customer success or related roles.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications
  • Experience with CRM, event management or venue booking systems would be advantageous.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities concurrently.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-focused with a proactive, positive and service-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

To succeed in this role, you will ideally:

  • Enjoy engaging clients, guests and stakeholders from diverse industries.
  • Be highly organised and responsive, with strong follow-through on commitments.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Remain calm and adaptable in a dynamic operating environment.
  • Take ownership of client requests and work proactively to resolve issues.
  • Be passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences and service excellence.
  • Thrive in a hands-on role where operational execution and customer satisfaction are key measures of success.

job.title: Senior Tax Analyst- Asia
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Role Summary

Reporting to the General Manger - Tax, the Senior Tax Analyst will play a key role in supporting the Group's tax function across the Asia Pacific region. The role is responsible for managing tax compliance and reporting obligations, supporting transfer pricing and tax accounting activities, driving tax technology initiatives, and providing practical tax advice to business stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced tax professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced, high-growth, multinational environment and wants to contribute to building a best-practice tax function across multiple jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tax Compliance & Reporting – Manage direct and indirect tax compliance obligations for Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia entities, including review of tax returns, payment calculations, forecasts, and deferred tax calculations. Provide technical analysis in support of statutory audits. Oversee and coordinate tax compliance activities outsourced to external service providers.
  • Tax Technology – Drive the implementation and adoption of tax technology solutions to improve efficiency and accuracy
  • Transfer Pricing – Ensure transfer pricing obligations (e.g., documentation, filings) are met under local laws and regulations
  • Tax Accounting – Support quarterly tax accounting and reporting, including calculation and tracking of transfer pricing corrections and Uncertain Tax Positions
  • Tax Audits – Manage and support tax audits across the region, liaising with tax authorities and advisors as needed
  • Business Advisory – Partner with the General Manager, Tax to advise business teams on tax implications and opportunities
  • Stakeholder Engagement – Build strong relationships with regional business, finance, legal, and policy leaders to proactively share tax insights and information

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Commerce, Law, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in corporate tax, international tax, transfer pricing, or tax advisory.
  • Experience working in a multinational corporate environment and/or a Big 4 accounting firm.
  • Strong understanding of APAC tax compliance and reporting requirements.
  • Experience managing external tax advisers and compliance providers.
  • Knowledge of tax accounting principles and transfer pricing concepts.
  • Experience using ERP systems and tax technology solutions.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience supporting tax audits and tax authority reviews.
  • Familiarity with tax automation, reporting tools, and data analytics platforms.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Singapore
  • Reporting to General Manager, Tax

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

We are part of the Global transportation team who manages the full lifecycle of transportation operations, ensuring reliable, secure, and sustainable movement of goods. This team manages the end-to-end transportation across 13 APAC countries, Including over 100 suppliers and 6 contract manufacturers through multimodal transport network including air, road, ocean Full Container Load/Less than Container Load (FCL/LCL), and sea-air solutions. We run the daily execution of all transportation activities for IN and OUT of APAC region. We ensure on-time delivery and we manage disruptions to protect regional supply chain velocity and performance.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. job.title: Director, CSAME Segment FP&A
job.description:
About This Role

Reporting to the VP, CSAME Finance, the FP&A Director is a senior finance leader responsible for shaping financial strategy, enabling data-driven decisions, and driving sustainable performance across Climate Solutions Asia Pacific, Middle East and Africa (CSAME).

The role leads long-range planning, annual operating plans, forecasting, performance management, and monthly and quarterly business reviews, while serving as a trusted partner to regional business and finance leaders.

The Director will strengthen FP&A capabilities, improve planning disciplines and insights, and build an effective, high-performing organization across a complex, multi-country matrix.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic planning: Lead the regional FP&A agenda, including long-range planning, annual operating plans, quarterly forecasts, scenario modeling, and target setting aligned with CSAME strategic priorities.
  • Performance management: Own monthly and quarterly business-review processes, delivering clear analysis of results, key drivers, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
  • Business partnership: Serve as a trusted finance partner to regional and business leaders, providing independent challenge, commercial insight, and decision support to drive profitable growth, cash generation, and productivity.
  • Decision support: Translate complex financial and operational data into concise, forward-looking insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Risk and opportunity management: Establish rigorous mechanisms to identify, quantify, track, and mitigate financial risks while accelerating actions to capture upside opportunities.
  • FP&A transformation: Partner with the broader Carrier FP&A organization to simplify and standardize processes, strengthen governance, improve forecast accuracy, and advance automation, analytics, and centralization where appropriate.
  • Financial governance: Ensure planning, reporting, and performance-management activities are timely, accurate, well controlled, and consistent with company policies and leadership expectations.
  • Organizational leadership: Build and lead a high-performing regional FP&A organization, including implementation of the FP&A Center of Excellence model, capability development, succession planning, and timely performance feedback.
  • Enterprise leadership: Model strong collaboration across businesses, functions, and geographies, and undertake other responsibilities aligned with the scope and seniority of the position.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline; MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
  • Typically 12 or more years of progressive finance experience, including significant leadership responsibility in FP&A within a large, complex, global organization.
  • Demonstrated success leading long-range planning, annual operating plans, forecasting, management reporting, and executive business reviews.
  • Strong commercial and operational acumen, with the ability to connect financial performance to business drivers and influence resource-allocation decisions.
  • Proven experience operating across multiple countries and cultures and leading effectively in a highly matrixed environment.
  • Track record of driving FP&A transformation, process standardization, digital enablement, productivity, integration, or operational-improvement initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capability, with the judgment to synthesize complex information into clear insights, choices, and actions.
  • Advanced financial-modeling and data-analysis skills; experience with enterprise planning, ERP, business-intelligence, and reporting platforms preferred.
  • Strong executive presence and communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to constructively challenge and influence at all levels.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, including building diverse teams, developing talent, managing performance, and fostering an inclusive, accountable culture.

Success Measures

  • Accurate, timely, and insightful plans, forecasts, and business reviews that improve management decisions and accountability.
  • Improved forecast accuracy and early visibility of risks and opportunities, supported by clear actions and ownership.
  • Achievement of regional financial commitments, including growth, profitability, cash flow, and productivity objectives.
  • Effective strategic partnership with business leaders, reflected in the quality, speed, and commercial impact of finance support.
  • Sustained simplification, standardization, and automation of FP&A processes, with strong governance and timely reporting.
  • A high-performing, engaged FP&A team with stronger capabilities, clear succession plans, and effective talent development.

Location : Bangalore Position : FullTime

**About Carrier

**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role:**

The Remote Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for remote commissioning, validation, integration, and troubleshooting of Building Management Systems (BMS) and HVAC control systems. The role requires deep technical understanding of Niagara Framework, control logic, field devices, and building equipment, with the ability to diagnose system-level issues and optimize performance remotely

Key Technical Responsibilities :

Perform remote commissioning of BMS and HVAC control systems using Niagara N4, NexRev, and Novar platforms.

Validate controller configurations, control logic, point databases, graphics, alarms, schedules, and trends.

Commission and verify field devices such as sensors, actuators, VFDs, dampers, valves, meters, and controllers.

Monitor and analyze live system data, alarms, trends, and logs to identify functional and performance issues.

Troubleshoot control logic, network communication, and application-level issues across BMS subsystems.

Diagnose integration issues across BACnet, Modbus, LON, and IP-based protocols.

Provide technical support through calls, emails, and remote sessions for live customer issues.

Support testing of HVAC systems including AHU, RTU, Heat Pump, VAV and lighting systems.

Coordinate remotely with site teams, commissioning agents, and internal engineering teams.

Prepare detailed commissioning reports, as-built documentation, and technical advisory notes.

Track commissioning issues, punch points, and action items to closure using project trackers.

Provide post-commissioning support and assist during system handover and stabilization phases.

Support critical commissioning and troubleshooting activities outside normal business hours when required.

Minimum Requirements

Strong hands-on knowledge of Niagara Framework (N4) including station setup, backups, restores, and upgrades.

In-depth understanding of BMS architecture, controllers, and supervisory systems.

Strong expertise in HVAC control sequences and building equipment operation.

Ability to troubleshoot application, controller, and network-level issues.

Knowledge of electrical and mechanical fundamentals related to HVAC and building automation.

Experience in BMS integrations and third-party device communication.

Ability to interpret control drawings, wiring diagrams, and functional descriptions.

Strong verbal and written communication skills for technical discussions with Technicians and stakeholders.

job.description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a candidate with strong expertise in X++ development, D365 F&O technical architecture, and integration strategies. The successful candidate will confidently engage in technical discussions, implementation strategies and D365 F&O template creations, ensuring seamless implementation, integrations and optimized performance, while mentoring engineers and guiding teams toward delivery excellence.

This role includes the design, development, and support of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) solutions. You will be involved in core development work, SSRS, Power BI & MS Fabric report building, platform upgrades, and supporting code deployments across multiple environments.

What You Will Do

Technical Delivery & Development

  • Deliver Dynamics 365 F&O implementations, upgrades, integrations, and customizations.
  • Own and drive X++ development, customizations, and extensions using best practices.
  • Perform customization and extension development using X++, Visual Studio, and the D365 Extension framework.
  • Ensure adherence to Microsoft D365 standards, extensibility framework, and upgrade‑safe customizations.
  • Review and optimize code for performance, scalability, and compliance with technical guidelines.

Integration Engineering

  • Design and implement integrations with third‑party systems using:
  • OData
  • REST / SOAP APIs

AIF / DMF

  • Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory
  • Dual Write
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate with functional consultants and project teams to align integration solutions with business needs.

Data Management, Security & Performance

  • Support data migration strategies and execution using DMF / Data Management Framework, acting as the primary technical SPOC.
  • Configure and manage security roles & privileges, workflows, batch jobs, and performance tuning.
  • Review technical designs, code, and deployment strategies to ensure compliance with best practices and security standards.

Technical Assets & Automation

  • Develop reusable templates, frameworks, and accelerators to standardize solution delivery.
  • Drive automation initiatives using Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and AI‑driven workflows.
  • Prepare TDD based on the FDD and requirements.
  • Prepare python code to perform testing automations.
  • Develop Technical Design Documents (TDDs) based on Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and business requirements, ensuring clarity and alignment between functional needs and technical solutions.
  • Build and maintain Python scripts to automate testing processes, improving efficiency, accuracy, and repeatability across development and deployment cycles

DevOps & Environment Management

  • Apply strong knowledge of DevOps pipelines, CI/CD, D365 templates, and environment management for F&O projects.
  • Manage build, release, and deployment activities across environments.
  • Oversee version control and branching strategies to ensure upgrade‑safe delivery.
  • Manage version control and code merges using GitHub repositories, ensuring proper branching strategies, conflict resolution, and upgrade‑safe delivery across environments.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Confidently engage in technical discussions, implementation strategies, and template creation.
  • Provide technical guidance to peers and junior developers to ensure delivery excellence.
  • Participate in workshops, demos, and discussions with finance, supply chain, IT, and dealer stakeholders.

Continuous Learning & Improvement

  • Stay current with Microsoft technologies, Azure services, and industry trends to inform technical decisions.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, DevOps, and solution governance.

What You Will Have

Technical Expertise

  • Deep hands‑on experience with Dynamics 365 F&O modules (Finance, Supply Chain, Project Operations).
  • Expert‑level knowledge of X++ development, SSRS reporting, and D365 F&O layered architecture.
  • Strong understanding of customization, configuration, and upgrade‑safe extensions.
  • Skilled in performance tuning, workflows, batch jobs, and security role configuration.

Tools & Frameworks

  • Proficiency in Visual Studio, D365 Extension framework, and developer workbench tools.
  • Skilled in integration strategies using OData, REST/SOAP APIs, AIF/DMF, and Azure services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory).
  • Experience with Common Data Services (Dual Write) for integration with Dynamics 365 Sales, Field Service, and Project Operations.
  • Knowledge of SQL Server Management Studio, DMF tools, and ETL techniques for data migration.
  • Hands‑on experience with Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and AI‑driven workflows for automation.

DevOps & Environment Management

  • Expertise in Azure DevOps: Git, pipelines, CI/CD, release management, and test plans.
  • Skilled in environment management, version control (GITHUB), and branching strategies.
  • Experience managing build, release, and deployment activities across Dev/UAT/Prod environments.
  • Familiarity with Lifecycle Services (LCS) and Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC).

Considerations for Top Candidates

  • Advanced Debugging Skills – Ability to troubleshoot complex X++ code issues, identify root causes, and implement optimized fixes without impacting upgrade safety.
  • Database Proficiency – Strong knowledge of SQL Server, indexing strategies, query optimization, and handling large transactional datasets within D365 F&O.
  • Testing Automation – Experience building automated test scripts (e.g., using Python or other frameworks) to validate customizations, integrations, and performance benchmarks.
  • API Development & Management – Skilled in designing custom APIs, managing authentication/authorization flows, and ensuring secure data exchange between F&O and external systems.
  • Performance Engineering – Hands‑on expertise in profiling system performance, tuning batch jobs, and optimizing heavy workloads in production environments.
  • Upgrade & Hotfix Readiness – Ability to assess Microsoft cumulative updates, apply hotfixes, and validate compatibility of customizations during platform upgrades.
  • Cross‑Module Technical Depth – Practical exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, and Project Operations with the ability to extend functionality across multiple modules.
  • Code Review & Quality Assurance – Experience conducting peer reviews, enforcing coding standards, and ensuring compliance with Microsoft best practices.
  • Environment Troubleshooting – Skilled in diagnosing environment issues (Dev/UAT/Prod), resolving deployment failures, and managing dependencies across builds.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing – Ability to prepare clear technical design documents (TDDs), integration specifications, and reusable developer guides for team adoption.
  • Integration & Reporting Proficiency –Demonstrated expertise in leveraging Microsoft Fabric and other middleware platforms to design scalable integration pipelines, enable real‑time data exchange, and deliver advanced reporting solutions across Dynamics 365 CE Sales and Field Service.
  • Test Automation Expertise – Extensive experience with modern testing frameworks and tools for Dynamics 365 F&O applications. Preferred exposure to Leapwork, Azure App Testing, Playwright, with accepted proficiency in JMeter, Ranorex, Selenium, or equivalent platforms to validate customizations, integrations, and performance across Finance, Supply Chain, Retail & Commerce & Project Operations modules.

Experience

  • 8–10+ years of demonstrated work experience in ERP technologies with 6+ years in Dynamics 365 F&O/AX technical development.
  • Proven experience as a Technical Developer in at least 5 full‑cycle D365 F&O implementations.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and manage technical delivery.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • MB‑500: Finance & Operations Apps Developer
  • Experience with Power Pages (portals) or AI‑powered Copilot Studio

job.title: Trade Compliance Consultant
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

At Caterpillar, trade compliance is more than meeting regulatory requirements - it is about enabling the business to move with confidence in a complex global environment. As part of the Trade Center of Excellence (TCOE) within Law, Security & Public Policy, the Regional Trade Compliance Analyst will help turn trade requirements into practical solutions for Singapore and Australia.

Working alongside world class compliance, legal, and business leaders, the successful candidate will act as a trusted business partner - strengthening controls, supporting strategic decisions, and embedding compliance into day-to-day operations.

For a trade compliance professional looking to solve complex challenges and make a meaningful regional impact, this role offers the opportunity to help shape the future of trade compliance at Caterpillar.

What You Will Do

  • Risk assessment and mitigation: Support customs and trade compliance risk assessments, identify potential gaps, and help implement appropriate mitigation actions.
  • Compliance program support: Assist in developing, implementing, and maintaining trade compliance policies, procedures, controls, and processes.
  • Business partnership: Work closely with business divisions, legal, and compliance teams to provide practical trade compliance guidance across the India region.
  • Training and capability building: Deliver training on applicable trade, customs, and regulatory requirements relevant to Caterpillar’s products, services, and technologies.
  • Stakeholder communication: Communicate risks, recommendations, progress, and outcomes clearly and effectively to relevant stakeholders.

What You Have

  • Trade and customs compliance: Strong understanding of international trade regulations, customs processes, import/export controls, and compliance program requirements.
  • Analytical judgment: Ability to evaluate complex issues, identify root causes, assess risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Problem solving: Ability to resolve operational or compliance challenges and improve processes, controls, and ways of working.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to build trusted relationships across business, legal, compliance, and external stakeholders.
  • Communication and training: Ability to explain regulatory requirements clearly, deliver effective training, and communicate recommendations across levels and functions.

Top Candidate Will Also Have

  • Demonstrated expertise in trade compliance, customs, import/export operations, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting, developing, or managing compliance processes, controls, or procedures.
  • Strong business judgment, intellectual curiosity, and ability to support leadership priorities.

Additional Information

  • This position requires working onsite five days a week.

How We Support You (Employee Benefits)

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance. (prorated based upon hire date).

Final Details

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of Singapore which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

job.title: Data Center Shift Lead- Woodlands
job.description:
Job Summary

The successful candidate will deliver high calibre maintenance services within critical environments. Responding speedily to fault/breakdown requests, efficiently undertaking routine daily checks and scheduled maintenance of plant or equipment are of paramount importance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Adhere and support the facilities management strategy for the agreed client contract.
  • Oversee the facilities management service, which encompasses ad hoc maintenance, fire, mechanical, electrical support and, following environmental safety guidelines to ensure business continuity is maintained.
  • Manage site operations to ensure continuity of property services with minimum disruption to the client’s business operations.
  • Manages the on-site activities of shift/day technicians, and where required vendors and contractors.
  • Supervise and manage and mentor the technicians on site to ensure exceptional performance is being achieved. Shift Lead is responsible for supporting the Senior Engineer in setting and attaining performance goals, as well as responsible for the development, coaching, and counselling of the rest of the site technicians.
  • Perform hours of operations to provide site coverage as necessary, including working shift rosters to achieve full staff coverage of sites.
  • Raise work permits (including Tag out, Confined spaces, High Voltage, Fire Isolation, and Hot Works requirements), sign off work permits and collaborate with various groups to optimize the work schedule.
  • Where required conduct and document client meetings with appropriate work stream leaders, contractors
  • Conduct required property and operational inspections and review property operations to ensure cost effectiveness and business continuity is maximized.
  • Report and recommend technical and operational initiatives.
  • Perform risk assessments where required to support site risk reduction strategies
  • Articulate and live the CBRE culture, set an example by modelling the required behaviors and hold others (employees and peers) accountable for their actions by identifying and acting on behavior which is inconsistent with agreed standards.
  • Comply with all CBRE systems used to meet its health and safety obligations.
  • Work safely and not put themselves or anyone else’s health or safety at risk by their acts or omissions.
  • Comply with CBRE Environmental policies and adhere to procedures and work instructions that are relevant to their activities.
  • Operate in a manner that will minimize any adverse environmental impacts associated with their activities.
  • Ability to research, learn, and perform operational duties (switching, isolating, fault rectification, incident recovery, etc) to ensure equipment viability with minimum supervision.
  • Create and nurture on-site Client and stakeholder relations.
  • Some routine maintenance and monitoring tasks, Examples of items (Various Meter and UPS readings, Chiller Plant Monitoring, Replacement of Lights, New Tap Off Boxes, Basic Facility Repairs and Maintenance etc.)
  • Update site log of all incidents and happenings during shift and update next shift Technician and Senior Engineer(s).
  • Maintain awareness of current operating procedures, general site instructions and site safety guidelines and implement and monitor where required.
  • Perform system isolations and switching of supplies, change duties cycles or shut down equipment for maintenance.
  • Operate emergency plants such as generators, redundant chillers, cooling towers and take logs operating whilst in test or emergency operation.
  • Supporting the maintenance of electrical & mechanical infrastructure per manufacturers’ recommendation and client/contract statements of Work (SOW’s)
  • Develop, review, implement and audit local Method of Procedures (MOP’s), Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOP’s).
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the building(s) infrastructure and their layouts, functions and complexities
  • Endorse day to day and future compliance to safe working practices, quality standards conformity and best practice methods
  • Volunteer ideas / initiatives that contribute to the service levels and delivery
  • Undertake other tasks, as required by the site management team, in accordance with experience and competencies
  • Provide escorting/vendor management when/where required including supporting internal day technicians with planned and reactive maintenance works.
  • Support the shift lead(s) during their absence.
  • 12 hour rotating shift 4 on 4 off (2 days, 2 nights), though subject to change.

Required Knowledge and Skills:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential

  • Unrestricted Electrical or Air conditioning and Refrigeration License (Trade qualifications in electrical, mechanical, with strong preference for A Grade Electricians)
  • Good building services knowledge
  • Experience in critical environments
  • Good Customer relationship skills
  • Working knowledge of “Permit to work” systems
  • Understand and interpret technical drawings / processes
  • Experience of CMMS and BMS systems
  • Computer skills in Microsoft Office and a relevant Computerized Maintenance Management System
  • Strong technical background electrical, mechanical background or engineering related discipline.
  • Client relationship experience.
  • Knowledge in one of the major core areas, facility management or corporate real estate.

Desired

  • HV Operator/switching qualification and experience
  • 3 -5 years’ experience in a Data Centre environment
  • Experience of Microsoft Office, and mobile workorder applications

About CBRE Group, Inc.CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. The company has more than 155,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage servicing, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience, critical infrastructure); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). job.title: Assistant Manager, Corporate & Workplace Services
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Purpose

The Assistant Manager, Corporate & Workplace Services is responsible for ensuring the efficient management of workplace operations, office facilities, procurement activities, corporate governance support, ISO management system coordination, and sustainability reporting. The role serves as a key coordinator between internal stakeholders, service providers, and regulatory bodies to ensure workplace effectiveness, operational excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement.

The incumbent will oversee office administration, facilities management, procurement activities, workplace experience initiatives, ISO certification maintenance, and Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) reporting requirements while ensuring adherence to corporate policies, audit requirements, and governance standards.

Key Accountabilities

1. Office Administration & Procurement

  • Manage the procurement of office supplies, furniture, equipment, and workplace services in accordance with company procurement policies.
  • Source, evaluate, and manage vendors and service providers to ensure quality, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery.
  • Monitor office operating expenses and support annual budgeting and cost management initiatives.
  • Maintain inventory records and asset registers for workplace-related equipment and supplies.
  • Support contract administration, vendor performance reviews, and service renewals.

2. Workplace & Facilities Management

  • Oversee the day-to-day management of office facilities to ensure a safe, functional, and productive work environment.
  • Coordinate maintenance, repairs, renovations, office moves, and workplace improvement projects.
  • Manage facilities service providers including cleaning, security, pest control, office maintenance, and building management teams.
  • Ensure workplace compliance with safety, health, environmental, and building regulations.
  • Support business continuity initiatives and workplace emergency preparedness programs.
  • Drive workplace efficiency and employee experience enhancement initiatives.

3. ISO Management Systems & Compliance

  • Coordinate and maintain ISO management systems including documentation, records management, and compliance requirements.
  • Support internal and external ISO audits, surveillance audits, and certification renewals.
  • Monitor corrective and preventive actions arising from audit findings and ensure timely closure.
  • Facilitate management review meetings and maintain audit readiness across departments.
  • Work closely with process owners to ensure continuous compliance with ISO standards and corporate governance requirements.
  • Support policy development, process reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

4. Sustainability & ESG Reporting

  • Coordinate data collection and validation for sustainability reporting requirements.
  • Consolidate environmental, workplace, operational, and governance performance data from relevant stakeholders.
  • Support the preparation of sustainability reports, ESG disclosures, and regulatory submissions.
  • Track sustainability performance indicators and support initiatives aligned with corporate sustainability objectives.
  • Collaborate with business units to improve sustainability data quality, reporting processes, and governance controls.
  • Assist in implementing sustainability initiatives and awareness programs across the organisation.

5. Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as the primary liaison with building management, service providers, auditors, and external agencies.
  • Build effective partnerships with internal stakeholders to support workplace and operational requirements.
  • Manage vendor performance against contractual obligations and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Support cross-functional projects related to workplace, sustainability, governance, and operational excellence.

Key Requirements

Qualifications

  • Degree in Business Administration, Facilities Management, Building Management, Engineering, Sustainability, Environmental Management, or related disciplines.
  • Professional certification in Facilities Management, Sustainability, ESG Reporting, or ISO Lead/Internal Auditor certification will be advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in office administration, facilities management, corporate services, workplace management, sustainability reporting, or ISO management systems.
  • Experience supporting ISO certification audits and management systems.
  • Experience managing vendors, procurement activities, and workplace operations.
  • Exposure to sustainability reporting or ESG data management will be advantageous.

job.title: Account Director
job.description:
About us

We’re growing, not slowing, here at Macquarie Technology Group because we’re passionate about doing things differently. We want to challenge the industry and look for better ways of doing things. As a team, Macquarie Government are hardworking, results and success focused. We also take the time to celebrate our success and make sure our people are doing work that makes a difference.

We believe that collaboration & team connection is key for success. This role will have a hybrid working model arrangement of 3 days in our CBD offices & the remaining working from home. #LI-Hybrid

We require security clearance for this role, you must be an Australian citizen to be eligible to obtain a security clearance.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a strategic Tier 1 Government account from our Canberra or Sydney office.

This is a high-impact role for a commercially driven leader with a proven track record in complex strategic transformation. You'll work directly with senior government executives to understand strategic priorities, shape transformation agendas and position Macquarie as a long-term technology partner across cloud, cyber security, networking, data centre and managed services.

You'll lead complex, multi-year opportunities from strategy and discovery through to solution development, negotiation and delivery — bringing together executive stakeholders, technical teams and commercial partners to deliver meaningful customer outcomes.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a strategic Tier 1 Government account from our Canberra or Sydney office.

This is a high-impact role for a commercially driven leader with a proven track record in complex strategic transformation. You'll work directly with senior government executives to understand strategic priorities, shape transformation agendas and position Macquarie as a long-term technology partner across cloud, cyber security, networking, data centre and managed services.

You'll lead complex, multi-year opportunities from strategy and discovery through to solution development, negotiation and delivery — bringing together executive stakeholders, technical teams and commercial partners to deliver meaningful customer outcomes.

Why Us?

  • We're Australia's Great Place to Work 2026 certified for 3 years in a row.
  • For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award!
  • Over 42% of Australian government agencies use and trust us. They depend on us to protect them from private and state-sponsored cyber attackers.
  • We have the highest Net Promoter Score on the ASX, the [World's best customer experience](https://www.businessthink.unsw.edu.au/articles/macquarie-telecom-tudehope-customer-experience) & [crowned in 2020 at the World Communications Awards](https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/BU2010/S00476/macquarie-telecom-group-wins-best-customer-experience-in-the-world.htm).
  • You’ll make an impact: Enjoy being part of a driven team with a collaborative culture that values decision-makers and action.
  • We Invest in you: Accelerate your career through our learning and development opportunities - think Gallup strengths-based training, defined career pathways and fantastic internal mobility opportunities across the group.
  • A dynamic and supportive team that values smart thinking.
  • A workplace where your business insights are celebrated.

What you'll do

  • Own and grow a strategic Tier 1 Government account, building relationships across executive, technology, commercial and procurement stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute multi-year account and transformation strategies aligned to customer priorities.
  • Identify, shape and lead complex, high-value transformation opportunities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and senior government executives.
  • Lead major sales engagements, tenders, proposals, business cases and commercial negotiations.
  • Mobilise internal technical, commercial and delivery teams around customer outcomes.
  • Build strategic pipeline, identify growth opportunities and drive long-term account value.
  • Navigate complex government procurement, governance and stakeholder environments.

What you'll bring

  • Proven experience selling into Tier 1 Federal Government or large enterprise environments.
  • A strong track record in complex strategic transformation and multi-year technology programs.
  • Executive-level relationship and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and senior government leaders.
  • Strong commercial acumen and a track record of delivering against ambitious sales targets.
  • Experience across cloud, cyber security, networking, telecommunications, data centre or managed services.
  • Deep understanding of government procurement, tenders and complex commercial negotiations.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
  • The ability to connect business strategy, technology transformation and commercial outcomes.
  • An Australian Government security clearance, or previous experience holding one.

This is an opportunity to shape major technology transformation within one of Australia's most significant government organisations — working at executive level, influencing strategy and building a partnership that extends well beyond a traditional technology sale.

If you're energised by complex environments, strategic transformation and high-impact customer relationships this role is for you.

If this excites you, apply now, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Deputy Manager - Facility & Maintenance
job.description:
About Business:

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Job Purpose: The Lead - Gas & Chemical, PEX is responsible for overseeing the safe and efficient management of bulk gases and specialty chemicals. This includes ensuring compliance with safety regulations, optimizing system performance, and leading a team to maintain operational standards. The role involves coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to manage handling, storage, and distribution processes effectively.

Responsibilities

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure that all gas and chemical operations meet safety regulations and industry standards. Conduct audits and risk assessments to identify hazards, implement corrective actions, and mitigate risks.

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Organizational & Culture Building:

  • Fostering a collaborative, agile culture that aligns with company values, driving employee engagement, and ensuring organizational growth and development.

Leadership in Change Management:

  • Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies.

Bulk Gas System Management:

  • Oversee the management of bulk gas systems, including their handling, storage, and distribution. Ensure adherence to safety protocols, and conduct regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks and maintain operational efficiency.

Specialty Chemicals Handling:

  • Supervise the storage, handling, and application of specialty chemicals. Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and develop safe use and disposal procedures.

Gas System Management:

  • Direct the operation and maintenance of gas systems to ensure safe and efficient handling. Perform regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks and ensure safety compliance.

Chemical Process Oversight:

  • Oversee chemical processes, including their handling, storage, and application. Develop procedures for safe use and waste management to meet environmental and safety standards.

Process Innovation:

  • Lead the development of efficient, eco-friendly chemical and gas processes to boost yield and sustainability.

System Optimization:

  • Enhance the efficiency and performance of gas and chemical systems through data analysis and process improvements. Collaborate on system upgrades to boost reliability and reduce costs.

Training and Development:

  • Develop and deliver training programs on safe gas and chemical handling and emergency procedures. Conduct drills and ensure that personnel are well-versed in safety protocols.

 

Team Development:

  • Foster a respectful and safe work environment. Lead effective teams, mentor team members, and promote professional growth and success.

People Development:

  • Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Engineer - Gas & Chemical
  • Package Incharge - O&M (CAS & PCW)
  • Area Incharge - Chemical
  • Lead - C&I
  • Lead - Mechanical

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Regulatory Agencies (e.g., OSHA, EPA)
  • Gas Suppliers
  • Chemical Vendors
  • Regulatory Agencies
  • External Maintenance Contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering is essential. Master's degree in Engineering Management or a related field would be advantageous. Strong academic foundation in mechanical engineering principles, maintenance management, and operations is crucial.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • Minimum of 12-15 years of experience in operations and maintenance within a large-scale manufacturing environment. Proven track record in managing maintenance teams, implementing maintenance strategies, and driving operational efficiency. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop maintenance teams.

job.title: Shift Engineer EMD
job.description:
Lead Electrical BoP/CHP

Maintenance Strategy Execution:

Execute proper electrical maintenance activities for BoP, CHP, including RO Plant, Sea Intake, FGD, Hydrogen plant, DM plant, Conveyor belts, Crusher house, Stacker Reclaimers, etc. and associated areas to ensure continuous operational reliability.

Prepare and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Job Safety Analyses (JSAs), and Standard Maintenance Plans (SMPs) for BoP/CHP and associated areas to reflect current best practices and operational requirements.

Support the implementation of improvement projects for BoP, CHP, and associated areas.

Execute comprehensive maintenance strategies, including preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance, to minimize downtime and extend equipment life.

Conduct annual overhauling and manage maintenance during outages, focusing on safe, timely, and efficient project completion and adherence to established protocols and standards.

Perform execution of AOH and COH within budgets and allotted manpower.

Troubleshoot equipment failures and conduct equipment failure analysis to prevent recurrence and improve system reliability.

Maintenance and System Enhancement Operations:

Execute proactive maintenance and testing to ensure equipment operates within permissible limits and suggest corrective actions, as needed.

Monitor business associates performance, bill certifications, and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.

Perform timely completion of Preventive Maintenance (PM), Corrective Maintenance (CM), and condition monitoring activities.

Identify and act on opportunities for process and system enhancements to meet evolving operational needs and directives from leadership.

Engage in repairing and refurbishment activities for associated area equipment, ensuring that all maintenance work is carried out to the highest standards.

Perform the effective use of SAP for tracking maintenance activities, managing spare parts inventory, and ensuring the timely closure of notifications.

Inventory and Resource Management:

Monitor the condition and availability of all BoP/CHP equipment, ensuring that Service Transformers, HT and LT Switchgear, HT and LT motors, DC Systems, DG Sets, Lifts in Chimney and Chimney lightings, Stacker Reclaimer Electrical Auxiliaries, Wagon Tripler are functioning optimally.

Assist in the spares inventory management and development of vital indigenous spares for BoP/CHP equipment.

Perform timely testing of electrical equipment for BoP, CHP and associated areas.

Create PRs for materials and services and prepare SES (Service Entry Sheets) for completed services.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA, ABEM and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Maintain compliance with legal and statutory requirements, including electrical license renewal and certifications for elevators.

Mitigate hazardous processes, participate in mock drills, and ensure the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.

Digitalisation and Automation:

Execute comprehensive Digitalisation strategies to optimize operational efficiency.

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Monitor data from digital systems to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

All depts

Head Office

Service depts.

Techno Commercial

11+ years of experience in electrical maintenance within power plants or heavy industries.

Experience in the power generation industry, specifically with BoP/CHP operations.

job.description:
Techno-Commercial Planning & Implementation:

Category Planning & Strategic Sourcing Execution:

  • Implement ESG-aligned logistics practices including route optimization, reduction of emissions, green handling processes, and waste-minimized packaging.

Data Analytics, Reporting & Value Improvement:

job.title: Sub Station In-Charge
job.description:
Lead - Projects Substation (Site)-Tx

Project Management:

Drive effective site management for substation projects by overseeing project monitoring, coordination, execution planning, and supervision of all site activities.

Ensure timely project progress by planning and supervising daily site activities, and maintaining daily and monthly progress reports.

Implement and maintain QC measures and systems by ensuring quality of materials and workmanship on-site, while overseeing all aspects of electrical works in compliance with Field Quality Plans (FQP).

Facilitate smooth execution by coordinating with the main EPC contractor, Electrical Inspectors, Power Grid, and regional load dispatch centers to support system interfacing and substation commissioning.

Achieve project milestones within approved budgets by preparing and running RA bills for the company and contractors on a monthly basis, and ensuring accurate material reconciliation.

Compliance Management:

Maintain strict adherence to safety and quality standards by implementing site-wide safety protocols and creating a zero-harm environment.

Promote compliance with regulatory requirements by ensuring all site activities meet statutory and safety standards, and maintaining material receipt and handover documents.

Certify electrical erection and commissioning activities by witnessing site tests on equipment and certifying test reports in line with required standards.

Liaison and Stakeholder Management:

Facilitate effective communication and coordination with external stakeholders by liaising with main EPC contractors, service providers, and OEMs to support seamless project execution.

Build strong relationships with government authorities by engaging local government bodies, and coordinating with power grid operators and load dispatch centers for smooth system operations and substation charging.

Support interdepartmental collaboration by maintaining effective communication with internal departments and aligning on project goals.

Financial Management:

Ensure cost efficiency by preparing and managing project budgets, tracking expenses, and controlling cash flow to align with project schedules.

Maintain accuracy in resource allocation by reconciling materials, overseeing billing, and ensuring compliance with budgetary guidelines.

Risk Management:

Ensure project safety by rigorously implementing site-wide safety protocols and conducting regular safety audits, fostering a zero-harm environment for all personnel.

Minimize potential project delays by proactively identifying and assessing risks, allowing for timely mitigation strategies to be enacted throughout the project lifecycle.

Technology Integration and Innovation:

Enhance project efficiency by integrating advanced project management software and tools, facilitating real-time monitoring and communication among all stakeholders.

Drive continuous improvement in project execution by adopting innovative techniques and technologies, resulting in optimized workflows and reduced operational costs.

Team Management:

Foster a collaborative, productive team environment by coordinating with team members, providing guidance, and facilitating interdepartmental communication.

Support continuous learning and skill development by providing coaching, encouraging teamwork, and maintaining a respectful, cohesive work culture.
