job.title: Commercial Contracts Lawyer
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Commercial Contracts Lawyer to support handling of customer contracting and commercial contracting matters.

This role will be based in Singapore.

Key responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, focusing on customer contracts and service level agreements with hyperscale and other major customers.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, operations, finance, and technical teams, to ensure legal compliance and mitigate risks in commercial transactions.
  • Provide legal opinions and advice on regulatory compliance matters in connection with responsibility areas (including data privacy, cybersecurity, and environmental regulations).
  • Monitor legal developments in the industry, focusing on key responsibility areas, and provide updates and guidance to the organization on relevant legal issues and best practices.
  • Manage outside counsel and legal service providers as needed to support the company's legal needs.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of legal policies, procedures, and templates to streamline the contracting process and ensure consistency across the organization.

The successful candidate:

  • Qualified lawyer with admission to practice law in Hong Kong, Australia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, or the United States.
  • 8-12 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) in commercial contracting.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation, and contract management skills, with a proven ability to handle complex commercial transactions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide practical and commercially-oriented legal solutions.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in English is required, with fluency in Mandarin or other Asian languages being an advantage.
  • Prior in-house experience with a major hyperscaler on commercial contracting; experience with data center contracts will be highly valued.
  • Familiarity with industry-standard contracts and best practices in the data center and technology sectors.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to work in a dynamic and rapidly-evolving industry.
  • Strong commitment to professional ethics and integrity.

  • *

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Counsel, Construction, to support handling of project delivery, construction and procurement matters relating to the development and operation of our data center facilities.

This role will be based in Singapore.

Key responsibilities

  • Advise on legal matters, including drafting, reviewing, and negotiating construction contracts, subcontractor agreements, and engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracts.
  • Advise on and manage legal risk across multiple delivery and procurement methodologies (e.g., EPC, EPCM/agency construction management, design-build, and multi-package/trade contracting), selecting and adapting contract forms and risk allocation to suit each project and market.
  • Provide legal support and guidance on project delivery and procurement, including drafting and negotiating supply agreements, vendor contracts, and service agreements.

  • Advise on joint venture, consortium, and special purpose vehicle structures.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including construction, engineering, operations, and finance teams, to ensure legal compliance and mitigate project delivery risks.
  • Provide legal opinions and advice on regulatory compliance matters, including health and safety, environmental, and planning/building regulations.
  • Manage outside counsel and legal service providers.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of legal policies, procedures, and templates to streamline contracting processes and ensure consistency across the organization.

The successful candidate:

  • Qualified lawyer with admission to practice law in Hong Kong, Australia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, or the United States.
  • 10-15 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) in construction law, preferably with experience in the data center or technology industry.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on a range of procurement and delivery methodologies (EPC, EPCM, design-build, multi-package/trade contracting) for large-scale infrastructure or data center projects.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation, and contract management skills, with a proven ability to handle complex transactions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels, with the ability to provide practical and commercially-oriented legal solutions.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in English is required, with fluency in Mandarin or other Asian languages being an advantage.
  • Prior experience working in-house or in a law firm supporting clients in the data center, technology, or telecommunications industries, with a focus on construction, procurement and project delivery matters.
  • Experience delivering hyperscale data center programs across multiple markets/jurisdictions using varied procurement strategies.
  • Familiarity with industry-standard construction contracts and best practices in the data center and technology sectors.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to work in a dynamic and rapidly-evolving industry.
  • Strong commitment to professional ethics and integrity.

job.title: Senior Director, Design Delivery Sector Head
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

  • *

We are seeking a Senior Director, Design Delivery Sector Head with a strong background in either mechanical or electrical engineering to lead the end-to-end design execution of mission-critical data centre infrastructure across the Asia Pacific region. This senior leadership role will own the integrated design delivery process from early concept through construction, driving consistency, technical excellence, and innovation across a growing portfolio of hyperscale and enterprise-grade data centre projects.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise (preferably in mechanical or electrical systems), strong leadership across multidisciplinary teams, and a track record of executing complex data centre designs at scale. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, design consultants, construction teams, and strategic partners to ensure project success in terms of quality, performance, time, and cost.

Key responsibilities

Strategic & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the overall MEP design strategy for assigned data centre projects across the region, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and technical rigor.
  • Own the mechanical and electrical discipline leadership, including chilled water systems, HVAC, liquid cooling, or power distribution, UPS, and MV/LV systems.

Cross-Disciplinary Design Integration

  • Champion seamless coordination between mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, architectural, structural, and security disciplines.
  • Drive adoption of best practices, innovation, and lessons learned across the portfolio.

Design Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee the full design lifecycle from feasibility and concept through detailed design, IFC, and construction support – ensuring alignment with business goals and customer requirements.
  • Monitor and drive performance of external consultants and vendors, ensuring deliverables meet cost, quality, and schedule expectations.

Design Governance & Standardization

  • Establish and enforce internal design governance, including design reviews, technical due diligence, and risk assessments.
  • Maintain and evolve internal design standards, master specifications, and reference guides to support rapid and consistent deployment.

Innovation & Future Readiness

  • Lead technical innovation efforts including liquid cooling readiness, AI/HPC support, or grid-interactive power strategies.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure future-proof design direction.

Execution Support & Commissioning

  • Provide senior oversight and troubleshooting during construction and commissioning phases to validate that design intent is maintained.
  • Review and validate Sequence of Operations (SOO) and critical systems performance during T&C.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as a key technical voice to internal leadership, customers, and partners—articulating design strategies, decisions, risks, and value propositions clearly and confidently.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (or equivalent).
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data centre design and delivery, including at least 5 years in hyperscale or colocation environments.
  • Proven leadership of complex, multi-disciplinary design efforts with responsibility for multiple projects across geographies.
  • Deep knowledge of mechanical and/or electrical systems including HVAC, chilled water, free cooling, UPS, MV/LV distribution, or liquid cooling.
  • Familiarity with regional APAC codes and international standards (ASHRAE, ISO, IEC, NFPA, etc.).
  • Experience with design tools such as AutoCAD, Revit/BIM, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer, or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Strong communicator and influencer with the ability to manage both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth, international environment is highly advantageous.

job.title: SmartRecruiters Implementation Lead
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to the Head of Digital HR, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Head of Talent Acquisition, the SmartRecruiters Implementation Lead will lead the scoping, design, implementation, adoption, launch and stabilisation of SmartRecruiters across Digital Edge. This is a one-year fixed-term contract, with the potential for renewal subject to business requirements to provide ongoing SmartRecruiters administration, continuous improvement and possible future support for SAP SuccessFactors. The role will ensure the solution is intuitive and effective for candidates, recruiters, hiring managers and HR users, while establishing regional consistency and meeting local market requirements. The role may be based in Singapore or another APAC location.

Key working relationships:

The role will work closely with the wider HRIS and Digital HR team, in-country HR Business Partners to capture local requirements, and Talent Acquisition Partners as the principal user group. It will also partner with business leaders, hiring managers, IT, information security, integration teams and implementation vendors, and liaise directly with the CHRO as required.

**

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end, multi-country implementation of SmartRecruiters, covering discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, integration, data migration, testing, deployment, launch and post-launch stabilisation.
  • Own the implementation plan, milestones, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, decision log, change control, status reporting and escalation process, ensuring delivery is transparent, well governed and aligned with agreed outcomes.
  • Translate business and local market requirements into practical design decisions; recommend standardised approaches and constructively challenge requests that would introduce unnecessary complexity, weaken controls or compromise the user experience.
  • Design an intuitive, consistent and effective experience for candidates, recruiters, hiring managers and HR users, balancing global process principles with legal, regulatory and operational needs across Digital Edge markets.
  • Lead vendor and delivery-partner management, including scope, deliverables, timelines, quality, issue resolution and accountability for agreed outcomes.
  • Establish testing governance and coordinate system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing, including test plans, scripts, defect management, entry and exit criteria, business sign-off and production validation.
  • Own implementation readiness, communications, stakeholder engagement, training, enablement, launch support and adoption activities; capture feedback, monitor usage and drive continuous improvement after go-live.
  • Present recommendations, design decisions, risks and progress updates to senior stakeholders and governance forums, facilitate decisions and respond clearly and directly to questions from leaders and users.
  • Define success measures and track adoption, user experience, process efficiency, data quality and other agreed benefits to support benefits realisation.
  • Establish implementation-ready administration and support arrangements, including configurations, workflows, job templates, forms, notifications, permissions, career-site settings, country requirements, integrations, security, privacy controls, reporting and documentation.
  • During stabilisation—and as part of any renewed longer-term remit—manage incidents, fixes, releases, access reviews, reporting, vendor support and approved enhancements, while identifying opportunities to improve SmartRecruiters and potentially support SAP SuccessFactors.

The successful candidate:

**

  • Demonstrated experience leading, or playing a significant delivery role in, a comparable multi-country SmartRecruiters implementation. Experience should span requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, data migration, deployment and post-launch stabilisation; general ATS administration experience alone is not sufficient.
  • Strong knowledge of SmartRecruiters capabilities, configuration, workflows, permissions, integrations, reporting, security, release management and operating-model considerations.
  • Proven project delivery and governance capability, with experience managing plans, risks, dependencies, decisions, vendors, change control, testing, readiness, communications, training, launch support and benefits realisation.
  • A strong user-experience and adoption mindset, with the ability to balance global consistency, local market needs, process effectiveness, data integrity and ease of use.
  • Credible, confident and engaging with senior stakeholders, with strong presentation, facilitation and communication skills and the presence to build support among leaders who may be resistant to change.
  • Sound judgement and the confidence to operate independently, make practical recommendations, challenge constructively and maintain delivery momentum in a fast-moving, multi-country environment.
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear system and process designs and explain technical matters simply and directly to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder-management and documentation skills, with a collaborative approach across Talent Acquisition, HR, HRIS, IT, vendors and business teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business or a related field.
  • SmartRecruiters certification is preferred. Experience with SAP SuccessFactors, HR technology integrations and change management is advantageous.

**

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Senior Technical Specialist RAN
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

As the Senior Technical Specialist, T2 RAN Ops, you’ll play a key role in ensuring the optimal performance and availability of the Optus RAN Network to maintain a high standard of customer experience. You’ll provide hands-on technical operational support and contribute to the technical governance of suppliers across Incident, Change, and Problem Management. You’ll also play a critical role in supporting the Radio Access portion of the Satellite Site network (delivered via VSAT geostationary backhaul and aggregated in a Hetnet Gateway co-located with VSAT equipment). Working initially during business hours (subject to change as the network evolves), you’ll collaborate closely with managed service providers, vendors, and internal engineering teams to implement network strategies and enhance operational effectiveness.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute technical operational processes and provide technical support to maintain network availability.
  • Respond to and assist in resolving incidents escalated by Managed Services where issues are not immediately resolvable.
  • Support Problem Management by contributing to root cause analysis and corrective action recommendations.
  • Manage and respond to escalations from Service Assurance Managers on critical incidents under guidance.
  • Assist with planning and execution of network changes, expansions, and upgrades.
  • Recommend improvements to network design to enhance performance and reliability.
  • Ensure all planned changes meet Optus’ quality and performance policies.
  • Support continuous improvement activities alongside Engineering, Vendors, and Managed Services.
  • Contribute to tools strategy and automation initiatives by providing operational insights.
  • Participate in alarm filtering, correlation analysis, and service assurance automation efforts.
  • Provide operational input into weekly/monthly KPI and SLA reporting processes.
  • Act as a point of knowledge for peers and contribute to team knowledge sharing and training initiatives.

What You Bring

  • A relevant degree in Engineering (Communications, Electrical or similar) or Diploma with extensive related work experience.
  • 10+ years in the Mobile/Mobile-Satellite industry, with particular expertise in VSAT, IP, RF and cellular backhaul.
  • Advanced technical understanding of VSAT, RF, IP and 3G/4G cellular systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and escalate effectively.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills across various subsystems to deliver and assure end-to-end VSAT and Mobile backhaul services.
  • Experience with protocol-level application testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cybersecurity skills and operational experience.
  • Vendor and Customer management and negotiation skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • ITIL framework compliance and adherence experience.

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

job.title: Human Resources Business Partner
job.description:
Job Summary

Partners with the business to contribute to talent outcomes and enhance our culture to enable business success. Operates in service of, and in partnership with, the business to proactively engage, listen, and collaborate with business leaders to identify strategic needs, purposefully balance enterprise and local needs, shape solutions and interventions, and determine priorities using technology and people analytics. Leverages the full HR function to meet business needs deliver as ONE HR team. Developing authentic and capable leaders who embody Cummins Leadership Behaviors and bring talent strategies to life.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Solution Developer: Delivers a strategic workforce plan that directly and clearly links innovative and effective talent strategies with strategic business objectives. Assesses strategic talent concerns, risks and opportunities and delivers on the agreed plan that drives solutions to meet the strategic needs of the business. Strategic Consultant: Understands the issues facing the business in the present and future. Engages with business leadership to ensure the HR priorities are aligned to those strategic business needs. Functional Facilitator: Leverages the full HR function to deliver as ONE HR team, ensuring clarity on who is driving what dimensions of work and the expected outcomes and timelines. Collaborates with all arms of HR to manage initiatives and regularly review impact and success. Works nimbly to adjust as necessary to enable business success. Organization Effectiveness & Change Leader: Partners with the business to identify areas where improvement to the efficiency and effectiveness of the organization is required. Is courageous in developing and leading change management initiatives designed to drive the business culture and performance improvements critical for future success. Leadership Coach: Invests time and resources into developing authentic and highly capable leaders and are always thinking about ways to bring Cummins values to life. Assists leaders in identifying their development areas and building development plans acting as a confidant. Contributes to succession planning to identify key and pivotal roles in their area of responsibility, ensuring that any leadership gaps are closed that may arise in the future. Culture Champion: Leveraging listening strategies to understand sentiment and drive engagement and connection. Using multiple listening vehicles ensures employee voices are being heard, and visible plans are implemented to drive improvements to the employee engagement, experience, and culture at a site/local level.

Competencies:

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Change Management - Applies the Cummins structured process and tool set for engaging individuals and organizations through change to achieve and sustain business results and outcomes.

Organization Design - Applies Cummins Organization Design principles and tools, whilst partnering with leaders, to determine the optimal organizational design and structure to deliver on strategic goals.

Team Effectiveness Facilitation - Guides team to increased effectiveness through observation, facilitation and application of structured tools to enhance team and individual awareness, resulting in a capability to deliver desired business outcomes.

Team Effectiveness is part of Cummins leadership development framework which focuses on developing self aware and effective leaders.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Human Resources Consulting - Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.

Strategic Workforce Planning - Leverages business insights, qualitative and quantitative data to develop comprehensive talent solutions that meet the strategic needs of the business; ensures the organization has a diverse and robust pipeline of talent that delivers the necessary mix of skills and capabilities, organizational structures, and talent placement to be successful now and in the future.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Financial acumen - Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.

Cultivates innovation - Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.

Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

Business Acumen - Ability to integrate into the business decision making process by applying a relatable understanding of the industry, market conditions, shareholder expectations, business strategies, business value propositions, and key profitability levers.

Strategic Problem Solving - Drives solutions to strategic problems that fall outside of past experience through a top-down, hypothesis-driven approach with frequent iteration that evolved with diverse learnings gathered through the course of the project.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field highly preferred

Experience

Significant level of experience required

  • This HRBP role directly supports two critical manufacturing plants – PHP and CPG – under PSBU India, both located at the Mega-Site in Phaltan.
  • These plants together contribute substantial revenue to PSBU , with a strong PBIT performance and production, also both plants are projected to deliver accelerated growth in the coming years and require talent ramp up
  • The combined workforce across both plants includes 400+ on-roll employees, along with a significant population of flexi workforce employees, adding to workforce complexity.

job.title: Supply Chain Planner
job.description:
Job Summary

To plan and maintain daily Supply Chain operations in one or more functional areas such as materials, production, inventory, logistics, customer service, demand management or order fulfillment. Ensures internal and external customers' expectations and requirements are met.

Key Responsibilities

Develop planning system strategies to improve signals across the supply chain Monitor and adjust parameters in the planning system. Use common processes tools, and information systems. Analyze and interpret Key Performance Indicators to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Execute the daily operational planning process within a specified functional area. Identify potential supply chain failures as part of the planning process and mitigate associated risks Work closely with stakeholders - internal and/or external to develop short term tactical improvements. Use the planning system to drive consistent planning signals across the supply chain Participate in functional process improvement teams

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

​Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

​Part Change Control Management - Evaluates and implements engineering change request (obsolescence, supersessions, new part release, etc.) to meet customer delivery requirements while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

​Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Master Supply Scheduling - Establishes and maintains a valid Master Production Schedule for a family of products, which meets customer’s expectations and requirements while maximizing operational efficiency; validates procurement scheduling, production scheduling, and replenishment planning are aligned to manufacturing and assembly assets for conversion.

Material Planning - Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Minimal to intermediate level of experience required

This role is to offer support in the US time zone and hence incumbent needs to operate in Night Shift (5PM to 2AM IST). At SCS&A we offer Night Shift allowance & Pickup and Drop facilities (within PMC & PCMC jurisdiction)to all employees working in this shift.

The role specific requirements are as below –

•Coordination with internal or external supplier base and stakeholders across various functions

•Processing and monitoring orders against suppliers

  • Work towards meeting the supply plan
  • Monitor and make adjustments to the planned and release procurement signals and expedite as necessary
  • Metrics analysis & Reporting. Experience in Kinaxis , GOMS and aftermarket material planning.

job.title: Electronic Systems Controls Technical Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary

This controls focused position tailors electronic control systems for Cummins products. People in these positions will decompose product requirements into functional requirements and design and tune controls that operate on Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications. Additionally, there is responsibility to configure (tune), and complete comprehensive validation testing of the fully integrated hardware and software systems.

Key Responsibilities

Contributes to the development of electronic controls (open and closed loop)and diagnostics for a variety of applications (internal combustion engine, power systems, powertrain, etc). Owns investigation, problem resolution, and documentation for these systems with guidance from more experienced team members. Uses strong knowledge of application of controls and first principles to guide decision making.

Works and improves electronic controls development processes and tools. Processes include system specification, modeling and simulation, calibration, Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP&R), and troubleshooting. Application of tools for simulation, calibration, and product life maintenance required.

Contributes to negotiations, translates and decomposes requirements and voices from customers into functional requirements for controls algorithms, designs algorithms to meet these requirements, tunes these algorithms, and designs tests to validate performance against these requirements.

Contributes to decisions in the areas of electronic and electrical controls and diagnostic design, requirements, calibration, and test that impact the quality and performance of individual calibrated features and/or components by using systems knowledge and understanding of product (internal combustion engine, power systems, powertrain, etc). Responsible for review of less-experienced controls engineers' work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient design.

Contributes independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team.

Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Responsible for interacting and collaborating with cross functional teams.

Contributes as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site.

Competencies:Design and Application of Mechatronics Systems - Specifies electronic hardware and interconnections that measure and control systems; applies electronic hardware and interconnections in Cummins' products.

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

Machine Integration and Optimization - Combines various parts or sub-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is

required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required

with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making.

Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred.

Cybersecurity

  • Knowledge . cybersecurity regulations and standards applicable to embedded control systems
  • Ability to derive, analyse, and manage cybersecurity requirements for controllers, HMIs, communication interfaces, and connected tools.
  • Experience conducting threat analysis, risk assessments, cybersecurity gap analysis, and mitigation planning for embedded control systems.
  • Skilled in product and process documentation to demonstrate compliance to cybersecurity norms.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts for embedded systems products, test plan creation and system level validation.
  • Understanding of controller, HMI, engine ECM, telematics, and plant/network communication architectures , boundary diagrams and interfaces from a cybersecurity perspective.
  • Ability to define cybersecurity work products, support audits/evaluations, and ensure compliance throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Maintain SDLC for product - ensuring compliance to process, validation and release ( CRA, UL). Secure Product Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) and Regulatory Compliance.

System Engineering skills

  • Skilled in genset controllers system
  • Electronics and Electrical power systems knowledge
  • Electronic System - Harness, Sensor, Actuator, Switch gears, breakers, charging alternator
  • Electronic Control Architecture - *microprocessor, HW, SW, Service tool, HMI
  • 3 phase power supply, synchronization, alternator.
  • Genset Domain Knowledge - PLC, Paralleling,3rd Party Interfacing
  • Feedback Control Loops/Theory (PG Programs)- AVR, Voltage Regulation, Speed Governing
  • System engineering process flows and tools
  • Requirement gathering

  • DFMEA

  • 7 step problem solving tool

job.title: Supply Planning Coordinator - Level III - OFFC
job.description:
Under minimal supervision and in accordance with Cummins Delegation of Authority Policy, determines the quantity and timing of materials required to meet the master production schedule and/or independent customer demand. Initiates and expedites purchase or production orders as required to ensure material availability and customer delivery requirements are met. The role is responsible for monitoring supply and demand, managing material planning parameters, addressing supply constraints and exceptions, and collaborating with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, quality, and other supply chain stakeholders to optimize inventory and delivery performance.

Under minimal supervision and in accordance with Cummins Delegation of Authority Policy, determines the quantity and timing of materials required to meet the master production schedule and/or independent customer demand. Initiates and expedites purchase or production orders as required to ensure material availability and customer delivery requirements are met. The role is responsible for monitoring supply and demand, managing material planning parameters, addressing supply constraints and exceptions, and collaborating with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, quality, and other supply chain stakeholders to optimize inventory and delivery performance.

Key Responsibilities

Supply & Materials Planning

  • Determine material quantities and order dates based on demand, master production schedules, inventory levels, lead times, and supply constraints.
  • Initiate purchase and work orders to support demand plans and ensure timely material availability.
  • Monitor materials planning systems for exception messages, alerts, shortages, past-due orders, and other supply risks.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and take appropriate corrective actions to maintain alignment between supply and demand.
  • Reconcile order boards for critical suppliers, critical parts, and past-due orders on a routine basis.
  • Expedite purchase or production orders when required to support customer and manufacturing requirements.
  • Provide accurate and timely updates on inventory availability, shortages, and back-order recovery plans.

Supplier & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Participate in allocation and supply constraint discussions with Sourcing Managers, suppliers, and other Cummins entities to understand constraints and their business impact.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve lead times, optimize order quantities, and balance supply with demand.
  • Take ownership and accountability for supplier schedules that support end-customer requirements.
  • Collaborate with Supply Chain Planners and other stakeholders across the organization to reposition excess inventory to locations with supporting demand.
  • Document, communicate, and follow up on action items that may impact the ability to execute the supply plan.
  • Support supplier improvement initiatives focused on improving delivery and supply chain performance.

Inventory & Part Change Management

  • Perform quality checks on material planning master data, including lead times, order quantities, and other planning parameters.
  • Support Plan for Every Part (PFEP) activities and ensure material planning parameters support efficient material flow.
  • Manage part change requests, including new part releases, supersessions, obsolescence, and engineering changes.
  • Support ramp-up and ramp-down activities while balancing customer requirements and minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
  • Work with Quality to ensure timely disposition of non-conforming material.

Master Scheduling & Performance Management

  • Support the establishment and maintenance of valid master production schedules for assigned products or product families.
  • Validate that procurement, production scheduling, and replenishment plans are aligned with manufacturing and assembly requirements.
  • Monitor materials and supply chain KPIs, identify performance gaps, and support actions to improve delivery, inventory, and supply performance.
  • Assess the impact of supply chain performance on end customers and balance competing priorities to achieve business objectives.

HSE, Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Report work-related injuries, illnesses, incidents, and hazards and comply with applicable HSE standards, policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Complete required HSE, quality, and functional training.
  • Follow applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives involving quality, safety, process efficiency, material flow, inventory, and supply chain performance.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize processes and improve planning and reporting efficiency.
  • Remain flexible and perform other responsibilities as required to support business goals.

Teamwork & Development

  • Communicate effectively with assigned teams, suppliers, and cross-functional support functions.
  • Build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Complete training and personal development activities aligned with business requirements and career goals.
  • Demonstrate accountability, ownership, and the required level of proficiency in core competencies.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of materials planning, supply and demand management, inventory control, and production scheduling.
  • Ability to use materials planning systems to manage supply and demand plans and resolve exceptions.
  • Understanding of Plan for Every Part (PFEP) principles and their application across the end-to-end supply chain.
  • Knowledge of part change control, including engineering changes, new part releases, supersessions, and obsolescence.
  • Ability to analyze supply chain KPIs, identify gaps, understand customer impact, and support improvement actions.
  • Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to manage complex, high-volume, and sometimes conflicting information.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across different teams, functions, and audiences.
  • Customer-focused approach with the ability to prioritize end-customer requirements.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results.
  • Ability to optimize work processes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other analytical tools.
  • Exposure to automation and analytics tools such as Power BI and SQL , with an interest in leveraging data to improve supply chain processes and reporting efficiency.
  • Experience with planning or business systems and exposure to tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, or similar applications is advantageous.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

  • Materials planning

  • Inventory control

  • Experience working with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve material shortages, delivery constraints, and supply issues.
  • Experience analyzing planning exceptions, inventory data, supply chain KPIs, and root causes is preferred.
  • Exposure to data analytics, automation, Power BI, SQL, or other reporting/analytical tools is desirable.
  • Experience supporting continuous improvement or supply chain optimization initiatives is an advantage.

Core Competencies

job.description:
Job Description

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Home Energy Management Systems (HEMS),edge-to-cloud architecture, IoT ecosystems, and cybersecurity. In this role, they will be responsible for translating product requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable architectural solutions, driving architectural governance, and ensuring seamless integration across HEMS, EcoOS, edge services, data services, core services, and Azure cloud platforms.

job.title: Specialist - Data Center Operations
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The role of Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

This role designs, plans, installs, and / or maintains mechanical, electrical, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability data center environments.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Assist in scheduling and supervising vendors/subcontractors during equipment / systems maintenance and service.
  • Provides recommendation of improvements to the operations and maintenance program on an on-going basis.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Seasoned understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Seasoned proficiency of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Seasoned knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Seasoned knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.)

  • Experience required:
  • Seasoned experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Seasoned experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Seasoned experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Seasoned experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Seasoned experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Sr. Application Architect
job.description:
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team. You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built. In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.

Key job responsibilities We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:

  • Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
  • Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
  • Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
  • Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
  • Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
  • Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
  • Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
  • Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
  • Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
  • Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

  • 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
  • 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
  • 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Remediation Engineer – Cybersecurity Operations
job.description:
Dear Aspirant!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

We are looking for: Cybersecurity Professional - Remediation Engineer – Cybersecurity Operations

You’ll make an impact by

  • Perform standard server patching and security updates in accordance with approved change and maintenance procedures.
  • Execute workstation remediation activities including operating system updates, software updates, hardening, and security configuration changes.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified through enterprise vulnerability scans and security assessments.
  • Perform configuration corrections based on approved security baselines and vulnerability remediation guidance.
  • Support antivirus/EDR remediation activities, including agent health, policy compliance, detection remediation, and security tool recovery.
  • Coordinate vulnerability rescans following remediation and investigate findings that remain open.
  • Perform validation testing to confirm that vulnerabilities and security configuration gaps have been successfully remediated.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation of remediation activities, implementation evidence, and validation results.
  • Coordinate with asset owners and infrastructure/application teams when remediation requires downtime, application changes, or vendor support.
  • Support exception and risk acceptance workflows when remediation cannot be completed within defined timelines.
  • Identify recurring technical remediation challenges and recommend standard fixes, automation, or hardening improvements.
  • Validate remediation through appropriate OT-safe testing, rescanning, configuration verification, and evidence collection without adversely affecting operational processes.
  • Apply compensating controls such as network segmentation, access restrictions, service hardening, application allowlisting, monitoring, or configuration changes when direct patching is not feasible.
  • Plan and execute OT security remediation in coordination with operations, engineering, asset owners, and vendors, ensuring that changes are performed within approved maintenance windows.
  • Perform vulnerability remediation across IT and OT environments, including SCADA, substations, utility systems, HMI, PLC, RTU, DCS, servers, and supporting infrastructure..

Use your skills to move the world forward!

  • B.E./B.Tech./MCA/M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • 6–8 years of experience in infrastructure security, system administration, vulnerability remediation, or cybersecurity operations.
  • Hands-on OT/ICS experience with SCADA, substations, utilities, HMI, PLC, RTU, DCS, industrial control systems, or similar environments.
  • Understanding of OT patching and remediation constraints, including vendor qualification, maintenance windows, system availability, safety considerations, legacy operating systems, and change management.
  • Knowledge of industrial networking and protocols such as IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, OPC/OPC UA, PROFINET, Ethernet/IP, or similar is desirable.
  • Experience applying IEC 62443 principles and OT hardening practices is preferred.
  • Strong hands-on experience with server, workstation, and infrastructure remediation.
  • Good knowledge of Windows and Linux administration, patching, configuration management, and hardening.
  • Experience with vulnerability remediation based on CVE/CVSS findings and scanner recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security, antivirus/EDR platforms, and security agent troubleshooting.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanners such as Tenable, Qualys, Wiz, Rapid7, or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of networking, TLS, authentication, system services, databases, and common enterprise infrastructure components.
  • Ability to perform technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for persistent vulnerabilities.
  • Experience with scripting/automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar is desirable.
  • Strong change management, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Hands-on enterprise experience with patching, hardening, vulnerability remediation, and validation.
  • Certifications such as Microsoft, Linux, Security+, CEH, GIAC, or equivalent are preferred.
  • Preferred Certifications:
  • Microsoft, Linux, Security+, CEH, GIAC, or equivalent infrastructure/security certifications.
  • Key interfaces:
  • Asset Owners | Infrastructure | Application Teams | Vulnerability Management | SOC | Vendors.

job.title: Territory Sales Manager - ACVS Security Products
job.description:
Who we are?

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.**

Work Location : Mumbai, India** What will you do?**

Responsible for driving revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion for the ACVS (Access Control, Video Surveillance & Security) product portfolio across the assigned territory. The role focuses on developing strategic customer relationships, strengthening channel partnerships, expanding market presence, and positioning the company's security products and solutions across key verticals including Commercial Buildings, Data Centers, Manufacturing, BFSI, Transportation, Healthcare, Education, Retail, Power, and Critical Infrastructure.

You will lead business development initiatives, manage key accounts, work closely with consultants and system integrators, and ensure consistent achievement of sales targets while enhancing brand visibility and competitive positioning within the security industry.

**

**

What will you do?

You will execute the territory growth strategy through effective customer engagement, partner development, and disciplined sales execution, including:

  • Achieve assigned revenue, booking, and margin targets for ACVS product lines including Video Surveillance, Access Control, and Integrated Security Solutions.
  • Drive new customer acquisition while expanding wallet share within existing enterprise, government, and strategic accounts.
  • Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, consultant engagement, channel development, and market coverage.
  • Build strong relationships with End Users, Consultants, PMC firms, Architects, System Integrators, EPC Contractors, and Channel Partners to identify and influence projects at an early stage.
  • Position the company's security products and integrated security solutions in key projects and specifications to drive long-term business opportunities.
  • Work closely with channel partners and distributors to improve coverage, capability, and market penetration across the assigned territory.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities, competitive threats, customer trends, and technology requirements, providing regular market intelligence to management.
  • Collaborate with Presales, Product Management, Marketing, Operations, and Leadership teams to develop winning solution strategies and customer value propositions.
  • Review project specifications, RFPs, and tender documents to ensure appropriate product positioning and competitive differentiation.
  • Deliver technical and commercial presentations, product demonstrations, and consultative discussions with customers and influencers.
  • Develop and execute account plans for strategic customers and large opportunities to maximize long-term growth.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, opportunity tracking, and customer records within SFDC or CRM systems.
  • Ensure timely project follow-up, commercial closure, payment collection support, and customer satisfaction throughout the sales cycle.
  • Build and promote the company's reputation as a trusted OEM and security solutions provider by maintaining strong customer engagement and industry visibility.
  • Drive consultant and specification-led business by ensuring inclusion of company products in project designs and approved vendor lists.**

What we look for?**

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Electronics, Electrical, IT, or related discipline.
  • MBA in Marketing or Business Management preferred.

Experience

  • upto 15 years of experience in Security Industry sales, business development, or channel management.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ACVS products including CCTV/Video Surveillance, Access Control, and Security Software Platforms.
  • Proven experience managing large projects, enterprise accounts, consultants, and channel partners.
  • Experience working with OEMs, security solution providers, or system integrators is highly preferred.

**

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of Video Surveillance, VMS platforms, AI Analytics, Access Control, Intrusion Detection, and Integrated Security Solutions.
  • Ability to drive specification and consultant-led business.
  • Strong knowledge of project sales cycles, tendering processes, and commercial negotiations.
  • Excellent customer relationship management and consultative selling skills.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and influencing abilities.
  • Ability to engage with CXOs, Security Heads, IT Teams, Facility Heads, and Procurement stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen with focus on revenue growth, margin management, and market expansion.
  • Experience in managing channel partners, distributors, and system integrator networks.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools, sales forecasting, and pipeline management.
  • Highly self-driven, result-oriented, and capable of operating in a competitive market environment.**

What we offer

We offer a challenging and exciting position as part of a global, multi-industrial corporation. Joining us provides a stimulating work environment, career development opportunities, and the chance to make a significant impact on society.**

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion stems from our core values. We lead with integrity and aim for a future aligned with our customers' vision for success. Our culture fosters engagement, innovation, and collaboration, ensuring every employee contributes to our collective mission.

job.title: Java Devloper
job.description:
