job.title: Salesforce Technical Lead
job.description:
Salesforce Technical Lead

Overview: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Lead with mandatory hands-on expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce and proven experience building custom websites using Salesforce Experience Cloud. In this role, you will own the technical direction for enterprise B2B ecommerce storefronts and customer-facing digital experiences on the Salesforce platform, leading solution design, development, integration, performance optimization, and delivery across commerce capabilities such as catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and self-service experiences. You will partner with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, and onshore/offshore engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable commerce and Experience Cloud solutions while mentoring developers and enforcing Salesforce engineering best practices.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of scalable Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2B ecommerce solutions and Experience Cloud-based customer portals.
  • Build and customize Salesforce Experience Cloud websites, storefronts, portals, and self-service experiences using Experience Builder, custom themes, page templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components.
  • Own solution architecture for B2B commerce capabilities, including product catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and personalized buyer experiences.
  • Develop and customize commerce and Experience Cloud experiences using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), Flow, SOQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, and Experience Builder.
  • Integrate Salesforce Commerce Cloud with ERP, payment, tax, search, shipping, inventory, product information, and order management systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, middleware, and event-driven architecture.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, Delivery Leads, QA, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-architected commerce and Experience Cloud solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership to onshore and offshore developers through design reviews, code reviews, estimation, troubleshooting, coaching, and delivery planning.
  • Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards for code quality, security, performance, governor-limit awareness, accessibility, release readiness, and platform governance.
  • Analyze existing commerce and Experience Cloud implementations and optimize performance, scalability, usability, accessibility, and maintainability across storefront, portal, and backend components.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, integration specifications, data models, deployment notes, website configuration details, and operational support guides.
  • Stay current with Salesforce Commerce Cloud, B2B Commerce, Experience Cloud, Experience Builder, LWR, and platform release updates, recommending improvements that reduce technical debt and improve customer experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including experience leading technical delivery for enterprise Salesforce implementations.
  • Must have hands-on experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce, including storefront configuration, catalog, pricing, cart, checkout, buyer groups, entitlements, and order-related workflows.
  • Must have proven experience building custom websites, portals, and self-service experiences using Salesforce Experience Cloud, including Experience Builder, custom themes, templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components.
  • Strong expertise in Salesforce B2B Commerce on Lightning Experience, Experience Cloud, Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), and Commerce storefront development.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing B2B ecommerce capabilities such as catalogs, price books, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, reorder, account hierarchy, purchase workflows, and order management integrations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, SOSL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, Salesforce data models, security, sharing, and governor limits.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems such as ERP, PIM, OMS, tax, payment, shipping, inventory, search, identity providers, and middleware platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, JSON/XML, and event-driven patterns.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead developers, run technical design discussions, perform code reviews, estimate work, resolve escalated issues, and guide onshore/offshore teams in Agile delivery.
  • Strong understanding of scalable architecture, reusable component design, website performance tuning, accessibility, secure coding practices, release management, and Salesforce DevOps.
  • Proficiency with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Azure Repos, Salesforce DX, Azure Pipelines, or equivalent DevOps tooling.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and tools such as Azure Boards or Jira.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer, Experience Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or System Architect are highly preferred.

job.title: HR Functional Applications Analyst
job.description:
What you will do

As an HR Technology Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting configuration requests and participating in projects. You will be a strategic business partner who applies technology to support business requirements.

Demonstrating Workday expertise, the HR Technology team partners with HR Centers of Expertise and the HR community to answer functionality questions, resolve issues, work with vendors on system‑related concerns, and test new functionality. The team is involved in many different projects, enabling the HR Technology Analyst to work across the business to ensure successful HR processes.

You will also support and manage day‑to‑day operations with Paradox and HiredScore to ensure smooth recruiter workflows and high‑quality candidate engagement.

The Analyst will be involved in the deployment of new Workday features as well as operational improvements; this includes implementing new security roles, leading configuration changes, and executing end-to-end testing for Workday upgrades.

How you will do it

  • Configure changes in Workday based on business requirements.
  • Configure and maintain Workday Recruit processes, including job requisitions, job postings, candidate stages, screening steps, and offer workflows to support a seamless recruiting lifecycle.
  • Project team member/lead for the design and implementation of new Workday functionalities, including business process configuration, testing, interface and integration support, implementation through deployment, and postproduction support.
  • Support processes within Workday, with a particular focus on recruiting workflows and TA related functionality.
  • Develop strong relationships with internal partners, including the Talent Acquisition CoE, to gain an understanding of business requirements and translate them into effective system solutions.
  • Create custom Workday reports as needed to meet business needs/objectives.
  • Plan, coordinate, and implement testing efforts for changes within Workday, including recruiting related enhancements and integrations.
  • Support the design, development, and performance of Workday and related business data and processes. Focus on identifying trends, resolving root causes, predicting future implications, and finding solutions to drive effective business decisions.
  • Proactively identify and assist in prioritizing opportunities to streamline business and/or system processes, especially within the recruiting lifecycle.
  • Lead biyearly Workday upgrades, including end-to-end testing of Workday Recruit functionality.
  • Partner with the Talent Acquisition CoE to analyze and enhance the candidate journey, using Workday Recruit configuration and supporting technologies to streamline application flow and improve candidate experience.
  • Oversee daily operations and optimization of Paradox and HiredScore, including troubleshooting issues, monitoring performance, driving adoption, and identifying enhancements that improve recruiter efficiency and candidate engagement.

What we look for

Required

  • Degree in business or management information systems, HR (CIPD), or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience with case management, specifically ServiceNow.
  • Experience with Human Capital Management systems, ideally Workday.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to prioritize and find solutions in a timely manner.
  • Self-motivated and self-organized working style with the ability to work effectively on diverse project teams.
  • Customer service focus and flexibility in supporting business unit needs.
  • Demonstrated competence in presenting concepts clearly and accurately with strong written and verbal interpersonal skills. Able to positively represent Johnson Controls and communicate with others at varying managerial and technical levels.
  • Commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
  • History of significant customer satisfaction, building rapport, and influencing decisions while working in a consultative role with customers.

Preferred

We’d ideally love you to have experience as a contributing team member within HR operational projects and new implementations, including the full change request lifecycle (solution design, configuration, testing, communication, etc.). An overall understanding of HR data, HR processes, and the change/implementation life cycle is important.

Workday experience is highly desirable, particularly in configuring and supporting:

  • Workday Recruit (job requisitions, job postings, candidate stages, screening steps, offer workflows, and recruiting related security)
  • Payroll
  • Compensation
  • Time Off
  • Reporting
  • Security

How you will do it

Application and Special Quotation Support

Product & Product Applications Development

  • Engagement in industry organizations and technical seminars

What we look for

BE/ Btech - Mechanical or Electrical and minimum 3 years of HVAC or refrigeration related experience in application engineering, product engineering or technical marketing is required.

Demonstrated business management skills in product application environment preferred

Technically savvy, possessing strong knowledge of application and field practices related to air cooled chillers

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite Applications

Strong verbal and written English skills

Acts as on-site project leader to plan, execute, and complete assigned projects. Delegates tasks to execute and fully complete assigned projects. Coordinates communication with customer during all phases of the project. Coordinates the work of subcontractors.

How you will do it:

  • Define scope, budget and schedule for projects

  • Identify potential project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions
  • Establish effective communication with customer

  • Ensure and monitor compliance to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards and specifications.
  • Perform regular quality audit for all the suppliers and sub-contractors.
  • Identify and secure variation order.
  • Cost control. Track, monitor and ensure delivery of financial commitment as per CIS.
  • Managing reports and documents
  • Work closely with Sales team for tender bidding
  • Supervision of sub-contractors’ work at site.

  • Assign task to, and supervise Assistant Project Engineer, Technician, if any.

  • Follow-up on payment from customers and verify payment to our suppliers.

  • 2 years of supervisory experience
  • Require interaction with clients, consultants and sub-contractors, etc.
  • Need to work odd hours as and when required, whenever the work need to be done on time.

What we offer

  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities

job.title: Manager - Zero Trust
job.description:
Job Code:

Job Code Name:

Business Title: Manager – Zero Trust

Region: APAC – Bengaluru/Pune

Country: India

Grade: 175

What you will do

As Manager – Zero Trust, you will own the Zero Trust strategy and roadmap, aligned to NIST SP 800-207 and the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model. You will drive measurable removal of implicit trust across identity, devices, networks, applications and data, and approve the designs that go to production. You will lead and grow a multi-disciplinary team through structured Zero Trust training, clear performance management and real delegation. You will deliver concurrent programs with sprint discipline, operational SLAs and audit readiness. You will also act as the organization's Zero Trust advocate with IT partners.

What we look for

Required

  • 10+ years in cybersecurity, across network security, identity, cloud or security architecture, with meaningful hands-on depth rather than oversight only.
  • 6+ years of direct people management. We mean line management with hiring, development, performance, retention and succession accountability, not technical leadership of a project team.
  • Practical Zero Trust experience in role. You have designed, implemented or led Zero Trust initiatives in an enterprise, and can describe what you changed, how you measured it and what went wrong.
  • Strong grounding in Zero Trust principles and frameworks, including NIST SP 800-207, the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model or equivalent, and the judgment to apply them to a real, imperfect estate.
  • Working knowledge across several Zero Trust domains:

o ZTNA and SSE/SASE

o Microsegmentation

o Identity and access management

o Privileged access

o Conditional access and MFA

o Device trust

o Application and developer-environment access

o Data protection

  • Experience developing security strategies, architectures and roadmaps, and owning their delivery from design through build, operation and automation.
  • Enough technical depth to credibly review and challenge designs from senior network and identity engineers.
  • Experience leading the response to high-severity security incidents. This means coordinating IT, legal and business teams through containment, remediation and post-incident control improvement.
  • Experience building or scaling a team, not only inheriting one, including managing across regions and planning capacity.
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills. You can explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and defend a technical position to senior leadership.

Preferred

  • Zero Trust certification, such as the CSA Certificate of Competence in Zero Trust (CCZT), Forrester Zero Trust Strategist, or a vendor Zero Trust certification.
  • Broader security or architecture certification, such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SANS (GIAC) or TOGAF.
  • Hands-on experience with leading Zero Trust platforms, for example:

o SSE/ZTNA: Zscaler or Netskope

o Microsegmentation: Guardicore or Illumio

o Identity and IDaaS: Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping Identity or Google Cloud Identity

o Identity governance: SailPoint, Saviynt or equivalent

o Privileged access management

  • Network security background across on-premises and cloud:

o On-premises: firewall policy and rule management, IDS/IPS, network access control, remote access VPN and internet proxies.

o Cloud: cloud proxies, cloud web application firewall and API protection (WAF/WAAP), and Azure or GCP security services.

  • Cloud security posture management across multi-cloud environments (CSPM/CNAPP).
  • Security operations experience, including SIEM tools such as Splunk for log analysis and event correlation, and risk-based vulnerability management.
  • AI security experience, either securing enterprise use of AI or applying AI to security operations.
  • Exposure to OT and IoT security, including IEC 62443.
  • Automation experience, such as Python, PowerShell, low-code platforms or ITSM integration.
  • Experience in a large, regulated enterprise with a legacy estate, M&A activity and real technical debt.
  • Working knowledge of security and regulatory frameworks, such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001, SOX, PCI DSS, GDPR and HIPAA.

Johnson Controls International plc. is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view[ EEO is the Law](https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/migrated_files/employers/poster_screen_reader_optimized.pdf). If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers](https://www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers).

job.title: Anaplan Scrum Master
job.description:
Anaplan Scrum Master

Johnson Controls is looking for an experienced Scrum Master to support Anaplan-driven planning work across business and technology teams. In this role, you will help teams deliver with clarity, keep priorities aligned, and improve how planning solutions move from ideas to release.

Role Overview

This role is focused on guiding Agile delivery for Anaplan initiatives in a collaborative enterprise environment. You will partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, model builders, analysts, and technical teams to keep delivery organized, transparent, and moving forward. We are looking for someone with 7+ years of experience who can bring structure, momentum, and steady facilitation to complex planning work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, and release planning.
  • Partner with Product Owners to keep the backlog prioritized, clear, and ready for sprint execution.
  • Translate business needs into user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria that support Anaplan delivery.
  • Coordinate across business users, Product Owners, model builders, analysts, and technical teams to maintain alignment on scope, dependencies, and delivery goals.
  • Support UAT activities by helping validate delivered solutions against acceptance criteria and business expectations.
  • Track impediments, risks, and delivery blockers, and help drive timely resolution.
  • Protect the team from unnecessary scope creep and external disruptions while keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Support transparency through delivery updates, sprint health indicators, and progress reporting.
  • Encourage continuous improvement in planning, collaboration, and release readiness.

How You Will Do It

  • Own outcomes with accountability and integrity by keeping commitments visible, raising risks early, and following through on agreed actions.
  • Stay close to the work by understanding the details of Anaplan delivery, removing blockers quickly, and helping the team focus on what matters most.
  • Improve every day by using retrospectives, candid conversation, and practical problem-solving to strengthen flow, quality, and predictability.
  • Win as one team by building trust across business and technology partners, respecting diverse perspectives, and supporting shared goals.
  • Use Agile ceremonies and delivery data to keep the team aligned, informed, and ready for the next sprint.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience, including proven experience as a Scrum Master in an Agile environment.
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, and Agile frameworks.
  • Experience translating business requirements into user stories, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience supporting Anaplan initiatives or enterprise planning solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to influence without authority and navigate change effectively.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-moving environment.
  • Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with financial forecasting, commercial planning, workforce planning, or other enterprise planning processes in Anaplan.
  • Exposure to Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, or similar collaboration tools.
  • Experience supporting UAT, release readiness, and delivery metrics reporting.
  • Familiarity with The Anaplan Way or similar structured planning delivery methods.

Why Join Us

You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of planning, technology, and business delivery, helping teams turn requirements into practical Anaplan solutions. This role offers meaningful collaboration, visibility across functions, and the chance to strengthen Agile ways of working in a supportive environment.

job.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
job.description:
Salesforce Technical Architect - Bangalore

Johnson Controls is looking for a Salesforce Technical Architect in Bangalore to design scalable, secure Salesforce solutions and guide technical delivery across the platform.

Role Overview

In this role, you will own the technical architecture for complex Salesforce initiatives, translating business needs into practical, well-designed solutions. You will work closely with technical teams and stakeholders to shape integrations, data design, security, and deployment practices that support long-term platform success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of scalable Salesforce solutions for complex business requirements.
  • Translate business needs into well-architected technical solutions aligned to strategic goals.
  • Mentor Salesforce tech leads, developers, data analysts, and integration developers.
  • Conduct technical design reviews and code reviews to support quality and maintainability.
  • Architect integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Define the system architecture landscape, identify gaps, and deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Implement platform security best practices for authentication, data sharing, and encryption.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, QA, and Change Management teams for deployments and performance.

How You Will Do It

  • Own outcomes with accountability, security, and integrity, while making sound technical decisions that stand up to enterprise use.
  • Stay close to the work, remove blockers early, and keep the focus on solutions that matter for the customer.
  • Use candor, root-cause thinking, and continuous improvement to strengthen the platform over time.
  • Win as one team by collaborating with developers, QA, DevOps, change management, and business stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10-12 years of experience with Salesforce platform architecture and development across multiple cloud platforms.
  • Strong understanding of scalable, performance-driven solutions and design patterns for large data volumes.
  • Deep knowledge of data modeling, governance, and management within Salesforce.
  • Experience architecting integrations with external systems using REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with authentication and authorization, including SSO.
  • Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation tools.
  • Experience leading technical teams.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Fluent in English.

Nice to Have

  • Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or Service Cloud experience.
  • Active Salesforce certifications such as Application Architect, System Architect, or Technical Architect.

Why Join Us

Join a collaborative team where you can shape enterprise Salesforce architecture, mentor others, and contribute to secure, high-performing solutions that support business growth. If you enjoy solving complex problems and working across teams, this role offers the chance to make a real impact.

If this sounds like the right next step for you, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Intern, Investor Relations & Communications (Jan 27 - Jun 27)
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As of 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

As part of the Investor Relations & Communications team of CapitaLand Investment Limited, you will support a range of initiatives across both functions, including financial reporting, investor engagement, and corporate communications.

Responsibilities

  • Support the preparation of key deliverables such as quarterly financial results, annual reports, stock market analyses, and financial marketing materials in a timely manner
  • Assist in preparing investor profiles, briefing materials, and presentation decks for investor meetings and conferences
  • Provide event support for investor relations activities, including results briefings, non-deal roadshows, and investor conferences
  • Support the development of internal materials, including board paper, research updates, daily market summaries and peer benchmarking
  • Curate and create engaging content and visuals for social media platforms and CLI website
  • Analyse and report on CLI’s and competitors’ social media content and performance
  • Maintain and update corporate website content
  • Assist in the development of the CapitaLand Investment Wikipedia page
  • Support in the management of content libraries and information databases (eg. image/video library; media database)
  • Perform any ad-hoc tasks as assigned

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Degree in Finance, Accountancy, or any other relevant disciplines
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
  • Familiarity with Bloomberg, and digital content and design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, social media management and Content Management Systems (CMS) is an advantage
  • Strong organisational and communications skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Detail-oriented , meticulous, and able to work accurately under time constraints
  • Basic understanding of real estate, finance, and/or accounting concepts

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Hardware Engineer, AI Cluster Commissioning
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Hardware Engineer, AI Cluster Commissioning, is a hands-on team player who will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient deployment, test, and operation of our HyperCube systems. The ideal candidate will be involved in the commissioning and remediation of the latest AI cluster platforms including compute, network, and storage components, provide high-quality technical support, troubleshoot issues, and work with vendors and partners to resolve them in a timely manner. This role requires hands-on work in demanding data center environments, including equipment installation, hardware replacement, structured cabling, and physical infrastructure remediation activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the deployment, commissioning, and remediation of large-scale AI clusters comprising thousands of GPUs, high-speed networks, and high-performance storage systems.
  • Support site teams during commissioning, testing, and equipment setup.
  • Assist with system installations, modifications, and setup as part of the commissioning team.
  • Assist with network cabling and integration.
  • Diagnose server, GPU, storage, and networking failures.
  • Collect logs and diagnostic information, support technical teams during failure investigations, and assist engineering teams in identifying recurring failure patterns and root causes.
  • Perform component-level replacement and remediation.
  • Execute hardware validation procedures and acceptance tests.
  • Verify firmware, cabling, and system configurations.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide timely updates and technical support to project and operations teams, ensuring smooth collaboration.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Keep accurate service records, equipment logs, and submit required documentation promptly.
  • Safety & Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols.
  • Training & Development: Stay current on equipment, processes, and industry standards through ongoing learning.
  • Inventory & Quality Control: Maintain tools, spare parts, and equipment inventory.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Required

  • Diploma or equivalent, technical certification, trade qualification.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role, including hands-on experience with IT equipment maintenance and repair.
  • Good problem-solving and communication skills. Proven to be able to work effectively under direction.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as required during system commissioning.
  • Must hold an unrestricted driver’s license.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with high-density GPU server and rack environments.
  • Experience with data center networking and structured cabling.
  • Experience performing hardware diagnostics and component replacement.
  • Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command-line troubleshooting.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely lift and move IT equipment.
  • Ability to work in data center environments for extended periods.
  • Comfortable working in confined spaces and around high-density equipment racks.
  • Willingness to undertake domestic and international travel for deployment and commissioning activities.

Employment Basis

Full-time

job.title: Staff Information Security Engineer, Product Security
job.description:
About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

The Information Security Engineer (ISE) team mission is to make it easy for Google and the world to ship secure products. The Singapore-based team is focused on scaling our operations and risk reduction efforts through advanced automation and remediation. Our mission is to safeguard billions of users by efficiently triaging external security reports and proactively eliminating classes of vulnerabilities across Google's products and infrastructure. We aim to evolve into a self-sustaining, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-motivated operation that provides deep insights into vulnerability trends while fostering a community of security researchers.

In this role, you will lead a team of security engineers to scale our capacity to perform research, conduct analysis, derive risk insights and drive large-scale remediation projects across Google. You will also guide the development of AI agents to automate root cause analysis, variant analysis and trend analysis of vulnerabilities. You will be a technical leader, able to mentor, and guide other engineers, fostering a collaborative environment to achieve collective goals. You will have a technical foundation and exceptional cross-functional collaboration skills to manage complex security tests and operations. You will have a breadth of application security experience: web security, mobile security, Application Programming Interface (API) security, authentication and access control, threat modeling, conducting security assessments, etc.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to teammates. Understand and advise others on complex processes and workflows related to product security response and remediation efforts.
  • Foster global collaboration and maintain a high level of operational independence while collaborating with Global Leads in the United States (US) and Zurich to align on remediation efforts.
  • Drive end-to-end development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents and infrastructure to automate root cause analysis, variant analysis, trend analysis, remediation to reduce manual workloads.
  • Build and maintain a unified vulnerability analysis pipeline and dashboarding system to provide executive-level insights into emerging threats and program Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Drive large-scale remediation efforts that eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities across Google’s products and infrastructure.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Product Manager, Google Wallet
job.description:
About the job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

As a Product Manager on the CPX Surfaces team, you will help shape the Google Wallet Android app, used by hundreds of millions of people around the world. You will own a significant piece of the product, driving new features from early discovery through launch. You will partner directly with an engineering team in Singapore, while collaborating with our global teams, to drive Wallet and Google Pay forward. **

Responsibilities

  • Define the product goal and roadmap for your specific surface areas within the Wallet Android app, guiding features from early ideation through launch and iteration.
  • Work day-to-day with your engineering team in Singapore and global User Experience (UX) teams to design, build, and ship high-quality consumer experiences.
  • Translate Wallet’s broader account-based goal into tangible mobile features that bring real value to our user's everyday lives.
  • Leverage user research, market insights, and product metrics to prioritize what we build, balance trade-offs, and measure success.
  • Align with Product Managers (PMs) and cross-functional teams across San Francisco/Mountain View/New York (SFO/MTV/NYC) to ensure your features integrate seamlessly into the broader Google Wallet and Google Pay ecosystem.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: PCB Engineer
job.description:
The PCB Engineer will join the L7 - IN - NUMERIC - PCB Technical department of IN - NOVATEUR ELECTRICAL & DIGITAL SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED (NEDS) in Raipur. The role focuses on end‑to‑end PCB development, hands‑on repair, failure analysis, and ensuring high‑quality production through effective soldering, troubleshooting, and fault‑finding techniques.

Responsibilities

  • Design and layout printed circuit boards based on engineering specifications.
  • Perform hands‑on soldering, component placement, and rework on prototype and production boards.
  • Conduct failure analysis and root‑cause investigations for defective PCBs.
  • Develop and execute test plans for functional verification and reliability testing.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to resolve design and manufacturing issues.
  • Maintain documentation of design changes, repair procedures, and analysis results.
  • Support the RRC (Reliability, Repair, and Certification) process for product releases.
  • Provide technical guidance and training to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and internal quality guidelines.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives for PCB processes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • 1–5 years of hands‑on experience in PCB repair, failure analysis, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in soldering techniques, including surface‑mount and through‑hole components.
  • Strong knowledge of electronic circuit theory and component behavior.
  • Familiarity with PCB design tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCad, or Eagle).
  • Ability to read and interpret schematics, layout files, and bill of materials.
  • Experience with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and logic analyzers.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and attention to detail in fault finding.
  • Effective communication skills for cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Willingness to work in Numeric Raipur location and adhere to project timelines.

job.title: Quality Technician
job.description:
At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Quality Technician to join the Power & Thermal Management division in Tuas, Singapore.

The Quality Technician position is responsible for ensuring that all purchased material is reviewed & inspected for conformance against defined criteria using the necessary measurement and inspection equipment. He/She also responsible for resolving the nonconforming materials with the vendors, and provide the support to production ensuring manufacturing processes are followed along with identifying and aiding in the troubleshooting of quality related issues.

Responsibilities

Main Job Duties:

  • Inspection of all incoming material to determine conformance with applicable drawings, specifications, and/or instructions
  • Perform First Article Inspections (FAI) on new part submissions
  • Records inspection results into defined repository

  • Experience supporting enterprise analytics, reporting, and data product initiatives.

Job Description

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Tax Analyst to join our Compensation Tax -Global Finance Services Division.

The incumbent would play a key role in supporting accounting, expatriate taxation, and payroll functions. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with diverse business partners across global operations, ensuring compliance and accuracy in expatriate tax and U.S. payroll tax processes.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield Office, Bangalore, India

What you will do

Expatriate Tax Compliance:

  • Assist the Manager in globally managing the expatriate tax compliance process across nearly 50 host countries to ensure timely filing of tax returns and adherence to tax equalization policies.
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to coordinate expatriate tax filings, payments, and settlements for approximately 1,500 current and repatriated expatriates.
  • Analyse & compile data and respond to U.S. federal and state tax authority notices and communicate with tax authorities to address and resolve tax notices/audits
  • Lead the Global Tax Equalization Acceptance process, manage tax files with external service providers, create supporting documentation for U.S. federal and state income tax payments.
  • Lead tax-related accounting activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and providing detailed tax information.
  • Analyses and opines on proposed changes to U.S. tax legislations and regulations with regard to the impact on compensation compliance requirements or calculations, requiring in-depth experience, knowledge and judgment. Participates on teams within or outside of the U.S. on tax and business initiatives.

Payroll Tax Compliance:

  • Support the daily import of payroll tax payment files for all U.S. payroll entities.
  • Review daily tax payments and assist with the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual federal, state, and local tax filings, including Forms 940 and 941 for all payroll entities.
  • Communicate with tax authorities to address and resolve tax notices, facilitate the application process for tax identification numbers, and manage related correspondence
  • Phone call to tax authorities to resolve tax notices, applying for tax identification numbers etc.
  • Assist the Manager to support the U.S. Federal/state Reporting & Analysis team (1120 team) with compensation/payroll related information including Schedule M for Executive Officer Aircraft, Executive Compensation 162(m) and payroll apportionment for state tax allocation.

Key Partnerships:

  • Collaborate with business partners such as Ernst & Young, Cartus, eTrade, Global Payroll, the Global Mobility team (HR), Legal, Treasury, Compensation & Benefits, Executive Compensation, and Legal Entity/Business Unit Accounting teams across global operations.

What you will have

  • Bachelor's or master’s level degree related to Accounting or Finance
  • 4-6 years of tax related experience at Big 4 public accounting firm and/or large multinational corporation would be preferred
  • Experience with HR, payroll, and tax processes/systems/software (MasterTax, WorkDay, G/L, CorpTax, Excel)
  • Enrolled Agent Certification or CPA, would be an added advantage
  • Understanding of accounting and business processes, and enterprise operations
  • Research and opine on complex tax technical issues
  • Broad technical knowledge of tax laws and regulations
  • Proven ability to work with a team and eager to take on new challenges
  • Demonstrate high levels of initiative, good judgment, excellent analytical and communication skills

Additional Information:

  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office

Skills desired:

Accuracy and Attention to Detail:Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
  • Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy.
  • Productively balances speed and accuracy.
  • Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals.
  • Implements a variety of cross-checking approaches and mechanisms.
  • Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.

Analytical Thinking:Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Seeks discrepancies and inconsistencies in available information; explains variances.
  • Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation.
  • Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research.
  • Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action.
  • Approaches a complex problem by breaking it down into its component parts.
  • Chooses among a diverse set of analytical tools according to the nature of the situation.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking:Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.

job.title: AVP, Corporate Enterprise Identity Systems
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission

Make identity StarHub’s enterprise control plane: one canonical identity, Google Workspace / Cloud Identity as the workforce front door, planned AD retirement, and accountable governance of all identities.

Own the end-to-end identity roadmap across architecture, authoritative sources, migration, lifecycle and operations, enabling Zero Trust, AWS, M&A and safe AI adoption.

Accountabilities

  • Own the Identity-Led Enterprise strategy and 18-month roadmap, delivering approved scope, budget and milestones.
  • Own the canonical identity model (Global Person ID), authoritative sources and attribute precedence across SuccessFactors and legacy M&A sources.
  • Establish Google Workspace / Cloud Identity as the sole workforce authentication and SSO front door.
  • Retire AD as a workforce authority: inventory dependencies, then migrate, federate, retire or time-bound exceptions.
  • Govern privileged, non-human and AI-agent identities so privileged/autonomous actions remain attributable to an accountable human.
  • Implement CISO-set identity policy; BTS operates it, while the CISO owns policy, risk acceptance and exceptions.
  • Report status, risks and decisions to the CIO, ISLT and ICC, and own the Identity OKR.

Strategy & Architecture

  • Translate the Identity-Led Enterprise position paper into a phased architecture covering authoritative sources, canonical identity, Google front door, access enforcement, workload access and telemetry.
  • Define AD-to-Google coexistence, including event authority, JML and exit criteria for every AD dependency.
  • Select IGA/PAM tooling that supports the Google-first model without creating a second identity authority.
  • Set integration and onboarding standards for applications, AWS, endpoints, integration and AI platforms.

Delivery & Migration

  • Lead matrixed architecture, security, engineering, project resources and partners; control scope, sequencing, RAID and budget.
  • Deliver migration waves with identity clean-up, role/group rationalisation, orphan-account testing and validated deprovisioning.
  • Automate JML from SuccessFactors and approved contractor/guest workflows, including sponsors, end dates and revalidation.
  • Reconcile MyRepublic, JOS and Strateq under the canonical model using match logic, confidence thresholds, adjudication and merge/unmerge controls.

Governance & Controls

  • Separate standard and privileged personas; enforce named approvals, break-glass controls and quarterly access certification.
  • Maintain a non-human identity registry covering owner, purpose, environment, credentials, review and decommission trigger.
  • Enforce zero net-new unmanaged shared/generic accounts and reduce existing account debt to a published schedule.
  • Govern AI agents as non-human identities with approved purpose, data domains, actions and act-as/on-behalf-of modes, aligned to the IMDA Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI.
  • Feed GWS, AWS, endpoints and critical applications into the SIEM using common identity identifiers.
  • Provide audit evidence for identity controls, including CCoP and internal audit.

Qualifications

Team, Vendors & Stakeholders

  • Lead and develop the IAM Specialist across identity engineering, governance and controls.
  • Own the IAM managed-service vendor, including scope, SLAs/KPIs, reviews, change and commercial performance.
  • Retain StarHub design authority and control ownership; build internal capability and reduce vendor dependency under the IS Best Team insourcing strategy.
  • Partner with HR and application/platform owners on data quality, lifecycle, roles, approvals and provisioning.
  • Optimise Google/Microsoft licensing as AD retires; track business-case benefits and report realisation to Finance.

Areas of Impact

  • Zero Trust enforcement across the corporate estate.
  • Single-provider SSO and improved employee/partner sign-in.
  • AD retirement and associated Microsoft licence savings.
  • Fewer orphaned, shared and ownerless accounts and cleaner audits.
  • Safe, attributable AI-agent adoption.
  • Faster, lower-cost future M&A integration.
  • Move Identity from Legacy to Intelligent on the IS estate map by FY30, and Identity & Access from L2 to L4.

Ideal Track Record

  • 12+ years in identity and access management, security architecture or enterprise platforms, including leading at least one enterprise IAM programme end to end.
  • Has led at least one large directory migration or consolidation (for example on-premises AD to a cloud IdP such as Google Cloud Identity, Entra ID or Okta) in an organisation of several thousand identities.
  • Hands-on depth in identity lifecycle and JML automation, IGA, PAM, SSO / federation (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and access certification.
  • Experience governing non-human identities: service accounts, workload identity, secrets and certificate-based patterns, ideally including AWS IAM.
  • Working knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and emerging identity controls for AI agents.
  • Experience reconciling identities across multiple HR systems or after mergers and acquisitions.
  • Has presented to C-level or board committees and won funding and decisions with clear business cases.
  • Delivers through a lean team and influence: managed-service vendors, system integrators and matrixed teams, with a track record of holding vendors to SLAs and outcomes.
  • Has coached and developed junior engineers or specialists.
  • Familiarity with Singapore requirements (CSA Cybersecurity Code of Practice, PDPA, IMDA AI governance) preferred.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CCSP, IDPro CIDPro, Google Cloud or AWS security) are an advantage.

job.title: Data Center, Contract Commercial Manager
job.description:
About the role

  • To own contract governance and contracting for a designated contract or line of business within CBRE Data Center Solutions (DCS)- Direct Line Business, making sure every agreement is issued on approved templates, reviewed, agreed, executed, and filed correctly.
  • The Contract Commercial Manager is the day-to-day contracting contact for the client and works with the operational team so that quotations are submitted in a form that allows contracts to come through cleanly and quickly.
  • The role operates within the commercial frameworks, templates, and delegations of authority set by the Divisional Commercial Director

What You’ll Do:

Contract Governance and Execution

  • Ensure all contracts, statements of work, purchase orders, variations, and change orders for the contract or line of business are issued on CBRE-approved templates and the agreed framework terms.
  • Review contract documents once issued by the client, checking scope, pricing, payment terms, and key provisions against the approved template, the agreed framework, and the quotation submitted.
  • Identify departures from the approved position and liaise with the client to correct them, escalating material deviations as required.
  • Manage documents through internal review and delegation of authority approval to execution, making sure the correct version is signed by the correct signatory.
  • File executed contracts and supporting records in the designated repository and keep the contract register complete and current.
  • Track key dates and obligations, including expiry, renewal, notice periods, insurance, and security requirements, and flag them to the business in time to act.

Client Liaison

  • Act as the primary commercial contact for the client on contracting matters for the assigned contract or line of business.
  • Build working relationships with the client's procurement, and contracts teams to keep documents moving and turnaround times short.
  • Resolve contracting queries and administrative issues, such as version control, missing information, or purchase order mismatches, before they delay execution or payment.
  • Attend client and account governance meetings where contracting matters are on the agenda.

Quotation Quality and Team Support

  • Work with operational and account teams so that quotations are prepared on the approved templates, reference the correct framework terms, and set out the scope, assumptions, and exclusions needed for a clean contract.
  • Review quotations before submission for compliance with commercial policy, pricing rules, and delegations of authority.
  • Give the team practical feedback where a quotation has caused contracting delays or disputes, and fix the process issue behind it.
  • Maintain standard assumptions, exclusions, and quotation guidance for the contract or line of business.

Commercial Policy / Procedure Compliance

  • Promote compliance with CBRE governance policies, procedures, and delegations of authority.
  • Maintain and advise on the use of standard documentation and templates, and recommend updates to the Commercial Director where templates no longer fit the work.
  • Check and challenge business processes for compliance, and report exceptions.
  • Provide accurate contract data for Business Reviews, audits, and commercial reporting.

Educate and Advise

  • Advise the operational team on contractual obligations, including scope, change control, notices, and invoicing requirements.
  • Deliver briefings and training on the quotation-to-contract process and the correct use of templates.
  • Raise commercial awareness across the team through day-to-day guidance and team meetings.

In-Life Contract Management

  • Administer change control and variations in line with the contract, making sure changes are documented and agreed before work proceeds.
  • Identify commercial risk arising in delivery, such as scope creep or work performed without a signed contract or valid purchase order, and escalate with options.
  • Support the Commercial Director on renewals, claims, and disputes by providing contract history, correspondence, and supporting documentation.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Contracts issued on approved templates, with deviations identified and resolved or approved before signature.
  • Contracts executed before work starts; no work performed without a signed contract or valid purchase order.
  • Contract review and execution turnaround times met.
  • Contract register and filing complete, accurate, and audit ready.
  • Quotations submitted in the correct format, reducing rework and contracting delays.
  • Key dates and obligations flagged in time; no missed renewals or notice periods.
  • Positive client feedback on responsiveness and quality of contracting support.
  • Operational team understands and follows the quotation-to-contract process.

What You’ll Need:

  • These are the capabilities we consider essential for success in this role.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the discipline to spot where a contract departs from the approved template or the quotation it reflects.
  • Sound working knowledge of services contracts, including scope, pricing and payment terms, change control, liability, insurance, and termination.
  • Organised and process driven, able to manage a high volume of documents through review, approval, execution, and filing without losing track.
  • Confident dealing with client procurement and contracts teams, and able to explain contractual requirements to operational colleagues in plain terms.
  • Sound judgement on when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate.

Person Specification

  • The following describes the background our ideal candidate will bring. We welcome applications from those who are strong across most of these areas.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Working knowledge of commercial contracts in facilities management, Project/Construction -engineering services, outsourcing, or professional services environments.
  • Understanding of common pricing approaches, including fixed price, schedule of rates, and cost-plus, and how they translate into contract terms.
  • Familiarity with contract registers, document control, and contract lifecycle management systems.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word (tracked changes and document comparison) and Excel.
  • Typically, 4-6 years in contract administration, contract management, or commercial roles.
  • Experience reviewing client contract documents against templates or standard terms and managing them through approval and execution.
  • Experience working with operational teams on quotations, pricing submissions, or tender documentation.
  • Experience liaising directly with client procurement or contracts teams.
  • Degree qualified or equivalent experience. A qualification in law, commerce, contract management, quantity surveying or a related discipline is an advantage.

Location:

  • Based in Singapore - HQ Office (Tanjong Katong, PLQ)
  • Office base role - 5 days per week

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

job.title: Procurement Project Manager
job.description:
About Us

Macquarie Data Centres are Australia's most experienced Data Centre Provider and experts in seriously secure, sovereign and compliant data centres.

Our AI and cloud data centres are trusted by the world’s biggest hyperscalers, Global Fortune 500 companies and 42% of the Australian Federal Government. All our campuses are Certified Strategic by the Australian Federal Government and backed by a highly experienced cohort of government cleared engineers.

We are an owned by the ASX listed Macquarie Technology Group.

Step into one of Australia’s most secure, high-performance Data Centres and launch your engineering career supporting mission-critical infrastructure for cloud, defence and enterprise customers.

The Opportunity

We're building Australia's next generation of hyperscale and enterprise data centres, and we're looking for an experienced Contracts Manager to play a pivotal role in bringing these critical infrastructure projects to life.

Reporting to the Executive General Manager – Commercial, you'll be responsible for the commercial and contractual management of major project agreements from procurement through to execution and handover. You'll act as the central point of coordination across Procurement, Legal, Finance, Project Delivery, Engineering and our key vendors, ensuring contracts are commercially robust, compliant and executed seamlessly.

This is a highly visible role where you'll influence the successful delivery of multi-million-dollar infrastructure projects by managing long-lead equipment contracts, supporting main contractor engagements, administering commercial events and driving strong contractual governance throughout the project lifecycle.

If you thrive in complex project environments, enjoy negotiating commercial outcomes and want to work on some of Australia's most significant data centre developments, we'd love to hear from you.

We're building Australia's next generation of hyperscale and enterprise data centres, and we're looking for an experienced Contracts Manager to play a pivotal role in bringing these critical infrastructure projects to life.

For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award! About You

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to negotiate favourable contractual outcomes while managing risk.
  • Confident working across Legal, Procurement, Finance, Engineering and Delivery teams to achieve common objectives.
  • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail and a passion for maintaining robust contract governance.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leaders, contractors and suppliers.

job.title: Project Delivery, Senior Manager, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Senior Project Manager (Melbourne)

The Senior Project Manager plays a key role within the Construction team, leading the delivery of data center construction projects from conception through commissioning. This is a largescale, complex and technical construction projects where you will oversee both internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment across Sales, Operations, Development, and Engineering, while maintaining long term operational sustainability, cost efficiency, and schedule adherence.

You will be responsible for managing the end-to end delivery of construction and capital expenditure works for the Melbourne Campus Expansion. Core responsibilities include coordinating cross-functional teams, advising on design and construction frameworks, driving contractor performance, ensuring compliance with safety and local regulations, and implementing project controls to deliver projects on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

This is a high-visibility role that allows the Senior Project Manager to shape Vantage’s project delivery standards and operational excellence, while working closely with internal teams and stakeholders across the APAC region.

Essential Job Functions

  • Project Delivery: Lead the delivery of large-scale, complex data center construction projects from conception through commissioning within the Construction team. Oversee all project activities including utility interfacing, budgets, schedules, procurement strategies, and ECI interface.
  • Project Controls and Administration: Manage consulting deliverables and ensure alignment with project objectives and milestones. Supervise in-house quantity surveyors (QS), administer contracts, including progress claims, certificates, and related documentation. Track critical milestones, timelines, budgets, and project risks to ensure timely and successful delivery.
  • Contractor Management: Manage contractors and vendors, coordinating performance, compliance, and integration with project objectives. Oversee logistics, deliveries, and procurement to support project timelines.
  • Safety and Compliance: Act as a safety leader, fostering a culture of safety, security, and environmental responsibility across in-house teams and contractors. Ensure health, safety, and environmental compliance in all aspects of project execution.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive coordination and integration of internal partners and cross-functional teams, including New Site Development (NSD), Design & Engineering (D&E), Construction, Procurement, and Critical Operations, to deliver world-class data centers. Perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with exposure to global customers and complex technical challenges.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor of Science in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8-10 years in a senior management or project management role, with substantial experience in complex and technical construction projects.
  • Candidate from data centre industry is preferred, or Project Management with general contractor experience, ideally from Tier 1 / Tier 2 contractor, with proven experience managing projects valued at $500M or more.
  • Candidates with large-scale consultancy experience (mechanical, electrical, civil) and experience in complex infrastructure projects such as hospitals, government, or large industrial facilities are encouraged to apply.
  • Ability to perform in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with global customer exposure.
  • Experience in CSA (civil, structural, architectural) and/or MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) construction management.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management tools like MS Project or Primavera P6.
  • Experience developing executive level presentations.
  • PMP certification or equivalent is preferred.

Other Information

  • 5 days work week (Mon - Fri / regular working hours).
  • 41 Tullamarine Way Road, Tullamarine, VIC, 3043, Melbourne, Australia
  • Permanent position, hybrid working arrangement model.
  • Onboarding and on-the-job learning programme will be provided.

Why Join Vantage

  • Lead high-profile, large-scale data center projects in Melbourne.
  • Work in a hyper-growth APAC environment, shaping project delivery standards.
  • Opportunity for mentorship, professional growth, and cross-regional collaboration.
  • Exposure to Tier 1–3 contractors, complex construction frameworks, and cutting-edge data center technology.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

job.title: Sustainability Director, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Vantage is seeking an experienced and strategic regional Sustainability Director to lead Vantage’s sustainability program in the APAC region. As the regional subject matter expert, this leader partners closely with cross-functional teams to align global strategy with local priorities, guide the integration of sustainability into major development and operational decisions, and support key stakeholder engagement. The Director will shape and drive regional sustainability strategy that aligns and enables regional business strategy. The Director will work closely with the Global Sustainability Center of Excellence (COE) who serves to support and enable regional implementation of sustainability initiatives and stakeholder engagement.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Collaborate with the regional Sustainability Engineer to lead implementation of regional sustainability programs, performance improvement initiatives, and impact-reduction efforts.

job.title: Tax Director (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Role overview

STACK APAC is seeking an experienced, commercially minded Tax Director to lead its regional tax function. Based in Singapore and reporting to the CFO, APAC, the Tax Director will be responsible for tax strategy, structuring, governance and compliance across the Group’s operations in Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.

This will be an individual contributor role working closely with local finance teams and regional finance leadership.

Key responsibilities

Tax strategy, structuring and advisory

  • Lead the development and implementation of the Group’s APAC tax strategy, aligned with the Group’s commercial, investment and financing objectives.
  • Advise on the tax-efficient structuring of investments, development projects, acquisitions, disposals, reorganisations, financing arrangements and intercompany transactions.
  • Provide practical, timely advice on cross-border tax matters, including withholding taxes, permanent establishment risk, treaty access, repatriation of profits, indirect tax and transfer pricing.
  • Support Legal and commercial teams in reviewing contracts, customer arrangements, procurement structures and other transactions with material tax implications.
  • Identify tax risks and planning opportunities arising from changes in legislation, tax authority practice, business operations and new markets.
  • Manage external tax advisers on material advisory, structuring and transaction work, ensuring advice is commercially focused, proportionate and implemented effectively.

Tax compliance, reporting and governance

  • Own and oversee the regional tax compliance calendar and ensure accurate, complete and timely filing, payment and reporting across Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.
  • Oversee corporate income tax compliance and provisioning, including current and deferred tax reporting, tax disclosures and coordination with the financial reporting and audit process.
  • Oversee indirect tax compliance, including GST, consumption tax, sales and service tax, stamp duty and other transaction taxes, as applicable.
  • Oversee employment tax compliance, including payroll taxes, fringe benefits tax, employee share plan tax matters, social security-related obligations and expatriate tax matters where relevant.
  • Lead the Group’s transfer pricing framework, including intercompany pricing policies, local-file/master-file documentation, country-by-country reporting where applicable, and implementation of intercompany agreements.
  • Establish and maintain a robust regional tax control framework, tax risk register, policies, documentation standards and governance processes.
  • Ensure appropriate tax accounting positions are taken, documented and supported, including uncertain tax positions and tax contingencies.

Tax authority, audit and stakeholder management

  • Lead tax audits, reviews, enquiries, rulings and disputes, working with local finance teams and advisers to resolve matters efficiently and protect the Group’s position.
  • Develop constructive working relationships with relevant tax authorities, where appropriate.
  • Act as the central tax contact for the CFO, senior leadership, external auditors, lenders, investors and advisers on APAC tax matters.
  • Present concise tax updates, material risks, cash tax forecasts and key decisions to senior management and governance forums.

Team, process and capability building

  • Build a scalable regional tax operating model, including clear ownership between the central tax function, country finance teams and external advisers.
  • Drive process improvement, automation and use of technology to improve the quality, efficiency and visibility of tax compliance and reporting.
  • Manage the tax budget and adviser spend across the region.

Experience and qualifications

  • 10+ years’ relevant tax experience, gained in a combination of a Big Four or leading professional services firm and an in-house regional or multinational environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of corporate income tax, international tax, transfer pricing and indirect taxes in an APAC context.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on cross-border structuring, financing, acquisitions, disposals and complex intercompany arrangements.
  • Experience managing tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions, including tax accounting and audit processes.
  • Direct experience in Australia, Japan, Malaysia and/or Singapore is strongly preferred. Experience navigating tax matters in Japan and Malaysia, including working effectively with local advisers, would be particularly valuable.
  • Experience in infrastructure, real estate, data centres, energy, construction or another capital-intensive project environment is advantageous.

Equal Opportunity Employer
