job.title: Insurance & Treasury Operations Manager (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Role Overview

STACK APAC is seeking an Insurance & Treasury Operations Manager to manage the Group’s regional insurance programme and provide hands-on operational support for its debt, hedging and treasury activities.

The role will be within the Finance team and work closely with Delivery, Operations and external advisers to structure, place and administer insurance coverage across the APAC platform. It will also coordinate debt drawdowns, maintain debt and hedge records, administer interest and swap settlements, and support the timely delivery of lender reporting and financing obligations.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role requiring strong organisation, commercial judgment and the ability to work across multiple jurisdictions.

Key responsibilities

Insurance programme management

  • Manage STACK APAC’s insurance programme across the region, including construction, operational, corporate and specialty policies.
  • Work with brokers to structure, market, negotiate, place and renew insurance programmes, including:

Construction All Risks / Erection All Risks;

  • Delay in Start-Up / Advance Loss of Profits;
  • Property Damage and Business Interruption;
  • Public and Products Liability;
  • Professional Indemnity;
  • Directors’ and Officers’ Liability;
  • Cyber, Crime, Marine Cargo and other project- or business-specific covers.
  • Prepare underwriting submissions, coordinate data collection, analyse quotations and policy terms, and prepare renewal and placement recommendations for management approval.
  • Review policy terms, limits, deductibles, exclusions, endorsements and programme structures; identify coverage gaps, overlaps and opportunities to improve the cost of risk.
  • Coordinate with internal teams on insurance requirements for development projects, construction contracts, colocation arrangements, leases, procurement arrangements and financing documents.
  • Support the review of contractual insurance provisions, indemnities, liability caps, waiver-of-subrogation requirements and other risk-transfer provisions.
  • Manage the notification, coordination and resolution of material claims, working with brokers, insurers, loss adjusters, legal advisers and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate insurance records, including policy schedules, certificates, endorsements, claims registers, premium allocations, renewal calendars and insurer risk-engineering recommendations.
  • Prepare regular management reporting on coverage, premiums, claims, material exposures and renewal outcomes.

Treasury operations and financing administration

  • Maintain comprehensive registers of debt facilities, security documents, guarantees, letters of credit, hedging instruments and related financing obligations.
  • Coordinate debt drawdowns, including management of conditions-precedent checklists, collection of supporting documentation, preparation of drawdown notices and tracking of funds received.
  • Maintain debt-service calendars and coordinate the timely processing of interest, commitment fee, principal and other financing-related payments.
  • Maintain hedge registers covering interest-rate swaps and other hedging instruments, including notional amounts, maturities, reset dates, payment dates and counterparty confirmations.
  • Reconcile interest and swap payment notices against internal records and support the preparation of settlement instructions for authorised approval.
  • Monitor deadlines for lender reporting, compliance certificates, financial statements, project reporting and other financing deliverables; coordinate input from internal teams and external advisers.
  • Support debt-service and interest cash-flow forecasting, including reporting on near-term funding requirements and debt-service obligations.
  • Liaise with lenders, facility agents, hedge counterparties, banks, legal advisers and internal project-finance stakeholders on operational financing matters.
  • Support the preparation of management reporting on debt balances, liquidity, funding utilisation, interest expense, hedge positions and key financing obligations.

Experience and qualifications

  • 5+ years’ relevant experience in corporate insurance, insurance broking, treasury operations, project finance administration, banking or risk management.
  • Experience in infrastructure, construction, real estate, data centres, energy or another capital-intensive business is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with commercial insurance placement and administration, claims management or contract risk transfer.
  • Familiarity with construction and operational insurance, including CAR/EAR, DSU, property damage/business interruption, liability and financial-lines coverage.
  • Experience administering debt facilities, loan drawdowns, interest calculations, lender reporting and interest-rate hedging is preferred.
  • Experience with insurance markets and practices in Australia, Japan and Malaysia is favourable; broader APAC experience is advantageous.
  • Degree in finance, accounting, business, risk management, insurance or a related discipline preferred.
  • Strong analytical, organisational and stakeholder-management skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines across jurisdictions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical insurance and financing matters in practical commercial terms.

job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

About STACK

STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) is an award-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. We provide digital infrastructure that enables the world’s most innovative companies to scale, with facilities that meet or exceed the highest industry standards for availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience.

As a well-established data center business across APAC, the Americas, and Europe, STACK has successfully built several data centers in Melbourne and continues to expand its project portfolio with the goal of becoming a market leader in the hyperscale data center market.

STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data, Data runs on STACK.

About the role

The Director, Sustainability and Environment APAC owns the sustainability and environmental strategy for STACK developments through design, consent, construction readiness and operations. The role also leads the integrated sustainability and building-services ESD workstreams. It ensures that authority requirements, environmental obligations, energy-performance objectives and sustainability commitments are understood early, translated into design requirements and closed through clear, defensible submissions and reporting. Reporting to the Senior Vice President Engineering APAC, the role directs environmental, acoustic, sustainability and building-services ESD consultants; coordinates multidisciplinary technical reports, energy models and sustainability-rating submissions; and provides practical advice to Development, Engineering, Design Management, Delivery and Operations teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Define the environmental approval pathway for new sites, campus expansions and major design changes
  • Lead environmental due diligence for prospective sites and identify approval risks, fatal flaws, mitigation measures and information needed before acquisition or design commitment
  • Develop project design documents for local development applications, Victorian planning approvals, New South Wales State Significant Development Applications and other state or Commonwealth pathways where applicable
  • Act as STACK's principal design-side interface with EPA Victoria, NSW EPA, local councils, state planning departments and other referral authorities
  • Set the scope, evidence standard and review process for environmental impact assessments, planning reports, sustainability management plans, acoustic assessments, General Environmental Duty and supporting technical studies
  • Lead responses to council, state and regulator comments on development technical submissions
  • Direct and critically review specialist studies covering operational and construction acoustics, air quality and emissions, contaminated land, surface water and groundwater, waste, ecology and biodiversity, cultural heritage, landscape and visual impact, climate risk and other project-specific matters
  • Lead the integrated project sustainability and building-services ESD strategy from site selection and concept design through construction, commissioning and operational handover
  • Set energy-performance objectives and direct energy modelling across design stages
  • Establish and manage the sustainability-rating and certification strategy, including target setting, consultant coordination, evidence registers, submissions, assessor or authority comments and achievement tracking

About you

  • A relevant tertiary qualification in environmental science, environmental engineering, planning, sustainability, law or a related discipline
  • At least 10 years of progressive experience in environmental and sustainable design
  • Substantial recent experience within a multidisciplinary or specialist environmental consultancy team, directing approvals and technical assessment work for major developments or infrastructure, or Client-side experience following a senior consulting career, or evidence of working as an extension of a developer or asset owner team
  • Approvals experience for data centres, power generation, energy infrastructure, logistics, industrial facilities or other developments with material noise, air quality, water and community interfaces
  • Experience across both development approval and post-consent compliance, including construction environmental management and operational monitoring commitments
  • Experience with recognised Australian or international sustainability-rating frameworks and sustainability performance reporting for data centres, major infrastructure, industrial facilities or other energy-intensive assets
  • Demonstrated experience with Victorian and New South Wales approval systems, including direct engagement with EPA, councils and state planning authorities
  • Strong working knowledge of environmental legislation, the General Environmental Duty, planning permit and development consent processes, regulator expectations and the management of approval conditions
  • Proven ability to direct and review multidisciplinary technical reports, including environmental impact assessments, acoustics, sustainability management plans, building-services ESD strategies, energy models, sustainability-rating submissions and performance reports
  • Strong written communication, negotiation and presentation skills, with the judgement to brief executives and resolve complex issues with authorities and technical specialists

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organization in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.

1. Capex Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control project cash flows, ensuring alignment with approved budgets and funding plans.
  • Oversee billing, payouts, milestone-based disbursements, and ensure adherence to financial controls and compliance requirements.

4. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

5. Reporting, Governance & Accountability

  • Ensure accurate, transparent, and timely reporting of capex financial performance to the CFO, CEO and CHMO.
  • Maintain high standards of governance, audit readiness, and accountability across all capex‑related financial decisions.
  • Monitor performance against approved financial KPIs and initiate corrective actions where deviations are identified.
  • Strengthening internal controls and compliance mechanisms for capex planning, execution, and closure.

Qualifications

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related discipline.
  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in financial management, with strong exposure to:

Large scale capex project finance

  • Procurement finance and commercial negotiations
  • Financial controls, audits, and governance

Proven experience in managing financial oversight for capex intensive industries (infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, logistics, etc.). Strong expertise in financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management, Presentation. Enabler of automation with group, Power BI, MIS

job.title: Senior Engineer - Testing & Certification
job.description:
**

Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring

  • Analyze operational data from wind turbines to assess performance against expected benchmarks, including power output, efficiency, and availability.
  • Use advanced data analytics software (e.g., MATLAB, Python, R) to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement in turbine performance.

Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting

  • Conduct performance optimization studies, focusing on areas such as blade aerodynamics, control system tuning, and power curve adjustments.
  • Assist in troubleshooting performance issues on-site, using diagnostic tools to perform root cause analysis and implement corrective measures.

Testing and Validation of Performance Improvements

  • Participate in the testing and validation of performance enhancement initiatives, including prototype testing and field trials.
  • Collect and analyze test data to validate improvements, providing feedback to engineering teams for further refinement.

SCADA and Data Acquisition System Management

  • Manage SCADA systems and other data acquisition tools, ensuring accurate and reliable data collection for performance analysis.
  • Set up alarms, thresholds, and monitoring parameters to track key performance indicators in real-time.

Predictive Maintenance and Condition Monitoring

  • Implement predictive maintenance strategies using data analytics to forecast potential failures and schedule proactive maintenance.
  • Monitor condition-based data, such as vibration and temperature readings, to detect early signs of component wear and prevent performance drops.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain detailed records of performance analysis, tests conducted, and optimization measures implemented.
  • Prepare performance reports, highlighting key findings, improvement opportunities, and corrective actions taken.

Compliance with Standards and Procedures

  • Ensure all performance management activities comply with relevant industry standards and internal procedures, maintaining high data integrity and accuracy.
  • Support the preparation of compliance documentation for certification and audits.

Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams

  • Work closely with product improvement, R&D, and operations teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals.
  • Provide technical support and performance insights during the design and testing phases of new turbine components.

Training and Continuous Learning

  • Engage in continuous learning and professional development to stay updated on the latest performance optimization techniques and tools.
  • Participate in internal training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions to enhance skills and contribute to team development.

Adherence to Ethical Standards

  • Adhere to organizational ethical standards in data handling, analysis, and reporting, ensuring transparency and objectivity in performance assessments.
  • Participate in training on corporate policies, ethics, and compliance to uphold high professional standards.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Lead - Performance Management
  • QA Teams
  • Manufacturing Teams

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Performance Monitoring Equipment Vendors
  • Data Analytics Consultants

Qualifications

Educational Background:

  • BE in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering.

Work Experience:

  • 5+ years in performance analysis and optimization, focusing on operational data, efficiency improvements, and maintenance strategy development.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Proficient in data analytics, SCADA data interpretation, and applying continuous improvement methodologies to enhance turbine performance.

job.title: Technical Program Manager III, AWS Infra Supply Chain Automation
job.description:
Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges that impact cloud infrastructure at global scale? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team is seeking a Technical Program Manager III to drive critical programs that ensure AWS data centers have the right equipment, in the right place, at the right time. You'll tackle never-been-done-before problems involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly enable AWS's ability to scale and meet customer demand.

In this role, you'll leverage your program management expertise and technical depth to orchestrate complex supply chain initiatives across the Supply Chain Operating System (SCos). You'll work with cross-functional teams including engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that optimize AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain. This is an opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while solving ambiguous problems that require both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team supply chain automation programs, defining scope, validating requirements, and driving execution with measurable success criteria
  • Partner with engineering teams and business stakeholders to translate supply chain challenges into technical solutions, creating high-level designs and architectural approaches for the Supply Chain Operating System (SCos)
  • Drive alignment across diverse global teams by managing priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs while proactively identifying and mitigating risks before they become blockers
  • Establish program health metrics and operational excellence mechanisms, continuously monitoring progress and driving process improvements that enhance delivery efficiency
  • Influence technical and business decisions by building consensus across stakeholders, communicating program status through written narratives and presentations, and escalating appropriately to resolve contentious issues

A day in the life You start your day reviewing deployment metrics for a critical supply chain automation initiative, identifying a potential bottleneck in inventory forecasting. You organize a design review with partner engineering teams, asking probing questions to pressure-test assumptions and ensure the solution scales globally. After clarifying action items and owners, you draft a concise narrative for leadership addressing a cross-team dependency that needs resolution. You spend time mentoring a junior program manager on stakeholder management, then join a working session where you help engineering and operations teams navigate trade-offs between speed and technical debt for an upcoming launch.

About the team The AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team builds the software systems that orchestrate AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain at global scale. Our mission is to ensure AWS data centers have the right equipment, in the right place, at the right time to support customer demand. We work on complex challenges involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly impact AWS's ability to scale.

Our team values innovation, operational excellence, and continuous learning. We foster an inclusive culture where perspectives from varied backgrounds drive better solutions, and we invest heavily in developing our engineers and leaders. As AWS continues its rapid growth, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while working on programs of critical importance to Amazon's success.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
  • 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
  • 3+ years of software development experience
  • 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
  • Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
  • Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
  • Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

job.title: Sr Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - S&T
job.description:
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.

AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Key job responsibilities As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.

As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.

Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • Knowledge of cloud architecture
  • 10+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
  • Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
  • 7+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
  • Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
  • 10+ years' experience in designing and implementing large distributed systems, with deep expertise in core infrastructure, solution architecture, and distributed computing patterns.

job.title: Real Estate Strategy Manager (f/m/d)
job.description:
Senior Manager - Real Estate

Siemens Real Estate is responsible for Siemens' global real estate portfolio. Worldwide, we manage 8.7 million square meters of office and production space across around 1,400 locations. We design, plan and build. We operate our properties and provide the associated services. We are passionate about people, our planet and business needs. Across the entire real estate life cycle, we combine decades of experience with state-of-the-art technical expertise. We provide solutions for the transformation of the world of work and for sustainable growth. Drawing on this expertise, we also advise external companies.

Are you wondering how we will work in the future and how we can put people at the center? How can buildings become a key enabler of sustainable growth, and how can data help reduce CO2 emissions? Then join us. We look forward to receiving your application!

About the role

As Real Estate Strategy Manager based in India, you will be part of the global SRE Portfolio & Strategy Location Strategy team. You will develop fact-based location and portfolio strategies for Siemens in India and across Asia Pacific and Japan (APJ), connect local and regional market and regulatory insights with global portfolio objectives, and prepare transparent decision proposals for senior management. In this role, you will work closely with Siemens businesses, country and regional SRE teams, internal expert functions, and external advisors across APJ and internationally.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

  • Develop customer- and portfolio-driven real estate strategies for Siemens locations in India and across Asia Pacific and Japan (APJ), and contribute regional perspectives to global portfolio and location strategy initiatives.
  • Lead the preparation of location concepts, strategy papers, feasibility and pre-development studies, site selection assessments, master plans, and management decision proposals.
  • Structure and evaluate strategic real estate options, including consolidation, relocation, acquisition, leasing, redevelopment, sale and leaseback, and disposal scenarios, from business, customer, financial, sustainability, and real estate perspectives.
  • Analyze portfolio, location, infrastructure, demographic, workforce, and real estate market data for India and other APJ countries, including office, industrial, R&D, logistics, and emerging asset classes, and translate the findings into clear recommendations.
  • Assess country-specific market and regulatory conditions across India and APJ, including land and lease structures, zoning and development parameters, infrastructure plans, approval requirements, and location risks, in cooperation with local experts.
  • Manage interdisciplinary strategy projects and coordinate stakeholders across Siemens businesses, SRE functions, finance, legal, sustainability, operations, and external partners in India, across APJ, and internationally.
  • Manage and challenge external International Property Consultants (IPCs), brokers, valuers, and other advisors in India and across APJ, ensuring high-quality market intelligence, assumptions, benchmarks, and deliverables.
  • Apply artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to improve market research, portfolio transparency, scenario development, option comparisons, risk identification, and the preparation of decision documents, while observing applicable governance, data protection, and confidentiality requirements.
  • Develop reusable standards, templates, data-driven methods, and best practices for Location Strategy and support knowledge transfer among India, the wider APJ region, and the global team.
  • Prepare concise, management-ready presentations and communicate complex analyses and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

Profile:

job.title: Regional Portfolio Manager - Field Devices
job.description:
Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds.**

With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences.

Our Building Technologies portfolio includes intelligent field devices that form the foundation of high-performing building automation and HVAC control systems. Through sensors, control valves, valve actuators, damper actuators, room devices and measuring instruments, we enable efficient, safe and sustainable building operations.

As the Regional Portfolio Manager, you will lead the Field Devices portfolio across ASEAN within the Smart Infrastructure Buildings team. In this strategic role, you will drive portfolio growth, market development, product lifecycle management, technical competency, and partner enablement, collaborating closely with country sales organizations, partners, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and end-users to accelerate business growth through a strong combination of technical expertise, commercial acumen, and strategic depth in sensors, control valves, and HVAC applications.

You’ll create impact by

  • Business Growth & Market Development: Driving revenue growth, profitability, and market share for the Field Devices portfolio across ASEAN. Identify and develop opportunities across priority verticals (commercial buildings, healthcare, data centers, industrial facilities, infrastructure), collaborating with country sales and partner managers to execute go-to-market plans and influence project specifications with consultants, MEP designers, system integrators, OEMs, and contractors.
  • Partner & Customer Enablement: Acting as the regional technical expert for sensors, control valves, valve actuators, damper actuators, and associated field devices. Support country organizations and partners in pre-sales activities (application design, product selection, valve sizing, technical consultation, bid support), deliver training and technical workshops, and provide expert guidance for complex applications and technical issue resolution.
  • Portfolio & Product Leadership: Owning and managing the regional Field Devices portfolio (sensors, valves, actuators, damper actuators, room devices, measuring instruments). Lead lifecycle management, new product introductions, launches, and phase-ins/outs. Analyze market requirements, competitor offerings, and customer feedback to define ASEAN portfolio requirements and provide structured input to global product management.
  • Strategic Planning & Execution: Developing and executing regional portfolio growth strategies and business plans. Translate market intelligence into focused initiatives promoting sustainability, energy-efficiency, and digitalization outcomes, collaborating with regional management on forecasting, pricing, and strategic development.
  • Performance Management & Collaboration: Monitoring key business metrics (revenue, profitability, market share, portfolio performance), drive corrective actions, and foster best-practice sharing and collaboration across sales, technical support, training, bid management, and partner networks.

Your Defining Qualities

  • Educational Background: University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Control Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
  • Extensive Experience: Minimum 5 to 10 years of experience in HVAC controls, building automation, field devices, instrumentation, valves, actuators, or a related industry, backed by experience in technical sales, portfolio management, product management, application engineering, or business development (regional/multi-country ASEAN experience is a strong advantage).
  • Technical Competencies: Strong technical knowledge of HVAC control systems, field-level control applications, and sensing technologies (temperature, humidity, pressure, flow, CO2, IAQ). Deep expertise in control valves (characteristics, authority, flow coefficient, PICV, hydronic balancing), valve/damper actuators, airside/waterside HVAC applications, and the ability to size/select devices and interpret technical specifications.
  • Strategic & Commercial Acumen: Strong commercial mindset combined with technical credibility and strategic problem-solving skills to translate market intelligence into growth.
  • Other Competency: Hands-on experience specifically in the application, sizing, and selection of sensors, pressure-independent control valves, control valves, valve actuators, and damper actuators, along with a track record of supporting consultants and system integrators during specification stages.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Skills: Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, presentation, and communication skills. Fluent in English; additional ASEAN languages are an advantage.

In return, we offer you

  • Flexible mobile working policy that allows for time off for you to recharge and spend more time with your loved ones.
  • Attractive compensation and benefits.
  • Values-driven work culture with inclusive workplace policies and practices that prioritize diversity and inclusion.
  • Endless possibilities and opportunities for progression and learning.

Recruitment Process

  • CV Screening
  • A session with our recruiter to understand your motivation & your past experiences
  • 1-3 Business Interviews
  • Offer Stage
  • Medical test

Come join us, and #TransformTheEveryday for everyone!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.**

job.title: Workday Functional Analyst
job.description:
What you will do

As an HR Technology Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting configuration requests and participating in projects. You will be a strategic business partner who applies technology to support business requirements.

Demonstrating Workday expertise, the HR Technology team partners with HR Centers of Expertise and the HR community to answer functionality questions, resolve issues, work with vendors on system‑related concerns, and test new functionality. The team is involved in many different projects, enabling the HR Technology Analyst to work across the business to ensure successful HR processes.

A key focus of this role is supporting and enhancing Workday Recruit, partnering closely with the Talent Acquisition CoE to design, configure, and optimize recruiting processes that improve system performance and the overall candidate experience. You will also support and manage day‑to‑day operations with Paradox and HiredScore to ensure smooth recruiter workflows and high‑quality candidate engagement.

The Analyst will be involved in the deployment of new Workday features as well as operational improvements; this includes implementing new security roles, leading configuration changes, and executing end-to-end testing for Workday upgrades.

How you will do it

  • Configure changes in Workday based on business requirements.
  • Configure and maintain Workday Recruit processes, including job requisitions, job postings, candidate stages, screening steps, and offer workflows to support a seamless recruiting lifecycle.
  • Project team member/lead for the design and implementation of new Workday functionalities, including business process configuration, testing, interface and integration support, implementation through deployment, and postproduction support.
  • Support processes within Workday, with a particular focus on recruiting workflows and TA related functionality.
  • Develop strong relationships with internal partners, including the Talent Acquisition CoE, to gain an understanding of business requirements and translate them into effective system solutions.
  • Create custom Workday reports as needed to meet business needs/objectives.
  • Plan, coordinate, and implement testing efforts for changes within Workday, including recruiting related enhancements and integrations.
  • Support the design, development, and performance of Workday and related business data and processes. Focus on identifying trends, resolving root causes, predicting future implications, and finding solutions to drive effective business decisions.
  • Proactively identify and assist in prioritizing opportunities to streamline business and/or system processes, especially within the recruiting lifecycle.
  • Lead biyearly Workday upgrades, including end-to-end testing of Workday Recruit functionality.
  • Partner with the Talent Acquisition CoE to analyze and enhance the candidate journey, using Workday Recruit configuration and supporting technologies to streamline application flow and improve candidate experience.
  • Oversee daily operations and optimization of Paradox and HiredScore, including troubleshooting issues, monitoring performance, driving adoption, and identifying enhancements that improve recruiter efficiency and candidate engagement.
  • What we look for

Required

  • Degree in business or management information systems, HR (CIPD), or equivalent combination of education and experience.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Consumer Payments (Growth)
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Staff Software Engineer (Technical Lead) for Consumer Payments in Singapore, you will serve as a versatile technical anchor driving the evolution of Google’s payment capabilities.

This is a flexible, high-impact leadership role where your influence extends beyond a single team. You will provide technical direction, architect solutions, and make contributions across multiple domains and markets (e.g., eWallets, A2A rails, conversion funnels). You will partner closely with PMs, UX, and cross-functional leadership globally to translate ambitious business goals into resilient, scalable software systems.

You are expected to be a technical leader, remaining deeply involved in the codebase. You will contribute high-impact code and architectural designs for ambiguous and complex technical challenges across markets while raising the technical bar for engineers across the organization.Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the technical strategy across multiple areas within consumer payments, prioritizing efforts across different market-specific growth initiatives.
  • Write scalable, maintainable code and design architecture for critical, high-ambiguity system components. Use data and technical judgment to simplify domain complexity and guide targeted investments that eliminate technical debt.
  • Partner with Directors, PMs, UX, and TPMs across Singapore and global engineering centers to drive consensus and align technical strategies across markets.
  • Advocate for AI-accelerated development workflows by defining team-wide policies for the verification, security, and maintenance of AI-generated code.
  • Provide technical guidance and oversight to multiple concurrent workstreams, acting as an "Uber TL" rather than being tied to a single delivery team. Mentor and coach senior engineers across multiple areas, set high-bar engineering standards, and conduct rigorous design/code reviews.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Manager - Procurement
job.description:
The Manager – Procurement will head the L7 – IN – NUMERIC procurement team at IN‑NOVATEUR ELECTRICAL & DIGITAL SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED. You will be responsible for developing sourcing strategies, managing supplier relationships, and optimizing inventory levels to meet production schedules while minimizing costs and mitigating material shortages across all manufacturing sites.

Responsibilities

  • Key Responsibilities
  • 1. Procurement & PO Management
  • Manage procurement from PR to PO and PO closure.
  • Ensure timely PO creation and release based on MRP, production plan, consumption, MSL and lead time.
  • Monitor open POs, pending quantities and supplier commitments.
  • Follow up with suppliers and resolve delivery or quantity issues.
  • Ensure materials are available on time to support production.
  • 2. Inventory & Material Planning
  • Maintain optimum inventory across all plants.
  • Ensure MSL and replenishment levels are maintained.
  • Monitor material consumption, demand, stock and open POs.
  • Identify potential shortages, excess stock and slow-moving materials.
  • Use inter-plant stock transfer wherever possible before making fresh purchases.
  • Improve inventory turnover and reduce working capital.
  • 3. Supplier Management
  • Monitor supplier delivery, quality, MOQ and lead time.
  • Conduct regular supplier performance reviews.
  • Work with suppliers to:Reduce lead time
  • Reduce MOQ
  • Improve delivery reliability
  • Support smaller and more frequent deliveries

Take corrective action for delayed or poor-performing suppliers.4. KANBAN, Pull Flow & Lean SupplyIdentify suitable fast-moving materials for KANBAN / Pull System.Implement consumption-based replenishment with suppliers and stores.Define appropriate KANBAN quantities and replenishment frequency.Support Heijunka / level loading to smoothen material requirements.Reduce excess inventory, shortages and unnecessary material movement.5. Excess & Slow-Moving InventoryRegularly review ageing, excess and obsolete inventory.Prepare action plans for reducing old stock through:

  • Production consumption
  • Inter-plant transfer
  • Alternate usage
  • Supplier return
  • Other liquidation methods

Set reduction targets and track progress.6. SAP, MIS & Performance MonitoringEnsure effective use of SAP MM/PP for procurement and material planning.Maintain accurate MRP, lead-time, lot-size and replenishment parameters.Develop and monitor dashboards/reports for:

  • Inventory
  • MSL adherence
  • Shortages
  • Open PO ageing
  • Supplier OTD
  • Excess inventory
  • Lead-time and MOQ
  • Critical material availability

Present key issues and action plans to management.7. Multi-Plant CoordinationCoordinate material requirements across all plants.Ensure the right material reaches the right plant at the right time.Coordinate with Procurement, PPC, Production, Stores, Logistics and SCM teams.Proactively resolve critical material shortages and supply issues.Ensure continuous material availability without unnecessary inventory buildup.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or related field; MBA preferred.
  • Minimum 8 years of progressive procurement experience in manufacturing or industrial sectors.
  • Proven track record in managing multi‑plant procurement operations and inventory optimization.
  • Strong negotiation skills with demonstrated ability to achieve cost reductions.
  • Excellent analytical abilities with proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and Excel.
  • Knowledge of Indian procurement regulations, GST, and import/export compliance.
  • Leadership experience with the ability to mentor and develop a high‑performing team.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills across functions.
  • Certification such as CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent is an advantage.
  • Ability to work under pressure and make decisions in fast‑paced environments.

job.title: Senior Observability Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Administer the log and search platform (currently Splunk Cloud): indexes, data onboarding, roles and access, apps and knowledge objects, retention, and search and dashboard performance. Monitor ingest latency, skipped searches and licence consumption, and tune to keep cost under control.
  • Administer the APM, RUM and infrastructure monitoring platform (currently Splunk Observability Cloud): teams, tokens, integrations, detectors, alert routing and dashboards. Manage metric cardinality and usage against entitlement.
  • Roll out telemetry to all IS applications: OpenTelemetry Collector (currently the Splunk distribution) on AWS EKS and EC2, and APM instrumentation for Java, Go, .NET, Node.js and Python. Keep instrumentation vendor-neutral where possible so the backend can change without re-instrumenting. Maintain onboarding guides and report coverage per application.
  • Set up RUM for customer-facing web and mobile frontends and link browser sessions to backend traces, logs and infrastructure metrics, so an incident can be followed from the user to the data store.
  • Build and maintain observability as code (Terraform or equivalent) in Git with peer review and CI/CD, so detectors, dashboards and configuration are versioned, repeatable and free of manual drift.
  • Plan and run platform and agent upgrades with vendors: define the test plan, validate in non-production, sign off before release, and manage support cases and escalations. Run structured evaluations and proofs of concept when StarHub considers a new or replacement tool.
  • Design, build and operate AI and agent-assisted observability workflows, such as alert noise reduction, automated triage, root-cause summaries and natural-language querying, with human review and guardrails.
  • Apply controls aligned with MAS-TRM and CSA best practices to telemetry: retention, access control, audit logging, and masking of PII and sensitive data before ingest.
  • Perform User Access Reviews (UAR) on the observability platforms at least twice a year, covering user accounts, roles and tokens, and follow up on removals and exceptions. Participate in company-wide audits when required, providing evidence and closing findings on time.

**

Qualifications

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

Desired Background

  • Experience in medium-to-large technology, telecommunications or financial services organizations with complex hybrid-cloud environments and many application teams; has owned an enterprise observability platform, not only used one.

Seniority, Skills, Certifications (must-haves)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in observability, monitoring, SRE or platform engineering, including hands-on administration, optimization and health monitoring of an enterprise observability or log analytics platform. Splunk (Cloud or Enterprise) is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise APM/RUM/infrastructure monitoring platform across RUM, APM, infrastructure and data-storage monitoring. Splunk Observability Cloud is preferred; Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Elastic or similar is acceptable. Clear understanding of distributed tracing from frontend to backend.
  • Experience installing and operating OpenTelemetry-based telemetry on AWS (EKS, EC2) for Java, Go, .NET, Node.js and Python applications.
  • Experience managing observability configuration as code (Terraform or equivalent, Git, CI/CD).
  • Prior AI delivery experience in observability or IT operations: has taken an AI or agent-based capability into production use by operations or engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance standards (MAS-TRM, CSA), including telemetry data governance.
  • Certifications are a plus: Splunk Core Certified Admin or Power User, Splunk Observability Cloud certification, or equivalent vendor certifications on another observability platform.

Ideal track record #1

Owned an enterprise observability or log analytics platform at scale (Splunk preferred) as administrator and platform owner, improving search performance, stability or ingest cost, and ran vendor-led upgrades with test and validation plans and no unplanned outage.

Ideal track record #2

Rolled out APM and infrastructure telemetry (OpenTelemetry) across a large application estate with RUM-to-backend tracing in use during real incidents, measurably reducing time to detect or resolve.

Ideal track record #3

Delivered an AI or agent-based capability in production for monitoring, triage or root-cause analysis, with measurable impact such as less alert noise or faster resolution.

job.title: AI Cyber Defence Specialist
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

We are seeking an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Cyber Defence Specialist to lead the organisation’s threat management capabilities across Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, Threat Hunting and Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) by leveraging AI.

Reporting to the CISO Office, the candidate will be accountable for the responsibilities as stated below. The candidate will ensure these capabilities are intelligence-led using AI, measurable and aligned with applicable regulatory and industry expectations, including (but not limited to) the Cybersecurity Act and applicable Cybersecurity Codes of Practice (CCoP).

Roles and Responsibilities

**

  • Lead and manage the 24x7 Security Operations Centre (SOC) operations, including any Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) or MDR partner, ensuring security events are monitored, triaged, escalated and resolved within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Own the SOC operating model and its associated processes – tiered analyst structure, shift roster, playbooks, runbooks and escalation matrix – and drive measurable improvement in SOC maturity using AI.
  • Drive detection engineering across SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity and cloud-native security tooling; develop, tune and retire use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK to increase detection coverage and reduce false positives.
  • Ensure log source coverage across critical assets – endpoints, servers and networks.
  • Oversee SOAR automation to accelerate alert enrichment, triage and containment actions.
  • Define and report SOC KPIs and KRIs (e.g. MTTD, MTTR, ATT&CK coverage, alert severity, SLA adherence) to the CISO and senior management.
  • Lead the organisation’s response to critical zero-day and emerging vulnerabilities, including rapid exposure assessment, compensating controls and emergency patching coordination.
  • Establish and lead a structured, hypothesis-driven threat hunting programme based on threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK and anomalies observed in environment telemetry.
  • Develop hypotheses and techniques and execute hunts to identify undetected threats across the environment; convert hunt findings into new or improved detections.
  • Gather and analyse cyber threat information and intelligence from commercial feeds, government sources (e.g. CSA / Sectoral Lead) and open sources to derive insights on attack tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs), campaigns and threat actor profiles relevant to the organisation and its sector.
  • Operationalise threat intelligence, including IOC ingestion and management of the threat intelligence platform (TIP).
  • Act as a security incident responder for cyber incidents, coordinating technical response, containment, eradication and recovery across internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts and performance for MSSP/MDR, IR retainer, maintenance of the cybersecurity technology stack and security tooling providers; plan and manage the cyber defence budget.
  • Present the organisation’s threat landscape, incident trends and cyber defence posture to the CISO.
  • Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, providing evidence of control design and operating effectiveness.
  • Proactively coordinate with technical and business stakeholders and manage internal and external partnerships during a security incident.
  • Any other assigned duties when there is a change in business requirements and scope of work.

**

**

What we’re looking for...

You embrace continuous learning and use lessons from challenges to improve future outcomes. You can inspire and motivate others to deliver the organisation’s vision. You view obstacles as problems to be solved. You are driven by the desire to deliver positive outcomes for your internal customer – Singtel Digital InfraCo.

What you need to have

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of cybersecurity experience, with substantial hands-on experience in SOC operations, incident response and digital forensics, including at least 3 years leading a team.
  • Proven track record of leading the response to significant incidents (e.g. ransomware, targeted intrusions, data breaches) from detection through to recovery and post-incident review.
  • Hands-on expertise with SIEM (e.g. Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, QRadar), EDR/XDR (e.g. CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Trend Micro, Trellix), and SOAR platforms.
  • Experience with vulnerability management platforms (e.g. Tenable Nessus) and risk-based prioritisation approaches.
  • Highly analytical, with strong attention to detail and outstanding problem-solving skills; able to work independently and under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to be on call and respond outside office hours during major incidents and/or as and when the need arises.
  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications.
  • Strong knowledge of frameworks and regulations such as MITRE ATT&CK, CIS Controls v8.1, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Cybersecurity Act and PDPA.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled security operations and threats targeting AI/LLM workloads.

job.title: Smart Building and Innovation Engineer
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

Shape the future of Smart Buildings and intelligent infrastructure by turning emerging technologies and innovative ideas into real-world solutions.

As a Smart Building Solutions & Innovation Engineer, you will be part of a team responsible for envisioning, architecting, designing and implementing next-generation Smart Building solutions across Singtel Group properties and customer environments.

You will work across the full innovation and engineering lifecycle — from discovering new use cases, evaluating emerging technologies and developing proof-of-concepts, to solution architecture, design, system integration, implementation and continuous optimisation.

One Comcentre will serve as one of our key living labs and innovation platforms, where new technologies and Smart Building use cases can be explored, tested and demonstrated before being scaled or adapted to other Singtel properties and customer environments.

Working with business teams, technology partners, start-ups, vendors and customers, you will have opportunities to work with technologies such as IoT, AI, data analytics, automation, digital twins, smart workplace, sustainability and intelligent building systems.

This role is for someone who is curious about technology, enjoys solving real-world problems and wants to see their ideas progress from concept → prototype → deployment → scale.

**

Make An Impact By

**

Discover and Innovate

  • Explore emerging technologies and industry trends across Smart Buildings, IoT, AI, automation, sustainability and intelligent infrastructure.
  • Identify and develop new use cases that improve building intelligence, operational efficiency, sustainability, safety and user experience.
  • Participate in ideation, technology evaluation, experimentation, proof-of-concepts and innovation trials.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, technology partners, start-ups and customers to co-create new Smart Building solutions.
  • Evaluate successful innovations and identify opportunities to scale and replicate them across Singtel Group properties and customer environments.

Architect and Design

  • Translate business challenges, user requirements and innovative concepts into practical technical solutions.
  • Support the development of Smart Building solution architecture, system design, integration architecture, technical specifications and implementation plans.
  • Design how IoT devices, sensors, networks, building systems, applications, data platforms, cloud/edge technologies and AI capabilities work together as an integrated ecosystem.
  • Evaluate different technologies and solution options based on functionality, scalability, interoperability, cybersecurity, reliability, maintainability and user experience.
  • Develop architecture diagrams, technical documentation, system integration requirements and engineering deliverables.

Experiment, Validate & Scale

  • Take solutions from concept and design into real-world implementation.
  • Work with vendors, system integrators, contractors and internal technology teams throughout installation, configuration, integration, testing, commissioning and handover.
  • Coordinate technical activities across multiple technology domains and vendors to ensure individual systems operate as an integrated Smart Building solution.
  • Participate in site implementation, testing and troubleshooting across Singtel and customer environments.
  • Identify technical risks and issues and work collaboratively with relevant parties to drive them towards resolution.

Operate & Continuously Improve

  • Support the technical health and performance of Smart Building solutions deployed within Singtel environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across IoT, networks, applications, APIs, building systems and integrated platforms.
  • Work with technology partners and vendors to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, automation and user experience.
  • Maintain relevant architecture, configuration, technical and operational documentation.

Showcase and Engage

  • Support Smart Building demonstrations, workshops, customer engagements and technology showcases.
  • Ensure experience environments, including the One Comcentre Smart Building Show Suite, are technically ready for customer and stakeholder engagements.
  • Help translate complex technical solutions into compelling demonstrations and use cases that customers can easily understand.
  • Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand their challenges and explore how Smart Building technologies can address them.
  • Bring feedback and insights from customer engagements back into the team's innovation and solution roadmap.

Skills To Succeed

**

  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Building Services Engineering or a related engineering/technology discipline.
  • Fresh graduates and candidates with approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience are welcome
  • Strong interest in Smart Buildings, IoT, AI, automation, data, sustainability and emerging technologies.

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Principal Global Account Manager - IT/ITeS Industry, AGS-APJ-India-ITS
job.description:
Do you want to own the global cloud relationship with one of the world's largest System Integrators and drive its transformation on AWS? AWS is seeking a Principal Account Manager to serve as the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI, owning AWS revenue and adoption across the customer's worldwide operations.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI, you will own the end-to-end global sales relationship with a customer that operates across dozens of countries and hundreds of thousands of employees. This is a role for a leader with roughly twenty years of experience who can operate at the highest level of ownership, set global account strategy, and orchestrate a large, distributed virtual team across geographies. You will be the single global owner of the account, aligning regional sellers across NAMER, EMEA, and India, and driving AWS adoption across the customer's internal platforms, engineering environments, and lines of business. You will engage the customer's most senior executives, define a multi-year global strategy, structure the largest and most complex commercial constructs, and represent the voice of the customer inside AWS to shape product roadmaps and investment priorities. Success is measured by global revenue growth, consumption, and the depth of AWS's strategic position within the account worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the Global Account Strategy: Serve as the single global owner for the account. Define and drive a multi-year global account plan that aligns AWS capabilities with the customer's worldwide business objectives and technology roadmap.
  • Drive a Large-Scale Global Migration Motion: Lead the migration of the customer's on-premises, co-located, and competitor-cloud workloads to AWS at global scale. Build and execute multi-year migration and modernization programs across the customer's internal platforms, data centers, and delivery environments in every region, and drive the consumption growth that follows.
  • Accelerate Enterprise-Wide AI Adoption: Position AWS as the customer's platform of choice for AI and GenAI. Drive adoption of Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and the broader AWS AI and data stack across the customer's engineering, product, and internal-productivity use cases worldwide, and convert early experimentation into production workloads at scale.
  • Drive a Global, Multi-Geography Sales Motion: Lead one consistent global motion across NAMER, EMEA, India, and other regions. Set global revenue objectives, then align and mobilize regional account teams to execute against a single coherent plan rather than disconnected local efforts.
  • Executive Relationship Building at the Highest Level: Establish and sustain relationships with the customer's most senior global executives, including the CEO, CTO, President, and business unit and delivery leaders. Position AWS as the customer's primary strategic cloud provider and influence board-level technology decisions.
  • Structure the Most Complex Global Deals: Lead the large multi-year, multi-region commercial engagements, including PPAs, global framework agreements, and custom pricing constructs. Navigate complex global procurement, legal, and commercial processes across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Orchestrate Extended Teams: Operate as the single-threaded global leader, orchestrating across regional Account Managers, Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver unified outcomes for the customer.
  • Global Revenue Ownership and Forecasting: Own global revenue targets for the account, build and manage a healthy worldwide pipeline, forecast accurately across regions, and drive consumption growth across GenAI, data and analytics, migration, and modernization.
  • Segment Strategy Shaping: Contribute to AWS's global GSI segment strategy by identifying trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace across the account. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities and product direction.
  • Lead Without Authority: Set direction for a large virtual team that does not report to you. Align senior stakeholders across AWS regions and functions, resolve conflicting regional priorities, and drive execution through influence.
  • Mentor and Raise the Bar: Coach senior and junior Account Managers across the account team, share best practices for global account management, and act as a role model for how AWS engages its most strategic customers.

A day in the life As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI, you own the worldwide sales relationship and are responsible for the customer's global cloud journey on AWS. Your day combines global strategy, senior executive engagement, cross-region orchestration, and complex deal leadership.

A typical day may include:

  • Global Strategy and Alignment: Reviewing the global account plan, analyzing consumption and pipeline across regions, and aligning NAMER, EMEA, and India account leads on shared priorities and resourcing for the largest opportunities.
  • Executive Engagement: Running global steering committees and executive briefings with the customer's senior leadership, and joining regional business reviews to keep the worldwide plan on track.
  • Internal Orchestration: Engaging Solutions Architects and Product teams on technical proposals and roadmap needs, and coordinating across time zones with regional account teams.
  • Deal Leadership: Advancing the most complex global commercial engagements, structuring multi-region agreements, and removing blockers across legal, procurement, and commercial functions in multiple countries.
  • Advocacy: Bringing the voice of the customer into AWS, informing product roadmaps and investment decisions, and representing AWS at senior customer and industry forums.

About the team Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above, or MBA
  • Experience managing and growing large accounts, product marketing or management consulting roles
  • Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
  • Experience leading matrixed virtual teams that create and execute strategic programs
  • 15+ years of technology sales or strategic account management experience selling enterprise software, infrastructure, managed services, or cloud computing services.
  • - Experience consistently exceeding revenue targets in complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-geography environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as primary account manager of a global federated enterprise working with multiple business units and influencing governance and policy or equivalent
  • AWS or other cloud certification
  • Experience in the advertising, media or agency landscape, and proven track record of reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals via new and existing business
  • Prior experience of managing large GSI/IT & ITES customers.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. A day in the life As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for driving their cloud journey from initial engagement through large-scale adoption.
