job.title: Principal Global Account Manager - IT/ITeS Industry, AGS-APJ-India-ITS
job.description:
Do you want to own the AWS relationship with one of the world's largest System Integrators and reshape how tens of thousands of its developers build software? AWS is seeking a Principal Account Manager to serve as the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI / large IT & ITeS customer, owning AWS revenue and driving developer productivity and AI adoption across the customer's global engineering workforce.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI / IT & ITeS customer, you will own the end-to-end global sales relationship with an organization whose core asset is a global developer workforce numbering in the tens or hundreds of thousands. This is a role for a leader with roughly twenty years of experience who can operate at the highest level of ownership, set global account strategy, and orchestrate a large, distributed virtual team across geographies. Your central mandate is to make AWS the platform on which the customer's engineers build, and to drive a measurable step-change in their developer productivity through the AWS AI stack. You will own the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) motion end to end, from IDE and code generation through testing, deployment, and operations, embedding AWS AI tooling into how the customer's developers work every day. You will align regional sellers across NAMER, EMEA, and India, engage the customer's most senior executives, define a multi-year global strategy, structure the largest and most complex commercial constructs, and represent the voice of the customer inside AWS to shape product roadmaps and investment priorities.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the Global Account Strategy: Serve as the single global owner for the account. Define and drive a multi-year global account plan that aligns AWS capabilities with the customer's worldwide business objectives and engineering roadmap.
  • Drive Developer Productivity at Scale: Make AWS the default platform for how the customer's global engineering workforce builds. Drive adoption of Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, and the broader AWS developer tooling stack across the customer's delivery teams, and tie adoption to measurable gains in developer throughput, code quality, and time-to-delivery.
  • Own the AIDLC Motion End to End: Own the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle motion across the account. Embed AWS AI tooling into every stage of the customer's software lifecycle, from requirements and code generation through automated testing, code review, deployment, and operations, and convert developer-level adoption into enterprise-wide standardization.
  • Sell the AWS AI Stack: Position AWS as the customer's platform of choice for AI and GenAI. Drive adoption of Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, Amazon SageMaker, and the broader AWS AI and data stack across the customer's engineering, product, and internal-productivity use cases worldwide, and convert early experimentation into production workloads at scale.
  • Drive a Large-Scale Global Migration Motion: Lead the migration of the customer's on-premises, co-located, and competitor-cloud workloads to AWS at global scale, and drive the consumption growth that follows across every region.
  • Drive a Global, Multi-Geography Sales Motion: Lead one consistent global motion across NAMER, EMEA, India, and other regions. Set global revenue objectives, then align and mobilize regional account teams to execute against a single coherent plan rather than disconnected local efforts.
  • Executive Relationship Building at the Highest Level: Establish and sustain relationships with the customer's most senior global executives, including the CEO, CTO, Chief Digital Officer, and engineering and delivery leaders. Position AWS as the customer's primary strategic cloud provider and influence board-level technology and engineering decisions.
  • Structure the Most Complex Global Deals: Lead the largest multi-year, multi-region commercial engagements, including EDPs, PPAs, global framework agreements, and custom pricing constructs. Navigate complex global procurement, legal, and commercial processes across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Orchestrate Extended Teams: Operate as the single-threaded global leader, orchestrating across regional Account Managers, Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver unified outcomes for the customer.
  • Global Revenue Ownership and Forecasting: Own global revenue targets for the account, build and manage a healthy worldwide pipeline, forecast accurately across regions, and drive consumption growth across developer tooling, GenAI, data and analytics, migration, and modernization.
  • Segment Strategy Shaping: Contribute to AWS's global GSI and IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace across the account. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities and product direction.
  • Lead Without Authority: Set direction for a large virtual team that does not report to you. Align senior stakeholders across AWS regions and functions, resolve conflicting regional priorities, and drive execution through influence.
  • Mentor and Raise the Bar: Coach senior and junior Account Managers across the account team, share best practices for global account management, and act as a role model for how AWS engages its most strategic customers.

A day in the life As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI / IT & ITeS customer, you own the worldwide sales relationship and are responsible for driving the customer's developer productivity and AI transformation on AWS. Your day combines global strategy, senior executive engagement, cross-region orchestration, and complex deal leadership.

A typical day may include:

  • Global Strategy and Alignment: Reviewing the global account plan, analyzing developer-tooling and AI adoption metrics alongside consumption and pipeline across regions, and aligning NAMER, EMEA, and India account leads on shared priorities and resourcing for the largest opportunities.
  • Executive Engagement: Running global steering committees and executive briefings with the customer's engineering and business leadership, and joining regional business reviews to keep the worldwide plan on track.
  • Driving the Developer and AIDLC Motion: Working with the customer's engineering leaders on rollout plans for Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, and the AWS AI stack, reviewing adoption and productivity data, and removing blockers to enterprise-wide standardization.
  • Internal Orchestration: Engaging Solutions Architects and Product teams on technical proposals and roadmap needs, and coordinating across time zones with regional account teams.
  • Deal Leadership: Advancing the most complex global commercial engagements, structuring multi-region agreements, and removing blockers across legal, procurement, and commercial functions in multiple countries.
  • Advocacy: Bringing the voice of the customer into AWS, informing product and developer-tooling roadmaps, and representing AWS at senior customer and industry forums.

About the team The GSI and IT/ITeS team owns AWS's sales relationships with the world's largest System Integrators and technology services organizations, global companies whose competitiveness depends on how fast and how well their developers build. You will own the global relationship for one of these customers and work with a collaborative, high-energy team that values customer obsession, ownership, and results at global scale.

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience managing and growing large accounts, product marketing or management consulting roles
  • Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
  • Bachelor's degree or above
  • Experience reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals
  • Experience leading matrixed virtual teams that create and execute strategic programs
  • 15+ years of technology sales or strategic account management experience selling enterprise software, developer tooling, infrastructure, managed services, or cloud computing services.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as primary account manager of a global federated enterprise working with multiple business units and influencing governance and policy or equivalent

  • Experience in the advertising, media or agency landscape, and proven track record of reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals via new and existing business

job.title: Senior Project Engineer, Lead engineer – Electrical HV System – INOPC
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Engineering Manager ###

The primary focus of this role will be to act as the technical lead for all engineering activities in assignments classified as HV system engineering complexity (66kV to 400kV). Ensures that the activities related to all engineering disciplines within the project are executed in an efficient and cost-effective manner, in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards.

**

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to Process Automation business for Operation Centers and Quality division based in Bangalore / Chennai, India.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform basic and detail engineering activities and provide optimized solutions for High Voltage electrical system in industrial projects specifically Offshore wind farm, Onshore Power from Shore and Battery energy storage system (BESS).
  • Preparation Key SLD, Protection single line diagram, equipment arrangement plan and section.
  • Design calculations for equipment sizing, earthing calculation, cable sizing, cable tray sizing, lighting calculation, lightning calculation
  • Layout engineering for equipment arrangement, cabling, earthing, lighting and lightning protections.

  • Air Insulated Switchgear (AIS) from 66kV and up to 400 kV

  • Shunt Reactors

Prepare equipment BOM, cable schedule, Interconnection diagram and termination schedule for complete HV systemCoordinate with substation automation system / SCADA system for interface engineering activities, Coordination with civil, structural, supply chain, commercial, project management, and manufacturing, testing and site execution teams. Estimate effort for engineering, testing and commissioningPrepare Engineering Schedule in line with agreed document deliverable list, matching engineering portion of project schedule.Travelling to customer and vendor locations to support engineering, manufacturing and FAT activities.Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
  • Minimum 10 to 15 years of relevant experience for Project Engineering
  • Worked as Project Engineer in at least 4 to 6 large size projects in HV system.
  • Onshore/Offshore -substation experience will be preferred. Minimum 1 to 2 years experince on site execution is preferred.
  • Pre-Bid Engineering, Bid & Proposal exposure is an added advantage.
  • Proficiency in using design tools like relay selections, equipment sizing, earthing, lighting calculation tools etc.,
  • Basic Knowledge of power system study and network modelling preferred
  • Basic knowledge on communication archtecture, IEC 61850, relay selections (ABB/Hitachi/GE/SEL) is preferred.
  • Understanding the various International Standard/ statutory requirements like IEEE/IEC/ANSI

More about us

ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Cyber Security Instructor, Mandiant, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

As a Security Consultant, you will be responsible for helping clients effectively prepare for, proactively mitigate, and detect and respond to cyber security threats. Security Consultants have an understanding of computer science, operating system functionality and networking, cloud services, corporate network environments and how to apply this knowledge to cyber security threats.

As a Security Consultant, you could work on engagements including assisting clients in navigating technically complex and high-profile incidents, performing forensic analysis, threat hunting, and malware triage. You may also test client networks, applications and devices by emulating the latest techniques to help them defend against threats, and will be the technical advocate for information security requirements and provide an in-depth understanding of the information security domain. You will also articulate and present complex concepts to business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical contributors and successfully lead complex engagements alongside cross functional teams.

In this role, you will be responsible for aspects of both internal and external education, specifically in cyber security areas such as digital forensics and incident response. As a technical functional role, it includes training delivery, course development, and documentation support. You will work with a sense of purpose and urgency, can prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and demonstrate keen attention to detail resulting in the delivery of high-quality work products.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. By scaling decades of frontline experience, Mandiant helps organizations to be confident in their readiness to defend against and respond to cyber threats.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver classroom training to a variety of technical audiences.
  • Provide support for cyber security course development efforts, including product research, providing subject matter expertise, and training content review.
  • Create, update, and maintain slide decks and lab exercises for customer-facing training. Assist with updates for course descriptions, syllabi, and other collateral pertaining to external education.
  • Coach students and assess their technical capabilities, processes, and procedures as they investigate simulated attack scenarios.
  • Build effective relationships and work collaboratively within all levels of an organization.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Lead Solutions Architect, Smart Building & Autonomous System
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

The Lead Solutions Architect, Smart Building & Autonomous Systems is a senior technical role responsible for the solution architecture, technical design, systems integration, engineering governance and delivery assurance of Smart Building, Workplace and Autonomous Systems solutions.

For One Comcentre, the role will work closely with the Practice Lead, Infrastructure Experience & OpsTechDesign to establish and govern the overall Smart Building architecture framework, ensuring that the Integrated Services Platform (ISP), Building Management System (BMS), building subsystems, IoT/OT infrastructure, workplace and tenant technologies, AI platforms and autonomous systems are designed and integrated as a secure, interoperable, resilient and extensible technology ecosystem.

The role will provide technical leadership and design assurance across technology vendors, system integrators and development teams, ensuring that technical designs and deliverables align with established architecture principles, technical standards, operational requirements and the overall One Comcentre technology vision.

Working in partnership with the Product Manager and business stakeholders, the Lead Solutions Architect will translate business requirements, product concepts and use cases into technically feasible solution architectures, specifications and implementation plans, and lead their technical delivery from concept through prototyping, integration, testing, commissioning and production deployment.

The role will also support the evolution of Smart Buildings towards AI-enabled and increasingly autonomous operations, applying Generative AI, Agentic AI, robotics and emerging technologies to enhance building operations, workplace experiences and tenant services.

**

Make An Impact By

**

Smart Building Solution Architecture

  • Lead the end-to-end solution architecture for Smart Building, Workplace and Autonomous Systems.
  • Develop logical, physical, integration, data and deployment architectures.
  • Define how ISP, BMS, IoT/OT systems, building subsystems, workplace platforms, tenant technologies, data platforms, AI and autonomous systems operate as an integrated ecosystem.
  • Evaluate technology and solution options based on interoperability, scalability, resilience, security, operability and lifecycle considerations.
  • Ensure architecture supports both current building requirements and future technology evolution.

Architecture Framework & Technical Governance

  • Work with the Practice Lead to establish and maintain the One Comcentre architecture framework, reference architectures and technical standards.
  • Define architecture principles, integration patterns, technical guardrails and engineering standards.
  • Establish requirements for APIs, data exchange, interoperability, cybersecurity and system interfaces.
  • Conduct architecture and technical design reviews across vendors and system integrators.
  • Assess design deviations and recommend appropriate technical resolutions.
  • Maintain architecture decisions, technical baselines and key design documentation.
  • Ensure vendor solutions and deliverables comply with approved architecture and technical requirements.

Smart Building & OpsTech Integration

  • Provide technical leadership for the implementation and integration of ISP, BMS and other Smart Building subsystems.
  • Coordinate integration across access control, security, smart lifts, visitor management, smart parking, lighting, energy management, environmental systems, workplace technologies and other building systems.
  • Ensure building systems can securely exchange data, events and authorised commands with other platforms.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration risks and technical constraints early in the design and delivery lifecycle.
  • Ensure Smart Building systems do not evolve into isolated technology silos.

**

Systems Integration & Interoperability

  • Define northbound and southbound integration requirements.
  • Develop and review APIs, interface specifications, data flows and system interaction sequences.
  • Apply appropriate API, IoT, messaging and event-driven integration patterns.
  • Define data ownership, system-of-record and information-exchange principles.
  • Review vendor APIs, SDKs and integration capabilities.
  • Design integration across cloud, edge and on-premises environments.
  • Promote open architecture and minimise unnecessary proprietary dependencies and technology lock-in.

Technical Design & Vendor Assurance

  • Review and challenge vendor architecture and detailed technical designs.
  • Conduct technical design workshops and engineering reviews.
  • Assess vendor technical submissions against specifications and architecture standards.
  • Review interface-control documents, APIs, network requirements, data flows and system dependencies.
  • Identify design gaps, integration risks and technical non-compliance.
  • Drive technical issues through resolution with vendors, consultants and system integrators.
  • Support technical assessment of design changes and their impact.
  • Ensure final as-built designs and technical documentation accurately reflect the implemented environment.

Solution Engineering & Technical Delivery

  • Translate business and functional requirements into technical requirements and solution designs.
  • Lead the technical lifecycle from requirements, architecture and detailed design through build, integration, testing, commissioning and operational handover.
  • Coordinate technical dependencies across multiple systems and delivery teams.
  • Resolve complex cross-platform and integration issues.
  • Define technical acceptance criteria and validation requirements.
  • Participate in relevant FAT, SAT, SIT, UAT and commissioning activities.
  • Ensure solutions are technically ready, supportable and operationally viable before production acceptance.

AI & Autonomous Building Architecture

  • Design technical architectures for the application of Generative AI and Agentic AI within Smart Building operations.
  • Develop integration patterns between AI agents, building platforms, operational systems and data sources.
  • Design agentic workflows capable of supporting intelligent decision-making and authorised operational automation.
  • Define appropriate security, governance, human-in-the-loop, fail-safe and exception-handling mechanisms.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies for technical feasibility, scalability and production readiness.
  • Support the progressive evolution from conventional building automation towards more intelligent and autonomous building operations.

Robotics & Physical AI Integration

  • Develop technical architecture for integrating robotics and autonomous systems into the Smart Building environment.
  • Define robot interaction with lifts, automatic doors, access control, communications and other building infrastructure.
  • Define requirements for robot identity, authentication, connectivity, orchestration and charging.
  • Work with robotics vendors and building-system providers to develop and validate end-to-end integration.
  • Establish reusable integration approaches that can support multiple robot types and technology providers.
  • Address safety, fail-safe behaviour and operational exception scenarios.

Prototyping, MVP & Innovation

  • Translate new business and operational use cases into technically feasible solution concepts.
  • Lead development teams in rapid prototyping and technical experimentation.
  • Design and deliver Proof-of-Concepts, MVPs and pilot solutions.
  • Apply Agile development approaches to accelerate solution validation.
  • Assess prototypes for performance, integration, cybersecurity, scalability and operational readiness.
  • Develop production architecture for successful pilots and support their transition into operational environments.
  • Continuously assess emerging technologies that could enhance Smart Building and autonomous operations.

Technical Team Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership to developers, integration engineers and solution engineers.
  • Translate solution architecture into implementable technical work packages.
  • Guide development teams on integration, APIs, data, cloud/edge, AI and Smart Building architecture.
  • Conduct technical reviews and ensure engineering quality.
  • Facilitate Agile technical sprints and resolve technical blockers.
  • Mentor technical team members and strengthen internal Smart Building, OpsTech, AI and autonomous-system capabilities.

Stakeholder & Product Partnership

  • Work closely with the Product Manager, Practice Lead, business stakeholders and operational teams to understand business objectives, user requirements and priorities.
  • Translate product and business requirements into robust technical solutions and implementation approaches.
  • Provide technical feasibility assessments, solution options, constraints, dependencies and recommendations to support product and investment decisions.
  • Communicate complex architecture and engineering considerations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, consultants, technology partners and vendors throughout the solution lifecycle.

**

Skills To Succeed

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a related technology or engineering discipline.
  • Relevant professional certifications in Solution Architecture, Cloud, IoT, AI, Cybersecurity, Smart Buildings, Agile or Project Management would be advantageous.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant technical experience in Smart Building, Intelligent Building, Workplace Technology, IoT/OT, building systems integration or related technology domains.
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering integrated Smart Building or Workplace solutions.
  • Strong understanding of BMS, IBMS/ISP, IoT, OT/IT convergence and building subsystem integration.
  • Experience developing solution, integration, data and deployment architectures.
  • Experience with APIs, IoT protocols, event-driven integration, cloud/edge architectures and data integration.
  • Experience reviewing and governing technical designs from vendors and system integrators.
  • Experience leading complex multi-vendor system integration and resolving cross-system technical dependencies.
  • At least 1 year of practical project experience involving Generative AI and/or Agentic AI, preferably applied to operational automation or intelligent environments.
  • Experience leading developers, solution engineers or multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • Experience delivering prototypes, Proof-of-Concepts, MVPs and pilots using Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with robotics, autonomous systems or Physical AI is highly advantageous.
  • Experience with building, workplace, tenant and retail technologies is highly desirable.
  • Strong project-management and technical-delivery experience.
  • Strong technical and solution architecture capabilities.
  • Able to operate across IT, OT, Smart Building, AI and autonomous-system domains.
  • Comfortable challenging vendors and system integrators on architecture and technical design.
  • Strong analytical and complex problem-solving capabilities.
  • Able to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Regional Program Manager, Global Network Acquisition
job.description:
About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As Regional Program Manager, you will define the governance frameworks and operational rhythms that drive our strategic roadmap across the region. In this role, you will bridge cross-functional teams, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and partner with executive leadership to translate complex strategic goals into rapid, measurable execution.

Leveraging structured program management methodologies, you will ensure seamless cross-team alignment, enhance operational agility, and accelerate the delivery of business-critical transformation initiatives.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary lead structuring and facilitating key regional operational cadences, including regional business reviews, agreement governance (plan/agreement approvals), and quarterly town halls.
  • Establish structured operational frameworks bridging commercial, technical, and executive stakeholders to drive joint accountability across major initiatives.
  • Own end-to-end program roadmaps, risk mitigation, and continuous process improvements to boost regional agility and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain full portfolio visibility tracking milestones, budgets, action plans, and KPIs to ensure strategic targets stay on schedule.
  • Partner directly with senior leadership to steer agreement approvals and resolve bottlenecks, ensuring critical timelines are met.

job.title: Expression of Interest - Energy and Technical Professionals
job.description:
Take your energy and technical experience into critical digital infrastructure— without starting over.

CDC Data Centres is growing its Victorian team and wants to hear from people with experience across electrical systems, HVAC, mechanical services, facilities, commissioning, project delivery and energy infrastructure. If you have worked with

complex, critical or high-availability infrastructure, your skills could be highly relevant to opportunities at CDC.

  • Register once to be considered as CDC continues to grow

Meet CDC at All Energy Australia

CDC Data Centres will be at All Energy Australia on 28–29 October 2026 at the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre.

Visit the CDC team to learn more about the infrastructure behind Australia’s digital economy, the experience we’re looking for and where your career could take you. Whether or not you’re attending the event, you can register your interest in

opportunities with CDC.

About CDC:

CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. With operations across the ACT, NSW, Victoria and New Zealand, our people support the reliable infrastructure behind Australia’s digital

economy.

Why build your career at CDC?

A move into data centres doesn’t mean starting again. At CDC, you can build on the electrical, mechanical, operational or project experience you already have while developing your capability in a highly technical, critical-infrastructure environment.

For candidates moving into Service Technician roles, the CDC Academy provides tailored training, specialised courses and hands-on learning alongside experienced Service Technicians—helping you develop your data centre capability and grow

over the long term.

CDC also offers:

  • Parental Leave – Inclusive parental leave entitlements above legislative requirements to help you start, grow and care for your family
  • Volunteer Leave – Two days of leave to support a cause or charity of your choice
  • Employee Assistance Program – Comprehensive support available to you and your family
  • CDC Social Events – Inclusive events for employees and their families, including BBQs, family picnics and community events

Who we’d like to hear from:

We welcome expressions of interest from professionals with experience in:

  • Electrical trades and engineering
  • Refrigeration, HVAC and mechanical systems
  • Facilities and critical operations
  • Commissioning and controls
  • Construction, fit-out and project delivery
  • Technical project management
  • Energy, utilities and infrastructure

What happens after you register:

Your expression of interest will be reviewed against CDC’s current and anticipated requirements. If your experience aligns with a suitable opportunity, a member of the CDC team may contact you. Registering your interest does not guarantee

employment, but it allows CDC to consider you as the Victorian team continues to grow.

Important to know:

All Australian CDC positions require Australian Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance. Role-specific eligibility, location and roster requirements will be confirmed if a suitable opportunity arises.

CDC is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is valued and respected. We encourage people from different industries, backgrounds and experiences to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: Maintenance Systems & Planning Coordinator (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Maintenance Systems & Planning Coordinator supports the safe, compliant and reliable operation of STACK’s mission-critical infrastructure by administering the Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS), coordinating maintenance schedules, and governing the change management workflow. This role chairs the weekly Change Advisory Board (CAB) to ensure disciplined process execution, while technical approvals remain with the ACOM and COM. The position ensures no conflicting maintenance activities occur across mechanical, electrical, controls and supporting systems and prevents excessive change stacking on the same day. The Coordinator also administers the rotating shift roster, annual/sick leave entries, and relief coverage planning to maintain continuous staffing for 24/7 operations.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

  • Uphold STACK’s 100% uptime objective by maintaining accurate, reliable CMMS data to support operational decision-making.
  • Administer the CMMS system including asset hierarchies, PM schedules, work order creation, close-out documentation, service reports and evidence accuracy.
  • Ensure maintenance plans are reflected correctly in the 52-week schedule and updated promptly after changes, deferrals or engineering adjustments.
  • Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB), ensuring every submission meets STACK procedural standards (MOP/SOP/ITP, rollback, risk assessments, communication plans).
  • Maintain the Change Calendar, applying freeze windows, preventing high-risk clustering and ensuring changes do not conflict across systems.
  • Identify and prevent conflicts between maintenance and change activities (e.g., electrical + cooling + controls) to protect redundancy, safety and availability.
  • Ensure ACOM and COM remain the technical and operational approvers for all changes; accurately record decisions and required actions.
  • Link change records to the correct assets, PM tasks and work orders to preserve data integrity and operational traceability.
  • Track deferred changes, overdue actions, incomplete close-outs and escalate procedural non-compliance to the CFM.
  • Support vendor scheduling by ensuring all works are accurately recorded, do not conflict with site operations and include required compliance documentation.
  • Maintain audit-ready CMMS and change documentation for internal reviews, customer audits and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and issue weekly/monthly reporting: PPM compliance, overdue work orders, change volumes, risk categories, conflict flags, and CAB action closure.

People

  • Demonstrate professional conduct, clear communication and strong organisational discipline.
  • Collaborate closely with the COM, ACOM, and FM team to coordinate maintenance, change and scheduling activities.
  • Work with the CFM and HR to administer roster coverage, leave planning and Award-related tracking.
  • Maintain strong relationships with vendors, ensuring coordinated scheduling, document submission and compliance with STACK processes.
  • Support new starters with CMMS onboarding, change management process education and roster familiarity.
  • Promote teamwork and operational consistency across all shifts and disciplines.

Competencies

  • Strong understanding of CMMS/EAM systems, asset structures, work order flows and preventive maintenance programs.
  • High attention to detail with disciplined record-keeping and documentation control.
  • Ability to chair structured meetings (CAB), maintain accurate minutes and enforce procedural quality.
  • Scheduling and planning capability, with ability to detect and resolve conflicts between maintenance and change activities.
  • Clear communication skills for interacting with engineers, supervisors, vendors and operations leadership.
  • Proficiency with Excel for roster tools, coverage metrics and operational reporting.
  • Process-driven approach aligned to safety, compliance and availability.
  • Strong organisational discipline and reliability under time-sensitive conditions.

Work Environment / Conditions

  • Primarily Monday–Friday with occasional extended hours during high-activity periods or major change windows.
  • Participation in operational readiness reviews, maintenance pre-briefs, CAB meetings and vendor coordination tasks.

Travel Required

  • Minimal travel expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in mission-critical environments (data centre, hospital, utilities, transport, Defence or similar).
  • Experience administering CMMS/EAM systems and coordinating maintenance or change schedules.
  • Familiarity with operational change management workflows (CAB, MOP/SOP/ITP, PIR).
  • Exposure to technical systems (electrical, mechanical, HVAC or controls) is desirable but not essential. Engineering or trade background preferred but not essential.
  • Understanding of rostering, Award considerations and staffing coverage models for 24/7 operations.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.
  • Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.
  • Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Legal entitlement to work in Australia.
  • Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements (as applicable), including right-to-work checks and reference checks.
  • Ability to meet data centre security requirements including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.
  • Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific area.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

job.title: Warehouse Coordinator - Level IV - SHOP
job.description:
Job Summary

Acts as a formal resource coordinating others. Coordinates operations through interaction with operations management. Coordinates activities for different areas like Inbound, Outbound, Kitting, etc. based on direction from Operations management.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards.
  • Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment.
  • Promote interdependence by looking out for one another.
  • Correct hazards within your control and capabilities.
  • Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact.

Lead HSE Training and actively engage workforce Quality

  • Follows all applicable standard work, work instruction/process documentation and established quality procedures.
  • Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures.
  • Performs quality checks for damage and for discrepancies between goods and invoices.
  • Identifies and controls non-conforming material.

Delivery

  • Receive incoming goods, accurately sort, label/package, store goods and arrange storage to optimize warehouse space.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Mode Selection - Evaluates and selects appropriate transportation mode and equipment type by lane through shipment volume analysis against business requirements to provide optimal shipping method (balance cost, quality and time).

Leads projects for design, development and maintenance of a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Designs and provide guidance on building reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Designs and implements physical data models to define the database structure. Optimizing database performance through efficient indexing and table relationships. Participates in optimizing, testing, and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Designs, develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Job Description

Position: Manager - Product Application Engineer - L1 Technical Support (East Zone)

Location: Kolkata

Reporting To: Regional Sales Manager

Position Summary

The L1 Technical Support Engineer will provide pre-sales and application support for Industrial Automation products including Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), Soft Starters, PLCs, HMIs, Industrial Communication, and related automation solutions. The role will serve as the first level of technical expertise for channel partners, sales teams, and customers across the South Zone, ensuring timely support, product selection guidance, application development assistance, and effective customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pre-Sales Technical Support
  • Provide technical compliance evaluation against customer specifications and tender requirements.

  • Review customer inquiries, specifications, BOQs, and application requirements.

job.title: Senior Engagement Manager, AWS Strategic Industries
job.description:
Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.

This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you. 221100 10044

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.
  • Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.
  • Facilitate release planning, workshops, and discovery sessions using multiple delivery and cloud frameworks (such as Agile, Waterfall, Well-Architected Framework, and Cloud Adoption Framework) to translate customer strategy into executable roadmaps.
  • Lead complex business and technical discussions, harmonize conflicting perspectives, and guide customers to define and expand on their cloud adoption strategy while identifying opportunities to maximize engagement value through scope and financial negotiations.
  • Establish reusable delivery mechanisms, best practices, and documentation standards that improve quality and efficiency across engagements, and mentor fellow engagement managers to raise the overall team capability.

A day in the life You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and preparing for a steering committee meeting with a customer's leadership team, where you present delivery progress and align on upcoming milestones. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team planning session, helping architects and developers prioritize the next sprint. After lunch, you join a technical review to validate that a proposed solution meets the customer's business objectives, then spend time coaching a newer engagement manager on stakeholder communication. Your afternoon wraps with a pipeline discussion, where you help shape an upcoming pre-sales opportunity.

About the team AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.

We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. Whether you are helping a customer adopt generative artificial intelligence or guiding a complex enterprise transformation, you will work alongside some of the brightest minds in cloud technology and have the opportunity to shape how organizations innovate at scale.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
  • 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
  • Bachelor's degree in STEM field
  • Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
  • Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
  • Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
  • active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
  • AWS certification
  • Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
  • Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
  • Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

job.title: Software Development Engineer II, Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation, Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

As a Software Development Engineer II on our Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team, you will build large-scale distributed applications using serverless technologies, data lakes, and NoSQL databases to automate the complex processes that keep AWS infrastructure growing ahead of customer demand. The team is expanding quickly with a strong pipeline of projects ready for you on day one, and we are actively investing in new features and AI adoption. If you enjoy building systems from the ground up and solving problems that require creative, unconventional thinking, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and build large-scale distributed applications using serverless technologies, data lakes, and NoSQL databases to automate infrastructure supply chain processes for AWS.
  • Collaborate with internal teams such to understand scaling requirements, translating them into technical designs that account for performance, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Write high-quality, well-documented code across the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and operations, ensuring solutions can be maintained by engineers new to the codebase.
  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and design discussions, actively training new team members on system architecture and operational practices.
  • Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, improving system reliability through proactive monitoring and automation.

A day in the life You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics and triaging any operational alerts. By mid-morning, you are whiteboarding a new automation workflow with teammates, weighing tradeoffs around data structures, algorithms, and service dependencies. After lunch, you pair with a junior engineer on a code change, coaching them through the review process. Later, you pick up one of the projects waiting in the team's backlog, scoping the technical approach and drafting a design document for peer review.

About the team The Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team sits within AWS Infrastructure Services and directly contributes to the scaling capability of core AWS services. We work alongside software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers across AWS. Together we help deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. With a growing project pipeline and active investment in AI-driven capabilities, this is a compelling time to join. You will experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Inclusive Experiences Amazon values inclusive experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • 2+ years of building complex software systems experience
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Siemens IT is looking for a highly motivated SAP S/4HANA Finance & AI Enablement Consultant to join a globally connected team driving Finance transformation across Siemens. This role combines deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance with a passion for artificial intelligence, digital innovation, and intelligent automation. job.title: Regional Sales Manager, APAC - NEMA Motors Division
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

International Sales Manager - MONM__

Your role and responsibilities

The Regional Sales Manager, APAC is a regional business owner - not a traditional sales leader - who reports directly to the EVP International Sales as part of the core international leadership team. The Regional Sales Manager has full end-to-end accountability for all commercial activities in their assigned geography, including strategy, customer development, quotation, orders, delivery, invoicing, and cash collection.

Operating with entrepreneurial autonomy, the RSM holds the regional P&L, leads a distributed team of country managers and sales professionals, commercializes the portfolios of three Global Business Lines across their region, and coordinates with Global Operations for supply chain support. Beyond day-to-day sales execution, the RSM serves as ABB Motion's strategic eyes and ears in the market, actively identifying growth opportunities, market gaps, competitive dynamics, product adaptation needs, and acquisition targets - providing structured, actionable market intelligence that directly informs global product strategy and organizational decisions, rather than simply managing existing business.

The work model for the role is: hybrid ; #LI-Hybrid

The selected base location for this role is Singapore, with the possibility to relocate from other countries in the region.

The role is contributing to the (Motion / NEMA Motors Division) globally.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Regional Business Strategy & Market Development – Define and execute go-to-market models, develop 3-year regional strategies, drive profitable growth, identify whitespace opportunities, and expand market share across new and existing customer segments in the assigned region.
  • Sales Performance & P&L Accountability – Own the regional P&L including orders, revenue, gross margin, and profitability; drive order and margin targets; manage costs, EBITA profit, and working capital; and maintain financial discipline across all commercial metrics.
  • Customer Relationship & Account Management – Build and maintain senior-level customer relationships; provide trusted advisory services to key accounts; manage channel partners and account coordination; and drive best-in-class customer experience across the region.
  • Market Intelligence & Portfolio Feedback – Gather market insights on competitive landscape, pricing dynamics, and application trends; provide structured feedback to product leadership on portfolio gaps, certifications, and product adaptation needs; and identify acquisition targets or partnership opportunities.
  • LSU Partnership & Sales Team Leadership – Lead and inspire Area Sales Managers and sales professionals; develop comprehensive sales plans with local sales units aligned to regional goals; drive quarterly business reviews; and create a high-performance team culture with strong accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Sales Planning & Performance Management – Develop and drive regional sales plans with clear objectives and action plans; analyze channel and segment results; monitor KPIs and trends; identify deviations; and implement corrective actions to meet budget expectations and strategic objectives.

Qualifications for the role

  • 12+ years of senior commercial leadership in industrial B2B environments, ideally in drives, motors, or related automation technologies
  • Proven track record of profitable multi-country sales growth with direct P&L accountability - including both defending existing business and winning new market share
  • Demonstrated experience developing markets and expanding customer bases, not just managing existing accounts
  • Experience providing structured portfolio and pricing feedback to product or business line organizations - and influencing product strategy based on market intelligence
  • Ability to identify and articulate product adaptation, certification, and infrastructure needs with commercial specificity and business case rigor
  • Demonstrated commercial instinct for identifying acquisition targets or partnership opportunities that accelerate market access or capability
  • Experience leading geographically distributed sales organizations end-to-end, including back-office execution functions
  • Strong strategic mindset combined with hands-on execution capability and disciplined performance management across the full commercial cycle
  • Fluency in English and other regional languages.

Assets

  • Familiarity with ABB Motion's portfolio (drives, motors, services) and its competitive landscape internationally, NEMA Motors is a plus
  • Experience navigating complex matrix organizations across business lines, product management, and geographies
  • Prior involvement in M&A processes, market entry studies, or footprint planning in an industrial context

More about us

ABB’s NEMA Motors Division is a marketer, designer and manufacturer that offers Baldor-Reliance® industrial electric motors, primarily in North America. The Division focuses on quality, reliability and efficiency to provide a comprehensive offering of NEMA motors in the market across most industrial segments and applications.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Data Centre Plan & Spec Manager
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

**

Role Overview

**The Data Center Plan & Specification Manager is responsible for driving early-stage influence with data center owners, developers, design consultants, and engineering stakeholders to ensure Carrier’s thermal management solutions are positioned effectively in project specifications. The role requires strong technical understanding of data center HVAC and high-density cooling requirements, including chilled water systems, air-side solutions, liquid cooling readiness, energy efficiency, redundancy, sustainability, and lifecycle cost considerations. The successful candidate will develop technical and budgetary proposals, conduct lifecycle and value-based analysis, and translate evolving customer requirements into differentiated plan and specification strategies.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

**

  • Build Strategic Industry Relationships – Develop strong partnerships with data centre owners, developers, consultants, engineering firms and key specification influencers across the region.
  • Shape Projects from the Start – Position Carrier solutions early in the design cycle, influencing concepts, specifications and tender requirements before projects reach procurement.
  • Engineer Future-Ready Cooling Solutions – Support high-density and AI-ready data centres with chilled water, air- and water-cooled chillers, liquid cooling enablement, CDUs and hybrid cooling strategies.
  • Turn Technical Expertise into Value – Develop compelling technical proposals, basis-of-design recommendations, lifecycle cost analysis and TCO solutions that address customer and project requirements.
  • Champion Sustainable Data Centre Design – Drive energy and water optimisation, PUE improvement, lower-carbon solutions, heat recovery opportunities and efficient plant design.
  • Stay Ahead of the Data Centre Market – Track hyperscale and colocation trends, consultant preferences, competitor specifications and emerging cooling technologies to strengthen Carrier’s market position.
  • Connect Strategy, Sales & Execution – Partner with sales, application engineering, product, factory and service teams while managing the project pipeline, specification progress and key opportunities across the region.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

  • Drive Consultant & Stakeholder Engagement – Build trusted relationships with data centre owners, developers, consultants, contractors and key technical decision-makers to position Carrier as a preferred cooling solutions partner.
  • Influence Plans & Specifications – Engage early in the project lifecycle to shape cooling strategies, equipment selections and technical specifications, supporting opportunities from concept through to order conversion.
  • Develop Mission-Critical Cooling Solutions – Translate customer requirements into reliable, scalable and energy-efficient HVAC solutions covering chilled water systems, airflow management, redundancy and high-density cooling.
  • Support AI-Ready Data Centre Design – Promote future-ready thermal solutions including direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, rear-door heat exchangers and hybrid air/liquid cooling architectures.
  • Deliver Technical & Commercial Value – Develop compelling technical recommendations and value propositions that balance performance, reliability, sustainability, lifecycle cost and commercial requirements.
  • Champion Sustainability & Compliance – Ensure proposed solutions align with relevant HVAC and data centre standards while supporting PUE improvement, energy efficiency and broader sustainability objectives.
  • Identify & Develop the Project Pipeline – Track market activity, consultant engagements and early-stage projects, identifying opportunities and supporting progression from specification through to award.
  • Collaborate Across the Region – Partner with sales, application engineering, product, factory, service and leadership teams across Asia Pacific and the Middle East to deliver coordinated solutions and share market and competitive intelligence.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better.

This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

The Financial Analyst supports the FP&A and Finance Business Partnering functions for Customer Operations and other finance/business initiatives. The role focuses on delivering insightful financial analysis, supporting budgeting and forecasting activities, and partnering stakeholders to drive operational and financial performance improvements. The individual will work closely with business teams to support decision-making, improve financial visibility, and contribute to cost optimisation and transformation initiatives across the organisation.

FP&A Support

  • Support the preparation of budgets, forecasts, long-range plans, and monthly management reporting
  • Perform variance analysis against budget and forecast to identify key trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Consolidate and analyse financial and operational data to support business performance reviews
  • Assist in preparing management presentations, dashboards, and financial insights for stakeholders

Finance Business Partnering – Customer Operations

  • Partner Customer Operations and other business units to support financial performance management
  • Provide ad-hoc analysis and financial insights to support operational and strategic decision-making
  • Support business cases, cost optimisation initiatives, and investment evaluations
  • Work closely with stakeholders to understand business drivers and financial impacts

Process Improvement & Transformation

  • Support finance transformation and process improvement initiatives across FP&A and reporting processes
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, standardisation, and data accuracy
  • Contribute to automation and simplification initiatives to reduce manual processes and improve turnaround time
  • Document financial processes, assumptions, and reporting methodologies where required

Financial Governance & Controls

  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial information used for reporting and analysis
  • Support compliance with finance policies, governance standards, and internal controls
  • Assist with audit requests and finance reviews where required

Qualifications

  • University degree, major in Accounting or Finance
  • Relevant experience in FP&A, process improvement
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a degree of ambiguity
  • Good interpersonal, communication and collaboration skills
  • Effective collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong MS Office tools knowledge, Excel proficiency, SAP, Workday Adaptive Planning is considered a plus
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken
  • Positive, proactive and self-motivated personality

job.title: Senior Manager, Finance
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As the Senior Manager, Finance, you will report to the Senior Director, Group Financial Controller in managing statutory and management reporting, financial governance, accounting policy matters and business strategic projects across Australian jurisdictions. This will be a 6 to 8 month fixed term contract role covering parental leave.

You will play a key leadership role in overseeing complex accounting matters, guiding the AU finance team, and supporting strategic transactions and asset monetization projects in partnership with Group and regional stakeholders.

What You'll Do

Leadership and Team Management

  • Lead and develop the Australia finance reporting team, providing coaching, direction, and technical guidance to ensure delivery of high-quality reporting outputs.
  • Build capability and drive maturity in reporting processes, strengthening controls, timelines, and alignment with Group standards.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement within the AU finance function.

Statutory and Management Reporting

  • Oversee the statutory and management reporting obligations for all Australia entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with Group policies and AASB/IFRS.
  • Lead month-end close activities, ensuring key deliverables are met, intercompany balances are reconciled, and reporting packs are submitted on time.
  • Review financial results, identify variances, and provide commentary and insights to management and Group stakeholders.
  • Oversee the preparation and audit of statutory financial statements, managing external auditor relationships and ensuring smooth year-end sign-off.

Process and Transformation

  • Drive process standardization and improvement across AU reporting, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Partner with Group Reporting and Systems teams to support automation and system enhancements for consolidation and statutory and management reporting tools.
  • Strengthen governance, documentation, and control frameworks to support sustainable reporting excellence.
  • Champion a continuous improvement mindset and lead initiatives that align with the Group’s finance transformation agenda.

Cross Functional Team Collaboration

  • Partner closely with cross functional teams; Group Reporting, Finance Operations, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Treasury, and regional Financial Control teams to drive alignment across deliverables.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, proactive-problem-solving, and operational excellence within Finance.

What You'll Bring

  • Qualified Accountant (CA/CPA or equivalent) with 10-15 years’ experience in financial reporting, controllership, or technical accounting, preferably with multinational or high-growth organizations.
  • Strong knowledge of AASB and IFRS, with experience in accounting for complex transactions and preparing accounting position papers.
  • Proven experience in team leadership and coaching, managing small, high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated capability in statutory reporting, month-end close, and audit management.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Group, Tax, Legal, Treasury and external auditors.
  • Strategic mindset with a passion for process improvement, transformation, and team development.
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
