job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities III - Singapore
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Critical Facilities Engineer III supports the operation, maintenance, and reliability of mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role performs a broad range of maintenance and operational activities while applying technical knowledge and established procedures to resolve issues and support site operations. Working as part of a collaborative team, the engineer helps ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations while continuing to develop expertise across critical facility systems.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on facility systems and equipment to support reliable operations.
  • Carry out repairs, inspections, and installation activities across facility infrastructure in accordance with established procedures and safety standards.
  • Monitor the Building Monitoring System (BMS) and respond to alarms by investigating issues and supporting resolution efforts.
  • Support the operation and maintenance of critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, plumbing, fire suppression, and life-safety systems.
  • Assist with energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives by identifying opportunities and supporting implementation activities.
  • Perform day-to-day operational tasks independently while seeking guidance on more complex or unfamiliar situations.

Vendor Support

  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers performing maintenance activities within the data center.
  • Support the work approval process, including pre-work briefings, monitoring activities, and confirming completion of work.
  • Ensure vendor activities are conducted in accordance with site procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate technical documentation, records, and asset information.

Site Administration & Incident Support

  • Prepare and maintain site documentation, permits, logs, and records, including Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs) and operational scripts.
  • Identify potential infrastructure risks and Single Points of Failure (SPOFs) and raise recommendations for review.
  • Respond to site incidents, equipment failures, and operational issues in accordance with established procedures.
  • Support incident investigations and documentation activities to improve operational reliability and resilience.
  • Apply operating procedures and compliance requirements to support safe and effective site operations.

Work Orders & Additional Projects

  • Complete operational work orders and support system installations related to facility infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain auxiliary systems and supporting equipment to minimize operational impact.
  • Support approved changes to mechanical, electrical, and specialized systems.
  • Participate in infrastructure upgrades, maintenance programs, lifecycle replacement initiatives, and site improvement projects.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts that enhance operational performance and reliability.

Collaboration

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support operational activities and resolve facility issues.
  • Share knowledge and support team members during maintenance activities and operational events.
  • Communicate inventory and spare-parts requirements to maintain operational readiness.
  • Participate in training and development activities to expand technical capabilities and support career growth.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or equivalent qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience is also valued.
  • Typically 1–3 years of experience in critical facilities, facilities operations, data center operations, industrial facilities, building operations, or a related technical environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Understanding of electrical, mechanical, cooling, or building systems.
  • Familiarity with maintenance procedures, facility monitoring systems, and safe work practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Commitment to safety, operational excellence, and continuous learning.

Work Requirements

  • Ability to perform hands-on operational and maintenance tasks within a data center environment.
  • Ability to work at height and in confined or tight spaces where required.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including shift-based schedules, weekends, night shifts, and public holidays to support 24x7 mission-critical data center operations.

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. job.title: Application Support Developer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Key Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain enterprise applications and digital solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable application designs.
  • Support application integrations, APIs, databases and enterprise systems.
  • Ensure applications meet performance, reliability, security and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with business users, project teams and technical stakeholders throughout project delivery.
  • Support application troubleshooting, incident resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of application architecture, coding standards and development practices.
  • Ensure solution documentation, technical specifications and operational guides remain current and accurate.

Core Responsibilities

1. Application Design & Development

  • Analyse business and functional requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Design, develop and enhance web, mobile or enterprise applications.
  • Create reusable, scalable and maintainable application components.
  • Develop APIs, microservices and system integrations where required.
  • Ensure adherence to software development standards, architecture principles and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical design sessions.

2. System Integration & API Development

  • Develop and maintain application integrations with internal and external systems.
  • Build and support RESTful APIs and service-oriented integrations.
  • Ensure application interfaces are secure, reliable and scalable.
  • Support integration testing and troubleshooting activities.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, security and architecture teams during implementation.

Development references highlight enterprise software development, REST-based integrations, full-stack development, enterprise application platforms and cloud-native architectures.

3. Database Development & Data Management

  • Design and develop database structures, queries, stored procedures and reports.
  • Ensure data integrity, accuracy and performance optimisation.
  • Support database troubleshooting and performance tuning activities.
  • Work closely with data teams on data migration and synchronization requirements.
  • Ensure proper backup, recovery and security controls are implemented.

4. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop and execute unit testing, system testing and integration testing activities.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and defect resolution processes.
  • Ensure applications meet quality, performance and security standards.
  • Assist in release testing and deployment validation.
  • Promote automated testing and quality assurance best practices.

5. Application Support & Maintenance

  • Provide Level 2 / Level 3 application support where required.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis.
  • Support change requests, enhancements and system upgrades.
  • Monitor system performance and recommend improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain system documentation and operational procedures.

Application support, system maintenance, production support and troubleshooting responsibilities are reflected across internal development references.

6. DevOps & Cloud Deployment

  • Support CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Participate in cloud deployment and cloud-native application initiatives.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams on release automation and environment management.
  • Ensure applications are designed with scalability, resilience and observability considerations.
  • Support monitoring and incident management activities.

Cloud-native development, DevSecOps, microservices, CI/CD and automated deployment practices are highlighted within internal application modernization initiatives.

7. Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare technical specifications, design documents and support documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning and solution reviews.
  • Recommend technical improvements, development standards and process enhancements.
  • Keep abreast of emerging technologies, frameworks and development approaches.
  • Contribute to technical knowledge sharing and capability building.

Qualifications, Experience & Knowledge

  • Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of relevant application development experience.
  • Experience building enterprise applications, web applications, APIs or mobile solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum or DevOps delivery practices.
  • Experience with modern programming languages such as:Java
  • C#
  • .NET
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript
  • Python
  • Node.js

Experience with frameworks such as:

  • Spring Boot
  • .NET Framework / .NET Core
  • Angular
  • React
  • Vue.js

Experience working with relational and non-relational databases.Familiarity with cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform would be advantageous.Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

job.title: DevOps Engineer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Key Accountabilities

  • Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient application build, testing, release and deployment activities.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployment using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible or equivalent.
  • Support cloud infrastructure operations across AWS, Azure or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Manage containerised application deployment using Docker, Kubernetes or related orchestration platforms.
  • Monitor infrastructure and application health, identify performance issues and implement proactive improvements.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve deployment quality, system scalability, reliability and resilience.
  • Support incident resolution, root cause analysis, documentation and continuous improvement of operational processes.
  • Ensure DevOps practices are aligned with security, governance, compliance and operational standards.

Core Responsibilities

1. CI/CD Pipeline Management

  • Design, build, maintain and optimise CI/CD pipelines for application deployment.
  • Automate build, test, release and deployment processes to improve delivery speed and consistency.
  • Integrate source code repositories with deployment tools and quality checks.
  • Support pipeline troubleshooting, deployment issue resolution and release coordination.
  • Ensure deployment processes are repeatable, auditable and aligned with release management standards.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Operations

  • Provision, configure and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure or equivalent platforms.
  • Support migration from on-premises environments to cloud or hybrid cloud platforms.
  • Manage compute, storage, networking, security groups, load balancing and related cloud services.
  • Monitor cloud resource usage and support cost optimisation activities.
  • Maintain cloud infrastructure reliability, availability, performance and scalability.

3. Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation or equivalent.
  • Automate system build-outs, environment provisioning and configuration management.
  • Develop automation scripts to reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
  • Maintain reusable infrastructure modules, templates and deployment scripts.
  • Ensure automation practices follow security, governance and documentation standards.

4. Containerisation & Orchestration

  • Build, manage and support containerised application environments using Docker.
  • Deploy and manage workloads on Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration platforms.
  • Support container image management, registry usage and deployment automation.
  • Monitor container platform health, resource utilisation and application performance.
  • Work with development teams to improve container readiness, scalability and resilience.

5. Monitoring, Incident Support & Reliability

  • Implement monitoring, alerting and logging solutions for infrastructure and applications.
  • Track system health indicators, performance trends and anomaly detection.
  • Respond to incidents, perform troubleshooting and support root cause analysis.
  • Document technical resolutions, operational procedures and lessons learned.
  • Recommend improvements to enhance system stability, availability and recoverability.

6. Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Apply security best practices across cloud infrastructure, pipelines and deployment workflows.
  • Support access control, secrets management, patching and vulnerability remediation activities.
  • Ensure DevOps processes comply with internal governance, audit and security requirements.
  • Maintain documentation for configurations, access controls, deployment processes and operational support.
  • Collaborate with security and infrastructure teams to improve DevSecOps practices.

7. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with developers, infrastructure engineers, security teams and business stakeholders.
  • Provide technical input during solution design, deployment planning and production readiness reviews.
  • Recommend improvements to DevOps processes, automation frameworks and platform reliability.
  • Support Agile delivery practices and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Share knowledge, document best practices and contribute to team capability building.

Qualifications, Experience & Knowledge

  • Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, system administration, infrastructure engineering or application deployment support.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD or equivalent.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or equivalent.
  • Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms.
  • Good understanding of Linux / Windows server administration, networking, security and cloud infrastructure concepts.
  • Experience with source code version control tools such as Git.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as CloudWatch, Dynatrace, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced technology environment.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions clearly.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

'

Connectivity

job.title: Lead - Fire Officer
job.description:
Lead Safety & Fire

Operational Management and Readiness:

Manage fire safety manpower, ensuring adequate staffing and readiness for all shifts.

Attend to all rescue/fire calls during the shift within premises and site.

Ensure the fitness and readiness of fire tenders, accessories, and other firefighting equipment.

Assist seniors in the performance of various fire prevention/firefighting duties, as required.

Communicate administrative/firefighting matters to the seniors, as needed and ensure effective communication systems from the fire station are maintained.

Check and ensure all outsourced fire staff or other contracting agencies are reporting for duty as per requirement.

Equipment and System Maintenance:

Maintain and check fire safety systems regularly to ensure efficient operations.

Conduct periodic and standard tests of all fire station equipment, appliances, and breathing apparatus sets.

Responsible for the monthly checks and quarterly maintenance of fire extinguishers as per schedule.

Oversee the refilling of fire extinguishers and maintain records of occurrences and equipment status.

Ensure periodic tests of all fire station equipment, appliances, and BA sets during shifts as per station check sheet requirements.

Training and Campaigns:

Conduct Safety induction Training and vertigo test for new staff and workers of agencies and support in safety campaigns and participate in mock drills to prepare staff for emergency situations.

Conduct various EHS Training programs and track training data and ensure the completion of mandatory training hours as per CEA regulation.

Provide support and required information for investigation of near-miss incidents and incidents to identify root causes and implement preventive measures.

Conduct awareness sessions for agency workmen to reinforce safety standards.

Track and ensure monthly safety virus campaigns to highlight and mitigate potential safety risks.

Provide support for audits and inspections- daily, weekly, monthly to maintain high safety standards and continuous improvement.

Monitoring and Reporting:

Upload daily safety observations for the whole plant in GENSUITE.

Conduct weekly initiatives at assigned areas, prepare reports, and monitor compliance.

Ensure the display of safety signages to maintain awareness and compliance.

Manage the availability and usage of PPEs by staff and workers of agencies at the site as per service order.

Compile and report critical observations for fire safety of the entire plant.

Business Sustainability:

Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Conduct various audits and surveys, including night vigilance, dry grass survey, and critical area audits.

Ensure the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.

Release and monitor Hot work permits in the plant for its compliances.

Ensure adherence to compliances as per KRONOS.

Conduct stand-down meetings and conduct trainings for Rapid Response Team (RRT) members.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

All departments - Station/Plants

Key Stakeholders - External:

Audit Agencies

Contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (preferably in Fire Safety or Chemical Engineering) or related field and mandatory Advanced/Post Diploma in Industrial Safety or Degree (BSc/MSc) in PCM; MSc. in Chemistry + Post Diploma/Advance Diploma or B.Sc. in Fire Engineering/ B.tech Fire Engineering.

Work Experience (Range of years):

8+ years of experience in fire safety management and operations within the power or heavy industry sector.

Preferred Industry:

Power Generation or Energy sector

job.title: Assistant Manager - SCADA

job.title: Director, Service Delivery
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Service Delivery

Service Delivery encompasses the end-to-end deliverables specified in the Service Contract provided by Singtel Group (or its subsidiaries). This includes service governance, client engagement with customers, and managing the expectations and outcomes for both external and internal senior stakeholders. Service Delivery also focuses on account growth and ensuring an excellent customer engagement experience.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for managing multiple account delivery teams in alignment with Singtel's commitments to various service contracts.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to develop strategic and tactical plans to ensure delivery meets contractual obligations to customers. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to): -

  • Driving service delivery to meet and exceed contractual SLA commitments.
  • Sponsoring delivery teams in implementing digitalization initiatives to enhance efficiency and improve the service engagement experience.
  • Managing senior stakeholders (e.g. CxOs, VPs, and IT Heads) through effective communication and portfolio management during major incidents.
  • Building and strengthening client relationships through in-depth knowledge of customer domains.
  • Identifying opportunities and supporting the Sales Team in pursuing new business prospects to grow the EWO portfolio.

Operations

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to lead both the Service and Technical delivery team in day-to-day operations matters, and ensure services are delivered with pride and sustainable model to meet our SLA deliverables. Operation delivery includes leading team on delivery excellence, and drive towards continuous service improvements, and to enhance the service values to the customer.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to engage and manage 3rd party partners and vendors, to align their delivery competency and capabilities with Singtel service contract to our customers.

Financial Management

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to manage the financials for the service portfolios under the purview, in accordance with the Business Case of the service contracts on Cost of Delivery, recovery of cost in respective cost centre in a healthy state.

Financial management responsibilities include but not limited to: -

  • Annual AOP budgeting, financial planning across the portfolio.
  • Manpower and resourcing budgeting
  • Operation run rate and forward planning
  • Monthly financial status tracking and progressive report
  • Operations and Financial optimization

People and Growth

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to coach and mentor Service Delivery Managers, and delivery teams, whether under direct or indirect management (e.g., third-party partners or contractors). This includes providing thought leadership and demonstrating strong people management skills for the various teams within the service portfolios.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for developing a Portfolio Strategy and Tactical Performance Measurement for the teams under their supervision. They should adopt a top-down approach to KPI setting for the delivery teams within the portfolio.

Additionally, the Associate Director, Service Delivery should conduct routine communication sessions with members of the delivery teams and their direct reports to provide directives and guidance. This includes holding weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual meetings, as well as one-on-one sessions and performance assessments, as required.

Corporate Engagement

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support Global Delivery 5 key initiatives within their portfolio: -

  • Customer First,
  • Quality First,
  • People First,
  • Digital First,
  • Security First,

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support any other Singtel and/or SEB corporate program and events, as required.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support and promote collaboration within the delivery teams, Singtel and/or SEB organization.

Skills for Success

  • ITIL Foundation
  • Min 8-10 years working in enterprise scale IT environment or 15 years in senior delivery role managing in Cross Domains (multiple technical domains) enterprise environment

Proficient in

  • Service Delivery Management
  • Project Management
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Proficient in at least 2 or more technical workstreams (Network, System, DB, Storage, Hosting, Cloud, Workplace services, Telco services)
  • Executive Stakeholders Management
  • People management
  • Presentation skills
  • Project P&L & Portfolio Financial Management
  • Coaching / Mentorship skillsets

job.title: Senior Technical Specialist, Mechanical
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

As the Technical Specialist (Mech and Fire), you’ll help shape and deliver critical infrastructure projects across Optus Technical Facilities, including telephone exchanges, data centres and related network facilities. You’ll lead the planning, design, procurement, construction delivery, commissioning and governance of mechanical, electrical, fire, hydraulic and Building Management System infrastructure, ensuring projects are safe, compliant, resilient, cost-effective and delivered with minimal impact to live telecommunications operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify infrastructure constraints, risks, capacity limitations and asset lifecycle requirements across Optus Technical Facilities, contributing to investment strategies and Annual Operating Plan development.
  • Oversee and govern engineering solutions, technical scopes, specifications, standards and design requirements across mechanical, electrical, fire protection, hydraulic, structural and BMS disciplines
  • Review consultant, contractor and vendor designs to ensure compliance with Optus Engineering Standards, Australian Standards, statutory requirements and industry best practice.
  • Develop project scopes, cost estimates, risk assessments, business cases and delivery strategies that balance operational risk, cost, schedule and service continuity.
  • Lead procurement activities, including tender documentation, scope packages, vendor engagement, technical bid evaluations, contractor recommendations and commercial efficiencies.
  • Manage capital expenditure programmes typically ranging from $2 million to $10 million, including budgets, forecasting, expenditure and financial reporting.
  • Lead critical infrastructure projects from award through construction, commissioning and handover across live operational telecommunications environments.
  • Manage contractors, consultants and vendors to ensure safe, compliant and high-quality delivery against programmes, budgets, milestones and operational requirements.
  • Oversee construction planning, staging, site inspections, audits, toolbox meetings, permit systems and resolution of technical issues, defects, non-conformances and delivery risks.
  • Protect continuity of critical services throughout construction and ensure compliance with WHS obligations, construction regulations and operational readiness requirements.
  • Manage commissioning, integrated systems testing and operational handover, including FAT and SAT documentation, asset registration, training, as-built drawings, O&M manuals and defect rectification plans.
  • Maintain effective contractor and supplier relationships, support audit and regulatory compliance activities, and escalate critical project, operational, financial and safety risks with mitigation strategies.

What You Bring

  • A degree in Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  • 10–15 years’ experience delivering critical facility infrastructure projects, ideally across data centres, telecommunications facilities, mission-critical environments or major infrastructure projects.
  • Proven experience in construction delivery, project management and contractor governance across complex, live operational environments.
  • Strong technical understanding of mechanical systems, electrical systems, fire protection systems, BMS and controls, and critical facility infrastructure.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with experience managing CAPEX programmes, procurement activities, project budgets, cost estimates and cashflow forecasts.
  • Detailed knowledge of Australian Standards, the Building Code of Australia and WHS legislation, with a strong focus on compliance, safety and operational resilience.
  • Proven ability to develop business cases, secure funding approvals, prepare technical specifications and scopes of work, and produce tender documentation.
  • Experience with telecommunications infrastructure, data centre design and operations, critical power systems, DC infrastructure, national capital works programmes or asset lifecycle planning is desirable.
  • Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent is desirable.
  • Customer-focused, organised and self-disciplined, with clear written and oral communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • Demonstrated leadership, ownership and teamwork, with the ability to influence Engineering, Operations, Procurement, contractors, suppliers and other delivery partners.

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences.

We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.

We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive.

If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity

Operates machines and production equipment independently in accordance with quality and productivity requirements safely in a manufacturing environment and may instruct or coach others.

job.title: Manufacturing Assembly Process Engineering - Experienced Professional
job.description:
Job Description

Schneider Electric SE is a French multinational company that specializes in digital automation and energy

management. Schneider Electric is a publicly traded Fortune Global 500 company, the company posted revenues

of €34.2 billion. It addresses homes, buildings, data centers, infrastructure and industries, by combining energy

technologies, real-time automation, software, and services. Schneider Electric is the parent company of APC,

Aveva, L&T E&A among so many.

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy

of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage

switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes,

agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

Position Title: Manager – New Product Industrialization

Education: B.Tech ( Electronics) with 5 – 8  years of experience in DFM + FMEA + LabVIEW + PLC + SQL

Location: Vadodara

Key Responsibilities

  • PCBA Assembly & Process Engineering
  • PCBA Assembly Process Ownership:
  • Define, implement, and optimize PCBA assembly processes including SMT, THT, reflow soldering, wave soldering, and selective soldering to meet quality, cost, and throughput targets.
  • DFM / DFA & Manufacturing Support:
  • Review PCB designs for Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA), collaborate with design teams to resolve layout, footprint, and solderability issues before production release.
  • Production, Yield & Quality Improvement:
  • Analyze assembly defects (solder bridges, tombstoning, insufficient solder, component misalignment), drive root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to improve FPY and reduce rework.
  • Create LabVIEW applications for data acquisition, instrument control, and automation.
  • Design and develop electrical panels, including schematics and component selection.
  • Test and debug LabVIEW code and electrical panels to ensure functionality and performance.
  • Implement error handling and corrective actions for both software and hardware components.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to integrate LabVIEW applications and electrical panels with other system components.
  • Participate in design reviews and provide technical input to ensure seamless integration.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of LabVIEW projects and electrical panel designs, including block diagrams, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure documentation is comprehensive, up-to-date, and accessible to team members.
  • Conduct safety analyses and audits to ensure LabVIEW applications and electrical panels comply with relevant standards and regulations.
  • Perform regular audits to verify compliance and implement necessary safety measures.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance to team members and end-users for both LabVIEW applications and electrical panels.
  • Conduct training sessions on the operation and maintenance of LabVIEW applications and electrical panels.
  • Stay updated with the latest technologies and techniques in LabVIEW programming and electrical panel design.
  • Conduct research and development to improve existing solutions and develop innovative new ones.

Functional Competencies:

  • Expertise in PCBA assembly processes (SMT, THT, reflow, wave, selective soldering) with focus on quality, cost, and throughput optimization.
  • Strong capability in DFM/DFA reviews, ensuring manufacturing readiness and first-time-right production.
  • Proven skills in production yield improvement, defect analysis, RCA, and CAPA to enhance FPY and reduce rework.
  • Proficient in LabVIEW-based test automation and electrical panel design, including schematics, integration, and debugging.
  • Effective in cross-functional collaboration, documentation, safety compliance, and technical support across the product lifecycle.

Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable

opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute

their best.

We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate and we ‘embrace different’ as one of our core

values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to

championing inclusivity in everything we do. This extends to our Candidates and is embedded in our Hiring

Practices.

You can find out more about our commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion here and our DEI Policy here

Schneider Electric is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct.

job.title: Engineer II, Materials Engineering
job.description:
Job Description

Roles & mission

The role of a Line Localization Engineer at Schneider Electric is responsible for providing Engineering Support for all assigned Line localization/duplication projects defined with GSC (International). Here's a consolidated overview of the key responsibilities and qualifications:

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all engineering aspects of complex line localization and industrialization projects, ensuring timely delivery of business so as to meet quality, cost, and delivery targets.
  • Collaborate with various departments including Global Supply Chain (GSC), Offer Strategy teams, League Leaders to ensure alignment and seamless project execution.
  • Align with all stakeholders (Quality, Indus, GSC..) to ensure smooth execution and meet the project schedules
  • Collaborate with other  global Hubs (e.g., China, France,NAM) for all aspects of Engineering documentation and support, Gate approvals, know how and knowledge transfer.
  • Planning & Execution- Develop project plans using Work Breakdown Structures, Manage project schedules and monitor KPI achievements for all Line localization projects.
  • Work closely with Product Owners on product technical specifications and Offer Technical Leaders for Engineering documentation, Testing plans,Certification requirements
  • Develop and test product qualification, certification and reliability requirements. Provide technical guidance to cross functional teams esp GSC assigned to Localization project.
  • Coordinate product qualification and documentation for handover to production facilities. Help ensure readiness of local production lines, including tooling, process validation.
  • Manage execution of Manufactured samples build, validation and testing in close co-ordination with GSC Technical & Quality Team
  • Prepare all the artifacts, documents, results, presentations for the stage reviews to meet the stage gates criteria. Provide input into project gate reviews (e.g., Do Gate), and help define the best industrial/supply chain scenarios.
  • Develop and update product documentation including drawings, BOM's and design guides.
  • Ensure timely reporting and updates to all stakeholders on project status and risks.
  • Troubleshoot and perform root cause analysis to resolve design related failures during localization completion and stabilization.
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in product design, testing, and validation processes.
  • Drive process optimization and standardization across localized lines.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, or Electromechanical Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 4-8 years in a similar industry
  • Certifications in PMP, dFSR, Quality tools desired.

Preferred: Preferred experience in LV domain, with understanding of ACB, MCCB, MCB, CTR ( overload relay, contactor, MPCB), Busways; LV panel.  Deep knowledge on 2 (compulsory) or more is desirable.

Skills

Experience in product life cycle  product design & development, production, costing, quality, value engineering,

Fair knowledge on continuous Engineering process with good Project management skills.

Good knowledge on design tools PDM/PLM/Creo. Past experience in SE tools (PDM/Symphony/MCSV/3D/2D drawing release) & SE process is an added advantage

Expertise in CAD tools such as PDM, Creo and geometric dimensioning & tolerancing (GD&T), including tolerance stack-up analysis. Knowledge of GD&T and Tolerance stack up

Fair knowledge on manufacturing processes (e.g., molding, stamping, machining, moulding etc..) & assembly processes  with decent knowledge on materials selection.

Good communication and presentation skills—both verbal and written—with the ability to prepare necessary status reports and technical presentations to stakeholders.

Proven track record of successfully launching new product development, QVE (quality value engineering), customizations, localization of products & part and product transfer project.

Familiarity with industrial costing and supply chain optimization

job.title: Supply Chain Inventory Planner
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

The Supply Chain Inventory Planner is responsible for ensuring the availability, accuracy, and strategic management of spare parts and materials required to support Schneider Electric’s Solar Utility Scale service operations. This role plays a critical part in securing service continuity for our customers by managing end‑to‑end order flows, optimizing inventory levels, and collaborating closely with regional operations teams. The Planner acts as the Supply Chain Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the service organization within the assigned geographic area.

Key Responsibilities

Order & Fulfillment Management

  • Oversee the entire order management cycle, including converting purchase requisitions (PRs) into purchase orders (POs), tracking order status, and coordinating deliveries with the service center and service dispatcher teams.
  • Maintain clear visibility on all spare parts ordered for offline inverters and ensure strict prioritization to prevent customer production losses.

Operational Coordination

  • Act as the Supply Chain SPOC for the local service operations leader, service dispatchers, and service technicians.
  • Develop a strong understanding of preventive maintenance schedules, associated spare parts requirements, and inventory needs for corrective maintenance.

Inventory Optimization

  • Monitor and control inventory levels at the local service center.
  • In collaboration with business operations, establish and update safety stock parameters and replenishment processes twice per year for critical corrective‑maintenance spare parts.
  • Identify inventory excess and propose corrective actions to optimize working capital and overall warehouse efficiency.

Planning & Forecasting

  • Manage large‑volume preventive maintenance orders, ensuring they are placed up to one year in advance to provide a firm forecast signal to the factory.
  • Share regional operational insights with the Supply Chain Operations Leader and the SIOP Leader to support accurate forecasting and regional demand planning.
  • Ensure alignment between regional planning and global supply chain objectives and strategies.
  • Monitor production plans and collaborate closely with manufacturing sites—particularly the Bangalore factory—to ensure timely capacity adjustments and proactively drive production ramp‑ups when required.

Qualifications & Competencies

Experience & Technical Skills

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Planning, Inventory Management, or Service Operations Supply Chain, ideally within industrial, energy, or field‑service environments.
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, data analysis).
  • Strong data orientation with the ability to analyze and deep-dive into ERP systems (NetSuite / Oracle) to extract, validate, and interpret data.
  • Proven ability to generate reports, dashboards, and data-driven recommendations.

Behavioral & Communication Skills

  • Excellent communication skills, capable of building strong working relationships with service leaders, technicians, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational abilities, with a structured and anticipatory approach to workload.
  • Comfortable working under pressure, managing urgent priorities, and maintaining clarity and accuracy in execution.

Mindset & Problem-Solving

  • Proactive, initiative-driven, and solutions-oriented — not just an executor.
  • Demonstrated capacity to identify problems, analyze root causes, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable challenging the status quo and proposing innovative approaches to enhance processes and operational performance.

What's in it for you:

  • Btech Any

job.title: Head of Marketing, India, AWS , Field Marketing-APJ
job.description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a senior marketing leader to define and execute the marketing strategy for India — one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important markets in the Asia Pacific region. This is a player/coach role: you will set the long-term marketing direction for India while staying deeply connected to execution across demand generation, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), events, digital marketing, and public relations.

As the Head of Marketing for India, you will be the single-threaded owner of marketing strategy, planning, and campaign execution targeting startups, developers, digital natives, SMBs, enterprises, and public sector customers across India. You will lead and develop a high-performing regional marketing team, drive orchestration across global marketing functions — including the Integrated Demand Centre (IDC), digital marketing, and events (Flagship and Cohort) — and deliver locally resonant programs that accelerate customer acquisition, pipeline growth, and brand awareness.

You will partner closely with the India sales leadership team, cross-functional marketing leaders across Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ), and global corporate teams to ensure marketing programs are tightly aligned to business priorities and deliver measurable impact.

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with executional rigor, has a proven track record of building and scaling marketing functions in India's technology landscape, and brings a genuine passion for cloud technology and an entrepreneurial mindset.

Key job responsibilities

  • Create compelling, results-driven marketing plans, complete with market assessments that deliver identified objectives to the business
  • Overseeing implementation of the Marketing strategy for India - including campaigns, events, digital marketing, and PR.
  • Lead overall implementation of marketing programs including lead generation activities,

eMarketing campaigns, product & solutions sales support, reference programs, customer & developer marketing programs, etc.

  • Organize, assist and implement marketing events, including the AWS Summits, exhibitions, seminars, tradeshows and product launches.
  • Day to day management and development of the marketing team.
  • Work closely with the company’s Sales team; enabling them to meet their commercial objectives by providing them with appropriate tools, materials and presentations.
  • Develop and execute customer-driven, locally oriented marketing strategies and programs that will increase customer demand, sales, and positively impact Amazon Web Services brand equity.

A day in the life The Head of Marketing for India will be responsible for building and executing marketing plans that deliver customer acquisition and retention programs necessary to power AWS's continued growth in India. The role's core responsibility is to use a combination of strong strategic planning and hands-on execution skills to successfully plan, develop, execute, and measure demand generation programs that deliver marketing contribution to the sales pipeline. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and action — setting the quarterly roadmap in the morning, reviewing campaign performance data over lunch, and joining a customer event debrief in the afternoon. No two days look the same, and that's what makes this role exciting.

  • 6+ years of team management experience
  • 15+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
  • Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners

  • Experience leading across multiple locales
  • Experience working cross-functionally with partner teams to drive adoption and usage of brand assets and messaging
  • Experience in strategic marketing management and market analysis and demonstrated ability to build and execute a strategy with clear goals and objectives to align to business and service objectives, and support portfolio objectives
  • Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
  • Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions, or experience communicating results to senior leadership

  • Deep understanding of the India technology and enterprise market landscape

job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Amazon Data Services (India) Pvt. Ltd. (ADSIPL) Data Center Security Group is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Systems Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems.

You will also be responsible for the continuous review of existing standards and to stay abreast of developments in new technology that will enhance the physical security of ADSIPL data centers and co-locations. You will work directly with the Cluster Security Manager, the Infrastructure Operations and Construction teams, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate the business' requirements into physical security systems design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the construction and deployment of physical security packages for all ADSIPL data centers and co-locations in the cluster. You will also work closely with contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with all security standards during the construction, testing and acceptance phases of the projects.

The ideal candidate for the role will have demonstrated the ability to work in all disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will have an in-depth knowledge of security technology, be innovative, highly organized, and will have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.

Key job responsibilities You will be responsible for observing Physical Security Standards and Programs that support the goals of the Global Physical Security Team, while enabling the local site managers to draw related services from the team, in a self-service manner. This includes: Excellent large-scale project and program management experience, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment Lead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, data center expansions and special projects

  • Lead physical multi-million-dollar security project lifecycle management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budget, change orders, and close-out documentation.
  • Contemporary knowledge of emerging physical security technologies to assess their applicability within the AWS physical security program.
  • Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) support for leadership to make strategic decisions regarding technology and procedure.

Effective prioritization of tasks, and seamless operation across organizational boundaries

  • Execution and coordination of preventative maintenance and repairs to security system equipment.
  • Ensuring compliance with physical security project standards, project Scopes of Work, budgets and timelines.
  • Designing, developing, and implementing solutions for system installations, upgrades, repairs and change management.

Supporting security system equipment commissioning, Completing final Test, Acceptance and project hand-off Building and deploying training programs for all users of physical security systems

job.title: Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support, ES – APJC-ASEAN
job.description:
The AWS Enterprise Support team is growing to meet the demands of a portfolio of always-on, latency-sensitive enterprise customers whose production workloads run across global AWS regions. As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the named technical point of accountability for some of the team's largest accounts — owning architectural guidance, operational strategy, and proactive support delivery end to end. The team is investing in three areas where you will have immediate impact: converting recurring support patterns into reusable automation and documented procedures, deepening technical expertise in databases, containers, networking, and capacity planning, and shifting the delivery mix from reactive case work to proactive resilience reviews, cost planning, and measurable customer outcomes. If you want to own a customer relationship where every interaction matters and your contributions raise the bar for the whole team, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers, advising on cloud architecture, operational strategy, and launch readiness across global AWS regions.
  • Assess customer environments for architectural risks and scaling constraints, then build actionable plans that maintain business continuity for workloads with 24/7 uptime requirements and unpredictable demand patterns.
  • Collaborate with account teams, Solutions Architects, and AWS service teams for compute, database, container, and networking services to resolve complex issues and drive product improvements informed by real customer patterns.
  • Analyze operational metrics and deliver periodic performance reviews to customer leadership, translating data into clear recommendations that strengthen security posture, cost efficiency, and system reliability.
  • Contribute to the team's shared knowledge base, standard operating procedures, and reusable automation, and mentor fellow Technical Account Managers to raise the collective capability of the group.

A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing an operational dashboard for a customer whose traffic can spike without warning, then jump into a call with their engineering team — in Mandarin — to walk through a scaling plan for an upcoming product release. After lunch you could be partnering with an AWS service team to troubleshoot a networking issue that spans a complex multi-account topology, and later in the afternoon you present a quarterly architecture review to a customer's leadership, highlighting risks mitigated and opportunities ahead.

About the team We are a cross-border Enterprise Support team within AWS that serves enterprise customers headquartered in Singapore while their production infrastructure runs in global AWS regions. Our closest partners are the account teams and Solutions Architects on our shared accounts, along with AWS service teams in compute, database, container, and networking. As our customer portfolio grows and workloads become more demanding, we are looking for a senior engineer ready to take designated ownership of key accounts and help us scale proactive delivery through better mechanisms, deeper technical expertise, and shared tooling.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of technical engineering experience
  • Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Proficiency in Mandarin is required as the role involves liaising with Mandarin-speaking clients/business partners/stakeholders/customers who predominantly communicate in Mandarin.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
  • Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

job.title: Principal Strategist, Energy & Water Infrastructure, Energy & Water - Asia Pacific Region
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Principal-level strategic leader to define and orchestrate the energy and water regulatory and community strategy across the Asia-Pacific region. This is a high-visibility role that operates at the intersection of regulatory policy, energy markets, and community engagement, requiring industry expertise to shape the environment in which AWS deploys critical infrastructure at scale.

You will orchestrate regulatory and community strategy across interconnected pillars: energy and water regulatory strategy that informs advocacy and prepares organizations for changing policy landscapes; and community strategy that builds social license to operate and positions AWS as a responsible, transparent infrastructure partner. You will work closely with Public Policy teams and will serve as the external face of AWS energy and water infrastructure in APAC, representing the organization at industry conferences, in media engagements, and before regulatory forums.

Key job responsibilities

  • Regulatory Strategy: Own the APAC energy, water, and sustainability regulatory strategy; monitor and forecast policy changes across markets, and proactively shape frameworks before they crystallize.
  • Advocacy Direction: Set the strategic direction that informs Public Policy priorities; providing the technical analysis, impact assessments, and positions that determine where and how AWS engages regulators and industry bodies.
  • Regulatory Readiness: Prepare internal teams to anticipate and respond to changing regulations, translating regulatory risk into practical action.
  • Community Strategy & Social License: Own a proactive community engagement framework, treating social license as a critical path for infrastructure delivery, and mitigate sentiment risk through transparent messaging on sustainability, clean energy, and water stewardship

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
  • Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
  • 10+ years of experience in energy, water, utilities, infrastructure, regulatory affairs, industry strategy, or related fields
  • Experience working with external stakeholders such as regulators, government agencies, or industry bodies in one of the markets in Asia Pacific region
  • Track record of public speaking, conference presentations, or media engagement in energy, water, or sustainability
  • Comfortable representing the organization in external settings, such as industry events or public forums

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing and executing regulatory or stakeholder engagement strategies across multiple Asia Pacific markets
  • Background in data center infrastructure, cloud computing, or large-scale technology infrastructure

job.title: Backbone Technical Business Developer, APAC Backbone
job.description:
AWS operates one of the world's largest and most complex backbone networks, connecting Regions and Availability Zones across 190+ countries to deliver highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable cloud infrastructure. Behind this global footprint is a network that must continuously scale to meet exponential demand while maintaining the highest levels of reliability and cost efficiency.

We are seeking a highly motivated Backbone Network Business Developer with strong commercial and technical acumen to join our Asia Pacific (APAC) team within the Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development (GCID) organization. In this role, you will develop innovative solutions to scale and expand the AWS backbone network across the APAC region, operating at the intersection of network engineering, commercial strategy, and vendor management. You will be responsible for planning, sourcing, and delivering the network infrastructure that powers AWS operations and connects AWS to the rest of the world.

As a subject matter expert in the telecommunications marketplace, you will bring deep experience with vendors, physical network infrastructure, optical technologies, and backbone network engineering. You will drive end-to-end commercial and technical vendor strategy across the region, developing solutions for wavelengths, dark fiber, and submarine cable capacity. Partnering with capacity planners, network engineers, and finance teams, you will ensure the most efficient and cost-effective network topology is delivered on time and within budget. You will also track telecommunications market trends, evaluate emerging technologies, and apply a unique blend of industry and technical expertise to find creative solutions that meet AWS's ongoing growth needs.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end supplier identification, evaluation, and contracting for backbone capacity, wavelengths, dark fiber, colocation, and submarine cable infrastructure across the APAC region.
  • Develop and negotiate technical and commercial solutions that optimize total cost of ownership while ensuring long-term scalability, route diversity, and network resilience.
  • Build strategic backbone network plans and investment business cases aligned with long-term capacity forecasts, and present actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders for approval.
  • Organize, track, and coordinate across multiple suppliers and internal teams to deliver new backbone capacity on time, within budget, and in compliance with operational standards.
  • Partner with capacity planners and network engineers to design the most efficient and cost-effective network topology across longhaul, metro, and subsea paths.
  • Collaborate with finance partners on business case development, operational budget planning, and end-to-end financial tracking of projects and supplier commitments.
  • Track telecommunications market trends, emerging technologies, supplier diversity, pricing benchmarks, and commercial frameworks to continuously inform sourcing strategy and surface new opportunities.

About the team About AWS

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience working in a network planning, network construction/implementation, or commercial implementation role at an ISP, telecoms operator, or Hyperscaler
  • Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
  • 3+ years of experience in the telecommunications or network infrastructure industry, with a focus on solving complex technical and commercial challenges
  • Experience leading or contributing to the architecture, design, and deployment of large-scale network systems, with a focus on capacity scaling, reliability engineering, and operational readiness
  • Experience developing financial models, business cases, and investment analyses that drive measurable business impact

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of IP networking fundamentals such as BGP, OSPF and other R&S technologies
  • Experience working in large-scale backbone or long-haul networking environments, including terrestrial and subsea infrastructure
  • Strong knowledge of optical transport technologies, DWDM systems, fiber optic cable types, and network test equipment
  • Experience negotiating and managing contracts with telecommunications suppliers, including pricing structures, SLAs, and capacity agreements
  • Knowledge of the APAC telecommunications landscape, including key carriers, submarine cable systems, and regulatory environments
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to model complex trade-offs across cost, capacity, route diversity, and risk
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations to senior stakeholders and influence across organizational boundaries

job.title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead (ELSP Pilot)__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you'll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. We are seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Power Electronics Engineer to join our Electrification business and lead the development of advanced power conversion and power quality solutions. This role will be responsible for technical leadership, design, validation, and continuous improvement of high-power electronic systems supporting critical industrial, utility, renewable energy, data center, and infrastructure applications.

You will work across the full product lifecycle, from concept development and system architecture through design, testing, industrialization, and field support. This is an excellent opportunity to help shape the next generation of power quality and energy management solutions while working with industry-leading technologies.

The work model for this role is onsite #LI-Onsite in either Auckland or Napier.

This role is contributing to the Critical Power product group in New Zealand.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead the design and development of high-power electronic converter systems, defining system architectures, converter control strategies, and technical solutions while conducting DFMEA activities to identify and mitigate potential failure modes early in the development process.
  • Review and approve designs, calculations, simulations, and test plans, while driving decision-making across multidisciplinary engineering teams and mentoring junior engineers to strengthen overall team capability.
  • Develop power converter topologies (VSI, CSI, etc.) for UPS and energy storage systems, including power stage design and analysis using IGBT, SiC, and GaN semiconductor technologies.
  • Lead modelling and simulation activities (SPICE, PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent), define validation strategies, and oversee laboratory testing to ensure products meet performance, reliability, safety, and compliance requirements.
  • Lead root cause investigations, drive corrective and preventive actions, and identify opportunities for performance improvements, cost reductions, and reliability enhancements.
  • Contribute to intellectual property development and drive compliance with applicable standards and regulations, including UL, IEC, RoHS, REACH, and other customer requirements.

Our team dynamics

You will join a dynamic and high-performing technical team within the Critical Power division. As a Senior Power Electronics Engineer, you will be part of an Agile Team, report to the Chapter Leader and collaborate with a diverse group of power electronics specialists, control systems engineers, and mechanical engineers. You will have the opportunity to mentor junior engineers and contribute to their professional development, while working across multi-site teams to deliver world-class solutions. This collaborative environment values technical innovation, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnerships that drive product excellence.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related discipline, with minimum 8+ years of experience in power electronics design and development.
  • Strong expertise in three-phase multi-megawatt power systems, power converter topologies, grid-connected power electronic applications, and power quality and energy storage systems.
  • Extensive experience with simulation and modelling tools such as SPICE, PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of power semiconductor devices, magnetics, filters and harmonics, thermal design, and protection systems.
  • Proven ability to lead complex engineering projects from concept to production.
  • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and technical domains.
  • Significant experience in working within multi-site and large engineering teams.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to the Hawkes Bay region if based in Auckland.

More about us

ABB's Critical Power product group, within the Smart Power Division, is a global leader in advanced UPS and energy storage solutions serving mission-critical applications worldwide. We protect the world's most demanding operations—from data centers and semiconductor fabrication plants to pharmaceutical manufacturing, cable production, aerospace facilities, and critical infrastructure. Our solutions enable 24/7 uptime and energy efficiency for the world's largest hyperscale data centers and enterprise customers, directly supporting the digital transformation of society.

Our engineering expertise spans over 50 years of innovation in power conversion technology. We design and deploy cutting-edge UPS systems ranging from 150 kVA to 3,000+ kVA, featuring advanced modular architectures and the latest energy storage technologies including traditional VRLA batteries, next-generation lithium-ion solutions, and innovative nickel-zinc battery systems. Our products achieve industry-leading efficiency exceeding 95-99%, with exceptional reliability standards including full online double-conversion architecture and redundant modular designs for mission-critical applications.

The Napier facility is home to our power electronics engineering hub and represents ABB's commitment to innovation in the Asia-Pacific region. We are actively developing next-generation technologies to support the global energy transition, including PowerExchanger grid support services that unlock revenue streams from UPS energy storage assets and enable broader renewable energy integration. Our focus on sustainability is evidenced by our comprehensive portfolio of environmentally certified solutions and our commitment to helping customers achieve their carbon reduction targets.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.title: Compressor Service Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Compressor Service Engineer

Objective: To perform efficient troubleshooting, maintenance, overhauling, testing, and commissioning of HVAC compressors, including screw, centrifugal, and magnetic bearing compressors, ensuring maximum equipment reliability, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and adherence to quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities Compressor Overhauling & Repair

Establish and lead a world-class HVAC Compressor Overhaul & Service Center capable of independently handling Screw, Centrifugal, and Magnetic Bearing Compressors through development of overhaul processes, troubleshooting expertise, tools & test facilities, technical documentation, spare part management, and customer support, ensuring high equipment reliability, reduced turnaround time, and superior service quality.

Perform complete dismantling, inspection, overhauling, and assembly of: o Oil Flooded Screw Compressors o Centrifugal Compressors o Magnetic Bearing Oil-Free Compressors

Conduct detailed inspection of: o Rotors o Impellers o Diffusers o Bearings o Shafts o Couplings o Seals o Motor components

Measure critical dimensions and clearances using precision instruments.

Prepare inspection reports with recommendations for component repair or replacement.

Execute compressor rebuilding as per OEM standards. Magnetic Bearing Compressor Expertise

Diagnose and troubleshoot magnetic bearing systems.

Understand operation of: o Active Magnetic Bearings (AMB) o Variable Speed Drives (VSD) o Position Sensors o Magnetic Bearing Controller Systems

Perform health checks and analysis of magnetic bearing compressor data logs.

Support commissioning and fault diagnosis of oil-free centrifugal chillers. Troubleshooting & Failure Analysis

Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for: o Bearing failures o Rotor damage o Surge conditions o High vibration o Motor failures o Refrigerant leakage o Oil contamination. Analyze vibration spectra and performance parameters.

Develop corrective and preventive action plans. Assembly, Testing & Commissioning

Precision assembly of compressor rotating components.

Rotor runout and clearance verification.

Alignment and balancing activities.

Witness and perform: o Leak Tests o Hydro Tests o Pneumatic Tests o Mechanical Run Tests o Performance Tests

Support commissioning and startup of chillers and compressor packages. Field Service Activities

Attend customer sites during planned shutdowns and emergency breakdowns. Execute annual maintenance contracts (AMC) and preventive maintenance activities.

Prepare service reports and customer recommendations.

Provide technical guidance to service technicians and customers. Required

Qualifications

Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.

Minimum 7 ~9 years hands-on experience in HVAC compressor overhaul.
