job.title: Principal Consultant - Infra Ops
job.description:
Principal Consultant - Infra Ops

Johnson Controls is seeking a Principal Consultant - Infra Ops to support the IT solution delivery component of the investment portfolio for a specific function or capability within a project. This role combines infrastructure operations knowledge with delivery discipline, stakeholder coordination, and clear accountability for outcomes.

Role Overview

In this role, you will help translate portfolio priorities into executable delivery plans, coordinate across business and IT partners, and support infrastructure operations initiatives from planning through implementation. You will work in a senior advisory capacity to keep delivery aligned to scope, schedule, quality, and business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accountable for the IT solution delivery component of the investment portfolio for a specific function or capability within a project.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, PMO, IT Delivery, and Infrastructure Operations teams to align scope, priorities, and delivery plans.
  • Support planning and execution of infrastructure operations initiatives, including dependencies, timelines, risks, and issue resolution.
  • Track progress against scope, cost, schedule, quality, adoption, and value outcomes.
  • Prepare clear status updates, decision points, and delivery documentation for stakeholders.
  • Coordinate escalation paths and support transition of delivered work into operational support.
  • Contribute to governance, risk management, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.

How You Will Do It

  • Take ownership of commitments by acting with accountability and integrity, tracking actions, surfacing risks early, and following through until issues are resolved.
  • Stay close to the work by working directly with delivery teams and stakeholders to remove blockers and keep priorities clear.
  • Use practical problem-solving to simplify dependencies, challenge assumptions, and keep delivery moving.
  • Collaborate across functions so business, PMO, and IT partners can make decisions with shared context and trust.
  • Improve every day by learning from delivery outcomes, communicating candidly, and applying lessons to future work.

Qualifications

  • University degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 6+ years of experience in IT solution delivery, infrastructure operations, or a related consulting or delivery role; more than 7 years of experience is preferred for this principal-level scope.
  • Experience coordinating project delivery, dependencies, and stakeholder communication across multiple functions.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure operations concepts, delivery governance, and service transition.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in a matrixed environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting PMO processes, steering committee updates, or portfolio governance forums.
  • Exposure to Agile or Waterfall delivery approaches.
  • Experience working with both business and technical teams on complex delivery initiatives.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to take a visible role in delivery work that connects infrastructure operations with business priorities. You will work with cross-functional teams, contribute to meaningful outcomes, and help strengthen the way work moves from planning to execution.

job.title: ServiceNow Senior Analyst
job.description:
ServiceNow Analyst - ITSM

Johnson Controls is seeking a ServiceNow Analyst - ITSM to support the ongoing enhancement and administration of the ServiceNow IT Service Management environment. In this role, you will help improve how IT teams manage incidents, requests, changes, problems, and service workflows across the business.

Role Overview

This position plays a key role in translating business and IT process needs into practical ServiceNow solutions. You will work with stakeholders, developers, process owners, and support teams to maintain reliable ITSM functionality, improve user experience, and support continuous service improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the ServiceNow ITSM platform across core processes such as incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge management.
  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for enhancements, process improvements, and platform changes.
  • Work with IT teams and stakeholders to configure, test, and deploy ServiceNow updates and workflow improvements.
  • Assist with data quality, reporting, dashboards, and KPI tracking for ITSM processes.
  • Support user acceptance testing, defect resolution, and release coordination for ServiceNow changes.
  • Maintain clear documentation for process flows, configuration decisions, and support procedures.
  • Help troubleshoot platform issues and coordinate with technical teams on root cause analysis and resolution.
  • Contribute to service improvement initiatives and help standardize ITSM practices across teams.

How You Will Do It

  • Own your commitments by following through on requests, tracking actions carefully, and raising risks early so issues can be resolved quickly and responsibly.
  • Stay close to the work by working directly with process owners, support teams, and end users to understand real pain points and remove barriers.
  • Improve every day by using feedback, incident trends, and testing results to simplify processes, strengthen controls, and make ServiceNow easier to use.
  • Win as one team by collaborating across IT and business partners, sharing information openly, and building trust through clear communication and dependable execution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience supporting ServiceNow ITSM or a similar IT service management platform.
  • Working knowledge of ITSM processes such as incident, request, change, problem, and knowledge management.
  • Experience gathering requirements, documenting processes, and supporting testing or deployment activities.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to data quality and process accuracy.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, process owners, and end users in a matrixed environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ServiceNow reporting, dashboards, workflow configuration, or CMDB-related activities.
  • Exposure to Agile delivery practices or structured release management.
  • Experience supporting integration points between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to support a critical platform that helps improve service delivery, process consistency, and end-user experience. You will work with collaborative teams, contribute to meaningful IT improvements, and help shape how ITSM capabilities evolve across the organization.

job.description:
Job Description

This role will lead complex technical programs, establishes scope and milestones, improves cross-team processes, automates reporting, and acts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams.

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

Program Ownership

  • Lead one or more major GPU Cluster Health domains such as strategic customer availability, partner repair execution, RMA/spares governance, data/reporting framework, repair workflow improvement, or engineering platform tooling.
  • Translate availability gaps into structured programs with scope, owners, milestones, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive-ready status.
  • Drive weekly operating rhythm for assigned domains, including KPI review, blockers, escalations, decisions, and follow-through.

Customer and Horizontal Leadership

  • Support the vertical/horizontal TPM model by owning either a customer vertical or a horizontal functional area.
  • For vertical ownership, lead availability and repair strategy for assigned strategic customers and customer clusters.
  • For horizontal ownership, lead cross-cutting programs such as NVIDIA/AMD partner tracking, SDE/SRE tooling, RMA/spares feedback loop, SOP tracking, or metrics/reporting framework.

KPI Definition and Governance

  • Define KPI measurement methods for repair health, including cluster availability, unavailable-host backlog, repair cycle time, repair success rate, reopen rate, spare availability, RMA loop performance, partner responsiveness, and SLA/SLO adherence.
  • Drive consistent reporting standards across TPMs and support teams.
  • Identify trends across multiple workstreams and convert them into prioritized corrective actions.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with India, Morocco, and Mexico SDE/SRE teams to identify tooling and first-level support needs.
  • Prioritize tooling requirements that reduce manual repair coordination, improve triage, automate reporting, or accelerate repair handoffs.
  • Work with GSL, CHS, CPV, TRS, Warminator, and data center operations to remove repair blockers.
  • Support incident-style escalation for clusters at availability risk.

Continuous Improvement

  • Lead post-program retrospectives and drive process updates.
  • Standardize repeatable playbooks, intake processes, escalation paths, and repair governance artifacts.
  • Identify automation opportunities and advocate for prioritization.

Expected Outcomes

  • Major repair programs have clear objectives, metrics, owners, and measurable improvement.
  • Leadership has reliable visibility into customer cluster health and repair risk.
  • Repair blockers are resolved through structured governance instead of ad hoc escalation.

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical) - Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
job.description:
Job Summary

At Equinix, our Critical Facilities Specialists operate, manage, maintain, and repair critical and non-critical power systems, HVAC, BMS, plumbing, fire control & suppression, and all site services. Our critical facilities specialists also perform all related vendor support in a mission critical environment.

This fast-paced role supports the overall functioning of the data center by focusing on maintaining and improving the facility’s critical infrastructure. This includes all regularly scheduled maintenance and ad hoc repairs/troubleshooting. We have a role for an Electrical specialist based at Derrimut and are looking to interview immediately for the position.

This role will be suitable for an individual with positive attitude who is willing to go beyond a job description and a written process to contribute to the success of our data center operations. As the critical facilities specialist will work in a highly collaborative environment, a team-first mindset will be crucial in navigating through the workdays.

Responsibilities

  • Completes all maintenance protocols, plans, activities on time and accurately, including daily, weekly, and monthly site checks
  • May manage and oversee specialist vendors for all major works, planned repairs and maintenance, electrical, and special systems
  • Ensures that sufficient spare parts are available on site for frequently used parts or parts with long lead times and maintains critical spares register
  • Monitors for and responds to BMS (Building Monitoring System) alarms in accordance with engineering policies and procedures, escalating to and working with Controls Engineering team where required
  • Participate in an on-call roster to act as the first responder for sites’ incidents, managing, resolving, and/or escalating critical issues outside of regular working hours
  • Oversee plumbing, security and fire suppression systems vendor activities
  • Coordinates/oversee work with vendors to ensure that maintenance activities are carried out as per Equinix's requirements
  • Commissioning and project work that will vary in scale and scope over time
  • Edits and tracks the work approval process for service providers (including briefing at the start of work, control of work during the day, final review of the work carried out)
  • Recommend changes/updates to technical files for plants and equipment in cooperation with vendor, and the supervisors, ensuring as built are up to date
  • Creates engineering scripts (switching schedules) and undertake safe switching practice.
  • Ensures that all Equinix safety standards are followed, as well quality procedures related to maintenance, including all Incident Management
  • Reviews processes, procedures, systems. Communicates process deviations and proposed changes to a higher level so that relevant follow-up measures can be carried out
  • Develops training and supports training of other Data Center (International Business Exchange) employees in relevant engineering topics and processes
  • Provides guidance and mentoring to other team members while being mentored on any areas of improvement

Qualifications, key skills, and attributes required:

  • Understanding through practical experience of critical facility operations and equipment, particularly electrical systems and infra
  • Trade qualification or Degree Certified with previous hands-on or service work experience
  • Sound knowledge or understanding of Controls would be a bonus
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting and repairing complex mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in time-sensitive situations
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workload effectively
  • Capability to execute tasks through effort and collaboration without formal written process
  • Collaborative mindset but also with the drive to complete assigned tasks autonomously when required

Benefits of the role:

  • Monday-Friday role based at a static site with flexible work arrangements
  • Salary package containing shares, annual bonus, healthcare allowance

job.title: People & Culture Operations Manager (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

The Role

Based in Singapore, this role will work closely with the VP, People & Culture in driving the regional HR operations agenda across Singapore, Australia, Japan, Malaysia and other APAC markets as the business grows. It is newly created and will focus on HR systems implementation and optimisation, process excellence, data integrity, employee lifecycle management and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on operational leader who is comfortable working across countries, managing change and translating regional requirements into practical, user-friendly processes.

Key Responsibilities

People operations and employee lifecycle

  • Continuously improve end-to-end people operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, probation, employee changes, transfers, offboarding and HR documentation.
  • Establish clear, consistent and scalable regional processes, service standards, workflows, templates and governance.
  • Ensure employee records, HR documentation and people data are accurate, complete, secure and maintained in line with company policy and local requirements.
  • Partner with country HR teams and external providers to ensure effective delivery of local HR administration, payroll inputs and statutory processes.
  • Identify operational risks, bottlenecks and inconsistencies, and implement practical solutions to improve service quality and efficiency.

HR systems, data and reporting

  • Lead the implementation, optimisation and ongoing management of HR systems, including HRIS, ATS, performance management, learning and other people-related platforms.
  • Act as the regional process owner for HR systems, ensuring effective system configuration, user adoption, data quality and governance.
  • Partner with IT, Finance, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Learning and external vendors on system integrations, enhancements and issue resolution.
  • Develop meaningful dashboards, reports and metrics to support workforce planning, decision-making and operational oversight.
  • Establish strong data-management practices, including regular audits, reporting controls and data-privacy requirements.
  • Support HR teams and managers to resolve issues with HR systems whenever required.

Change management and process excellence

  • Support and lead regional People & Culture process-improvement initiatives, from requirements gathering and process design through implementation, communication, training and adoption.
  • Develop change-management plans that enable leaders, managers and employees to adopt new systems, processes and ways of working.
  • Simplify and standardise regional processes while allowing for appropriate local-market requirements.
  • Build process documentation, training materials, user guides and knowledge resources that improve self-service and reduce operational dependency.
  • Monitor service delivery and stakeholder feedback, using insights to drive continuous improvement.

Stakeholder and team leadership

  • Partner closely with the country HR teams and business leaders to understand operational needs and deliver effective solutions.
  • Provide guidance and support to People & Culture team members on operations, systems and process requirements.
  • Build strong working relationships with Finance, IT, Legal, Payroll and other internal stakeholders.
  • Manage relevant vendors and service providers, including performance, service levels, cost and compliance.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Management or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 8-10 years’ experience in HR operations, HRIS, change management, or shared services, in a regional or multi-country environment.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing or improving HR systems and processes.
  • Strong understanding of the employee lifecycle, HR data management, HR governance and operational controls.
  • Experience working across multiple APAC countries and managing different local practices and requirements.
  • Strong project- and change-management capability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with HR data, reports and dashboards.
  • Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to explain processes and systems clearly to non-HR audiences.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and solutions-focused, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience in a high-growth, infrastructure, technology, engineering, construction or operational environment will be advantageous.
  • Demonstrate leadership capabilities without direct authority.

Core Competencies

  • Operational excellence: Creates clear, efficient and scalable processes, with strong attention to quality, control and service delivery.
  • Systems and digital mindset: Uses HR technology, data and automation to improve the employee and manager experience.
  • Change leadership: Plans and delivers change in a structured, practical manner that builds stakeholder understanding and adoption.
  • Continuous improvement: Proactively identifies inefficiencies, root causes and opportunities to simplify, standardise and improve.
  • Regional collaboration: Works effectively across different countries, cultures and local-market requirements while maintaining a consistent regional approach.
  • Stakeholder management: Builds trusted relationships, communicates clearly and influences stakeholders at all levels.
  • Commercial and strategic judgement: Balances employee experience, operational efficiency, compliance, risk and business priorities.
  • Data-driven decision-making: Uses accurate people data and meaningful insights to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
  • Ownership and execution: Takes accountability, follows through on commitments and manages multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Integrity and discretion: Handles sensitive employee information with professionalism, sound judgement and confidentiality.

What Success Looks Like

  • People operations are consistent, efficient and fit for scale across APAC.
  • HR systems are well adopted, reliable and provide accurate, useful people data.
  • Employees and managers have a clear, positive experience throughout key people processes.
  • Country HR teams spend less time on manual administration and more time on value-adding business support.
  • Operational risks, data-quality issues and process gaps are proactively identified and addressed.
  • The People & Culture function is equipped to support STACK’s continued growth across APAC.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK Infrastructure provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

job.title: Data Scientist - Deputy Manager
job.description:
1 Business Understanding & Solution Design

  • Engage business SPOCs to define problem statements, success criteria and decision workflows; convert them into analytical use cases.
  • Prepare Business Requirement Documents, Solution Design Documents and approach notes; obtain sign-off from business and techno-functional owners.
  • Define KPIs, accuracy thresholds and acceptance criteria before development begins.

3.2 Data Engineering & Governance

  • Source, reconcile, and validate data across internal systems, SCADA/market feeds, weather, and third-party sources.
  • Apply data quality controls — unique-key checks, missing-block detection, completeness checks, duplicate handling, time-zone standardization and mapping validation — before model training and reporting.
  • Build reproducible feature pipelines including lagged, rolling, calendar and exogenous features.

3.3 Model Development & Validation

  • Develop and tune machine learning and time-series models (tree-based, boosting, statistical and deep learning methods) for demand, price, sales and footfall forecasting.
  • Deliver computer vision and NLP solutions for compliance checks, monitoring and document/resume intelligence use cases.
  • Develop Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions using LLMs, RAG and tool-enabled agents to automate enterprise workflows and support intelligent decision-making.
  • Perform back-testing, ensemble comparison, error attribution and block-level validation; benchmark against existing baselines using MAPE, bias and unexplained variance.

3.4 Deployment & MLOps

  • Deploy models on Databricks and Azure with scheduled jobs, automated retraining triggers and outputs published to the Unity Catalog.
  • Remove manual dependencies through automation; ensure monitoring, versioning and fallback logic for production runs.
  • Coordinate with data engineering and IT for integration, UAT and production rollout.

3.5 Reporting, Stakeholder & Project Management

  • Present results, accuracy trends and recommendations to business heads and senior leadership; publish minutes of meeting and track actions.
  • Manage delivery through JIRA — break down epics into stories and tasks, track dependencies, risks and timelines in an Agile cadence.
  • Mentor junior data scientists and interns; review code, methodology and documentation.

Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in Data Science, Big Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 3–6 years of applied data science experience with at least one solution deployed to production.

Preferred

  • Domain exposure to power and energy markets, utilities, manufacturing, cement or aviation.
  • Certifications in Databricks, Azure Data Engineering / AI, or cloud ML platforms.
  • Publications or conference presentations in applied analytics or operations research.

job.title: Engineer, Project Delivery, Korea
job.description:
Who we are

**

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

**

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

The Engineer, Project Delivery is a hands-on technical role embedded within the in-country construction team, responsible for providing civil and structural engineering oversight across the full project lifecycle – from pre-construction design support through construction QA/QC to structural completion, building envelope close-out and handover.

Reporting to the in-country Project Director, this role acts as the owner’s on-site C&S representative, ensuring that all civil and structural works are designed, constructed, verified and closed out in accordance with Digital Edge’s technical standards, customer requirements, applicable local building codes, and Ready-for-Service (RFS) milestones.

During pre-construction, the Engineer, Project Delivery supports design delivery by reviewing civil and structural deliverables – including the seismic, multi-storey and high floor-loading requirements typical of mature-market data centre sites – and coordinating with consultants and statutory bodies. During construction, the role shifts to a resident engineer and QA/QC function – the most critical phase – acting as the primary in-country owner of quality and design intent for all civil and structural scope from earthworks and foundations through to structural completion. During completion and handover, the role coordinates statutory inspections and structural certification and enables timely release of work areas to follow-on MEP and fit-out trades.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Construction & Design Support

  • Review and provide technical input on civil and structural design deliverables (concept, schematic, detailed design, and IFC drawings) – including seismic design, base isolation/damping where applicable, multi-storey structural frames and high floor-loading zones – to ensure alignment with Digital Edge standards and the Hypercore reference design.
  • Coordinate with the platform Design Delivery team, the local Architect/Engineer of Record and external consultants to resolve design queries, RFIs, and value engineering proposals relating to civil and structural scope.
  • Lead constructability reviews for foundations, structural frame, and building envelope, identifying potential clashes, sequencing issues, and long-lead procurement dependencies (structural steel, precast, façade).
  • Support statutory approvals for civil and structural scope, including building permit and structural review submissions, coordination with local authorities and third-party structural checkers.
  • Participate in design review gates and provide field-informed feedback to improve design quality and buildability.

Construction Execution – QA/QC & Resident Engineer (Primary Focus)

  • Act as the owner’s C&S representative on site, providing day-to-day oversight of all civil and structural works from the earliest stage of construction.
  • Conduct QA/QC inspections across all civil and structural works – including earthworks, piling and foundations, reinforced concrete works, structural steel, precast elements, building envelope/façade, waterproofing and roofing, seismic restraint and anchorage, equipment plinths and support structures, and external works/hardstand.
  • Validate contractor compliance with approved method statements, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), shop drawings, material submittals, and material test certificates (concrete, reinforcement, structural steel).
  • Witness and verify critical hold points – including pile testing, major concrete pours, structural steel connection and welding inspections, and envelope water-tightness testing.
  • Monitor civil and structural progress against the critical path schedule, flagging deviations and driving recovery actions.
  • Conduct frequent site inspections to identify defects, workmanship issues, and design conflicts as early as possible, ahead of follow-on MEP works.
  • Enforce site safety standards and proper construction practices for all civil and structural trades, ensuring compliance with Digital Edge HSE requirements and local regulations.
  • Identify and escalate non-conformances (NCRs) and design conflicts early, coordinating resolution with the Project Manager and Design Delivery team.
  • Maintain weekly reporting on civil/structural quality status, installation readiness, and risk items to the Head of Projects.

Structural Completion & Handover (Primary Focus)

  • Coordinate structural completion and building envelope close-out to enable timely handover of work areas to MEP and fit-out trades.
  • Verify structural provisions for MEP equipment installation – openings, plinths, anchor points, and floor load capacities – ahead of MEP mobilisation.
  • Support load testing, structural surveys, and settlement monitoring where required by design or local authority requirements.
  • Coordinate statutory completion inspections and structural certification with local authorities and third-party inspection bodies.
  • Ensure all civil and structural punch list items and NCRs are tracked, resolved, and closed out ahead of downstream MEP and T&C activities.
  • Support preparation of as-built documentation, structural certification records and close-out records for civil and structural scope for handover to Operations.

Stakeholder & Coordination

  • Work closely with the Project Manager on day-to-day site coordination, contractor management, and progress reporting.
  • Coordinate with the platform Design Delivery team on design clarifications, change orders, and technical queries during construction.
  • Interface with civil/structural contractors, testing laboratories, geotechnical and structural consultants, and façade specialists to ensure alignment on quality, schedule, and technical requirements.
  • Build strong working relationships with local authorities, third-party structural checkers, testing bodies, and inspection agencies as required.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

Candidate Profile:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering (or equivalent).
  • 8+ years of experience in civil and structural engineering for large-scale construction projects, preferably data centres or mission-critical facilities.
  • Demonstrated experience in on-site QA/QC, resident engineer, or construction supervision roles for civil and structural works, ideally from early works (earthworks/piling) through structural completion.
  • Strong working knowledge of foundations, reinforced concrete construction, structural steel, precast, and building envelope systems; experience with seismic design and multi-storey mission-critical structures is highly advantageous.
  • Familiarity with international standards and codes (ACI, BS, Eurocode, ISO) and in-depth knowledge of local building codes, statutory approval and inspection processes.
  • Proficiency with engineering tools such as AutoCAD, Revit/BIM, and Excel.
  • Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer, or equivalent certification is advantageous.
  • Strong communicator with the ability to coordinate across internal teams, contractors, consultants and authorities in a fast-paced, multi-project environment.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Technical Specialist Transmission Core
job.description:
• Work Pattern: Rotating shift roster, including morning, afternoon and night

What You’ll Do

  • Execute technical operational processes and provide technical support to maintain network availability.
  • Respond to and assist in resolving incidents escalated by Managed Services where issues are not immediately resolvable.
  • Support Problem Management by contributing to root cause analysis and corrective action recommendations.
  • Manage and respond to escalations from Service Assurance Managers on critical incidents under guidance.
  • Assist with planning and execution of network changes, expansions, and upgrades.
  • Recommend improvements to network design to enhance performance and reliability.
  • Ensure all planned changes meet Optus’ quality and performance policies.
  • Support continuous improvement activities alongside Engineering, Vendors, and Managed Services.
  • Contribute to tools strategy and automation initiatives by providing operational insights.
  • Participate in alarm filtering, correlation analysis, and service assurance automation efforts.
  • Provide operational input into weekly/monthly KPI and SLA reporting processes.
  • Act as a point of knowledge for peers and contribute to team knowledge sharing and training initiatives.

What You Bring

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Telecommunications or Science discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years’ hands-on experience in multi-vendor Metro/Long-Haul DWDM networks.
  • Solid understanding of DWDM technologies (ROADM, TOADM, Optical Amplifiers), SyncE and PTP protocols.
  • Experience supporting technology and vendors in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and escalate effectively.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

job.title: Principal Specialist Internet Optimisation
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a Principal Technical Specialist, Internet Optimisation to join our Design and Optimisation team, based in Macquarie Park, Sydney. As the senior technical authority for Internet-facing network services, you’ll shape the performance, efficiency, resilience and engineering evolution of Optus’s Internet network.

Working as a senior individual contributor, you’ll turn Internet traffic behaviour, customer experience signals and network telemetry into clear engineering decisions. You’ll define optimisation strategy, shape routing and interconnection policy, guide capacity and resilience investments, and lead the resolution of the most complex Internet performance issues across architecture, operations, security, product, commercial teams, vendors and external partners.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and maintain the Internet optimisation strategy, technical roadmap, architecture principles and measurable performance outcomes across Internet Core, peering, transit, edge routing, DNS, DDoS protection, CDN and content interconnection.
  • Own and evolve BGP routing policy, traffic engineering principles, route hygiene and inter-domain routing controls across multi-homed Internet environments, including peering, transit, IXP presence, private interconnects, failover and capacity distribution.
  • Correlate network telemetry, active measurements, flow data, service KPIs and customer experience indicators to diagnose latency, packet loss, throughput, DNS, CDN, gaming, streaming, cloud access and international connectivity issues.
  • Act as the principal design authority for novel, high-risk or cross-domain Internet optimisation decisions, governing reference designs, standards, decision records and technical guardrails for routing, interconnection, DNS, DDoS and observability.
  • Drive model-driven, API-first automation, telemetry, data models, dashboards and analytical tooling that improve policy validation, compliance, change assurance and the speed of technical diagnosis.
  • Provide principal-level leadership during major Internet incidents and cross-provider faults, leading evidence-based root cause analysis, systemic improvement, reusable troubleshooting playbooks and knowledge transfer across engineering and operations teams.

**

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, a postgraduate qualification or expert-level certification such as CCIE or JNCIE are highly regarded.
  • Extensive experience, typically 15+ years, in large-scale IP or Internet network engineering, with recognised depth in Internet architecture, optimisation and operational troubleshooting within a carrier, hyperscaler, content network, major enterprise or technology vendor environment.
  • Expert-level knowledge of BGP, routing policy, communities, convergence, route reflectors, multipath, filtering, multi-homed design, peering, transit, IXPs, private interconnects, edge routing, Internet Core, anycast, RPKI and routing security.
  • Advanced capability in analysing latency, loss, jitter, throughput, congestion, utilisation, flow telemetry and active measurements, with strong understanding of TCP, QUIC, DNS, CDN, caching, cloud connectivity and application-path dependencies.
  • Practical experience with network automation and observability using APIs, Netconf/YANG, Ansible, streaming telemetry, SNMP, NetFlow/IPFIX, logs, synthetic testing and event correlation, together with scripting or data analysis using Python, SQL or equivalent.
  • Industry credibility and the ability to lead through expertise without formal authority, with strong executive communication, commercial awareness, sound judgement, stakeholder influence, mentoring and cross-company collaboration skills.

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts.
  • Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional ‘Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences.

We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.

job.title: Business Development Executive (Federal Government)
job.description:
AUS | Hume | 34 - 42 Sheppard Street

Full time

J0108327

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Iron Mountain is seeking a strategic and highly motivated Business Development Executive – Federal Government to join our ANZ Sales team based in Canberra. In this dedicated vertical role, you will be responsible for leading executive-level relationships, orchestrating portfolio growth, and managing the full sales cycle for large, complex enterprise accounts across the Australian Federal Government sector. You will own the overall account strategy to drive long-term revenue growth, client retention, and strategic solution adoption across major Federal agencies.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Strategic Prospecting & Deal Closure: Own and nurture key executive & C-suite relationships to understand and anticipate all potential needs that Iron Mountain can support. Lead the full sales cycle, including joint ownership of contract negotiations, required documentation, and team coordination to close complex deals and secure revenues.
  • Shape & Solution Complex Client Needs: Lead discovery and executive meetings, driving a relevant and differentiated solution play that matches customer demands with Iron Mountain's proposition.
  • Lead Account Management & Planning: Own the overall Federal account strategy, defining the vision, white space mapping, competitive landscape, and stakeholder mapping. Act as the account quarterback, accountable for everything from opportunity identification to cross-functional team execution and issue resolution.

What You'll Bring

  • Deep understanding of and established networks into key Australian Federal Government departments and agencies.
  • Proven track record of operating with an Enterprise mindset, demonstrating persuasive, persistent, and adaptive consultative sales skills at the C-suite level.
  • Strong background in digital transformation, data foundations, information governance, or enterprise platform software sales into the public sector.
  • Executive presence with proven experience directly engaging and managing relationships at the C-suite level.
  • Strong knowledge of market insights, competitive intelligence, Whole-of-Government panels, and public sector procurement frameworks.
  • Ability to propose complex solutions and leverage data, tools, and insights to forecast and prioritise sales activities.
  • Excellent negotiation, collaboration, and cross-functional leadership skills in a matrixed environment.
  • High results orientation with a history of meeting or exceeding enterprise revenue quotas.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Total Rewards: Attractive base salary, uncapped incentive/commission structure, and superannuation.
  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Hybrid working model balancing client engagement, site visits, and remote/home flexibility.
  • Continuous Growth & Development: Access to global enterprise sales frameworks, structured leadership pathways, and continuous professional learning opportunities.
  • Global Brand & Impact: The opportunity to represent an S&P 500 global leader and shape the growth of our dedicated Federal Government portfolio across the ACT.
  • Employee Wellbeing & Support: Access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program (EAP), corporate wellness initiatives, and paid parental leave policies

Category: Sales

Iron Mountain is a global leader in storage and information management services trusted by more than 225,000 organizations in 60 countries. We safeguard billions of our customers’ assets, including critical business information, highly sensitive data, and invaluable cultural and historic artifacts. Take a look at our history here.

Iron Mountain helps lower cost and risk, comply with regulations, recover from disaster, and enable digital and sustainable solutions, whether in information management, digital transformation, secure storage and destruction, data center operations, cloud services, or art storage and logistics. Please see our Values and Code of Ethics for a look at our principles and aspirations in elevating the power of our work together.

If you have a physical or mental disability that requires special accommodations, please let us know by sending an email to accommodationrequest@ironmountain.com. See the Supplement to learn more about Equal Employment Opportunity.

Iron Mountain is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. We recruit and hire applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law.

job.title: Electrician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

Troubleshoots, assembles, installs, tests and maintains electrical systems using all necessary tools to keep equipment available and capable. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment. May work independently and instruct or coach others.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards.
  • Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment.
  • Promote interdependence by looking out for one another.
  • Correct hazards within your control and capabilities.
  • Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact.
  • Engage in HSE Training.

Quality

  • Applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship.
  • Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis.
  • Performs work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments.
  • Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system.
  • Follows all process documentation and quality procedures.
  • Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures.
  • Performs quality inspections.

Delivery

  • Fully proficient performing troubleshooting, electrical repairs and maintenance of equipment .
  • Conforms to applicable codes and standards to maintain, install, and operate electrical systems.
  • Instructs and coaches others and acts as an informal resource for team members with less capability.
  • Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks.
  • Performs other duties as required to meet business goals.
  • Work with peers and support staff to:

Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Schedule maintenance activities around production requirements Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork

  • Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams.
  • Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements.
  • Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

PPM and Breakdown Maintenance of machine shop.

Machine safety Improvement.

HIRA and JSA.

LOTO and Electrical safety.

job.title: QR045 - Technical Information Systems Engineer
job.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Technician Information Systems Engineer to join our team on a 12-month fixed-term contract based in Scoresby however open to other capital cities.

Supporting our ERP transformation project, the Quantum Program, you will help maintain accurate engineering and manufacturing product data, manage engineering change activities, and collaborate with internal stakeholders to deliver quality business outcomes across multiple functions.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Supporting product and engineering projects by ensuring product data and Bill of Materials (BOM) information is accurate and maintained across multiple systems and markets.
  • Updating engineering drawings, product structures, and BOMs within product lifecycle management (PLM) systems.
  • Working with CAD models and engineering documentation to investigate issues, validate product data, and support design updates.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to coordinate manufacturing BOM updates and ensure engineering changes are implemented accurately.
  • Supporting engineering change management activities by following established processes, systems, and workflows.
  • Maintaining accurate technical documentation, product records, and configuration data to support business and customer requirements.
  • Assisting with project coordination activities, including tracking progress, communicating updates, and identifying potential risks or issues.
  • Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance engineering processes, systems, and overall operational efficiency.
  • Working closely with stakeholders across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Product Management to deliver successful project outcomes.

About you

You will be an early to mid-career engineer with a strong interest in mechanical product design, engineering change management and project coordination. You will be comfortable working across multiple teams and have the ability to turn technical information into clear actions and decisions.

You will be able to communicate effectively with multiple team members and stakeholders. You will have a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work, with a strong focus on documentation practices.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related STEM discipline.
  • Exposure to an engineering, manufacturing, product development, or technical services environment through internships, work placements, co-op programs, or early-career employment.
  • An interest in product design, engineering change processes, and project coordination.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Well-developed written and verbal communication skills.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Exposure to CAD, PLM, ERP, or other engineering systems and tools is highly regarded

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive and attractive Salary Package on Offer
  • Hybrid Working Model & Free Onsite Parking
  • Comprehensive Cummins product training provided
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees

Please note: this is a fixed term assignment.

Under indirect supervision, updates Procurement systems and co-ordinates approval and control of Procurement activities. Provides support to sourcing and finance teams globally.

  • Document closure and complete recording activities for various contracts and other supplier documentation.
  • Prepare documentation for sourcing events.
  • Support work delivering results in meeting cost, quality, delivery, and inventory goals.

  • Liaison between procurement teams and other functions.
  • Participating in health safety and environmental awareness and improvement activities and daily tasks.
  • Perform any other tasks assigned.

Knows how to access documents in the appropriate Document Management System (DMS) and/or who to ask if clarification or expansion of the information contained in each document is needed.

Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.

Requires some work experience and intermediate level knowledge obtained through training or on-the-job experience.

Experience using Microsoft office including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word required.

Prior Supply Chain systems experience preferred.

job.description:
Job Summary

As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you'll lead end-to-end recruitment across a broad portfolio of professional, technical, engineering, manufacturing, and operational roles throughout the Asia Pacific region.

In this role you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand workforce needs and develop effective hiring strategies
  • Act as a trusted talent advisor, providing market intelligence, talent mapping, and recruitment insights that support informed decision-making
  • Develop innovative sourcing strategies to attract and engage both active and passive talent
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle
  • Champion inclusive hiring practices and contribute to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion initiatives
  • Leverage recruitment analytics and market data to drive continuous improvement and hiring effectiveness
  • Support employer branding and talent attraction initiatives that strengthen Cummins' position as an employer of choice
  • Manage offer negotiations and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure a seamless onboarding experience
  • Build strong relationships across multiple countries, functions, and leadership teams throughout APAC

To be successful in this role you will have the following:

  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
  • Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  • Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.
  • Interpersonal savvy - Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.
  • Persuades - Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others.
  • Candidate Assessment and Selection - Defines qualification requirements and selection criteria for open positions using Cummins tools; employs objective selection processes that meet compliance requirements; assesses, evaluates and selects candidates against pre-determined job specifics and "Select for Cummins" competencies, and communicates openly with candidate and stakeholders to ensure timely hiring outcomes.
  • External Talent Sourcing - Identifies and applies appropriate candidate sourcing methodologies and tools to identify, attract and engage a diverse pool of talent in the external market.
  • Human Resources Business Process Execution - Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.
  • Human Resources Consulting - Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.
  • Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field or equivalent experience required.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, RPO, executive search, or agency recruitment
  • Experience recruiting across multiple job families and varying levels of seniority
  • Strong sourcing and talent attraction capability, including passive candidate engagement and market mapping
  • Proven ability to influence and build credibility with hiring managers and senior stakeholders
  • Experience recruiting within technical, engineering, manufacturing, industrial, operational, or professional services environments
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills
  • A data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret labour market trends and recruitment metrics
  • A passion for delivering exceptional candidate experiences
  • Exposure to recruitment across multiple APAC markets will be highly regarded

job.title: Sr Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - Strat Acc.
job.description:
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.

AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Key job responsibilities As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.

As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.

About the team The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • Knowledge of cloud architecture
  • 10+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
  • Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
  • 7+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
  • Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
  • 10+ years' experience in designing and implementing large distributed systems, with deep expertise in core infrastructure, solution architecture, and distributed computing patterns.
  • Professional experience in pre-sales consulting with proven presentation skills, executive engagement capabilities, and track record of effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels while managing ambiguous requirements.

job.title: Snr Manager Design Engineering - India, Data Center Engineering
job.description:
As the Senior Manager, Design Engineering - India, at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL), you'll play an integral role in our engineering leadership team. A highly effective group of architects and structural, civil, mechanical, electrical and controls engineers. This team is responsible for continuously innovating on behalf of our customers whilst delivering the highest quality engineering solutions for our capacity delivery projects. You will have a direct hand in project outcomes. You'll shape design direction and improve design delivery across all India projects. You'll also set the design procedures and protocols for developing future systems.

You'll work with many parts of the AWS organisation, with external engineering partners, with permitting and regulatory bodies. You'll also engage the wider community in India on technical matters relating to data center development. That means bringing an AWS engineering view to industry bodies and forums, standards and building code committees, and policymakers.

Amazon's data centers are industry-leading examples of innovation in sustainability, energy efficiency, resiliency and cost-effectiveness. We're known for our speed to market and reliability. This role sits within the team responsible for the design of critical data center facilities in India. Our design team is at the forefront of creating and delivering innovative products. It's a diverse, upbeat group that is changing the face of cloud computing.

We continue to grow and are looking for team members who can support our speed to market, raise the bar and want to keep growing professionally. Amazon's work environment is unique and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. We give strong support to continuous learning and employee development.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Leading a multidisciplinary team of engineers in the design of critical data center infrastructure systems across India.
  • Chairing weekly design meetings with internal engineering teams, internal customers and external consultants to resolve design issues, keep design milestones on track and escalate where needed.
  • Driving process improvements across design delivery.
  • Creating and tracking metrics on the cost, quality and duration of design. This includes collecting data from construction and commissioning teams as designs are implemented, so lessons learned feed back into future designs.
  • Establishing capital project design budgets, contributing to complex business cases for existing and new AWS Region deployments in India, and working with AWS Finance to secure project funding.
  • Working with AWS engineering leads to schedule engineering resources and influence design changes based on internal customer needs.
  • Partnering with internal customers to establish project scope, schedule and deliverables.
  • Engaging the wider community in India - industry bodies and forums, standards and building code committees, and government and regulatory agencies - on technical matters relating to data center development, in partnership with AWS Public Policy.
  • Owning design document control, including the document controller's workflow and audits of deliverables.

Key job responsibilities Leading a team of engineers/architect in the design of data center critical infrastructure systems in India

  • Facilitating weekly meetings with internal stakeholders, external consultants, permitting authorities and community stakeholders to address design issues, meet design milestones and escalate as needed.
  • Driving process improvements.
  • Creating and tracking metrics related to cost, quality and duration of design as well as collecting data from construction and commissioning teams as designs are implemented.
  • Establishing capital project design budgets and contributing to complex business cases for existing region and new region deployment in India.
  • Collaborating with AWS finance teams to secure funding for projects.
  • Working in partnership with AWS Engineering leads to schedule engineering resources and influence design changes based on internal customer needs.
  • Partnering with internal customers to establish project scope, schedule and deliverables.
  • Managing document controller’s workflow and audit of deliverables
  • Lead weekly staff and project readiness meetings with stakeholder teams;
  • Drive best practices on the team, deal with ambiguity and competing objectives, and proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks;
  • Use creativity, good judgment and significant innovation in evaluating, simplify and developing project procedures including document control, tracking project metrics and inter-team information dependencies;
  • Identify continuous improvement strategies focused on variety of project phases including real estate due diligence, planning, design, permitting and construction;
  • Engage with an experienced engineering discipline leads, influencing roadmaps, priorities and process working across multiple teams including capacity delivery, site selection, utilities, due diligence, design, construction and commissioning.;
  • Report on status of development, quality, operations, and performance to management;
  • Write effective narratives and present them concisely and effectively to Directors and VPs;
  • Establish a mature team optimized for operational excellence, using standard project management, communication protocols and automated systems;
  • Have joint managerial oversight of additional employees in India including but not limited to, all Architects, Electrical, Mechanical, Colo, Structural, Controls, and Field Engineers in India;

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Electrical, Mechanical, Structural Engineering or equivalent field
  • 10+ years of data center design, HVAC design, or related product development experience
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary design across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural and controls disciplines on large-scale capital projects. Experience managing design budgets, schedules and delivery teams comprising internal resources supplemented with external design consultants.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience defining data center system-level architecture, documenting performance and equipment requirements, creating and communicating conceptual designs, and creating and maintaining project documentation
  • Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience engaging industry bodies, standards or building code committees, regulators or government agencies on technical matters, e.g. Bureau of Indian Standards committees, including the National Building Code
