job.title: Subsea Technical Program Manager, Subsea Backbone
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a Subsea Technical Program Manager with proven experience, strong sense of ownership and passion for defining and driving large cross-functional programs in the infrastructure and networking space. The candidate should be self-driven, have the ability to learn quickly and influence decision-making across organizations. The candidate should be an expert in telecommunications cable route engineering and marine survey and installation operations. In this position, you will work closely with various Amazon business units to gather, refine and drive program goals to deliver submarine cable projects. You will have the opportunity to implement new processes and procedures driving continuous improvement while interacting with a broad range of stakeholders across Amazon.

At Amazon, we set a high bar, so expect to be challenged on the scope and scale of the problems we tackle. We are moving fast, using the latest technologies, and transforming the way we deliver global connectivity.

Key job responsibilities In this position, the candidate will work closely with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders to deliver submarine cable projects across the globe. The candidate should be able to represent and lead for Amazon in deployment and operational meetings, coordinate complex projects spanning a number of geographies and deliver the project to our high standards.

They should have a deep knowledge of how to construct fiber based networks that span long haul fiber and colocation including the selection and deployment of optical equipment interfacing with submarine cables. Finally, the candidate should be able to ensure that the delivered network is handed over with a suitably validated operational model appropriate to the specific deployment and location.

Specific knowledge of submarine telecommunication cable route engineering, cable survey and installation operations including burial are required.

A day in the life Our projects are multi year in duration, requiring careful planning, disciplined execution and with a growing program, constant invention and simplification. We work with internal and external stakeholders and partners, driving projects to meet our goals and timelines. We ensure that the delivery of the projects meet our high standards and specifications. When faced with an issue or delay, we invent to solve for the roadblock alerting our customers along the way. Communications are crisp, timely and always advise a path forward. We learn from each other, ensuring global consistency.

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
  • 3+ years experience of marine operations for telecommunications cable survey and installation
  • Direct knowledge and experience in the subsea telecoms cable industry

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Engineering or a foreign equivalent
  • Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

job.title: Manager – Ops to Ops & Components Business
job.description:
We're improving the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings, and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered optimally and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components, and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.

JOIN US! WE MAKE REAL WHAT MATTERS. THIS IS YOUR ROLE

Role Purpose

Own and lead end-to-end order management for components business-from demand intake through SAP order execution, providing order confirmations with delivery date, tracking reviews, delivery adherence, and cross-functional closure-while ensuring production feasibility (takt time, capacity,

sequencing) and driving resolution of quality/technical issues impacting customer delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Order Management Ownership (E2E)

  • Own order entry, validation, prioritization, and fulfilment for components business.
  • - Run daily/weekly SAP-based order tracking reviews, highlight risks (capacity, shortages, quality holds), and drive closure.
  • - Ensure OTD (On-Time Delivery) through proactive expediting, promise-date governance, and exception management.

job.title: AI Data Centre Solutions Architect - Asia Pacific
job.description:
AI Data Centre Solutions Architect - Asia Pacific

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

You'll make a difference by

  • Representing Siemens' AI Factory Architecture organisation across Asia Pacific: Serve as the regional technical architecture representative, communicating Siemens AI Factory reference architectures across power, cooling, automation, digital, and compute infrastructure while adapting them to local market requirements.
  • Engaging strategic customers and leading architecture discussions: Support hyperscalers, AI infrastructure providers, colocation operators, enterprises, developers, EPCs, and technology partners through workshops, design reviews, technical presentations, RFIs/RFPs, and solution-development activities.
  • Translating global reference architectures into APAC-ready solutions: Localise architectures based on regional regulations, electrical standards, grid characteristics, operating environments, supply chains, and customer requirements across Asia Pacific.
  • Partnering with sales teams to drive integrated solution opportunities: Enable account teams through technical guidance, architecture training, value-based messaging, and support for opportunities that combine multiple Siemens technologies into a single customer solution.
  • Acting as a bridge between global expertise and regional execution: Leverage knowledge from global specialists while sharing customer requirements, competitive intelligence, technology trends, and market insights back to the global architecture organisation.
  • Driving the adoption of next-generation AI infrastructure architectures: Support the deployment and continuous improvement of solutions for AI factories, hyperscale data centres, liquid cooling, microgrids, digital twins, BMS/EPMS/SCADA platforms, modular infrastructure, and emerging electrical architectures.

Your defining qualities

  • Extensive experience in data centres or critical infrastructure environments: Approximately 10+ years of experience in data centres, electrical infrastructure, industrial automation, mission-critical facilities, or related technology sectors.
  • Strong customer-facing solution architecture expertise: Experience supporting technical sales, consulting, application engineering, pre-sales engineering, or solution architecture engagements with hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, or developer customers.
  • Deep electrical infrastructure knowledge with APAC market expertise: Strong understanding of MV/LV electrical systems, regional codes and standards, utility/grid requirements, and the localisation of global architectures for Singapore and wider Asia Pacific markets.
  • Broad technical understanding across multiple infrastructure domains: Working knowledge of electrical distribution, cooling systems, controls and operational technology, digital solutions, and AI compute infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across organisations and disciplines: Experience collaborating with engineering, commercial, and partner organisations to deliver integrated customer solutions throughout the data centre lifecycle.
  • Strong AI and automation fluency: Experience leveraging AI tools, workflow automation, and productivity technologies to improve architecture development, customer engagement, knowledge management, and sales-support processes.

In return, we offer you

  • Flexible Work Environment: Including a mobile working policy that supports your well-being and allows you to prioritize what matters most.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: A comprehensive package to reward your contributions.
  • Values-Driven Culture: An inclusive workplace that prioritizes diversity and belonging.
  • Continuous Learning & Development: Opportunities to grow your skills and advance your career.

Recruitment Process

  • CV Screening
  • If shortlisted, a session with our TA Consultant to understand your motivation & your past experiences
  • 2-3 Business Interviews
  • Offer Stage

Transform the everyday with us!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

job.title: Project Manager - BMS
job.description:
Join a global leader shaping smarter, more sustainable buildings

At Johnson Controls, we're redefining how the world's most critical facilities operate. As a global leader in smart buildings, building automation, HVAC solutions, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, we help some of the world's most complex environments perform at their best.

From data centres, healthcare facilities, and pharmaceutical plants to advanced manufacturing and higher education campuses, our technologies create safer, smarter, and more sustainable spaces where reliability and performance are non-negotiable.

With over 140 years of industry leadership, Johnson Controls combines cutting-edge technology, world-class lifecycle services, and one of the industry's strongest field services networks to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and communities.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Competitive salary package plus superannuation and car allowance
  • Career progression within a global organisation
  • Ongoing technical training and professional development
  • Exposure to large-scale, complex BMS and HVAC projects
  • Be part of a collaborative, high-performing project delivery team

About the Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to join our Adelaide-based Projects team.

This role is ideal for a project professional with a strong background in Building Automation Systems (BMS), Building Management Systems, Controls, or HVAC solutions who enjoys leading projects from inception to completion while building strong customer relationships.

You will take ownership of project delivery, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with customers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders, you'll play a key role in delivering innovative and sustainable building solutions across a diverse portfolio of projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of assigned projects from initiation through to handover.
  • Drive successful project outcomes by managing scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk.
  • Monitor and report on project financial performance, ensuring profitability and cost control.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, contractors, and key stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage project reviews, commissioning activities, and customer acceptance processes.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and drive operational efficiencies.
  • Champion a culture of professionalism, accountability, and customer excellence.
  • Support innovation and digital transformation initiatives across project delivery.

What We're Looking For

We're keen to connect with professionals who have experience within the Building Automation, Controls, HVAC, Smart Buildings, or Critical Infrastructure industries.

Ideally, you will bring:

  • Trade qualification in Electrical, HVAC, Refrigeration, or an Engineering degree.
  • Proven experience managing BMS, Building Automation, Controls, HVAC, or related building services projects.
  • Strong understanding of Building Automation Systems, control strategies, system architecture, and design intent.
  • Experience overseeing Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and project close-out activities.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience managing project budgets and financial performance.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and customer engagement skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, MS Project, and project management tools.
  • Experience with BIM and AutoCAD will be highly regarded.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced project environment.

Build Your Career with Johnson Controls

If you're looking to join an industry leader at the forefront of smart buildings, sustainability, and critical infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help deliver the next generation of intelligent building solutions.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. Our culture is built on integrity, collaboration, and continuous growth, ensuring every employee has the opportunity to thrive and make a meaningful impact.

You have the talent. You have the voice. Together, we'll shape the future.

job.title: Site Reliability Technical Operations Manager
job.description:
Summary

The Site Reliability Engineering team at Johnson Controls is seeking a Technical Reliability & Support Manager to lead cloud product reliability, operational support, and production stability across global cloud applications and platforms. This role will be responsible for managing day-to-day technical operations, L2/L3 support coordination, incident response, service reliability governance, and continuous improvement for cloud products hosted across platforms such as Azure (primarily), Google Cloud, Ali Cloud, and other cloud environments.

The role will partner closely with Engineering, SRE, Security, Observability, and external support partners to ensure production issues are resolved quickly, recurring problems are eliminated, support processes are standardized, and operational risks are proactively identified and addressed.

Primary Duties:

  • Lead technical operations and support management for cloud products across global environments
  • Manage day-to-day L2/L3 support activities, incident response, escalations, and production issue resolution
  • Own service reliability governance for assigned cloud products, including availability, incident trends, MTTR, recurring issues, and operational risks
  • Partner with Engineering, SRE, Security, Observability and Platform teams to improve service stability and operational readiness
  • Drive incident management, problem management, RCA/PCA reviews, and corrective action tracking for production issues
  • Ensure timely communication during incidents, including stakeholder updates, executive summaries, customer-impact statements, and resolution updates
  • Establish and manage support processes aligned with ITIL practices, including incident, problem, change, service request, and escalation management
  • Define, track, and report operational KPIs such as availability, MTTR, incident volume, severity trends, backlog, service requests, alert noise, and SLA performance
  • Identify recurring operational pain points and drive permanent fixes through engineering backlog, automation, monitoring improvements, and process enhancements
  • Collaborate with Observability teams to ensure critical application, infrastructure, database, and integration components are properly monitored and alerted
  • Support implementation and adoption of SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, and reliability / supportability scorecards for cloud products
  • Ensure production readiness for new product releases, migrations, infrastructure changes, and platform transformations
  • Lead operational reviews with internal teams, vendors, and external support partners to ensure accountability and continuous improvement
  • Drive automation of manual support tasks, ticket workflows, reporting, and operational runbooks to improve efficiency and consistency
  • Ensure support activities, incidents, changes, and action items are properly documented and tracked in tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, or equivalent platforms
  • Manage support handoffs across global teams and ensure clear ownership, escalation paths, and communication protocols
  • Provide technical leadership during high-severity incidents, major outages, migrations, and critical customer-impacting events
  • Ensure compliance with security, audit, operational, and IT governance standards for cloud product support
  • Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices, support models, and knowledge base articles
  • Mentor support engineers and technical teams on reliability practices, incident handling, RCA quality, and operational excellence

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in technical operations, production support, SRE, cloud support, or reliability engineering.
  • Strong experience managing cloud-hosted applications and support operations.
  • Good knowledge of Azure (preferred), with exposure to AWS, GCP, or Ali Cloud.
  • Experience with incident management, problem management, change management, and operational governance.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native technologies, microservices, APIs, databases, containers, and Kubernetes.
  • Understanding of observability tools such as Grafana, Datadog, ELK, Logz.io, Azure Monitor, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of reliability practices including SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, monitoring, alerting, and automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, networking, databases, and cloud services.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and vendor coordination skills.
  • Ability to lead high-severity incidents and drive operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Cloud Operations / SRE leadership
  • L2 production support (good to have L2 Production Support)
  • Incident & escalation management
  • RCA/PCA and problem management
  • Azure cloud and cloud-native platforms
  • Observability, monitoring & KPI reporting
  • ITIL-based support processes
  • Automation and runbook development
  • Executive communication & stakeholder management
  • Leadership in high-pressure production environments

job.title: Developer II
job.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Software Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to join our product development team. You will work across the software development lifecycle to build, enhance, and support scalable applications and product features. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys solving problems, writing clean code, and collaborating closely with product, engineering, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software features and product components using modern development practices.
  • Translate product requirements into technical solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with delivery goals.
  • Build and support application components, integrations, and APIs using C#, .NET, ASP.NET, and Web APIs.
  • Work with SQL Server and data models to support application functionality and data integrity.
  • Partner with product managers, analysts, QA, and other engineers to clarify requirements, validate solutions, and improve delivery outcomes.
  • Participate in code reviews, unit testing, debugging, and troubleshooting to improve quality and performance.
  • Contribute to deployment activities, release support, and issue resolution across development environments.
  • Document technical designs, decisions, and support details clearly and consistently.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product reliability, development standards, and engineering processes.

How You Will Do It

  • You will own your work with accountability, safety, and integrity, and you will deliver solutions that are dependable and well thought through.
  • You will stay close to the work, listen to users and stakeholders, and focus on what matters most to remove barriers and deliver value.
  • You will improve every day by using candid communication, solving problems methodically, and learning from feedback and delivery outcomes.
  • You will win as one team by sharing knowledge openly, building trust, and working effectively across functions and perspectives.
  • Use Agile ways of working to plan, prioritize, and deliver work in a transparent and collaborative manner.
  • Apply strong attention to detail when designing, coding, testing, and documenting product features.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software development or product development engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP.NET, and Web APIs.
  • Experience with SQL Server and database design concepts.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and the SDLC.
  • Ability to analyze requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to REST APIs, Microsoft 365, or Power Platform tools.
  • Experience supporting product enhancements in a fast-paced engineering environment.

job.title: Construction Manager, Data Center Facilities Development (Sydney)
job.description:
Job Description

Leads the construction of data centers by colocation providers, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Creates, reviews, and maintains documentation, including design review, commissioning, and problem-solving papers. Implements and oversees quality control processes to ensure all construction activities meet design specifications and industry standards. Conducts detailed site walks and leads the startup and commissioning phases of major data center projects. Identifies gaps in risk identification and mitigation and develops tailored solutions to address these gaps. Serves as the primary point of contact between the company and colocation providers. Selects, negotiates, and manages contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers, ensuring contract compliance and performance and construction activities align with the approved design plans and specifications. Oversees the installation of power, cooling, networking, and structured cabling systems.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Construction Project Management-Project Planning and Execution:

-Leads the construction of data centers by colocation providers, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

  • Develops and maintains detailed project schedules, coordinating with colocation providers to ensure timely milestone delivery across multiple projects.
  • Creates and manages project budgets, optimizing resource allocation to ensure cost-effective project execution.
  • Creates, reviews, and maintains documentation, including design review, commissioning, and problem-solving papers, ensuring standards are upheld, documents are managed effectively, and materials are suitable for their intended purpose.

Construction Project Management-Project Integration and Quality Assurance:

-Implements and oversees quality control processes to ensure all construction activities meet design specifications and industry standards.

  • Collaborates actively in the coordination and integration of tenant fit out projects, ensuring alignment between different phases of design, construction, and commissioning.
  • Conducts detailed site walks to monitor schedule, coordination, and quality throughout the life of the project.
  • Leads the startup and commissioning phases of major data center projects, ensuring that all systems are operational and meet design specifications.

Risk and Problem Management:

-Evaluates the risk profiles associated with timely project delivery for multiple projects.

  • Identifies gaps in risk identification and mitigation and develops tailored solutions to address these gaps.
  • Develops and implements mitigation strategies for major construction project risks to ensure project success.

Stakeholder and Vendor Management:

job.title: Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, Google Photos Web
job.description:
About the job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

As the Tech Lead Manager of the Photos Web team, you will lead the Sydney-based team holistically responsible for Google Photos on mobile web and desktop. You will guide the team to ship features which capitalize on the unique advantages of the Web form factor, showcase Artificial Intelligence (AI) magic and bring key mobile features to the web, while maintaining service health and stability and building an effective team. Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client-side (web and mobile), with server-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. We are dedicated to making Google experiences centered around the user.

Responsibilities

  • Define and influence technical direction and long-term strategy in conjunction with other Engineering Managers and Tech Leads, helping the team make balanced trade-offs, and prioritize engineering excellence investments in a systemic way.
  • Provide career management and coaching to help your team grow in directions that are exciting to them.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional peers such as Product and User Experience (UX) to collaboratively define the goal and strategy for Google Photos on web.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Consumer Payments, Growth
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Consumer Payments Growth engineering team’s mission is to accelerate the adoption, everyday usage, and long-term retention of Google Wallet and Google Payments globally.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team in Singapore, you will set technical direction and own end-to-end engineering workstreams for global growth initiatives from real-time decisioning pipelines and financial rewards settlement to stateful quest engines and low-latency signal aggregation. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to transform growth strategies into resilient, highly scalable production systems.You will be a technical leader in the codebase: writing clean, scalable code, establishing high standards through architectural design reviews, driving technical simplification across distributed dependencies, and mentoring engineers across the Singapore and Tokyo engineering sites.Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Build high-performance communications infrastructure that delivers personalized, contextual in-app messages and lifecycle notifications across mobile, web, and checkout surfaces.
  • Architect resilient, idempotent financial settlement workflows and digital voucher vaulting systems with strict transactional consistency and anti-abuse controls.
  • Design low-latency feature stores and telemetry pipelines to support high-velocity A/B testing, counterfactual logging, and causal attribution in close partnership with data science. Implement stateful milestone quest engines and gamified reward mechanics that drive sustainable user engagement and positive unit economics.
  • Drive technical execution for complex multi-quarter projects, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, conduct rigorous design reviews, and advocate Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted development to accelerate velocity.

job.title: Data Center Critical Environment Technician Manager - Melbourne
job.description:
Overview

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Data Center Critical Environment Technician Manager.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I CE Technician Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

People Management

  • Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  • Model - Live our culture; Embody our values; Practice our leadership principles.
  • Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes; Enable success across boundaries; Help the team adapt and learn.
  • Care - Attract and retain great people; Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations; Invest in the growth of others.

Equipment and Systems Operations

  • Serve as an operations specialist one or more major area of operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators, and work on advanced tasks independently.)
  • Oversee and coach team with the inspection of critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions to develop and analyze trends.
  • Monitor performance of maintenance and operations utilizing telemetry, control systems, and other platforms and is able to identify all alarms.
  • Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work and generate reporting to identify outstanding and ongoing work orders.
  • Safely and quickly respond to and lead an onsite incident response team for all abnormal conditions that impact operations and coordinate with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs.
  • Enhances, develops new, or follows preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to incidents.
  • Gathers necessary information and creates incident timelines/data, root-cause analyses, and/or action items following an abnormal condition.

Equipment and Systems Maintenance

  • Guide, oversee, and perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for one or more disciplines and one or more types of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems) and escalate when appropriate.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for one type of equipment and oversee everyday tasks and troubleshooting within their area of expertise
  • Have a hands-on understanding of how equipment works within disciplines they have been trained and how to troubleshoot equipment, systems, subsystems, and components independently within their trained discipline(s).
  • Provide and/or assign team to provide necessary escort to third-party contractors, sub contractors, vendors, and service providers on site for all severity leveled procedures. Coordinate and schedule supplier/vendor on-site activities and recognizes circumstances when to stop supplier work to address potential and/or identified concerns.
  • Take part in getting third-party work underway (e.g., making sure systems are properly energized/deenergized), ensuring the work is started and completed in a safe manner in accordance with standard practices, procedures, federal/local legislation, and municipal codes.
  • Advises colleagues on inspection and supervision issues.
  • Provides consultation to lower-level colleagues in troubleshooting systems and problems

Critical Environment Culture

  • Understands, follows, ensures, and coaches team on safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance with applicable federal, state, local, and Microsoft requirements.
  • Proactively ensures safety and security requirements are followed and met for the work of themselves and others.
  • Maintain safe working conditions and escalate immediately when unsafe working conditions are observed.
  • Assesses and identifies appropriate resources and equipment necessary to fully support environmental health and safety (EH&S) objectives.
  • Participates in required meetings, trainings, and necessary handoffs.

Other

  • Embody our [culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values)

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND 3+ years mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)
  • OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • Citizenship Verification: This position requires verification of Australian Citizenship to meet federal government security requirements.You will need a valid Australian passport to verify your citizenship.
  • NV1/2, PV Clearance Assessment: This position may require an enhanced background check conducted through the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency.

While not required, we also look for the followingPreferred Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND 6+ years mission critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)
  • OR Associate's Degree or technical trade certification (e.g., military, trade school), or higher-equivalent education AND 5+ years mission-critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)
  • OR equivalent experience.
  • 1+ year(s) people management experience.
  • 1+ year(s) experience in a specialized area (e.g., mechanical field, electrical field, controls field) or related field.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. job.title: Finance Manager (Revenue)
job.description:
Job Description

The Finance Manager will lead the Group’s revenue accounting team and oversee revenue assurance controls. The role works closely with Product, Billing, IS and other stakeholders to assess new and bundled sales arrangements, determine the appropriate accounting treatment, resolve reconciliation issues and improve the systems and processes that support accurate reporting.

job.title: Senior Engineer I, Software Test
job.description:
Job Description

Company Overview: Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, committed to providing innovative solutions that ensure Life Is On everywhere, for everyone, and at every moment. We are looking for a V&V Security Engineer to perform baseline security Verification & Validation of web applications and APIs. The role sits between Security-focused QA and Application Security and is intended for someone who can independently perform structured security validation without requiring hardcore penetration testing expertise. The engineer will work closely with QA, Development and Product Security teams to validate security controls, identify common security weaknesses, document findings and escalate advanced security issues when required.

Key Responsibilities

  • V&V Security Testing
  • Perform security validation for application features and APIs as part of the V&V lifecycle.
  • Understand feature functionality, user roles and expected security controls before testing.
  • Validate security requirements across authentication, authorization, input validation, business logic, APIs, sessions, file handling and security headers.
  • Verify security controls at the backend/API level, not only through the UI.
  • Identify, reproduce and document security weaknesses.
  • Web & API Security Testing

Perform baseline testing for:

  • Authentication: login, password reset, authentication enforcement and bypass scenarios.
  • Authorization & Access Control: RBAC, horizontal/vertical access control, IDOR, object ownership, user/site/device/tenant access and restricted APIs.
  • Input Validation: mandatory fields, null/empty values, datatype, length, boundaries, IDs, dates, enums and unexpected parameters.
  • Business Logic: workflow bypass, date/quantity restrictions, duplicate requests, invalid state transitions and frontend-only restrictions.
  • Session Management: logout, expiry, token/session reuse and privilege changes.
  • REST APIs: request/response validation, HTTP methods, headers, JSON bodies, authorization and parameter manipulation.
  • File Security: upload/download validation, file types, MIME types, size restrictions and access control.
  • Security Headers: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and other project-required headers.
  • Error Handling & Information Disclosure: stack traces, internal paths, sensitive data, tokens, credentials and other unintended information exposure.
  • Reporting & Collaboration
  • Create clear and reproducible security findings.
  • Capture request/response evidence and screenshots.

job.title: DGM Direct Procurement Sourcing Management
job.description:
Job Description

INTRODUCTION

  • The Busway business is one of the fast-growing product lines within Low Voltage Power Products, manufacturing sheet-metal fabricated busway enclosures, housings, joints and copper/aluminium bus-bar assemblies for power distribution.
  • This position is a Strategic Sourcing Buyer for the Busway category who will also act as the Procurement Manager, owning end-to-end procurement for the plant – sheet metal, fabrication, bus-bar/conductor materials, hardware, insulation and packaging.
  • The role requires deep, hands-on understanding of sheet metal costing (clean-sheet / should-cost), press-shop and fabrication processes (laser cutting, CNC punching/bending, welding, powder coating), and sourcing from vendors in switchgear, busway, panel-building or similar sheet-metal-intensive industries.

The incumbent will design and implement the annual procurement operating plan for the plant, driving cost, quality, delivery and localization targets while managing the local supplier base end-to-end.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1\. CATEGORY BUYER / PROCUREMENT MANAGER:

Spend Management:

  • Own the full procurement spend of the plant for sheet metal, fabricated parts, bus-bar/conductor material, hardware and consumables – supplier selection, development and Supplier Qualification (SAM).
  • Manage supplier performance management, spend analytics, needs preparation and Annual Procurement & Purchasing Planning (APOP) for the Busway category.
  • Coordinate effectively with Regional and Global Busway/sheet-metal category teams to formulate and execute category strategies at plant level.
  • Own contract management and procurement risk management, including single/mono-source mitigation.

Sheet Metal & Part / Component Development:

  • Lead RFQ/RFP issuance, negotiations, PPAP/APQP coordination, pricing agreements and MSA/LTC/QTC coordination with fabrication and sheet-metal suppliers.
  • Drive tooling and capex negotiations for press tools, dies and fixtures with fabrication vendors.
  • Validate supplier quotes using clean-sheet costing / should-cost models for sheet metal (material yield, cycle time, press tonnage, tooling amortization, surface treatment/powder coating cost build-up).

Cost Reduction / Productivity:

  • Deliver annual cost reduction targets through negotiation preparation, should-cost analysis, external benchmarking, multi-year agreements, change of supplier, Value Engineering/Value Analysis (VAVE) and localization.
  • Identify and implement design-for-sourcing and design-for-manufacturing opportunities in sheet metal parts jointly with Engineering.

Plant Procurement Management & Supply Continuity:

  • Act as the single point of contact for all plant-level procurement activities, ensuring uninterrupted material flow to the shop floor (line-side feeding, inventory norms, VMI where applicable).
  • Collaborate with the plant Supply Chain team to ensure smooth material flow from suppliers and resolve day-to-day supply escalations.
  • Drive alternate sourcing / change of supplier initiatives to secure supply continuity and avoid single-source or mono-source risk.

Collaboration with Cross Functions:

  • Partner closely with Plant Operations, Quality and Engineering to improve productivity, quality and on-time delivery for the Busway line.

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

  • Proven, hands-on experience in the Busway business or a closely related sheet-metal-intensive electrical/switchgear industry.
  • Deep, practical understanding of sheet metal costing and sourcing – clean-sheet costing, press-shop processes, laser cutting, CNC bending, welding, fabrication and powder coating/surface finishing.
  • Working knowledge of busway/switchgear components – enclosures, bus-bar assemblies (copper/aluminium), joints, insulation and their supplier base.
  • Demonstrated experience acting as a Plant Procurement Manager – owning plant-level supply continuity, vendor management and cross-functional coordination.
  • Strong negotiation, project management and cross-functional leadership skills in a matrix, multi-BU environment.
  • Entrepreneurial, customer-focused, comfortable challenging status quo and driving change.
  • Digitally savvy – keen to apply digital tools to improve procurement efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills; fluent in English.

REQUIREMENTS

B.Tech / B.E. – Mechanical Engineering (Electrical background also considered)

  • Minimum 10-15 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing / Procurement, with substantial exposure to the Busway business or a similar sheet-metal-fabrication-intensive industry (switchgear, panel building, enclosures, electrical equipment manufacturing).
  • Deep, hands-on understanding of sheet metal costing and sourcing – clean-sheet cost methodology, press shop economics, tooling investment, laser cutting, CNC bending/punching, welding and powder coating.
  • Strong knowledge of buy analysis, should-cost/clean-sheet costing and BOM-level cost breakdowns for fabricated and bus-bar/conductor parts.
  • Prior experience acting as a Plant Procurement Manager – owning end-to-end plant procurement, supplier management and supply continuity.
  • Hands-on experience with rebalancing / localization of critical sheet metal and fabricated parts.
  • Experience working in a matrix environment across organizations and functions.
  • Strong leadership, negotiation and performance management skills.

Domain expertise in Busway / Sheet Metal Fabrication and technically sound in cost engineering

job.description:
Job Description

In Schneider Electric everything we do promotes progress and sustainability for all — our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies where we live and work. From the products, software, and services driving the digital transformation of energy management and automation to corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make an impact by helping people and organizations become more resilient and efficient, more electric and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

The position is for a Regional Principal Electrical Engineer providing consulting and design services for mission critical facilities across the C&SP, Colocation, IT, Telecoms, Financial Services sectors and other key industries.

This role is responsible for the end-to-end design of electrical system for mission-critical environments, including Data Centres and Command Centres. You will ensure all technical solutions are optimized for project success, compliance to standards and highest customer satisfaction.

The successful candidate must demonstrate engineering excellence in electrical systems for mission-critical facilities. The person should show leadership and ability to conduct effective communication at senior levels with key customers and industry partners and maintain a high profile within the business and project community to solidify Schneider Electric’s reputation as a premier, trusted business partner.

The incumbent will play a pivotal role in scaling Schneider’s M&E design and consulting capabilities by providing mentorship and fostering technical development within the team. As a subject matter expert, you will provide technical leadership for mission-critical projects across diverse sectors, including IT, Financial Services, Government and other industry segments.

The successful candidate must hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering and have a minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience. This role requires a self-motivated leader with strong communication and business consulting skills who is comfortable engaging with customers at all levels. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative team player with proven project management expertise and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with a diverse group of internal stakeholders to drive project success and organizational alignment.

This includes:

  • Countries Pre-sales and Solutions Managers
  • Global Solution Architects
  • Account Managers and Sale Representatives
  • Key Functional Leaders

What will you do?

Electrical System Design

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Liaise with client project teams, external consultants and internal stakeholders to comprehensively define project requirements, scope and technical objectives.
  • Solution Development: Convert project requirements into optimized engineering solutions that fulfill customer needs and provide a competitive advantage through right design and equipment selection.
  • Compliance: Ensure all proposed solutions adhere strictly to local standards, regulation, codes and safety requirements.
  • Technical Documentation: Produce comprehensive engineering packages, including capacity and design calculations, technical drawings, single line diagrams, layouts and specifications.
  • Value Proposition: Develop solution presentations, value propositions and compliance matrices to demonstrate technical alignment.
  • Project Lifecycle Oversight: Design solutions should ensure successful project implementation and customer satisfaction.
  • On-site Engineering Support: Provide technical guidance to the teams during installation regarding engineering processes, tools, procedures, regulatory compliance while ensuring quality control and accurate technical interpretation.

Bid Management

  • Proposal Development:  Provide bid management support through the preparation of technical solution proposals, including the development of detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQ) and Bills of Materials (BOM).
  • Vendor Strategy and Costing: Identify and qualify third-party vendors. Establish preliminary cost estimates and ensure alignment with project budgetary requirements.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Participate in customer meetings to provide updates on proposal status and address any technical or logistical challenges.
  • Risk Mitigation and Reporting: Proactively identify and escalate roadblocks during the proposal phase to internal stakeholders, providing consistent status reports to the Country Solutions Manager.
  • Process Governance: Maintain strict adherence to Schneider Electric’s project methodologies, internal processes and approval procedures throughout the bid lifecycle.

Customer Care and Quality

  • Quality Assurance: Ensure alignment between the proposed technical solution and the project scope to deliver high-quality and high-performance outcomes.
  • Pre-sales Excellence: Deliver engineering services during the pre-sales phase to drive highest customer satisfaction and trust.
  • Issue Resolution and Escalation: Escalate customer concerns to the Solutions Manager, maintaining accountability for the successful resolution and closure of all issues.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify solution or process enhancements, documenting and communicating to the respective owners and stakeholders to drive organizational excellence.

Partner Management

  • Vendor Qualification and Compliance: Identifying, qualifying, and managing third-party partners to ensure they strictly adhere to Schneider Electric’s methodologies, safety standards, and code of conduct.
  • Performance and Strategic Selection: Monitor partner performance and select service providers based on their ability to deliver high quality results and enhance overall customer satisfaction.

Training and Development

  • Competency Building : Lead the training and development of internal staff and external partners to ensure the high level technical competency required for successful service delivery.
  • Continuous Professional Growth: Proactively maintain and update personal expertise in emerging technologies, industry tools, and evolving regulatory and industry standards.

What qualifications will make you successful for this role?

  • Bachelor’s Degree Electrical Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in Engineering or related discipline, particularly in mission critical applications and consulting engagement skills
  • Travel requirement: International (25%)
  • Technical Skills:
  • Electrical Expertise: In depth understanding of electrical distribution system design, including knowledge of electrical system components such as transformers, HV, MV, LV switchboards, electrical switchboard design standards, grounding, generator systems, etc.
  • Industry Standards: Demonstrate a thorough understanding of global best practices for the design, installation and operation of electrical systems.
  • Engineering Documentation and Procurement: Possess proven skills in project engineering and the development of technical documentation, supported by strong capabilities in vendor qualification and commercial negotiation.
  • Stakeholder Management: Confidently engage and build professional relationships with senior IT directors, facility managers, external consultants and executive-level stakeholders within major corporations
  • Leadership and Mentorship: Demonstrate exceptional leadership qualities with a structured methodology for developing, mentoring and motivating the Engineering and Project team.
  • Effective Communication: A strong communicator capable of articulating complex technical and non-technical information effectively, both in writing and verbally, to diverse audiences.
  • Customer Advocacy and Professionalism: Maintain a professional, customer-centric approach when engaging with both internal and external clients.
  • Operational Excellence: Exhibit superior time management and the ability to consistently meet project deadlines under pressure.
  • Ethics and Cultural Agility: Uphold the highest standards of business ethics and integrity, with the flexibility to adapt operational styles within a multi-cultural environment.

Job Description

The QVE (Quality Value Engineering) Technical Lead role at Schneider Electric is a specialized leadership position focused on driving cost optimization, quality improvements, and value engineering initiatives across product lines.

Key Responsibilities

. Value Engineering Leadership

  • Lead QVE initiatives to reduce product costs while maintaining or improving quality and performance.
  • Work closely with R&D, procurement, manufacturing, and marketing teams to identify and implement cost-saving opportunities
  • Collaborate with global HUBs and regional teams (e.g., China, France) to ensure alignment and knowledge transfer.
  • Oversee multiple QVE projects simultaneously, Align with all stakeholders (Quality, Indus, GSC..) to ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and meet performance targets
  • Supplier Engagement: Collaborate with suppliers to explore alternative materials, components, or manufacturing processes that can reduce costs
  • Collaborate with other  global Hubs (e.g., China, France,NAM) for all aspects of Engineering documentation and support, Gate approvals, know how and knowledge transfer.
  • Planning & Execution- Develop project plans using Work Breakdown Structures, Manage project schedules and monitor KPI achievements for all Line localization projects. Conduct risk analysis and implement corrective actions.
  • Work closely with Product Owners on product technical specifications and Offer Technical Leaders for Engineering documentation, Testing plans,Certification requirements
  • Develop and test product qualification, certification and reliability requirements. Provide technical guidance to cross functional teams esp GSC assigned to these projects.
  • Manage execution of Manufactured samples build, validation and testing in close co-ordination with GSC Technical & Quality Team
  • Prepare all the artifacts, documents, results, presentations for the stage reviews to meet the stage gates criteria. Provide input into project gate reviews (e.g., Do Gate).
  • Establish governance mechanisms to track QVE project progress and report savings and performance metrics to senior leadership.Ensure timely reporting and updates to all stakeholders on project status and risks.
  • Troubleshoot and perform root cause analysis to resolve design related failures during QVE implementation  and stabilization.
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in product design, testing, and validation processes.

Qualifications

job.description:
Job Description

Ready to drive a meaningful IMPACT in shaping how we bring offers to market? This role bridges global offer strategy with India market execution for IDPAC Activity within Industrial Automation BU, combining portfolio ownership and roadmap, go-to-market leadership, commercial performance, and customer-backed innovation across industrial automation segments.

Responsibilities-

  • Lead and grow IDPAC Offer portfolio for Greater India with ownership of offers across ePAC Controllers, DCS, Open SDA, connectivity and related software’s.
  • Translate global PAC Process Automation Controllers offer roadmaps into India-relevant portfolio choices, unique value propositions, launch priorities, pricing actions and sales enablement.
  • Build a differentiated offer strategy for target segments with sharp focus on growth, profitability and market-share expansion.
  • Champion OPEN software-defined open automation by positioning hardware-independent, interoperable and application-centric architectures that reduce vendor lock-in and improve agility for customers.
  • Act as the strategic and operational reference point between Global teams, India Sales, Segment Marketing, Prescription, Channel Ecosystem and customers to drive end-to-end offer lifecycle performance.

Requirements-

  • BE/BTech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or equivalent engineering discipline.
  • Discrete & Process Automation Exposure (Good to have)
  • MBA / PGDM, product management certification, commercial strategy exposure, or specialization in industrial software / digital transformation (Good to have)
  • 8 Years of overall experience
  • 6+ years in PLC/DCS/SCADA, process control architectures, automation software, portfolio management, go-to-market execution, or customer-facing solution positioning.

COMPETENCIES REQUIRED

Technical Competencies

  • Strong understanding of PLC, DCS, SCADA, industrial networks, cybersecure architectures and process control applications.
  • Ability to position integrated IDPAC architectures across EcoStruxure Plant layers.
  • Domain knowledge of software-defined open automation concepts: decoupling software from hardware, open standards, interoperability, reusable libraries and modular application design.

Functional Competencies-

  • Offer strategy, portfolio lifecycle management, product launch, go-to-market planning, pricing, forecast/pipeline governance and business performance tracking.
  • Ability to convert market intelligence, competitor activity and customer pain points into offer gaps, roadmap asks, value propositions and sales plays.
  • Strong presentation, stakeholder management and influencing skills across sales, global teams, prescription, channels, SI partners and customers.

Behavioral Competencies-

  • Customer-first & mission-based mindset, strategic clarity, ownership, collaboration, structured execution and ability to influence without authority.
  • Self-learner with curiosity for digital automation shifts, comfort with ambiguity, strong communication discipline and ability to simplify complex automation topics for commercial teams.

What's in it for me?

  • Opportunity to shape go-to-market strategy and work alongside talented, collaborative teams

  • Supportive culture that values innovation, autonomy, and continuous learning

job.title: Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Technical Lead
job.description:
Job Description

Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Technical Lead

Job Description

The Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Technical Lead serves as the primary technical point of contact across product development teams, driving the design, development, integration, validation, and delivery of complex multi-technology products. This role combines expertise in Electronics Hardware, Embedded Systems, Connectivity Technologies, and System Engineering to ensure successful execution throughout the product lifecycle.

The role is responsible for influencing technical architecture, ensuring design feasibility, driving cross-functional collaboration, managing technical risks, and leading system integration efforts across multiple engineering domains. The Technical Lead works closely with R&D, Product Management, Program Teams, Quality, Manufacturing, and other stakeholders to deliver innovative, reliable, and scalable solutions that meet customer and business requirements.

About the Role (Mission)

As a Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Technical Lead, your mission is to provide technical leadership for the development of next-generation multi-technology products by leveraging expertise in electronics hardware, embedded systems, electrical engineering, software integration, connectivity solutions, and system architecture. You will drive innovation, technical excellence, and cross-domain collaboration to deliver high-quality products that create meaningful value for customers and the business.

What will you do?

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Serve as the primary technical lead throughout the product lifecycle from concept to commercialization.
  • Define and influence product architecture, technical roadmaps, and system-level design strategies.
  • Lead cross-functional technical discussions and drive key engineering decisions.
  • Ensure alignment between product requirements, system architecture, and business objectives.

Electronics Hardware & System Design

  • Lead the development and integration of electronics hardware systems, including analog, digital, mixed-signal, power electronics, control systems, and embedded platforms.
  • Review hardware schematics, PCB designs, component selection, and system-level interfaces.
  • Ensure hardware reliability, safety, manufacturability, and compliance with applicable industry standards.
  • Support design verification and validation activities for electronic and electrical systems.

Multi-technology Product Integration

  • Drive seamless integration across hardware, firmware, software, mechanical, electrical, communication, and cloud-connected systems.
  • Ensure interoperability between subsystems and platforms.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to resolve complex system integration challenges.
  • Define interface requirements and integration strategies for connected products.

Program Execution & Technical Planning

  • Define technical scope, development plans, resource needs, and engineering effort estimates.
  • Prioritize technical activities based on business and shared team backlog priorities.
  • Monitor technical progress and proactively address project risks and dependencies.
  • Support product release readiness reviews and milestone achievements.

Validation, Testing & Quality

  • Develop system validation strategies, test plans, and verification methodologies.
  • Lead system integration testing, qualification activities, and root cause investigations.
  • Ensure compliance with performance, reliability, safety, EMC/EMI, and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement in quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

Innovation & Problem Solving

  • Investigate emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Conduct technical research and feasibility studies for new products and features.
  • Identify, analyze, and resolve complex technical challenges.
  • Recommend innovative solutions that improve product performance, cost, quality, and scalability.

Mentorship & Collaboration

  • Mentor and guide engineers across multiple technology domains.
  • Provide technical reviews, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
  • Foster a collaborative and innovation-driven engineering culture.
  • Partner effectively with product management, program management, quality, manufacturing, and customer-facing teams.

What qualifications will make you successful for this role?

Education

  • BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech / MSc in:
  • Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)
  • Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE)
  • Electronics Engineering
  • Embedded Systems
  • Systems Engineering

Experience

  • Proven experience leading complex multi-technology product development programs.
  • Experience in electronics hardware design, embedded systems, electrical systems, and product integration.
  • Demonstrated success in driving technical decisions across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Experience managing system validation, verification, and product qualification activities.
  • Strong background in product development from concept, design, integration, testing, and product launch.

Technical Skills

  • Electronics Hardware Design and Development
  • Analog, Digital, and Mixed-Signal Electronics
  • Embedded Systems and Microcontroller-based Architectures
  • Power Electronics and Control Systems
  • PCB Design, Hardware Validation, and Debugging
  • Electrical Systems Integration
  • Firmware and Software-Hardware Interface Design
  • System Architecture and Systems Engineering
  • Signal Integrity, EMC/EMI, Reliability, and Safety Engineering
  • IoT, Industrial Automation, Smart Connected Products
  • Communication Protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Modbus, Ethernet, USB)
  • Wireless Technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee, LoRa, Cellular)
  • Product Lifecycle Management and Engineering Change Processes
  • Requirements Management, Risk Assessment, and Root Cause Analysis
  • Agile and Hybrid Product Development Methodologies

Leadership & Professional Skills

  • Strong technical leadership and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders across engineering and business functions.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and navigate ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Proven experience mentoring engineers and building high-performing technical teams.
  • Strong project planning, prioritization, and execution capabilities.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

Join us in developing innovative, next-generation products that combine electronics hardware, embedded systems, and system technologies. As a Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Technical Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping technical strategy, driving engineering excellence, and delivering impactful solutions that advance technology and create meaningful value for customers worldwide. Your expertise and leadership will help transform ideas into industry-leading products while mentoring the next generation of engineering talent.

job.title: Engineer II, Package Substation Solutions
job.description:
Job Description

Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

Package Substation Solutions

Location: Bangalore, India

About the Role

Schneider Electric is expanding its portfolio of outdoor package substation solutions to support customers across global markets. We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Package Substation Solutions team to play a key role in the design and delivery of reliable and field-proven substation solutions.

The role offers the opportunity to work on international projects, collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams. Specific projects initially in India and Australia working directly with the UK technical expert and product owner for Package Substations.

Role Purpose

The Mechanical Design Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end mechanical design of package substations and outdoor enclosure & work closely with the global PSS OTL. The role focuses on delivering robust, manufacturable, and compliant solutions that meet customer requirements while ensuring structural integrity, operational safety, ease of installation, and cost-effective fabrication.

The successful candidate will contribute to both project execution and continuous product improvement by leveraging existing designs and developing new package substation platforms for global applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop detailed 3D models and assemblies for package substations, enclosures, and associated equipment using Creo.
  • Create efficient equipment layouts that optimise accessibility, maintainability, ventilation, safety clearances, and installation requirements.
  • Adapt and enhance existing package substation designs to improve speed, quality, and standardisation.
  • Design new package substation structures and enclosure solutions based on customer-specific technical requirements.
  • Specify structural materials, sheet metal components, steel grades, coatings, and corrosion protection systems.
  • Generate manufacturing-ready engineering drawings incorporating GD&T principles and applicable fabrication standards.
  • Prepare technical documentation and engineering data packages for seismic, vibration, and finite element analysis activities.
  • Support manufacturing, sourcing, and project teams during design reviews and product industrialisation activities.
  • Collaborate with global engineering teams across India, the UK, and Australia to deliver customer projects on schedule and to quality standards.

Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on design standardisation, cost optimisation, and product reliability

job.title: Service Desk Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

The Service Desk Analyst provides support for basic incident resolution and requests reported by APAC Schneider Employees. Responsibilities include initial assessment, research, and resolution of basic incidents and requests regarding use of applications, software and infrastructure components. The Service Desk Analyst would be responsible for collecting information through a customer conversation, probing, accessing support tools, and additional support teams if needed. Problems beyond the scope of their ability or responsibility are resolved by engaging other support teams in a timely manner.

Responsibilities:

1) Addresses and resolves basic incidents and requests; logs all incidents and requests; engages

other service desks or appropriate support teams to resolve incidents that are beyond the scope of

their ability or responsibility.

2) Uses the appropriate CTI categories for logging incidents and requests.

3) Creates a positive customer support experience and builds strong relationships through deep

problem understanding, ensuring timely resolution or escalation, communicating promptly on

progress, and handling customers with a professional attitude.

4) Ensures the end-to-end customer experience and acts as a single point-of-contact for the

customer.

5) Analyzes and resolves incidents and requests regarding use of application, software or hardware.

Logs and tracks incidents/requests from identification through resolution. Follows up with other

support teams involved in resolution to ensure incidents are resolved, requests are filled, and the

customer communication is complete. Documents resolutions and updates self-help knowledgebase.

6) Gains knowledge on applications, processes, and support to increase ability to resolve requests on

first contact.

7) Provides after hours and on-call support as needed.

8) Adheres to and supports ITIL standards and procedures.

9) Adheres to Companies Code of Conduct and Mission and Value statements.

10) Flexible to perform other adhoc duties/shifts assigned as per operational requirement.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (Required):

Demonstrates and desire to learn processes, application, and technology.

Demonstrates good customer handling skills and techniques.

Good communication and negotiation skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred:

Competency in MS Office O365 Suite.

ITIL Foundation certification (not Mandatory)

Prior experience in supporting customers in Technical Service Desk environment.

Prior experience voice, chat & email support.

Proficiency in using support software tools –Outlook,O365, Active Directory, VPN, Service Now,

Windows 8/10 and above, iOS & Android devices.
