job.title: Senior Associate GCP Data Engineer - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

As a key member of the Data Team at Equinix, we are seeking a skilled GCP Data Engineer who will be responsible for end-to-end development of Data Engineering use cases, Equinix Data Lake platform and tools. You will design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and analytics solutions on Google Cloud Platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud-native data technologies and a passion for building robust, efficient data pipelines that drive business insights.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Cloud Dataflow, Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow), Dataform/dbt and Cloud Functions
  • Build real-time streaming data pipelines using Cloud Pub/Sub, Kafka and Dataflow
  • Implement automated data quality checks and monitoring across all data workflows
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost efficiency through proper resource allocation and scheduling
  • Architect and implement data lake and data warehouse solutions using Dataproc, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Cloud SQL
  • Design optimal data models, partitioning strategies, and clustering for analytical workloads
  • Manage data lifecycle policies and implement automated archival and retention strategies
  • Ensure data security, encryption, and access control across all storage layers
  • Build and optimize BigQuery datasets for analytics and reporting use cases
  • Create and maintain dimensional models and fact tables for business intelligence
  • Implement data marts and aggregation layers for improved query performance
  • Support self-service analytics through proper data cataloging and documentation
  • Having good knowledge of Dataplex and Analytics hub
  • Integrate data from various sources including databases, APIs, SaaS applications, and file systems
  • Implement change data capture (CDC) solutions for real-time data synchronization
  • Work with third-party data providers and external data feeds
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging
  • Troubleshoot data pipeline issues and implement robust error handling mechanisms
  • Maintain data lineage documentation and impact analysis capabilities

Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • GCP Services: 2+ years hands-on experience with BigQuery, Cloud Dataflow Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, Cloud Pub/Sub, Dataform/dbt and Cloud Functions
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python/Java and SQL; experience with Spark/Beam development
  • Data Technologies: Strong understanding of Apache Beam, Apache Airflow, and distributed computing concepts
  • Database Systems: Experience with both RDBMS (Cloud SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (Bigtable, Firestore) databases
  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, or similar tools

Professional Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles
  • 2+ years of specific experience with Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of data modelling techniques and dimensional modelling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE)
  • Experience with data governance and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, SOX)
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Experience with streaming technologies beyond GCP (Kafka, Spark Streaming)

job.title: Assistant Manager - FQA (Mechanical)
job.description:
Quality Assurance and Inspection:

  • Coordinate and conduct site inspections with O&M engineers as per quality procedures, codes, and standards.
  • Execute all inspection activities of BTG and BOP, including PDI of materials and spares.
  • Execute inspection of boiler, pressure parts, welding, turbine and auxiliaries.
  • Identify and inspect Boiler Tube Leakage rectification works with NDT testing and other quality procedures.
  • Conduct visual inspections and witness various Destructive and Non-Destructive Testing (DPT, MPT, UT, RT) to verify equipment integrity.
  • Execute inspections and thickness surveys of boiler pressure parts, coal bunkers, APH, HP and LP Valves, rotary parts, etc.
  • Arrange PDI inspections of procurement material/spares at vendor premises and provide MDCC (Material Dispatch Claims Certification).
  • Provide support for third-party inspections and certifications of safety equipment and healthiness of equipment.

Quality Control and Testing:

  • Conduct welder qualification tests (for both IBR and non-IBR) and maintain welder performance records.
  • Prepare, review, and approve materials, QAPs, and FQPs of various site packages.
  • Prepare and review WPS, PQR, and WPQ documents.
  • Operational Excellence and Compliance:
  • Raise NFA (Note for Approval) for deviations and modifications and obtain approval through the system.
  • Provide budget inputs and ensure the sustainability of resources and processes.

Resource Management, Training, and Innovation:

  • Provide TNI inputs and drive feedback sessions for continuous learning.
  • Provide innovative ideas and recommendations.
  • Support quality awareness training sessions for maintenance engineers and agency engineers/supervisors to foster a culture of quality and excellence at the site.
  • Manage relationships with external agencies to ensure the timely submission of bills, closure of accounts, and resolution of financial matters related to mechanical works.

Business Sustainability:

  • Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.
  • Maintain the safety of business associates/other contractors and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.
  • Ensure compliance with technical audits, safety audits, and business excellence assessments.
  • Implement CHETNA Safety standards in the department to achieve zero harm.
  • Conduct regular safety audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant environmental, health, and safety regulations and company policies.

Digitization and Automation:

  • Execute integration of advanced technology and comprehensive digitization strategies in mechanical quality assurance processes to optimize operational efficiency.
  • Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy.
  • Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.
  • Monitor and analyse data from digital systems to inform decision-making and improve quality outcomes.

  • Maintenance Mechanical
  • Operations & Maintenance
  • Techno Commercial

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Agencies and contractors

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution.

Work Experience (Range of years):

6+ years of experience in quality assurance/control, with a significant portion in a leadership role within the power sector or related heavy industries.

Preferred Industry:

Candidates with experience in the power generation, energy, or related heavy industrial sectors are preferred, with a strong background in operational excellence and quality management systems.

job.title: Lead - Security Automation & Loss Prevention
job.description:

job.title: Lead – Field Instrumentation Maintenance

job.title: Duty Manager - Aocc/jcc
job.description:
Operational Oversight:

Direct and supervise daily operations across the shift, ensuring compliance with established operational standards and procedures.

Monitor flight schedules, OTP (On-Time Performance), delays, and cancellations, taking necessary actions to minimize disruptions.

Notify airlines, ground handlers, and operators of adverse weather conditions and implement Low Visibility Procedures (LVP) when required.

Coordinate with ATC for expected time of arrival (ETA) updates, parking stand assignments, runway usage changes, and aircraft towing/engine run-ups.

Resource Management:

Manage the allocation and utilization of airport resources such as parking stands, boarding gates, check-in counters, and baggage reclaim belts during shift operations to maximize asset utilization.

Regularly monitor resource usage and promptly address any concerns related to allocation, availability, or maintenance.

Emergency and Contingency Management:

Support the implementation of emergency response plans in collaboration with relevant stakeholders during disruptions or crises.

Manage operations during crisis situations (e.g., weather events, security incidents, or equipment failures) to minimize impact on passengers and airport activities.

Team Supervision:

Lead and support team members in the shift, offering direction and ensuring that performance aligns with organizational standards.

Evaluate team performance and foster professional growth through tailored development plans for team members.

Stakeholder Coordination:

Engage with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate seamless operations and promptly address any emerging issues.

Act as the primary point of contact for all stakeholders during the shift, including airlines, ground handlers, customs, immigration, ATC, and security agencies.

Communicate operational updates, disruptions, and emergency response actions to senior management and relevant stakeholders promptly.

Compliance and Reporting:

Uphold adherence to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements across all managed sections or sites.

Ensure that all operational activities are in line with airport SOPs and safety guidelines.

Maintain accurate records of shift operations, incidents, and disruptions in AOCC/JCC systems.

Generate and submit daily shift reports, including key performance metrics (OTP, resource utilization, disruptions) for management review.

Non-scheduled operators

Medical agencies

Bachelor's Degree in Aviation Management, Business Administration, or a related field

5-7 years of relevant experience in airport operations.

job.title: Plant Head (PSP Hydro- O&M)
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Ensure reliable, safe, and efficient operation of all generating units, auxiliaries, and balance of plant systems.
  • Develops and maintains safe system of work (SSOW) procedures, including HIRA, PTW, LOTO, JSA etc.
  • Ensures full compliance with Statutory HSS, environmental and technical requirements from central and state governmental bodies (i.e. CEA, CERC, DSA, SCEI, AP/CPCB, Cybersecurity etc. compliances).
  • To provide oversight of all operational & maintenance activities, management of the operational and maintenance teams, financial control, contract management, environmental compliance, regulatory compliance, technical compliance, risk evaluations and relationship management.
  • Achieve generation targets, pumping schedules, and meet SLDC / RLDC instructions. Liaison with SLDC/RLDC, DISCOMs, OEMs, regulatory bodies and government agencies, as and when required.
  • Strategic oversight of reliability centered maintenance (RCM), including preventive, predictive, condition based and corrective maintenance approach.
  • Maintaining and sharing complete plant operation & maintenance records, including daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting needed to corporate office management team.
  • Prepare and manage plant O&M budget and P&Ls, work to optimize the costs and maximize production. This includes developing and tracking the monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets and keeping them within approved limits.
  • Responsible for overseeing end‑to‑end O&M contract management, including contractor performance monitoring, compliance, service delivery, budgeting, and risk mitigation.
  • Responsible for local co-ordination with Government authorities / clients / Vendors and local community representees. Effective Coordination and dispute settlements with O&M contractor, local community and other stakeholders, as and when required.
  • Ensure availability of critical spares inventory to meet the exigencies, in co-ordination with plant maintenance heads.
  • Support billing, PPA compliance, DSM management, and settlements, as and when required.
  • Define and monitor O&M Plans to achieve yearly Generation targets (including minimization of APC) and yearly agreed of Plant/Machines Availability targets.
  • Delegates and assigns work tasks to Plant O&M team to maintain optimum plant operations.
  • Assess plant operational procedures to identify areas of inefficiency and formulate action plan for continuous improvements.
  • Lead plant improvement projects, modernization initiatives, digital transformation, and automation upgrades.
  • Lead, train and develop a multi-disciplinary team at Plant level: i.e. for operations, mechanical, electrical, C&I, safety, civil and other support functions.
  • Develop and execute risk management strategies to mitigate O&M risks and ensure compliance with internal audits.
  • Ensure implementation on approved CSR plan at plant level.
  • IMS implementation at Plant and coordination with central IMS team.

Qualifications

  • B.E/B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.
  • 20+ years of experience in operations and maintenance within the hydro power generation sector.
  • Strong knowledge of Statutory and regulatory requirements pertaining to Hydro and PSS Plants.
  • Must have O&M experience in large-scale hydropower plants/ pump storage plants.
  • Experience leading a team of managers, engineers and technicians for large scale hydro/pump storage power Plants operations and maintenance works.
  • Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) for Plant Operations and Maintenance works.
  • Knowledge of analytics tools for performance optimization and risk assessment.
  • Advanced certifications in operations management or power generation technologies are preferred

job.title: Facility Engineer (Mechanical)
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in late 2019, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

Roles Open for This Intake:

**

We are hiring 3 job families and roles across our Jakarta site. All roles are shift-based and site-based. Full job descriptions will be shared with registered candidates ahead of the event, but the high-level summary are provided below.

  • Facility Technician

Hands-on operation and maintenance of critical electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems in a 24/7 data center environment.

What you'll do

  • Monitor and maintain power, cooling, and control systems
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and routine inspections
  • Responding to incidents, alarms, and equipment anomalies
  • Coordinate with vendors during planned and unplanned work

What we're looking for

  • 1–2 years' experience in mechanical, electrical, or HVAC systems (data center, telecom, or other critical environments preferred)
  • Vocational diploma (SMK) or higher in a relevant technical field
  • Willing to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends
  • Physically capable of equipment handling in operational conditions
  • Customer Care Assistant, Site Operations

First point of contact for customer inquiries, incident handling, and service coordination on site. This is a customer-facing operations role, not an engineering role.

**

What you'll do

  • Manage customer tickets and service requests end-to-end
  • Coordinate with internal technical teams to resolve incidents within SLA
  • Maintain accurate documentation and reporting
  • Contribute to process improvements across the customer journey

What we're looking for

  • Prior customer service experience, ideally in data center, telco, or tech environments
  • Diploma or degree (business, operations, or related fields preferred)
  • Basic understanding of data center operations (advantage, not required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English
  • Team Lead, Facility Operations

Leads a team of Facility Technicians across shifts, with day-to-day ownership of site operations, incident response, and maintenance execution.

**

What you'll do

  • Supervise and develop a team of technicians across rotating shifts
  • Own incident response, escalation, and root-cause follow-through
  • Ensure compliance with safety, operational, and vendor standards
  • Partner with the Facility Manager on planning, reporting, and continuous improvement

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in data center, mission-critical facilities, or industrial operations, with at least 2 years leading a team
  • Strong technical grounding in electrical and/or mechanical systems
  • Proven track record managing incidents in a 24/7 environment
  • Diploma or degree in engineering or a related technical discipline

Why Digital Edge:

**

  • Work on infrastructure that matters: you'll operate the facilities powering Indonesia's largest digital platforms
  • Regional scale, local ownership: part of a 30+ site platform across Asia, with decisions made close to the ground in Jakarta
  • Backed for the long term: Stonepeak-funded with over US$1.6B in committed capital
  • Clear technical career paths in one of the fastest-growing data center markets in the region

Career Day Format:

**

  • Confirmation of invites will be sent to shortlisted candidates only.
  • Full day session with option for AM/PM sessions including role briefing, technical conversation, and meeting with hiring managers.
  • Same day outcomes
  • Venue shared only after registration is confirmed.
  • Registration window: 3rd July to 28th July

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Lead, AI & Agent Operations #AIDA
job.description:
About the Role

Lead the Day 2 AI & Agent Operations function, accountable for operating, monitoring, evaluating and governing the organisation’s production AI estate — GenAI agents and traditional classical AI/ML models. Manage agent operations and evaluation / observability team and the traditional classical machine-learning operations team. Own the operating model that takes AI from build to dependable production — handover gates, 24×7 monitoring and incident response, evaluation and observability, and safe model operations. Ensure defined standards of reliability, safety and quality. Serve as the senior operational point of accountability for AI in production, and as the primary partner to the Day 1 build organisation, platform, data and business stakeholders.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Own the Day 2 operating model end to end — handover gates, evaluation and observability, 24×7 agent operations, and traditional ML operations — across both locations.
  • Lead and develop both the Singapore and India team of agent operations & evaluation and ML operations.
  • Manage a distributed, cross-border operation: define how Singapore and India work together, ensure clear ownership and handoffs, and safeguard coverage, quality and team wellbeing across time zones.
  • Hold gate and go/no-go authority for the AI estate, and protect the integrity of evaluation decisions — ensuring that even where the same engineers both run and evaluate agents, quality judgments remain evidence-based and are not compromised by delivery pressure.
  • Own incident governance for the estate — severity standards, escalation, rollback and the contact-centre fallback for customer-impacting events — and represent major incidents and remediation to senior stakeholders.
  • Govern deployment and change discipline for agents and ML models (regression gating, rollback authority, change coordination) with the platform and Day 1 build teams.
  • Own the function’s service-level objectives, error-budget policy and KPIs (availability, proactive-detection rate, mean-time-to-resolve, model performance, cost) and report AI reliability and value to the Chief AI Officer and the board.
  • Set the growth and maturity roadmap for the function — scaling coverage, tooling and headcount as the AI estate grows.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
  • 10+ years in technology with experience leading production operations, SRE, or ML/AI functions
  • Experience leading teams, including remote or offshore / cross-border teams
  • Track record operating or governing ML/AI systems in production
  • AI/ML operations, reliability engineering and observability
  • Evaluation, gating and quality governance for AI
  • Understanding of both LLM/agent and traditional ML lifecycles and their failure modes
  • Incident management, service-level objectives and error budgets
  • People leadership across cultures, locations and time zones, with care for team wellbeing
  • The independence and integrity to protect quality and safety under pressure
  • Clear, decisive judgment under incomplete information and during incidents
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
  • Telco consumer, enterprise (B2B) and network operations and their customer-impact considerations

job.title: Senior Agent Operations & Evaluation Engineer​ #AIDA
job.description:
About the Role

An engineering role that operates the live GenAI agents and builds the evaluation and observability that proves they are accurate, safe and improving.

On the operations side, keeps agents healthy, performs first-level triage and incident response, and minimises downtime.

On the evaluation and observability side, builds the operational dashboard for each use case, defines the metrics that matter, runs the evaluation suites, and proactively detects issues before customers do.

Works closely with the Day 1 build teams, solution architects and business owners across Singtel Singapore.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Build and maintain the operational observability dashboard for each AI / agent and Classical AI ML use case, across system health, performance, quality, safety and business-outcome metrics.
  • Define, with build teams and solution architects (technical metrics) and product / business owners (outcome metrics), what needs to be measured per use case; consume the telemetry the platform provides.
  • Build and run the evaluation suites (offline before launch and continuous evaluation on sampled production traffic after) and drive proactive detection of drift and quality decay.
  • Monitor live agents, using the dashboards and automated safeguards, and act on alerts and proactive signals.
  • Perform first-level triage and in-scope fixes (restart, safe-listed configuration, cache reset, routing fallback) per the runbooks.
  • Manage incidents — classify severity, route by fault domain, escalate with a full evidence bundle, and verify-and-close in production — while owning the incident throughout.
  • Contribute to the handover gate — verifying operability and evaluation evidence before an agent is accepted into full operation.

**

  • 6 - 10 years across software / SRE / data or ML engineering
  • Hands-on production operations experience AND hands-on evaluation, data-analysis or quality experience
  • Experience with LLM / agentic systems
  • Monitoring, alerting and observability; log / trace analysis
  • Evaluation methods and metric design for AI systems
  • Dashboarding tools and Python

  • LLM observability and evaluation tooling (e.g. tracing, eval harnesses)

job.title: Account Management Specialist
job.description:
Being part of Cummins means working alongside today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better. Thank you for your interest in continuing to grow your Cummins career!

We are looking for a talented Account Management Specialist to join our team in Tuas, Singapore location. This will be following Onsite with Flexibility work model.

Supports the account team and account strategies to build customer relationships and grow our share of the customer's wallet with an assigned set of customers or a geographic region.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Supports the account team in developing and maintaining positive customer relationships. Assists in organization of customer visits and negotiations.

  • Coordinates internal communication across sales roles and segments and/or with internal stakeholders. Supports the account team to meet revenue and share goals within assigned accounts.
  • Act as a champion for the voice of the customer within the business. Supports projects intended to improve customer relationships and customer value and to grow the business with assigned accounts.
  • Executes the Cummins Sales Process. Supports/Maintains accurate reporting and forecasting, using Cummins tools and processes and Customer Relationship Management systems.
  • Supports revenue growth by identifying and contacting new business opportunities and participating in cost reduction initiatives.
  • Manages account receivable deliverables including discussing and negotiating payment terms.
  • Maintains Sales forecasts and tracks progress and accuracy against forecast.
  • As applicable, works with internal stakeholders and customers to balance inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
  • Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
  • Articulating Value Proposition - Interprets internal and external customer needs based on relevant application; explains and demonstrates products, solutions, and services to distinguish strengths and weaknesses to meet customer's specific needs to differentiate against competition.
  • Channel Awareness - Explains and contextualizes industry structure, dynamics, and path to market in order to advance organizational goals.

  • Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers' perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.

Synthesizes complex information from internal and external resources to deliver tailored solutions for the internal or external customer.

job.title: L4-Product support Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Company Overview

Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, delivering innovative solutions that ensure _Life Is On_ for everyone, everywhere, and at every moment. As part of our growing digital ecosystem, we are strengthening our technical support capabilities for EcoStruxure Building Activate (EBA)—a cloud-connected, nextgeneration building automation platform used worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled L4 Product Support Engineer to join our advanced support organization and ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of our building automation solutions in the field.

Role Overview

The Level 4 Product Support Engineer provides expert-level technical support, advanced troubleshooting, and system-level diagnostics for complex issues that go beyond the scope of L3 support. This role serves as the technical escalation point for global support teams, partners, and country front-office engineers.

You will work closely with R&D, QA, product management, and field teams to analyze defects, replicate issues, propose corrective actions, and contribute to long-term product improvements. This role requires strong system thinking, analytical depth, and the ability to investigate issues spanning hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile components.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis

  • Investigate and resolve complex system-level issues across hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile platforms.
  • Analyze logs, traces, network captures, system metrics, and API interactions to identify root causes.
  • Reproduce field issues in lab environments to validate hypotheses and support engineering teams.
  • Own critical escalations from L3 teams, ensuring timely and high-quality resolution.
  • Provide RCA documentation, corrective action proposals, and long-term recommendations.

System-Level Analysis & Integration Support

  • Perform deep-dive analysis of EBA system architecture, including controllers, gateways, cloud components, and mobile workflows.
  • Support integration efforts across different layers of the EBA platform and its external integrations.
  • Validate end-to-end workflows to ensure subsystem interoperability and performance.
  • Troubleshoot integration protocols such as BACnet, Modbus on the edge side and MQTT, REST APIs, HTTPS, and other IoT communication layers for the cloud communication
  • Identify system bottlenecks, performance issues, and configuration defects.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Serve as the bridge between field support teams and R&D engineering groups.
  • Provide detailed field insights to influence product roadmaps and design decisions.
  • Document troubleshooting guides, diagnostic procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Deliver post-escalation briefings and contribute to continuous improvement loops.
  • Mentor L3 engineers and help elevate the technical competence of the product support team.

Support for Senior L4 Initiatives

  • Contribute to product quality improvement initiatives, including failure mode analysis and test coverage enhancements.
  • Participate in cross-functional reviews, defect triages, and technical deep-dive sessions.
  • Support the development of troubleshooting tools, diagnostic frameworks, and automation scripts.
  • Recommend improvements in escalation workflows, documentation structure, and customer experience practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in system-level troubleshooting, advanced technical support, or product integration roles.
  • Strong analytical and debugging skills with experience diagnosing complex behaviours across distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience with building automation, HVAC systems, IoT devices, or industrial automation platforms.
  • Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for automation, data extraction, and analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux fundamentals, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, certificates), and API-level debugging.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with HVAC systems and building controls.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Grafana, and Jenkins.
  • Hands-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, analyzers).
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies and collaborative workflows.
  • Experience working in global, multiregional support environments.

Performance Objectives:

  • Deliver timely and effective resolution of escalated critical issues within defined SLAs.
  • Improve product reliability by contributing RCAs, reproducible defect scenarios, and engineering-quality test cases.
  • Reduce repeat escalations through robust analysis and knowledge sharing.
  • Strengthen team capabilities through mentorship, documentation, and diagnostic tool improvements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and system stability.

Why Schneider Electric

At Schneider Electric, you join a company committed to sustainability, innovation, and inclusion. You will collaborate with global teams, work on mission-critical building automation solutions, and directly influence product quality and customer satisfaction worldwide. Your work will help ensure resilient, intelligent, and energy-efficient buildings across the globe.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

job.title: GM – Organization-Wide Technical Skill Development
job.description:
Job Description

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

This position will be for Vadodara Plant for Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.)

Designation: GM – Organization-Wide Technical Skill Development

Experience: 15-18+ years of experience in the Switchgear Industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, either in Technical Training, R&D, or Manufacturing Operations.

Position Summary

The Lead for Technical Skill Development will spearhead the creation and implementation of a comprehensive, company-wide technical competency framework. This role is responsible for upskilling the technical workforce (engineering, R&D, manufacturing, and field service) in Low Voltage switchgear products (ACB, MCCB, MCB, Panels, Switchboards) and modern manufacturing processes (IoT, automation). The goal is to build a high-performance culture, reduce R&D-to-production transfer time, improve quality, and standardize technical processes across all plants in India.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

Strategic & Technical Leadership

  • Competency Mapping: Define role-based technical competencies for engineering, production, quality, and R&D roles (e.g., design engineers, testing technicians, assembly line workers).
  • Technical Roadmap: Develop a multi-year technical skill development strategy aligned with the company’s product roadmap, focusing on IEC standards, 61439 panel solutions, and digital switchgear technologies.
  • Knowledge Management: Create a structured repository for technical knowledge, standardizing design practices, and ensuring "lessons learned" are implemented across projects.

Training Design & Implementation

  • Curriculum Development: Design, curate, and implement technical training modules for LV Switchgear design, manufacturing, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on Training: Lead practical, hands-on sessions for technicians on switchgear assembly, testing protocols, and safety procedures.
  • Modern Training Methods: Implement hybrid learning solutions, including e-learning platforms, virtual reality (VR) simulations for complex assembly, and classroom workshops.
  • Onboarding: Develop a rigorous technical induction program for new engineering and production hires.

Operational & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Location Coordination: Coordinate training across different plants and R&D centres in India to ensure consistency and standardize operating procedures.
  • Subject Matter Expert (SME) Liaison: Work closely with R&D, QA, Manufacturing, and Engineering heads to ensure training content is up to date with new product introductions and engineering changes.
  • External Training: Collaborate with external industry experts, technical institutes, and consultants for specialized training.

Assessment & Effectiveness Measurement

  • TNA (Training Needs Analysis): Conduct individual and team skills gap analyses regularly.
  • ROI/Impact Measurement: Evaluate training effectiveness through metrics, such as reduced rework, faster troubleshooting, and improved productivity in manufacturing.
  • Certification: Implement certification programs to recognize technical expertise within the organization.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of employees certified under the technical competency framework.
  • Reduction in manufacturing rework or quality issues attributed to skill gaps.
  • Reduction in time-to-market for new products (R&D to production training efficiency).
  • Training hours per employee (technical).
  • Adherence to the Annual Training Calendar.

Required Candidate Profile:

Education & Experience

  • Education: B.E./ B.Tech in Electrical/Electronics/Mechanical/Production Engineering (essential). M.Tech in Power Systems/Electrical Engineering/Mechanical Engineering is a plus.
  • Experience: 15-18+ years of experience in the Switchgear Industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, either in Technical Training, R&D, or Manufacturing Operations.
  • Knowledge: Deep understanding of Low Voltage Switchgear products (ACB, MCCB, Switchboards) and IEC/IS standards (especially IEC 61439).

Skills & Competencies

  • Technical Expertise: Strong background in design, testing, and troubleshooting of switchgear components and panels.
  • Training Skills: Expertise in instructional design, adult learning principles, and modern training technologies.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to manage teams and drive initiatives across multiple locations.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills to engage both shop-floor technicians and senior R&D management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certification in Training & Development.
  • Six Sigma Black Belt
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning creation tools.
  • Understanding of LEAN and Six Sigma methodologies in manufacturing

What's in it for you:

  • Opportunity to lead strategic quality initiatives across multiple manufacturing sites
  • Platform to implement innovative quality improvement programs that drive organizational success
  • Professional growth through exposure to diverse manufacturing processes and systems
  • Collaborative environment that values continuous learning and development
  • Chance to make a significant impact on organizational excellence and customer satisfaction

job.description:

This role is responsible for driving customer adoption, market positioning, and go-to-market strategy for Amazon Quick's generative AI capabilities across enterprise and mid-market customers in Asia ANZ – Australia & New Zealand ASEAN – Southeast Asian nations (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam) Korea (South Korea) South Asia / India – India & Sri Lanka Priority Countries (large, mature geographies) Australia India Japan Singapore South Korea Emerging & Fast-Growing Markets Indonesia Malaysia New Zealand Philippines Thailand Taiwan Vietnam

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive adoption of Amazon Quick's GenAI capabilities (Amazon Q Business, Q Developer, and AI-powered analytics) with key enterprise and mid-market customers
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and technical leaders, helping them understand how generative AI transforms business intelligence, data analytics, and decision-making
  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies that accelerate proof-of-concept to production deployment
  • Build deep relationships with customers across industries (financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, retail, etc.) to understand their GenAI challenges and opportunities

Market Positioning & Messaging

  • Develop positioning, messaging, and value propositions for Amazon Quick relative to competitive alternatives
  • Create and refine sales plays, customer case studies, and industry-specific use cases that demonstrate Quick's GenAI capabilities
  • Track market evolution and competitive landscape; provide insights to product and marketing teams on market trends and customer needs
  • Synthesize customer and partner feedback to inform product roadmap prioritization and service evolution

Sales Enablement & Team Leadership

  • Educate and enable regional AI/ML specialists, account teams, and sales organizations on Amazon Quick's GenAI capabilities, assets, and go-to-market strategies
  • Develop training materials, workshops, and enablement content for sales teams
  • Collaborate with Solutions Architects and Technical Account Managers to support complex customer engagements
  • Mentor junior specialists and build a high-performing specialist team

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem

  • Engage with system integrators, consulting partners, and technology partners to co-develop solutions and accelerate customer adoption
  • Identify partnership opportunities and develop joint go-to-market strategies
  • Present to partner audiences at industry events and summits
  • Build and maintain relationships with key industry analysts and thought leaders

Business Development & Growth

  • Identify and pursue new market opportunities for Amazon Quick's GenAI capabilities
  • Develop industry-specific strategies and vertical-focused initiatives
  • Track key metrics: customer adoption, pipeline generation, revenue influence, and market share
  • Contribute to quarterly business reviews and strategic planning with leadership

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct sales or business development in software, cloud or SaaS markets selling to C-level executives experience
  • Deep understanding of generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and enterprise AI applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization
  • Experience with AWS services, particularly Amazon Quick, QuickSight, Amazon Q, or related AI/ML services
  • Background in financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, or other key vertical markets

job.title: Senior Customer Success Specialist, Amazon Connect
job.description:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing millions of customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung.

AWS is seeking an experienced Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) Customer Success Specialist for Amazon Connect. Connect was born out of Amazon’s own need for the best CCaaS solution that works at scale, while improving customer experience. Today, Connect is one of AWS's fastest growing services, leveraging native generative AI capabilities to improve customer and employee experiences. As a Connect Customer Success Specialist, you will act as a strategic advisor to customers, helping them innovate and optimize their contact center and customer experience through adoption of the Connect capabilities. You will lead cross-functional field teams in sales, solutions architecture, partner sales, product, and will work at the CxO level with customers to maximize the value of their Connect investment.

The ideal candidate will have enterprise sales and/or consulting experience in Contact Center as a Service or similar SaaS solutions in areas such as telecommunications, VoIP, and/or or CRM/ERP applications. You will be passionate about customer experience and advocacy and bring the voice of the customer into the product development process. You will enjoy solving complex problems; our customers will rely on your guidance to scale Connect across their complex global businesses, overcoming technical and organizational roadblocks on the way.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, managing relationships and being a strategic advisor, driving enterprise-wide adoption of Connect.
  • Deliver compelling presentations, product demos, sample solutions and programs, events, and discussions to enable customer success.
  • Build customer skills and proficiency with Connect.
  • Engage with C-level stakeholders to understand the value proposition of Connect and uncover new areas of business value.
  • Develop account plans in conjunction with field teams.
  • Meet annual revenue targets through increased adoption of Connect.
  • Work with partners and ISVs to extend reach & drive adoption of AWS solutions.

A day in the life The Amazon Connect Customer Success Specialist (CSS) will create a matrix environment with resources from our partner community, Professional Services, AWS account teams, and Connect service team members to drive customer success. A CSS will run attach service plays, customer engagements to drive adoption of migrating services, work with our partner community to scale and align key members of the services team for optimization and retention efforts. Last, a CSS will uncover cases that align to Connect unique business value to be shared with AWS Marketing.

About the team Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
  • 2+ years of customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
  • Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
  • Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams
  • 2+ years of experience leading and advising customers through complex contact center migrations and/or customer experience journeys

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
  • Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Power Diagnostics® Center, Control Systems Engineer
job.description:
Looking for challenging role? If you really want to make a difference - make it with us

Can we energize society and fight climate change at the same time?

At Siemens Energy, we can. Our technology is key, but our people make the difference. Brilliant minds innovate. They connect, create, and keep us on track towards changing the world’s energy systems. Their spirit fuels our mission.

Our culture is defined by caring, agile, respectful, and accountable individuals. We value excellence of any kind. Sounds like you?

The Analytic Services Operations Team within Siemens Energy is looking for Engineer to monitor, maintain and troubleshoot data processing based on the Data Acquisition Platform WIN_TS and the Power Diagnostics® Centers. Additionally, one will have to handle project instrumentation & control engineering for large turbines. The WINTS is a Windows based diagnosis server which is connected to the control system of the turbine (e.g.: SPPA-T3000) to collect I&C signals and messages. Furthermore, there are several 3rd-party systems connected to the WINTS network (e.g.: Vibration Analysis, Delphin Data Logger, Argus…) collecting detailed information and exchanging data with WINTS. With the Siemens standard remote solution cRSP (common Remote Service Platform) the WINTS is securely connected to the internet and reachable from all over the globe. The collected data is transferred to Siemens Energy data centers where already twenty years of hundreds of turbine data is stored. Beyond pure data storage the collected data is processed on daily basis and engineers in SE GP G SV TI PA and other organizations are supplied with automated analysis results on operational data and related information or alarm notifications.

Your new role – challenging and future-oriented

  • You will be working closely with our teams in Erlangen, Mülheim and Orlando to monitor data processing in the Power Diagnostics® datacenters and take action to support data related requests or troubleshooting for the whole data chain from power plant to Power Diagnostics® center. For troubleshooting you will be also in contact with site staff to figure out local problems. The maintenance of local and backend systems is also part of this job. You will be working closely with our teams in Germany & USA to perform the data acquisition tasks. This position is based in Gurgaon (India) and will involve working in morning or night shifts.
  • Monitoring of data processing in the Power Diagnostics® datacenters and execution of regular system maintenance task to ensure continuous operation.
  • Thermodynamics (TDY) data processing and system or process troubleshooting.
  • Acquisition of partial data files, Sequence of Event files and control system data upon request of Operations Engineers and Service Engineering.
  • Troubleshooting of data acquisition and connection issues to restore data availability and quality
  • Communication & collaboration with site staff and colleagues in Mülheim, Erlangen and Orlando
  • Maintenance of local data acquisition, data transmission and backend server systems
  • Coordinate cross-functional problems related to data acquisition and data processing including management of incoming requests via support mailbox/distribution list
  • Contribution to 24/7 on call duty
  • Contribution to 24/7 hotline support for customer phone calls and track issues for managed Power Diagnostics® sites

Your new role – challenging and future-oriented

•Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Controls/ Electronic Engineering or a closely related subject

  • 6+ years of relevant experience
  • Advanced handling of Windows Server OS (e.g.: Windows Server 2012 R2, 2016, 2019)
  • Experience in basic IP networking (routing, switches…)
  • Experience in industrial standard communication and OPC classic and OPC UA
  • Turbine Thermodynamics behaviour knowledge
  • Ability and willingness to work non-standard shifts, including nights.
  • Being able to work in global team
  • Communication skills

Preferred Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

  • CCNA/ CCNP/MCSE/ MCSA Certification preferred
  • Strong knowledge in VPN
  • CRSP router & Terminal Server configuration
  • Experience on Siemens DCS SPPA-T3000
  • Knowledge of major components of power plants
  • Practical knowledge of database and scripting tools like MS Access, Python, Visual basic etc.
  • Solid experience with working in a global team
  • Experience in handling of large data and analytical screening.
  • Ability and willingness to learn new fields, Committed to personal development and continuous improvement
  • High flexibility in taking new tasks/responsibilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

We’ve got quite a lot to offer. How about you?

This role is based in Gurgaon. You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

job.title: Baan Functional Consultant
job.description:
Baan Functional Consultant (Open) - Bangalore | 4 to 7 Years

Johnson Controls helps create smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, and this role supports the ERP platforms that keep business operations running smoothly. As a Baan Functional Consultant, you will help business users and support teams maintain stable ERP processes, resolve functional issues, and improve the day-to-day experience across Baan IV and ERP LN environments.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Baan Functional Consultant with hands-on experience in ERP functional support and user issue resolution. In this role, you will work closely with business users, functional teams, and technical teams to analyze issues, support production operations, validate process changes, and help ensure reliable ERP performance across the Baan landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support for Baan IV, ERP LN FP3, and LN 10.4 ERP applications.
  • Analyze user incidents, identify functional gaps, and support timely resolution with the right teams.
  • Work with business users to clarify process issues, reproduce problems, and confirm expected outcomes.
  • Support production issues, change activities, and functional testing for ERP process updates.
  • Coordinate with technical teams on fixes, enhancements, and interface-related issues.
  • Validate data and process integrity across ERP transactions and support root-cause analysis for recurring issues.
  • Document resolutions, process notes, and functional changes clearly for continuity and knowledge sharing.

How You Will Do It

  • Take ownership of issues end to end, keeping user impact, accountability, safety, and integrity in focus until the process is restored or the right workaround is in place.
  • Stay close to the business process and the people using it so you can understand the real problem, not just the symptom.
  • Use structured analysis and candid root-cause discussion to prevent repeat issues and improve support quality over time.
  • Work as one team with functional, technical, and business partners to move changes forward smoothly and remove obstacles quickly.
  • Document clearly and follow through on commitments so fixes, decisions, and process changes are easy to trace and support.

Qualifications

  • 4 to 7 years of experience in Baan functional support, ERP consulting, or application support.
  • Hands-on experience with Baan IV, ERP LN FP3, and LN 10.4 ERP environments.
  • Strong understanding of ERP business processes and functional issue handling in a production support setting.
  • Experience working with business users to analyze issues, validate solutions, and support testing or process changes.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams and communicate clearly with stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to problem-solving.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Baan development, customization, or integration support.
  • Working knowledge of Baan technical architecture, SQL, or data extraction activities.
  • Experience supporting third-party interfaces or Baan EDI-related activities.

Why Join Us

At Johnson Controls, you will be part of a collaborative environment where practical problem-solving, reliability, and teamwork matter. This role offers the opportunity to support core ERP systems that help keep operations running effectively and to build deeper expertise in the Baan and ERP LN ecosystem.

If you are ready to bring your Baan functional experience to a role that values ownership, teamwork, and continuous improvement, we would like to hear from you.

job.title: ServiceMax Functional Lead
job.description:
ServiceMax Functional Lead

Johnson Controls is a global leader in smart buildings, security, and HVAC solutions. In this senior techno-functional role, you will lead the functional design and delivery of ServiceMax capabilities that support field service operations, connect business needs with technical execution, and help teams work more effectively.

Role Overview

We are looking for a ServiceMax Functional Lead with 10+ years of experience to own end-to-end solution design, implementation support, and adoption for ServiceMax and Salesforce-based field service solutions. You will partner with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and support teams to translate operational needs into scalable solutions, improve service processes, and ensure strong delivery from design through handover.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end ServiceMax solution design, development coordination, and implementation support.
  • Gather and analyze business requirements from field service, operations, and customer support teams.
  • Translate functional needs into technical specifications aligned with ServiceMax and Salesforce best practices.
  • Work with architects, developers, and IT teams on solution design, integration, data flow, and delivery planning.
  • Configure and support ServiceMax modules such as Work Orders, Entitlements, Installed Base, Preventive Maintenance, and Dispatch Console.
  • Support Salesforce and ServiceMax customizations, including workflows, validation rules, custom objects, and integrations.
  • Plan and execute integration testing, support UAT, and help resolve defects and process gaps.
  • Prepare and maintain technical and operational documentation, including support runbooks and training materials.
  • Deliver training and guidance to users and support teams to improve adoption and continuity.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building across the delivery team.

How You Will Do It

  • Take ownership with accountability and integrity by staying close to the work, clarifying scope early, and following through on commitments.
  • Focus on what matters by removing blockers quickly, keeping solutions practical, and making decisions that improve field service outcomes.
  • Work as one team with architects, developers, analysts, QA, and support partners so delivery stays aligned from design to production support.
  • Improve every day through candid feedback, root-cause problem-solving, and continuous refinement of the solution, documentation, and handover process.
  • Protect safety, quality, and trust in the way you design, test, document, and release changes for users and support teams.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in ServiceMax, Salesforce, or field service solution delivery.
  • Strong experience in the field service domain.
  • Proven experience implementing or supporting ServiceMax or Salesforce-based solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce platform architecture and development concepts.
  • Ability to create and support solutions using ServiceMax tools and configuration options.
  • Experience with testing, UAT support, issue resolution, and operational handover.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Service Flow Manager, Process Builder, and Visual Workflow.
  • Proven exposure to ServiceMax GO or mobile field service applications.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum delivery methods.
  • Experience with Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of Oracle or SQL Server.
  • Experience in manufacturing, utilities, or medical devices environments.

job.title: Senior Controls Automation Engineer
job.description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls & Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems.

This is a hands-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal & Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.
  • Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms.
  • Execute and support Pre-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
  • Implement and verify Cause & Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences.
  • Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues.
  • Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution.
  • Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones.

Essential Requirements

  • Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering.
  • Minimum 5 years' hands-on PLC programming experience.
  • Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory).
  • HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent.
  • Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
  • Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP.
  • Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause & Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives.

Desirable Experience

  • Oil & Gas, Marine or Offshore projects.
  • Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety-related control systems.
  • Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511).
  • OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443).
  • Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.

What We're Looking For

A practical, hands-on Controls Engineer who can quickly understand control systems, solve automation problems, support project delivery, and work effectively with suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Travel within the UK, Turkey and Vietnam will be required for FAT, commissioning and project support activities.

job.title: Tech Lead - Data Science
job.description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Tech Lead - Data Scientist to play a key role in building our Agentic AI Platform — a system of autonomous, tool-using AI agents that plan, reason, and execute complex business workflows end-to-end. The ideal candidate combines strong ML fundamentals with hands-on experience in LLM-based application development, agent orchestration frameworks, and Microsoft Azure cloud services. You will architect and ship production-grade agentic solutions, mentor junior team members, and set technical direction for GenAI initiatives across the organization.

Experience Range= 8 to 12 yrs

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and productionize multi-agent systems — including planning, tool calling / function calling, memory, and orchestration — using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Develop RAG pipelines end-to-end: document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search (Azure AI Search / FAISS / pgvector), re-ranking, and grounding for agent knowledge.
  • Integrate agents with enterprise systems and APIs via tool/function calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar connector patterns.
  • Build and maintain LLM evaluation frameworks for agentic workflows — task-completion metrics, hallucination detection, trajectory analysis, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and A/B testing.
  • Implement guardrails, safety, and governance for agents: prompt-injection defense, content filtering, role-based tool permissions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and audit logging.
  • Fine-tune and optimize LLMs where needed (LoRA/PEFT, prompt optimization, model routing, latency/cost trade-offs) on Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry.
  • Design, build, and evaluate classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, NLP) where they complement agentic workflows.
  • Own LLMOps/MLOps for the platform: experiment tracking, prompt versioning, CI/CD, observability and tracing (LangSmith, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry), drift monitoring, and retraining strategies.
  • Collaborate with data engineers on data quality, availability, and governance across Azure Data Lake, Databricks, and Synapse Analytics.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into agentic AI solutions; present architecture decisions and results to senior stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior data scientists, lead code/design reviews, and champion engineering best practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 8-10 years of professional experience in data science / ML, with at least 3 years building LLM or GenAI applications in production.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent (at least one in production).
  • Strong understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, agent memory, and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Expert-level Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, async programming, API development with FastAPI).
  • Hands-on experience with Azure services: Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, Azure ML, Azure AI Search, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or Synapse.
  • Experience with vector databases and embeddings (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS, or pgvector).
  • Solid grounding in classical ML: supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and hyperparameter tuning; experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale data.
  • Proven MLOps/LLMOps experience: MLflow, prompt/model versioning, CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), and production monitoring.
  • Ability to evaluate and mitigate LLM-specific risks: hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, and cost/latency constraints.

Good to Have

  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenAI Assistants/Agents SDK, or Anthropic tool-use APIs.
  • Microsoft certifications: AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer), DP-100 (Azure Data Scientist Associate).
  • Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Phi) using LoRA/QLoRA and serving via vLLM or Azure ML endpoints.
  • Familiarity with observability/tracing for agents: LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Knowledge of containerization and deployment: Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Container Apps.
  • Big data experience with Apache Spark (PySpark) via Azure Databricks.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs, graph RAG, or semantic layers for agent grounding.
  • Contributions to open-source GenAI/agentic projects or published technical content.

Technical Stack

Category

Tools & Technologies

Languages

Python, SQL

Agentic & GenAI

LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, MCP, Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic Claude

RAG & Vector Search

Azure AI Search, FAISS, Qdrant, pgvector, Hugging Face embeddings

ML/AI Frameworks

scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers

Cloud Platform

Microsoft Azure (AI Foundry, Azure ML, Databricks, Data Factory, Synapse)

LLMOps / MLOps

MLflow, LangSmith/Langfuse, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, AKS

APIs & Serving

FastAPI, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps

job.title: Oracle Fusion Americas - IT Project Manager
job.description:
Oracle Fusion Americas - IT Project Manager

Johnson Controls creates smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, and the teams behind our digital platforms help enable that mission across regions and business functions. In this role, you will support Oracle Fusion Americas initiatives that strengthen delivery, governance, and operational stability for the business.

You will work closely with global stakeholders, delivery teams, and service partners to keep programs moving with clarity, accountability, and a strong focus on business outcomes.

Role Overview

We are looking for an IT Project Manager with 7+ years of experience to lead Oracle Fusion Americas projects and support activities. This role is suited to someone who can coordinate cross-functional delivery, manage priorities across multiple teams, and help ensure Oracle Fusion initiatives are executed effectively from planning through stabilization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, execution, and coordination of Oracle Fusion Americas IT projects, enhancements, and support initiatives.
  • Manage project scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, and action items across business and technical teams.
  • Coordinate with business process owners, solution architects, functional consultants, technical teams, and vendor partners.
  • Support governance routines, status reporting, and stakeholder communication for ongoing delivery efforts.
  • Track production support needs, deployment activities, and incident resolution progress for assigned workstreams.
  • Drive backlog prioritization and follow-up on approved enhancement and support requests.
  • Support planning across onshore and offshore delivery teams to meet committed timelines.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen operational stability.

How You Will Do It

  • You will keep delivery plans clear, current, and visible to stakeholders, so priorities and timelines stay aligned.
  • You will work closely with distributed teams and service partners, removing blockers early and escalating issues with good judgment.
  • You will use disciplined governance, regular check-ins, and concise reporting to keep programs moving predictably.
  • You will approach problems with a continuous-improvement mindset, looking for practical ways to improve process, quality, and response time.
  • You will balance urgency with accountability, making sure commitments are tracked through completion and handoff is smooth.
  • You will communicate clearly with both technical and business audiences, translating complexity into actionable next steps.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in IT project management, program coordination, or delivery leadership.
  • Experience supporting Oracle Fusion ERP initiatives, enhancements, implementations, or production support.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders across business and technology teams.
  • Strong skills in project planning, prioritization, reporting, risk management, and issue resolution.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.
