job.title: JSM Machine Shop Maintenance- Controls
job.description:
Job Summary

The Controls & Electrical Maintenance Engineer is responsible for troubleshooting, maintaining, repairing, and continuously improving electrical, control, CNC, PLC, automation, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing operations. This role supports equipment uptime, preventive and predictive maintenance programs, root cause analysis, machine reliability initiatives, and operational excellence. The incumbent works independently on complex issues while also coaching and supporting less experienced team members, ensuring compliance with Cummins safety, quality, and maintenance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Champion a strong safety culture by adhering to all Cummins HSE policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Immediately stop work and report unsafe conditions, incidents, injuries, or hazards.
  • Follow machine safety standards, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures, and electrical safety requirements.
  • Utilize appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and promote safe work practices.
  • Identify and mitigate hazards associated with electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and automated systems.
  • Participate in HSE training and contribute to an injury-free workplace culture.

Equipment Maintenance & Reliability

  • Troubleshoot and repair electrical, PLC, CNC, automation, hydraulic, and pneumatic system failures.
  • Perform preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities to maximize equipment availability and reliability.
  • Support CNC machines, Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), robotic cells, conveyors, nut runners, and automated production equipment.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to PLCs, HMIs, CNC controls, servo systems, spindle drives, sensors, motion control systems, and industrial communication networks.
  • Conduct panel-level troubleshooting, electrical modifications, system commissioning, and component replacements.
  • Analyze recurring equipment failures and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support TPM, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, MTTR reduction, and MTBF improvement initiatives.

Controls & Automation

  • Support, modify, and optimize PLC programs, HMI applications, and machine control systems.
  • Implement automation improvements that enhance productivity, quality, safety, and process efficiency.
  • Support MES, OEE monitoring systems, and Industry 4.0 initiatives where applicable.
  • Assist with machine upgrades, automation projects, and integration of new technologies into manufacturing systems.
  • Develop and implement machine programming solutions to improve machine utilization and overall performance.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Execute maintenance activities in accordance with electrical drawings, technical documentation, operating manuals, and specifications.
  • Apply high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship during all maintenance activities.
  • Support equipment downtime analysis and root cause investigations.
  • Perform quality inspections and ensure adherence to established quality standards.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction, energy efficiency, process optimization, and waste elimination.
  • Provide feedback into preventive maintenance systems and support continuous improvement projects.

Planning & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, preventive maintenance documentation, breakdown reports, and spare parts usage in CMMS systems such as MAXIMO.
  • Support spare parts planning and inventory management activities.
  • Coordinate with OEMs, contractors, and vendors for specialized maintenance support and equipment upgrades.
  • Schedule maintenance activities to minimize impact on production requirements.

Teamwork & Collaboration

  • Work closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, and Operational teams to resolve equipment issues.
  • Act as a technical resource and provide guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing to team members.
  • Participate actively in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) and continuous improvement teams.
  • Complete required training and actively engage in personal and professional development activities.
  • Communicate effectively across functions to support business objectives and operational excellence.

Qualifications

Education

  • Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Industrial Automation, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline.
  • High School Diploma/Secondary Education certificate may be considered where supplemented by significant relevant experience and applicable technical qualifications.
  • Certifications in PLC Programming, Industrial Automation, CNC Systems, Robotics, Electrical Maintenance, or related areas are preferred.

Additional Requirements

  • May require licensing or authorization for compliance with export control or sanctions regulations, where applicable.

Skills

Technical Skills

  • Electrical Maintenance & Troubleshooting
  • PLC Programming & Industrial Automation
  • CNC Controls & Diagnostics
  • HMI & SCADA Systems
  • Factory Automation & Control Systems
  • Machine Programming
  • Servo Drives, Spindle Drives & Motion Control Systems
  • Electrical Drawings, Schematics & Control Panels
  • Industrial Communication Networks (Profinet, Profibus, Ethernet/IP)
  • Hydraulic & Pneumatic Systems
  • Robotics & Automated Material Handling Systems
  • MES, OEE Monitoring & Industry 4.0 Technologies
  • CMMS/MAXIMO Applications
  • Predictive Maintenance & Condition Monitoring
  • Root Cause Analysis & Reliability Engineering
  • TPM (Total Productive Maintenance)

Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Drives Results
  • Nimble Learning
  • Values Differences
  • Health & Safety Fundamentals
  • Controls Safety
  • Electrical System Troubleshooting
  • Manufacturing Knowledge
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset
  • Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking
  • Coaching and Knowledge Sharing

Experience

  • Minimum 6-8 years of relevant experience in Electrical Maintenance, Controls Engineering, CNC Maintenance, Industrial Automation, Manufacturing Maintenance, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience supporting CNC machining centers, assembly equipment, automated production systems, and manufacturing automation technologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting expertise in PLCs, HMIs, CNC controls, servo systems, drives, sensors, robotics, and industrial communication networks.
  • Experience working with automation platforms such as Fanuc, Siemens, Mitsubishi, Allen-Bradley, Omron, Bosch Rexroth, or equivalent systems.
  • Proven experience in preventive maintenance, predictive maintenance, root cause analysis, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement programs.
  • Experience in high-volume manufacturing, machining, assembly, or industrial production environments is preferred.

This dual customer/product focused position serves as the senior technical liaison between OEMs, Customers, sales and represents our customers during new product development programs. Integrating high quality and optimized customer solutions requires the interaction with sales and marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

Application Engineering in alternator. Obtains input and negotiates with Subject Matter Experts and Value Package Introduction (VPI) Teams and delivers product data and installation requirements to Application Engineers and OEMs Makes decisions in the areas of product selection, design, and integration that impact OEM machine performance, optimization and quality Applies and improves processes such as Installation Quality Assurance, OEM integration and product selection and tools such as Advisor, Cummins OnLine Specifications (COLS) and Global Customer Engineering (GCE) required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Develops strong working relationships with customer technical counterparts to serve as their primary liaison to deliver specialized product technical information, manage product specifications, communicate product change information, conduct complex installation issue resolutions and facilitate customer requests Applies technical expertise in the areas of product, application and market knowledge to support OEM product selection and equipment design Leads the translation of customer needs and "voice of the customer" into functional product requirements to provide input on program-related decisions Serves as customer/market advocate inside Cummins during participation in new product development programs, design reviews and product change request processes Ensures products are applied and installed correctly to meet customer system requirements and environments Assures installation quality by validating prototype machine performance and ensuring installations meet Cummins requirements Utilizes Analysis Led Design (ALD) and Six Sigma tools to optimize product and system performance Proposes innovative customer-focused initiatives and projects Assists with the transfer of knowledge through coaching and mentoring less experienced engineers Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Machine Integration and Optimization - Combines various parts or sub-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Product Selection - Guides customers to the best product offerings for their markets and applications; offers best-fit solutions to customers by optimizing product specifications to make Cummins' offerings easy to install into new applications; represents features and benefits of products in terms that customers understand; ensures Cummins' products aren't misapplied through using Cummins' technical information systems, local and application requirements.

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Company Overview

Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, committed to providing innovative solutions that ensure Life Is On everywhere, for everyone, and at every moment. Ecostruxure Building Activate is responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering high-quality software and solutions to monitor and control \[energy/HVAC/lighting/building systems\] for small and medium buildings. We are expanding our team in Gurugram and looking for a senior Product Manager to drive product strategy and lead its execution.

Job Description

As a senior Product Manager, you will lead the definition and prioritization of product strategy to ensure alignment with strategic business goals and customer needs. You will translate market insights, customer feedback, and technical feasibility into a cohesive product roadmap, and guide cross-functional and Agile teams in executing against it. This role focused on strategic ownership of the product — driving go-to-market direction, stakeholder alignment, and value creation — while also contributing to the growth of a small team supporting the product line. You will work on complex matters requiring in-depth product management expertise and broad industry understanding, exercising independent judgment to navigate ambiguous, high-impact situations.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Market Ownership:

  • Own and drive the successful commercialization of products, managing the full lifecycle from concept through market launch and ongoing optimization.
  • Define and evolve the value proposition for the product line, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and evolving market trends.
  • Develop and implement robust feature strategies based on usage analysis and customer feedback.
  • Own strategic planning and strategic thinking for the product roadmap, balancing short-term delivery with long-term product vision.
  • Integrate stakeholder feedback, market trends, and technical feasibility into cohesive development plans.

Agile Execution & Delivery:

  • Lead prioritization and refinement of product backlogs to ensure alignment with strategic goals and customer needs.
  • Serve as Product Owner within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) where applicable — performing backlog grooming and driving Product Increment (PI) planning.
  • Guide Agile teams by translating strategic insights into actionable, well-defined features and user stories.
  • Based on product demonstrations, accept features into the system baseline.
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering to clarify requirements and support delivery through clear sprint and PI objectives.

Stakeholder & Value Management:

  • Collaborate with architects and key stakeholders to clarify and deliver project requirements.
  • Foster alignment across teams to ensure product outcomes deliver measurable business value.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across the organization, representing the product in various meetings and forums.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams (Offer management, engineering, design, QA) to ensure alignment and smooth execution.
  • Explain and present product strategy and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Continuously evaluate and improve product and team processes.
  • Stay up to date on the latest industry, market, and technology trends.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor, and coach a small team of \[product owners/analysts\], fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 12+ years in product management, product ownership, or related roles, with significant experience in \[cloud/IoT/BMS or relevant domain\].
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proven experience in stakeholder management, strategic planning, strategic thinking, and value proposition creation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor a small team, in addition to strong individual ownership of product strategy.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain and present concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and independent judgment skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguous, complex situations.

Tools & Project Management:

  • Hands-on experience with Atlassian Jira & Confluence Cloud, GitHub Enterprise, and Azure DevOps.
  • Experienced professional working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Scaled Agile (SAFe) mode.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in computer science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Experience as a Product Manager for a SaaS platform is a strong added advantage.
  • Experience with automation systems or industrial/energy sector products is advantageous.
  • Certifications in Product Management or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (PO/PM).

Rewards designed for you

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our [Career Page](https://www.se.com/careers).

\\* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. job.title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst is accountable for defining, designing and implementing end to end use-cases on our global, cross functional data repository and reporting platform. This role ensures that the platform’s data, analytics, and integration architecture is leveraged to drive data into insights that drive business value using analytics, data visualization, and AI.

The role acts as a solution architect and a technical authority for translating business and data requirements into robust architectural designs and ensuring architectural integrity across all releases. The role implements data ingestion pipelines, complex semantic models and delivers value driven visualizations and data outputs

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

> Define and own the solution architecture for the semantic parts and use cases on the reporting platform, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic models, analytics, and consumption layers. > Design scalable and secure data architecture patterns aligned with the Global Data Platform and enterprise architecture standards. > Translate business and functional requirements into end-to-end technical designs, ensuring feasibility, performance, and maintainability. > Lead architectural decision-making for new capabilities, enhancements, and integrations, including trade-off analysis across cost, performance, and complexity. > Assess technical feasibility and lead proofs of concept (PoCs) for new requirements, technologies, and architectural patterns. > Collaborate closely with IT’s Data Foundation team to guide ETL implementation, ensuring adherence to agreed architectural designs. > Build semantic layers on top of DB/Datalake/Warhousing layers - Define and maintain architecture documentation, including logical, physical, and data flow diagrams. > Ensure robust data governance, security, and access control are embedded in the solution design. > Support user onboarding and adoption from a technical enablement perspective, ensuring solutions are intuitive, performant, and fit for purpose. > Provide architectural oversight for support, incidents, and enhancements, ensuring root causes are addressed structurally rather than tactically.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

> Advanced analytical mindset with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems, identify relevant data sources, and translate findings into clear, decision-ready insights. > Ability to translate complex business and functional requirements into clear, actionable technical designs across ingestion, transformation, semantic modelling, reporting, and consumption layers. > Strong understanding of business intelligence, data architecture, semantic modelling, data visualisation, and analytics delivery in enterprise environments. > Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality, data protection, privacy, security, and access control principles, with the judgement to embed them pragmatically into solution design. > Proficient in advanced analytics and reporting tools, including Excel, Power BI, SQL-based analysis, semantic models, DAX, and modern cloud data platform capabilities. > Strong ability to identify trends, anomalies, root causes, business opportunities, and risks from complex internal and external datasets. > Excellent communication, listening, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders and influence decisions across multiple teams. > Strong collaboration skills and ability to build trusted working relationships with business stakeholders, IT delivery teams, data governance, security, and platform teams. > High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and disciplined approach to documentation, requirements quality, testing, validation, and continuous improvement. > Self-directed, highly organised, outcome-oriented, and able to independently coordinate multiple assignments while maintaining delivery quality in a global, cross-functional environment.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree or postgraduate qualification in data, analytics, technology, or business is advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Relevant professional certifications are advantageous, for example Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Engineer, Azure Data Fundamentals, Databricks, SQL, data governance, data privacy, or agile delivery certifications.
  • Equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and demonstrable enterprise analytics experience may be considered.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

> Advanced demonstrated experience working in a business intelligence, analytics, data product, or solution architecture capacity within a complex enterprise environment. > Proven experience translating business needs into end-to-end analytics solutions, including requirements definition, data sourcing, modelling, dashboard design, testing, deployment, and adoption support. > Advanced experience working with data collection, ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and reporting tools across internal and external data sources.

> Strong hands-on experience with Power BI architecture, including report development, semantic models, DAX, performance optimisation, row-level security, deployment pipelines, and governed shared datasets.

> Experience with modern data platforms and cloud-based analytics capabilities, such as Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, SQL databases, data lakes, APIs, or comparable technologies.

> Experience producing Excel-based and BI-based reporting, analytics outputs, briefing notes, dashboards, metrics layers, and executive-ready insights used to inform business decisions.

> Demonstrated experience identifying trends, patterns, anomalies, business drivers, risks, and improvement opportunities from large or complex datasets. > Experience collaborating with business stakeholders, IT delivery teams, enterprise architecture, data governance, security, and privacy stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable analytics solutions. > Experience documenting requirements, specifications, data flows, business rules, metrics definitions, technical designs, testing outcomes, and operational support procedures. > Experience providing support, resolving business and data issues, recommending process improvements, and improving the accuracy, relevance, usability, and actionability of analytics outputs.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

Who we are

job.title: Infrastructure Deployment Engineer, OID, IT Services
job.description:

job.title: Broker Operations Manager II, AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL)
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS APAC Brokerage Ops Team seeks a motivated Brokerage Operations Manager to drive and optimize our customs operations across the region. In this role, you will lead process improvements, standardize operational procedures, and execute strategic initiatives while maintaining tactical excellence in day-to-day operations. You will operate autonomously in managing customs brokerage operations, developing performance metrics, and establishing best practices.

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in logistics and transportation operations, with demonstrated ability to learn complex regulatory environments and troubleshoot operational challenges independently. Success in this role requires project management skills to lead operational initiatives, drive process automation, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. This position offers opportunities to influence regional strategy and drive operational excellence within AWS logistics operations.

Key job responsibilities

VENDOR MANAGEMENT

  • Manage customs broker relationships and drive performance improvement initiatives across the region
  • Own broker performance metrics and reporting, providing data-driven insights for business decisions
  • Coordinate and standardize customs clearance processes across AWS sites/programs
  • Resolve complex broker issues and implement preventive measures

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

  • Analyze operational data to identify and execute process improvements
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration to optimize import/export operations
  • Lead automation projects and implement solutions for recurring customs clearance challenges
  • Develop and track operational metrics to enhance efficiency and reduce clearance delays

A day in the life In this role, you will manage customs brokerage operations across APAC, working with key stakeholders including Transportation teams, Finance, AWS service teams, and Trade Compliance partners. Your activities include:

  • Drive operational performance through daily management of customs brokers, resolving complex clearance issues
  • Monitor and analyze clearance metrics, implementing solutions to reduce delays and documentation gaps
  • Partner with internal teams to optimize documentation flow and ensure broker compliance with trade requirements
  • Lead broker performance reviews and develop action plans to address service gaps
  • Own performance reporting and analytics for regional leadership
  • Lead process automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency

About the team This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing, high-impact team. AWS Cloud Logistics manages a continuously evolving portfolio of shipments and warehousing operations through a worldwide supply chain. We deliver the right product at the right time, cost, and place — ensuring our AWS supply chain is reliable, scalable, and cost-optimized. The data governance function is critical to how we operate: every planning decision, every operational escalation, and every system automation depends on accurate, timely data flowing through our ecosystem.

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in customs brokerage operations and international logistics
  • Demonstrated expertise in customs regulations, documentation, and compliance procedures
  • Experience managing cross-border shipments and resolving customs clearance issues

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in data center, cloud computing, or technology industry operations is preferred
  • Strong communication skills with ability to present information clearly to various stakeholders, including leadership
  • Familiarity with customs management systems and/or trade documentation platforms
  • Experience working in fast-paced, tech-driven environments

job.title: Protection & Automation Engineer
job.description:
Hey Innovator!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future.

Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an extraordinary addition to our vibrant team.

Siemens Technology and Services Private Limited (STSPL) is the Indian subsidiary of German multinational engineering and electronics conglomerate Siemens that focuses on IT and management services. The subsidiary is split into four units: Corporate Technology India, Siemens Corporate Finance and Controlling, Global Shared Services, and Siemens Management Consulting. Located in Balewadi High Street in Pune, it has over 5000 employees.

We are looking for a Protection & Automation Engineer meeting the need for smart-mobility solutions.

We are making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions.

Your new role – Challenging and future oriented

This role focuses on delivering Protection, Automation & Control engineering for Railway & Metro traction substations, OHE/PS systems, and depot power systems. The engineer must have strong command over Siemens SIPROTEC relays, Siemens PLCs, A8000 RTUs, and communication protocols commonly used in rail applications.

  • Protection Engineering for Railway Systems
  • Prepare protection philosophy & settings for 25 kV AC traction substations.Configure and test SIPROTEC 4/5 series relays for Distance protection, Transformer protection, Distance protection, Busbar protection

Implement CFC logic for advanced interlocking used in railway traction power.Implement cyber security hardening measures2. Railway Control & Automation

  • Program Siemens PLC (S7 1500/ ET200SP) for local/remote control in Traction Substation, Sectioning Post, paralleling Posts, SP, SSP.
  • Implement interlocking logic for breakers, isolators, ATs & protection coordination.
  • Integrate PLC/RTU with SCADA systems used in railways.
  • Siemens RTU (A8000) Engineering
  • Engineer and configure A8000 RTUs for railway substations.
  • Develop IEC 60870 5 104/101 communication with Operation Control Center (OCC)
  • Create & integrate IEC 61850 SCD/ICD files for traction power automation.
  • Documentation & Project Delivery
  • Prepare railway specific engineering documents: Traction Substation, Sectioning Post, Paralleling Posts, Sub-Sectioning and Paralleling Post protection concept Drawings
  • Control & interlocking philosophy
  • Network Diagrams

Support Factory Integration Tests (FIT)/Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and support for commissioning.Ensure compliance with IEC, EN, IEEE & local standards.Support Project manager / Technical manager with Project planning We don’t need superheroes, just super minds

  • Siemens DIGSI 4 & 5
  • TIA Portal for Siemens PLC
  • Siemens A8000 engineering tools
  • IEC 61850, IEC 104, Modbus, DNP3, Profinet
  • Visio for drawings
  • Bonus points for fundamental project management knowledge
  • Willingness to travel (e.g., for site visits, FAT/FIT support, commissioning)
  • Proactive and detail-oriented mindset
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken). Additional language skills [e.g., German] are a plus.

Qualifications

  • B.E/B. Tech in Electrical or Power System Engineering
  • 8-12 years of working experience with railway traction projects, metro projects, or utility substations
  • Familiarity with ISO / IEC standards (added advantage)
  • Experience with Railway Traction power supply concepts (added advantage)

We’ve got quite a lot to offer. How about you?

This role is based in Pune. You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

Find out more about Mobility at: [https://new.siemens.com/in/en/products/mobility.html](https://new.siemens.com/in/en/products/mobility.html) and about Siemens careers at: [www.siemens.com/careers](http://www.siemens.com/careers)

job.title: Lead – Quality
job.description:
Lead - Quality

Location: Navi Mumbai (Project Site) Reporting To: Project Director/ Quality Team Lead Business Title: Manager

We are seeking a Lead – Quality to lead and manage quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) activities for large‑scale electrical Low Side works in hyperscaler data center projects. The scope primarily includes MV and LV systems such as RMUs, Transformers, LV switchboards, UPS systems, batteries, busducts, cabling, earthing, and ELV systems.

This role is suited for a mid-level to lead EPC professional with strong experience in project quality management, inspections, documentation, and client/PMC interface. The Lead – Quality will ensure that construction, testing, and commissioning activities are executed in full compliance with approved quality plans, project specifications, applicable standards, and hyperscaler requirements.

The Lead – Quality will be responsible for achieving project quality objectives related to installation compliance, inspection readiness, defect prevention, documentation completeness, and handover quality, while ensuring alignment with defined project quality processes and EHS requirements.

Key Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Develop, implement, and monitor the Project Quality Plan (PQP) in line with contract requirements and client hyperscaler standards.
  • Lead QA/QC activities for electrical Low Side works including installation, testing, and commissioning phases.
  • Review and approve ITPs, method statements, checklists, inspection formats, and quality procedures.
  • Coordinate with construction, commissioning (Cx), engineering, and safety teams to ensure quality requirements are embedded in execution.
  • Ensure L1–L3 installation quality readiness prior to commissioning and support quality compliance during L4 IST and L5 reliability runs.
  • Act as the primary interface with client, PMC, and third-party inspectors for inspections, audits, and quality reviews.
  • Monitor site inspections, NCRs, observations, punch items, and corrective/preventive actions to closure.
  • Ensure quality compliance of vendor and subcontractor works through audits, inspections, and surveillance.
  • Support inspection and acceptance of electrical equipment, materials, and Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) where applicable.
  • Review and consolidate quality dossiers, inspection records, test certificates, and handover documentation.
  • Conduct internal quality audits and ensure closeout of audit findings and lessons learned.**

Ideal Candidate Profile:**

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering

Experience & Competencies

  • 12–15 years of experience in EPC projects with strong exposure to quality management and QA/QC execution.
  • Proven experience as Quality Engineer / Quality Manager / Lead – Quality in data center or mission‑critical projects.
  • Strong understanding of electrical Low Side systems including LV panels, UPS, batteries, busducts, cabling, earthing, and auxiliary systems.
  • Experience supporting quality compliance across construction, testing, commissioning, and handover phases.
  • Familiarity with hyperscaler quality standards, structured inspection processes, and documentation requirements.
  • Strong capability to interface with clients, PMCs, vendors, and cross‑functional project teams.
  • Good understanding of EHS integration with quality processes on active construction and energized sites.
  • Strong leadership, coordination, communication, and documentation skills.

job.title: Sr Project Lead
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Engineering Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities :

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as the technical lead for all engineering activities in assignments. Each day, you will ensure the activities related to all engineering disciplines within the project are executed in an efficient and cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by acting as a design authority for a particular engineering discipline and completing the corresponding engineering assignments.

The work model for the role is: #LI Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Automation Business of Process Industries in Bangalore .

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Knowledge of DCS/ PLC HW/SW Components .
  • Knowledge of IT/ Network/ Peripherals like UPS, Printer, PC’s, Server components of DCS .
  • knowledge in application programming & HMI development/ modifications for PLC/ DCS systems .
  • Knowledge on different communication protocols used between PLC & Drives or in automation.
  • Knowledge of below ABB systems is added advantage o ABB automation systems like 800xA, Advant, Compact HMI etc. ABB ACS880 multi drive, standalone drives o ABB ACS800 multi drive, standalone drives o ABB DCS800 LVDC drives

Qualifications for the role :

  • 8-10 years of relevant work experience in automation systems, application programming & leading of projects end-to-end.
  • Customer focused  Self-motivated and a self-starter .
  • Good listening and communication skills (both internally and with customers).
  • A fast learner with an interest to share knowledge and train peers/ customers .
  • Fluency in English, written and oral, is a must.

More about US :

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager – Data Centres
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Location: Sydney or Melbourne

Shape the Future of Digital Infrastructure

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Manager – Data Centres to lead growth across hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise customers in the Pacific.

This is not a traditional sales role. It’s a front-line strategic leadership position at the intersection of infrastructure, technology, and sustainability—where you will influence how next-generation data centres are designed, built, and operated.

job.title: EHS Officer (part time - 3 days per week)
job.description:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

About You

At Johnson Controls, diversity and inclusion are fundamental to who we are. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, strengthen collaboration, and create better outcomes for our customers and communities.

We are committed to creating an environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work. Together, we foster a culture where everyone has the opportunity to grow, contribute, and succeed.

job.title: Lead Application Engineer I
job.description:
Lead Application Engineer I – Fire Protection & Suppression Systems’ Presales Engineering

**

About India Sales Support CoE

India Sales Support CoE organization entails of 792+ engineers supporting Johnson's Controls branches across the world for 20+ years. We are a global organization with field experiences across the different markets right from Asia to North America, Europe to Latin America, and the Middle East. The collected diverse experience in one single organization enables us to be an effective partner for our JCI branches. This engineering organization offers controls, Security & Fire and Energy solution.

About Fire & Security Business

10+ years of wide JCI/Tyco and third-party system knowledge for design, detailed engineering and implementation of Fire Protection and Suppression system. Team provides the services and value-added solutions for the system and provides onsite & remote engineering support across the globe for engineering.

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end-to-end presales engineering activities of Fire protection & Suppression opportunities from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno-Commercial activities of the projects covering various such as Fire Sprinkler, Hydrant, water spray, foam and gas suppression Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D&E and OPS approval for booking.

How you will do it:

  • Review the project inputs and project intake form shared by the Front desk/Sales.
  • Analyze the requirement and initiate the Kick-off call with Front Desk after getting CoE SFDC Code and time frame.
  • Prepare designs on given floor plans to arrive with the BOQ; in case BOQ is unavailable.
  • Identify potential issues/risks and proactively bring them to the customer's knowledge and help to mitigate the identified risks.
  • Initiate the discussion with OEMs & subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.
  • Analyze the proposal and commercials received from the OEM and verify the same based on the past data and benchmark costing available in the SCM Database.
  • Upon completion of cost comparison, prepare the optimized techno-commercial Costing sheet, Proposal, and Compliance Statements.
  • Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
  • Perform 2nd level QC of the deliverables done by other Application Engineers in the team
  • Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet & assigned training on time.
  • Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
  • Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.
  • Actively derive the strategy for increasing the win rate.
  • Align with Organization KPIs such as Quality, Cycle Time, OTD, Win rate, Productivity, etc.

What we look for

  • BE (Mechanical / Electrical)
  • Must have 10+ years of relevant experience in Fire Protection & Suppression Systems domains.
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Protection & Suppression Systems (Fire Sprinkler, Pre-action system, Water spray, standpipe & hose system, Hydrant network, Fire water storage, Stationary pumps, Foam suppression, water mist system, Kitchen hood system, Gas Suppression – FM, Novec, Inergen & Co2 etc.).
  • Knowledge in Building Management System will be added advantage for the role.
  • Must have presales and estimation experience on various verticals (Transportation, Commercial, Fit-outs, Industries, Data Centers, etc.).
  • Capable of performing hydraulic and flow calculation and doing product selections along with the deviation/compliance statements.
  • Must be able to work on complex costing sheets covering Material, Engineering, Operations, and Subcon costs.
  • Skill in articulating offered solutions in a structured way through high-standard technical proposal documents.
  • Must build a strong network with the 3rd party vendors regionally specific.
  • Must be a quick learner & keen on problem-solving techniques.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Must be a good team player.

Preferred

  • Experienced in designing Fire Protection & Suppression systems (fire hydrant, sprinkler, HVWS, MVWS, Foam, Water Mist, Gas Suppression) per NFPA, BSEN, Vds, TAC, and NBC norms.
  • Proficient in hydraulic and flow calculations using SprinkCAD, Fire-CAD, ANSUL, and HYGOOD.
  • Preparing the bill of quantity (BOQ) & material track sheet as per approved / shop drawings and material technical data sheet.
  • Coordination with consultants / clients for contractual clarifications and to get the approval of design.
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD, Sprink CAD, Fire CAD, Navis and Excel.

job.title: AI Application Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: AI Application Engineer

Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking AI Application Modernization Engineer to join our Digital Transformation team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer with deep expertise in legacy application modernization, AI-assisted software development, and Microsoft cloud technologies.

As AI Application Modernization Engineer, you will lead the transformation of mission-critical business applications built on VB6 front-end technologies and IBM i (AS400) platforms, including Synon, RPG, RPGLE, and CLP. You will leverage AI and Generative AI technologies to accelerate code conversion, application modernization, testing, documentation, and deployment to modern Microsoft platforms.

You will play a critical role in reducing technical debt, improving application maintainability, and accelerating JCI's digital transformation strategy through scalable, cloud-ready solutions.

How you will do it

AI-Powered Application Modernization

  • Hands on application development to modernization of legacy applications built using VB6, Synon, RPG, RPGLE, CLP, and IBM i (AS400) technologies.
  • Utilize Generative AI, GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code analysis, conversion, testing, and documentation.
  • Design and execute migration strategies from legacy platforms to modern Microsoft technologies.
  • Develop reusable modernization frameworks, patterns, and best practices for enterprise-scale application transformation.

Microsoft Development & Cloud Engineering

  • Design and develop modern business applications using Microsoft technologies including C#, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, and .NET MAUI.
  • Modernize desktop applications into cloud-enabled and cross-platform solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
  • Design API-first architectures and service-based integrations using Azure services.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure and scalable solutions.

AI Strategy & Engineering Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and Generative AI to improve software engineering productivity and modernization outcomes.
  • Lead proof-of-concepts and pilots demonstrating AI-driven modernization capabilities.
  • Establish engineering standards, governance, and best practices for AI-assisted application development.
  • Mentor development teams on modernization approaches, AI tools, and Microsoft development platforms.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of software development experience.
  • 5+ years of experience with VB6 application development and maintenance.
  • Proven experience modernizing legacy applications to Microsoft technologies.
  • Experience delivering large-scale application modernization or migration programs.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools and Generative AI technologies.
  • Experience working with enterprise business-critical applications and complex integrations.

Technical Expertise

Front-End Technologies - Visual Basic 6 (VB6), C#, .NET Framework, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, WinUI, WPF, XAML, HTML5, JavaScript

Back-End Technologies

Synon (CA 2E), RPG, RPGLE, CLP, IBM i / AS400, DB2, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, API Development

AI & Modernization Technologies

Azure OpenAI, GitHub Copilot Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, AI-assisted code conversion tools, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Cloud & DevOps

Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Power Platform, CI/CD Pipelines

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience converting VB6 applications to .NET MAUI, WinUI, or modern Microsoft technologies.
  • Experience modernizing Synon, RPG, RPGLE, or AS400 applications.
  • Experience with Azure-based application modernization programs.
  • Knowledge of enterprise architecture, application rationalization, and technical debt reduction strategies.
  • Experience within manufacturing, industrial, or enterprise ERP environments.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications preferred.

Ideal Candidate: An engineer who has successfully delivered VB6 and AS400 modernization programs and has leveraged AI technologies to accelerate application conversion to modern Microsoft platforms such as .NET, MAUI, Azure, and Power Platform.

The incumbent will be responsible for managing the execution of multiple HVAC and chiller projects simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery in line with customer requirements, contractual commitments, and company objectives. The role will focus on project planning, coordination, schedule management, commercial follow-up, and driving projects through defined toll gates from HOTO to closure.

The incumbent will work closely with customers, vendors, site teams, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Coordination

  • Manage HVAC/chiller old, ongoing and new projects at different stages of execution.
  • Ensure projects are executed as per approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
  • Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, factories, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Track project milestones and drive closure of pending activities.

Schedule Management

  • Prepare and maintain project schedules in coordination with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Obtain customer approval for schedule baselines during HOTO.
  • Monitor progress against planned schedules and initiate corrective actions for delays.
  • Drive timely completion of project milestones and support toll gate movement.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Monitor project costs, committed costs, and revenue realization.
  • Support achievement of forecasted revenue for assigned projects.
  • Ensure timely preparation and submission of invoices as per contractual milestones.
  • Follow up with customers for payment collections and resolution of commercial issues.
  • Maintain Unbilled Revenue (UBR) within prescribed limits.

Risk & Issue Management

  • Identify project risks and implementation challenges at an early stage.
  • Maintain project risk and issue logs.
  • Escalate critical risks, delays, and customer concerns to the Senior Project Manager in a timely manner.
  • Work with stakeholders to implement mitigation and recovery plans.

Customer Management

  • Maintain regular communication with customers regarding project status, schedules, deliveries, and outstanding actions.
  • Address customer concerns promptly and coordinate internal support for resolution.
  • Ensure customer expectations are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle.

Material & Resource Coordination

  • Coordinate with procurement, logistics, factory, and service teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Track material availability and installation readiness.
  • Monitor resource deployment requirements at project sites.

Reporting & Governance

  • Update project status, forecasts, and financial metrics regularly.
  • Participate in project review meetings and provide accurate project performance updates.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational project management processes and documentation requirements.
  • Support movement of projects through defined stage gates and successful project closure.

Desired Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of HVAC systems, chillers, and applied projects.
  • Knowledge of project management fundamentals including:Planning and Scheduling
  • Cost Monitoring
  • Risk Management
  • Quality Compliance
  • Customer Management

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Timely invoicing and collection performance.

job.title: Project Coodinator
job.description:
L&D Shared Services – Project Manager

Job Description

#

What you will do

Manage end-to-end L&D content delivery projects by owning planning, governance, coordination, execution, tracking, and closure across the project lifecycle. The Project Manager will work closely with internal project coordinators, project leads, instructional designers, QA analysts, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure learning deliverables are delivered on time, within scope, within cost, and with the expected quality. The role requires strong operational discipline, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, intake governance, effort and timeline estimation, reporting, quality governance, analytics-driven planning, conflict resolution, and continuous improvement to support the current L&D Shared Services operating model.

In addition to the above, the Project Manager will be expected to:

Own project governance by managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, stakeholder expectations, and delivery commitments across active projects.

Enable smooth coordination between internal teams, external stakeholders, vendors, IDs, QA analysts, and coordinators to ensure clear handoffs and accountability.

Drive operational excellence through intake tracking, POD updates, vendor workflow governance, reporting hygiene, process documentation, and continuous improvement.

How you will do it

  • Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, and closure for L&D content development and learning delivery projects.
  • Participate in requirement gathering, clarify scope, define delivery approach, and create phase-wise project and communication plans.
  • Support effort, cost, timeline, and resource estimation to enable realistic delivery commitments and project prioritization.
  • Determine and govern the execution strategy across in-house teams and vendors based on scope, capacity, skills, timelines, and delivery complexity.
  • Partner with project coordinators for internal coordination, trackers, meeting logistics, documentation, and follow-ups.
  • Partner with project leads for external stakeholder coordination, requirement alignment, escalations, and delivery commitments.
  • Manage vendor engagement under the hourly model, including initiation, onboarding inputs, effort tracking, communication, and delivery governance.
  • Coordinate with instructional designers, QA analysts, and vendors to ensure content quality, review cycles, rework tracking, and timely sign-offs.
  • Define and track quality expectations, quality metrics, review outcomes, and QA reporting inputs in partnership with QA stakeholders.
  • Maintain project plans, RACI details, trackers, status reports, action logs, risk logs, and project documentation for transparency and continuity.
  • Provide timely updates through stakeholder meetings, project reviews, dashboards, business reports, success stories, and stakeholder escalation management.
  • Use available analytics, project data, and delivery trends to inform project planning, scope discussions, risks, capacity decisions, and improvement actions.
  • Identify risks, blockers, capacity concerns, scope changes, and dependency issues early; escalate with recommended actions where needed.
  • Resolve conflicts, remove execution barriers, and drive alignment across internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support successful delivery.
  • Drive intake discipline by supporting requirement clarity, prioritization inputs, delivery readiness, and alignment with shared services processes.
  • Evaluate completed projects, capture lessons learned, track feedback, and recommend process improvements to improve speed, quality, cost discipline, and stakeholder experience.
  • Stay informed on L&D trends, authoring standards, and operational best practices to support scalable and relevant learning solutions.

#

Qualification & Experience

  • Graduate or postgraduate degree in business, learning, project management, operations, or a related field.
  • 8–12+ years of experience in project management, learning operations, content development, shared services, or vendor-managed delivery environments.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects across global stakeholders, vendors, instructional design, QA, and operations teams.

Skills

  • Strong project governance, planning, tracking, risk management, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to manage cross-functional work across PM, coordinator, ID, QA, vendor, and business stakeholder groups.
  • Strong estimation and planning skills, including effort, timeline, cost, resource, and phase-wise delivery planning.
  • Project financial and cost governance mindset with the ability to manage multiple projects within agreed timelines, cost expectations, and quality standards.
  • Strong documentation discipline, including project plans, status reports, trackers, action logs, SOPs, and handover notes.
  • Experience with dashboards, reporting governance, analytics, and tools such as Power BI, MS Project, Planner, SharePoint, Excel, and Jira or equivalent tools.
  • Working knowledge of learning content development processes, authoring tools, SCORM/xAPI standards, review cycles, quality metrics, and QA workflows.
  • Vendor management experience, including execution strategy, workflow coordination, effort tracking, communication, issue resolution, and delivery quality checks.
  • Ability to influence without authority, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, drive accountability, and work effectively across time zones.
  • Strong customer orientation with a focus on quality, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Preferred

  • Understanding of instructional design, adult learning principles, learning technologies, and multimedia/content production workflows.
  • Experience working in shared services, GCC, L&D operations, or vendor-partnered delivery models.
  • Familiarity with HVAC, Building Automation, Fire & Security, or similar industrial/technical learning environments.

job.title: Senior Engineer – Acoustics
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced Modeling & Simulation: Develop, validate, and execute high-fidelity numerical models to predict and optimize the acoustic performance of HVAC systems, transport refrigeration units, and components (such as compressors, fans, structures, and air handlers).

ü Aero-Acoustics & Fluid-Structure Interaction: Conduct Computational Aero-Acoustics (CAA) simulations to predict flow-induced noise, fan noise, and turbulence-driven acoustic phenomena.

ü Vibro-Acoustics & Structural Dynamics: Analyze structural-acoustic coupling, structure-borne noise transmission, and vibration propagation using Finite Element Method (FEM) and Boundary Element Method (BEM) solvers.

ü Regional Commonization & Standards: Champion efforts to standardize and commonize acoustics simulation methodologies globally. Collaborate with international design centers to harmonize workflows while addressing varying regional regulations and market requirements.

ü Experimental Correlation: Collaborate closely with physical testing laboratories to design validation tests, analyze dynamic measurement data (sound power, vibration, modal testing), and correlate experimental results with simulation models.

ü Design Optimization: Partner with product development teams to provide actionable, physics-based design recommendations early in the development cycle to reduce noise and enhance sound quality.

ü Innovation: Keep abreast of emerging simulation technologies, and drive continuous improvement in simulation capability and speed.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (M.S./M.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Acoustics, or a highly related technical discipline.
  • PhD will be a plus.
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on industrial experience in acoustics modeling and simulation..
  • Knowledge in Acoustics and noise control (specific to HVAC products is desirable).
  • Should be able to perform Acoustics (Aero/Vibro) simulations, with emphasis on fan/blowers.
  • Good depth in CFD (or) FEA with experience in performing simulations is an added advantage
  • Hands-on experience on Acoustics/CFD/FEA tool preferably Actran, ANSYS Mechanical, Fluent, CFX, or Simcenter.
  • Theoretical knowledge of Acoustics, Numerical methods, Fluid dynamics and FEA.
  • Experience in Acoustics testing is desirable.
  • Experience in the HVAC industry is desirable.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML, IIOT and digital twin is preferred.
  • Strong teamwork, interpersonal, communication, and project management skills required.
  • Knowledge of programming languages and proven examples of improving productivity using various scripts.
  • Ability to work in a matrix team environment for the common objectives
  • Be part of org initiatives and contribute to ensure progressive, diverse and inclusive environment imbibing Trane values and culture.

.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly analytical with strong problem‑solving capability.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to manage work priorities independently.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong initiative to influence design improvements.
  • Proven ability to apply best‑practice approaches and engage in continuous learning.
  • Ability to lead technically within cross-functional programs and drive engineering clarity.

Review technical reports, failure trends, root-cause analysis, and corrective/preventive actions.

Ensure compliance with company policies, safety procedures, statutory requirements, and quality standards.

Maintain accurate service records, equipment history, job cards, reports, and dashboards.

Coordinate with dealers, vendors, OEMs, contractors, and major customers.

Identify training requirements and improve the technical capability of the service team.

Prepare regular reports on service performance, pending complaints, field failures, costs, and customer feedback.

Drive process improvements to reduce downtime, repeat complaints, and operating costs.

Support budgeting, manpower planning, spare-parts planning, and departmental targets.

Travel to customer sites or branches when required.

Typical KPIs:

Spare part revenue targets

Average response and resolution time.

Number of pending and overdue complaints.

Customer satisfaction score.

Spare-parts consumption and service cost

Qualifications and Experience

Approximately 5–10 years of experience in technical service, field operations, equipment maintenance, or after-sales support.

At least 2–5 years of experience supervising a service team.

Experience with service management software, CRM, ERP, or ticketing systems.

Strong knowledge of troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, documentation, and customer handling.

Experience in refrigeration, HVAC, reefer equipment, industrial machinery, or similar equipment would be advantageous.

Required Skills

Team leadership and staff coordination.

Technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

Customer-service and complaint-resolution skills.

Planning, prioritisation, and follow-up.

Vendor and dealer management.

Report preparation and data analysis.

Good written and verbal communication.

Working knowledge of MS Excel, ERP, CRM, and service-ticketing systems.
