job.title: Software Verification Lead
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Description

The CTCT division (a joint venture between Trimble and Caterpillar) develops positioning, control and automation products for earthmoving and paving machines in the construction and mining industries, using technologies such as GNSS, optical total stations, lasers, sonics and IMUs. The products are used in a range of applications where the operator of the machine benefits from having accurate horizontal and vertical guidance.

Working in a team, you will be involved in the specification, design, documentation, and execution of testing of the machine control software and hardware. You will work closely with software and system engineers to ensure CTCT continues to provide high-quality products to the earth moving industry.

Key Accountabilities Key Outcomes

Operational

Test Engineers will be assigned discrete segments of functionality from a project and will be responsible for:

  • API, integration and system testing of products during development.
  • Interpretation of high-level marketing requirements into detailed user-centric specifications suitable for development purposes.
  • Create bug reports with detailed information and relevant supporting diagnostic information to allow the effective triaging and resolution of software issues.
  • Creating and updating test and regression plans for new features or products or replacement products
  • Creating and updating manual functional and non functional test cases.
  • Developing, executing, and maintaining automated test scripts to optimise the testing process and reduce manual testing efforts
  • Continuous improvement of testing processes.
  • Helping diagnose, troubleshoot and reproduce customer escalated cases
  • Any other duties directed by Management as and when required

Health and Safety

  • Demonstrates participation in the hazard reporting process.
  • Demonstrates participation in accurate reporting of incidents.
  • Contribute to a positive health and safety culture within the team
  • Maintains a safe and clean work environment always.
  • Reads, understands and follows all Safe Work Procedures
  • Ensures access to and wears the appropriate PPE.
  • Always work within the guidelines of the CTCT Health and Safety Policy or that of other PCBUs if off site
  • Undertake training as directed to ensure you are competent to safely operate equipment.

Skills / Competencies

  • Curiosity and drive for continuous learning
  • Effective and proactive communication skills (verbal and written)
  • Strong problem-solving
  • Having a flexible approach to working in a changing environment
  • Ability to work as part of a collaborative team
  • Analytical approach and attention to detail
  • An understanding of the Agile software development process with a desire to learn.

Qualifications / Experience

  • Minimum or 5 years experience in a relevant role, QA, Software Test Engineer or Software Engineer.
  • ISTQB Certified Tester "Foundation Level"/"Advanced Level"/"Agile Tester" certification or equivalent certification is beneficial.
  • An understanding of C++, Web or Android code is beneficial but not required.
  • Experience with Auto Test writing, tools and framework

_Caterpillar of Australia and New Zealand is not currently hiring foreign national applicants that require or will require sponsorship._

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

September 28, 2026 - October 11, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Senior Technical Services Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Senior Technical Services Manager (Sr TSM), you will report to the Operations Director and work closely with the rest of the Operations team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Oversee critical environment maintenance planning activities at your data centre
  • Lead, mentor, and train a team of site based technical resources (TSM, Maintenance Manager and Coordinator), and contract management of site facilities providers for the tactical delivery of maintenance activities
  • Work closely with Building Services Manager on other property related matters

Your Day to Day

  • Effectively manage the site and achieve 100% uptime and compliance with customers' SLAs and safety
  • Oversee the planning and coordination of all preventive maintenance and repair works; ensure change management, incident management procedures and safety requirements are followed; coordinate activities as required with customers
  • Coordinate with the development team to manage construction activity and installations, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards
  • Review and support customer capacity management plan to ensure power capacity is well maintained and within limitations
  • Maintain site operating procedures (SOP, MOP, EOP) and any other documentation required by law, e.g. RA, SWMS and EHS
  • Ensure compliance with site held accreditations, including, but not limited to, ISMS, SOC2, PCI, ISO9001, ISO14001
  • Maintain compliance with local regulatory requirements including environmental, building, fire, electrical, hydraulic, occupational health & safety
  • Primary operational contact for customers and local point of escalation during emergency events and day-to-day operations
  • Attend witness testing of all equipment during commissioning to validate sequence of operations
  • Receive and review all operational documentation for new capacity
  • Handle provisioning of data centre services including connectivity, power services, deployment, and any additional services to be delivered to the data centre customers
  • Run minor capital projects for customers/internal purposes
  • Lead all maintenance and repair vendors and OPEX budget
  • Track operational metrics, data and analyse risks
  • Conduct regular property inspections
  • Evaluate plans and promote operational efficiency, passion for continuous improvement including power utilisation and cost efficiency

Requirements

  • 5+ years experience of managing mechanical and electrical in data centres (preferred), facilities, engineering operations, semiconductor, trades or related fields
  • Electrical or mechanical trade background or degree preferred. Solid understanding of data centre infrastructure, including power and cooling systems, fire, and security systems
  • Knowledge of local statutory regulations and requirements
  • Ability to establish and review Method of Procedure documents, maintenance reports, incident reports, emergency event summaries, root cause analysis reports, CAPEX/OPEX budget forecasts/reports and O&M manuals
  • Able to read and comprehend single line diagrams
  • Experience running 3rd party service providers; setting and managing critical metrics, negotiating contracts and pricing for services
  • Familiarity with Customer Portals, BMS, Computerized Maintenance Management Systems, CAD is a plus
  • Good leadership and experience in supervising small teams of technical staff
  • Effective key partner management experience
  • Strong customer centric approach, and ability to drive front-line staff attitude change
  • Ability to deliver effective presentations
  • Have Own Security NV1 Clearance or ability to get one (Australian sites only)

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Engineer II, Electronics Hardware Technical Lead
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirements Engineering & Traceability
  • Lead definition, decomposition, and validation of hardware requirements from system and stakeholder inputs (functional, electrical, environmental, safety, regulatory).
  • Establish and enforce bi‑directional traceability from stakeholder → system → hardware → design artifacts → verification → validation (V-model).
  • Product Development Leadership
  • Translate requirements into architectural choices and design constraints for PCBs, power, analog/mixed-signal, and environmental constraints.
  • Collaborate with Electrical Design, Layout, and FW to ensure requirements are feasible, cost-optimized, and testable.
  • Align requirements with DFx (DFT/DFM/DFR), EMI/EMC, safety (e.g., IEC/UL), thermal, and reliability objectives.
  • Guide teams through FMEA, FTA, worst-case analysis (WCA), tolerance analysis, derating, and component selection aligned to lifecycle and obsolescence plans.
  • Atleast lead min 1 product end to end responsibility from Design to Release to Market.
  • Experience on ATS (Auto Transfer Switch) controller development is added advantage.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 10–14 years of hands-on hardware development experience, including:
  • Analog design (low-noise, precision, sensor interfaces, signal integrity)
  • Power supply design AC/DC and DC-DC flyback,Full bridge etc.
  • Mixed-signal systems (ADC integration, grounding, isolation strategies)
  • Digital design (MCUs, FPGAs, high-speed logic, clocking architectures)
  • Deep understanding of PCB design and hardware architecture, including:
  • Multi-layer PCB stack-up planning
  • EMI/EMC-aware layout practices
  • Thermal-aware design and component placement
  • Proven expertise in hardware design analysis and validation, including:
  • Worst Case Analysis (WCA), derating, and tolerance stack-up analysis
  • Simulation tools (SPICE, SI tools,
  • Solid expertise in EMI/EMC and regulatory compliance, including:
  • Design for compliance (emissions, immunity, ESD, EFT, surge)
  • Standards such as IEC, UL, CISPR, ISO (as applicable)
  • Pre-compliance and certification test strategies
  • Strong hardware debugging and root-cause analysis capability:
  • System-level issue isolation across analog, digital, and power domains
  • Experience resolving EMI/EMC failures, field issues, and production escapes
  • Expertise in component engineering and lifecycle management, including:
  • Component selection based on performance, cost, and availability
  • Obsolescence risk mitigation and second sourcing
  • Supplier technical interaction and qualification

Rewards designed for you

job.title: Data Technical Project Manager (TPM)
job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager who can combine agile delivery discipline with data platform and cloud engineering literacy to coordinate development and release cycles across StarHub’s C360 data domains.

In this role, you will work closely with Domain Owners (DOs), Data Architects, Engineering Managers (EMs), Platform Engineers, and Biz Data Analysts/Scientists to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery across systems that support StarHub’s analytics, AI, and machine learning journeys.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with agile project delivery in a DataOps or cloud-native environment, preferably across data ingestion, transformation, and machine learning pipelines — with a solid understanding of Snowflake, AWS, CI/CD, MLOps and observability frameworks, and end-to-end delivery metrics.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Agile Management

  • Drive agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and maintain team rhythm and cadence.
  • Manage backlog hygiene, ensuring stories are well-defined, estimated, and prioritized.
  • Plan and execute phased delivery strategies across multiple environments (DEV/SIT/PROD) within AWS and Snowflake ecosystems.
  • Track delivery health through velocity, throughput, data quality SLAs, and pipeline stability metrics.
  • Identify and resolve blockers, risks, and cross-domain dependencies early.
  • Maintain clear delivery dashboards and status reporting to senior stakeholders.
  • Ensure alignment between Data Engineering, Platform DevOps, and Analytics/ML teams for synchronized delivery.

Technical Coordination & Planning

  • Partner with Domain Owners, Data Source Owners, Data Architects & Engineers to align deliverables to data and analytics milestones.
  • Coordinate with DevOps and QA/QE teams to ensure readiness for integration, testing, and release.
  • Coordinate delivery dependencies with external partners across ingestion, migration, and ML projects.
  • Support Domain Owners and report on key DataOps KPIs, including ingestion success rate, pipeline failure rate, data freshness, and platform cost utilization..
  • Participate in sprint demos and ensure acceptance criteria are met for each increment.

Stakeholder & Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Work with Data Owners, Business Unit Data Leads (CBG, EBG, FIN, COPS, SmartHub), and Release Program Managers to align sprint deliverables to journey-level milestones.
  • Collaborate with Journey Owners (JOs) and business stakeholders to clarify priorities and expected outcomes.
  • Coordinate delivery dependencies with external partners across ingestion, migration, and ML projects.
  • Communicate risks, decisions, and delivery trade-offs clearly across key stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement & Governance

  • Drive adoption of agile, DataOps, MLOps and cloud automation best practices across DXP Data teams.
  • Analyze delivery and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities in throughput, cost efficiency, and data quality.
  • Support incident RCA reviews and platform post-mortems, ensuring learnings are captured and converted into actionable backlog improvements.
  • Contribute to standardized delivery governance, templates, and documentation across domains.
  • Champion cost optimization and monitoring frameworks for Snowflake warehouses, AWS usage, and data pipeline efficiency.

Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, Information Systems, Business Analytics or related field.
  • Agile, PMP, or DevOps certifications (e.g., CSM, SAFe, PMI-ACP, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SnowPro Core) preferred.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in data platform delivery, data ops & quality management, or analytics program management, with at least 3 years in a technical project management, delivery lead or scrum master capacity.
  • Proven track record managing data engineering teams delivering pipelines and analytics workloads via CI/CD within AWS and Snowflake architectures..
  • Proven experience coordinating ingestion, modeling, and ML engineering deliveries based on modern data tech stacks such as Snowflake, Apache Airflow, Airbyte, NiFi and AWS SageMaker.
  • Strong understanding of DataOps automation, role-based access control, data security, and cost optimization in cloud data environments..
  • Hands-on level familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, Monday.com, Snowflake, SQL, dashboarding.
  • Experience in telecommunications, data platform delivery, or enterprise analytics programs is an advantage.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile data engineering, cloud architecture, and DevOps principles.
  • Demonstrated experience fostering data-driven culture and enabling data literacy across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a bias for execution.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resilient in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

job.title: Critical Operations Supervisor - MECHANICAL (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Critical Operations Supervisor - Mechanical provides day-to-day operational leadership and technical governance to ensure the safe, compliant and reliable performance of all mechanical and cooling infrastructure across the site. This Monday-Friday role is accountable for coordinating mechanical operations, overseeing major works and maintaining regulatory and contractual compliance.

The position participates in a rotating on-call roster to provide after-hours escalation, ensuring timely response to mechanical, thermal or cooling-related incidents. The Supervisor leads the Mechanical workstream across all shift teams, providing expert escalation on complex issues and coordinating critical activities such as planned shutdowns, cooling plant maintenance, thermal risk mitigation, troubleshooting and return-to-service (RTS) validation.

This role is also responsible for ensuring mechanical training, competency and authorisation requirements are met. The Supervisor partners closely with site stakeholders to uplift procedures, enhance plant performance, strengthen operational readiness and continuously improve the mechanical reliability of the facility.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

  • Uphold STACK’s 100% uptime objective by providing disciplined operational leadership and oversight of site mechanical and cooling systems.
  • Ensure safe and compliant operation of all mechanical systems, including chilled water systems, CRAC/CRAH units, cooling towers, pumps, valves, filtration equipment and associated controls.
  • Maintain real-time situational awareness of mechanical system condition, thermal stability, redundancy state and risk indicators through BMS/EPMS and field verification.
  • Act as the primary mechanical escalation point for shift teams, providing real-time guidance, diagnostic support and risk evaluation.
  • Lead the development, review and implementation of operational and maintenance procedures, including MOPs and SOPs for mechanical systems.
  • Coordinate major mechanical activities, including planned shutdowns, incident response, corrective maintenance, onsite troubleshooting and programmed maintenance.
  • Provide technical direction during planned maintenance, resets, cooling plant adjustments, valve alignments and energisations to ensure safe execution aligned to site procedures.
  • Review and provide input into risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work controls, isolations/LOTO and return-to-service documentation.
  • Verify operational readiness following maintenance, resets, parameter changes or commissioning activities by confirming alarms, redundancy status, thermal performance and control sequences.
  • Ensure all operational activities are carried out with due regard to health and safety, business risk and STACK’s 100% uptime objective.
  • Act as incident manager for mechanical incidents when required, including during on-call periods.
  • Coordinate vendor activities affecting mechanical systems, ensuring safe execution, alignment to site requirements and correct post-work configuration.
  • Identify systemic risks, recurring thermal issues, capacity constraints and mechanical design limitations, and escalate as required.
  • Improve operational documentation, including SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, shift logs, CMMS data quality, handover standards and alarm-handling procedures within the mechanical workstream.

People

  • Model outstanding safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct.
  • Provide coaching, uplift and technical mentoring to Senior Data Centre Specialists, Senior Critical Operations Technicians and Critical Operations Technicians to strengthen team capability and execution consistency.
  • Reinforce high-quality shift communication, including clear escalation structures, accurate technical context and structured handovers.
  • Ensure clear and accurate transfer of information between rotating shifts, maintaining continuity of operations and supporting consistent decision-making across the team.
  • Support onboarding and technical familiarisation for new team members, clarifying operating boundaries, site safety and shift expectations.
  • Collaborate effectively with Security, Projects, Operations and vendors to support safe and coordinated campus operations.
  • Represent Critical Operations during customer visits, tours, audits and technical discussions, maintaining a concierge-level customer service approach at all times.
  • Contribute practical insights and recommendations during toolbox talks, performance reviews, drills and operational meetings.

Competencies

  • Advanced operational judgement in a mission-critical environment.
  • Strong technical capability in mechanical and cooling systems, including chilled water, HVAC and airflow management.
  • Expert interpretation of plant telemetry, thermal behaviour, automation sequences and redundancy models.
  • Structured troubleshooting and stabilisation capability under pressure.
  • Proficiency with BMS/EPMS, CMMS and operational data platforms.
  • Skilled in coaching, guiding and uplifting technical capability in others.
  • Strong written and verbal communication suitable for incidents and customer interactions.
  • Calm, authoritative presence during alarms, escalations and operational events.
  • Strong coordination and oversight skills for work control, vendor interaction and RTS verification.
  • Continuous improvement mindset focused on safety, reliability and operational excellence.

Work Environment / Conditions

  • This is a Monday-Friday position with rotating on-call requirements to support after-hours incidents and escalations.
  • Work occurs across data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required under site policy.
  • Participation in emergency response, readiness exercises and incident management activities is required.

Travel Required

  • Minimal travel expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Mechanical trade qualification, such as Certificate III/IV in Mechanical, HVAC or Refrigeration, or a mechanical engineering qualification with suitable Australian recognition or registration.
  • Extensive experience in data centres or other mission-critical facilities, including utilities, hospitals, Defence or industrial environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise operating and monitoring critical cooling and mechanical systems, including CRAC/CRAH, chilled water systems, pumps, cooling towers, airflow and filtration systems.
  • Strong background in inspecting, triaging and stabilising mechanical plant under abnormal conditions.
  • Experience reviewing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, risk assessments and commissioning documentation.
  • Ability to interpret mechanical schematics, chilled water diagrams, airflow layouts, control logic and OEM manuals.
  • Knowledge of permit-to-work processes, isolations/LOTO and operational risk frameworks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication for technical reporting, incident updates and customer briefings.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.
  • Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.
  • Physical capability to perform inspections, rounds and emergency response tasks.
  • Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Legal entitlement to work in Australia.
  • Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements, as applicable, including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.
  • Ability to meet data centre security requirements, including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.

job.title: Critical Operations Supervisor - ELECTRICAL (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Critical Operations Supervisor - Electrical provides day-to-day operational leadership and technical governance to ensure the safe, compliant and reliable performance of all site electrical infrastructure. This Monday-Friday role is accountable for overseeing electrical operations, coordinating major works and maintaining regulatory and contractual compliance.

The position participates in a rotating on-call roster to provide after-hours escalation, ensuring timely response to electrical incidents or abnormal conditions. The Supervisor leads the Electrical workstream across all shift teams, providing expert escalation for complex electrical issues and coordinating key activities such as planned shutdowns, switching operations, fault response, energisation and de-energisation activities, and return-to-service (RTS) validation.

This role ensures that all electrical training, competency and authorisation requirements are met and maintained. The Supervisor works closely with site stakeholders to uplift procedures, strengthen electrical safety practices, enhance plant performance and continuously improve operational readiness across the facility.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

  • Uphold STACK’s 100% uptime objective by providing disciplined operational leadership and oversight of site electrical systems and associated work controls.
  • Ensure safe and compliant operation of high-voltage systems, in coordination with the High Voltage Operations Manager, and low-voltage systems, including adherence to switching rules, site processes and required training and authorisation prerequisites.
  • Maintain real-time situational awareness of electrical system condition, redundancy state and risk indicators through EPMS/BMS and field verification.
  • Act as the primary electrical escalation point for shift teams, providing real-time guidance, diagnostic support and risk evaluation.
  • Lead the development, review and implementation of operational and maintenance procedures, including MOPs and SOPs.
  • Coordinate major electrical activities, including planned shutdowns, incident response, corrective maintenance, onsite troubleshooting and programmed maintenance.
  • Provide technical direction during planned maintenance, shutdowns, functional testing and energisations to ensure safe execution aligned to site procedures.
  • Review and provide input into risk assessments, switching plans, permit-to-work controls, isolations/LOTO and return-to-service documentation.
  • Verify operational readiness following maintenance, resets, system changes or commissioning activities by confirming alarms, redundancy status, load paths and control sequences.
  • Ensure all operational activities are carried out with due regard to health and safety, business risk and STACK’s 100% uptime objective.
  • Act as incident manager for electrical incidents when required, including during on-call periods.
  • Coordinate vendor activities affecting electrical systems, ensuring safe execution, alignment to site requirements and correct post-work configuration.
  • Identify systemic risks, recurring faults, capacity constraints and design issues, and escalate as required.
  • Improve operational documentation, including SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, shift logs, CMMS data quality, handover standards and alarm-handling procedures within the electrical workstream.

People

  • Model outstanding safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct.
  • Provide coaching, uplift and technical mentoring to Senior Data Centre Specialists, Senior Critical Operations Technicians and Critical Operations Technicians to strengthen team capability and execution consistency.
  • Reinforce high-quality shift communication, including clear escalation structures, accurate technical context and structured handovers.
  • Ensure clear and accurate transfer of information between rotating shifts, maintaining continuity of operations and supporting consistent decision-making across the team.
  • Support onboarding and technical familiarisation for new team members, clarifying operating boundaries, site safety and shift expectations.
  • Collaborate effectively with Security, Projects, Operations and vendors to support safe and coordinated campus operations.
  • Represent Critical Operations during customer visits, tours, audits and technical discussions, maintaining a concierge-level customer service approach at all times.
  • Contribute practical insights and recommendations during toolbox talks, performance reviews, drills and operational meetings.

Competencies

  • Advanced operational judgement in a mission-critical environment.
  • Strong technical capability in electrical systems, protection behaviour and switching operations.
  • Expert interpretation of plant telemetry, protection responses, automation sequences and redundancy models.
  • Structured troubleshooting and stabilisation capability under pressure.
  • Proficiency with BMS/EPMS, CMMS and operational data platforms.
  • Skilled in coaching, guiding and uplifting technical capability in others.
  • Strong written and verbal communication suitable for incidents and customer interactions.
  • Calm, authoritative presence during alarms, escalations and operational events.
  • Strong coordination and oversight skills for work control, vendor interaction and RTS verification.
  • Continuous improvement mindset focused on safety, reliability and operational excellence.

Work Environment / Conditions

  • This is a Monday-Friday position with rotating on-call requirements to support after-hours incidents and escalations.
  • Work occurs across data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required under site policy.
  • Participation in emergency response, readiness exercises and incident management activities is required.

Travel Required

  • Minimal travel expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • A-Grade Electrical Licence (Australia), or an electrical engineering qualification with relevant Australian registration suitable for the scope of the role.
  • Extensive experience in data centres or other mission-critical facilities, including utilities, hospitals, Defence or industrial environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise operating and monitoring critical power systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs/PMMs, ATS/STS and associated control systems.
  • Strong background in inspecting, triaging and stabilising critical plant under abnormal conditions.
  • Experience reviewing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, risk assessments, switching plans and commissioning documentation.
  • Ability to interpret single-line diagrams, network diagrams, automation logic and OEM manuals.
  • Knowledge of permit-to-work processes, isolations/LOTO and operational risk frameworks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication for technical reporting, incident updates and customer briefings.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.
  • Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.
  • Physical capability to perform inspections, rounds and emergency response tasks.
  • Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Legal entitlement to work in Australia.
  • Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements, as applicable, including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.
  • Ability to meet data centre security requirements, including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.
  • Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific facility.

job.title: Director, Design Delivery
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

  • *

We are seeking a Director, Design Delivery with a strong background in either mechanical or electrical engineering to lead the end-to-end design execution of mission-critical data centre infrastructure across the Asia Pacific region. This senior leadership role will own the integrated design delivery process from early concept through construction, driving consistency, technical excellence, and innovation across a growing portfolio of hyperscale and enterprise-grade data centre projects.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise (preferably in mechanical or electrical systems), strong leadership across multidisciplinary teams, and a track record of executing complex data centre designs at scale. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, design consultants, construction teams, and strategic partners to ensure project success in terms of quality, performance, time, and cost.

Key responsibilities

Strategic & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the overall MEP design strategy for assigned data centre projects across the region, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and technical rigor.
  • Own the mechanical and electrical discipline leadership, including chilled water systems, HVAC, liquid cooling, or power distribution, UPS, and MV/LV systems.

Cross-Disciplinary Design Integration

  • Champion seamless coordination between mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, architectural, structural, and security disciplines.
  • Drive adoption of best practices, innovation, and lessons learned across the portfolio.

Design Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee the full design lifecycle from feasibility and concept through detailed design, IFC, and construction support – ensuring alignment with business goals and customer requirements.
  • Monitor and drive performance of external consultants and vendors, ensuring deliverables meet cost, quality, and schedule expectations.

Design Governance & Standardization

  • Establish and enforce internal design governance, including design reviews, technical due diligence, and risk assessments.
  • Maintain and evolve internal design standards, master specifications, and reference guides to support rapid and consistent deployment.

Innovation & Future Readiness

  • Lead technical innovation efforts including liquid cooling readiness, AI/HPC support, or grid-interactive power strategies.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure future-proof design direction.

Execution Support & Commissioning

  • Provide senior oversight and troubleshooting during construction and commissioning phases to validate that design intent is maintained.
  • Review and validate Sequence of Operations (SOO) and critical systems performance during T&C.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as a key technical voice to internal leadership, customers, and partners—articulating design strategies, decisions, risks, and value propositions clearly and confidently.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (or equivalent).
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data centre design and delivery, including at least 5 years in hyperscale or colocation environments.
  • Proven leadership of complex, multi-disciplinary design efforts with responsibility for multiple projects across geographies.
  • Deep knowledge of mechanical and/or electrical systems including HVAC, chilled water, free cooling, UPS, MV/LV distribution, or liquid cooling.
  • Familiarity with regional APAC codes and international standards (ASHRAE, ISO, IEC, NFPA, etc.).
  • Experience with design tools such as AutoCAD, Revit/BIM, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer, or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Strong communicator and influencer with the ability to manage both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth, international environment is highly advantageous.

job.title: Account Manager/Director
job.description:
Account Manager

Location: Gurugram

Role Summary

The role drives sales growth of the Siemens Process Instrumentation portfolio through OEMs, the primary customer base. These include machine builders from industry as well as process side. The role also leverages the wider DI portfolio (automation, drives, digitalization) so that OEMs standardize on complete Siemens solutions. The candidate needs strong application knowledge of field instrumentation, an understanding of OEM business models, and the ability to get Siemens designed into OEMs' standard products for repeat, volume business. As a senior role, it involves independent ownership of key OEM accounts, contributing to regional OEM strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • OEM Business Growth and Account Management
  • Drive order intake and revenue for the Siemens Instrumentation portfolio through OEMs. The portfolio includes flow (SITRANS F: electromagnetic, Coriolis, ultrasonic), pressure (SITRANS P), temperature (SITRANS T), level (SITRANS L: radar and ultrasonic), valve positioners (SIPART), and weighing (SIWAREX, belt scales). Knowledge of Process Analytics is an advantage.
  • Independently own key OEM accounts. Build account plans, map the key stakeholders (design, purchase, management) and develop long-term, strategic relationships.
  • Target OEMs across different sectors.
  • Identify and acquire new OEMs and grow share of wallet in existing OEM accounts.
  • Contribute to regional OEM business planning, including annual targets, segment strategies and portfolio positioning. Share OEM feedback with product management for localization, pricing and portfolio development.
  • Design-in and Standardization
  • Work with OEM design and engineering teams to get Siemens instruments designed into their standard products, drawings and BOMs, and to standardize on Siemens across product lines.
  • Understand OEM applications and P&IDs, then do instrument sizing and selection, and optimize the BOQ for cost, performance and delivery.
  • Negotiate and manage frame agreements, rate contracts and annual volume commitments with OEMs, so that business is repeatable and predictable.
  • Support OEMs with end-customer approvals. This means engaging end users, consultants and EPCs so that Siemens instruments are accepted on OEM-supplied skids and packages.
  • Solution Selling and Partnerships
  • Cross-sell and up-sell the wider DI portfolio to OEMs: controllers (S7-1200, S7-1500), HMI, TIA Portal, drives and motors (SINAMICS, SIMOTICS, and PMA portfolio such as SIMOTION and servo motors where relevant), and industrial communication. Offer integrated, instrument-to-controller solutions that make OEM machines more competitive.
  • Promote digitalization offerings such as device diagnostics, asset management (SIMATIC PDM), Industrial Edge and IoT-based remote monitoring. These help OEMs differentiate their equipment and build service revenue.
  • Work with channel partners and system integrators to serve OEMs, including partner enablement and joint account planning.
  • Conduct product presentations, technical workshops, demos and training for OEM design and service teams.
  • Market Intelligence and Sales Operations
  • Track OEM market trends, OEM expansion plans and competitor activity, particularly Endress+Hauser, KROHNE, Yokogawa, Emerson, ABB, VEGA, WIKA and IFM. Use this intelligence for value-based selling and competitive positioning.
  • Maintain the opportunity pipeline, forecasts and win/loss analysis in CRM (Salesforce), and give regular updates to management.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including product management, the application/technical support center, order management, logistics and service. The aim is competitive pricing, reliable lead times and smooth support for OEMs.

Technical Requirements

  • Must have
  • Strong knowledge of process instrumentation: measuring principles, selection criteria, installation requirements and calibration.
  • Ability to work with P&IDs, data sheets, GA drawings and BOMs of OEM skids and equipment.
  • Understanding of hazardous area classification and certifications (ATEX, IECEx, PESO), SIL requirements, hygienic and sanitary requirements for pharma and F&B, and material selection for process conditions.
  • Knowledge of field communication protocols: HART, IO-Link, PROFIBUS PA, PROFINET, Modbus.
  • Working knowledge of PLC-based automation and how instruments integrate with OEM control panels.
  • Qualifications and Experience
  • B.E./B.Tech in Instrumentation, Electronics & Instrumentation, or Instrumentation & Control Engineering (preferred). Electrical/Electronics candidates with a strong instrumentation background may also be considered.
  • 10-14 years of experience in sales, business development or application engineering of process instrumentation, with instrumentation or automation OEMs or companies selling to them.
  • At least 5 years in a customer-facing OEM sales or key account management role, with a proven record of design-in wins and volume business growth.
  • Established network among OEMs in the assigned region. Familiarity with the related end-user and EPC community is an advantage.
  • Key Competencies
  • Techno-commercial acumen and value-selling skills, with an understanding of OEM cost structures and the price-volume balance.
  • Strategic thinking and account planning.
  • Strong customer relationship management and networking.
  • Ability to influence OEM owners, design heads and purchase heads.
  • Good communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Coaching and mentoring skills.
  • Strong ownership and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Self-driven, target-oriented, with a positive attitude and resilience.
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.

job.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI
job.description:
About the job

As a Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol [MCP] servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Build evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Be able to co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Reliability & Observability Analyst I
job.description:
About the Role

Job Type: Full-time | Location: Sydney |Work Location Type: #onsite IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC. With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

We are seeking an IOC Reliability & Observability Analyst I with a strong reliability, observability, and automation mindset to support our 24/7 HPC Data Center Operations. The role focuses on analyzing operational signals, improving incident quality, and supporting AIOps enabled automation and tooling and is designed for candidates early in their careers who want to grow into Site Reliability, Infrastructure Operations, or Platform Engineering paths. This is an entry‑level (Level 1) IOC role focused on operational analysis, data quality, and reliability signal validation rather than system design or engineering ownership. You will support IOC, engineering, and operations teams by analyzing incidents, validating operational signals, and identifying opportunities to improve detection quality and operational reliability under established processes and guidance.

Requirements

  • 1-3 years of experience in IOC, NOC, SRE‑adjacent operations, systems analysis, or technical support roles
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • Exposure to 24/7 production environments supporting infrastructure, cloud, or data center operations
  • Foundational awareness of SRE concepts such as service health, MTTR/MTTD, and the incident lifecycle, with the ability to apply these concepts in operational analysis.
  • Working knowledge of Linux-based systems, basic networking concepts, and infrastructure dependencies
  • Experience working with metrics, logs, and alerting systems across infrastructure or application environments
  • Familiarity with observability platforms (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus-style metrics)
  • Ability to assess alert quality, identify noise, and recognize monitoring gaps
  • Awareness of AIOps concepts such as anomaly detection, event correlation, and alert noise reduction, primarily for the purpose of reviewing and validating automated insights
  • Experience validating automated insights and supporting alerting or observability automation
  • Ability to read automation artifacts (Python, Bash, or configuration-based workflows) and assist with minor updates under documented procedures and guidance
  • Ability to analyze incident trends and system behaviors with strong attention to data accuracy, signal integrity, and identify recurring issues or improvement opportunities
  • Clear communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with operations and engineering teams

Other important requirements

  • Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies

Responsibilities

  • Analyze incident data, system behaviors, and operational signals across GPU clusters, networks, and facilities to identify risks and trends
  • Identify detection gaps, alert delays, false positives, and under-monitored systems, and document findings for review by IOC leadership or engineering teams
  • Validate ticketing and incident data for accuracy, completeness, and reporting integrity
  • Support continuous improvement of observability by evaluating metrics, logs, alerts, and dashboards
  • Assist in refining operational views focused on service health, reliability, and signal quality
  • Generate post-incident insights highlighting trends, risks, and improvement opportunities
  • Support AIOps-enabled capabilities by reviewing outputs from anomaly detection, alert correlation, and event clustering, and flagging accuracy or data-quality issues
  • Validate automated insights and escalate tuning or accuracy issues to IOC and engineering teams
  • Assist with testing automation related to alert routing, enrichment, and suppression, and submit recommended changes through established change and review processes
  • Produce and maintain SLA/KPI dashboards and reliability reports using established templates, definitions, and data sources
  • Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to inform preventive measures, workflow improvements, and monitoring enhancements
  • Contribute to runbook updates, operational documentation, and reliability initiatives in partnership with IOC and engineering teams
  • Develop foundational SRE skills in preparation for expanded operational responsibility
  • This role operates under defined IOC processes and supervision, with increasing responsibility as skills and experience develop

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader total rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.

  • Compensation & Rewards

Competitive salary range finalized based on experience and impact

AUD$95,000-100,000/annum

Short and long-term incentive programs designed to reward both results and long term company success

Wellbeing & Benefits

  • Paid vacation to recharge, travel, or simply enjoy more life outside of work

We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!

IREN Limited is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. This job will remain posted until filled. While we appreciate all applications we receive, we are only able to contact candidates under consideration.

By applying for this position and submitting your resume and application materials, you consent to the processing of your personal information in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Statement available on our website at [www.iren.com](http://www.iren.com/).

job.title: Senior HVAC Project Engineer (Marine)
job.description:
About the Role

Carrier Corporation’s Marine Division has been a trusted partner to the international maritime and offshore industries for decades. By uniting our activities under one Marine umbrella, we leverage cutting-edge technology and deliver a comprehensive portfolio of marine solutions, services, and expertise to shipbuilders, owners, and operators worldwide.

Carrier Marine and Offshore Systems provides advanced air conditioning products and systems for everything from cruise ships to offshore platforms and oil tankers. We are seeking a customer-focused Senior HVAC Project Engineer to join our Marine team and help drive technical excellence and project success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Apply expertise in air conditioning, refrigeration design, heat transfer, fan systems, and HVAC systems.
  • Supervise project performance and ensure timely delivery.
  • Manage project costs effectively, identifying opportunities for savings to maximize profitability.
  • Troubleshoot project challenges and recommend practical solutions.
  • Communicate directly with external customers, providing technical support and guidance.
  • Support marine dealers and customers across Carrier’s product portfolio.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and Carrier factories to resolve technical and scheduling issues.
  • Present findings and corrective actions clearly to customers.
  • Work with Carrier factories and external suppliers to ensure designs meet customer requirements.
  • Manage subcontractors and oversee compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Participate in all phases of projects—from design through installation and commissioning—ensuring technical compliance.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems.
  • Marine industry experience is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience leading project teams or managing multiple small to mid-sized projects.
  • Familiarity with commercial or industrial HVAC components and related systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues effectively on HVAC installations.
  • Self-starter with the ability to learn quickly and work independently under minimal supervision.
  • Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail and prioritization abilities.
  • Strong follow-up and follow-through skills to meet deadlines and customer expectations.
  • Exceptional communication and technical writing skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience with SAP, Salesforce, AutoCAD/Eplan is a plus.
  • Light overseas travel required 10%-20%

Minimum Requirements

  • Diploma to Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience.

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

job.title: Cyber Security Engineer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

OT / ICS Operations & Security Management

  • Support the company's ICS/OT operations, including networks, systems, endpoints, and cybersecurity tools.
  • Maintain OT system and network monitoring to ensure availability and reliability.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and provide day-to-day operational support for cybersecurity solutions within the ICS environment.
  • Support day-to-day control system operations and troubleshoot issues to ensure reliable plant performance.
  • Monitor systems for unusual or suspicious activities and respond to cybersecurity incidents, alerts, and threats.
  • Maintain and enhance security controls for critical systems to meet operational and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Manage CII system and network backup processes to ensure business continuity and recovery readiness.

Information Security Governance & Compliance

  • Manage and maintain the organization's Information Security Management System (ISMS).
  • Conduct annual reviews and updates of ISMS policies, procedures, and supporting documentation.
  • Implement and maintain cybersecurity requirements in compliance with CSA, PSO, EMA, CCOP, ISO 27001:2022, and other applicable standards and regulations.
  • Take ownership of ISMS-related activities and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Serve as the key liaison between the organization, customers, auditors, service providers, and internal information security stakeholders.

Risk, Vulnerability & Security Assessment

  • Conduct annual cybersecurity risk assessments for Critical Information Infrastructure (CII) systems.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate cybersecurity risks to ensure critical systems remain secure and resilient.
  • Perform vulnerability management and patch management activities for OT/ICS environments.
  • Plan and execute cybersecurity activities including:Vulnerability Assessments (VA)
  • Penetration Testing (VAPT)
  • Threat Hunting
  • Purple Team Exercises
  • Tabletop Exercises
  • Security Reviews and Assessments

Review cybersecurity advisories and implement mitigation measures where necessary.Audit & Regulatory Management

  • Support and coordinate internal and external cybersecurity audits.
  • Plan and execute annual cybersecurity audit programs.
  • Coordinate CSA audits, vulnerability assessments, compliance reviews, and mandated regulatory audits.
  • Ensure audit findings are tracked, remediated, and closed within agreed timelines.
  • Support information security requirements during both internal and external audits.

Security Projects & Technology Improvement

  • Review existing technology architecture and identify vulnerabilities, weaknesses, and improvement opportunities.
  • Plan, implement, and oversee cybersecurity technology upgrades, enhancements, and major system changes.
  • Develop technical solutions, cost estimations, budgets, and proposals to meet cybersecurity requirements for internal and external projects.
  • Support the delivery, commissioning, and cybersecurity assurance of new projects and plant systems.
  • Ensure all new systems meet operational, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements before deployment.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with business units, service providers, and external stakeholders to ensure OT cybersecurity requirements are met.
  • Collaborate with internal IT security personnel and Site Information Security Officers (SITSO) on cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Evaluate and monitor cybersecurity service performance and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) of third-party vendors and contractors.
  • Coordinate cybersecurity activities with the EC&I Department and support departmental objectives.

Training & Awareness

  • Develop and deliver cybersecurity awareness programs and training sessions for employees.
  • Promote cybersecurity best practices across the organization.

Provide guidance and support to users on cybersecurity policies, procedures, and compliance requirements.'

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or Diploma in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Infrastructure

PLATFORM

Operating Division

job.title: Senior/Technical Officer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

You will support the Operations Engineer in ensuring smooth daily operations by performing the following duties:

  • Carry out routine checks and testing of plant equipment and propose job cards in a proper manner
  • Monitor plant parameters and make adjustments/troubleshoot via DCS or in the site to ensure parameters are within limits, including temperature, pressure, flue gas emissions, etc
  • Manage boiler water condition and level, including monitoring and controlling water consumption
  • Perform the necessary equipment switch-over, like feed water pumps, flue gas treatment compartment, chemical dosing silo, etc.
  • Optimize refuse incineration throughput based on operating conditions
  • Ensure chemicals and consumables optimization
  • Record and document changes in work procedures accurately and precisely according to plant ISO standards and quality management procedures
  • Update plant status – informing equipment failure or situation in time to immediate superior
  • Ensure that incidents (if any) are well-handled and properly documented with minimum disruption to operations
  • Enforcement of Permit-to-Work (PTW) System with good Risk Assessment System in line with identified Work Inventory. Administer PTW system and LOTO well
  • Assist in isolation and normalization of equipment safely based on plant P&ID drawings
  • Assist the Operations Engineer in management of activities for Operations with regard to Central Control Room (CCR), Weighbridge, Water and Wastewater Treatment Plant, Overhaul, reception hall, bunker management and other general plant matters
  • Handle and resolve all technical issues related to operations of boilers, turbo-generators, Flue gas treatment and its auxiliaries
  • Ensure smooth and efficient operation of turbo-generators and associated common equipment
  • Work with Maintenance team on carrying out Boiler and Turbo-Generators overhaul and any ad hoc work activities in SWTE
  • Have a safety mindset and participate actively in safety initiatives and events
  • Contribute to improvement and optimization projects
  • Liaise with contractors on matters relating to operations and solid waste management
  • Supervise refuse/ash crane and ash-handling operations that are carried out by contractors
  • Ensure contractor compliance to in-house rules and HSE protocol. Ensure adequate supervision is provided and jobs are carried out safely
  • Any other ad-hoc duties assigned by supervisor / plant management

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • At least a Higher NITEC in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical Engineering or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of the principles and mechanics of plant equipment and DCS functions is essential
  • At least a Class 2 Boiler Attendant Certificate is preferred but not mandatory
  • Preferably have attended training relating to HAZMAT/First Aid/Incident Management/Work-at-Height/Confined Space. Trainings will be planned for those who have not been trained
  • Strong safety mindset and can-do attitude
  • Meticulous with good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Good team-player with high initiative
  • An interest in process or Waste-to-Energy (WTE) Plant operations. Must be able to get accustomed to WTE environment
  • Committed to 12-hour shift work and willing to provide support on off/rest day when required
  • This is a 2 years contract position

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Infrastructure

PLATFORM

Operating Division

job.title: Operations Manager

job.title: Manager, Rewards & Well Being
job.description:
What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end annual reward processes, including salary review, performance bonus and promotions, covering planning, guidelines, modelling, governance, stakeholder alignment and management reporting.
  • Lead market benchmarking and compensation analysis including salary ranges, market positioning, compa-ratios and internal relativities, translating market data into clear recommendations.
  • Conduct job evaluation and job sizing for new and changed roles, assessing scope, complexity, accountability and organisational impact while ensuring consistency with approved methodology and internal relativities.
  • Lead and contribute to reviews of salary structures, reward frameworks and targeted reward solutions, developing options and business cases that balance competitiveness, equity, affordability and implementation considerations.
  • Manage benefits and well-being programmes, using claims, utilisation, employee feedback and market insights to assess programme effectiveness, cost and employee experience.
  • Manage relationships with insurers, brokers and well-being providers, including service performance, cost management, issue resolution and programme improvements.
  • Develop advanced analytics, scenario modelling and management insights, identifying trends, risks and workforce implications and translating complex data into actionable recommendations.
  • Partner People & Culture, Business Leaders, Finance and Group Rewards on reward budgets, forecasts, policies and implementation, influencing decisions through sound judgement and evidence-based advice.
  • Strengthen reward governance and controls, and lead simplification, standardisation, automation and digitalisation of reward processes and ways of working.

**

What You'll Bring

  • Degree in HR, Business, Finance or a related discipline; professional Compensation & Benefits / Total Rewards certification and IHRP certification would be advantageous.
  • 7–10 years of relevant HR experience, with substantial Compensation & Benefits / Total Rewards experience and demonstrated ownership of complex reward processes or projects.
  • Strong knowledge of compensation principles, salary structures, market benchmarking and annual reward cycles.
  • Quantitative capability, including financial modelling, scenario analysis and development of business cases and management recommendations.
  • Sound judgement in reward governance, risk management and handling sensitive and confidential employee information.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to constructively challenge proposals and communicate recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint capabilities; exposure to workforce analytics, automation and emerging AI/digital HR practices would be advantageous.

job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

**

The IA Manager, Investigation is responsible for conducting and supporting investigations into allegations of fraud, corruption, whistleblower matters, misconduct and other breaches of Group policies involving Singtel, NCS and their respective subsidiaries. The role supports Singtel Group’s efforts to prevent, detect, investigate and respond to fraud and corruption risks, while strengthening internal controls and promoting a strong culture of integrity and accountability. This includes supporting the referral of appropriate matters to law enforcement agencies where warranted.

The IA Manager, Investigation also assist business and line management in discharging their responsibility for fraud risk management by developing and implementing proactive programmes and processes to reduce the risk of fraud and corruption. This includes but not be limited to methodologies and processes to prevent detect and assess fraud across all Business Units, their products services and processes and assisting in fraud prevention for new products, business channels and opportunities.

In addition, the IA Manager, Investigation supports other ad hoc internal audit projects and special reviews as directed by the Group Chief Internal Auditor and/or Head, Financial & Operational Audit and Investigation. The position reports directly to Head, Financial & Operational Audit and Investigation.

**

Make An Impact By

  • Independently plan and conduct investigations into allegations of fraud and other serious misconduct involving Singtel employees, contractors, agents or other representatives, securing and preserving appropriate evidence in a lawful manner to facilitate potential criminal prosecution by law enforcement agencies and maximise the recovery of losses incurred by the Company.
  • Manage multiple investigations simultaneously and effectively prioritise case workloads to ensure that matters are investigated, reported and resolved expeditiously in accordance with agreed timelines.
  • During investigations, identify weaknesses in processes and internal controls that have led, or could lead, to fraudulent activities, recommend appropriate remedial actions to management and secure management’s commitment to implement the agreed actions, and follow up on their implementation.
  • Recommend appropriate actions to HR in respect of employee found to have committed fraud.
  • Prepare high-quality and concise investigation reports that clearly present the relevant facts, evidence, findings, conclusions and recommendations arising from the investigations.
  • Assist in development and delivery of fraud awareness programmes for employees, contractors, agents and other representative across Singtel, NCS and its subsidiaries, as applicable.
  • Conduct internal and external environmental scanning to identify and analyse new and emerging fraud trends. Disseminate findings across Singtel and its subsidiaries in the form of advice and actionable intelligence.
  • Proactively identify and address control gaps and high-risk weaknesses in existing policies and procedures that may increase exposure to fraud and/or organised criminal activity.
  • Assist in managing all notifications and referrals of actual or suspected fraud, corruption or serious misconduct received through various reporting channels.
  • Collaborate with management to implement best practices in fraud prevention, detection and control.
  • Act as a liaison with law enforcement agencies on cases investigated and provide updates, as required.

Skills for Success

  • Tertiary qualifications in Fraud Risk Management, Investigations, or other related disciplines or equivalent work experience.
  • Demonstrable investigative and police liaison experience (minimum 5 years required).
  • Demonstrable experience in applying innovative analytical techniques.
  • A good understanding of Singapore criminal legislation.
  • Demonstrable innovative problem-solving skills, critical analysis of complex issues, and formulation of business solutions.
  • Strong Project Management skills.
  • Thorough knowledge of Forensic Accounting.
  • Exceptional communication skills in liaising with all levels of management, verbally and in writing allowing communication of complex material to audiences with varying levels of understanding.
  • Ability to articulate risk strategy and policy coherently and convincingly at a high level.
  • The ability to adapt to a changing work environment, comprehend complex issues, determine core issues and provide solutions within demanding time constraints.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

**

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.
