job.title: Sr Engineer-I/C-Industrial Water
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Engineer – Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) to lead the execution and delivery of global Industrial Water and Wastewater projects. In this role, you will provide technical leadership, manage project teams, and drive engineering excellence across Instrumentation, Control Systems, Automation, and Functional Safety aspects.

You will work closely with project managers, engineering managers, discipline & sub-discipline leaders, global engineering teams, and resource managers to deliver high-quality engineering solutions while contributing to team development, talent growth, and organizational objectives. The position combines project execution responsibilities with people leadership and strategic resource planning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Instrumentation and Control engineering activities for industrial water and wastewater projects.
  • Provide expertise in Instrumentation systems, Process analyzers, PLC, DCS, SCADA, and HMI systems, Industrial communication networks, Functional Safety, ESD systems, and interlocks.
  • Apply advanced engineering principles and innovative approaches to solve challenging technical problems.
  • Develop, review, and approve complex I&C engineering deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables meet quality, challenging schedule, budget, and client requirements.
  • Conduct technical evaluations and submittal reviews of vendor proposals, drawings, and documentation.
  • Collaborate effectively with clients, project teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
  • Promote compliance with company quality standards, engineering procedures, and industry best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, knowledge-sharing programs, risk management, and lessons-learned implementation.
  • Staff supervisory responsibilities as assigned.
  • Build and develop high-performing engineering teams in collaboration with global and regional leaders.
  • Career development along with talent development and training.
  • Support the India/APAC IC&C chief engineer with resources to drive efficient processes and tools.
  • Support Global growth strategy, hiring and staff forecasting including supplemental workforce planning.
  • Develop subject matter experts (SME’s) and staff to support/lead project & proposal efforts.
  • 80% of your time will be allocated for project execution and proposal responsibilities. With the expectation that the remaining time will be utilized to develop Industrial Water team and tools.
  • Provide Leadership to the team, nurture trust and develop talent.
  • Assist in hiring, workforce planning, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Foster a collaborative, agile, and inclusive work environment.

#LI-SB1#

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) Engineering or Electronics, or Electrical with instrumentation specialization or equivalent.
  • 15+ years of relevant experience in areas such as engineering design, project execution and leading teams
  • Experience in running large project teams, supervisor experience, technical expertise & problem-solving skills.
  • Looking for professional who can help mentor and coach others, not just execute the projects.
  • Looking for dynamic/adaptable/flexible professionals that understand alternative delivery models.
  • Experience with development execution process, standards & codes (ISA, IEC, NFPA), training etc is a plus. Understanding of codes, API, and water industry standards.
  • Preferred Client/Industry Experience (With Industrial Water Aligned Scope, i.e. Industrial Water Projects for these industries) in one or more industries below;
  • Data Centers
  • Semiconductor
  • Mining
  • Food and Beverage
  • Pharmaceuticals
  • Life Sciences
  • Preferred Delivery Method Experience (Alternative Delivery and Variety of Delivery Experience is a plus)
  • EPC
  • FEL/FEED
  • Design Build
  • Services
  • Familiarity with Industrial Water Clients, solutions, markets, and strategies.
  • Familiarity with I&C engineering processes & tools and local & international standards.
  • Good communication skills in written and spoken English.
  • Preferred Competencies
  • Technical leadership with excellent project execution & risk management
  • Process change management
  • Excellent problem-solving, decision making
  • Resources planning
  • Delegation
  • Conflict Management
  • Team building and Talent Development
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Drive for results/resolution
  • Leadership
  • Strategic and business needs planning

Minimum Qualifications

Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 11 years related work experience. All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

Certifications

Relevant Instrumentation, Automation, or Control Systems certifications

job.title: Maintenance Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

Lead end-to-end Plant Engineering & Maintenance across Machining, Engine Assembly & Test Beds, Utilities and Facilities, ensuring high uptime, reliability, safety, compliance and cost efficiency

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics Maintenance for 350+ machines/equipment across Machining and ATPU.
  • Drive preventive, predictive and condition-based maintenance, TPM, RCA and zero-breakdown culture.
  • Own equipment performance: OEE, uptime, MTBF, MTTR and breakdown reduction.
  • Manage facility and utilities including HT electrical systems, HVAC, compressors, DG, cranes, PIVs and civil infrastructure.
  • Lead Greenfield/Brownfield projects, CAPEX, new equipment installation, commissioning and plant upgrades.
  • Drive Industry 4.0, MES, digital maintenance and predictive analytics initiatives.
  • Manage spares, vendors, maintenance budgets and cost optimization.
  • Lead approximately 100 employees + 70 contract workforce across a 3-shift operation.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, environmental and statutory requirements including Factory Inspector, Electrical Inspector, PESO and MPCB.
  • Drive energy-efficiency initiatives and continuous improvement.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Drives engagement - Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Data Mining - Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.

Equipment/Capital Procurement - Selects manufacturing equipment which meets the Cummins manufacturing specifications and meets the project or program needs.

Manufacturing Prognostics - Applies prognostics techniques by collecting real time equipment conditions and then use advanced analytics and artificial intelligence technologies to project future failures to eliminate unplanned equipment and systems down time.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Preventative and Predictive Maintenance - Interprets machine and tool maintenance records and data to develop and execute preventative and predictive management strategies to drive continuous improvement within the manufacturing process.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Builds effective teams - Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

B.E./B.Tech – Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

18–22 years of plant engineering / maintenance experience

  • Strong exposure to Diesel Engine / Powertrain / Automotive manufacturing.
  • Hands-on experience in Machining + Engine Assembly + Test/Dyno.
  • Strong knowledge of CNC/VMC/SPM, TPM, SAP PM/Maximo, vibration analysis and thermography.
  • Experience with CAPEX/OPEX, facility management and large maintenance teams.
  • Knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 45001/14001/50001 and statutory compliance.
  • Strong shop-floor orientation with a 24x7 manufacturing mindset.

Key Deliverables

  • High equipment uptime and plant reliability.
  • Reduction in breakdowns and maintenance costs.
  • Effective execution of CAPEX and strategic projects.
  • Improved maintenance process maturity and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Optimized spare parts inventory and manufacturing overhead management.
  • Safe, compliant, and efficient facility operations.

job.title: Startup Account Manager, South, AWS Startups
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) offers a set of cloud services that enable all companies, from startups to enterprises, to run virtually everything in the cloud, including mobile applications, big data analytics, AI/ML platforms, and microservices/serverless infrastructures. Amazon Internet Services Private Limited (AISPL), the reseller for cloud services in India, is looking for a Senior Startup Account Manager to help drive the growth of high-potential startups in India. You need to possess passion about Startups, be a self-starter with a strong entrepreneurial spirit who is prepared to work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous environment, execute against ambitious goals, and consistently embrace the Amazon Culture. Your responsibilities will include driving growth and user adoption, migrations and ensuring startups select AWS as their preferred cloud provider in India. You will work closely with counterparts in business development, marketing, solution architecture and partner teams to lead execution of BD plays.

The candidate should have technical background that enables him/her to drive engagement at the CXO level as well as with software developers and IT architects. The candidate should be an exceptional analytical thinker who thrives in fast-paced dynamic environments and has excellent communication and presentation skills. He/She should be visioning and executing via collaboration with an extended team to address all startup’s needs.

Key job responsibilities

job.title: SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Lead — Logistics & Supply Chain
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

IS Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will co-own our SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud unit as a single value stream, leading everything non-finance - supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, procurement, and sales / order-to-cash — end to end. This is a fully accountable owner's seat in a clean-core, fast-moving environment with one mandate: run this unit as fast and as AI-automated as possible. You will own the operational outcome together with one equal peer who leads finance; there is no hand-off to a support team, and no hierarchy between you.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid #hybrid

Preferred location: India or Europe

This role is contributing to the Installation Products Division of the Electrification business area in Europe.

Main stakeholders are operations and supply chain, the Finance co-owner, and the central platform team

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Co-owning the unit as one value stream and owning the non-finance operations end-to-end - run as connected flows (source-to-pay, plan-to-produce, order-to-deliver), not module silos - with full accountability for a single shared outcome alongside the Finance co-owner.
  • Driving AI adoption at scale and stretching automation to its limit - beginning with test and regression automation against the continuous Public Cloud release cadence, then automating the operational flows themselves, deploying AI only where it moves a real metric.
  • Running the unit fast and lean - assessing every S/4 Public Cloud release for fit and new functionality, adopting what adds value while keeping the core clean, and drawing on the central team's Developer, Integration, and Reporting services to deliver (directing and consuming them, not duplicating them).
  • Co-owning the cross-functional seams with the Finance owner - order-to-cash and procure-to-pay run across both of you - so the end-to-end flow holds and nothing falls between operations and finance.

Our team dynamics

You will join a small, senior, high-ownership team — two equal co-owners running one unit — where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role

  • You have hands-on SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud experience - not Private, not ECC alone. You know the clean-core model, the release cadence, and what the Public Cloud will and will not allow.
  • You are driven to adopt AI at scale and push automation - test automation first - to its absolute limit; you treat a clean, fast-moving unit as a place to find the ceiling of what can run with no manual effort, not to hold a steady state.
  • You are highly skilled across the non-finance value chain - MM, PP, IM, LE/WM, SD, QM - and you think in end-to-end flows (source-to-pay, plan-to-produce, order-to-deliver), not isolated module configuration.
  • You have a demonstrated track record of extreme ownership, owning an outcome end to end (build and run) - and you can share a single outcome with an equal peer without building turf.
  • You are passionate about learning and intellectually honest - comfortable with ambiguity, quick to say "I don't know" or "I was wrong," and curious enough to outpace your own defensiveness.
  • You are at ease communicating in English; an additional European language is a plus.
  • A degree in engineering or a related technical field is a plus.

You hold a valid work authorization for the European market if applicable.

More about us

ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas&Betts), helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Division’s products are engineered to provide ease of installation and perform in demanding and harsh conditions, helping to ensure safety and continuous operation for utilities, businesses and people around the world. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty-Rap® cable ties, T&B Liquidtight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold™ reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac™ distribution connectors, Hi-Tech Valiant™ full-range current limiting fuse for fire mitigation, faulted current indicators and distribution connectors, cable accessories and apparatus with products for overhead and underground distribution. Manufacturing includes made-to-stock and custom-made solutions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Senior Security Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Security Analyst — Integrated Security Operations Center Location: Bengaluru, India Experience: Junior to mid-level Schedule: Rotating shifts supporting 24x7 operations

About the role

We are seeking a curious, detail-oriented Security Analyst to join our new Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) in Bengaluru.

You will monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts across our technology environment. Your core responsibility is 24x7 alert triage: separating suspicious activity from routine events, assessing impact, and taking timely, authorized action.

As operational needs and your skills evolve, you will also contribute to incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, and security improvement projects.

What you’ll do Security monitoring, triage, and response

  • Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, identity, email, network, and cloud security platforms.
  • Correlate logs and evidence to assess alert validity, severity, scope, and business impact.
  • Follow response playbooks; perform authorized containment and remediation; escalate complex or high-impact issues.
  • Maintain clear investigation records, document decisions, and provide thorough shift handoffs.
  • Partner with security, IT, and business teams to resolve issues and strengthen response quality.

Incident response and improvement

  • Support incident response through evidence collection, timeline development, scoping, containment, and recovery.
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews and improvements to playbooks, procedures, and operational knowledge.
  • Identify recurring alert patterns, workflow gaps, and automation opportunities.

Detection engineering and threat intelligence

  • Help develop, test, tune, and document detection rules to improve coverage and reduce false positives.
  • Review relevant threat intelligence and apply it to investigations and detection improvements.
  • Support indicator validation and guided threat-hunting activities.

Special projects

  • Contribute to projects such as onboarding security data sources, evaluating tools, improving reporting, and building lightweight automation.
  • Take on additional security operations responsibilities aligned with business needs and development goals while maintaining operational coverage.

What you’ll bring

  • Foundational knowledge of security operations, common attack techniques, and incident investigation.
  • Familiarity with Windows, Linux, networking, authentication, and enterprise or cloud services.
  • Experience with—or practical exposure to—security alerts, logs, and tools such as SIEM or EDR.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to follow procedures while knowing when to escalate.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including strong documentation and cross-shift collaboration.
  • Willingness to work scheduled shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Typically 1–4 years of relevant experience in security operations, incident response, IT operations, or a related field. Strong internships, labs, projects, or equivalent practical experience are also welcome.
  • A degree in cybersecurity, computer science, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience investigating phishing, malware, suspicious authentication, endpoint, or cloud security events.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and threat-informed investigations.
  • Basic scripting or query skills in Python, PowerShell, SQL, KQL, or SPL.
  • Exposure to SOAR platforms, detection development, or incident response exercises.
  • Certifications such as Security+, CySA+, or security-platform certifications. Helpful, but not required.

How you’ll grow You will help shape a new security operations center while building hands-on investigative experience. Over time, you can take greater ownership of investigations and contribute more deeply to incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, and security improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Security Monitoring - Security Tool Design and Development: -Plans and performs in-depth security assessments across a variety of products and services to identify potential vulnerabilities.

  • Creates testing tools to help engineering teams identify security-related weaknesses.
  • Conducts security design and provides recommendations and guidance for improvement.
  • Participates in reviews of security alerts.

Event Response: -Recognizes and escalates complex security violations to senior team members.

  • Follows protocols to take appropriate actions needed to contain and mitigate events.
  • Contributes to post-event reviews to identify areas for improvement.

Compliance: -Contributes to compliance assessments to identify gaps and ensure compliance with internal and external obligations.

  • Reviews security compliance deliverables and ensures adherence to policies and industry standards.
  • Implements measures to ensure compliance with internal and external obligations , collaborating with relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintains inventory systems from a security perspective.

Business Continuity Support: -Contributes to the development of business continuity and disaster recovery plans, processes, and procedures.

  • Ensures the execution of business continuity plans to support critical organizational systems and data in the face of disruptions.
  • Participates in assessing readiness for certification and/or audit to identify areas for improvement.

Data Security and Privacy: -Provides security best judgment and recommends best practices of data security using various tools and techniques such as encryption, hashing, masking, and access management to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive information.

  • Reviews documentation and procedures to identify areas for improvement in data security practices.

Research and Innovation: -Demonstrates advanced knowledge of industry security practices and seeks opportunities to expand knowledge through self-study and training.

  • Stays updated on emerging trends to stay ahead of evolving threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Explores novel techniques to solve unique security problems.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: -Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. Collaboration & Partnership: -Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. Problem Solving: -Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. Continuous Learning: -Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. Continuous Improvement: -Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. job.title: Senior Manager, Data Center Facilities Development
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Manager, Data Center Facility Development leads the planning, governance, and execution of data center construction and development projects in India. The role is accountable for programme, cost, risk, quality, safety, contractor performance, commissioning readiness, and handover across new builds, expansions, retrofits, and other critical infrastructure workstreams.

Working closely with internal partners and external providers, the role aligns construction delivery with design, network, operations, commissioning, real estate, and business requirements. The Senior Manager also directly manages and develops project and construction professionals, establishes consistent delivery practices, and drives timely resolution of issues that could affect project milestones or operational readiness.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1) Project & Program Delivery Leadership

Lead end-to-end delivery of assigned construction projects, including new builds, expansions, retrofits, and customer-driven delivery.

Own integrated delivery plans, milestones, readiness gates, and recovery actions to meet business commitments such as Early Access, RFS, energisation, network readiness, and customer turn-up.

Provide timely, fact-based project reporting and escalate material risks, decisions, and constraints to regional leadership.

2) Project Governance & Controls

Implement disciplined project controls across schedule, cost, risk, dependencies, change control, QA/QC, commissioning readiness, and handover.

Maintain accurate forecasts, critical-path plans, risk registers, issue logs, and action trackers; intervene early to remove constraints and protect delivery milestones.

Partner with PMO, Contracts, QS, and Procurement on commercial discipline, change management, claims exposure, and contractor performance.

3) Cross-Functional & Partner Management

Coordinate closely with Design, Network, Commissioning, Operations, Real Estate/Facilities Development, and external delivery partners to ensure plans and readiness criteria are aligned.

Act as a senior day-to-day point of contact for contractors, consultants, colocation partners, customers, and internal stakeholders during delivery.

Build productive working relationships across diverse technical and non-technical stakeholder groups, resolving issues with clarity and pace.

4) Safety, Quality & Operational Readiness

Champion a safety-first culture and ensure delivery activities comply with applicable site, company, and local regulatory requirements.

Drive quality assurance, inspections, defect management, system completion, commissioning readiness, and handover activities.

Ensure construction handover is complete, orderly, and suitable for transition into commissioning and operations.

5) People Leadership & Capability Building

Directly manage, coach, and develop Construction Managers, Project Managers, and/or project controls personnel, setting clear expectations and supporting performance growth.

Plan team capacity and resource allocation to meet the local delivery pipeline and changing business priorities.

Embed consistent delivery practices, templates, reporting rhythms, and lessons learned across the team.

Success Measures (KPIs)

Delivery performance: milestone attainment, schedule trend stability, critical-path reliability, and approved-budget performance.

Safety: incident performance, audit outcomes, and demonstrable safety leadership.

Quality & readiness: defect closure, commissioning-readiness gates, and handover-pack completeness.

job.title: Senior Construction Manager, Data Center Facilities Development
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Construction Manager, Data Center Infrastructure Development provides on-site leadership for the execution of mission-critical data center projects in Singapore. Working with project management, design, procurement, commissioning, operations, colocation providers, and contractors, the role oversees construction delivery across base-building, civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls, security, and life-safety systems.

The position is accountable for safe site operations, programme and milestone control, quality assurance, contractor performance, risk management, and issue resolution. The role ensures that construction work complies with approved designs, project standards, and applicable local requirements, while coordinating the interfaces needed for tenant fit-out, network deployment, testing, commissioning, and final handover.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Construction Leadership (AI / High-Density): Lead site-based delivery of AI data center infrastructure including base building, MEP, white space readiness, containment, and enabling works.

Colocation Provider Oversight: Direct and govern colocation provider execution to ensure work is delivered to OCI standards, with strong accountability for schedule, quality, and coordination.

Schedule & Milestone Control: Drive short-interval planning, look-aheads, constraint removal, and recovery actions to protect critical dates and readiness gates.

Independent Risk Evaluation: Independently assess delivery plans and actual progress to identify risk early, close gaps in mitigations, and clearly communicate potential business impacts.

Tenant Fit-Out & Network Readiness Integration: Coordinate interfaces across design, construction, and commissioning to ensure base building delivery supports tenant fit-out and network deployment readiness (space, power, cooling, cable routes, access windows, cleanliness).

Quality Assurance & Closeout: Own QA/QC execution including ITPs, inspections, NCRs, corrective actions, punch lists, progressive turnover, and closeout discipline.

Design & Change Coordination: Ensure construction aligns to approved design intent; support disciplined change control, field clarifications, and document governance.

Safety & Compliance: Lead safety performance and compliance with local regulations, codes, standards, and OCI requirements; drive audits, incident learnings, and corrective actions.

Vendor & Performance Management: Manage contractor and vendor performance, ensure scope compliance, and provide structured provider evaluation inputs for continuous improvement.

Reporting & Stakeholder Management: Run site cadence (daily/weekly), provide executive-ready updates, maintain action/issue registers, and escalate blockers quickly.

Site Presence and Travel: This is a site-based role in Singapore requiring strong on-the-ground leadership throughout the project lifecycle, with up to 25% travel as required for project delivery.

Required Skills & Experience

Deep data center construction knowledge: Strong expertise across civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls, and plumbing in mission-critical environments.

Lifecycle delivery experience: Proven capability through mobilization, construction, commissioning readiness, and turnover/handover.

High accountability leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead under pressure, drive delivery discipline, and mentor teams while holding vendors accountable.

Risk & problem solving: Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills in fast-paced, high-dependency construction environments.

Commercial awareness: Experience supporting contract administration inputs (variations, claims, EOTs, progress validation) with clear records and evidence.

Tools & systems: Strong reporting capability and familiarity with document/project platforms such as Aconex, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or similar.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

10+ years of experience in data center and/or colocation construction, gained with a GC, colocation provider, or hyperscaler.

Proven track record delivering large-scale construction outcomes across schedule, quality, safety, and stakeholder expectations.

job.title: Director, Data Center Facilities Development JAPAC
job.description:
Job Description

The Director Data Center Facilities Development JAPAC is accountable for the regional strategy, governance, and execution of new data center builds, expansions, retrofits, and capacity upgrades across JAPAC. The role leads a regional delivery team and works closely with Real Estate, Design, Network, Commissioning, Operations, contractors, utilities, and customers to deliver scalable, reliable, mission-critical facilities.

Responsibilities

1) Facilities Development Leadership (JAPAC Portfolio)

Own end-to-end facilities development outcomes across JAPAC programs, including new data center builds, expansions, retrofits, capacity upgrades, and customer-driven delivery.

Establish and maintain clear delivery governance: milestones, readiness gates, reporting cadence, and executive decision forums.

Ensure delivery plans align with business commitments, including capacity availability, early access, energisation, network readiness, commissioning, and customer turn-up.

2) Regional Process & Standardization

Implement and continuously improve regional facilities development processes covering program management, change control, risk, cost, QA/QC, commissioning readiness, and operational handover.

Standardise operating rhythms: weekly program cycle, critical path tracking, trend reporting, and issue escalation.

Build repeatable toolsets and templates, including dashboards, site-readiness checklists, handover packs, commissioning-readiness plans, and risk registers.

3) Program Governance & Controls

Drive disciplined schedule, risk, and dependency management across multiple parallel projects.

Lead critical path intervention and recovery planning when needed (acceleration plans, resource smoothing, constraint removal).

Ensure strong management of change, claims exposure, procurement interfaces, and commercial discipline in partnership with PMO, Contracts, and Quantity Surveying teams.

4) Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

Align Facilities Development with Real Estate, Design, Network, Commissioning, and Operations to ensure integrated planning, capacity delivery, and operational readiness.

Act as the senior point of contact for facilities development execution across internal leadership, colocation partners, consultants, general contractors, utilities, and customers.

Lead executive-level communication—clear, concise, data-driven reporting with recommended actions/decisions.

5) Safety, Quality, and Readiness

Champion a “safety-first” culture and ensure compliance with regional and site safety requirements.

Drive quality assurance practices, including inspections, defect management, systems completion, integrated testing, and commissioning readiness.

Ensure consistent handover, documentation, and site standards across the transition from construction to commissioning and operations.

6) Team Leadership & Capability Building

Lead and develop a high-performing regional facilities development team, including Construction Managers, Project Managers, PMO, and program controls professionals.

Build regional capacity plans and resource strategies that match the JAPAC data center development pipeline.

Coach leaders to improve communication, stakeholder engagement, and disciplined execution.

Success Measures (KPIs)

Delivery performance: capacity and milestone attainment, early access and RFS performance, schedule trend stability, and critical-path reliability.

Safety: incident rates, audit outcomes, and safety culture indicators.

Quality and readiness: defect closure rates, commissioning and integrated-testing gates passed, handover-pack completeness, and operational acceptance.

Governance: on-time reporting, accurate forecasting, effective escalations/decision turnaround.

Process maturity: adoption of the regional facilities development system, measurable cycle-time reductions, and fewer recurring delivery issues.

Required Experience & Qualifications

12+ years of construction, facilities development, or program delivery experience, ideally in mission-critical environments such as data centers, critical infrastructure, industrial, pharmaceutical, aviation, or utilities.

Proven leadership delivering multi-project data center or critical-facility portfolios across JAPAC. Experience in Singapore and/or Australia is highly valued.

Strong understanding of the full data center development lifecycle: site and utility interfaces, design coordination, construction execution, commissioning, integrated testing, and operational handover.

Demonstrated capability building scalable processes, governance frameworks, and delivery teams across multiple markets.

Exceptional stakeholder management across technical and non-technical teams.

Familiarity with contract/commercial management and schedule/cost controls.

Preferred

Experience delivering hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center programs.

Knowledge of data center commissioning, integrated systems testing, and operational-readiness gating.

Experience working with colocation or partner delivery models, utilities, and integrated network and customer dependencies.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strategic leadership and execution focus: able to set direction and drive facilities development outcomes.

Program governance and schedule discipline; familiarity with P6 or MS Project is a plus.

Strong risk, dependency, and escalation management.

High EQ, executive communication, and cross-cultural leadership across JAPAC markets.

job.title: Logistics Technician
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Logistics Technician within our Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT) team, you will perform cycle audits, execute incoming/outgoing deliveries, [co-ordinate security escorts for third-party vendors](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393557002720?hl=en?timeout=20), and document inbound and outbound deliveries. This early careers opportunity will allow you to deepen your knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction and advance your career in the process. This role is based 100% onsite within one of our Data Centers based in Canberra.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our Data Center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Leverage process knowledge and best judgment to complete tasks with minimal direct supervision.
  • Maintain a strong focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks.
  • Maintain and steward up-to-date and accurate logical information within various inventory management systems (e.g., configuration management databases, asset management repositories).
  • Ensure detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.
  • Help to reconcile and report inventory discrepancies.
  • Perform destruction of data bearing devices (DBD) following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Microsoft policies as necessary.
  • Notify management about ordering stock shortages. Escalate any issues to management.
  • Comply with security and data management policies.
  • Embody our [culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, or TAFE AND 1+ year(s) industry work experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, and/or logistics, inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field.
  • OR equivalent industry work experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • Citizenship Verification: This position requires verification of Australian Citizenship to meet federal government security requirements, this includes verification of a current Australian Passport.
  • NV1/2, PV Clearance Assessment: This position may require an enhanced background check conducted through the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency.

Whilst not required, we also look for the following_Preferred_ Qualifications:

  • 2+ year(s) industry work experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, IT, and/or logistics, operating heavy-load movement equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, chassis lifts) for a large corporation
  • OR equivalent industry work experience.

Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about [requesting accommodations.](https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/accessibility.html)

job.title: Project Engineer – IR
job.description:
**

Job Description

Shape the Future of Smart, Sustainable Infrastructure with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls (JCI), we're reimagining how buildings and critical facilities operate. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable building solutions, we help organisations optimise energy performance, improve safety and security, enhance operational resilience, and achieve their sustainability goals.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry leadership, Johnson Controls partners with customers across commercial buildings, healthcare, data centres, education, advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, mining, and critical infrastructure. Our cutting-edge technologies, digital platforms, and engineering expertise are driving the next generation of intelligent and connected environments.

Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer (Projects & Design) to join our Brisbane team, contributing to the design and delivery of complex electrical systems and engineered solutions for high-profile projects.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

At JCI, you'll be part of a global organisation that invests in its people and provides genuine opportunities for long-term career growth.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary package with career development opportunities
  • Work with industry-leading technologies and complex engineering projects
  • Strong commitment to work-life balance and employee wellbeing
  • Access to world-class training, technical development, and leadership programs
  • Global mobility and career progression opportunities within Johnson Controls
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment

About the Role

As an Electrical Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, development, and delivery of electrical systems, ensuring projects are completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest engineering standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop low-voltage electrical systems and switchboards
  • Produce engineering drawings, schematics, calculations, and technical documentation
  • Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), commissioning, troubleshooting, and system validation activities
  • Ensure designs comply with relevant Australian and international standards including AS/NZS, IEC, ANZEx, and IECEx requirements
  • Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and continuous safety improvement initiatives
  • Collaborate closely with project managers, manufacturing teams, contractors, and customers to deliver high-quality outcomes
  • Provide technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from concept through to commissioning

About You

We're looking for a motivated engineer who enjoys working on technically challenging projects and thrives in a collaborative environment.

You will bring:

  • Electrical trade background and/or Degree in Electrical Engineering
  • Minimum 4 years' experience in electrical design and project delivery
  • RPEQ registration, or the ability to obtain registration
  • Strong working knowledge of AutoCAD and PowerCAD
  • Experience designing switchboards and LV electrical systems
  • Sound understanding of Australian electrical standards and compliance requirements

Highly Regarded:

  • Experience within mining, oil & gas, defence, manufacturing, utilities, or other hazardous industrial environments
  • Knowledge of instrumentation, hazardous area installations, and Ex-certified equipment
  • Familiarity with hazardous area certification processes and IECEx requirements

Join a Global Industry Leader

If you're looking to advance your engineering career with a company at the forefront of innovation, sustainability, and critical infrastructure solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and be part of building smarter, safer, and more sustainable environments for the future.

Applicants must have Australian working rights. Employment is subject to successful completion of pre-employment medical, police, reference, and drug & alcohol screening.

job.title: Associate Service Sales Engineer
job.description:
About us

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do

As Associate Service Sales Engineer, you will be supporting the sale of Labour & Materials (L&M) labour hours, travel, and materials for service tasks, and the sale/administration of Planned Service Agreements (PSA) for uptime.

Gain exposure to digitalization and retrofit opportunities while working under supervision to help generate quotes, manage opportunities, and engage customers.

How You Will Do It:

Primary Responsibilities (L&M & PSA Focus)

  • L&M sales:

Assist in pricing and selling Labour & Materials for field service tasks, including labour hours, labour rates, travel charges, and materials used. Ensure quotes reflect accurate scoping and margin targets, with engineering support as needed.

  • Quote preparation:

Prepare clear L&M quotations with defined labour, travel, and materials elements; use standard templates and guidance to ensure consistency.

  • PSA sales

Support the promotion and administration of PSA (Planned Service Agreements) for uptime, including quoting, basic proposal development, and coordination with operations and teams.

  • Attaching L&M/PSA:

Work with teams to identify opportunities to include L&M on service jobs or to offer PSA alongside existing services; support strategies to improve attach rates.

  • Customer data collection:

Gather site and equipment data, maintenance history, and usage information to tailor L&M quotes and PSA scopes; maintain accurate records in the CRM.

  • CRM & documentation:

Keep opportunities, quotes, and related documents up to date in the CRM; ensure accuracy and compliance of commercial paperwork.

Secondary Responsibilities (Digitalization & Retrofit)

  • Digitalization support: Assist in promoting digital service offerings (monitoring platforms, connectivity) by collecting customer data and supporting value-based proposals as directed.
  • Retrofit support: Aid in identifying retrofit/upgrade opportunities; coordinate with field/engineering teams for initial scoping and proposal preparation.

Operational & Support Responsibilities

  • Quotation support: Prepare quotes, pricing inquiries, and basic technical proposals under supervision; ensure timely, accurate documentation.
  • Customer engagement: Assist in proactive communication before, during, and after quotes; follow up on AR, PO, TOC, and other commercial documents.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Support regional offices and coordinate with Operations, Procurement, and Engineering to fulfill customer needs; assist with market surveys and competitive analysis as required.
  • Documentation & delivery: Ensure electronic documentation is complete and compliant; support timely parts delivery and service execution planning

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • L&M quotes won and L&M attach rate (percentage of opportunities converting to L&M quotes/sales).
  • PSA revenue, gross margin, and renewal activity (as applicable).
  • L&M/PSA pipeline growth and conversion rate.
  • On-time service delivery and adherence to project timelines.
  • Margin achievement on L&M and PSA engagements.
  • Customer satisfaction and retention metrics.

Relationships

  • Internal: Sales, Operations, Admin, Procurement, Engineering, Regional Offices.
  • External: Customers, Vendors, Contractors, Service Partners.

What We Look For:

  • Qualifications & Experience:

Diploma or Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related) or equivalent.

  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in service sales, maintenance, or related field; experience with L&M stand-alone quotes or service work is a plus.
  • Exposure to industrial sectors (manufacturing, oil & gas, heavy equipment) is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with digital service platforms is advantageous.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Foundational sales aptitude with ability to articulate value-based solutions.
  • Customer-centric, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and able to work independently as well as across functions.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills; proficient with CRM and MS Office.
  • Quick learner, willing to develop expertise in L&M (Labour & Materials) and PSA.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Senior Manager, Communications
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

The Senior Manager, Corporate Communications will lead day-to-day and proactive communications across Singapore, Malaysia and India.

Based in Singapore or Malaysia, the role will translate AirTrunk’s corporate communications strategy into market-level activity, building stakeholder confidence, strengthening executive visibility and supporting the company’s growth across the region.

The role will work across media, social and internal channels and partner closely with regional leadership, Corporate Affairs, development, operations, energy and sustainability, commercial and people teams.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced communications professional who can develop strategy, write high-quality content, manage issues and build trusted relationships with media, government, industry and community stakeholders.

Your Day to Day

  • Strategy and planning: Translate the global communications strategy into quarterly market plans, maintain the regional runway, identify emerging issues and opportunities, and align and repurpose communications across Singapore, Malaysia and India.
  • Corporate narrative and messaging: Adapt and maintain AirTrunk’s regional narrative, message house, Q&As, proof points and briefing materials, ensuring consistency across markets, spokespeople and channels as priorities evolve.
  • Executive and leadership communications

Support executive positioning across the region by identifying opportunities and preparing speeches, talking points, media briefs, interviews, LinkedIn content and training.

  • Media relations: Build priority media relationships, develop narrative-by-outlet plans, pursue proactive opportunities and manage pitches, briefings, outreach, embargoes, spokespeople and agency coordination.
  • Thought leadership, campaigns and content: Develop campaigns and high-quality content that explain AirTrunk’s role in digital infrastructure and demonstrate its contribution to local skills, suppliers, communities, energy infrastructure and economic growth.
  • Issues and crisis communications: Monitor emerging issues, prepare response materials and crisis scenarios, advise regional leaders on reputational risks and coordinate timely, factual and consistent responses.
  • Social and internal communications: Manage regional corporate and executive social calendars, develop content and case studies from across the business, and support internal communications that connect employees to regional priorities and AirTrunk’s reputation.

What success looks like

  • Regional executives are better prepared and more visible on priority issues and themes.
  • AirTrunk has stronger relationships with priority media and external stakeholders.
  • Communications activity is increasingly proactive, with campaigns, thought leadership and executive positioning complementing announcements and reactive work.
  • Emerging issues are identified early and managed with clear, consistent advice.
  • AirTrunk’s narrative is understood and consistently represented across markets and channels.
  • Communications demonstrate AirTrunk’s contribution to digital infrastructure, local economies, communities, skills and supply chains.
  • Regional activity delivers measurable improvements in reach, engagement, sentiment, share of voice and stakeholder confidence.

Requirements

  • 12+ corporate communications experience.
  • Experience working across Southeast Asia, ideally Singapore and Malaysia, with an understanding of the Indian market.
  • Strong writing and editing skills across media, executive, social and internal communications.
  • Experience advising senior executives and preparing them for media, speaking and stakeholder engagements.
  • Experience developing proactive campaigns and thought leadership, not only managing announcements.
  • Strong judgement in handling complex, sensitive or fast-moving issues.
  • Ability to understand complex technical, infrastructure, energy or policy issues and explain them clearly.
  • Experience managing agencies and working across a regional or matrixed organisation.
  • Strong stakeholder and relationship-building skills.
  • Cultural awareness and the ability to adapt communications to different markets.
  • A practical, collaborative and hands-on approach.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Accountant - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a strong and experienced statutory accountant with a solid background in financial reporting, IFRS, local GAAP, external audit or technical accounting. The successful candidate will bring a strong accounting foundation, sound judgement and the ability to apply accounting principles across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions.

Previous experience in CAPEX accounting, fixed assets or project accounting is advantageous, but it is not essential. CAPEX accounting can be learned. More important is an analytical mindset, attention to detail and a natural curiosity to investigate issues, challenge unusual results and understand the drivers behind financial outcomes.

CAPEX and fixed asset accounting will become the successful candidate’s area of specialisation. The role will support the accounting, reporting and statutory compliance of capital expenditure, fixed assets and capital projects within a multinational environment that reports under US GAAP while also meeting local statutory reporting and financial statement filing requirements.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop specialised CAPEX expertise while applying and expanding strong statutory accounting and financial reporting skills within a dynamic global finance organisation.

Responsibilities

  • Support the accounting, reporting and statutory compliance of capital expenditure, fixed assets and capital projects
  • Prepare and review financial information, reconciliations and supporting schedules in accordance with applicable accounting standards and reporting requirements
  • Support the preparation of statutory financial statements and disclosures, ensuring compliance with local GAAP, IFRS and other relevant accounting frameworks
  • Analyse financial data, investigate variances and identify the root causes of accounting and reporting discrepancies
  • Partner with operational teams, project managers, procurement and other stakeholders to ensure the completeness and accuracy of financial information
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, reconciliations and technical accounting support
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives that strengthen controls, reporting quality and operational efficiency
  • Assist in the implementation and application of accounting policies within a multinational reporting environment, including exposure to US GAAP reporting requirements
  • Stay informed of developments in accounting standards and statutory reporting requirements across relevant jurisdictions
  • Support and collaborate with team members across finance and accounting functions to promote best practices and knowledge sharing

Qualifications

  • Qualified accountant (CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA or equivalent)
  • Strong experience in statutory accounting, financial reporting, general ledger accounting, technical accounting, external audit or a related finance function
  • Good knowledge of IFRS, local GAAP or other recognised accounting frameworks
  • Experience preparing, reviewing or supporting statutory financial statements and disclosures
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve accounting issues
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy
  • Ability to identify unusual trends, balances and variances and perform detailed analysis to determine underlying causes
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced international environment
  • Experience with fixed asset accounting, CAPEX accounting, project accounting or asset management processes
  • Exposure to US GAAP reporting requirements
  • Experience working within a multinational organisation, shared services environment or global finance function
  • Experience supporting multiple legal entities and jurisdictions
  • Knowledge of Oracle or other enterprise financial systems

What Will Make You Successful

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has a genuine affinity for numbers and financial analysis
  • Enjoys investigating discrepancies and understanding the story behind the numbers
  • Demonstrates strong professional curiosity and a willingness to challenge unusual outcomes
  • Takes ownership of issues and follows them through to resolution
  • Can balance technical accounting requirements with practical business realities
  • Thrives in a collaborative global environment and continuously seeks opportunities for improvement

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to develop specialised CAPEX and fixed asset expertise within a global finance organisation
  • Exposure to US GAAP, IFRS and local statutory reporting requirements across multiple jurisdictions
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment with opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Ongoing training and coaching to build expertise in CAPEX accounting and related technical accounting topics
  • Meaningful involvement in statutory reporting, technical accounting and process improvement initiatives that drive business value

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

job.title: Regional Due Diligence Director, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Description

The Program Director is accountable for leading the front-end development lifecycle of new data center opportunities across APAC, progressing projects from initial site identification through land acquisition and execution readiness. Acting as the central coordinator across internal and external stakeholders, this role drives due diligence, investment decision-making, and governance processes to maximize site conversion and ensure development opportunities align with Vantage's strategic growth objectives.

The Program Director will oversee cross-functional due diligence programs spanning site evaluation, technical and infrastructure assessments, commercial analysis, and risk management. A key responsibility will be leading governance frameworks, stage-gate processes, and investment approval pathways to ensure opportunities meet defined criteria before advancing. The role will provide transparency across the APAC project pipeline, develop robust business cases, and lead the preparation and presentation of investment recommendations to the APAC Investment Council and other executive decision-making forums.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration across Leadership, Site Selection, Design & Engineering, Construction, Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and other subject matter experts. Acting as a key integrator, the Program Director will align technical, commercial, operational, and strategic priorities, drive decision-making through effective governance, and ensure Vantage has the right capacity in the right markets at the right time to support customer demand and long-term growth across the APAC region.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council, driving strategic investment decisions, prioritization of development opportunities and portfolio growth initiatives across the region.
  • Lead and manage all aspects of technical and commercial due diligence and front-end planning for new development projects, including site assessments, feasibility studies, conceptual design, due diligence workstreams, power and fibre strategy development, entitlement, and permitting activities.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment between development, investment, operations, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure successful project execution and achievement of regional growth objectives.
  • Lead the definition and execution of due diligence programs for complex infrastructure development opportunities, ensuring key technical, commercial, regulatory, and delivery risks are identified, appropriately investigated, and assessed to support investment, acquisition, and development decision-making.

Duties

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council process, providing transparency across the regional development pipeline, developing robust business cases, and preparing and presenting investment recommendations to executive leadership and decision-making forums.
  • Serve as the primary owner of front-end development activities, driving opportunities from site identification through land acquisition by coordinating due diligence, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and investment approvals to improve conversion of site selection opportunities.

  • Lead and manage relationships with external consultants, landowners, contractors, utilities, government authorities, regulatory agencies, and industry stakeholders to secure successful project outcomes and maintain development momentum.
  • Drive project outcomes from concept through execution readiness, establishing scope, schedule, budget, governance frameworks, consultant engagement strategies, and business case approvals while maintaining alignment with strategic objectives and investment criteria.
  • Oversee portfolio reporting and governance, ensuring leadership maintains full visibility of pipeline health, site conversion performance, project risks, costs, schedules, market dynamics, and capital deployment priorities.
  • Identify and mitigate development, permitting, commercial, infrastructure, and execution risks to support successful project advancement and informed investment decisions.

  • Champion continuous improvement by incorporating lessons learned, market intelligence, industry trends, and best practices to enhance development processes, strengthen governance, and support Vantage's long-term growth strategy across APAC.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Degree in Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Flexibility to travel regularly across APAC.
  • Adaptable, self-motivated, and comfortable working across multiple time zones, cultures, and remote environments.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.
