job.title: Customer Order Management Representative - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

The Customer Order Management Representative Level III under minimal supervision and in accordance with Cummins Delegation of Authority Policy uses analytical and quantitative methods to understand, predict, and enhance supply chain processes. Collaborative cross-functional intelligence to validate and execute the demand plan and shorten the order to cash cycle. Aligns the supply plan with the demand plan and drives stability in the supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for assigned customer accounts for the entire order life cycle (from new customer set-up, order entry/modification, escalations; responsibilities might include logistics management) to ensure orders are shipped to agreed deadline.
  • Act as the single-point-of-contact to Cummins' customers, parts distribution centers and/or manufacturing plants and cross functional departments to process and fulfil customer orders; providing accurate documentation and continual communication to customer throughout the process.
  • Take ownership of and resolve complex customer inquiries through extensive research, a detailed understanding of Cummins processes, systems, and practices; provide timely and informative responses as per the Service Level Agreement.
  • Request support from the next appropriate level of customer support for complex escalations/issues providing documentation throughout the process.
  • Maintain accurate records of all internal and external interactions in the appropriate database/system.
  • Ensures customers comply with export polices and ensures required export/shipping documentation is compiled to the relevant legislation.
  • Acts as liaison between the customer and aftermarket and/or manufacturing location for quality issues; submit Material Non-Conformance or Process Non-Conformance.
  • Conformance claims via the Quality Management System.
  • Knowledge of Quality Management Systems.
  • Supports Supervisor with hosting customer visits at local facility.
  • Prepare and distribute standard and customized internal and customer reports.
  • Understands Customer Order Management policies, procedures and metrics.
  • Support Customer Order Management departmental goals and initiatives to become a more proactive customer support organization.
  • Serves as Quality Management Systems Champion (e.g. Internal Auditor Certification) and/or Subject Matter Expert.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Customer Support - Demonstrates how proactive customer support interactions are required at each phase of the order life cycle to ensure customer satisfaction; describes how customer support and the order life cycle are interconnected to ensure an overall positive customer experience.

Order Life Cycle - Demonstrates the phases of the end-to-end order life cycle, terminology and functional collaboration that enable customer orders to be fulfilled; describes how the order life cycle and customer support are interconnected to ensure an overall positive customer experience

Order Life Cycle Systems Knowledge - Demonstrates the steps within each system screen to process customer orders, order modifications and respond to customer queries to ensure accurate and timely order processing and query resolution.

Order Processing - Demonstrates the steps necessary to manage the processing of customer orders through order receipt, exception identification and resolution to ensure orders are fulfilled to customer requirements

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Degree in related field preferred.

2 plus years of relevant customer order management, account management or in the supply chain field

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Team focused and passionate about customer support

Time management: Demonstrates effective and efficient use of individual and organizational time to achieve key business objectives

Attention to detail: Accurate data entry skills Fast typing speed with accuracy, extreme attention to detail

job.title: Tendering Manager – EHV Substations
job.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day (Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS & GIS Substation Projects)

As the Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS & GIS Substation Projects, you will lead the end-to-end tendering and bid management activities for High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) substation projects, transmission and distribution infrastructure, EPC packages, and related power system solutions. You will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing winning bid strategies, managing techno-commercial proposals, and ensuring competitive positioning across utility and private sector markets.

In this leadership role, you will collaborate closely with engineering, procurement, project management, finance, legal, and supply chain teams to deliver high-quality and profitable bids. You will engage with customers, utilities, consultants, and EPC partners while leveraging market intelligence, risk assessment, and pricing strategies to maximize business success. We are looking for an experienced tendering professional with deep expertise in AIS/GIS substations, power infrastructure projects, and business acquisition who can combine technical knowledge, commercial acumen, and market insight to drive sustainable growth and successful project acquisitions.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Drive business growth by identifying and evaluating tender opportunities across HV/EHV AIS & GIS substations, transmission lines, switchyards, EPC projects, and power infrastructure developments.
  • Monitor utility tenders, government procurement portals, private sector RFQs, and emerging market opportunities to support strategic business expansion.
  • Lead bid/no-bid evaluations by assessing project viability, competitive landscape, risk profiles, customer requirements, and organizational capabilities.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with utilities, consultants, EPC partners, renewable developers, industrial customers, and key industry stakeholders.
  • Lead the complete tendering lifecycle from opportunity identification through bid submission and contract award.
  • Review tender documents, technical specifications, BOQs, drawings, contractual conditions, and commercial requirements to ensure comprehensive bid compliance.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including engineering, procurement, finance, legal, projects, and supply chain functions for successful bid preparation.
  • Develop and submit technical proposals, commercial offers, prequalification documents, and supporting credentials in line with customer requirements.
  • Conduct detailed techno-commercial assessments, evaluating project scope, engineering solutions, execution methodologies, delivery schedules, and resource requirements.
  • Identify project risks, commercial exposures, contractual deviations, and mitigation strategies to protect business interests.
  • Prepare management approval notes, bid strategy documents, and executive summaries to support informed decision-making.
  • Develop competitive project costing models, pricing strategies, and profitability assessments while maintaining strong win probability.
  • Perform market intelligence studies, competitor benchmarking, pricing analysis, and commodity trend assessments to strengthen bid competitiveness.
  • Coordinate with vendors, OEMs, and suppliers to obtain optimized quotations, technical inputs, and commercial support.
  • Prepare project cash-flow analyses, margin evaluations, and business case assessments to support commercial decision-making.
  • Analyze transmission, distribution, renewable integration, AIS/GIS technology, and utility investment trends to support strategic growth initiatives.
  • Maintain bid databases, pricing benchmarks, and competitive intelligence repositories to enhance future tendering effectiveness.
  • Conduct customer meetings, technical discussions, pre-bid clarifications, and tender negotiations to position Siemens Energy as a preferred partner.
  • Participate in site visits for scope validation, feasibility assessment, logistics evaluation, constructability reviews, and risk identification.
  • Review contractual terms and conditions, identify commercial and contractual risks, and recommend negotiation strategies and risk mitigation measures.
  • Support post-tender activities including customer clarifications, techno-commercial discussions, contract finalization, and project handover to execution teams.
  • Drive lessons learned and post-bid reviews to continuously improve bid quality, competitiveness, and business acquisition success rates.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech).
  • MBA in Marketing, Operations, Finance, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • 12-20 years of professional experience in tendering, estimation, proposal engineering, business acquisition, or bid management within the power sector.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience specifically focused on HV/EHV AIS and GIS substation projects.
  • Strong expertise in AIS substations up to 765 kV and GIS substations up to 400 kV/765 kV.
  • Deep understanding of transmission line projects, switchyards, EPC contracting, and power system infrastructure projects.
  • Strong knowledge of protection and control systems, power transformers, reactors, HV switchgear, GIS equipment, SCADA, SAS, and communication systems.
  • Proven experience managing tenders for utility customers including PGCIL, State Utilities, SEBs, DISCOMs, Railways, Metro projects, and other government entities.
  • Demonstrated experience in bidding for private sector customers including industrial facilities, renewable energy developers, data centers, oil & gas companies, and commercial infrastructure projects.
  • Strong understanding of utility tendering procedures, contractual frameworks, project execution models, and regulatory requirements.
  • Expertise in project costing, pricing strategy development, margin optimization, and financial risk assessment.
  • Experience conducting competitor analysis, market intelligence studies, benchmark assessments, and business opportunity evaluations.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance competitiveness, profitability, and project execution risks.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric approach.
  • Proven experience working within cross-functional, multicultural, and matrix organizations.
  • Professional proficiency in English with excellent verbal, written, presentation, and business communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel as required for customer meetings, site assessments, bid discussions, and business development activities.

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio offering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens-energy-india.com

https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by #TeamPurpleIndia. job.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

ROLE SUMMARY

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Database Reliability Engineer to join our Engineering and Technology team. You will own and evolve the operational datastore platform that Firmus AI Cloud and our internal platform services depend on. The work sits on bare-metal and self-hosted infrastructure as well as cloud, with proven recovery and measurable reliability as first-class product qualities. You build a paved road so product teams can provision and change databases safely, with low cognitive load, instead of waiting on a ticket queue.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architecture & Standards

Set and improve how we run databases for customer-facing and internal platform workloads. Choose the right pattern for the job: relational, document, NoSQL, or cache. Define connection pooling and database proxies. Define how we scale with vertical growth, read replicas, sharding or partitioning, and multi-site setups. Set HA and failover standards for shared multi-tenant systems. Keep tenant isolation clear and limit blast radius when something fails.

  • Automation & Lifecycle

Own provisioning, config, upgrades, backup, restore, and decommissioning with infrastructure as code and solid automation. Set RPO and RTO. Prove restore and failover with regular drills. Give product teams safe self-service for routine database work so they do not wait on you for every change.

  • Reliability & Performance

Own production health across on-premises and cloud database: SLOs, capacity, query performance, and database monitoring. Fix hard production issues such as lock contention, replication lag, memory or storage pressure, slow queries, and storage or network bottlenecks. Join on-call, lead post-mortems, and turn fixes into automation or better runbooks. Track storage and compute cost when you plan capacity.

  • Security & Compliance

Own access control, encryption in transit and at rest, audit logging, and change control for the databases. Extend Firmus SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 controls as we add sites and services. Keep backup, restore, and recovery evidence ready for audit. Keep privileged access tight.

  • Partnership & Escalations

Work with software and platform engineers on schema design, safe migrations, data modelling, and performance reviews before release. Work with data engineering and observability where your databases connect to their systems, such as CDC (Change Data Capture), read replicas, and database telemetry. Run design reviews that raise the bar. Join customer escalations when the issue is database reliability, performance, or recovery.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years in database reliability engineering. At least 3 years owning PostgreSQL in large-scale production, such as high concurrency, large datasets, or multi-tenant services. That includes replication, failover, backup and restore, query tuning, and incidents you owned.
  • Deep PostgreSQL performance troubleshooting under load, including planner behaviour, locking, bloat, and connection storms.
  • Hands-on with a PostgreSQL HA and backup stack such as Patroni-style HA, pgBackRest or WAL-G, and pgBouncer or a similar pooler. Has shipped schema or major version changes under load.
  • Production Redis or Memcached ownership. Has run it with HA or clustering, managed memory and eviction under load, and made clear persistence and failover choices.
  • Production experience with at least one document or NoSQL store such as MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar. Includes HA or replica setup, backup and restore, and at least one failure mode you diagnosed yourself.
  • Automates database work with infrastructure as code and Python or Go. Experience with stateful databases on Kubernetes and operators is valued.
  • Has defined RPO and RTO, run restore and failover drills, and owned SLOs, on-call, and post-mortems that led to lasting fixes.
  • Understands the Linux storage and network path that affects database performance. Has used Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar for database monitoring.
  • Has operated databases under compliance such as SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Willing to take part in the incident-response on-call rotation for the databases you own.
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Singapore
  • Report to: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

Job Summary

The End User Technology (EUT) Platform Engineer is responsible for the design, deployment, administration, support, and continuous improvement of enterprise end-user computing environments across both Windows and macOS platforms. This role provides advanced technical support, manages device lifecycle and software deployment processes, delivers platform engineering and packaging services, and ensures security, compliance, performance, and user experience across desktop and mobile technologies.

The engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Security, Infrastructure, Networking, and Service Management, to support global end-user technologies and drive automation, standardization, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Administration

  • Design, deploy, administer, and maintain Windows 10/11 and macOS environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and security.
  • Manage endpoint lifecycle activities including provisioning, imaging, deployment, configuration, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning.
  • Administer endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune and other Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain endpoint policies, configurations, and compliance standards.
  • Manage software distribution processes, application updates, and deployment strategies.
  • Develop deployment automation and packaging solutions using scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to validate application compatibility and deployment readiness.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide Level 3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents involving hardware, operating systems, applications, and device management technologies.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Windows, macOS, mobile devices, software deployments, and endpoint security.
  • Participate in major incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, and service restoration activities.

Identity & Collaboration Services

  • Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), and Microsoft 365 services.
  • Support authentication, device enrollment, access management, and endpoint integration with enterprise services.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain endpoint security controls and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor system health, vulnerabilities, patch compliance, and security posture across managed devices.
  • Partner with Security teams to remediate risks and maintain compliance with corporate standards.

Operations & Service Improvement

  • Monitor platform performance, capacity utilization, and operational metrics.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and user experience enhancements.
  • Participate in change management, release management, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Support onboarding activities, technical projects, and strategic transformation efforts.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Document solutions, best practices, deployment methodologies, and known issues.
  • Provide training, guidance, and mentoring to end users and IT teams on platform technologies and processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 6+ years of experience supporting enterprise end-user computing environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Windows 10/11 and macOS administration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with endpoint management solutions such as Microsoft Intune, and equivalent MDM platforms.
  • Experience with application packaging, deployment, and software lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), Microsoft 365, and identity management concepts.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint security, compliance, and device management best practices.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and customer service skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively within global cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of virtualization and modern endpoint management practices.
  • Understanding of network fundamentals and endpoint connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting cloud-first workplace technologies and modern device management strategies.
  • Exposure to Zero Trust security principles and endpoint compliance frameworks.

Key Personal Attributes

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-focused with a commitment to delivering exceptional user experiences.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Continuous learner with a passion for emerging end-user technologies.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented.

job.title: Sr. Application Engineer I
job.description:
Job Description

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Fire Alarm Panels, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Knowledge on Simplex & Zettler fire alarm product along with Xtralis, Securiton & Wagner product for Aspirating Smoke Detection system
  • Simplex & VESDA certifications will have added advantage
  • Expertise in Fire Alarm Code and Guidelines. Should be familiar with local code requirement for Singapore, Hong Kong & Malaysia region.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.), Blue Beam
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, and other protocols.
  • Should have good experience for subcon/vendor engagement keeping close

co-ordination with procurement

  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

10+ years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System’s Desing and Estimation.

For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou).

job.title: QA Software Engineer
job.description:
Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a QA Software Engineer to join the Power and Thermal Management Division in Bengaluru, Karnataka/India. As a QA Software Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software products through manual and automated testing. You will create and maintain test plans, test cases, automation scripts, and defect reports, while collaborating closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, and other QA team members throughout the development lifecycle.

You will also contribute to test automation strategy, analyze automated test results, troubleshoot failures, and participate in technical and architecture discussions. AI-assisted engineering tools will be an important part of the role, supporting activities such as test design, automation development, debugging, defect investigation, and continuous improvement of QA processes.

Responsibilities

  • Design, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, negative, boundary, compatibility, and system testing.
  • Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects throughout their lifecycle.
  • Analyze automated test results, logs, and failures to identify product, automation, or environment issues.
  • Debug and troubleshoot network protocols, APIs, services, and system behavior.
  • Maintain clear and accurate QA documentation.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Participate in technical, design, architecture, and code review discussions from a quality and testability perspective.
  • Integrate and maintain automated tests within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to support test case generation, automation development, debugging, log analysis, defect investigation, and technical documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve test efficiency, coverage, reliability, and overall QA productivity.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, automation frameworks, and engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Software Testing, or a related engineering role.
  • Strong understanding of Software QA methodologies, testing techniques, and Agile software development practices.
  • Experience creating and executing both manual and automated test cases.
  • Experience with functional, regression, integration, negative, boundary, compatibility, and concurrency testing.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or contributing to automated test frameworks.
  • Experience working with CI/CD environments and automated test execution pipelines.
  • Experience troubleshooting software defects, analyzing logs, and identifying potential root causes.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar technologies for testing, automation, debugging, or technical analysis.

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automated test suites.
  • Ability to identify suitable automation candidates and improve regression and end-to-end test coverage.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and practices, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Git, GitLab, GitHub, and standard code review workflows.
  • Strong scripting or programming skills in Python are required. Experience with Golang or Java is a plus.
  • Basic knowledge of networking, APIs, web services, and distributed systems.
  • Practical knowledge of Generative AI and AI-assisted software engineering tools.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for test generation, automation development, test data creation, debugging, log analysis, and defect investigation.
  • Ability to critically review and validate AI-generated code, scripts, test cases, and technical recommendations.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and providing appropriate technical context to AI tools.
  • Interest in applying AI to areas such as automation maintenance, failure analysis, test optimization, and defect classification.
  • Experience testing AI-enabled applications or features is considered a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to clearly document test results, defects, and technical findings.
  • Strong interest in continuously improving QA practices, automation coverage, engineering efficiency, and software quality.

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About the Position

As a Pre-field Rep – Marketing & Sales Operations Representative (MSOR), you will join a structured 18–24 month Field Rep development program designed to accelerate your career at Caterpillar.

Through a combination of hands-on rotations, training, and global exposure, you will build the skills needed for a future field-based role supporting dealers and customers. You will learn directly from senior leaders and subject matter experts while gaining practical experience across the business.

What Marketing & Sales Means at Caterpillar

At Caterpillar, Marketing & Sales focuses on helping dealers optimise marketing and sales operations to improve customer outcomes, and business performance.

While this role supports Marketing & Sales functions, it is not a traditional sales representative or marketing specialist role. The focus of this position is to collaborate with Cat dealers to build capability, drive process improvement, and execute Marketing and Sales Operations related strategies.

What the Field Rep Program Offers

  • A 12-week intensive onboarding and training experience
  • International exposure, including travel across Asia and Europe on learning trips
  • Rotational assignments across key business functions
  • Mentorship from experienced leaders and subject matter experts

What you will learn in the program:

  • Build foundational knowledge of Caterpillar's products, customers, industries, and dealer network
  • Develop commercial, analytical, consulting, and professional skills
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across dealer management, marketing, sales, product, and strategic business functions
  • Gain exposure to business planning, customer experience, growth strategies, process improvement, and operational excellence practices
  • Rotational Assignments through various Caterpillar Divisions to (i) develop industry and product application knowledge, (ii) build a strong understanding of the Cat dealer network and (iii) strengthen your capabilities for future roles within the organisation

Your Future Role

Upon successful completion of the program, you will have the opportunity to move into a field role, where you will:

  • Partner with Cat dealers to strengthen marketing and sales operations and improve business performance
  • Build dealer capability and support strategic growth and process improvement initiatives
  • Champion customer experience and support initiatives that improve market coverage and customer engagement
  • Use data and insights to identify opportunities and develop solutions that improve customer outcomes and commercial performance
  • Act as a trusted advisor to dealers, helping them improve performance and deliver exceptional customer experience
  • We’re looking for candidates who:
  • Hold a degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Project Management, Operations Management, or a related discipline
  • Have experience managing or supporting projects, process improvement initiatives, business development activities, or operational improvements
  • Are strong communicators and relationship builders
  • Enjoy solving problems and working with data
  • Demonstrate commercial curiosity, a growth mindset, and adaptability
  • Are open to travel (up to 30%) and relocation within Australia
  • You may also have up to 3 years of experience in marketing, business, analytics, project management, operations, sales support or change management.

Additional Information**

Whilst applicants will be considered from across Australia, you may be required to relocate upon completion of your developmental period. Company support is provided with relocation.

Must have full Australian working rights

Testimonials from Field Rep Program Graduates

“It was one of the best early‑career experiences I’ve had. You get to travel through Asia and Europe, spend time in world‑class facilities, and build real technical and leadership skills - all while working for a global industry leader”

  • Program Graduate, Marketing & Sales

"Being a part of this program was a once in a lifetime opportunity for me, and it provided me with immense growth both professionally and personally." - Program Graduate, Marketing & Sales

“The program has been a valuable part of my development. It has broadened my understanding of Caterpillar products, systems, and dealer operations, enabling me to provide more effective support to Cat dealers and customers and deliver greater value in my role every day.”

  • Program Graduate, Product Support

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

September 23, 2026 - October 15, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Service Delivery Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end delivery of services to clients, ensuring high-quality performance, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. This role combines client and stakeholder engagement, operational excellence, and financial oversight to drive service success and business growth.

Job Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management a. Build and maintain strong client relationships as the primary point of contact for service-related matters. b. Manage client expectations, inquiries and escalations effectively. c. Collaborate with clients to understand their needs, gather feedback and ensure satisfaction and retention.

Service Improvement d. Continuously evaluate service delivery processes to identify improvement opportunities e. Drive initiatives to enhance service quality and improve customer satisfaction. f. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to implement

Sales Support g. Partner with the sales team to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts h. Support the development of proposals and presentations to demonstrate service value. i. Provide insights from client interactions to help refine sales strategies.

Financial Management j. Manage service delivery budgets, ensuring cost-effectiveness and optimal resource allocation. k. Monitor financial performance, analyze variances, and implement corrective actions where necessary.

Risk Management l. Identify potential risks and issues related to service delivery and implement mitigation plans. m. Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, standards and organizational policies.

Reporting & Documentation n. Prepare and deliver regular service performance reports to clients and management. o. Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation, including service processes, policies and operational manuals.

Qualifications

i. Minimum 8 years proven Service Delivery experience in the IT industry in similar capacity. ii. Experience managing client relationships and service performance. iii. Proven experience in Service Delivery, Operations and Account Management roles. iv. IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) certified and experience in application of the framework. (required) v. Certification in Customer Success Management will have added advantage.

job.title: ICT Engineer (Loyang)
job.description:
About the Role

As CBRE Information & Communications Technology Service Delivery Technician, you will provide on-site support for the ICT and Engineering services within the Data Center environment.

This job is part of the Critical and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for technical maintenance services in critical client environments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Receive, review, and complete IT equipment installation, relocation and decommission requests within timeframes and to industry standards.
  • Provide problem-solving support. This includes server reboots, backups, visual inspections, etc.
  • Escort third-party engineers and ensure their compliance with the site standards.
  • Receive, respond, and assign break and fix tickets within the agreed timeframe or escalate if they cannot be resolved.
  • Ensure that on-site documentation including work-related standard operating procedures are created, reviewed & updated whenever there is an instruction or process change.
  • Receive, assess, and complete patching and de-patching requests.
  • Develop a good working relationship with all members of staff and client representatives.
  • Provision and fault diagnosis and rectification of network channel connectivity, installation, relocation & decommissioning of IT equipment, and general engineering maintenance & housekeeping of the critical services.
  • Ensure a safe and healthy working environment while maintaining a professional image.
  • Use existing procedures to solve straightforward problems.
  • Impact through clearly defined duties, and methods and tasks are described in detail.
  • Deliver own output by following defined procedures / processes under close supervision and guidance.

What You’ll Need:

  • Training in a Technical discipline having served an apprenticeship or equivalent with 1-2 years of job-related experience. In lieu of a diploma, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Must meet the physical requirements of this role.
  • Ability to follow basic work routines and standards in the application of work.
  • Communication skills to exchange straightforward information.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
  • Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.
  • Basic math skills. Ability to calculate simple figures such as percentages, discounts, and markups.

job.title: Cyber Security Engineer
job.description:
About us

We’re growing, not slowing, here at Macquarie Technology Group because we’re passionate about doing things differently. We want to challenge the industry and look for better ways of doing things. As a team, Macquarie Government are hardworking, results and success focused. We also take the time to celebrate our success and make sure our people are doing work that makes a difference.

We believe that collaboration & team connection is key for success. This role will be based in Canberra on-site with one of our clients.

We require security clearance for this role you must be an Australian citizen to be eligible to obtain a security clearance or ideally already hold NV1 security clearance.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our growing cyber security team in Canberra. This opportunity is ideal for someone with around 18 months to 4 years' experience in a SOC or cyber security environment who has hands-on experience with Splunk log onboarding, use case development, detection engineering and security monitoring.

You'll play a key role in onboarding and normalising log sources, building and tuning detections, investigating alerts, and supporting incident triage and response activities across customer environments. We're looking for someone who understands how security data flows into a SIEM, can work through detection logic, and enjoys improving visibility and security outcomes through well-designed use cases and analytics.

Working alongside experienced cyber professionals, you'll continue to develop your skills across Splunk, detection engineering, threat monitoring and incident response while supporting environments that genuinely matter. If you're curious, proactive, and eager to grow your technical capability in a high-performing team, this could be a great next step in your cyber security career.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our growing cyber security team in Canberra. This opportunity is ideal for someone with around 18 months to 4 years' experience in a SOC or cyber security environment who has hands-on experience with Splunk log onboarding, use case development, detection engineering and security monitoring.

You'll play a key role in onboarding and normalising log sources, building and tuning detections, investigating alerts, and supporting incident triage and response activities across customer environments. We're looking for someone who understands how security data flows into a SIEM, can work through detection logic, and enjoys improving visibility and security outcomes through well-designed use cases and analytics.

Working alongside experienced cyber professionals, you'll continue to develop your skills across Splunk, detection engineering, threat monitoring and incident response while supporting environments that genuinely matter. If you're curious, proactive, and eager to grow your technical capability in a high-performing team, this could be a great next step in your cyber security career.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Monitoring, triaging, investigating, and responding to security alerts and incidents within our Security Operations Centre (SOC)
  • Onboarding and integrating new log sources into Splunk, including writing and tuning data inputs, parsing configurations, field extractions, and validating data quality
  • Developing, refining, and optimising Splunk searches, dashboards, alerts, and detection logic to improve threat detection capability
  • Investigating security events, identifying patterns, determining severity, and escalating incidents in line with established playbooks and procedures
  • Contributing to the continuous improvement and uplift of SOC processes, runbooks, and detection logic
  • Collaborating with internal cloud, network, endpoint, and engineering teams to improve log coverage and security monitoring across environments
  • Keeping up with the evolving threat landscape and bringing practical ideas to improve the team’s capability

About You

  • A degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 18 months to 4 years of hands-on SOC experience, including practical experience onboarding, validating, and tuning log sources in Splunk
  • Strong working knowledge of common attack techniques, threat indicators, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework, with the ability to apply this knowledge during investigations
  • Experience working with security technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint detection tools, cloud security platforms, and related monitoring tools
  • Confident analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex security events and make sound escalation decisions
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain incidents, risks, and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice To Have

  • Splunk certifications (e.g., Splunk Core Certified User or Power User)
  • Exposure to SOAR platforms or security automation
  • Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or equivalent

If this role excites you Apply Now!

job.title: Senior Director, Testing & Commissioning (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

About the role

This role is to support our development of Data Center projects in Australia. They will work as part of the STACK Data Centre Australia team and be responsible for the management of commissioning of mission critical equipment, start-up, and testing, as well as managing our staff and CxA consultants for all our projects in Australia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership for the execution of commissioning to meet our standards.
  • Manage projects and Cx teams in progress and future projects as directed. This will include all commissioning related design, contractual and financial aspects in consultation with STACK management.
  • Look for opportunities to streamline the commissioning process without compromising on the quality required.
  • Participate in the procurement of CxA Consultants for our projects including managing this process.
  • Management of STACK commissioning staff in Australia. Creation of CxA RFP proposal documentation as instructed.
  • Overall management of CxA Consultants with your STACK Cx staff.
  • Review of CVs and recommend employment of new staff. Staff removal will need to be done in conjunction with the VP of commissioning.
  • Manage training of staff in the execution of their duties. Ensuring commissioning delivery is correct.
  • Conduct regular reviews of STACK staff at minimum every quarter.
  • Create operational standards and practices for staff to follow in line with STACK requirements.
  • Conduct design review process with our Engineering team.
  • Provide support with the review of the Cx schedule with GC, CxA and STACK internal stakeholders. Comment on the schedule where required.
  • Provide support for the development and review of equipment and system test scripts as needed.
  • Provide support for the development, review and approval of Cx L4 and 5 test scripts.
  • Review all reports issued by our CxA. These include all design reviews, Load-bank plans, IST intent, IST method statement, IST interim and final reports ETC.
  • Conduct planning for upcoming projects on the commissioning strategy and how this is to be implemented. Resources and Cx equipment to be outlined in any strategy creation.
  • Participate in the procurement of LLE equipment, skid and containerized solutions. for our projects alongside our procurement team.
  • LLE Vendor coordination and management during procurement, including technical analysis of the commissioning scope.
  • Identify scope gaps in procurement of LLE equipment, skid and containerized product with Procurement/Delivery team.
  • Participate in our off-site skid integration.
  • Participate in our off-site containerized solutions.
  • Create off-site commissioning procedures.
  • Endeavor to seek prefabricated solutions for electrical/mechanical systems to encourage building and commissioning with speed for our projects.
  • Management and attendance to factory witness testing as required in consultation with VP of commissioning.
  • Ligase with the Operations team to gain a good understanding of their requirements at handover.
  • Support design specification review, manufacturer submittals, single line drawing sets, and project schedule documentation.
  • Look to improve Cx Alloy system for STACK use.
  • Manage the STACK commissioning equipment that includes load-banks, load-bank cabling, PQA and data loggers.
  • When required look to procure additional commissioning equipment.
  • Ensure safe work practices are followed by all participants on the commissioning team at the customer site.
  • Engage with STACK customers to ensure positive experience, goal achievement, schedule adherence and questions answered.
  • Manage the STACK customer CxV Consultant with your STACK Cx staff.
  • Attend PCG meetings as required.
  • Provide support to other regional projects as instructed.**

Equal Opportunity Employer**

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Develop and support business plans related to contracts, focusing on efficiency and effectiveness.

Apply knowledge to manage and modify contracts according to their specific structure.

Preparing Change Authorization Request including validation of Variations.

Coordinate with relevant departments to assess, negotiate, and settle claims while minimizing financial and operational impact.

Create and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards, presenting data in a clear and actionable format for management review and decision-making.

Preparing Final Accounts and Closure of Contracts

Dispute Resolution:

Lead mediation sessions, ensuring adherence to contractual terms, maintaining thorough documentation and conducting post-resolution analyses to enhance future processes.

Ensure all Compliance (Insurances, Bank Guarantees) and Regulations (HR, GST compliance).

Collaborate with stakeholders to establish clear performance and quality standards, ensuring these metrics are effectively measured and adhered to, thereby promoting compliance and enhancing overall project outcomes.

Continuous Improvement:

Regularly assess and recommend modifications or renewals of contracts based on project requirements and performance evaluations.

Collaborate with internal teams to identify sources for labor, machinery, and materials, enhancing operational efficiency.

Team Leadership and Management:

Organize and hire relevant personnel for contract execution and devise development plans for key team members.

Consulting with Internal (Design, Procurement, Finance, etc.,) & External (Contractors, Consultants, etc.,) stakeholders to maintain highest standards.

Education Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or relevant

Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) - Good to Have

Certified Contract Manager (CCM) - Good to Have

Work Experience:

12+ years of experience in Contracts Administration or a related field.

job.title: Manager - Cell Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Ensure that all maintenance procedures for PERC technology comply with safety standards and protocols, focusing on handling and processing sensitive components like passivation layers.

Innovation:

  • Driving continuous improvement by leading R&D efforts to develop advanced solar technologies and identifying market trends to maintain a competitive edge.

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leadership in Change Management:

  • Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies.

People Development:

  • Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions.

PERC Technology Management:

  • Oversee maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) solar cells, focusing on the unique aspects of this technology, such as passivation layers and rear surface treatment.

Issue Diagnosis and Repair:

  • Address and resolve issues related to PERC cell performance, including troubleshooting problems with passivation layers, rear surface contact, and overall cell efficiency.

Preventive Maintenance:

  • Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules tailored to the specific needs of PERC cells, such as ensuring the integrity of the passivation layer and rear contacts.

Quality Assurance:

  • Ensure that maintenance practices uphold the high standards required for PERC cells. Perform detailed inspections to verify the condition of passivation layers and rear surface contacts..

CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions):

  • Identify and address specific issues affecting PERC cells, such as degradation of passivation layers or rear contact problems, and implement corrective and preventive measures to enhance cell performance.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and coordinate the maintenance team in handling PERC cells, providing specific guidance on handling and maintaining passivation and rear contact systems.

Performance Monitoring:

  • Track performance indicators specific to PERC cells, such as efficiency metrics and degradation rates of passivation layers, to optimize maintenance strategies and improve cell longevity.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Production Team
  • Engineering Department
  • Quality Assurance Team
  • Operations Management

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • PERC Equipment Manufacturers
  • Spare Parts Suppliers
  • Technical Consultants
  • External Auditors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • 12-14 Years of experience in cell maintenance, with specific experience in PERC technology.

job.title: Senior Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead preventive, predictive, breakdown, and condition-based maintenance activities of Boiler systems and auxiliaries.
  • Ensure high reliability and availability of Boiler equipment including Pressure Parts, APH, ESP, PA Fans, FD Fans, ID Fans, Soot Blowers, Dampers, Ducting, Expansion Joints, Coal Piping, and associated systems.

  • Monitor Boiler performance parameters and identify opportunities for reliability improvement, efficiency enhancement, and equipment life extension.
  • Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of recurring failures and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
  • Ensure effective implementation of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), TPM initiatives, vibration monitoring, thermography, and condition monitoring practices.
  • Coordinate closely with Operations, C&I, Electrical, CHP, Ash Handling, and Engineering teams to ensure seamless unit operation.
  • Review and optimize maintenance schedules, manpower deployment, spare management, and contractor productivity.
  • Monitor inventory levels of critical spares and ensure availability of essential materials during planned and emergency maintenance activities.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, PTW systems, statutory regulations, and Adani safety protocols during all maintenance activities.
  • Manage and supervise contractors, service providers, OEM representatives, and maintenance teams to achieve project and maintenance objectives.
  • Drive digital maintenance practices through SAP PM, maintenance analytics, failure tracking systems, and performance dashboards.
  • Identify and implement cost optimization initiatives without compromising safety, quality, and equipment reliability.
  • Develop maintenance team capabilities through training, coaching, technical guidance, and succession planning.
  • Support management in achieving plant KPIs related to PLF, equipment availability, forced outage reduction, heat rate improvement, and maintenance budget adherence.

Educational Qualification

Mandatory:

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university.

Preferred:

  • MBA (Operations) or equivalent management qualification.

Experience Requirements

  • 15 -20 years of relevant Mechanical Maintenance experience.
  • Minimum 6-8 years specifically in Boiler Maintenance of Thermal Power Plants.
  • Experience in large utility power units (300 MW and above preferred).

  • Coordinate platform refreshes, deployments, migrations, testing and operational handover with Business Units and vendors.
  • Support platform lifecycle activities including upgrades, capacity, resilience, maintenance and technical-risk remediation.
  • Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, issues and key technical decisions.

**

Infrastructure & Network Security

  • Support security engineering across servers, operating systems, virtual infrastructure and network environments.
  • Support network-security capabilities including firewalls, segmentation, secure connectivity and remote access.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, system, network and security-platform integration issues.
  • Support secure configuration, vulnerability remediation and security hardening activities.

**

Vendor, Tender & Financial Management

  • Support RFP/RFQ and tender activities including requirements development, technical evaluation, vendor clarification and proposal assessment.
  • Work with vendors to manage technical deliverables, implementation activities and service commitments.
  • Support budget planning, expenditure tracking and financial governance for cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Manage technology lifecycle considerations including licensing, maintenance, support renewals and capacity requirements.

**

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, systems or network security.
  • Good understanding of servers, operating systems, networking, firewalls, VPNs, routing, switching and segmentation.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity platforms, infrastructure deployments or technology refreshes.
  • Ability to review technical designs and troubleshoot system, network and integration issues.
  • Experience working with vendors and supporting technology procurement, tender or commercial activities.
  • Good project coordination, stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills.

Good to Have

  • Experience with vulnerability management, privileged access, endpoint security, network security or other enterprise cybersecurity platforms.
  • Experience with Linux/Windows administration, virtualisation or data-centre infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with scripting, APIs or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with RFP/RFQ, budgeting, licensing and vendor management.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCNA/CCNP, ITIL, PMP or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements in large enterprise or critical-infrastructure environments.

job.title: QR047 - Quality Administrative Assistant
job.description:
Job Summary

Coordinates documents and gathers and inputs data related to assigned administrative support duties for a team, department, function or other organizational leader/group. Completes work with a limited degree of supervision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine to complex information requests.
  • Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets.
  • Completes data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities.
  • Performs associate functions as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings.
  • Responds to, or redirects, routine to complex inquiries from external or internal sources about the organization/department, its activities, or processes so callers/visitors are answered promptly and accurately.
  • Prepares documentation for payment of vendors, suppliers and other third parties as applicable; submits documentation and enters request for payments into accounting system; responds to inquiries from accounts payable and payees.
  • Documents and maintains departmental policies and procedures.
  • Participates as a team member on departmental related business improvement assignments and projects as needed.
  • Performs other routine to complex administrative activities as needed per the established procedures of the organization and/or department.
  • Act as an informal resource for colleagues with less experience.

We are looking for a talented Administrative Associate III for a 12-month fixed-term to join our team in Scoresby, VIC .

This is more than a traditional administration role. You'll play a key part in supporting business operations, data reporting, process improvement initiatives, and a major Quality and SAP transformation project. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you'll contribute to reporting, documentation, data management, and continuous improvement activities that support business-critical decisions.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Support a large-scale transition from Movex to SAP.
  • Work with Quality, Operations, and Data Analytics teams.
  • Assist with reporting, dashboards, KPIs, and business process documentation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and business transformation initiatives.
  • Build valuable exposure to SAP, Power BI, data analytics, and enterprise reporting.
  • Join a collaborative global organisation committed to innovation and sustainability.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:  **

  • Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine to complex information requests.
  • Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets.
  • Completes data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities.
  • Performs associate functions as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings.
  • Responds to, or redirects, routine to complex inquiries from external or internal sources about the organization/department, its activities, or processes so callers/visitors are answered promptly and accurately.
  • Prepares documentation for payment of vendors, suppliers and other third parties as applicable; submits documentation and enters request for payments into accounting system; responds to inquiries from accounts payable and payees.
  • Documents and maintains departmental policies and procedures.
  • Participates as a team member on departmental related business improvement assignments and projects as needed.
  • Performs other routine to complex administrative activities as needed per the established procedures of the organization and/or department.
  • Act as an informal resource for colleagues with less experience.

About you

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys administration, data analysis, stakeholder coordination, and process improvement, and is looking to broaden their experience within a global industry leader.

  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
  • Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.
  • Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem-solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.
  • Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem-solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.
  • Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.

To be successful in this role you will need the following: 

  • High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
  • 3-4 years of relevant administrative, reporting, data coordination, or business support experience.
  • Experience working with databases, spreadsheets, reporting tools, or business systems preferred.
  • Exposure to quality reporting, process documentation, ERP systems (SAP/Movex), or project support will be highly regarded.
  • The ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, from site teams through to senior leadership.
  • 10% travel with other sites and availability to be onsite as required

Compensation and Benefits

  • Participation in an annual variable compensation (bonus) program
  • Annual remuneration reviews
  • Salary continuance insurance
  • Comprehensive Cummins product training provided
  • Cummins Employee Discount program – Includes Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles
  • Onsite parking
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees
  • Quality function's transition from Movex to SAP
  • Define future-state Quality business processes and controls
  • Review and approve business requirements, process maps, and Quality functional specifications
  • Ensure Quality requirements are fully integrated within strategic & major accounts, Manufacturing, Inventory Management, Service Operations, and Customer Support processes ( all defined process currently supports different BU Quality process control)
  • Identify business risks associated with process changes and implement mitigation plans
  • Support deployment, hypercare, and post-go-live stabilization activities.
  • support migration of Quality KPI reporting from Movex into SAP and approved enterprise reporting platforms.
  • Support Data Analyser to create and maintain a comprehensive inventory of existing Quality reports, dashboards, KPIs, and queries.
  • Document current Movex query logic, source tables, data relationships, business rules, and calculations.
  • Coordinate mapping of Movex fields, reports, and business logic to SAP data structures and reporting models.
  • Validate Movex-to-SAP field mappings and approve reporting requirements.
  • Work with Data & Analytics teams to design sustainable Power BI and SAP reporting solutions.
  • Assess reporting impacts resulting from SAP process changes.
  • Define reporting acceptance criteria and reconciliation requirements.
  • Ensure business-critical reporting remains available throughout the transition.
  • Support development of automated reporting solutions and reduced manual data extraction.

job.title: Manager, Procurement (Based in Singapore)
job.description:
This position will lead a team of procurement staff in planning, organising and executing the procurement activities mainly for the property management team across multiple assets with the objective of obtaining the most competitive pricing for the products and services procured, whilst ensuring compliance with procurement policies and SOPs.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and support to internal business units on sourcing and procurement capabilities and processes, and the procurement team in the execution of procurement activities for the property management team including vendor management activities and relationships, service level agreements and contract negotiations.
  • Source, obtain and evaluate the most competitive pricing for the products and services procured.
  • Review tender documents, tender evaluations and analysis, and quality checks on goods and services prepared by the team.
  • Review and update the approved vendor list periodically.
  • Plan, schedule and monitor the procurement of term contracts and minor capital projects to ensure timely approval and award.
  • Prepare reports and statistics for management review.
  • Ensure procurement activities comply with procurement policies and SOPs.
  • Reinforce standards, process and templates that support the delivery of procurement activities, conduct periodic audits on the procurement process and documentation.

Job Requirements
