job.title: DCEO , Data Centre Engineering Operations, Data Centre Engineering Operations
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Infrastructure Operations is hiring a Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer to maintain and operate the critical infrastructure that keeps AWS's global cloud running 24/7.

What You'll Do

1/ Manage day-to-day engineering operations of data center critical infrastructure 2/ Plan and execute corrective and preventative maintenance 3/ Respond to facility incidents as a first responder 4/ Supervise specialist vendors and contractors 5/ Drive operational excellence across safety, security, availability, and cost 6/ Develop into a subject matter expert for your facility

What You'll Need

1/ Experience in critical facilities management 2/ Strong technical understanding of data center systems 3/ Results-driven mindset with a focus on continuous improvement Why It Matters: You're not just maintaining a building — you're ensuring the reliability of infrastructure that millions of AWS customers depend on every day.

Key job responsibilities The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

  • Act as the site primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders involving communication and relationship management.
  • Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
  • Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA’s as required.
  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analysis, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
  • Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
  • Work with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
  • Establish documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
  • Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
  • Assist in recruiting efforts.
  • Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues

A day in the life In day today scale, you will be involved in:

  • Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility MEP management.
  • Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
  • Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

  • Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filtering, battery monitoring systems, branch circuit monitoring systems or SCADA systems

job.title: Software Development Engineer II
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AIS is seeking a highly motivated and passionate Software Development Engineer who is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying Supply Chain Software and Application. In this role you will collaborate with business leaders, work backwards from customers, identify problems, propose innovative solutions, relentlessly raise standards, and have a positive impact on AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement. In this, you will work closely with a team of Data Engineers and Data Scientists to architect the application programming interface (API) and user Interface (UI) in context with the business outcomes. You will be responsible for the full software development life cycle to build scalable application and deploy in AWS Cloud with high security bar. These are all greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up. You will be part of a Supply Chain Automation team within AWS building large scale distributed applications, designing and developing systems from scratch utilizing technologies and frameworks like reactive micro services, serverless computing and distributed NoSQL data stores.

Key job responsibilities

  • Solve complex architecture and business problems to come up with extensible solutions.
  • Work with business leaders, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to ideate business-friendly software solutions.
  • Design client-side and server-side architecture for Supply Chain applications.
  • Write high quality code that is modular, functional and testable.
  • Develop functional databases, applications, and servers to support Supply Chain platforms.
  • Write effective APIs and develop technical specifications and documentation.
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency; troubleshoot, debug and upgrade applications.
  • Formally mentor junior engineers on design, coding and troubleshooting.
  • Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
  • 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
  • Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
  • Experience with Supply Chain Planning and Procurement system development is a plus

job.description:

  • Data Collection & Reporting: Assist in gathering, organising and analysing sustainability data from properties around the world, focusing on key performance indicators such as energy, waste, and carbon emissions.
  • Liaising with Global Properties: Work closely with operational teams at our global properties to ensure timely and accurate submission of sustainability data. Provide support and guidance to local teams as needed to improve data reporting processes.

  • Onboarding New Properties to UL 360 & Greenview Portal: Assist in the onboarding process for new properties to the UL 360 and Greenview Portal data collection platforms. This includes guiding properties through the platform setup, ensuring proper data entry, and troubleshooting any issues during the integration process.
  • Liaising with Parent Company: Coordinate with our parent company to ensure that all their sustainability data and reporting requirements are met in a timely and accurate manner. Ensure compliance with any additional data reporting
  • Data Entry & Updates: Ensure that all sustainability data is entered into the relevant tracking systems on time and in line with reporting schedules.
  • Develop & Maintain Reporting Tools: Assist in creating and maintaining data dashboards and reports that provide real-time insights into sustainability performance.
  • Reporting Support: Help prepare periodic sustainability reports and presentations for internal stakeholders, summarising global sustainability progress, trends, and opportunities.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Serve as a point of contact for property teams regarding sustainability data and the UL 360 and Greenview Portal platforms, answering questions and offering support to ensure compliance with reporting requirements.

job.title: Senior Logistics Technician
job.description:
Overview

[As a Microsoft Senior Logistics Technician within our Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT) team, you will prioritize and assign ticketed work to technicians on the team, provide guidance on inbound/outbound logistics tasks](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393557001960?hl=en?timeout=20), and ensure that inventory balances are accurate. This opportunity will allow you to demonstrate your expertise in standard processes and procedures for [Inventory & Asset](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393557001960?hl=en?timeout=20)Management and develop skills around mentorship of peer technicians accelerating your career growth in the process. This role is based 100% onsite within one of our Data Centers in Canberra.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.[Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393557001960?hl=en?timeout=20)

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Prioritize ticketing queues, work to resolve escalations, and clear blocking issues to enable continued[delivery of Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) activities.](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393557001960?hl=en?timeout=20)
  • Provide task specific guidance to a team of technicians responsible for preparing and executing incoming/outgoing deliveries and documenting inbound/outbound packages (e.g. purchase order [PO] receiving, Rack Movement Supervisor [RMS] activities).
  • Co-ordinate with external stakeholders including third-party warehouses, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) vendors, and suppliers as necessary to facilitate inbound and outbound deliveries.
  • Perform assigned tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations.
  • Leverage process knowledge and technical skills to resolve escalations (or further escalate if needed), clear blocking issues, and may enable on site and/or remote data center support activities.
  • Maintain a strong stakeholder focus to improve quality and ensure that the customer receives the highest return on their investment.
  • Ensure teams maintain and perform steps required to keep the inventory balance accurate.
  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) about the Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) warranty process ensuring teams process failed vendor hardware devices using tools and processes RMAs.
  • Manage schedule of DBD destruction or shredding in partnership with senior leadership and ensure team is following all processes and procedures to perform DBD destruction.
  • [Attend, conduct, or assist in conducting daily safety briefings, completes required safety training, provides guidance to technicians to facilitate compliance with safety procedures (e.g., Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393557001960?hl=en?timeout=20), rack moving, heavy-equipment usage, lifting, ladder/rolling stair use).
  • Seek out opportunities to contribute to workstreams and evolve existing workstream processes, services, and solutions toward greater simplification and automation.
  • Embody our [culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or TAFE AND 2+ year(s) industry work experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment and/or logistics, including experience with inventory and asset management, retail, warehouse management, RMA's or a related field
  • * OR equivalent industry work experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • Citizenship Verification: This position requires verification of Australian Citizenship to meet federal government security requirements, this includes verification of an Australian Passport.
  • NV1/2, PV Clearance Assessment: This position may require an enhanced background check conducted through the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency.

Whilst not required, we also look for the following_Preferred_ Qualifications _:_

  • 3+ year(s) industry work experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, IT, and/or logistics, including experience with inventory and asset management, retail, warehouse management, RMA's or a related field, operating heavy-load movement equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, chassis lifts) for a large corporation
  • OR equivalent industry work experience.

Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. job.title: Service Now Jr Admin
job.description:
Job Title: ServiceNow Senior Administrator

About the Role

We are looking for a ServiceNow Senior Administrator to manage the day‑to‑day health, stability, and configuration of our ServiceNow platform. This role requires strong hands‑on experience with ITSM and ITAM, solid understanding of platform architecture, and the ability to support enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and guide junior team members. You will work closely with developers, process owners, and platform stakeholders to ensure the system runs smoothly and follows best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily administration of the ServiceNow platform, including user management, roles, groups, and access controls.
  • Maintain and improve core modules such as ITSM and CMDB; experience with ITAM, ITOM, HRSD, or SecOps is a plus.
  • Configure and manage forms, fields, lists, UI policies, UI actions, and basic workflow or Flow Designer logic.
  • Support platform upgrades, patches, regression testing, and general maintenance activities.
  • Monitor data quality across key tables, including CMDB, ITSM, SAM/HAM, and ITOM‑related records.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and implement long‑term fixes.
  • Assist with catalog items, record producers, notifications, and workflow automation.
  • Work with cross‑functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into configuration tasks.
  • Maintain clear documentation for configuration changes, processes, and platform updates.
  • Provide guidance to junior admins and support teams on platform standards and best practices.

Core Skills & Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, tables, forms, ACLs, and role‑based access.
  • Hands‑on experience with ITSM and ITAM (required).
  • Working knowledge of Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Flow Designer.
  • Familiarity with Script Includes, Glide APIs, and basic scripting (JavaScript).
  • Understanding of integrations, Scripted REST APIs, and data exchange concepts.
  • Good awareness of CMDB relationships, data models, and data quality practices.
  • Experience with Service Portal or UI customization is helpful.
  • Understanding of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow.

Qualifications

  • 4–6+ years of hands‑on experience administering or developing in ServiceNow.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience supporting upgrades, maintenance, and platform improvements.
  • Background working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  • ServiceNow CSA certification required or in progress; additional certifications (ITSM, CMDB, HRSD, ITAM) are a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and business teams.
  • Ability to mentor junior team members and support platform governance.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.

Overview: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced and business-focused Product Owner to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of data and integrations teams for an enterprise eCommerce application. This role will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineering, architecture, and external partners to translate business needs into scalable data flows, APIs, integration requirements, and prioritized product backlogs. The Product Owner will drive outcomes that improve data quality, system interoperability, operational efficiency, and user adoption while ensuring solutions meet security, governance, performance, and compliance expectations. The role requires techno-functional skills to analyze data, write SQLs, create and update field mappings, and debug issues with cross-platform teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for data and integrations teams.
  • Be the SME for APIs, and data process flows.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, pain points, reporting needs, process gaps, and integration requirements, translating them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, application development, architecture, security, and QA teams to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data and integration solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, and compliance considerations are embedded into product requirements and delivery decisions.
  • Manage sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, demos, and stakeholder reviews in alignment with Agile delivery practices.
  • Evaluate technical feasibility, business value, risk, and dependency impacts when prioritizing features, enhancements, defects, and technical debt.
  • Work with teams to establish performance, reliability, monitoring, and support expectations for data pipelines, APIs, and integration services.
  • Support user acceptance testing by validating that delivered capabilities meet business objectives, functional requirements, and defined acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate cross-functional dependencies across internal teams, external vendors, and enterprise platforms to ensure successful end-to-end delivery.
  • Communicate product status, roadmap priorities, delivery risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Drive adoption and continuous improvement by gathering feedback, monitoring usage, measuring product success, and identifying opportunities to enhance data and integration capabilities.

Qualifications

  • 6-8 years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, solution delivery, data platforms, integrations, or enterprise application delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience defining product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing user stories, and prioritizing work based on business value, technical feasibility, and stakeholder impact.
  • Functional understanding of APIs and data integration concepts, including APIs, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, batch and real-time processing, data mapping, and system interoperability.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ERP, CRM, data warehouses, data lakes, middleware, iPaaS, or integration platforms.
  • Ability to translate complex business processes and data needs into clear functional and technical requirements for engineering and delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with data governance, data quality, data privacy, master data management, lineage, security, and compliance considerations.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum teams, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with business users, technical teams, vendors, architects, QA teams, and leadership.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain data and integration concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance strategic product direction with day-to-day delivery decisions.
  • Experience with product management and delivery tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of cloud data platforms, API management, event streaming, middleware, or modern integration architecture is preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Salesforce, cloud, data, or integration certifications are preferred.

job.title: Sr Mgr, Pricing Excellence
job.description:
Role summary

The Senior Manager, Pricing Excellence will lead the development and deployment of Carrier's pricing excellence capability across the Asia, Middle East and Africa (AME) region. The role is responsible for driving sustainable margin expansion through pricing analytics, governance, deal support, commercial processes, and capability building.

This position will partner closely with business leaders, sales teams, product line leaders, finance, and commercial operations teams to improve pricing discipline, increase price realization, strengthen margin management, and establish pricing as a strategic lever for profitable growth.

Role Responsibilities:

  • ### Pricing Strategy & Governance

Develop and deploy regional pricing frameworks, policies, and governance processes.

  • Establish pricing guardrails, Delegation of Authority (DOA) structures, review forums, and escalation processes.
  • Drive consistency in pricing decision-making across countries and business segments.
  • Support leadership in balancing growth, competitiveness, and profitability objectives.

Pricing Analytics & Insights

  • Build and manage pricing dashboards and analytical tools to improve commercial decision-making.
  • Identify price leakage, margin erosion, discounting trends, and pricing opportunities.
  • Analyze pricing performance by market, product line, customer segment, channel, and country.
  • Develop recommendations to improve margin realization and commercial effectiveness.

Deal Review & Commercial Support

  • Support large, strategic, and complex deal reviews.
  • Partner with commercial teams to evaluate pricing scenarios and profitability implications.
  • Facilitate pricing war rooms and deal review forums for key opportunities.
  • Drive adoption of value-based pricing principles across the region.

Commercial Performance Management

  • Define and track pricing KPIs including: Price realization Discount leakage Margin improvement Approval cycle times Pricing compliance Win rate by margin band
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to regional and country leadership teams.

Capability Building & Change Management

  • Lead pricing excellence training programs for commercial and product management teams.
  • Develop playbooks, tools, and standard methodologies to improve pricing maturity.
  • Build organizational capability in pricing analytics, negotiation, and value selling.
  • Act as the regional subject matter expert for pricing and margin optimization.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, Product Management, Commercial Excellence, and General Managers.
  • Influence senior stakeholders to drive adoption of pricing best practices.
  • Lead regional pricing initiatives and continuous improvement programs.

Minimum Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in pricing, commercial excellence, strategy, sales operations, finance, consulting, or related commercial leadership roles.
  • Experience in industrial, HVAC, building solutions, engineered products, manufacturing, or B2B environments preferred.
  • Demonstrated success driving pricing initiatives, margin improvement, and commercial transformation programs.

Minimum Skills:

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong financial acumen and business judgment.
  • Experience with pricing analytics and dashboard development.
  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority across multiple countries and business units.
  • Strong project management and change leadership skills.

##

**

##

About Carrier

**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

**

##

About the role Carrier is seeking an Application Engineer to join the Application Engineering team supporting HVAC controls and building automation solutions. This role is responsible for developing, testing, and delivering control applications, graphics, and technical documentation for factory and field-deployed systems. The ideal candidate will combine strong HVAC knowledge with controls programming expertise and will play a key role in enabling successful product releases and sustaining existing solutions across multiple product platforms.

Sequence of operation documents

Bug fixes and defect resolution

job.title: DCS/BMS Service Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As the DCS (Distributed Control System)/BMS (Building Management System) Service Engineer, you will report to the DCS Regional Manager (who is based in Australia), and work closely with the rest of the Technical Operations team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Providing technical expertise relating to the DCS with a heavy emphasis on maintenance, system optimisation and root cause analysis
  • Ensuring that the existing systems are maintained to the highest possible standards with the ultimate goal: a fine-tuned control system that provides information that can be heavily relied on and quickly address, prevent and/or anticipate any system errors that may arise
  • Lead and manage small-scale improvement projects aimed at enhancing system performance and efficiency.
  • Being part of a wider in-sourced DCS Service & Support Team supporting infrastructure across the whole of Asia, Australia and India.

What You'll Do

  • DCS and CMS Maintenance: Fully maintain the Distributed Control System (DCS) and Central Monitoring System (CMS) from servers to field devices across multiple sites, ensuring efficient operation as per the maintenance scope of works. This includes conducting system backups, ensuring ICT and cybersecurity compliance, and updating firmware/software in collaboration with 3rd party providers.
  • Optimization and Risk Mitigation: Provide risk-mitigated plant optimization strategies, including system optimization and energy efficiency initiatives. Analyze vast amounts of data to generate actionable insights and recommendations, using analytics-based approaches to enhance system performance and reliability.
  • Incident Management and Technical Support: Attend to controls-related incidents, including event investigations, root cause analysis, and problem management. Provide L1 to L3 technical support across site teams and other locations as required, ensuring adherence to response priority SLAs.
  • Niagara Diagnostics and Communication Protocols: Address performance issues within Niagara applications, ensuring optimal functionality. Maintain communication protocols at peak efficiency, resolving issues that cause lags or high processor utilization.
  • Collaboration and Site Confidence: Work closely with site operations teams during maintenance activities, ensuring open communication and integration with site teams to build strong relationships and confidence in system operations. Contribute to the successful resolution of post-construction controls-related defects.
  • Continual Improvement and Project Delivery: Lead and support DCS-related projects aimed at system optimization and operational improvements that benefit data center facilities. Ensure adherence to system baselines, safe work practices, and change management procedures.

**

What You'll Bring

**

  • 3+ years experience in the maintenance, programming, and integration of Tridium Niagara based control systems (essential); data centre experience preferred
  • Awareness of mission critical Data Centre infrastructure such as redundant electrical systems and chilled water plant control strategies
  • A working knowledge of HVAC, Electrical, UPS, and associated plant and the different automation protocols, e.g. BACnet, Modbus, DNP3, etc.
  • Ability to construct PLC code from scratch and fully understand existing code including industrial PLC ladder logic and DDC visual logic
  • Ability to interpret mechanical and electrical drawings and specifications
  • Possess strong technical implementation background in DDC/PLC logic, Bacnet/Modbus configuration, ICT/networking and server administration
  • Experience working with a range of DDC, BMS and SCADA products and platforms such as Distech Controls, Johnson Controls, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, Moxa and so forth.
  • Familiarity with relevant codes and standards such as ASHRAE, BCA, AS.
  • Hands-on experience in plant optimisation and tuning
  • Strong computer and networking skills
  • Strong communicator with the ability to interact with all professional levels within an organisation
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Billings Resolution Specialist
job.description:
The Opportunity:

Join our Finance team as a Billing Consultant, where you’ll play a key role in resolving complex customer billing enquiries and disputes while delivering a high standard of customer service.

You’ll investigate billing issues from end to end — analysing invoices, contracts, pricing, account information and billing data to understand what has happened, determine the right outcome and communicate it clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.

Working closely with Credit, Account Management, Service Delivery, Sales, suppliers and carriers, you’ll help resolve complex billing matters while identifying the root causes behind recurring issues and finding ways to prevent them happening again.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, working with data and getting to the bottom of complex issues. Based in our Sydney office, you’ll work across Macquarie Technology Group’s business and government customer base in a role where your work has a direct impact on customer experience and our NPS.

The Opportunity:

Join our Finance team as a Billing Consultant, where you’ll play a key role in resolving complex customer billing enquiries and disputes while delivering a high standard of customer service.

You’ll investigate billing issues from end to end — analysing invoices, contracts, pricing, account information and billing data to understand what has happened, determine the right outcome and communicate it clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.

Working closely with Credit, Account Management, Service Delivery, Sales, suppliers and carriers, you’ll help resolve complex billing matters while identifying the root causes behind recurring issues and finding ways to prevent them happening again.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, working with data and getting to the bottom of complex issues. You’ll also have the opportunity to improve processes, reporting and ways of working, including leveraging AI and modern technology to make billing resolution smarter and more efficient.

Based in our Sydney office, you’ll work across Macquarie Technology Group’s business and government customer base in a role where your work has a direct impact on customer experience and our NPS.

About You

  • You’re an analytical problem solver who enjoys investigating issues and finding practical solutions.

Required Skills

job.title: Senior Manager, Design Delivery
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1 billion in committed capital.

Our mission is to bridge the digital divide across Asia Pacific by building the sustainable digital ecosystems of the future. Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making digital infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical.

Founded in 2020 the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, and the Philippines.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Grit: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

We are seeking a highly skilled and driven Senior Design Delivery Manager with a strong electrical/mechanical engineering background to lead the design and delivery process for our data centre projects across the APAC region. This leadership role is responsible for managing the successful implementation of the overall design, with particular focus on mechanical systems such as HVAC, chilled water systems, and liquid cooling readiness.

The ideal candidate will work cross-functionally to ensure the electrical/mechanical design is integrated effectively into the full MEP design and executed in line with project objectives, quality standards, and schedule commitments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Electrical/Mechanical Design Leadership:

Drive the mechanical design development, including HVAC, cooling distribution systems, chilled water plants, and white space air management, ensuring alignment with performance, efficiency, and operational goals; Contribute to initializing cooling plant or various equipment standard operating procedures (SOPs) and producing clear, comprehensive technical advice to support technical review process across different manufacturers.

  • End-to-End Design Delivery:

Oversee the delivery of the full data centre design scope—from concept to IFC—ensuring technical quality, timely execution, and alignment with customer and business requirements.

  • Integrated Design Management:

Lead coordination across disciplines—mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, architectural, structural, and security—to ensure seamless integration of the design.

  • Consultant and Vendor Management:

Manage design consultants and key vendors, reviewing deliverables and resolving technical challenges to ensure compliance and constructability.

  • Design Assurance & Technical Reviews:

Conduct design reviews and risk assessments to validate that mechanical systems meet internal requirements, regulatory standards, and operational best practices.

  • Documentation & Standardization:

Maintain and improve internal design guidelines, technical specifications, and standard details to ensure consistency and quality across projects.

  • Construction & Commissioning Support:

Interface with construction and commissioning teams to ensure mechanical systems are installed and tested as per design intent. Review and validate the Sequence of Operations (SOO) during T&C.

  • Continuous Improvement:

Stay informed on industry trends and evolving cooling technologies (e.g. liquid cooling, hybrid solutions) to drive innovation and future-proof our designs.

  • Stakeholder Engagement:

Communicate design concepts, progress updates, and risks effectively with internal stakeholders, customers, and senior management.

  • Mentoring Process

Contributes to mentoring junior team members and supports the identification and development of training programs for new team members as the team grows.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

Candidate Profile:

**

  • Bachelor’s Degree in relevant Engineering studies or equivalent.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in electrical/mechanical system design and delivery, with at least 3 years in hyperscale or colocation data centres.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical systems design, including HVAC, chilled water, free cooling, and white space environmental control.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, Excel, PowerPoint; Revit or BIM coordination experience is advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage consultants and lead design integration across disciplines.
  • Familiar with APAC regional design codes and international standards (ASHRAE, ISO, etc.).
  • Strong analytical, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification is preferred.
  • Experience with liquid cooling or AI workload readiness is a plus.

If you’re passionate about driving innovative design solutions and want to help shape the future of digital infrastructure in Asia, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Project Manager

Outside Plant Operations

  • Lead engagement with Engineering, Procurement, Legal, Regulatory and Workplace Safety stakeholders for each CSD/USD project.
  • Assess technical, operational, commercial and stakeholder requirements and recommend optimal solutions.

End-to-End Construction & Project Management

  • Develop tender requirements and participate in evaluation and award processes.
  • Lead contractors through construction and ensure engineering, safety and quality compliance.
  • Manage project scope, schedule, cost, quality, risks and contractor performance; make timely onsite decisions when field conditions differ from approved plans.
  • Review claims, variations, invoices and acceptance of completed works; ensure close-out, handover and as-built documentation.

Underground Infrastructure Operations, Access & Asset Stewardship

  • Assume responsibility for operation, maintenance, access governance and infrastructure integrity.
  • Assess and coordinate third-party access applications, operational risks, site constraints and applicable charges.
  • Coordinate onsite access where works may affect telecommunications infrastructure; maintain access records and GIS/as-built information.
  • Safeguard infrastructure integrity and resolve operational disputes.

Commercial, Contractual & Stakeholder Negotiation

  • Lead technical, commercial and contractual negotiations with stakeholders.
  • Review ownership interfaces, cost-sharing arrangements, charges and commercial obligations.
  • Apply operational knowledge so contractual terms are practical and enforceable; work with Legal, Risk and Procurement on agreements and risk exposure.
  • Manage commercial commitments, billing and payment obligations; resolve disputes and recommend escalation where exposure is significant.

**

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor Degree in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical or related Engineering discipline
  • At least 3 years of relevant telecommunications, underground utility or infrastructure project experience
  • Outside Plant operations, maintenance and incident / restoration management.
  • Common / Utilities Service Duct feasibility, alignment planning, detailed design, underground-space optimisation and cost estimation.
  • Construction and project management covering scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, contractor performance and close-out.
  • Underground infrastructure access governance, asset integrity, GIS / as-built information and third-party works coordination.
  • Technical, commercial and contractual negotiation, including claims, cost sharing, charges and commercial obligations.
  • Stakeholder coordination and negotiation; incident leadership; engineering judgement; dispute resolution.
  • Safety and operational compliance; contractor performance auditing; field inspection and risk assessment.
  • Tender requirements and evaluation participation.

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Strategic Planning and Operations Lead, APAC Sales
job.description:

  • Create and deliver executive-level communications, including weekly business reviews, briefings and strategic narratives, that engage and align senior stakeholders across sales, product, data science, and operations
  • Deliver timely, decision-ready insights to the right stakeholders, in a form they can act on directly. which includes the WHAT, WHY, SO WHAT. Able to identify commonalities and insights that can potentially scale across markets and regions
  • Partner with Data Science and Finance to provide a data-driven approach on goals and planning
  • Translate global initiatives into regional execution, and develop regional work with the potential to scale globally

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 5 or more years of experience in a hands-on quantitative or technical role,
  • Demonstrated proficiency with SQL and Python, including hands-on experience with large, complex, multi-source datasets in a production data environment
  • Demonstrated experience taking an insight through root-cause diagnosis to an executed action plan with a measurable business outcome
  • Experience driving GTM outcomes through Sales and cross-functional partners

Preferred Qualifications

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. job.title: Specialist - Data Center Operations
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The role of Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

This role designs, plans, installs, and / or maintains mechanical, electrical, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability data center environments.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Assist in scheduling and supervising vendors/subcontractors during equipment / systems maintenance and service.
  • Provides recommendation of improvements to the operations and maintenance program on an on-going basis.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Seasoned understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Seasoned proficiency of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Seasoned knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Seasoned knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.)

  • Experience required:
  • Seasoned experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Seasoned experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Seasoned experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Seasoned experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Seasoned experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Senior AI Engineer

Skills

  • Ability to bridge software engineering fundamentals with modern AI/GenAI technologies to deliver production-ready solutions.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, architecture decisions, and technical recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to understand business problems and translate them into scalable AI applications.
  • Strong technical leadership, mentoring, and decision-making capabilities in fast-paced and evolving technology environments.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience building, deploying, and maintaining AI-powered applications and intelligent agents.
  • Expertise in Large Language Model (LLM) application development and Generative AI solution design.
  • Experience developing agentic AI workflows, multi-agent systems, and AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering, agent evaluation, guardrails, grounding techniques, and AI application observability.
  • Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, vector databases, and knowledge management architectures.

  • Experience integrating both commercial and open-source foundation models.
  • Knowledge of model serving, inference optimization, and AI workflow orchestration patterns.
  • Software Engineering & Application Development
  • Strong proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications and APIs.
  • Experience with modern software engineering practices including object-oriented design, design patterns, testing, and secure coding principles.
  • Experience developing REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or similar frameworks for AI application development.
  • Understanding of distributed systems and scalable application architecture.
  • Data Engineering & AI Platforms
  • Experience working with Azure Databricks, Spark, and modern data platforms supporting AI workloads.
  • Strong understanding of data pipelines, feature engineering, and data preparation for AI applications.
  • Experience integrating enterprise data sources, structured and unstructured datasets, and knowledge repositories.
  • Familiarity with vector databases and embedding-based retrieval architectures.
  • Understanding of modern data lake, warehouse, and lakehouse architectures.
  • Cloud, DevOps & MLOps
  • Strong experience with Azure cloud services supporting AI workloads, including:

job.title: Senior ProServe Cloud Architect , Professional Services - ASEAN
job.description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced Senior ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) to join our ASEAN team based in Singapore. In this role, you'll work closely with customers across Singapore and the broader ASEAN region to understand their technical requirements and business objectives, designing and implementing tailored cloud solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes.

As a Senior PCA, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption journey — from migration and modernization to building cloud-native applications and leveraging emerging technologies such as generative AI. You will be a key player in the pre-sales process, providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the customer's cloud journey.

Key job responsibilities Technical Leadership & Solution Design

  • Lead cloud solutioning during the pre-sales motion, providing demonstrations, initial scoping, designing, and managing AWS solutions while providing technical guidance and best practices
  • Architect and design scalable, resilient, and secure cloud solutions that address complex customer challenges across industries including public sector, financial services, telecommunications, and enterprise
  • Drive cloud modernization and AI/ML transformation initiatives, including generative AI adoption strategies
  • Define and lead technical workstreams across multiple concurrent engagements

Customer Engagement & Advisory

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and senior technical stakeholders, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions to address customer challenges
  • Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations
  • Build deep customer relationships and identify opportunities to expand AWS adoption and Professional Services engagement
  • Collaborate with AWS account teams, solution architects, and service teams to deliver integrated solutions

Delivery Excellence

  • Lead and deliver complex cloud engagements including migrations, modernizations, data & analytics, and application development projects
  • Ensure delivery quality, manage technical risks, and drive customer satisfaction
  • Define project scope, estimates, and technical approaches for statements of work (SOW)
  • Mentor and guide junior architects and consultants on the team

Thought Leadership & Community

  • Share knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, creation of reusable artifacts, and process improvements
  • Contribute to the development of ProServe best practices, frameworks, and accelerators
  • Represent AWS ProServe at customer events, industry conferences, and community forums across ASEAN
  • Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to apply new AWS services and features to customer challenges

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
  • 5+ years of leading development of solutions backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
  • Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
  • Experience leading complex, multi-workload cloud engagements (migration, modernization, cloud-native development)
  • Strong experience in pre-sales solutioning, including scoping, estimation, and proposal development

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
  • Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
  • Experience with enterprise systems including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
  • Experience working with public sector, government, and regulated industry customers in Singapore and ASEAN
  • Familiarity with ASEAN market dynamics, digital transformation initiatives (e.g., Smart Nation, government cloud policies), and regional compliance requirements
  • Experience with generative AI, machine learning, and data analytics solution design
  • Experience with large-scale migration programs (1000+ servers) using AWS Migration tools and methodologies

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: R&D Associate Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Lab Team Lead__

Your Role and Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. Join our R&D Centre of Excellence (lab organization) based in Napier and you’ll get to shape the future of energy. Our products range from Power Protection (UPS) to Battery Energy Storage to Static Frequency Converters, with power ranges from 300kW to 3600kW. Our team was proud to be named Exporter of the Year at the ExportNZ ASB Hawke’s Bay Export Awards and to receive the Ziwi Excellence in Innovation Award, recognizing our commitment to innovation and global impact.

We are looking for a range of skills from qualified engineers to industrial electricians to technicians who want to contribute to the future of energy.

Work model: Onsite #LI-Onsite

  • Define product test requirements and conduct electrical/electronics testing, including high power systems.
  • Prototype and develop hardware test rigs, ensuring compliance with safety protocols.
  • Apply reliability engineering principles and international standards (CE & UL) to product testing.
  • Automate testing processes and provide clear, high-quality reports to support product development.

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters – because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

##

Qualifications for the Role

  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or equivalent qualification (e.g., industrial electrician, technician diploma, trade certification)
  • Previous exposure to and experience with 3‑phase systems
  • Experience with products such as UPS, energy storage systems, variable speed drives, or PLCs
  • Knowledge of international product safety standards (CE & UL) and reliability engineering practices
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills in a laboratory environment
  • Familiarity with electrical/electronic test equipment and report writing
  • Mindset to innovate, take ownership, and drive continuous improvement

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Sales Manager Fire Suppression - Pan India
job.description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place - where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solution.

Job Role -

Sales Manager – Fire Suppression will be responsible for driving the growth of the Fire Suppression business across India. The role will focus on Gas Suppression and High-Pressure Water Mist (HPWM) solutions across key market segments.

Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve Order Intake, Revenue and business growth targets.

Build strong relationships with key End Users, particularly in Data Centers and Industrial verticals.

Develop and maintain strong engagement with Consultants, EPCs, PMCs and System Integrators.

Leverage relationships with State Fire Departments and other key stakeholders.

Provide technical and application expertise on Fire Suppression systems, designs and relevant standards.

Identify new market opportunities, strategic projects and applications to expand the business geographically.

Develop partners and strengthen the Fire Suppression ecosystem across India.

The ideal candidate should be a go-getter with 15+ years of relevant experience, strong market relationships and a proven track record of building and growing project-based Fire Suppression business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Growth & Sales

o Develop and execute the national sales strategy for the Fire Suppression portfolio to achieve Order Intake and Revenue targets.

o Identify new market opportunities, applications and verticals to expand the Fire Suppression business.

o Develop a healthy sales funnel and ensure effective conversion of opportunities into orders.

o Drive business growth through direct engagement with end users, consultants, EPCs, system integrators and strategic partners.

o Identify and develop large projects in Data Centers, Industrial, Infrastructure, Transportation, Energy and other high-value segments.

  • End-User & Key Account Management

o Build and maintain strong relationships with key end users, especially in the Data Center and Industrial sectors.

o Develop strategic account plans for major customers and identify opportunities for specification and standardization of Siemens Fire Suppression solutions.

o Engage with decision makers at CXO, technical, project and procurement levels to create business opportunities.

  • Consultant & Stakeholder Engagement

o Establish strong relationships with Fire & Life Safety consultants, MEP consultants, EPCs and project management consultants.

o Drive product and system specifications with consultants and key influencers.

o Conduct technical presentations, solution workshops and product demonstrations.

o Develop relationships with government and infrastructure stakeholders including State Fire Departments to create opportunities and support project approvals/specifications.

  • Technical & Solution Knowledge

o Develop in-depth understanding of Fire Suppression systems, applications, design requirements and relevant codes/standards.

o Demonstrate strong technical knowledge of Gas Suppression systems and High-Pressure Water Mist solutions.

o Understand system architecture, hydraulic/design considerations, application suitability, equipment selection and project execution requirements.

o Work closely with Pre-Sales, Engineering, Product Management and HQ teams to develop technically and commercially competitive solutions.

  • Market & Competition

o Continuously monitor market trends, customer requirements, competitor activities and pricing dynamics.

o Develop strategies to improve Siemens' competitiveness and market penetration.

o Identify portfolio gaps and communicate market requirements to Product Management and HQ.

o Develop a clear understanding of competitors and their offerings in Gas Suppression and Water Mist markets.

  • Partner & Channel Development

o Identify, onboard and develop suitable Fire Suppression partners/System Integrators across key regions.

o Build partner capability through technical training, product training and joint customer engagement.

o Develop a scalable partner ecosystem to support national business growth.

o Monitor partner performance and develop corrective actions where required.

  • Project & Opportunity Management

o Drive strategic opportunities from lead generation through specification, tendering, negotiation and closure.

o Develop project strategies covering key stakeholders, competition, commercial positioning and win strategy.

o Ensure accurate opportunity management and funnel hygiene in Siemens Sales systems.

o Coordinate with internal stakeholders for pricing, technical support, approvals and project execution.

  • Business Development & Market Expansion

o Identify emerging applications for Fire Suppression, including Data Centers, BESS, Industrial facilities, tunnels, transportation, critical infrastructure and other high-risk applications.

o Expand the geographical footprint of the business by developing new customers, consultants and partners.

o Generate new business opportunities beyond the existing customer base and create a sustainable long-term growth pipeline.

  • Internal Collaboration

o Work closely with Regional Sales teams to drive execution of the national Fire Suppression strategy.

o Coordinate with Pre-Sales, Engineering, Operations, SCM, Finance, Product Management and HQ teams.

o Provide regular market intelligence, sales forecasts, funnel reviews and business updates to management.

Candidate Profile

  • Experience: 15 years of relevant experience in Fire Suppression / Fire & Life Safety / Building Safety solutions.
  • Strong experience in Gas Suppression and/or High-Pressure Water Mist systems; exposure to both portfolios will be preferred.
  • Strong technical understanding of Fire Suppression systems, design principles, applications, codes and standards.
  • Proven experience in selling complex project-based Fire Suppression solutions.
  • Strong existing network with Data Center and Industrial end users.
  • Experience working with consultants, EPCs, PMCs and system integrators.
  • Experience and established connect with relevant government/infrastructure stakeholders such as State Fire Departments will be highly valuable.
  • Strong commercial understanding, negotiation skills and ability to manage large strategic opportunities.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across India.

Key Competencies

  • Strong hunter / business development mindset
  • Go-getter with a strong ownership mentality
  • Strategic account development
  • Consultative and solution selling
  • Technical & application knowledge
  • Strong networking and stakeholder management
  • Commercial and negotiation skills
  • Ability to influence consultants and end users
  • Strong execution orientation
  • Ability to work independently and build a business from the ground up Success Measures

The role will be measured on:

  • Fire Suppression Order Intake and Revenue growth
  • New customer and end-user acquisition
  • Data Center and Industrial business development
  • Strategic project wins
  • Sales funnel creation and conversion
  • Consultant/specification development
  • Partner development and productivity
  • Geographic expansion
  • Growth of Gas Suppression and HPWM businesses
  • Market share and competitive positioning

This role is based in Mumbai/ Gurgaon/ Thane where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.

Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

Find out more about Smart Infrastructure at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/topic-areas/smart-infrastructure.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers
