job.title: Labour Compliance Executive
job.description:
Labour Compliance Executive (Contractual)

Johnson Controls is looking for a Labour Compliance Executive to support project compliance and subcontractor compliance activities across customer assignments. In this role, you will help prepare, submit, track, and close compliance documentation while working closely with customers, subcontractors, and internal teams.

Role Overview

You will be responsible for managing statutory and project-related compliance documentation end to end. The role combines customer coordination, subcontractor guidance, document control, audit support, and follow-up on remarks and approvals to help ensure compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Arrange initial calls or meetings with customers to understand their compliance process requirements and gather information on document submissions.
  • Prepare and provide compliance documents as per customer requests.
  • Ensure timely preparation, submission, and maintenance of all required compliance documents, both online and offline, in line with regulatory guidelines and internal policies.
  • Track customer remarks on submitted compliance documents and coordinate the required corrections or responses.
  • Obtain audit reports related to compliance submissions from the customer site and maintain the related records.
  • Conduct introductory calls with subcontractors to explain the billing process and compliance expectations.
  • Guide subcontractors in accordance with JCI HR SOP and customer requirements.
  • Review subcontractor compliance documents against the checklist and identify gaps or non-compliance.
  • Coordinate with the JCI Project Team, SCM Team, and subcontractors to address non-compliance and drive closure.
  • Obtain Compliance Manager approval for reviewed compliance documents and share the approved status with the subcontractor.
  • Support BOCW, CLRA, and ISMW related licenses and returns.
  • Maintain knowledge of minimum wages, labour laws, PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, and related compliance requirements.
  • Support implementation of the new wage code for subcontractors and vendors.

How You Will Do It

  • Take ownership from intake to closure, keeping every compliance case accurate, traceable, and submitted on time.
  • Stay close to the work by clarifying requirements directly with customers and subcontractors before issues become delays.
  • Work with discipline and attention to detail when handling checklists, registers, remarks, approvals, and audit records.
  • Use candor and problem-solving to flag gaps early, resolve non-compliance quickly, and improve the process over time.
  • Collaborate as one team with project, SCM, HR, and compliance stakeholders while still working independently and managing priorities effectively.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 7 years of experience in labour compliance, statutory compliance, project compliance, or subcontractor compliance.
  • Graduate degree in HR, Commerce, Business Administration, Social Work, or equivalent experience.
  • Good communication skills, with local language proficiency mandatory.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, manage tasks effectively, and meet deadlines.
  • Good working knowledge of MS Office, especially Word and Excel.
  • Working knowledge of BOCW, CLRA, ISMW, PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, minimum wages, and labour law compliance.
  • Understanding of customer-facing compliance documentation, audit follow-up, and internal control requirements.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting project compliance and subcontractor compliance in a customer-facing environment.
  • Exposure to compliance checklists, audit reports, and remark closure workflows.
  • Familiarity with third-party or contractual project environments.
  • Experience with new wage code implementation for subcontractors and vendors.

If this sounds like the right fit for your background, we’d like to hear from you.

This role will see you working across a portfolio of commercial buildings, healthcare facilities, critical infrastructure, industrial sites, and other complex customer environments. You'll be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, optimising, and supporting Building Management Systems that play a critical role in our customers' operations.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, Delivery Managers, Architects, and Development Teams to ensure alignment on priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
  • Agile Metrics and Reporting: Monitor and analyze key Agile metrics such as velocity, sprint burndown, cycle time, lead time, and team health indicators to drive data-driven improvements.
  • Risk and Dependency Management: Identify, communicate, and manage risks, dependencies, and blockers across teams to minimize delivery impacts and ensure smooth execution.

Must Have

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master and 8-12 years of overall IT industry experience preferred. with strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and SAFe methodologies.
  • SAFe certifications - SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), Certified Scrum Master (CSM).
  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure effective team delivery.
  • Support SAFe Program Increment (PI) Planning, ART events, dependency management, and cross-team collaboration.
  • Coach teams and stakeholders on Agile best practices, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and self-organization.
  • Track Agile metrics such as Velocity, Burndown, and PI Predictability, and provide visibility into risks, issues, and progress.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile tools Azure DevOps, along with excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • 8 to 12 years of overall IT experience

job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Title:Engineering Manager

Overview: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the design, development, delivery, and ongoing support of a .NET-based web application. This role will provide both people leadership and technical direction for a team of software engineers, partnering closely with Product Owners, Architects, QA, UX, DevOps, security, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, high-quality digital capabilities. The Engineering Manager will be accountable for team performance, engineering execution, technical standards, delivery commitments, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, Azure platforms, modern web application architecture, Agile delivery, and a proven ability to mentor engineers, manage priorities, resolve technical risks, and align engineering outcomes with business goals.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing engineering team responsible for building, enhancing, and supporting the application.
  • Own engineering execution across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, code quality, testing, release readiness, deployment, support, and production stability.
  • Provide technical direction for application architecture, development, RESTful APIs, integrations, database design, security, scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Architects, QA, UX, DevOps, security, operations, and business stakeholders to translate business priorities into clear technical plans and delivery milestones.
  • Drive engineering best practices, including clean code, design patterns, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, documentation, and secure development standards.
  • Manage delivery commitments, sprint or release planning, dependency resolution, risk mitigation, resource allocation, and workload balancing for the engineering team.
  • Review technical designs and implementation approaches to ensure solutions are maintainable, extensible, performant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Support troubleshooting of complex application issues, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, integration failures, and quality defects.
  • Coach engineers through regular feedback, career development conversations, goal setting, performance reviews, skills development, and succession planning.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, team planning, vendor coordination, and capability building to ensure the team has the right skills and capacity to meet delivery objectives.
  • Promote a collaborative, accountable, inclusive, and continuous improvement-oriented engineering culture focused on customer value and operational excellence.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, including hands-on development of enterprise web applications using Microsoft technologies.
  • 3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing software engineering teams, including performance management, delivery ownership, and technical guidance.
  • Strong proficiency with .NET framework and Azure platform, RESTful services, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and asynchronous programming.
  • Experience designing, developing, and operating scalable, secure, maintainable web applications and backend services in a modern enterprise environment.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL Server or other relational databases, including data modeling, query optimization, stored procedures, and application data access patterns.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, including services such as App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, storage, identity, monitoring, or related platform capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based source control, branching strategies, automated testing, build and release practices, DevOps tooling, and application monitoring.
  • Ability to review architecture and code, guide technical decision-making, address technical debt, and ensure engineering standards are consistently applied.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with Product Owners, Architects, QA, UX, DevOps, security, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, problem-solving, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Preferred qualifications include Microsoft Azure or .NET certifications, experience with microservices, containerization, frontend frameworks such as Angular, React, or Blazor, and ecommerce or B2B web application experience.

job.title: Regional Ethics & Compliance Officer, Southeast Asia & Australia
job.description:
Position Title

Regional Ethics & Compliance Officer, Southeast Asia & Australia

Position Purpose

The Regional Ethics & Compliance Officer (ECO), Southeast Asia & Australia, is the senior Ethics & Compliance leader accountable for advancing Carrier’s ethics, compliance, investigations, and integrity agenda across Southeast Asia and Australia.

The role also supports the strategic execution of international trade compliance priorities across Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa (AME). Working in close partnership with senior business leaders and the Legal, Human Resources, Audit, Security, and Corporate Ethics & Compliance teams, the ECO identifies and mitigates compliance risk, strengthens a culture of integrity, and enables sustainable business growth. As a member of the AME Ethics & Compliance leadership team, the role provides trusted counsel on complex risk matters, leads significant investigations, and ensures consistent application of Carrier’s global compliance framework across diverse markets and jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Compliance Leadership
  • Define and execute the regional Ethics & Compliance strategy in alignment with Carrier’s global priorities, business objectives, and evolving regional risk profile.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to regional leadership on ethics, compliance, governance, and integrity matters, translating regulatory requirements into practical business guidance.
  • Advance program maturity through continuous improvement, data-driven insights, and disciplined operational execution.
  • Provide compliance leadership for strategic business initiatives, including acquisitions, transformations, integrations, and market expansion.
  • Risk Assessment & Governance
  • Lead periodic compliance risk assessments, prioritize key exposures, and oversee timely remediation plans.
  • Monitor emerging regulatory developments, enforcement trends, and business risks across the region, and assess their potential impact.
  • Develop clear governance reporting, performance metrics, and executive briefings that support informed decision-making.
  • Partner with Legal, Human Resources, Audit, Security, and business leaders to design and implement effective risk-mitigation measures.
  • Investigations & Speak Up Program
  • Lead complex, high-impact investigations involving alleged misconduct, conflicts of interest, fraud, corruption, retaliation, and policy violations.
  • Ensure investigations are conducted promptly, independently, consistently, and with appropriate confidentiality and procedural rigor.
  • Oversee regional Speak Up case management and anti-retaliation efforts, identifying trends and opportunities for preventive action.
  • Present substantiated findings, risk implications, and practical recommendations to senior leadership and relevant governance forums.
  • Training, Communications & Culture
  • Develop and deliver risk-based Ethics & Compliance training and communications tailored to leaders, employees, and relevant third parties.
  • Promote a culture in which employees feel empowered to raise concerns, seek guidance, and make decisions consistent with Carrier’s values.
  • Engage leaders as visible champions of integrity and support initiatives that strengthen ethical leadership and accountability.
  • Third-Party & Trade Compliance Oversight
  • Provide oversight and guidance for regional third-party risk management, due diligence, onboarding, monitoring, and remediation activities.
  • Advise on export controls, economic sanctions, and other international trade compliance matters in partnership with relevant subject-matter experts.
  • Conduct site assessments, compliance reviews, and distributor or channel-partner engagements to evaluate control effectiveness and reinforce expectations.
  • Regional Network Leadership
  • Build, coach, and coordinate a high-performing network of local Ethics & Compliance Officers and compliance champions across SEAP.
  • Lead cross-functional and cross-border compliance initiatives, fostering consistent standards, shared learning, and effective execution across jurisdictions.

Job Grade

Manager / Professional M6 / P6

Location

Singapore (preferred) or Malaysia

**

Reporting Line

Reports directly to the Director, Deputy Ethics & Compliance Leader, Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa, with regular engagement and significant visibility to AME and Corporate Ethics & Compliance leadership.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in ethics and compliance, legal, investigations, audit, risk management, or a related function.
  • Demonstrated success leading regional or multinational compliance programs in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Substantial experience managing complex and sensitive investigations, including the assessment of evidence and development of defensible recommendations.
  • Strong working knowledge of anti-corruption, competition law, regulatory compliance, corporate governance, and third-party risk management.
  • Experience with international trade compliance, including export controls and sanctions, is strongly preferred.
  • Relevant professional certification—such as CCEP, ICA, legal, audit, or investigation credentials—is desirable.

Key Competencies

  • Executive presence and the ability to build credibility, challenge constructively, and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinking, sound judgment, and an enterprise-wide perspective.
  • Uncompromising integrity, independence, discretion, and resilience.
  • Clear, persuasive communication and strong executive presentation skills.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to balance risk mitigation with practical commercial considerations.
  • Cultural agility and the ability to operate effectively across functions, countries, and regulatory environments.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English; proficiency in an additional Asian language is advantageous.

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

job.description:
**Southeast Asia, Financial Planning & Analysis Financial Planning Analyst Singapore Full time

**Build a career with confidence:

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the role

The Southeast Asia Financial Planning & Analysis role is responsible for regional financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance management across Southeast Asia. This position partners closely with country finance teams, regional business leaders, and functional stakeholders to provide timely financial insights, support strategic decision-making, and drive disciplined execution against financial commitments. The role also supports regional forecast consolidation, performance analysis, working capital management, and planning processes, while advancing standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support Southeast Asia financial reporting cadence, including weekly performance updates, monthly forecasts, quarterly business reviews, annual operating plans, and long-range planning cycles.
  • Consolidate regional forecasts and performance results across sales, orders, backlog, profitability, cash flow, working capital, and functional costs.
  • Prepare clear, executive-ready financial reviews, performance narratives, and decision-support materials for regional leadership.
  • Partner with country finance teams, Equipment and Aftermarket leaders, and business stakeholders to identify risks, opportunities, and actions required to deliver financial targets.

  • Support HFM data consolidation activities, including out-of-balance reviews, data validation, and HFM lock procedures.
  • Drive reporting standardization, process optimization, and automation initiatives to improve quality, speed, and scalability across the region.
  • Support ad hoc financial analysis, business cases, and leadership requests as required.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related discipline; professional certification such as CPA, ACCA, or CFA is advantageous.
  • 5–8 years of experience in financial planning and analysis, commercial finance, controllership, or a related finance role, preferably within a multinational or regional business environment.
  • Strong financial modelling, forecasting, variance analysis, and business performance management skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to develop executive-level financial presentations and analysis.
  • Experience with financial systems such as HFM and SAP; exposure to dashboarding, automation, or business intelligence tools is a plus.

Strong analytical capability with the ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and simplify financial messages for decision-making.

Continuous improvement mindset with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to drive process simplification and automationCarrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. job.title: ICT Support Specialist
job.description:
About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia's leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities.

Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC's diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone's unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world's best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

The ICT Support Specialist works across a broad range of technologies, providing advanced technical support to end users while contributing to the administration and maintenance of CDC ICT environment. The role combines senior service desk responsibilities with systems administration capability, ensuring incidents are resolved efficiently while supporting the ongoing reliability, security and performance of the organisation's IT infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide advanced IT support for hardware, software, network, application, and end-user issues, including managing escalations and ensuring excellent customer service.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex incidents and service requests while maintaining accurate ticketing, documentation, and communication.
  • Administer and support core infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, networking, file services, and endpoint management.
  • Manage and support corporate ICT assets, including laptops, desktops, printers, mobile devices, MDM solutions, and business applications such as Microsoft Office.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver projects, upgrades, migrations, technical documentation, and continuous service improvements.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring within the ICT team, supporting junior staff, sharing technical knowledge, and contributing to a positive team culture.

About you

  • Minimum five years' experience in senior Service Desk, ICT Support or Systems Administration role
  • Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Entra IS (Azure AD), Exchange Online, SharePoint, Intune and supporting Windows 10/11 desktop environments
  • Sound understanding of networking fundamentals (LAN, WAN, DNS and TCP/IP)
  • Experience managing ICT assets and endpoint devices, participating in infrastructure projects and technology implementations.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving capabilities

Essential:

Australian Citizenship and ability to obtain an NV1 Security Clearance. This role is a fully onsite role.

What's in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC's offers staff and their family's inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: Data Center Technician (Shift pattern)
job.description:
Overview

Location: Schiphol

This role involves working a 6 day shift rotation covering shifts 06:00-14:30, 14:30-12:00(midnight) and 12:00(midnight) - 06:00.

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services.

As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.
  • Participates in daily safety briefings, completes required training aligned to the role and workload including safety training, and complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
  • Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with guidance from other technicians.
  • Complies with security and data management procedures and policies with guidance from other technicians and completes the required security training.
  • Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data centre facilities.
  • Embodies our culture and values.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience, with basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.
  • Work Schedule: Ability to work shifts, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Transportation: Valid driver’s licence and access to a personal vehicle for travel to client sites and company locations as part of shift responsibilities._*This role requires you to be on-site and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised._

Background Check Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is mandatory for this role. These include, but are not limited to:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: Must be passed upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • Applicable certifications such as:
  • CompTIA: A+, Server+, Network+
  • Basic Structure Cabling (BSC)

Data Center Technicians ATR-B - The typical base pay range for this role across Netherlands is € 42,600.00 - € 55,000.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

job.title: Officer - Tool Room
job.description:
To ensure maximum availability, reliability, and performance of plastic injection moulds by effectively managing preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, spare parts planning, mould life monitoring, and technical improvements. The role will provide dedicated toolroom support for critical projects and ensure timely resolution of mould-related issues to minimize production downtime and improve tooling life.

Responsibilities

  • Perform timely preventive and corrective maintenance on plastic injection molds.
  • Prioritize and attend to mold breakdowns, coordinating with internal and external resources to minimize downtime.
  • Conduct systematic troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for repetitive mold failures.
  • Maintain accurate records of mold history, maintenance, breakdowns, and life data, adhering to ISO documentation standards.
  • Monitor mold life and cavity condition, preparing renewal or refurbishment plans as needed.
  • Plan and manage critical mold spare parts to ensure quick availability during breakdowns and maintenance.
  • Coordinate with external toolrooms and vendors for mold repairs, modifications, and technical improvements.
  • Review and assess the technical feasibility of mold modifications in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Support mold trials after repairs or modifications, ensuring successful handover for production.
  • Develop contingency plans for critical molds to maintain production continuity during major breakdowns.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in the plastic injection molding industry.
  • Strong knowledge of mold systems, including cores, cavities, sliders, lifters, and hydraulic components.
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting 2D mold drawings, assembly drawings, and component drawings.
  • Familiarity with basic toolroom manufacturing processes such as grinding, milling, drilling, and EDM.
  • Understanding of ISO systems, maintenance standards, and safety requirements.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Effective communication and coordination skills to collaborate with internal and external teams.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Willingness to support emergency and off-shift activities to ensure production continuity.
  • A proactive approach to continuous improvement and a commitment to maintaining high toolroom standards.

job.title: IT Analyst Applications(Disaster Recovery Operations Analyst II)
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced IT Analyst Applications (Disaster Recovery Operations Analyst II)to join our India Cybersecurity Support team - CAT IT Division.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.

Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST

Role Purpose

The Disaster Recovery Operations Analyst II is responsible for developing, maintaining, and testing disaster recovery capabilities that enable recovery of critical business services following outages, cyber incidents, infrastructure failures, or other disruptive events. The role collaborates across technology and business functions to strengthen organizational resilience and recovery readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans, procedures, and documentation.
  • Coordinate disaster recovery exercises, tabletop simulations, and recovery testing activities.
  • Ensure disaster recovery test environments remain operational and available.
  • Coordinate recovery activities during exercises and real-world incidents.
  • Track recovery dependencies, risks, issues, and escalation activities.
  • Partner with application owners, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders to maintain recovery readiness.
  • Analyze recovery gaps and recommend process, tooling, and architectural improvements.
  • Validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs), Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs), and application criticality ratings.
  • Produce dashboards, status reports, and compliance evidence.
  • Support audit, governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain application dependency mappings and recovery repositories.

Required Skills

  • Disaster recovery and business continuity planning.
  • Risk assessment and business impact analysis.
  • Backup, recovery, and replication technologies.
  • Knowledge of cloud, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure technologies.
  • Incident management and operational support.
  • Process documentation and governance management.
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to perform effectively during high-pressure situations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related discipline.
  • Experience in Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, Infrastructure Operations, Cybersecurity, or Technology Risk.

Industry certifications such as:

  • CBCP
  • EDRP
  • CISSP
  • ITIL Foundation

Success Measures

  • Recovery plans are maintained and reviewed within defined schedules.
  • Recovery exercises and testing activities are successfully completed.
  • Recovery risks and control gaps are reduced over time.
  • Audit and compliance requirements are met.
  • Recovery objectives are achieved during tests and incidents.
  • Reporting and evidence collection are timely and accurate.

Skill Descriptors Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
  • Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
  • Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
  • Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
  • Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
  • Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
  • Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
  • Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
  • Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
  • Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design). Level Working Knowledge:

  • Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
  • Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
  • Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
  • Provides instant support for end users of application software.
  • Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.

job.title: 24/7 Data Centre Technician (Industrial Electrical/HVAC) - Relocate to Melbourne
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia and New Zealand's leading data centres.

With CDC continuing to grow across Australia, we're expanding our search to New Zealand and are keen to connect with trade-qualified candidates who are actively looking to relocate to Melbourne, Australia.

We're seeking qualified Electricians and HVAC/Refrigeration Mechanics with experience in commercial or industrial environments. Experience working in critical infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, or data centres will be highly regarded.

We also have a growing footprint in Auckland, New Zealand. While we are not actively recruiting for these positions in Auckland at this stage, we're always keen to connect with strong candidates and build our talent pipeline for future opportunities.

Please note, due to security restrictions we can only pursue applicants who hold current New Zealand Citizenship.

  • Relocation assistance will be provided for successful applicants.
  • Tailored CDC Learning Academy and hands-on training provided
  • 24/7 Shift Roster over 8 days - 2 days, 2 nights- 4 days off (Hours are 6-6)
  • Location: Laverton in Melbourne's Western Suburbs**

About Us

CDC Data Centres is Australasia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities across ACT, NSW, VIC, WA and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

At CDC, our Service Technicians work in live data centre environments, supporting the operation of mission‑critical infrastructure.

If you’ve spent time in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, a lot of this will feel familiar. Working to procedures, taking safety seriously, and understanding the impact of your work is critical. A data centre applies those same principles to power, cooling, fire systems and monitoring, all operating continuously. The difference is the environment, the scale, and the opportunity to apply your skills in a stable, growing industry.

We welcome people from a range of technical backgrounds and provide training and support to help you apply your existing skills in a more operational, monitoring‑focused environment.

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day:

  • Monitoring and responding to alarms and alerts across power, cooling, and fire systems
  • Performing physical inspections to ensure equipment and infrastructure are operating within defined parameters
  • Responding to faults and incidents, prioritising actions, and determining when escalation or contractor support is required
  • Carrying out operational switching and control activities to prevent unplanned outages
  • Supporting planned maintenance and monitoring contractors on site, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures and approved methods of operation
  • Documenting incidents, maintenance activities, and observations to support continuous improvement

This role works on a rotating 24/7 shift roster (2 days, 2 nights, 4 off) and suits individuals who are comfortable making decisions, following defined processes, and working calmly in high‑reliability environments.** Benefits, Training and Offerings:**

Our training program provides tailored content through our CDC Academy, specifically designed for individuals starting out in this role. You'll learn hands-on by shadowing and working alongside our experienced Service Technicians, gaining essential knowledge to develop your skillset.

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.**

About You

We're looking for individuals who are in a position to move to Australia as soon as possible, or ideally before the end of the year.

Ideally, you'll be a qualified Electrician or Refrigeration Mechanic with proven experience in large-scale industrial or technical environments. Experience working in critical infrastructure is highly regarded and will be a strong advantage.

Desirable experience:

  • A trade or technical background in Electrical, Refrigeration/HVAC, Mechanical, or a related field (highly desirable)
  • Experience working in critical or high‑availability environments with strong safety and compliance requirements
  • Exposure to monitoring or control systems such as BMS, EMS, or SCADA‑type platforms
  • Familiarity with complex infrastructure or plant equipment (e.g. HVAC systems, power systems, generators, fire systems)
  • Strong fault‑finding, problem‑solving, and situational awareness skills
  • The ability to produce clear documentation, logs, and post‑incident reports

Essential:

New Zealand Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NZ Security Clearance.** How to Apply:**

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.** Closing Date:** Applications close on Sunday, 4th October 2026. Please note: We will be reviewing applications as they come through and actioning suitable candidates before this date.

  • Provide immediate medical care and first aid in case of workplace injuries or emergencies, ensuring compliance with safety protocols.
  • Collaborate with the Site HR Head to design and execute health awareness campaigns, focusing on occupational health risks specific to thermal power plant operations.
  • Ensure the medical center complies with all internal standards and aligns with Adani Power’s focus on operational excellence and sustainability.
  • Train and guide first responders and safety teams on emergency medical procedures and protocols.
  • Monitor and manage health-related KPIs, such as incident response times and employee health indices, to support the site’s operational goals.
  • Liaise with external medical facilities and specialists to ensure advanced care when required.
  • Stay updated on the latest medical practices and technologies relevant to industrial health services.

Qualifications

  • MBBS degree from a recognized medical institution.
  • Additional certification in Occupational Health or Industrial Medicine is preferred.

job.title: Senior Manager, Consolidated and Group Reporting
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to the Financial Controller, this role will lead the Group's consolidation, financial reporting and technical accounting activities. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely Group reporting and providing technical accounting guidance on complex or non-routine matters. This is a hands-on role requiring strong technical accounting knowledge and the ability to both review and perform consolidation and reporting activities where required.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation and reporting process.
  • Review country submissions and consolidation adjustments, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and Group-level adjustments.
  • Lead the assessment of complex or non-routine IFRS accounting matters and determine the appropriate Group accounting position.
  • Prepare and review technical accounting papers and accounting memos for significant transactions and judgmental accounting matters.
  • Work with Group Financial Accounting to develop and maintain Group accounting policies, with responsibility for the technical IFRS interpretation underlying those policies.
  • Lead the preparation of Group financial statements and related disclosures.
  • Manage Group external audit matters and discussions on significant accounting judgments.
  • Review and improve the Group consolidation process, controls and reporting timelines.
  • Work closely with the Systems & Transformation team to move the current manual consolidation process toward a system-based solution.
  • Provide technical accounting guidance to Group and country finance teams where matters require interpretation or significant judgment.

The successful candidate:

**

  • Qualified accountant (CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent).
  • Approximately 10–15 years of relevant experience, ideally combining Big 4 audit/accounting advisory experience with commercial experience.
  • Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and Group consolidation.
  • Strong experience with multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation.
  • Experience preparing technical accounting papers and consolidated financial statements.
  • Strong experience managing external audit and complex accounting matters.
  • Experience with ERP and consolidation systems; NetSuite experience would be an advantage.
  • Hands-on and able to work through complex issues while also providing leadership and review.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Senior Manager, Group Financial Accounting
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the Financial Controller, this role will be responsible for driving accounting quality and consistency across the Group. The role will provide financial accounting leadership to country finance teams, review country financials before they flow into Group consolidation and ensure consistent application of Group accounting policies and accounting treatments across all entities. The role will also oversee the holding company accounting team and Group-wide AR governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the review and challenge of country financial results before submission into Group consolidation, including detailed balance sheet and P&L reviews, significant movements, unusual transactions and accounting issues.
  • Drive consistent application of Group accounting policies and accounting treatments across all countries and entities.
  • Identify differences in accounting practices across countries and work with country finance teams to align accounting treatment across the Group.
  • Provide day-to-day accounting guidance and support to country finance teams and act as a key escalation point for accounting and close-related matters.
  • Identify new, complex or judgmental accounting matters and work with the Consolidation & Group Reporting team to determine and document the appropriate technical accounting position.
  • Ensure technical accounting conclusions and Group accounting policies are appropriately implemented across all relevant entities.
  • Establish consistent month-end close and accounting practices across the Group, including minimum standards for reconciliations, supporting schedules, review and sign-off.
  • Review the quality and completeness of balance sheet reconciliations and drive resolution of long-outstanding, unsupported or material reconciling items.
  • Review significant accruals, provisions, fixed assets, CIP, leases and other material balance sheet areas.
  • Review the profitability and financial performance of individual data centers, including performance through to the P&L bottom line.
  • Oversee Group-wide AR, including aging, collections, overdue balances, provisioning and escalation of significant collection issues.
  • Develop Group-level AR reporting and drive accountability with country finance teams for collection performance.
  • Lead the holding company close and oversee the holding company accounting and AP team.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, close efficiency and overall quality of financial reporting.

The successful candidate:

  • Qualified accountant (CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent).
  • Approximately 10–15 years of relevant financial accounting experience.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS and practical application of accounting standards.
  • Strong experience in financial close, balance sheet management and financial statement review.
  • Strong understanding of fixed assets, capex/CIP, leases, accruals, provisions and other key balance sheet areas.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to identify accounting issues through review of financial statements and trial balances.
  • Hands-on, practical and comfortable operating in a growing organization where processes are still developing.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Retail Manager
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll lead frontline teams to deliver strong sales performance and exceptional customer experiences while creating an engaging and high-performing retail environment.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As a Retail Manager, you will assist the Business Manager in driving sales performance, customer experience and operational excellence across the retail store.

You will lead and coach frontline teams, manage manpower and store performance, ensure effective inventory management and create a customer-first culture. You will also serve as the store’s technical product advisor, helping the team stay confident and knowledgeable about our latest products, services and digital ways of working.

Sales Planning & Performance Management

  • Lead, train and mentor staff on technical services and products.

Customer Experience

  • Ensure a high level of customer service through regular assessment, coaching and follow-up with the team.

  • Implement visual merchandising standards, directives and promotions while maintaining store cleanliness and organisation.
  • Manage customer escalations and service recovery within established empowerment guidelines.

Inventory Management

  • Monitor sales performance and ensure effective stock management.
  • Maintain accurate inventory with zero stock discrepancy.

Operational Effectiveness

  • Comply with all company policies and procedures.
  • Execute store process improvements to strengthen operational effectiveness.

job.title: Associate Director, PropTech Innovation & Strategic Partnerships
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

The Associate Director, PropTech Innovation & Strategic Partnerships will support Singtel Group Property to shape and drive its property technology innovation programme and strategic partnerships, and co-create new Enterprise and Consumer solutions and business opportunities.

The role leads the development of technology-enabled innovations and solutions, commercial models and ecosystem partnerships, with a flagship mandate under the Workplace28 technology programme and the new Comcentre HQ as a lighthouse for innovation.

Technology and data are leveraged as enablers to enhance workplace, people and tenant experience, and improve asset performance - not as ends in themselves. The role will connect Singtel’s built environments with its operating businesses and people, using Singtel’s properties and workplaces as real-world platforms to co-create, test and validate new solutions, and translate proven solutions into customer propositions and commercial opportunities.

The incumbent will manage opportunities from discovery and business case through partnership, funding, validation and operationalisation, and scale successful solutions across Singtel’s wider property portfolio. Working across Group Property, Workplace, Consumer, Enterprise, IT, Digital, other business units and ecosystem partners, the role will establish a disciplined Innovation Framework and Partnership Ecosystem to prioritise, develop and scale opportunities that deliver meaningful people, customer, operational and commercial value.

Make An Impact By

Workplace28 Technology & Property Innovation

**

  • Lead the technology innovation agenda for the Workplace28 programme and new Comcentre HQ.
  • Translate Workplace28 user experience ambitions into prioritised use cases and innovation workstreams, working with Workplace, IT, Tech, AI and Robotics specialists to develop appropriate solutions.
  • Use existing Singtel commercial sites and workplaces as real-world innovation platforms to co-create, pilot and validate solutions for customers and future tenants of One Comcentre.
  • Identify opportunities to extend the innovation approach and deploy successful solutions across Singtel’s wider property portfolio.

Innovation Strategy, Framework & Portfolio

**

  • Shape and manage Group Property’s innovation strategy, framework and portfolio, aligned with business, workplace and customer priorities.
  • Establish a structured approach from opportunity discovery and prioritisation through business case, experimentation, validation, operationalisation and scale.
  • Assess opportunities based on customer/user value, business impact, strategic relevance, scalability and commercial potential, working with technical teams to assess feasibility.
  • Establish clear governance, stage-gates and go / no-go criteria, and track innovation investment, progress and realised benefits.
  • Drive strong idea-to-pilot, pilot-to-scale discipline, progressing successful initiatives while stopping or redirecting those that do not demonstrate sufficient value.

Customer Solutions & Use-Case Development

**

  • Ensure innovation starts with a real customer or business problem, rather than with the technology.
  • Identify and understand the needs of our customers - employees, businesses and future tenants, translating them into high-value use cases and solution opportunities.
  • Develop customer journeys, solution concepts, value propositions, business requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Work across Workplace, Group Property, Consumer and Enterprise to identify opportunities that improve customer experience and asset performance.
  • Validate propositions with users and stakeholders before significant investment or deployment

New Technology Discovery & Ecosystem Development

**

  • Identify technologies and ecosystem partners that can address defined customer or business needs, working with technical specialists to assess feasibility.
  • Explore how Singtel’s in-house solutions, deep capabilities and broad ecosystem can complement externally sourced technologies to create differentiated customer solutions.
  • Maintain visibility of emerging technologies and market developments relevant to Property, Workplace and customer experience.
  • Build an innovation ecosystem across technology companies, start-ups, OEMs, research institutions, government agencies and strategic partners.
  • Facilitate co-creation, prototypes and pilot initiatives with ecosystem partners.
  • Connect external innovation with relevant Singtel capabilities and business opportunities.

Strategic & Commercial Partnerships

**

  • Identify, develop and manage strategic innovation and commercial partnerships that accelerate Singtel’s innovation and business agenda.
  • Lead the development of MOUs, collaboration agreements, co-innovation and partnership arrangements, working with Legal, Procurement and relevant stakeholders.
  • Develop partnership models spanning co-creation, co-development, co-investment and go-to-market collaboration.
  • Structure partnerships around clear customer, strategic and commercial outcomes, rather than conventional buyer-vendor relationships.
  • Build long-term ecosystem relationships that provide access to new capabilities, innovation and business opportunities.

Customer Solutions & New Business Development

**

  • Identify opportunities to translate Property and Workplace innovations into scalable customer and business solutions.
  • Partner with Consumer and Enterprise to identify customer needs, market opportunities and differentiated propositions.
  • Develop customer-led solutions, value propositions, business and operating models, and routes to market.
  • Use Singtel’s physical environments as real-world platforms to validate solutions and demonstrate customer value.
  • Identify opportunities to create new value through enterprise adoption, external customer solutions and new business models.

Business Cases, Commercial Models & Innovation Funding

**

  • Develop robust business cases covering customer value, investment, business impact, scalability and commercial potential.
  • Develop commercial and partnership models that enable viable deployment and scale, including co-investment, fee-based, subscription, revenue-sharing and platform models where relevant.
  • Identify and develop innovation funding opportunities, including internal investment, partner co-funding, grants and other funding sources.
  • Evaluate and recommend where Singtel should invest, partner, pilot, scale, commercialise or stop.
  • Track innovation investment and realised benefits, ensuring continued funding is supported by measurable outcomes and evidence of scalability.

Innovation Delivery, Scale & Commercialisation

**

  • Drive innovation from business case and pilot through implementation, adoption, scale and commercialisation.
  • Structure pilots around clear customer needs, business outcomes and measurable success criteria.
  • Orchestrate business, Property, Workplace, IT and ecosystem partners to translate concepts into operational solutions.
  • Develop the business and operating readiness required to move successful pilots into production, working with technology specialists on technical readiness.
  • Identify pathways to replicate and scale proven solutions across Singtel’s property portfolio and into Consumer and Enterprise opportunities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on innovation, customer solutions, partnerships and new business opportunities.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Business, Economics, Real Estate, Technology, Innovation or related discipline**
  • 12–15+ years of relevant experience in real estate, commercial strategy, innovation, customer solutions, business development.
  • Strong experience working across real estate, digital solutions, property technology and partnership management.
  • Domain knowledge in Property with experience in real estate functions such as asset management, marketing, leasing or operations.
  • Track record developing new businesses, products, platforms or technology-enabled solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience taking opportunities from business case and concept through implementation, scale and commercialisation

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Associate Director – Data Center Controls (BMS) - BDx Data Centers
job.description:
Role Summary

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, programming, installing, and troubleshooting HVAC Controls and Electrical SCADA systems.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop BMS and power management projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
  • Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS improvement projects in BDx data centers.
  • Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
  • Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
  • Conduct engineering analysis and research designs and methods of data center equipment and facilities.
  • Ensure designs and installations meet requirements (e.g., predicted cooling, structural, operational concerns, etc.
  • Develop data center vulnerability remediation playbooks for control system designs in conjunction with IT teams.

Experience

Experience of 10+ years in designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls and Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, Building Management System (BMS) Controls software and networks.

Qualification and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Excellent understanding of industry-standard electrical and mechanical systems used in data centers, as well as controls/monitoring systems.
  • Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
  • Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
  • Project coordination experience with multiple teams or vendors to meet project requirements for data centers.
  • TCP/IP, MQTT, BACnet and/or MODBUS communication protocol experience.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and project management software.
