job.title: IT Operations Lead - BDx Data Centers
job.description:
Role Summary

The Senior IT Operations Lead will provide technical leadership and operational ownership of the organization's internal IT infrastructure and OT technology environment supporting Data Center operations. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role within a captive Data Center organization, responsible for the reliability, security, availability, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of the organization's own technology environment.

Duties and Responsibilities

1. IT Infrastructure Operations & Reliability

  • Provide technical and operational leadership for the organization's enterprise IT infrastructure supporting corporate and Data Center operations.
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and security of infrastructure operating on a 24x7x365 basis.
  • Oversee networking, servers and compute, virtualization, storage, backup, firewalls, security infrastructure, wireless, telephony, collaboration systems, end-user computing, and monitoring platforms.
  • Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and operational KPI tracking.

2. OT Security & Data Center Technology Environment

  • Support and govern IT and OT security procedures relevant to Data Center operations.
  • Work closely with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Automation, and Technology teams to ensure appropriate protection and segregation of IT and OT environments.
  • Develop and maintain procedures for secure access, privileged access, remote connectivity, patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening.
  • Support security assessments, audits, vulnerability remediation, risk mitigation, incident response, and root cause analysis involving IT and OT-related systems.

3. IT Service Management & Operational Governance

  • Lead and continuously improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, and Asset Management processes.
  • Analyse recurring incidents and operational trends and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Drive service reviews, KPI reporting, risk tracking, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement.

4. Infrastructure Architecture & Technology Lifecycle

  • Participate in infrastructure reviews and assess the impact of new systems, technology changes, and infrastructure enhancements.
  • Provide recommendations for scalability, resilience, security, operational supportability, and risk mitigation.
  • Support infrastructure modernization including cloud, hybrid infrastructure, software-defined networking, automation, and Infrastructure-as-a-Service models.

5. SDLC, Change & Release Governance

  • Demonstrate strong awareness of SDLC and its impact on infrastructure and production environments.
  • Work with application, automation, engineering, and technology teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for development, testing, deployment, and production releases.
  • Ensure appropriate testing, documentation, rollback plans, approvals, risk assessments, and operational readiness before production implementation.

6. Information Security, Compliance & Documentation

  • Support compliance with ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 requirements and maintain relevant operational documentation and evidence.
  • Maintain infrastructure standards, procedures, architecture diagrams, Configuration Items (CIs), CMDB records, and IT asset documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance actions.

7. Security, Monitoring & Critical Incident Management

  • Provide technical oversight for routers, switches, Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity infrastructure.
  • Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, operational visibility, and proactive issue detection.
  • Lead technical investigations for major incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

8. Vendor & Internal Stakeholder Management

  • Manage technical relationships and escalations with infrastructure, security, telecommunications, and technology vendors.
  • Partner with internal Data Center Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Automation, Applications, Corporate IT, Facilities, and business stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical risks, operational performance, improvement initiatives, and infrastructure status to senior stakeholders.

9. Individual Contributor Technical Leadership

  • Act as a senior technical owner and subject matter expert, leading through technical expertise, governance, influence, and operational ownership.
  • Work independently on complex technical and operational issues and mentor engineers where required.
  • This is primarily a hands-on senior individual contributor role and is not intended to be a traditional service delivery, customer account management, or managed services role.

Experience

15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, infrastructure operations, or IT operations leadership.

  • Experience supporting business-critical, highly available, 24x7x365 infrastructure environments.
  • Strong experience operating internal enterprise or captive technology environments; experience should not be limited to external customer managed services delivery.
  • Strong technical experience across enterprise networking, Layer 2/3 infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, servers, virtualization, monitoring, infrastructure security, backup, and configuration management.
  • Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and continual service improvement.
  • Practical understanding of IT and OT security principles, access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, infrastructure hardening, and operational security procedures.
  • Strong awareness of SDLC, production change governance, release management, testing, risk assessment, rollback planning, and operational readiness.
  • Experience with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, Cacti, or similar tools.
  • Experience conducting infrastructure architecture reviews and developing mitigation plans for technical and operational risks.
  • Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

Qualification and Experience

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience working in a Data Center operator or other mission-critical infrastructure environment.
  • Exposure to OT environments supporting critical infrastructure, including Data Center automation, BMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar operational technologies.
  • Knowledge of OT/ICS security principles and industrial cybersecurity practices.
  • Experience with public cloud, hybrid cloud, software-defined networking, infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, or DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with Zero Trust, SIEM, SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, or security monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

Preferred Certifications

  • CCNP or equivalent Cisco certification.
  • CISSP, CISM, or equivalent information security certification.
  • ITIL certification.
  • Microsoft infrastructure, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), OT/ICS security, or Six Sigma/process improvement certifications.

job.title: 2027 Undergraduate Financial Control Internship
job.description:
Our culture believes in POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL . We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what \#LifeAtCummins is all about.

If you are an undergraduate Accounting student looking to jump start your career, we are offering a 13-month full time internship based our Scoresby office . This is a unique opportunity to gain skills and knowledge while you are working full time commencing 27th January 2027 .

In this role you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Assisting in month end closing (journals and reconciliations)
  • Assisting in compilation of reporting information
  • Provide an accounting support and financial analysis for Business Leaders
  • Leading small process improvement projects
  • Assist in internal/external audit process

About You

To qualify for this undergraduate internship, it is essential that you:

  • Are currently studying a degree Majoring in Accounting
  • Have between 1 and 8 units of study left to complete of your undergraduate degree as of January 2027
  • Are available for the full 13 months and be willing to defer your studies for that duration.

_Note:_ _Applicants that do not meet these qualifying requirements unfortunately will not be considered._

To be successful in this role, you will possess skills/abilities or be able to perform:

  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to work autonomously
  • Inquisitive nature
  • Confidence in communicating with a range of stakeholders
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills

_This is a 13-month, full time, paid placement and the successful candidate will be required to defer their studies for the duration of the program._

How to apply:

  • For all applications, please submit your resume, cover letter and academic transcript via the link provided.
  • In your cover letter, please specify how many units of study you have remaining on your undergraduate degree and your motivation behind applying both to Cummins and this specific internship.

Note: We will be unable to assess your application without all of the required documents, so please ensure you attach your resume, cover letter and academic transcripts at the time of application.

job.title: JSM 2 Controls
job.description:
Job Summary

The Electrical Maintenance & Automation Technician is responsible for troubleshooting, installing, maintaining, testing, and optimizing electrical and automation systems to ensure manufacturing equipment availability, reliability, and operational efficiency. This role supports preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities while working with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, MES integration, vision systems, and advanced automation technologies. The position contributes to improving equipment performance, reducing downtime, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and maintaining compliance with Cummins' Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), Quality, and operational standards. The role may also provide technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot, repair, install, test, and maintain electrical systems, industrial automation equipment, and manufacturing machinery to maximize equipment uptime and reliability.
  • Perform preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities on manufacturing equipment and electrical control systems.
  • Diagnose and resolve faults related to PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, drives, sensors, industrial controls, and electrical components.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize Siemens TIA Portal applications, PLC programs, HMIs, vision systems, and automation equipment.
  • Support MES integration and smart manufacturing technologies to improve operational efficiency and equipment performance.
  • Perform machine programming modifications, electrical system upgrades, and automation improvements to enhance productivity and reliability.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, machine drawings, and technical documentation to execute maintenance activities effectively.
  • Ensure electrical systems comply with applicable electrical codes, safety standards, and manufacturing requirements.
  • Conduct equipment downtime analysis, root cause investigations, and corrective actions to eliminate recurring failures.
  • Maintain preventive maintenance schedules, equipment history, maintenance records, and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities with production schedules to minimize equipment downtime and production interruptions.
  • Participate in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, and support teams to improve equipment reliability, productivity, and manufacturing performance.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment by adhering to Cummins Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), and Quality standards.
  • Coach and provide technical guidance to technicians and team members, supporting skill development and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, ITI, Diploma, or equivalent technical qualification in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or a related technical discipline.
  • Additional certifications in PLC programming, Siemens automation technologies, industrial automation, or electrical maintenance are preferred.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export control or sanctions regulations.

Skills

Technical Skills

  • Electrical maintenance of industrial and manufacturing equipment
  • Preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance
  • PLC programming and troubleshooting, preferably using Siemens TIA Portal
  • HMI, SCADA, MES integration, and industrial automation systems
  • Vision systems and smart manufacturing technologies
  • Machine programming and automation optimization
  • Electrical system troubleshooting and fault diagnosis
  • Industrial control systems, motors, drives, sensors, and instrumentation
  • Reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and structured problem-solving methodologies
  • Preventive maintenance planning and maintenance documentation
  • Basic understanding of hydraulic and pneumatic control systems
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration
  • Customer focus and results orientation
  • Sound decision-making and problem-solving capability
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Ability to mentor and coach team members
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn emerging automation technologies
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams

Experience

  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in electrical maintenance, industrial automation, or manufacturing maintenance within a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens TIA Portal , PLC programming, HMIs, SCADA systems, and industrial automation.
  • Experience with vision systems , MES integration, and factory automation technologies.
  • Experience supporting high-volume assembly line maintenance and improving equipment reliability and uptime.
  • Proven experience in electrical troubleshooting, machine programming, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of TPM, Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and manufacturing process optimization is preferred.
  • Experience mentoring technicians or supporting team capability development is an added advantage.

job.description:
We are looking for a talented QA Intern to join our team in Pandan Ave, Singapore. This is an onsite role. Internship period will be 6 months or longer, depending on Singapore colleges/universities session. Internship period will start from Jan 2027 onwards.

The internship with the Cummins Quality Assurance department will provide the intern exposure to real business operations regarding quality systems, compliance standards, process improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives in maintaining operational excellence and product quality. The intern will be given hands-on opportunities to understand, analyze, and improve current operational and quality-related processes while supporting cross-functional teams in achieving quality objectives.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with operations functional managers and team leaders on process and system improvements related to quality assurance, operational efficiency, and compliance standards.
  • Support quality inspection activities, process monitoring, and documentation review to ensure compliance with company quality requirements and procedures.
  • Assist in compiling, analyzing, and maintaining quality-related metrics, reports, and dashboard tracking to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop and update quality dashboards and visual reports to support data-driven decision-making and operational monitoring.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives such as process optimization, waste reduction, and standardization activities.
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities for operational or quality-related issues.
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams including operations, warehouse, engineering, and other stakeholders to improve workflow efficiency and product/service quality.
  • Promote a quality-first mindset by supporting quality awareness sharing, communication initiatives, and best practice discussions across teams.
  • Assist in preparing quality documentation, reports, SOP reviews, presentations, and audit-related materials.
  • Support internal inspections, compliance reviews, and quality improvement projects assigned by the QA team.
  • Be trained to understand quality management systems, operational procedures, dashboard reporting, and process compliance requirements.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Communicates effectively – Developing and delivering clear communication that supports collaboration across different teams and stakeholders.
  • Ensures accountability – Taking ownership of assigned tasks and meeting commitments effectively.
  • Plans and aligns – Managing priorities and coordinating work aligned with organizational goals and operational requirements.
  • Problem solving and analytical thinking – Identifying issues, analysing data, and supporting process improvement initiatives.
  • Continuous improvement mindset – Participating actively in initiatives that improve operational quality, efficiency, and compliance.
  • Quality mindset and collaboration – Promoting quality awareness, teamwork, knowledge sharing, and proactive improvement culture within the organization.

Preferred Qualification

  • Technical skills: Competent in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and dashboard reporting tools (Power BI is an advantage); able to perform data analysis and reporting. Knowledge of quality tools, process improvement methodologies, or risk assessment is a plus.

job.title: Senior Technical Site Due Diligence Manager
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

NTT GDC APAC - Global Infrastructure Development is looking to recruit a Senior Technical Site Due Diligence Manager. The role will support data centre expansion and construction projects across specific regions.

You will play a key role in the site selection and development stage with accountability for the technical due diligence process & master planning for new and existing NTT GDC regions. Alongside Test Fits, this role will involve inputting into the permitting strategy and compiling and analysing site information to identify any impact / risks on development costs & schedule or present a risk to the operation of the data center. You will be expected to engage, instruct, direct, and manage internal resource alongside external consultants, contractors, and experts to ensure technical due diligence & master planning is complete, whilst compiling & mitigating risks and reporting these to the NTT GDC stakeholders.

You will have a strong track record of program management, a demonstrated ability to deliver multiple high priority projects simultaneously and the ability to drive alignment across teams with competing priorities.

You will help develop and promote adoption of best practice process and procedures for site due diligence in the design and engineering, and wider construction and expansion teams.

What we are looking for

Key Role and Responsibilities:

Site Selection and Technical Due Diligence:

  • Present a regional progress report on all projects
  • Lead the Technical Due Diligence process, collaborating with internal stakeholders to guide the expansion of NTT GDC facilities in new and existing regions, by conducting site selection risk analysis and due diligence assessments.
  • Utilize technical expertise to assess and validate the suitability of potential sites, considering factors such as infrastructure, environmental impact, and regulatory compliance.
  • Engage with internal resources and external consultants on power requirements for the sites and ensuring that a clear demonstratable timeline for power is developed as part of the TDD report.
  • Ensure that the constraints of each site are identified with documentary evidence for any limiting factors such as zoning plans and planning requirements.
  • Create and Manage TDD criteria/checklists to enable, and be accountable for, Go/No Go recommendations and decisions.
  • Work with the construction teams and the consultants to create project specific permitting strategies.
  • Develop the project timeline with an explanatory note against each timeline duration giving the next team in the development lifecycle an understanding of assumptions made.
  • Write scope of works for consultants to execute technical assessments and reports.
  • Assess proposals and evaluate them for completeness and manage all correspondence and invoices.
  • Brief consultants on the sites and the requirements to be executed for a red flag report.
  • Hold a site safety briefing ahead of site walks to ensure risks are discussed and protocols understood.
  • Accountable for coordinating site visits, specialist reviews and associated reports and debriefs.
  • Act as the primary contact for external consultants and vendors as well as internal stakeholders, involved in technical due diligence processes.
  • Assess and draw conclusions from a wide range of real estate, engineering, construction, policy, planning, and business development considerations.
  • Responsible for production of compliant test-fits for new sites using Sketchup, also use of CAD and other software to scale and dimension drawings for stage one test fit development.
  • Be proficient in power point to develop presentations to communicate to external stakeholders potential solutions.
  • Brief consultants on 3D flythroughs and drone footage requirements
  • Collaborate with the internal global reference design team and the regional design managers to ensure specific regional inputs are made to make test fits work.
  • Work in conjunction with the associated Site Acquisition Manager (owner of the purchase deal) and Development Manager (owner of pre-construction development) for each site to ensure TDD delivery is progressing in line with the agreed budget and programme.
  • Ensure regular reporting of progress against agreed plans to senior members of Design and Engineering, Delivery and the associated Expansion managers.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance, quality and value for money received through third party appointments.
  • Ensure that NDA’s are executed and consultants are briefed on the confidential nature of projects.
  • Technical & Process Improvement
  • Ability to use technical drawings and scale drawings to develop test fit library for the global team.
  • Contribute to the development of tools, processes, and procedures to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the site selection, test fits and due diligence functions.
  • Develop and manage long term relationships with internal stakeholders, key consultants and external subject matter experts to ensure optimal performance.
  • Interface with peers in other departments within the region and with peers in site selection teams globally.
  • Reporting & Quality Control:
  • Develop and maintain a dashboard which represents all projects in region and update the status weekly
  • Ensure that collaboration between all due diligence staff in region is aligned with the global standards
  • Review all consultant reports and work before presenting to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work with site acquisition managers, development manager and construction teams to define and track critical metrics that measure progress towards strategic goals on sites.
  • Analyse data from the seller's data rooms to ensure concise and informative reports are produced by the team.
  • Present findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders, including senior leadership members, and investors when required.
  • Build relationships and a network in region of consultants and trusted advisors that contribute to successful due diligence outcomes.
  • Proactively investigate and address any significant deviations from the global reference design
  • Streamline reporting procedures to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
  • Implement data visualization tools to improve the clarity and impact of reports.
  • Leverage automation to reduce manual data entry and improve reporting frequency.
  • Establish and maintain robust data quality controls to ensure the accuracy and reliability of all reported information.
  • Conduct regular data audits and implement corrective actions as needed.

Knowledge and Key Attributes:

  • You will have a broad understanding of normal and abnormal concepts associated with data centre site development at scale.
  • You will have a solid understanding of cost and time drivers associated with site development e.g., Remediation, Cut and Fill, Utilities connections etc.
  • You will be able to evaluate and assess initial vendor or real estate agent information packs and identify gaps against a prescribed schedule of technical site selection due diligence activities.
  • You will be able to write scope of works for consultants to execute their engineering assessments of land and buildings.
  • You will possess a high-level knowledge of the planning and permitting issues associated with large format industrial buildings such as height restrictions, boundary setbacks, perimeter security, vehicle reticulation analysis, requirements for stormwater attenuation, easements, power routing etc.
  • Able to procure and build a database of exemplar scoping documents for technical site selection studies e.g., topographical assessments, ground condition, environmental risk assessments, etc.
  • Possess familiarity with the concept of progressive de-risk and able to compile, update and maintain RAG reports individually and or on a consolidated basis.
  • Hold a University Degree in Construction, Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Engineering or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience in technical due diligence for mission critical and/or similar hi-tech content M&E led industries (e.g., Pharmaceutical, Food and Drink manufacturing, Oil and Gas, Energy, etc.)
  • Experience working within site acquisition teams, preferably in a leading role on the buy side.
  • International experience and outlook both in type of company (multi-national Consultant/Operator) and project experience
  • Clear and concise written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Demonstrate self-management by supporting and developing teams, fostering a positive team atmosphere, overcoming obstacles, and embracing challenges confidently.
  • Exhibit rounded thinking, self-awareness, and a collaborative approach.
  • Possess organizational skills with a can-do/will-do attitude and a consistent ability to translate ideas into impactful actions.
  • Able and happy to travel within region and internationally up to 35% of working time.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Sales Operations Specialist
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

About this opportunity:

  • Global company with strong systems and support
  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Attractive Remuneration package
  • Career planning and opportunities
  • Location: Windsor (Brisbane

​

Join us in shaping the engine behind high-performing sales teams.

Are you passionate about driving operational efficiency and enabling sales success through process mastery? We’re looking for a Sales Operations Specialist who thrives on structure, precision, and continuous improvement to support our Pacific sales function in achieving its ambitious goals.

What You’ll Be Responsible For:

As a key partner to the Sales Operations Manager and Sales Leaders, you’ll be the go-to expert for sales process optimization, data integrity, and operational cadence. Your mission: to streamline workflows, enhance reporting accuracy, and ensure our sales systems and tools are working smarter—not harder.

Core Responsibilities

  • Sales Process Management: Maintain and improve sales processes aligned with GTM policies. Document workflows, standardize procedures, and drive adoption across the field.
  • Data Integrity & Governance: Monitor Salesforce data quality, initiate cleanse motions, and ensure compliance with data governance policies.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and PowerBI visualizations to support sales capacity planning, pipeline health, utilization, and field efficiency.
  • Salesforce Championing: Promote best practices in Salesforce usage, drive seller-level granularity, and ensure SFDC remains the single source of truth for pipeline and performance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with operations teams to align on standardized processes and support onboarding/offboarding workflows.
  • Sales Cadence Support: Enable sales leaders with reporting and insights for major deal reviews, forecasting sessions, and performance check-ins.
  • Process Improvement: Analyze operational bottlenecks and recommend scalable solutions to improve productivity and effectiveness.

What You Bring:

  • 2–3 years of experience in Sales Operations or Sales Analytics
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end sales operations processes

job.title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Mentors teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. Identifies and removes performance/scalability bottlenecks for hyper‑scale workloads; defines scalability requirements with stakeholders; and designs elastic, high‑impact systems while advancing innovation in data plane platforms. Engineers and oversees fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable designs; optimizes resilience mechanisms (load‑shedding, throttling, rate‑limiting); and sets SLO‑aligned durability and availability standards across dependent services. Establishes KPIs and advanced telemetry; applies formal verification for complex features; and develops robust replication/synchronization strategies. Advises and leads resolution of complex production issues, sets operational readiness and SOP standards, and directs incident response and RCAs. Architects advanced security controls, drives remediation and compliance, and delivers enterprise‑level automation (IaC) and change strategies enabling safe, automated patching, updates, and rollbacks.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Mentor the team in the architecture and design of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems, ensuring horizontal and vertical scalability and overall performance, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Lead the identification of performance and scalability bottlenecks and recommend solutions to optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to improve performance for hyper-scale systems.

–Lead collaboration with stakeholders to define system scalability requirements, ensuring the defined requirements meet customer expectations.

–Leverage deep expertise to design high-impact, interdependent systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Drive innovation in the use of data plane platforms.

–Evaluate whether systems are meeting nonfunctional scalability requirements, and proactively anticipate growing business needs within the business unit.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Design and oversee the implementation of fault-tolerant, interdependent systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing sophisticated redundancy, replication, and automatic failover capabilities.

–Lead the design and implementation of systems that effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Guide the optimization of advanced mechanisms to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design interdependent systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), driving standards for availability and durability of other computing services within the organization

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify risks, gaps, or cyclical dependencies in running, interdependent systems.

–Drive the creation and customization of highly complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms, proactively ensuring system health and reliability.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Maintain expertise in industry standards for verifying correctness and apply existing techniques to interdependent systems.

–Formally verify complex features (e.g., via TLA+) to ensure system design correctness for various interdependent systems.

–Develop advanced strategies for data replication and synchronization, ensuring robust data integrity and availability

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Advise on efforts to diagnose, debug, and resolve complex issues in active, interdependent systems to support ongoing operation.

–Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

–Maintain expertise in dependencies, dependents, and owned systems to drive effective troubleshooting and performance.

–Set standards for operational readiness and standard operating procedures within the department, and hold third-party partners accountable for meeting those standards.

–Oversee operational support rotations, providing expert guidance in incident response and leading root cause investigations to prevent future occurrences.

Compliance & Security:

–Architect advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, and lead initiatives to enhance data and application protection.

–Guide the execution of comprehensive remediation plans to address identified security vulnerabilities.

–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations, and guide documentation efforts across projects.

Automation & Change Management:

–Develop enterprise-level automation tools and strategies (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) and oversee their implementation.

–Drive alignment of change management plans and organizational initiatives for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and design interdependent systems to allow for automation of these processes.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

–Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

–Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions). Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

–Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization. Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals. Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

–Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy. Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing [accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com](mailto:accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com) or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

job.title: Service Engineer - Data Center - T2/B2
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.

  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.
  • Proficient in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control faults using service tools and diagnostic software.
  • Strong customer communication skills and ability to work in critical data centre environments.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and industry best practices.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mission‑critical data centres or large industrial cooling systems.

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

ROLE SUMMARY

Network Engineer is responsible for stable, secure, and efficient network operations for enterprise customers through proactive Day 2 support and Level 2 technical expertise. The role focuses on timely incident resolution, maintaining high service availability, supporting changes and maintenance activities, and strengthening operational capability across Huawei NCE Campus and other supported network and security platforms.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide Level 2 support for Huawei NCE Campus network infrastructure and other supported enterprise networking platforms.
  • Ensure timely incident resolution and service restoration for customer environments, with clear diagnostics and escalation where required.
  • Perform root-cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and recommend preventive measures to reduce recurrence.
  • Maintain accurate network configurations, operational records, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with Day 1, cybersecurity, service management, and project teams to ensure seamless service delivery and effective handovers.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network incidents involving switching, routing, wireless, access control, and firewall environments.
  • Perform configuration updates, firmware upgrades, and planned maintenance activities in accordance with approved procedures and change controls.
  • Conduct periodic health checks, monitoring, and performance analysis to identify and address potential service disruptions.
  • Support integration and interoperability testing with additional network platforms and products where required.
  • Provide technical reports, update service tickets, maintain operational records, and contribute to service reviews and operational meetings.

Qualifications

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • At least 5 years of experience in network operations, managed services, or medium-sized campus / enterprise network environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of Huawei NCE Campus, with practical experience supporting network incidents, changes, and day-to-day operations.
  • Working knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, IP addressing, VLANs, switching, routing, network access control, and enterprise connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on exposure to one or more of Aruba, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, and Fortinet environments is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to perform structured troubleshooting, log and evidence collection, root-cause analysis, and effective escalation to vendors or higher-level engineering teams.
  • Experience with firmware upgrades, configuration changes, preventive maintenance, and operational change procedures.
  • Comfortable working with ticketing systems, monitoring tools, network documentation, and service management processes.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with engineers, service management, project teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.

job.title: Manager - Cloud & Security Customer Service Operations
job.description:
Broad outline of the Role

  • Responsible for providing L3 operational support for customer network services and solutions delivered across the data centre environment, including Cisco ACI, Nexus switches, routing, switching, and associated network services.
  • Responsible for diagnosing and resolving complex network incidents, performing root cause analysis, and providing appropriate technical solutions within agreed service levels.
  • Acts as a conduit between customers and internal teams such as Network Engineering, Architecture, Security, Systems, and Operations for effective issue resolution.
  • This is an operational role responsible for maintaining the availability, performance, and reliability of data centre network infrastructure, while providing technical guidance to L1/L2 support teams and reviewing the quality of technical work undertaken by these teams.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

  • Graduate with 7–12 years of relevant network engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience in data centre networking.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco ACI and Cisco Nexus environments.
  • Experience working in an L3 network support/engineering role in a 24x7 operational environment.

Other Knowledge & Skills

  • Good knowledge of Cisco ACI, Nexus switching, routing and switching, VLAN, VRF, BGP, OSPF, vPC, LACP, TCP/IP, and network troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of ACI concepts such as Spine/Leaf architecture, APIC, EPGs, Bridge Domains, Contracts, and L3Out.
  • Experience in troubleshooting complex network connectivity, routing, switching, and data centre infrastructure issues.
  • Good understanding of integration with firewalls, load balancers, WAN, servers, and other infrastructure components.
  • Good understanding of incident, problem, change, and service management processes.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Maintains awareness of the latest technologies and developments in data centre networking and Cisco ACI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L3 technical administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and support to ensure efficient functionality and availability of data centre network infrastructure.
  • Perform incident validation, incident analysis, root cause analysis, and solution recommendation for complex network and ACI-related issues.
  • Troubleshoot Cisco ACI, Nexus, routing, switching, connectivity, VLAN/VRF, BGP, OSPF, vPC, and related network issues.
  • Act as a point of escalation for Level-1 and Level-2 network support teams, providing technical guidance and assistance in resolving complex incidents.
  • Coordinate with Network Engineering, Architecture, Security, Systems, Cloud, Application, and Operations teams on escalations, performance issues, outages, and service-impacting incidents.
  • Coordinate with Cisco TAC and other technology vendors for complex issues requiring vendor-level investigation and resolution.
  • Assist with the development, revision, and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures, Working Instructions, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
  • Participate in network upgrades, ACI maintenance, migrations, implementation activities, and infrastructure refresh projects, including pre- and post-change validation.
  • Monitor network and ACI infrastructure performance and provide recommendations for tuning, optimization, capacity management, and service improvement.
  • Perform regular health checks and proactively identify potential network availability, performance, capacity, and connectivity issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation relating to network configurations, ACI environment, topology, IP addressing, incident resolutions, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly operational reports covering incidents, network performance, availability, outages, and service-related activities.
  • Provide recommendations for improving network operations, processes, procedures, standards, and support practices.
  • Maintain an inventory of operational procedures used by the network operations team and regularly review and update these procedures based on technology changes, incidents, and operational requirements.
  • Support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major and recurring incidents and drive corrective and preventive actions to minimize repeat issues.
  • Participate in 24x7 support, on-call, and shift-based operations as required.
  • Ensure all activities are performed in accordance with established security, compliance, change-management, and operational standards.

Certifications

  • CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Data Center preferred.
  • Other equivalent networking certifications are an advantage.

  • network security
  • switching protocols
  • incident management
  • root cause analysis

job.title: Sr Manager - Software & Application Development
job.description:
As a Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our infrastructure to ensure scalability, reliability, and security. You will have hands-on experience in infrastructure hardening, storage solutions, containerization technologies, observability tools, and application security practices.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage infrastructure hardening processes to enhance the security posture of our cloud-based platforms.
  • Configure NetApp S3 storage solutions to suit project requirements – Administration and provisioning data containers and ACL’s.
  • Manage Docker and Kubernetes clusters to orchestrate containerized applications effectively.
  • Administer Kafka clusters, including configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting, to support high-throughput, distributed data streaming.
  • Implement and maintain observability solutions using Grafana and Prometheus, enabling comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and visualization of system metrics and logs.
  • Configure and manage Node-RED instances for IoT integration and workflow automation.
  • Implement MQTT protocols for lightweight messaging between IoT devices and backend systems.
  • Conduct application hardening activities, including secure coding practices, vulnerability assessments, and patch management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and respond to incidents promptly, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum availability.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry best practices, continually improving our infrastructure and processes.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer or similar role, with a focus on cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure hardening techniques, including network security, access control, and vulnerability management.
  • Proficiency in deploying and managing NetApp S3 storage solutions or similar cloud storage platforms.
  • Strong expertise in Docker and Kubernetes, including containerization, orchestration, and cluster management.
  • Experience in administering Kafka clusters, with knowledge of configuration, replication, and performance tuning.
  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Puma for monitoring, logging, and tracing.
  • Experience configuring and managing Node-RED instances for IoT integration.
  • Knowledge of MQTT protocols for lightweight messaging and IoT communication.
  • Experience with application hardening practices, including secure coding, vulnerability assessments, and patch management.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues in a production environment.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Required Skills

  • software development
  • application development
  • cloud security
  • infrastructure hardening
  • s3 storage
  • platform engineering
  • cloud native infrastructure
  • kafka
  • application security
  • application hardening

Operating Division

job.title: Facility Engineer (Electrical)
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in late 2019, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

Roles Open for This Intake:

**

We are hiring 3 job families and roles across our Jakarta site. All roles are shift-based and site-based. Full job descriptions will be shared with registered candidates ahead of the event, but the high-level summary are provided below.

  • Facility Technician

Hands-on operation and maintenance of critical electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems in a 24/7 data center environment.

What you'll do

  • Monitor and maintain power, cooling, and control systems
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and routine inspections
  • Responding to incidents, alarms, and equipment anomalies
  • Coordinate with vendors during planned and unplanned work

What we're looking for

  • 1–2 years' experience in mechanical, electrical, or HVAC systems (data center, telecom, or other critical environments preferred)
  • Vocational diploma (SMK) or higher in a relevant technical field
  • Willing to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends
  • Physically capable of equipment handling in operational conditions
  • Customer Care Assistant, Site Operations

First point of contact for customer inquiries, incident handling, and service coordination on site. This is a customer-facing operations role, not an engineering role.

**

What you'll do

  • Manage customer tickets and service requests end-to-end
  • Coordinate with internal technical teams to resolve incidents within SLA
  • Maintain accurate documentation and reporting
  • Contribute to process improvements across the customer journey

What we're looking for

  • Prior customer service experience, ideally in data center, telco, or tech environments
  • Diploma or degree (business, operations, or related fields preferred)
  • Basic understanding of data center operations (advantage, not required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English
  • Team Lead, Facility Operations

Leads a team of Facility Technicians across shifts, with day-to-day ownership of site operations, incident response, and maintenance execution.

**

What you'll do

  • Supervise and develop a team of technicians across rotating shifts
  • Own incident response, escalation, and root-cause follow-through
  • Ensure compliance with safety, operational, and vendor standards
  • Partner with the Facility Manager on planning, reporting, and continuous improvement

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in data center, mission-critical facilities, or industrial operations, with at least 2 years leading a team
  • Strong technical grounding in electrical and/or mechanical systems
  • Proven track record managing incidents in a 24/7 environment
  • Diploma or degree in engineering or a related technical discipline

Why Digital Edge:

**

  • Work on infrastructure that matters: you'll operate the facilities powering Indonesia's largest digital platforms
  • Regional scale, local ownership: part of a 30+ site platform across Asia, with decisions made close to the ground in Jakarta
  • Backed for the long term: Stonepeak-funded with over US$1.6B in committed capital
  • Clear technical career paths in one of the fastest-growing data center markets in the region

Career Day Format:

**

  • Confirmation of invites will be sent to shortlisted candidates only.
  • Full day session with option for AM/PM sessions including role briefing, technical conversation, and meeting with hiring managers.
  • Same day outcomes
  • Venue shared only after registration is confirmed.
  • Registration window: 3rd July to 28th July

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll help create meaningful engagements with enterprise customers and senior decision-makers, turning conversations, insights and relationships into opportunities for deeper partnership and business growth.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As the Customer Marketing Manager, you will translate Singtel Enterprise’s marketing priorities into high-impact customer engagement programmes that strengthen strategic relationships, generate customer insights, support pipeline progression and build customer advocacy.

You will connect account-level customer activation with senior-leader platforms such as the Customer Advisory Council (CAC), executive roundtables, industry forums and CE/CXO engagements. Working closely with Sales, Business Development, Client Solution & Transformation (CST), Enterprise Product and senior leadership, you will ensure every engagement is purposeful, coordinated and followed through to measurable business outcomes.

How You will Make An Impact:

Customer Engagement Strategy & Programme Management

  • Develop and execute integrated customer engagement plans aligned to Enterprise growth priorities, strategic accounts, vertical programmes and the annual marketing calendar.
  • Translate Enterprise marketing priorities into targeted programmes across priority accounts, customer segments and growth sectors.
  • Develop annual and quarterly activation plans covering executive engagements, customer events, workshops, forums, roundtables, exhibitions and account-based sessions.
  • Design engagements around clear business objectives, target personas, account priorities and intended customer outcomes.
  • Apply the Connect–Converse–Convert–Champion framework to support relationship development, opportunity progression and customer advocacy.
  • Maintain an integrated calendar across customer engagements, senior-leader platforms and strategic industry touchpoints.

CE/CXO & Senior-Leader Engagement

  • Identify opportunities to engage priority customers through CAC sessions, executive roundtables, industry forums, leadership dinners and other CE/CXO platforms.
  • Partner with senior leaders, Sales and account teams to define customer agendas, objectives and follow-up plans.
  • Curate executive engagement journeys combining thought leadership, customer challenges, Singtel capabilities, industry perspectives and peer interaction.
  • Coordinate senior-management participation, executive hosting, briefing requirements and customer protocols.
  • Prepare executive briefs, customer profiles, account context, talking points and run-of-show documents.
  • Track relationships and opportunities arising from senior-leader engagements and ensure disciplined account-level follow-through.

Customer Events & Engagement Execution

  • Lead end-to-end planning and delivery of customer events, executive forums, workshops, roundtables, exhibitions, networking sessions and appreciation programmes.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, responsibility matrices, checklists and contingency plans.
  • Manage venues, agencies, vendors, speakers, event production, branding, technical requirements, hospitality and on-site operations.
  • Manage internal approvals, procurement, purchase orders, contracts, invoicing and governance requirements.
  • Conduct post-event reviews covering customer feedback, lead outcomes, stakeholder observations and improvement actions.
  • Ensure customer experiences meet the standards expected for senior executives, strategic customers and VIP guests.

Customer Insights & Business Outcomes

  • Capture Voice of Customer insights from events, senior-leader platforms, surveys and stakeholder feedback.
  • Monitor customer trends, industry developments, competitor activity and emerging executive topics.
  • Translate customer insights into actionable recommendations for GTM messaging, customer engagement, solution positioning and future programmes.
  • Strengthen governance and follow-through of marketing-generated leads and customer actions.
  • Maintain dashboards and trackers covering account engagement, leads, follow-up progress and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales to support the progression of customer engagement into qualified conversations and opportunities.
  • Monitor MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline influence and account progression where attributable.

Stakeholder, Vendor & Governance Management

  • Work independently across Sales, Enterprise Product, CST, Business Development, Marketing, senior management and external partners.
  • Manage agencies, vendors, speakers, facilitators and ecosystem partners against agreed scopes and service standards.
  • Maintain accurate programme documentation, budgets, customer records, trackers and approvals.
  • Ensure programmes comply with brand, legal, procurement, finance, data-protection and internal governance requirements.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies and operational issues and drive them through to resolution.

##

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
  • At least 6–9 years of relevant experience in B2B customer marketing, executive engagement, events, corporate communications or stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex customer programmes from concept through execution and post-event follow-up.
  • Experience supporting senior-executive, C-suite or VIP engagements.
  • Experience partnering with Sales and business teams on account-based customer engagement.
  • Strong programme and project management capabilities.
  • Proven ability to manage agencies, vendors, budgets and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong written communication and executive-briefing skills.
  • Able to maintain structured trackers, dashboards, budgets and reports, including leveraging AI tools and capabilities.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, marketing automation, event platforms and customer-data tools.
  • Able to interpret customer engagement, lead and pipeline-performance metrics.
  • Highly organised, resourceful and able to work independently.
  • Strong ownership with the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Lead AI Portfolio Management & Commercialization #AIDA
job.description:
About the Role

This is a highly visible role at the centre of Singtel’s enterprise AI transformation. The AI Portfolio Management & Commercialization Lead will own integrated portfolio performance across more than eight value pools and over 50 AI use cases, ensuring investments are strategically prioritised, delivery risks are actively addressed and the strongest capabilities are positioned for enterprise scale and commercialization.

A defining requirement of the role is the ability to convert complex portfolio performance, technology and business information into clear, compelling executive narratives. The role will support the Chief AI Officer and senior leadership forums with decision-ready insights, strategic recommendations and a credible view of progress, value, risks and trade-offs.

Success requires an uncommon combination of strategic thinking, structured problem solving, portfolio leadership, commercial acumen and exceptional communication. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in ambiguity, navigating a complex stakeholder environment and influencing senior leaders without relying on formal authority.

Make an Impact By:

  • Enterprise AI Portfolio Leadership
  • Lead the integrated management of Singtel’s enterprise AI portfolio connecting strategy, investment, delivery, adoption and value realization.
  • Drive portfolio prioritisation, sequencing and governance, balancing strategic impact, execution readiness, risk, dependencies and resource constraints.
  • Establish a clear, decision-ready view of portfolio health and identify systemic issues, trade-offs and interventions required to protect outcomes.
  • Orchestrate senior cross-functional interventions across business, product, technology, data, finance, legal and risk teams, acting as the escalation point for material portfolio issues.
  • Strengthen portfolio disciplines, decision rights, management information and operating cadence as AIDA scales.
  • Executive Portfolio Narrative & Strategic Influence
  • Translate complex portfolio performance, value realization, technology developments and strategic risks into concise, compelling narratives for Executive/ Senior leadership forums.
  • Develop high-impact executive read-outs, strategic reviews, investment cases and decision papers that clearly frame progress, implications, trade-offs and recommended actions.
  • Synthesize multiple value pools and workstreams into a coherent enterprise story, ensuring leadership has the right level of insight.
  • Use structured problem solving and fact-based analysis to challenge assumptions, sharpen recommendations and accelerate executive alignment and decision-making.
  • Shape the broader narrative of Singtel’s AI transformation for selected internal and external engagements.
  • Commercialization
  • Identify selected AI and Agentic AI assets with potential for broader productisation or external commercialization.
  • Shape commercialization pathways and business cases, including market opportunity, customer need, value proposition, packaging, go-to-market options and commercial model considerations.
  • Partner with Enterprise, Consumer, Product, Commercial, Technology, Finance, Legal and Risk stakeholders to assess opportunity attractiveness and commercialization readiness.
  • Develop and nurture a qualified pipeline of opportunities, moving promising concepts from initial exploration toward structured validation and accountable ownership.
  • Engage strategic customers and ecosystem partners, including hyperscalers, startups and industry participants, where partnerships can accelerate capability development, adoption or market reach.

Skills for Success

Experience

  • At least 10 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, enterprise transformation, portfolio management, digital or technology strategy, or comparable leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional portfolios and influencing senior executives in a matrixed organisation.
  • Strong track record of structuring ambiguous problems, developing actionable recommendations and driving outcomes without direct line authority.
  • Experience developing executive-level narratives, presentations and decision materials for C-suite or senior leadership audiences.
  • Experience in commercialization, business-case development, productisation, partnerships or go-to-market strategy.

Professional Capabilities

  • Enterprise portfolio strategy, prioritisation, governance and performance management.
  • Consulting-calibre structured problem solving, synthesis and strategic judgement.
  • Exceptional written communication, narrative development and executive presentation skills.
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to connect AI investments to business value, customer outcomes and growth opportunities.
  • Working understanding of AI, data and technology transformation, with the ability to translate technical complexity into business implications.
  • Executive presence, stakeholder navigation and the ability to build alignment across competing priorities.

Preferred

  • Experience in a top-tier or leading management consulting firm, corporate strategy office or high-performing transformation environment.
  • Experience supporting a Chief AI Officer, C-suite office, enterprise transformation office or senior steering forum.
  • Exposure to telecommunications, enterprise technology, digital platforms, AI commercialization or ecosystem partnerships.
  • MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.

What Success Looks Like

  • Senior leaders have a clear, credible and decision-ready view of portfolio progress, value, risks and actions required.
  • AI initiatives are prioritised and governed with stronger discipline, clearer accountability and faster resolution of enterprise-level issues.
  • Complex portfolio information is consistently converted into sharp executive narratives that drive alignment and decisions.
  • Selected AI capabilities progress toward enterprise reuse, productisation or external commercialization through well-structured opportunities and partnerships.
  • The AI Value Realization Team is recognised as a trusted strategic partner to AIDA leadership, business units and enterprise governance forums.

job.title: Manager, Talent Acquisition
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Talent Acquisition & Business Partnership

  • Partner Hiring Managers and HR stakeholders to understand business strategy, workforce priorities and emerging capability requirements to translate business needs into practical and forward-looking talent acquisition strategies.
  • Advise stakeholders on talent availability, market conditions, compensation expectations, competitor activity and realistic hiring timelines.
  • Challenge hiring requirements constructively and help Hiring Managers differentiate between critical skills, trainable capabilities and traditional credential requirements.
  • Translate business strategy, technology transformation and purpose into compelling talent narratives.

2. End-to-End Recruitment Excellence

  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from intake and sourcing through assessment, offer and onboarding.
  • Develop differentiated sourcing strategies for specialist, niche and high-volume requirements.
  • Drive strong recruitment discipline including timely feedback, pipeline management and closure of aged vacancies.
  • Ensure recruitment practices remain compliant with applicable employment legislation, internal policies and fair hiring principles.

3. AI, Automation & Digital Recruitment

  • Champion the adoption of AI and automation across Talent Acquisition to improve speed, quality and recruiter productivity.
  • Use AI-enabled tools to support areas such as talent sourcing, CV screening, job description development, candidate engagement and interview preparation.
  • Identify repetitive recruitment activities that can be automated or redesigned.
  • Maintain appropriate human oversight and responsible use of AI in hiring decisions.

4. Talent Intelligence & Proactive Sourcing

  • Build talent pipelines before vacancies arise, particularly for critical and emerging skills.
  • Conduct external talent mapping and competitor intelligence to identify where key capabilities reside.
  • Develop talent communities for recurring and difficult-to-hire skill areas, and utilise market intelligence to advise the business on talent scarcity, location strategy, skills adjacency and alternative talent pools.
  • Convert sourcing insights into actionable recommendations for business and workforce planning.
  • Provide Hiring Managers and leadership with clear insights on recruitment performance and talent-market conditions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Approximately 6–10 years of Talent Acquisition or recruitment experience, preferably within a complex, fast-moving organisation.
  • Strong end-to-end recruitment and direct sourcing capability for evolving, specialist or difficult-to-hire capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and influence Hiring Managers.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret recruitment data and translate insights into action.
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms, sourcing technologies, recruitment analytics and utility of AI-enabled recruitment tools.
  • Good understanding of fair and responsible hiring practices.
  • Experienced in talent mapping, workforce planning, employer branding and TA transformation work.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Sunnybank
job.description:
Sunnybank, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual Retail Service Consultant to join our Sunnybank team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:
