job.title: Staff Engineer- I&C Scada (BESS)
job.description:
Job Summary

Black & Veatch is seeking a SCADA engineering professional with a strong focus on Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) to support the design, integration, and commissioning of utility-scale energy storage projects.

This role emphasizes end-to-end SCADA engineering for BESS facilities, including integration with Energy Management Systems (EMS), Battery Management Systems (BMS), Power Conversion Systems (PCS), and utility communication systems. The candidate will support conceptual and detailed engineering activities including controls architecture, network design, communications, telemetry, data mapping, and system integration across the full project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop engineering design documents and deliverables for SCADA systems supporting BESS projects.
  • Design and coordinate SCADA system architecture integrating BMS, EMS, PCS, and PPC systems.
  • Develop control narratives, data mapping, alarms, and monitoring strategies.
  • Lead and participate in design reviews (30%, 60%, 90%, IFC).
  • Coordinate SCADA scope with utility interconnection and grid compliance requirements.
  • Support vendor selection, specifications, and design reviews.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Support FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities.
  • Perform testing, validation, and troubleshooting during commissioning.
  • Provide field and remote support to construction teams and clients

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with utility-scale BESS projects.
  • Familiarity with EMS, BMS, PCS, and PPC systems.
  • Experience with SEL RTAC and related hardware.
  • Knowledge of DNP3, Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850.
  • Knowledge of NERC CIP, PRC-028, IEEE 2800 standards.
  • Experience with SCADA network and fiber systems.
  • Experience with commissioning multi-vendor systems.
  • Experience with HMI platforms such as Ignition or AVEVA.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 5+ years SCADA engineering experience.
  • 3+ years experience with utility-scale BESS projects.
  • Experience with SCADA design and commissioning activities.

Minimum Qualifications

Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 5 years related work experience. All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

Certifications

Work Environment/Physical Demands

Competencies

Salary Plan

ENG: Engineering

Job Grade

016

BVH, Inc., its subsidiaries and its affiliated companies, complies with all Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) affirmative action laws and regulations. Black & Veatch does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, religion, color, sex, national origin, marital status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender Identity and expression, disability, veteran status, pregnancy status or other status protected by law.

Black & Veatch is committed to being an employer of choice by creating a valuable work experience that keeps our people engaged, productive, safe and healthy. We offer professionals an array of health and welfare benefits that vary based on their geographic region and employment status. This may include health, life accident and disability insurances, paid time off, financial programs and more. Professionals may also be eligible for a performance-based bonus program.

By valuing diverse voices and perspectives, we cultivate an authentically inclusive environment for professionals and are able to provide innovative and effective solutions for clients.

job.title: Senior Manager – Site Acquisition (Data Centre)
job.description:
IND | Navi Mumbai | Data Center Units (305, 501, 801 & 901–903)

Full time

J0105763

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Job Summary Iron Mountain is seeking a strategic and experienced Senior Manager – Site Acquisition to join our Data Center Development team.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end site acquisition lifecycle—from identification, due diligence, and commercial negotiations through to final transaction closure—to secure high-quality, expansion-ready sites for data center developments. You will work closely with an interdisciplinary network of real estate, legal, engineering, power, regulatory, and finance experts to drive scalable infrastructure growth across target markets.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the identification, evaluation, and commercial negotiation of strategic data center sites, securing commercially viable site-control structures, agreements, Letters of Intent, and Memorandums of Understanding.
  • Collaborate with internal cross-functional partners—including legal, finance, engineering, and power procurement—as well as external utilities, brokers, landowners, and government authorities to execute transactions and validate site viability.
  • Ensure compliance with company investment frameworks, governance standards, statutory approvals, land-use zoning, and environmental risk requirements throughout the site selection process.

job.title: Gas Turbine: Turbine Airfoils Casting Simulations Engineer
job.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Turbine Airfoils Casting simulation engineer plays a pivotal role in transforming how we design and manufacture complex turbine hardware design. You will lead the development and validation of conventional cast & cutting-edge DS (directionally solidified) process modeling, core breakage prediction, and foundry process modeling capabilities. Working at the intersection of design, simulation, and manufacturing, you will focus on upstream design simulation to embed manufacturability early in the development cycle, significantly reducing defects, lead times, and costs while improving component reliability.

Job requires regular interaction with global teams hence engineer should have persuasive communication skills and cross-cultural knowledge.

How You'll Make an Impact (Gas Turbine, R& D, India)

  • Develop and validate advanced DS process modeling methodologies with a strong emphasis on core breakage prediction and mitigation.
  • Practice Siemens Energy high fidelity, extensively validated, and equiaxed casting simulation modeling methodology to provide expert foundry process modeling support to ensure robust, high-yield casting designs.
  • Drive upstream design simulation initiatives that integrate manufacturability directly into the turbine component design process.
  • Develop new cooling technologies within the constraints of manufacturability, balancing performance, thermal management, and casting feasibility.
  • Collaborate closely with design, materials, and manufacturing teams to create and implement new simulation-driven design-for-manufacturing (DFM) workflows.
  • Identify and resolve critical casting challenges through innovative modeling techniques, data analysis, and real-world validation.
  • Contribute to methodology development that pushes the boundaries of casting simulation accuracy and speed.
  • Be a point of contact, speaking partner and provide expertise regarding hot gas path heat transfer related topics in a project.
  • Developing new concepts and building CAD models using NX, design internal cooling and perform Conjugate Heat Transfer analysis of Turbine Airfoils and Heat Shields using CFX & Star CCM+, performing Casting Simulation using ProCAST.
  • Understanding of fundamental concepts in fluid mechanics (pressure drop) & heat transfer discipline (using non-dimensional correlations).
  • Able to understand physics, apply relevant assumptions, interpret and post process results.
  • Collaborating with project leads in understanding the project requirements, finding solutions to design challenges, and delivering results within agreed timeline & quality.
  • A fraction of time will be dedicated to advancing the technical expertise of other team members and mentoring.

What You Bring

  • Mechanical engineer with an MTech in Mechanical engineering (major in Metallurgy and Foundry, Material Science, Fluid & Thermal Science) and demonstrated expertise in the field of Casting, Solidification physics, heat transfer and fluid mechanics.
  • 5 years of experience with parametric CAD modeling in NX.
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in thermal analysis and design of internal cooled gas turbine components.
  • Ability to generate thermal boundary conditions and perform Flow & Heat Transfer engineering calculations under steady state, transient heat transfer (involving all modes i.e. conduction, convection and radiation) and multi-phase CFD/CHT simulations using Star CCM+. (minimum 4 years of experience).
  • Understanding Investment Casting & Solidification physics and experience of running casting simulations using ProCAST and experience of working in foundry would be an advantage. (minimum 2 years of experience).
  • Good knowledge of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) for gas turbine airfoils.
  • Basic knowledge of Finite element analysis & ability to review the results. Good Familiarity with FE codes like Sim center 3D, ANSYS or general-purpose FEA tool.
  • Basic knowledge of Turbomachinery Aerodynamics, Mechanical Integrity (Fatigue, Creep, Fracture).
  • Exposure to SAP and Teamcenter PLM.
  • Programming skills like Python and NX Open.
  • A balance between scientific rigor and engineering judgement.
  • An attitude of curiosity, perseverance in the face of uncertainty, and a desire for engineering excellence as well as patience.

Personality

  • Strong interpersonal skills i.e., collaborator, quick learner, energetic, imaginative, innovative, ability to adapt quickly & effectively etc.
  • Willing to collaborate & work with colleagues located in multiple time zones (Europe & the US).
  • Self-driven in work tasks with a willingness to learn and try new methods to solve a problem.
  • Align with Organization Purpose, Values & Behavior & adhere to business compliance guidelines.
  • Effective communicator both verbal and non-verbal.
  • Ability to write clear and descriptive reports in English.

This is a rare opportunity to work on high-visibility, high-impact programs where your technical contributions will directly influence turbine performance, production efficiency, and long-term competitiveness. You will have the autonomy to innovate, the resources to validate your methods, and the chance to see your work move from simulation to actual hardware in some of the most advanced gas turbines in the world. If you are passionate about simulation, manufacturability, and solving complex engineering problems that matter, this is the role where you can make a lasting technical impact.

About the Team (Power Generation)

In the large steam and gas turbine domain, we offer services and solutions for gas turbines, large steam turbines, large generators, and associated control technology. Our portfolio serves customers such as power utilities, Independent Power Producers (IPPs), Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) firms, and industrial clients. We provide a comprehensive range of offerings including maintenance, operation, digital services, modernization and upgradation, plant flexibilization, as well as control and digitalization solutions (digital control systems, field instruments, and equipment) and professional consulting.

Our power generation portfolio also includes industrial steam turbines (ranging from 10 kW to 250 MW), condensers, and service offerings designed to extend the lifespan and efficiency of industrial steam turbines through heat recovery solutions. We cater to a wide range of process industries—including oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, paper & pulp, sugar & ethanol, and marine—helping customers reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. A key focus area is delivering integrated industrial decarbonization solutions built on electrification, automation, and digitalization, while supporting sustainability through carbon-optimized energy systems and hydrogen generation.

Who is Siemens Energy India?

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens-energy-india.com

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by #TeamPurpleIndia. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

job.title: Graduate Engineer (Gordon Brothers)
job.description:
Launch Your Engineering Career with Australia's Industrial Refrigeration Leader

Gordon Brothers Industries (GBI), part of the Johnson Controls (JCI) family, is Australia's largest industrial refrigeration company and a trusted partner to some of the nation's most critical industries.

With over 100 years of engineering excellence and offices all across Australia, GBI specialises in the design, construction, commissioning, service, and maintenance of complex industrial refrigeration systems.

Supporting industries including food and beverage manufacturing, cold storage, pharmaceutical production, healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and distribution, GBI delivers innovative solutions that improve safety, reliability, efficiency, and sustainability.

As part of Johnson Controls, a global leader in industrial cooling, energy efficiency, and decarbonisation solutions, GBI combines local expertise with access to world-class technologies, resources, and innovation. Together, we help customers optimise operations, reduce environmental impact, and meet the demands of an increasingly sustainable future.

Why Join Gordon Brothers Industries?

This is more than a graduate role. It's an opportunity to develop into a well-rounded engineer while working alongside industry experts on large-scale industrial refrigeration and engineering projects.

You'll gain hands-on exposure to:

  • Industrial refrigeration system design and engineering
  • Project management and project delivery
  • Manufacturing and construction environments
  • Client engagement and technical consulting
  • Site commissioning and operational support
  • Safety, compliance, and risk management
  • Emerging sustainability and energy-efficiency technologies

Whether your long-term goal is technical leadership, project management, design engineering, or consulting, this role provides a strong foundation for a successful engineering career.

What We Offer

  • Exposure to diverse engineering disciplines and projects
  • Structured training and professional development
  • Mentorship from highly experienced engineers and industry specialists
  • Competitive salary package
  • Career progression opportunities within GBI and the broader Johnson Controls network
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment

About the Role

Due to continued business growth, we are seeking a motivated Graduate Engineer to join our Brunswick-based team.

Working closely with experienced Engineers, Project Managers, and Service Teams, you'll play an important role in supporting the design, delivery, and ongoing optimisation of industrial refrigeration solutions for leading Australian businesses.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with engineering calculations and refrigeration system design.
  • Support the preparation of estimates, tenders, and project proposals.
  • Evaluate existing refrigeration systems and identify improvement opportunities for clients.
  • Participate in project management activities, including procurement, scheduling, stakeholder coordination, and project administration.
  • Assist with cost control and successful project delivery.
  • Contribute to risk assessments, safety planning, and compliance activities.
  • Develop knowledge of Australian and international engineering standards and ensure adherence across projects.
  • Prepare engineering drawings and documentation using AutoCAD and other drafting tools.
  • Conduct site inspections, engineering audits, and technical assessments.
  • Prepare clear and professional client reports.
  • Support commissioning activities for new refrigeration installations.
  • Collaborate with the Service team to deliver technical support and engineering solutions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across engineering and project management processes.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic graduate who is eager to learn, technically curious, and excited by the opportunity to work in a specialised and highly regarded engineering sector.

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Process, or Chemical Engineering
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong understanding of thermodynamics and heat transfer principles
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation
  • Current Australian driver's licence
  • Full working rights within Australia

Desirable

  • Experience using AutoCAD or similar design software
  • Exposure to refrigeration, energy, manufacturing, or process industries
  • Previous engineering internship or industry placement experience

Build Your Future with GBI

This is an outstanding opportunity to join an industry leader and gain exposure to the full engineering project lifecycle, from concept and design through to commissioning and operational support.

job.title: HVAC Project Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do

As a Senior Project Engineer, you will work with HVAC engineers to achieve year on year P&L growth

How you will do it:

  • Strong fundamental knowledge of HVAC system and equipment, perform technical calculation and analysis, such as heat load, energy consumption, sound level, airflow, ESP and so on.
  • Strong project management experience and skills with contractual knowledge
  • Liaise with Sale Team to coordinate HVAC equipment selection and ordering.
  • Re-Selection of equipment base on customer’s requirement.
  • Place order with Factory upon design approval.
  • Updating and follow-up customer change order, ensure comments from consultant and clients are follow-up proactively
  • Liaising with different stakeholders (Factory, Forwarder, Customer, Sub-Contractors) to ensure smooth deliver of equipment to site.
  • Project system analysis, solution study, technical specification, drafting, and problem solving
  • Project Documentation, ensuring receipt of relevant certification, correspondence, documents, drawings, and financial records.
  • Revenue & Billing Forecast
  • Monitor working practices, managing contractors and reporting lack of compliance to your line manager
  • Attend technical briefing, presentation and job site support
  • Improve Internal Process.
  • Conduct/monitor internal meeting with peers to ensure all project activities are align.

What we look for:

  • Degree/Diploma in Engineering or relevant certifications
  • Good understanding of HVAC equipment, system and operation.
  • Good knowledge of [SAP system application and operation.](https://www.sap.com/sea/products/erp.html)
  • Experience in 2D/3D modeling of HVAC equipment, Piping, Ducting & Chiller Plant layout.
  • Drafting experience such as AutoCAD, Revit and Navisworks will be advantageous
  • Managing project P&L to ensure all project balance sheet.
  • Provide training, education and share relevant work experience to peers.
  • Ability to multitask at work on fast paced environment.
  • Effective communication skills in the workplace liaise with customer & factory.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Instructional Designer/Learning Experience Designer (Commercial, Products, and Service Solutions - Sales Focus)
job.description:
Instructional Designer/Learning Experience Designer (Commercial, Products, and Service Solutions - Sales Focus)

What you will do

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to apply your Instructional Design expertise to projects that support a global, digitally-driven organization? Do you have experience leading projects supporting commercial or sales organizations? Do you want to turn all those great ideas you have into tangible results that make a difference? Do you have experience designing multi-media learning solutions to drive business outcomes? Are you adept at project management? If that’s the case, Johnson Controls Inc (JCI) has an amazing opportunity for you!

The future is being built today, and Johnson Controls is making that future more productive, secure, sustainable, and far safer. We are harnessing the power of the cloud, the Internet of Things, and user-design thinking to deliver intelligent buildings and smart cities that connect communities in ways that make people’s lives – and the world – better. Are you excited about enabling an organization transforming the buildings industry?

Your challenge, if you wish to accept it, will be to create innovative and effective enablement materials that support Johnson Controls’ sellers to understand customer needs throughout a building’s lifecycle , communicate value, and position our broader building systems and services portfolio with confidence. You will do this by working collaboratively with colleagues and business leaders, immersing yourself in the fascinating business, bringing creativity and hard work to every project you do, and being open to learning new skills and technologies every single day. Requirements include a strong learner-focused mindset, business acumen, a willingness to act amid ambiguity, strong project management skills, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Does this sound like you? If so, keep reading!

How you will do it

  • Design intuitive and creative learning or performance support tools and sales programs
  • Develop training with an emphasis on innovative learning and performance support that could be used globally
  • Apply what you know about adult learning and share what you learn along the way with the rest of the team
  • Use strong project management skills in developing outcomes that positively impact the business
  • Work very closely with team members who will develop your designs
  • Partner and collaborate with Commercial (Sales) focused learning experience designers (peers) located across the globe
  • Driven curation strategies that pull content from multiple sources across our learning ecosystem
  • Drive in depth discovery and needs analysis with stakeholder and learner interviews
  • Act as an internal consultant and combine multiple perspectives into holistic solutions that maximize the impact on the business
  • Create and support a strong global team environment
  • Engage commercial partners and stakeholders to develop capability building programs
  • Participate in organizational development exercises including group facilitation, team building, and systems analysis
  • Maintain current knowledge of trends and issues in instructional design and training
  • Understand technology to effectively design your learning and performance support tools
  • Leverage innovative learning technologies and platforms to deploy learning, including the Johnson Controls Workday Learning platform.
  • Establish measurement and evaluation plans that include key business metrics and return on investment strategies

What impact would you have?

Everyone wants to feel like they’re having an impact. In this position, you absolutely will. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Support successful launches of new products/solutions by ensuring that our sales organization has the training they need for success.
  • Enable sellers to succeed in their roles through role based training and skill development training.
  • Impact sellers, sales managers, and sales leaders from around the world as a part of a global team creating stimulating ways to help our sales organizations build new skills and improve their performance.
  • Investigate new opportunities and develop effective training that is impactful and inventive
  • Directly impact key performance indicators such as quota attainment, secured volume, and revenue generation
  • Align your ingenuity and innovative ideas with the global strategic plan of the business
  • Learn on a day-to-day basis about how our equipment and strategies work to conserve energy and protect our environment

Focus on Johnson Controls’ expanding portfolio of technology-based anproducts impacting our customers’ daily life

What we look for

  • Experience:5-10 years of designing and developing learning solutions preferred (exposure to Commercial / Sales, Industrial Tech B2B solutions preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience in Instructional Design and storyboarding, working for the Training & eLearning industry
  • At least 1-2 years of experience in stakeholder communication

Education

  • Holds a bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, and Education or Graduate or PG from a recognized university
  • Demonstrates certain levels of proficiency in evaluations, Kirkpatrick model, Philips ROI model, ADDIE, Agile, cultural, and regional adjustments, change management, and adult learning theory

Technical: JCI’s product and services portfolio is complex, so we need someone who is quick to grasp how building environments are created and business lines organized. Don’t worry, we’ll help you with that!Quality: Produces content and materials with the highest polish when required, but knows when to create fast and informalProfessional: Has personal ethics, does quality work, and has a positive attitudeArticulate: Has strong writing and communication skills

Specialized skills:

  • Empathetic – Ability to connect with learners while enabling change. Understanding of human-centered needs to allow individual growth through learning and personal development
  • Creative – Can look at a project and find alternatives
  • Flexible – Can change course if needed
  • Cutting edge – Isn’t limited by what’s out there today and is constantly looking for what is next
  • Detailed – Realizes the importance of details in leading to impactful outcomes
  • Collaborative – Collaborates with other designers, vendors, program managers, and more people in the business than we can count
  • Ambitious – Willing to assume authority, take risks, and set clear goals for career development
  • Proactive approach – Continually questions existing work standards and processes and delivery to find better, faster, less expensive, or more effective ways to do things

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou).

job.title: iScala Analyst
job.description:
iScala ERP Analyst

At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

Role Overview

The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day-to-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4-6 years of hands-on experience in ERP support or techno-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
  • Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
  • Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
  • Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end-user training activities.
  • Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
  • Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
  • Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
  • Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.

How You Will Do It

  • You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
  • You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
  • You will use structured problem-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
  • You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
  • You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
  • Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
  • Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
  • Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
  • Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross-functional stakeholders in English.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance-related ERP functions.
  • Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end-user training.
  • Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.

Why Join Us

You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.

If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Servicenow Platform Architect
job.description:
Job Title: ServiceNow Architect

About the Role

We are looking for a ServiceNow Architect to lead the overall design, architecture, and governance of the ServiceNow platform. This role requires deep hands‑on experience across multiple ServiceNow products, strong understanding of platform architecture, and the ability to guide development teams while working closely with process owners, business leaders, and technical stakeholders. You will define standards, design scalable solutions, and ensure the platform supports long‑term business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end‑to‑end architecture of the ServiceNow platform across ITSM, CMDB, and at least one additional product such as ITOM, ITAM (SAM/HAM), HRSD, SecOps.
  • Design scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with platform best practices and organizational standards.
  • Translate business requirements into technical designs, data models, workflows, and integrations.
  • Lead technical design sessions, solution reviews, and architecture discussions with developers and stakeholders.
  • Oversee complex configurations: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Flow Designer logic.
  • Guide integration design using Scripted REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and external systems.
  • Ensure CMDB structure, relationships, and data quality support service mapping and operational processes.
  • Support platform upgrades, patching, regression testing, and long‑term platform roadmap planning.
  • Troubleshoot high‑impact issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and recommend permanent fixes.
  • Provide technical leadership to developers and administrators; review code and ensure adherence to standards.
  • Define governance, naming conventions, documentation practices, and development guidelines.
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure compliance and platform stability.
  • Drive automation, workflow optimization, and platform performance improvements.
  • Maintain clear documentation for designs, integrations, data models, and architectural decisions.

Core Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of ServiceNow architecture, data models, tables, ACLs, and role‑based access.
  • knowledge of Data Fabric and Creator Pro addon.
  • Strong expertise in ITSM, ITAM and ITOM (required).
  • Hands‑on experience with at least two additional modules: ITOM, ITAM (SAM/HAM), HRSD, SecOps, SPM, or ATF.
  • Advanced scripting skills: JavaScript (server and client), Glide APIs, Script Includes, and UI scripting.
  • Strong knowledge of Flow Designer, Workflow Editor, and process automation.
  • Experience designing and maintaining Scripted REST APIs, integrations, and data exchange patterns.
  • Solid understanding of CMDB relationships, discovery patterns, service mapping, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with Service Portal, widgets, and UI customization.
  • Understanding of ATF for automated testing.
  • Strong grasp of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow modules.
  • Experience with Scoped Apps, custom tables, and application lifecycle management.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of hands‑on ServiceNow experience, including development and administration.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise‑level ServiceNow solutions.
  • Strong understanding of platform best practices, architecture principles, and governance.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  • ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, CIS (ITSM/CMDB/HRSD), or CTA are preferred.
  • Ability to mentor developers and admins and lead technical discussions.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and business stakeholders.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.

job.title: Principal Performance Test Engineer (Fusion Load Testing)
job.description:
Job Description

As a member of the Support organization, your focus is to deliver post-sales support and solutions to the Oracle customer base while serving as an advocate for customer needs. This involves resolving post-sales non-technical customer inquiries via phone and electronic means, as well as, technical questions regarding the use of and troubleshooting for our Electronic Support Services. A primary point of contact for customers, you are responsible for facilitating customer relationships with Support and providing advice and assistance to internal Oracle employees on diverse customer situations and escalated issues.

Responsibilities

As a Principal Support Engineer, you will offer strategic technical support to assure the highest level of customer satisfaction. A primary focus is to create/utilize automated technology and instrumentation to diagnose, document, and resolve/avoid customer issues. You are expected to be an expert member of the technical problem solving/problem avoidance team, routinely sought after to address extremely complex, critical customer issues. Services may be frequently provided by on-site customer visits.

Experience Level:8 to10+ years relevant working experience

Qualification:BE, BTech, MCA or equivalent preferred. Other qualifications with adequate experience may be considered.

  • Software Analysis & Design knowledge/experience

  • Technically responsible for all the Testing performed by the Team

Secondary & Automation Skills:

  • Specialist in any one area or technology such as Saas Fusion Apps, EBSO, PeopleSoft, Hyperion, JD Edwards etc,
  • Knowledge of current industry wide Quality & Test processes and practices, Tools and techniques
  • Solution-oriented and creative thinker.

Other Details:

  • Excellent team player
  • Effective negotiation skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Strong customer management skills
  • Willing to learn new applications
  • Quick learner who adapts to new technology.
  • Committed to studying and meeting the needs of business users.

Location:

Bangalore

Qualifications

Career Level - IC4

  • Load Testing Tools

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. job.title: Territory Manager - Sales
job.description:
As a Territory Manager, you will play a crucial role in our sales strategy, focusing on channel sales and retail operations. Your primary objective is to develop and maintain strong relationships with our primary and secondary distributors, ensuring effective product distribution and market penetration. You will be working closely with our retail partners to understand their needs and provide excellent support.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop sales territories, focusing on channel sales and retail partnerships.
  • Build and maintain relationships with primary and secondary distributors, ensuring effective product distribution.
  • Expand our numeric reach and market presence by identifying new sales opportunities.
  • Track and analyze sales data, providing regular reports and insights to the sales team.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and execute sales campaigns and promotions.
  • Provide excellent customer service and support to our retail partners and end-users.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and competitor activities, offering insights to the team.
  • Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent NEDS and build our brand presence.
  • Work closely with the product team to understand product features and benefits, ensuring effective communication to distributors and customers.

Qualifications

  • A proven track record in sales, with experience in channel sales and retail operations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret sales data and market trends.
  • Knowledge of primary and secondary distribution channels and their dynamics.
  • Familiarity with collection tracking and management processes.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple territories effectively.
  • Proficiency in using sales and CRM tools for data tracking and analysis.
  • A proactive and results-driven approach to sales and territory management.
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned territories as required.
  • A positive and collaborative attitude, with a passion for sales and customer satisfaction.

job.title: Senior Analyst - R2R
job.description:
The RTR Analyst will lead the end-to-end Record to Report workstream, ensuring the absolute accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of financial data and reporting.

This role involves managing general ledger accounting, running the month-end and year-end close processes, enforcing internal controls, and steering digital automation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Close & GL Management

  • Oversee the end-to-end month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing timelines to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Ensure accuracy across the General Ledger (GL), subsidiary ledgers, and fixed asset accounting operations.
  • Produce and review consolidated financial statements, including Profit & Loss (P&L), Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements.
  • Reconciliations & Quality Assurance
  • Drive timely investigation and resolution of any open, aged, or anomalous line items.
  • Review and sign off on crucial balance sheet account reconciliations (e.g., GL, Bank, Fixed Assets etc)
  • Validate revenue recognition provisions, and inventory evaluations

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Perform comprehensive monthly variance analysis to explain operational performance trends to relevant stakeholders (CFO, Controllership, Operation Finance)
  • Ensure absolute adherence to applicable accounting standards such as US GAAP, IFRS, or Local GAAP.
  • Implement various digital tool which will help in day to day accounting operation.
  • Capable of monitoring control systems designed to preserve company assets and report accurate financials.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the core point of contact for internal and external auditors, delivering necessary documentation and mitigating risks.
  • Manage expectations at the leadership level through routine financial governance reporting.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Professional qualifications such as CA or CMA or Any Finance Degree are highly desirable, Minimum experience of 3-5 years of corporate accounting experience
  • Professional with a record of success working with large teams, to work in sync with set parameters to achieve business goals.
  • Proven experience steering complex financial close cycles and handling multi-entity configurations
  • Advanced proficiency with prominent enterprise ERP systems like SAP, S4 HANA
  • Direct experience using automated reconciliation platforms such as BlackLine is a significant advantage
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skill.

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

job.title: Principal Software Engineer - Java
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and contribute to strategic modernization initiatives across Helios platforms, including transformation of legacy Java/J2EE applications to cloud-native(AWS) and scalable architectures
  • Guide implementation approach for modernization initiatives, ensuring alignment between architecture intent and delivery execution
  • Define and guide target architecture patterns and design principles for modernization efforts
  • Drive experiments and proof-of-concepts (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns, enabling data-driven technology decisions
  • Translate successful POCs into scalable, production-ready solutions and drive adoption across teams
  • Influence engineering practices, standards, and architectural decisions across the broader Helios development community
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, and code reviews, enforcing coding standards, best practices, and maintainable design patterns
  • Mentor and coach engineers on low-level design, object-oriented design, and modern software engineering practices, elevating overall engineering capability
  • Deep-dive into complex legacy modules, identifying constraints, and proposing optimal modernization or refactoring strategies
  • Partner with DevOps and platform teams to ensure build, release, deployment readiness, and adoption of modern CI/CD and containerization practices
  • Identify and drive opportunities to embed AI and automation into engineering workflows, improving developer productivity, quality, and delivery speed

Required Skills & Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, including strong hands-on development and technical leadership experience
  • Proven experience in Java/J2EE-based application development, including leading design and delivery of scalable services
  • Strong expertise in software architecture, design patterns, object-oriented design, and low-level design principles
  • Experience modernizing legacy enterprise applications and transitioning to microservices-based architectures
  • Hands-on experience with Spring frameworks, REST/JSON APIs, and distributed system design
  • Comprehensive knowledge of database technologies, including Postgres, SQL, and NoSQL, with proven ability to design, optimize, and troubleshoot data solutions.
  • Strong experience with data access technologies (JPA/Hibernate/JDBC)
  • Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit) and building high-quality, testable software
  • Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, tagging), Maven or equivalent build tools, and strong debugging skills
  • Experience leading or contributing to POCs, innovation initiatives, or modernization programs
  • Strong experience working with cross-functional and global teams, influencing without direct authority
  • Excellent technical communication, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement skills
  • ​Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and working with DevOps/CI-CD pipelines
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes for orchestration of containerized applications
  • Experience working with software systems in autonomous vehicles, mining, construction, or similar industrial domains
  • Understanding of onboard (machine) and offboard (cloud/office) system architectures and their integration in distributed autonomy platforms
  • Familiarity with communication protocols and networking concepts used in distributed systems (e.g., TCP/IP, messaging systems, telemetry pipelines)
  • Experience designing or integrating systems involving machine-to-cloud or edge-to-cloud communication

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Relocation is available for this position.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

September 16, 2026 - September 29, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

In this role, you will independently manage a broad range of people matters to deliver workforce outcomes that strengthen organisational capability, employee engagement and business performance. job.title: Legal Counsel, Real Estate & Planning
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Legal Counsel, Capital Projects, you will report to Senior Director, Capital Projects, and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • You will work closely with the AirTrunk Legal, Site Selection and Development teams and other key business stakeholders, applying your broad expertise and knowledge to lead and drive key site selection, property, planning, leasing and acquisition workstreams across the APJ region.
  • You will advise on new, significant and unique initiatives, strategies and processes being developed across the site selection, property, planning, land acquisition space to enable the rapid expansion of AirTrunk data centre developments across APJ, utilising your conceptual thinking to understand advanced issues and implications and convey them appropriately.
  • You will be able to hone new skills and expertise in related workstreams as required, such as energy/power, construction, development and procurement, applying an in-depth knowledge of AirTrunk’s business, operations, technologies and services and providing legal support on AirTrunk’s strategic initiatives.

Your Day to Day

  • Review and negotiate legal contracts, and provide practical and commercial legal advice on a range of property and planning workstreams across APJ, and clearly convey advanced information concisely and commercially.
  • Support the Site Selection team to implement new, or improve on existing, commercial arrangements and contractual frameworks and policies to support the rapid expansion of data centre developments through APJ.
  • Monitor and identify emerging property, foreign investment, planning issues and developments from a legal or regulatory perspective, drive initiatives to ensure awareness, and compliance and improve processes within AirTrunk, including through training and development of new policies and procedures.
  • Advise the Site Selection team as needed to monitor, manage, and resolve claims and/or disputes.

Requirements

  • Law degree from an accredited law school.
  • Minimum of 8 years in real property experience gained from a reputable law firm and/or within an in-house environment, experience in planning a plus.
  • Experience in advising across a broad range of property-related areas, across APJ markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply sound judgement and commercial acumen to a range of negotiations, whilst delivering practical legal advice that manages risk.
  • Ability to autonomously and efficiently manage multiple workstreams, priorities and stakeholders.
  • Excellent negotiation, relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Enjoys being challenged, has a “can do” attitude, is prepared to go above and beyond and is eager to learn and develop an in-depth knowledge of AirTrunk’s business and operations.
  • Thrives in a fun, team-oriented, fast-paced working environment.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Role Purpose

Lead the strategy, product development, transformation, onboarding, orchestration, and engineering evolution of the Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) portfolio, encompassing SD-WAN, Secure Service Edge (SSE) and Secure Internet Access.

The role requires deep expertise in Lead-to-Order (L2O), Order-to-Cash/Order-to-Billing (O2C/O2B), and Trouble-to-Resolve (T2R) customer journeys, service orchestration platforms, AI-enabled automation, API-driven ecosystems, and cloud-native security architectures. The position will drive seamless customer onboarding, service lifecycle management, policy-based provisioning, and Zero-Touch MACD (Move, Add, Change, Delete) operations across the SASE portfolio while enabling scalable digital service delivery and customer experience transformation.

Key Responsibilities

SASE Product Strategy & Portfolio Management

  • Drive product strategy, portfolio evolution, onboarding, and lifecycle management for SASE services including SD-WAN, SSE, and Secure Internet Access.
  • Define and execute product roadmaps aligned with enterprise security, cloud transformation, and digital connectivity strategies.
  • Lead portfolio modernization initiatives to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, automation, and service adoption.

Lead initiatives to continuously enhance and maintain high service quality and guest satisfaction by overseeing guest experience and service delivery for Pranaam Services. Develop feedback mechanisms to capture customer insights and use them to drive service improvements.

Stakeholder Management:

Expand business networks and opportunities and build and maintain strong relationships with corporates, hotels, and travel agents to expand business networks and create new opportunities.

Operational Management:

Ensure smooth daily operations of the Pranaam service at regional airport by optimizing resource allocation, managing staff schedules, and maintaining adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements.

Feedback and Improvement:

Implement effective feedback management processes, regularly monitoring customer feedback to identify service improvement areas and drive continuous enhancements in service delivery.

Quality Assurance and Compliance:

Ensure all Pranaam services meet quality standards and comply with relevant local and international regulations.

Develop and implement quality assurance frameworks, including regular audits, to maintain service excellence and compliance.

Contingency Crisis Management:

Manage responses to any operational disruptions, customer complaints, or emergencies at regional airports, ensuring swift and effective resolutions while maintaining service quality.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

Utilize data-driven methods to analyze customer trends, service performance, and market conditions. Provide insights and recommendations to senior management to inform strategic decisions.

Team Leadership and Development:

Encourage team collaboration and accountability, fostering a culture of continuous improvement to meet organizational goals effectively.

Mentor and coach team members, identifying high-potential individuals and developing them into future leaders through focused development plans.

Digital Mindset:

Promote the use of digital tools and technology to enhance service efficiency, customer experience, and operational performance. Support the introduction and utilization of the Pranaam App to ensure a seamless, customer-centric experience.

job.description:
Production Management:

Manage daily production activities to ensure output targets, process flow, and delivery timelines are consistently achieved. Monitor operations for adherence to SOPs and technical specifications.

Drawing Interpretation:

Interpret complex technical drawings and convert them into executable actions for production planning, scheduling, and team coordination.

Resource Utilization & Optimization:

Efficiently allocate manpower, equipment, and materials to maximize productivity and minimize operational costs and wastage.

Process Improvement:

Continuously analyze production processes to identify inefficiencies, implement corrective actions, and drive lean practices to enhance overall output.

Safety Compliance:

Compliance to safety protocols, conduct regular safety inspections, and ensure a safe working environment for all team members.

Risk Management:

Identify potential production risks, delays, or resource shortages early and develop action plans to address them proactively.

Equipment & Maintenance Support:

Digital mindset:

job.title: Deputy Manager - Gas & Chemical
job.description:
Chemical Systems Maintenance:

  • Oversee the maintenance and calibration of chemical systems and equipment used in gas and chemical processes, ensuring optimal performance and compliance with safety regulations through regular inspections and servicing.

Manage Bulk Gas Systems:

  • Oversee bulk gas handling, storage, and distribution. Ensure safety protocols and efficient operations. Perform regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks.

Handle Specialty Chemicals:

  • Supervise specialty chemicals' storage, handling, and application. Ensure regulatory compliance and develop safe use and disposal procedures.

Gas System Management:

  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of gas systems to ensure safe and efficient gas handling. Conduct regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks and comply with safety regulations.

Coordination of Maintenance Activities:

  • Coordinate maintenance schedules and activities across chemical systems and equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of maintenance tasks while minimizing disruption to operations and ensuring safety compliance.

Chemical Process Oversight:

  • Supervise chemical processes, including handling, storage, and application. Develop procedures for safe use and waste management to meet environmental and safety standards.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure gas and chemical operations meet safety regulations and industry standards. Perform audits and risk assessments to identify hazards and implement corrective actions.

System Optimization:

  • Enhance the efficiency and performance of gas and chemical systems through data analysis and process improvements. Collaborate on system upgrades to boost reliability and cut costs.

Training and Development:

  • Train staff on safe gas and chemical handling and emergency procedures. Develop training programs and conduct drills to ensure personnel are well-versed in safety protocols.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain records of gas and chemical system operations, including maintenance and compliance reports. Prepare detailed management reports on system performance and safety.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Lead - Gas & Chemical
  • Area Incharge - Chemical
  • Package Incharge - O&M (CAS & PCW)
  • Engineer - Chemist
  • Lead - C&I
  • Area Incharge - Electrical

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Chemical Suppliers
  • Gas System Providers
  • Regulatory Authorities
  • Environmental Agencies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field is essential. Additional certifications in hazardous materials management or environmental compliance would be beneficial. Strong understanding of chemical properties, handling procedures, and regulatory requirements is crucial.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in handling and managing gases and chemicals within an industrial setting. Proven track record in ensuring chemical safety, maintaining chemical inventory, and complying with environmental regulations. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop chemical handling procedures.

job.title: Screener
job.description:
Baggage Screening and Threat Detection:

Attend all the regulatory trainings and clear trainings as per the regulatory attempts

Operate X-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.

Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X-ray screening.

Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.

Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:

Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.

Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.

Equipment Maintenance and Pre-Operational Checks:

Conduct routine pre-operational checks of X-BIS, ETD, CT-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.

Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.

Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:

Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.

Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.

Time Management and Efficiency:

Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.

Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.

Workplace Conduct and Decorum:

Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.

Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

CSO

Lead Avsec Audit & Compliance

Pass Section

Lead - ILHBS/ Duty Manager - ILHBS/ Sr Screener

Terminal Operations

IT

HR Department

Compliance and Regulatory Teams

Other Airport Departments (e.g., Operations, Customer Service)

Key Stakeholders - External:

Transportation Security Administration (TSA)

Aircraft Operator

Airport Authorities

Passengers

ASG

BCAS

Local Police

Service Providers

Law Enforcement Agencies

Regulatory Bodies

Industry Associations

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center

NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred

Work Experience:

Freshers or 1-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.

Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.

Physical Qualification:

Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /

lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses

or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.

Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for

frequencies below 2000 Hz.

Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.

Movement-of-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any

pronounced speed impediment.

Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor

Deportment & Appearance - Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,

deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

job.title: Finance Manager (Process Optimisation)
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

To support Record to Report (RTR)’s process optimization initiatives, this role will be responsible for identifying process gaps and improvement opportunities, simplifying, and standardizing activities and driving automation and system enhancement across RTR.

The role partners with business users, IT and transformation/Group Digital Office teams to translate business needs into practical solutions, support implementation and change, and sustain benefits post-implementation.

The role is also expected to provide operational support for RTR activities, including month-end close, financial accounting and reporting, and other assignments based on business priorities and resource needs.

Make an impact by

  • Review existing RTR processes and identify opportunities for simplification, standardisation and automation.
  • Work with process owners and users to understand business requirements and support process improvements.
  • Coordinate and track process improvements and transformation initiatives, including timelines, issues and deliverables.
  • Work with IT and automation teams on business requirements, solution design and development.
  • Coordinate UAT, implementation, training and change management activities.
  • Monitor post-implementation results and identify areas for further improvement.
  • Provide guidance and ongoing support to team members for assigned initiatives
  • Support month end close activities, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet accounts review, audit and any other RTR tasks as required.
  • Support other RTR activities or initiatives as assigned.

**

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Accountancy, Finance, Business or a related discipline; or equivalent professional qualification.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience with exposure to financial operations, accounting/ reporting and/or process optimisation & transformation initiatives
  • Good finance and accounting process knowledge
  • Process mapping and root-cause analysis
  • Experience supporting process improvement, automation or transformation initiatives
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, familiarity with Power Platform, AI tools will be advantageous.
  • Good stakeholder management
  • Strong problem solving and analytical mindset
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills
  • Good organisation, prioritisation and coordination skills
  • Understanding of finance controls, governance and audit requirements

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Social Commerce Intern #Generalinternships
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. As an intern, you'll gain hands-on experience in the fast-growing world of social commerce, livestream shopping and digital retail.

##

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As a Social Commerce Intern, you will support the planning and execution of livestream campaigns across TikTok Shop, Shopee Live, Lazada and other social commerce platforms.

You will get hands-on experience across the full social commerce journey — from campaign planning and platform operations to livestream hosting, performance analysis and sales conversion. Working with brands, merchants, affiliates and internal teams, you will help create engaging livestream experiences that connect with customers and drive commercial outcomes.

How You will Make An Impact:

Livestream & Campaign Execution

  • Coordinate and execute livestream campaigns across TikTok Shop, Shopee Live, Lazada and other social commerce platforms.
  • Support end-to-end campaign planning, including promotional mechanics, product assortment setup, campaign scheduling and content coordination.
  • Collaborate closely with livestream hosts, brand partners, affiliates, merchants and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless campaign execution.
  • Host livestream sessions approximately three times per week, including evenings and weekends when required.
  • Provide real-time operational and troubleshooting support during livestreams and campaign periods to ensure smooth execution.

###

Platform Operations & Commercial Support

  • Manage day-to-day platform operations, including product listing setup, voucher creation, campaign configuration and promotional optimisation.
  • Monitor campaign performance and analyse key livestream metrics including traffic, engagement, conversion and sales performance.
  • Support growth initiatives to improve customer engagement and drive commercial outcomes across social commerce channels.
  • Assist with content coordination, inventory planning and post-campaign performance reporting.

##

Skills for Success:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Diploma in Marketing, Mass Communications, Business, Retail Management, eCommerce or a related discipline.
  • Passionate about social commerce, livestreaming, digital marketing and creating engaging customer experiences that drive sales.
  • Confident, energetic and creative, with the ability to present comfortably in front of a camera.
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail and good time management skills.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
  • Positive, proactive and collaborative, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willing and able to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, when required.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Lead Agent Evaluation & Instrumentation #AIDA
job.description:
Role Summary

Lead the Agent Evaluation & Instrumentation function as the independent quality authority for the telco’s production AI estate. Own the Day 1 → Day 2 handover process and hold go/no-go gate authority over every AI agent and AI/ML model entering production.

Define what “good” means through the metrics catalogue, evaluation suites, and instrumentation standards, and ensure the organisation can prove agent quality, safety, and reliability before and after launch.

Lead a team of evaluation and instrumentation engineers and analysts, safeguarding evaluation independence from delivery pressure.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Own, publish, and continuously improve the Day 1 → Day 2 handover process, operability gates, and shadow-run exit criteria across all agent archetypes (RAG, SQL, task-based autonomous, AI/ML models, voice overlay).
  • Chair operability gate reviews and issue independent go/no-go decisions with written findings; track remediation of conditional passes to closure.
  • Set instrumentation and telemetry standards (trace schema, required events, dashboards) and certify telemetry completeness before shadow-run exit.
  • Lead, coach the Agent Eval & Instrumentation team to build specific AI/Agent use case operational and evaluation dashboards in consultation with Agent Capabilities Services and Business/Product Owners.
  • Drive the improvement engine: convert production signals into a prioritised optimisation backlog routed to Agent Capabilities Services, Data & Harness Engineering, and AI/Agent Operations, and evidence that shipped improvements moved the target metric.
  • Represent Agent Eval & Instrumentation with cross-functional partners such as (Agent Capabilities Services, Data & Harness Engineering, Central AI Platform & Ops, AI Lab) and provide quality and reliability inputs to CAIO/board reporting.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Agent Eval & Instrumentation team; manage evaluation independence, workload prioritisation, and performance.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 10+ years in software/ML/quality with 3+ years leading technical teams
  • Experience operating or evaluating ML/LLM systems in production
  • LLM/agent evaluation methods (offline & online, LLM-as-judge)
  • Metrics design and observability/instrumentation for AI systems
  • Understanding of RAG, SQL agents, autonomous agents and AI/ML model lifecycles
  • Strong stakeholder management and the independence to hold a line
  • Clear written communication for gate findings and executive reporting
  • People leadership and coaching

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.
