job.title: Vulnerability Management Technical Lead
job.description:
What you will do

  • The development and implementation of the Colt Vulnerability Management Framework.
  • Enhancing the scope and efficiency of current vulnerability scanning and management tools and integration between them.
  • Design and manage the periodic penetration testing exercise.
  • Collaborating with identified stakeholders to provide specialist guidance and support, ensuring effective vulnerability identification, prioritisation and remediation activity definition.
  • Perform Vulnerability scans using Vulnerability Management tool
  • Responsible for working with leading team to assist with understanding threat data and vulnerabilities found on client’s network
  • Prepare and send error free Vulnerability Management reports to respective stakeholders
  • Send scan notification and completion emails as per defined timelines.
  • Configuration of vulnerability scans and reporting
  • Troubleshooting in case of scan failures or tool-based issues
  • Identify false positive and connect with vendor and support teams to resolve it
  • Drive remediation connects with multiple stake holders / resolver groups

What we're looking for

  • Self-driven individual with vulnerability management function experience.
  • Proven experience with products dealing with vulnerability management services which include - Rapid7, Qualys, Nessus etc.
  • Strong understanding on Windows systems, Linux systems
  • Strong understanding on Networking
  • Should have completed certifications like CEH, ECSA or other equivalent security certifications
  • Degree in Information Technology, Engineering or similar
  • In-depth knowledge of and experience in security concepts such as cyberattacks and techniques, risk management, incident management, threat management, etc.
  • Depth insight on all latest vulnerabilities and highlight the risk to client environment
  • Proficient in preparation of reports, dashboards and documentations.
  • Knowledge /Experience of security technologies such as Cisco/Juniper Firewalls, Application Firewalls, IPS, SIEM, Proxy, NAC, etc.

What we offer you:

Looking to make a mark?

At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.

Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.

Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.

We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.

Diversity and inclusion

  • Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

Most recently we have:

  • Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
  • Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
  • Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our [DEI pages](https://www.colt.net/about/inclusion-diversity/).

Benefits

Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
  • Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
  • Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
  • Global Family Leave Policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

A global network

  • When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

job.title: Project Manager - Facilities
job.description:
Job Summary

Manages, develops, and implements project(s) of varying complexity and size in assigned functional area. Partners with business stakeholders to ensure a successful project completion.

Key Responsibilities

Leads multiple projects from inception to completion; facilitates project planning sessions with internal stakeholders to determine the scope and objectives of each project; works with business stakeholders to establish project performance goals; designs project plan, develops timeline, identifies project milestones, and tracks performance against performance goals and timeline. Identifies, tracks, and works with others to resolve project issues. Monitors and communicates project status to project team. Plans and monitors project budget, conducts research and analysis; provides input into the design and development of project plans and timelines. Manages project risk; uses quality tools to identify areas of risk; works with others on the team and outside the team to identify alternatives or solutions. Documents and shares team learning's with other teams; draws on other project team experiences to enhance the success of the project. Maintains project notes, databases, and other records; monitors measures and communicates with Project Sponsor and other stakeholders on status of specific projects and assignments. Identifies and assigns appropriate resources to accomplish various project tasks; guides and coaches team members through various stages of the project; provides developmental feedback to team members.

Competencies:

Financial acumen - Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.

Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Project Issue and Risk Management - Manages the process to identify, assess and prioritize issues and risks using recommended tools and disciplines. Drives actions to minimize, monitor and control risks and issues and to maximize the most positive outcomes possible.

Project Resource Management - Develops resource (expense and headcount) plans using recommended project management tools and processes to manage resources effectively.

Project Schedule Management - Manages the planned schedule using the recommended schedule management tools and processes to drive completion within the agreed timeline.

Project Scope Management - Manages a list of project deliverables (scope) using the recommended project management tools and processes to ensure that the project includes all the work required and only the work required to complete the project successfully.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree required (Engineering background preferred)

Experience

5 to 7 years of relevant experience required.

  • Manage day-to-day facilities operations and coordinate with internal stakeholders and service partners.
  • Manage and coordinate Integrated Facility Management (IFM) activities and vendor operations.
  • Lead and manage IFM vendor staff to ensure effective delivery of services.
  • Oversee housekeeping, transportation, cafeteria and other facility services .
  • Coordinate and manage facility-related projects from planning through execution.
  • Oversee the maintenance and upkeep of HVAC systems and other facility infrastructure.
  • Coordinate with relevant stakeholders and vendors for facility requirements, issues and resolutions.
  • Support AOP, CAPEX and OPEX planning and tracking.
  • Manage facility budgets and monitor expenses to ensure effective utilization of resources.
  • Prepare and maintain reports, presentations and dashboards related to facilities operations and projects.
  • Use MS Excel and PowerPoint for data analysis, reporting, presentations and tracking of facility activities.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Process Quality
job.description:
Job Description

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

This position will be based at Ahmednagar Factory for Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.)

Designation: Deputy Manager– Process Quality

Location: Ahmednagar

Qualification: BE (Any engineering)

Experience: 3 years to 6 years

Key Deliverables / Key Responsibilities/Deliverables (Min 4 need to be filled in decreasing order of importance)

  • Support quality assurance activities across the end-to-end manufacturing lifecycle to ensure products meet established quality, safety, and regulatory standards.
  • Promote and reinforce a quality-focused culture within manufacturing operations by adhering to and advocating standard quality practices and procedures.
  • Execute quality improvement initiatives aimed at reducing manufacturing process variability, defects, and quality risks.
  • Participate in quality assurance and validation activities for new, transferred, or modified manufacturing lines and processes.
  • Collaborate with Procurement Quality and cross-functional teams to investigate and resolve supplier-related manufacturing quality issues.
  • Apply defined quality tools, methods, and inspection techniques to monitor process performance and product quality.
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities for manufacturing deviations and nonconformances.
  • Maintain accurate and timely quality documentation in compliance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Execute assigned tasks within defined parameters, schedules, and priorities while meeting quality expectations.

Ready to dive into the world of data and AI? Join Schneider Electric's East Asia Customer Experience & Commercial Transformation Adoption team and gain hands-on experience working with data science, analytics, and digital commerce across more than 10 countries. You will collaborate with international stakeholders across Southeast Asia and other regions while supporting business decision-making through data-driven insights.

What will you do:

  • Support the extraction, transformation, and visualization of sales data. Conduct market analysis, competitor benchmarking, and industry trend research.
  • Assist with the preparation and maintenance of monthly sales reports, including data consolidation, restructuring, and visualization.

  • Collaborate with a multicultural and international team supporting business operations across 10+ countries.
  • Prepare sales presentations, customer proposals, business reviews, and management reports.

  • Good understanding of SQL and database fundamentals.

The Measurement & Analytics Division is among the world’s leading manufacturers and suppliers of smart instrumentation and analyzers, working at the heart of industrial digital transformation. The Measurement & Analytics Division’s portfolio consists of analyzers measuring compositions of gases and liquids; instrumentation measuring process variables such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level; force measurement solutions measuring parameters such as flatness, thickness, and tension; and advanced digital solutions for device management, device health check and predictive maintenance. The Measurement & Analytics Division serves key industries such as oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, as well as the marine industry. job.title: Senior Engineer - Network
job.description:
Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer

Location- Pune

What you will do

As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security & perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.

Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.

The role will be working as part of a global high-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.

How you will do it:

  • Manage and implement network security infrastructure
  • Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
  • Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
  • Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
  • Cloud-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo-blocking controls
  • Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
  • Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
  • Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
  • Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
  • Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
  • Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
  • Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
  • Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
  • Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
  • Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
  • Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo-blocking and reduction of the internet-facing attack surface.

What we look for:

Required

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
  • Strong network infrastructure security background across both on-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
  • Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security-related changes in a production environment.
  • Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
  • Great organisational skills.
  • Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
  • Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
  • Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
  • Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
  • Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
  • Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.
  • Familiarity with service now Ticketing and CMDB is desirable
  • Demonstrated capability to take part as lead security engineer in multi-phase / multi-year network projects or programs, leading these projects to successful implementation.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skill.
  • Strong vendor management experience.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills to provide clear messages to all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain strategic working relationships with peers and constituents at all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated analysis and problem solving skills using innovative thinking.
  • Knowledge of ITIL based practices.
  • Knowledge of Python and automation skills are desirable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other applicable discipline.
  • 8+ years of proven, hands-on network security experience at global enterprise organizations, including significant experience owning and operating a Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) environment at scale.
  • Network security Professional level certification preferred (e.g. Zscaler ZDTA/ZCCP/ZCCA, Fortinet NSE, Imperva, etc.); Zscaler certification strongly preferred.
  • CISSP, CEH, CISM or CISA certifications is a plus.

  • Salesforce
  • SharePoint

  • API standards
  • Data contracts

job.title: Integrated Solutions Service Tech 3
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Assistant Manager - Service (HVAC & Chillers) to oversee service operations, maintenance activities, troubleshooting, and customer support for HVAC systems and chiller installations. The role involves managing service teams, ensuring timely resolution of customer issues, maintaining service quality standards, and driving customer satisfaction while achieving business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations Management

  • Manage preventive maintenance (PM), breakdown maintenance, and annual maintenance contract (AMC) activities for HVAC and chiller systems.
  • Ensure timely execution of service schedules and adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Monitor service performance, response times, and customer satisfaction metrics.
  • Coordinate with customers and internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide technical guidance for troubleshooting HVAC equipment, chillers, AHUs, FCUs, cooling towers, and related systems.
  • Support service engineers in resolving complex technical issues.
  • Analyze recurring equipment failures and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure compliance with OEM guidelines and safety standards.

Team Management

  • Lead and supervise service engineers, technicians, and subcontractors.
  • Allocate resources effectively to optimize service efficiency.
  • Conduct technical training and skill development programs for the team.
  • Monitor team productivity and performance.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
  • Handle customer escalations and ensure prompt resolution.
  • Conduct periodic service review meetings with key customers.
  • Identify opportunities for AMC renewals, service upgrades, and spare parts sales.

Financial & Commercial Management

  • Support preparation of service budgets and resource planning.
  • Monitor service revenue, AMC contracts, and profitability.
  • Ensure timely invoicing and payment follow-up.
  • Control service costs while maintaining quality standards.

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure strict adherence to EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) policies.
  • Conduct safety audits and toolbox talks for service teams.

job.title: Oracle R12 ERP Finance Functional Consultant
job.description:
Job Description

Job Title- Oracle EBS R12 Finance Techno-Functional Consultant –

Location - Bangalore

Johnson Controls is a global organization focused on smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, fire protection, life safety, thermal management, energy efficiency, and decarbonization. In this role, you will help keep critical finance systems running smoothly while working with business and technical teams to improve stability, support, and performance.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Oracle EBS R12 Finance Techno-Functional Consultant who combines strong Oracle Financials knowledge with hands-on technical capability. This role is suited to someone who can support production issues, analyze finance processes end to end, and work closely with stakeholders to resolve problems quickly and accurately. Based in Bangalore, this position requires deep experience in Oracle EBS finance support, root-cause analysis, and SLA-driven issue resolution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide techno-functional support for Oracle EBS R12 Finance applications and related business processes.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues within agreed SLAs.
  • Support month-end and sub-ledger close activities, including issue investigation and resolution.
  • Work across Oracle Financials modules such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, and Cash Management as applicable.
  • Use PL/SQL and related technical analysis to identify root causes and implement fixes or workarounds.
  • Collaborate with business users, process owners, and technical teams to understand requirements and support end-to-end finance processes.
  • Review recurring issues, identify opportunities for automation or process improvement, and help strengthen system stability.
  • Document solutions, support actions, and recurring issues clearly for continuity and knowledge sharing.

How You Will Do It

  • You will take ownership of issues from first analysis through resolution, with a strong focus on accountability, accuracy, and timely follow-through.
  • You will stay close to the finance process, remove blockers quickly, and focus on what matters most to users and stakeholders.
  • You will use structured problem-solving to identify root causes, validate fixes, and improve the way issues are handled over time.
  • You will work as one team across business and technical functions, building trust through clear communication and collaboration.
  • You will approach your work with candor and continuous improvement, looking for small but meaningful ways to strengthen support, reporting, and process stability.
  • You will use your Oracle EBS knowledge and PL/SQL skills to bridge functional needs with practical technical solutions.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in Oracle EBS R12 Finance techno-functional roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Financials and finance support processes.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle EBS finance modules such as GL, AP, AR, FA, and Cash Management.
  • Strong PL/SQL skills for analysis, debugging, and solution support.
  • Experience in production support, issue handling, and SLA-driven environments.
  • Solid understanding of month-end close and sub-ledger accounting processes.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and a proactive approach to problem resolution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting Oracle EBS integrations or interface troubleshooting.
  • Exposure to Oracle Discoverer or reporting discussions.
  • Experience identifying automation or process improvement opportunities.
  • Broader exposure to cross-functional Oracle EBS support beyond Finance, such as SCM or HR.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to work on important finance systems in a collaborative environment where your expertise can directly improve business continuity and user experience. At Johnson Controls, you will be part of a global company with a practical focus on customer impact, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

If you are ready to bring your Oracle EBS Finance expertise to a role with real ownership and impact, we would like to hear from you.

job.title: Service Branch Manager
job.description:
Shape the Future of Smart Buildings with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls, we're creating smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings for the future. As a global leader in building technologies, advanced HVAC solutions, and smart building systems, we partner with customers to improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain mission-critical environments across industries including mining, healthcare, data centres, pharmaceuticals, education, manufacturing, and commercial infrastructure.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry leadership, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, market-leading products, and a highly skilled service workforce to help customers solve complex operational challenges and create sustainable outcomes.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Service Branch Manager to lead our Service Operations team in Brisbane.

This is an exciting opportunity for a proven Service Manager, Operations Manager, HVAC leader, or high-performing people leader ready to take the next step into a broader leadership role. Backed by a strong national leadership team, you will drive branch performance, business growth, operational excellence, and customer success while leading a talented team of technical professionals.

You will play a key role in shaping the future of the branch, developing people, strengthening customer partnerships, and delivering sustainable business outcomes.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute branch strategies that support sustainable growth, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
  • Align branch objectives with broader business goals and market opportunities.

Financial Performance

  • Drive profitability, productivity, and operational efficiency across the branch.
  • Manage budgets, forecasts, and financial performance to achieve business targets.

Customer Success

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and stakeholders.
  • Leverage customer feedback to continuously improve service delivery and customer outcomes.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead and embed best-practice business processes to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality operations.
  • Drive a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous improvement.

Business Growth

  • Lead service and systems sales initiatives to achieve and exceed growth targets.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships and develop new business.

Resource & Workforce Planning

  • Ensure the branch is appropriately resourced with the people, tools, and capabilities required to deliver on commitments.
  • Support workforce development, succession planning, and team engagement.

Why Johnson Controls?

Across our 15 Australian branches, our employees choose Johnson Controls because of our collaborative culture, strong technical expertise, and commitment to employee growth.

You'll benefit from:

  • Leading a high-performing and technically skilled team.
  • Access to world-class HVAC, BMS, and smart building technologies.
  • Strong support from national leadership and functional experts.
  • Career progression opportunities within a global organisation.
  • A culture that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • The opportunity to make a real impact on customers, people, and business performance.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years' experience within HVAC, BMS, building automation, mechanical services, facilities management, or related building services industries.
  • Technical qualifications in HVAC, Refrigeration, Building Automation, Electrical, Mechanical, or a related discipline.
  • Previous experience in Service Management, Operations Management, Project Delivery, or a similar leadership role.
  • We also welcome applications from experienced team leaders or supervisors ready to step into a broader management position.
  • Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience managing contracts, financial performance, and operational outcomes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project management tools.

Ready for Your Next Leadership Challenge?

If you're looking to join a market leader and take ownership of a growing service business while leading a talented team of industry professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion regarding this opportunity, please contact Janis Sotelo at [janis.sotelo@jci.com](mailto:janis.sotelo@jci.com), or submit your application today!

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, our dedication to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is embedded in our values and culture. We believe diverse perspectives drive innovation, strengthen collaboration, and help us better serve our customers and communities.

We foster a high-performance environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. Your voice matters, your ideas are welcomed, and your unique experiences help shape the future of our business, our customers, and our culture.

job.title: Intern, Communications (Jan - Jun 2027)
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across more than 270 cities in over 45 countries.

Job Description

As a Communications Intern at CapitaLand Development (CLD), you will gain hands-on experience telling the stories behind some of Asia’s most iconic real estate projects. You will support corporate communications, media engagement, digital content, website management and brand storytelling - all while working with teams across CLD’s business units and core markets of Singapore, China and Vietnam.

This internship will help you build a strong portfolio, sharpen your strategic thinking and develop practical communications, digital and web skills in a regional business environment.

What You Will Get to Do

  • Draft and edit materials such as media releases, factsheets, award submissions and social media posts
  • Support media outreach, ideate story angles and pitch stories to the media
  • Plan and create content for platforms such as LinkedIn and Instagram
  • Support photo and video production, including planning shoots, writing scripts and reviewing edits
  • Update CLD’s corporate website and create engaging digital content for different channels and audiences
  • Monitor website, media and social media performance, and assist with reporting
  • Collaborate with colleagues across CLD’s core markets, gaining exposure to different market and cultural contexts
  • Contribute ideas during team brainstorms, project meetings and cross-functional discussions

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong written and spoken English (a writing test is required)
  • A keen interest in storytelling, branding, digital content and trends
  • Familiarity with content creation and tools such as Canva, CapCut and/or Adobe Creative Suite
  • Confidence in creating and adapting content for websites, social media and other digital channels
  • Interest in content management systems, web publishing, digital analytics, search engine optimisation or basic HTML would be an advantage
  • A proactive, organised and detail-oriented independent learner
  • A collaborative team player with good coordination and time-management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Why Join Us?

Gain real-world corporate communications experience at one of Asia’s leading real estate companies. You will work on "live" projects, learn from experienced professionals and build a portfolio across digital channels.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short writing sample, such as a school assignment, blog post or article. You may also include examples of digital or social media content you have created.

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Job Description

Data Center Technician – Trainee Program

Location: Sydney, Australia

Anticipated Start Date (subject to change): November 2, 2026

At OCI, we design, build, deliver, and operate Oracle’s global cloud infrastructure. Our teams support the servers, storage, networking, power, cooling, and critical infrastructure that enable customers worldwide to run their most important workloads. We operate in a fast-paced environment where safety, operational excellence, innovation, and customer focus are at the center of everything we do.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is expanding rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technicians to join our Infrastructure Operations team through our Trainee Program. This structured 12 week onboarding and development program is designed to accelerate the growth of early-career technicians by combining hands-on operational experience, technical training, mentorship, and career development. The trainee program involves 2 weeks of classroom-based training plus 10 weeks of on-the-job training at our data centres. This is a paid 12 week trainee program and successful candidates will be considered for full time permanent opportunities at the conclusion of the program.

We are looking for candidates from all backgrounds to join our mission—whether you are a recent high school graduate, have experience in retail, hospitality, construction, sales, or any other field, we welcome you to apply!

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Qualifications

  • Ph.D., Master’s degree, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Statistics, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience with a Master’s degree, or 3+ years with a Ph.D., applying machine learning to real-world problems.
  • Strong Python programming skills and experience building production-quality ML, GenAI, or data systems.
  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch and modern deep-learning stacks; experience with Hugging Face, LLMs, VLMs, diffusion models, or multimodal models is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with data-centric AI or GenAI methods, such as synthetic-data generation, data-quality measurement, dataset curation, weak supervision, model-based labeling, active learning, deduplication, or data augmentation.
  • Experience designing experiments and interpreting results through statistical analysis, ablation studies, benchmark evaluation, and error analysis.
  • Strong understanding of model training, inference, evaluation, and production monitoring.
  • Ability to evaluate research papers, identify practical value, and implement useful techniques in real-world systems.
  • Experience building scalable data or ML pipelines using distributed compute, cloud storage, batch processing, or workflow orchestration.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing technical proposals, design documents, experiment reports, and stakeholder presentations.

Description

  • Design and build data-centric Generative AI methods for synthetic data generation, multimodal data curation, augmentation, filtering, deduplication, and data-quality assessment.
  • Develop and evaluate synthetic-data pipelines for text, speech, vision, and multimodal GenAI use cases, including controllable generation, provenance tracking, safety checks, and domain adaptation.
  • Build evaluation frameworks that connect data quality with downstream model performance through benchmark design, ablation studies, error analysis, and model-feedback loops.
  • Research, prototype, and implement modern generative AI techniques, including LLM/VLM-based data generation, fine-tuning, instruction tuning, preference optimization, and model-based data labeling.
  • Build scalable data and ML pipelines for data acquisition, cleaning, transformation, metadata extraction, embedding generation, labeling, training, and evaluation.
  • Develop production-quality code for batch and real-time ML workflows, including model inference, feature processing, data validation, monitoring, and operational automation.
  • Translate research papers and emerging GenAI techniques into practical systems that improve data quality, model performance, and customer-facing AI outcomes.
  • Partner with modeling, product, infrastructure, and domain teams to define data requirements, quality standards, evaluation criteria, and delivery plans.
  • Operate across the full development lifecycle, including research, prototyping, experimentation, productionization, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, runbooks, and production support.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of data-centric GenAI solutions and synthetic-data capabilities.
  • Define and maintain data-quality standards, evaluation metrics, and validation processes for GenAI datasets and models.
  • Conduct experiments, analyze results, and recommend data or modeling improvements based on measurable outcomes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prioritize use cases, align on technical requirements, and deliver scalable production solutions.

job.title: Applications Engineer II
job.description:
At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Aplications Engineer (Design) - APAC to join the Data, Power & Control - Starline Team in Tuas, Singapore (Remote). The Applications Engineer provides high-level engineering expertise, technical design and commercial support on the application of Starline high amperage busduct products to specific projects and customers. The Engineer has the task of overseeing the activities aimed at defining and consequently drafting the offers for the products. The role is also responsible for identifying and providing reliable solutions for all technical issues related to design and field install to assure complete customer satisfaction through all stages of the project. The role establishes and maintains strong relationships throughout the project life cycle.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

  • Maintain High-level expertise of product knowledge and application.
  • Complete System Layouts: design layouts of busduct systems based on site
  • Audit & Surveys, Customer drawings, Project tenders and Field input.
  • Utilize AutoDesk Suite to assess understand customer requirements
  • Experienced in 3D design such as AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor & BIM360
  • Create product technical system layouts from engineered drawings (catalog sheets, FAQ’s, Tech Briefs, Reports, instructions, etc.)
  • Provide technical and commercial support to sales and to customers onsite or remotely as required on topics including but not limited to product estimation, RFQ support, ratings, compliance with local regulations and Standards, safety, functionality, Product hands on training, customization, troubleshooting and pricing.
  • Attend customer facing meetings which may include providing customer presentations for product solutions and project updates.
  • Drafting offers related to bus duct products, verifies the technical aspects of the application (based on the technical needs expressed by the customer, drawings of the installation layout.)
  • Verifying the technical characteristics (operating temperature, power, installation, material, quantity, etc.)
  • Supports the management of the customer’s project through the entire project life cycle
  • Work with internal departments such as Purchasing, R&D, Test, Product Engineering, 3rd party assembly providers, for assembly designs, resolve customer & Field technical design issues.

Additional Duties

  • Onsite troubleshooting and rework.
  • Technical liaison to the sales team
  • Training on busduct products and design tools to Sales network
  • Provides Service Group through helping to project manage installations.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Aptitude for electrical product design and application in power distribution and busduct products.
  • Experienced user of AutoDESK programs – AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor
  • Experience using BIM360
  • Familiarity with the IEC standards and various IEC certifications
  • Persuasive and articulate, with an ability to communicate and influence people at all levels, verbally, in writing and by presentation.
  • Stable, loyal and reliable, with a customer focused personality.
  • Self-reliant, flexible and resourceful.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering field.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.
  • Familiar with project management tools such as Prince2
  • Proficient in technical writing and communication.
  • Prior experience with Busduct products is preferred
  • Ability to travel up to 15% on a regular basis and 20% occasionally, mainly in APAC, other locations as required.

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • The performance of this position may occasionally require exposure to the manufacturing and construction areas where, under certain areas, the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses and mandatory hearing protection are required. Also exposed to certain high working areas like high ceiling or floor level.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods of time
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 23kg occasionally

Note: The above Job Description is representative of the responsibilities and qualifications necessary to be successful in this role. It does not encompass every job duty or responsibility; other tasks may be assigned as necessary. Further the job

description does not alter the at-will nature of employment with Legrand and does not create a contract of employment.

job.description:
What will you do:

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality service, maintenance, commissioning, and technical support for chiller systems in mission‑critical data center environments. You will:

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control‑related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start‑up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Lead site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all serviced equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer data center protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely execution of service tasks.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis activities and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Coordinate with internal teams—including sales, project management, and engineering—to ensure seamless project and service delivery.
  • Ensure timely submission of RCA and 8D reports to customers.
  • Attend Monthly MOR and Quarterly QBR review meetings with data center customers.

What you will bring: (Skills & Competencies):

  • Deep technical expertise in Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers, preferably within mission‑critical data center environments.
  • Strong understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  • Ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using advanced tools and diagnostic software.
  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC systems.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, equipment manuals, wiring diagrams, and P&IDs.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work confidently in critical environments.
  • Familiarity with industry safety standards and best practices.
  • Strong problem‑solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Experience with mission‑critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM‑specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
  • Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is an added advantage.

Qualification:

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5–10 years of direct experience servicing chillers, preferably in data centers.
  • Strong analytical abilities and a structured approach to problem solving and documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate with internal teams and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Willingness to travel as per project and service requirements.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer - D365 CE, Bangalore
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a Lead Software Engineer – D365 CE to lead the technical delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) solutions. This role combines technical leadership, solution architecture, and team management, ensuring enterprise-scale CRM/ERP implementations align with business requirements, best practices, and performance standards. This role will serve as a technical authority, driving architectural decisions, developing complex solutions, and collaborating cross-functionally with product, integration, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, solution architecture, and other development teams to ensure high-quality solutions and applications.

The ideal candidate will drive implementation strategies, contribute to reusable CE templates, and ensure seamless deployments with optimized performance. They will also mentor consultants and guide teams toward delivery excellence.

What You Will Do

This role will lead the end‑to‑end design, development, and delivery of scalable enterprise solutions across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement and Finance & Operations. Responsibilities span multiple apps in CE, including Sales, Marketing, Customer services & Field services. The Solution Architect will be accountable for designing, building, and implementing complex solutions that integrate seamlessly across these Dynamics 365 applications like D365 F&O, ensuring scalability, performance, and business value.

Key responsibilities include:

Enterprise Architecture Leadership

  • Architect and implement Dynamics 365 CE modules (Sales, Customer Service, Marketing & Field Services).
  • Lead technical delivery of CE implementations, upgrades, integrations, and customizations.
  • Architect robust, scalable, and secure technical solutions using Agile methods, aligned with business requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with functional leads, project managers, and external partners to ensure technical strategy supports business goals.

Development & Customization

  • Drive design, configuration, and customization of mobile apps, CRM workflows, plug‑ins, forms, and dashboards.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Working Knowledge:

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation. Level Extensive Experience:

Preferred exposure to Leapwork, Azure App Testing, Playwright, with accepted proficiency in JMeter, Ranorex, Selenium, or equivalent platforms to ensure quality and reliability of Sales and Field Service customizations.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of database technologies, including Postgres, SQL, and NoSQL, with proven ability to design, optimize, and troubleshoot data solutions.
  • Strong experience with data access technologies (JPA/Hibernate/JDBC)
  • Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit) and building high-quality, testable software
  • Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, tagging), Maven or equivalent build tools, and strong debugging skills
  • Experience leading or contributing to POCs, innovation initiatives, or modernization programs
  • Strong experience working with cross-functional and global teams, influencing without direct authority
  • Excellent technical communication, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement skills
  • ​Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and working with DevOps/CI-CD pipelines
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes for orchestration of containerized applications
  • Experience working with software systems in autonomous vehicles, mining, construction, or similar industrial domains
  • Understanding of onboard (machine) and offboard (cloud/office) system architectures and their integration in distributed autonomy platforms
  • Familiarity with communication protocols and networking concepts used in distributed systems (e.g., TCP/IP, messaging systems, telemetry pipelines)
  • Experience designing or integrating systems involving machine-to-cloud or edge-to-cloud communication

Posting Dates:

September 16, 2026 - September 29, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Sales Advisor
job.description:
Job Description

The Sales Associate/Brand Associate is responsible for achieving sales, delivering service and operations excellence. He/she also engages in innovation and productivity initiatives for the store. In order to drive seamless customer experience across channels, he handles order fulfilment processes for customers in store.

He operates in a fast-paced, diverse and customer-centric store environment. As the first point-of-contact in store, he serves as the ambassador of the organisation.

He is a highly motivated and service-oriented individual. He communicates well and thrives in a team environment.

Qualifications

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

job.title: Senior Solutions Architect (Network and 5G)
job.description:
Job Description

  • Partner with large deal pursue team and Account Teams to shape account strategies and build pipeline through a consultative selling approach, supporting strategic pursuits and new customer acquisition.
  • Lead customer discovery and architecture workshops; translate business, technical, operational and service requirements into end-to-end network architectures, defined scope, assumptions and measurable outcomes.
  • Act as the design authority for complex solutions covering campus and data centre networking, wired and wireless networks, routing and switching, WAN/SD-WAN, application delivery and managed network services.
  • Architect telco connectivity solutions across internet, DIA, MPLS/IP VPN, Ethernet and local or international connectivity, addressing bandwidth, latency, QoS, carrier and access diversity, last-mile resilience, failover and SLA requirements.
  • Apply network security by design, including segmentation, NGFW/firewall, IPS/IDS, NAC, secure remote access, SASE/ZTNA, DDoS protection, secure management and traffic visibility.
  • Evaluate architecture options and technology choices based on performance, availability, scalability, interoperability, operational supportability, commercial viability and risk, while maintaining vendor-neutral judgement.
  • Own the technical solution package, including reference architecture, high-level design, bill of materials, compliance responses, statement of work, assumptions, dependencies, risks, customer presentations and proof-of-concept approach.
  • Lead technical workstreams for complex bids and architecture reviews, coordinating specialists, product teams, delivery, operations and technology partners to ensure the solution is complete, deliverable and aligned with customer outcomes.
  • Provide technical input to pricing, licensing and total-cost-of-ownership considerations, and ensure alignment among the architecture, service model, implementation schedule, SLA and contractual commitments.
  • Lead the transition from presales to delivery and provide architecture assurance during implementation, reviewing major design changes and governing deviations from the approved solution.
  • Coach and mentor network presales consultants and engineers through discovery, design and proposal reviews, opportunity support and structured knowledge sharing.
  • Lead internal initiatives to develop reusable network offerings, reference architectures, design standards, playbooks and enablement materials, and monitor relevant market and technology developments. *

Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, with at least 12 years of relevant ICT experience and substantial experience in network presales, solution architecture or technical consulting.
  • Demonstrated experience acting as the technical authority for complex, multi-site and multi-technology network solutions, including leadership of strategic bids and cross-functional solution teams.
  • Strong architectural knowledge of campus and data centre networking, wired and wireless networks, routing and switching, WAN/SD-WAN, application delivery, network automation, network observability and managed network services.
  • Have experience in telco connectivity design, including internet/DIA, MPLS/IP VPN, Ethernet, local and international connectivity, access selection, carrier diversity, bandwidth and QoS planning, latency, resilience and SLA considerations.
  • Strong understanding of network security architecture, including segmentation, NGFW, IPS/IDS, NAC, secure remote access, SASE/ZTNA, DDoS protection and secure network management.
  • Ability to define and evaluate non-functional requirements covering availability, resilience, scalability, performance, interoperability, operability, observability and supportability.
  • Sound solutioning knowledge of major networking platforms such as Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, F5 and Arista, or equivalent technologies; depth in selected platforms and vendor-neutral judgement are expected.
  • Strong capability in high-level design, proposal development, bill-of-materials building and validation, statement-of-work definition, risk and dependency management, proof-of-concept planning and commercial solutioning.
  • Proven ability to coach and develop technical professionals, lead initiatives without relying solely on formal authority, and influence senior business and technical stakeholders.
  • Relevant professional certification such as CCIE, HCIE, Aruba ACE, PCNSE or equivalent is preferred.
  • Exposure to private 5G and 5G integration with enterprise networks is an added advantage.
  • Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic pursuits in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Elanora
job.description:
Brisbane, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual Retail Service Consultant to join our Elanora team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You’re confident in navigating difficult enquiries, ease tricky situations with empathy and respect, and work toward the best solution for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support one another, stay accountable, and create a customer‑first environment where everyone succeeds.

What’s in it for you?

  • $35 p/h + super + applicable loadings.
  • Phenomenal perks, including 25% off Optus products and exclusive access to unique discounts with our retail partners.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.
  • Flexible rosters that work around the life you live outside of work.

Intrigued, but not sure you tick every box? That’s completely okay! We still encourage you to apply. We all grow, learn and develop together, and this role might be the perfect next step in your career journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: ILHBS Screener
job.description:
Baggage Screening and Threat Detection:

Attend all the regulatory trainings and clear trainings as per the regulatory attempts

Operate X-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.

Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X-ray screening.

Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.

Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:

Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.

Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.

Equipment Maintenance and Pre-Operational Checks:

Conduct routine pre-operational checks of X-BIS, ETD, CT-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.

Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.

Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:

Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.

Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.

Time Management and Efficiency:

Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.

Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.

Workplace Conduct and Decorum:

Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.

Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

CSO

Lead Avsec Audit & Compliance

Pass Section

Lead - ILHBS/ Duty Manager - ILHBS/ Sr Screener

Terminal Operations

IT

HR Department

Compliance and Regulatory Teams

Other Airport Departments (e.g., Operations, Customer Service)

Key Stakeholders - External:

Transportation Security Administration (TSA)

Aircraft Operator

Airport Authorities

Passengers

ASG

BCAS

Local Police

Service Providers

Law Enforcement Agencies

Regulatory Bodies

Industry Associations

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center

NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred

Work Experience:

Freshers or 1-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.

Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.

Physical Qualification:

Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /

lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses

or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.

Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for

frequencies below 2000 Hz.

Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.

Movement-of-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any

pronounced speed impediment.

Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor

Deportment & Appearance - Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,

deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

job.title: Lead - Technical Services Lead
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Partner with Head-Ahmedabad in understanding the organization’s requirement for Hard services across all facilities (including MEP maintenance services, Inventory management for all supplies and tools, Infrastructure management and maintenance, and space management)
  • Develop the budget for Hard Services in consultation with Head-Ahmedabad;
  • Ensure adherence to pre-defined budgetary and cost optimization guidelines
  • Define a service delivery framework and service delivery plan for hard services basis the requirements for every facility/property under purview
  • Define and communicate operating procedure/ guidelines for hard services in accordance with the overall policy guidelines; Update the operating procedures from time to time keeping in consideration the changing business dynamics and requirements
  • Conduct Need assessment of MEP services from future operational perspective
  • Develop a Business Continuity plan from an Admin perspective to ensure smooth operations across locations
  • Develop & ensure implementation of SOPs, Engineering Guidelines for Electro- mechanical services, and operation control procedures for smooth operations
  • Prepare, analyse & improve SoWs for AMCs for maximum benefit realisation
  • Assess, identify, and plan the Life Cycle Completion, replacement of the Electro-mechanical equipment
  • Plan a calendar and ensure all MEP activities and structural upgradations are carried out for all facilities (heating/cooling systems, plumbing and water management, lightings, scientific tank cleaning, façade cleaning, painting etc.) with minimal/ zero downtime/ service disruption
  • Conduct service inspection and create a sustenance plan for pre-emptive and reactive maintenance to minimize downtime at Sites
  • Track and ensure timely renewal & submission of all mandatory compliances, licenses and health, safety, and statutory environmental requirements
  • Run and oversee complete snag management cycle for acquired property / infrastructure; Ensure closure of critical snags pertaining to MEP services.
  • Ensure monitoring of PPM calendar with adherence to all safety protocols
  • Management of readable Blue-prints, Schematics and diagrams of the equipment’s
  • Analyse and record all test results and prepare analysis documentation statement
  • Oversee all mechanical services including HVAC systems, elevators, escalators, Mechanized Systems- BMU, Façade Cradle systems, Dumb waiters, waste disposal systems, Lift well and Stairwell pressurization system, Basement Ventilation & Exhaust System, etc.
  • Oversee all electrical & instrumentation services including lighting, load Management & distribution systems, UPS, elevators, earthing and grounding systems
  • Oversee all plumbing services including domestic water system, Softener System, RO system, hot & cold-water system, flushing water system, sewage water system, storage tanks, rainwater harvesting system, Water bodies etc.
  • Design a plan for mechanical services basis the requirement for the property and work closely with engineering team for proper and timely support
  • Devise an annual maintenance calendar for inspection of all services and create a plan for preventive and reactive maintenance for mechanical services to minimize downtime
  • Develop a robust breakdown maintenance plan for all core mechanical services; Manage proper placement of signage pertaining to demarcation of safety lines around electromechanical area
  • Create a training calendar to ensure resources are updated with the technical know-how, market best practices and industry standards
  • Manage day to day operations (including routine maintenance operations, IBMS Rooms and related services and preventive controls) of all mechanical services at respective facility, site or guest house and address critical incidents if any while reporting any near misses
  • Review mechanical services’ performance at regular intervals; Conduct audits and root cause analysis of identified issues and ensure timely resolution of all problems with optimal utilization of all resources to increase site effectiveness.
  • Lead the conceptualization, design development and planning of new building and infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with Architect, Interior Design, MEP Consultants to finalize the design and execute strategy.
  • Review and validate design proposals, layout plans and construction drawings.
  • Execution and monitoring of Projects.
  • Monitor appropriate and timely resolution of hard services’ queries/ grievance redressal at the Helpdesk; Address escalations if any and provide guidance to teams to effectively resolve all queries
  • Analyse the service performance and employee satisfaction levels (through formal / informal feedback) and pilot strategic initiatives to drive process improvements to improve employee satisfaction
  • Maintain close coordination with other departmental services viz. Fire, Security, Telecom, IT and extend support as required
  • Manage communication pertaining to planned maintenance activities
  • Adhere to the Admin Governance framework and ensure all hard service processes are in compliance with the same
  • Analyse audit findings with regards to hard service operations and collaborate with the concerned stakeholders to develop effective action plans for mitigating risks/ gaps identified
  • Ensure timely submission & verification of service partner bills as well as timely pay-out as per agreed SLAs (for all facility services)
  • Conduct operational reviews from time to time and ensure smooth service delivery and adherence to defined SLAs for hard services
  • Identify and build partnerships and relationships with external vendors, government officials to ensure all necessary permits are in place
  • Successfully leverage these networks for value creation for Adani; Oversee partner offerings and lead negotiations with them for all hard services
  • Provide insights on service partner performance and address/ resolve any escalations
  • Identify areas within Hard services which could be automated/ integrated with technology and collaborate with the relevant stakeholders to plan and deploy these initiatives
  • Ensure smooth functioning of the tools for Hard services’ delivery; Track customer satisfaction levels
  • Assets’ database to be maintained basis tagging of assets and verified on a bi-annual basis
  • Coordinate with third party for timely availability of contractual manpower, manage them through shift planning and manage daily roster for all services; Ensure staff is working in line with the agreed SLA
  • Drive a performance driven culture – Set goals, review performance and provide feedback to ensure a motivated and committed team
  • Foster an environment of learning and excellence within the team

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering (Preferred: MBA (Operations/Facilities Management) / PGDM in Facilities Management)
  • 8-12 years of experience in Facility Management, Corporate Administration, Workplace Services, Hospitality, Real Estate Operations, or IFM.
  • Min 5+ years in Technical Services, Facility Engineering, Building Operations, or IFM.
  • Experience managing corporate campuses, commercial buildings, data centers, industrial facilities, or mixed-use developments.
  • Hands-on exposure to MEP operations and critical infrastructure management.
  • Exposure in facility digitization and CAFM implementation.
  • Experience handling senior leadership and executive workplace environments

job.title: Factory Medical Officer
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the on-site medical center, ensuring it is equipped and staffed to handle emergencies and routine health issues effectively.
  • Develop and implement health and wellness programs aimed at improving employee well-being and reducing absenteeism.
  • Conduct regular health check-ups and maintain accurate medical records for all employees and contractors.
  • Provide immediate medical care and first aid in case of workplace injuries or emergencies, ensuring compliance with safety protocols.
  • Collaborate with the Site HR Head to design and execute health awareness campaigns, focusing on occupational health risks specific to thermal power plant operations.
  • Ensure the medical center complies with all internal standards and aligns with Adani Power’s focus on operational excellence and sustainability.
  • Train and guide first responders and safety teams on emergency medical procedures and protocols.
  • Monitor and manage health-related KPIs, such as incident response times and employee health indices, to support the site’s operational goals.
  • Liaise with external medical facilities and specialists to ensure advanced care when required.
  • Stay updated on the latest medical practices and technologies relevant to industrial health services

Qualifications

  • MBBS degree from a recognized medical institution.
  • AFIH - Associate Fellow of Industrial Health (Mandatory)
  • Additional certification in Occupational Health or Industrial Medicine is preferred.

job.title: Head - Training Delivery - Ports & Logistics (Other than Gujarat Cluster)
job.description:
Responsibilities

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

  • Own the training delivery strategy, annual training calendar, governance framework, and capability roadmap for ports and logistics operations across assigned regions.
  • Lead the delivery of technical, operational, safety, compliance, supervisory, and leadership training programs for frontline workforce, technicians, operators, supervisors, and management personnel.
  • Drive capability development across cargo handling, terminal operations, marine activities, warehousing, logistics, equipment operation, maintenance, and operational excellence domains.
  • Establish competency frameworks, certification pathways, training standards, assessment systems, and refresher training mechanisms for all critical roles.
  • Manage training centers, simulators, laboratories, practical learning infrastructure, and deployment resources across locations.
  • Build, mentor, and manage a cadre of internal trainers, SMEs, external faculty, and partner agencies to ensure training quality and scalability.
  • Partner closely with Business Heads, Operations Leaders, HR, Safety, Maintenance, and Functional Excellence teams to align capability-building initiatives with business priorities.
  • Ensure training effectiveness through assessments, workplace observations, operational KPIs, certification compliance, and post-training performance tracking.
  • Lead deployment planning, trainer allocation, budget utilization, training audits, governance reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
  • Drive standardization of content, delivery methodology, competency assessments, and reporting systems across all assigned locations.
  • Identify future capability requirements emerging from automation, digitalization, new equipment deployment, and business expansion projects.
  • Represent Adani Skills & Education in capability-building discussions with OEMs, industry bodies, technology partners, regulators, and external institutions.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing large-scale workforce capability-building, technical training, competency development, or learning operations.
  • Strong exposure to cargo handling systems, port operations, terminal processes, safety management, workforce productivity, and operational excellence practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing multi-location training delivery, large trainer pools, certification systems, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience in competency mapping, capability frameworks, training governance, assessment architecture, and performance measurement.
  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, program management, communication, and execution capabilities.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across assigned port locations outside Gujarat.

job.title: Lead - Shantigram Cluster
job.description:
