  • Ensure all admin services comply with internal standards & compliance, legal regulations, and organizational policies. Oversee audits and ensure continuous compliance to support an efficient workplace.

  • Higher degree in relevant field is preferable

Experiences:

  • Rich experience of formulating strategies and conceptualizing service management frameworks
  • Experience of working on technology and digitalization projects.
  • Strong understanding of financial and cost optimization principles
  • Experience of running F&B production and operations for a large facility with exposure to housekeeping services
  • Sound knowledge of planned preventative maintenance, response maintenance and forward maintenance planning
  • Strong experience of space management and space occupancy plan designing
  • Robust experience of drafting and implementing policies at corporate level; Experience managing operational budgets with exceptional planning and project management skills
  • Rich experience of service partners management; Experience of dealing with contractual workforce employed for service delivery
  • Demonstrates a good working knowledge of buildings services installations including HVAC / Electrical and other technical systems

Experience of Quality Management would be preferred.

job.title: Screener - ILHBS
job.description:
Baggage Screening and Threat Detection:

Attend all the regulatory trainings and clear trainings as per the regulatory attempts

Operate X-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.

Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X-ray screening.

Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.

Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:

Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.

Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.

Equipment Maintenance and Pre-Operational Checks:

Conduct routine pre-operational checks of X-BIS, ETD, CT-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.

Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.

Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:

Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.

Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.

Time Management and Efficiency:

Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.

Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.

Workplace Conduct and Decorum:

Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.

Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

CSO

Lead Avsec Audit & Compliance

Pass Section

Lead - ILHBS/ Duty Manager - ILHBS/ Sr Screener

Terminal Operations

IT

HR Department

Compliance and Regulatory Teams

Other Airport Departments (e.g., Operations, Customer Service)

Key Stakeholders - External:

Transportation Security Administration (TSA)

Aircraft Operator

Airport Authorities

Passengers

ASG

BCAS

Local Police

Service Providers

Law Enforcement Agencies

Regulatory Bodies

Industry Associations

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center

NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred

Work Experience:

Freshers or 1-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.

Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.

Physical Qualification:

Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /

lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses

or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.

Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for

frequencies below 2000 Hz.

Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.

Movement-of-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any

pronounced speed impediment.

Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor

Deportment & Appearance - Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,

deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

job.title: Data Loss Prevention Lead
job.description:
Strategic Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Manage a comprehensive DLP program, including data discovery, classification, and protection policies.
  • Conduct DLP and DSPM assessments to identify, mitigate, and report data protection risks.
  • Ensure compliance with data protection regulations across multiple geographies.
  • Collaborate with legal teams to review contracts and MSAs for DLP compliance.
  • Oversee deployment and tuning of disk encryption technologies (e.g., BitLocker).
  • Understanding of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and evaluate vendor risks from a DLP perspective.
  • Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) reviews to ensure DLP/DAM/DSPM considerations are integrated.
  • Manage and respond to data breaches and DLP incidents.
  • Stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.

People Management

  • Foster an environment of learning, excellence, and innovation within the team and across teams.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members.
  • Conduct performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Ensure continuous professional development of team members.

Qualifications

Educational qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field.
  • 10–12 years of experience in data loss prevention, data discovery/classification, and database/data security.
  • Experience with DSPM tools and integration in hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and NIST.
  • Experience with DLP, DSPM, disk encryption tools and automation.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or OSCP are a plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.

job.description:

  • Aids in the technical analysis process by collecting data to determine specifications for new projects.

job.title: Wind BOP
job.description:
Operational Support and Performance Monitoring:

Monitor the performance of solar systems, ensuring that energy production targets are being met and all equipment is functioning efficiently. Assist in the analysis of operational metrics such as Performance Ratio (PR), Capacity Utilization Factor (CUF), Plant Availability (PA), and Grid Availability (GA). Collect performance data and identify potential areas for improvement, reporting findings to senior team members.

Safety and Compliance Support:

Adhere to safety protocols and ensure safe working conditions by following operational and safety guidelines. Participate in safety training sessions, toolbox talks, and safety audits to ensure compliance with safety regulations. Help maintain safety documentation and ensure timely submission of reports, including Joint Meter Readings (JMR) and other regulatory compliance reports.

Operational Procedure and Policy Support:

Follow established procedures and assist in recommending improvements for operational efficiency. Support the implementation of operational policies by providing feedback on procedures and identifying inefficiencies. Assist in collecting and analyzing feedback to suggest improvements in processes and procedures for better operational outcomes.

Team Collaboration:

Work closely with operations, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure smooth and efficient operations. Assist in supporting cross-functional team efforts to improve system performance and resolve operational challenges. Provide support to senior team members in troubleshooting, data collection, and problem-solving.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation Support:

Participate in continuous improvement activities by suggesting minor process enhancements and providing input on operational best practices. Assist in the testing and adoption of new technologies or tools aimed at enhancing wind energy production or operational efficiency. Collect data and provide insights that contribute to optimizing solar operations and improving system reliability.

Documentation and Reporting:

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of performance data, maintenance activities, and safety compliance. Prepare reports on system performance, operational issues, and maintenance logs as required by the operations team. Assist in compiling data for senior management presentations, providing feedback on system performance and areas for improvement.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Regional Head / Station Head

Central Cluster Head

Head - Operation

HO & Site O&M team

Supporting department - Project, Engineering, Safety, BD, Projects, MAAS, HSE, ESG, Techno-commerical, HR, Admin, Finance, BEx, Land, Legal, Insurance, etc.

Clients

Investors

Other IPP

Regulatory Agencies

Local Communities

Vendors/Suppliers/Contractors/OEMs

Grid Authoritirs-NRLDC/SLDC

Govt. officials

Local communities

B.E./B.Tech/Diploma - Electrical or Mechanical or relevant to Energy Sector

1-5 years of experience in Energy Sector is must.( If Diploma holder: additional 2-3 Y Exp. req.)

job.title: Lead- Transport Services
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Design and implement a Group-wide transportation strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Lead national planning, route optimization, and long-term capacity design to enhance service and ROI.
  • Establish a strong governance framework to ensure consistency, transparency, and accountability across transportation operations.
  • Provide regular assurance to leadership on spend control, vendor compliance, and performance standards.
  • Drive internal audits, compliance checks, and corrective actions where required.
  • Ensure compliance to respective processes w.r.t. governance protocols
  • Drive the standardization of Transport services across group.
  • Lead the deployment of a centralized Transportation Management System (TMS) and digitization initiatives.
  • Ensure all 3000+ vehicles are integrated under a unified Central Command Center for real-time monitoring, analytics, and decision-making.
  • Make recommendations to the concerned teams to add features and upgrade the transport portal to enhance user experience & signoff key features and functionalities of the portal and other tools as applicable
  • Define and enforce standard operating procedures for vehicle sourcing, vendor engagement, billing, and documentation.
  • Institutionalize process rigor across all locations and business units.
  • Update the SOP’s from time to time keeping in consideration the business dynamics and user requirements
  • Partner with techno-commercial and BU teams to analyze spend trends & rate structures.
  • Monitor transport resource utilization and optimize allocation across BUs to reduce idle time and inefficiencies.
  • Drive cost-saving initiatives without compromising service or compliance.
  • Build a pan-India network of reliable transport partners.
  • Oversee vendor performance, SLA compliance, and periodic re-evaluations to ensure continuity and quality of service.
  • Conduct Quarterly reviews with service partners, ensuring SLA and performance levels are achieved
  • Manage and optimize the Group’s 400 Cr plus transportation budget.
  • Provide strategic inputs on budget planning, variance analysis, and cost rationalization.
  • Ensure full adherence to national and state-level transport regulations and safety mandates.
  • Lead risk identification and develop mitigation frameworks, including business continuity planning.
  • Act as the Group’s transport strategy lead, aligning with BU heads and senior stakeholders to drive operational efficiency, compliance, and cost visibility.
  • Build and lead a high-performing national transport team, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop strong internal working relationships with all departments
  • Prepare FAQs and monitor timely resolution of queries raised at the Traveller Helpdesk; Address escalations if any and provide guidance to teams to effectively resolve all queries/ grievances
  • Analyse service performance and traveller satisfaction levels (through formal / informal feedback) and pilot strategic initiatives to drive process improvements.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in Transport Operations, Fleet Management, Logistics, Mobility Services, Corporate Administration.

Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing enterprise-wide travel operations.

job.title: BD and M&A (Roads)
job.description:

  • Identify potential business opportunities withi the sector and create a robust pipeline of prospective projects and clients.

  • Ensure adherence to all company policies, procedures, and business ethics codes.

  • Prepare and periodically update comprehensive databases to keep the BD team and management well-informed.
  • Shortlist upcoming projects, tender/auction timelines, and production phasing, and perform SWOT analysis of existing business operations.

Financial and Technical Liaison:

  • Communicate queries and project requirements to auditors or consultants.
  • Engage with consultants to form the requirements of bids and coordinate with internal departments to gather necessary information.
  • Facilitate effective communication between internal teams, including finance, technical, and legal departments, to ensure project alignment and readiness.

Technology and IT Enablement:

  • Utilize MS Office proficiently for data analysis, report preparation, and presentation development.

job.title: Lead F&B
job.description:
Customer Experience Management:

Ensure the smooth and efficient operation of all Food & Beverage outlets, driving high levels of customer satisfaction and seamless service delivery.

Effectively manage client grievances through a structured and empathetic approach to ensure timely resolution and client satisfaction.

Provide excellent customer service by ensuring a welcoming environment by maintaining cleanliness and orderliness in the dining areas.

F&B Outlet Operations:

Assist in daily operations of F&B outlets, ensuring smooth service flow and compliance with brand standards.

Ensure the smooth and efficient operation of all Food & Beverage outlets, driving high levels of customer satisfaction and seamless service delivery.

Stay updated and maintain a thorough understanding of the lounge's F&B offerings, including menus, beverages, and special dietary requirements, to effectively answer guest inquiries.

Continuously assess and improve operational processes, from check-in to service delivery, to enhance efficiency, reduce wait times, and improve guest satisfaction.

Manage lounge capacity effectively during peak and off-peak hours, ensuring optimal use of space and resources while maintaining high service levels.

Ensure Food Safety and Hygiene:

Ensure implementation and maintenance of strict food safety and hygiene protocols to safeguard food quality and prevent contamination.

Conduct regular kitchen audits to ensure compliance with health, safety, and operational standards across all F&B outlets.

Regulatory and EPOS Compliance:

Ensure that all F&B concessionaires strictly follow their respective Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain consistency and quality.

Campaign Management:

Oversee and ensure the smooth implementation of all promotional activities and activations at all F&B outlets, maximizing their impact on customer experience and sales.

Performance Reporting:

Help use the data to find ways to make the lounge experience better and more efficient.

job.title: Team Member -AOCC
job.description:

Monitor terminal operations to detect congestion or unusual incidents and coordinate corrective actions with terminal operations, security, and other relevant teams.

Ensure seamless baggage delivery operations by monitoring processes and resolving delays.

Supervise Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS) and Gate Operating System (GOS) to ensure parking stands are allocated before flight arrival and maintain on-time block and off-block operations.

Coordinate with the Landing Parking Cell and non-scheduled operators to facilitate departure clearances according to flight plans.

job.title: Site Head - Tara (Revised)
job.description:
Site Head - Coal Mining

Mine Operations & Production Management:

Oversee daily mining operations, ensuring production targets are met while maintaining safety, environmental, and regulatory compliance.

Supervise drilling, blasting, excavation, and transportation activities to optimize efficiency and minimize downtime.

Implement cost-effective measures to enhance operational performance and stay within allocated budgets.

Monitor and evaluate mining equipment performance, ensuring timely maintenance and repairs to prevent delays.

Develop and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to streamline mining processes.

Pre-Construction Planning & Regulatory Compliance:

Lead pre-construction activities, ensuring all statutory clearances, including environmental and forest approvals, are obtained.

Liaise with regulatory bodies such as DGMS, Pollution Control Board, and State Mining Offices to secure necessary permits.

Manage land acquisition challenges and ensure smooth transition processes for mining operations.

Develop and implement a comprehensive Safety Management Plan in compliance with DGMS norms, MMDR Act, and environmental laws.

Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and training programs to ensure a zero-accident workplace.

Resource Allocation & Cost Management:

Strategically deploy personnel and equipment to maximize efficiency and achieve production goals.

job.title: Business Head - Lounges & Hotels
job.description:

Talent & Culture

  • To create a high-performance culture by ensuring that business and individual objectives are set, understood and cascaded appropriately.
  • To establish an excellent internal communication system through regular and transparent communication as well as cross-functional collaboration to maximize synergies.
  • To lead, inspire, develop and engage a talented workforce that supports the strategic and future needs of the business and drives for efficiency and improves effectiveness

Operational

  • Develops effective best practice work and business procedures for Adani Group
  • Collaborates with executive leadership to define the organization's long-term mission and goals, identifying ways to support this mission through talent management.
  • Identifies and executes key performance indicators for the organization on commercial, operations, finance, human resource, etc. to ensure relevant KPIs are executed and reviewed on a quarterly basis.
  • Understanding of operational departments [Guest Services, Facilities Management, Housekeeping, Culinary, Food & Beverage, Customer Engagement, Quality Assurance, etc.] and work with country and local leadership to ensure it is functioning in line with the standards set by partners and HQ.
  • Ensures corporate policies and procedures are being utilized and recommends improvements.
  • Drives the overall business using technology to improve efficiency and achieve maximum operational efficiencies including but not limited to automation and optimization.
  • Leads the City or Country in the event of a Crisis working closely with HQ.
  • Actively participates in addressing internal and external audit findings by working with relevant stakeholders and taking necessary corrective action promptly.
  • Lead the Executive Committee [ExCom] and hold meetings at least once a month by focusing on the company’s overall priorities and goals from a City and Country level.
  • ExCom must define specific strategic plans and actions that will be undertaken to drive and increase revenue, profit, productivity, market share, staff development, technology and attach them to measurable KPIs. The minutes of ExCom meetings will be shared between the leadership Steering Committee members.

Revenue, Growth and Profit Maximization

  • Sets comprehensive goals for department performance and growth
  • Liaises with Commercial Leadership to develop and execute commercial strategies in each location.
  • Directly accountable for driving the budget and forecast by implementing a commercial strategy and business plan through execution, utilizing all available business tools and intelligence.
  • Ensures the delivery of budgeted revenues across all revenue streams.
  • Utilizes Business Intelligence tools to analyze data and performance, providing actionable information for making informed business decisions.
  • Optimizes manpower costs by analyzing trends and costs, setting systemic standards for teams to follow, and tracking the results of planned efforts.
  • Prepares the annual business plan and budgets including but not limited to manpower, etc.
  • Works with the various airport General Managers, Assistant General Managers, Finance PIC, Human Resources PIC including Operations PIC to ensure profits are maximized in line with budgeted revenue and profit targets set.
  • Ensures regular business reviews are conducted with all relevant stakeholders, including pricing and rate strategies are in place to achieve positive business results.

Pre – Opening

  • Drives collaboration across all departments and stakeholders to ensure pre-opening, refurbishment, or delisting projects are opened or closed within the set time frame.
  • Communicate with the Project Team and Project Manager for the project completion timeline.
  • Review the Pre-Opening critical path to schedule key project milestones, work streams, and activities.
  • Manage and approve resources requirements for pre-opening as needed.
  • Communicate and liaise with leadership to define project priorities and implementation opportunities and challenges and keep them up to date with project risks and opportunities.
  • Ensure company standards are reflected in the projects in terms of Marketing, Branding, IT, F&B, HR requirements/standards.

Financial and Commercial Acumen

  • Supports the country finance teams with clear guidelines, responsibilities and ways of working that benefit the Corporate, Shared Services and Country-Level Finance team
  • Reviews, monitors and analyses financial performance in collaboration with the Country Finance against established goals and benchmarks by managing relevant revenue workstreams including driving cost efficiency and savings without impacting customer or brand experience.
  • Supports the collection of accounts receivable by collaborating with respective Country Finance and Commercial teams, including HQ and other stakeholders.
  • Conducts necessary monthly meetings covering commercial and revenue management strategies, credit collection, operational, strategic planning and execution, etc.
  • Manages underperforming or loss-making outlets, developing short-to-long action plans for each business unit to restore profitability.

Business Development

  • Represents the business units in presentations to the Investment Committee, Steering Committee, and other relevant entities as necessary.
  • Forges strategic partnerships and relationships with clients, vendors, agencies, venue partners, and all other professional business relationships.
  • Be a key stakeholder collaborating with the legal team on contract management, including but not limited to contributing to the development of effective and efficient contract terms and conditions.
  • Growth Management aggressively promotes the business unit maximizing its utilization and negotiating lease agreements as determined necessary and in the best interest of the company.
  • Conducts frequent sales and calls with clients to stay updated on the business status and trends.
  • Develops and maintains strong relationships with all internal and external stakeholders including but not limited to airport authorities, owners, business units, etc.
  • Develops and aligns with Country and HQ business development teams on strategic plans for expansion and growth of the country’s business
  • Works with business development and finance stakeholders to analyze ROI for capital projects before committing funds and assesses if anticipated results were achieved upon completion.
  • Works with various stakeholders to provide efficient and accurate assessments on project leads and opportunities including inherent risk in the event of underperformance or early termination.
  • Proposes relevant new concepts and designs to various stakeholders for review and consideration with the objective to expand and grow the business through quality product differentiation.

Qualifications

  • Degree or relevant qualification in a relevant field to the role.
  • 15–20 years of progressive industry experience across business development, revenue generation, P&L management, and operations, with a proven track record of driving business growth and operational excellence.
  • Minimum 15+ years in a senior management role within the Travel, Airline or Hospitality Industry.
  • A mix of experience from management to operations of Airports, Hotels, F&B and/or Travel industry.
  • Proven prior experience in a leadership role with analytical, strategic and tactical decisions making including evaluating and identifying business opportunities.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience presenting financial, commercial and operational plans.
  • Working experience in various countries and regions would be an advantage.
  • Strong and proven leadership skills with an emphasis on leading, engaging, recognizing, developing and mentoring employees.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, handle pressure, and establish clear expectations.
  • Experience working in a collaborative and hierarchal environment.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English as well as other key languages.

job.title: Tech Lead - Electrical Engineering
job.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at [Trane Technologies](https://www.tranetechnologies.com/), and through our businesses including [Trane®](http://www.trane.com/index.html) and [Thermo King](http://www.thermoking.com/na/en.html), sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our [benefits](http://careers.tranetechnologies.com/global/en/benefits) designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

Essential skills:

New Technology Projects (NTP), New Product Development, Productivity (VAVE), Q&R

  • Develop products by studying customer requirements and criteria
  • Proficient in Electrical Component Specifications, Selection, Analysis, Testing (Functional & Reliability) of followings:
  • Electrical Components: Contactor, Relay, Primary and Secondary Protection devices, Transformer
  • LV Motors (AC Induction, Brush DC, BLDC, Stepper, Servo, Permanent Magnet)
  • LV Motor Controllers (Drives, VFD, Inverter)
  • Design and development of control panels
  • Hands-on experience on UL and IEC STDs for Electrical system development & qualification
  • Responsible for developing Product Level Electrical design, Wiring & Harness Design
  • Work along with Multi-Disciplinary (Structural, Electronics, Software and Reliability) Team to develop System or Component Level Functional, Reliability & Qualification Requirements and Design
  • To Foster an Environment conducive for Innovation & Change with good Analytical Thinking and must make design trade-offs to ensure high reliability and best performance & low cost
  • Work closely with Supply Management to Source and Evaluate / Qualify the purchased Components and Assemblies
  • Make Tradeoff analysis of circuits and components with respect to performance, cost, quality and design flexibility
  • Manage multiple technical requirements in parallel as lead of the Electrical team
  • Mentor & Guide team members on technical areas
  • Good understanding of safety and protection standards and their implementation
  • Thorough understanding of various electrical codes and country standards
  • Knowledge in PLM and system level activities
  • Good Communication Skills – Ability to work with onsite Teams and engineers
  • Experience in hiring and leading contract resources & interns
  • Strong problem solving and analysis skills
  • Vendor identification, co-ordination and follow up
  • Knowledge in Electrical design tool – preferred

job.title: Asst Project Manager_DC
job.description:
What will you do:

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will deliver advanced service, commissioning, and troubleshooting expertise for chiller systems in mission-critical data center environments. You will:

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy-efficiency improvements in existing cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and equipment documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer-specific operational protocols.
  • Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface regularly with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely project and service completion.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including sales, engineering, and project management to ensure seamless service delivery.
  • Submit RCA and 8D reports in a timely manner.
  • Attend Monthly MOR and Quarterly QBR meetings with data center clients.

What you will bring: (Skills & Competencies)

  • Strong expertise in Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, ideally in data center environments.
  • Deep understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and redundancy concepts.
  • Proficiency in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using diagnostic tools and software.
  • Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, technical drawings, P&IDs, and OEM manuals.
  • Strong communication skills to operate effectively in mission‑critical customer environments.
  • Sound knowledge of safety standards and best practices.
  • Strong problem-solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
  • Knowledge of energy-efficiency programs, retrofits, and performance optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is a plus.

job.description:

##

  • Support Trane Technologies’ innovation roadmap by driving adoption of Salesforce advancements such as Salesforce AI/Einstein, Data Cloud, DevOps Center, and automation tools.

  • 17+ years of total IT experience, with 10+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience in development, analysis, architecture, and delivery leadership.

  • Strong background in translating complex business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.

  • Strong financial acumen with experience handling P&L, forecasting, and resource planning.

  • A passion for emerging Salesforce technologies and continuous improvement.

job.title: Technical Lead – Applied Mechanics
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute structural and FEA simulations for Thermo King components and systems across truck, trailer, bus, rail, and marine applications.
  • Analyze static, dynamic, fatigue, and vibrational loads that reflect real-world harsh transport conditions, including road-induced vibration, shock, mounting stresses, and thermal structural interactions.
  • Build high-fidelity finite element models for complex assemblies such as compressors, frames, mounts, enclosures, brackets, refrigerant line supports, and other mechanical subsystems within Thermo King units.
  • Provide clear, actionable design recommendations to global engineering teams to improve durability, manufacturability, reliability, and weight efficiency.
  • Partner with Reliability Engineering, Product Engineering, and Test Labs to align analysis assumptions with actual duty cycles, test profiles, and validation plans specific to transport refrigeration.
  • Develop and maintain simulation methods tailored for Thermo King’s dynamic, vibration, and shock‑load environments , including vibration durability, road load simulation, fatigue estimation, and structural integrity assessments.
  • Support new product development (NPD) programs with early-stage design evaluations and simulation-driven insights to accelerate development and reduce physical test iterations.
  • Prepare high-quality technical documentation summarizing analysis approach, boundary conditions, correlations, and engineering recommendations.
  • Contribute to capability growth within the Modeling & Simulation team through method development, knowledge-sharing, and informal mentoring of early career analysts.
  • Collaborate with global Thermo King stakeholders to understand program priorities, feasibility risks, and analysis needs.
  • Leverage experience with physical test techniques—such as single and multi-axes shaker table testing, accelerated life testing, strain measurement/strain gauging, and related methods—to improve model correlation and enhance simulation accuracy.
  • Provide technical leadership within projects, influencing decisions, guiding analysis strategies, and coordinating simulation activities across cross-functional teams (without formal people management).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.
  • PhD will be a plus.
  • 8–12+ years of hands-on experience in structural/FEA analysis, ideally in automotive, off-highway, refrigeration, or transport-related industries.
  • Strong proficiency in FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, or similar platforms.
  • Solid grounding in mechanical behavior under vibration, impact/shock, fatigue, and nonlinear material/structural response.
  • Proven expertise building and validating complex models that correlate well with physical testing.
  • Ability to convert simulation results into clear engineering guidance for multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with mobile equipment or transport-related engineering (automotive, rail, off-road equipment, refrigeration units, etc.).
  • Familiarity with Thermo King product categories or similar ruggedized HVAC/transport cooling systems.
  • Exposure to vibration spectrum analysis, random vibration, harmonic response, and durability methodologies aligned with transport environments.
  • Experience with scripting (Python, APDL, etc.) to automate workflows or develop reusable modeling templates.
  • Understanding of thermal-structural coupled simulations or refrigerant system component behavior is a plus.
  • Experience with single and multi-axes shaker table testing, accelerated life testing, strain measurement/strain gauging, and related structural validation techniques.
  • Technical project leadership, task leadership, or cross-functional technical coordination experience.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly analytical with strong problem‑solving capability.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to manage work priorities independently.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong initiative to influence design improvements.
  • Proven ability to apply best‑practice approaches and engage in continuous learning.
  • Ability to lead technically within cross-functional programs and drive engineering clarity.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Analyze large, complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable business insights.
  • Design, develop, and deploy AI and GenAI applications that address business needs using machine learning, large language models, and intelligent workflow orchestration.
  • Build and optimize predictive, statistical, and time series models for business and operational use cases.
  • Develop robust data pipelines, ETL workflows, and feature engineering processes using SQL and Python to support AI/ML applications.
  • Lead Python-based application development for automation, data transformation, model integration, API development, and AI-powered workflows.
  • Develop LLM-powered solutions such as copilots, knowledge assistants, summarization tools, search-and-retrieval solutions, and domain-specific recommendation systems.
  • Apply Generative AI techniques including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks, grounding strategies, response evaluation, and workflow integration.
  • Prototype and productionize AI application architectures, including integrations with vector databases, model APIs, cloud services, and enterprise systems.
  • Contribute to the evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI systems, including model quality, hallucination reduction, latency, cost, and user experience.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, analysts, domain experts, and business stakeholders to define, prioritize, and deliver AI-driven solutions.
  • Translate business problems into scalable AI/ML and GenAI use cases, technical designs, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Develop and enhance dashboards, reports, and BI solutions using Tableau where needed to support model insights and business decisions.

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Manager to lead technical delivery, grow team capability, and support the continued expansion of the CX Salesforce Practice at ITC, Trane Technologies. job.title: Senior ICM Developer
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced ICM Rule and Advanced Workflow Developer to support our SAP-based incentive compensation platform. This role plays a critical part in translating compensation plan design into system configuration, ensuring accurate payouts, strong governance, and efficient approval workflows. You will work closely with Sales Operations, HR, Finance, and IT teams to configure calculation rules, build scalable workflows, and support ongoing compensation processing.

Roles & responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain complex incentive compensation calculation rules within SAP
  • Translate plan documents into system logic including rate tables, tiered curves, accelerators, thresholds, caps, and clawbacks
  • Develop eligibility and crediting rules based on role, hierarchy, territory, and business unit
  • Support compensation cycles including accruals, adjustments, and final payouts
  • Troubleshoot calculation discrepancies and perform root cause analysis
  • Validate inbound data from HR, Finance, and operational systems
  • Design and configure multi-step approval workflows for plan assignments, exceptions, and manual adjustments
  • Implement conditional routing based on business attributes and compensation structures
  • Configure automated notifications and escalation triggers
  • Ensure workflows align with internal control and compliance requirements
  • Improve process efficiency by reducing manual intervention

What We’re Looking For

  • 3 to 6 years of experience working with SAP-based incentive compensation systems
  • Strong understanding of incentive plan design and payout mechanics
  • Hands-on experience configuring calculation rules and Advanced workflows
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable system logic
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, HR, Finance, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SAP HR or Finance integrations
  • Familiarity with compensation accrual and reconciliation processes
  • Background in Sales Operations or Compensation Operations

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. job.title: Core Technician
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Service Engineer will be responsible for service, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chiller systems in data centre environments. The role also includes supporting and executing data centre HVAC projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, and seamless customer communication. This position requires deep technical expertise in chiller operations, system optimization, and data centre cooling infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing data centre cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer operational protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface with customers regularly to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure completion of service and project tasks.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (sales, project management, engineering) for seamless service and project delivery.
  • Timely submission of Root cause analysis & 8D reports to customers
  • Monthly MOR, Quarterly QBR meetings required to be attended with DC customers

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or relevant technical field.
  • 5–10 years of hands-on experience servicing Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, preferably in data centre applications.
  • Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.
  • Proficient in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control faults using service tools and diagnostic software.
  • Strong customer communication skills and ability to work in critical data centre environments.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and industry best practices.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mission‑critical data centres or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific chiller training or certifications (e.g., Trane, Carrier, Daikin).
  • Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system performance optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is a plus.

job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
Summary

The Modeling & Simulation team is seeking a highly skilled and collaborative Senior Engineer – Acoustics to lead advanced predictive modeling efforts. In this role, you will apply state-of-the-art numerical methodologies to solve complex noise and vibration challenges across our diverse product portfolios.

The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise spanning both vibro-acoustics and aero-acoustics. This role requires a unique balance of rigorous engineering execution alongside a global perspective—focusing on commonizing acoustic methodologies and simulation standards across different regional engineering teams to meet varying regional customer and regulatory requirements.

.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced Modeling & Simulation: Develop, validate, and execute high-fidelity numerical models to predict and optimize the acoustic performance of HVAC systems, transport refrigeration units, and components (such as compressors, fans, structures, and air handlers).

ü Aero-Acoustics & Fluid-Structure Interaction: Conduct Computational Aero-Acoustics (CAA) simulations to predict flow-induced noise, fan noise, and turbulence-driven acoustic phenomena.

ü Vibro-Acoustics & Structural Dynamics: Analyze structural-acoustic coupling, structure-borne noise transmission, and vibration propagation using Finite Element Method (FEM) and Boundary Element Method (BEM) solvers.

ü Regional Commonization & Standards: Champion efforts to standardize and commonize acoustics simulation methodologies globally. Collaborate with international design centers to harmonize workflows while addressing varying regional regulations and market requirements.

ü Experimental Correlation: Collaborate closely with physical testing laboratories to design validation tests, analyze dynamic measurement data (sound power, vibration, modal testing), and correlate experimental results with simulation models.

ü Design Optimization: Partner with product development teams to provide actionable, physics-based design recommendations early in the development cycle to reduce noise and enhance sound quality.

ü Innovation: Keep abreast of emerging simulation technologies, and drive continuous improvement in simulation capability and speed.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (M.S./M.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Acoustics, or a highly related technical discipline.
  • PhD will be a plus.
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on industrial experience in acoustics modeling and simulation..
  • Knowledge in Acoustics and noise control (specific to HVAC products is desirable).
  • Should be able to perform Acoustics (Aero/Vibro) simulations, with emphasis on fan/blowers.
  • Good depth in CFD (or) FEA with experience in performing simulations is an added advantage
  • Hands-on experience on Acoustics/CFD/FEA tool preferably Actran, ANSYS Mechanical, Fluent, CFX, or Simcenter.
  • Theoretical knowledge of Acoustics, Numerical methods, Fluid dynamics and FEA.
  • Experience in Acoustics testing is desirable.
  • Experience in the HVAC industry is desirable.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML, IIOT and digital twin is preferred.
  • Strong teamwork, interpersonal, communication, and project management skills required.
  • Knowledge of programming languages and proven examples of improving productivity using various scripts.
  • Ability to work in a matrix team environment for the common objectives
  • Be part of org initiatives and contribute to ensure progressive, diverse and inclusive environment imbibing Trane values and culture.

.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly analytical with strong problem‑solving capability.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to manage work priorities independently.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong initiative to influence design improvements.
  • Proven ability to apply best‑practice approaches and engage in continuous learning.
  • Ability to lead technically within cross-functional programs and drive engineering clarity.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Visualization & Product Development Analyst
job.description:
The Role

The Visualization & Product Development Analyst supports dashboard delivery and analytics product development that convert priority data into usable business insights. This role is important to sustaining dashboard delivery and pipeline development that convert priority data into usable business insights across the organization.

This position is a development and delivery role that combines visualization expertise, analytical capability, and product-oriented execution. The individual will build dashboards, reporting products, and analytics solutions using platforms such as Tableau, Google Looker, and Dataiku in ways that are scalable, reliable, and aligned to business needs. This role will work closely with stakeholders and partner teams to translate defined requirements into intuitive, business-facing outputs that support effective decision-making.

The ideal candidate is detail-focused, quality-minded, and skilled in data storytelling, testing, documentation, and reporting execution. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys building polished analytics products, validating data accuracy, and ensuring delivered solutions are reliable, maintainable, and easy for end users to understand and adopt.

This role will be based at our Bangalore, India office and will report directly to the Visualization & Product Development Leader for ISC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate defined business requirements into dashboards, visualizations, and analytical outputs that support business priorities by converting data into clear, actionable business insights.
  • Build analytics and reporting solutions using Tableau, Google Looker, Dataiku, and related tools in a scalable, reliable, and maintainable manner.
  • Apply strong data storytelling practices to create intuitive, user-friendly, and decision-oriented reporting products.
  • Perform data validation, testing, and quality checks to ensure dashboards, reports, and analytics products are accurate and reliable.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, dashboard enhancement opportunities, and user experience requirements.
  • Identify gaps in dashboards, reporting processes, and data structures, and recommend practical improvements to strengthen usability and performance.
  • Document dashboard logic, metric display rules, testing outcomes, reporting requirements, and related processes to support consistency and scalability.
  • Present visualizations, findings, and recommendations in a clear and business-relevant manner to stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple deliverables effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail, quality, and delivery timelines.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, dashboard development, reporting, or a related field.
  • Experience working with Tableau, Google Looker, Dataiku, or similar analytics and visualization platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality in reporting and analytics delivery.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with testing, validation, and documentation practices for dashboards and analytics solutions.
  • Experience with SQL, Python, or other data analysis and automation tools is preferred.
  • Exposure to data quality, reporting standards, and visualization best practices is a plus.
  • Experience in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing environments is a plus.
  • Master’s degree in a related field is a plus.

What You Will Bring

  • A detail-focused mindset with a strong commitment to accuracy, quality, and consistency in analytics delivery.
  • The ability to translate defined business requirements into scalable, reliable, and user-friendly dashboards and reporting solutions.
  • Skill in data storytelling that helps transform data into clear, intuitive, and actionable business insights.
  • A disciplined approach to testing, validation, and documentation to ensure solutions are reliable and maintainable.
  • A collaborative and delivery-oriented approach to building analytics products that support business value.

job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Service Engineer will be responsible for service, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chiller systems in data center environments. The role also includes supporting and executing data center HVAC projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, and seamless customer communication. This position requires deep technical expertise in chiller operations, system optimization, and data center cooling infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing data centre cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer operational protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface with customers regularly to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure completion of service and project tasks.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (sales, project management, engineering) for seamless service and project delivery.
  • Timely submission of Root cause analysis & 8D reports to customers
  • Willing to work in Shift available to work on Holidays & public holidays to meet agreed SLA
  • Monthly MOR, Quarterly QBR meetings required to be attended with DC customers

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or relevant technical field.
  • 5–10 years of hands-on experience servicing Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, preferably in data centre applications.
  • Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.
  • Proficient in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control faults using service tools and diagnostic software.
  • Strong customer communication skills and ability to work in critical data centre environments.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and industry best practices.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mission‑critical data centres or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific chiller training or certifications (e.g., Trane, Carrier, Daikin).
  • Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system performance optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is a plus.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Data Engineering Analyst
job.description:
The Role

Trane Technologies is seeking a Data Engineering Analyst to join our ISC Data Architecture & Governance team based in Bangalore, India. This is a hands-on role for a candidate who can build scalable data engineering pipelines, analyze legacy systems and workflows, and help modernize our data landscape on Google Cloud Platform.

In this role, you will be responsible for ingesting data from internal and external sources into our enterprise data lake, with a strong focus on the bronze layer of a medallion architecture. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements, clarify business logic, support testing, and design practical solutions that improve reliability, usability, and scalability.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to work independently, determine next steps, and communicate effectively with customers and stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.

This role is based in our Bangalore, India corporate office and reports directly to the Data Architecture & Governance Manager for ISC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and ETL/ELT workflows on Google Cloud Platform using BigQuery, Airflow, and Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Ingest data from internal and external sources into the enterprise data lake, with primary ownership of the bronze layer within a medallion architecture.
  • Analyze legacy systems, databases, workflows, and transformation logic to understand current-state processes, dependencies, and opportunities for modernization.
  • Document current-state data flows and system behavior and develop recommendations for process improvement, architecture simplification, and legacy-to-cloud modernization.
  • Use strong SQL skills to analyze source data, validate transformations, understand embedded business logic, and support data analysts with trusted datasets.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and internal customers to gather requirements, clarify needs, support testing, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Work independently to identify next steps, resolve technical and process issues, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Apply data quality, governance, documentation, and security standards while continuously improving pipeline reliability, scalability, and performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud data platforms, data integration, or related roles.
  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong working knowledge of BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to analyze legacy systems, investigate data issues, validate transformations, and support analytics users.
  • Knowledge of Python and Data Engineering packages such as PySpark and Airflow
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi-structured data.
  • Familiarity with data lake concepts and medallion architecture, especially bronze-layer ingestion patterns.
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata, lineage, and data quality practices.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and self-management skills.
  • Experience working in cross-functional or global teams.
  • Google Cloud certifications are a plus.

**

What You Will Bring

  • A hands-on engineering mindset with the ability to move from analysis to design to delivery.
  • Strong curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity in legacy environments.
  • The ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • A proactive, self-directed approach to identifying priorities and driving work forward.
  • A passion for building scalable, maintainable data solutions that support business value.

At Trane Technologies, we offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs that help our employees thrive in both their professional and personal lives. We are proud of our winning culture, which is inclusive and respectful at its core. We share a passion for serving customers, caring for others, and boldly challenging what’s possible for a sustainable world.

We are committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.description:

Strategic Partnership:

1-3 Years

Experience

job.title: Engineer - Customer Interaction Suite
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Automation Test Engineer / Quality Engineer with strong technical expertise in web and API automation, complete test lifecycle ownership, and a deep understanding of Agile methodologies.

The ideal candidate will play an integral role in the product development lifecycle, working closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure that every release meets the highest quality standards through automation, continuous testing, and data-driven validation.

Key Responsibilities:**

1. Test Strategy and Planning

Define and implement comprehensive test strategies and test plans aligned with product requirements, user stories, and sprint goals.

  • Create detailed test cases, test data, and test environments for functional, regression, integration, load, and automation testing.
  • Perform complete test lifecycle activities including requirement analysis, test design, test execution, defect management, and test closure reporting.
  • Ensure traceability between user stories, test cases, and defects.

2. Automation Framework Design and Maintenance

Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for both Web UI and API services using tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, or Postman/Newman.

  • Develop reusable automation scripts and integrate them within the CI/CD pipeline to enable continuous testing.
  • Configure and maintain automated test execution as part of the merge and deployment process to validate builds in lower and higher environments.
  • Implement version control and review mechanisms for automation code using Git-based repositories.
  • Track automation coverage and integrate reports with dashboards for visibility.

3. Collaboration and Agile Delivery

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Work closely with developers during sprints to clarify acceptance criteria and ensure early detection of defects.
  • Collaborate with developers during debugging sessions and reproduce defects effectively with detailed logs and evidence.
  • Participate in user story creation and refinement using BDD and Gherkin syntax, ensuring test coverage and acceptance criteria are clear and measurable.
  • Contribute to Test Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior Driven Development (BDD) initiatives to improve code quality and reliability.

4. Testing Types and Execution

Execute different forms of testing including sanity testing, regression testing, hotfix validation, load and performance testing, and full automation testing.

  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and help implement preventive measures.
  • Conduct end-to-end testing across multiple environments and integrations.
  • Ensure quality gates are met before each release.

5. CI/CD Integration and Tooling

Integrate test automation with CI/CD systems like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.

  • Configure automated build validation, smoke test runs, and regression tests during deployment pipelines.
  • Manage environment setup for test execution including containerized test environments using Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Use monitoring tools to track build health and test results.

6. Data and Database Validation

Perform data validation and integrity testing across systems involving both RDBMS and document-based storage.

  • Work with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB for test data creation, verification, and validation of business logic.
  • Write SQL and NoSQL queries to validate backend data consistency and performance.

7. Release and Quality Governance

Participate in release management processes and coordinate test readiness before deployment.

  • Provide test summary reports and present quality metrics in release readiness meetings.
  • Conduct release demos to product and business teams, showcasing test results and automation coverage.
  • Ensure quality compliance and documentation for all production releases.

Required Skills and Experience

2–4 years of strong hands-on experience in test automation for web and API-based systems.

  • Proficiency in programming languages ; Java, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
  • Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or RestAssured ( With Selenium and Playwright being mandatory )

Deep understanding of Agile practices and ceremonies.

  • Proven experience collaborating with large, cross-functional teams, developers, and DevOps engineers.
  • Knowledge of BDD tools like Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Behave with Gherkin syntax.
  • Familiarity with TDD approaches and integration with CI/CD systems.
  • Practical experience in integrating test automation with tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, or GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or Xray.
  • Exposure to load and performance testing tools like JMeter, Locust, or LoadRunner.
  • Strong database skills in both RDBMS and NoSQL systems (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in a product-based company with end-to-end ownership of testing and automation processes.

  • Familiarity with API mocking and simulation tools like Postman, WireMock, or Swagger.
  • Experience executing automated tests in cloud-based test platforms such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs for browser compatiblity

Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple priorities with attention to detail.

Required Skills

  • test automation
  • playwright
  • selenium
  • rest assured
  • api testing
  • typescript
  • javascript
  • load testing

job.title: Assistant Manager - Cloud & Security Network Operations & Support
job.description:
Job Title: F5 Load Balancer - Level 3 Engineer

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced F5 Load Balancer L3 Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize network load balancing infrastructure. This role is crucial to ensure high availability, performance, and security of applications delivered through F5 technologies. As an L3 engineer, you will work on complex troubleshooting, configuration, and implementation tasks, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery.

Responsibilities

  • F5 Load Balancer Administration:
  • Implementation and manage F5 load balancers (LTM, GTM, ASM, APM modules).
  • Develop and implement F5 profiles, rules and policies to meet business requirements.
  • Maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot F5 infrastructure to ensure uptime and reliability.
  • Analyze logs and performance data to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Implement health checks and failover strategies to ensure high availability of applications.

Firewall Administration:

  • Network Security
  • Manage Checkpoint/Cisco ASA firewalls
  • Provide support for firewalls

Troubleshooting:

  • Serve as the Level 3 (L3) escalation point for resolving complex network and application-related issues.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity, traffic flow, and application performance issues involving F5 products.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with network engineers and application teams to ensure alignment on load balancing requirements.
  • Collaborate on security compliance audits and assessments related to load balancing and traffic management.

Security:

  • Implement security measures such as SSL offloading, web application firewalls (WAF), and DDoS protection on F5 devices.
  • Stay updated on the latest security threats and ensure configurations are optimized to mitigate risks.

Documentation:

  • Create and maintain documentation for F5 configurations, processes, and network architecture.
  • Provide technical training and knowledge transfer to junior engineers or team members.

Automation & Optimization:

  • Automate routine tasks using F5 iControl REST API and scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
  • Propose improvements and optimization strategies for load balancing services.

Requirements

  • Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Experience

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with F5 load balancers (BIG-IP LTM, GTM, ASM, APM). Checkpoint or ASA firewalls.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing advanced load balancing solutions.
  • Experience with networking protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL, DNS, and related technologies.

Skills

  • Proficiency in writing and debugging F5 iRules.
  • Strong understanding of application traffic flows and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Knowledge of network security principles, SSL certificates, and encryption methodologies. Firewall management
  • Familiarity with other load balancers, firewalls, and web proxies is a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based load balancing solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with DevOps tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Jenkins for infrastructure automation.
  • Soft Skills:
  • Flexible to work according to requirements
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.
  • Strong communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently or collaboratively.
  • Certifications:
  • F5 Certified BIG-IP Administrator (F5-CA) or higher certification is preferred.
  • CCNA/CCNP or other relevant network certifications are good to have.

Required Skills

  • network security
  • f5 load balancer
  • checkpoint
  • firewall
  • ipsec vpn
  • f5 big-ip
  • f5 irules

The candidate will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team of Masterplanners, Architects, engineers, and project managers to create innovative and functional designs that meet the needs business needs and the highest standards of quality. Expertise in Urban design, design management, and stakeholder management is essential.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Lead the master planning for a large-scale mixed use development, encompassing commercial, hospitality, offices, convention centers, etc.

· Develop site layouts, urban design guidelines, transportation plans, and landscaping strategies that respond to site constraints, zoning codes, environmental conditions, and project goals.

· Lead the design development of the master plan through all stages, including feasibility analysis, data collection, design brief preparation, iterative concept development, and technical documentation, ensuring adherence to design standards, budgets, and timelines.

· Collaborate with external consultant and Internal project teams to develop detailed master plans, drawings, and specifications.

· Utilize demographic, economic, and geographic data to inform planning decisions and strategies.

· Develop comprehensive urban design strategies, master plans, and zoning guidelines that enhance the functionality, sustainability, and livability of urban spaces.

· Assess land use patterns, zoning regulations, and policy frameworks to guide development.

· Integrate transportation solutions, transit-oriented development, and multi-modal transportation systems into planning efforts.

· Contribute to the development of planning policies, guidelines, and regulations.

· Develop innovative and sustainable urban design solutions that enhance the functionality, aesthetics, and livability of urban areas.

· Provide guidance and mentorship to junior designers, fostering their professional growth and development.

· Conduct urban research and analysis to inform design decisions, incorporating best practices, emerging trends, and sustainable design principles.

· Prepare and present strategy documents, masterplan reports, and visualizations to internal and external stakeholders, including investors and statutory bodies

· Incorporate sustainable design principles and environmental considerations into master plans.

· Ensure that urban design projects comply with zoning regulations, local codes, and planning guidelines.

Qualifications

Experience:

· 15–18 years as a Master planner/Urban Designer, with significant work on large-scale mixed use real estate projects.

· Proven track record in leading full-cycle projects from concept development to on-site completion.

Education Qualification:

· Bachelor of Architecture from a recognized institution.

· Preferred: M. Arch from reputed institutes such as CEPT University and School of Planning & Architecture (SPA).

Certification Required:

No specific certifications required, but relevant certifications in architectural design are advantageous.

Behavioural Skills:

· Exceptional leadership and communication skills.

· Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

· Ability to thrive in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.

Technical Skills:

· Proficiency with AutoCAD, Sketch Up, MS office and know how of Revit, GIS would be essential.

· Proficiency in building/planning, infra codes for Urban design, planning and building.

· Experience in preparing design brief and feasibility studies.

Non-Negotiable Skills:

· Expertise in master planning, urban design, infrastructure coordination, transportation, landscaping, and sustainable development

· Must have exhibited design and design coordination skills with various design stakeholders like landscape, traffic, infra (including PHE, Electrical etc.) and SMEP

· Demonstrable workplace experience of survey and analysis of sites, preparation of base plans and supporting material required for urban design and master planning work is essential.

· At least one full cycle of experience from concept development to on-site completion

Conclusion:

The Lead Master Planner role at Adani presents an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional to lead transformative design initiatives in the real estate and hospitality industry. If you are passionate about creating innovative and sustainable architectural solutions and possess the requisite skills and qualifications, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable contributor to our dynamic team.
