job.description:
Job Summary

Black & Veatch is seeking an exceptional and experienced professional to join our Infrastructure Advisory organization as a Consultant – Consulting to provide expertise around OT SCADA Systems Testing and Integration. The world is changing at an unprecedented rate and that change increases the demand for innovation and efficiency to deliver solutions and services across the world’s utility infrastructure. Join Black & Veatch’s growing Infrastructure Advisory business and use your talents and expertise to deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable results for our clients, with the opportunity to grow your skills, expand your professional network, and shape a rewarding career path aligned with your aspirations.

The Delivery Team is a diverse group of early-to-mid career professionals with a solid foundation of utility experience and knowledge. Peers are engaged in a wide range of technical projects and encouraged to sharpen their skills to provide clients superior consulting services and continue to advance in a specialized career track. You will work with professionals in the Consulting and Digital Delivery Teams who represent a dynamic and cross-functional group of experts in strategy, data, technology, and asset management systems. Together, they deliver innovative, data-driven solutions that help clients navigate complex infrastructure challenges across diverse industries.

We partner with clients to align their people, processes, technologies, and data in response to rapid industry transformation. Our work enables organizations to modernize infrastructure, optimize asset performance, enhance resilience, and achieve long-term sustainability goals. By joining this team, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and client success. You’ll contribute to mission-critical projects that make a meaningful impact on communities and industries around the world.

Key Responsibilities

The Testing Engineer is responsible for executing system-level testing activities to validate that solutions meet defined functional and non-functional requirements. This role ensures quality assurance through structured test execution, comprehensive test case development, traceability management, and disciplined defect lifecycle management. The Testing Engineer works closely with project teams, SMEs, and vendors to drive issue resolution and maintain transparency into system quality through effective reporting.

System Test Execution

  • Execute system, integration, and acceptance test cases in accordance with approved test plans and schedules
  • Validate system behavior against expected results and document outcomes with supporting evidence
  • Support readiness activities including environment validation and test data verification

Test Case Development & Maintenance

  • Develop, review, and maintain structured test cases aligned to business requirements and use cases
  • Ensure completeness of test coverage across end-to-end workflows and integration scenarios
  • Update test cases based on defect learnings, requirement changes, and system updates

Requirements Traceability Management

  • Maintain and update the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) to ensure full coverage between requirements, test cases, and defects
  • Report out on completeness of traceability coverage by testing phase
  • Identify gaps in coverage and coordinate development of additional test scenarios
  • Ensure traceability supports impact assessment and decision-making

Defect Management and Triage Facilitation

  • Log, track, and manage defects through a centralized defect management tool
  • Participate in and facilitate defect triage sessions to review, validate, prioritize, and assign issues
  • Collaborate with developers, SMEs, and vendors to support defect resolution, retesting, and closure
  • Ensure defects are properly linked to originating test cases and requirements

Test Reporting & Quality Metrics

  • Produce regular test execution reports, defect summaries, and quality metrics for project stakeholders
  • Track and communicate test progress, risks, and system readiness
  • Provide insights into defect trends, coverage status, and exit criteria readiness

Advanced Technology & Automation Skills

  • Demonstrate fluency in AI technologies, large language model (LLM) APIs, autonomous agent development, and software testing automation frameworks to enhance testing efficiency and quality

Scope

  • Billable Hours target established in annual goal setting process. Generally works on 1-4 concurrent projects at a given time.

#LI-PG1

Management Responsibilities

Individual Contributor

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in instrumentation,  Information Technology or Engineering
  • 5+ years of experience in system and user acceptance testing, configuration, application support, or technical implementation roles or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system testing
  • Experience with electric utility control systems operations or maintenance
  • Actively participated in at least two ADMS or other OT platform projects through the complete lifecycle including requirements development, design, systems integration & implementation and testing
  • Knowledge of industry standards (e.g., NERC CIP, IEC, IEEE) and utility regulatory environments
  • Experience supporting utility or critical infrastructure systems
  • Familiarity with configuration workbooks, parameter management, or system setup in enterprise applications
  • Familiarity with requirements traceability frameworks and governance models
  • Experience working in vendor-integrated environments with structured testing governance

Minimum Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, instrumentation or computer engineering, Information Systems, or similar Technical domain
  • 3 years of experience in system and user acceptance testing, configuration, application support, or technical implementation roles or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system testing
  • Ability to analyze requirements and translate them into structured test cases
  • Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., ALM, qTest, Jira)
  • Exposure to software development or system delivery lifecycle (SDLC) including design, build, testing, and deployment within large-scale enterprise programs
  • Functional understanding of OT systems such as ADMS, EMS, SCADA, or similar platforms
  • Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into structured test case outputs
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Effective communication skills to enable cross-functional coordination and lead triage discussions
  • Knowledge of Electric utilities operations functions and associated processes
  • Actively participated in at least one ADMS or other OT platform projects with technical domain experience
  • Hands-on experience in utility OT platforms such as ADMS, EMS, SCADA, DERMS, or related systems

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or relevant work experience. 4+ years experience in a business/consulting environment.  All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

job.title: Senior Engineering Technician - Electrical Oil & Gas
job.description:
Job Summary

Functions as a senior engineering technician, technical design specialist and/or supervisor. Applies advanced technical expertise to address complex design challenges, typically within a specific engineering discipline, and contributes to the development of innovative engineering solutions. Utilizes digital tools and design software (e.g., CAD, BIM, 3D modeling) in conjunction with standardized procedures to create, modify, and maintain technical documentation, drawings, and project deliverables. In addition to hands-on design and production responsibilities, this role provides consultation, training, and oversight to other engineering technicians to ensure quality, consistency, and adherence to project standards.

Key Responsibilities

Communicate and may set appropriate design and graphic standards. Reviews project requirements and accurately determines the correct format and contents of the required deliverables. Promotes quality within project/group/section. Reviews design inputs in order to ensure consistency. Assists to ensure deliverables are in compliance with the specific codes and standards in force for the project. May contribute to the continuous improvement of guides and standards. May participate in and lead process improvement activities and assignments. Responsible for drawing control and historical records, utilizing the appropriate method, as established by the project. Demonstrates personal accuracy and drives continual improvement and change management efforts. Applies basic engineering principles and established design practices in developing complex design concepts and deliverables. job.description:
Job Summary

Functions as technical specialist, or has management and/or administrative responsibilities for a group. May supervise multi-discipline engineering staff on projects of medium to high complexity, and/or is recognized as a key reference for technical guidance through depth and breadth of knowledge. Has some influence for scope of responsibilities within the organization.

#LI-AP2

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively provides guidance and direction on department design guides, standards, systems, applicable engineering codes and B&V policies. May own, maintain, update, or develop engineering standards and guides. Provide technical guidance to others regarding projects or disciplines.
  • Applies knowledge and ensures compliance with B&V quality program. Establishes related processes, and promotes a culture that is conducive to quality. Supports continuous improvement, change management and risk management efforts.
  • Prepares a variety of complex engineering deliverables for multiple or mega projects.  Performs complex research and develops recommendations for equipment and/or materials selection. Oversees collection, assimilation, and management of data for engineering work.
  • Prepares complex engineering calculations following standard methods and principles.  Manages assigned budget, schedule, and quality requirements. Develops and applies advanced engineering solutions to complex problems. Responsible for ensuring project teams delegate appropriate tasks to lower level team members to develop depth of project execution staff.  Reviews lower level engineering work or assignments. Is responsible for one or more of the following: leading production teams; coordinating multiple discipline activity; and serving as the responsible charge for projects. Establishes work plan to be applied to a given project.
  • Actively coordinates with all other internal/external team members on complex projects. Typically responsible for defining project schedules for single discipline or may have responsibility for multiple disciplines.
  • Responsible for determining identification of key client interests and drivers on projects. Communicates client interests and drivers to project team members and develops approaches to accommodate these concerns in the performance of the work on complex projects.
  • Works to identify future client needs and how to better position B&V for the future.    May offer other services to the client. Typically provides support to business development or pursuit activities.
  • Serves as the technical specialist in a broad area of specialization, or in a narrow but specialized field. Develops and applies advanced engineering concepts and approaches to unique engineering problems. Typically supports multiple projects on very complex technical challenges. Typical roles include being recognized as an industry expert, participating in professional societies by presenting papers, acting as a section lead for a large or complex specialty area, an engineering consultant for larger scale projects. May support the chief engineers or top engineering management, and is accountable for discipline-specific engineering processes.
  • Typically oversees performance management, career planning, recognition, learning and development, and corrective actions. May participate in compensation management, succession planning, disciplinary actions, employee relations and workforce planning.   Actively mentors lower level and mid level professionals and identifies successors to train in the specifics of their role.

  • Lead HVAC and plumbing design activities for industrial water and wastewater facilities.
  • Develop and review HVAC design criteria, load calculations, ventilation, exhaust, pressurization, heating, cooling, and equipment sizing.

  • Prepare and review HVAC and plumbing drawings, specifications, schedules, equipment datasheets, calculations, and design reports.
  • Coordinate HVAC and plumbing deliverables with process, civil, structural, architectural, electrical, I&C, fire protection, piping, and procurement teams.
  • Review deliverables for technical quality, code compliance, constructability, maintainability, and interdisciplinary coordination.
  • Support vendor reviews, RFIs, construction support, commissioning, and startup activities for HVAC and plumbing systems.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to standardization, training, and knowledge sharing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant HVAC and plumbing engineering experience for industrial, water, wastewater, utility, infrastructure, manufacturing, or mission-critical facilities.
  • Proven experience leading HVAC and plumbing deliverables for complex multidisciplinary projects.
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems including ventilation, exhaust, pressurization, heating, cooling, filtration, humidity control, equipment room ventilation, and electrical room cooling.
  • Strong knowledge of plumbing systems including domestic water, sanitary drainage, storm drainage coordination, emergency fixtures, floor drains, hose bibbs, plumbing fixtures, and water heaters.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing calculations, design criteria, specifications, drawings, schedules, datasheets, technical evaluations, and design reports.
  • Professional registration or chartered engineer certification.
  • Experience with industrial water, wastewater, data center, semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, power, oil & gas, mining, food and beverage, pharmaceutical, or life sciences facilities.
  • Experience with corrosive, hazardous, high-humidity, chemical storage, electrical, control, laboratory, and process support spaces.
  • Experience with EPC, FEL/FEED, design-build, and engineering services delivery models.
  • Familiarity with ASHRAE, SMACNA, IMC, IPC, UPC, NFPA, IBC, and applicable energy codes.

job.title: Senior Analyst (Data Center Design Expert)
job.description:
Job Summary

With a focus on utility industries such as Power, Oil & Gas, Data Infrastructure and Water as well as other resource-intensive sectors, Black & Veatch’s Global Advisory group provides a range of holistic strategic, process, financial and technology solutions. Black & Veatch brings together combined expertise in advanced analytics and practical business experience with extensive organizational, technology and engineering capabilities. Throughout the world, we deliver solutions that work best for the program needs, organization, assets and customers.

Our professionals improve organizational effectiveness, and reduce risks and costs by enabling our clients to adopt and operationalize new technologies and approaches. We help justify and fund major improvements to your utility network and assets. We help you achieve a clear, systematic approach to managing risks. And worldwide, we work with executive leadership teams to identify and design business-case solutions to some of our world’s most transformational initiatives solving energy, water, decarbonisation and other finite resource challenges.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design review of mission critical infrastructure for data centers
  • Working on transaction projects of technologies like water projects, etc.
  • Compiles data from design documents, contracts
  • Review technical inputs in financial model for data centres, water technologies etc
  • Data analysis and crunching
  • Draft inputs to technical due diligence, construction and operation monitoring report
  • Presenting data in meaningful formats to be used by project teams

Consulting Capability:

  • Delivers or contributes to the development of work products throughout at least one phase of an engagement
  • Uses recognized methods to deliver work products
  • Contributes to risk and issue identification and synthesis of solutions

Industry knowledge capability:

  • delivers work products and demonstrates a broad knowledge of an industry or market including trends, current state of the art and driving factors
  • collects and analyzes information specific to the industry to recommend alternatives

Project delivery:

job.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer- Data Center CFD Lead
job.description:
Job Summary

Functions as technical specialist, or has management and/or administrative responsibilities for a group. May supervise multi-discipline engineering staff on projects of medium to high complexity, and/or is recognized as a key reference for technical guidance through depth and breadth of knowledge. Has some influence for scope of responsibilities within the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively provides guidance and direction on department design guides, standards, systems, applicable engineering codes and B&V policies. May own, maintain, update, or develop engineering standards and guides. Provide technical guidance to others regarding projects or disciplines.
  • Applies knowledge and ensures compliance with B&V quality program. Establishes related processes, and promotes a culture that is conducive to quality. Supports continuous improvement, change management and risk management efforts.
  • Prepares a variety of complex engineering deliverables for multiple or mega projects.  Performs complex research and develops recommendations for equipment and/or materials selection. Oversees collection, assimilation, and management of data for engineering work.
  • Prepares complex engineering calculations following standard methods and principles.  Manages assigned budget, schedule, and quality requirements. Develops and applies advanced engineering solutions to complex problems. Responsible for ensuring project teams delegate appropriate tasks to lower level team members to develop depth of project execution staff.  Reviews lower level engineering work or assignments. Is responsible for one or more of the following: leading production teams; coordinating multiple discipline activity; and serving as the responsible charge for projects. Establishes work plan to be applied to a given project.
  • Actively coordinates with all other internal/external team members on complex projects. Typically responsible for defining project schedules for single discipline or may have responsibility for multiple disciplines.
  • Responsible for determining identification of key client interests and drivers on projects. Communicates client interests and drivers to project team members and develops approaches to accommodate these concerns in the performance of the work on complex projects.
  • Works to identify future client needs and how to better position B&V for the future.    May offer other services to the client. Typically provides support to business development or pursuit activities.
  • Serves as the technical specialist in a broad area of specialization, or in a narrow but specialized field. Develops and applies advanced engineering concepts and approaches to unique engineering problems. Typically supports multiple projects on very complex technical challenges. Typical roles include being recognized as an industry expert, participating in professional societies by presenting papers, acting as a section lead for a large or complex specialty area, an engineering consultant for larger scale projects. May support the chief engineers or top engineering management, and is accountable for discipline-specific engineering processes.
  • Typically oversees performance management, career planning, recognition, learning and development, and corrective actions. May participate in compensation management, succession planning, disciplinary actions, employee relations and workforce planning.   Actively mentors lower level and mid level professionals and identifies successors to train in the specifics of their role.

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated expertise in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) applied to data center airflow, thermal management, liquid-cooling, and mission-critical facility analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency with Cadence Reality™ Data Center (formerly 6SigmaRoom) for modeling and analysis of internal and external data center environments, including airflow management, heat transfer, cooling optimization, transient failure analysis, and liquid-cooling applications.
  • Experience with additional CFD platforms such as Siemens Simcenter STAR-CCM+ or ANSYS Fluent, or equivalent CFD software for advanced thermal-fluid analysis.
  • Experience developing and applying flow network models for liquid-cooling systems, including coolant distribution units (CDUs), piping networks, pumps, manifolds, and rack-level cooling technologies.
  • Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field with a specialization in fluid dynamics, heat transfer, thermal sciences, or CFD; or equivalent industry experience supplemented by advanced CFD training and coursework.
  • Strong understanding of thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, and data center cooling technologies, including air-cooled and liquid-cooled infrastructures.
  • Experience with data center infrastructure design, cooling architecture evaluation, and industry standards supporting hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data centers.
  • Strong understanding of HVAC systems and data center infrastructure design standards.
  • Knowledge of industry standards and best practices for data center design and operation.
  • Strong technical report writing skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Minimum Qualifications

Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 18 years related work experience. All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

job.title: Team Member-Treasury
job.description:
Responsibilities

1\. Risk Management, Limit Monitoring & System Implementation

  • Limit Setup & Monitoring: Set up, monitor, and enforce exposure and stop-loss limits across treasury activities, providing regular performance and utilization reports to senior leadership.
  • Breach Management: In the event of an exposure or stop-loss limit breach, proactively seek immediate trade ratification and formulate a concrete action plan to bring utilization back within limits. Report breach summaries and subsequent progress to senior management.
  • Risk Analytics: Analyze and control the risk of treasury dealings. Calculate, analyze, and report Value at Risk (VaR) on a regular basis.
  • Stress Testing: Run forward-looking forecasts and simulations using sensitivity analysis and stress testing to provide deep insights into potential portfolio impacts.
  • System Implementation & Reporting: Provide business and risk intelligence to management to assist in the implementation of advanced risk management systems.

2\. Trade Execution Control, Valuations & Mandates

  • Execution Source Control: Monitor and control trade execution channels (such as FXGo, Bloomberg Chat, or official Voice calls). Escalate any unauthorized trade execution sources immediately.
  • Dealer Mandates: Maintain up-to-date dealer mandates and ensure that all treasury transactions are executed in strict accordance with corporate authorization rules.
  • P&L Computation: Compute and publish daily Profit and Loss (PnL) statements for all trading / risk management desks of Group Treasury.
  • Valuation & MTM Reconciliation: Ensure the absolute correctness of trade valuations by assessing and testing the pricing methodologies utilized by the FinMechanics (FM) system.

3\. Hedging, Debt Documentation & DCM Coordination

  • Risk quantification: Actively monitor and report quantum of Risk run by desk and ad well as Group along with sensitivity and scenarios.
  • Covenant Tracking & Monitoring: Set up, maintain, and manage a robust tracking framework to monitor compliance with financial, operational, and hedging covenants under existing and new debt documents (including USD Bonds, ECBs, FCLs, and bilateral bank facilities). Ensure zero defaults by proactively flagging covenant headroom risks to senior management.
  • Economic Value of Treasury Activities:Actively analyze, quantify and report on the economic value of Treasury decisions.
  • Hedge Cost Benchmarking: Track, analyze, and publish actual hedge costs against benchmark hedge costs for USD Bonds, External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs), and Foreign Currency Loans (FCLs) on a regular basis.
  • DCM Documentation: Coordinate with key internal and external stakeholders—including legal teams, lead managers, and BUs—to timely execute Debt Capital Markets (DCM) documentation.

4\. Audit Compliance

  • Audit Coordination: Serve as the primary point of contact for the internal audit team. Ensure swift resolution of audit findings and establish clear, time-bound action plans to address any noted control gaps.

Qualifications

  • Education: Chartered Accountant (CA), Financial Risk Management (FRM), CFA, or MBA in Finance from a premier institution.
  • Experience: 5 to 9 years of direct experience in a Treasury Middle Office, Treasury Control, or Market Risk department within a large multinational conglomerate, major bank, or financial institution.

job.title: Deputy General Manager - Techno Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing:

  • Plan and forecast Capex procurement needs based on the projects in pipeline and organization's strategic objectives.
  • Formulate contractual terms and conditions for major EPC contracts to secure favorable terms.
  • Negotiate with vendors for long-term contract terms to ensure beneficial agreements.
  • Select the bidding process, prepare vendor selection approaches, and vendor evaluation criteria to streamline the procurement process.
  • Review RFI and RFP documents, identify potential bidders, and organize pre-bid meetings to facilitate a competitive bidding process.
  • Conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations and fact-based negotiations/e-auctions to select the best vendors.
  • Review Notes for Approval (NFA) for selected bidders and obtain required approvals to ensure compliance with company policies.
  • Leverage extensive experience in mining and material handling procurement, including handling mining and EPC contractors, explosives, CHPP, and project monitoring to develop and implement procurement strategies.

Core Procurement Activities:

  • Understand the Techno-Commercial strategy and plan for the Business Unit (BU) to implement strategic initiatives for all categories (Group-wide/BU specific) as per plan.
  • Oversee the review of approved PRs from user departments to ensure correctness and completeness of PRs.
  • Coordinate with leads in identifying the type and method of procurement based on material/service type, urgency, stock availability, rate contracts, value, and delivery timeline to optimize procurement efficiency.

Contract Management:

  • Oversee the preparation of contract documents as per protocols and standard templates to ensure consistency and compliance.
  • Set up approved contract records within the ERP system to maintain accurate and accessible records.
  • Maintain contract documents for future reference and compliance to ensure traceability and accountability.
  • Collate Advance Bank Guarantee/Contract Performance Bank Guarantee (ABG/CPBG)/Customs related documents from vendors to secure financial assurances.
  • Prepare, review, and issue rate contracts based on approved NFAs to secure long-term pricing agreements.
  • Prepare master outline agreements in ERP systems based on rate contracts to streamline procurement processes.
  • Prepare PO/SO for procurement under valid rate contracts to facilitate timely procurement.

Supplier Management:

  • Oversee the identification of vendor evaluation criteria in consultation with quality, engineering, and project management departments to ensure rigorous vendor selection.
  • Ensure completeness of forms submitted by vendors and update the approved vendor list to maintain an accurate and up-to-date vendor database.
  • Coordinate with new vendors for evaluation documents and with quality/engineering/user teams for assessments if required to ensure comprehensive vendor evaluations.
  • Prepare vendor segmentation matrices and performance evaluation criteria to categorize and assess vendor performance effectively.
  • Oversee the evaluation process for CapEx and services vendors, ensuring thorough review of vendor scorecards.
  • Plan improvement actions for vendors with unsatisfactory performance to enhance vendor performance.
  • Manage all cluster CAPEX commercial activities and site TC functions as per Delegation of Authority (DoA) to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

Data Management and Risk Management:

  • Collate and analyze data related to large scale procurement activities (e.g., commodity analysis, supplier debugging) to derive actionable insights.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and value through data analysis to drive continuous improvement.
  • Identify procurement risks for assigned categories using master lists, supply market analysis, long-term procurement plans, annual procurement plans, and project risk registers to mitigate risks.

People Management:

  • Work towards achieving set goals and participate in performance reviews to stay aligned with team objectives.
  • Communicate personal development needs and actively engage in creating and following Individual Development Plans (IDP) for professional growth.
  • Develop skills in current and future functional focus areas as per the capability matrix and IDP guidelines to contribute to team versatility.

Technology Integration:

  • Utilize digital solutions for comprehensive tracking and analysis of capital expenditure projects, ensuring accurate forecasting and budgeting.
  • Implement digital tools for project management and reporting, improving transparency and efficiency in Capex initiatives.
  • Contribute to action planning and implementation based on data analytics to enhance CAPEX procurement strategies.

Key Internal Stakeholders: Projects team Marketing department Finance & Accounts team Quality Assurance Team

Key External Stakeholders: Vendors Suppliers External agencies

Qualifications

Work Experience (Range of years):

Work Experience (Range of Years):

More than 12 years of experience in supply chain management, procurement.

job.title: Sr Data and AI specialist
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Requirement elicitation, understanding the business need and trying to solve the business problem with data as the tool.
  • Translating the business requirement into data requirement, understanding limitations of system to design a transformation pipeline
  • Work closely on the data, by querying & transforming the data set to make it available to users in required structure and form
  • Write complex transformation queries that can be used for process automation & incremental data load
  • Use best of query and coding(python) worlds to design efficient transformation logics
  • Understand the efficiency factor of query and python and work-around to avoid heavy functions
  • Work on end-to-end Power BI reports and dashboard development. Own the admin jobs of Power BI and take necessary actions in case of issues
  • Understanding business problem/objectives, developing wireframes & designing appropriate data strategy
  • Perform data extraction, data transformation, data modelling, maintain data models, reporting systems, dashboards, performance metrics and other leading edge analytical systems that support key business decisions
  • Approach problems and issues structurally to find the root cause of the issues in data/processes
  • Hands on AI delivery experience across GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG pipelines in complex enterprise environments.

Qualifications

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complicated and large amounts of data with business insights
  • Overall experience of 7+ years in data management, with minimum 3+ years of experience as full stack developer
  • Experience in working with datasets in databases with SQL language
  • Strong technical expertise in Power BI-Power Query & DAX, best practices for visualization & developing optimized backend architecture
  • Sound knowledge of cloud and related components for data manipulation, transformation etc
  • Candidates with expertise in Python coding will be preferred
  • Delivery Ownership and mentoring junior team members
  • Experience in building AI models, RAG pipelines, Model lifecycle management

job.title: Assistant Manager - Projects - PNG
job.description:
Responsibilities

PNG Projects Engineer - O3

Project Execution and Support:

  • Assist in the execution of PNG, including site preparation, equipment installation, and commissioning, ensuring all tasks are completed according to project plans and timelines.
  • Collaborate with the Projects Lead to ensure that all engineering activities meet design specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements.
  • Conduct on-site inspections and assessments to monitor progress, identify potential issues, and ensure that all work complies with technical specifications.
  • Prepare and update detailed engineering drawings, technical documents, and project plans, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.
  • Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure the timely delivery of materials and services required for project completion.

Technical Support and Problem Solving:

  • Provide technical support to the project team, troubleshooting and resolving engineering issues that arise during the project lifecycle.
  • Analyze and interpret technical data, drawings, and specifications to support decision-making and ensure the successful completion of project tasks.
  • Implement engineering solutions to address on-site challenges, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines and budget.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of engineering best practices, focusing on improving efficiency, safety, and quality in project execution.
  • Participate in technical meetings and reviews, providing input and recommendations to optimize project outcomes.

Quality Control and Assurance:

  • Monitor and enforce quality control measures throughout all phases of the project, ensuring that all work meets the required standards and specifications.
  • Conduct regular inspections and tests on materials, equipment, and systems to verify their compliance with project requirements and industry regulations.
  • Document and report any quality issues or non-conformities, working with the project team to implement corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
  • Assist in the development of quality assurance plans and procedures, ensuring that they are effectively implemented and adhered to during project execution.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure that all engineering activities comply with local, regional, and national safety regulations and industry standards, minimizing the risk of accidents or incidents.
  • Participate in safety audits and inspections, identifying potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks.
  • Provide input on safety protocols and procedures, ensuring that they are followed by all team members and contractors during project execution.
  • Assist in the preparation of safety documentation, including risk assessments, method statements, and safety plans, ensuring they are complete and accurate.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation, including engineering drawings, technical specifications, progress reports, and inspection records.
  • Prepare regular project status reports for the Projects Lead, highlighting key achievements, challenges, and any areas requiring attention.
  • Assist in the preparation of as-built documentation upon project completion, ensuring that all records reflect the final state of the project.
  • Ensure that all documentation is properly filed and accessible, supporting future project reviews and audits.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with other engineers, project managers, and stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Participate in project meetings, providing updates on engineering activities and contributing to discussions on project planning and execution.
  • Liaise with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to resolve any technical issues and ensure alignment on project objectives and timelines.
  • Provide clear and concise technical information to non-engineering team members, ensuring they understand the requirements and constraints of the project.

Continuous Improvement and Learning:

  • Stay informed about the latest developments in engineering practices, technologies, and industry standards relevant to PNG or CNG projects.
  • Identify opportunities for improving engineering processes and practices, proposing and implementing changes that enhance project performance.
  • Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge, ensuring continued growth and contribution to the project team.
  • Share knowledge and insights with the project team, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Internal Stakeholders:

  • Regional office
  • Corporate office
  • TechnoCommercial Team
  • HSE Team
  • Operations & Maintenance

External Stakeholders:

  • Vendors
  • Contractors
  • Local authorities
  • Regulatory bodies
  • Consultants

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

Work Experience:

3+ years of experience, preferably in construction project management.

Proven experience in managing large-scale infrastructure projects from inception to completion.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the gas distribution, oil and energy, or utilities sectors.

job.title: Deputy Manager-Safety
job.description:
Responsibilities

Central or Site Safety Executive - Mining

Safety Management System:

Develop and execute comprehensive Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems (OHSMS) programs for Coal Washeries within the Cluster.

Prepare annual safety plans and procedures, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and industry standards.

Develop and maintain a safety training calendar for both Adani and contract employees, ensuring timely completion of safety training programs.

Conduct employee training sessions to disseminate safety protocols and implement best practices in various safety domains such as life safety, chemical safety, hazardous materials management, etc.

Monitor program effectiveness and make necessary adjustments to improve safety outcomes.

Conduct and oversee budget planning and allocation for all safety-related initiatives to ensure adequate resources are available for maintaining and enhancing workplace safety.

IMS Implementation:

Oversee the implementation of Integrated Management Systems (IMS) standards including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.

Plan and conduct internal audits, ensuring compliance with IMS requirements and addressing non-conformities promptly.

Coordinate external periodic/recertification safety risk audits in collaboration with certification agencies.

Safety Initiatives and Committee Meetings:

Support the implementation of new safety initiatives aimed at enhancing safety effectiveness at the site, such as Gensuite and Behavior-Based Safety programs.

Implement and oversee comprehensive safety protocols to mitigate heavy vehicle risks within the coal mining operation, ensuring the safety of personnel and minimizing the potential for accidents or incidents

Organize and facilitate site/department level safety committee meetings to address safety gaps and implement corrective actions.

Monitor and ensure the timely closure of observations and recommendations from safety committee meetings.

Review safety reports and send it to HOD for monitoring safety controls by conducting weekly review meetings with cluster head.

Coordinate and organize events with local communities and schools aimed at promoting safety awareness and education.

Contractor Safety Management:

Develop and implement a robust contractor safety management system in accordance with Group SOPs.

Conduct safety meetings and toolbox talks with contractor safety officers and supervisors.

Oversee the training of contract workmen through safety induction programs and periodic training sessions.

Evaluate the performance of vendors and contractors to ensure adherence to safety standards.

Liasion with safety taskforce to ensure standard for contract safety on timely basis.

Incident Investigation and Emergency Response:

Direct the investigation, reporting, and analysis of accidents and major incidents to prevent recurrence.

Collaborate with department heads to review major incidents and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions.

Function effectively as a coordinator of the emergency response team, ensuring readiness to handle emergencies effectively.

Statutory Compliance and Mock Drills:

Ensure compliance with state and central statutory requirements as well as industry standards pertaining to occupational health and safety.

Organize and conduct mock drills for emergency preparedness in communication with HOD Cluster head.

Review drill exercises, identify gaps, and implement necessary improvements for efficient safety control.

Coordinate with TCD team to maintain safety inventory such as helmets, belt, safety glasses, gloves, safety shoes, earplugs, and respirators, etc.

Automation and Digitization:

Utilize real-time monitoring systems, including IoT devices and mobile applications, to proactively identify and address safety hazards on-site, ensuring a swift and effective response.

Implement and manage digital platforms for incident reporting, safety audits, and data analysis, enhancing the accuracy of safety metrics and facilitating continuous improvement in safety practices.

job.title: Engineer - Engineering
job.description:
Responsibilities

*Key Responsibilities of Role

Process Design and Implementation

  • Design and implement blade manufacturing processes, including resin infusion, layup, and curing, using advanced process control techniques to ensure consistency and quality.
  • Develop detailed work instructions and process flow diagrams to guide production teams in executing blade manufacturing tasks effectively.

Production Optimization and Troubleshooting

  • Optimize production processes by analyzing cycle times, material usage, and labor efficiency, implementing changes to reduce waste and improve throughput.
  • Conduct on-site troubleshooting of process deviations, including resin flow issues and curing irregularities, to minimize downtime and maintain production targets.

Quality Control and Process Monitoring

  • Establish in-process monitoring systems to track key parameters such as temperature, pressure, and resin flow during blade production, ensuring compliance with design standards.
  • Perform root cause analysis on process-related defects, utilizing data-driven techniques to implement corrective actions and enhance process stability.

Site Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis

  • Participate in site troubleshooting and corrective actions for blade process issues, conducting on-the-ground analysis to resolve quality or operational challenges.
  • Use advanced diagnostic tools to identify process inefficiencies and implement solutions to improve production reliability.

Process Documentation and Standards Compliance

  • Maintain up-to-date documentation of process specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality control checklists to ensure compliance with industry and company standards.
  • Ensure all processes adhere to regulatory requirements, including health, safety, and environmental standards.

Material Integration and Testing

  • Work closely with the Blade Material Engineer to test and validate new materials in the production environment, ensuring seamless integration with existing processes.
  • Conduct trials of alternative resin systems or composite materials, analyzing results to determine feasibility and performance impact.

Adherence to Policies and Ethical Considerations

  • Adhere to organizational policies and ethical standards in all engineering activities, ensuring transparency and integrity in process design and execution.
  • Participate in training on corporate policies, ethics, and compliance to maintain high professional standards.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation

  • Proactively seek opportunities for process improvements, engaging in Kaizen events and Lean initiatives to enhance production efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Stay updated on the latest advancements in blade manufacturing technologies, incorporating best practices and innovations into the process design.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Blade Material Engineer
  • Lead - Blade Process Engineering
  • Manufacturing Teams
  • QA Teams

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Composite Material Suppliers
  • Tooling Suppliers

Qualifications

Educational Background:

  • BE in Mechanical Engineering or related field.

Work Experience:

  • 5+ years designing blade manufacturing processes, with a focus on optimizing production flow and implementing corrective actions for defects.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Proficient in process monitoring, root cause analysis, and integrating new materials into existing production lines for enhanced blade quality.

job.title: Associate Manager - Regulatory and Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Regulatory (ERCG)

Policy Advocacy and Regulatory Compliance:

Assist in monitoring policy developments and regulatory changes that may impact the organization's operations.

Support efforts to ensure that the organization's practices align with current regulations and legislative requirements.

Help gather information and contribute to internal discussions on how sector regulations and government interventions may affect the organization.

Aid in the preparation of compliance documentation and reports, ensuring that all business activities adhere to regulatory standards.

Stay up-to-date with changes in legislation and regulatory requirements, and assist in communicating these changes to relevant departments within the organization.

Due Diligence and Research:

Conduct due diligence for mergers and acquisitions (M&A) from a regulatory perspective, preparing notes and presentations for the Business Development (BD) team.

Perform regulatory research by reviewing updates from regulatory websites such as the Ministry of Power (MOP) to identify new draft notifications, regulations, or policies.

Support compliance efforts by contributing to the development and maintenance of internal controls and procedures.

Litigation Coordination and Petition Drafting:

Coordinate with advocates, briefing them on regulatory litigation matters, and ensure timely submission of petitions.

Brief legal firms on specific cases and assist with in-house drafting of petitions by compiling information and ensuring logical presentation.

If law firms are drafting petitions, provide a first draft or a comprehensive information bucket for their use.

Manage administrative tasks related to litigation, such as obtaining certified copies of legal documents.

Internal MIS and Reporting:

Prepare internal MIS reports listing cases pending before the court, categorizing them by criticality, forum, and plant, and disseminate to promoters.

Compile monthly reports detailing judgments passed, new guidelines from state or central regulators, and other relevant updates.

Conduct weekly review meetings to discuss regulatory cases and develop strategies based on direction from the Head/ Chief of Energy Regulatory and Commercial group (ERCG).

Monitor the progression of regulatory cases, keeping detailed records of filings, hearings, and judgments.

Assist in the preparation and organization of legal documents required for regulatory submissions and correspondence.

Public Hearings and Petition Filing:

Attend public hearings, both online and in-person, and provide briefings on the proceedings.

File petitions after obtaining approval from the team lead and Head/ Chief of ERCG, ensuring adherence to internal protocols.

Payment Processing:

Generate a Note in SAP (NIS) checklist and apply for filing fees for petitions related to disputes and claims.

Coordinate with the Group Data Governance and Control (GDGC) team for system uploads and facilitate the review process with the Adani Business Excellence team before final payment by the finance team.

Handle different types of statutory or court fee payments required by various regulatory bodies, whether online or via challan.

Obtain payment certificates and provide them to the team lead for record-keeping and further action.

Administrative Assistance and Process Enhancement:

Execute administrative tasks related to legal filings, such as managing Vakalatnamas and ensuring the availability of certified copies for proceedings.

Support the Lead in organizing and managing regulatory files and references for efficient access and review.

Identify opportunities for streamlining regulatory processes and propose improvements to current systems.

Participate in the implementation of technological solutions that enhance the efficiency and accuracy of regulatory monitoring and reporting .

Key Stakeholders - Internal

GDGC

ABEX Team

Finance team

Legal team

Commercial team

Regulatory team for transmission, thermal, AEML team

Key Stakeholders - External

Advocates/lawyers

Regulatory authorities/governmental agencies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

B.E./ B.Tech/ Masters ( Power Management, related field), Additional Certifications in regulatory affairs or compliance preferred

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 5 years of experience in regulatory compliance, preferably in power and transmission or related field.

Preferred Industry:

Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to power and transmission industry, with an understanding of regulatory challenges and compliance mechanisms.

job.title: Team Lead Insurance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Risk Transfer Strategy Execution & Insurance Management

  • Lead the assessment of emerging global risks, including climate-related, cyber, and geopolitical risks, to ensure the group’s insurance portfolio remains adaptive.
  • Support the Group Head in the reinsurance procurement process for high-value and complex risks, collaborating with reinsurers to secure optimal coverage for emerging risks.
  • Lead the insurance needs analysis for new assets, acquisitions, and business ventures by coordinating with business units and technical teams to assess operational risks.
  • Ensure proper coverage for all new acquisitions and ventures by engaging with local insurers and reinsurers.
  • Ensure timely endorsements for new assets or additional coverage needs, minimizing exposure to risk by guaranteeing that insurance is in place before assets become operational.

Comprehensive Insurance Renewal

  • Lead the annual insurance renewal process for all assets and liabilities, ensuring that insurance terms are reviewed and adjusted based on changes in asset values and risk profiles.
  • Collaborate with the CFO (Chief Financial Officer) and Financial Controller to ensure approval of the renewal strategy before proceeding to market, and maintain constant communication to update them on any changes.
  • Engage with the market to obtain competitive renewal terms, negotiating directly with insurers and reinsurers to achieve the best possible premium rates and coverage conditions.

Request for Proposals (RFPs) Management

  • Manage the preparation and issuance of Request for Proposals (RFPs) for various types of insurance, ensuring clear communication of the group’s requirements to insurers.
  • Lead the creation of NFAs (Notes for Approval) to ensure adherence with corporate governance standards.

Claims Management & Settlements

  • Lead the claims management process, ensuring efficient assessment, documentation, and settlement in compliance with policy terms.
  • Collaborate with third-party adjusters and surveyors to ensure accurate claims evaluation and timely settlement.
  • Lead the development of data analytics framework for forecasting claims trends, improving decision-making, and reducing the risk of future claims.
  • Lead the digitization of policy and claims documentation, ensuring all records are easily accessible and stored in a central repository.

Market Relations

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local and global insurers, reinsurers, and InsurTech companies to secure competitive quotes and favourable terms.
  • Negotiate with insurance brokers to ensure alignment between the group’s risk profile and available coverage.
  • Actively engage with facultative reinsurers when necessary, securing reinsurance policies either through direct outreach or intermediaries to cover high-value or complex risks.

Insurance Operations & Process Standardization

  • Lead the execution of standardization of insurance processes across the organization, ensuring consistency in policy procurement, claims reporting, and documentation management.
  • Supervise the development and integration of standardized insurance-related forms, ensuring compliance and efficiency across business units.

Negotiation and Finalization of Insurance Policies

  • Lead multi-round negotiations with insurers to finalize terms for both new policies and renewals, focusing on achieving the best coverage limits, deductibles, and premiums.
  • Ensure accurate communication of risk details and coverage to the insurers.

Corporate Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with insurance regulations, including SEBI, IRDAI, and regional standards, across the group’s insurance activities.
  • Lead preparation of compliance reports, including insurance certifications and auditor reports for statutory filings.
  • Work closely with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all insurance contracts align with corporate policies and regulatory standards.

Risk Identification & Business Interface

  • Lead identification of new and emerging risks across the group’s operations, ensuring effective mitigation strategies are implemented.
  • Lead the establishment of a robust third-party risk management framework, ensuring vendors, suppliers, and contractors working with the group are covered by appropriate liability insurance.
  • Collaborate with business units to update the insurance portfolio, addressing changes in the risk landscape.

Digitization and Automation

  • Lead the digitization of the insurance function, including the development of a centralized bid management system to streamline procurement and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Drive automation of insurance-related processes, including the development of a digital insurance management system to generate automated workflows for claims management, premium payments, and coverage renewals.
  • Integrate AI-driven tools for predictive risk modelling to optimize coverage, minimize premium costs, and improve operational efficiency.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

  • Align with the Group Head Insurance on market trends, pricing shifts, and underwriting criteria that could impact the group’s strategies.
  • Collaborate with internal departments (finance, legal, technical) to ensure alignment between insurance requirements and business objectives.
  • Liaise with the legal department to ensure policy interpretations are aligned with business interests.
  • Manage the interface between business units and insurers, ensuring seamless communication regarding evolving insurance needs.

People and Team Management

  • Ensure insurance team members are aligned with business strategy and insurance objectives, providing them with career development opportunities.
  • Oversee team performance, supporting continuous development and departmental excellence in line with organizational goals.
  • Cultivate an environment conducive to collaboration, enabling the team to thrive within the dynamic landscape of the energy sector.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Internal Stakeholders:

  • CFO (Chief Financial Officer)
  • Financial Controller
  • Business Unit Heads
  • Legal Team
  • ABEX Team
  • Technical Teams
  • Senior Leadership

External Stakeholders:

  • Local Insurance Companies
  • Reinsurers
  • Insurance Brokers
  • Surveyors and Loss Adjusters
  • Facultative Reinsurance Providers

Qualifications

Qualifications:

B.E./ B.Tech., Additional MBA in Insurance or additional insurance qualifications preferred

Experience:

Minimum 12 - 14 years of experience in corporate insurance, underwriting, or risk management roles, with significant experience in negotiating with insurers and reinsurers.

Industry Preferred:

Background in Power and Energy sector preferred with an understanding of both local and international insurance markets and the ability to engage with facultative reinsurers for complex risks.

job.title: Head Design & Approvals - Real Estate Mixed use - Mumbai North Sahar
job.description:
Responsibilities

Purpose:

Adani Airport City is developing Mixed Use Real Estate Airport Cities including Retail, Office, Hotels, Convention Centre and Arena across various cities – Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Lucknow, Guwahati spanning over 22 Mn. Sft in the initial Phases

Head - Design  is responsible for leading and overseeing the development of innovative and sustainable design concepts that enhance airport infrastructure and passenger experiences. This role involves strategic planning, team leadership, and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to ensure design excellence and alignment with business goals. By leveraging industry best practices and advanced technologies, the Head of Design aims to create flexible, future-ready environments that optimize operational efficiency and support the airport's growth and sustainability objectives.

Strategic Leadership:

Continuously assess industry best practices and emerging trends to develop innovative design concepts for both greenfield and brownfield projects that enhance airport flexibility and future readiness.

Analyze key business drivers for design and create strategic plans that positively impact the airport's operational and financial performance.

Consultant Management:

Identify, select, and engage with local and global design consultants or consortia to ensure comprehensive coverage of the design scope.

Collaborate with senior leadership and consultants to prepare and deliver impactful design presentations to stakeholders.

Operational Excellence:

Develop and oversee effective design delivery strategies, continuously assessing and improving team strengths and weaknesses.

Establish systems for ongoing reviews of design consultants’ drawings in coordination with the in-house MEP design team, ensuring adherence to specifications.

Drive the implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) that define turnaround times (TATs) for design activities to ensure consistency and timely deliverables.

Interdepartmental Collaboration:

Foster close collaboration with internal stakeholders to align departmental goals and objectives, facilitating timely project delivery.

Develop proactive strategies to anticipate challenges and course corrections necessary for efficient departmental operations.

Project Management and Oversight:

Manage the entire lifecycle of Design projects from initiation through to launch and successful operations. Ensure that all design-related deliveries are timely, accurate, and aligned with stakeholder requirements, managing dependencies effectively.

Conduct frequent mission meetings to monitor progress, identify potential delays, and implement corrective actions as needed.

Address and resolve design-related queries and concerns from stakeholders promptly and effectively.

Sourcing and Product Development:

Work closely with the sourcing team to explore new products and technologies, maintaining a real-time database for continuous improvement in design.

Track project progress through design review meetings, internal reviews, and monthly progress assessments, ensuring accountability and transparency.

Reporting and Communication:

Ensure preparations of comprehensive reports and presentations for various departments and the CEO’s office, highlighting design delivery performance and project updates.

Ensure that design outputs align with stakeholder expectations, providing detailed lifecycle estimates and cost impacts for alternative proposals and new technologies.

Budget Management:

Monitor and ensure that design activities align with project budgets and estimates, maintaining strict oversight of financial performance.

Maintain vigilance over design changes, facilitating timely discussions to prevent budget overruns and ensure adherence to approved financial plans.

Oversee the profit and loss (P&L) of the design department, ensuring financial accountability and sustainability.

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead and mentor an in-house design management team, fostering a culture of high-quality design delivery and collaboration.

Encourage participation in external training programs, conferences, and industry events to keep the team updated on best practices and emerging trends.

Digital Mindset:

Advocate for the adoption of advanced digital tools and technologies (e.g., BIM, GIS, VR) to enhance design processes and improve efficiency.

Promote a culture of data-driven decision-making within the design team, encouraging the use of analytics to inform design choices and project strategies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Project Director at respective assets

Senior Management of the Group

CPAG Team

PMAG

PPC Team

Planning Team

Legal and Compliance Teams

Finance and Budgeting Teams

Urban Planning Authorities

Real Estate Developers

Design and business Consultants

Construction Contractors

Environmental Regulatory Bodies

Community Representatives

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

A Master’s degree in Urban Design, Architecture, or a related field is preferred.

Certifications such as PMP (Project Management Professional) and LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) are advantageous. Certifications available in India include NICMAR’s Project Management Certification and IGBC’s Accredited Professional Certification.

Work Experience:

18+ years of experience in architectural design and urban planning

Experience in Greenfield project development.

Experience in planning & design management of mixed use development, hotels, retail mall, offices, convention centres, terminals and ATC.

job.description:

Establish and oversee project governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and quality standards.

Develop and track key project performance indicators (KPIs) to measure project success and identify areas for improvement.

Project Delivery & Execution:

Manage end-to-end execution of airport construction, expansion, and modernization projects, ensuring adherence to scope, timelines, and budget.

Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, including consultants, contractors, and government authorities, to facilitate seamless project execution.

Oversee risk management initiatives, proactively identifying and mitigating potential risks that could impact project delivery.

Ensure adherence to high-quality construction standards, sustainability goals, and regulatory compliance throughout the project lifecycle.

Financial & Resource Management:

Prepare detailed project budgets, monitor ongoing costs, and ensure financial control throughout the project lifecycle. Monitor project CAPEX, OPEX and resource allocation to maintain profitability.

Provide accurate and timely financial reports to senior management, ensuring transparency and accountability in project spending.

Conduct financial performance analysis and post-project evaluations to ensure projects meet financial goals and ROI targets.

Stakeholder Engagement:

Act as the primary point of contact for key internal stakeholders, including senior management, legal, compliance, finance, and operations teams.

Build and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders, including investors, developers, contractors, government agencies, and regulatory bodies.

Facilitate collaboration between cross-functional teams to ensure project objectives are met, fostering a cohesive and efficient work environment.

Work closely with the marketing and leasing teams to ensure alignment between development plans and commercial strategies.

Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management:

Ensure all projects comply with local, state, and federal regulations, including environmental, safety, zoning, and construction codes.

Oversee the permitting and licensing process for each project, ensuring all necessary approvals are obtained in a timely manner.

Develop and implement risk management strategies to address potential issues that could impact project timelines, costs, or quality.

Lead efforts in compliance with sustainability and environmental standards, minimizing environmental impact during project execution.

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of project managers, engineers, and technical staff.

Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence within the project management team.

Provide training and development opportunities for team members to enhance skills and professional growth.

Set clear goals and KPIs for the team and monitor performance to ensure project success.

Sustainability:

Integrate sustainability principles into construction and development projects, including carbon reduction, energy efficiency, and waste management.

Lead initiatives to achieve green certifications and promote environmental stewardship.

Digital Mindset & Innovation:

job.title: Section Head - Fire & Safety
job.description:
Responsibilities

Section Head Fire

Fire Safety Management:

Oversee fire safety for high-risk areas, particularly fuel storage zones, to prevent fire incidents.

Ensure the standardization of firefighting equipment and appliances, maintaining readiness at all times.

Lead fire risk assessments and implement control management strategies to meet international benchmarks.

Liaise with neighbouring fire services and other agencies like Mutual Aid Response Group (MARG) for collaborative efforts.

Conduct SRFA audits and facilitate technical audits at site.

Develop and manage the budget for the fire safety department, ensuring cost-effective resource allocation.

Plan and prepare technical specifications for fire-fighting equipment and appliances according to existing code of practice in fire service.

Emergency Response and Training:

Manage the fire team during emergencies, providing leadership in fire and rescue operations.

Organize regular fire drills, mock drills, and disaster management exercises to ensure staff preparedness.

Develop and maintain SOPs for firefighting equipment and life-saving gear, ensuring high adequacy and readiness.

Conduct fire incident investigations and carry out mitigation plans for hazardous processes.

Train all security, fire and safety staff, as well as employees, on first aid, firefighting, and evacuation procedures.

Ensure the completion of mandatory training as per CEA regulation for all fire safety personnel.

Actively contribute to the Emergency Preparedness part in the PSM subcommittee.

Observe National Fire Service Week, ensuring participation and event organization.

Ensure active participation in CEC-FPM as a committee member.

Equipment and Infrastructure Oversight:

Ensure the development and maintenance of fire stations and the fire service fleet.

Plan and prepare technical specifications for firefighting equipment, maintaining critical spares and consumables.

Facilitate technical audits at the site and ensure the maintenance of fire protection systems.

Ensure maintenance of the fire service vehicles.

Business Sustainability:

Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Ensure the implementation of Business Excellence initiatives like 5S, QC, IMS, etc.

Maintain safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.

Follow up on audit compliances conducted by the Fire Safety team.

Ensure strict adherence to statutory compliances as per applicable mandates and the Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act.

Conduct detailed reviews and audits of firefighting systems as per OISD, BIS, TAC, NFPA, and NBC guidelines.

Document fire service activities in compliance with statutory regulations, prepare and submit monthly MIS and ORT data.

Ensure working on SAP and other modules as per requirement of Fire Safety.

Digitization and Automation:

job.title: Senior Manager - Quality
job.description:
Responsibilities

Head FQA

Operational Excellence:

  • Develop and execute strategic and tactical plans in collaboration with peers and section heads ensuring healthiness and 100% availability of all the systems.
  • Ensure implementation of Root Cause Analysis (RCA) action points to minimize boiler tube leakages (BTLs) and improve reliability of the units.
  • Monitor and ensure timely Boiler Tube Leakage (BTL) inspection checks and Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) to prevent tube leakages.
  • Ensure material dispatch clearance in a timely manner for smooth operations.
  • Assign mechanical, electrical, and civil engineers to appropriate project phases, as required.
  • Oversee regular maintenance, including planned and unplanned overhauling, to enhance O&M performance.
  • Implement modification/station excellence projects at various stages, including fit-up, welding, alignment, pre-heating, PWHT, and NDT (DPT, MPT, RT, UT).
  • Implement welder qualification tests during shutdown/AOH/COH to maintain high-quality standards.
  • Ensure FQA (Field Quality Assurance) plans are followed and equipment are in healthy condition for site inspections round the clock.
  • Conduct all civil quality inspections at the site, ensuring structural integrity.

Quality Assurance and Control:

  • Implement QA protocols during spares procurement for various departments to ensure compliance with quality standards.
  • Review and approve various Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs) tailored to site requirements.
  • Implement Pre-dispatch inspection of spares/materials at vendor premises.
  • Ensure all inspections during regular maintenance, Reserved Shut Down (RSD), and Annual/Capital Overhauling (AOH/COH) are conducted as per QAP/Checklist/past learnings.

Budget Management:

  • Review and manage the department's budget, ensuring cost-effective procurement and resource allocation.
  • Monitor and control expenses related to quality assurance activities and maintenance operations.
  • Ensure accurate forecasting and budgeting for spares, materials, and equipment required for quality inspections.
  • Provide financial reports and analysis to senior management regarding quality-related expenditures.
  • Collaborate with Techno Commercial and F&A department to negotiate contracts and manage vendor relationships for cost-effectiveness.

Business Sustainability:

  • Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.
  • Implement and maintain standards, systems, and procedures as per IMS and 5S within the department.
  • Maintain the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols, as per CHETNA and achieve zero harm.
  • Comply with all legal requirements of department activities in a timely manner.

Digitization and Automation:

  • Lead and execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency.
  • Innovate and implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals/strategy.
  • Review and implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.
  • Brainstorm and adopt new technologies and innovations to enhance the quality process.
  • Ensure the integration of advanced technology and digitization within the department's operations.
  • Leverage data analytics and digital tools to improve quality assurance and control measures.

People and Team Engagement:

  • Participate in the recruitment process to attract and retain skilled personnel for the FQA team.
  • Conduct quality trainings and awareness sessions for maintenance engineers, contract engineers, and vendors.
  • Drive and enhance employee engagement across the team to sustain a positive workplace culture and ensure high employee retention.
  • Lead, inspire, and mentor the team to foster a high-performance culture and ensure cross-skilling through job rotation, technical, and behavioural trainings.
  • Ensure proper succession planning in the team.
  • Encourage innovation and continuous improvement by empowering team members to contribute ideas and solutions.

  • Techno Commercial

job.title: Senior Engineer - Quality
job.description:
Responsibilities

Composite Materials Quality Assurance:

  • Conduct thorough inspections and testing of composite materials to ensure they meet the required standards for blade moulding.
  • Collaborate with material suppliers to address any quality issues and to improve the material properties for enhanced blade performance.

Inspection of Blade Moulding Processes

  • Conduct in-process inspections during blade molding, focusing on critical parameters such as fiber layup, resin application, and curing profiles.
  • Use specialized equipment such as laser scanners and ultrasound probes to detect defects like delamination's, voids, and improper fiber orientations.

Monitoring Moulding Parameters

  • Monitor key molding parameters, including temperature, pressure, and vacuum levels, ensuring they are within specified limits for optimal blade quality.
  • Adjust process settings as needed to prevent defects and ensure consistent quality throughout the blade.

Non-Conformance Management and Corrective Actions

  • Identify and document non-conformances in molding and finishing processes, coordinating with production teams to implement corrective actions.
  • Utilize root cause analysis techniques such as Fishbone Diagrams and 5-Why Analysis to address defects in the blade manufacturing process.

Supplier Material Validation

  • Inspect incoming materials for molding, including fiberglass and resins, ensuring they meet specifications for strength, flexibility, and moisture content.
  • Conduct sample testing of materials to verify consistency and suitability for the molding process.

Documentation and Reporting of Inspection Results

  • Maintain detailed records of all molding inspections, including process parameters, defect observations, and corrective actions taken.
  • Ensure inspection reports are accurately completed and available for quality audits and process reviews.

Support for Process Improvement

  • Support for the new material trials in moulding, collect and record the trial data and submit the report to supplier quality. Provide feedback on molding process performance, identifying areas for improvement and suggesting changes to enhance blade quality.
  • Participate in process trials for new materials and technologies, assessing their impact on molding quality.

Compliance with Moulding Standards

  • Ensure all molding processes comply with relevant standards such as IEC 61400-23 and internal specifications for blade manufacturing.
  • Stay updated on new molding techniques and best practices to continuously improve process control and quality.

Team Collaboration and Support

  • Work closely with production operators to ensure quality requirements are clearly understood and implemented during the molding process.
  • Assist in training operators and inspectors on the correct use of inspection tools and adherence to quality standards.

Safety and Process Adherence

  • Follow all safety protocols during inspections, including handling of chemicals and operation of molding equipment.
  • Ensure that all molding activities are conducted in accordance with standard operating procedures and quality guidelines.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Lead - Finishing /Moulding/ Supplier (QA Blade)
  • Moulding Inspector (QA Blade)
  • Head - Supplier Quality Mechanical (QA)
  • Executive - Mould Installation
  • Engineer - Finishing (QA Blade)
  • Lead - Industrialization / Blade Process
  • Blade Production
  • Blade Process / tooling
  • Blade Engineering

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • External auditors
  • Calibration Laboratory

Qualifications

Educational Background:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or Materials Science.

Work Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in quality assurance for molding processes in composite or blade manufacturing.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Expertise in molding inspection techniques, process control, and compliance with relevant manufacturing standards.
