job.title: AI Product Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

P

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI products in finance, from ideation and requirement gathering to deployment, scaling, and continuous product development.
  • Drive comprehensive business process reengineering by identifying high-value opportunities for AI integration within existing financial workflows and SAP environments.
  • Design and author detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), and Statements of Work (SoWs) for enterprise AI initiatives.
  • Orchestrate SAP integration for critical financial modules (e.g., Order-to-Cash, Treasury) and manage third-party system integrations via secure APIs.
  • Calculate, track, and present ROI for AI projects to ensure strict alignment with financial objectives and strategic business growth.
  • Manage the development, scope, and implementation of foundational AI agents, optimizing business flows and generating precise user stories.
  • Lead Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and scope management for cross-functional technical teams.
  • Act as the primary liaison for stakeholder management across finance, engineering, and executive leadership, ensuring seamless communication.
  • Oversee vendor management, collaborating with external technical partners to align solution designing with internal architectural standards and API integration protocols.

Domain Expertise & Operational Tools

  • Strong capability in solution designing, mapping business flows, and translating complex technical requirements into actionable business value.
  • Fundamental understanding in enterprise SAP environments and orchestrating third-party system interoperability via APIs.
  • Fundamental understanding of Cloud Architecture basics (e.g., AWS, Azure) to effectively guide AI deployment strategies.
  • Basic proficiency in Agile project management platforms (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps) for sprint planning and user story management.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing critical decisions across diverse technical and financial teams.
  • Effective and clear communication skills, adept at articulating complex AI product visions and API integration timelines to non-technical business leaders.

job.title: Category Lead C&L (Import)
job.description:
Responsibilities

On-Time Shipment Clearance: Ensure timely custom clearance of imported shipments to facilitate prompt delivery to the plant. Coordinate with relevant parties to minimize delays. Minimize Detention, Interest, and Penalty Charges for Import Shipment: Achieve customs clearance without incurring detention charges by optimizing processes and adhering to timelines, thus avoiding additional costs. Vendor Payment: Oversee timely payments to suppliers to maintain good relationships and ensure the smooth flow of materials. Monitor payment cycles to prevent disruptions. Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to customs regulations and compliance requirements. Regularly audit processes to prevent non-compliance and its associated risks. Availing Duty Benefits: Maximize utilization of available duty benefit schemes, including Advance License, EPCG, and IGCR. Ensure proper documentation and compliance to leverage these benefits effectively. Innovation: Integrating advanced technologies, such as automation and AI, to streamline customs clearance processes, enhance logistics operations, and improve efficiency across the supply chain. Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making: Driving the adoption of digital tools like customs management systems, shipment tracking platforms, and predictive analytics to optimize logistics workflows and make informed, datad-riven decisions. Organizational & Culture Building: Fostering a culture of compliance, efficiency, and collaboration by empowering teams with the knowledge and tools to align with customs regulations and company logistics goals. Leadership in Change Management: Leading the implementation of new technologies and processes, ensuring smooth transitions and minimal disruption during changes. People Development: Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions. Key Stakeholders - Internal: · Shift Incharge - Import Logistics · Import Team · Procurement Department · Logistics Team Key Stakeholders - External: · Suppliers · Customs Authorities · Freight Forwarders · Importers

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Work Experience (Range of years): 8-12 years of experience in import logistics, including experience in managing import processes and teams, with strong knowledge of customs regulations.

job.title: Deputy Manager- Quality Assurance & Control
job.description:
Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Inspection:

  • Coordinate and conduct site inspections with O&M engineers as per quality procedures, codes, and standards.
  • Execute all inspection activities of BTG and BOP, including PDI of materials and spares.

  • Conduct visual inspections and witness various Destructive and Non-Destructive Testing (DPT, MPT, UT, RT) to verify equipment integrity.
  • Execute inspections and thickness surveys of boiler pressure parts, coal bunkers, APH, HP and LP Valves, rotary parts, etc.

  • Provide support for third-party inspections and certifications of safety equipment and healthiness of equipment.

job.description:

  • Coordinate with contractors and service providers to carry out maintenance tasks, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs, ensuring these are readily available for review.
  • Implement best practices in maintenance management, contributing to continuous improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Analyze system data and performance metrics to identify potential areas for improvement and to prevent future operational disruptions.

job.title: Assistant Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

Mold Design and Fabrication

  • Lead the design and fabrication of main molds for wind turbine blades, utilizing CAD software and advanced molding techniques to ensure precise geometry and structural integrity.
  • Oversee the creation of detailed mold specifications, including core material configurations and mold surface treatments.

Mold Maintenance and Calibration

  • Develop and implement maintenance schedules for molds, including periodic inspections, cleaning, and repairs to maintain mold accuracy and performance.
  • Calibrate molds and related equipment to ensure consistent dimensional accuracy and optimal production results.

Process Integration and Optimization

  • Ensure seamless integration of molds into the blade production process, coordinating with pre-fabrication and post-mold teams to achieve efficient workflows.
  • Optimize mold processes, including alignment and resin flow, to enhance production efficiency and blade quality.

Quality Control and Assurance

  • Conduct thorough inspections of molds and finished blades, using tools such as CMM and laser scanners to verify compliance with design specifications and quality standards.
  • Address and resolve any quality issues related to mold performance, implementing corrective measures to prevent defects.

Equipment Operation and Maintenance

  • Operate and maintain mold fabrication and processing equipment, including CNC mills and injection molding systems, ensuring proper functionality and performance.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs to prevent equipment downtime and ensure consistent production.

Safety and Compliance

  • Implement and enforce safety protocols related to mold handling, including proper use of PPE and safe operation of heavy machinery.
  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations and standards, maintaining accurate documentation and facilitating regular audits.

Process Improvement and Innovation

  • Identify opportunities for process improvements in mold design and production, including the integration of new technologies and materials to enhance mold performance and efficiency.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and advancements to incorporate best practices and innovative solutions.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain comprehensive records of mold design, fabrication, maintenance, and performance data.
  • Prepare and submit detailed reports on mold-related activities, including any issues encountered and resolutions implemented.

Training and Development

  • Provide training and support to junior engineers and production staff on mold design, operation, and maintenance.
  • Share expertise and knowledge to enhance team skills and overall production capabilities.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Pre Fab Engineer
  • Head - Production
  • Lead - Tooling
  • Maintenance Lead - Mechanical

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Tooling Suppliers
  • Calibration Service Providers
  • Material Suppliers

Qualifications

Educational Background:

  • B. Tech/BE in Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Engineering.

Work Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in mold design and maintenance within a composite manufacturing environment.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Proficiency in mold design, fabrication techniques, and integration into production processes in the wind energy sector.

job.title: Lead - C&I Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation Engineer AHP and Water circuit (BoP)

System Availability and Maintenance:

Manage the continuous availability and reliability of Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Ash Handling Plant (AHP) and water treatment systems including analysers.

Conduct regular maintenance activities for AHP and water treatment systems to prevent system failures and ensure optimal performance.

Schedule and perform regular backups of PLC systems to safeguard against data loss and system downtime.

Manage the timely calibration of weighbridges and road weighbridges to ensure accurate measurements and compliance with regulatory standards.

Coordinate with contract manpower for on-field maintenance of AHP and water treatment systems to maintain system efficiency.

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability.

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes.

Budget, Inventory and Documentation Management:

Provide requirements of C&I systems for AHP and water treatment systems, to ensure effective budget planning.

Manage spares and inventory, including the development of indigenous spares for cost optimization.

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department, promoting a culture of sustainability.

Develop the skills of Contract Supervisors and Technicians through knowledge sharing to build a competent workforce.

Maintain the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols.

Ensure the implementation of and compliance with proper work permit systems to maintain operational safety and efficiency.

Implement filed related ZFO to eliminate human error and maintain operational excellence.

Maintain a thorough understanding of PLC systems for AHP and water treatment systems to ensure compliance with technical specifications.

Manage contractor safety and oversee departmental business associates to ensure a safe working environment.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency within the C&I systems domain.

Implement automation solutions to support the overall organizational goals and strategy.

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas to stay ahead of industry trends.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Key Stakeholders - External:

Vendor

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree.

Work Experience (Range of years):

6+ years of experience in control and instrumentation within the power plant or heavy industry sector.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in power generation, with exposure to BoP (Balance of Plant) operations including coal handling plant, water treatment plant and ash handling plant, CCTV, PA systems, FDA systems, etc.

job.title: Associate Manager - C&I Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation Engineer AHP and Water circuit (BoP)

System Availability and Maintenance:

Manage the continuous availability and reliability of Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Ash Handling Plant (AHP) and water treatment systems including analysers.

Conduct regular maintenance activities for AHP and water treatment systems to prevent system failures and ensure optimal performance.

Schedule and perform regular backups of PLC systems to safeguard against data loss and system downtime.

Manage the timely calibration of weighbridges and road weighbridges to ensure accurate measurements and compliance with regulatory standards.

Coordinate with contract manpower for on-field maintenance of AHP and water treatment systems to maintain system efficiency.

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes.

Budget, Inventory and Documentation Management:

Provide requirements of C&I systems for AHP and water treatment systems, to ensure effective budget planning.

Manage spares and inventory, including the development of indigenous spares for cost optimization.

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section.

Develop the skills of Contract Supervisors and Technicians through knowledge sharing to build a competent workforce.

Maintain the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols.

Ensure the implementation of and compliance with proper work permit systems to maintain operational safety and efficiency.

Implement filed related ZFO to eliminate human error and maintain operational excellence.

Maintain a thorough understanding of PLC systems for AHP and water treatment systems to ensure compliance with technical specifications.

Manage contractor safety and oversee departmental business associates to ensure a safe working environment.

job.title: Lead - Security
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • The Lead Security will be entrusted with comprehensive responsibilities that ensure the integrity and safety of the entire thermal power facility.
  • These include:
  • Developing and implementing strategic security policies and procedures tailored to the specific needs of the thermal power industry, ensuring alignment with Adani’s corporate governance and compliance requirements.
  • Leading a multidisciplinary security team, including security officers, surveillance operators, and emergency response personnel, fostering a culture of accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement.
  • Conducting thorough risk assessments and vulnerability analyses to identify potential security threats and mitigate them proactively by deploying advanced security technologies and physical controls.
  • Overseeing access control systems to safeguard critical infrastructure and ensuring that all personnel, contractors, and visitors adhere to security protocols without impeding operational efficiency.
  • Coordinating with local law enforcement, fire departments, and emergency services to establish strong partnerships and effective response mechanisms during incidents or emergencies.
  • Managing incident response planning and execution, including drills, investigations, and reporting, to minimize impact and facilitate swift resolution of security breaches or threats.
  • Ensuring compliance with national and international safety regulations, environmental guidelines, and industry best practices, incorporating these standards into daily security operations and audits.
  • Spearheading employee training programs on security awareness, emergency preparedness, and behavioral safety to enhance the overall security posture and embed a risk-conscious culture.
  • Collaborating closely with IT and cybersecurity teams to integrate physical and cyber security strategies, safeguarding sensitive operational data and control systems against evolving threats.
  • Preparing detailed reports and presentations for senior management and stakeholders, providing insights and recommendations to optimize security investments and resource allocation.
  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging security technologies, trends, and legislative changes, advocating for innovative solutions to maintain Adani’s leadership in security excellence.
  • Championing diversity and inclusion within the security team by promoting equitable opportunities and respect for all team members.
  • Ensuring alignment of security objectives with Adani’s sustainability goals by adopting environmentally responsible security practices and technologies.
  • Managing budgets, contracts, and vendor relationships related to security equipment, services, and maintenance, optimizing cost-efficiency without compromising quality.
  • Acting as the primary point of contact for all security-related audits, inspections, and compliance checks, facilitating smooth and transparent evaluations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Security Management, Engineering, Criminal Justice, or related discipline - Advanced degrees or diplomas in security, risk management, or industrial safety will be an advantage
  • Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in security management within the Thermal Power or heavy industrial sectors
  • Proven track record of managing large-scale security teams and implementing security systems in high-risk environments
  • Experience in compliance with industrial safety and regulatory standards relevant to power plants

job.title: Site Head - Talabira
job.description:
Responsibilities

Mines Manager or Site Head - Coal Mining

Mine Operations & Production Management:

Oversee daily mining operations, ensuring production targets are met while maintaining safety, environmental, and regulatory compliance.

Supervise drilling, blasting, excavation, and transportation activities to optimize efficiency and minimize downtime.

Implement cost-effective measures to enhance operational performance and stay within allocated budgets.

Monitor and evaluate mining equipment performance, ensuring timely maintenance and repairs to prevent delays.

Develop and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to streamline mining processes.

Pre-Construction Planning & Regulatory Compliance:

Lead pre-construction activities, ensuring all statutory clearances, including environmental and forest approvals, are obtained.

Liaise with regulatory bodies such as DGMS, Pollution Control Board, and State Mining Offices to secure necessary permits.

Manage land acquisition challenges and ensure smooth transition processes for mining operations.

Develop and implement a comprehensive Safety Management Plan in compliance with DGMS norms, MMDR Act, and environmental laws.

Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and training programs to ensure a zero-accident workplace.

Resource Allocation & Cost Management:

Strategically deploy personnel and equipment to maximize efficiency and achieve production goals.

Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules to reduce equipment downtime.

Ensure proper inventory management for spare parts and consumables to avoid disruptions in operations.

Monitor project expenditures, identify cost-saving opportunities, and ensure financial alignment with budgetary constraints.

Innovation & Digital Transformation:

Drive the adoption of digital tools such as pit-to-plant digitization to enhance transparency and decision-making.

Implement advanced mechanization practices and data analytics to improve operational efficiency.

Collaborate with IT and engineering teams to integrate innovative technologies into mining operations.

Regularly evaluate digital platforms to optimize performance and align with business objectives.

Stakeholder & Team Management:

Liaise with internal teams, including engineering, logistics, finance, and HR, to align operational goals with business strategies.

Manage relationships with external stakeholders such as contractors, regulatory authorities, and community representatives.

Ensure clear communication and periodic updates on project progress and operational challenges.

Resolve disputes and monitor contractor performance to maintain adherence to project timelines.

Safety & Environmental Governance:

Promote a strong safety culture by enforcing adherence to safety protocols and industry best practices.

Lead incident investigations and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.

Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, including waste management, air quality monitoring, and sustainability initiatives.

Stay updated on the latest regulatory developments affecting mining operations.

Employees

Forest Department

job.title: Senior Manager - Cell Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Comprehensive Preventive Maintenance:

  • Develop and implement preventive maintenance strategies for all clusters and tools to enhance performance and reliability, and to reduce unexpected breakdowns.

Predictive Maintenance:

  • Develop and implement predictive maintenance strategies for all clusters and tools to predict the upcoming failure and plan in preventive maintenance Plan.

Tool Management and Coordination:

  • Oversee the maintenance, calibration, and operational readiness of all tools across clusters, coordinating with teams to ensure tools are functioning within specifications.

Cross-Cluster Integration:

  • Ensure seamless coordination between different clusters and maintenance teams, facilitating effective communication and integration of maintenance efforts across all areas.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of preventive maintenance activities, tool conditions, check sheets and repair histories. Prepare and present regular reports on maintenance performance and compliance.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify opportunities for process improvements in maintenance practices. Implement enhancements based on performance data, feedback, and industry best practices to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions):

  • Manage the CAPA process by investigating maintenance issues, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective and preventive actions to address and prevent recurring problems. Document and track CAPA progress and effectiveness.

Safety Protocol Compliance:

  • Ensure all maintenance activities adhere to established safety protocols and regulations. Regularly review and update safety procedures, conduct safety audits, and provide training to ensure a safe working environment during Preventive maintenance.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and mentor the maintenance and repair team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high performance and adherence to best practices.

Quality Assurance:

  • Monitor and enforce quality standards in maintenance activities to ensure tools and equipment meet performance and reliability criteria.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Maintenance Technicians
  • Production Managers
  • Quality Assurance Teams
  • Operations Managers

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Equipment Manufacturers
  • Service Providers
  • Maintenance Contractors
  • Regulatory Bodies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • 8-12 Years of experience in years in maintenance management, including at least 3 years in a leadership role.

job.title: Associate General Manager - Talent Acquisition
job.description:
Responsibilities

1. Strategic Talent Acquisition

  • Partner with business leaders and HRBPs to understand workforce needs and develop proactive hiring strategies.
  • Lead full-cycle recruitment for mid to senior-level roles, ensuring quality and timely hiring.
  • Analyze talent market trends and provide insights to improve sourcing strategies.
  • Drive employer branding initiatives to enhance the company’s visibility and attractiveness in the talent market.

2. Recruitment Operations & Process Excellence

  • Oversee job postings, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management.
  • Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job portals, and other sourcing partners.
  • Implement and optimize ATS and recruitment tools for efficiency and data accuracy.
  • Track and report recruitment metrics (TAT, cost-per-hire, source effectiveness, etc.) to leadership.

3. Onboarding & Candidate Experience

  • Design and execute structured onboarding programs in collaboration with HR, Admin, IT, and Security.
  • Ensure seamless Day-1 readiness including documentation, system access, and induction.
  • Continuously improve onboarding experience based on feedback and best practices.

4. Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulations in all hiring practices.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready documentation for all recruitment and onboarding activities.
  • Support internal and external audits related to hiring processes.

5. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Mentor and guide junior recruiters and support staff.
  • Act as a point of contact for business leaders on all talent acquisition matters.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with HR, Admin, IT, and Finance for smooth hiring and onboarding.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Experience: 15-20 years of progressive experience in talent acquisition, preferably in a mid-to-large scale organization.
  • Preferred Exposure: Experience in managing bulk hiring, niche roles, and leadership hiring.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Expertise in sourcing strategies, interview techniques, and recruitment analytics.
  • Proficiency in ATS, HRIS systems, and MS Office Suite.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on execution mindset.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Environment
job.description:
Responsibilities

Environmental Compliance & Regulatory Management

  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, and statutory requirements issued by CPCB, SPCB, MoEF&CC, CGWA, and other regulatory authorities.
  • Monitor adherence to Environmental Clearance (EC), Consent to Operate (CTO), Consent to Establish (CTE), and other statutory conditions.
  • Coordinate with government agencies and regulatory bodies for inspections, audits, approvals, and compliance reporting.
  • Ensure timely submission of statutory environmental reports and returns.

Environmental Monitoring

  • Monitor ambient air quality, stack emissions, water quality, effluent discharge, noise levels, and other environmental parameters.
  • Ensure effective operation and monitoring of pollution control systems such as ESP, FGD, ETP, STP, Dust Suppression Systems, and Ash Handling Systems.
  • Analyze environmental data and initiate corrective actions to address deviations.

Ash & Waste Management

  • Ensure compliance with Fly Ash Utilization norms and related statutory requirements.
  • Monitor hazardous waste, biomedical waste, used oil, e-waste, and solid waste management activities.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders for safe disposal and utilization of waste.

Audits & Sustainability Initiatives

  • Conduct internal environmental audits and coordinate external audits.
  • Implement environmental management systems in line with ISO 14001 standards.
  • Drive sustainability initiatives related to resource conservation, water management, waste reduction, carbon footprint reduction, and biodiversity management.
  • Identify opportunities for environmental performance improvement and cost optimization.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain environmental records, statutory registers, approvals, and compliance documents.
  • Prepare monthly MIS, compliance reports, presentations, and management updates.
  • Support environmental due diligence and risk assessment activities.

Stakeholder Management

  • Liaise with plant departments, regulatory authorities, consultants, and external agencies.
  • Support community and CSR-related environmental initiatives wherever required.
  • Provide guidance and awareness training to employees on environmental compliance and best practices.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering / Chemical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Civil Engineering.
  • Master's Degree/Diploma in Environmental Engineering or Environmental Management will be preferred.

job.title: PCS - Design
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities PCS Design & Development

  • Design and develop PCS architecture for BESS and renewable energy applications.
  • Define electrical specifications, single-line diagrams (SLD), and system configurations.
  • Select appropriate inverter, converter, transformer, switchgear, and protection equipment.
  • Develop technical specifications and engineering design documents.

System Engineering

  • Perform power system studies, load flow analysis, short-circuit analysis, and protection coordination.
  • Ensure seamless integration between PCS, Battery Management System (BMS), EMS, and SCADA.
  • Evaluate grid interconnection requirements and compliance standards.
  • Support system optimization for efficiency, reliability, and performance.

Design Validation & Testing

  • Develop validation plans and testing procedures.
  • Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and commissioning activities.
  • Analyze test data and resolve system performance issues.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards and regulations.

Technical Documentation

  • Prepare detailed engineering calculations and reports.
  • Develop design guidelines, operational manuals, and technical specifications.
  • Review vendor drawings and technical submissions.
  • Support certification and regulatory compliance activities.

Cross-Functional Coordination

job.title: Deputy Manager - Environment
job.description:
Responsibilities

Environmental Compliance & Regulatory Management

  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, and statutory requirements issued by CPCB, SPCB, MoEF&CC, CGWA, and other regulatory authorities.
  • Monitor adherence to Environmental Clearance (EC), Consent to Operate (CTO), Consent to Establish (CTE), and other statutory conditions.
  • Coordinate with government agencies and regulatory bodies for inspections, audits, approvals, and compliance reporting.
  • Ensure timely submission of statutory environmental reports and returns.

Environmental Monitoring

  • Monitor ambient air quality, stack emissions, water quality, effluent discharge, noise levels, and other environmental parameters.
  • Ensure effective operation and monitoring of pollution control systems such as ESP, FGD, ETP, STP, Dust Suppression Systems, and Ash Handling Systems.
  • Analyze environmental data and initiate corrective actions to address deviations.

Ash & Waste Management

  • Ensure compliance with Fly Ash Utilization norms and related statutory requirements.
  • Monitor hazardous waste, biomedical waste, used oil, e-waste, and solid waste management activities.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders for safe disposal and utilization of waste.

Audits & Sustainability Initiatives

  • Conduct internal environmental audits and coordinate external audits.
  • Implement environmental management systems in line with ISO 14001 standards.
  • Drive sustainability initiatives related to resource conservation, water management, waste reduction, carbon footprint reduction, and biodiversity management.
  • Identify opportunities for environmental performance improvement and cost optimization.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain environmental records, statutory registers, approvals, and compliance documents.
  • Prepare monthly MIS, compliance reports, presentations, and management updates.
  • Support environmental due diligence and risk assessment activities.

Stakeholder Management

  • Liaise with plant departments, regulatory authorities, consultants, and external agencies.
  • Support community and CSR-related environmental initiatives wherever required.
  • Provide guidance and awareness training to employees on environmental compliance and best practices.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering / Chemical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Civil Engineering.
  • Master's Degree/Diploma in Environmental Engineering or Environmental Management will be preferred.

Experience & Skills

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in Environment Management within Thermal Power Plants or heavy industries.
  • Strong knowledge of environmental laws, pollution control norms, EC compliance, and statutory requirements.
  • Experience in handling SPCB, CPCB, and MoEF&CC compliance matters.
  • Knowledge of fly ash utilization, water conservation, hazardous waste management, and environmental monitoring systems.
  • Familiarity with ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, data analysis, and compliance reporting.

job.title: Deputy General Manager - Talent Acquisition
job.description:
Responsibilities

1. Strategic Talent Acquisition

  • Partner with business leaders and HRBPs to understand workforce needs and develop proactive hiring strategies.
  • Lead full-cycle recruitment for mid to senior-level roles, ensuring quality and timely hiring.
  • Analyze talent market trends and provide insights to improve sourcing strategies.
  • Drive employer branding initiatives to enhance the company’s visibility and attractiveness in the talent market.

2. Recruitment Operations & Process Excellence

  • Oversee job postings, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management.
  • Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job portals, and other sourcing partners.
  • Implement and optimize ATS and recruitment tools for efficiency and data accuracy.
  • Track and report recruitment metrics (TAT, cost-per-hire, source effectiveness, etc.) to leadership.

3. Onboarding & Candidate Experience

  • Design and execute structured onboarding programs in collaboration with HR, Admin, IT, and Security.
  • Ensure seamless Day-1 readiness including documentation, system access, and induction.
  • Continuously improve onboarding experience based on feedback and best practices.

4. Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulations in all hiring practices.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready documentation for all recruitment and onboarding activities.
  • Support internal and external audits related to hiring processes.

5. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Mentor and guide junior recruiters and support staff.
  • Act as a point of contact for business leaders on all talent acquisition matters.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with HR, Admin, IT, and Finance for smooth hiring and onboarding.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Experience: 15-20 years of progressive experience in talent acquisition, preferably in a mid-to-large scale organization.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Expertise in sourcing strategies, interview techniques, and recruitment analytics.
  • Proficiency in ATS, HRIS systems, and MS Office Suite.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on execution mindset.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Instrumentation
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain instrumentation systems that ensure accurate measurement, control, and automation of production parameters in the copper manufacturing process.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of instrumentation-related issues to minimize downtime and enhance plant reliability.
  • Plan and supervise preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for instrumentation equipment such as sensors, transmitters, control valves, analyzers, and PLC/DCS interfaces.
  • Collaborate with production, maintenance, quality control, and safety teams to ensure instrumentation compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Execute calibration procedures and maintain records to guarantee optimal performance and traceability of instrumentation devices.
  • Support commissioning and start-up activities for new instrumentation installations or upgrades, ensuring smooth integration with existing systems.
  • Analyze instrumentation data and generate reports to assist in process optimization, energy efficiency initiatives, and cost reduction strategies.
  • Mentor and guide junior instrumentation engineers and technicians, fostering knowledge sharing and skills development within the team.
  • Drive continuous improvement projects focused on instrumentation reliability, accuracy, and automation to support Adani’s sustainability and innovation goals.
  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of emerging instrumentation technologies and industry best practices, recommending their adoption where beneficial.
  • Ensure adherence to Adani’s safety protocols and promote a culture of safety awareness in all instrumentation activities.
  • Manage vendor relationships and coordinate with external service providers for specialized instrumentation maintenance and calibration tasks.
  • Contribute to documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and training programs related to instrumentation systems.
  • Participate actively in internal and external audits to ensure compliance and identify areas for improvement

Qualifications

  • B.E/B,Tech Instrumentation / E&I / C&I or related field
  • Over 2 years of progressive experience in instrumentation engineering, preferably within the copper manufacturing or heavy process industry
  • Proficient in the design, installation, and maintenance of industrial instrumentation systems specific to copper manufacturing processes

job.title: Lead - C&I Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Boiler)

Operational Excellence and Equipment Reliability:

Monitor the availability and functionality of all C&I systems related to Boiler area including firing systems, Mill fan, ASLD, CAMS, and MOV.

Conduct routine maintenance of MOV, Boiler, and Auxiliaries to prevent equipment failures.

Execute timely overhauls of the Boiler systems to maintain operational integrity.

Troubleshoot and rectify breakdowns of equipment to ensure continuous operation.

Coordinate with other departments to minimize maintenance delays and optimize equipment availability.

Execute calibrations as per schedule and prepare detailed reports on findings and adjustments.

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability.

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes.

Technical and Process Improvement:

Perform periodic backups of Boiler PLC and auxiliary systems to secure operational data.

Provide resources and guidance to contractor technicians for routine maintenance tasks.

Follow the established checklist for equipment maintenance to ensure thoroughness and accuracy.

Maintain the FGD (Flue Gas Discharge) systems to ensure environmental compliance.

Inventory Management and Documentation:

Provide inputs to Team Leads for effective spares and inventory management, including the development of indigenous spares.

Manage the procurement process for equipment and services, ensuring value for money and adherence to financial guidelines.

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA, CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Maintain a culture of safety by providing proper training and ensuring adherence to safety protocols and ensuring zero accidents.

Implement field related ZFO Action Items and AWMS initiatives.

Adhere to BPT processes, technical audits, and compliance requirements.

Report unsafe conditions, acts, and near misses in the work area to prevent incidents.

Follow the guidelines of the work permit system to ensure safe working conditions.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency.

Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals/strategy.

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Environment & Sustainability

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Key Stakeholders - External:

Vendor

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree.

Work Experience (Range of years):

4+ years of experience in in C&I systems, preferably in power plant boiler operations.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in power generation, or related process industries with a focus on control and instrumentation systems.

job.title: Lead - Training Design & Deployment
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Analyse business requirements, target roles, participant profiles, performance gaps and operational context to define clear learning outcomes and an appropriate training approach.
  • Design role-based curricula, learning journeys, course outlines and detailed session plans with logical sequencing, duration, delivery method, practice requirements and assessment points.
  • Develop facilitator guides, participant workbooks, presentations, job aids, case studies, activities, simulations, observation checklists, practical exercises and digital-learning content as required.
  • Create measurable learning objectives and assessment blueprints, including baseline, formative, summative and practical assessments aligned to the expected job capability.
  • Apply adult-learning principles and suitable instructional-design models while adapting content for participants with different education levels, languages and workplace exposure.
  • Work with subject-matter experts, program owners, delivery leads, trainers and business stakeholders to capture technical inputs, validate accuracy and obtain timely content approval.
  • Convert complex technical or operational information into clear, simple and visually understandable learning content without diluting critical safety, quality or process requirements.
  • Define trainer requirements, training infrastructure, equipment, batch size, delivery duration and other program dependencies needed for successful implementation.
  • Pilot or observe training delivery, collect feedback and assessment evidence, and revise the learning solution based on learner performance and stakeholder inputs.
  • Maintain version control, standard templates, content repositories and approval records so that current and authorised materials are used across all locations.
  • Support program delivery through trainer briefing, content orientation, quality checks, training audits and resolution of design-related issues during implementation.
  • Use training data and effectiveness results to recommend improvements in curriculum, methodology, practice intensity, assessment design and reinforcement mechanisms.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Education, Instructional Design, Learning and Development, Psychology, Human Resources, Engineering, Management or a related discipline.
  • Preferred minimum 5 years of experience in instructional design, curriculum development, technical training design, learning solutioning or program design, preferably in an industrial or workforce-skilling environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in needs analysis, competency mapping, curriculum design, session-plan development, assessment design and creation of trainer and learner materials.
  • Working knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional-design methodologies, blended learning and evaluation of training effectiveness.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel; exposure to e-learning authoring tools, learning management systems or digital-content platforms is desirable.
  • Strong writing, visual structuring, stakeholder-management, project-planning, quality-review and version-control skills.

Ability to understand technical subject matter, ask structured questions, work with multiple subject-matter experts and translate inputs into practical learning solutions.

job.title: Production Engineer
job.description:
Responsibilities

Production Management:

Manage daily production activities to ensure output targets, process flow, and delivery timelines are consistently achieved. Monitor operations for adherence to SOPs and technical specifications.

Drawing Interpretation:

Interpret complex technical drawings and convert them into executable actions for production planning, scheduling, and team coordination.

Resource Utilization & Optimization:

Efficiently allocate manpower, equipment, and materials to maximize productivity and minimize operational costs and wastage.

Process Improvement:

Continuously analyze production processes to identify inefficiencies, implement corrective actions, and drive lean practices to enhance overall output.

Safety Compliance:

Compliance to safety protocols, conduct regular safety inspections, and ensure a safe working environment for all team members.

Documentation & Reporting:

Maintain and update production records, daily logs, and 15-day progress reports with key performance data including output, downtime, rework, and resource consumption.

Stakeholder Management:

Work closely with cross-functional teams including quality, maintenance, planning, and logistics to ensure smooth handoffs and effective communication.

Risk Management:

Identify potential production risks, delays, or resource shortages early and develop action plans to address them proactively.

Equipment & Maintenance Support:

Support equipment upkeep by ensuring timely maintenance, escalating technical issues, and minimizing unplanned downtimes through coordination with the maintenance team.

Digital mindset:

Champions a digital mindset within the organization to drive innovation and competitiveness. Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

Lead - Production

Senior Production Engineer

NA

job.title: Lead - Retail Leasing
job.description:
Responsibilities

Develop and Optimize Tenant Mix for Retail Leasing:

Lead the development and execution of retail leasing strategies aimed at attracting a diverse mix of retailers that align with the mall’s positioning and market.

Ensure that leasing activities drive footfall, support long-term profitability, and enhance the mall’s status as a top retail destination.

Market Research and Retail Prospect Identification:

Conduct in-depth market research to track retail trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activities, using this data to strategically target retailers that appeal to mall visitors.

Identify and approach retail brands that can help increase footfall and fill gaps in the current tenant mix to improve the mall’s retail offerings.

Retail Tenant Negotiation and Lease Management:

Regularly report leasing data and insights to senior management, recommending adjustments to optimize space utilization and enhance mall profitability.

Documentation and Reporting of Retail Leasing Activities:

Ensure that all retail leasing activities, including lease agreements, tenant correspondence, and store design approvals, are accurately documented.

Provide regular reports on retail occupancy, footfall patterns, rental yields, and tenant sales performance, delivering valuable insights for strategic decision-making.

Digital Mindset:

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead and collaborate with diverse teams (marketing, projects, design) to ensure alignment on leasing strategies and execution.

Implement training programs to enhance staff capabilities, focusing on service quality and operational excellence.

job.title: Assistant Manager - F&M
job.description:

Oversee ETP and STP Operations:

Manage Resources:

Implement Conservation Measures:

  • Identify and implement effective water-saving technologies and practices across PUW, ETP, and STP to reduce overall water consumption and minimize environmental impact while enhancing operational efficiency.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure adherence to strict safety protocols and enforce the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Conduct regular safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments to ensure compliance with safety regulations and operational standards.

Drive Continuous Improvement:

  • Leverage data analytics to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement across all systems. Introduce and implement new technologies and process optimizations to improve performance, reduce downtime, and achieve operational cost savings.

Team Development:

  • Lead and mentor the operations and maintenance teams, ensuring a safe, respectful, and productive work environment. Foster a culture of continuous improvement, providing training and development opportunities for the team to grow professionally.

job.title: Associate Manager - Cell Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Safety Compliance:

  • Ensure that all maintenance procedures for PERC technology comply with safety standards and protocols, focusing on handling and processing sensitive components like passivation layers.

Innovation:

  • Driving continuous improvement by leading R&D efforts to develop advanced solar technologies and identifying market trends to maintain a competitive edge.

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

PERC Technology Management:

  • Oversee maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) solar cells, focusing on the unique aspects of this technology, such as passivation layers and rear surface treatment.

Issue Diagnosis and Repair:

  • Address and resolve issues related to PERC cell performance, including troubleshooting problems with passivation layers, rear surface contact, and overall cell efficiency.

Preventive Maintenance:

  • Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules tailored to the specific needs of PERC cells, such as ensuring the integrity of the passivation layer and rear contacts.

Quality Assurance:

  • Ensure that maintenance practices uphold the high standards required for PERC cells. Perform detailed inspections to verify the condition of passivation layers and rear surface contacts..

CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions):

  • Identify and address specific issues affecting PERC cells, such as degradation of passivation layers or rear contact problems, and implement corrective and preventive measures to enhance cell performance.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and coordinate the maintenance team in handling PERC cells, providing specific guidance on handling and maintaining passivation and rear contact systems.

Performance Monitoring:

  • Track performance indicators specific to PERC cells, such as efficiency metrics and degradation rates of passivation layers, to optimize maintenance strategies and improve cell longevity.

The scale of our business assures a steady availability of coal, extracted in the most responsible ways, which promises constant supply of power to both urban and rural geographies of India ensuring no hurdles are faced by the citizens in the path to achieving their dreams. The mining industry is considered a major contributor to the growth of the Indian economy. The mining business unit of the Adani group was established in 2007 as the last link in ensuring energy security for India. We are also developing and operating mines in Indonesia and Australia.

In the past few years, we have transformed from a coal trading and importing company to a comprehensive integrated coal management company. We have a diversified trading portfolio and are involved in Coal and Coke trading.

job.title: Lead - Capex Finance Controller
job.description:
Responsibilities

Budgeting & Financial Planning Protocols:

  • Develop comprehensive capex and opex plans and detailed financial models for all upcoming and ongoing projects, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives.
  • Validate financial assumptions related to cost, timelines, and revenue impact, and ensure adherence to financial performance benchmarks such as Payback Period, Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and Return on Capital Employed (ROCE).
  • Incorporate risk buffers and scenario analysis to strengthen planning accuracy and decision-making confidence.

Fund Utilization & Reporting Mechanisms:

  • Monitor short- and long-term cash flow forecasts to ensure optimal fund availability and rational deployment across projects in coordination with the Treasury team.
  • Oversee vendor billing processes, Letter of Credit (LC) utilization, and advance payments to maintain financial discipline and prevent working capital inefficiencies.
  • Implement robust fund tracking and reporting systems to enhance transparency and accountability.

Financial & Operational Reporting:

  • Consolidate project-level financial and operational data into structured, periodic reports for senior management and stakeholders.
  • Automate recurring reporting processes where possible to improve efficiency and ensure real-time visibility into Capex performance.

Cost Governance & Financial Controls:

  • Lead financial governance through regular variance analysis, highlighting deviations from budget and ensuring timely interventions.
  • Prepare and present quarterly reports on key financial performance indicators (KPIs), enabling leadership visibility and proactive risk management.
  • Establish and monitor internal financial controls, and initiate corrective measures in cases of overspending, budget breaches, or unapproved expenditures.

Value Engineering:

  • Provide analytical and financial support during contract negotiations to ensure that final deals align with the organization’s cost optimization objectives and financial targets.
  • Review and refine Capex BOQs and budget estimates in coordination with project and finance teams; support financial negotiations and commercial discussions by providing cost analysis and recommendations for optimization.
  • Review vendor quotations for commercial feasibility, benchmark costs against industry standards, and offer value engineering insights to enhance deal value.
  • Leverage financial modeling to influence strategic procurement and vendor selection decisions.

Project Returns & Closure Reports:

  • Track actual financial performance of projects both during execution and post-commissioning to ensure delivery against projected returns.
  • Prepare comprehensive project closure reports in alignment with Detailed Project Report (DPR) expectations, capturing key financial metrics, learnings, and deviations.
  • Escalate material variances or performance issues to leadership for timely review and corrective planning.

Cross-Functional Alignment:

  • Collaborate with Technical, Commercial, Project Management, and Business Unit FP&A teams to ensure alignment on critical Capex parameters, risk exposures, and mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure the Head – CFMC is present in all relevant forums, with access to data at par with CFOs for capex decision-making.
  • Drive end-to-end Capex lifecycle hygiene—from budget approval and drawdown to execution tracking and final closure—ensuring compliance with governance frameworks and internal policies.
  • Act as a bridge between functions to facilitate consistent communication, faster resolution of issues, and a unified approach to Capex management.

Qualifications

  • Chartered Accountant Degree or ICWA Or an MBA from reputed institute (with finance background) or CFA Level 2
  • PMP / MBA (Finance) will be an added advantage
  • 10 + years of experience in Site Finance Controlling capital financial planning, project finance, or corporate finance

Location - Mundra (Gujarat)

job.title: Associate Manager- Mechanical (CHP Commissioning)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Asst.Manager - CHP Commissioning will be responsible for leading and managing all commissioning activities related to the CHP plant, ensuring that all systems and components function according to design specifications and operational standards. Key responsibilities include:

  • Commissioning Planning and Execution: Develop detailed commissioning plans and schedules in coordination with project management and engineering teams to ensure timely completion of CHP commissioning milestones.
  • Technical Supervision: Oversee mechanical, electrical, and control system testing to validate the integrity, safety, and performance of CHP equipment including boilers, turbines, generators, and auxiliary systems.
  • Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Analyze commissioning data to identify issues, implement corrective actions, and optimize system performance to achieve operational efficiency targets.
  • Coordination and Communication: Act as a liaison between design engineers, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to facilitate problem resolution and ensure smooth commissioning progress.
  • Safety and Compliance: Enforce Adani's stringent safety protocols and environmental regulations throughout all commissioning activities to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare comprehensive commissioning reports, technical documentation, and performance records for regulatory compliance and future reference.
  • Training and Development: Support the training of operations personnel on new CHP systems and procedures to guarantee seamless handover and sustained operational reliability.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify process improvements and implement best practices in commissioning methodologies consistent with Adani's culture of innovation and excellence.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with various stakeholders including vendors, consultants, and internal departments to ensure alignment with project goals and company standards.

Qualifications

Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in commissioning and operation within the power/energy sector, specifically in CHP plants, thermal power stations, or equivalent.

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering or a related field from a recognized university.

job.title: Deputy Manager - HVAC
job.description:
Responsibilities

Operation and Maintenance of Chillers:

Oversee the operation of chillers, ensuring that they are running at maximum efficiency to provide consistent cooling performance.

Implement maintenance protocols, ensuring that all preventive and corrective maintenance tasks are scheduled and completed on time, reducing downtime and improving overall system reliability.

Conduct regular inspections and analyze operational data to identify potential issues before they escalate and guide the team in troubleshooting and problem-solving, making necessary adjustments to optimize chiller performance and energy use.

Energy Conservation Initiatives:

Lead energy conservation initiatives by identifying areas of inefficiency within the HVAC systems and implementing industry best practices for energy saving and collaborate with the team to set and meet energy reduction goals, such as optimizing chiller setpoints and monitoring energy performance metrics.

Conduct periodic energy audits and assessments to identify patterns of excessive energy usage and implement improvements that promote more sustainable operation, such as advanced controls, automation, or use of alternative energy sources where feasible.

Purchasing and Inventory Control:

Manage the inventory levels for HVAC parts, tools, and equipment to balance availability and cost-effectiveness.

Work closely with procurement to ensure that critical parts are stocked without overloading inventory, reducing holding costs while maintaining availability for emergency repairs.

Establish strong vendor relationships by coordinating regular purchase order follow-ups to ensure timely delivery of supplies and regularly evaluate vendor performance and negotiate terms to secure cost-effective, high-quality parts for HVAC system maintenance.

Preventive and Predictive Maintenance Planning:

Develop and oversee the preventive maintenance (PM) and predictive maintenance (PdM) schedules, ensuring all HVAC equipment undergoes regular checks and services to maintain optimal performance. Set clear maintenance guidelines, monitor adherence to schedules, and adjust plans as necessary to accommodate operational demands.

Assess equipment performance data and feedback from the team to proactively address recurring issues, minimizing downtime and prolonging the life of the equipment. Implement predictive analysis techniques, such as vibration monitoring and thermography, to detect potential problems before they disrupt operations.

Safety Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the team strictly adheres to workplace safety protocols, including PPE requirements, safe handling of refrigerants, and compliance with OSHA and industry-specific safety standards.

Implement risk mitigation strategies, like hazard identification and lockout-tagout (LOTO) procedures, to create a safe working environment and regularly conduct safety audits and safety training sessions to maintain a high level of safety awareness and lead efforts to improve safety practices, encourage reporting of near-miss incidents, and work closely with the safety department to resolve any identified hazards.

Team Leadership and Development:

Guide and mentor the HVAC team members by clearly assigning roles and responsibilities, providing continuous support, and conducting regular performance reviews to address individual strengths and areas for improvement, and establish a collaborative culture to improve team productivity and ensure all tasks are aligned with company standards.

Develop and implement team policies that encourage a high standard of work, accountability, and a safe working environmen to foster a unified approach to HVAC maintenance and energy conservation.

Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

Work Experience:

  • 10+ years and Minimum 5 years’ experience in Handling central chilling plant above 2000 Tons capacity with above 500 tons of individual chiller.

job.title: Manager - MTPOE (Planning)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Role: Manager - MTPOE (Planning)

Inventory Management and Planning:

Execute inventory planning as per overhauling requirements to facilitate timely procurement from external vendors within budget constraints, ensuring optimal stock levels for operational efficiency.

Monitoring running inventory that is consumed regularly and ensuring availability for uninterrupted operations.

Manage Capitalized Inventory, including high-value items that are essential for major breakdowns but are consumed less frequently.

Identify obsolete inventory items and plan their removal in consultation with O&M to optimize resource utilization.

Operational Excellence:

Execute financial asset verification and implementation, ensuring accuracy and accountability in asset management.

Initiate Note for Approvals (NFA) at the department/station level to streamline the approval process.

Act as an Internal Finance Controller, coordinating with departments to gather data and submit for Finance approvals based on a defined checklist.

Prepare Service Entry Sheets to ensure accurate recording of services rendered.

Inventory Tracking and Reporting:

Monitor Non-Moving Inventory (NMI), prepare provisions (quarterly), execute transfer of NMI to other plants and provide management updates on NMI status and consumption patterns.

Conduct vital item availability tracking on a weekly basis to ensure immediate response capabilities in case of breakdowns.

Supervise the PR/PO process, including monitoring, follow-ups with the Techno Commercial for PR to PO conversion, and ensuring timely delivery of items.

Engage in planning for the procurement of indigenous spares by coordinating with relevant departments.

Regularly update inventory levels and communicate with departments to request consumption details and facilitate the raising of POs.

Carry out screening of purchase requisition (PR) items.

Budget and Financial Oversight:

Coordinate with the maintenance teams to gather and consolidate inputs on budgetary requirements for the year and share with Section Head for review..

Monitor Opex consumption for existing projects and Capex consumption for new initiatives, providing insights for financial planning.

Upload Capex expenditure reports into the system, coordinate approvals with Finance based on Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), and ensure CEO approvals for Capex when necessary.

Monitor PR/PO tracking for the year by departments and manage non-compliances/deviations in Capex Expenditure Reports (CER).

Manage the timely completion of projects based on Capex within the defined timelines.

Carry out variance analysis for CAPEX, OPEX and procurement budget.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Prioritize the safety of personnel and equipment by enforcing proper training and adherence to safety protocols.

Manage inventory manuals and implement updates to maintain compliance with industry standards and best practices.

Implement and oversee safety processes, including participation in Safety meetings to promote a culture of safety within the organization.

Facilitate different audits and ensure compliance with audit requirements.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency across inventory and budget management.

Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategies.

Implement process and system improvements by adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas to enhance operational workflows.

Facilitate the digitization of inventory tracking and budget reporting processes to improve accuracy and accessibility of data.

job.title: Team - GCP - Civil & Structure
job.description:
Responsibilities

Purchase Requisition Processing:

Review and convert approved purchase requisitions into Requests for Quotation (RFQs) or Purchase Orders (POs) after thorough validation of item specifications, quantities, and required approvals.

Ensure that all commercial and technical details are accurately captured, aligned with procurement policies and category strategies.

Leverage data analytics to suggest procurement interventions, identify opportunities for optimization, and provide category-specific recommendations for cost, delivery, or quality improvement.

Vendor Coordination & Follow-up:

Coordinate with vendors for quote submission, clarifications, and material delivery.

Follow up for documentation, test reports, and certifications.

Support the preparation of the supplier segmentation matrix, Supplier performance evaluation criteria and frequency for each supplier segment, and supplier scorecards.

Evaluate and report on quality of materials / service procured vis-à-vis defined standards and execute corrective action as required at supplier end.

RFQ & Technical Document Preparation:

Assist in preparing comprehensive RFQ packages, ensuring inclusion of all relevant technical specifications, terms, and required documentation.

Ensure consistent formatting of vendor responses and timely dissemination of drawings, specifications, and offer details to relevant stakeholders for technical and commercial evaluations.

Order Tracking & Expediting:

Monitor the status of issued POs by tracking delivery schedules, milestones, and dispatch details on a continuous basis.

Identify and escalate delays proactively, coordinating with vendors to expedite shipments and ensure adherence to committed timelines.

Update ERP systems and procurement tracking tools with real-time order status to ensure transparency and smooth downstream processes.

Documentation & Compliance:

Maintain comprehensive documentation for each procurement activity, including RFQs, vendor quotations, comparative statements, POs, inspection reports, and correspondence.

Ensure that all documentation complies with audit requirements and internal control guidelines.

Monitor approval workflows and maintain structured filing systems (digital or physical) for traceability and regulatory compliance.

Coordination with Internal Teams:

Collaborate with Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) and stores personnel for Goods Receipt Note (GRN) issuance and inspection coordination.

Share timely updates on vendor performance, delivery schedules, and any deviation resolutions.

Address and resolve operational or site-level procurement issues, acting as a bridge between vendors and internal stakeholders.

Reporting & Analytics Support:

Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly Management Information System (MIS) reports covering PO status, deliveries, and procurement health indicators.

Support category leads with data-driven insights on cost trends, savings realization, vendor performance, and procurement efficiency metrics.

Ensure accuracy in data consolidation and highlight any deviations or improvement areas for proactive action.

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering in Civil / Electrical / Mechanical / Instrumentation. Masters Degree in SCM / Project Management / Operations Management is preferred

Work Experience:

7+ years of category-specific procurement experience in infrastructure, EPC, or industrial projects

Deep understanding of various bidding process (TBCB, limited tender, open tender, conventional, any specific strategy etc.), prepare vendor selection approach and vendor evaluation criteria depending on the nature of the Sub-category

Proficiency in category strategy, Logistics, Supply Chain and Material Management ,vendor management, and working knowledge of SAP, SLM, ARIBA, or equivalent e-Auction platforms

job.description:

job.title: Deputy Manager -C&I -O&M
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Turbine)

Monitor the availability and functionality of all Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Turbine including UPS, DCS, SWAS, CPU systems, Governing system, ETS, HPLP Bypass, Turbine, and Auxiliaries.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Field Quality Assurance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Inspection:

  • Coordinate and conduct site inspections with O&M engineers as per quality procedures, codes, and standards.
  • Execute all inspection activities of BTG and BOP, including PDI of materials and spares.
  • Execute inspection of boiler, pressure parts, welding, turbine and auxiliaries.

  • Execute inspections and thickness surveys of boiler pressure parts, coal bunkers, APH, HP and LP Valves, rotary parts, etc.
  • Arrange PDI inspections of procurement material/spares at vendor premises and provide MDCC (Material Dispatch Claims Certification).
  • Provide support for third-party inspections and certifications of safety equipment and healthiness of equipment.

Quality Control and Testing:

  • Conduct welder qualification tests (for both IBR and non-IBR) and maintain welder performance records.
  • Prepare, review, and approve materials, QAPs, and FQPs of various site packages.
  • Prepare and review WPS, PQR, and WPQ documents.
  • Operational Excellence and Compliance:
  • Raise NFA (Note for Approval) for deviations and modifications and obtain approval through the system.
  • Provide budget inputs and ensure the sustainability of resources and processes.

Resource Management, Training, and Innovation:

  • Provide TNI inputs and drive feedback sessions for continuous learning.
  • Provide innovative ideas and recommendations.
  • Support quality awareness training sessions for maintenance engineers and agency engineers/supervisors to foster a culture of quality and excellence at the site.
  • Manage relationships with external agencies to ensure the timely submission of bills, closure of accounts, and resolution of financial matters related to mechanical works.

Business Sustainability:

  • Maintain the safety of business associates/other contractors and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.
  • Ensure compliance with technical audits, safety audits, and business excellence assessments.
  • Implement CHETNA Safety standards in the department to achieve zero harm.
  • Conduct regular safety audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant environmental, health, and safety regulations and company policies.

Digitization and Automation:

  • Execute integration of advanced technology and comprehensive digitization strategies in mechanical quality assurance processes to optimize operational efficiency.
  • Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy.
  • Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.
  • Monitor and analyse data from digital systems to inform decision-making and improve quality outcomes.

  • Maintenance Mechanical
  • Operations & Maintenance
  • Techno Commercial

Key Stakeholders - External:

Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution.

Preferred Industry:

Candidates with experience in the power generation, energy, or related heavy industrial sectors are preferred, with a strong background in operational excellence and quality management systems.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Mine Operations (FCC)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Blasting Officer - Coal Mining

Drilling and Blasting Operations:

Develop and implement drilling patterns and blasting patterns for efficient coal seam removal.

Develop detailed blast designs and plans based on geological data, operational requirements, and safety standards.

Collaborate with mine engineers and surveyors to determine the optimal placement and quantity of explosives for each blast.*Supervise explosive handling procedures to maintain safety standards.

Manage the cost of blasting operations through the selection of the most cost-effective blasting material, creating blasting plans, and strategy development.

Prepare blast sites according to the approved blast plan, ensuring all safety measures are in place.

Drill blast holes to the specified depth and diameter, and load explosives as per the blast design.

Conduct post-blast analysis to evaluate the effectiveness of the blast and identify any areas for improvement.

Collect and analyze data on fragmentation, muckpile characteristics, and environmental impact.

Magazine Maintenance and Explosive Handling:

Ensure all explosives are stored securely in designated, compliant storage facilities.

Monitor storage conditions to prevent any safety hazards, such as temperature or humidity fluctuations.

Maintain accurate records of explosives inventory, including quantities received, used, and remaining.

Conduct regular inventory checks to ensure all explosives are accounted for and stored correctly.

Statutory Record Maintenance and Government Coordination:

Maintain accurate records of drilling and blasting activities, equipment deployment, and maintenance.

Ensure compliance with DGMS guidelines and SOPs for record-keeping.

Obtain necessary permits and approvals for blasting activities, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

Submit periodic reports to DGMS, including monthly returns, vibration studies, load sheets, and other required documentation.

Safety and Compliance:

Lead toolbox talks to promote safety awareness among staff and contractors.

Enforce safety guidelines, environmental regulations, and mine closure/reclamation requirements.

Conduct periodic mine rounds to observe operations and ensure compliance with safety standards, including ground vibration, sound air pressure, fly rocks, and shattering effects.

Operational Efficiency and Digital Dexterity:

Collaborate with colliery engineers to optimize mine operations and achieve production targets.

Implement measures to improve productivity, reduce costs, and enhance overall operational efficiency.

Provide guidance and training to shift incharge and contract employees to foster a culture of safety and excellence.

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to deploy digital tools that align with business objectives.

Ensure the effective utilization of digital platforms to improve team efficiency and productivity.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Mines Manager

Safety Officer

Collery Engineer

OB incharge

Blasting Officer

Employees

Key Stakeholders - External

Contractors

Vendors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Essential: B.Tech/B.E-Mining with First Class Certificate of Competency (R - Coal) issued by DGMS

Work Experience (Range of years):

5-10 years
