job.title: Associate Manager - Operations & Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

PNG O&M Engineer - O4

Operational Support:

  • Assist in the day-to-day operations of PNG pipelines, ensuring the efficient and reliable delivery of services.
  • Monitor the performance of equipment and systems, conducting routine inspections to identify and address any operational issues.
  • Support the implementation of operational strategies and procedures developed by the O&M Lead to optimize system performance and reliability.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory, safety, and environmental standards during operations, reporting any deviations to the O&M Lead.
  • Provide technical support during the integration of new systems or equipment into existing PNG infrastructure.

Maintenance Execution:

  • Execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities on PNG pipelines equipment, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
  • Utilize diagnostic tools and techniques to monitor the condition of pipelines and infrastructure, identifying maintenance needs.
  • Coordinate with contractors and service providers to carry out maintenance tasks, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs, ensuring these are readily available for review.
  • Implement best practices in maintenance management, contributing to continuous improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.

Technical Problem Solving:

  • Troubleshoot technical issues that arise during operations or maintenance activities, providing timely and effective solutions.
  • Analyze system data and performance metrics to identify potential areas for improvement and to prevent future operational disruptions.
  • Collaborate with the O&M Lead to develop and implement engineering solutions that enhance the reliability and efficiency of PNG.
  • Participate in technical meetings and reviews, offering insights and recommendations to optimize project outcomes.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure all maintenance and operational activities comply with safety regulations and industry standards, minimizing the risk of accidents or incidents.
  • Participate in safety audits and inspections, identifying potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks.
  • Assist in the development of safety protocols and procedures, ensuring they are adhered to by all team members and contractors.
  • Prepare safety documentation, such as risk assessments and method statements, to support safe operations and maintenance practices.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, including maintenance logs, inspection reports, and equipment manuals.

  • Assist in the preparation of operational and maintenance reports for senior management, highlighting key findings and areas for improvement.
  • Ensure that all documentation is organized, accessible, and complies with internal and external audit requirements.

Team Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with other engineers, technicians, and team members to ensure smooth execution of maintenance and operational activities.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure that project objectives and timelines are met.
  • Participate in team meetings, providing updates on engineering activities and contributing to discussions on improving operational efficiency.
  • Liaise with other departments as needed to ensure integrated and effective operations of PNG pipelines.

Continuous Improvement and Learning:

  • Identify opportunities to improve maintenance processes and practices, proposing and implementing changes that enhance performance.
  • Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge, ensuring continued growth within the team.
  • Share knowledge and insights with the team, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Cell Production
job.description:
About Business:

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Solar: Adani Solar is India's 1st and largest vertically integrated solar PV manufacturer with 4 GW cells & modules and 2 GW of ingots & wafers manufacturing capacities

Job Purpose: The Shift Engineer - Cluster - Printing ensures overall supervision of printing process and machine operators that includes operators training, operators deployment, making SOPs, work instructions, check lists for machine, process flow and production, hence to ensure a successful & safe operation in the shop floor as per production plan. job.title: Senior Manager -Enggineering
job.description:
Responsibilities

Subsystem-Level Electrical Design

  • Lead the end-to-end design and optimization of turbine electrical subsystems, focusing on high-performance inverters, control circuits, and transformer interfaces for reliable grid integration.
  • Optimize nacelle cabling layouts to reduce electromagnetic interference (EMI), minimize power losses, and improve thermal management in compact spaces.
  • Design redundant electrical pathways to enhance fault tolerance and ensure continuous turbine operation under extreme conditions.

Integration of Electrical and SCADA Systems

  • Coordinate the seamless integration of electrical components with SCADA platforms, ensuring real-time data capture, fault detection, and rapid response mechanisms.
  • Resolve compatibility issues between SCADA software and electrical subsystems, focusing on synchronization of monitoring with turbine control logic.
  • Develop protocols for optimized data flow, ensuring minimal latency and reliable system feedback loops.

Component Validation and Testing

  • Manage comprehensive testing protocols for turbine electrical components, including insulation resistance, power converter efficiency, and transformer load handling.
  • Collaborate with instrumentation teams to ensure accurate sensor placement and calibration, capturing critical performance metrics.
  • Supervise fault simulation tests, such as grid fault ride-through (FRT) events, to validate subsystem behavior under adverse conditions.

Power Conversion Optimization

  • Oversee optimization of power conversion systems by implementing harmonic distortion mitigation strategies and fine-tuning inverter control parameters.
  • Analyze power quality metrics to ensure adherence to grid compliance standards, focusing on voltage stability and transient response performance.

Failure Analysis and Corrective Actions

  • Conduct root cause failure analysis (RCFA) for electrical subsystem failures, such as converter overheating or generator insulation breakdown.
  • Define and implement corrective actions, including design modifications for improved thermal management and enhanced material selection for reliability.
  • Develop reliability improvement plans, integrating predictive maintenance schedules into operational workflows.

Collaboration with Instrumentation Teams

  • Work closely with instrumentation engineers to configure and validate sensors for monitoring voltage, current, and thermal performance across components.
  • Ensure SCADA-integrated data acquisition systems provide accurate and actionable insights into subsystem performance.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts for sensor-related issues, ensuring minimal disruption to turbine monitoring and control.

Grid Interface and Compliance

  • Analyze grid connection points to validate voltage stability and ensure compliance with international standards, such as IEC 61400-21.
  • Develop real-time voltage and frequency regulation algorithms to support grid stability during transient and steady-state operations.

Thermal and Power Loss Analysis

  • Conduct detailed thermal performance studies for converters, transformers, and cabling, focusing on heat dissipation efficiency and thermal stability under varying loads.
  • Analyze power loss patterns in nacelle wiring, identifying hotspots and proposing improved layouts or materials to enhance efficiency.
  • Validate thermal simulations with field data to ensure subsystem performance aligns with design expectations.

Technical Reporting and Documentation

  • Prepare detailed technical reports highlighting subsystem performance evaluations, failure analyses, and actionable recommendations for improvement.
  • Document testing procedures, validation protocols, and outcomes for traceability during audits and certifications.

Mentorship and Guidance

  • Mentor junior engineers in advanced topics, such as harmonic distortion analysis and thermal management in high-voltage systems.
  • Conduct regular technical reviews of team deliverables to ensure alignment with project requirements and quality standards.
  • Develop training modules focusing on the latest advancements in electrical engineering and renewable energy technologies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Head - Engineering
  • Head - Electrical Engineering
  • Electrical Engineer
  • OMS Engineering & Support - Electrical
  • Nacelle Plant Support Engineer - Electrical
  • Lead - Blade Process Engineering
  • Lead - Testing & Certification
  • Lead - Grid Compliance
  • Lead - Performance Management
  • Lead - Load Simulation
  • Lead - Mechanical Drive Train
  • Manufacturing Teams
  • QA Teams

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Electrical Component Suppliers

  • Grid Compliance Consultants
  • Certification Bodies

Qualifications

Educational Background:

  • BE in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.

Work Experience:

  • 8+ years in designing, testing, and optimizing electrical systems, including power converters and transformers. Experience with failure analysis, thermal management, and compliance verification is essential.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Expertise in load management, harmonics mitigation, and SCADA systems. Familiarity with IEC standards and advanced simulation tools is required.

job.title: Senior Manager- CCR
job.description:
Responsibilities

A. CCR Production Operations & Target Delivery

  • Lead day-to-day CCR production operations to achieve planned copper rod output, quality and dispatch readiness.
  • Ensure smooth operation of shaft furnace / holding furnace, casting system, rolling mill, cooling, coiling and handling areas.
  • Monitor production plan versus actual performance, identify deviations and drive corrective actions with shift teams.
  • Optimize plant throughput, yield, availability and operating discipline while minimizing process interruptions and rework.
  • Ensure effective shift handover, daily production review, manpower deployment and shop-floor execution governance.

B. Safety, Compliance & Shop-Floor Discipline

  • Ensure adherence to safety standards, SOPs, PTW requirements, LOTO, PPE compliance and safe operating practices in CCR operations.
  • Drive hazard identification, near-miss reporting, unsafe condition closure and safety engagement with operators and contract workforce.
  • Maintain operational discipline through checklist compliance, logbook accuracy, housekeeping, 5S and process control documentation.
  • Ensure statutory, environmental and quality system compliance applicable to CCR production operations.
  • Build a safety-first operating culture across shifts through training, audits and visible shop-floor leadership.

C. Process Control, Quality & Defect Reduction

  • Maintain critical process parameters for molten copper temperature, oxygen level, casting speed, rolling conditions, cooling and surface finish.
  • Work with quality, laboratory and process teams to ensure copper rod meets required specifications for diameter, conductivity, elongation, surface quality and coil condition.
  • Analyze process deviations, rod breaks, surface defects, dimensional variation, cracks, scale formation and other quality issues.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and corrective / preventive actions for recurring process and quality failures.
  • Support process trials, standard parameter setting and improvement projects for stable CCR operations.

D. Equipment Reliability, Maintenance Coordination & Utility Interface

  • Coordinate closely with mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and utility teams for equipment health, breakdown analysis and preventive maintenance planning.
  • Monitor critical equipment including furnace, casting wheel, rolling stands, shear, coiler, cooling system, pumps, burners and material handling systems.
  • Support planned shutdown execution, equipment readiness checks, start-up preparedness and post-maintenance trial stabilization.
  • Identify reliability concerns impacting production, quality, energy consumption and safety performance.
  • Ensure timely closure of process-related maintenance observations and operational improvement actions.

E. Continuous Improvement, Cost & Team Development

  • Drive improvement initiatives for productivity, yield, energy efficiency, consumable consumption, downtime reduction and quality cost reduction.
  • Use production data, process trends, defect analysis and equipment performance inputs to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Develop SOPs, OPLs, training modules and skill-building plans for operators, technicians and shift personnel.
  • Support digitalization of production monitoring through dashboards, shift MIS, process analytics and automated reporting.
  • Build a high-performance production team focused on safety, quality, reliability, accountability and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

  • B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgy, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Production or Industrial Engineering.
  • Additional qualification in Operations Management, Process Engineering, Quality Management or Manufacturing Excellence will be preferred.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • 10–15 years of experience in copper rod / CCR operations, non-ferrous metals production, casting and rolling, process control, production planning or plant operations in large manufacturing setups.
  • Minimum 4–6 years of direct exposure to CCR plant operations, copper rod quality, furnace / casting / rolling process, shift management, troubleshooting and maintenance coordination.

Environmental Compliance and Quality Management:

Plan the overall strategy and lead the team in managing environmental compliance and adherence to legal requirements.

Government and Public Relations:

Ensure the development and maintenance of the Green Belt around plant premises as per EC conditions.

job.title: Smelter Blend Planner
job.description:
Responsibilities

A. Concentrate Material Planning & Availability

  • Prepare rolling concentrate material plans by using Blend optimization model aligned with smelter, SAP, Refinery, PMR feed requirements( in line with TOR ), production targets, stock norms, and shipment schedules.
  • Monitor concentrate inventory across port, plant, yards, warehouses, and in-transit positions to ensure uninterrupted availability.
  • Coordinate with commercial and procurement teams for shipment visibility, arrival schedules, allocation plans, and supply continuity.
  • Track daily consumption, receipts, stock ageing, inventory coverage, and deviations against plan.
  • Support proactive risk mitigation for feed shortages, shipment delays, quality variations, demurrage exposure, and operational constraints.

B. Concentrate Quality, Blending & Consumption Coordination

  • Coordinate with operations, laboratory, quality, and process teams for concentrate grade, moisture, impurity levels, assay results, and blend suitability.
  • Support development of concentrate blend plans considering copper grade, impurities, process constraints, availability, and plant performance requirements.
  • Track planned versus actual feed consumption, blend deviations, quality impact, and corrective actions.
  • Maintain material master data, quality records, stock reconciliation inputs, and planning assumptions for accurate decision-making.
  • Provide planning inputs for feed optimization, process stability, and raw material utilization improvement.
  • Optimize secondary materials, internal by products etc consumption plan basis concentrate blend for best utilization of resources and guide operation team.

C. Logistics, Port Coordination & Material Movement

  • Coordinate with port, logistics, supply chain, and operations teams for vessel berthing, unloading, evacuation, storage, and internal material movement.
  • Track vessel ETA, discharge status, rake / truck movement, yard capacity, handling constraints, and dispatch priorities.
  • Support timely movement of concentrate from port to plant based on production priorities and inventory cover requirements.
  • Monitor logistics-related risks including congestion, delays, demurrage, detention, handling losses, and storage limitations.
  • Prepare daily and weekly material movement updates for planning reviews and leadership visibility.

D. Inventory Control, Reconciliation & Reporting

  • Drive structured monitoring of opening stock, receipts, consumption, closing stock, in-transit material, and inventory cover days.
  • Coordinate periodic stock reconciliation with finance, stores, operations, port, commercial, and weighbridge teams.
  • Maintain planning dashboards, MIS reports, stock ageing analysis, shipment tracker, and concentrate availability summaries.
  • Identify variances in book stock versus physical stock and support root-cause analysis with concerned stakeholders.
  • Ensure accurate and timely reporting for daily production meetings, monthly reviews, and raw material governance forums.

E. Planning Governance, Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish planning discipline through daily reviews, exception reporting, escalation mechanisms, and corrective action tracking.
  • Develop scenario plans for shipment delays, quality deviations, high / low stock situations, production changes, and logistics disruptions.
  • Support digitalization of raw material planning through dashboards, automated trackers, SAP / system reports, and analytics-based decision support.
  • Drive continuous improvement in inventory accuracy, planning reliability, stock visibility, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Develop strong functional depth across concentrate planning, commercial interfaces, logistics operations, plant consumption, and inventory governance to provide reliable planning support and business continuity.

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgy, Chemical, Mechanical, Mining, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • MBA / PG Diploma in Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Materials Management, or Business Analytics will be preferred.
  • 10–15 years of experience in raw material planning, concentrate planning, supply chain, logistics, inventory control, production planning, commercial coordination, or operations planning in metals, mining, smelting, refinery, port-linked, or heavy manufacturing industries.
  • Minimum 4–6 years of exposure to copper concentrate / bulk raw material planning, shipment tracking, inventory reconciliation, stock governance, plant consumption planning, and cross-functional coordination.

job.title: Associate Manager - C&I - O&M
job.description:

Lead - Field instrumentation (Boiler)

Operational Excellence and Equipment Reliability:

Monitor the availability and functionality of all C&I systems related to Boiler area including firing systems, Mill fan, ASLD, CAMS, and MOV.

Conduct routine maintenance of MOV, Boiler, and Auxiliaries to prevent equipment failures.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

job.title: CHIEF SALES & Marketing Officer
job.description:
Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Ensure all sales and marketing strategies comply with corporate governance policies and procedures.

Performance and Budget Management

  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for both sales and marketing.
  • Utilize performance metrics to assess the overall effectiveness of strategies and campaigns.
  • Develop and manage budgets, ensuring cost-effective resource allocation to maximize ROI.

  • Foster collaboration between sales and marketing teams to ensure a unified approach.
  • Mentor and develop the leadership team within the Sales and Marketing department.
  • Promote a high-performance culture focused on achieving business goals.

Ethical Standards and Transparency

  • Champion ethical practices across all sales and marketing activities, ensuring transparency and integrity.
  • Implement policies and procedures to prevent fraud and maintain high ethical standards.
  • Foster a culture of compliance with ethical guidelines and promote accountability within the department.

Internal Control and Risk Management

  • Establish robust internal controls to prevent leakages and ensure financial integrity in sales and marketing operations.
  • Conduct regular audits and reviews to monitor compliance with internal controls and identify areas for improvement.
  • Implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential risks associated with sales and marketing activities.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Drive innovation in sales and marketing strategies and processes to stay ahead of industry trends and competitors.
  • Encourage a culture of innovation within the department, supporting initiatives that enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Evaluate new technologies and methodologies to optimize sales and marketing operations and improve ROI.

System Policy and procedures

  • Set clear guidelines for sales practices, customer interactions, data management, and the use of marketing materials.
  • Ensure data security and set guidelines defining how customer data should be handled and protected.

Financial Management

  • Oversee the budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning of sales and marketing initiatives.
  • Analyse market trends, customer behaviour, and the competitive landscape to make informed decisions that will drive revenue growth and profitability.
  • Set financial targets for the department and monitor performance against these targets to meet financial objectives of the organization.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Experience in the cement or manufacturing industry is highly preferred. Demonstrated success in leading large, diverse teams and managing multiple functions.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Building Management Systems (BMS)
job.description:
Responsibilities

BMS System Engineering & Maintenance:

Lead the engineering, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of BMS systems, ensuring that they operate efficiently, reliably, and in compliance with airport standards.

Oversee the day-to-day operation of BMS infrastructure, including HVAC, lighting, electrical systems, fire alarm systems, and access controls, ensuring their seamless integration with other airport systems.

Ensure continuous monitoring, testing, and updating of BMS systems to maintain optimal performance levels across all facilities.

Develop and execute maintenance schedules for BMS systems, ensuring proper preventive maintenance and minimal downtime.

Troubleshooting and Fault Resolution:

Lead troubleshooting efforts in case of system failures, quickly diagnosing faults within BMS-related systems and resolving issues with minimal disruption to airport operations.

Coordinate with engineering teams to repair or replace faulty components of BMS systems, ensuring efficient and timely resolutions.

Implement diagnostic tools and technologies to identify potential issues before they impact the operations of the airport.

Energy Efficiency and Sustainability:

Monitor and optimize energy consumption across airport facilities by utilizing BMS for HVAC systems, lighting, and electrical load management.

Implement energy-saving initiatives through BMS systems, ensuring energy optimization and contributing to the airport’s sustainability goals.

Evaluate the performance of BMS systems in managing energy usage, recommending improvements for greater cost savings and environmental benefits.

Safety and Regulatory Compliance:

Ensure that all BMS systems comply with airport-specific safety standards, industry regulations, and local environmental health and safety guidelines.

Conduct regular safety audits and inspections on BMS-related systems, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with safety standards such as fire safety, electrical safety, and hazard control.

Assist in the development and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for BMS operation and maintenance to ensure a safe environment for all stakeholders.

Budget Planning & Forecasting:

Develop and manage the annual budget for BMS operations, including system maintenance, upgrades, energy-saving initiatives, and staffing.

Prepare detailed budget forecasts, considering historical data, upcoming projects, and planned system enhancements to ensure adequate financial planning.

BMS Performance Monitoring:

Lead the monitoring of BMS data for system performance, energy usage, and operational efficiency, utilizing system dashboards and reports.

Analyze system data to detect performance trends and inefficiencies, implementing corrective measures as necessary.

Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to BMS system uptime, reliability, and energy consumption to ensure continuous improvement.

Vendor and Contractor Management:

Oversee relationships with third-party vendors and contractors responsible for BMS system components or services, ensuring high-quality service delivery and compliance with contractual obligations.

Coordinate with vendors for the timely procurement of equipment, materials, and parts required for the maintenance and repair of BMS systems.

Manage vendor service level agreements (SLAs) and ensure that maintenance and repair activities are performed within specified time frames and quality standards.

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead and supervise the BMS engineering and maintenance team, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.

Develop and implement training programs to improve the technical skills and knowledge of the BMS team.

Ensure proper documentation of maintenance activities and work orders, ensuring that team members follow industry best practices and safety guidelines.

Project Management and System Upgrades:

Lead BMS system upgrade projects, including design, installation, and commissioning, ensuring alignment with airport’s engineering objectives and timelines.

Plan and manage engineering projects related to BMS integration with other airport systems, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations during implementation.

Assist in evaluating and selecting new BMS technologies and tools to enhance operational capabilities.

Reporting and Documentation:

Provide regular reports on the status and performance of BMS systems, including energy usage, maintenance activities, and system health.

Maintain detailed records of system configurations, maintenance logs, troubleshooting reports, and compliance audits to ensure transparency and accountability.

Document system updates, troubleshooting efforts, and any changes to BMS configurations, ensuring all data is current and easily accessible for future reference.

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

Certification in Building Management Systems (BMS) or similar, such as from the Building Controls Industry Association (BCIA) or equivalent

Additional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, or energy management are a plus

Professional engineering license (depending on the country/region)

Work Experience:

10+ years of experience working with BMS systems, including hands-on installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting

Proven experience in managing teams and leading projects within the BMS or building automation industry

Strong background in working with control systems, HVAC, lighting, and energy management solutions

Experience collaborating with contractors, clients, and other engineering teams on large-scale building projects

Familiarity with industry regulations, safety standards, and energy efficiency guidelines

job.title: Lead - C&I Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - DCS\_PLC (Distributed Control System\_ Programmable Logic Control)

System Reliability and Maintenance:

Ensure the availability and functioning of all control loops in auto mode, maintaining reliability of equipment protection under BTG.

Schedule and execute regular backups of DCS and PLC systems to prevent data loss.

Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of DCS and PLC hardware to minimize downtime.

Monitor system alarms daily and ensure the healthiness and redundancy of systems.

Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) for annual maintenance activities and system upgrades.

Manage the proper functioning of Operator Workstations (OWS) and Engineering Workstations (EWS).

Hardware and Software Management:

job.title: Brand on Digital Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

Brand Strategy Leadership:

Design and lead the execution of advanced branding strategies, aligning them with overarching business objectives & utilize in-depth market research, brand positioning analysis, and competitive benchmarking to formulate campaigns targeting diverse audiences.

Integrate cross-platform approaches, including traditional and digital media channels, to enhance brand visibility and perception with high-level budget allocations, resource planning, and milestone-setting for key campaigns.

Content Ecosystem Development:

Develop a robust content ecosystem that spans multimedia formats, from video and infographics to long-form editorial content & guide teams in crafting narratives that resonate with specific audience segments while staying true to the corporate brand identity.

Ensure content complies with emerging industry standards, including accessibility and SEO optimization, while pioneering innovations in content presentation and user engagement tactics.

Social Media and Digital Branding Governance:

Define the strategic roadmap for corporate social media engagement, encompassing platform selection, content themes, and annual calendar planning to approve and monitor top-tier campaigns that involve significant investment or reputation impact.

Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for social platforms, tracking metrics with sophisticated tools like Sprout Social or Hootsuite & drive efforts to capitalize on new-age platforms like metaverse branding or AR/VR experiences.

Data-Driven Brand Insights:

Lead initiatives to extract actionable insights from multi-channel branding efforts, utilizing tools like Tableau or advanced CRM analytics by studying user behaviors, preferences, and patterns to refine ongoing campaigns.

Propose data-backed modifications in brand positioning and outreach efforts to C-suite executives, ensuring strategic decisions are grounded in accurate, real-time analytics.

High-Impact Campaign Leadership:

Spearhead high-visibility campaigns such as corporate rebranding, mergers and acquisitions communication, and crisis management initiatives & develop the strategic framework and oversee operational execution to ensure measurable impact.

Employ advanced project management tools like Asana or Jira to manage timelines, resources, and deliverables, ensuring seamless coordination across multiple stakeholders.

Brand Consistency Authority:

Act as the final authority on brand guidelines and their application, resolving disputes or ambiguities in brand representation across marketing and communication channels.

Champion corporate identity adherence during collaborations with external agencies, ensuring third-party outputs align with internal standards and values.

Corporate Communications Team

Marketing Team

Finance Department

IT and Technology Support

Key Stakeholders - External:

Social Media Platforms

Media Houses

Event Management Firms

Government Advertising and Media Regulatory Bodies

Brand Strategy Consultants

Digital Marketing Suppliers

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, or Business Administration from a recognized institution is essential.

Certifications in advanced digital marketing, brand strategy, or media planning are highly desirable.

Extensive knowledge of digital branding, analytics platforms, and emerging trends in social media ecosystems is required to drive strategic initiatives.

Work Experience:

13+ years of proven experience in branding, communication, or digital strategy roles, preferably within large corporate or multinational settings.

Demonstrated expertise in managing high-impact branding campaigns, overseeing digital advertising budgets, and leading cross-functional branding projects is essential for this role.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Techno Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities of Role

Purchase to Receipt Process Execution:

  • Process purchase requisitions (PR) and convert them into purchase orders (PO) as per approved workflows in SAP/Ariba.
  • Coordinate with suppliers for order acknowledgments
  • Support PO amendments, cancellations, and extension processes in alignment with business needs and approvals.

Post-PO Process Compliance & Coordination:

  • Maintain compliance with Delegation of Authority (DOA), tax (GST, eWay bill), and statutory requirements during procurement execution.

Operational Reporting & Issue Resolution:

  • Support root cause analysis (RCA) for any delays, process gaps, or data errors in the P2D cycle.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to the Lead – Purchase to Deliver for timely closure.
  • Ensure adherence to SLAs/KPIs related to procurement transaction processing.

Stakeholder & Vendor Support:

  • Act as the first point of contact for vendor BU TC queries on PO status, dispatch readiness, and payment eligibility post-receipt.
  • Coordinate internally with business unit procurement, operations, and finance teams for procurement clarifications.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and automation testing within procurement workflows. Implement Issue and Escalation Tracker and log. Ensure timely closure of all improvement – corrective/preventive actions

Work with GCC TC Head to initiate, implement and monitor all continuous improvement projects relevant for operational performance improvement

  • Implement capacity management and operations business continuity management plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery to assigned Sector business.

Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in Engineering, Commerce, or Management.
  • Certifications in Procurement, Techno-Commercial Operations, or Supply Chain (preferred).
  • Work Experience: 2–5 years of experience in procurement operations, purchase order processing, or techno-commercial functions.

job.title: IMS Lead - Business Excellence
job.description:
Responsibilities

IMS Framework Design and Integration:

Design and integrate a comprehensive Integrated Management System (IMS) that aligns with ISO standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and organizational objectives.

Ensure the IMS framework integrates quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management systems into a cohesive structure that enhances operational efficiency and regulatory compliance, leverage industry best practices and technological advancements to create a robust and scalable IMS.

System Architecture and Process Optimization:

Develop and refine the architecture of the IMS to support seamless integration across various management systems.

Focus on process optimization by implementing advanced methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Management (BPM), utilize process mapping and simulation tools to identify inefficiencies and enhance process performance, ensuring that the IMS supports continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Risk Management and Compliance Integration:

Integrate comprehensive risk management practices within the IMS to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks.

Implement advanced risk assessment tools and techniques, including probabilistic risk analysis and scenario planning, to ensure robust risk management, ensure that the IMS supports compliance with local, national, and international regulations by embedding compliance checks and controls within the system.

Performance Monitoring and Data Analytics:

Establish advanced performance monitoring mechanisms using data analytics and real-time dashboards.

Implement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of the IMS and its impact on organizational performance, utilize data analytics platforms and business intelligence tools to analyze performance trends, identify areas for improvement, and drive data-driven decision-making.

Audit and Assurance Processes:

Develop and manage rigorous internal and external audit processes to ensure the integrity and effectiveness of the IMS, implement automated audit management systems to streamline audit processes, track findings, and ensure timely corrective actions.

Coordinate with certification bodies and regulatory agencies to maintain compliance and certification status.

Technology Integration and System Upgrades:

Lead the integration of advanced technologies and digital solutions within the IMS to enhance system functionality and efficiency.

Explore and implement emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and blockchain to improve data accuracy, process automation, and system interoperability, plan and execute system upgrades to ensure the IMS remains current with technological advancements and industry standards.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Senior Leadership Team

Department SPOCs

Operations Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

External Auditors

Industry Certification Bodies

Regulatory Agencies

Consultants

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Engineering or a related field

Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA) or relevant certification in Operations Excellence (preferred)

Work Experience:

8+ years of experience in managing integrated management systems

Certifications in IMS standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001)

job.title: Lead - Field instrumentation (Turbine)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Turbine)

Operational Excellence and Equipment Reliability:

Monitor the availability and functionality of all Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Turbine including UPS, DCS, SWAS, CPU systems, Governing system, ETS, HPLP Bypass, Turbine, and Auxiliaries.

Conduct routine maintenance tasks for SWAS, Motor Operated Valves (MOV), Turbine, and Auxiliaries to prevent operational disruptions.

Execute timely overhauls of units to maintain optimal performance and reduce downtime.

Troubleshoot and resolve equipment breakdowns promptly to ensure continuous operations.

Conduct scheduled calibrations of instrumentation and generate detailed reports on findings and adjustments.

Allocate necessary resources and guidance to contractor technicians for the execution of routine maintenance tasks.

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability.

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes.

Technical and Process Improvement:

Perform periodic backups of DCS, PLC, PSI, and other turbine and auxiliary systems to safeguard operational data.

Provide technical expertise and resources to contractor technicians for routine maintenance and system upgrades.

Follow equipment checklists meticulously to maintain high standards of operation and maintenance.

Inventory Management and documentation:

Provide inputs to Team Leads for effective spares and inventory management, including the development of indigenous spares.

Manage the procurement process for equipment and services, ensuring adherence to financial guidelines.

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department to maintain business continuity.

Implement field related of ZFO Action Items and AWMS to promote continuous improvement.

Adhere to the BPT process, technical audits, and compliance with safety regulations to ensure zero accidents and a safe working environment.

Report any unsafe conditions, acts, and near misses in the work area to prevent potential hazards.

Follow the CHETNA process and ensure all departmental compliances are met.

Ensure compliance with safety audit observations and implement corrective actions as needed.

Utilize the work permit system guidelines to manage and control work-related risks effectively.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency across the department.

Implement process and system improvements by adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Ensure the integration of advanced technology and digitization in daily operations to improve system performance.

Drive the adoption of digital tools and platforms to streamline workflows and enhance data-driven decision-making.

job.title: Lead - SCADA (E&M)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Maintenance and Operation of SCADA Systems:

Conduct regular maintenance checks on assigned SCADA systems within specific plant segments, ensuring they run smoothly and efficiently by performing system diagnostics, software updates, and addressing any minor technical issues to prevent interruptions in operations.

Identify and troubleshoot any technical malfunctions in the SCADA systems, collaborating with other team members if necessary to resolve issues quickly and prevent unplanned downtime, which could impact plant productivity and safety.

Network Security and Protocol Management:

Regularly monitor and configure network security protocols within the SCADA system to ensure safe and uninterrupted data transfer across different plant sections by managing firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption protocols that protect sensitive information.

Set up, configure, and maintain essential SCADA-related infrastructure, such as servers, switches, and routers, to provide a secure and stable network environment that supports the SCADA system and prevents unauthorized access or data breaches.

Technical Support for Business Development:

Act as a technical advisor to the sales and business development teams, providing insights on SCADA system functionalities and potential upgrades that align with client needs by giving input on the feasibility, cost, and benefits of different SCADA solutions to aid in sales strategies and client presentations.

Engage in discussions about emerging technologies in SCADA and related control systems, communicating potential benefits to the business development team to support marketing initiatives and promote advanced solutions that could attract new clients.

Technical Review and Vendor Communication:

Review technical specifications, industry standards, and product brochures when considering SCADA software purchases from vendors and carefully evaluate these documents to confirm the software meets plant requirements, is compatible with existing systems, and aligns with regulatory standards for SCADA.

Maintain open communication with vendors, discussing product capabilities, licensing terms, and support services to ensure any SCADA system acquisitions are well-understood, fully documented, and meet the plant's current and future technical needs.

SCADA System Programming and Development:

Assist in developing user-friendly SCADA screens, custom databases, and reporting tools that enable efficient monitoring and analysis of plant data by designing clear, responsive interfaces that give operators real-time access to critical information and streamline workflows.

Configure and manage SCADA system networks to support data integration across various plant segments.

Safety and Compliance Management:

Ensure that all SCADA system operations adhere to established safety protocols, regulatory standards, and industry best practices by routine checks and updates to safety features and compliance documentation, which help protect both personnel and equipment.

Maintain accurate documentation for all licenses, support contracts, and compliance-related records associated with SCADA software and hardware to avoid compliance issues, supports system audits, and ensures clear tracking of all SCADA-related liabilities and assets.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

Collect and analyze SCADA data to generate insights into system performance, energy consumption, and operational efficiency.

Develop and deliver detailed reports to management, including recommendations for system improvements.

Maintain accurate logs of system events, alarms, and incidents for audit and compliance purposes.

Energy Efficiency and Sustainability:

Use SCADA data to identify opportunities for energy conservation and sustainable practices.

Implement advanced control strategies to reduce energy waste and optimize resource utilization.

Collaborate with the Energy Management team to achieve airport-wide energy reduction goals.

Prepare CAPEX and OPEX budgets for the mining department, including monthly MIS and provision preparation.

Liaison and Advanced Technology Adoption:

Liaise with D.M.S. (Mech.) and D.M.S. (Elect.) to ensure smooth and safe mine operations.

Implement advanced technologies for mechanization and automation in mines to enhance efficiency and safety.

Equipment Lifecycle Management and Energy Conservation:

job.title: Manager
job.description:

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure that all gas and chemical operations meet safety regulations and industry standards. Conduct audits and risk assessments to identify hazards, implement corrective actions, and mitigate risks.

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Organizational & Culture Building:

  • Fostering a collaborative, agile culture that aligns with company values, driving employee engagement, and ensuring organizational growth and development.

Leadership in Change Management:

  • Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies.

Bulk Gas System Management:

  • Oversee the management of bulk gas systems, including their handling, storage, and distribution. Ensure adherence to safety protocols, and conduct regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks and maintain operational efficiency.

  • Supervise the storage, handling, and application of specialty chemicals. Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and develop safe use and disposal procedures.

  • Oversee chemical processes, including their handling, storage, and application. Develop procedures for safe use and waste management to meet environmental and safety standards.

Process Innovation:

  • Lead the development of efficient, eco-friendly chemical and gas processes to boost yield and sustainability.

System Optimization:

  • Enhance the efficiency and performance of gas and chemical systems through data analysis and process improvements. Collaborate on system upgrades to boost reliability and reduce costs.

Training and Development:

Team Development:

  • Foster a respectful and safe work environment. Lead effective teams, mentor team members, and promote professional growth and success.

job.title: Completion Engineer
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Completion Engineer

Completion Engineering and Operations:

• Design, plan, and execute completion engineering operations to achieve well objectives on time and within budget while minimizing environmental impact.

• Conduct engineering analyses to ensure completion designs meet well objectives efficiently, focusing on sand face completion concept selection, tubing stress analysis, and completion fluids.

Compliance and Standards:

Technical Documentation and Support:

• Maintain computer models to track and predict key completion parameters and performance metrics.

Post-Completion Activities:

• Develop and maintain comprehensive well files and performance tracking in accordance with established formats.

Project Leadership:

• Collaborate with various E&P disciplines to ensure effective interaction and coordination throughout the completion process.

• Lead performance improvement initiatives, including operational scheduling, requisitions, and technical documentation preparation.

Cost Estimation and Budgeting:

Oil and Gas Industry

job.title: Deputy General Manager (Safety)
job.description:
Responsibilities

HSE Governance and Compliance:

Develop a comprehensive occupational health and safety management system aligned with ISO 45001:2018, tailored to the specific risks and operational requirements of hydro PSP sites, and ensure its consistent implementation.

Conduct detailed safety audits, identify compliance gaps, and work collaboratively with site teams to close observations, ensuring adherence to both statutory and group-level safety standards.

Risk Management and Mitigation:

Regularly update the Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA) framework based on incident learnings and site-specific observations to proactively address potential risks and hazards.

Develop and implement detailed Fatality Prevention Plans (FPP) for high-risk activities, ensuring the adoption of preventive measures to eliminate hazards before they escalate.

Incident Prevention and Response:

Lead the investigation of incidents, near-misses, and unsafe acts, using root cause analysis methodologies to derive actionable insights and prevent recurrence of similar events.

Create comprehensive incident reports that include learnings and corrective actions, sharing these insights across all Hydro PSP sites to promote organizational awareness and continuous improvement.

Employee Training and Skill Development:

Organize specialized training sessions tailored to Hydro PSP operational risks, focusing on emergency response, equipment handling, and compliance with safety standards to enhance overall site readiness.

Conduct competency assessments for all site employees and contractors, ensuring they possess the necessary skills and knowledge to operate safely and effectively in their respective roles.

Safety Engagement Initiatives:

Lead safety awareness campaigns and engagement initiatives, such as safety townhalls, workshops, and community safety programs, to foster a culture of shared responsibility and proactive safety behavior.

Plan and execute safety-focused events, including National Safety Day and World Environment Day, to reinforce the organization's commitment to safety excellence and employee well-being.

Reporting and MIS Management:

Maintain detailed safety scorecards and regularly update MIS systems with critical safety metrics, ensuring accurate and timely reporting to senior management.

Utilize digital tools and governance platforms to track compliance, monitor safety performance, and ensure seamless communication of key safety data across the organization.

Hydro Project Teams

Cluster Safety Leads

HR and Training Teams

Maintenance Teams

Senior Management

Key Stakeholders - External:

Regulatory Authorities

Certification Bodies

Hydro Contractors and Vendors

Local Emergency Services

Industry Safety Groups

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, or related fields).

Advanced Diploma/ Post Diploma in Industrial Safety.

Certifications in project safety and ISO standards (e.g., NEBOSH, ISO 45001, or IMS certifications).

Work Experience:

15+ years of experience in hydro safety operations or similar domains, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.

Expertise in managing safety for complex hydro projects, including risk mitigation and compliance with safety regulations.

job.title: Senior Manager - WSMD Lab (Copper Concentrate)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lab Operations Planning and Execution:

  • Manage daily and shift-wise laboratory testing activities in line with smelter production priorities.
  • Ensure timely receipt, preparation, analysis, and reporting of samples from smelting, converting, refining, slag, dust, by-products, and related process streams.
  • Coordinate with production, process, and quality teams to prioritize urgent samples and ensure quick analytical feedback for operational decisions.
  • Monitor adherence to sample collection, labelling, preservation, testing, and reporting protocols to maintain reliability of results.

Process Optimization and Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify improvement opportunities in sample preparation, testing turnaround time, analytical accuracy, and laboratory workflow efficiency.
  • Support implementation of standard methods, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives within WSMD laboratory operations.
  • Track routine operational bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions with the Lab Head and concerned departments.
  • Assist in adoption of improved analytical practices, automation support, and digital tools for better lab productivity and data reliability.

Quality Assurance and Control:

  • Ensure execution of quality control checks, calibration verification, standardization, and validation of analytical results as per defined procedures.
  • Maintain compliance with approved laboratory SOPs, test methods, internal quality standards, and applicable statutory or customer requirements.
  • Review routine test data for abnormalities, deviations, or inconsistencies and escalate critical issues to the WSMD Lab Head.
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for testing errors, repeat analysis, delays, and non-conformities.

Equipment Readiness and Troubleshooting:

  • Ensure availability, calibration, routine checks, and proper functioning of laboratory instruments and equipment used for WSMD analysis.
  • Coordinate with maintenance, OEMs, and service providers for troubleshooting, breakdown resolution, AMC support, and instrument reliability.
  • Maintain equipment logbooks, calibration records, preventive maintenance schedules, and breakdown history for audit readiness.
  • Support safe and correct operation of instruments by lab chemists, technicians, and shift personnel.

HSE and Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure strict adherence to HSE requirements, PPE usage, chemical handling procedures, waste disposal norms, and emergency response protocols inside the WSMD Lab.
  • Conduct routine safety observations, housekeeping checks, and compliance follow-ups in coordination with the Lab Head and Safety team.
  • Support compliance with environmental and statutory requirements related to laboratory chemicals, residues, samples, and waste streams.
  • Promote safe work practices among lab team members and ensure timely closure of safety observations and audit points.

Cost Management and Budgeting:

  • Monitor consumption of chemicals, reagents, gases, standards, glassware, spares, and other laboratory consumables to support uninterrupted operations.
  • Assist the Lab Head in inventory planning, PR follow-up, vendor coordination, and cost control initiatives for routine lab requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce wastage, optimize reagent usage, and improve cost efficiency without compromising testing quality.
  • Maintain records of consumable usage, stock levels, and critical inventory items for operational planning and audit purposes.

Shift Team Coordination and Capability Building:

  • Coordinate daily work allocation for lab chemists, technicians, samplers, and shift personnel as per testing load and operational requirements.
  • Guide team members on standard test procedures, safe lab practices, instrument handling, documentation, and quality expectations.
  • Support training, skill development, and multi-skilling of laboratory team members to build operational flexibility.
  • Ensure continuity of laboratory operations during shifts, peak workload, audits, and absence of senior leadership, while developing readiness to succeed the WSMD Lead role in future.

Reporting and Data Analytics:

  • Ensure timely preparation, review, and submission of routine analytical reports, shift reports, quality summaries, deviation reports, and MIS data.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of sample records, test results, calibration data, corrective actions, and audit-related information.
  • Analyze lab performance trends such as turnaround time, repeat testing, deviations, equipment uptime, and sample load to support improvement actions.
  • Escalate critical quality trends, abnormal results, and urgent operational issues to the WSMD Lab Head and concerned stakeholders.

Digitization and Tech Adoption:

  • Support use of SAP Lab/LIMS and other digital systems for sample tracking, result entry, report generation, and data traceability.
  • Ensure timely and accurate digital updating of test results, equipment records, calibration schedules, and lab MIS.
  • Assist in implementation of automation, dashboards, and data-driven reporting practices to improve laboratory efficiency.
  • Promote disciplined data entry, record retention, and system compliance among lab team members.

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related science/engineering discipline

Master’s degree in Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred

Work Experience (Range of years):

Over 15 years of experience in Quality Assurance within the Copper Manufacturing industry

Relevant experience in laboratory operations, analytical quality control, or process lab functions, preferably in copper smelting, metals, mining, chemicals, or process industry environment; suitable for Senior Manager level with team coordination, operational ownership, and future leadership readiness

Certifications:

Certification in Quality Management or Quality Assurance

Additional certifications in Laboratory Management or Environmental Compliance preferred

job.title: Senior Engineer – Digital Solutions and AI Integration
job.description:

  • Java Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring MVC

Process Automation

  • Proven track record in building enterprise automation workflows using Microsoft Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop flows).

Cloud Platforms

  • Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider ( Azure, AWS, or GCP), including serverless computing, object storage, managed database services, and IAM policies.

Teamwork, Communication & Execution

  • Collaboration & Team Player: Demonstrated capability to work effectively within multi-disciplinary & multi-location teams, engaging collaboratively with team members, product managers, vendor partners, UX designers, and business stakeholders.
  • Interpersonal & Communication Skills: Adept at verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal skills to translate technical concepts for non-technical leadership and clearly express solution requirements, designs, concepts, etc.
  • Action-Oriented & Proactive: Highly self-motivated, action-oriented, and proactive in taking ownership, identifying potential roadblocks early, and proposing practical digital solutions.

Preferred Experience

  • Understanding of LLM/SLM fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, ChromaDB, Qdrant).
  • Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and function-calling protocols.
  • DevOps & Containerization: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps for automated building and deployment.
  • Scripting Languages: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript for data processing and AI script integration.
  • Agile Delivery: Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with cross-functional business, data, and digital product teams.
  • Problem-Solving & Communication: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures and articulate tech solutions to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualification

job.title: Associate Manager - Cell Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Safety Compliance:

  • Ensure that all maintenance procedures for PERC technology comply with safety standards and protocols, focusing on handling and processing sensitive components like passivation layers.

Innovation:

  • Driving continuous improvement by leading R&D efforts to develop advanced solar technologies and identifying market trends to maintain a competitive edge.

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leadership in Change Management:

  • Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies.

People Development:

  • Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions.

PERC Technology Management:

  • Oversee maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) solar cells, focusing on the unique aspects of this technology, such as passivation layers and rear surface treatment.

Issue Diagnosis and Repair:

  • Address and resolve issues related to PERC cell performance, including troubleshooting problems with passivation layers, rear surface contact, and overall cell efficiency.

Preventive Maintenance:

  • Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules tailored to the specific needs of PERC cells, such as ensuring the integrity of the passivation layer and rear contacts.

Quality Assurance:

  • Ensure that maintenance practices uphold the high standards required for PERC cells. Perform detailed inspections to verify the condition of passivation layers and rear surface contacts..

CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions):

  • Identify and address specific issues affecting PERC cells, such as degradation of passivation layers or rear contact problems, and implement corrective and preventive measures to enhance cell performance.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and coordinate the maintenance team in handling PERC cells, providing specific guidance on handling and maintaining passivation and rear contact systems.

Performance Monitoring:

  • Track performance indicators specific to PERC cells, such as efficiency metrics and degradation rates of passivation layers, to optimize maintenance strategies and improve cell longevity.

  • Production Team
  • Engineering Department
  • Quality Assurance Team
  • Operations Management

  • Spare Parts Suppliers
  • Technical Consultants
  • External Auditors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • 12-14 Years of experience in cell maintenance, with specific experience in PERC technology.

Draft the Note for Approval (NFA) for the selected bidder and secure necessary approvals as per the Delegation of Authority (DoA).

Contract Management:

Establish and maintain approved contract records within the ERP system, ensuring adherence to system functionalities and policies. Draft, review, and issue rate contracts based on approved decisions. Formulate master outline agreements (OA) in the ERP system based on rate contracts. Generate Purchase Orders (PO) or Sales Orders (SO) for procurement under valid rate contracts.

Post Order Management:

Expedite the delivery of ordered materials to ensure timely arrival. Create Change Orders or Amendments to orders, including adjustments in quantity/rate, additional items, and time extensions. Oversee inbound logistics services for other Ex-Works domestic supplies. Implement contingency plans in response to immediate business needs. Provide assistance to the operations team in managing resources effectively.

Supplier Management:

Formulate vendor evaluation criteria and a vendor segmentation matrix based on annual spending and associated risks. Establish vendor performance evaluation criteria and determine evaluation frequency for each vendor segment. Foster strategic partnerships with suppliers/vendors to benefit Adani from a long-term perspective and leverage them for business value additions.

Documentation & Reporting:

Assist in gathering and analyzing data related to various procurement activities (e.g., commodity analysis, supplier debugging) for respective categories. Identify and pursue efficiency and value improvement opportunities through data analysis. Support action planning and implementation based on data analytics for assigned categories.

Quality Assurance:

Ensure all procured materials and services meet the required quality standards and specifications. Work with the quality control team to address and resolve any quality-related issues with suppliers.

Digital Mindset:

Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

Team Development:

Promote a respectful and safe workplace, lead collaborative and productive teams, and mentor for growth and success.Offer guidance, support, and mentorship to team members, facilitating their development and success while maintaining high morale and motivation.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Environment
job.description:
Responsibilities

Ecological Survey and Monitoring:

Conduct seasonal surveys of terrestrial flora and fauna within a 10 km vicinity of power station, ensuring comprehensive data collection and analysis.

Perform extensive monitoring of avifauna and interpret terrestrial ecology data using various diversity indices to assess ecological health.

Prepare and submit half-yearly terrestrial ecological survey reports, detailing findings and providing insights for ecological management.

Coordinate with the horticulture department for the development and tracking of green zones, aligning with Environmental clearance conditions.

Ecological Reporting and Regulatory Adherence:

Coordinate, collect data, and submit Annual Terrestrial Ecology reports for other operational sites of APL, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

At the site level, manage the collection and submission of data for sustainability reporting, addressing observations raised by auditors and providing necessary backups.

Oversee terrestrial-related ISO certifications, maintaining compliance with international standards and best practices.

Conduct assigned internal audits to ensure adherence to ecological and environmental policies and procedures.

Interact with statutory bodies like State forest departments, government offices, and institutions for data generation and authentication.

Plant Level Engagement and Safety:

Actively participate in plant-level functions such as safety and 5S initiatives, contributing to a culture of operational excellence and workplace organization.

Ensure the safety of business associates and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols, minimizing risks and promoting a safe working environment.

Coordinate with external agencies for conducting Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) studies for upcoming projects, and thorough ecological evaluations.

Conduct training sessions for business associates on legal aspects related to terrestrial ecology, enhancing awareness and compliance.

Business Sustainability:

Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department, promoting sustainable practices and compliance.

Lead initiatives to reduce environmental impact and promote biodiversity conservation, aligning with the company's sustainability goals.

Implement measures to enhance resource efficiency and reduce waste, contributing to the company's environmental stewardship.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency, streamlining data collection and analysis processes.

Innovate and implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy, enhancing ecological monitoring capabilities.

Review and implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas to advance ecological assessment methods.

Drive the integration of advanced technology and digitization within the department, ensuring the use of cutting-edge tools for ecological surveys.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Master's degree in Ecology, Environmental Science, or a related field with a focus on terrestrial ecosystems/.PhD (preferred)

Work Experience (Range of years):

5+ years of relevant experience in ecological surveying, monitoring, and data analysis.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the power sector or related industries with a strong background in environmental management and sustainability practices.

job.title: Manager - Engineering
job.description:
Responsibilities

Real-Time Monitoring of Turbine Operations

  • Monitor turbine operations in real-time using SCADA systems, tracking performance metrics such as power output, rotor speed, and grid connection status.
  • Identify and report deviations from normal operating parameters, coordinating with the SCADA lead for further analysis and corrective actions.

Alarm Response and Incident Reporting

  • Respond to alarms generated by the SCADA system, following predefined protocols to assess, document, and escalate incidents as necessary.
  • Maintain accurate records of incidents, actions taken, and outcomes to support continuous improvement and compliance reporting.

Data Logging and Analysis

  • Perform data logging and initial analysis of turbine performance data, identifying patterns that may indicate emerging issues or optimization opportunities.
  • Support detailed analysis by preparing data sets and reports for use by engineering teams in root cause analysis and troubleshooting.

System Health Checks and Maintenance Support

  • Conduct regular system health checks to ensure all SCADA components are functioning correctly, including sensors, communication links, and control interfaces.
  • Assist in basic maintenance tasks such as resetting alarms, recalibrating sensors, and updating software as directed by the SCADA lead.

Cybersecurity Compliance and Data Integrity

  • Adhere to cybersecurity protocols within the SCADA environment, ensuring data security and integrity are maintained at all times.
  • Report any suspicious activity or security breaches to the SCADA lead, supporting efforts to safeguard system operations.

Compliance with Operating Procedures

  • Follow all standard operating procedures for SCADA monitoring, including guidelines for alarm management, data handling, and communication with other departments.
  • Participate in regular audits and training sessions to ensure compliance with industry standards and internal policies.

Support for Troubleshooting Activities

  • Assist in troubleshooting activities, providing real-time data and observations to support root cause analysis conducted by SCADA engineers.
  • Document findings and recommendations from troubleshooting activities to contribute to the development of improved response protocols.

Team Collaboration and Communication

  • Work closely with SCADA and operations teams to ensure coordinated responses to system events, sharing information and insights as needed.
  • Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, including engineers, technicians, and management, to ensure smooth SCADA operations.

Continuous Learning and Development

  • Engage in training and professional development activities to enhance skills in SCADA monitoring, data analysis, and system troubleshooting.
  • Stay informed about updates to SCADA systems and industry best practices to maintain a high level of technical competence.

Contribution to Continuous Improvement

  • Provide feedback on SCADA system performance, alarm settings, and response procedures, suggesting improvements to enhance monitoring effectiveness.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, supporting the SCADA team in implementing new technologies and optimizing system operations.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Lead - Grid Compliance

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • SCADA Equipment Vendors
  • Field Service Providers

Qualifications

Educational Background:

  • Diploma or BE in Instrumentation or Electrical Engineering.

Work Experience:

  • 1-3 years monitoring SCADA systems, managing system alerts, and assisting in incident response.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Familiarity with SCADA software, basic diagnostic tools, and understanding alarm response procedures.

job.title: Associate Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze large-scale operational and business datasets to identify trends, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation, and analysis using SQL and Python.
  • Support business decision-making through statistical analysis, forecasting, and performance reporting.
  • Monitor operational performance and identify root causes of underperformance.
  • Conduct customer, market, and competitor analytics to support business growth initiatives.

  • Automate reporting and analytics processes to improve efficiency and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with operations, engineering, finance, sales, and customer support teams to implement data-driven solutions.
  • Develop predictive models and analytical frameworks to support business objectives.
  • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders through reports and presentations.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Management, or equivalent preferred

job.title: Assistant Manager - ESG
job.description:
Responsibilities

ESG Analyst

Planning and Execution:

  • Assist in executing the ESG strategy by collecting data on environmental, social, and governance metrics from various departments.
  • Coordinate the submission of monthly data from KPIs across departments, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.
  • Support the planning of sustainability initiatives by providing critical data inputs for environmental and governance frameworks.

Process Optimization and Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify areas for process improvements in data collection, ensuring efficiency and accuracy.
  • Recommend improvements in the existing ESG reporting system to optimize data flow and minimize errors.
  • Implement streamlined data processes to enhance integration between departments for better ESG performance.

HSE and Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure adherence to the Environmental Management System (EMS) by collecting data on regulatory compliance for air, water, waste, and safety.
  • Monitor compliance across departments and submit findings to regulatory authorities as required.
  • Review the data for consistency with regulatory requirements, providing input for necessary corrections.

Cost Management and Budgeting:

  • Track costs associated with ESG-related activities, ensuring that data collection and reporting processes are within budget.
  • Assist in budget planning for sustainability and governance projects by analyzing financial data related to ESG initiatives.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities in the implementation of ESG programs.

Resource and Workforce Management:

  • Coordinate with departments to gather ESG-related data, ensuring all teams are aligned with reporting timelines.
  • Support ESG-related workforce planning by providing data insights for staff involved in sustainability and governance projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to manage resources for ESG reporting and compliance activities.

Reporting and Data Analytics:

  • Prepare monthly and quarterly ESG reports, including integrated and sustainability reports, using data collected from various departments.
  • Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for environmental and governance aspects, identifying trends and areas of concern.
  • Contribute to the development of the governance framework by providing detailed data analysis and insights.

Digitization and Tech Adoption:

  • Utilize digital tools and software for ESG data collection and analysis, improving the efficiency of reporting processes.
  • Implement digital dashboards to track key ESG metrics in real-time, allowing for quicker decision-making.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Operations Team
  • Finance Team
  • Legal team
  • Secretarial

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Regulatory Bodies
  • ESG Consultants
  • Environmental Auditors
  • Rating agencies

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Bachelor's / master’s degree in environmental science, Sustainability, or related field

Work Experience (Range of years):

4-8 years in sustainability, ESG reporting, or data analysis roles
