Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Contact Centre Specialist - Network Operations Centre
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Only applicants with full Australian Citizenship can be considered for this role, due to security requirements.

*After initial onboarding and training this will be on a 24 x 7 rotating roster 5 days required on-site

*

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

Join Optus as a Contact Centre Specialist, where you’ll deliver high‑quality managed services and technical support across Cloud Contact Centre technologies for a large government client. Working within a mature ITIL environment, you’ll take ownership of escalated issues, support change and incident processes, and collaborate with customer and internal teams to ensure stability, continuity, and exceptional customer experience. This role blends hands‑on technical troubleshooting with strong stakeholder engagement, contributing to customer satisfaction, compliance, process improvement, and seamless delivery of Contact Centre services.

Your day to day will consist of

  • Deliver technical support for Cloud Contact Centre environments, handling escalated incidents and customer issues.
  • Update and maintain ServiceNow records, ensuring accurate tracking of incidents, changes, and customer interactions.
  • Execute complex MACs, transitions, and after‑hours changes in line with agreed processes and maintenance windows.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues and support customer security requirements.
  • Keep technical documentation current to support ongoing operations and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Participate in service governance meetings, providing updates, insights, and support for incident and problem management.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Strong ICT technical and operational background with experience supporting Contact Centre, Networks and Cloud technologies.
  • Proven troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and ability to manage user‑facing technical issues under pressure.
  • Working to SLAs in a Network Operational Centre (NOC) environment and familiar with service management processes.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, including incident, problem, and change management processes.
  • Ability to work autonomously with strong organisational skills and flexibility to adapt to shifting priorities.
  • Excellent customer and vendor engagement capabilities with a focus on positive outcomes and communication.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear documentation and stakeholder updates.
  • Ability to coordinate across cross‑functional teams and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and ways of working.
  • Desirable: Cloud skills, knowledge of major CC platforms, and awareness of emerging IP communications technologies

The good stuff…. | What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170. job.title: Quality Technician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

Ensures products received or produced meet technical specifications trains others and assists in process development. Works under minimal supervision. Supports customer issues resolution at customer end

Key Responsibilities

Support at customer end , SPOC for customer to identify and resolve issues . Provide 8D and issues resolution to customer for any issues , Verifies the final quality of products on the production line at customer end

Compares the physical characteristics of components, materials, equipment and products to technical specifications to identify defects.

Separates products that do not have the desired technical specification, using basic and/or complex measurement techniques and equipment.

Documents products that do not meet technical specifications using specified systems.

Trains others in the use of measurement equipment, segregation of non-conforming product and documentation.

Follows the norms and standards of quality defined by the Company.

Reports progress on problem resolution to management.

Assists in the development of new methods and procedures.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Diploma in Engineering preferred.High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Measurement Science - Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, “Metrology” e.g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.

Quality Process Management - Proficient application of quality tools and methods (e.g. APQP, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, Capability studies, Process Audit, inspection, test, etc.) to ensure quality of products, processes and services.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Laboratory Management - Leads technical resources while managing the business aspects of a laboratory using measure to control both the technical and business aspects of the organization and assuring the requirements of the appropriate certifications and/or accreditations are met.

job.title: Construction Safety Manager, APJC DCPD H&S
job.description:
About AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Do you enjoy taking an idea and turning it into something? Do you ever find yourself marveling at buildings, infrastructure, or landmarks and ask "what does it take to build something like that?" This role is for an experienced Health and Safety (H&S) Specialist, H&S Engineer, or H&S Manager who will support AWS Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD) projects. Internally, you will partner with DCPD teams such as Construction, Commissioning, Security, DCHS Ops and Procurement Teams to achieve health and safety goals and improve our safety culture. Externally, you will engage with General Contractors and AWS Suppliers to confirm/clarify the business expectations for H&S, and look for ways to continually improve H&S of our contracted services. You will work under the direction of Regional Health and Safety Manager within the assigned region of Asia Pacific/Japan China.

Key job responsibilities You will influence program development, framework and strategy but will be responsible for deploying programs that cover H&S elements of leadership, planning, support, operational controls, continuous improvement, performance management, ensure the businesses are operating to jurisdictional requirements, and AWS Safety Management Program (SMP) requirements.

Examples:

  • Coordinates with DCPD Construction Managers to prioritize H&S in planning and execution in all phases of DCPD projects.
  • Ensures & Monitors General Contractors and AWS deployment vendors compliance to onboarding requirements in Avetta.
  • Performs project H&S kickoff sessions, and performs reviews of General Contractor and AWS deployment vendor’s Construction Safety Management Plans where required
  • Documents data and anecdotes in standard reporting tools (Weekly Business Reviews, Monthly Project Reviews) for DCPD and H&S leadership teams
  • Identifies improvement opportunities at project(s), and partners with Data Center Health and Safety (DCHS) Operational Team on regional issues that impact construction/operations handover phases.
  • Audits projects to the mental model ‘do you have a process, and are you following it?’ Then analyzes data (leading and lagging indicators) for trends, risks/opportunities and reports out at project/regional levels and within governance programs
  • Conduct regular site visits with construction managers
  • Participates in project and regional specific contractor and internal team H&S kickoff sessions and annual performance review sessions.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
  • Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
  • Master's degree or equivalent

job.title: Senior Partner Account Manager, Singapore Public Sector , ASEAN Partner and Specialist Organisation
job.description:
Would you like to own building the future of AWS's public sector partner business in Singapore? Are you energized by the opportunity to drive cloud adoption across Government, Healthcare, and Education through strategic partner relationships? Do you thrive at the intersection of sales execution, partner development, and public sector impact?

AWS Partner Account Managers (PAMs) work with select large Systems Integrator (SI) partners to develop go-to-market strategies that expand cloud adoption across Public Sector organizations. As a Public Sector PAM based in Singapore, you will lead the joint sales motion between AWS and your assigned SI partner(s) - creating and executing campaigns that align to AWS Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS) strategic initiatives and your partner's market positioning in Singapore's Government, Healthcare, and Education sectors.

You will work closely with AWS Account Executives, Solution Architects, Public Sector Industry Leaders, and Partner Marketing to develop new routes to market - building pipeline through joint offerings, solutions, and strategic initiatives tailored to Singapore's public sector landscape. The ideal candidate possesses a direct sales and partnership/alliance background that enables them to engage, earn trust, and influence at the CxO level with both partner executives and public sector decision-makers. Successful PAMs think strategically about business, policy, and technical challenges to convey compelling partner value propositions that address public sector outcomes.

Key job responsibilities Drive public sector revenue (Government, Healthcare, Education) through partner-attached opportunities with assigned SI partner(s) Build senior relationships with SI partner executives and AWS leaders to drive joint business value for public sector customers Create and execute Joint Partner Sales Plans targeting government initiatives (Smart Nation, GovTech modernization, healthcare digitization), aligned to AWS strategic direction Work cross-functionally with AWS Account Executives, Solution Architects, Public Sector SMEs, and Partner Marketing to develop new revenue opportunities Develop regular stakeholder interlocks between partner sales teams, AWS public sector account teams, and government stakeholders Cultivate long-term partner relationships and execute joint pursuits with AWS, partner, and end-customer interests at the forefront Communicate partner initiatives, joint wins, and successes across AWS field teams Prepare and lead regular business reviews for AWS senior management

A day in the life The PAM is an individual contributor role responsible for leading the public sector partner business with partner. You will define CxO relationship strategy - engaging AWS senior leaders for executive sponsorship, coordinating executive business reviews, and developing sales opportunities around partner offerings and solutions for public sector customers. You will build and maintain key relationships across government agencies and institutional buyers, advance strategic sales opportunities, and work with a regional team of Partner Managers to manage pipeline and deliver results. This role requires navigating Singapore's public sector procurement landscape, understanding government technology priorities, and translating them into joint partner-AWS solutions.

  • 8+ years of business development, partner development, sales or alliances management experience

job.title: Sales Manager - Low Voltage Systems
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

LVS Sales and Marketing Manager – South East Asia__

As a Sales Manager for ABB's Low Voltage Switchgear business in Singapore, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, market penetration, and customer engagement across ABB's Low Voltage Systems and Solutions portfolio. You will develop and execute sales strategies, build strong customer relationships, identify new business opportunities, and achieve sustainable growth in orders, revenue, profitability, and market share while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sales strategies and business plans to achieve order growth, revenue, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction targets for ABB's Low Voltage Systems and Solutions business.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with customers, consultants, EPCs, and contractors key stakeholders by understanding their needs and providing technical and commercial solutions aligned with ABB's value proposition.
  • Identify, develop, and drive new business opportunities through market analysis, customer engagement, competitive positioning, and promotion of ABB's Low Voltage Switchgear portfolio.
  • Prepare and manage quotations, proposals, contracts, and commercial negotiations, ensuring technical and financial accuracy while supporting project execution, cash collection, and sales administration activities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to execute marketing initiatives, product launches, and customer engagement activities that strengthen ABB's market presence and brand positioning.
  • Monitor sales performance, pipeline development, and project opportunities, implementing recovery plans and corrective actions where necessary to achieve business objectives.
  • Maintain the highest standards of safety, integrity, compliance, and ethical business conduct in accordance with ABB's policies and values.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or any related engineering field.
  • Minimum 7 years of sales, business development, or account management experience within the electrical industry, with a strong focus on Low Voltage Systems, Switchgear, Power Distribution, Motor Control, or related Electrification solutions.
  • Proven track record of achieving sales targets and developing business opportunities within the Singapore market, particularly with consultants, contractors, EPCs, and end users.
  • Strong technical and commercial knowledge of Low Voltage Switchgear, Power Distribution Systems, Motor Control Centers (MCC), Protection Solutions, and related ABB or competitor product offerings.
  • Experience in preparing commercial proposals, contract negotiation, strategic account management, and managing complex sales opportunities from identification through order closure.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build long-term customer relationships and influence decision-makers at multiple levels.
  • Demonstrated commitment to safety, integrity, compliance, and ethical business practices, with the ability to work collaboratively across local and regional teams.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.title: Data Center Project Manager
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Project Manager (DCPM), you will manage assigned IT projects to meet service delivery objectives as well escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles. You will also follow safety policies and procedures and participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents. This job will allow you to build a solid understanding of data center procedures, engage in collaboration across various teams as well as provide mentorship across data centers by sharing outstanding practices.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCPM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keep costs reasonable and contribute to staying within budget.
  • Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
  • Perform troubleshooting for service incidents and escalates, as appropriate, to meet SLA/OLAs, with minimal disruption to the client/customer and business.
  • Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.
  • Proactively review schedules and avoid conflicts when possible. Identify, coordinate, manage expectations, and offer alternatives when defining customer solutions.
  • Manage relationships with clients and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.
  • Suggest ways for reducing the risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.
  • In alignment with management priorities, hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service). Support escalation of issues to appropriate owner.
  • Embody our[culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Qualification or equivalent AND 2+ years experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale environments OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field AND 5+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 7+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR equivalent experience.
  • Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, PMP, ITIL, CDCP.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about [requesting accommodations.](https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/accessibility.html)

job.title: Technical Project Manager (Back End)
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager with strong experience in agile delivery and backend engineering environments to lead the development and operational rollout of StarHub’s core digital platforms.

You will work cross-functionally with Domain Owners (DOs), Engineering Managers (EMs), DevOps teams, QA, Solution Designers (SDs), and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to drive predictable, high-quality delivery of back-end services that support consumer and enterprise customer journeys.

Your ability to manage modern cloud-native development cycles — across CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, and API ecosystems — will be critical to enabling secure, scalable, and resilient platforms that power StarHub’s digital evolution.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Agile Management

  • Drive agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and maintain team rhythm and cadence.
  • Manage backlog hygiene, ensuring stories are well-defined, estimated, and prioritized.
  • Plan and execute phased delivery strategies, ensuring release readiness through Blue/Green deployments, canary releases, and feature flagging.
  • Track delivery health through velocity, throughput, and scope stability metrics.
  • Identify and resolve blockers, risks, and cross-domain dependencies early.
  • Maintain clear delivery dashboards and status reporting to senior stakeholders.

Technical Coordination & Planning

  • Partner with Domain Owners and Tech Leads to align on architecture, delivery scope, and capacity planning.
  • Coordinate with DevOps and QA/QE teams to ensure readiness for integration, testing, and release.
  • Support implementation of continuous delivery and observability practices across teams.
  • Define, Monitor and report on key delivery KPIs, including deployment frequency, Mean Time To Recovery, defect Leakage rate, change failure rate ensuring all releases meet defined Service Level Objectives and performance baselines.
  • Participate in sprint demos and ensure acceptance criteria are met for each increment.

Stakeholder & Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Work with Solution Designers (SDs) and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to align sprint deliverables to journey-level milestones.
  • Collaborate with Product/Journey Owners (POs/JOs) and business stakeholders to clarify priorities and expected outcomes.
  • Communicate risks, decisions, and delivery trade-offs clearly across key stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement & Governance

  • Drive adoption of agile and DevOps best practices across DXP teams.
  • Analyze delivery metrics to identify improvement opportunities in velocity, predictability, and quality.
  • Support incident RCA reviews and ensure learnings are converted into actionable backlog improvements.
  • Contribute to standardized delivery governance, templates, and documentation across domains.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Agile, PMP, or DevOps certifications (e.g., CSM, SAFe, PMI-ACP) preferred.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in software delivery or digital product management, with at least 3 years in a technical project management, delivery lead or scrum master capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience with CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native architecture (e.g., Kubernetes, EKS), and backend service delivery
  • Strong understanding of API management, event-driven architecture, observability tooling and modern deployment strategies (Blue/Green, Canary, Feature Flags).
  • Strong familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, Monday.com, Splunk.
  • Experience in telecommunications, digital platform delivery, or large-scale integration programs is an advantage.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile, DevOps, and continuous delivery practices.
  • Ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Technical fluency with backend engineering patterns and delivery pipelines
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a bias for execution.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resilient in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Job Summary

Mandatory / Primary Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end data architecture for high-throughput, event-driven CPaaS systems.

Design and maintain a data lake using Apache Hudi to support: Upserts and deletes Incremental queries Time-travel and auditability

  • Build real-time analytics datasets in ClickHouse for dashboards, tenant metrics, and campaign analysis.

  • Evaluate new data technologies and patterns through POCs.
  • Collaborate with product and operations teams on data-driven features.

Skills

Mandatory / Primary Skills Apache Pulsar (topics, partitions, subscriptions, geo-replication) Apache Flink (stateful stream processing, windows, checkpoints) Apache Hudi (Merge-On-Read, Copy-On-Write, incremental processing) ClickHouse (real-time analytics, high-cardinality datasets) Event-driven and streaming data architectures Event sourcing and state-transition modeling Idempotent, replay-safe, and failure-tolerant data pipelines Designing systems for high TPS and frequent state updates Multi-region data design and disaster recovery Secondary Skills Redis for low-latency caching, counters, and ephemeral state PostgreSQL for transactional, relational, and reference data MySQL for operational data stores and legacy integrations Low-Level Design (LLD) for scalable, fault-tolerant components High-Level Design (HLD) for distributed, multi-region systems NoSQL stores for hot state (e.g., Mongo, DynamoDB, Cassandra) Relational databases for reference/config data Data lake query engines (Athena, Spark) Observability for data pipelines (lag, freshness, reconciliation) Containerized runtimes and cloud-native deployments Prior experience with CPaaS, telecom, or large-scale messaging platforms Experience & Background 12-14 years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or distributed systems Proven experience building large-scale, streaming-heavy data platforms Strong hands-on background in real-time analytics and data consistency Comfortable operating at Principal & Staff Engineer level with full technical ownership

job.title: Asst. Manager - Financial Reporting & Compliance
job.description:
Role Overview

The Fixed Assets Assistant Manager will be part of the Finance Centre of Excellence and will be responsible for end‑to‑end fixed assets, leases and ARO accounting, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and strong financial governance. The role will own accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and audit coordination related to fixed assets, while partnering with multiple stakeholders to maintain compliance with applicable GAAP and internal policies.

This role will also contribute to process improvement, standardization, and automation initiatives within the fixed assets domain.

Key Responsibilities

Fixed Assets, Leases & ARO Accounting

  • Manage complete lifecycle accounting for fixed assets, including capitalization, depreciation, impairments, transfers and disposals.
  • Perform Capex and fixed assets accounting ensuring adherence to accounting standards and company policies.
  • Account for leases and Asset Retirement Obligations (ARO) in accordance with applicable GAAP.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed schedules for fixed assets, leases, ARO and related balances.

Reconciliations & Book Hygiene

  • Prepare and review fixed asset related reconciliations and ensure timely resolution of open items.
  • Ensure clearing of open items in General Ledger accounts in SAP to maintain hygiene of the books.
  • Review accrual accounting related to capex and fixed assets to ensure accurate financial reporting.

Reporting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare monthly MIS for India and international entities with focus on fixed assets and capex.
  • Prepare monthly variance analysis and provide commentary to management.
  • Prepare consolidated schedules and reports and respond to consolidation‑related queries.
  • Support monthly and quarterly financial review processes with fixed asset related inputs.
  • Prepare standard, ad‑hoc reports and KPIs related to fixed assets and capital expenditure.

Audit, Compliance & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary liaison with statutory auditors for fixed assets, leases and ARO matters.
  • Ensure timely closure of statutory audits and related audit reports for assigned entities.
  • Prepare and submit audit data and respond to audit queries in a timely manner.
  • Support internal audits and other external reviews, including tax and regulatory surveys.
  • Coordinate with cross‑functional stakeholders for capex approvals, asset tagging, and reporting requirements.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Drive process simplification, standardization and automation across fixed assets accounting and reporting.
  • Support implementation and adherence to finance policies, standards and processes.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Finance Centre of Excellence.

Qualifications & Experience

  • CA / ACCA or other equivalent professional qualification.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in finance, with exposure to fixed assets and capex accounting preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Exceptional proficiency in Advanced Excel.
  • Hands‑on experience with SAP (mandatory).
  • Strong understanding of financial and accounting principles.
  • Working knowledge of leases, ARO, and asset accounting under applicable GAAP.
  • Familiarity with financial analysis and reporting tools.
  • Understanding across finance domains including taxation, treasury and FP&A.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

job.title: Lead - Captive Operations
job.description:
Job Description - L2 SD-WAN Engineer Job Title: L2 SD-WAN Engineer Location: Hyderabad Experience: Minimum 5-7 years Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./MCA with minimum 5 years of relevant experience OR BCA/B.Sc.-IT with minimum 7 years of relevant experience

Certifications Required: OEM certification in at least one SD-WAN technology is preferred/mandatory, such as:

Cisco SD-WAN Fortinet Secure SD-WAN Versa SD-WAN

CCNA/CCNP, NSE/FCP, Versa Certified or equivalent networking/SD-WAN certification will be an added advantage. CEH certified

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly capable and experienced L2 SD-WAN Engineer to join the Network Operations team at the client location. The candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, configuration, maintenance, and implementation of multi-vendor SD-WAN environments. The role requires strong hands-on experience in SD-WAN technologies and enterprise networking, with the ability to work across different OEM platforms such as Cisco SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, and Versa SD-WAN. The candidate will work closely with L1, L3, Network, Security, ISP, and OEM teams to ensure high availability, optimal performance, and secure connectivity across data centers, branch offices, cloud environments, and remote locations.

  • The candidate should have a good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, centralized orchestration, underlay and overlay networks, routing protocols, VPN/VRF, IPsec tunnels, application-aware routing, QoS, high availability, and Internet/MPLS connectivity.
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Monitor and manage multi-vendor SD-WAN infrastructure, including Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa SD-WAN solutions.
  • Perform day-to-day operational support and troubleshooting of SD-WAN devices, controllers, orchestrators, and management platforms.
  • Monitor the health and availability of SD-WAN overlay and underlay networks, including WAN links, tunnels, controllers, and edge devices.
  • Troubleshoot SD-WAN connectivity issues involving MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G, and other WAN transport technologies.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to IPsec tunnels, overlay connectivity, routing, VPN/VRF, BGP, OSPF, static routes, and route propagation.

Cisco SD-WAN / Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Fortinet Secure SD-WAN / FortiGate Versa SD-WAN

Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Fixed Assets accounting lead to join our finance team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the company's fixed assets, ensuring compliance with multiple GAAP standards, performing timely monthly closures, and preparing Management Information System (MIS) reports. This role requires proficiency in SAP Hana, advanced Excel skills, and a strong aptitude for automation and advanced technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fixed Assets Management: Maintain the fixed assets register, ensuring all acquisitions, disposals, and depreciation entries are accurately recorded. Conduct regular physical verification of assets and reconcile with the fixed asset register. Coordinate with various departments for capital expenditure (CapEx) budgeting and tracking.

  • Drive the application of advanced technologies and automation in fixed assets and enterprise asset life cycle management.
  • Provide training and support to team members on fixed asset management best practices.

  • Familiarity with other accounting software and tools.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (L2.5 – Nokia Networks)

Position: Assistant Manager – L2.5 (Nokia)

Experience: 5–10 Years

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

Location: Pune (Work From Office – 5 Days, Supporting 24×7 Operations)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Overview

We are looking for a skilled L2.5 Network Engineer (Assistant Manager) with hands-on experience in Nokia networking technologies to support enterprise LAN, WAN, and Data Centre operations.

The role acts as a bridge between L1 operations and L3 SME, responsible for handling complex incidents, performing advanced troubleshooting, and ensuring network stability across environments where Nokia devices are prominent.

The candidate should demonstrate strong technical expertise, ownership, and an eagerness to learn emerging technologies and deepen understanding of enterprise networks.

Key Responsibilities

Operations & Incident Management

  • Provide L2.5 support for LAN, WAN, and Data Centre networks.
  • Handle P2/P3 incidents independently and assist L3 in P1 critical incidents.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and issue isolation for Nokia devices.
  • Ensure timely resolution within defined SLAs.

Nokia Platform Support

  • Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot: Nokia 7750 SR Series
  • Nokia 7250 IXR Series
  • Nokia 7220 Spine-Leaf architecture

Support implementation and changes under L3 guidance.Service Technologies

  • Work on configuration and troubleshooting of: Epipe
  • IPIPE
  • VPRN
  • VPLS

Support MPLS, VPN, and QoS-related configurations.Routing & Switching

  • Troubleshoot and maintain: Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, EIGRP
  • Switching protocols: STP, VLANs, HSRP, VRRP

Handle failover scenarios and routing issues.Policies & Network Configuration

  • Assist in managing: Prefix lists
  • Route policies
  • Access control policies

Implement changes as per design and standards.Nokia Service Platform (NSP)

  • Perform monitoring and basic configuration tasks using NSP.
  • Support troubleshooting and reporting activities.

Data Centre & Enterprise Network Support

  • Work on enterprise network environments with high availability.
  • Support spine-leaf architecture operations and connectivity.

Escalation & Collaboration

  • Act as escalation point for L1 teams.
  • Work closely with L3 SMEs for complex issue resolution.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and vendors.

Learning & Skill Development

  • Actively enhance knowledge of Nokia technologies and enterprise networks.
  • Stay updated with new tools, automation, and networking trends.

Automation Support

  • Basic exposure to network automation tools (Python, Ansible).
  • Assist in execution of automation tasks.

Documentation

  • Maintain accurate documentation of: Incident details
  • Configurations
  • SOPs and troubleshooting steps

Qualifications & Skills

Technical Expertise

  • Hands-on experience with: Nokia 7750, 7250, and 7220 platforms
  • Routing & switching protocols
  • MPLS and VPN technologies

Networking Knowledge

  • Good understanding of: Enterprise LAN/WAN/Data Centre environments
  • High availability and redundancy concepts

Tools & Platforms

  • Exposure to Nokia NSP
  • Experience with network monitoring tools

Additional Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Ability to work in operational environments with ownership
  • Good communication and coordination skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Nokia NRS or equivalent certification
  • CCNA / CCNP or relevant networking certifications
  • Exposure to Arista devices (added advantage)

Key Expectations

  • Ability to handle complex incidents with minimal supervision
  • Strong collaboration with L1 and L3 teams
  • Continuous learning and skill enhancement
  • Ensuring network uptime and operational efficiency

Required Skills

  • network engineering
  • routing
  • switching
  • nokia service platform
  • nokia sr
  • nokia ixr
  • ospf
  • bgp
  • mpls
  • vlan
  • stp
  • eigrp
  • network monitoring
  • incident management
  • network operations center
  • l2 support
  • l3 support

job.title: Lead - Captive Operations
job.description:
Job Description – L2 Firewall Security Engineer

Job Title: L2 Firewall Security Engineer

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: Minimum 5–7 years

Qualification:

· B.E/B.Tech/MCA with minimum 5 years of relevant experience

· OR BCA/BSc-IT with minimum 7 years of relevant experience

Certifications Required:

· Must possess CEH, CHFI, GSEC, GMON, ITIL (at least one mandatory)

· OEM certification in at least one firewall technology (Checkpoint, Palo Alto, Fortinet)

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly capable and experienced L2 Firewall Security Engineer to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) at client location. The candidate will be responsible for managing, monitoring, and troubleshooting perimeter security devices, including Checkpoint, Palo Alto, and Fortinet firewalls. This role requires advanced technical knowledge of firewall rule configurations, threat mitigation, and hands-on operational support for security infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

· Monitor and manage Checkpoint, Palo Alto, and Fortinet firewall devices in a SOC environment.

· Review and implement firewall rules and access control policies.

· Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues across security perimeter devices.

· Perform routine health checks, version upgrades, and patch management on firewall devices.

· Analyze and respond to firewall logs and alerts to identify and mitigate threats.

· Act on threat intelligence and advisories related to network and perimeter security.

· Collaborate with L1 and L3 teams to escalate and resolve complex firewall issues.

· Participate in firewall change management process, including request validations and impact assessments.

· Work with audit and compliance teams to support firewall-related reviews and data collection.

· Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and service-level agreements (SLAs).

· Create documentation and update knowledge base articles for recurring firewall issues and solutions.

· Support the design and implementation of firewall HA, DR drills, and network segmentation strategies.

· Work closely with SOC teams to correlate firewall events with other security incidents.

· Perform VA/PT remediation from firewall configuration perspective.

· Generate reports related to rule usage, dormant rules, and policy cleanup activities.

· Perform backup and restore operations for firewall configuration as per defined schedules.

· Create reports and dashboards for firewall health, incidents, and threat trends.

· Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to support reporting and presentations.

· Continuously improve firewall performance and coverage through tuning and optimization.

· Maintain awareness of latest security threats and firewall feature enhancements from OEMs.

Required Skills

  • firewall
  • palo alto firewall
  • fortinet firewall
  • network security
  • firewall management
  • change management
  • incident management

This role involves close collaboration with internal teams and clients to maintain high service availability and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor shared mailboxes and alerts to identify and respond to incidents, requests, and tasks.
  • Track and manage tickets through ServiceNow, ensuring timely updates and SLA adherence.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of network-related issues.
  • Infrastructure automation with terraform, ansible
  • Vulnerability assessment, management, Patch management, database management
  • Coordinate with internal teams, clients, and service owners for issue resolution and deployments.
  • Obtain required access, approvals, and validations before executing changes or deployments.
  • Communicate with stakeholders before and after deployments to ensure seamless operations.
  • Participate in weekly client status calls to provide updates on progress, risks, and action plans.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of troubleshooting steps, solutions, and operational activities.
  • Support audit and compliance requirements through proper documentation and reporting.
  • Take ownership of assigned tasks and drive them to closure.
  • Continuously improve processes by identifying inefficiencies and recommending automation or preventive actions.
  • Stay updated with new tools, technologies, and SRE best practices.

Key Skillsets

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching)
  • Experience with network troubleshooting tools (Ping, Traceroute, Wireshark, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with incident management tools such as ServiceNow
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell / scripting for automation (preferred)
  • Experience in Power Query / Excel / data reporting tools (added advantage)
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Nagios, etc.)
  • Understanding of deployment, change, and release management processes
  • Strong experience in incident management and RCA (Root Cause Analysis)
  • Knowledge of SRE principles: reliability, availability, automation, and observability
  • Experience working in SLA-driven environments
  • Exposure to ITIL framework (Incident, Problem, Change Management)

Soft Skills

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work under pressure
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills
  • Proactive mindset with focus on continuous improvement
  • Team collaboration and client-facing experience

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Sr Manager- Data Privacy projects - Data Privacy projects
job.description:
The Privacy Manager will lead the integration of privacy-by-design into customer-facing products and services across telecom, SaaS, CPaaS, and cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in application architecture, information security, and access control protocols, enabling proactive privacy risk management and regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities: Review and embed privacy-by-design and privacy engineering principles into product architecture, development, and deployment. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define and implement privacy controls. Conduct Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for new and existing products. Evaluate and implement technical safeguards including encryption, pseudonymization, and secure access controls. Monitor and interpret global privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, DPDP Act) and translate them into actionable product requirements. Develop and maintain privacy notices, consent mechanisms, and data handling protocols. Support incident response and breach management for commercial products. Provide technical guidance and training to cross-functional teams on privacy best practices. Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Minimum 7 years of experience in privacy and data protection roles. Strong understanding of application architecture, data flows, and security protocols. Hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies and privacy governance tools and software. Certifications such as DCPP, CIPP, CIPT, FIP, CISSP, CISA or CISM are highly desirable. Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and analytical skills.

job.description:

job.description:
Responsible for managing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise SD-WAN and network infrastructure in a 24x7 operations environment. Acts as the highest level of technical escalation within operations, ensuring network availability, performance, security, and service continuity.

Monitor and manage SD-WAN infrastructure across multiple sites and regions.Configure and troubleshoot SD-WAN policies, application-aware routing, path selection, and WAN optimization features.Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for SD-WAN-related incidents.Manage device onboarding, provisioning, and lifecycle activities.Ensure optimal performance of internet, MPLS, broadband, and LTE connectivity.

Security and Compliance

Change and Release Management

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Branch Network L2 Engineer to support and manage enterprise branch network infrastructure across multiple locations. The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on expertise in Routing & Switching, enterprise network operations, incident management, and compliance-driven environments. The role involves ensuring high network availability, troubleshooting complex issues, implementing changes, and supporting branch network transformation initiatives while maintaining SLA compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day operations of enterprise branch network infrastructure.

  • Execute network changes, branch migrations, link upgrades, and device replacements through approved change management processes.
  • Coordinate with ISPs and internal teams for WAN, MPLS, Internet, SD-WAN, and leased-line-related issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and recommend permanent corrective actions.
  • Maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, IP addressing plans, and inventory records.
  • Support vulnerability remediation and ensure compliance with enterprise security policies.
  • Ensure all network devices comply with enterprise configuration standards and audit requirements.
  • Participate in DR drills, network audits, compliance reviews, and security assessments.

  • Work closely with L1, L3, security, server, and application teams for issue resolution.

Technical Skills

Routing & Switching

  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco or Aruba enterprise switching platforms.
  • Configuration and troubleshooting of VLANs, STP, RSTP, MSTP, EtherChannel, Port Security, and QoS.
  • Hands-on knowledge of routing protocols including OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, and Static Routing.
  • Experience with HSRP/VRRP/GLBP.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, NAT, DHCP, DNS, and IPv4 addressing.
  • Experience in LAN, WAN, MPLS, Internet, and VPN connectivity.

Enterprise Network Operations

  • Incident, Change, Problem, and Service Request Management.
  • Network monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, ManageEngine, or similar.
  • Configuration backup and restoration.
  • Network performance analysis and optimization.
  • Log analysis and troubleshooting using CLI.

Enterprise Compliance & Governance

  • Hands-on experience supporting enterprise audit and compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and change governance.
  • Experience with configuration standardization and compliance validation.
  • Understanding of security hardening guidelines and enterprise network policies.
  • Support for vulnerability remediation and audit observations.
  • Experience maintaining documentation for internal and external audits.

Desired Skills

  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.

  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: Deputy General Manager - CSM- Sales - Continental Europe
job.description:
Purpose of your Role:

The broad objective of this role is to drive Customer Success through revenue growth, contract renewals, churn mitigation, timely SDWIP closure, Cross-sale/Up-sale and driving adoption and consumption of usage-based services and provide life-cycle support to clients finally resulting into achieving Revenue AOP and NPS Targets.

Grows the revenue from the assigned account/s through:

  • Build and execute revenue growth plan in allocated accounts.
  • Churn mitigation using cross sell or upsell during renewals maintaining a "farming" mindset to CSM. ("Farming" term is used in the context of performance analysis linked upgradation, cross-sales & up-sales of the contracted services).
  • Drive accelerated conversion of Service Delivery funnel into realizable revenue.
  • Drive consumption of usage-based services to expand revenue, through effective boarding, adoption, and expansion of services.
  • Ensures quality 360-degree life cycle management of the customer account, ensuring meeting / exceeding the NPS threshold for the territory and all other contractual obligations.
  • Nurturing and retaining the customer, voice of the customer analysis, reference programs and Service reviews.
  • Develops deep relationships within the customer senior management (C-Level) account across functions create greater value for TCL services thereby enhancing customer lifetime value.

Key Responsibilities

  • CSM is expected to meet Account Contracted Gross Revenue Targets. Contracted Gross Revenue is defined by the following 4 areas.
  • Baseline Revenue as FY start.
  • SDWIP Acceleration.
  • Usage services adoption and growth - revenue target.
  • Managing AOP for Price erosion, terminations, Service credits, aged debt.

Contact / Customer Onboarding

  • Own the customer contract/project onboarding process and drive alignment between Sales, Solutions, Program Management, and key customer stakeholders who are responsible for buying, designing, delivering, and consuming TCL services.
  • Internal Kick-off call & handover from Sales to Delivery Program Management.
  • Agree with the customer on an approach to Time to Value with customer and internal teams.
  • Introduce relevant customer stakeholders to Tata Communications People, Processes & tools and make it easier for them to do business with us.
  • Define Customer Engagement Model along with the customer (Time based, Value-based, Event-Based).
  • SDWIP funnel management to accelerate implementation for faster revenue realization by clearing the internal and external dependencies.
  • Govern on-hold decision at entry and reduce cancellations.
  • Service Adoption & revenue enhancement.
  • Ensuring timely activation and service acceptance.
  • Services which are usage based and require end user deployment or migration of traffic such as GSIP are to be monitored and tracked effortlessly to ensure order aspirations are reached.
  • For usage-based services like UCAAS, analyze customers’ usage to help identify areas for adoption and enhancement.
  • Identify training needs for end users and if identified, orchestrate this with a product or other functions.
  • For network services, understand current network usage and establish predictive capacity and trending.
  • Drive adoption on customer self-service portal (Optimus/TCX)

Nurture and Retain

  • Monitor performance & customer health signals & proactively mitigate any pain points.
  • Ensure availability of services as per contract.
  • Develop and execute action plan based on various customer feedback including CSAT, NPS and other ways of capturing Voice of Customer.
  • Retain Loyalist, Convert Neutral & Detractors into Loyalist.
  • Define and operate Governance Model along with the customer (Time based, Value-based, Event-Based).
  • Own and end to end managed customer service life cycle.
  • Churn mgmt.: The CSM is required to come up with a clear renewal and retention strategy for the allocated account/s and orchestrate the execution of the strategy leveraging the larger TCL set of stakeholders across functions. The objective is to proactively retain the customer and ensure churn mitigation through a combination of minimal erosion and service and consumption expansion. Some opportunities may be handed to Account Mgmt. teams to close depending on qualifications. (e.g. technology migration laden renewals or those that involve public sector / government tendering / RFPs).
  • Continuous service improvement planning.
  • Own and provide in-life contract life cycle management to the account.
  • Contract management in terms of deployment obligations, Terms and conditions, service level agreements, penalties.

Moves, Adds, Changes and Deletes (MACD)

  • Own end-to-end MACD responsibility, including providing repricing, quotations, documentation and closure formalities. Post MACD order closure hand over to the respective teams for regular execution of the MACD orders.

Expand

  • Work together with sales to create a near- and long-term account success plan (ADP)
  • Traffic expansion for subscription services and consumption expansion for usage-based services.
  • Help uncover new opportunities for the sales team and pass on those opportunities to them.

Role Development

  • Ensure Individual remains certified and trained with our Growth Services
  • Position himself/herself as the knowledge partner to the customer in the context of the customer environment

Required Qualification and Experience:

  • Relevant Technical/Business Studies Degree or MBA with 10 - 15 years of experience in customer facing role.
  • Customer Experience should be relationship based either through Account Mgmt. or Service
  • Customer Success Mgmt. profile. Should have carried targets in some form in previous role/s.

Base Salary Range: €66,400 - €87,316. The salary may be adjusted within this range based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and the specific needs of the position.

Other Compensation: The position is eligible to participate in a sales-based incentive program

job.title: Manager - Customer Interaction Suite
job.description:
A Technical Program Manager (TPM) is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of complex technology programs, including product development, deployment, and lifecycle management for communication platforms such as SMS, WhatsApp, Email, RCS and Voice solutions. The role acts as a bridge between Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful implementation and adoption of products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the planning, execution, and delivery of technical programs and product initiatives.
  • Manage the complete product lifecycle for SMS, WhatsApp Business, Email, and Voice communication platforms.
  • Lead product deployment, implementation, onboarding, and rollout activities across customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Product, Operations, Security, Compliance, and Business teams to deliver solutions on time.

Define program scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.

  • Manage customer integrations, platform migrations, and deployment strategies.
  • Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and ensure smooth execution.
  • Track program KPIs, adoption metrics, service performance, and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive process improvements, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Provide executive-level reporting and stakeholder communication.

Required Skills

  • Strong program and project management experience.
  • Good understanding of CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service) products including SMS, WhatsApp Business API, Email, and Voice solutions.
  • Experience managing product deployments, customer implementations, and platform integrations.
  • Knowledge of APIs, cloud platforms, system architecture, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, and product development methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving, risk management, and analytical abilities.

Success Metrics

  • Successful delivery and deployment of communication products.
  • On-time program execution and customer go-live completion.
  • Platform adoption and utilization growth.
  • Service reliability, uptime, and operational efficiency.
  • Customer satisfaction and business impact.
  • Effective management of risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.

One-line Summary: A TPM drives the development, deployment, and adoption of SMS, WhatsApp, Email, and Voice products, ensuring seamless execution of technical programs, customer implementations, and business outcomes across cross-functional teams.

job.description:
Job Description for Structural Engineer:

Professional skills:

Structural Designer Engineer with 2 to 4 years of experience in Structural Design and Analysis of Steel structures such as Lattice towers, Monopoles and Guy Masts using various tools and techniques. Analysis of foundations of steel structures.

Software skills: -

Primary: STAAD Pro, MS Tower, RSTAB / RFEM, MS Excel

Additional skills: AutoCAD, RISA-3D, Hilti, Idea statica, Bluebeam

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering / B.E Structural Engineering.
  • Proficiency in English & German (Preferable)

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform structural design and/or assessment of telecommunication structures and preparation of relevant documentation using Indian and international standards.
  • Steel lattice towers
  • Steel and concrete monopoles
  • Rooftops poles and Antenna mounts
  • Quality check for the assessments with respect to the client requirements.
  • Provide modification/strengthening solutions in case of member failure.
  • Analysis of existing modifications for monopoles such as flat plates, bridge stiffeners, transition stiffeners and extensions.
  • Study and analyze all inputs from client to prepare & include Structure information, Antenna details, Shelter information, Mount/strengthening structural modelling, connection drawing, Lease area details and Technologies.
  • Analysis of existing modifications for self-supporting towers such as half pipe attached to the leg members, member replacements and bracing changes.
  • Analysis of anchor bolts and baseplates for telecommunication structures.
  • Foundation design and analysis of various kinds of foundations such as isolated footing, mat footing, pile foundation etc.
  • Analysis of foundation modifications such as foundation jacketing and composite foundations.
  • Develop the excel tools for different types of manual calculations to be performed outside software being used.
  • Engineering review of construction drawings prepared by the CAD technicians.
  • Prepare BOM (Bill of Materials) and technical documentation for production.
  • Conduct design reviews and implement feedback for continuous improvement.

Knowledge required -

  • Good knowledge and working experience in Eurocodes / Australian codes and standards such as:
  • AS3995-1994
  • ANSI/TIA-222-G and ANSI/TIA-222-H
  • IBC2015
  • BS EN 1993-1-1
  • IS 875- Part III- 2015
  • IS 800 – 2007
  • Good knowledge & understanding of Telecom network mainly on Cell sites structures.
  • Strong Knowledge in Steel members, Mounting standards, Member connections, Bolts, Brackets etc.
  • Good to have knowledge in technological upgradation like 4G and 5G networks.
  • Hands on experience and exposure to Nokia, Huawei and Ericsson wireless platforms.

Required Skills

job.title: Manager - IT Operations & Infrastructure
job.description:
Network Infrastructure – Lead

Purpose of Role:

Lead & own the complete lifecycle management of the network infrastructure across ODCs, Data Centers, Customer Environments, and Internet connectivity. Responsible for architecture, deployment, operations, security, compliance (ISO 27001), capacity planning, lifecycle management, and technology modernization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Network Operations & Support: Oversee day-to-day operations, ensure 24x7 availability of network services; lead incident, problem and change management; participate in Major Incident Management.
  • Infrastructure Management: Manage Cisco switches (Catalyst, Nexus) & Fortinet firewalls (FortiGate), WAN/MPLS/Internet links, IPSec VPN, customer network segments, DC network.
  • Security Management: Firewall policy governance, network segmentation, secure architecture design, vulnerability remediation, penetration test remediation, security hardening.
  • Lifecycle Management: Device, firmware & software lifecycle planning (EOL/EOS), refresh & upgrade programs, asset lifecycle & tracking.
  • Capacity & Performance: Forecast network capacity, utilization analysis, bandwidth planning, performance optimization.
  • Governance & Compliance Support: Audit support (ISO 27001), prepare compliance evidence, manage SOPs, define network standards.
  • Vendor Management: Cisco & Fortinet OEM coordination, ISP/MPLS management, AMC & support contract governance.
  • Reporting: Monthly OPR, Network KPI dashboard, network availability reporting, capacity & performance reports for executive management.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • 8–12 years in large scale enterprise networking with Cisco switching/routing and Fortinet firewall technologies.
  • Demonstrated capability in WAN (MPLS), Internet edge architectures, IPSec/SSL VPN connectivity, and multivendor network integrations.
  • Experience in ISO 27001 compliant environments and audit support.
  • Strong leadership, mentoring and communication skills; experience leading an L2/L3 network team.

Preferred Certifications & Qualifications:

  • Fortinet NSE (levels 4–7)
  • ITIL Foundation

job.title: Manager - Transport and Network Engineering International
job.description:
Broad outline of the Role

As a RHOSP Platform Engineer, the candidate will be responsible to implement the architectural designs, build specification documentation, perform horizontal scaling, and support the lifecycle management of virtualization platform. Operating at the core of our digital infrastructure, the candidate will ensure our Red Hat OpenStack Platform (RHOSP) and underlying applications deliver a high-performance environment that meets business objectives while adhering to strong engineering standards. The candidate will support the evaluation of new releases, implement non-disruptive platform upgrades, and deliver designs that scale capacity ahead of tenant demand.** **

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: Technical/ Engineering degree with 5 years experience, of which 3+ years of dedicated hands-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining Red Hat OpenStack Platform (RHOSP) in a enterprise or service-provider environment
  • Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, System Administration, or equivalent practical experience
  • Core Systems: Proven mastery of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), hypervisor tuning, and OpenStack Director / TripleO deployment mechanisms
  • Automation: Advanced proficiency with Ansible, Python scripting, Postman/APIs, etc

Other Knowledge & Skills

  • Certifications: Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in OpenStack or Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenStack (preferred)
  • Networking: Deep knowledge of SDN topologies, OVN/OVS, BGP/MPLS, L2/L3 networking, and DPDK/SR-IOV data-path acceleration
  • Life Cycle Management: Extensive experience with Storage and VNF lifecycle management and performance tuning
  • Emerging Tech: Familiarity with Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) and OpenStack Services on OpenShift (RHOSO) architecture transition

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Design & Evolution: Implement the architectural designs, continuously refine the core RHOSP platform to support evolving business requirements, while adhering to engineering and operational standards
  • Documentation and design: Prepare design and specification documentation, and other reference material, to grow, scale and operate the platform
  • Deployment & Scaling: Design capacity expansion, executing compute cluster scaling
  • Lifecycle Management & Upgrades: Implement the release and patching plans, deploy major RHOSP version upgrades, and support the eventual transition from RHOSP to OpenShift
  • Automation and performance: Support orchestration/automation development effort, establish/deploy performance monitoring capabilities
  • Core Services Integration: Implement and support key backend infrastructure, including storage, OVN/OVS, and high-performance DPDK networking paths
  • Platform Security & Compliance: Implement hardening standards, RBAC policies, and encryption mechanisms across OpenStack API endpoints, control plane, and hypervisor

Required Skills

  • network engineering
  • red hat openstack platform
  • network function virtualization
  • sdn topologies
  • red hat enterprise linux
  • hypervisor tuning
  • storage
  • ceph
  • nfs

job.title: Sr. Manager - India Prime
job.description:
Position Overview

The Senior Partner Sales Account Manager (PSAM) – Prime Segment is a senior sales leadership role responsible for driving revenue growth, net-new customer acquisition, and aggressive territory expansion within top-tier ("Prime") enterprise partner ecosystems.

Designed for a seasoned sales professional with 10 to 12 years of enterprise sales and partnership experience, this position blends strategic territory development with senior-level deal execution. You will build and scale new geographic or vertical territories, lead complex co-selling pursuits, and align matrixed teams—orchestrating tight execution across Territory Sales Managers (TSMs), Inside Sales Representatives (ISRs), and executive partner leadership.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Territory Development & New Customer Acquisition

  • Formulate and execute multi-year territory growth plans to capture white space and drive aggressive net-new customer acquisition across Prime enterprise accounts.
  • Lead end-to-end sales pursuits for high-value strategic opportunities, establishing multi-threaded connections across C-suite executives, procurement, and technical leadership.
  • Own the overarching revenue and pipeline development results for the Prime Segment portfolio.

2. Cross-Functional Sales Orchestration (TSM & ISR Leadership)

  • Territory Sales Managers (TSMs): Co-develop regional GTM plans, align on field coverage, and co-sell high-stakes enterprise deals to drive velocity and deal size.
  • Inside Sales Representatives (ISRs): Direct inbound and outbound pipeline-generation initiatives, set lead-qualification standards, and convert high-intent prospects into closing opportunities.
  • Establish clear rules of engagement across partner, field, and inside channels to eliminate overlap and maximize rep productivity.

3. Senior Partner Alliance & Executive Alignment

  • Architect and manage Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with Prime partners, securing executive buy-in, co-investment budgets, and dedicated partner sales resource commitments.
  • Design and deploy advanced partner enablement models, sales playbooks, and co-selling frameworks that increase partner-led deal sourcing.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for strategic deal structuring, commercial negotiations, and high-value renewals.

4. Operational Rigor & Commercial Execution

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline management and accurate multi-quarter forecasting using enterprise CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Lead high-impact Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with internal executive sponsors and external partner leadership to evaluate performance.
  • Gather market and competitor intelligence to influence product roadmaps and strategic GTM investments.

Qualifications & Requirements

Experience & Track Record

  • 10–12+ years of progressive experience in B2B enterprise sales, channel account management, or strategic alliances within SaaS, Enterprise Software, or Cloud Infrastructure environments.
  • Consistent track record of managing enterprise-level client and partner accounts.
  • Demonstrated history of launching net-new territories and building high-yield partner co-sell ecosystems from the ground up.

Leadership & Collaborative Competencies

  • Master-level expertise in orchestrating tri-party coverage models with Field Sales (TSMs) and Inside Sales (ISRs) teams.
  • Executive presence with proven capability to negotiate complex, multi-stakeholder commercial terms with C-level executives (CEO, CRO, CIO).
  • Strategic mindset with strong financial literacy, capable of designing revenue-share models, joint GTM budgets, and commercial contracts.

Technical & Systems Proficiency

  • Advanced proficiency in CRM ecosystems (Salesforce), partner relationship management (PRM) tools, and sales engagement stacks

Required Skills

  • sales management
  • partner management
  • account management
  • partner enablement
  • territory sales
  • salesforce
  • crm

job.title: Critical Environment Operations Manager
job.description:
Overview

Microsoft’s Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As aCritical Environment Operations Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, Office 365, Xbox,OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Sydney role - 100% on-site This position requires verification of Australian Citizenship to meet federal government security requirements, You will need a valid Australian passport to verify your citizenship.

Responsibilities:

  • Empower a culture of safety, security,and compliance in all aspects of our Datacenter operations
  • Lead a team of Mechanical, Electrical and Control System professionals supporting Microsoft's online services
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our Datacenters
  • Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability to ensure optimal operational efficiency
  • Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE)incidents year over year
  • Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives
  • Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring
  • Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and business partners
  • Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent AND 5+ years experience of mission-critical service management (e.g., providing IT services, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, military, or managing physical operations in an IT and/or critical environment infrastructure).
  • 3+ years experience in leading a diverse, technical team.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6+ years enterprise-level experience managing large scale and complex projects/programs AND 6+ years experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU) AND 6+ years experience in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) AND Experience managing budget $1M+.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services
  • Experience working on large scale CE projects

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
