job.title: Retail Consultant, Colonnades
job.description:
Colonnades, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital experiences that help people feel more connected.

We’re searching for positive, customer‑focused Retail Service Consultant to join our Colonnades team in a Part-Time capacity. If you love helping people, thrive in a supportive team environment, and bring energy to every conversation, we’d love to have you on board.

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships, with our customers and with each other.

Your day to day:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Build strong product knowledge and become an expert across the full range of tech solutions, explaining everything in a friendly, simple and accessible way.
  • Use your personality, listening skills and service centric approach to understand customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Support customers through all enquiries, anything from general questions to complex issues, using empathy, clear communication and calm de‑escalation.
  • Contribute to a welcoming, customer‑first environment by working closely with your team and helping create memorable moments for every visitor.
  • Stay adaptable and proactive, helping out in periods of high activity and jumping in where needed to keep the store running smoothly.

It starts with you!

  • Service Superpower: You naturally focus on customer needs, offer genuine support, and let great service lead to phenomenal outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers understand technology, breaking it down simply and guiding them to the right solution.
  • Problem‑Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with genuine curiosity and integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You stay steady during tricky situations, easing tension with care and working toward the best result for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support and educate one another, stay accountable and create a space where everyone succeeds together.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and access to exclusive discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Embrace what matters most with a paid Connected Day each year to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • Build meaningful connections through people-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • We support growing families, with inclusive paid parental leave (up to 14 weeks for primary caregiver).

We encourage you to apply, even if this is something new to you! None of us fits every requirement, and we all learn, grow and develop together. This could be the excellent next step in your retail or customer‑service journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

job.title: IT Service Delivery Leader - Senior (SAP Service Management)
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for the management, operations, delivery and support of defined IT applications and/or infrastructure services; directs and coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives using available resources.

Key Responsibilities

Contributes to the delivery and support of specific IT services. Supports the development and maintenance of services and ensures that tools and resources are capable and available (i.e. IT Service Catalog, Asset Management system) Generates and reports service delivery metrics and drives standards across regions and locations (i.e. Scorecards, Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and Customer Satisfaction or Net Promoter Scoring). Acts as a point of contact for customers for service related inquiries and maintains relationships with key customers and suppliers. Is familiar with SLA / Operational Level Agreements between other IT Services Provided. Encourages root cause analysis using the formal problem solving approach for recurring issues. Champions the use of Six Sigma to reduce costs and improve processes. Identifies opportunities for service improvements, discuss with the customer and raise the request for change for assessment if appropriate Maintains the accuracy of service related standards, procedures and work instructions in a knowledge management system. Able to support the Service Owner when needed. Champions the use of ITIL Standards for IT Service Deliverables Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.

Competencies:

Financial acumen - Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

IT Supplier Relationships - Leverages a vendor management framework to manage strategic supplier relationships and supplier performance based on business need throughout the contract life using the required processes and tools to control costs, drive service excellence, mitigate risks, and gain increased value from the suppliers.

Request Fulfillment - Manages a service request through its life cycle with efficiency and professionalism using the required processes and tools to maintain customer satisfaction.

Service Asset and Configuration Management - Manages service assets and configuration items by maintaining accurate configuration records to support other service management processes with documented and verifiable information.

Service Catalog Management - Maintains a service catalog that contains all details of active and approved services in service operations using the required processes and tools to provide clear and relevant information to users.

Service Level Management - Ensures the quality of the services delivered meet agreed levels using the required processes and tools in order to maintain customer satisfaction.

Troubleshooting - Diagnoses and resolves the customer-identified issue by utilizing appropriate department standards to satisfy customer expectations.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 5+ years of experience.

  • Owns global operational accountability for SAP S/4HANA Service Management processes and supporting capabilities.
  • Oversees service process performance, operational efficiency, customer service outcomes, warranty and contract execution support, service parts integration, and service business insights.
  • Partners with service business leaders, process owners, field service teams, aftermarket operations, regional stakeholders, and delivery teams to improve process performance and adoption.
  • Governs incidents, problems, enhancements, and operational risks impacting service execution, customer commitments, warranty performance, technician enablement, and service operations.
  • Drives continuous improvement opportunities across service order management, service execution, service parts processes, customer support, and service reporting.Common Functional Operations Framework
  • Run: Assures stable production operations, effective incident and problem management, and reliable service performance.
  • Improve: Drives continuous improvement, process optimization, standardization, automation, and reduction of manual effort.
  • Govern: Oversees Service Assurance, enhancement demand, release readiness, operational risk, and service provider performance.
  • Measure: Uses business insights, SAP analytics, Signavio, Business Process Insights, and operational metrics to inform decisions.
  • Transform: Shapes the functional operations roadmap, reduces technical debt, and influences future capability evolution through lessons learned from production operations.

job.title: Superintendent, HSSEQ
job.description:
Job Summary

To provide proactive HSSEQ leadership and operational assurance for a defined segment of the marine fleet. The Superintendent acts as the critical link between the Head HSSEQ and vessel-level HSSEQ Managers, ensuring consistent implementation of the Integrated Management System (IMS) across all assigned vessels, driving performance improvement, and ensuring full compliance with ISM, ISPS, MLC, MARPOL, ISO 45001, 14001, and 9001.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic & Operational Oversight (Segment Level)

  • Segment Performance Ownership: Accountable for all HSSEQ KPIs (TRIR, LTIF, near-miss reporting rate, audit closure rates, environmental incidents) across assigned fleet segment.
  • Risk Profiling: Maintain a live risk register for the segment (geographic, operational, asset-specific) – e.g., heavy weather routes, piracy-prone areas, client-specific HSSE requirements.
  • Fleet Assurance Schedule: Plan and execute a rolling program of announced and unannounced vessel visits, safety inspections, ISM internal audits, and ISPS security assessments (minimum 1 visit per vessel per 6 months).

Management of Offshore HSSEQ Managers & Vessel Leadership

  • Direct Support & Coaching: Provide technical guidance and performance feedback to Offshore HSSEQ PIC and Masters regarding incident investigation, PTW audits, safety culture interventions, and client HSSE interface.
  • Competency Assurance: Verify that all offshore HSSEQ PIC and vessel safety officers meet segment-specific competency requirements (e.g., DP familiarization, heavy-lift, anchor handling safety).
  • Succession Planning: Identify high-potential offshore HSSE talent for promotion within the segment.

Incident Management & Investigation (Segment Level)

  • Lead or escalate high-potential (HiPo) incidents, LTI, and major environmental breaches across the segment, ensuring consistent use of investigation methodology (e,g. TapRooT / 5-Why).
  • Review all incident reports from vessels before submission to the Head HSSEQ – ensure root causes and systemic corrective actions are identified.
  • Track corrective action closure rates across the segment and escalate overdue actions.

Client & Third-Party Interface (Segment-Specific)

  • Act as the primary HSSEQ point of contact for client HSSE teams within the segment (e.g., major oil companies, NOCs).
  • Lead client pre-qualification and tender responses for HSSE sections – present segment performance data during client audits.
  • Coordinate joint safety campaigns and client-led verification visits on assigned vessels

Compliance & Assurance (ISM / ISPS / MLC)

  • Serve as alternate or designated DPA (Designated Person Ashore) for vessels within the segment (if qualified under ISM Code).
  • Monitor certificate validity (Class, Flag, Oil Major COCs, DOC extension) and advise vessels on upcoming surveys.
  • Oversee external audit readiness (Flag state, Class, Oil Major, ISO) – pre-audit vessels and debrief findings.

Environmental & Quality Performance

  • Monitor segment-level environmental metrics – carbon intensity (CII), oil-in-water exceedances, garbage segregation deviations, NOx/SOx compliance.
  • Drive ISO 14001 segment objectives (e.g., reduction in single-use plastics, improved fuel efficiency measures).
  • Review customer satisfaction feedback (quality angle) and identify systemic non-conformities across the segment.

REPORTING & ANALYTICS (Segment Dashboard)

  • Weekly: Highlight report to Head HSSEQ – significant incidents, outstanding audits, permit deviations.
  • Monthly: Segment HSSEQ Dashboard (leading/lagging, trend analysis, vessel ranking by safety observation rate).
  • Quarterly: Segment Management Review input – resource gaps, training needs, risk profile changes.
  • Ad Hoc: Root cause analysis summaries for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 process safety events (per IOGP).

Key Requirements

  • A degree in Nautical Studies, Engineering or any relevant degree.
  • COC Class 1 Master/Engineer
  • Candidates should ideally have at least 10 years of experience in operations or HSE & Quality

Certifications

job.title: Senior Manager, Project Cost Control
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Project Cost Control, will develop, implement, and maintain the project cost control framework and management reporting for post-award selected newbuild projects in Zhoushan. This role will also ensure the timely, accurate, and complete reporting of project revenue, costs, forecasts, and financial performance to support effective project management and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take over post-award contracts, tender documents, and bid estimates from the Commercial team to establish the project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and develop the project as-sold budget as the baseline for project cost control.
  • Set up client revenue reporting, where required under the contract, in collaboration with the Commercial team.
  • Monitor and update actual costs incurred, work performed and committed costs on a monthly basis using the ERP system, and perform detailed cost analysis.
  • Verify that costs are correctly allocated in accordance with the WBS and ensure that actual costs and budgets are measured and reported consistently at the same WBS level.
  • Identify cost variances, analyse their causes, forecast the Estimate at Completion (EAC), and report financial performance and cost trends.
  • Establish and maintain registers for change orders, invoices, budget transfers, and cost trends, and prepare the necessary supporting documentation.
  • Identify, quantify, monitor, and develop mitigation or action plans for project risks and opportunities.
  • Prepare the Monthly Project Status Report (PMSR), detailed project cost reports, cost phasing, and other project financial analyses.
  • Conduct monthly project cost reviews to identify cost optimization opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Work closely with Commercial, Engineering, Project Management, Finance,Procurement, and Subcontract teams to ensure alignment on project cost control objectives and financial performance.
  • Promote cost awareness, financial discipline, and best practices across the project team.
  • Prepare ad hoc financial and project performance reports as required by Senior Management.
  • Participate in the implementation and continuous improvement of ERP systems and other project management tools and processes.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to Project Cost Control personnel in the Zhoushan Yard.
  • Undertake regular business travel (expected once a quarter) to support project execution and stakeholder engagement.

Key Requirements

  • Degree Holder in Engineering or Science with exposure in maritime industry.
  • 15 years relevant working experience.
  • Proficiency in project cost control management with strong reporting and effective communication skills
  • Microsoft Office (Advanced in MS Excel, Intermediate to Advanced Word and PowerPoint) and ERP system (like SAP, Oracle etc.)
  • Good analytical skill with the ability to interpret complex data and make sound recommendation.
  • Attention to detail, accuracy, and a commitment to meeting deadlines and objectives.
  • Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Education

Bachelors in Engineering or Science

job.title: Applied AI Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Applied AI Engineer supports POSH's AI programme by contributing to the delivery of prioritised use cases — assisting in the development of AI agents and solutions built on the Group's enterprise AI platform. This person will develop hands-on experience across the full AI delivery lifecycle: from translating business requirements into working prototypes, to deployment and user adoption support.

This is not a purely technical role. Equal weight is placed on business engagement, user adoption, and solution delivery as on technical execution. Prior domain knowledge is not a requirement for this role. This person is expected to spend time with the various functional and operational teams in POSH — understanding how the business works, what problems matter, and what good looks like in practice — and to bring that understanding back into everything they build.

Key Responsibilities

Use Case Delivery & Business Engagement

**

  • Work with POSH business functions to understand operational workflows, identify AI opportunities, and validate that proposed solutions address the right problems.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications and working prototypes.
  • Facilitate structured user acceptance testing sessions with operational teams. Presenting solutions, capturing feedback, and documenting gaps for iteration
  • Manage expectations proactively on timelines, data dependencies, and scope.
  • Develop HITL review interfaces and feedback mechanisms in close collaboration with domain experts.
  • Support the handover of deployed solutions to operational owners with documentation, user guides, and structured walkthroughs.

Data & System Integration

  • Assess data quality, validate schemas, and surface integration issues with the Business Excellence Team and data owners.
  • Integrate AI solutions with POSH's / Group’s enterprise systems using the integration standards and infrastructure.
  • Flag aspirational data assumptions and system-dependent dependencies early for programme-level decision

AI Agent Development

  • Configure and deploy AI agents on the enterprise platform — applying agentic design patterns including multi-agent architectures, tool-use, and autonomous workflow execution.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines for POSH-specific knowledge bases: ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector indexing, and retrieval optimisation.
  • Implement LLM integration — prompt engineering, structured output design, and iterative refinement for operational and regulatory quality standards
  • Build document processing components: OCR pipeline integration, multimodal content extraction and pre-processing for AI consumption.
  • Document and escalate platform gaps or POSH-specific requirements for COE review.

Testing, Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

  • Assist in developing and maintaining AI evaluation frameworks for POSH use cases: accuracy benchmarking, hallucination detection, retrieval quality scoring, and regression testing across model updates.
  • Conduct structured testing of agent behaviour before any production deployment, including edge cases, adversarial inputs, and failure mode analysis
  • Monitor deployed solutions; escalate anomalies promptly and support resolution with clear documentation.
  • Collaborate with the Group Data & Automation COE on platform standards and technical governance.
  • Document all agents, configurations, data schemas, and integration points to enterprise standards.

Key Requirements

Experience

  • 1-2 years of software engineering or data/AI engineering experience – including exposure to LLM-based development in any context. Internships, research attachments, and early-career roles are all considered.

  • Some experience, or a demonstrated interest in, working with non-technical users: explaining technical concepts in plain language, gathering requirements, or presenting findings.

Essential Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Python for AI/ML pipeline development and data processing.
  • Working knowledge of LLM-based application development: RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and structured output handling.

  • Exposure to cloud-native development (Microsoft Azure preferred) and vector databases
  • Good understanding of document processing pipelines — OCR, PDF/image extraction, chunking strategies, and multimodal content handling.
  • Basic understanding of API design (REST/ async) and microservices integration.

**

Advantageous — Domain & Industry Knowledge

  • Familiarity with maritime, offshore, or similarly regulated, asset-heavy industries.
  • Exposure to compliance-driven environments where audit trails and regulatory alignment are operational necessities.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint / Microsoft 365, SAP, or equivalent enterprise platforms.

Personal Attributes

  • Curiosity: Genuinely interested in how operations work and how AI can improve them — not just in the technology itself.
  • Structured thinking: Manages concurrent tasks, communicates priorities clearly, and keeps stakeholders informed.
  • Credibility with users: Communicates clearly without jargon. Earns trust through listening and delivering solutions that fit how people actually work.
  • Ownership mindset: Takes initiative, follows through, raises blockers early — and knows when to escalate rather than proceed alone.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: Makes sound technical decisions when requirements are evolving. Moves forward pragmatically and documents assumptions.
  • Engineering rigour: Builds things others can understand, maintain, and build on. Takes documentation and testing seriously.

job.title: Manager, Technology Solutions
job.description:

The IT Manager is an influential IT Application Owner responsible for delivering IT support operation excellence, continuous improvement, and strong application project delivery. This role emphasises delivering high-quality outcomes, bringing in emerging technologies — including AI and advanced analytics and delivering measurable business value while fostering sustainable growth. Ideal for a motivated individual passionate about driving digital transformation, deploying AI solutions, and delivering excellence in a complex, multi-site maritime and industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Application Ownership:

  • End-to-End Management: Serve as the IT owner for designated software applications, managing the full lifecycle including implementation, updates, support & maintenance, and decommissioning. IT owner also to ensure the application continues to meet business needs and performance standards.
  • System Stability and Performance Monitoring: Ensure quality support meeting SLA. Oversee the performance of applications, ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement to meet evolving business needs.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact between IT and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment between the organization's objectives and the application's capabilities. Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, ensuring optimal service delivery, ongoing support, and contract management. Work collaboratively across IT team to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability across systems.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure that applications comply with internal policies, industry standards, and legal regulations. Maintain security best practices and manage risks. Oversee VAPT exercises, vulnerability remediation, and security hardening for Application and Hosting environment.
  • Requirements Gathering: Lead the process of gathering business and technical requirements for enhancements or new software solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to define project scope.

Application Landscape Management & Modernisation

  • Define, Design, Document and continuous modernization of application architecture landscape in partnership with SaaS providers and Developer Partners for bespoke Applications. Drive migration from legacy monoliths toward modern, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures with API and Agentic AI MCP readiness
  • Own availability and disaster recovery (DR) planning for critical applications; test and validate RTO/RPO targets.
  • Access cloud and hybrid deployment models to evaluate fit for applications under management. Assess data sovereignty, cost, and risk trade-offs when recommending hosting options

AI Adoption & Automation

  • Champion the integration of AI/ML-driven observability, AIOps tooling, and intelligent alerting to reduce noise and accelerate diagnostics.

Data Centre Solutions Architect (Design Manager/Senior Manager)

Posting Start Date:

18/12/2025

Country/Region:

Singapore

Work Location:

Singapore Great World City

K2

Req ID:

355

Job Summary

The Data Centre Solutions Architect (Design Manager/Senior Design Manager) will be responsible for design and innovation, market research, evaluating, and implementing the newly technical solutions to optimize K2 future data centre’s infrastructure with high efficiency, and performance. This role plays a critical part in ensuring K2 always advanced and prepared to fulfil the quick change and demand of the global data centre requirements, ensure technical excellent, stand operational, sustainability, and scalability goals while aligning with industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Design, Innovation & Technical Solutions

  • Conduct market research to identify new ideas and technologies that can be used to develop a comprehensive K2 data centre design solution, including layout planning, power distribution, cutting-edge high-density cooling systems, critical control/monitoring infrastructure with different construction methods.
  • Ensure all K2 newly developed design solutions adhere to customer requirements, Uptime Institute’s Tier standards, ASHRAE thermal guidelines and relevant industry best practices.
  • Participate in the development of new MEP design and construction concepts, produce K2 data centre design libraries, and system specifications.
  • Lead and manage design and innovation projects, influence K2 technical design decision-making. Efficiently handle technical problems with demonstrate creativity in solutions.
  • Assisting customer RFP support, developing new ideas on MEP design to meet the new AI ready data centre on performance, operation and quality requirements.
  • Recommend and integrate advanced solutions to improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon footprint, and enhance facility performance and availability.
  • Works closely with internal teams as well as collaborating with external vendors to perform and support design and development activities.
  • Conduct feasibility studies on new MEP technology on the market, support technical due diligence for the new supply chain and manufacture data centre products.
  • Perform on going technology market research on Liquid Cooling on high density Data Centres. Develop a design scheme to how power delivery can be provided in a small footprint.
  • Design, develop the system prototypes of data centre solution with vendors to ensure the newly developed solution meets the specifications and K2 engineering requirements.
  • Writing white paper, producing reports and documentation. Participating in technical meetings, seminars and conferences.

Infrastructure Design Optimization

  • Evaluate and implement newly developed design and product solutions to optimize data centre power usage effectiveness (PUE) and water usage effectiveness (WUE).
  • Assess and improve construction methods, cooling design, rack layout, and power distribution for maximum construction, commissioning and operation efficiency.
  • Develop TCO strategies to improve equipment lifecycle management and reduce maintenance costs.

Management & Implementation

  • Lead design development and innovation, support technical discussions and provide guidance to project delivery teams during construction, commissioning, and handover stages.
  • Ensure proper documentation of design specifications, drawings, equipment details, and solution implementation processes.
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure designs support redundancy and resilience for critical systems.
  • Implement vendor-agnostic procurement strategies / process with a multi-vendor design template for each MEP system.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Delivery, Operations, Facilities and IT to align the newly developed technical solutions with business needs.
  • Engage with suppliers and contractors to ensure solution/equipment developed fully aligns with K2 technical vision and design requirements.
  • Develop a geopolitical risk register to guide equipment selection and procurement strategies by customer type and region.

Compliance & Sustainability

  • Ensure all newly developed designs and solutions comply with local regulations, industry standards and company policies.
  • Integrate sustainable design practices including renewable energy solutions, heat recovery systems and carbon footprint reduction initiatives.

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, data centre engineering, or related fields.
  • Certifications such as CDCP (Certified Data Centre Professional), DCD (Data Centre Design), or Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Designer are highly desirable.
  • Minimum 5–8 years of experience in data centre design, solutions architecture, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Sound technical knowledge and proven experience in delivering high-density data centres, colocation facilities, or hyperscale environments.
  • Strong understanding and technical background in electrical power or cooling system, excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others.
  • Keen interest in construction industry and M&E infrastructure development
  • Demonstrate technical rigor and creativity, continuous learning and improvement, alignment to fast changing data centre industry needs.
  • Solid problem-solving skills and excellent understanding of data centre MEP system interface requirements.
  • Proficient in design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, or BIM (Building Information Modelling).
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision, including time management and prioritisation.
  • Ability to analyse and resolve complex technical issues at a basic principle level, collaborating across multiple disciplines of DC application.
  • Flexible approach to working in a small design and innovation team, requiring a hands-on approach to getting things done.
  • Familiarity with industry standards such as TIA-942, ISO 27001, and ASHRAE guidelines.

Education

Bachelors in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering

job.title: Commissioning Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary

The Commissioning Specialist is responsible for supporting and executing commissioning activities across multiple projects, ensuring systems and equipment are installed, tested, and operating in accordance with design requirements, project specifications, and applicable standards. The role supports the Commissioning Manager in delivering projects safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute commissioning activities from pre-commissioning through final acceptance.
  • Review commissioning procedures, method statements, test scripts, and technical documentation.
  • Witness and support FAT, SAT, functional testing, integrated system testing (IST), and performance testing.
  • Coordinate commissioning activities with contractors, vendors, consultants, and project teams.
  • Monitor Cx1–Cx5 commissioning progress and ensure activities are completed according to the project schedule.
  • Review test results, identify deficiencies, and follow up on punch list items through closure.
  • Verify equipment and system performance against design intent and project requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain commissioning reports, test records, trackers, and close-out documentation.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during commissioning.
  • Ensure compliance with project safety requirements and applicable codes and standards.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma/Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant experience in testing, commissioning, construction, or facilities engineering.
  • Experience in data centre / mission-critical projects
  • Familiarity with relevant industry standards and commissioning practices.
  • Experience with electrical and/or mechanical systems such as generators, UPS, switchgear, cooling systems, CDU, CRAH, pumps, and BMS/EPMS is advantageous.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of testing and commissioning processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, SLDs, schematics, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong coordination and communication skills.
  • Able to manage multiple commissioning activities and priorities concurrently.
  • Detail-oriented with good documentation and reporting skills.
  • Able to work effectively with contractors, vendors, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Willingness to support FAT/commissioning activities outside normal working hours when required.
  • Proactive, responsible, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

#JR815

Education

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering

Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering & Electronics

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Snapshot

As our Quality Manager in Mumbai you will be responsible for implementing and operationalising the Global Minimum Standard for Quality (GMS‑Q) and the Quality Playbook across all construction activities within their assigned region. This role provides strategic and technical leadership in quality governance, quality assurance, quality control, documentation management, inspections, testing and handover readiness across AirTrunk’s projects delivery lifecycle. The role ensures that all projects regardless of delivery model, geography, or contractor capability adhere to AirTrunk’s global quality requirements, Technical Requirements (TR), Inspection and Test Plan/Checklist standards (ITP/ITC), and statutory regulations. Drives Lesson Learned, proactive quality risk management, consistent reporting, uplift of supply chain capability, embedding of quality systems, and cross‑regional alignment through the GMS‑Q.

Key Responsibilities

1- Quality Governance & GMS‑Q Implementation

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Global minimum standards across all regional projects, ensuring alignment with global standards, ISO 9001 principles and AirTrunk’s Quality Policy.
  • Ensure project teams, GCs, subcontractors and consultants adhere to AirTrunk’s quality governance gates, assurance requirements and documentation workflows.
  • Integrate quality expectations into Pre‑Flight and In‑Flight activities, supporting governance reviews, readiness assessments, and quality‑related approvals.

2- Quality Assurance (QA)

  • Establish QA expectations with GCs and consultants, ensuring clarity on ITP/ITC requirements, hold/witness points, material verification, commissioning protocols and record management.
  • Conduct quarterly quality audits (design reviews, onsite audits, documentation audits, supplier capability assessments) to identify systemic gaps and track corrective actions.
  • Drive regional alignment with enterprise systems including Visibuilt, Procore, Smartsheet, DroneDeploy and digital QA tools.

3- Quality Control (QC) & Site Delivery Support

  • Oversee inspections, testing, verification and surveillance.
  • Ensure the effective implementation of ITPs/ITCs across all trades, identifying non‑conformance trends and systemic issues.
  • Support project teams during construction, commissioning and handover phases with specialist quality advice.
  • Ensure close‑out of CARs, NCRs and Defects within agreed timeframes and to an acceptable standard.

4- Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain and update the Regional Quality Risk Register, ensuring alignment with the Global Quality Risk Register.
  • Identify regional recurring issues and ensure lessons learned are developed and communicated.
  • Proactively identify emerging quality risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Undertake quarterly Lessons Learned workshops to capture regional insights, identify recurring issues

5- Documentation, Records & Handover Readiness

  • Ensure that all documentation, test results, QA/QC evidence, and handover packages are complete, traceable, and compliant with GMS‑Q, TRs, and customer requirements.
  • Support the Document Controllers in reinforcing regional compliance with documentation workflows, systems, metadata requirements and archiving standards.
  • Validate the completeness of Quality Records, Manuals, commissioning documentation and customer deliverables.

6- Stakeholder, GC & Vendor Quality Engagement

  • Provide coaching and quality capability uplift to GCs, subcontractors, and consultants.
  • Partner with Regional Delivery, Engineering, Commissioning, Operations, Design, and Development teams to resolve quality issues and strengthen quality culture.
  • Engage with customers as required to demonstrate quality performance and resolve escalations.

7- Regulatory & Standards Compliance

  • Ensure all construction activities meet applicable regional statutory, authority and technical requirements (e.g., NCC Australia, BCA Singapore, Japanese Building Codes, Malaysian UBBL, Hong Kong FSD), while maintaining alignment with AirTrunk’s global standards.
  • Oversee third‑party inspections and certifications to support regulatory approvals.

8- Reporting & Performance Metrics

  • Own regional quality reporting, including weekly dashboards, NCR/defect performance, leading indicators, audit findings, and key risk themes.
  • Contribute to the Global Quality Dashboard and enterprise reporting packs.
  • Track and report against GMS‑Q compliance levels and quality KPIs.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience in construction quality, QA/QC management, or technical engineering roles within data centres, critical infrastructure, or large‑scale industrial projects.
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 and quality management systems, with experience embedding quality frameworks in fast‑paced delivery environments.
  • Proven experience conducting audits, managing ITP/ITCs, overseeing commissioning quality, and driving NCR/RCA processes.
  • Familiarity with AirTrunk‑standard systems including SharePoint, Visibuilt, Procore, Smartsheet, and DroneDeploy, or similar QA/QC and construction management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of multidisciplinary construction (architectural, civil, mechanical, electrical, fire, ICT, security, structural, hydraulics).
  • Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultural and technical environments.
  • Ability to influence contractors and drive a strong quality culture.
  • Experience managing regional portfolios or multi‑project oversight preferred.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

job.title: Interconnection Product and Sourcing
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to Director of Product Strategy, the Interconnection Product Manager will be responsible for platform-wide data center product development and lifecycle management. In this role, you will:

  • Lead the development and execution of the interconnection product roadmap across markets, covering Cross Connect, Data Centre Interconnect, Internet Access, and third-party network products and service enablement.
  • Define differentiated product positioning and strategy across different markets, in respect to different portfolios of shared colocation, dedicated building and campus.
  • Partner with in-country GTM Leadership, Business Development, Engineering and Operations teams to drive product readiness, adoption and performance.

Key responsibilities

Interconnection Product Roadmap Development and Execution:

  • Translate customer needs, market trends, competitive developments and business priorities into product requirements, propositions, policies and prioritised roadmap initiatives.
  • Align regional product direction with in-country requirements while promoting platform consistency, scalability and reuse.
  • Lead productization preparation for new and enhanced offerings, including service definitions, operational readiness, commercial alignment, internal training and launch planning.
  • Develop clear product documentation, governance processes and ownership models to support ongoing operation and lifecycle management.
  • Maintain and refresh product collateral, including sales decks, data sheets, product guides, use cases and other sales enablement materials.

Commercial and Product Performance Management

  • Monitor product performance across growth, revenue, profitability, cost, adoption and other agreed performance indicators.
  • Initiate and execute plans to improve product performance, with support from in-country leadership teams and relevant corporate functions.
  • Prepare, maintain and uphold the product business case, ensuring that investment, pricing, cost, demand and return assumptions remain current and properly governed.
  • Provide regular performance analyses, insights and recommendations to management to support portfolio decisions and prioritisation.

Technology and Innovation:

  • Work closely with Engineering, Solutions and Operations teams to identify, assess and introduce new interconnection technologies and innovations to the platform.
  • Define requirements and integration approaches that allow new capabilities to complement established products, systems, processes and operational standards.
  • Monitor developments across data centre connectivity, network ecosystems, automation and third-party platforms to maintain product relevance and competitiveness.
  • Closely coordinate pilots, Proof-of-Concept in controlled product introduction.

Sales and Customer Opportunities Support

  • Work closely with Go-to-Market, Business Development and Solutions teams to support interconnection opportunities, customer engagements and strategic pursuits.
  • Develop and deliver product training for Sales, Solutions, Operations and other internal stakeholders.
  • Build competitive intelligence and practical sales tools that improve opportunity qualification, solution consistency and customer communication.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Business or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in product management, network services, telecommunications, data centre interconnection, cloud connectivity or digital infrastructure
  • Demonstrated success in managing products throughout their lifecycle, including product strategy, roadmap development, feature prioritisation, performance management, and continuous improvement. Preferred experience in driving standardisation, governance, and portfolio-level product initiatives across multiple markets or regions.
  • Strong understanding of interconnection and connectivity products such as cross connects, data centre interconnect, carrier access, internet exchange, cloud connectivity and third-party network services. Experience in dealing with 3rd party network product and services collaboration preferred.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and resilient, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

job.title: Senior AI Data Engineer #AIDA
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Powering the Future with AIDA

**

To lead the next phase of our AI evolution, we’ve launched a new business unit AIDA – Artificial Intelligence & Data Analytics – a strategic engine driving our transformation designed to scale our AI ambitions with precision and purpose. This marks a pivotal shift in how we operate, innovate, and serve to embed intelligence into every layer of our business.

At Singtel, this is more than a technology upgrade. It’s a strategic transformation that redefines how value is created across the enterprise core— augmenting human capabilities and unlocking entirely new potential. It is a transformation journey by aligning people, platforms, and processes under one cohesive strategy. Our mission is to build AI literacy, and foster a culture where intelligence empowers people.

**

We welcome you to join us on a transformational journey that’s reshaping the telecommunications industry — and redefining what’s possible with AI at its core. Grow with us in a workplace that champions innovation, embraces agility, and puts human potential at the heart of everything we do.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

  • Responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable data ingestion, transformation, and serving capabilities across a modern hybrid cloud data platform, ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, reusable, and aligned to enterprise architecture and governance standards.
  • Develop and optimise batch and streaming pipelines using cloud tools such as Databricks and Kafka, applying sound engineering practices to ensure performance, resilience, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to the delivery of reliable, secure, and high-quality data for analytics, reporting, and machine learning use cases
  • Lead the implementation and operationalisation of knowledge base and retrieval-augmented generation solution stacks to support scalable GenAI and agentic use cases across business domains

Make an Impact by:

  • Design, build, optimise, and maintain batch and streaming data ingestion pipelines using platforms such as Databricks and Kafka, ensuring scalability, reliability, observability, and alignment with enterprise data architecture standards.
  • Perform data transformation and cleansing using PySpark or SQL based on business and technical requirements
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data workflows to ensure data quality and pipeline reliability
  • Provide technical guidance to engineers and delivery partners on data platform patterns, reusable components, code quality, deployment readiness, and production support practices.
  • Lead integration of data from diverse source systems including files, APIs, databases, and streaming platforms, working with source-system owners and consuming teams to define fit-for-purpose ingestion patterns and delivery timelines.
  • Help maintain metadata and pipeline documentation for transparency and traceability
  • Own production readiness for assigned data and AI platform components, including observability, incident triage, root-cause analysis, release coordination, and continuous improvement of operational runbooks.
  • Participate in integrating pipelines with tools such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Delta Lake, and other platform components
  • Build and maintain knowledge base and RAG solution on variety of hosting platforms
  • Implement and operate knowledge base storage, lifecycle management and embedding/vectorization
  • Contribute to automation efforts using version control and CI/CD workflows
  • Apply data governance, security, access control, and operational risk policies during solution design and implementation, ensuring pipelines and knowledge platforms meet enterprise compliance requirements.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5–8 years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or cloud-scale analytics solution delivery, with demonstrated ownership of production pipelines and platform components.
  • Proven ability to independently design, build, optimise, and operate production-grade batch or streaming data pipelines, including orchestration, observability, error handling, performance tuning, and operational support.
  • Hands-on experience with Python and SQL for data transformation and validation
  • Familiarity with Apache Spark (especially PySpark) and large-scale data processing concepts
  • Experience with implementing knowledge base and RAG solutions for agentic AI use cases
  • Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills and a keen attention to detail
  • Able to work independently and lead technical discussions with engineers, architects, product owners, source-system teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into secure and maintainable platform solutions.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture, cloud security, access control, CI/CD, release management, and production operations for data and AI platform solutions.

**

job.title: Associate Director-IS/ IT Technology & Commercial Management
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

Support regional IT technical and commercial evaluation to achieve IS/ IT cost leadership across Singtel Group and Associate companies. Drive technical and commercial analysis for strategic RFPs, tenders, investments, and vendor engagements, ensuring solutions are technically sound, commercially competitive, future-ready, and aligned with Group interests.

Make an impact by

**

IT Cost Leadership & Commercial Governance

  • Drive Group-wide synergies to achieve cost leadership across mobile IS/ IT platforms, cloud infrastructure, OSS/BSS, and digital systems.
  • Develop and institutionalize regional IS/ IT cost benchmarks, methodology, pricing frameworks, and best practices to improve commercial consistency and investment decisions.
  • Lead regional IS/ IT price benchmarking, commercial analysis, and cost optimization across Singtel Group and Associate companies.
  • Support and participate Singtel Group, OpCo’s and Associates RFPs, RFIs, tenders, contract renewals, and annual price reviews through commercial assessments and ensuring technical assessments are fair and sound.
  • Support OpCo and Associates to review vendor proposals and commercial submissions to ensure optimal scope, competitive pricing, and value for investment.
  • Develop and maintain cost models covering:
  • Software licensing
  • Cloud and infrastructure platforms
  • System implementation, integration, and migration
  • Managed services and operational support
  • Identify cost drivers, optimization opportunities, and commercial risks, recommending strategies to improve investment efficiency and reduce total cost of ownership (TCO).
  • Support commercial negotiations by providing pricing benchmark data, commercial recommendations, and negotiation strategies.
  • Balance technical requirements, business objectives, commercial competitiveness, and long-term operational sustainability in investment decisions.
  • Partner with IT, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Business stakeholders across Singtel Group and Associate companies to strengthen commercial competitive and investment outcomes.
  • Prepare quarterly briefing pack on IS/ IT benchmark, RFP challenge notes, IT commercial movements and vendor concentration insights for Group MC.

Investment Governance and Technology Insights

**

  • Review and rationalize OpCo and Associate IS/ IT investment plans, Annual Operating Plans (AOPs), and capital budgets to maximize investment value and strategic alignment.
  • Perform technical and commercial due diligence on major IS/ IT investment proposals and Board approval papers.
  • Keep in view Associates major IS/ IT key transformation programs and investment progress; provide regular update to IG Business team and Group MC.
  • Provide recommendations and briefing materials to Group MC and Singtel Board representatives supporting OpCo/ Associate investment decisions.
  • Engage industry partners, including Bridge Alliance, TM Forum, hyperscale’s, vendors, and technology partners, to evaluate emerging technologies, commercial models, and market trends that enhance Group competitiveness.
  • Build and maintain knowledge repositories for emerging IT platforms, vendor capabilities, commercial models, and market pricing to support future technology investments.

Core Accountabilities

  • Achieve sustainable ISIT cost leadership across Singtel Group and Associate companies.
  • Protect Singtel Group's and Associates interests through independent technical and commercial reviews.
  • Improve investment outcomes through robust price benchmarking, commercial assurance, and negotiation support.
  • Optimize technology investments by balancing cost, capability, scalability, and business value.
  • Strengthen regional collaboration, knowledge sharing, and adoption of best practices.
  • Deliver measurable savings, investment efficiencies, and long-term value across Group.

**

Skills for Success

  • 15+ years in telecommunications IS/ IT, solution architecture, commercial evaluation, and IS/ IT systems investment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Professional certifications such as TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, PMP, ITIL, TM Forum, or equivalent are desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of telecom IT architectures, including OSS/BSS, Billing, Charging, Policy Control, CRM, Digital BSS, Mediation, and Order Management.
  • Understanding of cloud-native architectures, virtualization, containers, and public/private/hybrid cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, etc).
  • Good to have experience in large-scale telecom IT transformation, system integration, and modernization programmes.
  • Understanding of telecom industry trends, digital transformation, cloud computing, AI/automation, TM Forum frameworks, and emerging IT system technologies.
  • Commercial evaluation and analysis skills for telecom IT solutions and managed services.
  • Experience supporting RFPs, RFIs, tenders, contract negotiations, and vendor evaluations.
  • Ability to identify cost drivers, commercial risks, and value optimization opportunities.
  • Good understanding of software licensing models, cloud commercial models, managed services and implementation pricing.
  • Good analytical capability with a data-driven approach to benchmarking, cost analysis, and investment decisions.
  • Ability to communicate complex architectures to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong rapport and collaborative working relationships at all levels and key Group, OpCo’s and Associates stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel to locations where our Singtel Group Associates operate, as needed.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Associate Engineer
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

We are looking for an Associate Engineer to work in iLab, supporting testing and validation of broadband devices and services.

The role will mainly perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for broadband devices such as Residential Gateways (RG), ONT/ONR and Wi-Fi devices. The Associate Engineer will work closely with Engineering, Operations and vendors to ensure new devices and firmware meet the required test criteria before deployment to customers.

The role will also support daily lab operations, troubleshooting, test automation and maintenance of lab systems.

Make an impact by:

  • Perform UAT for broadband devices and new firmware according to test plans and acceptance criteria.
  • Test broadband devices such as RG, ONT/ONR, Wi-Fi routers and mesh devices.
  • Perform basic functional, regression, performance, stability and security testing.
  • Support GPON/XGS-PON broadband testing and new project implementation in the lab.
  • Perform basic network testing using tools such as Wireshark, iPerf, ping and other network test tools.
  • Perform Wi-Fi testing such as speed, connectivity, coverage, stability and roaming.
  • Monitor firmware soak and stability tests and report any abnormal behaviour.
  • Reproduce reported faults in the lab and assist engineers and vendors with troubleshooting.
  • Collect device logs, packet captures and test results for problem investigation.
  • Record test results and report defects or issues found during UAT.
  • Retest firmware after fixes are provided by vendors or Engineering.
  • Support development and improvement of test cases and test procedures.
  • Support test automation and RPA activities to reduce repetitive manual testing.
  • Perform basic scripting or automation using Python or other scripting tools, where required.
  • Maintain lab equipment, test devices and test environments.
  • Perform basic maintenance of lab servers, including OS updates, security patches and SSL certificate renewal.
  • Maintain proper documentation of test results, firmware versions and lab configurations.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Operations and vendors on testing and troubleshooting activities.
  • Perform other technical or lab-related tasks assigned by the manager.

Skills for Success:

  • Diploma in Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent from a recognised institution.
  • No experienced required.
  • Basic understanding of networking and TCP/IP.
  • Basic knowledge of IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLAN and Wi-Fi.
  • Familiarity with Windows and Linux environments.
  • Basic knowledge of network troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, ping and iPerf would be an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of GPON, broadband routers, ONT/ONR or Wi-Fi devices would be an advantage.
  • Familiarity with VMware and Docker would be an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of Python or scripting would be an advantage.
  • Interest in test automation, RPA and networking technologies.
  • CCNA or ITIL 4 certification would be an advantage but is not mandatory.

job.title: Data Scientist #AIDA
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

As a Data Scientist within the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) business unit, you will assume a key role in driving insights discovery and AI/ML model development to predict and respond to market changes and their impact on Singtel’s business. Your work will influence critical decisions across the organization—enabling data-driven strategies that uncover new customer insights, optimize operations, and unlock new revenue streams.

In this role, you will play a leading part in advancing AI initiatives, where AI is used to personalize and scale telco product and service offerings. You will develop predictive models for network anomaly detection, customer behavioral analysis, and cross-sell optimization. This includes close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners to co-create data-driven AI/ML solutions.

Make an Impact By:

  • Lead Data Science Initiatives: Drive AI/ML initiatives supporting Singtel’s product and service offerings by working closely with stakeholders from Network, Enterprise, Sales, Product, and external partners. Define problem statements and architect end-to-end solutions—including the use of Generative AI and LLMs where applicable—to align with strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and partner needs.
  • Model Development & Integration: Design, build, and productionize analytical models that enable intelligent decisioning within customer journeys. Integrate these models into customer-centric decision engines while championing best practices around model governance, scalability, explainability, and continuous performance monitoring.
  • Customer Behavior & Lifecycle Analysis: Leverage customer behavioral data across Singtel’s Mobile, Broadband, and entertainment services to uncover actionable insights. Maintain and enhance analytical models that inform segmentation, product targeting, and value-based engagement strategies. Enable data exploration, insight discovery, and controlled experimentation (e.g., A/B testing, uplift modeling) to support lifecycle marketing and campaign optimization.
  • Data Exploration & Experimentation: Enable robust data exploration, insight discovery, and experimentation for lifecycle marketing campaigns. Devise and execute rigorous A/B tests, segmentations, and optimization strategies to continuously improve business outcomes.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality: Provide guidance to junior data scientists and collaborate on code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices, maintain high code quality, and promote knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate complex analytical findings and recommendations to diverse audiences—ranging from technical teams to senior leadership—in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.

Skills for success:

  • Bachelor or Postgraduate degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, with at least 3 years of relevant working experience.
  • Deep technical and data science expertise, demonstrating proficiency in:
  • Machine Learning & Statistical Modelling: Including linear regression, GLMs, time series forecasting, supervised learning (e.g., gradient boosted trees, neural networks), segmentation, clustering, design of experiments, and causal inference.
  • LLMs & Generative AI: Fine-tuning and evaluation of large language models (e.g., GPT, LLaMA), prompt engineering, red-teaming, and performance monitoring
  • Efficient data manipulation (with skills in SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop/Hive, and Databricks) and data visualization (using tools like Power BI).
  • Familiar with software engineering best practices, including modular code design, reproducibility, and testing. Proficient with version control tools such as GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AWS, GCP) and ML lifecycle tools (e.g., MLflow, Airflow)

Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and solve complex business problems through data analysis.

  • A team player with a customer-focused mindset, able to work well in a team and passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Excellent data visualization and communication skills, with the ability to present insights and findings in a clear, concise, and compelling manner, both in written and verbal form.
