job.title: Sales Account Manager (Senior Connectivity Sales Specialist)
job.description:
Job Description

Job purpose

We are looking for a motivated Enterprise Connectivity Sales Specialist to drive revenue growth by selling both core infrastructure and advanced networking and connectivity solutions to C-level executives and IT leaders. You will own the full client sales lifecycle—from lead discovery and solution scoping to closing complex, multi-year service contracts.

Responsibilities

  • Account Acquisition & Expansion: Target and close mid-market and enterprise prospects through strategic prospecting, executive networking, and consultative selling.
  • Account Ownership and Supported : Own targeted key Enterprise Connectivity accounts and support rest of EBG base
  • Responsible for meeting and exceeding Orderbook, Revenue and Gross Margin targets
  • Solution Architecture & Scoping: Partner with Solutions Engineers to design tailored connectivity solutions addressing client needs around bandwidth, latency, redundancy, and security.
  • Pipeline & Deal Management: Build and manage a strong sales pipeline using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), providing accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Contract & Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, service level agreement (SLA) terms, and pricing strategies for high-value enterprise accounts.
  • Market & Product Expertise: Maintain deep subject matter expertise in core enterprise connectivity solutions:
  • Network & Transit: Layer 1-3 services including but not limited to Dedicated Internet, Dark Fiber, Ethernet/MPLS
  • Cloud & Edge: Direct Cloud Connect (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute), SD-WAN, SASE
  • Platform and Managed Services: Managed CPE solution eg Managed Router, Managed Firewall

Qualifications

  • Diploma in IT/Engineering/ICT related field with at least 5 years of B2B sales experience within telecommunications, network service providers, or cloud connectivity vendors.
  • Advantageous to possess experience managing accounts in Healthcare, Education (Institutes of Higher Learning) and Hospitality
  • Proven understanding of WAN architectures, SD-WAN, multi-cloud interconnectivity, and enterprise networking hardware for both domestic and international connectivity.
  • Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding revenue and order book quotas with complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Demonstrated ability to pitch and build trust with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, and VP-level decision-makers.

In this permanent, embedded role, you will provide breakdown and scheduled maintenance service to our local clients and specialising in engine maintenance and repairs across mining applications.

You will make an impact in the following ways:

Plus a range of personal and professional benefits, including discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles.

If you require any reasonable adjustments to accommodate a health condition or disability, please let us know. Your journey with us matters._

Critical Competencies:

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electrical Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards on working with low and/or high voltage by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; applies basic electrical theories and electronics components knowledge using appropriate tools and procedures to diagnose and repair products safely and efficiently.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

job.title: Regional Capability Trainer - Western
job.description:
Completes troubleshooting, repairs and rebuilds on engine products in a service workshop independently while coaching and developing less experienced technicians

Key Responsibilities

1. Hands-On Workshop Coaching

  • Teach apprentices how to use hand tools, power tools, torque tools, and precision measurement gear correctly.
  • Show them how to dismantle, inspect, and reassemble components safely and cleanly.
  • Demonstrate how engines, fuel systems, air systems, and aftertreatment systems work—using real examples in the shop.
  • Walk apprentices through “what goes wrong” and how to identify faults, damage, wear, and failure modes.
  • Build foundational troubleshooting skills using real units, real jobs, and real failures.

2. Apprentice Readiness & Confidence Building

  • Help first-years get comfortable in the workshop—how to move safely, set up their workspace, and think like a technician.
  • Teach shop etiquette: teamwork, communication, keeping a tidy bay, and respecting the craft.
  • Support apprentices who may lack confidence or exposure by giving them structured, achievable tasks.

3. Capability Tracking & Individualised Support

  • Use the standardised capability tracker to guide development, set expectations, and maintain consistency across regions.
  • Adapt coaching approaches to each apprentice—ensuring flexibility to address gaps, strengths, and real-time needs.
  • Provide apprentices with targeted support in areas flagged through the tracker or identified in the workshop.

4. Branch Support & Integration

  • Work closely with Service Managers, Supervisors, and Technicians to ensure apprentices are developing the right skills.
  • Identify capability gaps at each branch and provide targeted hands-on coaching sessions.
  • Support the embedding of standard work practices and safe working methods in day-to-day workshop tasks.
  • Travel to nearby or regional sites when required —usually infrequent and planned (<10%), but may increase as program needs evolve.

5. Technical Demonstrations & Practical Learning

  • Run short, practical mini-sessions in the workshop (e.g., correct measuring techniques, wear pattern identification, torque procedures).
  • Set up hands-on problem‑solving activities using failed components or stripped-down engines.
  • Guide apprentices through real diagnostic processes using actual customer units when appropriate.

6. Apprentice Progression & Support

  • Provide input for apprentice capability reviews based on observed workshop performance.
  • Work with the Apprentice Program Manager to identify apprentices needing additional support.
  • Celebrate growth and milestones to keep apprentices engaged and motivated.

Responsible for performing electrical maintenance and supporting machine operations to ensure equipment reliability and availability. job.title: Senior Project Manager - Power Generation
job.description:
Based at our Wetherill Park branch in New South Wales, you will join our expanding Power Generation team and lead the delivery of complex commercial, data centre, and critical infrastructure projects across the state.

Working closely with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, builders, vendors, subcontractors, and internal Cummins teams, you will manage projects from initial planning and design coordination through procurement, installation, commissioning, and final handover. You will ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer requirements, relevant standards, and Cummins quality expectations.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex Power Generation projects from planning and design coordination through procurement, installation, commissioning, and handover.
  • Manage project schedules, budgets, forecasting, costs, resources, risks, and overall commercial performance.
  • Coordinate customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, builders, vendors, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Work with Engineering teams to coordinate technical specifications, drawings, electrical schematics, equipment schedules, and project documentation.
  • Lead key delivery activities, including design reviews, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), site installation, commissioning, and project close-out.
  • Ensure projects comply with customer requirements, Australian Standards, safety requirements, and Cummins quality and engineering guidelines.
  • Proactively manage project risks and build strong stakeholder relationships through clear and consistent communication.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Minimum five years’ Project Management experience within Power Generation, electrical infrastructure, critical power, construction, mechanical, or a similar technical environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex technical projects through planning, procurement, installation, commissioning, and handover.
  • Practical understanding of diesel and/or gas generator systems, electrical infrastructure, and associated balance of plant.
  • Experience reviewing engineering drawings, electrical schematics, technical specifications, equipment schedules, and other project documentation.
  • Strong commercial and financial capability, including project budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and revenue management.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and contractors.
  • Working knowledge of relevant Australian Standards and safety requirements, with tertiary qualifications in Project Management, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline preferred.

job.title: Technician - Field Service
job.description:
Job Summary

Diagnoses and completes less complex repairs to engines at the customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

Engages customers in a courteous and professional manner. Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs. Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete less complex repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools. Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field. Escalates unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor. Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional service opportunities with customer. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements. Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation. Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)

Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution

Locally valid driving permit

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Basic level field service work experience

Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products

Customer service experience

Good communication skills. Work well within a team environment , also need to work autonomously when required in the field. Good computer skills. Insite and QSOL experience preferred. Good attitude towards work and team.

job.title: Procurement Risk Analyst
job.description:
The Procurement Risk Analyst supports procurement and supply chain operations by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating supplier and supply chain risks to ensure business continuity and operational efficiency. This role executes procurement strategies aligned with material buying plans, with a focus on improving supplier performance, capacity readiness, and risk mitigation ahead of demand. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, supplier risk management expertise, data visualization skills, and stakeholder collaboration to provide actionable insights that support procurement decision-making and supply continuity. The analyst will also act as a data steward, ensuring data quality, governance, and consistency across procurement systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze supplier and supply chain data to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and potential business impacts, and provide actionable insights to procurement and business leaders.
  • Coordinate with sourcing managers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to assess risks and develop mitigation and business continuity plans.
  • Support supplier performance improvement initiatives while maintaining high-quality product and service delivery.
  • Monitor supplier capacity, continuity of supply, reputational risks, and margin-related risks, and proactively implement risk mitigation strategies.
  • Prepare and present recommendations for process improvements, risk reduction opportunities, and alternative courses of action to procurement leadership.
  • Support procurement operations related to supplier onboarding, qualification, contract management, payment issues, and order fulfillment.
  • Serve as the communication conduit between suppliers, sourcing teams, and manufacturing facilities during supplier issues or disruptions.
  • Provide delivery and expediting support to plants/sites during supplier constraints or operational challenges.
  • Support management and execution of engineering releases impacting suppliers.
  • Collect, validate, and maintain supplier scorecard data and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Act as a Data Steward by ensuring data integrity, governance, quality, and consistency across procurement systems.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and automations using tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Excel, and database systems to improve efficiency and visibility.
  • Proactively monitor procurement systems, identify issues, and drive corrective actions to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Document and share best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives across procurement teams.
  • Drive process automation and system enhancements to improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

Skills & Competencies

  • Supply Base Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate supplier risks related to supply continuity, reputation, and profitability.
  • Data Analytics & Visualization: Strong capability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data, identify trends, and present actionable insights using dashboards and reporting tools.
  • Procurement Systems Knowledge: Proficiency in ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and related purchasing, quality, and payment systems.
  • Advanced Technical Skills: Expertise in Advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, Macros), Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, and reporting automation.
  • Supplier Performance Management: Ability to monitor supplier KPIs, manage corrective actions, and drive continuous supplier improvement.
  • Supplier Capacity Management: Understanding of supplier capacity planning, forecasting, and demand alignment.
  • Contract Management: Ability to assess contractual terms, monitor supplier compliance, and manage contract lifecycle activities.
  • Problem Solving: Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving using data-driven methodologies.
  • Negotiation Excellence: Ability to support negotiations to achieve mutually beneficial business outcomes.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration and relationship-building with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, and internal stakeholders.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and present insights effectively.
  • Escalation & Conflict Management: Ability to manage escalations calmly and resolve issues with minimal business disruption.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, implement process improvements, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Agility & Decision Making: Quick decision-making capability with strong business judgment in dynamic environments.

Experience

  • Minimum 5–6 years of experience in procurement, supply chain analytics, supplier management, or source-to-pay operations.
  • Hands-on experience in procurement data analysis, business intelligence, and visualization tools.
  • Experience in supplier risk management and business continuity planning.
  • Exposure to end-to-end Source-to-Pay processes including supplier qualification, onboarding, contract management, and payment cycles.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in global or matrix organizations.
  • Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments preferred.

Additional Information

  • Work Location: Cummins India Technical Center (IOC), Pune, India
  • Shift Timing: Afternoon / EMEA Shift (12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST)
  • Work Mode: Hybrid / On-site with flexibility

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred, with specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations.
  • Additional certifications in Risk Management, Procurement, Project Management (PMP/Prince2), or Data Analytics are an advantage.

Line Balancing - Evaluates work activities performed by individuals or machines to identify opportunities to optimize operating time and distributing of the work content to meet the changes in customer demands while continuing to optimize manufacturing processes.

Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.

Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.

Industrial Engineering Knowledge - Integrates the pillars of industrial engineering techniques by applying a comprehensive and quantitative analysis to available data to be used as decision factors for the development or improvement of manufacturing processes to contribute to the most efficient process.

job.description:
Being part of Cummins means working alongside today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Receive and inspect incoming goods against invoices, sort, label, and store stock safely to optimize warehouse space
  • Accurately pick, pack, and dispatch outgoing orders on schedule
  • Process orders and complete system data entry to keep inventory records accurate and up to date
  • Conduct regular cycle counts and routine stocktakes to maintain stock control
  • Liaise directly with internal teams, suppliers, and transport partners regarding deliveries and orders
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area at all times

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Previous warehousing or stores experience is a plus, but if you are new to warehousing we are more than happy to fully train the right candidate!
  • A current Forklift licence is advantageous
  • Intermediate computer skills (including MS Excel) with the ability to pick up new systems quickly
  • Ability to work independently with a strong commitment to safe and efficient work practices
  • Great communication skills and a positive, team-first attitude

job.title: Buying Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary

The Strategic Sourcing / Procurement Specialist supports sourcing, localization, supplier management, commercial negotiations, and cost optimization activities for Cummins products. The role is responsible for analyzing supplier quotations, conducting should-cost and benchmarking analysis, developing sourcing strategies, managing supplier agreements, and identifying cost reduction opportunities while ensuring quality, delivery, compliance, and long-term supplier relationships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage supplier agreements, including Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), purchasing agreements, and other commercial contracts.
  • Lead sourcing and localization programs, ensuring timely execution and achievement of project milestones.
  • Develop and evaluate should-cost models for castings, forgings, machined components, sheet metal, brake components, and proprietary parts.
  • Prepare and evaluate tooling cost estimates for new product development and localization projects.
  • Conduct raw material cost trend analysis, RM indexing, price benchmarking, and commercial analysis to support supplier negotiations.
  • Lead commercial negotiations with suppliers and drive successful cost settlements while maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Prepare and issue RFQs and evaluate supplier quotations using Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and technical-commercial analysis.
  • Analyze and benchmark BOM costs for complete vehicles, aggregates, and sub-systems to identify cost optimization opportunities.
  • Identify and implement Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VA/VE) and cost reduction initiatives across commodities.
  • Develop sourcing strategies, assess supplier capabilities, and support supplier selection and development.
  • Monitor manufacturing technologies, cost drivers, market trends, and industry developments across commodities such as gears, castings, forgings, sheet metal, brake components, bearings, rubber, and seals.
  • Manage procurement transactions and reporting using ERP systems such as SAP MM, JD Edwards, or Oracle .
  • Ensure compliance with procurement policies, procedures, ethical sourcing practices, and applicable commercial requirements.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to achieve sourcing and project objectives.
  • Analyze sourcing data and market intelligence to identify process improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
  • Maintain appropriate supplier, legal, and compliance documentation in applicable systems.
  • Support supplier onboarding, vendor management, and procurement process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • A degree or specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, or related discipline is preferred.
  • Additional qualifications in strategic sourcing, cost engineering, or supply chain management will be an advantage.

Skills & Experience

  • Relevant experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, commodity management, cost engineering, or supplier management .
  • Hands-on experience in should-cost analysis and cost estimation for manufacturing processes such as castings, forgings, machining, sheet metal, brake components, or proprietary parts.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling costs, raw material cost drivers, and supplier economics.
  • Experience in RFQ management, supplier quotation analysis, cost benchmarking, and commercial negotiations.
  • Knowledge of VA/VE, cost reduction, localization, and sourcing strategy development .
  • Working knowledge of SAP MM, JD Edwards, Oracle , or similar ERP/procurement systems.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills with the ability to use cost and market data for business decisions.
  • Understanding of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles and supplier evaluation methodologies.
  • Strong financial acumen and understanding of procurement cost structures.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, stakeholder management, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with suppliers and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong project/program management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against timelines.
  • High level of integrity and understanding of procurement ethics, policies, and compliance requirements.

Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment and adapt to changing business requirements.

job.title: Site Quality Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Responsible for applicable systems related to plant customer issues such as corrective requests. Leads containment activities. Ensures products and processes meet initial and long-term quality standards (Examples: IATF, customer specific requirements, Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Product Parts Approval Process (PPAP) documentation submittal etc.). Supports change management activities for current product and Value Package Introduction (VPI) by supporting verification of products and processes to ensure key measures are met and analyzing data for decision support. Supports and or leads less complex quality audits. Serves as a quality technical resource to other functional areas. Supports the prioritization of continuous improvement with cross functional key business partners by utilizing industry proven methodology (Example: Lean Manufacturing, 7 step problem solving, Intelligent Quality Tools and Methods (IQTM), etc.). Basic understanding and application to Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) core tools. May lead less complex and/or support Safe Launch initiatives through VPI.

Competencies:

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Quality Influence - Ability to recognize stakeholders, create a forum to professionally extract stakeholder perspectives, drive and engage in constructive conflict, and to influence outcomes in order to ensure Cummins makes a balanced decision inclusive of Quality priorities.

Advanced Product Quality Planning - Leads the technical quality planning and ensures customer satisfaction through structured and measurable processes as defined by industry standard.

Measurement Science - Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, “Metrology” e.g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Production Part Approval Process - Coordinates the level of submission of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities and information related to the introduction of new or changed products and processes; dispositions the product’s readiness for production in accordance with the Production Parts Approval Process (PPAP) and APQP provisions of Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) manuals and Cummins procedures in order to meet supplier and customer requirements.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Quality Process Management - Proficient application of quality tools and methods (e.g. APQP, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, Capability studies, Process Audit, inspection, test, etc.) to ensure quality of products, processes and services.

Quality Systems Management - Utilizes the quality tools and processes to ensure the quality management system is understood, implemented, maintained, and demonstrates its ability to consistently and effectively provide products/services that meet requirements.

Statistical Foundations - Applies statistical tools and technique to influence decision making; leverages understanding of data collection methods, key statistics, graphical and analytical methods to describe process performance, gain insights and drive improvement action

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Quality 4.0 - Leverages cloud-based systems and digitization to drive improved quality outcomes. Knowledge and application of Quality 4.0 (Q4.0) and digitization of quality management. Examples of Q4.0 are cloud native software applications, digital twin, simulation, adaptive intelligence and connected systems.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific subject or experience equivalent is preferred.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Minimal to intermediate level of relevant work experience required.

  • Willingness to visit customer sites in Phaltan as and when required.
  • Knowledge of analyzing BIS and RFT issues and identifying root causes.
  • Ability to implement corrective and preventive actions to achieve BIS and RFT targets.
  • Monitors quality performance and supports continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process efficiency and product quality.

Junior Collection Manager is responsible for managing accounts receivable, ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices from business clients, performing account reconciliations, and resolving disputes. The role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder communication, and attention to detail to maintain healthy cash flow and minimize aged receivables

Key Responsibilities

1. Collections

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding balances and reducing delinquency
  • Handle outbound and inbound calls to customers for payment reminders
  • Conduct proactive outreach to customers via phone and email to resolve past-due invoices and secure payment commitments
  • Maintain detailed and accurate collection notes and account histories within the system to support transparency and continuity
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in collections processes
  • Collaborate with field representatives and internal stakeholders to resolve complex customer issues and support strategic initiatives
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of collections policies, procedures, and tools to enhance efficiency and scalability
  • Build strong relationships with customers to improve payment cycles

2. Account Reconciliation

  • Perform periodic reconciliation of customer accounts
  • Identify discrepancies between internal records and customer statements
  • Investigate unapplied cash, short payments, or overpayments
  • Work with internal teams (billing, sales, finance) to resolve mismatches
  • Maintain accurate and updated account statements

3. Dispute Management

  • Identify, log, and track customer disputes related to invoices
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders (billing, operations, sales) for resolution
  • Ensure timely closure of disputes to avoid payment delays
  • Maintain dispute logs and provide root cause analysis
  • Work on preventing recurring issues through process improvements

4. Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports on collections, aging, disputes
  • Analyze aging reports to identify trends, highlight at-risk accounts, and provide actionable insights to leadership
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve collection efficiency
  • Perform monthly and quarterly responsibilities such as Allowance Analysis and journal entry, collection escalation for doubtful accounts and monthly reporting package for collections metrics.
  • Track KPIs such as DSO (Days Sales Outstanding), collection rate, dispute resolution TAT

5. Compliance & Process Adherence

  • Ensure adherence to company credit policies and collection procedures
  • Maintain proper documentation for audits and compliance requirements
  • Support internal and external audit queries related to receivables

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelors or Master’s degree in finance or equivalent
  • 7–8 years of experience in Global Collections, including U.S. customer portfolios
  • Experience managing large, high-volume AR portfolios with measurable impact on DSO
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem‑solving capabilities
  • Ability to negotiate and influence outcomes while remaining tactful and respectful.
  • Excellent time management with the ability to independently prioritize and manage portfolios
  • Proficiency in ERP Systems & Collection Tools – SAP, Oracle, High Radius
  • Demonstrated ownership of high-value, complex AR portfolios with material cash impact
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail
  • Willingness and ability to work U.S. Shifts
  • Mandatory Work from Office

job.title: IT Operations Support Specialist
job.description:
The IT Support Specialist works independently to deliver advanced IT and Manufacturing IT (MFG IT) operational support, ensuring system availability, efficiency, and reliability while driving continuous improvement across services.

This role is based out of our office in Perth.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

Operations & Advanced Troubleshooting

  • Provide Tier 2/3 local and remote hardware, software, network, and server support across corporate and manufacturing locations.
  • Diagnose and manage system compliance tools (Antivirus, Tanium, SOTI, Macrium, WSUS).
  • Support server infrastructure, hosted applications, and lead remote teams during major incident resolutions.
  • Perform full device life cycle management: OS installation, provisioning, deployment, backup/recovery, and decommissioning.

Service Management & Governance

  • Manage incidents and requests from initiation through closure, maintaining high customer satisfaction and SLA compliance.
  • Enforce Cummins IT governance, security standards, and operational guidelines.
  • Author and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and technical knowledge base documentation.

Project Delivery & Vendor Management

  • Serve as an active project team member executing IT service line deliverables using standard Project Management tools.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party vendors and contractors for onsite installations and hardware activities.
  • Travel to regional Cummins facilities on short notice for critical hands-on operational or project tasks.

Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze support trends to drive root-cause analysis and preventive measures.
  • Apply continuous improvement tools (e.g., Six Sigma) to enhance service delivery efficiency and reduce operational costs

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Associate Degree, relevant industry training, or certifications preferred.
  • ITIL knowledge or certification desirable.
  • MCSE certification preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required
  • 5 Plus years of experience in a similar role

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary package
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles.
  • Annual remuneration review
  • Participation in an annual variable compensation (bonus) program
  • A range of personal and professional benefits
  • Onsite parking
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees
  • Paid Parental leave (Conditions apply)

job.title: Technician - Field Service
job.description:
Being part of Cummins means working alongside today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better.

We are seeking an experienced Technician – Field Service to join our dynamic team based out of our coastal Bunbury branch, south of Perth in Western Australia. In this role, you will diagnose and complete repairs to Cummins engines and related components at customer sites, while also supporting workshop repairs and other Cummins branches as required.

  In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways: **

  • Engage customers in a courteous and professional manner, anticipating needs and ensuring prompt, efficient service.
  • Diagnose and complete repairs to Cummins engines and related components at customer sites using specialised tools, documented procedures and policies.
  • Identify and prepare required parts and tools to complete repairs efficiently and to a high standard.
  • Perform preventative maintenance activities in line with documented schedules and standards on engines and related components in the field.
  • Escalate unresolved technical issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or the Supervisor.
  • Complete required documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims and quality documents, via handwritten forms or business system input screens.
  • Identify additional service opportunities with customers and support a positive customer experience.
  • Complete training in line with skill and business requirements.
  • Maintain the service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health, Safety and Environmental policies, procedures and legislation, reporting any issues or incidents to site management and your Supervisor.
  • Complete in-workshop repairs as required and provide support to other Cummins branches when needed.

To be successful in this role you will need the following: **

  • WA driver’s licence
  • Australian working rights
  • Mechanical trades qualified as Heavy Diesel Mechanic or Mobile Plant Mechanic or Light Vehicle with Heavy Diesel experience.
  • Cummins experience is not required however engine experience is desirable
  • Safety Focused and the ability to work effectively in a team environment

Additional Information:

  • Full Time / 38 hours per week
  • Overtime as required – Penalty rates paid for all work above 38 hours
  • On Call Roster 2:6 weeks
  • All your Safety equipment / PPE and uniforms are provided and laundered
  • Domestic Relocation from across Australia _may_ be offered for the right candidate
  • _Local Valid Drivers License is required_

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Cert III) or equivalent
  • Basic level of workshop or field service experience required
  • Basic level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products
  • Heavy Vehicle Experience preferred
  • HR License preferred

Critical Competencies:

  • Health & Safety Fundamentals – Champions proactive safety behaviours and actions to prevent injuries.
  • Diagnostics Application – Troubleshoots issues, identifies failed components, and documents solutions.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application – Uses electronic tools to diagnose, maintain, and resolve service issues.
  • Engine Systems Interactions – Analyses electrical and mechanical system interactions to diagnose and repair effectively.
  • Product Repair & Maintenance – Completes quality repairs and maintenance in line with guidelines and standards.
  • Service Documentation – Accurately records customer, equipment, technical, and repair information.
  • Technical Escalation – Escalates complex issues appropriately and records troubleshooting activities.
  • Values Differences – Recognises the value of diverse perspectives and experiences.

job.title: Data Engineer Manager 2
job.description:
Job Summary

Leads a team of data engineers in designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. Collaborates with business stakeholders, IT partners, and analysts to implement data engineering solutions that support analytics and reporting needs. Translates strategic guidance into actionable engineering plans and ensures high-quality, timely delivery of data solutions. Promotes best practices in data architecture, governance, and performance optimization across projects.

Key Responsibilities

Leads data engineering teams in developing, testing, and deploying robust data pipelines, integrations, and platforms to support enterprise analytics and reporting needs. Translates data strategy and architecture guidance into actionable engineering initiatives and project deliverables. Collaborates with data architects, analysts, and business partners to design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance data solutions. Ensures adherence to data governance, privacy, and compliance standards in all data engineering activities. Oversees performance optimization, reliability, and maintenance of data systems and platforms. Guides team members in adopting best practices in data modeling, ETL development, and cloud data services. Monitors system capabilities, identifies improvement opportunities, and implements upgrades and enhancements. Develops and mentors data engineers to build technical proficiency and career growth within the team. Provides technical expertise and problem-solving support for complex data issues within ongoing projects. Supports operational and business decision-making by ensuring timely and accurate data availability across key systems. Responsible for team financial management including annual operating plan (AOP), budget management, and forecasting to ensure alignment with organizational goals

Job Summary – JM2

Junior Collection Manager is responsible for managing accounts receivable, ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices from business clients, performing account reconciliations, and resolving disputes. The role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder communication, and attention to detail to maintain healthy cash flow and minimize aged receivables

Key Responsibilities

1. Collections

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding balances and reducing delinquency
  • Handle outbound and inbound calls to customers for payment reminders
  • Conduct proactive outreach to customers via phone and email to resolve past-due invoices and secure payment commitments
  • Maintain detailed and accurate collection notes and account histories within the system to support transparency and continuity
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in collections processes
  • Collaborate with field representatives and internal stakeholders to resolve complex customer issues and support strategic initiatives
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of collections policies, procedures, and tools to enhance efficiency and scalability
  • Build strong relationships with customers to improve payment cycles

2. Account Reconciliation (Recon)

  • Perform periodic reconciliation of customer accounts
  • Identify discrepancies between internal records and customer statements
  • Investigate unapplied cash, short payments, or overpayments
  • Work with internal teams (billing, sales, finance) to resolve mismatches
  • Maintain accurate and updated account statements

3. Dispute Management

  • Identify, log, and track customer disputes related to invoices
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders (billing, operations, sales) for resolution
  • Ensure timely closure of disputes to avoid payment delays
  • Maintain dispute logs and provide root cause analysis
  • Work on preventing recurring issues through process improvements

4. Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports on collections, aging, disputes
  • Analyze aging reports to identify trends, highlight at-risk accounts, and provide actionable insights to leadership
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve collection efficiency
  • Perform monthly and quarterly responsibilities such as Allowance Analysis and journal entry, collection escalation for doubtful accounts and monthly reporting package for collections metrics.
  • Track KPIs such as DSO (Days Sales Outstanding), collection rate, dispute resolution TAT

5. Compliance & Process Adherence

  • Ensure adherence to company credit policies and collection procedures
  • Maintain proper documentation for audits and compliance requirements
  • Support internal and external audit queries related to receivables

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelors or Master’s degree in finance or equivalent
  • 7–8 years of experience in Global Collections, including U.S. customer portfolios
  • Experience managing large, high-volume AR portfolios with measurable impact on DSO
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem‑solving capabilities
  • Ability to negotiate and influence outcomes while remaining tactful and respectful.
  • Excellent time management with the ability to independently prioritize and manage portfolios
  • Proficiency in ERP Systems & Collection Tools – SAP, Oracle, High Radius
  • Demonstrated ownership of high-value, complex AR portfolios with material cash impact
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail
  • Willingness and ability to work U.S. Shifts
  • Mandatory Work from Office

job.title: Senior Project Engineer - Power Generation
job.description:
Job Summary

This role is based at our Pooraka Branch, South Australia, where you will join our expanding Power Generation team providing technical leadership and application engineering support for projects across Data Centres, Energy Management, Healthcare, Commercial Buildings, Industrial Facilities, Utilities, Mining, and other critical infrastructure sectors.

Working closely with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, project managers, and Cummins teams across the Asia Pacific region, you will develop reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective power generation solutions that meet both technical and commercial requirements.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Develop technical solutions for diesel and gas generator systems, power generation packages, and integrated power solutions.
  • Engage directly with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, and internal stakeholders to understand technical and commercial requirements.
  • Prepare and review technical specifications, single line diagrams, system architecture, equipment schedules, and engineering documentation.
  • Provide on-site expertise during installation and commissioning of equipment, ensuring we provide a high quality and safe solution for our customers.
  • Review electrical and mechanical system designs to ensure compliance with Australian Standards, customer specifications, and Cummins engineering guidelines.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout project execution including design reviews, factory acceptance testing (FAT), site installation, commissioning, and project close-out.
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Service, Project Management, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to ensure successful project delivery.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in power generation, electrical infrastructure, critical power, or industrial power systems.
  • Experience delivering technical solutions for industries such as Data Centres, Healthcare, Mining, Commercial Buildings, Utilities, Manufacturing, or Infrastructure.
  • Experience creating and reviewing engineering drawings, electrical schematics, technical specifications, and project documentation.
  • Strong understanding of Australian Standards and relevant electrical codes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

Desirable traits for the role include:

  • Knowledge of SCADA, PLCs, Building Management Systems (BMS), or Power Management Systems.
  • Design drafting skills, Autocad, Creo, Solidworks or similar.
  • Experience with Cummins, CAT, MTU, Kohler, or other power generation equipment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Flexible Lifestyle – Monday to Friday (Hybrid)
  • Competitive salary package
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles.
  • Annual remuneration review
  • Participation in an annual variable compensation (bonus) program
  • A range of personal and professional benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees
  • Paid Parental leave (Conditions apply)

Responsibilities

The successful applicant will be responsible for working independently and leading a small team of engineers towards successful completion of engineering projects with a key focus on systems engineering. This role requires a blend of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, systems engineering, team leadership and project/task management skills. This role will have no direct reports.

This role requires occasional extended travel both within Australia and Internationally in support of project needs. This typically involves travel to a Cummins or sub-supplier facility or to a construction site, and providing engineering expertise in the construction phase or witnessing or performance of testing/commissioning. Some work sites may be in remote areas.

In support of wider power generation projects, the successful applicant will have the opportunity to lead a multi-discipline team of engineers and to support other Lead Engineers in the deployment of major projects.

  • Engineering support for major projects, provide technical solution/proposal,
  • Mentor junior engineers and engineering interns,
  • Be the key conduit and liaison for Project Managers to plan and direct works
  • Assess a project for required engineering input,
  • Identify and manage technical risk within a project,
  • Develop an engineering delivery plan appropriate to the project’s needs,
  • Lead a team of other engineers, external consultants and sub-suppliers in the delivery of the engineering plan,
  • Work with other lead engineers towards the delivery of other projects as necessary,
  • Interface with customers and sub-suppliers on engineering matters,
  • Asist the Engineering Leadership Team in the development of standardised work practices towards a continuous improvement goal,

The preferred applicant would be able to demonstrate:

  • Extensive experience in previous project delivery (power generation, green energy, distribution, substation, high voltage, switchgear, mining, rail, defence, heavy industry, construction or similar),
  • Create, review and critique designs, test plans, procedures and reports,
  • Adhere to ISO 9001 quality work practices,
  • Assess engineering risks in accordance with ISO 31000,
  • Develop and maintain engineering deliverable plans while tracking task progress for their team as a key conduit for the Project Management team,
  • Task planning and basic project management skills
  • Customer facing skills,
  • Maintain an interdependent safety culture within their team,

Job Engineering

Job Type Exempt - Experienced

job.title: Electrician - Level IV
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment failure analysis. Performs work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Ensures all process documents and quality procedures are updated and acts as a resource to provide help to others. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Fully proficient performing troubleshooting, electrical repairs and maintenance of equipment. Conforms to applicable codes and standards to maintain, install, and operate electrical systems. Leads and coordinates others acting as a formal resource for team members with less experience. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Performs other duties as required to meet business goals. Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Schedule maintenance activities around production requirements Solve problems and improve processes Actively identify issues and implement solutions Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Competencies:

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

job.title: Data Engineer 4
job.description:
Job Summary

Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.

Competencies:

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.

Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.

Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities.

Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:

  • Exposure to Big Data open source
  • SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
  • SQL query language
  • Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
  • Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment
  • Exposure to Agile software development
  • Exposure to building analytical solutions
  • Exposure to IoT technology

Core Responsibilities Unique to the Role

1) Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains.

2) Apply Data-as-a-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers.

3)

Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.

Required Skills, Education, or Experience

1) Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud-based technologies.

2) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise-scale data products.

job.title: Data Engineer 2
job.description:
Job Summary

Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.

Competencies:

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.

Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.

Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

3 to 6 Years of relevant experience

Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities.

Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:

  • Exposure to Big Data open source
  • SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
  • SQL query language
  • Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
  • Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment
  • Exposure to Agile software development
  • Exposure to building analytical solutions
  • Exposure to IoT technology

Core Responsibilities Unique to the Role

1) Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains.

2) Apply Data-as-a-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers.

3)

Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.

Required Skills, Education, or Experience

1) Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud-based technologies.

2) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise-scale data products.

3) Ability to translate business and product requirements into efficient technical solutions while considering scalability, performance, maintainability, and reusability.

4) Experience working in Agile, cross-functional teams and collaborating effectively with product, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.

5) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred (Nice to Have) Skills, Education, or Experience

1) Experience working within a Data-as-a-Product operating model, including exposure to data catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and certified data products.

2) Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI initiatives, including preparation of AI-ready datasets, semantic models, knowledge assets, or data structures supporting intelligent business solutions.

Job Systems/Information Technology

Organization Cummins Inc.

Role Category On-site with Flexibility

Job Type Exempt - Experienced
