job.title: Technician - Field Service
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a talented Diesel Technician to join the high performing team at our Cairns branch in Far North Queensland. In this role you will diagnose and complete repairs to engines at the customer’s site.

You will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Engage customers in a courteous and professional manner. Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs.
  • Apply the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools.
  • Perform preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor.
  • Complete required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens.
  • Identify additional service opportunities with customer.
  • Complete training in line with skill and business requirements.
  • Maintain service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.
  • Complete in workshop repairs as required

Additional Information:

  • Full Time / 38 hours per week
  • On Call Roster
  • Overtime as required – Penalty rates paid for all work above 38 hours
  • All your Safety equipment / PPE and uniforms are provided and laundered
  • Domestic Relocation from across Australia _may_ be offered for the right candidate
  • _Local Valid Drivers License is required_
  • _Remote Area Travel Required_

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Cert III) or equivalent
  • Basic level of workshop or field service experience required
  • Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products

_Preferred but not essential:_

  • _Heavy Vehicle or Mobile Plant Experience_
  • _HR License_
  • _Cummins experience_
  • _Remote Work Experience_
  • _Power Generation (Mechanical) experience_

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Overtime & Loading penalties
  • Safety equipment / PPE provided
  • Uniforms provided
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles
  • Annual remuneration review
  • Participation in an annual variable compensation (bonus) program
  • A range of personal and professional benefits
  • Onsite parking
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees
  • Paid Parental leave (Conditions apply)

_At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, colour, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law._

Critical Competencies:

  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  • Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.
  • Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.
  • Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.
  • Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.
  • Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

job.title: Supply Chain Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

Lead efforts within one or more Supply Chain functions including materials, production, inventory, logistics, demand management and order fulfillment. Ensures internal and external customers' expectations and requirements are met from end to end in each of the supply chains.

Key Responsibilities

Manage daily operations across functions to ensure a dependable and efficient supply chain. Lead continuous improvement projects that align with Cummins Operating System and Functional Excellence direction and leverage common processes tools, and information systems. Support Corporate Supply Chain initiatives and lead the cross Business Unit planning processes to ensure intra-company alignment. Mitigate long term supplier constraints by collaborating with functional stakeholders. Create common supply chain processes and procedures by establishing collaborative business partner relationships. Approach daily problem solving and continuous improvement opportunities strategically and tactically to achieve performance targets. Develop, understand and improve necessary Key Performance Indicators. Analyze operational trends and develop corrective action plans. Address supply chain failures promptly to ensure operations stability; escalate as appropriate. Prepare and manage an annual operating plan including expense resources, and capital. Manage, coach, and develop staff; work with employees to set goals in training and development, performance, and career planning.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Directs work - Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.

Drives engagement - Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.

Material Planning - Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Supply Chain Knowledge - Influences, with the ability to concisely explain and/or elaborate on, the multi-disciplined and end-to-end integration of the flow of information, products, and services to achieve the desired result for the end customer within the first-fit or aftermarket business segments while balancing the tensions of inventory, cost, and delivery.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Significant level of experience required. 5-7 years of relevant experience preferred.

This position leads multi-location supply chain teams with end-to-end responsibility for the supply chain operations of CGT Ahilyanagar , CGT Ranjangaon , and the OMCS team in Pune . The role manages material planning, procurement, logistics, warehousing, transportation and supplier performance for manufactured and outsourced products, including exclusive oversight of OSP facilities , to ensure optimal delivery, quality, cost, and operational performance

job.title: Pricing Analyst - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

The Pricing Analyst – Senior is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing pricing strategies that drive profitable growth while maintaining market competitiveness. This role leads pricing operations, pricing analytics, and cross-functional pricing initiatives by ensuring accurate pricing data, executing strategic price revisions, supporting customer pricing, and delivering actionable business insights. The position collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, and business leadership to align pricing decisions with organizational objectives, enhance pricing processes, and improve customer value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, implementation, and execution of pricing strategies that support business growth, profitability, and competitive positioning.
  • Plan, analyze, obtain approvals for, and execute annual and mid-year pricing revisions across multiple product lines and market segments.
  • Maintain accurate pricing data across ERP, CRM, order management, rebate, and pricing systems, ensuring data integrity and first-time accuracy.
  • Manage multiple pricing structures and price lists while ensuring synchronization across enterprise systems.
  • Prepare customer quotations and pricing proposals in collaboration with Sales teams and support complex customer pricing negotiations.
  • Analyze pricing performance, market trends, customer behavior, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data to recommend pricing improvements and business actions.
  • Lead pricing governance forums and facilitate collaborative pricing decisions with Sales, Finance, and business leadership.
  • Design and continuously improve pricing methodologies, pricing policies, and pricing philosophies aligned with business objectives.
  • Lead pricing analytics initiatives by leveraging business intelligence, automation, AI, and digital tools to improve pricing effectiveness and decision-making.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, forecasts, and executive presentations that provide meaningful pricing insights and business recommendations.
  • Lead pricing improvement projects, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Ensure timely resolution of complex pricing issues while providing excellent support to internal and external customers.
  • Maintain confidentiality of pricing information and ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Monitor pricing operational KPIs including turnaround time, accuracy, and service levels, implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop pricing team members while fostering a collaborative, high-performance work environment.

Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, Supply Chain, and other business functions to achieve shared business goals.

Core Competencies

  • Pricing Strategy & Execution
  • Pricing Analytics & Business Intelligence
  • Market Analysis & Forecasting
  • Financial & Commercial Acumen
  • Customer Pricing & Quotation Management
  • Data Analysis & Decision Making
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Stakeholder Management & Influencing
  • Project Leadership & Continuous Improvement
  • ERP, CRM & Pricing Systems Management
  • AI & Digital Analytics Adoption
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking
  • Process Excellence
  • Customer Focus
  • Effective Communication
  • Accountability & Ownership
  • Managing Ambiguity
  • Building Networks
  • Collaboration
  • Coaching & Team Development
  • Valuing Diverse Perspectives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Marketing, Strategy, Accounting, Business Administration , or a related discipline is required.
  • Master's degree or relevant professional certifications in Pricing, Finance, Analytics, or Business Management are preferred.
  • Position may require compliance with applicable export controls or sanctions regulations.

Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience in pricing, commercial finance, pricing analytics, sales operations, business analytics, or related commercial functions.
  • Experience developing and implementing pricing strategies within manufacturing, automotive, industrial, aftermarket, or B2B environments is preferred.
  • Strong analytical capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insights into business recommendations.
  • Experience managing complex pricing structures, customer pricing, rebates, quotations, and enterprise pricing systems.
  • Working knowledge of ERP and CRM platforms (such as Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or equivalent).
  • Experience leading pricing governance, cross-functional projects, and strategic pricing initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate across multiple business functions.
  • Experience leading or mentoring teams and driving employee development.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting/analytics tools; experience with Power BI, Tableau, AI-enabled analytics, or similar platforms is advantageous.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high levels of accuracy, quality, and customer focus.
  • The position is for India aftermarket DBU Pricing leader.
  • Lead a team of three office employees – who manage the day to day DBU pricing operations and Pricing analytics.
  • Takes care of the strategic pricing – which involves carrying out all the mass scale annual and mid year price revisions – including planning, analysis, seeking approvals from pricing councils, execution of the actions, providing the right justifications to the market etc.
  • Leads the DBU Pricing councils. Ensures decisions are taken collaboratively by the Pricing, Finance and Sales leaders in this forum.

  • Manage the DBU Direct customer pricing. Prepare the quotations to these customers in co-ordination with the sales team expectations and sometimes participate in the customer pricing negotiations.

job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

The Engine Field Service Technician – Level II is responsible for diagnosing, maintaining, and completing less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites. The role requires a strong customer focus, sound technical knowledge, effective troubleshooting skills, and adherence to Cummins’ safety, quality, and service standards.

The role may be considered for both internal and external candidates , based on relevant qualifications, technical capability, experience, and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and complete less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites using approved procedures, service publications, specialized tools, and electronic service tools.
  • Engage with customers in a courteous and professional manner, understand their needs, and provide prompt and effective service solutions.
  • Translate customer complaints into structured troubleshooting plans and identify failed components through appropriate diagnostic methods.
  • Perform preventive maintenance activities in accordance with documented schedules, procedures, and technical standards.
  • Identify, prepare, and use the required parts, tools, equipment, and service information to complete repairs efficiently and accurately.
  • Apply knowledge of engine mechanical and electrical systems, including fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, sensors, controls, and related systems, to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Validate completed repairs by confirming that the reported issue has been resolved and the equipment is operating as required.
  • Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to experienced Field Service Technicians, technical experts, or the Supervisor, as appropriate.
  • Accurately complete service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality records, and required information in business systems.
  • Maintain accurate customer, equipment, technical, and troubleshooting records to support service history and future diagnostics.
  • Identify additional service opportunities and communicate relevant customer needs to support service excellence.
  • Maintain service vehicles, tools, and equipment in a clean, safe, and operational condition.
  • Complete required technical and developmental training in line with individual skill requirements and business needs.
  • Comply with all applicable Health, Safety & Environmental policies, procedures, standards, and legislation, and promptly report incidents, hazards, or other concerns to site management and the Supervisor.
  • Promote a professional, customer-focused, and safety-oriented approach across all field service activities.

Key Competencies

  • Effective Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally across different audiences and situations.
  • Customer Focus: Builds positive customer relationships and delivers solutions aligned with customer needs.
  • Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Uses structured troubleshooting approaches, technical information, service tools, and measurements to identify and resolve product issues.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application: Selects and effectively uses appropriate electronic hardware and software tools for diagnosis, maintenance, and repair.
  • Engine Systems Knowledge: Understands the interaction between mechanical and electrical engine systems and applies this knowledge to field diagnostics and repair.
  • Product Repair & Maintenance: Performs repairs, maintenance, component replacement, disassembly, and assembly in accordance with approved procedures and quality standards.
  • Service Documentation: Accurately records technical information, troubleshooting activities, repairs, and service outcomes in the required systems.
  • Technical Escalation: Recognizes issues requiring additional expertise and escalates them appropriately while ensuring complete documentation of troubleshooting performed.
  • Health & Safety: Demonstrates proactive safety behavior, identifies hazards, follows HSE requirements, and contributes to a safe working environment.
  • Manages Complexity: Analyzes technical information and applies sound judgment to resolve field service issues.
  • Self-Development: Demonstrates a willingness to learn, develop technical capability, and complete required training.
  • Develops Talent: Supports knowledge sharing and contributes to the development of colleagues where appropriate.
  • Values Differences: Works effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and values different perspectives.

Qualifications

  • Vocational diploma/certificate from a relevant technical institution.
  • Apprentice-trained Engine Technician qualification is preferred.
  • Locally valid driving permit/license.
  • Any additional technical certifications relevant to engine, mechanical, electrical, or field service activities would be advantageous.
  • The position may require applicable licensing or authorization to comply with export control and sanctions regulations.

Skills

  • Basic to intermediate troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for engines and related systems.
  • Ability to use mechanical and electronic service tools and diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to interpret service manuals, technical publications, diagnostic results, and repair procedures.
  • Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical engine systems.
  • Ability to perform preventive maintenance and less complex repairs independently.
  • Good customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to accurately complete service reports, warranty documentation, timesheets, and electronic service records.
  • Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work safely and effectively at customer sites.
  • Ability to identify when technical escalation is required.
  • Willingness to travel and work in field/customer-site environments as required.

Experience

  • Basic level field service experience is preferred.
  • Intermediate-level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products.
  • Experience in engine maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, or related technical service environments.
  • Customer service experience, preferably in a technical or field service environment.
  • Experience using diagnostic tools, service software, and technical documentation would be advantageous.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a technically capable and customer-focused professional who can independently handle routine field service activities and less complex engine repairs while recognizing when issues require escalation. The candidate should demonstrate strong safety awareness, willingness to learn, disciplined service documentation, and the ability to build effective customer relationships.

Key account manager service for HHP segment.

Adherence to Service Level Agreement (SLA), HSE guidelines and other business compliance.

  • Have clear understanding of contract scope and discuss with all the concerned at dealership on the commencement of any new contract.
  • Support dealership and solution team to prepare an accurate PM schedule.
  • Failure trend analysis especially under LHP CAMC and ensure stocking of parts as per FTA through DAMs.
  • Ensure the team reviews open SRN regularly and supporting dealership on PM and breakdown SLA compliance.
  • Ensure 100 % utilization of contract cap value. Have a monthly review of parts consumption to be tracked and ensure consumption of supplied parts are as per agreed cap value of individual contract. Prepare proactive maintenances and parts replacement in order to prevent breakdowns and share with the customer as per capped value yearly.
  • Ensure that vendor evaluation score should be above 95% for all the CAMC customers

Develop relationship with customer

  • Prepare and update key / CAMC customer profiles highlighting decision-making positions. Update yearly
  • Plan proactive customer engagement and comply. Plan monthly 10 customer / month
  • Create 100% activities against all the action points decided in the meeting and track to close as per the agreed timelines. Also keep the customer posted with updates for the Open action items. Within 3 days of the meeting.
  • Conduct QBR / MIS with key CAMC customers. Quarterly
  • Identify critical success factor of all the key customer in the region and prepare customer support plan accordingly.
  • Aim to improve the percentage of customer issues resolved on the first contact, minimizing escalations and enhancing overall customer satisfaction.

PM Quality Enhancement

  • ensure that all CAMC service KAMs carryout service quality audits at least for 5 DGs in a month based on 2 previous PMs done and share report with HOD, maintain a tracker with before and after audit status.
  • Release consolidated report with findings and improvement plan and track the improvement in processes at dealership.
  • Conduct preventative maintenance trainings per dealership. Cover all branches through Area offices KAMs
  • Drive seasonal check-ups / maintenance campaigns.
  • > Seasons / geographical locations
  • Audit DG sets older than 10 years through AO KAMs. min 5 DGs / month
  • Drive alternator maintenance compliance with all the CAMC customers. Increase in Alternator maintenance SRNs by 20% over previous year.
  • Conduct health checks and lube oil sample analysis. Prepare and release an yearly plan and release compliance status monthly.

Predictive Maintenance Drive

  • Analyse service data of 5 Key customer's in the area at least for last 2 years and identify parts support gaps and failure trend and take proactive measures to prevent the failures for HHP/LHP at key customers. Publish the analysis once in 6 months.
  • Identify the engines having clocked more than 5000 hours or 5 years, whichever is earlier and carry out health check ups to demonstrate our value added services to customer.

職務描述

We are looking for a Buyer to join our Procurement Team and support purchasing execution and supply operations.

This role is responsible for managing purchase orders, coordinating supplier delivery, and supporting stable material supply to meet business and production requirements.

The ideal candidate enjoys organizing information, solving operational issues, and collaborating across functions to move things forward. You do not need to know everything from day one — but we value people who take ownership, follow through, and continuously improve the way work gets done.

This position provides opportunities to develop procurement capability through supplier interaction, operational exposure, and cross-functional collaboration.

職責

ESSENTIAL DUTIES  AND  RESPONSIBILITIES

Procurement & Supply Execution

  • Convert purchase requests into purchase orders and maintain purchasing records in ERP systems.
  • Issue purchase orders and coordinate order execution with suppliers.
  • Monitor delivery schedules and follow up supply status to support business requirements.
  • Support order adjustments, long-term order planning, and pre-order preparation when required.
  • Coordinate operational issues across internal teams and suppliers to ensure smooth order execution.
  • Support pricing discussions for specific purchasing scenarios when applicable.

Supplier Coordination & Operational Support

  • Work with suppliers to confirm delivery commitments and resolve operational issues.
  • Maintain order status visibility and support issue escalation when necessary.
  • Coordinate purchasing-related transactions and support cross-business unit collaboration.
  • Build productive working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Invoice & Procurement Administration

  • Monitor supplier invoice submission and support invoice reconciliation activities.
  • Coordinate with Finance to resolve invoice-related issues and ensure transaction accuracy.
  • Maintain procurement documentation and system records.

job.description:
Job Description

At a Glance

Additional Duties

Also exposed to certain high working areas like high ceiling or floor level.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Mould Tool Development (MTDM)
job.description:
Job Description

The Deputy Manager will play a crucial role in developing, validating, and standardizing injection moulding processes for new and existing moulds. They will qualify moulds, support production commissioning, and establish robust parameters to maintain consistent quality and performance. This role is integral to the success of the Mould Tool Development (MTDM) department and the overall research and development efforts of the company.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct T1, T2, and follow-up mould trials at supplier sites to assess mould functionality and process capability.
  • Qualify new injection moulds at suppliers before dispatch, ensuring they meet quality standards.
  • Execute mould commissioning and validation at production plants, aiming for First Time Right (FTR) performance.
  • Optimize moulding process parameters for repeatability and efficiency.
  • Perform root cause analysis to identify and eliminate moulding defects, ensuring defect-free components.
  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive process documentation, including setting sheets, reports, and SOPs.
  • Coordinate with mould suppliers for trials, process optimization, and timely delivery of moulds.
  • Support cross-functional teams, including Production, Tool Room, Quality, and R&D, for successful mould commissioning.
  • Provide technical support and training to production and tool room teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Plastic, Polymer, or Tool & Die Engineering.
  • 8-12 years of experience in injection moulding process development, mould qualification, and production commissioning.
  • Scientific Injection Moulding certification is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience with injection moulding machines from leading manufacturers.
  • Strong knowledge of plastic material processing (PP, ABS, PC, etc.) and hot/cold runner systems.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and Creo for interpreting engineering drawings and GD&T.
  • Understanding of DFM principles and mould construction.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001/14001/45001 systems and documentation.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication and the ability to collaborate across functional teams.

job.title: Senior Manager
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Manager - Corporate Finance & Controllership is responsible for leading the organization's finance operations, ensuring robust financial governance, regulatory compliance, effective cash management, and accurate financial reporting. The role oversees Accounting, Accounts Payable, Treasury, Direct Taxation, Statutory Audits, Internal Controls, and Internal Audit coordination while partnering closely with cross-functional teams to support business objectives and maintain strong compliance standards.

Responsibilities

Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Lead and oversee all accounting activities ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
  • Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing of books.
  • Review and validate financial statements, reconciliations, and accounting entries.
  • Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes and controls.

Accounts Payable Management

  • Ensure timely verification, approval, and processing of vendor payments.
  • Monitor payable cycles and maintain strong vendor relationships.
  • Ensure adherence to delegation of authority and payment control procedures.
  • Drive efficiencies and automation within the procure-to-pay process.

Treasury & Cash Flow Management

  • Manage working capital, cash flow planning, and liquidity requirements.
  • Monitor banking operations and maintain strong relation with bankers.
  • Ensure timely execution of payments and treasury transactions.
  • Validate EMDs & Bank Guarantee’s as per business requirement.
  • Support EXIM business for compliance and LC related activities where applicable.

Taxation & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee direct tax compliance.
  • Coordinate with external consultants for certifications, Form 15CA/CB.
  • Ensure compliance with all statutory, legal, and regulatory requirements with internal and external team.

Audit Management

  • Lead and coordinate statutory audit activities ensuring timely completion and closure of audit observations.
  • Manage internal audit engagements and facilitate implementation of corrective actions.
  • Act as the primary finance liaison with external auditors and internal audit teams.
  • Monitor audit findings and drive sustainable process improvements.

Internal Controls & Governance

  • Establish and maintain a robust internal control framework.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and financial governance requirements and strong adherence to DOA.
  • Drive a strong control environment with a zero-tolerance approach toward compliance violations.
  • Conduct periodic reviews to identify and address financial and operational risks.

SG&A Analysis & Business Performance Monitoring

  • Prepare and present monthly SG&A expense analysis.
  • Analyze cost variances, spending trends, and key financial performance indicators.
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to management for cost optimization.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead and develop finance teams including plant finance and accounting personnel.
  • Allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance, and support capability development.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor team members and strengthen succession planning within the finance function.

Business Partnering

  • Collaborate closely with operations, procurement, sales, HR, legal, and other functions to support business requirements.
  • Provide financial guidance to stakeholders for strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Participate in business initiatives and transformation projects.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and financial governance requirements.

Managing of Numeric Subsidiary and Gratuity trust account

  • Interacting with Bankers for closure of Lanka Technology along with filing of annual income tax returns.
  • Annual filing of Income Tax return for Numeric Trust accounts.

Qualifications

Chartered Accountant with 8 to 10 years of relevant Experience

job.title: Senior PCB Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

At NEDS, we are looking for a talented and experienced Senior PCB Engineer to join our L7 - IN - NUMERIC - PCB Technical department. As a key member of our team, you will play a vital role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality printed circuit boards (PCBs) for our advanced electrical and digital systems. Your expertise will be instrumental in ensuring the reliability and performance of our products, contributing to our reputation for innovation and excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop PCBs for a variety of electrical and digital systems, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
  • Conduct thorough PCB layout and routing, considering factors such as signal integrity, power distribution, and thermal management.
  • Review and analyze PCB designs, providing constructive feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware and software engineers, to ensure seamless integration of PCBs into the overall system.
  • Stay updated with the latest technologies, industry trends, and best practices in PCB design and manufacturing.
  • Mentor and guide junior PCB engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to PCB functionality, identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
  • Conduct thorough testing and validation of PCBs, ensuring they meet specified requirements and industry standards.
  • Document and maintain accurate records of PCB designs, revisions, and test results for future reference and compliance.
  • Support the production team by providing technical expertise and guidance during PCB assembly and manufacturing processes.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in PCB design, repair, and soldering.
  • Diploma or ITI qualification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • In-depth knowledge of PCB design principles, including schematic capture, layout, and routing.
  • Proficiency in using PCB design software such as Altium, Cadence, or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of electrical and electronic components, circuits, and their interactions.
  • Experience with PCB manufacturing processes, including fabrication, assembly, and testing.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex technical documentation and schematics.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a methodical approach to troubleshooting.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Willingness to stay updated with industry advancements and a commitment to continuous learning.

job.title: AGM - Data Analytics
job.description:
Job Description

Legrand fosters an inclusive, innovative, and diverse environment where individuals can contribute meaningfully.

You will play a pivotal role in enabling Legrand India to become a data-driven, insight-led, and AI-enabled enterprise, shaping the future of our digital and business transformation

Responsibilities

  • Understand the current landscape and framework of Legrand India’s systems and data.

3\. Business Partnering & Decision Support

  • Guide and train the key users from different functional domains in using data analytics.
  • Engage with Business Heads to translate business needs into actionable analytics.
  • Provide data-backed recommendations for GTM strategy, category growth, channel performance, NPI insights, customer segmentation, and revenue growth initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships with global and corporate teams to align tools, models, and standards with Legrand Group’s global analytics direction.

4\. Product & Innovation

  • Drive digitalization of processes with analytics embedded into workflows and decision systems
  • Work closely with Digital Transformation team to build analytics solutions using Fabric and Azure framework.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related fields; MBA preferred.

  • Experience: 5 - 10 years of experience in Data Analytics, BI, or Data Architecture roles.
  • Good understanding of manufacturing, supply chain, and sales analytics; electrical/industrial/FMCG

Experience preferred and will be added advantage :-

  • Hands-on expertise with:
  • Power BI / Tableau
  • SQL, Python/R
  • Cloud platform Azure – most preferred
  • Fabric framework – most preferred
  • Gen AI frameworks (MS/AWS/Google etc) and their use for data analytics and deep diving

job.title: Plugs Assembler I
job.description:
Job Description

At a Glance

Starline – a company of Legrand has an exciting opportunity for an Assembler to join the Data, Power, Control Team in Singapore. The Assemblers manufactures and assembles a variety of configurations of mechanical and basic electrical assemblies used in electrical distribution systems.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

Essential Functions

  • Read shop drawings and wiring diagrams
  • Read Bills of Materials (BOMs) to determine component parts and assembly sequences of electromechanical units
  • Make electrical connections according to specifications
  • Assemble parts, and position, align, and fasten assemblies, subassemblies, using hand tools and power tools.
  • Modify parts by drilling, tapping, countersinking, etc. machine tools, power and pneumatic hand tools.
  • Position, align, and adjust parts for proper fit and assembly.
  • Measure parts to determine tolerances, using tape measures and precision measuring instruments such as micrometers and calipers.
  • Attach labels and mark identifying information on parts.
  • Adhere to all company policies, guidelines and practices including the SECRIT values.

Additional Duties

  • Cross training to work in other functional department of the plant
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Tool selection — determining the kind of tools and equipment needed to do a job.
  • Oral Comprehension – The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
  • Ability to operate cordless hand tools, power tools and pneumatic tools.
  • Ability to read shop drawings and wiring diagrams preferred.
  • Ability to read standard tape measure.
  • Ability to work in a cohesive team environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Level/A Level/ ITE or High School Diploma or equivalent
  • One year of experience in manufacturing preferred

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • Lifting:  Ability to lift and carry up to 75 lbs occasionally; ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs often.
  • Finger Dexterity: The ability to make precisely coordinated movements of the fingers of one or both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble very small objects.
  • Manual Dexterity: The ability to quickly move hand, hand together with arm, or two hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.
  • Arm-Hand Steadiness: The ability to keep hand and arm steady while moving arm or while holding arm and hand in one position.
  • Vision: The ability to see details at a close range and have the ability to tell the difference in the colors of wires.

job.description:
Job Description

A. Trade Marketing & Retail Excellence

  • Partner with Sales to identify high-potential outlets and markets where focused trade interventions can unlock incremental throughput, visibility or premium mix.

B. Experience Centres & Strategic Partner Activation

  • Build and manage an engagement calendar for Legrand’s Experience Centres (Studios/ ZIPs)
  • Improve the overall customer and shopper experience through displays, demonstrations, experiences, launch programs and partner-specific activations.
  • Develop programs that support incremental sales, lead generation, conversion and premiumization
  • Create post-activation measurement frameworks linking activity to sales uplift, leads/funnel movement, conversion and partner performance.

C. Experiential Marketing, BTL & Influencer Engagement

  • Own the BTL and experiential activation calendar across electricians, retailers, architects, dealers and other relevant influencers/decision-makers.
  • Develop concepts and execution frameworks for retailer meets, electrician engagement, product demonstrations, roadshows, consumer experiences, launches and other field activations.
  • Lead end-to-end planning of experiential programs: objective, audience, concept, agency brief, production, logistics, on-ground execution, measurement and post-event learning.
  • Ensure every experience is consistent with Legrand's premium brand standards while remaining relevant to the audience and commercial objective.
  • Build repeatable activation properties and playbooks rather than relying only on one-off events.

D. Events, Exhibitions & Brand Experiences

  • Lead Legrand’s participation in major exhibitions, industry events, customer events
  • Own event objectives and success metrics - visibility, engagement, qualified leads, customer/partner participation, sales opportunity and brand impact - rather than measuring events only on attendance.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, agencies and vendors to ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.
  • Develop post-event reports with learnings, ROI/impact assessment and recommendations for future editions.

E. Agency, Vendor & Budget Management

  • Build and manage a capable ecosystem of regional and national vendors/fabricators/activation agencies to improve speed, quality and scalability of execution.
  • Drive vendor onboarding, rate benchmarking, negotiation, quality control, timelines, service levels and reconciliation.
  • Continuously identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising brand experience or execution quality.
  • Own allocated Trade/BTL/Experiential budgets, ensuring disciplined planning, approvals, utilization and ROI tracking.

F. Data, Measurement & Trade Marketing Dashboard

  • Establish a Trade Marketing dashboard covering deployment, outlet activation, visibility compliance, activation impact, Modern Trade scorecards, competition intelligence and spend.
  • Define simple, decision-oriented KPIs that connect marketing activity with business outcomes such as throughput, incremental sales, counter/shelf share, leads, conversion and premium mix.
  • Use DMS/sales data, retail audits, market intelligence and field feedback to identify opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
  • Institutionalize pre- and post-activity measurement and build a culture of test–learn–scale.

G. Cross-functional Leadership

  • Work closely with Sales, Brand, Product, Commercial, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain and regional teams to convert business priorities into market execution.
  • Act as the bridge between Brand strategy and last-mile execution, ensuring that what is planned centrally is practical, scalable and measurable in-market.

Influence without authority and build strong relationships with sales leaders, channel partners, agencies and Vendors.

job.title: Director User Exp Design
job.description:
Job Description

Honeywell User Experience (HUE) design studios lead the creation of next-generation experiences for the connected world. Leveraging well-established human-centered design principles, HUE ensures that Honeywell products and applications are the most useful, usable, and desirable in the marketplace. The studios operate globally across North America, Europe, China, and Australia, fostering a collegial,

ROLE OVERVIEW

The PA HUE Leader at HTCS is a senior design executive responsible for two interconnected capabilities: (1) leading the HUE Design Studio for the Process Automation (PA) business, driving the UX vision, strategy, and delivery aligned with the PA SBG and GBE leadership; and (2) overseeing the Technical Writer team, ensuring that product knowledge is translated into accurate, user-centered documentation that enhances the overall customer experience.

This dual mandate positions the PA HUE Leader as a key steward of both visual-interactive experience design and content-driven experience design — recognizing that great products must be equally well-designed and well-documented.

Responsibilities

SCOPE OF LEADERSHIP

A. HUE Design Studio — Process Automation

Lead a growing, multidisciplinary team of User Experience designers delivering next-generation, delightful solutions across the PA product portfolio. Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing design capability and infrastructure aligned with PA business strategy.
  • Recruiting, developing, and managing UX design talent; managing resources and operational plans.
  • Overseeing multidisciplinary competencies: design research, experience design, interaction design, visual design, and industrial design.
  • Driving 2–3 high-impact, innovative offerings based on a UX-led approach.
  • Delivering design projects on time to support business growth and enhance product value.
  • Collaborating with PA Global Experience Design teams to implement a design strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Contributing to HUE best practices for User Experience Design throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Participating as a decision-maker at project reviews; providing a clear, consistent UX perspective to teams and stakeholders.
  • Creating and executing human-centered designs that differentiate Honeywell brands globally.
  • Applying, building, and evolving the Honeywell Design Language System (DLS) and brand identity program.
  • Contributing to management updates, operational reviews, and leadership dialogue at HUE Global Leadership and HTS India Leadership.
  • Collaborating with all Honeywell functions that interact with customers to deliver end-to-end journey alignment.
  • Establishing a framework for regular usability testing with dedicated UX researchers embedded across studios.
  • Overseeing co-creation workshops with end users to inform new product and service development.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve data visualization and interpretability through design.
  • Promoting a holistic, end-to-end user experience strategy across all product touchpoints.
  • Championing system thinking and storytelling techniques to align product vision with user needs.

B. Technical Writer Team — Documentation & Content Experience

Provide leadership and strategic direction to the Technical Writer team, ensuring product documentation is accurate, structured, and user-centered. This team is integral to the customer experience and works at the intersection of product knowledge and communication design. Key responsibilities include:

  • Overseeing end-to-end documentation for products and programs, covering user guides, installation manuals, administrator guides, and troubleshooting references.
  • Directing the development of feature walkthroughs, process flow documentation, and security white papers.
  • Ensuring the team effectively uses MadCap Flare to produce high-quality HTML and PDF documentation.
  • Guiding the creation of HTML-based user assistant files that enhance in-product guidance.
  • Building and managing a structured review and feedback cycle with key stakeholders — developers, testing teams, program managers, installation teams, and security teams.
  • Embedding technical writing quality standards focused on content accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
  • Aligning documentation strategy with the broader UX and product experience roadmap, ensuring parity between product design intent and user-facing documentation.
  • Fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the technical writing function, including upskilling in structured authoring and content design principles.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) from an institute of repute in Design, Human Factors, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 12 or more years of experience in User Experience design of products and software applications.
  • Demonstrated experience in a senior design leadership role, managing multidisciplinary teams including UX designers, researchers, and/or technical writers.
  • Experience working in Agile environments with lean UX methodologies.
  • International experience working with regional businesses and geographically distributed design teams.
  • Proven track record of delivering innovative, market-released UX design solutions; portfolio required.
  • Experience directing and managing external design and development firms.
  • Exposure to or direct experience overseeing technical documentation functions is an advantage.

Design & Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in UX design tools: Figma, prototyping platforms, interaction and visual design toolsets.
  • Deep understanding of Design Language Systems and brand identity programs.
  • Ability to create low-fidelity to high-fidelity prototypes across the design lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated research skills across qualitative and quantitative methods.
  • Familiarity with technical documentation platforms (e.g., MadCap Flare, HTML/PDF publishing pipelines) is desirable.
  • Understanding of structured content principles, single-source publishing, and content strategy.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Ability to translate complex vision into understandable concepts and workable design narratives.
  • Strong ability to influence product, software, hardware, and development teams during early-stage development.

Required Skills

  • B.Des, M.Des
  • Team handling
  • UX design
  • Ux Research

job.title: Manager, Physical Security Enablement - Singapore - Mascot
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Manager, Physical Security Enablement to lead the successful delivery and integration of physical security programs across new data centre developments, expansions and major customer initiatives throughout Asia-Pacific.

Reporting into the regional leadership team, this role combines program leadership, physical security expertise and stakeholder management to ensure security systems, processes and vendors are aligned throughout the design, construction, installation, commissioning and handover phases of our projects.

This is a highly visible regional role supporting construction and expansion projects across Asia, requiring regular travel sites. Candidates who enjoy working in dynamic environments, influencing cross-functional teams and seeing projects come to life from concept through to operational handover will thrive in this position.

Regular travel throughout Asia should be expected, including visits during design validation, installation, commissioning, operational readiness and handover phases. The successful candidate should enjoy being on-site and working directly with project teams, stakeholders and vendors to drive successful outcomes.

Responsibilities

Physical Security Program Enablement

  • Lead the deployment and integration of physical security programs across new data centre builds and expansion projects throughout Asia-Pacific
  • Partner closely with Global Design & Construction (GDC), Data Centre Operations and Security Program teams to ensure security requirements are successfully incorporated into project delivery
  • Support security readiness activities during design, construction, installation, commissioning and operational handover
  • Identify and mitigate physical security risks throughout the project lifecycle
  • Drive consistency and standardisation of physical security practices across the region

Project & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead multiple concurrent security enablement initiatives across geographically dispersed locations
  • Partner with internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants and vendors to ensure successful project outcomes
  • Provide guidance and leadership to regional security teams supporting active project sites

Security Systems & Technical Oversight

  • Manage security vendor relationships responsible for hardware installation, upgrades, maintenance and support
  • Lead SPOF (Single Point of Failure) and End-of-Life (EOL) assessments and remediation initiatives
  • Support issue resolution, root cause analysis and vendor escalation for complex technical security challenges

People Leadership

  • Lead and develop a small regional team, and own performance management with direct reports currently based in Singapore
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement
  • Provide coaching, mentoring and guidance to security professionals supporting regional programs and projects

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience leading physical security programs, projects or operations within a data centre, mission-critical, hyperscale, telecommunications, infrastructure or high-security environment
  • Experience supporting large-scale construction, commissioning, fit-out or infrastructure projects
  • Strong stakeholder management capabilities across engineering, construction, operations and vendor organisations
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of physical security systems and their deployment within operational environments
  • Experience supporting new builds, expansions and commissioning activities
  • Experience working with security systems integrators, consultants and technology vendors
  • Understanding of project lifecycle delivery from design through operational handover
  • Experience working within highly regulated, operationally critical or customer-facing environments
  • Knowledge of business continuity, security governance and risk management practices

job.title: Vice President, Portfolio Management
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Overview

The VP will serve a dual mandate — driving portfolio management excellence across Keppel’s private data centre funds, while acting as a product specialist and capital formation partner. The role sits at the intersection of portfolio management, investor relations, and product development, requiring a commercially astute individual who can credibly engage both institutional investors and internal investment teams.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Management & Fund Oversight

  • Develop and execute portfolio strategy, business plans, and annual budgets in alignment with the fund's mandate and investment guidelines.
  • Maintain centralized oversight of the private data centre funds, encompassing capital allocation, compliance with investment restrictions, performance monitoring, and adherence to governance frameworks.
  • Actively manage fund liquidity, control fund-level expenses, and implement strategies to optimize investor distributions and risk-adjusted returns.
  • Build, own, and continuously maintain life-of-fund financial models, ensuring integrity of projections, cash flow forecasting, and scenario analysis.
  • Produce rigorous fund-level performance metrics, investor reporting, and returns benchmarking against relevant private real estate, infrastructure, and data centre peer universes.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for existing investors of the Funds, to respond to their queries

Investment & Asset Management Support

  • Participate actively in the investment process — including evaluation of acquisition and divestment opportunities — by providing portfolio-level context, capital allocation perspectives, and investor return considerations.
  • Collaborate with asset management teams to monitor business plan execution across portfolio assets, escalating risks and opportunities as appropriate.
  • Contribute the portfolio and investor lens to investment committee deliberations, ensuring deal-level decisions are evaluated within the context of overall fund construction and mandate constraints.

Product Specialist / Capital Raising

  • Act as a product specialist for the data centre fund strategy in investor meetings
  • Working as part of a team to support end-to-end capital raising activities, including contributing to the development of marketing materials, pitchbooks, DDQs, RFP responses, and fund terms documentation.
  • Provide substantive responses on fund strategy, portfolio construction, performance attribution, and risk management.
  • Partner with structuring teams on the design and launch of new fund products and co-investment vehicles, ensuring alignment with market demand and investor preferences.
  • Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with a broad institutional investor base including sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurance companies, family offices, and fund-of-funds.

Market Intelligence & Thought Leadership

  • Monitor and synthesize competitive intelligence across private real estate, digital infrastructure, and data centre investment markets, tracking trends in capital flows, fund structures, pricing, and investor sentiment.
  • Produce thematic content to support fundraising narratives, investor communications, and strategic planning.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Pre-requisites:

  • Masters / Degree in Finance / Business Administration from leading university
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience with private real estate / infrastructure funds in investment or asset management role with broad knowledge and extensive networks in the private infrastructure/ real estate markets for the Asia Pacific region.
  • Commercially astute, and possess sharp analytical, research, problem solving skills and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead investor discussions; Proven track record in dealing with international institutional investors will be viewed favorably.
  • A self-motivated team player who is meticulous, detailed oriented, organized and able to learn quickly and independently
  • Proficient with financial modelling, market and industry research in infrastructure, real estate or other private equity assets;
  • A strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management skill and ability to interact well with different functions and levels.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in fast pace dynamic environment

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Connectivity

PLATFORM

Fund Management

job.title: Software Development Manager, Software Development
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Come and be part of the AWS Supply Chain team and build systems that enable AWS to rapidly grow and continue to be the pioneer and widely recognized leader in Cloud Computing, and have direct and immediate impact on the hundreds of thousands developers and businesses around the world who use AWS every day.

Supply Chain Management (AWS_SCM) systems are at heart of ensuring that we can provide our customers with the right computing services, in the right region, at the right time! The SC.os team is responsible for building the end-to-end supply chain automation that enable control of our global footprint for our hyper-growth cloud computing.

Key job responsibilities

  • As a technical leader on the team, you will be responsible guiding your team through the design, development, testing, and deployment of a range of products.
  • In addition, you will help build the roadmaps for software teams, developing innovative customer experiences.
  • We are looking for an experienced technical manager who is excited about building industry leading distributed systems in the Supply Chain domain.
  • You will be part of the team that architects, designs, and implements highly scalable distributed systems that provide availability, scalability and latency guarantees.
  • This is a hands on technology position. You need to not only be a top software manager with a good track record of delivering, but also excel in communication, leadership and customer focus.
  • This is a unique and rare opportunity to get in on the ground floor and help shape the supply chain software, product and business.
  • A successful candidate will bring deep technical and software expertise and ability to work within a fast moving, startup environment in a large company to deliver solid code that has a broad business impact.

job.title: Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support New Zealand
job.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

You'll craft and execute strategies to drive customer adoption and use of AWS services while providing expert guidance on architecture, support strategies, project planning, and operational excellence.

Working with some of the most iconic businesses in the country you'll provide technical leadership and consultative expertise across the customer lifecycle. This role offers opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills while solving challenging problems in cloud adoption migration and optimization. job.description:

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • O2C Process Configuration: Configure and maintain Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes such as credit management, billing, collections, and accounts receivable within the Central Finance (CFIN) system, ensuring alignment with business needs and industry best practices. Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders and process owners to thoroughly understand their requirements, document functional specifications, and translate these into system configurations.
  • System Integration: Facilitate seamless integration of O2C processes within the CFIN system, as well as with other enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, etc.), ensuring smooth data flow and automation of processes across platforms. User Support & Training: Provide ongoing functional support to end-users, addressing issues, offering solutions, and conducting training to ensure optimal utilization of the system and full understanding of O2C processes.

Process Optimization: Regularly monitor and evaluate O2C processes to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and best practice implementation within the CFIN system.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for O2C system configurations, process flows, and integration points, ensuring compliance with internal standards and regulatory guidelines. Collaboration with Technical Teams: Work closely with IS architects, developers, and technical teams to ensure that functional requirements are correctly implemented and aligned with system design specifications.
  • Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution: Provide expert troubleshooting support for O2C-related system issues, working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to resolve any challenges promptly. Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about the latest industry trends, best practices, and system updates to continuously enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of O2C processes within CFIN.
  • Project and New Demand Management: Take ownership of configuring new demands or changes in system functionality, ensuring proper alignment with system design documentation and business requirements. O2C-Related Data Management: Oversee the management and accuracy of O2C-related data within the system, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with business rules across all O2C processes.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in O2C SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture. Proven experience (5+ years) in O2C process management, with a strong background in system configuration and implementation within SAP or similar ERP environments (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN).
  • Strong functional knowledge of Order-to-Cash processes, including order management, credit management, billing, collections, and accounts receivable. Experience in configuring O2C processes in SAP or similar ERP systems, with a solid understanding of integration points and data flows across systems. Familiarity with Central Finance (CFIN) and integration with other finance-related modules.
  • Experience with requirements gathering, business analysis, and documentation of functional specifications. High level understanding on Credit Management & Integration process between source & CFIN High level Down Payment concepts, Industry solution for Project Cash flow, Provisioning based on global rule sets, Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and technical teams. A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems. Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
