job.title: R&D Domain Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Manager ###

What We Believe In

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, quality control solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.

Your Role and Responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for an R&D Engineer – System 800xA & Quality Control System (QCS) to join our Process Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the validation, testing, and lifecycle support of ABB System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions, ensuring high-quality, reliable, and secure industrial automation software for the Pulp & Paper industry.

Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies, perform end-to-end system integration testing, and collaborate with Product Management, Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to deliver robust automation solutions while driving continuous quality improvements.

This role is contributing to the Process Industries – System 800xA & QCS Research & Development organization in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

##

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies for System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions by performing functional, integration, regression, system, cybersecurity, and end-to-end testing to ensure product quality, reliability, and compliance with ABB engineering standards.
  • Validate industrial automation solutions by testing DCS integrations, QCS control strategies, process parameters, alarm management, historical data, industrial communication, and overall system performance across diverse operating scenarios.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Software Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to manage defect lifecycles, support release readiness, participate in Agile ceremonies, and deliver high-quality software using modern testing methodologies, Azure DevOps, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
  • Drive engineering excellence by developing test automation frameworks, improving validation processes, mentoring team members, maintaining technical documentation, supporting customer demonstrations, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications for the Role

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5–10 years of experience in software testing or validation for Industrial Automation, DCS, PLC, SCADA, or Quality Control Systems, with hands-on experience in ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, and Control Builder M.
  • Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies including functional, system, integration, regression, simulation, and end-to-end validation, along with experience using Azure DevOps, Git/TFS, and test automation frameworks.
  • Experience with Quality Control Systems (QCS), DCS integration, industrial process control, and Pulp & Paper applications is preferred, with knowledge of IEC 61131-3 programming and industrial automation architectures.
  • Understanding of Industrial Cybersecurity (IEC 62443), automated testing practices, AI-assisted testing tools, and Agile software development methodologies is considered an advantage.
  • Professional certifications such as ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent testing certifications are preferred.
  • Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional global teams and drive continuous quality improvement initiatives.

##

More About Us

ABB's Process Industries business serves customers across mining, minerals, metals, cement, pulp & paper, battery manufacturing, food & beverage, and other industrial sectors by delivering integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that improve productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability.

Our R&D organization develops next-generation industrial automation software, distributed control systems, Quality Control Systems (QCS), cloud-enabled digital platforms, and intelligent engineering solutions that help customers optimize manufacturing processes and accelerate digital transformation. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced automation technologies, ABB continues to shape the future of industrial operations.

At ABB, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams to build world-class automation and quality control solutions while advancing your expertise in industrial software, system validation, digital engineering, and AI-assisted testing. We foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion where every individual is empowered to make a meaningful impact.

ABB is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. Employment is subject to applicable background verification and pre-employment screening in accordance with ABB policies.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Sales Support Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Support Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities:

This is a 'Sales Support Specialist - Electrification' role in Process Industries Division. In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (Process Industries division) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your technical skill by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Onsite

This role is contributing to the Automation – Process Industries business. Main stakeholders are customers, EPCs/consultants, sales and engineering teams, product management, and project execution functions.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Delivering technical consultation and optimized electrification solutions by analyzing customer requirements, reviewing specifications, and defining clear scopes with transparent cost and responsibility mapping.
  • Preparing comprehensive techno-commercial proposals including bill of quantities, cost estimation, and competitive bid strategies while identifying and managing commercial, technical, and contractual risks.
  • Collaborating with engineering, service, vendors, and product units to develop value-driven proposals and support sales growth through technical presentations, workshops, and customer problem resolution.
  • Driving customer engagement and pre-sales activities to acquire orders, improve profitability, and achieve key performance metrics including order intake, Net Price Variance (NPV), and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Ensuring achievement of business objectives including revenue growth, volume targets, and profitable expansion across assigned product portfolios, industries, and geographic markets.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputed university or institution.
  • 10-18 years of experience in technical sales, bids & proposals, engineering, or solution development for large-scale electrification projects across Mining, Metals, Cement, Paper, and other process industries.
  • Extensive expertise in Electrical Power Distribution Systems, including HV Substations (AIS & GIS), MV & LT Switchgear, Intelligent MCCs, Transformers, Busducts, Battery Chargers, Cable Management Systems, and associated electrical infrastructure.
  • Extensive knowledge of motor and drive sizing, selection, and application engineering for process industry requirements, particularly in mining equipment, metals processing plants, profile mills, cement plants, and paper manufacturing facilities.
  • Hands-on experience in preparing techno-commercial proposals, solution engineering, and customer-facing technical discussions, supported by strong written and verbal communication skills with fluency in English.
  • Proficiency in electrical system studies and engineering tools such as ETAP, with additional experience in E-house solutions, substation automation systems, and integrated electrification solutions considered a strong advantage.

More about us:

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do:

Acts as on-site project leader to plan, execute, and complete assigned projects. Delegates tasks to execute and fully complete assigned projects. Coordinates communication with customer during all phases of the project. Coordinates the work of subcontractors.

How you will do it:

  • Define scope, budget and schedule for projects
  • Device project implementation methodology
  • Plan and oversee work schedule for the multiple small to medium scale project under responsibility, in coordination with supervisor.
  • Identify potential project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions
  • Establish effective communication with customer
  • Track and update progress, task and project health to supervisors
  • Ensure and monitor compliance to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards and specifications.
  • Perform regular quality audit for all the suppliers and sub-contractors.
  • Identify and secure variation order.
  • Cost control. Track, monitor and ensure delivery of financial commitment as per CIS.
  • Managing reports and documents
  • Work closely with Sales team for tender bidding
  • Supervision of sub-contractors’ work at site.
  • Schedule purchase and deliveries of all materials for the project in a timely manner
  • Assign task to, and supervise Assistant Project Engineer, Technician, if any.
  • System applications, drafting, data base generation and commissioning
  • Follow-up on payment from customers and verify payment to our suppliers.
  • Train customer and provide first year maintenance warranty schedule visit.
  • Hand over project to customer and later to service team.

What we look for:

  • Degree with minimum 8 years relevant experience in BMS System
  • Excel, Word and Project essential
  • 2 years of supervisory experience
  • Require interaction with clients, consultants and sub-contractors, etc.
  • Need to work odd hours as and when required, whenever the work need to be done on time.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Senior Application Engineer (Electronic Security Systems)
job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do:

In this role, you will handle the engineering, configuration, integration, testing, and technical implementation of security solutions from design through commissioning. You will work closely with project managers, technical managers, construction teams, commissioning engineers, clients, and third-party vendors to deliver integrated systems that meet project specifications, client requirements, and industry standards.

How you will do it:

  • Prepare and provide technical documentation, including shop drawings, as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, and programming matrices.
  • Develop and review system architecture, security system designs, device schedules, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure correct specifications and material orders are aligned with project requirements.
  • Ascertain design needs and help develop project scope and specifications.
  • Collaborate with customers, SM/PM, and relevant stakeholders to monitor work progress and support expedited installation.
  • Perform inspection, setup, testing, and commissioning of electronic security system installations, including Access Control, CCTV, Intrusion Alarm, Intercoms/Public Address, and Electronic Lock and keys.
  • Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), pre-commissioning activities, and troubleshooting.
  • Identify and resolve system configuration issues, software-related issues, integration challenges, and technical queries.
  • Promote and practice health and safety policies and procedures throughout project operations and client contracts.
  • Carry out and encourage proactive customer relations.
  • Provide on-site placement when needed.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree from a reputable university in Electronics, Computer & Science, Instrumentations, or Industrial Engineering.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in installation, configuration, or servicing of Lenel OnGuard, CCURE 9000, AMAG, BVMS, Interlogix, PIDS, DSC, Kantech, or HID.
  • Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Software House, LenelS2, Gallagher, Genetec, Milestone, Senstar, and Traka.
  • English proficiency in reading, writing, and conversation.
  • Computer literacy and networking knowledge, including MS Windows, Linux, Office, LAN, and Fiber Optic.
  • Experience in civil and electrical construction works.
  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate with vendors and make decisions using industry-standard knowledge.
  • One or more certifications in Lenel OnGuard, CCURE 9000, AMAG, or BVMS.
  • Experience with AutoCAD or Revu BlueBeam.
  • Ability to provide technical assistance as needed to related parties.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Service Team Manager (HVAC & Chillers) - Brisbane Relocation Opportunity
job.description:
Build Your Future with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the environments where people live, work, learn, and thrive. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers optimize energy performance, reduce carbon emissions, and deliver resilient operations across critical industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry leadership, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, lifecycle services, and an unrivalled field service network to help customers achieve exceptional results while creating a more sustainable future.

Ready for a Lifestyle Change?

If you're an experienced HVAC, Refrigeration, or Chiller Services leader currently based elsewhere in Australia and looking for your next challenge, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

Join our Brisbane leadership team and enjoy the benefits of living and working in Queensland, including a warm climate, affordable lifestyle, excellent schools, and easy access to some of Australia's most iconic beaches and outdoor destinations.

We welcome applications from experienced professionals across Australia who are open to relocating to Brisbane for the right career opportunity.

About the Opportunity

An exciting leadership opportunity has become available for an experienced Service Team Manager to lead our Brisbane Chiller Services team.

In this pivotal role, you will oversee day-to-day service delivery operations, leading a team of highly skilled technicians, apprentices, and a Service Delivery Manager. You'll play a key role in driving operational excellence, developing talent, strengthening customer relationships, and growing our service and maintenance portfolio across Queensland.

This position is ideal for a proven HVAC or Chiller industry leader who enjoys being close to the business, supporting teams in the field, and delivering outstanding outcomes for customers.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing service team to achieve operational and financial objectives.
  • Drive operational excellence across the Chiller Service business.
  • Manage service delivery performance, maintenance schedules, contract execution, and budget outcomes.
  • Review customer accounts to identify opportunities for growth, profitability, and enhanced service delivery.
  • Oversee backlog management, estimating activities, contract renewals, and onboarding processes.
  • Manage workforce planning, technician utilisation, labour forecasting, and materials allocation.
  • Support the ongoing development of technicians through coaching, mentoring, training, and performance management.
  • Lead recruitment and onboarding initiatives to build a strong and capable team.
  • Partner directly with customers and attend site visits to ensure exceptional service delivery and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated leadership experience within the HVAC, Refrigeration, or Chiller industry.
  • Strong technical understanding of Chiller systems, with Controls experience highly regarded.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, drive performance, and deliver operational results.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong commercial acumen, planning, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Exceptional organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a focus on safety, quality, and customer outcomes.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Lead an established and growing service business in Brisbane.
  • Opportunity to relocate and build your career in one of Australia's fastest-growing regions.
  • Career development opportunities within a global industry leader.
  • Access to world-class training, leadership development, and technical expertise.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Competitive remuneration package and employee benefits.
  • Opportunity to contribute to innovative and sustainable solutions that make a real impact.

Eligibility

This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Australia with full, unrestricted Australian working rights.

Successful candidates will be required to complete pre-employment checks, including a medical assessment, criminal history check, and drug and alcohol screening.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're an experienced HVAC or Chiller leader ready to take the next step in your career and relocate to Brisbane for an exciting leadership opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of sustainable building solutions with Johnson Controls.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, diversity and inclusion are fundamental to who we are. We foster a culture where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives. Together, we create an inclusive environment that drives innovation, strengthens our teams, and helps us deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and communities.

You have the opportunity. You have the voice. You belong at Johnson Controls.

job.title: Lead Application Engineer I
job.description:
What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Security System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Security System (Access, Video, Intrusion , Complete ELV system etc)
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Security System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Security Systems (Access, Video, Intrusion , Complete ELV system etc)
  • Expertise in Security Guidelines.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.) , Blue Beam
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols.
  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

9+ years of relevant experience in Security System.

job.title: Application Engineer- Presales Chiller
job.description:
Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

Provide technical product application support ( mech plus electrical knowledge) to sales teams in pursuit of air cooled chiller equipment sales opportunities in the India Market, to power our customer’s mission by utilizing the right equipment for the application. Successful application engineering support will accomplish team mission through three key avenues.

How you will do it

Application and Special Quotation Support

  • Respond to field sales inquiries related to Chiller / Heat pump application/technical/manufacturing capabilities in connection with product specifications
  • Identify and guide field sales toward solutions necessary to meet customer requirements
  • Support projects with requirements of several products and optimize the final scope of supply
  • Review and evaluate special options requirements and support SQ (Special Quote) needs by providing cost and lead time estimates

Requires development of subcomponent specifications, supplier engagement and negotiation, and analysis of factory manufacturing capability

Expert Solutions

  • Support field sales on technical clarifications with customers, potentially requiring direct engagement with customers
  • Guide field sales and key customers on system design approaches and enhance competitive advantage by specifying tailored equipment packages. Expert solutions will balance chiller performances with sub-system components and features
  • Align field support with knowledge of chiller products available in the market, and with regional product strategy
  • Define specifications for chillers and sub-systems in support of project opportunities

Product & Product Applications Development

  • Monitor and analyze frequent questions, requests and pitfalls to identify new applications, develop new special quotation offerings, and guide global product teams.
  • Provide necessary material for literature applications, product presentations, and training materials
  • Collect and offer constructive feedback to global product teams on resources, tools and documentation available to field sales and customers
  • Deliver training presentations on product changes and new products to field sales and key customers
  • Engagement in industry organizations and technical seminars
  • Monitor and offer formal comment on product/application relevant codes and standards

What we look for

BE/ Btech - Mechanical or Electrical and minimum 3 years of HVAC or refrigeration related experience in application engineering, product engineering or technical marketing is required.

Demonstrated business management skills in product application environment preferred

Technically savvy, possessing strong knowledge of application and field practices related to air cooled chillers

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite Applications

Strong verbal and written English skills

job.title: Senior Manager CFS Industrial Sales
job.description:
Who we are: -

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

job.title: Site Reliability Engineer, AI Infrastructure
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why you’ll love working here

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work.

Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

Firmus Technologies is seeking a skilled Site Reliability Engineer, AI Infrastructure to join our Operations team, supporting the daily operations and maintenance of our AI-accelerated high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure. This role will work closely with Field Service Engineers, HPC and Network Engineering teams, and assist the Global Operations Centre (GOC). This is a unique opportunity to contribute directly to the stability and growth of cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support in the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of various high-end GPU servers, storage servers, networking equipment and software components in highly secure environments.
  • Perform hardware diagnostics, systems functionality and firmware updates as required.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to assist in tailored customer environments deployment (eg: bare-metal systems, HPC Clusters, Kubernetes, Slurm etc).
  • Serve as first line of engineering support for onsite operational issues, including troubleshooting hardware, network and software problems, and firmware compliance.
  • Troubleshoot incidents, escalate critical issues and provide feedback to appropriate teams for improvements.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure 24/7 availability and responsiveness to critical issues.
  • Provide technical support to the GOC Support Specialist team in troubleshooting compute infrastructure related problems.
  • Document incident details, resolutions, and lessons learned to enhance future problem-solving.
  • Maintain clear, accurate, and up-to-date documentation to promote effective knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Communicate effectively with GOC, HPC Engineers, internal teams, stakeholders, and end-users to ensure alignment on issue resolution.
  • Take part in team meetings and knowledge-sharing sessions to foster collaboration and continuous learning.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in field service technical areas.
  • Strong understanding of server hardware technology, firmware lifecycle, Linux environments and troubleshooting hardware problems, with adherence to physical and system-level security standards.
  • Experience with scripting languages (eg: Bash, Python)
  • Familiarity with using configuration management, CICD tools, workload manager and cluster softwares (eg: Slurm, Kubernetes, Nvidia BCM) and Observability tools (eg: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc)
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Location

This role is based in Brooklyn, Melbourne, Australia.

Employment Basis

Full-time

job.title: Advanced Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Mathematical Formulation: Translate ambiguous business problems into mathematically sound framework objectives and optimisation targets.
  • Production-Grade Engineering: Write clean, modular, and maintainable code using production-level design patterns to scale mathematical models.
  • Big Data Processing: Design and manage scalable data pipelines to process massive datasets efficiently for model training and inference.
  • Deep Learning & Vision Development: Build, train, and fine-tune complex neural networks across text, audio, and visual modalities.
  • Cloud Deployment: Architect and deploy models to cloud environments, leveraging distributed computing and robust cloud infrastructure.

Required Technical Skills & Competencies

1\. Tooling, Libraries & Software Engineering

  • Core Language: Advanced proficiency in Python with a strict adherence to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, clean coding standards, and design patterns.
  • Machine Learning Libraries: Advanced proficiency in scikit-learn (sklearn) for data preprocessing, feature engineering, and baseline modelling.
  • Deep Learning Frameworks: Core expertise in PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow for building, customizing, and training deep neural networks from scratch.
  • Big Data Ecosystem: Experience with Apache Spark (PySpark) and the Hadoop Ecosystem (HDFS, Hive, MapReduce) for handling, transforming, and querying large-scale distributed datasets.
  • Cloud Architecture: Experience building and deploying scalable machine learning applications on major cloud platforms ( AWS, Azure, or GCP).

2\. Core Mathematics & First-Principles ML

  • Foundational Math: Solid foundation in Linear Algebra (eigenvalues, SVD, matrix decompositions), Multivariable Calculus (partial derivatives, gradients, Jacobians), and Probability Theory (Bayesian inference, probability distributions, expectation maximization).
  • Machine Learning: In-depth understanding of standard Machine Learning algorithms (Trees, Boosting, SVMs, GMMs) with the ability to explain the underlying loss functions and optimizations mathematically.
  • Deep Foundations: Thorough understanding of Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs), mathematical derivation of backpropagation, hyperparameter initialization strategies (Xavier, He), optimization variants (Adam, RMSProp), and advanced regularization techniques (L1/L2, Dropout, Batch Normalization).

3\. Advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP)

  • Sequential Networks: Hands-on experience with sequence modeling, including Word Embeddings (Word2Vec, FastText), RNNs, LSTMs, and GRUs.
  • Transformer Ecosystem: Deep structural knowledge of the Transformer architecture (Self-Attention math, Multi-Head mechanisms).
  • Pre-trained NLP Models: Experience implementing and fine-tuning encoder-only (BERT, RoBERTa) and decoder-only (GPT series) architectures.

4\. Computer Vision (CV) & Document AI

  • Spatial Networks: Deep understanding of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), feature map mathematics, pooling operations, and advanced CV backbones.
  • OCR & Document Processing: Proven track record building or customizing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) systems for complex text extraction pipelines.
  • Vision Transformers: Familiarity with the adaptation of attention mechanics to visual tasks (ViTs, Swin Transformers).

Education & Experience

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s, Master's, or Ph.D. in a highly quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Physics, or Operations Research).
  • Experience: 4 to 6 years of industry experience working as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer with a portfolio of complex multimodal projects.

job.title: Sr Advanced Software Engr
job.description:
Job Description

As a Sr IT Analyst here at Honeywell, you will lead complex, high-impact IT projects, using your expertise to provide guidance on IT strategy and drive data-informed decision-making. Your responsibilities will involve analyzing intricate IT systems, identifying areas for improvement and innovation, and offering solutions to address business challenges. By staying current with emerging IT trends and technologies, you will directly contribute to the organization's technology roadmap. Your work as a Sr IT Analyst will not only enhance operational efficiency but also maintain our competitive edge and position as a global technology leader.

In this role, you will be instrumental in driving the organization's technology strategies and projects, aligning them with business objectives. Your expertise will lead to data-informed decision-making, enhancing operational efficiency, and contributing to the organization's technology roadmap. By analyzing complex IT systems and offering innovative solutions, you will play a key role in shaping the future of technology at Honeywell. Join us in this influential position, and be a driving force behind technological excellence, innovation, and the organization's continued leadership in the global technology landscape.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the analysis, design, and implementation of business systems
  • Gather and document business requirements from stakeholders
  • Collaborate with crossfunctional teams to develop technology solutions
  • Perform system testing and ensure quality assurance
  • Provide technical guidance and support to the team

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of experience in IT analysis, project leadership, or related roles.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies and industry trends.

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant industry certifications.
  • Experience with project management methodologies.
  • Innovation-driven mindset.
  • Ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
  • Passion for staying at the forefront of IT trends.
  • Demonstrated leadership in technology innovation and process improvement.
  • Strong research and presentation skills.

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilledData Specialist (Senior Data Engineer)join our Financial Systems Tech Support -CAT IT Division

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a good foundation in data engineering principles, a keen analytical mindset, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. As a Junior Data Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and infrastructure to support our organization's data needs.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

What you will do

Data Pipeline Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store large volumes of data from various sources.
  • Implement data workflows using ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure data quality and integrity.

Data Integration and Management

  • Collaborate with data architects, product owners, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver data solutions that meet their needs.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, into a unified data platform.
  • Manage and optimize data storage solutions, ensuring efficient data retrieval and processing.

Data Quality and Governance

  • Implement data quality checks and validation processes to ensure the accuracy and consistency of data.
  • Adhere to data governance policies and best practices to maintain data security and compliance.

Performance Optimization

  • Monitor and optimize data pipeline performance to ensure timely and efficient data processing.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and system issues to maintain data pipeline reliability.

Documentation and Collaboration

  • Document data engineering processes, workflows, and solutions for future reference and knowledge sharing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making and project initiatives.

What you will have

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, or software development.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience on advanced SQL any Database. (Oracle, Teradata, snowflake).
  • Experience in data integration area and hands on experience in any of the ETL tools like Datastage , Informatica , Snaplogic etc.
  • Able to transform technical requirements into data collection query.
  • Should be capable of working with business and other IT teams and convert the requirements into queries.
  • Good understanding of ETL architecture and design.
  • Good knowledge in Databases, SQL, or PL/SQL
  • Good experience with CI/CD tools such as Github Actions (AzDO pipelines)
  • Good to have knowledge on Unix commands
  • Good to have an experience on AWS Glue
  • Good to have knowledge on Qlik replication tool
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.
  • Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST

Soft Skills

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment.
  • Eagerness to learn new technologies and stay updated with industry trends.

Skills desired:

Value Realization: Knowledge of value realization methods; ability to plan, execute, monitor and manage business activities and resources to determine and achieve the actual value from a business initiative as estimated in an associated business case.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes the importance of Value Realization milestones for long-term projects.
  • Assists in measuring and attaining post-project implementation value.
  • Identifies process changes or business value integration in change initiative plans and activities.
  • Contributes to project team communication regarding the linkage of a change initiative to its associated business goals and case.

Communicating Complex Concepts: Knowledge of effective presentation tools and techniques to ensure clear understanding; ability to use summarization and simplification techniques to explain complex technical concepts in simple, clear language appropriate to the audience.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Uses comparisons to familiar ideas when introducing a technical or novel feature.
  • Separates fundamental concepts from supporting details in explaining a product or service.
  • Explains products and services with little or no use of technical jargon or advanced vocabulary.
  • Emphasizes the most important facts or features of a product or service.
  • Perceives lack of audience comprehension; further simplifies explanation when needed.

Agile Development: Knowledge of agile methodologies and the agile development lifecycle; ability to utilize formal agile methodologies, disciplines, practices and techniques for the delivery of new and enhanced applications.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Explains a specific agile process and its associated checkpoints and deliverables.
  • Works with a specific agile development methodology.
  • Interprets metrics used to measure progress and effectiveness.
  • Defines key selection and qualifying criteria for projects suitable for agile development.
  • Applies major tools and techniques associated with the specific methodology.

Cloud Computing: Knowledge of cloud-based solutions and their applications; ability to design, implement, and manage cloud-based solutions to meet business needs and improve operational efficiency.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Designs and implements a cloud-based solution to meet a specific business need or requirement.
  • Configures and deploys cloud-based infrastructure, such as virtual machines, storage, and networks.
  • Migrates applications and data to a cloud-based environment, including data migration and integration.
  • Implements cloud-based security measures, such as access controls, encryption, and firewalls.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves common cloud-based issues, such as connectivity problems and performance degradation.

Database Design (Physical): Knowledge of database systems; ability to establish a data model for designing an organization's database that runs effectively and efficiently for better business outcome.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Researches relationships between different business data sets.
  • Participates in the establishment of data structures based on their relationships.
  • Adheres to an organization's database design policies.
  • Utilizes database design tools and techniques.
  • Tests the effectiveness of the database before its release for business use.

ETL Process: Knowledge of the extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) process; ability to develop a database through the ETL process.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Ensures the accuracy and effectiveness of data provided for the warehouse.
  • Loads selected data into the warehouse on a regular basis.
  • Derives necessary business or technical information from original data.
  • Acquires a large amount of data from different sources/systems.
  • Solves technical and administrative problems during the ETL process.

Information Management: Knowledge of an organization's existing and planned Information Architecture and Information Management (IM) methodology; ability to collect and manage information from different sources, and distribute this information to enhance operational efficiency.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Directs the implementation of information processing and operation standards to protect and manage information assets.
  • Develops capabilities, features and uses for major IM platforms.
  • Coaches others on issues and considerations for managing structured vs. unstructured data.
  • Advises on improvement plans for existing and forecasted information architecture.
  • Consults on all major information management platforms and practices.
  • Consults on information architecture concepts, disciplines and practices.

Modeling: Data, Process, Events, Objects: Knowledge of data, process and events; ability to use tools and techniques for analyzing and documenting logical relationships among data, processes or events.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Defines common types of data, processes or event models.
  • Participates in model reviews and walkthroughs.
  • Explains existing models to clients and describes their associated business processes.
  • Focuses on modifying Data Structure, Access and Entity Relationship Diagrams.
  • Prepares reports to recap current findings and issues in data, processes or event models.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers)

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO)

EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans and individuals with disabilities - are encouraged to apply.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Application Specialist SPDM
job.description:
At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse talent with technical acumen to develop tomorrow’s reality. With Engineering Enterprise Apps and Engineering AI solutions, we are uniquely positioned to have an immediate impact on the transformation at our customers to leverage the full value of their simulation analyses and data and AI – and create much better products much faster.

Let's make the difference together!

About the role

The Application Specialists team is an essential component of the Engineering Enterprise Apps & Engineering AI product management team by offering top-tier expertise in the solution portfolio as well as the key industry sectors and applications. With the team of application specialists we develop advanced workflows and best practices that boost our customers' productivity. Such workflows and best practices will directly impact our ability to accelerate sales cycles in pre-sales context, as well as being an essential instrument to achieve effective customer adoption and hence create expansion opportunities at our customers.

The work involves connecting the relevant product lines from the Simcenter portfolio, fostering advanced technical thought leadership, and maximizing the visibility and business success of the Simcenter portfolio.

Responsibilities

As Application Specialist you stand in the center of a continuously evolving solution portfolio bringing new features & functionalities with every release, and the dynamics of an equally fast evolving market where new trends and opportunities arise as a result of emerging new technology. The challenge of the application specialist will be to understand our customers’ current and future challenges and to articulate the value of the EEA portfolio through well documented, industry-relevant, example use cases that show our customer the potential of advancing their ways of working with our EEA portfolio.

You will look across the boundaries of individual products and will be able to identify synergies and opportunities for improvement at the interface of our technologies so as to deliver a seamless experience for our end users.

Activities also include

  • Supporting portfolio developers, business development teams, sales and pre-sales teams in customer pursuits with dedicated Proof-of-Concept development and demonstration
  • Relaying customer and market needs and trends to the product management teams
  • Act as a sounding board to the product management teams for new requirement / specification development
  • Active stakeholder in product milestone demonstrations, technical enablement, etc
  • Assisting in the development of collateral for the relevant campaigns and technical marketing initiatives
  • Participating and presenting at internal and external webinars, seminars and user conferences
  • Promoting the portfolio through writing blog posts, posting videos, contributing in discussion forums etc.

Your qualifications

We are looking for someone who is an excellent communicator and capable of translating a value proposition and associated content at the level of different audience. You are self-organized and know how to handle incoming requests from many different angles and varying priority, while creating high-quality deliverables. You are a permanent learner – whether product, market, trends, you stay up to date and well informed.

Specific qualifications we will be looking for :

  • 10+ years expertise as application engineer in simulation ; leveraging AI, data and data management, and simulation process orchestration as tools
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens’ Simcenter EEA portfolio is a plus
  • Hands-on experience in engineering verification and validation processes, through simulation and/or physical testing in either automotive, aerospace or defense industry. Awareness about the value of traceable, correctly annotated data to support reuse and improve efficiency and quality of results.
  • Strong written, communication and presentation skills in English
  • Knowledge of applicable solutions for documenting engineering workflows (SolutionLink, …) is a plus
  • Able to travel occasionally

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

At Siemens, we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds

Our Benefits & Rewards

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the SIEMENS Benefit [link.](http://https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/)

The primary locations for this opportunity are Romania, Belgium, and India. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:

Romania: RON 145.300 – RON 276.000

Belgium: €53.500 – €96.300

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees (benefits availability varies by country).

This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.

job.title: Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor
job.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor to strengthen cybersecurity governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities across business functions and digital solutions. The role will serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, technology teams, and leadership by ensuring cybersecurity requirements, regulatory obligations, and corporate policies are effectively integrated into business operations and digital programs.

The Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor will assess security risks, define mitigation strategies, support compliance initiatives, and guide teams through security assurance activities across cloud, enterprise, and operational technology environments. The position requires strong expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, security controls, risk management, and regulatory compliance, combined with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical business solutions.

This is a highly collaborative role requiring effective stakeholder engagement, governance leadership, and the ability to drive security awareness and compliance maturity across global and cross-functional teams.

A Snapshot of your Day

A typical day involves collaborating with project teams, solution architects, IT leaders, and business stakeholders to evaluate cybersecurity risks and compliance requirements for ongoing initiatives. You review security assessments, advise on remediation activities, and ensure controls align with enterprise standards and regulatory obligations.

You may participate in governance reviews, support audits, assess cloud and application security designs, and provide recommendations that enable secure business operations while balancing productivity, innovation, and risk management objectives.

How You’ll Make an Impact (responsibilities of role)

Strategic

  • Develop and promote cybersecurity governance frameworks, policies, standards, and controls that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise business and technology leaders on cybersecurity risks, compliance obligations, and security-by-design principles during digital transformation initiatives.
  • Drive cybersecurity risk management programs by identifying emerging threats, assessing business impact, and recommending pragmatic mitigation strategies.
  • Support the development and execution of compliance roadmaps to improve organizational security maturity and regulatory readiness.
  • Partner with stakeholders to establish security requirements for enterprise applications, cloud services, operational systems, and third-party solutions.
  • Monitor cybersecurity trends, industry standards, and evolving regulations, ensuring the organization remains aligned with best practices and compliance expectations.
  • Promote security awareness and foster a culture of accountability for cybersecurity and data protection throughout the organization.

Operational

  • Conduct security risk assessments, control reviews, and compliance evaluations across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and operational processes.
  • Support internal and external audits by coordinating evidence collection, control validation, remediation tracking, and compliance reporting.
  • Review solution architectures, project designs, and implementation plan to identify security gaps and recommend appropriate controls.
  • Perform vendor and third-party security assessments to evaluate cybersecurity posture and contractual compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to implement security controls related to identity management, data protection, network security, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Track cybersecurity findings, vulnerabilities, and compliance deviations while driving corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support incident investigations, root cause analysis, and lessons learned activities from a governance and compliance perspective.
  • Maintain cybersecurity documentation, risk registers, policy records, and compliance artifacts to support governance and auditability.

What You Bring (required qualification and skill sets)

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security governance, compliance, risk management, or related advisory roles.
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and industry standards such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, IEC 62443, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting compliance programs related to data privacy, information security, cloud security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven ability to conduct security risk assessments, define mitigation plans, and communicate risk decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with enterprise security controls including identity and access management, data protection, security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles across Azure, AWS, or hybrid environments.
  • Experience collaborating with global cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to balance security requirements with operational and business objectives while driving practical outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CCSP, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity requirements within industrial, energy, engineering, manufacturing, or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Knowledge of Operational Technology (OT) security and industrial cybersecurity controls.
  • Familiarity with data privacy regulations and compliance frameworks such as GDPR and related international standards.
  • Experience with security governance platforms, GRC solutions, and audit management tools.
  • Exposure to DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle methodologies.
  • Experience leading cybersecurity awareness initiatives, compliance assessments, or regulatory audits at enterprise scale.

Tech Stack

  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC): ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer, MetricStream, or similar platforms for risk management, control monitoring, and audit readiness.
  • Cloud Security: Microsoft Azure Security Center, Microsoft Defender, AWS Security Services, and cloud governance solutions to manage security posture and compliance.
  • Identity & Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Privileged Access Management, RBAC, and multi-factor authentication technologies.
  • Security Monitoring & Threat Detection: SIEM and security analytics platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or equivalent solutions.
  • Vulnerability & Risk Management: Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or similar solutions for vulnerability assessment, remediation tracking, and risk reporting.
  • Compliance & Audit Management: Policy management, evidence collection, control testing, and regulatory reporting tools supporting governance activities.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Power BI, and ServiceNow for stakeholder engagement, reporting, and governance workflows.
  • Methodologies & Frameworks: ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, IEC 62443, Risk Management Frameworks, and Security-by-Design principles.

job.title: Project Manager - Data Centres
job.description:
As Australia's digital economy continues to accelerate, Siemens is playing a critical role in enabling the next generation of data centre infrastructure. Through our Electrification & Automation business, we deliver innovative power distribution, automation, digitalisation and energy solutions that help hyperscale, colocation and enterprise customers build resilient, sustainable and high-performing facilities.

Siemens are looking for a highly experienced Data Centre Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of integrated power solutions across Australia's rapidly growing data centre market. Sitting within Siemens' Electrification & Automation business, you'll drive end-to-end project excellence, technical quality, and customer satisfaction across mission-critical infrastructure — delivering resilient, high-performance solutions aligned to global standards and local market needs. The successful candidate will be responsible for:

  • Leading end-to-end delivery of large-scale data centre projects, ensuring scope, schedule, cost, and quality objectives are consistently achieved across multiple concurrent programs
  • Overseeing the full lifecycle of MV switchgear and integrated power distribution systems, from design through to commissioning, maintaining best-practice standards in testing and lifecycle performance
  • Building and maintain senior relationships with data centre developers, contractors, and operators — acting as a trusted advisor and leading contract negotiations, variation management, and commercial discussions
  • Building and develop a high-performing team, coaching emerging leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Leveraging digital tools, data insights, and automation to enhance productivity and enable smarter project execution
  • Championing a zero-harm safety culture, ensuring full compliance with Siemens and Australian regulatory standards

You'll have proven experience in project or program leadership within the data centre, utilities, or mission-critical infrastructure sector, with a strong track record delivering MV/LV electrical systems including switchgear, protection, and control. You're experienced in EPC delivery models and complex stakeholder environments, with a deep understanding of Australian standards, grid connections, and data centre design requirements. A tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline is preferred.

You take ownership of outcomes across all project phases and thrive in high-pressure, mission-critical environments. You balance immediate delivery priorities with long-term growth opportunities, bring cross-functional teams together to achieve shared goals, and communicate with influence across executive stakeholders and diverse teams. You hold yourself to uncompromising standards in safety, engineering, and delivery.

A strong network across the Australian data centre ecosystem — spanning hyperscale providers, colocation operators, Tier 1 contractors, and mission-critical engineering consultants — will be a significant advantage in this role.

Siemens are committed to ensuring our workplace reflects the communities in which we operate, that everyone has access to the same opportunities and is treated fairly, and that we actively empower the voices of every individual voice.

We strive to provide a safe working environment for each member of our diverse team and commit to continuously develop our ways of working on this journey. From our Innovate Reconciliation Action Plan to our diverse cultural celebrations, LGBTQIA+ education and support to our gender equity initiatives, we strive to make our workplace an inclusive environment where every individual feels empowered and heard. You can learn more about Siemens’ commitment to diversity and sustainability in Australia and New Zealand here.

job.title: Solution Engineering Manager – Primary Engineering (AIS/GIS Substations)
job.description:
Solution Engineering Manager – Primary Engineering

Location: Kolkata

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Solution Engineer – Primary Engineering, you will play a key role in the engineering and design of High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) substations, supporting the successful execution of power transmission and distribution projects across industries, data centers, utilities, and grid substations.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing primary engineering solutions for AIS substations up to 765kV and GIS substations up to 400kV. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams including Secondary Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Procurement, Project Management, and Customers to deliver technically optimized, compliant, and cost-effective solutions. Your technical expertise will contribute to ensuring quality, reliability, safety, and operational excellence throughout the project lifecycle.

We are looking for a passionate and technically strong electrical engineering professional with experience in substation primary engineering, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within diverse project teams.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Prepare Design Basis Reports and technical specifications for electrical systems.
  • Develop Single Line Diagrams (SLD), substation layouts, sections, and arrangements for various bus configurations.
  • Design electrical clearance diagrams, cable containment systems, and earthing systems.
  • Perform DSLP and grounding design calculations in compliance with project requirements and industry standards.
  • Conduct conductor sizing, short-circuit force calculations, and sag-tension calculations for transmission and substation applications.
  • Perform sizing calculations and equipment selection for Transformers, MV/LV Switchgear, DC Systems, Battery Systems, Battery Chargers, and UPS systems.
  • Support preparation of customer proposals, Bill of Materials (BOM), Request for Quotations (RFQs), and technical documentation.
  • Review customer specifications and perform vendor drawing reviews for EHV equipment, transformers, cables, and associated systems.
  • Collaborate with Secondary Engineering teams and support mechanical system design activities.
  • Coordinate engineering interfaces with Civil, Mechanical, Protection, and Substation Automation System (SAS) teams.
  • Participate in offer reviews, technical discussions, and engineering clarifications with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable Indian and international standards, project specifications, and quality requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing engineering quality, efficiency, and standardization.
  • Contribute to successful project execution by providing innovative and technically optimized engineering solutions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Electrical Engineering.
  • Experience in Primary Engineering for AIS and GIS Substation Projects serving Industrial, Data Center, State Electricity Board (SEB), and Grid Substation customers.
  • Experience related to AIS Substations up to 765kV and GIS Substations up to 400kV is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of primary engineering design principles for HV and EHV substations.
  • Expertise in preparation of SLDs, layouts, sections, electrical clearance diagrams, cable containment systems, and earthing designs.
  • Knowledge of equipment sizing and selection for Transformer, MV, LV, DC, Battery, Battery Charger, and UPS systems.
  • Familiarity with conductor sizing, short-circuit force calculations, and sag-tension calculations.
  • Understanding of load flow studies, short-circuit studies, and relay coordination principles will be an added advantage.
  • Basic understanding of Protection Systems, Substation Automation Systems (SAS), and Auxiliary System Design.
  • Working knowledge of Indian and International standards and regulations relevant to substation engineering.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, ETAP, MS Office, and other engineering design tools.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to technical excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous learning.

Key Success Indicators

  • Engineering Quality and Design Accuracy
  • On-Time Engineering Deliverables
  • Compliance with Technical Specifications and Standards
  • Customer Satisfaction
  • Proposal and Tender Quality
  • Design Optimization and Cost Competitiveness
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration Effectiveness
  • Engineering Productivity
  • Project Execution Support
  • Continuous Improvement Contributions

About Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL)

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customer installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping countries navigate their energy transition and achieve their net-zero ambitions.

SEIL is a pure-play energy technology company, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support customers across the entire energy value chain. Our portfolio includes low-to-zero emission power generation, power transmission and storage, and industrial decarbonization solutions.
