job.title: Solution Engineering Lead – Primary Engineering (AIS/GIS Substations)
job.description:
Solution Engineering Lead – Primary Engineering

Location: Mumbai

Reporting To: Engineering Manager / Head of Engineering

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Solution Engineer – Primary Engineering, you will play a key role in the engineering and design of High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) substations, supporting the successful execution of power transmission and distribution projects across industries, data centers, utilities, and grid substations.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing primary engineering solutions for AIS substations up to 765kV and GIS substations up to 400kV. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams including Secondary Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Procurement, Project Management, and Customers to deliver technically optimized, compliant, and cost-effective solutions. Your technical expertise will contribute to ensuring quality, reliability, safety, and operational excellence throughout the project lifecycle.

We are looking for a passionate and technically strong electrical engineering professional with experience in substation primary engineering, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within diverse project teams.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Prepare Design Basis Reports and technical specifications for electrical systems.
  • Develop Single Line Diagrams (SLD), substation layouts, sections, and arrangements for various bus configurations.
  • Design electrical clearance diagrams, cable containment systems, and earthing systems.
  • Perform DSLP and grounding design calculations in compliance with project requirements and industry standards.
  • Conduct conductor sizing, short-circuit force calculations, and sag-tension calculations for transmission and substation applications.
  • Perform sizing calculations and equipment selection for Transformers, MV/LV Switchgear, DC Systems, Battery Systems, Battery Chargers, and UPS systems.
  • Support preparation of customer proposals, Bill of Materials (BOM), Request for Quotations (RFQs), and technical documentation.
  • Review customer specifications and perform vendor drawing reviews for EHV equipment, transformers, cables, and associated systems.
  • Collaborate with Secondary Engineering teams and support mechanical system design activities.
  • Coordinate engineering interfaces with Civil, Mechanical, Protection, and Substation Automation System (SAS) teams.
  • Participate in offer reviews, technical discussions, and engineering clarifications with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable Indian and international standards, project specifications, and quality requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing engineering quality, efficiency, and standardization.
  • Contribute to successful project execution by providing innovative and technically optimized engineering solutions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Electrical Engineering.
  • Experience in Primary Engineering for AIS and GIS Substation Projects serving Industrial, Data Center, State Electricity Board (SEB), and Grid Substation customers.
  • Experience related to AIS Substations up to 765kV and GIS Substations up to 400kV is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of primary engineering design principles for HV and EHV substations.
  • Expertise in preparation of SLDs, layouts, sections, electrical clearance diagrams, cable containment systems, and earthing designs.
  • Knowledge of equipment sizing and selection for Transformer, MV, LV, DC, Battery, Battery Charger, and UPS systems.
  • Familiarity with conductor sizing, short-circuit force calculations, and sag-tension calculations.
  • Understanding of load flow studies, short-circuit studies, and relay coordination principles will be an added advantage.
  • Basic understanding of Protection Systems, Substation Automation Systems (SAS), and Auxiliary System Design.
  • Working knowledge of Indian and International standards and regulations relevant to substation engineering.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, ETAP, MS Office, and other engineering design tools.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to technical excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous learning.

Key Success Indicators

  • Engineering Quality and Design Accuracy
  • On-Time Engineering Deliverables
  • Compliance with Technical Specifications and Standards
  • Customer Satisfaction
  • Proposal and Tender Quality
  • Design Optimization and Cost Competitiveness
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration Effectiveness
  • Engineering Productivity
  • Project Execution Support
  • Continuous Improvement Contributions

About Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL)

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customer installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping countries navigate their energy transition and achieve their net-zero ambitions.

SEIL is a pure-play energy technology company, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support customers across the entire energy value chain. Our portfolio includes low-to-zero emission power generation, power transmission and storage, and industrial decarbonization solutions.

job.title: SRE Engineer
job.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Error Budgets for AI services, understand scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure for AI model serving, training pipelines, and data workflows, maintain comprehensive observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) using tools like Datadog or Open Telemetry.

Responsibilities

Enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Error Budgets for AI services

Lead incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes to minimize downtime and prevent recurrence

Proactively identify and resolve reliability risks before they impact end users

Maintain scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure for data pipelines, ML workflows and data workflows

Handle cloud infrastructure (Azure) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform

Oversee Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads (Docker) supporting AI microservices

Maintain comprehensive observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Open Telemetry

Develop intelligent alerting systems to detect anomalies in AI model performance, latency, and efficiency

Automate repetitive operational tasks through scripting and tooling (Python, Bash, Go)

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for model deployment and service updates

job.title: Senior System Design Engineer
job.description:
Hello visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

Siemens Global Business Services (GBS) is a Siemens Service Company that provides innovative digital solutions and customer-oriented business services. With more than 20 years of experience, Siemens GBS taps into its understanding of how organizations and businesses work to seamlessly integrate, digitalize and optimize business processes with a portfolio that covers end-to-end business needs.

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Lead complete BAS engineering design activities for global data center projects from project kickoff through engineering completion while ensuring high-quality deliverables within project schedules.
  • Develop control system architecture, controller selection, network topology, point databases, I/O schedules, control schematics, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Cause & Effect Matrix, alarm strategies, and Sequence of Operations documentation.
  • Design control solutions for mission-critical infrastructure including chiller plants, CRAH/CRAC units, Cooling Distribution Units (CDU), cooling towers, pumps, heat exchangers, AHUs, precision cooling systems, and environmental monitoring.
  • Integrate Building Automation Systems with UPS, generators, ATS, STS, power monitoring systems, fire alarm systems, access control, leak detection, and DCIM platforms.
  • Perform engineering reviews, resolve technical challenges, support customer discussions, participate in design workshops, and mentor junior engineers.
  • Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), remote commissioning, engineering estimations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Your success is grounded in:

  • 6–10 Years of relevant experience
  • Education: Bachelor’s / master’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Control & Instrumentation Engineering, Mechatronics, or related discipline.
  • Preferred
  • Experience supporting hyperscale or colocation data center projects.
  • Strong knowledge of BAS architecture, HVAC control sequences, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, controller engineering, and engineering documentation.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills with experience supporting international customers.
  • Certified Data Centre Professional (CDCP) with Knowledge of AI-ready cooling systems, liquid cooling, Digital Twin, BIM, and EPMS/DCIM integration.

Technical Skills PreferredPLC/DDC Design, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC UA, AutoCAD, Microsoft Visio, Revit (preferred), Microsoft Office, HVAC Control Systems, Chiller Plants, CRAH/CRAC, CDU, Pumps, Cooling Towers, UPS, Generator Interfaces, Environmental Monitoring.

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

This role is based in Bangalore. But you’ll also get to visit other locations in India and globe, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries and the shape of things to come. We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries.

job.title: OEM Application Lead - HVAC
job.description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.

Role Objective

Lead the OEM team in developing, standardizing, and deploying innovative HVAC and datacenter cooling automation solutions that enable OEM customers to achieve superior performance, energy efficiency, and reliability. The role is responsible for driving technical excellence, customer success, and the adoption of Siemens automation technologies across the rapidly evolving global datacenter cooling market.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the development and deployment of equipment automation applications for datacenter cooling systems.
  • Ensure consistent application architecture, software quality, and engineering best practices across projects.
  • Guide the design and implementation of applications for:

? CRAC (Computer Room Air Conditioning)

? CRAH (Computer Room Air Handling)

? Fan Wall Units (FWU)

? Chillers

? Cooling Towers

? Coolant Distribution Units (CDU)

? Immersion Cooling Systems

? Direct-to-Chip Liquid Cooling Solutions

? Emerging Datacenter Thermal Management Technologies

  • Review and approve application designs, control sequences, and commissioning strategies.
  • Act as the senior technical escalation point for strategic OEM customers.

  • Minimum 10 + years of experience in:
  • HVAC equipment design
  • Controls engineering and automation
  • Application software development
  • Datacenter cooling solutions
  • Leading technical teams or application engineering groups.
  • Proven experience working directly with OEM customers and cross-functional global teams.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • PLC Programming (FBD, ST)
  • Python
  • MATLAB
  • LabVIEW
  • HTML5, Angular, or equivalent web technologies
  • Data Analytics and Performance Optimization Tools

This role is based in Chennai, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. job.title: QAQC Manager (Contract)
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced QA/QC Manager to lead quality assurance and compliance programs across our operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring service delivery meets contractual, client, and regulatory requirements while driving continuous improvement initiatives and leading a high-performing quality team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage QA/QC activities, ensuring compliance with client, company, and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality management systems, processes, and standards.
  • Monitor quality performance metrics and identify opportunities for service improvement.
  • Conduct quality audits, inspections, and compliance reviews to ensure operational excellence.
  • Prepare and present quality and compliance reports to clients and key stakeholders.
  • Manage audit readiness programs and support internal and external audits.
  • Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with operational teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the QA/QC team, including performance management and training.
  • Escalate quality and compliance risks to senior management as required.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business, Facilities Management, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Compliance, or a related field.
  • Experience managing quality systems, audits, compliance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of quality management principles, standards, and best practices.
  • Proven ability to analyze data, identify trends, and implement effective quality solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience leading and developing teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Professional quality certifications (e.g., ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, Six Sigma, CQE) are advantageous.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Warriewood
job.description:
Warriewood, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual Retail Service Consultant to join our Wariewood team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You’re confident in navigating difficult enquiries, ease tricky situations with empathy and respect, and work toward the best solution for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support one another, stay accountable, and create a customer‑first environment where everyone succeeds.

What’s in it for you?

  • $35 p/h + super + applicable loadings.
  • Phenomenal perks, including 25% off Optus products and exclusive access to unique discounts with our retail partners.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.
  • Flexible rosters that work around the life you live outside of work.

Intrigued, but not sure you tick every box? That’s completely okay! We still encourage you to apply. We all grow, learn and develop together, and this role might be the perfect next step in your career journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

IT Business Partner for Corporate Functions. Serve as the trusted technology adviser to the People and Culture and Sustainability leadership teams. Optimise financial, commercial, vendor and workforce performance

job.title: Product Manager, Middleware & Integration Platforms
job.description:
##

Role Mission

Own and govern StarHub's enterprise middleware and integration ecosystem, providing a common technology umbrella for integrations connecting BTS and non-BTS systems. The role ensures integrations are designed, delivered and operated through secure, scalable and reusable enterprise patterns, with clear ownership across their full lifecycle.

The role provides product ownership and governance for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and future approved enterprise integration technologies.

Accountabilities

  • Own the enterprise middleware and integration platform portfolio across BTS and the wider StarHub technology ecosystem.
  • Establish clear platform ownership, governance and operating standards for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation capabilities.
  • Ensure integrations across BTS and non-BTS systems are visible, governed and managed under a common enterprise framework.
  • Drive adoption of reusable integration patterns to reduce duplication, manual effort, unmanaged interfaces and point-to-point solutions.
  • Define platform roadmaps, investment priorities and lifecycle strategies aligned with StarHub's modernisation, automation and AI agenda.
  • Partner with application, architecture, data, infrastructure, identity, cybersecurity and service management teams to enable secure and resilient integration.
  • Optimise platform utilisation, licensing, vendor performance and total cost of ownership.

##

Responsibilities

1.Enterprise Middleware & Platform Ownership

  • Own the product lifecycle for enterprise middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and other approved technologies.
  • Maintain an enterprise view of middleware platforms, major interfaces, workflows, automations and dependencies.
  • Ensure platforms remain fit-for-purpose, scalable, supported, secure and aligned to target architecture.
  • Establish clear service ownership, support models and lifecycle controls for critical integration capabilities.
  • Integration Governance & Standards
  • Establish enterprise standards and guardrails for APIs, application-to-application integration, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration and automation.
  • Define decision principles for the use of middleware, native application integration, APIs, RPA and workflow automation.
  • Govern new integration demand to prevent uncontrolled point-to-point development, duplicated tooling and technology sprawl.
  • Drive reuse of approved APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Ensure designs comply with architecture, cybersecurity, identity, data protection, resilience and operational support requirements.
  • Cross-Domain Integration Accountability
  • Provide the governance umbrella for integrations across BTS domains and integrations originating outside BTS that connect into BTS-managed platforms.
  • Support cross-domain integration across Finance, People, Productivity, Identity, Data, Customer and other enterprise technology domains.
  • Identify integration ownership gaps and establish accountable owners for interfaces crossing organisational or technology boundaries.
  • Ensure critical integrations have documented architecture, technical ownership, business ownership, monitoring and support arrangements.
  • Coordinate resolution of cross-platform integration risks, dependencies and service issues.

##

  • Automation & Orchestration
  • Govern enterprise use of automation platforms such as UiPath to ensure sustainable, reusable and supportable adoption rather than isolated automations.
  • Identify opportunities to remove repetitive manual work through integration, workflow automation and orchestration.
  • Assess automation opportunities based on business value, complexity, risk, scalability and maintainability.
  • Promote reusable automation components and patterns across business functions.
  • Measure realised benefits including effort reduction, cycle-time improvement, error reduction and productivity gains.
  • Product Roadmap & Portfolio Management
  • Develop and maintain the Middleware & Integration product roadmap and backlog.
  • Prioritise platform enhancements, new capabilities, migrations, rationalisation and decommissioning based on enterprise demand and value.
  • Manage platform dependencies, risks, releases and delivery priorities.
  • Build business cases for material investments and track measurable value realisation.
  • Continuously assess emerging middleware, integration, automation and AI-enabled orchestration capabilities.
  • Vendor & Commercial Management
  • Manage strategic relationships with middleware, integration and automation technology vendors and delivery partners.
  • Lead platform licensing, consumption, capacity and commercial reviews.
  • Identify opportunities for licence optimisation, platform consolidation and cost reduction.
  • Establish vendor performance measures and regular service reviews.
  • AI & Intelligent Integration Enablement
  • Enable governed integration patterns that allow approved AI and agentic capabilities to securely interact with enterprise systems and data.
  • Partner with relevant AI, architecture, cybersecurity and identity teams on connectors, APIs, orchestration and tool-access patterns.
  • Ensure AI-enabled integrations follow least-privilege access, auditability, data protection and appropriate human approval controls.
  • Evolve middleware capabilities to support future agent-to-system and machine-to-machine integration patterns.

##

Scope Boundary

The role owns the middleware capability, platforms, standards and governance. Individual application teams remain accountable for their application functionality and domain-specific requirements, while integrations crossing systems or domains are governed through the Middleware & Integration capability.

Areas of Impact

  • A single governed enterprise approach to middleware and integration across BTS and non-BTS platforms.
  • Reduced proliferation of point-to-point integrations, duplicated automation tools and unmanaged workflows.
  • Increased reuse of enterprise APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Faster and more reliable delivery of cross-platform business capabilities.
  • Improved resilience, observability, supportability and lifecycle ownership of critical integrations.
  • Reduced manual effort and operating cost through governed automation.
  • A secure integration foundation for AI-enabled and agentic business processes.

Ideal Track Record

  • 7-10 years of experience in enterprise integration, middleware, automation, product management or technology transformation.
  • Proven experience managing enterprise integration or automation platforms in a complex organisation.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, middleware, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration, system-to-system connectivity and RPA.
  • Experience with platforms such as Workato, UiPath, MuleSoft, Boomi, ServiceNow IntegrationHub or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience managing technology products across multiple business and technology domains.
  • Good understanding of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, identity, ITSM and operational support requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, commercial arrangements, product roadmaps and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions.
  • Experience with AI-enabled automation, orchestration or agentic integration patterns is advantageous.

job.title: Advanced R&D Engr/Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

_Advanced R&D Engr/Scientist – Gas Processing Technologies_

Innovate to solve the world's most important challenges.

The future is what you make it.

When you join Honeywell UOP, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers that are developing sustainable technologies that will accelerate the energy transition to net-zero carbon.

Are you ready to help us shape the future? Become a #futureshaper!

An excellent career opportunity is currently available for anAdvanced R&D Engr/Scientist –Gas Processing Technologiesat Honeywell India Technology Center in Gurugram. This position is dedicated to accelerating the development and commercialization of cutting-edge Hydrogen and Carbon Capture technologies, focusing specifically on solvent-based technology solutions. The selected candidate will spearhead the development of novel technologies and will be responsible for creating integrated solutions that leverage UOP’s Hydrogen and Gas Processing technology portfolio.

Responsibilities

Position Responsibilities:

  • Leadership in New Product Development:Lead and support New Product Development (NPD) initiatives by managing cross-functional teams tasked with creating intricate integrated technology solutions. Conduct research on solvent-based carbon capture technologies, focusing on their effectiveness and efficiency in reducing CO2 footprint.
  • Project Management Excellence:Implement Z21 methodologies and project management best practices to ensure that all technology deliverables are met on schedule and within budget.
  • Pilot Plant Experimentation:Direct and facilitate pilot plant experiments while driving a model-based design of experiments (MBDOE) approach to expedite technology advancement.
  • Innovation and Intellectual Property:Identify and develop innovative solutions, authoring invention disclosures to contribute significantly to Honeywell UOP’s innovation initiatives.
  • Collaboration and Growth Strategies:Engage with business colleagues to effectively develop technologies that bolster existing business lines and support growth strategies.
  • Competitive Landscape Monitoring:Stay informed about competition, monitor advancements in relevant technological areas, and lead projects designed to address gaps.
  • Mentorship Role:Act as a mentor for less experienced scientists and engineers, fostering their growth and professional development.

Qualifications

You Must Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering.
  • Experience in carbon capture technologies, with a focus on solvent methods, is highly desirable.
  • Strong interest in R&D work.
  • Strong technical skills for leading experimentation and data analysis skills.
  • A self-starter and ability to drive innovation.

We Value:

  • Advanced degree (Masters, PhD) in Chemical Engineering.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in Technology Development, specifically in solvent-based technology commercialization.
  • Profound understanding of chemistry and chemical engineering principles, with applications in process, absorption, catalyst, and adsorbent technology development.
  • Proven experience in formulating and executing experimental plans, with proficiency in statistical tools for comprehensive data analysis. Ability to design experimental set-ups to meet project objectives.
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma principles with practical applications for managing risks and uncertainties; Six Sigma Green Belt certification is preferred; Black Belt certification is ideal.
  • Strong business acumen combined with an entrepreneurial mindset to drive technological development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to deliver impactful presentations to diverse audiences and effectively manage customer relationships.
  • Familiarity with laboratory techniques, data analysis software, and chemical engineering principles.

As a global leader in building technologies and advanced HVAC solutions, we help customers improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain mission-critical environments across sectors including mining, healthcare, data centres, pharmaceuticals, education, industrial facilities, and commercial infrastructure.

With more than 140 years of industry leadership, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, premium service delivery, and a highly skilled technical workforce to solve complex challenges and create smarter, more sustainable spaces.

About the Opportunity

Due to continued growth in our service business, we are seeking an experienced HVAC Service Technician to join our Mackay team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Refrigeration Mechanic or Electrician with commercial HVAC experience who enjoys working autonomously, solving technical challenges, and expanding their expertise across a diverse range of equipment and customer sites.

As part of our team, you'll work on some of the industry's most recognised HVAC systems while receiving ongoing support and training from one of the world's leading building technology companies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Preventative maintenance and reactive service work

  • Installation, overhaul, and servicing of commercial mechanical systems
  • Maintenance of equipment ranging from package units and split systems through to chillers and central plant
  • Exposure to Johnson Controls' Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Preparing quotes for small works and minor projects
  • Site coordination and customer engagement
  • Reading plans and supporting small commercial installation projects

About You

We're looking for someone who takes pride in delivering quality workmanship and building strong customer relationships.

Essential

  • Refrigeration or Electrical Trade Qualification
  • HVAC service and maintenance experience
  • Restricted Electrical Licence
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • Full Australian working rights

Highly Regarded

  • Experience working on chillers and commercial air-conditioning systems

  • Building Management Systems (BMS) exposure
  • Experience in commissioning and project work

The YORK Advantage

As the OEM for YORK chillers, Johnson Controls provides specialist manufacturer training that few employers can offer. You'll gain access to industry-leading technical resources, in-house chiller training, and opportunities to develop expertise across a broad range of HVAC technologies.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Successful applicants will be required to complete:

  • Reference checks
  • Pre-employment medical assessment
  • Criminal history check

Apply now in confidence.

job.title: Machine Setup Operator-Level 1
job.description:
Job Description

In this role, you will impact on the overall manufacturing efficiency and product quality by ensuring machines are properly set up and maintained, helping to meet production targets and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and adjust machinery and equipment to meet production specifications and quality standards.
  • Conduct routine inspections and quality checks to ensure machine performance and product consistency.
  • Collaborate with maintenance and production teams to troubleshoot and resolve machine issues promptly.
  • Maintain accurate records of machine setups, adjustments, and production outputs.
  • Follow safety protocols and maintain a clean and organized work environment.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Experience in machine setup and operation within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of machine tools and equipment, including the ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.
  • Proficiency in performing quality inspections and using measurement tools to ensure product accuracy.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and the ability to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Basic troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve machine issues efficiently.

WE VALUE

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 1-3 years of experience in machine setup or manufacturing operations.
  • Attention to detail and strong problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Willingness to learn and develop new technical skills related to machine operation and maintenance.

Honeywell International Inc. (Nasdaq: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world's most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, productivity, and global urbanization. Our teams leverage advanced machining technologies and continuous improvement methodologies to support diverse industries including aerospace, automotive, and industrial markets. We are committed to operational excellence and developing talent to drive innovation and customer satisfaction.

_Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status._ [Learn more](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/company/inclusion-and-engagement)

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status

  • You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

job.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
job.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

  • Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
  • Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  • Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
  • Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
  • In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
  • Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
  • Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
  • Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
  • Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
  • Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
  • Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life

  • Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
  • Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
  • Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
  • Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
  • Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

About the team The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
  • Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
job.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

  • Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
  • Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  • Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
  • Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
  • In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
  • Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
  • Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
  • Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
  • Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
  • Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
  • Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life

  • Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
  • Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
  • Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
  • Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
  • Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

About the team The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
  • Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

job.title: Network Test & Automation Engineer
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

The Engineer will execute and support existing/new project assignments covering GPON, Wi-Fi CPEs, IoT, and device-management technologies including but not limited to TR-069, TR-181, and TR-369. In addition, the role will support the operation, maintenance and troubleshooting of lab systems infrastructure.

This role focuses more on technical execution and troubleshooting of the above-mentioned requirements without neglecting project management skills, and the ability to work with cross-functional teams and vendors.

Make an impact by:

  • Develop scripts and tools using languages and/or automation platforms such as Python, or similar technologies to automate network configuration, test execution, monitoring, data collection and troubleshooting.
  • Plan, execute and document testing and validation for GPON, Wi-Fi CPEs and IoT solutions, including functional, interoperability, regression and end-to-end validation as required.
  • Develop, execute and maintain test cases covering device-management technologies and data models, including TR-069, TR-181 and TR-369.
  • Perform troubleshooting, analysis and diagnostics to enable faster failure root-cause identification and fault isolation, with or without vendor support.
  • Develop new test cases to meet new growth requirements and enhance existing test plans and validation coverage.
  • Manage and support lab systems infrastructure required for testing, including servers, operating systems, virtual machines, test platforms/tools, network connectivity, user/access administration and related services.
  • Perform routine administration, monitoring, maintenance, patching, backup/recovery and troubleshooting of lab systems to maintain availability, stability and security.
  • Coordinate with vendor(s) to identify requirements, timelines, dependencies and resources needed for testing improvement, automation and lab infrastructure activities whenever required.
  • Document test procedures, infrastructure configurations, processes, solutions and best practices for knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain periodic updates on progress, issues, risks and key callouts for immediate discussion and solutioning.
  • Manage project timelines and resources to ensure assigned projects and deliverables are completed on time.
  • Ensure lab infra compliance with company Group IT, cybersecurity and/or security requirements for all work performed.
  • Execute and/or support existing/new test project assignments across GPON, Wi-Fi CPE, IoT and associated device-management platforms.
  • Any other tasks assigned by the manager.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical field.
  • Certification in CCNA and ITIL 4 is preferred.
  • Proven experience in GPON/CPE testing in a lab environment.
  • Hands-on experience in testing and validation of IoT and CPE/device-management technologies, with knowledge of TR-069, TR-181 and TR-369 strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of lab test tools, lab operations and test equipment.
  • Good systems infrastructure management skills for lab environments, including administration and troubleshooting of Firewall, Network Switches, Linux and/or Windows systems, servers, virtual machines, applications/services.
  • Strong understanding of IP Networking concepts, protocols and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Familiar with scripting and automation across environments such as Python, Linux shell and Windows-based systems.
  • Good project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve complex technical problems across network, test platform and systems infrastructure layers.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation, organizational and analytical skills.

job.title: Lead Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Lead Critical Facilities Maintenance Technician possess an expert level of knowledge of their role and is responsible for the operational integrity and regulatory compliance of the data center electrical, mechanical, and fire life safety systems.

This role is also responsible for the processes that maximize customer uptime in the most cost-effective way and ensures that data center problems are promptly identified and repaired quickly, that contractors deliver quality services, and that internal customer service level agreements are met. The Skilled Critical Facilities Maintenance Technician develops creative approaches to keep operational costs to a minimum, while improving efficiency, and implementing new strategies.

This role acts as an informal facilitator and/or team leader, fostering a collaborative and innovative team culture focused on achieving operational excellence.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities:Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.Assist in scheduling and supervising vendors/subcontractors during equipment / systems maintenance and service.Provides recommendation of improvements to the operations and maintenance program on an on-going basis.Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.Knowledge and Attributes:Seasoned understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.Seasoned proficiency of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.Seasoned knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.Seasoned knowledge of CMMS systems.Seasoned knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.Seasoned knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications:Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related fieldTrade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC)Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.)

Experience required:Seasoned experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.Seasoned experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.Seasoned experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.Seasoned experience in facilities / building maintenance.Seasoned experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

job.title: Senior Team Lead - Mechanical - Facilities Projects
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Mechanical Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert responsible for the project execution, and commissioning of complex, mission critical data centre projects, leading mechanical system construction and design requirements from inception through completion. The role provides technical expertise across multiple projects and cross functional teams, overseeing mechanical procurement, TDS and shop drawing approvals, installation, testing and commissioning activities including SAT and IST, and ensuring compliance with applicable mechanical codes and standards, with strong experience in hyperscale data centres, HVAC systems, power backup DGs, and overall data centre systems and operations.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Review and approve project schedules aligned to client requirements and NTT programs and standards. Plan and execute assigned construction projects across pre‑construction, construction, and post‑construction phases. Ensure all project information checklists, pre‑planning tools, documentation, project execution plans, risk registers, and project directories are complete and maintained. Schedule and conduct pre‑construction and regular project site meetings with relevant internal and external stakeholders to identify, track, and resolve project issues and risks. Monitor implementation services from permitting through project closure, including site mobilization, subcontractor scheduling, construction execution, material quality, and adherence to approved plans. Ensure all construction plans and material specifications are reviewed, value‑engineered where applicable, and approved by the client prior to execution. Manage environmental, health, and safety programs at project sites, including safety guidelines, toolbox talks, safety orientations, and mitigation of unsafe practices that may impact schedules.

  • Prepare and submit weekly project reports covering schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, escalations, and delays.
  • Track and validate subcontractor scope completion, quality compliance, and readiness to support punch listing and client handover.
  • Ensure project milestones are achieved as per contract provisions and prepare accurate statements of accounts and settlements.

Manage and compile all handover documentation, including as‑built drawings, specifications, manuals, and warranty certificates, and support issuance of the Certificate of Completion. Design standard mechanical equipment sizing, specifications, and creative solutions to mechanical issues arising during design and operations of mission‑critical systems. Conduct QA/QC reviews of designs and documentation, including construction drawings and commissioning test scripts. Work closely with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, engineers, and commissioning agents to support testing, validation, and performance of mechanical and building systems. Participate in factory witness testing, troubleshooting activities, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and engineering calculations or studies as required. Perform other related project and engineering tasks as assigned. Knowledge, Skills and Attributes: Seasoned knowledge of mechanical equipment including air‑cooled chillers, pumps, water treatment systems, HVAC equipment, CRAC units, building management and industrial PLC control systems, air handling equipment, valves, piping, ductwork, storm and sanitary drainage, and industrial and domestic water systems. Seasoned competence in energy, fluid flow, heat transfer, and psychrometric calculations including sensible and latent loads, approach temperature, NPSH, pump and fan affinity laws, pressure loss, kW/Ton, EER, IPLV, and system state points. Strong understanding of control methods and hardware including signal types, data communication protocols for building automation and control networks, actuator types, failure modes, SCADA, and control tuning methods. Seasoned knowledge of applicable building codes, standards, and regulations including ASHRAE, ASME, IBC, NFPA, OSHA, life safety standards, environmental, health, and safety requirements, and local regulatory codes. Advanced problem‑solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills with the ability to perform complex data trending, tracking, and analysis. High personal standards for delivering thoughtful, polished, and high‑quality work products with strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Strong team orientation with excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude.
  • Ability to efficiently prioritize work and manage multiple tasks effectively.
  • Seasoned proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, Outlook, and MS Project.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or similar field required. Professional Engineering certification required. Experience in the data center industry Required Experience: Overall professional experience of 10–15 years in a relevant engineering Minimum 6 years of mechanical lead role experience working with Data Center environments. Seasoned experience preferably in a data center environment or critical environment

  • (hospital, power plant, etc.).
  • Seasoned experience with large scale technical operations.
  • Seasoned experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modelling.
  • Seasoned experience in SHRAE TC 9.9 publications including PUE, ASHRAE.

Advanced experience relating to recommended Temperature and Humidity Limits, Data Centre Controls, Containment. Seasoned demonstrated experience with system sequence(s) of operation for complex systems with multiple functions. Seasoned operating engineering experience with large mechanical systems including BMS trending, off-normal operation, and transient analysis.

We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Consultant - Full Stack (Django, DRF, React), Engineering Governance
job.description:
What you will do

  • Design, develop, deploy and maintain enterprise-grade full-stack web applications.
  • Design scalable backend services using Python, Django and DRF.
  • Build modern React applications and reusable UI components.
