job.title: Senior AI Engineer (Kubernetes & Customised Scheduler)
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Senior AI Engineer will be a core builder of the AI & Applications team’s Model-to-Grid product, designing, developing, and operating the Kubernetes-based workload orchestration layer for massive-scale AI factories. The role has a strong software and platform engineering focus: building a proprietary job scheduler that enables efficient, reliable, and policy-driven execution of training, fine-tuning, inference, batch, benchmarking, and agentic workloads across cutting-edge GPU systems, including NVIDIA NVL72 GB300-scale deployments and future-generation platforms such as VR200.

The proprietary scheduler is a central product differentiator. It must be network-topology aware and AI-factory-resource aware: making placement, queueing, prioritization, admission, and execution decisions based not only on nominal GPU availability, but also on GPU and NVLink/NVSwitch topology, node and fault-domain boundaries, RDMA and fabric health, storage locality and throughput, workload characteristics, capacity, power, thermal state, maintenance activity, and other operational constraints.

The resulting capability improves outcomes in two directions. For AI users, it provides better workload placement, lower queue times, higher GPU utilization, stronger job-success rates, improved end-to-end throughput, and faster time-to-results. For AI-factory and grid operators, it serves as a technical shock absorber by making demand more observable, controllable, schedulable, and responsive to infrastructure availability, system health, power, thermal, capacity, and operational conditions.

The role will work closely with other AI engineers, inference and optimization engineers, the Model-to-Grid product and program lead, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and operations teams. It will turn scheduler product requirements into robust production capabilities, integrating Kubernetes, custom controllers, APIs, observability, automation, workload recipes, benchmark signals, and supporting platform services. The work will align with the architectural direction of NVIDIA DSX OS and AI Factory Blueprint concepts - co-designed, resilient, multi-tenant AI-factory operations, while delivering the organization’s proprietary scheduler intelligence and differentiated Model-to-Grid capabilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, operate, and continuously improve the proprietary Kubernetes-native job scheduling platform for AI workloads.
  • Develop scheduler architecture, custom resource definitions, Kubernetes controllers, admission webhooks, scheduling plugins, APIs, CLI tools, and automation required to support workload submission, placement, execution, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Define and implement scheduling policies for training, fine-tuning, inference, benchmarking, batch, data-processing, and agentic workloads.
  • Build topology-aware placement mechanisms that account for GPU locality, NVLink/NVSwitch domains, node topology, NUMA affinity, NIC placement, RDMA paths, network-fabric topology, storage locality, and fault-domain boundaries.
  • Build AI-factory resource-aware scheduling mechanisms that account for cluster capacity, node health, fabric condition, storage performance, GPU availability, maintenance windows, software compatibility, capacity reservations, power limits, thermal conditions, and operational constraints.
  • Implement workload-control capabilities including admission control, queueing, priorities, quotas, fair sharing, reservations, preemption, gang scheduling, co-scheduling, backfilling, workload aging, retry policies, checkpoint-aware scheduling, deferred execution, and failure recovery.
  • Develop workload demand-shaping and grid-aware controls that allow eligible workloads to be delayed, paced, prioritized, rescheduled, right-sized, or placed differently in response to capacity, health, power, thermal, maintenance, or other AI-factory operating signals.
  • Integrate the scheduler with Kubernetes control-plane capabilities, GPU device plugins, node-feature discovery, network and storage services, observability systems, and policy engines.
  • Integrate, where appropriate, with Slurm, Slinky, vCluster, Kueue, KAI, Volcano, YuniKorn, or related systems to deliver a coherent workload-management experience across AI and HPC use cases.
  • Build a stable developer and user experience for workload submission and management, including APIs, SDKs, CLI workflows, templates, workload definitions, job-status visibility, event streams, scheduling explanations, and self-service troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Work with AI and inference engineers to encode validated model and workload recipes into scheduler-aware templates, including requirements for model size, precision, distributed parallelism, GPU count, topology, network, storage, runtime, benchmark target, and expected resource profile.
  • Enable Model-to-Grid benchmarking by exposing scheduler, placement, resource, and workload-lifecycle data for end-to-end analysis across models, runtimes, GPUs, network, storage, power, thermals, and application performance.
  • Build observability into the scheduling platform, including queue depth, scheduling latency, admission outcomes, placement decisions, resource fragmentation, topology quality, GPU utilization, job lifecycle, failure reasons, preemption events, retry behavior, power and thermal signals, and workload performance.
  • Develop actionable scheduler explanations and operator views that show why a workload was queued, admitted, placed, deferred, preempted, or rescheduled and what changes could improve execution outcomes.
  • Establish performance testing, load testing, scale testing, chaos testing, fault recovery testing, and regression testing for scheduler components and Kubernetes platform integrations.
  • Operate production Kubernetes clusters and associated scheduling services with strong reliability, security, change-management, backup, recovery, and incident-response practices.
  • Build CI/CD and GitOps workflows for scheduler code, configuration, CRDs, controllers, policy definitions, workload templates, and cluster-service releases.
  • Implement secure multi-tenancy and resource-governance controls, including namespace and tenant isolation, RBAC, quotas, workload identity, policy enforcement, audit trails, and controlled access to GPU, data, and infrastructure resources.
  • Partner with platform, infrastructure, networking, storage, and operations teams to ensure scheduler decisions reflect actual infrastructure capabilities, constraints, health, performance, maintenance, and capacity conditions.
  • Partner with the Model-to-Grid product and program lead to define scheduler feature scope, milestone plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, benchmark targets, documentation, and adoption measures.
  • Contribute to technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, design reviews, release readiness, incident postmortems, and continuous improvement of Model-to-Grid and AI-factory operations.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or comparable software and systems-engineering roles.
  • Deep practical expertise in Kubernetes architecture and operations, including control planes, scheduling, controllers, operators, CRDs, admission controllers, APIs, networking, storage, security, and multi-tenancy.
  • Demonstrated experience building, extending, or deeply integrating workload schedulers, resource managers, or orchestration systems, such as Kubernetes Scheduler Framework, Kueue, KAI, Volcano, YuniKorn, Slurm, Slinky, Run:ai, or proprietary implementations.
  • Strong programming skills in Go, with Python proficiency for automation, integration, tooling, and performance analysis.
  • Experience building production Kubernetes controllers, operators, scheduling plugins, admission webhooks, REST or gRPC APIs, CLI tools, and event-driven distributed services.
  • Strong understanding of GPU-accelerated AI/ML workloads, including distributed training, fine-tuning, model serving, inference, benchmarking, and batch processing.
  • Practical experience with GPU scheduling and resource allocation, including GPU partitioning, MIG where applicable, GPU affinity, multi-GPU workloads, gang scheduling, and topology-aware placement.
  • Understanding of GPU system topology and high-performance AI networking, including NVLink, NVSwitch, PCIe, NUMA, RDMA, RoCEv2, NIC affinity, collective communication, and network contention.
  • Familiarity with large-scale NVIDIA GPU architectures, including NVL72 GB300-class systems and future-generation high-density GPU platforms, and their implications for cluster scheduling, workload placement, network topology, operations, and fault handling.
  • Experience working with storage and data-path considerations for AI workloads, including high-throughput shared file systems, object storage, caching, data locality, checkpointing, and storage-performance constraints.
  • Understanding of AI-factory or data-center operations, including capacity planning, workload demand forecasting, power-aware scheduling, energy efficiency, thermal constraints, maintenance coordination, system health, resiliency, and infrastructure telemetry.
  • Experience with observability and performance analysis using tools and concepts such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, logs, traces, metrics, DCGM, GPU telemetry, network telemetry, workload profiling, and SLOs.
  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, infrastructure as code, policy as code, and safe production rollout practices using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo CD, Flux, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize, OPA, or Kyverno.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native security practices, including container security, image signing, software supply-chain controls, secrets management, RBAC, workload identity, network policies, runtime security, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Kubernetes, distributed systems, GPU workloads, networking, storage, operating systems, and application-level job execution.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Kubernetes scheduler and controller engineering.
  • Distributed systems architecture, reliability, and performance engineering.
  • GPU workload orchestration for training, inference, benchmarking, and AI applications.
  • Network-topology-aware and AI-factory-resource-aware workload placement.
  • Deep understanding of the relationship between workload intent, model configuration, runtime behavior, GPU topology, network, storage, and end-to-end performance.
  • Model-to-Grid engineering: connecting AI demand, scheduler decisions, benchmark data, infrastructure telemetry, and AI-factory operating constraints.
  • Multi-objective scheduling design across user throughput, latency, time-to-results, utilization, fairness, cost, power, energy, resilience, and grid or operator constraints.
  • Developer experience for AI workload submission, templates, APIs, observability, and troubleshooting.
  • Production ownership, incident response, change control, testing discipline, and operational excellence.
  • Security-conscious multi-tenant platform engineering.
  • Pragmatic architecture and technical decision-making under evolving hardware, software, and operational constraints.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with AI, applications, platform, infrastructure, networking, storage, security, operations, and product teams.
  • Delivery and adoption of a reliable proprietary Kubernetes-native scheduler that supports the AI & Applications team’s Model-to-Grid product roadmap.
  • Scheduler availability, reliability, recovery performance, and successful completion of scheduled workload operations.
  • Improvement in end-user workload outcomes, including lower queue time, reduced time-to-start, improved placement quality, increased job completion rate, faster time-to-results, higher training scaling efficiency, and improved inference throughput and latency.
  • Improvement in AI-factory resource efficiency, including GPU utilization, reduced resource fragmentation, improved multi-node placement, increased cluster throughput, more effective capacity use, and reduced avoidable network or storage contention.
  • Percentage of eligible workloads scheduled using topology-aware placement policies that account for GPU, NVLink/NVSwitch, network, RDMA, node, storage, and fault-domain characteristics.
  • Percentage of eligible workloads scheduled using AI-factory-resource-aware policies incorporating relevant capacity, health, maintenance, power, thermal, storage, or fabric signals.
  • Measurable accuracy and effectiveness of scheduler placement and admission decisions, based on workload performance relative to expected benchmarks, queue-time outcomes, job-success rate, resource utilization, user overrides, and operator intervention rates.
  • Reduction in manual scheduling, workload-placement, capacity-allocation, and operational-triage effort for users and AI-factory operators.
  • Quality and adoption of scheduler APIs, CLI tools, workload templates, model recipes, self-service workflows, scheduling explanations, and developer documentation.
  • Coverage and quality of scheduler observability, including end-to-end visibility of workload demand, queue state, scheduling decisions, placement rationale, resource use, failure modes, topology signals, and operational constraints.
  • Successful integration of scheduler telemetry and policy outcomes into Model-to-Grid benchmarking, capacity planning, performance optimization, and operator-facing insights.

job.title: Procurement Manager
job.description:
Procurement Manager – Property Operations

Join Goodman in a broad, hands-on procurement role where you’ll support the day-to-day delivery of procurement, supplier management and contract governance across our Australian property operations portfolio.

Working closely with Property, Building Services, Technical Services and other subject matter experts, this role supports procurement activity across services, minor works, OPEX and CAPEX, helping to bring structure, consistency and practical follow-through across a large operational environment.

This is not a narrow category specialist role. You will act as a practical “one stop shop” for procurement support across the portfolio, balancing commercial outcomes, compliance, service quality and stakeholder needs while helping to manage supplier performance, contract records, purchase-to-pay processes and outsourced procurement support.

What you’ll be doing

  • Support end-to-end procurement activity across service contracts, minor works, supplier engagements and day-to-day procurement requests.
  • Work with internal teams to prepare scopes, coordinate sourcing activity, support commercial evaluations and document approvals.
  • Manage supplier and contractor relationships, including performance, escalation, non-conformance and improvement actions.
  • Support contract administration, procurement governance and accurate contract records.
  • Manage purchase-to-pay activity through Yardi, including purchase orders, approvals, invoicing and process improvements.
  • Oversee the day-to-day relationship with Goodman’s outsourced procurement support partner, including service levels, quality, KPIs and issue resolution.
  • Help develop and embed supplier performance scorecards, review cadences and contractor management frameworks.
  • Provide practical reporting and insights on supplier performance, contract risk, BPO delivery, budget tracking and cost optimisation.

What we’re looking for

You’ll bring hands-on procurement, contract management or supplier management experience, ideally from a property, facilities, building services, infrastructure or operational services environment. You will be comfortable working across services, minor works, OPEX and CAPEX, and know how to manage suppliers in a live operating environment.

This role will suit someone who enjoys being close to the business, can bring order to busy operational settings, and is confident following procurement activity through from request to resolution.

  • Approximately 5+ years’ experience in procurement, contract management, supplier management or a related commercial role.
  • Experience supporting service categories such as cleaning, security, waste, grounds, mechanical, electrical, fire services or minor works.
  • Strong commercial judgement, negotiation skills and confidence working with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience with supplier performance, contract compliance, non-conformance or contractor management processes.
  • Understanding of purchase-to-pay processes, ideally using Yardi or a similar property or ERP system.
  • Experience managing outsourced partners, shared services or BPO arrangements would be highly regarded.
  • High attention to detail, strong organisation skills and a practical, solutions-focused approach.
  • The confidence to work independently across a broad portfolio while building strong relationships across the business.

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

job.title: Director, Pre-Construction, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

#

Position Overview

Vantage Data Centers is looking for a Director, Pre-Construction, APAC to provide overall pre-construction leadership for the growing Design, Engineering and Construction team and key internal partners, including New Site Development (NSD) and Site Selection (SSA), as the company expands across the region.

This role will be responsible for new and existing developments across new and existing sites, Working with Stakeholder teams on Due Diligence works on new sites, providing Design and Construction inputs (through consultation with the DE&C Teams), development of concept and schematic design with the Engineering team, Assisting with Consultant engagements and on-boarding, entitlement and permitting, and all aspects of pre-construction with general contractors and Project Management teams.

As a leader, this position will work seamlessly with multiple projects and teams, ensuring all pre-construction activities are aligned with strategic corporate objectives and supporting successful project delivery from early development through construction readiness.

# Essential Job Functions

Lead development and planning approval processes, including master and precinct planning, development planning, and construction permitting

Support utilities provisioning negotiations, with particular emphasis on power and networking provision with the NSD team

Partner with project teams to resolve data center designs that deliver Tier III data centers at optimal cost and in alignment with design parameters

Work with the Project Controls team to advise on programme, cost, buildability, regional statutory, consultant, and Early Contractor Involvement (ECI).

Manage Vantage’s build partners through technical feedback, review, and active participation in schedule and budget management during the pre-construction phase.

Duties

  • Assist with procurement and tender strategy for professional services, works, and where applicable, supply contracts for significant plant and equipment in partnership with the APAC OFCI team
  • Work with Project Controls on pre-construction programmes and micro-programmes, and contribute to the master construction programme
  • Work with general contractors, architects, and engineers to lead the project ECI phase
  • Manage direct reports, third-party project management resources, and staffing utilization
  • Create and manage RFPs for consultants and providers
  • Obtain project budgets, working with the Construction Commercial Team
  • Partner with stakeholders in Construction Cost and Finance to produce monthly project forecasts, including variance analyses
  • Ensure lessons learned are captured and placed into the feedback loop to drive continuous improvement

#

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or similar field, or equivalent experience
  • 7 to 10 years of experience in a management role required; 10 to 15 years preferred
  • Complex and technical construction experience required
  • Data center experience preferred
  • Experience in CSA and MEP construction management required
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools such as MS Project or P6
  • Experience developing executive-level presentations
  • Substantial project management experience preferred; PMP certification

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

job.title: Associate Critical Environment Technician
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia’s leading data centres.

  • Canberra's team is expanding with a new Data Centre. Join our team as we continue to grow in 2026.
  • Critical Infrastructure experience or HVAC or Electrical trades are desired
  • Tailored CDC Academy and hands-on training provided

About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are responsive, innovative and trusted in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

At CDC, our Critical Environment Technicians work hands-on in live data centres, supporting the day-to-day operation of mission critical infrastructure. This is a site-based role focused on planned works, maintenance, site logistics, and overall reliability during business hours.

You’ll play a key role in delivering technical facilities management — coordinating maintenance, managing site operations, and responding to incidents to keep our environments safe, secure, and always on.

If you’ve worked in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, much of this will feel familiar. The difference is the scale, the environment, and the opportunity to step into a stable, high-growth industry.

You’ll be part of CDC’s Operations team — on the ground every day, working closely together to deliver a strong customer experience and keep our facilities running at their best.

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day:

  • Monitoring and responding to alarms and alerts across power, cooling, and fire systems
  • Performing physical inspections to ensure equipment and infrastructure are operating within defined parameters
  • Responding to faults and incidents, prioritising actions, and determining when escalation or contractor support is required
  • Carrying out operational switching and control activities to prevent unplanned outages
  • Supporting planned maintenance and monitoring contractors on site, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures and approved methods of operation
  • Documenting incidents, maintenance activities, and observations to support continuous improvement

Benefits, Training and Offerings:

Our training program provides tailored content through our CDC Academy, specifically designed for individuals starting out in this role. You'll learn hands-on by shadowing and working alongside our experienced Service Technicians, gaining essential knowledge to develop your skillset.

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

You have experience working in environments where reliability, safety, and procedure matter - whether that’s through an electrical, HVAC, mechanical, or broader critical infrastructure background.

You might be a qualified electrician or HVAC technician looking to move away from a traditional tools‑based role and into operations, or someone in their technical career who is curious about how large‑scale, mission‑critical environments operate.

Regardless of background, we value motivation, strong attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and develop within a growing industry.

Desirable experience:

  • A trade or technical background in Electrical, Refrigeration/HVAC, Mechanical, or a related field (highly desirable)
  • Experience working in critical or high‑availability environments with strong safety and compliance requirements
  • Exposure to monitoring or control systems such as BMS, EMS, or SCADA‑type platforms
  • Familiarity with complex infrastructure or plant equipment (e.g. HVAC systems, power systems, generators, fire systems)
  • Strong fault‑finding, problem‑solving, and situational awareness skills
  • The ability to produce clear documentation, logs, and post‑incident reports

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

Closing Date: Applications close 11:59pm 27th of September 2026

job.title: Facilities Coordinator
job.description:
About Us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

This is an integral role, based out of our Hume data centre campus in Canberra - the successful candidate will be essential in managing the day-to-day logistics, overseeing site maintenance, physical security, and facility presentation through a range of administrative and scheduling activities. Joining a dedicated facilities team, and alongside other facilities coordinators, you will work closely with CDC operations to deliver a superior customer experience and uphold secure, uninterrupted facility maintenance. This role involves overseeing a range of scheduling tasks and providing hands-on site support to ensure the continuous operation of our site.

  • Ensure all facilities maintenance activities adhere to approved workplans, maintaining building compliance.
  • Liaise and coordinate with contracted staff to ensure efficient and accurate works are completed, across a range of verticals (e.g. structural, plumbing, regular facilities).
  • Ensure adherence to emergency and health and safety regulations, aligned to CDC policy.
  • Manage logistics within the facility, collaborating with the operations team to enforce security protocols and standards.
  • Conduct inspections for repairs or renovations of facility structures (such as lifts, pressure vessels, fire compliance, stormwater + plumbing), coordinating access for clients, guests, contractors, and suppliers accordingly.
  • Promote and enforce safe work practices, ensure strong presentation and upkeep standards, representing the company professionally.

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy - Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About you

Ideally, you'll bring experience in facilities, property, or building operations, with exposure to base building services, planned and reactive maintenance, and contractor management. Experience with DLP (Defects Liability Period) management and coordinating building compliance and safety obligations will be highly regarded.

This role works closely with customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders, so strong communication and relationship-building skills are essential. We're seeking someone who is organised, solutions-focused, and excited by the opportunity to join a growing and dynamic team.

  • Experience in scheduling or coordinating contractors and external vendors.
  • Excellent organisational and administrative skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  • Confident in MS Office, and tech savvy in nature to pick up internal systems.
  • Demonstrated experience in Property Management, Facilities Management, Office Management or Security Management.
  • Confident communicator, with the ability to speak to stakeholders of varying seniority levels.
  • Experience in identifying and managing building defects, with a strong understanding of compliance and rectification processes is highly desirable.

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and encourages everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: Operations Governance Manager

job.title: Research and Development Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Vertiv is seeking a Research and Development Engineer to join our high-density liquid cooling R&D team in Edenbridge, UK. The successful candidate will independently lead test design, experimental analysis, and development of next-generation liquid cooling solutions for data centre and critical infrastructure applications. This role involves hands-on laboratory work, test rig design and commissioning, data acquisition and analysis, and active collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams to advance Vertiv's thermal management product portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Design, set up, operate, and maintain liquid cooling test rigs and experimental apparatus in accordance with Vertiv Engineering SOPs and Standard Work procedures.
  • Lead and execute product performance test design and validation protocols for high-density liquid cooling systems, including cold plate assemblies, coolant distribution units (CDUs), and rear-door heat exchangers.
  • Independently collect, record, and analyse test data, drawing conclusions and presenting findings using data acquisition systems, ensuring accuracy and traceability per Vertiv's Item and Item Structure Management SOP (PLM-ISM-SOP-001).
  • Design and prepare test apparatus and instrumentation setups for R&D experiments, ensuring alignment with defined test objectives
  • Perform routine calibration and maintenance of laboratory instruments, pressure transducers, flow meters, thermocouples, and data acquisition tools.
  • Lead the development and documentation of test procedures, work instructions, and standard operating procedures aligned with Vertiv's Model-Based Definition (MBD) process
  • Maintain laboratory housekeeping standards, ensuring cleanliness and compliance with workmanship standards (processes, tools, materials, discipline, and cleanliness)
  • Lead prototype assembly, leak testing, pressure testing and functional operation of liquid cooling components, coordinating with senior engineers as required.
  • Comply with Vertiv's Electrical Safety Programme requirements, including proper use of PPE, risk assessments, and Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) procedures when working with energised test equipment.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to Standard Work development as outlined in the VOS Global Procedure.
  • Independently compile, analyse, and present test results, anomalies, and technical observations to the R&D engineering team in a timely manner.
  • Lead and support ECN (Engineering Change Notice) release processes and configuration management activities.

Requirements

Education

  • BEng (Hons) or HNC/HND (Level 4/5) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.

Experience

  • Ideally, previous engineering R&D or relevant field experience, with demonstrated ability to independently plan and conduct experiments.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with hydraulic/fluid systems, including pumps, valves, heat exchangers, and piping assemblies.
  • Proficiency in using data acquisition systems and laboratory instrumentation (thermocouples, pressure sensors, flow meters, power quality analysis).
  • Competence in reading and interpreting engineering drawings and technical specifications.
  • Solid understanding of heat transfer principles and fluid dynamics, with ability to apply theory to experimental design.
  • Familiarity with electrical safety practices for test environments.
  • Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications and data analysis tools.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative R&D team.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proactive approach to health and safety compliance.
  • Proven ability to independently solve engineering problems and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Nice to have

  • Foundation Degree or BEng (Hons) in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with liquid cooling systems, thermal management, or HVAC/R technologies.
  • Experience with programming languages (Python, Labview).
  • Knowledge of CAD software (Creo Parametric or equivalent) for reviewing 3D models and assemblies.
  • Experience with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems, particularly Oracle Product Development Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Lean manufacturing principles and Standard Work methodologies.
  • IOSH Managing Safely or NEBOSH General Certificate.
  • 18th Edition IET Wiring Regulations (BS 7671) awareness.
  • Experience working in a data centre or critical infrastructure environment.

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, you can request help by sending an email to [help.join@vertiv.com](mailto:help.join@vertiv.com)

job.title: Technical Service Delivery Director
job.description:
Milan, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

This position is based in Milan, Italy.

The Service Delivery Director is responsible for end-to-end delivery of telco and ICT services, ensuring services are delivered on time, within budget, and in line with agreed service levels and customer expectations.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership across Project and Service Management, driving service excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement for enterprise and/or wholesale customers.

Service Delivery Leadership

  • Own end-to-end service delivery performance across telco and ICT portfolios (e.g. fixed line network services, cloud, cybersecurity, managed services, unified communications).
  • Act as executive sponsor for key customer accounts, ensuring strong governance, escalation management, and relationship management.
  • Ensure service delivery aligns with commercial commitments, contractual SLAs, and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive a customer-centric culture focused on service quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

2. Project Management Oversight

  • Provide executive oversight of all delivery projects, including telco provisioning, network rollout, ICT transformation, service onboarding, and customer migrations.
  • Establish and govern a standardized Project Management framework (e.g. waterfall, agile, hybrid).
  • Ensure strong project governance, risk management, dependency management, and financial control.
  • Monitor delivery KPIs such as schedule adherence, cost variance, scope control, and benefits realization.
  • Intervene proactively on at-risk or critical projects to ensure successful outcomes.

3. Service Management & Operations

  • Lead Service Management functions aligned to ITIL / ISO 20000 best practices, including:
  • Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management
  • Service Level Management
  • Capacity, Availability, and Continuity Management
  • Ensure operational readiness for new services and smooth transition from project to BAU.
  • Oversee 24/7 operational support models (internal teams and/or vendors).
  • Drive service stability, reduction of repeat incidents, and improved MTTR and SLA compliance.

4. Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Establish service delivery governance frameworks, forums, and reporting structures.
  • Ensure compliance with security, data privacy, and regulatory standards relevant to telco and ICT services.
  • Manage vendor and partner performance, including SLAs, OLAs, and contractual obligations.
  • Oversee audit readiness and remediation of service delivery risks.

5. Financial & Commercial Management

  • Own service delivery budgets, cost optimisation initiatives, and financial forecasting.
  • Ensure delivery efficiency while protecting margins and supporting revenue growth.
  • Support pre-sales and bid activities by shaping delivery models, cost estimates, and risk assessments.
  • Drive productivity improvements through automation, tooling, and process optimisation.

6. People & Capability Leadership

  • Lead and develop high-performing teams across project management, service management, and operations.
  • Build succession plans and capability uplift in areas such as cloud, cybersecurity, automation, and digital service delivery.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Set clear performance objectives and manage talent development.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
  • 15+ years of experience in telco/ICT service delivery, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles.
  • Proven track record in managing large-scale service delivery portfolios and complex ICT/telco projects.
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL, ISO 20000, and project management methodologies (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, optimize costs, and drive revenue-supporting initiatives.
  • Experience in vendor/partner management and regulatory compliance.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive-level presentation skills.

job.title: Remediation Specialist
job.description:
What You'll Do

  • Assess and investigate customer cases across remediation programs, executive escalations, TIO disputes, Financial Counsellor referrals and other complex customer matters.
  • Review and analyse high-profile cases, develop remediation recommendations and present outcomes to senior stakeholders where required.
  • Lead complex investigations and collaborate with Quality Control, Regulatory, Legal and operational teams to ensure appropriate customer outcomes.
  • Champion the customer voice by identifying vulnerability, assessing customer impact and recommending fair and transparent resolutions.
  • Identify root causes and systemic issues, translating insights into improvements across processes, controls and customer experience.
  • Support proactive remediation initiatives while ensuring outcomes align with regulatory obligations and customer expectations.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years' experience in a dedicated remediation, complaints, dispute resolution or customer advocacy role managing complex cases end-to-end.
  • Proven experience identifying root causes, applying remediation frameworks and delivering fair outcomes for customers.
  • Strong experience managing escalated and sensitive customer matters with sound judgement, empathy and resilience.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple business areas and senior leadership groups.

job.title: Security Design and Integration Manager - India
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

The Security Design and Integration Manager will drive efforts in securing data centers across India and will be based out of Mumbai, or Hyderabad, working in a remote setup.

This role supports the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects in the region, from early design through commissioning and turnover, and oversees compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards across security design, integration, implementation, and programming. The role also supports the integration of EdgeConneX security and customer security efforts, ensuring compliance with all applicable standards. Successful execution requires strong navigation of local construction practices, regulatory authorities, and stakeholder dynamics, and the ability to build durable working relationships with sophisticated enterprise customers. This position is customer-facing and must uphold the ideals of EdgeConneX excellence.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects across from early design through commissioning and site turnover and oversee compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards throughout.
  • Serve as subject matter expert (SME) on EdgeConneX requirements and physical security standards, providing authoritative guidance to project teams, delivery partners, and stakeholders.
  • Support the definition of project security requirements and acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment to EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer expectations.
  • Support procurement and provide technical oversight of security designers, integrators, and programmers.
  • Review security designs and submittals produced by integration partners for compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercoms, and related field devices.
  • Liaise with customer security teams and local construction teams to align AdaniConneX project delivery with EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer-specific requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate and liaise with both AdaniConneX stakeholders and customer subject matter experts (SMEs) to align on security requirements, resolve issues, and maintain a shared understanding throughout delivery.
  • Oversight of physical security systems, including S2, Lenel, and Genetec systems.
  • Validate installation and configuration quality through quality checks, site walks, and commissioning reviews; audit security contractors on quality, schedule, and compliance.
  • Support closure of design gaps, defects, and punch items, including verification of corrective actions.
  • Adapt EdgeConneX baseline standards to local conditions and to authorities holding jurisdiction in India.
  • Maintain documentation quality, including design drawings, as-built records, test results, configuration records, and turnover packages.
  • Provide estimating and budgeting inputs for physical security systems when requested.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations on site turnover and operational acceptance.
  • Participate in shaping Security Design and Integration global standards and processes, and improve standards, templates, and repeatable design patterns to reduce rework and improve consistency across the portfolio.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong technical understanding of physical security systems and integration methods.
  • Ability to evaluate designs quickly, identify gaps, and make practical decisions under delivery pressure.
  • Strong vendor management sets expectations, enforces baseline requirements, and holds delivery partners accountable.
  • Strong communications, both written and verbal, in leading teams and coordinating with peers and other disciplines on driving projects and issues to closure.
  • Clear communicator who can translate technical requirements into simple, executable direction for integration partners and internal project teams.
  • Customer-facing presence; able to represent EdgeConneX professionally with sophisticated enterprise customers and sustain alignment through extended ramp and onboarding cycles.
  • Strong and effective team player working across various disciplines and peer groups; able to cover the full range of tasks required to get the job done.
  • Superb ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Disciplined execution: tracking, documentation, follow-through, and closure.
  • Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders in a multilingual Indian environment without losing attention to detail.
  • Commitment to organizational excellence and constant awareness of opportunities to improve processes and quality of deliverables.
  • Superb ability to work independently while adhering to standards.
  • Ability to use computer systems related to security management and reporting.

Experience / Education

  • 3+ years of experience in physical security design, systems integration, or physical security program delivery.
  • Minimum 2 of those years managing large-scale security design and installation projects.
  • Experience supporting critical infrastructure environments; Data center experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience delivering in India or the broader APAC region, including working knowledge of local construction practices and jurisdictional security requirements.
  • Experience working with technical drawings and standard construction deliverables such as submittals, requests for information, and as-built documentation.
  • A working knowledge or ability to learn: PCI/DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 certifications, as well as AutoCAD and associated drawing programs.
  • Candidates with experience in S2, Lenel, ExacqVision and/or Genetec are highly encouraged to apply.
  • Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Physical Security Professional (PSP), or equivalent certification preferred, or willingness to pursue.
  • Fluent in English required; proficiency in Hindi or additional Indian regional languages a plus.

job.title: Energy Portfolio Analyst (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Energy Analyst – Markets & Sustainability is a key role within STACK’s Power & Energy team, responsible for energy accounting, consumption forecasting, utility cost validation and administration of STACK’s electricity supply and renewable energy arrangements across its Australian portfolio.

The role will establish and maintain accurate visibility of energy consumption, cost and forecast demand across STACK’s data centres, providing the data and analysis required to support energy procurement, budgeting, sustainability reporting and business decision-making.

The Energy Analyst will also manage day-to-day interfaces with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and DNSPs, administer energy contracts and renewable energy certificate requirements, and support the implementation and ongoing management of STACK’s energy accounting systems.

This role will work closely with Power & Energy, Finance, Operations and other relevant stakeholders to ensure energy data, costs and forecasts are accurate, transparent and effectively managed.

Energy Accounting, Forecasting & Analytics

  • Manage energy forecasting across STACK’s Australian data centre portfolio, including validation of electricity invoices against metering data, contracted rates, network tariffs and applicable charges.
  • Investigate billing and consumption discrepancies and coordinate resolution with retailers, Metering Service Providers, DNSPs and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain short-, medium- and long-term electricity consumption forecasts, incorporating actual and forecast data centre load growth.
  • Track actual energy consumption and cost against forecast, identify material variances and provide supporting analysis.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards covering energy consumption, cost, forecasts and other relevant energy metrics.
  • Support Finance with energy accruals, budgeting, reconciliations and energy-related financial reporting.

Energy Markets, Contracts & Stakeholder Administration

  • Support administration of electricity retail contracts, PPAs, metering arrangements and other energy-related agreements.
  • Maintain a central register of energy contracts, key dates, pricing arrangements, obligations and renewal requirements.
  • Manage day-to-day interfaces with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and DNSPs relating to billing, metering, consumption data and account administration.
  • Coordinate LGC and other renewable energy certificate surrender requirements, including tracking, reconciliation and supporting evidence.
  • Support electricity procurement activities, retailer engagements, contract renewals and commercial evaluations.
  • Analyse consumption profiles, tariffs and energy costs to support procurement and portfolio decisions.

Energy Systems, Sustainability Reporting & Business Support

  • Support selection, implementation and ongoing administration of STACK’s energy accounting and energy management software, including integration of retailer, metering and internal energy data.
  • Maintain appropriate data-quality, validation and reconciliation processes across energy systems and reporting.
  • Provide accurate energy consumption, renewable energy and supporting data inputs into NABERS, NGER, renewable energy indices and other applicable sustainability and regulatory reporting.
  • Support establishment of energy accounting, metering and reporting processes for new and expanding data centre sites.
  • Identify opportunities to automate and improve energy data collection, invoice validation, forecasting and reporting.
  • Provide ad hoc energy analysis and administrative support as STACK’s energy procurement, sustainability and portfolio requirements continue to evolve.

Competencies

  • Strong numerical, analytical and data-management capability.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify billing and data discrepancies.
  • Understanding of electricity billing, metering, network tariffs and retail electricity arrangements.
  • Strong Excel/ Power BI and data-analysis capability.
  • Ability to develop clear forecasts, dashboards and management reporting.
  • Strong organisational and contract-administration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple external service providers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and establish processes within a developing function.
  • Commercial mindset and interest in Australian electricity markets and renewable energy.

Travel Required

Travel within Australia and, from time to time, internationally to support STACK projects, stakeholder meetings, technical reviews, workshops and commissioning activities.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Energy or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3–5 years’ relevant experience in energy, utilities, energy accounting, commercial analysis, finance or a related field.
  • Experience working with electricity invoices, utility accounts, energy data or metering information.
  • Experience with forecasting, budgeting, reconciliation or management reporting.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience analysing large datasets.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to manage recurring analytical and administrative processes.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience within the Australian electricity market.
  • Experience with large commercial and industrial electricity customers.
  • Experience working with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and/or DNSPs.
  • Understanding of NEM metering and electricity settlement data.
  • Experience with energy accounting or energy management software.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar data visualisation tools.
  • Understanding of LGCs, renewable energy certificates and renewable electricity procurement.
  • Exposure to electricity retail contracts, PPAs or energy procurement.
  • Familiarity with NABERS, NGER and renewable energy / sustainability reporting frameworks.
  • Data centre or other large energy-user experience would be highly regarded experience with 132 kV, 220 kV, 275 kV, 330 kV or higher-voltage systems.
  • Experience with Australian TNSPs/DNSPs and contestable assets.
  • Experience with hyperscale data centres or large industrial loads.
  • Experience with BESS and renewable-energy infrastructure.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

job.title: Electrical & Electronics VAVE - Product Testing
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description forEngineer – Product Testing(VAVE)

Job Description

Coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform testing and validation of VAVE-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
  • Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post-cost optimization.
  • Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
  • Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
  • Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
  • Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
  • Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
  • Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.

Job Specifications:

  • Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Experience: 5 to 6 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).
  • Hands-on experience in automation testing tools and programming for test systems.
  • Strong understanding of analog and digital circuits, power conversion principles, and common topologies.
  • Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
  • Familiarity with VAVE methodology, cost optimization principles, and supplier component qualification.
  • Proactive, analytical, and result-oriented, with the ability to think critically and solve problems independently.
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal in English).

Key Skills:

  • VAVE (Value Analysis & Value Engineering) implementation and testing
  • Power electronics testing (AC/DC, DC/DC, UPS)
  • Automation testing and scripting
  • Analog & digital electronics troubleshooting
  • Compliance & certification validation (UL, CE)
  • Test plan creation and execution
  • Cost optimization validation techniques
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis
  • Hands-on test and measurement capability (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, etc.)

About the Team

Work Authorization

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Technical Project Lead
job.description:
Job Description

Technical Project Lead (Energy Storage)

Pune, India

Job Description

Job Summary

The Technical Project Lead works with the offering management team to refine product requirements and turn them into product specifications that drive cross-functional team development. This role leads the development teams through the NPD process cycle at a technical level (as opposed to high-level program management) to make sure the end product meets the requirements.

This role will focus on Vertiv Energy Storage product line offerings. The individual will be responsible for understanding product requirements and developing technical product specifications that will drive the cross-functional development teams. This role works through the entire product development cycle to make sure the R&D team stays on schedule and meets the original market requirements. Close collaboration between offering management, system engineering, mechanical engineering, product engineering, firmware engineering, agency compliance, and product integrity teams.

Responsibilities

  • Drive requirements refinement, specification development, and task tracking through iterative review cycles.
  • Hold authority on system design decisions as they pertain to meeting market requirements for energy storage products.
  • Translate detailed technical development plans into simplified project milestones for executive tracking purposes.
  • Must track development progress vs plan and manage resource needs to stay on schedule.
  • Provide technical support and leadership to product development teams as the first step in the escalation path if issues or questions arise. Escalate major issues to the appropriate resources and pursue to closure.
  • Work with cross-functional teams (Offering Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/System Engineering, Firmware Engineering, Engineering Test) to create development plans and strategy and bring products from ideation to concept and market launch. Example development stages:
  • Requirements definition and enrichment by collaborating with cross-functional teams (Service, Sales, Manufacturing, etc.)
  • Detailed specification breakdown and work/task breakdown based on higher-level requirements
  • Concept development and refinement
  • Validation test planning and prototype planning
  • Full product or platform development and release into the PLM system
  • Prototype part ordering and local assembly
  • Prototype validation testing
  • Final conformance to specification checks and manufacturing handoff
  • Track and report on team and individual performance to management and executive leadership.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering ( Electrical preferred)
  • 3–4 years of relevant experience in project management on power converters, energy storage, and electrical engineering
  • SMC (Scrum Master Certification) not required, but a plus
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) not required, but a plus
  • Prefer experience with power conversion, battery energy storage systems (BESS), or related power electronics product development

job.title: SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting.
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Accounting & Reporting Manager - General Accounting ###

SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting.

Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences.

You will be working as SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and will be reporting to Accounting & Reporting Manager – GA and will be a part of Bangalore, India. In this role you will be primarily responsible for End-to-End Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and Internal Audit and Process Improvements and automation Process as SME or team focused on the complete, accurate, and timely completion of Fixed Assets & Reporting and related activities within the General Accounting (GA) team. Ensure compliance with internal guidelines and procedures as well as external regulatory requirements with strong understanding of USGAP and FA Module.

Fixed Asset Accounting Operations

  • Manage end-to-end fixed asset accounting processes.
  • Ensure accurate capitalization, transfers, retirements, disposals, and depreciation of assets.
  • Review and approve asset creation requests in compliance with accounting policies.
  • Maintain the fixed asset register and ensure completeness and accuracy.
  • Monitor Construction-in-Progress (CIP) accounting and capitalization activities.

Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

  • Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end fixed asset close activities.
  • Review depreciation runs and accounting entries.
  • Prepare and validate fixed asset reconciliations between subledger and general ledger.
  • Support financial statement disclosures related to Property, Plant & Equipment (PP&E).
  • Analyze asset balances and investigate significant movements.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure compliance with IFRS, US GAAP, local statutory requirements, and company accounting policies.
  • Maintain SOX/internal control documentation and evidence.
  • Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions.
  • Support internal and external audits through timely preparation of schedules and explanations.

Asset Lifecycle Management

  • Govern the complete asset lifecycle from acquisition to disposal.
  • Ensure appropriate asset classification and useful life assignment.
  • Review impairment assessments and asset write-offs.
  • Monitor leased assets and right-of-use assets where applicable.

Reconciliation & Data Quality

  • Perform periodic asset register reviews and reconciliations.
  • Resolve discrepancies between procurement, project accounting, and fixed assets records.
  • Ensure asset master data accuracy and integrity.
  • Develop and track key performance metrics related to fixed asset processes.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare management reports on capital expenditures, depreciation, asset additions, and disposals.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets.
  • Provide insights into capital investment trends and asset utilization.
  • Develop dashboards and report solutions for stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for fixed asset-related queries.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, Tax, Controllership, and Business Operations teams.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, statutory auditors, and tax advisors.
  • Provide guidance on fixed asset accounting treatments and policy interpretations.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify and drive process improvement initiatives.
  • Lead standardization and harmonization of fixed asset processes across entities.
  • Support system implementations, upgrades, and testing activities (e.g., SAP, Oracle, S4-HANA,Trintech)
  • Promote automation opportunities to improve efficiency and control.

SME Governance Responsibilities

  • Serve as the functional expert for fixed asset accounting.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members.
  • Provide guidance during transitions, migrations, and transformation projects.
  • Review complex accounting transactions and determine appropriate treatment.

Key Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of Fixed Assets Accounting, PP&E, Depreciation, Capitalization, and Asset Retirement.
  • Experience with IFRS, US GAAP, and internal controls.
  • ERP knowledge (SAP, Oracle,).
  • Advanced Excel and reporting skills.
  • Analytical problem-solving and stakeholder management.
  • Audit support and compliance expertise.
  • A master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce (MBA/Mcom) is must.
  • Minimum 10to 12 years of experience in Fixed Assets Accounting and Record to Report GA.
  • Experience leading teams in a shared service, GBS, or multinational environment.
  • Strong knowledge of working in SAP & FA Module.

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who deliver forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operate with the highest standards
