job.title: R2R and M&A Solution Lead
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of Central Finance ###

We are looking for an experienced and technically proficient M&A CFIN Architect to lead the design, integration, and optimization of finance solutions within the Central Finance (CFIN) landscape. This role is responsible for supporting any new company code, mergers, acquisitions, and divestments by ensuring that acquired entities are efficiently integrated into the target CFIN architecture in alignment with business objectives.

The CFIN M&A solution lead will assess the current-state finance and IT landscapes of acquired companies, define target-state architecture, and drive integration activities in CFIN system. The role requires close collaboration with Finance, IS Architecture, M&A integration teams, and external vendors to ensure seamless system integration, data consistency, process standardization, and compliance with ABB standards. The architect will also contribute to automation and optimization initiatives to improve testing automation and operational efficiency within the CFIN environment.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Delivery Leadership - Lead end-to-end delivery of R2R and M&A-related changes within CFIN from implementation through cutover and stabilization, Ensure delivery milestones, dependencies, risks and issues are actively managed and escalated where required, Drive successful deployment while protecting financial close, reporting and system stability
  • Team Leadership - Lead, mentor and develop the R2R and M&A Solution Architect team, Set clear priorities, accountabilities and delivery expectations across the team, Build strong functional capability and promote effective collaboration across workstreams
  • M&A & Legal Entity Delivery - Lead CFIN delivery for acquisitions, divestments, company-code onboarding and separation activities, Coordinate migration, mapping, reconciliation, testing, cutover and post-go-live activities, Ensure cross-functional dependencies with O2C, P2P, Treasury, Tax, MDG and technical teams are managed effectively
  • Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination - Work closely with Global Process Owners, Process Architects, M&A teams, Finance, MDG, technical teams and external partners, Ensure agreed designs and requirements are translated into executable delivery plans, Resolve delivery blockers and drive alignment across teams where ownership or dependencies span multiple areas
  • Delivery Assurance & Operational Readiness - Ensure solutions are fully tested, documented and operationally ready before deployment, Validate that agreed controls, reconciliation requirements and business acceptance criteria are met, Lead resolution of critical delivery and production issues during cutover and stabilization
  • Continuous Improvement - Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, automation and standardization across R2R and M&A activities, Drive reusable approaches for testing, migration, onboarding and cutover, Use lessons learned from previous deployments to improve future delivery.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science or a related field
  • 12–15+ years of SAP Finance experience with strong knowledge of SAP Central Finance and/or S/4HANA Finance
  • Strong functional expertise in Record-to-Report, including General Ledger, close, reconciliation, intercompany and financial reporting

job.title: Lead. Application Engineer I
job.description:
What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Building Automation System global projects as per country specific standards. Handling daily routine activities related to presales estimation support by preparing technical assessments. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify HVAC equipment, dampers and sensors.
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of sensors, control valves, dampers, air flow stations, controllers etc.
  • Preparation of Building Automation System network architecture
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables and on time deliveries.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self.

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics / Electronics & Communication.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Building Automation Industry, BMS Design Engineering.
  • Knowledge of HVAC systems like Chilled Water System, Cooling Towers, Primary & Secondary pumping systems, Hot Water System, Different types of AHUs, FCUs, VAV systems etc.
  • Strong knowledge of BMS architecture with different types of Operator workstations, Supervisory Controllers, DDC controllers, Sensors & Actuators etc.
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, LON, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols.
  • Must be proficient in wiring of starters, field devices, safety interlocks & panels.
  • Experience in engineering, installing and commissioning of HVAC & BMS systems for infrastructure projects like pharmaceuticals, airports, commercial buildings, hospitals.
  • Experience in the field of Automation (PLC programming/SCADA).
  • Must be a quick learner & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

job.title: Service Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Service Engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and servicing of Building Management Systems (BMS), Fire Alarm Systems, Access Control Systems, CCTV Surveillance Systems, Intrusion Detection Systems, and other ELV/Security solutions. The role requires strong technical expertise, customer interaction skills, and the ability to ensure system uptime and compliance with safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of Fire & Security Systems.
  • Diagnose and resolve faults in fire alarm, CCTV, access control, intrusion alarm, and control systems.
  • Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance activities as per service schedules.
  • Attend service calls and ensure timely closure of customer complaints.
  • Maintain service reports, maintenance records, and documentation.
  • Coordinate with customers, subcontractors, and internal teams for project execution and service delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and company procedures.
  • Support system upgrades, modifications, and integration activities.
  • Provide technical training and guidance to customers when required.
  • Participate in on-call support and emergency breakdown response.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Knowledge of Fire Detection & Alarm Systems.
  • Experience with CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion Alarm, and ELV Systems.
  • Understanding of Control Systems, BMS, and PLC basics is preferred.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and customer service skills.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and statutory compliance requirements.

Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, Mechatronics, or related discipline.
  • Relevant certifications in Fire & Security Systems are an advantage.

Experience

  • 2 to 6 years of experience in installation, commissioning, or servicing of Fire, Security, ELV, or Building Automation Systems.

job.title: Service engineer
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

###

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities.

APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What you will do:

HVAC Chiller Service Engineer - Troubleshooting

We are seeking an experienced HVAC Chiller Service Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing HVAC chiller systems, ensuring efficient operation and minimizing downtime. The role requires a strong technical background, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to maintenance and service.

What we look for:

  • ### Diagnose and troubleshoot issues with HVAC chiller systems, including compressors, evaporators, condensers, and associated components.
  • ### Perform routine maintenance and repairs on chillers to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
  • ### Identify and resolve mechanical and electrical faults, utilizing diagnostic tools and industry best practices.
  • ### Conduct inspections and testing of HVAC equipment to confirm system functionality and compliance with safety standards.
  • ### Provide on-site technical support to clients, including emergency repairs and troubleshooting.
  • ### Maintain accurate records of services performed, parts used, and recommendations for future maintenance.
  • ### Collaborate with other team members to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
  • ### Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and company policies.
  • ### Stay updated on new technologies and industry developments in HVAC systems

###

Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment.

###

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: Developer - Enterprise Integration
job.description:
-

Senior Integration Developer (6–9 Years)

Role Summary

A highly experienced, hands-on Senior Integration Developer responsible for designing and delivering complex, enterprise-grade integration solutions. Drives advanced development, owns Low-Level Design (LLDs), and ensures high-quality, CI/CD-driven delivery using Azure Integration Services, while mentoring teams and contributing to architecture alignment.

Key Responsibilities

Core Development (Primary Focus)

Lead the development of complex, large-scale integration solutions using Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Data Factory, Service Bus, Event Grid).

  • Build high-performance, scalable, and production-ready solutions, handling complex enterprise integration scenarios.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, advanced integration patterns, and shared components to accelerate delivery across programs.

API Development & APIM Governance

  • Design and implement enterprise-grade APIs using Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Configure advanced APIM policies including security, transformation, throttling, and routing.
  • Ensure APIs meet performance, security, and governance standards.

Low-Level Design & Technical Ownership

  • Own and drive Low-Level Design (LLDs) for modules and critical components.
  • Translate business and architectural requirements into scalable, well-structured technical designs.
  • Ensure strict adherence to architecture standards, design principles, and best practices.

Azure DevOps & CI/CD (Key Responsibility)

  • Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
  • Drive end-to-end automation of build, deployment, and release processes using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Ensure consistent, reliable, and high-quality releases across environments.
  • Improve deployment efficiency, rollback strategies, and release governance.

Testing, Debugging & Production Support

  • Lead unit testing, integration testing, and validation strategies.
  • Handle complex debugging and root cause analysis across APIs, events, and workflows.
  • Provide strong support for critical production issues and performance bottlenecks.

Monitoring, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement and enhance observability frameworks using Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
  • Ensure solutions meet SLAs for reliability, scalability, and performance.

AI & Copilot-Enabled Development

  • Actively leverage GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot for:
  • Code acceleration and optimization
  • LLD and API documentation generation
  • Debugging and performance insights
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity and delivery quality.
  • Contribute to adoption of AI-driven development practices within the team.

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding developers on design, coding, and best practices.
  • Conduct code reviews, design reviews, and quality checks.
  • Mentor engineers and junior developers, building strong technical capability across the team.

Collaboration in Complex Delivery Programs

  • Work closely with Leads, Architects, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders.
  • Drive alignment between design, development, and delivery timelines.
  • Actively contribute to high-velocity, agile delivery environments.

Required Skills

  • Experience: 6–9 years with strong focus on hands-on integration development in complex delivery environments.
  • Azure Integration: Deep expertise in Azure Integration Services (AIS).
  • API Development: Advanced experience with Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Programming: Strong coding expertise in C#, .NET, REST APIs, JSON, XML.
  • Design Skills: Proven experience in owning LLDs and contributing to HLDs.
  • Integration Patterns: Strong knowledge of event-driven, distributed, and microservices-based architectures.
  • Azure CI/CD: Hands-on expertise in designing and managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
  • Debugging & Performance: Advanced troubleshooting and optimization skills.
  • AI & Copilot Skills:
  • Active and effective use of GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot
  • Practical understanding of AI-assisted development workflows

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with MuleSoft (architecture, migrations, or coexistence).
  • Exposure to AI/ML integration use cases and intelligent automation.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security, API governance, and compliance frameworks.

New “About Us” copy:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

job.title: OTC Functional Analyst
job.description:
OTC Functional Analyst

At Johnson Controls, you will help support the systems and processes that enable customers to move from order to cash with accuracy, speed, and confidence. You will work with cross-functional teams to improve business performance, strengthen operational reliability, and support the day-to-day flow of Oracle Fusion OTC processes.

Role Overview

As an OTC Functional Analyst, you will support and improve Order-to-Cash processes across areas such as order management, invoicing, receipts, customer master data, and month-end activities. This role is well suited for a professional with 4-6 years of experience who enjoys solving business problems, working closely with stakeholders, and turning functional requirements into effective system support and process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support Oracle Fusion Order-to-Cash processes and contribute to stable, efficient business operations.
  • Analyze functional requirements and help translate them into practical system solutions and process enhancements.
  • Work with business and technical teams to support order management, invoicing, customer receipts, and related OTC activities.
  • Assist with issue resolution, root cause analysis, and post-go-live support for business-critical processes.
  • Support month-end close activities for OTC-related subledger processes, including reconciliation and documentation support.
  • Partner with stakeholders to improve process reliability, data quality, and end-user experience.
  • Contribute to testing, validation, and change support for system updates and process changes.
  • Document functional flows, business rules, and support activities clearly and consistently.

How You Will Do It

  • You will stay close to the business process, listen carefully to user needs, and remove friction where it affects customers or operations.
  • You will own your work with accountability, accuracy, safety-minded thinking, and integrity in every step.
  • You will use a continuous-improvement mindset, asking questions, challenging gaps, and helping the team solve problems early.
  • You will collaborate openly across business and technology teams, building trust and aligning different perspectives toward one outcome.
  • You will support structured issue handling, clear documentation, and disciplined follow-through from analysis through resolution.
  • You will contribute to reliable delivery by working methodically through testing, validation, and operational support activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience in an OTC functional analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash processes and their impact across the business.
  • Experience supporting Oracle Fusion OTC processes, including order management, invoicing, receipts, or related finance activities.
  • Ability to analyze business requirements, identify process gaps, and support functional solutions.
  • Experience working with customer master data and month-end close activities.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams.
  • Solid problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to documentation and follow-up.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on exposure to Oracle Fusion Financials AR or Oracle Fusion Order Management.
  • Experience with invoice processing, receipt handling, or AR subledger support.
  • Familiarity with DevOps or Agile ways of working.
  • Experience supporting testing cycles, change requests, or post-go-live operational support.

Why Join Us

You will be part of a team that values practical problem-solving, customer impact, and continuous improvement. At Johnson Controls, your ideas and collaboration can help strengthen the processes that keep business moving and customers supported.

If you are ready to bring your OTC expertise to a role where your work can make a real difference, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Executive, Engineering & Sustainability
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support to the Operations team on tender document review, developing/ reviewing the scope of work and specifications for M&E equipment replacement such as switchgear, genset, etc based on the latest code of practice and authorities’ requirements.
  • Review and provide technical support for M&E maintenance contract scopes and requirements for cost saving/ containment and effectiveness to prolong equipment lifecycle based on based on the latest code of practice and authorities’ requirements.
  • Assist with project handover and pre-opening programs, including on-site inspections, site acceptance tests, and defect rectifications to ensure the equipment is operating at the right specifications.
  • Offer technical support to the Operations team in addressing M&E operational challenges.
  • Provide technical guidance on M&E end-of-life replacement schedules and specifications.
  • Offer technical guidance, recommendations, and tracking of electrical loads, contracted capacity and maximum demand.
  • Manage and execute assigned projects and improvement initiatives, coordinating with stakeholders to ensure the successful execution of required operations, maintenance, and project activities.
  • Conduct audits and identify energy/ water saving opportunities, track and monitor chiller plant performance and provide timely advice to the Operations team to address any shortcomings.
  • Oversee digital solutioning and platform management to drive improvements in operational productivity and efficiency.
  • Undertake any other new tasks assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Diploma or any professional certification in Electrical or Mechanical or related discipline
  • Preference will be given to those with minimum 3-5 years relevant working experience
  • Familiar and good knowledge on M&E services and maintenance requirements
  • Preference will be given to those with minimum Grade 7 Licensed Electrical Worker (LEW) or good knowledge in Low/High voltage electrical and Scada system
  • Experience in Energy Management and Audit or digital solutioning will be an added advantage
  • Good command in English, spoken and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal and supervisory skills
  • Ability to multi-task, analytical and meticulous and high level of initiative
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Team player

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Cost Engineer, Data Center IT Fit-Out
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the solution to AI’s energy challenge, founded in Australia in 2019 by a visionary team of entrepreneurs. Our mission is to create the most energy-efficient AI infrastructure, combining cutting edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

Through ground-breaking research and development, we invented a verticalized AI Factory - a new class of digital infrastructure that replaces traditional data centres. Built on new approaches to liquid cooling, energy management, water use and modular construction methodology, the Firmus AI Factory delivers low-cost AI tokens across Asia-Pacific.

Firmus AI Cloud

We provide customers access to energy savings via our large-scale GPU cloud, Firmus AI Cloud. Rated Silver in The GPU Cloud ClusterMAX™ Rating System, our cloud empowers developers, enterprise, education and government users to train AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing list of services and applications, we are committed to building a cloud experience for our customers that is market-leading, proprietary and built to scale.

Why you’ll love working here

  • A fast-paced and dynamic environment working with next-gen technology. You’ll be operating at the intersection of sustainability and artificial intelligence – helping to transform an industry.
  • Working with and access to colleagues who are true innovators and leaders in their field.
  • As an emerging company, we work as a close-knit team. Work with the founders, grow a strong network, and witness the impact you make first-hand as we democratise AI tools for everyone – more sustainably, and more affordably.
  • We believe that people from diverse backgrounds come together to do their best work, be their authentic selves, and build great things. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Role Summary

The Cost Engineer is responsible for project cost control, budgeting, forecasting, commercial tracking, and financial reporting for data center IT fit-out projects. This role supports the Project Manager in monitoring project financial performance across procurement, deployment, logistics, installation, and integration activities.

The position will work closely with procurement, vendors, finance, logistics, and project teams to ensure accurate cost visibility, budget control, and timely reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

Experience in data center, mission-critical, or IT infrastructure environments is advantageous but not mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

Cost Control & Budget Management

  • Develop and maintain project cost reports, forecasts, and budget tracking tools.
  • Monitor actual costs against approved budgets and committed spend.
  • Track project expenditures across procurement, logistics, installation, deployment, and related project activities.
  • Support cost allocation across multiple workstreams and project phases.
  • Identify budget variances and recommend corrective actions.

Procurement & Commercial Tracking

  • Work closely with procurement and project teams to track purchase orders, vendor quotations, and committed costs.
  • Review and validate vendor quotations, invoices, and payment applications.
  • Track cost movements, freight costs, taxes, duties, and escalation risks.
  • Maintain visibility of long-lead procurement items and project commitments.
  • Support commercial evaluations and bid comparisons.

Forecasting & Financial Reporting

  • Prepare weekly and monthly cost forecasts and cash flow reports.
  • Provide financial status updates to the Project Manager and stakeholders.
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and update estimates based on project progress.

job.title: Machine Systems Integration Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Systems Integration Engineer

Role Summary

As a Systems Integration Engineer, you will be the technical bridge between machine electronics hardware, embedded software, and application-level features across Caterpillar's off-highway and tracked-machine product lines. You will own the end-to-end integration of Cat ECMs, Displays, and third-party components into a coherent machine electronics architecture — from requirements and architecture definition through HIL/SIL validation, factory support, and field issue resolution. You will work closely with Product Group stakeholders, global cross-functional engineering teams (electrical, mechanical, software), and factory/field teams to deliver reliable, high-quality machine systems on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Architecture & Requirements
  • Perform Cat architecture studies and develop control system architecture integrating Displays and Cat ECMs.
  • Author technical specifications and system/software requirements for machine application features, including new features, enhancements, and CPIs.
  • Establish integration strategy defining communication protocols (CAN/J1939, Ethernet/TCP-IP, etc.) between ECMs and Display systems.
  • Define and document supporting requirements — interfaces, calibration parameters, boundary diagrams — and drive standard application components for system coherence.
  • Electrical & Software Design Support
  • Support electrical schematic design activities, including ECM pinout design and component selection (sensors, switches, relays) in coordination with the electrical install team.
  • Define software requirements for diagnostics, display, and engine/machine application software teams.
  • Contribute to load studies and starting/charging analysis (battery, starter, alternator selection) where applicable.
  • Integration, Validation & Quality
  • Lead machine electronics system integration and validation, including HIL/SIL bench testing, test plan authoring, and root-cause review of test failures.
  • Integrate Display systems with Cat ECMs and third-party systems; conduct thorough system testing to confirm functionality, reliability, and safety standards.
  • Participate in Built-In-Quality (BIQ) reviews, FMEAs, and Design Verification Plans (DVPs); ensure quality standards are met across the development lifecycle.
  • Factory & Field Support
  • Provide in-person or remote build support for pilot and production machines; advise factory teams on end-of-line test stand design and software flashing setup.
  • Analyze field/telemetry data (e.g., product health data) to determine root cause of field issues and support difficult field escalations via phone/Teams/email.
  • Support machine commissioning, ensuring successful on-site integration of ECM and Display systems.
  • Technology Integration & Obsolescence
  • Support technology integration programs such as Payload, Cycle Segmentation, Operator Assist, Collision Mitigation, Connectivity, and similar features — from requirements through proof-of-concept.
  • Proactively manage obsolescence of electronics components; work with internal component teams and suppliers to identify and validate replacements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with electrical, mechanical, and software engineering teams to ensure seamless multi-disciplinary integration.
  • Collaborate with project managers and Product Group stakeholders to meet program timelines, budgets, and quality targets.
  • Document system architecture, programming logic, wiring diagrams, and release notes to support maintenance and future upgrades.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Instrumentation, or a related Engineering discipline.
  • 8 – 12 years of relevant engineering experience in electronics/controls system design, integration, or validation for automotive, off-highway, or industrial machine products (experience range depends on target level — Engineer vs. Senior Engineer).
  • Strong foundation in E&E components (sensors, switches, relays, ECMs) and control systems fundamentals.
  • Working knowledge of datalink protocols such as CAN/J1939 and Ethernet TCP/IP.
  • Ability to write clear, unambiguous technical specifications and requirements documents.
  • Good understanding of diagnostics and troubleshooting methodology for control system failures.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills — this role requires constant interaction with regional and global development teams.

Preferred / Top Candidate Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with HIL/SIL validation tools (e.g., Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape, dSPACE, MATLAB/Simulink).
  • Familiarity with version control and workflow tools such as GIT/SVN and Azure DevOps.
  • Exposure to AUTOSAR architecture and model-based development practices.
  • Machine-level design and product application knowledge; familiarity with Caterpillar design/Teamcenter release processes and BIQ practices.
  • Project leadership experience, Agile/Scrum exposure, and prior involvement in factory or field support activities.
  • Six Sigma methodology or structured problem-solving experience (e.g., 8D, FMEA).

What Success Looks Like

  • Machine electronics architectures that are robust, standardized, and reusable across product variants.
  • On-time delivery of validated software/system features that meet specification with minimal field escapes.
  • Strong, trusted working relationships with Product Group, factory, and global engineering counterparts.
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of obsolescence and integration risks well ahead of production impact.

Posting Dates:

September 7, 2026 - September 17, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Senior Data Scientist - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Data Scientist designs and deploys statistical, forecasting, and machine learning solutions to solve complex business problems. This role works with cross-functional teams to build production-ready models, generate actionable insights, and improve planning and decision-making at scale.

The role requires strong expertise in statistics, time series analysis, probabilistic forecasting, machine learning, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

**

Responsibilities

Statistical Modeling & Forecasting

  • Build and deploy statistical and probabilistic forecasting models for demand, capacity, and trend analysis
  • Apply time series methods including regression-based models, ARIMA/SARIMA, and state-space models
  • Define modeling assumptions, forecast uncertainty, and evaluation methods

Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling

  • Build and deploy machine learning models for forecasting and prediction, including regression, tree-based models, gradient boosting and neural networks
  • Select statistical or ML approaches based on accuracy, interpretability, robustness, and operational needs
  • Develop features and run experiments to improve model performance

MLOps & Production Deployment

  • Own the model lifecycle, including development, backtesting, deployment, monitoring, and retraining
  • Implement model monitoring, performance tracking, and data drift detection
  • Ensure models are versioned, reproducible, and production-ready

Data Engineering & Modeling

  • Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and hypothesis testing on large, complex datasets
  • Identify data requirements for forecasting and predictive modeling, including key inputs, data gaps, and quality needs
  • Work with big data technologies and distributed data processing to support scalable modeling
  • Partner with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, availability, and efficient data pipelines

Visualization & Insights

  • Create visualizations to communicate forecasts, trends, and model outputs
  • Translate model results into actionable insights for business and operational stakeholders

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with product managers, engineers, and business teams to define forecasting and analytics requirements
  • Communicate modeling approaches, assumptions, and results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or machine learning
  • Strong foundation in statistics and experience applying statistical methods in production
  • Proven experience with time series analysis and probabilistic forecasting
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning models such as regression, boosting, and neural networks
  • Experience owning production data science models, including deployment and monitoring
  • Experience working with large datasets and using SQL and Python for analytical and modeling workflows
  • Proficiency in Python and common DS/ML libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch/TensorFlow)
  • Experience working on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field

job.title: AI Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Nxera, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Passionate about making a real impact? Be at the forefront of the data centre (DC) industry with a unique focus on sustainability, connectivity and AI which sets us apart as the next generation DC operator. You will also get to gain invaluable experience in a fast-growing industry that is powering the digitalisation wave. Be empowered to co-create the future with our dynamic teams!”

We are seeking an AI Solutions Engineer (Agentic AI) to design, build and deploy enterprise AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI Agents. You will develop production-ready AI applications that automate knowledge-intensive workflows, integrate with enterprise systems and deliver secure, scalable and trustworthy AI experiences.

How You will Make An Impact:

AI Solution Development

  • Design, develop and deploy AI agents using LLMs, RAG and prompt engineering.
  • Build scalable AI workflows that automate enterprise business processes.
  • Translate business requirements into practical AI solutions.
  • Develop reusable prompt workflows, tool-calling capabilities and structured outputs.

Knowledge & RAG Engineering

  • Build and optimise RAG pipelines connected to approved enterprise knowledge sources.
  • Improve retrieval quality through chunking, embeddings, indexing and metadata strategies.
  • Maintain trusted knowledge bases and ensure source-grounded AI responses.

AI Platform & Integration

  • Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, APIs, databases and internal platforms.
  • Develop secure tool-calling capabilities and support deployment into production.
  • Monitor and optimise AI application performance.

Model Quality & Governance

  • Design evaluation frameworks to measure response quality, retrieval accuracy and hallucination risks.
  • Optimise prompts, guardrails and model performance.
  • Support governance, version control and human-in-the-loop review processes.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with product, engineering and business teams to deliver AI solutions.
  • Support demonstrations, UAT, production rollout and technical documentation.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or related discipline.
  • 3–5 years of software engineering experience with Python.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications, AI Agents or RAG solutions.
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar AI frameworks.
  • Experience integrating APIs, databases and enterprise systems.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, semantic search and prompt engineering.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD and container technologies.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI agent orchestration.
  • Experience deploying open-source LLMs (e.g. vLLM, Ollama).
  • Exposure to MLOps, model fine-tuning or domain adaptation.

Hiring Manager: Sivasankar Subbiah

Talent Acquisition Manager: Kong Chiew Yen

job.description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Accounting Associate to join Transformation RTR -Global Finance Services Division. The incumbent would an integral part of the Continuous Improvement (CI) Center of Excellence, specifically focused on standardization, optimization and digitalization, the candidate will support the execution of our continuous improvement framework within the Global Business Services scope.

  • Drive a culture of innovation, simplification and continuous improvement through best practice sharing, advocacy, and hands-on leadership.

job.title: Senior Commercial Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As Senior Commercial Manager, India based in our HQ in Mumbai, you will report to the Commercial Director, India & Middle East and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • You will provide commercial leadership, guidance and advice to support the delivery teams in all aspects of commercial and contract issues across the entire lifecycle of our data centre developments
  • You will negotiate complex contracts, both domestically and internationally, including the development and management of all contractual documentation
  • You will lead the commercial development reporting and administration function for the region, ensuring a high level of governance and accuracy to stakeholders

What you’ll do

  • Support management team with procurement and contract strategies for existing and new hyperscale developments in India
  • Lead customer contracts review during pre-flight and develop risk management strategy to manage any upstream/downstream gaps
  • Lead contract, cost and claims management and strategy across all in flight projects, partnering with the development team to resolve all day-to-day matters
  • Resolve contract interpretation issues and disputes in a creative manner, balancing both parties’ objectives and the long-term implications of changes or solutions
  • Proactively onboard new vendors for the region
  • Lead project close outs across region and conduct project lesson learned analysis upon all project completions
  • Develop and manage effective and streamlined processes and procedures and develop metrics quantifying performance across all projects
  • Assist with innovations, initiatives and continuous improvements aimed at increasing time and costs efficiencies of the delivery of our data centres
  • Develop complex business cases and analysis to management
  • Develop and review tender packages including developing scope of works, bid templates, tender evaluations, reviews, contracts negotiation and recommendations
  • Concurrently manage multiple projects including new data centre buildings and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centres
  • Travel to data centre sites both domestic and internationally for project initiation, project reviews and audits, constructability reviews, commissioning, project close out, and the like as required.

What you’ll bring

  • A relevant degree such as Law, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management or Engineering (or similar) with a minimum of 10 years work experience in the construction industry
  • Strong understanding of contract management and administration with a sound

understanding of contract law

  • Strong communication, negotiation, contract drafting and presentation skills
  • Demonstrated success in directing and influencing multi‐disciplinary teams, consultants, and contractors to deliver high quality outcomes
  • Demonstrable leadership and problem-solving skills
  • Sound knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and exposure to online collaboration tools
  • Have an attention to detail and be able to maintain high quality standards

Preferred:

  • Experience in India construction market, including navigating local partnerships, supply chain constraints, and regulatory approvals
  • Experience in hyperscale, data centre, or fast-track design and construct environments
  • Postgraduate qualifications in law, business, or management
  • Experience managing large-scale contracts (>USD $1bn equivalent)

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Health and Safety Director APAC DE&C
job.description:
Your Role

Lead Health & Safety across an assigned regional business portfolio by implementing the Global Health & Safety strategy, providing strategic leadership, governance and practical support that enables safe operational delivery. Build trusted relationships with regional leaders and ensure global standards are embedded while responding effectively to local business, regulatory and cultural requirements.

What you'll do

Regional Health & Safety Leadership

  • Develop and deliver the Regional Health & Safety Plan aligned with the Global Health & Safety strategy and annual priorities.
  • Lead the regional implementation of the Safely Powering Progress strategy.
  • Provide strategic advice to regional leadership on performance, priorities and emerging risks.
  • Promote a proactive safety culture that encourages leadership engagement, learning and continuous improvement.
  • Integrate Health & Safety into planning, operational delivery and business decision making.

Business Partnership

  • Provide strategic and operational Health & Safety support across the regional business.
  • Support implementation of global standards, frameworks and minimum requirements.
  • Work closely with operational leaders to develop practical solutions that enable safe business outcomes.
  • Support regional delivery of global programmes, projects and change initiatives.

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with business leaders, project teams, contractors and the Global Health & Safety team.
  • Influence decision making through credibility, collaboration and technical expertise.
  • Coach leaders to strengthen Health & Safety capability and accountability.

Governance & Assurance

  • Monitor regional performance using leading and lagging indicators.
  • Lead or oversee investigations into significant incidents and ensure lessons learned are shared regionally and globally.
  • Facilitate audits, assurance activities and management reviews.
  • Support contractor governance and performance management where applicable.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable legislation while maintaining alignment with global standards.

Global Collaboration

  • Contribute to the development of global standards, programmes and strategic initiatives.
  • Share regional insights, innovation and best practice to strengthen global capability.
  • Support cross-functional projects and working groups to improve Health & Safety performance.

Key Behaviours

  • Visible leadership
  • Business partnering
  • Collaborative
  • Pragmatic
  • Influential
  • Accountable
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Culturally aware

Skills & Experience

  • Extensive leadership experience in Health & Safety within complex operational environments.
  • Experience supporting multiple business units or regions within multinational and matrix organisations.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing capability.
  • Knowledge of Health & Safety management systems, governance, assurance and risk management.
  • Strong analytical capability with a practical, solutions-focused approach.

Success Measures Common Measures

  • Global Health & Safety standards are consistently implemented across the region.
  • Regional leaders view Health & Safety as a trusted business partner.
  • Governance, assurance and performance reporting support informed decision making.
  • Lessons learned and collaboration drive continual improvement.

Role-specific Measures

  • The Regional Health & Safety Plan is delivered in alignment with the Global Health & Safety strategy.
  • Regional performance demonstrates measurable improvement.
  • Leadership engagement and safety culture continue to strengthen.
  • Regulatory compliance and implementation of global standards are maintained.

A bit about us

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

To learn more about Digital Realty, please visit [digitalrealty.com](http://www.digitalrealty.com) or follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/digitalrealty) and [Twitter](https://twitter.com/digitalrealty).

What we can offer you

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We’ll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

Health and Safety Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals - they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners and our customers. job.title: Sustainability Compliance Tracing (SCT) Team Lead
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a detail-oriented Team lead with in-depth knowledge of carbon accounting, credit/offsets and reporting standards, and bio-fuel certification schemes such as the International Sustainability and Carbon Certification standards (ISCC) and Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB) to join our team. As the SCT Team lead, you will play a crucial role in ensuring compliance and procedures in our Infrastructure projects, as well as contribute your know-how of renewable energy and biofuels industries in our business.

  • Audit Management: Work with external auditors to coordinate and conduct desk and on-site audits, oversee periodic certification renewals, and manage corrective action plans throughout end-to-end supply chain for various sites/projects. Participate in internal quality assurance activities to maintain high standards of auditing.
  • Supply Chain Traceability: Verify chain of custody records, ensuring that sustainable material outputs match sustainable inputs across the supply chain. Expertise in environmental management systems
  • GHG & Mass Balance: Calculate and review life-cycle emissions and manage complex mass balance book-keeping systems. Analyze data and documentation to verify adherence to ISCC principles
  • Regulatory Compliance: Familiarity with relevant regulations and compliance requirements for global sustainability frameworks (like EU RED II or CORSIA), and stay up-to-date with changes in relevant standards, regulations, and industry best practices. Interpret and implement updates on international fuel blending mandates, sustainability policies, and trade documentation.
  • Team building: You are to build a team up gradually with the know-how to manage ISCC related certification needs for various interested molecules across the projects (such as Biomethane, Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), etc).
  • Stakeholder Guidance: Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Provide continuous guidance to suppliers and clients on ISCC EU/PLUS compliance and documentation, and other equivalent frameworks. Collaborate with clients to develop corrective action plans and monitor their implementation.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel as required for on-site audits.
  • Business Development & Partnering: You will work with the BDP team to prepare SCT commercial proposals for prospective clients. Ability to work independently and as part of a team would be crucial.
  • Any other works/due diligence assigned by the department head.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications

  • Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Engineering, or Agriculture, or related fields.
  • Certifications: Mandatory completion of official ISCC Basic Training (EU and PLUS), ISO-related certifications or other sustainability certifications will be a bonus. Where certification needs extended beyond ISCC in future, you may be nominated for training to upskill accordingly.
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of direct experience in sustainability auditing, quality management, or supply chain logistics.
  • Skills: Strong data-analysis capabilities (Excel or AI), attention to detail, and excellent client-facing communication.

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Infrastructure

PLATFORM

Operating Division

The role combines senior service desk responsibilities with systems administration capability, ensuring incidents are resolved efficiently while supporting the ongoing reliability, security and performance of the organisation’s IT infrastructure.

job.title: Senior Manager, Corporate FP&A
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

Reporting to the Head of FP&A, this role leads corporate FP&A processes including annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, board and management reporting, long-range planning and scenario analysis.

The role is the central coordinator of Digital Edge’s financial planning process, ensuring alignment between country forecasts, specialist FP&A capability owners and executive reporting requirements.

It will improve planning discipline, reporting efficiency and forecasting quality while supporting strategic initiatives and financing requirements across the business. Based in Singapore, supporting operations across Asia Pacific.

Key responsibilities

1. Budgeting, Forecasting and Planning

  • Own the annual budget, rolling forecast and long-range planning processes across the Group.
  • Establish planning calendars, submission standards and review schedules.
  • Coordinate forecast consolidation across countries and specialist FP&A capability owners.
  • Challenge assumptions, forecast risks and mitigation plans with business leaders and Country Finance.

2. Group Reporting and Executive Insight

  • Own delivery of monthly management reporting, board reporting and investor reporting support.
  • Prepare consolidated performance analysis, executive commentary and standardized reporting frameworks.
  • Provide insight into key drivers: revenue, margins, operating costs, capex and cash.

**

3. Strategic Planning and Performance Management

  • Develop financial models and scenario analysis to evaluate strategic initiatives and business performance.
  • Support executive decisions on investment, growth and resource allocation.

4. Corporate Cost Management and Efficiency

  • Partner with corporate function leaders to improve planning, forecasting and management of SG&A costs.
  • Develop cost-driver reporting and variance analysis across corporate departments.
  • Identify efficiency opportunities through analysis of volume, rate, mix, timing and resource allocation drivers.
  • Establish management reporting frameworks for corporate functional performance and spending discipline, with executive commentary on cost risks and corrective actions.

**

5. Process Improvement and FP&A Governance

  • Define enterprise planning standards, controls and review processes.
  • Improve forecast accuracy and reporting quality through process simplification and discipline.
  • Partner with FP&A capability owners and Country Finance teams to improve consistency of assumptions and methodologies.
  • Support automation and reporting enhancements and drive adoption of standardized planning and reporting practices.

Key Requirements & Qualifications

  • 8-10+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance or business finance, ideally in a regional or platform environment.
  • Track record leading budgeting, rolling forecast, long-range planning and management reporting processes.
  • Proven experience in SG&A cost control, corporate cost management and partnering with corporate function leaders.
  • Strong financial modelling, business analysis and executive communication skills; able to convert complex data into concise executive insight.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; strong planning, organization and project management capability.
  • Confidence partnering with senior executives, corporate functions, country finance teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Preferred: data centres, infrastructure, telecoms or other capital-intensive sectors; board, investor or lender reporting exposure.
  • Preferred: OneStream, Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, Power BI or similar platforms.

job.title: Associate Director - FP&A, Capex and Operating Cost Efficiency
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

**

Reporting to the Head of FP&A, this role leads FP&A governance, portfolio insight and operating cost efficiency for Digital Edge’s capex and operating cost base across Asia Pacific.

The Associate Director will establish an approval-to-cash view of capital spend, improve portfolio Latest Best Estimate (LBE) and cash forecasting, identify capex and operating cost risks, and provide clear financial challenge to Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Treasury and Country Finance.

The role includes direct people management of a small team of finance analysts and influences cross-functional stakeholders.

This role will be based in Singapore and will support projects and operations across Asia Pacific.

**

Key responsibilities

**

1. Capex Governance and Approval-to-Cash Reporting

  • Own the monthly approval-to-cash reporting framework covering approved budget, commitments, invoices, cash paid, LBE, contingency usage and key delivery risks.
  • Build a portfolio view of development and maintenance capex, highlighting variance drivers by volume, rate, scope, timing and foreign exchange.
  • Establish exception reporting and escalation for material cost overruns, cash slippage, contingency drawdown, approval gaps and late commitments.
  • Partner with Development, Procurement and Country Finance to strengthen capex governance, data quality and forecasting discipline.

**

**

2. Portfolio LBE, Cash Forecasting and Investment Analytics

  • Improve capex LBE accuracy and cash-flow visibility by integrating inputs from Development, Procurement and Country Finance.
  • Support investment reviews by validating financial assumptions, capex phasing, contingency, return metrics, sensitivity analysis and key commercial risks.
  • Maintain a consistent methodology for post-approval tracking of investment economics against approved business cases.
  • Prepare executive-level commentary on capex, cash and portfolio risks, with clear recommendations and accountable follow-ups.

**

3. Operating Cost Efficiency

  • Partner with Operations and Country Finance to analyse power, repairs and maintenance, facilities management and maintenance capex trends.
  • Identify cost efficiency opportunities using driver analysis across volume, rate, mix, utilization and timing.
  • Develop benchmarking and unit-cost analysis across sites.
  • Translate operating cost movements into senior management insight, separating controllable performance from market, usage and timing effects.

4. Team Leadership, Controls and Ways of Working

  • Lead, coach and develop a small team of finance analysts supporting capex reporting, operating cost analysis and portfolio performance reviews.
  • Define the capex FP&A calendar, submission standards, data ownership, review cadence and escalation process.
  • Work with Country Finance, Procurement and Treasury to reconcile spend, commitments and cash where process gaps exist.

**

Key Requirements & Qualifications

  • 10+ years in FP&A, project finance, infrastructure finance, capex control or corporate finance, with proven capex governance, project cost tracking, cash forecasting, variance analysis and portfolio reporting experience.
  • Ability to convert complex operational and financial data into senior management insights, recommendations and accountable follow-ups.
  • Strong stakeholder management across Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Treasury, Accounting and Country Finance.
  • Direct people management experience, including coaching analysts, setting priorities and improving output quality.
  • Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills and strong PowerPoint executive reporting capability.
  • Preferred: data centre, telecommunications, utilities, infrastructure, real estate development or energy-intensive asset experience.
  • Preferred: OneStream, Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, Power BI or similar tools; CPA, CFA, MBA or equivalent finance qualification.

job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. The Engineer will execute and support existing/new project assignments covering GPON, Wi-Fi CPEs, IoT, and device-management technologies including but not limited to TR-069, TR-181, and TR-369. In addition, the role will support the operation, maintenance and troubleshooting of lab systems infrastructure.

This role focuses more on technical execution and troubleshooting of the above-mentioned requirements without neglecting project management skills, and the ability to work with cross-functional teams and vendors.

Make an impact by:

  • Develop scripts and tools using languages and/or automation platforms such as Python, or similar technologies to automate network configuration, test execution, monitoring, data collection and troubleshooting.
  • Plan, execute and document testing and validation for GPON, Wi-Fi CPEs and IoT solutions, including functional, interoperability, regression and end-to-end validation as required.
  • Develop, execute and maintain test cases covering device-management technologies and data models, including TR-069, TR-181 and TR-369.
  • Perform troubleshooting, analysis and diagnostics to enable faster failure root-cause identification and fault isolation, with or without vendor support.
  • Develop new test cases to meet new growth requirements and enhance existing test plans and validation coverage.
  • Manage and support lab systems infrastructure required for testing, including servers, operating systems, virtual machines, test platforms/tools, network connectivity, user/access administration and related services.
  • Perform routine administration, monitoring, maintenance, patching, backup/recovery and troubleshooting of lab systems to maintain availability, stability and security.
  • Coordinate with vendor(s) to identify requirements, timelines, dependencies and resources needed for testing improvement, automation and lab infrastructure activities whenever required.
  • Document test procedures, infrastructure configurations, processes, solutions and best practices for knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain periodic updates on progress, issues, risks and key callouts for immediate discussion and solutioning.
  • Manage project timelines and resources to ensure assigned projects and deliverables are completed on time.
  • Ensure lab infra compliance with company Group IT, cybersecurity and/or security requirements for all work performed.
  • Execute and/or support existing/new test project assignments across GPON, Wi-Fi CPE, IoT and associated device-management platforms.
  • Any other tasks assigned by the manager.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical field.
  • Certification in CCNA and ITIL 4 is preferred.
  • Proven experience in GPON/CPE testing in a lab environment.
  • Hands-on experience in testing and validation of IoT and CPE/device-management technologies, with knowledge of TR-069, TR-181 and TR-369 strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of lab test tools, lab operations and test equipment.
  • Good systems infrastructure management skills for lab environments, including administration and troubleshooting of Firewall, Network Switches, Linux and/or Windows systems, servers, virtual machines, applications/services.
  • Strong understanding of IP Networking concepts, protocols and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Familiar with scripting and automation across environments such as Python, Linux shell and Windows-based systems.
  • Good project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve complex technical problems across network, test platform and systems infrastructure layers.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation, organizational and analytical skills.
