job.title: Lead AI Platform Architect #AIDA
job.description:
Role Summary

As a Lead AI Platform Architect, you will be the technical authority responsible for defining the architecture, technology strategy and roadmap for Singtel's enterprise AI platform, including the Central AI Kitchen (CAK) and its supporting AI ecosystem. You will drive the evaluation, adoption and governance of emerging AI technologies, ensuring the platform provides secure, scalable, reusable and enterprise-ready AI capabilities that accelerate AI innovation across the organisation.

Working closely with Enterprise Architecture, AI Platform Engineering, AI Platform Operations, Cybersecurity and business stakeholders, you will define the enterprise AI reference architecture, platform standards, reusable technical frameworks and architectural guardrails that enable consistent and scalable AI solution delivery.

You will provide technical leadership across AI platform strategy, foundation models, agentic AI, model lifecycle management, AI engineering frameworks and platform capabilities, ensuring the AI platform evolves in line with business priorities, technology advancements and enterprise governance requirements.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Define and maintain the enterprise AI platform architecture, technology roadmap and reference architecture for the Central AI Kitchen (CAK) or equivalent AI platforms.
  • Establish reusable AI platform capabilities, architectural principles, design standards and technical frameworks to enable secure, scalable and consistent AI adoption across the enterprise.
  • Evaluate, benchmark and recommend hosted, self-hosted and open-weight foundation models, defining enterprise model selection strategies based on business, technical and governance requirements.
  • Engage with technology partners, cloud providers, AI vendors and the broader technology ecosystem to explore emerging platform capabilities, evaluate new products and identify opportunities to enhance the enterprise AI platform.
  • Lead and oversee proof-of-concept (PoC), technology evaluation and pilot initiatives for emerging AI technologies, validating technical feasibility, business value, scalability and enterprise readiness while staying abreast of industry trends and advancements to continuously evolve the AI platform roadmap.
  • Establish platform architecture and best practices for model optimisation techniques
  • Define the enterprise architecture for multimodal AI capabilities, including language, speech, voice, document, image, vision-language and video models.
  • Define enterprise standards and governance for AI model lifecycle management, including model versioning, retraining strategies, regression management, performance evaluation and model retirement.
  • Lead technical evaluations, benchmarking and proof-of-concept initiatives for emerging AI technologies, frameworks, platforms and commercial solutions.
  • Assess emerging AI technologies and recommend Build, Buy or Partner strategies based on business value, enterprise architecture alignment, scalability and total cost of ownership.
  • Publish and maintain AI platform reference architectures, reusable design patterns, technical standards, implementation guidelines and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity and other governance teams to ensure AI platform architecture aligns with enterprise architecture principles, security requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Review and govern architecture proposals for new AI platform capabilities, technology adoption and platform enhancements to ensure consistency with enterprise architecture, platform strategy and governance standards.
  • Prepare, present and defend AI platform architecture proposals to the Solution Review Board (SRB), senior management and Group/Enterprise Architecture, and seek Architecture Review Board (ARB) clearance, where required, for new platform capabilities, architecture patterns, technology adoption, technology exceptions or enterprise architectural changes.
  • Provide architectural direction and technical guidance to AI Platform Engineering teams throughout platform capability planning and implementation.
  • Collaborate with AI Platform Engineering and Operation team to define platform observability, operational architecture, reliability requirements and lifecycle management strategies for production AI services.
  • Partner with AI Solution Architects to ensure reusable platform capabilities meet evolving business requirements and support scalable AI solution delivery.
  • Work closely with AI Security Architects to embed AI security, Responsible AI, privacy and governance requirements into platform architecture and design.
  • Mentor Platform Architects and senior technical engineers, fostering architecture excellence, innovation and continuous improvement across the AI platform.
  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for enterprise AI platform strategy, engaging senior management, Group/Enterprise Architecture, technology teams and business stakeholders to influence platform direction and drive the continuous evolution of a secure, scalable, interoperable and future-ready AI platform.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong foundation in enterprise platform architecture, distributed systems and cloud-native technologies.
  • At least 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, platform architecture, software architecture or cloud architecture, designing large-scale enterprise platforms.
  • At least 3 years of experience designing AI, Machine Learning or Generative AI platforms in an enterprise environment.
  • Proven experience defining platform architecture, technology roadmaps, architecture standards and reusable platform capabilities.
  • Experience leading architecture governance, including presenting architecture proposals to senior management and Architecture Review Boards (ARB).
  • Experience working across Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Data and Business teams.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise AI platform architecture, including AI application platforms, AI engineering ecosystems, Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) and agentic AI platforms.
  • Strong understanding of foundation models, Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), multimodal AI and enterprise AI deployment strategies.
  • Experience defining AI model lifecycle architecture, including model evaluation, fine-tuning strategies, deployment, versioning, monitoring and governance.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native, hybrid cloud and on-premises platform architectures, distributed computing and container orchestration principles.
  • Good understanding of enterprise AI application patterns, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, workflow orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), API integration and enterprise integration architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures and API-first design.
  • Experience defining architecture standards for AI security, Responsible AI, data governance, model governance, privacy and regulatory compliance.
  • Good understanding of AI platform reliability, scalability, observability, resiliency and performance optimisation principles.
  • Strong ability to evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate technology trends into enterprise platform capabilities, architecture standards and technology roadmaps.
  • Strong strategic, analytical and systems thinking, with the ability to simplify complex architecture and technology decisions for diverse stakeholders.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Enterprise Architecture, AI Solution Architecture, Platform Engineering, Platform Operations, Cybersecurity and Business teams.
  • Strong communication, presentation and documentation skills, with experience presenting architecture proposals and influencing senior management and governance boards.
  • Proven technical leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to guide architects and engineers, influence platform direction and drive architecture best practices.
  • Strong innovation mindset and continuous learning, with a passion for exploring emerging AI technologies and translating industry trends into enterprise platform capabilities.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Senior AI Platform Architect #AIDA
job.description:
Role Summary

As a Senior AI Platform Architect, you will be responsible for the architecture, technical design and evolution of assigned AI platform domains within Singtel's enterprise AI platform, including the Central AI Kitchen (CAK) or equivalent and its supporting AI ecosystem. You will define domain architecture, evaluate emerging technologies and develop reusable platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable and enterprise-ready AI services across the organisation.

Working closely with the Lead AI Platform Architect, Enterprise Architecture, AI Platform Engineering, AI Platform Operations, AI Security and AI Solution Architecture teams, you will translate enterprise AI platform strategy into domain-specific architectures, technical standards and implementation guidance, ensuring platform capabilities align with enterprise architecture, governance and business requirements.

You will serve as the technical lead for your assigned platform domain(s), providing architectural guidance throughout capability planning, implementation and lifecycle evolution while continuously evaluating emerging AI technologies to improve platform capabilities.

**

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Own the architecture, technical design and roadmap for assigned AI platform domain(s) or capability areas, ensuring alignment with the enterprise AI platform strategy.
  • Design for the particular reusable platform capabilities such as Model Gateway, MCP, Observability, Eval and AgentOps architecture, etc architectural patterns and technical standards for assigned platform domains.
  • Engage with technology partners, cloud providers and AI vendors to evaluate emerging technologies relevant to assigned platform domains.
  • Implement proof-of-concept (PoC), technology evaluation and pilot initiatives for assigned platform capabilities, validating technical feasibility, scalability and enterprise readiness.
  • Work with the Lead Platform architect to design the architecture and best practices for assigned AI platform capabilities, including model optimisation, inference, orchestration or other specialised domains.
  • Design platform capabilities supporting multimodal AI, AI agents, model lifecycle or other assigned technical domains.
  • Define architecture and governance for assigned platform capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise AI standards and lifecycle management practices.
  • Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, technologies and commercial platforms, recommending adoption within assigned platform domains.
  • Contribute to Build, Buy or Partner recommendations by assessing technologies against enterprise architecture principles, business requirements and platform strategy.
  • Develop and maintain architecture documents, reusable design patterns, implementation guidelines and technical standards for assigned platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity and governance teams to ensure assigned platform architectures comply with enterprise standards and security requirements.
  • Review architecture proposals for assigned platform capabilities and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, platform standards and governance requirements.
  • Prepare and present architecture proposals for assigned platform capabilities to the Solution Review Board (SRB), senior management and Group/Enterprise Architecture, and support Architecture Review Board (ARB) submissions where required.
  • Provide architectural guidance and technical direction to AI Platform Engineering teams throughout implementation of assigned platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with AI Platform Engineering and AI Platform Operations to ensure platform capabilities are designed for operational excellence, observability, reliability and maintainability.
  • Partner with AI Solution Architects to ensure platform capabilities effectively support business solutions and evolving enterprise AI requirements.
  • Work closely with AI Security Architects to incorporate AI security, Responsible AI, privacy and governance requirements into assigned platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the enterprise AI platform by identifying improvements, technology innovations and optimisation opportunities within assigned platform domains.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong foundation in software architecture, cloud-native technologies, distributed systems and AI platform technologies.
  • At least 5 years of experience in platform architecture, software architecture, cloud architecture or infrastructure architecture, designing enterprise platforms.
  • At least 2 years of experience designing AI, Machine Learning or Generative AI platforms or platform capabilities.
  • Proven experience designing architecture for one or more AI platform capabilities, reusable platform services or enterprise technical platforms.
  • Experience preparing architecture proposals and participating in architecture governance activities (e.g. SRB, ARB or equivalent).
  • Experience collaborating with Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Platform Operations, Cybersecurity, Data and Business teams.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineering Analyst
job.description:
Responsibilities

The Manufacturing Engineer will be responsible for supporting and improving manufacturing processes, will ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality production in accordance with engineering standards, Lean principles, and Vertiv requirements. The role will act as a key interface between engineering, production, quality, and supply chain, will drive continuous improvement, process optimization, and product industrialization.

Job Description

  • Respects the principles of environmental protection
  • Support and optimize manufacturing processes in accordance with drawings, BOMs, work instructions, and technical standards
  • Analyze production flows and will propose improvements related to safety, quality, cost, and delivery
  • Participate in the industrialization of new products and engineering changes (NPDI / ECO / ECN)
  • Define and update manufacturing documentation (work instructions, process flows, layouts, routings)
  • Support production during daily operations, troubleshooting technical and process-related issues
  • Analyze root causes of production problems and will implement corrective and preventive actions
  • Cooperate closely with other departments (Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, EHS)
  • Support line balancing, capacity analysis, and layout optimization
  • Support validation of tools, equipment, and production processes
  • Ensure compliance with internal standards, quality procedures, and safety regulations
  • Work in accordance with LEAN manufacturing principles and 5S methodology (VOS)
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by submitting and implementing improvement proposals
  • Perform all other activities related to the agreed type of work
  • Follow the procedures, rules, and principles of the integrated management system
  • Contribute to the development and adherence to standards with a focus on customer satisfaction, company culture, and continuous improvement

What will make you successful?

  • Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related fields
  • At least 7 years of experience in a manufacturing or industrial engineering role
  • Be able to read and interpret technical drawings and manufacturing documentation

Have knowledge of manufacturing processes and assembly methods

Have experience with process improvement and problem-solving techniques

Have basic knowledge of Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, Standard Work, VSM)

Be able to work with measuring equipment

Have basic PC skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Have good English knowledge

  • Comply with all health and safety and environmental protection requirements defined in the company's internal regulations or communicated during training.
  • Comply with required emergency prevention and operational control measures.
  • Report all accidents, occupational illnesses and emergencies.
  • Implement, implement and manage all health and safety and environmental protection matters related to the position.
  • In addition to the tasks listed above, other activities and responsibilities may be individually defined

job.title: Senior Analyst II, Digital Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a motivated and execution-oriented analyst to support Digital M&A for R&D and Cybersecurity initiatives.

This role focuses primarily on supporting acquisitions, divestitures and integration initiatives impacting R&D, software engineering and digital platforms.

The analyst will coordinate integration of workstreams, support onboarding of newly acquired engineering teams, track execution plans, manage stakeholder collaboration and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives.

Approximately 80% of the role is dedicated to Digital M&A activities within the R&D and Engineering ecosystem, while 20% focuses on cybersecurity andsource code governance initiatives.

What will you do?

  • We are looking for a motivated and execution-oriented analyst to support Digital M&A for R&D and Cybersecurity initiatives.
  • This role focuses primarily on supporting acquisitions, divestitures and integration initiatives impacting R&D, software engineering and digital platforms.
  • The analyst will coordinate integration of workstreams, support onboarding of newly acquired engineering teams, track execution plans, manage stakeholder collaboration and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives.

What are the key skills we are looking for?

  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of Digital M&A acquisitions, integrations, and divestitures across R&D and Engineering organizations under the leadership of the M&A R&D Program Manager.
  • Coordinate onboarding of newly acquired software and engineering teams into Schneider Electric's Digital Engineering ecosystem.
  • Support application, repository and engineering tool integration activities.
  • Maintain integration plans, action trackers, risk logs and governance documentation.
  • Coordinate activities across R&D, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Legal and Business teams.
  • Support digital due diligence and integration readiness assessments.
  • Track migration of engineering tools, development environments and digital platforms.
  • Support application separation and carve-out activities during divestitures.
  • Prepare executive updates, governance reviews and status reporting.
  • Drive follow-up on actions, dependencies, risks and mitigation plans.

What's in it for me?

  • This role offers a unique opportunity to build expertise at the intersection of Digital M&A, R&D, Digital Engineering, and Cybersecurity .
  • You will gain hands-on experience leading complex steams of acquisition, integration, and divestiture initiatives while collaborating with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.
  • The position provides valuable exposure to engineering ecosystems, digital transformation programs, secure development practices, and source code governance.
  • You will strengthen your project management, stakeholder engagement, and executive communication skills while developing a broad understanding of Schneider Electric's digital landscape.
  • This experience can accelerate your career toward leadership roles in Digital Transformation, M&A Integration, Cybersecurity, Strategy, or Program Management.

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • 7+ years of experience in Project Management, Business Analysis, Digital Transformation , Technology Consulting and / or Cybersecurity, with a strong track record of driving execution and delivering results.
  • Strong organizational, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and influence teams without direct authority.
  • Exposure to M&A integration, acquisitions or divestitures.
  • Experience working with R&D, Engineering or Technology organizations.
  • Basic understanding of cybersecurity and secure development practices.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal), with experience working across global, multi-country, and cross-functional teams, including interactions with senior stakeholders.
  • Execution-oriented, adaptable, and self-driven, with a passion for security and innovation, able to navigate ambiguity, manage changing priorities, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: DCO Manager , Infra Ops - HYD
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.Data Center Manager for the world’s biggest Cloud Infrastructure.

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

Key job responsibilities As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role. Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):

  • Managing and developing teams of high quality Data Center Technicians, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
  • Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers in India
  • Helping build and bring online new Data Centers in India
  • Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
  • Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
  • Liaising with internal teams & management groups at ADSIPL
  • Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers in India
  • Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of ADSIPL’s Data Centers in India and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
  • Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

A day in the life Managing and developing teams of high quality Data Center Technicians, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.

  • Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers in India
  • Helping build and bring online new Data Centers in India

About the team About AWS Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in software development
  • 7+ years of operations management experience
  • Experience leading process improvements
  • 5+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
  • Experience in major facilities incident management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 3+ months of network and operating system support experience
  • Experience in project management
  • 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
  • Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
  • Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations
  • Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Controls Engineer, Controls Deployment & Service India
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia & New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow-the-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination.

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:

  • Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
  • Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.

Key job responsibilities Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)

  • Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
  • Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
  • Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

A day in the life

  • Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.
  • Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.

job.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer, Observability
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

ROLE SUMMARY

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer, Observability, to join our Engineering and Technology team. You will establish how we measure, validate and communicate the health of GPU infrastructure used for customer and internal workloads. You will define trusted health signals and service-readiness criteria, and turn them into reusable dashboards, alerts, queries, diagnostic checks and operational guidance. Your work will help commissioning, infrastructure and operations teams bring capacity online safely, identify degradation early and recover from failures quickly. You will also make knowledge self-service by publishing clear reference implementations, runbooks and AI-ready operational knowledge that other teams can use and extend.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The Health Standard

Define GPU and host health criteria for customer and internal workloads, and the service-readiness gates that repair and capacity workflows depend on. Cover what stops or corrupts AI jobs: GPUs falling off the bus, XID events, ECC and memory faults, NVLink/NVSwitch degradation, thermal and power capping, NCCL and collective failures, silent data corruption, and stragglers running below fleet baseline.

  • Reference Implementations

Publish golden dashboards, alerts, PromQL/LogQL queries and health checks that other teams adopt and extend. Your output is the standard and the examples. The alerts must be specific, low-noise, and with a clear next action.

  • Diagnostics with Real Pass/Fail Criteria

DCGM checks, NCCL and bandwidth tests, stress and burn-in, and validation jobs that confirm a server matches expected performance. Others must be able to run them without you.

  • Fault Isolation

Separate a bad GPU from a cooling, host, network or power-limit problem using host and BMC/management-interface telemetry together, including when the same signature appears across many servers. A clean management view means nothing if the host is throwing faults.

  • Detection of the Failures that Don't Crash

Rising correctable ECC counts, NVLink retries, thermal slowdown, XID patterns, wrong results with no error. Keep the knowledge current: what each signal means, what to do next on the machine, and where the operation team must make the final decision.

  • Partnership and Escalation

Work with commissioning on bring-up and acceptance, operations on break-fix, infrastructure on what healthy hardware looks like, and the telemetry owners on making your signals production-grade. Run technical sessions with customer teams on the telemetry they need. Join GPU and host incidents, including debugging on the server and convert every finding into a reusable check, alert or runbook. Give engineering leadership a straight read on fleet health and risk.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years in GPU, HPC, AI infrastructure or closely related large-scale systems engineering environments, including ownership of health monitoring or diagnostics used by customers or internal teams.
  • Experience with production GPU fault diagnosis. You've found genuine faults through XID events, ECC/memory errors, NVLink issues, power or thermal limits and caught at least one before the job died.
  • Strong Linux and server fundamentals. You can debug on the machine and reason across GPU, CPU, memory, PCIe, power and cooling. You automate in Python or similar.
  • Hands-on with GPU diagnostics and validation such as DCGM, NCCL/collective tests, stress testing and you've turned them into checks other people run.
  • Experience analysing infrastructure telemetry, building trusted dashboards and alerts. Savvy with PromQL, LogQL, Grafana or comparable tooling. Able to follow an unexpected signal until there is a cause and can turn that into an alert or check others will trust.
  • Uses AI tools as a normal part of analysis and build work. Can structure health knowledge and build AI skills so operation team with AI assistants can use it effectively to recover from incidents.
  • Willing to take part in the incident-response on-call rotation.
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English.

Highly Desirable Experiences

  • Production experience on large GPU systems with tight GPU-to-GPU interconnect.
  • Multiple sites or GPU generations, especially preparing health monitoring before a new GPU class entered production.
  • Background at an AI cloud, GPU cloud or HPC centre running customer workloads.
  • Experience working with data or ML engineers on GPU/host failure prediction from health signals.
  • Built a structured operational knowledge so AI assistants can use it effectively during incident recovery.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Singapore
  • Report to: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Engineering Manager: Chiller Product Development
job.description:
Engineering Manager: Chiller Product Development, Pune

Johnson Controls delivers solutions that support smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. In this role, you will help shape chiller product development with a focus on performance, reliability, manufacturability, and customer value.

You will lead a team working at the intersection of mechanical design, validation, and production readiness, contributing to product improvements and new product introduction in a fast-moving engineering environment.

Role Overview

As Engineering Manager: Chiller Product Development, you will lead mechanical and design engineering activities for industrial refrigeration and chiller products. You will own key parts of the product development lifecycle, guide technical decisions, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to bring robust, cost-effective, and compliant solutions to market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of mechanical and design engineers supporting chiller product development.
  • Own the end-to-end development process from concept, design, prototyping, and testing through production release.
  • Prepare and review 3D models, engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, BOMs, and supporting technical documentation.
  • Generate and review pressure vessel and heat exchanger drawings and specifications to meet order and product requirements.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, procurement, marketing, and customer-facing teams to align engineering output with business needs.
  • Drive product improvements that enhance performance, cost-effectiveness, reliability, and manufacturability.
  • Support validation activities, design reviews, and engineering changes for new and existing products.
  • Evaluate technologies, materials, and design approaches that strengthen product competitiveness.
  • Support field and service teams with technical expertise and issue resolution when needed.
  • Mentor team members and build engineering capability through coaching, review, and feedback.

How You Will Do It

  • You will take ownership of outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity, ensuring engineering decisions are practical, traceable, and aligned to quality expectations.
  • You will stay close to the work by engaging with design, manufacturing, and service teams early, so issues are identified and removed before they affect customers.
  • You will use structured product development methods such as stage-gate thinking, DFMEA, and DVP&R to keep programs disciplined and well controlled.
  • You will encourage clear feedback, root-cause problem solving, and continuous improvement across product design, testing, and release activities.
  • You will win as one team by collaborating across functions, building trust with stakeholders, and valuing diverse technical perspectives.
  • You will keep documentation current and precise, including drawings, specifications, change records, and engineering deliverables.
  • You will balance technical depth with practical execution, ensuring designs are ready for production and supportable in the field.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • 10+ years of experience in industrial refrigeration or chiller product design and development.
  • At least 3 years of experience in a leadership or managerial role.
  • Strong knowledge of thermodynamics, heat transfer, and refrigeration cycles.
  • Proficiency in CAD tools such as AutoCAD and Creo.
  • Experience with product development processes including DFMEA, DVP&R, and stage-gate methodologies.
  • Experience creating and reviewing engineering drawings, BOMs, and technical documentation.
  • Excellent communication, project management, and team leadership skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ASHRAE, ISO, PED, ASME, or API requirements in product development or compliance work.
  • Exposure to pressure vessel and heat exchanger design for industrial refrigeration applications.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, procurement, or field issue resolution in a product development environment.
  • Familiarity with continuous improvement practices in an engineering or manufacturing setting.

Why Join Us

Join a collaborative team where your engineering leadership can directly influence product performance, reliability, and customer outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work across disciplines, support meaningful product improvements, and contribute to a culture that values safety, development, and practical innovation.

If you are ready to lead chiller product development and make an impact, we invite you to apply.

job.title: OTC Functional Analyst
job.description:
OTC Functional Analyst

At Johnson Controls, you will help support the systems and processes that enable customers to move from order to cash with accuracy, speed, and confidence. You will work with cross-functional teams to improve business performance, strengthen operational reliability, and support the day-to-day flow of Oracle Fusion OTC processes.

Role Overview

As an OTC Functional Analyst, you will support and improve Order-to-Cash processes across areas such as order management, invoicing, receipts, customer master data, and month-end activities. This role is well suited for a professional with 4-6 years of experience who enjoys solving business problems, working closely with stakeholders, and turning functional requirements into effective system support and process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support Oracle Fusion Order-to-Cash processes and contribute to stable, efficient business operations.
  • Analyze functional requirements and help translate them into practical system solutions and process enhancements.
  • Work with business and technical teams to support order management, invoicing, customer receipts, and related OTC activities.
  • Assist with issue resolution, root cause analysis, and post-go-live support for business-critical processes.
  • Support month-end close activities for OTC-related subledger processes, including reconciliation and documentation support.
  • Partner with stakeholders to improve process reliability, data quality, and end-user experience.
  • Contribute to testing, validation, and change support for system updates and process changes.
  • Document functional flows, business rules, and support activities clearly and consistently.

How You Will Do It

  • You will stay close to the business process, listen carefully to user needs, and remove friction where it affects customers or operations.
  • You will own your work with accountability, accuracy, safety-minded thinking, and integrity in every step.
  • You will use a continuous-improvement mindset, asking questions, challenging gaps, and helping the team solve problems early.
  • You will collaborate openly across business and technology teams, building trust and aligning different perspectives toward one outcome.
  • You will support structured issue handling, clear documentation, and disciplined follow-through from analysis through resolution.
  • You will contribute to reliable delivery by working methodically through testing, validation, and operational support activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience in an OTC functional analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash processes and their impact across the business.
  • Experience supporting Oracle Fusion OTC processes, including order management, invoicing, receipts, or related finance activities.
  • Ability to analyze business requirements, identify process gaps, and support functional solutions.
  • Experience working with customer master data and month-end close activities.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams.
  • Solid problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to documentation and follow-up.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on exposure to Oracle Fusion Financials AR or Oracle Fusion Order Management.
  • Experience with invoice processing, receipt handling, or AR subledger support.
  • Familiarity with DevOps or Agile ways of working.
  • Experience supporting testing cycles, change requests, or post-go-live operational support.

Why Join Us

You will be part of a team that values practical problem-solving, customer impact, and continuous improvement. At Johnson Controls, your ideas and collaboration can help strengthen the processes that keep business moving and customers supported.

If you are ready to bring your OTC expertise to a role where your work can make a real difference, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Lead Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

The Lead Engineer supports the operations, maintenance, reliability, security, and capacity management of StarHub's Cable Landing Stations and submarine cable facilities. The role coordinates and overssees technical activities involving submarine cable systems, colocation facilities, interconnection services, and supporting infrastructure while ensuring compliance with regulatory, consortium, and operational requirements. The Lead Engineer provides technical guidance, mentors junior engineers, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to maintain high service availability and operational excellence.

JOB DESCRIPTION

**a. Lead the operations and maintenance of submarine cable systems, cable landing stations, and associated infrastructure. b. Support the implementation and planning of telecommunications system in the StarHub cable landing station. c. Lead fault management, troubleshooting, restoration, and service recovery activities for submarine cable systems and CLS facilities. d. 24 x 7 standby with on call duties for cable station operations requirement, submarine cable systems (dry and wet segment) fault localizations and fault repair supports and coordination. e. Oversee and provide support on the implementation of M&E, building facilities, outside plant infrastructure systems in the cable station f. On-board representatives on vessel for submarine cable projects or repairs. g. Coordinate with and submit reports to submarine cable consortia NOC and NA regarding consortia related activities. h. Lead submarine cable and equipment room projects site survey/inspection, installation, and commissioning. i. Lead the planning, implementation, and management of colocation services, interconnection facilities, cross-connect services, and customer requirements within CLS facilities. j. Oversee equipment room facilities request to ensure efficient planning and allocation of floor space and power in the cable station. k. Support the implementation of colocation projects in the cable station. l. Review the process and procedure, and work with the relevant stakeholders to achieve better efficiency for cable consortia, backhaul and colocation services (space, power, and interconnection) in the cable station. m. Lead the team in maintaining and updating documentation of all submarine cable facilities, test equipment and spare plants including colocation customers’ colocation facilities and interconnection services in the cable station. n. Review and analyze cable station space and power usage and highlights for future requirements. o. Mentor, coach, and develop junior engineers through structured knowledge sharing, technical training, and on-the-job learning.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

a. Degree in Electrical/Electronics/ Communication Engineering b. Minimum 5-8 years of experience in submarine cable systems, transmission networks, cable landing station operations, telecommunications infrastructure, or related engineering fields. c. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing technical operations, projects, and multi-stakeholder environments. d. Strong knowledge of cable landing station operations, colocation facilities, transmission systems, power and cooling infrastructure, and physical security requirements. e. Experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing engineering teams. f. Team player, self-motivated and able to work independently

Qualifications

job.title: Technical Services Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As Technical Services Manager (TSM) reporting to our Senior Technical Service Manager (STSM), you will work closely with our Operations team, making an impact in a number of ways:

  • Supporting the STSM in relation to all aspects of data centre operations to achieve 100% uptime and compliance with customer SLAs
  • Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team of managers, technicians and third party vendors to plan, manage and supervise maintenance activities, both planned and reactive, on a nominated site.
  • First point of contact for AirTrunk’s customers in respect of works planning, incident management and reporting

What You'll Do

Either a portion of the data centre site or a portfolio of customers will be allocated to each Technical Service Manager (TSM). The TSM then runs this sub-section of the site, reporting and raising issues/tasks to the STSM as required;

  • Lead all aspects of the planning and coordination of all preventive maintenance and repair works, ensure change management and incident management procedures are followed; coordinate activities as required with customers
  • Coordinate with the Development team to run construction activity and installations, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards
  • Ensure adherence to site operating procedures (SOP, MOP, EOP) and any other documentation required by law, e.g. SWMS
  • Ensure compliance with site held accreditations, including, but not limited to, ISMS, ISO, SOC2, PCI.
  • Maintain compliance with local regulatory requirements including environmental, building, fire, electrical, hydraulic, occupational health & safety
  • Primary operational contact for customers and local point of escalation during emergency events and day-to-day operations
  • Attend witness testing of all equipment during commissioning to validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation
  • Manage the provisioning of data centre services including connectivity, power services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to customers
  • Lead minor capital projects for customers/internal purposes
  • Supervise operational metrics, data and analyse risks
  • Conduct regular property inspections
  • Take part in the 'on call' incident response roster

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of mechanical and electrical experience in data centres (preferred), facilities, engineering operations, trades or related fields
  • Ability to establish and review Method of Procedure documents, incident reports, emergency event summaries, root cause analysis reports, and O&M manuals
  • Ideally, successfully run 3rd party service providers and negotiate quote/pricing for services
  • Familiar with working with Customer Portals, BMS, Computerized Maintenance Management Systems
  • Have Own Security NV1 Clearance or ability to get one
  • Excellent collaborator with strong communication skills in English
  • Exceptionally flexible, forward-thinking and motivated by change
  • Effective customer management skills and meeting chair experience

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

What You'll Do

As the Service Delivery Coordinator, your daily responsibilities will include, but not limited to, the following key tasks, along with tackling a variety of other exciting challenges:

About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We are looking for an experienced individual who genuinely enjoys building relationships and takes pride in helping customers succeed. In this role, you will play a central part in supporting CDC’s customers across the full customer lifecycle, ensuring their experience with us is seamless, consistent and positive.

This is a highly visible, collaborative role where you will become a trusted partner to our customers and a key connector within CDC. You will work closely with teams across operations, delivery and commercial to bring people together, anticipate needs, manage risks early and deliver outcomes that go above and beyond expectations.

Reporting to the Head of Customer Success, you will have end to end ownership of customer satisfaction and the opportunity to continuously improve how we deliver for our customers, strengthening relationships and helping CDC show up at its best every day.

  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About you

You are an experienced customer success professional who enjoys ownership, thrives in complex environments and takes pride in delivering great outcomes for customers. You bring a calm, structured approach, build trust easily, and are motivated by making things work well, consistently.

  • Extensive experience supporting large or enterprise customers with engagement with leaders and wider internal & stakeholders

  • A solutions focused mindset with strong problem solving ability and attention to detail
  • A genuine commitment to customer satisfaction, taking ownership of outcomes and nurturing long term stakeholder relationships
  • Experience working closely with delivery leads to ensure aligned, consistent communication and progress across active projects

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. job.title: Senior manager - Group Internal Audit, Technology
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

  • *

The Senior Manager, Group Internal Audit – Technology is a senior specialist role within Singtel Group Internal Audit, reporting directly to the Audit director, and is responsible for providing independent, objective, and risk-based assurance over Singtel’s technology, cybersecurity, and digital environments. The Senior Manager leads and delivers complex technology and cybersecurity audits, engagements, overseeing audit planning, execution and reporting, and providing robust and evidence-based challenge to key stakeholders. The role contributes to the development of the technology audit plan and ensures audit outcomes are high quality, actionable, and support effective risk management and control improvement. Audit outputs contribute directly to management assurance, Audit Committee reporting, and regulatory disclosures. Group Internal Audit operates as a key pillar of Singtel’s corporate governance framework and reports functionally to the Singtel Group Audit Committee.

Make an Impact by

**

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, risk-based technology and cybersecurity audits across Singtel Group.
  • Develop Audit Planning Memorandums (APMs), defining audit objectives, scope, risks, and audit approach.
  • Design and implement audit programs and procedures aligned to Group Internal Audit methodology and professional standards.
  • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of IT general controls, application controls, cybersecurity controls, and technology governance frameworks.
  • Evaluate major technology initiatives and systems under development to ensure appropriate governance, controls, documentation, and security-by-design.
  • Provide independent assurance over cybersecurity risk management, including protection of networks, cloud environments, systems, and sensitive data.
  • Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations, industry standards, and Singtel policies (e.g. data protection, cybersecurity, technology risk).
  • Identify emerging technology risks and assess Singtel’s control maturity and risk posture.
  • Perform control advisory reviews for significant in-flight programs and strategic initiatives where required.
  • Identify root causes of control deficiencies and develop practical, commercially grounded recommendations.
  • Prepare high-quality audit reports with minimal supervision and ensure alignment and agreement of findings with senior management.
  • Lead audit kick-off and closing meetings with senior executives, ensuring clear communication of objectives, scope, findings, and risk implications.
  • Provide clear, credible challenge to senior stakeholders while maintaining strong professional relationships and audit independence.
  • Escalate significant or high-risk matters to the Audit Director and support Audit Committee reporting.
  • Coach, train, and review the work of less experienced auditors, embedding audit methodology, quality standards, and professional judgement.
  • Provide technical leadership in technology and cybersecurity auditing across the function.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of technology audit methodology, tools, and practices.
  • Oversee tracking and validation of management action plans and perform follow-up reviews to ensure timely and effective remediation.
  • Support annual audit planning, resource management, and prioritisation of technology audit coverage.
  • Contribute to ad-hoc assignments, investigations, and Audit Committee-related matters as required.
  • Stay current on emerging technology, cybersecurity threats, and industry developments, applying insights to strengthen audit coverage and impact.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, or CIA.
  • Extensive experience in technology audit, IT risk, cybersecurity, or internal audit, preferably within large, complex organisations.
  • Strong understanding of telecommunications, digital platforms, and large-scale technology environments.
  • Hands-on experience auditing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern architectures.
  • Proven ability to lead complex audits and engage credibly with senior management.
  • Excellent analytical, report writing, and influencing skills.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

**

**

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Senior Specialist, Radio Network Engrg
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

The Senior Specialist, Radio Network Engineering is responsible for evaluating, validating, and introducing new Radio Access Network (RAN) technologies and features to support the company's network evolution strategy. The role drives the technical assessment of emerging radio technologies through standards analysis, laboratory testing, feature evaluation, field trials, and commercial readiness activities, ensuring new capabilities deliver measurable improvements in network performance, spectrum efficiency, energy consumption, and customer experience.

  • Evaluate emerging RAN technologies, vendor solutions, and 3GPP Releases (e.g., Release 17, Release 18/5G-Advanced and Release 19 features) to support network evolution and technology roadmap planning.
  • Review and assess new 3GPP specifications and industry developments, including AI/ML for RAN optimisation, Ambient IoT, Reduced Capability (RedCap) devices, Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN), Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC), XR optimisation, enhanced Massive MIMO, network energy-saving features, and multi-antenna enhancements.
  • Conduct technical evaluation of new RAN software features, hardware platforms, and vendor releases, including capabilities such as 5G Carrier Aggregation enhancements, MIMO enhancements, Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS), uplink enhancements, network slicing support, positioning services (NR Positioning), and energy-saving functions.
  • Develop, execute, and manage laboratory validation plans to verify feature functionality, interoperability, performance, stability, and standards compliance prior to field deployment.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute Proof of Concept (PoC), interoperability testing, pilot deployments, and field trials, including defining objectives, KPIs, success criteria, and performance evaluation methodologies.
  • Support commercial rollout of approved radio technologies by developing deployment strategies, implementation guidelines, operational readiness documentation, and rollout acceptance criteria.
  • Analyse trial, benchmarking, and post-deployment performance data to identify improvement opportunities and recommend optimisation or corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with Radio Planning, Optimisation, Core Network, Transport, Device, OSS, Automation, and Operations teams, as well as equipment vendors, to ensure successful end-to-end technology introduction.
  • Engage equipment vendors to assess product roadmaps, software maturity, interoperability, and implementation plans, ensuring alignment with the company's network strategy and 3GPP standards evolution.
  • Prepare technical reports, engineering recommendations, standards impact assessments, deployment documentation, and executive presentations to support engineering governance and investment decisions.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 6–8 years of experience in mobile radio network engineering, RAN planning, optimisation, technology introduction, or network performance.
  • Hands-on experience in evaluating, testing, and deploying LTE and 5G NR features.
  • Experience conducting laboratory validation, interoperability testing, field trials, and commercial rollout of radio technologies.
  • Experience working with radio equipment vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of LTE, LTE-Advanced, and 5G NR radio technologies and architecture.
  • Ability to interpret and assess 3GPP specifications and translate standards into deployment requirements.
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methodologies, feature validation, troubleshooting, and KPI analysis.
  • Knowledge of radio performance metrics, RF engineering principles, and network optimization

job.title: Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC)
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

NTT is currently looking for a Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC). The Vice President, Regional Construction is a key executive role reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Construction. The successful candidate will have direct accountability for the design, supply chain and construction organizations in the region responsible for capital infrastructure investment. This role will provide strategic direction and leadership to enable and execute projects within specified timelines, budgets, and quality standards to enable the regional business goals of the company.

This is a full time remote role based in Malaysia, Singapore or Thailand.

What we are looking for

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans for the construction, design and supply chain organizations, aligning with the Global Infrastructure Development (GID) organization's overall goals, the business goals in the region and industry trends/best practices. Identify opportunities for growth, speed to market improvement, and cost optimization.
  • Team Leadership: Manage a team of construction, design and supply chain professionals, including project managers, engineers, architects, commercial managers, etc. Foster a collaborative and high-performing work environment, promoting teamwork and individual development.
  • Regional Leadership: Be the in-region leader of the broader GID team which includes the construction, design and supply chain organizations, but also global teams with in-region resources (safety, power, land, project controls and front end engineering).
  • Project Management: Ensure proper project management is occurring from initiation to completion, ensuring adherence to project plans, schedules, and budgets. Monitor progress, identify potential risks, and implement mitigation strategies as necessary.
  • Vendor and Contractor Management: Monitors the performance of general contractors, architects/engineers and other suppliers to ensure compliance, execution, quality, and safety standards.
  • Supply Base Development: Personally engage with the key principals of supply chain partners to develop a supply chain that can reliably support the business needs of the company in the region.
  • Budgeting and Financial Management: Liaisons with project controls on project funding plans, necessary financial forecasts and reports.
  • Quality Assurance: Work with CX/Quality team to ensure adherence to quality assurance and commissioning programs and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including sales, operations, clients and regulatory authorities. Communicate project updates, resolve issues, and maintain positive relationships with all parties involved.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, building codes, safety regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex construction projects on time and within budget.
  • Ability to build a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
  • Strong financial acumen and experience in budgeting, cost control, and financial analysis.
  • Proficiency in project management software, construction management tools, and MS Office suite.
  • Understanding of design and engineering.
  • Proven experience in implementing processes in a rapid growth environment
  • Knowledgeable of the basics necessary for operating in compliance where NTT is located.
  • Knowledgeable of the key supply chain operating concepts, executive relationships with supply chain partners in the region and claims management.
  • Knowledgeable of construction law and contracts.
  • Skilled at creating and maintaining a collaborative design/construction/operations environment in a global culture.

ACEDEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field. Master's degree (beneficial).

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Extensive experience (15+ years) in construction management, preferably in a leadership role within the construction industry. Ideally experience with design and supply chain sourcing in addition to construction.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Remain stationery for long periods of time.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Perform work during regional business hours and time zones with flexibility for global coordination.

WORK CONDITIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Travel required up to 50%.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.
