job.title: Sales Operations & Support Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

1\. Export Shipment and Collateral Management

This section focuses on operational oversight and documentation accuracy for technical products.

  • Plan, schedule, and coordinate the export of goods, including transportation, documentation, and customs requirements.
  • Ensure timely shipment and delivery of goods to meet customer expectations and avoid penalties or delays.
  • Oversee the correct preparation of export documentation such as invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin (FTA/AIFTA etc.
  • Ensure to share them in a timely manner with the relevant regional Interco team.
  • Coordinate with Engineering to ensure product specifications, technical manuals, and compliance certificates are included in the export documentation package.

2\. Product and Engineering Interaction

This section defines the collaboration with the technical teams.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Serve as the liaison between Interco/Commercial teams and the Engineering/Manufacturing departments.
  • Technical Readiness: Work with Engineering to track the design freeze, compliance sign-off, and production readiness of new or updated electrical/mechanical products intended for export.
  • maintain a foundational understanding of the technical side of the export product line to accurately represent technical status and requirements in planning meetings.
  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and proactively communicate product-related risks that could impact export timelines, such as regulatory compliance issues or last-minute design changes.

3\. Risk Mitigation & Process Optimization

This section is focused on continuous process improvement.

  • Identify and mitigate risks in the export process, including issues related to customs, logistics, or international regulations
  • Take the ownership of Developing, refining, and implementing efficient Interco export processes and workflows to streamline export operations
  • Identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies in the export processes and recommend solutions to enhance effectiveness and speed
  • Work with Engineering to define clear handover points (e.g., _Product to Documentation_ or _BOM to Logistics_) to reduce delays.
  • Resolve any issues that arise during the shipment process, such as delays, damaged goods, or customs holds

4\. Inventory, SIOP, and Product Lifecycle Management

This section includes the planning role, incorporating engineering readiness into the SIOP process.

  • Discuss with the regional Interco team and Plan to liquify the inventory in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate with regional Interco team and inform Demand /factory team if any order is expected to delay.
  • Conduct and attend weekly SIOP meeting for product readiness date.
  • Ensure Engineering's inputs on product testing, quality checks, and final assembly schedules are integrated into the SIOP meeting's discussion on the product readiness date.
  • Monitor FOC shipments (in case of need) through periodic credence meeting etc

5\. Export Order Dashboard and Interco Communication Management

  • Maintain export Smartsheet on a regular basis.
  • Share weekly OB and sales reports with LOB/region classification and tables.
  • Upload and maintain Interco order status on EBO for respective region
  • Ownership of maintaining the latest lead time sheet for all the export products on EBO
  • Lead the weekly meeting with Interco teams and effectively and timely communicate the order acknowledgement.

Qualifications: -

Required/ Minimum Qualifications: -

  • Bachelor’s Degree/ Diploma or equivalent of 5-10 years’ experience
  • Proven experience in project management, preferably in process improvement or organizational development projects.

Additional / Preferred Qualifications: -

  • Background in Thermal/ Power
  • Experience in implementing continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Six Sigma / Lean certifications / PMP or any other Project Management certification
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, utilizing data-driven insights for decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, conveying complex concepts clearly.
  • Ability to create and manage comprehensive documentation systems.
  • Demonstrated project management skills, planning, executing, and overseeing projects from conception to completion.
  • Experience leading change management initiatives, guiding teams through transitions.
  • Proven leadership skills, motivating and guiding cross-functional teams toward common goals.
  • Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager, Asia
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary:The Strategic Account Manager – Asia is responsible for developing and executing strategic account plans to drive sales growth, increase market share, and strengthen customer relationships across key markets in Asia.

Working closely with major customers, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership, you will identify business opportunities, deliver tailored solutions, and support the achievement of revenue and profitability targets. This individual contributor role requires strong commercial acumen, stakeholder management, and a proactive, customer-focused approach to position Vertiv as a preferred partner across the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Execute plans to increase market share and share of wallet in accordance with company targets for orders, revenue, and profitability, under the guidance of senior leadership.
  • Develop a strong understanding of key customers' priorities, challenges, and business objectives.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive account plans to achieve sales targets and revenue growth for assigned strategic accounts across the region.
  • Establish and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within customer organisations.
  • Understand customer requirements and collaborate with internal teams to tailor solutions that meet their specific needs, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Work closely with internal functions, including Marketing, Product Management, and Operations, to align strategies, deliver value, and provide seamless support to key accounts.
  • Analyse market trends, competitor activity, and industry developments to identify new business opportunities and recommend growth initiatives.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with key accounts, providing insights, performance updates, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions with customers, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that comply with company policies and profitability objectives.
  • Manage and resolve customer issues or disputes that may arise, maintaining open communication and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
  • Prepare accurate and timely reports, forecasts, and updates on key account activities, highlighting progress, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Remain up to date with industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance expertise and identify innovative strategies and best practices.
  • Contribute to medium and long-term strategies to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and recognition of Vertiv's capabilities, expertise, and technology leadership among targeted accounts.
  • Recommend new practices, processes, and performance measures to improve account management effectiveness and sales outcomes.
  • Act as a mentor to less experienced colleagues where appropriate, sharing knowledge and best practices to support team development.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline; an MBA would be advantageous.
  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in strategic account management, business development, or strategic sales, ideally within the technology, manufacturing, logistics, or industrial solutions sectors.
  • Proven track record of managing large, complex, multi-country accounts across the Asia region.
  • Demonstrated success in achieving sales objectives, driving revenue growth, and increasing share of wallet within strategic customer accounts.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and digital account management tools.

Skills & Competencies

  • Highly driven, proactive, and adaptable, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced regional environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a sound understanding of B2B sales cycles, negotiation, and contract management.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and build credibility with senior decision-makers.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate customer insights into actionable account strategies and process improvements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret market data, industry trends, and competitive intelligence.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in English; proficiency in additional Asian languages, such as Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean, would be advantageous.
  • Highly collaborative, with the ability to work effectively across functions to deliver customer-focused, value-driven solutions.
  • Ability to work independently on key initiatives whilst consulting with management to ensure alignment on priorities and desired outcomes.

Job Summary

The AutoCAD HVAC & Revit Draftsman/Designer is responsible for preparing detailed HVAC engineering drawings, layouts, and 3D BIM models using AutoCAD and Revit software. The role involves supporting the design, installation, and commissioning teams by developing accurate drawings in compliance with project specifications, industry standards, and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities HVAC Design & Drafting

  • Prepare HVAC layout drawings, ducting layouts, piping layouts, equipment placement drawings, and coordination drawings using AutoCAD.
  • Develop and maintain HVAC BIM models using Revit.
  • Generate shop drawings, installation drawings, as-built drawings, and fabrication drawings.
  • Create HVAC schematics, mechanical room layouts, and equipment schedules.
  • Prepare BOQ support drawings and material quantity take-offs.

BIM & Revit Modeling

  • Develop 3D HVAC models for commercial, industrial, and data center projects.
  • Perform clash detection and coordination with electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and architectural teams.
  • Update and modify BIM models based on project revisions and site feedback.
  • Ensure adherence to BIM execution plans and project standards.

Documentation & Coordination

  • Review engineering sketches, specifications, and design calculations.
  • Coordinate with project engineers, consultants, customers, and site teams.

Quality & Compliance

  • Verify drawing accuracy before release.
  • Incorporate client comments and design changes promptly.

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Certification in AutoCAD and Revit preferred.

Experience

Job Description

Brief Job Description:

Job Title

Service Engineer – Precision Air Conditioning (PAC)

Department

Service Operations – Thermal Management

Reporting To

Service Manager / Regional Service Manager

Job Summary

The PAC Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support for Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) systems and associated cooling equipment. The role requires ensuring maximum equipment uptime, meeting SLA commitments, and providing excellent customer service at data centers, telecom sites, IT facilities, and commercial establishments.

Key Responsibilities Installation & Commissioning

  • Perform installation, testing, and commissioning of PAC units and associated cooling systems.
  • Verify site readiness and ensure compliance with engineering drawings and safety requirements.
  • Conduct performance testing and prepare commissioning reports.
  • Coordinate with project teams, customers, and subcontractors during project execution.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Execute scheduled preventive maintenance activities for PAC units, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, condensers, CDU, FWU, and related systems.
  • Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, fans, control panels, sensors, and refrigerant circuits.
  • Submit maintenance reports and recommendations for improving equipment reliability.

Breakdown & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, and control systems.
  • Analyze alarms and operational abnormalities using controller logs and monitoring systems.
  • Ensure timely closure of breakdown calls as per SLA commitments.
  • Support emergency and critical site requirements during breakdown situations.

Customer Support

  • Provide technical support and guidance to customers.
  • Maintain professional communication during service visits.
  • Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Prepare service reports and obtain customer sign-off upon activity completion.

Spare Parts & Inventory Management

  • Identify and recommend replacement parts and consumables.
  • Maintain service inventory and tools in good condition.
  • Support quotation preparation for repairs and spare replacement requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) guidelines.
  • Ensure proper usage of PPE during service activities.
  • Maintain compliance with customer safety regulations and permit systems.
  • Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related field.
  • ITI (RAC/Electrical) with relevant experience may also be considered.

Experience

  • 2 to 8 years of experience in HVAC, Precision Cooling, or Critical Cooling Systems.
  • Experience in data centers, telecom infrastructure, IT facilities, healthcare facilities, or commercial buildings preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Good understanding of refrigeration cycle and HVAC principles.
  • Experience with:
  • Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) Units
  • CRAC / CRAH Systems
  • Chilled Water Systems
  • DX Cooling Systems
  • Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Condensers
  • CDU and FWU Systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot:
  • Compressors
  • EEV/TEV Valves
  • Refrigerant Circuits
  • PLC and Microprocessor Controllers
  • Electrical Panels and Drives
  • Sensors and Communication Networks
  • Knowledge of refrigerants and safe handling procedures.
  • Familiarity with BMS and remote monitoring systems.

Key Competencies

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Customer-focused approach.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently at remote sites.
  • Time management and SLA adherence.
  • Teamwork and collaboration.

Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

  • Preventive Maintenance Compliance.
  • First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR).
  • Breakdown Response Time (RT).
  • Turnaround Time (TAT) for call closure.
  • Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).
  • Service Revenue through spare parts identification.
  • Safety Compliance and Zero Incident Record.

Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel extensively across assigned geographical regions.
  • Availability for emergency breakdown support, weekend work, and on-call duty when required.

Preferred Industry Experience

  • Data Centers
  • Telecom Facilities
  • IT Parks
  • Critical Infrastructure Projects
  • Pharmaceutical Facilities
  • Manufacturing Plants
  • Commercial Buildings

Preferred Certification: HVAC/R, Refrigerant Handling, Electrical Safety, Working at Height, and OEM-specific PAC product training (Vertiv, Stulz, Schneider, Rittal, Climaveneta, etc.).

job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Application Development and Support Analyst to provide development, maintenance, enhancement, and production support for Oracle Applications. The role will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, troubleshooting application issues, and working closely with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure system stability and continuous improvement.

The candidate will be responsible for analyzing incidents and service requests, understanding business processes, identifying root causes, coordinating resolutions, supporting enhancements, and ensuring that Oracle Applications meet business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Support
  • Provide production support for Oracle Applications.
  • Analyze and resolve application incidents, defects, and service requests within agreed SLAs.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to Oracle modules, interfaces, concurrent programs, reports, workflows, and database objects.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions.
  • Support application deployments, patches, upgrades, and production releases.
  • Application Development
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Perform unit testing, system testing, and support user acceptance testing.
  • Business & Stakeholder Management
  • Work closely with functional teams and business users to understand requirements and resolve issues.
  • Participate in requirement gathering, impact analysis, and solution design.
  • Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain knowledge of business processes and their relationship with Oracle Applications.

Required Technical and Functional Skills

  • Strong functional knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) and/or Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications.
  • Good understanding of one or more Oracle functional modules.
  • Strong understanding of business processes related to the supported Oracle modules.
  • Experience in production application support and incident management. Experience in Manufacturing Industry preferred.
  • Ability to troubleshoot functional issues and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Experience in requirements gathering and functional analysis.
  • Experience preparing functional specifications and test cases.
  • Strong knowledge of SIT, UAT, regression testing, and defect management.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL for data validation and investigation is desirable.

Qualifications

job.title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Data, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
job.description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.

You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers. AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. 221100 10044

Key job responsibilities Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks.

Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale.

Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight.

Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks.

Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments.

Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations.

Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures.

Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace.

  • Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
  • Knowledge of data engineering pipelines, cloud solutions, ETL management, databases, visualizations and analytical platforms

job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
  • 1+ years of computer networking experience

job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Mechanical Engineering Team Lead - Data Centre ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to create and modify the standard designs of equipment, systems, or installations, including standard specifications for manufacturing, fabrication, or construction, using standard design concepts. Each day, you will design engineering solutions, including drawings and calculations according to contract specifications. You will also showcase your expertise by contributing to design reviews and design verification and modifying the design, as necessary.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Smart Power division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to the preparation of specific aspects of design assignments to meet the contractual obligations, adhering to relevant standards, safety, cybersecurity, and quality requirements.
  • Ensuring that Bill of Materials for the project meets contractual obligations and project gross margin requirements by not generating Project Left-Over Material.
  • Coordinating with manufacturing and testing functions to ensure the designs are appropriately manufactured / staged and tested, updating the engineering deliverables as built.
  • Using standard processes and tools and assisting in developing new processes and tools for the reuse of technical solutions.
  • Hands on experience on solid works 3D designs and AutoCAD (Mechanical engineering) is mandatory.
  • Knowledge of IEC61439-1 in terms of Type testing of LV systems

Qualifications for the role

  • You are highly skilled in Mechanical Design of LV Electrical Distribution Equipment, including Switchboards, Panel Boards and MCC/PCC Panels, with a good understanding of IEC 61439 standards.
  • You have 5 to 8 years of experience in Mechanical Design, preferably in LV switchboards and electrical distribution products.
  • Possess strong proficiency in SolidWorks and AutoCAD, with experience in 3D modelling, mechanical drawings, BOM preparation and manufacturing drawing release.
  • You are experienced in understanding customer requirements, preparing switchboard layouts, finalizing Mechanical BOMs and releasing drawings in SAP.
  • You are passionate about customer satisfaction, technical coordination, continuous improvement and achieving project KPIs.
  • BE/bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from a recognized/reputed university.
  • You are at ease communicating with customers and internal stakeholders and working effectively with cross-functional teams.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.title: Staff Partner Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

As a Generative AI (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within partners for our customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke and scalable agentic solutions directly with our partners, for and within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic partners, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical connector and feedback loop for the partner to Google, transforming real-world field and partner insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. You will serve as the agent engineer bridging the gap between AI prototypes and production-grade reality for our strategic AI partners and their own FDE teams.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a team lead and developer within the strategic AI partner for complex AI applications, working with the partner’s own teams to transition from rapid prototypes to production-grade, replicable agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable return on investment (ROI).
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure partner developed agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable partner and field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Co-build with a strategic AI partner’s forward deployed engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices.
  • Help partners to build their own agentic delivery capabilities to set them up for long term success, focusing on the ROI at customer engagements ensuring customer activation.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Software Engineer, Payments Security
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Write and review backend infrastructure code.
  • Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
  • Perform technical security assessments, code audits and design reviews.
  • Develop technical solutions to help mitigate security vulnerabilities.
  • Advocate security and secure practices throughout Google Payments.

job.title: Data Center Technician, Global Data Center Server Operations
job.description:
About the job

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g. Machine Learning platforms, network architecture).
  • Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose moderately complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and identify the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, and infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently. Independently execute advanced operational procedures as part of daily work activities and follow security policies and processes.
  • Shift work is required to meet evolving business needs and operational schedules.
  • Collaborate with the partner teams (e.g., Program Managers, Data Center Operations, and Software and Hardware Engineers) to complete tasks, and to escalate and resolve defined problems.

  • Adherence with all processes and guidelines to execute project within timeline.

  • BE /M.Tech (Mechnical / Chemical / Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics)
  • 4-8 Years’ experience in relevant field

Job Description – Project Engineer (Contractual Role)

Location: Mumbai Employment Type: Contractual (Contract to be renewed every year based on performance) Experience: 4–7 Years

Role Summary:

The Project Engineer will be responsible for end‑to‑end project execution of IBMS / ELV systems, ensuring timely installation, quality compliance, testing, and commissioning at project sites. The role demands strong hands‑on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and CFS systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute and manage IBMS / ELV projects at site.
  • Supervise installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of systems.
  • Handle project execution activities related to:

IBMS (Integrated Building Management Systems)

  • CCTV Systems
  • CFS (Critical / Fire & Life Safety Systems)

Coordinate with project managers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.

Ensure adherence to project schedules, quality standards, and safety guidelines.

Review technical drawings, BOQs, and system specifications.

Conduct site inspections and quality checks for installed systems.

Prepare daily/weekly project progress reports and maintain documentation.

Resolve technical and operational issues at site in coordination with stakeholders.

Required Skills & Technical Expertise:

  • Strong hands‑on experience in IBMS project execution.
  • Practical exposure to installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Mandatory experience in CCTV and CFS systems.
  • Good understanding of ELV system integration and site execution practices.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and schematics.
  • Good communication, coordination, and problem‑solving skills.

Qualification & Experience:

  • Diploma / BE / BTech in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / E&C or related discipline.
  • 4–7 years of relevant experience in IBMS / ELV projects.
  • Experience in commercial buildings, IT parks, data centers, or industrial projects preferred.

Reporting To:

Project Manager / Senior Project Engineer

job.description:

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. Maintain project quality, on time delivery and manage escalations.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Provides coaching and professional development to team members in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills to bridge the gap.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System
  • Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.),Blue Beam.
  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

2 to 8 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System.

job.title: Senior Executive (Dunning & Recovery)
job.description:
Job Description

Legal Recovery & Insolvency Management

  • Manage legal recovery and insolvency cases, including filing Proof of Debt (POD) claims with Liquidators and the Official Assignee (OA).
  • Monitor, track, and provide regular progress updates on ongoing legal cases to internal stakeholders.
  • Gather, compile, and verify legal documentation required for submission to external legal counsels.
  • Represent the company in Small Claims Tribunals (SCT) hearings and consultations (online and in-person).

Vendor Management & Dunning Operations

  • Manage relationships with Debt Collection Agencies (DCAs) and law firms; monitoring performance metrics and reviewing of billing/commission computations.
  • Oversee internal dunning workflows, and common mailbox inquiries/complaints.
  • Review and manage accounts under Specific Provisioning (SP) to maintain accurate provisioning
  • Prepare justification paper for bad debt write-offs (WO) for management approval.
  • Support process improvement initiatives, ad-hoc operational tasks, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements

BPO Managment

  • Supervise and review the work of BPO staffs handling credit reporting, Specific Provisioning (SP), and bad debt write-off (WO) preparation.

Qualifications

  • Degree or Diploma in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline, with a solid grasp of credit control and provisioning frameworks.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in dunning, credit recovery, and legal insolvency workflows, preferably within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven experience supervising BPO/offshore teams and reviewing operational submissions
  • Practical knowledge of local legal processes (POD filings, OA/Liquidator administration) and SCT hearing protocols.
  • Strong financial acumen in tracking Specific Provisioning (SP) and preparing write-off proposals.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and MS Office, with advanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Excel; knowledge of Google Apps Script or VBA preferred), alongside hands-on experience with SAP
  • Strong written communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills under tight timelines.

job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Plan and implement international networks and network requirements based on traffic forecasts to support international services.
  • Plan and implement bilateral restorations with overseas correspondent on 24 x 7 standby.
  • Negotiate with overseas correspondents on bilateral circuit requirement
  • Coordinate the implementation of circuits and associated equipment
  • Liaise with relevant parties for specific international network requirements
  • Coordinate implementation of restoration plan with international transmission
  • Perform effective activation, deactivation and provisioning of all StarHub’s International capacity and of different cable systems.
  • Advise and fulfill BDM enquiry on capacity availability and international circuit design.
  • Ensure all work orders are correctly provisioned, cost-effective, and delivered in a timely manner in alignment with specifications and requirements.
  • Project management of StarHub’s collocation and interconnections requirements at Singtel’s and other cable stations in the Asia Pacific region.
  • 24 x 7 standby with on call duties for submarine cable systems (dry and wet segment) fault localizations, fault repair and liaising with relevant cable systems and overseas carriers for restoration capacity.
  • On-board representatives on vessel for submarine cable projects, surveys and repairs.
  • Contract (StarHub Cable Station Interconnection Agreement) negotiation / revision with new / existing colocation carriers leading to the execution of agreement.
  • Working closely with Legal, Regulatory and Finance to create cable station services products and services including legal agreement, financial costing, internal workflow and processes based on legal and regulatory framework.
  • Maintain overall end-to-end responsibility for providing colocation services to customers at StarHub Cable Landing Stations.
  • Manage colocation customers to ensure efficient allocation of colo space and power in StarHub’s cable landing station.
  • Oversee colocation customers’ site access and security.
  • Keep up-to-date and accurate records of the customers’ colocation subscribed services.
  • Review, process, track, and maintain accurate records of cross-connection requests and completions; perform troubleshooting and fiber patching.
  • Liaise with colo customers on adhoc/emergency interconnection, troubleshooting and urgent site access requests.
  • Work closely with Cable Station and Facility Management teams to coordinate projects, manage colocation facility capacity, and optimize facility safety, performance, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Travel overseas to attend cable consortia meetings as required.

The Assistant Manager will lead a small team, resolve operational issues, and partner with both internal stakeholders and external parties (e.g., collecting agents, banks, and payment providers) to drive automation, efficiency, and cost savings, while enhancing customer and business experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end POS and payment operations, including validation, reconciliation, settlement, and exception handling.
  • Monitor and strengthen internal controls, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and risk mitigation.
  • Resolve issues across POS systems, payment gateways, and related platforms in collaboration with IS and product owners.
  • Collaborate with external collecting agents, banks, and payment service providers to ensure smooth operations, accurate settlements, and issue resolution.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and cost-saving initiatives to reduce manual work, errors, and transaction costs.
  • Partner with stakeholders such as IS, product owners, finance teams, etc to ensure accurate data flow, resolve issues, and recommend operational efficiencies.
  • Provide insights to enhance efficiency, customer experience, and support digital/technology initiatives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop team members, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

job.title: High Voltage Site Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the HV Site Engineer reporting to the Associate Director, HV Infrastructure, you will work closely with our Technology, Development, Construction, Commissioning and Operations teams, making your mark in several ways:

  • Lead the safe and effective on-site delivery of high voltage (HV) infrastructure across AirTrunk projects, ensuring installations meet approved designs, quality requirements, programme commitments and operational needs
  • Coordinate contractors, consultants, network service providers and internal teams through construction, testing, energisation, commissioning and handover
  • Provide practical site-based engineering solutions to HV issues, with a strong focus on safety, constructability, reliability and continuity of operations

Your Day to Day

  • Manage the on-site delivery of HV networks across new and existing AirTrunk sites, ensuring work is completed safely and in accordance with approved designs, applicable codes, standards and AirTrunk requirements
  • Oversee the installation of HV equipment and systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection relays, SCADA, earthing, cabling and DC systems
  • Review issued-for-construction drawings, specifications, method statements, inspection and test plans, safe work method statements and vendor documentation before site execution
  • Supervise and collaborate with principal contractors, specialist subcontractors and suppliers to achieve safe, practical and high-quality outcomes on time and within budget
  • Complete site inspections, monitor workmanship and quality records, and drive the timely resolution of non-conformances, defects and punch-list items
  • Coordinate HV access, isolations, permits and switching activities with authorised personnel, Site Specialists and Operations teams
  • Act as the site technical interface between designers, consultants, contractors, vendors, network service providers and AirTrunk stakeholders
  • Support testing, energisation and commissioning activities, including witnessing tests, reviewing results and confirming that systems are ready for safe operation
  • Prepare and review methods of procedure, switching plans and other site execution documents in conjunction with the Site Specialist and commissioning teams
  • Resolve site queries, constructability issues, clashes and design discrepancies through timely technical clarification and controlled change processes
  • Support the investigation and resolution of HV incidents, standing issues and emerging technical risks that fall outside local Operations capability
  • Identify opportunities to improve safety, programme, cost, quality and system performance, and share lessons learned across projects
  • Ensure complete project handover, including as-built drawings, test records, operation and maintenance manuals, asset information, training and outstanding-action close-out

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum five years of experience in HV construction, site engineering or project delivery, preferably within data centres, critical infrastructure, utilities or large-scale industrial projects.
  • Strong practical knowledge of HV equipment and installations, including switchgear, transformers, protection systems, SCADA, earthing, cabling and auxiliary DC systems.
  • Working knowledge of applicable Australian electrical standards, network service provider requirements, workplace health and safety obligations and HV safe systems of work.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret single-line diagrams, schematics, layouts, specifications and issued-for-construction documentation.
  • Experience reviewing method statements, safe work method statements, inspection and test plans, test documentation and contractor quality records.
  • Sound understanding of HV installation, testing, protection, energisation, commissioning and operational handover requirements.
  • Experience supervising contractors and coordinating multiple work fronts within a live construction environment.
  • Strong commitment to electrical safety, permit-to-work controls, risk management and high-quality site execution.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical, constructability and interface issues while maintaining programme and operational priorities.
  • Experience managing RFIs, non-conformances, defects, punch lists, red-line mark-ups and as-built documentation.
  • Competency with common engineering and document-control tools; familiarity with AutoCAD, PowerFactory, ETAP or similar applications is advantageous.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to coordinate contractors, consultants, authorities and multidisciplinary internal teams.
  • Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
  • A collaborative, accountable and delivery-focused approach, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced site environment.
  • Willingness to travel to AirTrunk project sites as required.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Command Center Analyst I
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Operational Monitoring & Support - Deliver Tier I operational support to ensure the continuous, uninterrupted operation of mission-critical 24/7 Data Centers.
  • Incident Management, Triage & Ownership - Serve as the primary operational intake point across all support channels (calls, emails, portal tickets). Efficiently assess business impact to assign accurate priority levels, and take definitive end-to-end ownership of all reported incidents, driving them to resolution or ensuring precise, timely escalation.
  • Critical Stakeholder Communications - Act as the definitive voice of the Command Center by drafting and broadcasting timely notifications for incidents, maintenance events, and regional advisories. Seamlessly translate complex technical jargon into clear, actionable updates for external customers, while maintaining strict technical accuracy when briefing internal engineering and leadership teams.
  • Bridge Facilitation - Lead and coordinate internal bridge calls during P1 incidents, ensuring the rapid mobilization of necessary technical teams, effective stakeholder engagement, and real-time decision-making to drive rapid resolution and minimize downtime.
  • Alarm Monitoring & Site Escalation - Proactively monitor and analyze infrastructure alarms to perform initial remote fault isolation. Rapidly engage and coordinate with local site teams to drive on-the-ground triage and physical mitigation.
  • Cross-Tier Collaboration - Maintain seamless, effective communication channels with advanced support tiers and management to immediately flag critical issues requiring urgent intervention.
  • Enterprise Ticketing & Real-Time Documentation - Leverage enterprise service management platforms to rigorously manage the complete lifecycle of all operational tasks. Comprehensively document all incidents, communications, maintenance, and problem details to ensure near real-time accuracy and traceability.
  • Performance & Compliance - Prioritize and execute daily tasks to consistently meet established KPIs and strictly adhere to customer SLAs.
  • Quality Assurance Adherence - Consistently meet established call quality and documentation scorecards, actively participating in routine QA audits to ensure exceptional, standardized service delivery across the operations floor.
  • Continuous Improvement & Team Development - Actively develop technical skills and industry knowledge through internal training programs, continuing education, and relevant certifications, while contributing to internal SOPs and operational training frameworks to elevate the teams’ overall technical baseline.

Qualifications

Experience & Technical Skills:

  • Diploma in Computer Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience working in a 24/7 Global Command Center, Network Operations Center (NOC), Data Center environment, or Contact Center.
  • 3+ years of proven success in delivering exceptional customer service or technical support.
  • Foundational knowledge of Data Center facility operations, including core mechanical/electrical (M&E) subsystems (UPS, Chiller, CRAC/CRAH, HVAC, Cooling systems, PDU), Building Management Systems (BMS), and physical security protocols.
  • Hands-on proficiency in enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, etc.
  • Industry certifications such as CDCP, CDCS, CDCTP, DCCA, DCD, ITIL v4/v5 Foundation, or equivalent Data Center credentials are highly advantageous.

Professional Competencies:

  • Communication - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to confidently engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Problem Solving - Strong analytical capabilities with a keen attention to detail and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.
  • Attitude & Teamwork - Brings a highly positive, collaborative and professional working attitude to the team, remaining constructive and resilient even during high-pressure incidents.
  • Accountability - Highly self-motivated, organized, and capable of prioritizing tasks independently in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated initiative to see issues through to absolute completion.
  • Discipline - A strong commitment to meeting deadlines and adhering strictly to operational procedures.

job.title: Construction Safety Manager ( Data Centre)
job.description:
Overview

Lead regional Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) governance for data centre construction projects, ensuring compliance with company standards, local regulations and industry best practices. The role provides independent oversight of project safety performance, contractor compliance, incident management and continuous improvement across the project lifecycle.

**

Make an Impact by

EHS Governance & Compliance

  • Develop and maintain regional construction EHS standards, procedures and governance requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with project HSE plans, environmental requirements, Permit-to-Work systems, Design for Safety principles and local regulations.
  • Review key contractor safety documents such as risk assessments, method statements, lifting plans and emergency response plans.
  • Conduct compliance reviews and audits and track corrective actions to closure.
  • Review and evaluate contractor EHS capability for regional tender including tender evaluation assessment.

Site Safety & Contractor Oversight

  • Conduct regular site inspections and governance reviews across regional projects.
  • Monitor high-risk activities including excavation, lifting, working at height, electrical works, hot work, confined space, MEP works, testing and commissioning.
  • Assess and monitor contractor EHS capability and performance, escalating significant concerns where required.
  • Drive safety improvement initiatives with project and contractor teams.

Risk & Incident Management

  • Oversee project risk assessments and verify appropriate controls are in place before work starts.
  • Ensure Design for Safety principles are integrated into design and construction activities.
  • Review incident investigations and root cause analyses, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
  • Analyse incident trends and share lessons learned across the region.

EHS Performance & Reporting

  • Participate in project and regional EHS governance monthly and quarterly meetings.
  • Prepare EHS dashboards and reports covering incidents, audits, training compliance, safety observations and key performance indicators.
  • Conduct regular EHS performance reviews with project leaders and senior management.

##

Environmental & Commissioning Safety

  • Monitor compliance with environmental requirements, including noise, dust, waste, chemical storage, water discharge and spill prevention.
  • Provide safety oversight for mission-critical works, including HV/LV electrical installation, energisation, testing and commissioning.
  • Review isolation procedures and risk controls before energisation and commissioning activities.

##

Authority

  • Request the Project Lead to stop or suspend unsafe work where there is imminent danger or serious non-compliance.
  • Require corrective actions before work resumes and escalate repeated or severe violations to senior management.
  • Recommend contractor suspension for serious or repeated safety breaches.

##

Skills for Success:

  • Degree or Diploma in Occupational Safety & Health, Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Management or a related discipline.
  • Preferred certifications include WSH Officer/Manager, NEBOSH, IOSH, ISO 45001/14001 Lead Auditor, CSP, OSHA or equivalent.
  • Minimum 10 years of construction safety experience, including at least 5 years in data centre or mission-critical infrastructure projects.
  • Experience managing EPC/general contractors, safety consultants and multi-country projects within APAC.
  • Proven experience in incident investigation, root cause analysis and contractor performance management.
  • Strong knowledge of construction safety, risk management, environmental compliance and Design for Safety.
  • Strong leadership, communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills with sound, independent judgement.
  • Proactive and collaborative working style, with willingness to travel across the region

##

Your Career Growth Starts Here. Apply Now!

job.title: Senior Information Security Specialist
job.description:
Role Summary

The Senior Information Security Specialist plays a key role in supporting Singtel Singapore Cyber Security ecosystem through hands-on technical execution. This role partners with business stakeholders to understand access requirements and ensure alignment with security controls.

The role involves

  • Supporting and ensuring the uptime of tools used within CISO Singtel Singapore, Cyber Security Team.
  • Collaborating with various technical teams in Singtel Singapore to ensure delivery of the outcome, on time and on budget.
  • Assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of assigned technology stack(s) against related IT controls and policies, regulatory obligations, Singtel Group cybersecurity policies and principles while balancing business objectives as well.

**

How You will Make An Impact:

**

  • Validate effectiveness of security tools managed by CISO Singtel Singapore, Cyber Security Engineering
  • Supporting and ensuring adequacy of Cyber Security posture for security tools managed by CISO Singtel Singapore, Cyber Security Engineering
  • Continuous review of current technology stack being managed is fit for use and cost effective.
  • Deploy new technology stack managed by the team where applicable to ensure fit for us and cost effectiveness.

**

1. Engineering:

  • Expand scope of various security systems such as but not limited to EDR, DAM, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA and Privileged Access Management where required to increase visibility of the tools
  • Deliver new security tools to uplift overall security posture of Singtel Singapore
  • Ensure that SOPs are documented, performed and in compliance with relevant security policies and standards
  • Subject matter expert for assigned technology stack(s), providing guidance to the team on managing the technologies including optimizing performance and capacity.
  • Work with stakeholders in IT and Enterprise to uplift coverage for assigned technology stack(s) where applicable
  • Work with the various SMEs of the various security systems managed by Cyber Engineering or other technical SMEs to ensure delivery of outcomes including tracking of the tasks required to meet the outcome
  • Engage relevant teams and/or vendors to diagnose and rectify technical problems where necessary
  • Ensure documents or processes required as part of project delivery methodology is adhered to
  • Support and provide inputs to design of technology stack(s) as subject matter expert so that it is fit-for-use, conforms to security best practices and is cost effective.

**

2 Customer Experience and Teamwork:

  • Demonstrate professional, pro-active qualities in dealing with internal clients and stakeholders.
  • Work with all stakeholders to meet operation and security requirements.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, effective communication and teamwork with peers.

**

3 Continuous Improvement:

  • Maintain strategic vendor partnerships, relevant education and certification.
  • Complete relevant education and training as required.
  • Keep abreast of relevant technology and cyber threat landscape.

**

  • A minimum of 3 to 6 years of relevant experience, with at least 2 years focused on cybersecurity in telco operations, network environments, or enterprise IT within the telecommunications domain including minimally 3 years hands-on experience in designing, administration or deployment of IT infrastructure components including implementing best practices like security hardening
  • Experienced in application hosting and operations across both on-premises systems and multi-cloud environments including AWS and Azure
