job.title: Director, Group Network Cyber Security
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

This is a technical leadership role within Group Strategy, Engineering and Innovation (GSEI) in Group Technology Network, responsible for providing strategic direction and deep expertise in telecommunications network cybersecurity across the Singtel Group, including its regional associates.

The role will lead and collaborate with network and cybersecurity subject matter experts across Singtel Operating Companies (OpCos) and regional associates to ensure alignment with Singtel Group’s broader strategic objectives.

The person will define, develop, and institutionalise network cybersecurity design principles, frameworks, and guidelines across multiple network domains, drawing from industry standards, best practices, and lessons learned from past incidents and operational experience.

Make an Impact by

**

a. Strategy Development

  • Partner closely with Group Cybersecurity to define and evolve the network security strategy and framework in alignment with Singtel Group’s business objectives, risk appetite, and industry trends.
  • Provide thought leadership on network cybersecurity, ensuring long-term resilience, scalability, and regulatory readiness across the Group.

b. Network Architecture & Design Governance

  • Establish and maintain a group-wide network security architecture framework, incorporating industry-recognised standards, specifications, and best-practice design principles.
  • Drive consistent adoption of network security guidelines across multiple network domains (e.g. core, access, transport, cloud, edge) to strengthen the Group’s overall security posture and operational resilience.

c. Technology Evaluation & Future Readiness

  • Identify, assess, and provide strategic guidance on emerging technologies and trends such as 6G, AI for Networks, and Networks for AI.
  • Articulate how evolving network security requirements and capabilities will both influence and be influenced by—the design, deployment, and operation of these technologies.
  • Translate complex technical implications into clear recommendations for leadership and stakeholders.

d. Group Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Foster strong collaboration and knowledge sharing across Singtel Group and regional associates within the network security domain.
  • Create and sustain platforms, forums, and communities of practice to share experiences, expertise, lessons learned, and incident insights.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, collective ownership, and proactive risk and incident management across the Group.

**

Skills for Success

**

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in telecommunications networks, with significant depth in network cybersecurity across large-scale, carrier-grade environments.
  • Proven experience in a technical leadership, architecture, or strategy role, within a telco network environment.
  • Strong track record of defining and implementing network security frameworks, architectures, and design principles across multiple network domains.
  • Hands on experience translating industry standards and best practices (e.g. 3GPP, ETSI, NIST, ISO/IEC, Zero Trust, Security by design) into practical, deployable network security controls.
  • Experience working with or influencing regional operating companies or affiliates, balancing group governance with local regulatory and operational requirements.
  • Experience evaluating and shaping security requirements for emerging technologies such as Quantum safe, 5G/6G, network virtualisation, cloud-native networks, AI-enabled networks, and automation.

**

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Deep understanding of telecommunications network architectures and protocols, including fixed, mobile, IP, transport, and cloud-native network environments.
  • Strong expertise in network security domains, including network segmentation, identity and access management, encryption, key management, signalling security, API security, and monitoring/detection.
  • Knowledge of secure network design and security tools, resilience engineering, redundancy, and high-availability principles in carrier-grade environments.
  • Familiarity with regulatory, compliance, and assurance requirements relevant to telecommunications and critical infrastructure security.

**

Leadership & Collaboration Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organisation, working across multiple OpCos, functions, and geographies without direct authority.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with various layer of stakeholders in various domain as such cybersecurity, network engineering, operations and risk/
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven capability to build communities of practice, encourage knowledge sharing, and foster a culture of security-by-design across the Group.

**

Professional Attributes

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance security, business objectives, cost, and operational practicality.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and forward-looking approach to risk management.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
  • Relevant professional certifications and knowledge (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CIS controls, GSMA security guidelines and control, cloud security controls) are advantageous.

**

**

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

job.title: Engineer I - Field Service
job.description:
Job Description

The PAC Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support for Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) systems and associated cooling equipment. The role requires ensuring maximum equipment uptime, meeting SLA commitments, and providing excellent customer service at data centers, telecom sites, IT facilities, and commercial establishments.

Key Responsibilities Installation & Commissioning

  • Perform installation, testing, and commissioning of PAC units and associated cooling systems.
  • Verify site readiness and ensure compliance with engineering drawings and safety requirements.
  • Conduct performance testing and prepare commissioning reports.
  • Coordinate with project teams, customers, and subcontractors during project execution.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Execute scheduled preventive maintenance activities for PAC units, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, condensers, CDU, FWU, and related systems.
  • Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, fans, control panels, sensors, and refrigerant circuits.
  • Submit maintenance reports and recommendations for improving equipment reliability.

Breakdown & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, and control systems.
  • Analyze alarms and operational abnormalities using controller logs and monitoring systems.
  • Ensure timely closure of breakdown calls as per SLA commitments.
  • Support emergency and critical site requirements during breakdown situations.

Customer Support

  • Provide technical support and guidance to customers.
  • Maintain professional communication during service visits.
  • Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Prepare service reports and obtain customer sign-off upon activity completion.

Spare Parts & Inventory Management

  • Identify and recommend replacement parts and consumables.
  • Maintain service inventory and tools in good condition.
  • Support quotation preparation for repairs and spare replacement requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) guidelines.
  • Ensure proper usage of PPE during service activities.
  • Maintain compliance with customer safety regulations and permit systems.
  • Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related field.

Experience

  • 4 to 8 years of experience in HVAC, Precision Cooling, or Critical Cooling Systems.
  • Experience in data centers, telecom infrastructure, IT facilities, healthcare facilities, or commercial buildings preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Good understanding of refrigeration cycle and HVAC principles.
  • Experience with:
  • Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) Units
  • CRAC / CRAH Systems
  • Chilled Water Systems
  • DX Cooling Systems
  • Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Condensers
  • CDU and FWU Systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot:
  • Compressors
  • EEV/TEV Valves
  • Refrigerant Circuits
  • PLC and Microprocessor Controllers
  • Electrical Panels and Drives
  • Sensors and Communication Networks
  • Knowledge of refrigerants and safe handling procedures.

job.title: Commissioning Technician - Thermal, VIC
job.description:
Job Description

The Thermal Customer Engineer (Technician) – Commissioning is a highly specialised technical role within the APAC ANZ division, responsible for delivering end-to-end commissioning of precision cooling systems including Computer Room Air Conditioning (CRAC), Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAH), Fan Wall Units (FWU), and Coolant Distribution Units (CDU). Reporting directly to the Service Operations Manager – Start Up Services, ANZ, this role is pivotal in ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of mission critical Thermal Infrastructure across large-scale environments, including Tier 1 Data Centres.

Key Responsibilities

Planning & Reporting:

  • Time Sheets - Digital reporting tool to be used to accurately record hours worked each day.
  • Commissioning/Service Reports - to be completed within set timeframes.
  • Proactively communicate project progress and any site issues to the Project Manager & Service Operations Manager.

Operational Delivery:

  • Own the commissioning process from start to finish - You'll lead the full commissioning cycle across Vertiv's complete range of CDU, CRAC, CRAH, FWU & TWU units, delivering critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important facilities running.
  • Work on landmark projects - Carry out L2, L3, and L4 commissioning tasks alongside experienced Vertiv Project & Commissioning Managers. If you've previously worked on Tier 1 Data Centre sites, you'll feel right at home here.
  • Broaden your expertise - This isn't a one-dimensional role. You'll also support the Service Team with maintenance and time & material works, giving you exposure across the full asset lifecycle.
  • Be the face of Vertiv - Build trusted relationships with our customers through professional, solutions-focused interactions. Your feedback helps shape how we deliver for our clients.
  • Never stop growing - Access ongoing training across multiple Vertiv technologies, keeping your skills sharp and your career moving forward.

Enjoy the perks - A fully maintained company vehicle and the support you need to represent Vertiv at the highest standard, every day.

Daily Work Duties and expectations:

  • Travel to various sites, including remote locations, requiring a valid Driver's Licence.
  • Undertake overnight or extended travel as project demands require.
  • Working on and around Energised Electrical equipment, adhering strictly to safety protocols.
  • Safely work on live refrigerant lines and pressure vessels, in compliance with refrigerant handling regulations and licensing requirements.
  • Working and Heights (needs Work at Heights Training and refreshed every 5 years)
  • Operate within HVAC mechanical systems, demonstrating physical adaptability including working in awkward body positions as required by the equipment configuration.
  • Undertake manual handling tasks, including lifting, carrying, and relocating equipment and components in accordance with WHS guidelines (e.g Compressors, Gas Bottles etc.).

WHS, Environment & Quality:

  • Comply with all Work, Health & Safety, Environment and Quality obligations
  • Actively champion a safety-first culture on all sites, leading by example and encouraging safe behaviours among colleagues and contractors.
  • I dentify, report, and mitigate workplace hazards promptly and effectively.

job.description:
Job Description

Senior Engineer – Code Compliance

Electrical & Thermal Products \| Vertiv Power and Thermal Management

| | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Experience<br> 5–10 years | Function<br> Code Compliance | Scope<br> Power + Thermal | Level<br> Senior Engineer |

Position Summary

The Senior Engineer – Code Compliance, Electrical & Thermal Products will support Vertiv Power and Thermal Management product lines by ensuring that product designs, engineering documentation, electrical systems, thermal systems, components, submittals, and certification deliverables comply with applicable product safety standards, electrical codes, thermal equipment requirements, customer specifications, and regional regulatory expectations.

This role is intended for a senior engineer with 5–10 years of experience in electrical design, thermal product engineering, safety/compliance, certification support, design review, or code compliance for industrial, data center, HVAC, power, or critical infrastructure products.

Product Scope

| | | | --- | --- | | Vertiv Power Products | Vertiv Thermal Products | | UPS and power systems; power distribution units; switchgear/switchboards; electrical panels; energy storage/battery systems; integrated modular solutions; racks and site monitoring systems. | CRAC units; fan walls; AHUs; XDUs; chillers; air cooling; liquid cooling; heat rejection/reuse equipment; controls and related cooling-system documentation. |

Key Responsibilities Electrical & Power Product Compliance

  • Review electrical schematics, single-line/three-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, power calculations, grounding and bonding systems, cable management, lighting/power distribution plans, monitoring/control systems, BOMs, installation documents, and maintenance documentation.
  • Ensure electrical designs comply with applicable electrical codes, product safety requirements, customer specifications, and regional regulatory expectations.
  • Support compliance for power products such as UPS, switchgear, switchboards, PDUs, power distribution systems, energy storage, integrated modular solutions, and site monitoring systems.
  • Support standards alignment for power products such as UL891 switchboards and UL1558 switchgear where applicable.

Thermal Product Compliance

  • Review thermal product designs and documentation for CRAC, fan wall, AHU, XDU, chiller, air cooling, liquid cooling, heat rejection, and heat reuse systems.
  • Support compliance review of submittals, airflow summaries, unit drawings, component performance, fan data, filter data, electrical cabinet heat calculations, safety notes, and component specification sheets.
  • Support testing, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting documentation, Method Statements, Risk Assessments, Site Acceptance Test procedures, and incident documentation where relevant to compliance deliverables.
  • Support refrigerant and regulatory-readiness reviews for cooling products, including low-GWP refrigerant transition requirements when applicable.

Cross-Product Standards & Certification Support

  • Interpret and apply product safety, electrical, thermal, environmental, and regional standards during NPD, sustaining engineering, customer projects, product changes, and product release activities.
  • Participate in design reviews with engineering, product management, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, and business unit teams to identify compliance risks early and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain compliance checklists, standards matrices, technical justifications, evidence packages, compliance reports, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Coordinate with internal compliance teams, certification bodies, suppliers, and product teams for certification evidence, product approvals, component changes, and compliance documentation.

Required Qualifications

| | | | --- | --- | | Area | Requirement | | Education | Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical  Engineering, Thermal Engineering, HVAC Engineering, Power Systems, or related engineering discipline. | | Experience | 5–10 years of experience in electrical design, thermal/HVAC product engineering, compliance engineering, product safety, certification support, or code compliance. | | Product exposure | Experience with power systems, power distribution, switchgear/switchboards, UPS, PDUs, racks, electrical panels, HVAC systems, CRAC, AHU, fan wall, XDU, chiller, liquid cooling, or data center infrastructure products. | | Electrical capability | Ability to review schematics, wiring diagrams, power calculations, grounding/bonding, control panels, component selections, BOMs, and installation documents. | | Thermal capability | Understanding of thermal product operation, airflow, cooling performance, hydronic/hydraulic/pneumatic fundamentals, and data center cooling principles. | | Standards knowledge | Working knowledge of NEC, UL, CSA, IEC, CE, NFPA 70E, thermal/HVAC-related standards, and regional compliance requirements relevant to the product scope. | | Documentation | Ability to prepare compliance matrices, design review notes, certification evidence, risk assessments, test documentation, corrective-action records, and technical justifications. | | Collaboration | Ability to work with product engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical/thermal engineering, quality, manufacturing, sourcing, suppliers, certification agencies, and business unit teams. |

Desirable Qualifications

  • Prior experience in data center infrastructure, critical power, thermal management, cooling systems, industrial electrical equipment, or mission-critical products.
  • Experience with power products such as UPS, switchgear, switchboards, PDUs, battery/energy storage systems, power distribution systems, and integrated modular solutions.
  • Experience with thermal products such as CRAC, fan wall, AHU, XDU, chillers, direct expansion systems, chilled water systems, liquid cooling, heat rejection, and heat reuse systems.
  • Familiarity with emerging high voltage data center and server rack standards.
  • Familiarity with product certifications and regional compliance requirements across North America, Europe, and global markets.
  • Refrigerant regulations, low-GWP refrigerant readiness, and LEED and BREAM sustainability documentation as applies to Data Centers where applicable.

Main Compliance Standards / Codes to Focus On

| | | | --- | --- | | Category | Standards / Codes | | Electrical installation & safety | NEC / NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, OSHA electrical safety requirements, lockout/tagout/tryout, arc flash, energized-work controls. | | Power product safety | UL508A, UL1995, UL891, UL1558, applicable CSA requirements, NEMA, ANSI, IEEE, IEC, and CE depending on product and market. | | Thermal / HVAC product compliance | Product-specific HVAC and thermal equipment standards relevant to CRAC, fan wall, AHU, XDU, chillers, airflow, filters, heat rejection, cooling performance, electrical cabinet heat, and component performance documentation. | | Quality / management systems | ISO 9001, ISO 45001, and ISO 14001 where applicable to manufacturing, safety, and environmental management systems. | | Data center / integrated systems | Local/regional electrical and construction codes, customer specifications, interoperable power/thermal system integration requirements, and standards playbook alignment. |

Technical Skills Required

  • Electrical code interpretation |
  • Thermal product compliance review |
  • Product safety standards interpretation |

  • Power distribution and control panel review |
  • HVAC/cooling system design review |

Job Description

Job Title: Application Development & Support Specialist

Function/Department: IT / Sales Applications

Reports to: Manager Application Development & Support

Location: Pune, India

Vertiv, a $4.5B global organization with nearly 30,000 employees, designs, builds and services critical infrastructure that enables vital applications for data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities. We support today’s growing mobile and cloud computing markets with a portfolio of power, thermal and infrastructure management solutions.

Position Summary:

The Application Development & Support Specialist will be responsible of the development of the Oracle Sales Cloud applications. He/She will be the subject matter expert of the Oracle Sales Cloud application including its integration with other digital tools.

The role will provide in-depth application support for Oracle Sales Cloud applications, execute and monitor application enhancements requests, develop and configure front end application design, coordinate with DB and backend integrations, escalate issues to application providers, deliver instance for development regression testing and facilitate regular meetings with assigned group.

Key Duties

  • Contribute into the development and the deployment of Oracle Sales Cloud System Configuration particularly in the designing, building, testing, implementation and stabilization.
  • Deploy system enhancements, service requests (change requests) ensuring solution is scalable and meets overall business requirements and identify/document functional gaps
  • Support regression and integration testing when there is a new release as well as in any situation when quick or detailed testing is a must.
  • Participate in root cause analysis / corrective action for critical issues and incidents
  • Analyze production configuration issues and resolve any technical gaps
  • Develop, support, maintain interfaces between Oracle Sales Cloud and related business critical systems.
  • Generate and maintain documentation for changes made to systems.
  • Collaborate with the Project Management Office to estimate the delivery timelines, estimate resourcing needs, and identify risks & issues upfront
  • Work system specifications and develop functioning programs using the Oracle Sales Cloud Platform or other Sales Enablement platforms
  • Develop test plans to ensure proper system functionality and defects free release and meet business requirements. Maintain systems to ensure reliability and performance.
  • Escalate issues and requests to vendor or implementation partner and ensure timely resolution.
  • Work effectively with remote team members, outsourced resources, and users to complete tasks.
  • Conduct ongoing quality reviews and analysis of data in Oracle Sales Cloud. Identifies data quality issues and escalates for corrective action

School Background / Working Seniority

  • Experience in Oracle Sales Cloud integrations with other sales platforms
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • International experience
  • Exposure /internship in an international System Integrator company is a plus

Basic Skills

  • Strong English language skills
  • Analytical, and Problem-solving skills are required

  • Exposure to Oracle ERP systems

  • Exposure creating Functional Requirement Documentation
  • Excellent Communication and Teamwork skills

  • Ready to move beyond own area of comfort
  • Ability to be adaptable and flexible while responding to deadlines on assignments and workflow fluctuations

job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Testing Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Team Lead – Testing ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to assist local unit in developing the necessary capabilities to effectively control products and systems. Each day, you will ensure compliance with internal, customer, and industry requirements within a cost-effective and safe working environment. You will also showcase your expertise by participating in the development and implementation of standards and test methods to ensure only compliant products, software, and services are released to the customer.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Smart Power division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Executing and assisting specific quality-related training, promoting a passion for quality and integrity in all actions, with a focus on result orientation.

job.title: HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Building Technologies

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. As a global leader in HVAC, building automation, energy efficiency, and decarbonization solutions, we help customers operate some of the world's most critical facilities, including hospitals, data centres, universities, pharmaceutical sites, and advanced manufacturing environments.

For over 140 years, Johnson Controls has been delivering innovative solutions that improve building performance, enhance efficiency, and create better outcomes for our customers and communities. Today, our people continue to lead the way through cutting-edge technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Service HVAC Technician to join our Sunshine Coast team, based in Warana.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technician looking to work on a diverse range of commercial HVAC systems while enjoying the lifestyle benefits of the Sunshine Coast. You'll be supported by a highly experienced national technical network and have access to industry-leading training, development, and career opportunities.

Whether you're currently servicing commercial HVAC systems, working with chillers, refrigeration, or mechanical services, this role offers the chance to broaden your technical expertise and grow your career with a global organisation.

Why Technicians Choose Johnson Controls

  • Work-life balance with flexibility built into our culture
  • Variety of work across commercial, healthcare, education, industrial, and critical infrastructure sites
  • Access to advanced technology, systems, and equipment
  • Ongoing technical training and industry-recognised development programs
  • Opportunities to expand into Chillers, Building Management Systems (BMS), Controls, and specialised solutions
  • RDO or overtime options to suit your lifestyle and earning goals
  • Career pathways locally, nationally, and globally
  • Strong team culture backed by one of the world's leading building technology companies

What You'll Be Doing

  • Service, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair commercial HVAC equipment
  • Diagnose faults and provide practical, customer-focused solutions
  • Complete preventative and reactive maintenance activities
  • Install, commission, and test HVAC systems and components
  • Provide technical support and recommendations to customers
  • Maintain accurate service reports and compliance documentation
  • Collaborate with a skilled team of technicians and technical specialists
  • Ensure all work is completed safely and in accordance with industry regulations

What You'll Bring

  • Certificate III in Air Conditioning & Refrigeration (or equivalent)
  • Queensland Restricted Electrical Licence (minimum requirement)
  • Experience servicing and maintaining commercial HVAC systems
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • A customer-focused approach and excellent communication skills
  • Current driver's licence
  • Commitment to workplace safety and quality workmanship

What's On Offer

  • Competitive salary package
  • Company vehicle and tools of trade
  • Ongoing training, certifications, and professional development
  • Exposure to leading-edge HVAC and smart building technologies
  • Supportive leadership and collaborative team environment
  • Long-term career security with a global industry leader

About Johnson Controls Australia

Johnson Controls operates one of Australia's largest HVAC and building services networks, supporting customers nationwide with innovative solutions that improve performance, sustainability, and reliability. Our technicians are at the forefront of delivering critical services that keep buildings operating efficiently and safely.

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

If you're looking for more variety, greater technical exposure, stronger career development, and the backing of a global leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and take the next step in your HVAC career with Johnson Controls on the Sunshine Coast.

Applicants must have full Australian working rights. Pre-employment checks, including medical, reference, police, and drug & alcohol screening, will be required as part of the recruitment process.

job.description:
Build Your Career. Enjoy the Lifestyle.

Imagine advancing your career while living in one of Australia's most sought-after coastal destinations. With stunning beaches, year-round sunshine, a relaxed lifestyle, and a growing economy, the Sunshine Coast offers the perfect balance between professional growth and quality of life.

For over 140 years, Johnson Controls has been helping customers create smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable buildings. As a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, we help organizations optimize performance, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with greater resilience across industries such as healthcare, data centers, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and we're committed to creating opportunities where careers thrive.

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Building Automation Service Technician to join our established and high-performing Sunshine Coast Service Team.

In this role, you'll service, maintain, and optimize complex building automation systems across a diverse portfolio of commercial customer sites, helping to deliver smarter and more energy-efficient buildings.

What's in it for You?

  • Competitive salary package plus fully maintained company vehicle
  • Choice of RDOs or overtime opportunities
  • Genuine commitment to work-life balance and flexibility
  • Access to internal remote technical support from industry experts
  • Structured technical training and ongoing professional development
  • The opportunity to work with industry-leading building automation technologies
  • Career development pathways within a global organization, including leadership and management opportunities

  • Install, commission, and program building automation and control systems

  • Conduct preventative maintenance and system optimization activities
  • Build strong customer relationships through exceptional service delivery
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards and company procedures

What We're Looking For

You are a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving complex problems and delivering outstanding outcomes.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Electrical Licence or Restricted Electrical Licence
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in building controls following apprenticeship completion
  • Experience with Building Performance and Energy Efficiency solutions
  • Strong understanding of commercial HVAC operations
  • Knowledge of chiller, boiler, and airside plant performance and design requirements
  • Experience with IT systems, network communications, and PC hardware configuration
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Strong commitment to safety, including proactive hazard identification and risk resolution

Grow with JCI

As a global organization, we actively support internal career progression. Whether you're looking to deepen your technical expertise, move into project delivery, explore other business areas, or develop into a leadership role, we'll help you achieve your career goals.

Ready to Apply?

If you're looking for a rewarding technical career with a global leader and want to enjoy everything the Sunshine Coast lifestyle has to offer, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to join Johnson Controls and help create smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, diversity and inclusion are integral to who we are. We foster a culture where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. Our High-Performance Culture encourages innovation, collaboration, and growth, ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to thrive and make a meaningful impact.

You have the power. You have the voice. You have the opportunity to help shape our culture and our future.

job.title: Project Manager (L&D Shared Services)
job.description:
** L&D Shared Services – Project Manager

Job Description

**

What you will do 

Manage end-to-end L&D content delivery projects by owning planning, governance, coordination, execution, tracking, and closure across the project lifecycle. The Project Manager will work closely with internal project coordinators, project leads, instructional designers, QA analysts, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure learning deliverables are delivered on time, within scope, within cost, and with the expected quality. The role requires strong operational discipline, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, intake governance, effort and timeline estimation, reporting, quality governance, analytics-driven planning, conflict resolution, and continuous improvement to support the current L&D Shared Services operating model.

In addition to the above, the Project Manager will be expected to:

Own project governance by managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, stakeholder expectations, and delivery commitments across active projects.

Enable smooth coordination between internal teams, external stakeholders, vendors, IDs, QA analysts, and coordinators to ensure clear handoffs and accountability.

Drive operational excellence through intake tracking, POD updates, vendor workflow governance, reporting hygiene, process documentation, and continuous improvement.

How you will do it 

  • Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, and closure for L&D content development and learning delivery projects.
  • Participate in requirement gathering, clarify scope, define delivery approach, and create phase-wise project and communication plans.
  • Support effort, cost, timeline, and resource estimation to enable realistic delivery commitments and project prioritization.
  • Determine and govern the execution strategy across in-house teams and vendors based on scope, capacity, skills, timelines, and delivery complexity.
  • Partner with project coordinators for internal coordination, trackers, meeting logistics, documentation, and follow-ups.
  • Partner with project leads for external stakeholder coordination, requirement alignment, escalations, and delivery commitments.
  • Manage vendor engagement under the hourly model, including initiation, onboarding inputs, effort tracking, communication, and delivery governance.
  • Coordinate with instructional designers, QA analysts, and vendors to ensure content quality, review cycles, rework tracking, and timely sign-offs.
  • Define and track quality expectations, quality metrics, review outcomes, and QA reporting inputs in partnership with QA stakeholders.
  • Maintain project plans, RACI details, trackers, status reports, action logs, risk logs, and project documentation for transparency and continuity.
  • Provide timely updates through stakeholder meetings, project reviews, dashboards, business reports, success stories, and stakeholder escalation management.
  • Use available analytics, project data, and delivery trends to inform project planning, scope discussions, risks, capacity decisions, and improvement actions.
  • Identify risks, blockers, capacity concerns, scope changes, and dependency issues early; escalate with recommended actions where needed.
  • Resolve conflicts, remove execution barriers, and drive alignment across internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support successful delivery.
  • Drive intake discipline by supporting requirement clarity, prioritization inputs, delivery readiness, and alignment with shared services processes.
  • Evaluate completed projects, capture lessons learned, track feedback, and recommend process improvements to improve speed, quality, cost discipline, and stakeholder experience.
  • Stay informed on L&D trends, authoring standards, and operational best practices to support scalable and relevant learning solutions.

**

Qualification & Experience

  • Graduate or postgraduate degree in business, learning, project management, operations, or a related field.
  • 8–12+ years of experience in project management, learning operations, content development, shared services, or vendor-managed delivery environments.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects across global stakeholders, vendors, instructional design, QA, and operations teams.

Skills

  • Strong project governance, planning, tracking, risk management, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to manage cross-functional work across PM, coordinator, ID, QA, vendor, and business stakeholder groups.
  • Strong estimation and planning skills, including effort, timeline, cost, resource, and phase-wise delivery planning.
  • Project financial and cost governance mindset with the ability to manage multiple projects within agreed timelines, cost expectations, and quality standards.
  • Strong documentation discipline, including project plans, status reports, trackers, action logs, SOPs, and handover notes.
  • Experience with dashboards, reporting governance, analytics, and tools such as Power BI, MS Project, Planner, SharePoint, Excel, and Jira or equivalent tools.
  • Working knowledge of learning content development processes, authoring tools, SCORM/xAPI standards, review cycles, quality metrics, and QA workflows.
  • Vendor management experience, including execution strategy, workflow coordination, effort tracking, communication, issue resolution, and delivery quality checks.
  • Ability to influence without authority, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, drive accountability, and work effectively across time zones.
  • Strong customer orientation with a focus on quality, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Preferred

  • Understanding of instructional design, adult learning principles, learning technologies, and multimedia/content production workflows.
  • Experience working in shared services, GCC, L&D operations, or vendor-partnered delivery models.
  • Familiarity with HVAC, Building Automation, Fire & Security, or similar industrial/technical learning environments.

job.title: Senior Instructional Designer
job.description:
Senior Instructional Designer

What You Will Do

The Senior Instructional Designer will play a key execution-focused role in supporting the Senior Manager, Instructional Design, by driving team priorities, operational initiatives, and delivering business-critical learning projects.

This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role. The role is expected to demonstrate operational leadership by driving priorities, influencing outcomes, and enabling effective execution across peers and project teams.

This role combines instructional design expertise with strong consulting, stakeholder management, and operational leadership capabilities. The successful candidate will be highly accountable, self-directed, and comfortable operating with minimal supervision while driving projects, solving problems, and influencing outcomes across the Instructional Design team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of high-impact learning solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Partner with stakeholders and SMEs to analyze needs, recommend solutions, and drive project execution.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, effectively engaging and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Support the Instruction Design Manager in driving team priorities, strategic initiatives, and operational excellence programs.
  • Identify challenges proactively, recommend solutions, and independently drive issues to resolution.
  • Establish effective working practices, streamline workflows, and improve team efficiency.
  • Leverage data, metrics, and business insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement
  • Support project governance by proactively managing risks, upholding quality standards, and ensuring on-time delivery through effective collaboration.

What We Look For

Experience

  • 10 - 14 years of experience in Learning Consulting / Learning Experience Design, and Instructional Design
  • Proven experience working with senior business stakeholders in a global environment.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex learning projects and operational initiatives.
  • Experience influencing teams and driving outcomes without formal authority.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent communication skills with an objective and professional communication style.
  • Strong L&D consulting and performance consulting capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive presence.
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Accountability and ownership mindset.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal direction and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple strategic and operational priorities in parallel.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when supporting strategic initiatives
  • Strong project and process management skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Continuous improvement and operational excellence mindset.
  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate:

  • Acts as a learning consultant to stakeholders
  • Demonstrates exceptional ownership, accountability, and execution discipline.
  • Anticipates issues and resolves them proactively.
  • Balances strategy and execution effectively.
  • Influences outcomes through expertise, credibility, and collaboration rather than formal authority
  • Acts as a trusted partner to the Senior Manager Instruction Design and the broader team.

job.title: Quality Analysts I – Reporting
job.description:
Quality Analyst I - Reporting

What you will do

Responsible for ensuring the quality, compliance, and effectiveness of learning solutions and operational processes delivered by the L&D Shared Services team. Partner with cross-functional teams to conduct quality reviews, testing, audits, and data analysis to ensure deliverables meet stakeholder expectations, business requirements, and quality standards.

How you will do it

  • Conduct quality reviews of eLearning, ILT/VILT, videos, job aids, LMS content, SharePoint sites, and digital learning solutions.
  • Perform manual testing of LMS platforms, learning technologies, and workflow applications.
  • Validate content accuracy, functionality, accessibility, branding, learner experience, and business requirements.
  • Identify, track, analyze, and report defects and quality issues.
  • Analyze quality trends and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support audits, governance reviews, compliance assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain quality checklists, review frameworks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Create quality dashboards, reports, and metrics using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
  • Perform data analysis and provide actionable insights to support business decisions.
  • Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), process standardization, and quality improvement efforts.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote quality best practices.

What we look for

  • Graduate or Postgraduate degree from a recognized university.
  • 5-8 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Learning Quality, Process Excellence, Data Analytics, or Learning Operations.
  • Experience supporting LMS, digital learning, and Shared Services environments.
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Specialized Skills:

  • Knowledge of instructional design, learning principles, SCORM, and xAPI.
  • Experience with LMS, learning technologies, and digital learning solutions.
  • Strong understanding of quality assurance, manual testing, and defect management.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and testing methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Python, R, or SAS.
  • Experience with structured/unstructured data analysis and statistical techniques.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and data visualization.
  • Experience in data mining, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and data storytelling.
  • Knowledge of Root Cause Analysis (RCA), process auditing, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

Competencies:

• Excellent communication and articulation skills

Enterprise Leadership Competencies: 0020

• Leading Self - Build a Performance Culture - Customer Orientation

• Leading Self - Create Growth Platforms – Collaboration, Managing Work

• Leading Self - Drive Operational Improvements - Execution Discipline, Digital Acumen, Adaptability

  • Skills: Quality Assurance • Learning Quality Review • LMS Testing • Manual Testing • Defect Management • Process Auditing • RCA • Continuous Improvement • Data Analytics • Statistical Analysis • Python • R • SAS • Power BI • Tableau • Data Visualization • Quality Reporting • SharePoint • Learning Technologies • Process Governance • Stakeholder Management

Preferred

  • Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS).
  • Experience with Power Automate, Microsoft 365, and SharePoint Online.

Quality Analysts I – Manual Testing

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality of learning solutions and associated deliverables developed by the L&D Shared Services team. You will perform quality reviews, testing, and validation activities to ensure deliverables meet defined quality standards, stakeholder requirements, compliance guidelines, and business expectations.

You will collaborate with Instructional Designers, Learning Technologists, Graphic Designers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to support error-free, consistent, and high-quality learning experience delivered on time.

How you will do it

job.title: IT Analyst
job.description:
Job Code:

Job Code Name: IT Analyst

Region:APAC

Country: India

Grade : 170

As a IT Analyst in IAM/Cybersecurity, you will work alongside experienced professionals to support the design, implementation, and operation of enterprise identity and access management and Active Directory solutions. This internship is designed to provide hands-on exposure to IAM technologies, Windows directory services, cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, disaster recovery, and real-world business challenges.

What we look for

  • Support Microsoft Active Directory administration, including user and group management, Organizational Unit (OU) administration, security groups, delegated permissions, and directory services operations.
  • Assist with Domain Controller lifecycle activities, including health monitoring, upgrades, decommissioning, replication validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Participate in Domain Controller promotion and demotion activities, following approved change, security, testing, and validation procedures.
  • Support Active Directory Sites and Services administration, including site and subnet configuration, replication topology review, and site migration activities.
  • Assist with Domain Administrator (DA) role administration, privileged account governance, access reviews, and adherence to least-privilege requirements.
  • Support the implementation and administration of security controls such as Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), privileged access management, and policy enforcement.
  • Assist in creating, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting Group Policy Objects (GPOs) aligned with enterprise security baselines and operational requirements.
  • Support Windows server and identity infrastructure patching activities, including pre-checks, deployment coordination, post-patch validation, and documentation.
  • Participate in vulnerability management activities, including reviewing findings, supporting remediation, validating closure, and maintaining evidence for reporting and compliance.
  • Support Disaster Recovery (DR) exercises for Active Directory and IAM services, including preparation, execution, service restoration validation, issue documentation, and follow-up actions.
  • Participate in monitoring system logs, analyzing security events, and responding to incidents under supervision.
  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, and security teams to troubleshoot authentication, authorization, replication, DNS, and access-related issues.
  • Help document IAM and Active Directory processes, prepare operational reports, and maintain audit and compliance records.
  • Contribute to PowerShell or Python automation for identity lifecycle management, Active Directory administration, health checks, and reporting.
  • Stay current on cybersecurity trends, threats, identity security practices, Windows infrastructure, and enterprise resilience concepts; participate in team knowledge-sharing sessions.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Currently pursuing a master’s degree (M.Tech/M.Sc) in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell & networking concepts.
  • Understanding of Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of Active Directory Domain Services, Domain Controllers, FSMO roles, DNS integration, replication, and health monitoring.
  • Exposure to Domain Controller promotion, demotion, site migration, or recovery activities.
  • Familiarity with Group Policy Management Console (GPMC), GPO configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of Domain Administrator role governance, privileged access management, and least-privilege principles.
  • Awareness of Windows patching, vulnerability management, remediation tracking, and validation processes.
  • Exposure to vulnerability management tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
  • Understanding of Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity concepts and experience supporting a DR exercise.
  • Exposure to PowerShell scripting, automation, or data analysis tools.
  • Certifications (if any): Microsoft, Okta, or other relevant security credentials (optional).

Johnson Controls International plc. is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. job.title: SIOP Transformation Sr. Manager- Data Center Focus
job.description:
SIOP Transformation Job Description (Data Center Focus)

Job Title

SIOP Transformation Sr. Manager

Job Summary

The SIOP Transformation Manager leads the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) process across the organization, with a strong focus on data center solutions and infrastructure programs.

This role partners cross-functionally with Commercial, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, and Finance teams to enable scalable, responsive planning aligned with rapid growth and complexity in the data center business environment.

Additionally, the role is responsible for coordinating lab testing schedules and validation readiness, ensuring alignment between product development, qualification cycles, and supply readiness for data center deployments.

Key Responsibilities

SIOP Transformation (Data Center Focus)

  • Lead SIOP transformation initiatives tailored to data center products and solutions, including cooling systems, infrastructure equipment, and integrated offerings.
  • Drive planning excellence to support high-growth, fast-cycle, and project-driven data center demand patterns.
  • Integrate project-based demand (e.g., hyperscale and colocation customers) into SIOP processes.
  • Enhance visibility and alignment across long lead-time components, capacity constraints, and critical supply risks typical in data center environments.
  • Deploy standardized SIOP governance, KPIs, and reporting to improve responsiveness, service levels, and inventory performance.
  • Enable scenario planning and risk mitigation for volatile demand, supply constraints, and deployment timelines.
  • Partner with regional and global teams to ensure alignment across multi-site manufacturing and data center programs.

Lab Schedule Coordination

  • Coordinate lab testing, validation, and certification schedules aligned with data center product requirements and timelines.
  • Ensure readiness for performance testing, reliability validation, and compliance standards critical for data center applications.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Quality, and Operations to prioritize testing based on customer commitments and launch schedules.
  • Monitor lab capacity, testing bottlenecks, and critical dependencies that may impact data center project delivery.
  • Integrate lab schedules into SIOP to improve visibility of constraints impacting production readiness and customer deployments.
  • Proactively escalate risks related to testing delays that could affect data center project timelines or customer SLAs.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a key connector across planning, engineering, lab operations, manufacturing, and commercial teams.
  • Drive alignment on priorities, especially for strategic data center customers and programs.
  • Lead executive SIOP reviews with clear data-driven insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops to strengthen end-to-end planning capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in SIOP/S&OP, supply chain, operations, or transformation roles.
  • Experience supporting data center, HVAC, infrastructure, or engineered-to-order products is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of integrated business planning, demand/supply planning, and inventory management.
  • Experience coordinating product validation, lab testing, or engineering cycles is a plus.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional transformation initiatives in complex global environments.

Critical Skills

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal) — able to effectively engage with global stakeholders, senior leadership, and customers.
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling capability for SIOP forums.
  • Ability to simplify complex data center planning challenges into clear, actionable insights.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across regions and functions.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.

Success Measures

  • Improved SIOP maturity and adoption across data center programs.
  • Enhanced alignment between customer demand, lab validation, and supply readiness.
  • Reduced risks and delays impacting data center deployments.
  • Improved service levels, forecast accuracy, and inventory performance.
  • Effective executive communication and decision-making support.

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life.
