job.title: Associate Security Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security, APJC Customer Security
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an Associate Secure AI Solution Architect to join our APJC Customer Security team. Customers across the region are moving fast on AI and need guidance on building securely. The patterns and frameworks that answer their questions exist — but they don't reach the field at scale without someone who owns the packaging, the events, the community, and the enablement. That's you.

Your primary mandate is the scale engine: the webinars, community events, enablement series, and builder circles that build Secure AI skills across the field, and the packaging of reference patterns into content a Solutions Architect or partner can pick up and use without a specialist in the room. You own this end to end — logistics, scheduling, content readiness, delivery, and follow-up.

Alongside the scale work, you get real keyboard time. You help build and test prototypes and reference implementations in sandbox environments, learning the AWS AI and security services (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) and modern development tooling as you go. You take well-scoped pieces of work through to done with guidance, and grow toward owning harder problems independently over time.

This is a role for someone early in their career who is genuinely excited by security and AI, learns fast, loves helping others succeed, and wants to build a deep technical foundation in one of the most important areas in the industry.

Key job responsibilities

  • Organise and run the channels that build Secure AI skills at scale — webinars, community events, enablement series, and builder circles — owning end-to-end coordination across multiple areas and time zones.
  • Package reference patterns and frameworks into field-ready enablement — briefings, guides, and workshop kits — that a Solutions Architect or partner can pick up and use without a specialist in the room.
  • Grow a community of practice around Secure AI, keeping content current and accessible so skills build consistently across the field and customers.
  • Track reach, engagement, and field adoption of the content and events you run, and share what you learn so the next round is sharper.
  • Get hands-on keyboard time building and testing prototypes and reference implementations in sandbox environments — learning the AWS AI and security services and modern development tooling as you go.
  • Take well-scoped, straightforward pieces of technical work through to done with guidance — learning the Secure AI control patterns (agent identity, prompt-injection defense, AI development lifecycle controls, guardrails, governance evidence) as you contribute to them.
  • Grow your technical depth and judgment over time, building toward owning harder problems independently.

A day in the life You start the morning in a sandbox, helping build out and test part of an agentic-identity reference pattern. You pick up a well-scoped piece — wiring up and validating one of the guardrail configurations — and take it to done, learning how the whole pattern fits together as you go.

Mid-morning you switch to the scale side of the role: you are running a webinar next week that brings a new pattern to the field, so you finalise the run-sheet, line up the presenter, and send the invites across the areas. You also tidy a workshop kit so any field Solutions Architect can deliver the session themselves.

After lunch you turn a reference architecture that was just published into a crisp enablement guide and a short briefing a Solutions Architect can take straight into a customer conversation. You check in with a builder-circle community you help run and clear a couple of small blockers for the organisers.

You close the day looking at how the last community event landed — who joined, what resonated, which content got reused — and share a short read-out with the team. No two days look the same, but the thread is consistent: you are learning to build, and making sure what the team builds reaches everyone

About the team APJC Customer Security helps customers across the region adopt AI on AWS with confidence — ensuring security, risk, and regulation accelerate AI adoption rather than slow it down. We run two coupled programmes: Secure AI (making AWS the best place to build securely with AI) and AI for Security (using AI to help customers defend themselves). As an Associate Secure AI Solution Architect, you own the enablement and community engine that helps the whole programme scale. You will have a clear development path, a peer community to learn from, and the chance to build a deep technical foundation in one of the most important areas in the industry.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
  • Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
  • Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. You will be responsible for the successful delivery of design delivery ensuring we continue to meet and exceed our industry leading quality and performance requirements.

Utilizing your Civil Engineering expertise, you will assist in assessing site constraints, developing acceleration strategies and supporting overall campus planning, development and construction. This position ultimately plays a pivotal role for the delivery of Data Center projects.

The successful candidate will be strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly with a history of delivering for their customers. The role requires creative engineering balanced with high quality and customer focus. You must be able to work as part of a large and dynamic team, including many internal stakeholders, customers as well as external stakeholders like design consultants, developers and general contractors.

Key job responsibilities

  • Develop and communicate conceptual designs and create/maintain project documentation before, during, and after construction.
  • Develop and maintain design standards, design prototypes, and template specifications related to site design.
  • Review Due Diligence assessments to determine site constraints, risks and develop investigation scopes.
  • Create, review, and release design consultant request for proposals.
  • Manage our external civil design consultants through the design and construction process.
  • Develop and review designs for grading, storm water, flood mitigation, utilities, and pavements.
  • Deep understanding of interdependent civil design elements to develop optimised earthworks and utilities designs and minimise the construction schedule.
  • Lead our internal modelling and documentation resources.
  • Coordinate with internal and external Architecture, Structure and MEP design engineers.
  • Effectively communicate design standards to internal and external project partners.
  • Manage multiple fast paced projects simultaneously.
  • Think outside of the box to find innovative solutions prior to and during the construction process to reduce costs without negative impacts on quality or reliability.
  • Travel for site assessments, internal design meetings, construction review, and interfacing with authorities having jurisdiction. Anticipated travel is approximately 25%.

A day in the life Given Amazon's global presence, 25% travel is required. This includes international travel to inspect and audit current and future data center sites. job.title: AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect
job.description:
Title: Job Application for AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect at SUBMER

Markdown Content: ![Image 1: Banner](https://s101-recruiting.cdn.greenhouse.io/job_board_renderer/job_board_configurations/banners/400/277/210/original/Careers_Header_3.png?1786531541)

[![Image 2: SUBMER Logo](https://s101-recruiting.cdn.greenhouse.io/external_greenhouse_job_boards/logos/400/393/810/original/submer-logo.png?1776345366)](https://www.submer.com/)

[Back to jobs](https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/submer)

AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect

India

**Location & work modality: India ( Remote)

About Submer

Submer enables organizations scaling AI to overcome the limits of traditional datacenters across power, compute density and efficiency.

We design and deliver scalable, high-density AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling, supporting everything from early AI deployments to full-scale production environments.**

What Impact you will have

We are looking for AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect

Department: Solutions Engineering / Presales

Position Summary

The AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect is responsible for designing end-to-end AI infrastructure solutions that enable customers to deploy scalable, high-performance AI and HPC environments. The role combines technical presales, solution architecture, infrastructure sizing, and deployment planning to deliver commercially viable and operationally sound AI infrastructure solutions.

The architect serves as the technical authority for compute, networking, storage, AI software stack, and infrastructure integration while working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product Management, OEM partners, and the Facilities Presales & Design teams to ensure that the AI infrastructure requirements are fully aligned with the data center's power, cooling, space, and physical infrastructure capabilities.

This role owns the AI infrastructure architecture and complements the facility design process.

What you will do

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Infrastructure Presales
  • Partner with Sales to qualify AI infrastructure opportunities.
  • Engage with customers to understand AI workloads, performance expectations, scalability requirements, and operational objectives.
  • Conduct technical discovery workshops and architecture discussions.
  • Prepare technical proposals, presentations, and solution demonstrations.
  • Support RFI, RFP, and RFQ responses.
  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor throughout the sales lifecycle.
  • AI Infrastructure Solution Architecture

Design complete AI infrastructure solutions including:

  • GPU compute clusters
  • AI Factory infrastructure
  • HPC platforms
  • High-performance storage
  • AI networking fabrics (Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE)
  • Kubernetes and container platforms
  • AI software stack integration
  • Cluster management
  • Security architecture
  • Monitoring and observability
  • Automation platforms
  • Scalability and expansion planning

Develop:

  • Solution architecture
  • Infrastructure sizing
  • Bill of Materials (BoM)
  • Reference architectures
  • Technical specifications
  • Solution documentation
  • Deployment architecture
  • Infrastructure Integration with Data Center Design

Work closely with Facilities Presales, Design, and Engineering teams to ensure the AI infrastructure solution is fully compatible with the proposed data center environment.

Provide technical inputs related to:

  • Rack power density
  • Rack layouts
  • GPU server deployment
  • Network topology
  • Cable density
  • Space requirements
  • Liquid cooling interfaces
  • CDU connectivity requirements
  • Infrastructure dependencies
  • Expansion strategy

Validate that the AI infrastructure can be successfully deployed within the facility constraints without owning the facility design itself.

  • Solution Validation & Delivery Readiness

Collaborate with Delivery and Engineering teams to ensure solution feasibility.

Support:

  • Technical design reviews
  • OEM interoperability validation
  • Deployment planning
  • Installation readiness
  • Factory acceptance planning
  • Site acceptance planning
  • Commissioning support
  • Technical handover to delivery teams

Maintain ownership of the AI infrastructure solution throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Operational Architecture

Ensure the proposed solution is designed for long-term operational success by considering:

  • Serviceability
  • Scalability
  • High availability
  • Redundancy
  • Cluster management
  • Monitoring
  • Capacity management
  • Firmware lifecycle

job.title: Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)
job.description:
:

Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)

Houston, Texas

Apply

Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)

Location: Remote (US-based strongly preferred)

Department: Legal

Reports To: General Counsel

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Submer

Submer designs and delivers end-to-end AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling.

We help organizations scale AI beyond the limits of traditional datacenters by enabling higher density, greater efficiency and lower environmental impact – accelerating time-to-AI from first deployment to full production.

What impact you will have

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Group Legal Counsel to join our growing team. This role will provide critical support to the Legal Department across a variety of corporate, commercial, compliance, and administrative legal matters. The ideal candidate will ideally be based in the the US and possess professional fluency in both English and Spanish, as they will support legal matters and documentation involving Spanish-speaking stakeholders and operations in Spanish-speaking jurisdictions.

This is an excellent opportunity for a strong, commercially minded, high-performing legal professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced, international business environment and partnering closely with executive leadership, outside counsel, and cross-functional teams.

What you’ll do

Corporate & Commercial Transactional Support

  • Act as a strategic legal partner at the group level, advising, reviewing and supporting negotiations on large client project agreements, partnerships, and vendor/supplier contracts across entities and jurisdictions.
  • Support fundraising activity: coordinate diligence, review and negotiate term sheets, MoUs, subscription agreements, SAFEs/convertible instruments, and related financing documents alongside outside counsel and finance.
  • Review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, from high-value client/vendor contracts to routine administrative documentation.
  • Partner with corporate finance on transactional matters, including entity structuring, intercompany agreements, and support for M&A or investment activity as needed.

Corporate Governance & Compliance

  • Lead entity management, board documentation, and corporate record maintenance across the group's legal entities, spanning multiple jurisdictions (including Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India).
  • Own regulatory filings, corporate compliance requirements, and monitoring of key deadlines and renewals across all jurisdictions where the group operates.
  • Design and drive internal compliance initiatives and policy management, ensuring policies are actually usable and adopted, not just written.
  • Flag legal and regulatory risk proactively to leadership, with practical recommendations rather than just issue-spotting.

Global & Cross-Border Legal Support

  • Draft, review, and translate legal, corporate, and business documents between English and Spanish; support Spanish-speaking employees, vendors, customers, and legal advisors.
  • Coordinate with local counsel across the group's jurisdictions; including Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India; to align global agreements with local law and practice. Note: the company is actively expanding internationally, so this footprint will likely grow.
  • Serve as a central point of contact for cross-border legal questions, helping the business navigate differing regulatory, employment, and contracting norms across regions.
  • Proactively build familiarity with the regulatory norms of new jurisdictions as the company expands into them, rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Flag where local law expertise or local counsel input is needed, and manage those relationships efficiently to avoid duplicated or unnecessary external spend.

Legal Operations & Efficiency

  • Own and modernize the company's legal operations function — contract lifecycle management, document repositories, matter tracking, and legal request intake.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, templates, and playbooks that reduce turnaround time and reliance on outside counsel.
  • Build and maintain a library of standard forms (NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, vendor agreements, employment-related documents) to accelerate day-to-day contracting.
  • Set and manage the outside counsel strategy: decide what should be handled in-house vs. externally, negotiate rates/scopes, and review external counsel work product for quality and cost before it reaches leadership.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Work alongside another senior lawyer to cover the full scope of the group's legal needs - this is a genuine partnership role
  • Bring independent judgment to the table: proactively flag risks, propose alternatives, and voice disagreement constructively rather than simply executing instructions.
  • Operate effectively amid organizational change - the company's structure is actively evolving, and this role will need to adapt scope and priorities as that unfolds rather than expecting a fixed mandate.
  • Mentor and potentially oversee paralegal or junior legal support as the function scales.

What you’ll need

  • Law degree and membership in good standing of a bar of a U.S. State, preferably Texas.
  • Minimum 7–15 years of experience as a practicing attorney, ideally with a mix of law firm and in-house/corporate legal department experience.
  • Fully remote role — you can be based anywhere in the world; US preferred and maintaining U.S. business hours (Central Time) required.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Able to operate semi-autonomously with modest supervision
  • Strong commercial legal background
  • Industry experience in technology, fintech, or other relevant commercial sectors
  • Comfort working across a genuinely global legal footprint (currently Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India, with further international expansion expected) - you don't need to already be an expert in each local law, but you should be willing and able to build familiarity with new regulatory norms as the company grows into new markets.
  • Demonstrated experience drafting, negotiating, and managing a broad range of commercial and corporate contracts across borders.
  • Experience supporting mid-large-scale fundraising, financing, or investment transactions (equity, debt, or venture-style deals).
  • Strong grounding in corporate governance, entity management, and regulatory compliance in a multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction structure.
  • Track record of managing outside/local counsel relationships across multiple countries and controlling legal spend.
  • Excellent judgment, organizational skills, and ability to prioritize across competing demands.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality, professional ethics and handling highly sensitive information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and document/contract management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting international, multi-entity business operations across more than one region (e.g., Europe, North America, Middle East, Asia-Pacific), and comfort operating in a company that is actively expanding into new markets.
  • Experience in engineering, manufacturing, technology, infrastructure, construction, or data center industries.
  • Prior experience building or improving a legal operations function from the ground up.
  • Notary Public certification (or willingness to obtain) is a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Multi-Jurisdiction & Cross-Border Coordination
  • Willingness to Learn New Regulatory Environments
  • Spain-Qualified, Bilingual (English/Spanish)
  • Commercial & Transactional Judgment
  • Corporate Governance & Compliance
  • Legal Operations & Process Design
  • Outside Counsel Management & Cost Control
  • Independent Judgment & Constructive Pushback
  • Adaptability & Comfort with Ambiguity
  • Confidentiality & Integrity
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

What we offer

  • Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
  • Medical Insurance Plan.
  • 401k Employee volunteer contribution Plan.
  • A great work environment characterized by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
  • You´ll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

job.title: Associate Director/ Director, Southeast Asia (Real Estate Investment)
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

As part of the CapitaLand Investment SEA business, you will be part of the SEA Investment team, reporting to the Head of Investment. You will play a pivotal role in supporting and leading investment, M&A, and related activities within the Southeast Asia (SEA) Investment landscape. Your key responsibilities will encompass the following areas:

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive investment strategies to support existing funds and facilitate the creation of new funds, with the objective of growing Funds Under Management (FUM).
  • Identify and secure pipeline assets for the fund through proactive deal sourcing and origination efforts.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop optimal investment structures and capital strategies to enhance investment returns.
  • Perform comprehensive market studies, develop operating assumptions, and conduct financial analyses with investment team to evaluate the feasibility of potential investments.
  • Conduct thorough due diligence and negotiations on potential pipeline assets and fund-related investments, ensuring compliance with investment criteria and risk management standards.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of investment-related documentation required for internal and fund investment committee approvals.
  • Ensure successful execution of divestment transactions to optimize portfolio performance.
  • Lead and mentor junior investment team members fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Good understanding in a wide variety of asset classes.
  • The Company may assign additional duties and/or vary the scope of work according to business requirements. Flexibility and adaptability to evolving business needs are essential.
  • Experience in fund management is preferred, but open to exploring candidates with fund management perspective, with a solid track record of deal experience in Southeast Asia.
  • Open to candidates from banking sector but possess good knowledge of Real Estate.
  • Proficient in stakeholder management.
  • Resourceful, solution-oriented with the ability to connect the dots to drive successful investment outcomes in a dynamic and competitive environment.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

What's in it for you?

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

More about us

The Marine & Ports Division serves the shipping and ports industries through its extensive portfolio of integrated systems and solutions that improve the flexibility, reliability and energy efficiency of vessels and container terminals. By coupling power, propulsion, automation, marine software and services that ensure maximum vessel uptime, the Division is well positioned to help the marine industry to achieve its decarbonization targets while improving the profitability and sustainability of our customers’ business throughout the entire lifecycle of vessels. With ABB Ability™ Marine software solutions and ABB Ability™ Collaborative Operations Centers around the world, shipowners and operators can run their fleets at lower fuel and maintenance costs, while improving crew, passenger and cargo safety as well as overall productivity of their operations. Further, the Division delivers automation, electrical systems and digital solutions for container and bulk cargo handling, from ship to gate. These solutions help terminal operators meet the challenge of larger ships, taller cranes and bigger volumes per call, and make terminal operations safer, greener and more productive.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Safe Coding
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google’s Product Security team is a global force of over 300 engineers in Zurich, Munich, Sunnyvale, Seattle, San Francisco and some other exciting places around the globe.

Our mission is as critical as it gets: Keep Google products secure and their users safe.

The Safe Coding team contributes to that mission by managing some of the biggest risks in software security. We innovate at scale by making secure coding effortless, for everyone.

In this role, you will help anchor our Software Supply Chain security team and co-lead innovation at scale to make secure coding absolutely effortless for everyone.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Lead by example, driving engineering excellence across the team while actively mentoring and developing technical talent.
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Technical Program Managers (T/PgMs) to define, refine, and execute the team’s goal, roadmap, and broader AI strategy.
  • Stay ahead of the evolving agentic threat landscape and navigate a dynamic AI environment, leading fast-paced, creative problem-solving to address emerging and legacy technical challenges.
  • Cultivate strong, actionable partnerships across internal stakeholders including Google's software supply chain integrity program and executive leadership as well as external industry leaders and academic partners.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Technical Lead
job.description:
Technical Lead

Johnson Controls (JCI) is searching for a highly skilled and experienced Technical Lead to lead a team of developers and testers on the construction of JCI’s internal and customer facing web and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have 8+ years of technical leadership capable of driving development and testing efforts in an agile environment.

Responsibilities

The Technical Lead will provide technical leadership as we design and build robust, elastic, and maintainable mobile and web-based applications. You must be a self-starter having a thorough understanding of Spring Boot, REST and SOAP services, ReactJS, Oracle or comparable RDBMS systems, SQL, Microsoft Azure software development and deployment tools, design patterns, and deployment strategies.

You will report to the Customer Experience Engineering Manager and work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Master, Solutions Delivery Leads, Solutions Architects, and partner companies as we deliver fresh and modern customer experience portals and mobile solutions to Johnson Controls North America customers.

The following areas are expected of the Technical Lead:

  • Technical Leadership: Lead end-to-end design, development, and deployment of scalable web applications using modern front-end (ReactJS), back-end (Java/Spring Boot), RDBMS (Preferably Oracle) technologies.
  • Architecture & Strategy: Define system architecture, ensure code quality, and drive adoption of best practices in performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Team Management: Lead developers and testers, conduct code reviews, and foster a collaborative environment to deliver projects on time.
  • Innovation & Upskilling: Stay updated with emerging technologies, introduce new tools/frameworks, and upskill the team to maintain a competitive edge.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required, specializing in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Minimum 8+ years of experience leading technical teams and architecting web and mobile applications
  • Strong experience with building complex web and mobile applications using onshore and offshore developers
  • Strong experience with providing technical guidelines to developers and performing code reviews
  • Strong experience with ReactJS and Spring Boot development
  • Strong experience in design, construction, and deployment of REST and SOAP services
  • Strong experience with Oracle or comparable RDMBS, SQL, and creating stored procedures
  • Experience with cloud platforms (with a strong preference for Microsoft Azure)
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure App Services, REDIS cache, and other cloud-based development tools
  • Experience with AI development tools, e.g. GitHub Copilot
  • Experience with incorporating Okta authentication and authorization into web and mobile applications
  • Experience with troubleshooting and solving application memory and performance issues
  • Experience with WebSphere Portal (HCL DX), WebSphere Application Server, and WebSphere Content Manager, a plus
  • Experience with JavaServer Pages (JSP) and JavaServer Faces (JSF), a plus
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum development practices and concepts
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Experience and desire to work within a fast-paced, iterative development environment

job.title: RTR Functional Analyst
job.description:
RTR Functional Analyst

At Johnson Controls, we help customers create smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings. Our teams work across finance, operations, and technology to support business performance and deliver outcomes that matter.

In this role, you will help strengthen Record to Report processes and support key finance activities in a collaborative environment where accuracy, service, and continuous improvement are valued.

Role Overview

We are looking for an RTR Functional Analyst with 4-6 years of experience to support Oracle Fusion Financials processes, month-end close activities, and finance transformation initiatives. You will work closely with RTR leads and cross-functional stakeholders to improve process performance, support issue resolution, and help ensure reliable financial operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development, enhancement, and day-to-day operation of RTR processes and solutions in Oracle Fusion Financials.
  • Work with finance and project teams to analyze current and future-state R2R processes and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Assist with month-end close activities, including process coordination, issue follow-up, and reporting support.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to support general ledger, fixed assets, intercompany, and tax-related process requirements.
  • Participate in UAT by preparing scenarios, executing tests, documenting results, and tracking defects through resolution.
  • Gather business inputs, document process requirements, and help translate them into practical system and process solutions.
  • Prepare reports, validate data, and support decision-making with clear analysis and accurate documentation.
  • Partner with finance, IT, and other functional teams to resolve issues and support successful delivery of enhancements and projects.

How You Will Do It

  • You will own your deliverables with accuracy, accountability, and integrity, especially during month-end and issue resolution.
  • You will stay close to the process, understand upstream and downstream impacts, and remove blockers quickly for finance users and project teams.
  • You will use clear analysis, candor, and continuous improvement to simplify RTR activities, close gaps, and strengthen controls.
  • You will work as one team with finance, IT, and cross-functional partners, sharing knowledge and balancing different perspectives to reach the best outcome.
  • You will use Oracle Fusion Financials and Excel to validate data, analyze results, and support accurate reporting.
  • You will keep documentation current and communicate progress clearly so stakeholders understand risks, dependencies, and next steps.
  • You will bring a structured, proactive approach to testing, issue follow-up, and process coordination.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience in RTR, record-to-report, finance operations, or ERP project environments.
  • Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials modules, including GL, FA, Intercompany, and Tax.
  • Familiarity with R2R business processes and month-end close processes.
  • Strong Excel skills, including working with data, formulas, and reconciliations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting ERP implementation activities or finance transformation programs.
  • Exposure to UAT, change management, or end-user training support.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, HFM, or OneStream.

Why Join Us

Join a team that values collaboration, practical problem-solving, and process excellence. At Johnson Controls, you will have the opportunity to support meaningful finance operations while contributing to an organization focused on delivering smarter and more sustainable outcomes.

If you are ready to bring your RTR expertise to a dynamic finance environment, we invite you to apply today.

job.title: QA Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer with a strong background in both automation and manual testing, particularly using Selenium with Java or C#. The ideal candidate will be a self-motivated and detail-oriented professional with a keen eye for identifying software defects and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products. This role supports a hybrid work model, offering flexibility to work both in the office and remotely.

Key Responsibilities

1. Test Automation: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium with Java or C# to ensure the quality and reliability of web applications.

2. Manual Testing: Conduct thorough manual testing, including functional, regression, and exploratory testing, to identify defects and verify software functionality.

3. Test Planning: Create comprehensive test plans and test cases based on project requirements and design specifications.

4. Azure Integration: Leverage knowledge of Azure and Azure DevOps to integrate testing activities into the development and release pipeline.

5. Defect Management: Document and track defects, working closely with developers and stakeholders to ensure timely resolution.

6. Performance Testing: Conduct performance and load testing as required to assess application scalability.

7. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve testing processes and methodologies and contribute to a culture of quality excellence.

8. Collaboration: Collaborate with development teams to ensure early testing integration and work closely with cross-functional teams to drive product quality.

9. Reporting: Provide clear and concise test reports, highlighting test results, defects, and progress to project stakeholders.

10. Documentation: Maintain up-to-date test documentation, including test cases, test plans, and automation scripts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/MCA or a related field.
  • 4 to 10 years of QA experience, with a strong focus on both manual and automation testing.
  • Proficiency in test automation using Selenium with Java or C#.
  • Experience with Playwright & TypeScript
  • Experience in API testing using Postman, REST Assured, Karate API automation tool, or using similar tools
  • Experience with GitHub
  • Strong knowledge of Azure and Azure DevOps for test management.
  • Experience working with Agile teams.
  • Experience with hybrid work arrangements.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
  • Certifications related to testing and quality assurance are a plus.

  • Deploy or integrate cloud technologies based on business partner requirements using automation-first approaches.
  • Enhance, follow, and contribute to enterprise cloud designs, processes, and governance.

Technical Support & Problem Solving

  • Serve as a technical SME for cloud infrastructure and platform services, providing troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance tuning across a complex global network.
  • Support solutions running on Azure and work closely with senior engineers, architects, and global teams.
  • Assist teams with documentation, training, onboarding, and platform usability.

Automation & DevOps

  • Build automated solutions for infrastructure deployment using PowerShell, Python, YAML, ARM Templates, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub), Azure CLI, VBS, Java, NodeJS, JSON, Bash, Azure Portal.
  • Contribute to standardized templates, repeatable deployment processes, and Infrastructure‑as‑Code practices.

Security, Compliance & Operational Excellence

  • Apply secure-by-design standards, identity best practices (Managed Identity, RBAC, Key Vault), and network security patterns.
  • Participate in LTA (Logical Technical Architecture) reviews, operational excellence practices, and cloud governance alignment.
  • Support monitoring, logging, disaster recovery, backup, and vulnerability remediation.

What you will have

  • 7+ years of Azure Cloud experience in application development, cloud operations, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Hands-on expertise with Azure core services:
  • IaaS (VMs, VNets, NSGs, Load Balancers, Storage, ASR)
  • Experience automating deployments using PowerShell, Python, JSON, YAML, CI/CD, Azure DevOps (Microsoft VSTS).
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across distributed systems and global network environments.
  • Experience supporting or building cloud architectures in production environments.
  • Ability to perform development/deployment assignments without close supervision.
  • Ability to work directly on technical problem identification and resolution, including responding to off-shift and weekend support calls.
  • Ability to deploy or integrate infrastructure technology components based on requirements gathered from customers.
  • Ability to perform integrated testing and customer acceptance testing of components that require careful planning and execution to ensure timely, quality results.
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office

Top Candidates Will Also Have:

  • Experience with Azure infrastructure operations or applications development, with special emphasis in areas of SAP workloads, networking, DNS, application services, security, distributed computing, databases, and storage
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related information technology degree
  • Azure Certifications such as AZ-120, AZ-900, AZ-104, or AZ-500
  • Experience using the SCRUM methodology
  • Experience working with IT security on infrastructure or applications security compliance and security vulnerability remediation activities
  • Strong verbal and written communication (English), teamwork, analytical, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem solving and customer service skills

Skills desired:

Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience:

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.

  • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
  • Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.

  • Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design). Level Working Knowledge:

  • Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
  • Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
  • Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms. Level Extensive Experience:

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
  • Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Working Knowledge:

job.title: Lead, Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Establish reliable and scalable quality engineering practices for StarHub’s digital platforms across mobile, web, backend and cloud-native systems. The Senior SDET will partner with engineering, product, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security and delivery teams to shift quality left, build meaningful automated quality gates, transition vendor-owned automation into sustainable in-house ownership, and provide fast, risk-based release confidence during migration, refactoring and platform modernisation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of the existing test automation from vendors and establish clear quality and governance standards, documentation, CI integration, reliability and maintainability expectations so automation becomes an integral part of product engineering.
  • Improve coverage, reliability and efficiency of automated tests across different platforms like web, mobile and backend
  • Improve quality of releases in terms of user experience and satisfaction by ensuring testability and automated tests are treated as first class citizens in the SDLC

Responsibilities

  • Partner with developers to design and implement tests at the right layer of the test pyramid or testing trophy, including unit, component, contract, API, integration, e2e, visual, accessibility
  • Setup automated quality gates across the SDLC to ensure issues are found as early as possible
  • Establish and track metrics for test automation to drive improvement and accountability
  • Improve test automation coverage, reliability and efficiency.
  • Use AI agents and coding assistants responsibly to assist with test planning, requirements analysis, risk discovery, test design, automation development, test data generation, failure triage, coverage gap analysis, documentation and refactoring.
  • Build internal tools, libraries, and platforms that make quality practices easier for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, data setup, environment reliability and release confidence.
  • Work with stakeholders across engineering and QE to ensure alignment on automation approaches and goals.
  • Work with vendors to deliver automation solutions to the standards defined.
  • Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, test plans, READMEs, onboarding guides and quality playbooks.

Areas of Impact:

  • Stakeholders: QA, Engineering, Program/Delivery Management, Product
  • Decision Rights: Strongly advise QA/Automation tools and license purchase, strongly advise KPIs for the test automation team
  • Resources: ~10 automation resources from vendors as peers, some existing licenses for UiPath, BrowserStack

Ideal Track Record:

  • Delivered automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) covering significant critical user journeys and behaviours, measurable regression improvement times in hours if not in days
  • Designed, or at least significantly contributed to, and implemented automated test frameworks from scratch that have measurably improved test efficiency.
  • Designed dashboards for reporting on test automation stats to stakeholders
  • Integrated tests with CI/CD pipelines
  • Used AI coding assistants or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent for testing, automation, documentation, triage or quality analysis.
  • Managed test environments and test automation infrastructure on cloud services like AWS, GCP, Browserstack, LambdaTest.
  • Built internal tools and utilities to make testing and QE easily accessible for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders improving productivity.

job.title: Director, Enterprise Client Solutions
job.description:
Job Description

The Director of Enterprise Client Solutions acts as the primary deal architect, story orchestrator, and strategic execution lead for the Chief of Enterprise. He / she leads a team of client-facing orchestrators to align multidisciplinary teams to pitch and convert large complex enterprise opportunities into technically feasible, commercially sound, multi-year deals. This role requires a highly effective communicator who can engage and influence C-suite, procurement, and Board-level stakeholders through clear, compelling executive narratives that articulate EBG’s distinctive value proposition.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Technology Advisor

  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including business, technology, procurement, and operational leaders.
  • Works closely with Strategic Account GMs to drive strategic account plans, including client priorities, whitespace opportunities, stakeholder maps, competitive position, and growth actions.
  • Lead executive client engagements, value-discovery workshops, solution briefings, and business reviews.
  • Act as the single orchestration point for strategic clients, ensuring coordinated engagement across internal teams.

Solution and Pursuit Leadership

  • Identify, qualify, and shape complex opportunities across connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, data and AI, digital workplace, managed services, and industry solutions.
  • Translate client challenges into clear value propositions, business cases, solution roadmaps, and commercial propositions.
  • Lead multidisciplinary pursuit teams comprising account managers, solution specialists, architects, bid, pricing, commercial, delivery, and partners.
  • Drive bid strategy, win themes, executive sponsorship, solution governance, risk reviews, and proposal quality for priority pursuits.
  • Ensure solutions are commercially sound, technically deliverable, scalable, and aligned to the client’s target operating model.

Delivery, Service and Value Realisation

  • Ensure a robust handover from pursuit to delivery, with agreed scope, assumptions, risks, commercials, success measures, and executive governance.
  • Partner with delivery and service-management leaders to resolve escalations and protect client outcomes.
  • Lead post-implementation value reviews to identify service improvements, upsell opportunities, renewals, and references.
  • Champion client experience, ensuring commitments made during the sales process are delivered in practice.

Internal and Partner Orchestration

  • Mobilise service lines to define offerings, product roadmaps, and specialist support required for client opportunities.
  • Work with technology services tribes on solution architecture, technical assurance, implementation approach, and managed-service design.
  • Build and activate strategic partnerships with technology providers, system integrators, and regional delivery teams.
  • Develop reusable account insights, industry plays, solution blueprints, and client references.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, telecommunications, consulting, managed services, or complex solution sales.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategic accounts and multi-service solution pursuits.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, data/AI, and managed services.
  • Proven commercial acumen, including business-case development, pricing, contract negotiation, and margin management.
  • Experience working with C-suite and senior public-sector, regulated-industry, or large-enterprise stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Win rate for priority pursuits and complex bids
  • Renewal rate, expansion revenue, and customer lifetime value
  • Client satisfaction, executive relationship strength, and referenceability
  • Delivery handover quality, major-escalation resolution, and value-realisation outcomes
  • Forecast accuracy and adherence to commercial and pursuit governance

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud and Third Party Platform Security
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

As a Senior Software Engineer for the Singapore Cloud and Third Party Security team, you will be a key technical driver for our growing software engineering team. You will leverage your software development expertise to own the design and delivery of scalable, high-quality systems and products that identify and remediate security risks across Alphabet's public cloud and third-party footprint. You will work with a high degree of autonomy, collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers to help build a strong engineering culture at our Singapore site.

**

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and deploy critical software components and products autonomously to identify, measure, and remediate security gaps in Alphabet's public cloud and third-party vendor usage.
  • Own and drive engineering milestones for specific projects within the Cloud and Third Party Security domain, ensuring high code quality, scalability, and security.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Security Engineers, Technical Solutions Consultants, and partner teams to define requirements, design systems, and implement scalable security controls.
  • Mentor junior software engineers in the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, high code quality, and continuous learning.
  • Identify technical debt and implement refactoring efforts to improve the overall maintainability, reliability, and complexity of engineering efforts within the team.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Technical Program Manager, APAC Fiber and Capacity Delivery
job.description:
About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end delivery of physical fiber paths, including Leased Waves and Dark Fiber, which form global layer-1 mesh for Google's production network. Manage delivery, testing, cross-connection, and disconnection of network assets like bulk fiber, Infrastructure, Internet Protocol Out-Of-Band, and colocation space/power.
  • Be the primary point of contact for telecommunication vendors regarding delivery timelines, tracking order progress, negotiating commitments, and escalating delivery blockers. Assess external vendor performance through regular audits, surveys, and Quarterly Business Reviews to maintain high On-Time Delivery rates.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders like Network Acquisition, Delivery, and Data teams to execute infrastructure deployments. Oversee and perform fiber characterization and acceptance testings to ensure fiber paths meet Google Standards.
  • Create, track, and update project data across internal systems and databases.
  • Identify and investigate operational discrepancies and drive rectification efforts on a case-by-case basis.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Manager, Interconnect & Fixed Voice Operations
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

Singtel Networks, the most established telecommunications infrastructure provider in Singapore is transforming to enable the digital generation of tomorrow. We are introducing new capabilities in 5G, Cloud, Analytics, Digital Commerce, Software Engineering, Cyber Security to enhance our core competencies and deliver innovative and differentiated Mobile and Fixed services (Broadband, TV and Telephony) for our customers. We are committed to celebrating inclusion and diversity and is a strong believer to upskill and nurture all individuals. Come join us today as we build Singtel’s Networks of tomorrow, and Empower Every Generation to live, work and play in new ways!

The Manager, Interconnect & Fixed Voice Operations is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and performance of Singtel’s local fixed voice interconnect systems. This role ensures seamless connectivity between Singtel and local and international operators, while maintaining high service availability, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

The incumbent will lead operational activities including system administration, fault management, service provisioning, and number portability operations. The role also drives cybersecurity compliance through system patching, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.

In addition, the role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders, external operators, and vendors to resolve service issues, implement system enhancements, and support regulatory directives such as scam call mitigation in partnership with IMDA and SPF.

Operations & Service Management

  • Oversee daily BAU operations of local fixed voice and interconnect systems to ensure high availability and performance
  • Ensure timely service provisioning, system monitoring, and execution of number migration/porting activities
  • Manage interconnect junctions and signalling links between Singtel and local/overseas operators (FBO/SBO/OLO)

Incident & Fault Management

  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of service issues, including call failures, signalling faults, and number portability issues
  • Manage and resolve escalations from TAC, INOC, ISMC, 1608, and external partners
  • Ensure timely handling of critical and urgent incidents, including after-office-hours escalations (e.g. VIP/VVIP cases)

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as the key point of contact for interconnect-related matters with external operators and partners
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders (Work Order, Product, Account teams) to ensure accurate order capture and timely provisioning
  • Engage vendors for issue escalation, including hardware replacement, software fixes, patching, and system upgrades

System Administration & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage system configuration, software upgrades, patching, and performance optimization
  • Oversee equipment lifecycle management, including refresh planning and execution
  • Review and govern Method of Procedure (MOP) for system changes and upgrades

Security, Compliance & Audit

  • Ensure systems meet cybersecurity standards through regular patching, vulnerability scanning, and mitigation
  • Support internal and external audit exercises and ensure proper documentation and controls
  • Manage IMDA directives related to scam prevention, including testing and implementation

Regulatory & Special Operations Support

  • Work with IAR, IMDA, and SPF to support scam call blocking initiatives and regulatory requirements
  • Support special events and emergency preparedness activities (e.g. SPF contingency planning)

Resource & Capacity Management

  • Manage C4 resource planning, including onboarding of new interconnect partners and capacity expansion

Skills for success:

  • Degree in IT/Computer or equivalent work experience in telecom,networking and IT
  • Strong knowledge of telecom networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
  • Experience with legacy signaling protocols (SS7/ISDN) and SIP-based voice systems

Linux knowledge

  • Understanding of interconnect architecture, number portability, and call routing
  • Good to have CCNA , CCNP or equivalent certification

At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

job.title: Director, Lifecycle Marketing
job.description:
At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

Make an Impact by:

  • Managing Consumer Base: Responsible for managing the consumer base, focusing on churn reduction, recontracting, Average revenue per unit (ARPU) improvement, and upsell targets. You will formulate strategic and operational customer lifecycle management strategies- supporting new technology penetration through scientific and data-driven marketing techniques.
  • Conceptualizing Lifecycle Marketing Strategies: Lead a team in conceptualizing customer lifecycle marketing strategies and translating them into executable plans. Your focus will be on driving retention, achieving upsell targets, and increasing service holding to achieve revenue and retention objectives. You will also drive recontracting through customer engagement and loyalty initiatives.
  • Championing AI-Enabled Marketing Transformation: Lead strategic integration of AI into Singtel’s lifecycle marketing agenda. You will oversee the implementation of hyper-personalization frameworks including content generation capabilities. Your focus will be on embedding AI-enabled segmentation, modelling, and real-time decisioning engines into lifecycle strategies.
  • Market Monitoring and Strategy: Stay abreast of market developments and monitor the competitive landscape to position the Consumer Business for new services. You will respond quickly and proactively to market intelligence and competitor feedback, steering marketing strategies to remain market relevant and customer-friendly. Customer insights will be a key focus, allowing you to tailor messaging and distribution channels accordingly.
  • Innovative Marketing Campaigns: Spearhead the execution of new approaches in marketing campaigns, such as hyper personalization, contextual targeting, improved automation, and tracking. Collaboration with marketing, sales, and data science teams will be crucial to develop and launch automated flows based on propensity models and behavioral data.
  • Customer Base Analysis and Reporting: Responsible for analyzing the customer base, owning customer information, data extraction, and regular tracking of marketing campaign effectiveness. Weekly reporting on key metrics and performance indicators will be part of your responsibilities.
  • Team Development: Develop and build a high-performance team through active resource planning, workload balancing, skill and expertise development, talent acquisition, and retention.
  • Campaign Strategy and Execution: Partner with various workstreams to manage campaign strategies and executions, including base management, calendar planning, targeting, segmentation, and reporting. You will implement processes to effectively prioritize and streamline user communications.

Skills for Success:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Accountancy, or related field. A Master of Business Administration (MBA) is desirable.
  • Relevant experience working in large corporations or MNCs. Competency and experience in customer management, churn, and lifecycle marketing.
  • Strong results orientation and stakeholder management experience.
  • Proven marketing strategy and management skills.
  • Experience in building customer journeys, including online and social media marketing, customer loyalty program management, web applications, and mobile and home business applications.
  • Experience and knowledge in devices, Telco data, customer analytics, and customer experience management (e.g., retail shops, call center, loyalty programs).
  • Possess Business acumen, presentation skills (both written and verbal), creativity, resourcefulness, analytical skills, leadership and people management capabilities, stakeholder management, solid budget management, and a challenger mindset.

Rewards that Go Beyond:

  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits.

The Team Coordinator assists the supervisor in the operation of an area of a department so that the Supervisor may increase focus on the people in the area and not be as involved in daily specific workflow issues.  The Team Coordinator is primarily responsible for ensuring continuous production flow by relieving bottlenecks within the department, filling in positions as needed, identifying part/resource shortages, and finding solutions and/or notifying Supervisors that solutions are needed, facilitating implementation of Lean Manufacturing processes, and requesting non-personnel related assistance of other departments by completing work orders and requesting engineering and SFA assistance. job.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Data Quality Developer will play a hands-on technical role in implementing and maintaining data quality controls, monitoring frameworks, and integration solutions across our enterprise MDM ecosystem. This position requires a strong technical background combined with excellent communication skills to work effectively with business stakeholders across the globe.

Working closely with the Data Governance Council Lead, this role will be responsible for configuring data quality platforms, implementing validation rules and workflows, developing dashboards and reports, and remediating data quality incidents across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.

Two Data Quality Developers will be hired — one focused primarily on the Ataccama platform (configuration, rules, profiling, monitoring) and the other focused on data quality operations outside of Ataccama (cross-system reconciliation, integrations, dashboards, remediation). Both developers serve as each other's backup and are expected to be cross-trained across all responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities Data Quality Platform Configuration & Customization

  • Configure and customize data quality platforms (primarily Ataccama) to ensure optimal user experience for data management
  • Implement data quality rules, validation logic, and automated controls within the DQ platform
  • Develop and maintain workflows to manage reference data across systems
  • Build monitoring capabilities for operational processes and data quality metrics
  • Perform data profiling and analysis using platform-native tools to identify data quality issues and patterns
  • Configure DQ platform integrations with MDM, Snowflake, and enterprise source systems

Data Quality Analysis & Remediation

  • Run reports across systems to calculate data quality dimensions (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness)
  • Execute data reconciliation reports across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
  • Remediate data quality incidents in a timely manner — triage, investigate root cause, and resolve
  • Identify recurring incidents and implement permanent fixes to resolve root cause issues
  • Manage incident resolution using ServiceNow to meet SLAs
  • Collaborate with MDM developers and integration developers to trace data quality issues across system boundaries
  • Analyze logs and data flows to isolate where quality degradation occurs in the pipeline

Dashboard & Reporting Development

  • Implement and maintain data quality dashboards using Power BI
  • Create business-friendly visualizations of data quality findings and trends
  • Develop reports to track quality metrics across all domains (customer, supplier, contact, item)
  • Build monitoring reports for operational processes and controls
  • Design health scoring dashboards that provide at-a-glance quality status for each domain

Data Integration & Synchronization

  • Implement data integrations to synchronize data across systems for quality monitoring and reconciliation
  • Develop ETL processes to support data quality and reconciliation needs (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, or platform-native connectors)

  • Present data quality findings in a business-friendly format
  • Conduct meetings with large audiences independently

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to the evolution of data quality maturity in the organization
  • Support the long-term data quality roadmap
  • Stay current with data quality best practices and emerging technologies

  • 4+ years ETL development experience for data integration and transformation (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, or platform-native connectors)
  • 3+ years experience building reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar visualization tools
  • 3+ years experience with data profiling tools and techniques for root cause analysis
  • 3+ years experience with data reconciliation across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
  • 2+ years experience with incident management and SLA-driven resolution using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
  • Experience working with business stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones
  • Proven track record of implementing data quality solutions and controls

Communication & Collaboration

  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language
  • Experience presenting to diverse audiences including business stakeholders and leadership
  • Proven ability to conduct meetings with large audiences independently
  • Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills
  • Comfortable working across global teams and time zones
