job.title: Sr. Manager IT Management
job.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Engineering Manager, MDM will lead a team of developers responsible for the ongoing development, support, and enhancement of our enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) platform. This is a hands-on technical leadership role — the Engineering Manager will personally design solutions, write and review code, estimate work from loosely defined requirements, and solve complex technical problems — while also managing team delivery and performance.

This role operates under a "you build it, you support it" model — there is no separation between development and support teams. The Engineering Manager is accountable for platform stability, sprint delivery, code quality, SLA compliance, and team performance across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.

The successful candidate must be a seasoned technical problem-solver first and a people manager second. They will work closely with the MDM Architect (who drives technical direction and design authority) and the Program Manager (who drives roadmap, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional coordination).

Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and manage a team of developers supporting and enhancing the MDM platform
  • Conduct sprint planning, prioritization, and ensure consistent monthly sprint delivery
  • Perform code reviews to maintain high code quality standards
  • Hire, onboard, and rapidly build capability in new team members
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Enforce the "you build it, you support it" model — ensure developers own their features through production support
  • Drive technical debt reduction and code optimization initiatives
  • Monitor and report on platform KPIs and team performance metrics
  • Work with platform vendors to drive open product issues to closure

Platform Development, Enhancement & Support

  • Lead the design and development of new MDM capabilities and features
  • Personally design solutions for complex problems and estimate effort from loosely defined requirements
  • Evaluate user stories, establish story points, and create delivery schedules
  • Oversee requirements gathering, design, development, and testing activities
  • Ensure adherence to software development best practices across the full SDLC
  • Manage incident resolution within established SLAs
  • Triage and resolve complex data issues spanning multiple systems
  • Oversee change management processes and ensure smooth deployments
  • Conduct post-production validation and manage release reversals when needed
  • Drive platform enhancements to improve stability and operational efficiency
  • Lead large-scale data migrations and bulk update operations in the MDM environment
  • Onboard new systems, organizations, and datasets to the MDM platform
  • Handle complex data reconciliation and synchronization across systems

Platform Migration & Modernization

  • Lead the technical execution of MDM modernization
  • Plan and execute phased migration strategy ensuring zero data loss and minimal business disruption
  • Design and validate data mapping between legacy and target platforms
  • Ensure feature parity and regression testing throughout migration phases

Technical Quality & Testing

  • Design and think through complex testing scenarios for platform changes
  • Lead unit testing, system integration testing, UAT, and non-functional testing efforts
  • Maintain and execute regression test cases during significant platform changes
  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment
  • Conduct DR (Disaster Recovery) testing and ensure business continuity
  • Debug, refactor, and rewrite code to improve performance and maintainability

Security & Compliance

  • Ensure security best practices are followed across all platform development
  • Oversee static and dynamic code analysis to identify and remediate vulnerabilities
  • Ensure SOX compliance for all platform changes and controls
  • Maintain secure coding standards and conduct security reviews as required

Required Qualifications Technical Expertise

  • MDM Platform Experience: 8-10 years hands-on experience working with at least one MDM platform (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio, SAP MDM, or similar)
  • SQL Proficiency: 8-10 years of experience and advanced knowledge of SQL for complex queries, data analysis, and troubleshooting
  • Coding Skills: Hands-on ability to write, debug, refactor, and rewrite code — this is not a management-only role
  • Problem-Solving: Proven ability to design solutions for complex problems and triage issues spanning multiple systems
  • Data Migration: Extensive experience with large data migrations and bulk update operations in MDM environments
  • System Integration: Experience onboarding new systems, organizations, and datasets to MDM platforms
  • Data Mapping & Integration: Hands-on experience with data mapping and integration using at least one integration platform
  • Event driven architecture: Experience with event-driven architecture and API-first integration patterns
  • AI/ML: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts for data matching and deduplication
  • Agile: Experience with Service Now agile and project management modules

Software Development Discipline

Deep knowledge of the complete software development lifecycle including:

  • Requirements gathering and analysis
  • Technical design and architecture
  • Development and coding standards
  • Unit testing and test automation, System integration testing (SIT), User acceptance testing (UAT), Non-functional testing (performance, security)
  • CI/CD pipeline implementation and management. Change management and deployment processes
  • Release management including release, post-production validation, roll back planning and execution

Delivery Management

  • Ability to estimate effort, duration, and resource requirements from loosely defined requirements
  • Experience evaluating user stories, establishing story points, and creating delivery schedules
  • Proven track record of sprint planning, prioritization, and consistent delivery
  • Experience managing SLAs and meeting incident resolution targets
  • Discipline to maintain regression test cases and ensure platform stability during significant changes
  • Experience running daily scrums

Leadership & Communication

  • 5+ years of experience managing technical teams of 8+ developers
  • Experience hiring, onboarding, and retaining technical talent
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to explain complex technical problems in business-friendly language
  • Experience creating design and technical documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multi-domain MDM experience (customer, supplier, contact, item)
  • Manufacturing industry experience across multiple countries
  • Familiarity with AI and ML modeling and production integration

Familiarity with Graph databases

job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

To perform CFD Analysis for system and component levels using Different Software’s Such as Celsius EC & Reality DC from Cadence, Ansys Icepak, and has exposure in Electronics cooling. Engineer needs to Conduct model checks and/or creating parametric models with available CAD packages and perform the sensitivity analysis independently with limited assistance. He / She should be able to generate the CFD mesh/model and run steady/ transient flow/thermal analysis using different software’s and analyze the simulation results as well as prepare the reports clearly and independently. Utilize the analytical skill set and simulation tools to analyze the fluid flow systems and recommendations for design improvements. He/ She should have knowledge on fan operation and performance curve as well as flow bench / Wind tunnel testing. He/ She should be clear about temperature measurement and handling thermocouple sensors. He/ She need to Participate and support the potential product development opportunities on a global level and provide technical expertise towards design. One must drive the virtual testing and reducing the physical tests, develop and improve of current best practices of the computational methods / Hand Calculations

  • Should have full time ME/M.Tech with specialization in Thermal Engineering/ Aerospace / heat power from a reputed Institute.

  • Comfortable in working with Creo/Pro-E for model check
  • Desirable to have a knowledge in AI Application and 1D Simulation

job.title: P3 Team Coordinator - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Team Coordinator assists the supervisor in the operation of an area of a department so that the Supervisor may increase focus on the people in the area and not be as involved in daily specific workflow issues.  The Team Coordinator is primarily responsible for ensuring continuous production flow by relieving bottlenecks within the department, filling in positions as needed, identifying part/resource shortages, and finding solutions and/or notifying Supervisors that solutions are needed, facilitating implementation of Lean Manufacturing processes, and requesting non-personnel related assistance of other departments by completing work orders and requesting engineering and SFA assistance. May be required to do other reasonable manufacturing duties as assigned.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reduces production bottle necks on manufacturing product line.
  • Address and correct workflow issues.
  • Learns all positions and fills in as needed.
  • Identifies part and resources shortages and provides solutions.
  • Communicates above situations to Supervisors, Engineers and Managers as appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School graduate or GED and minimal WorkKeys scores for the position.
  • 4+ Years Experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous lead position experience.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds unassisted.
  • Able to lift between 50 and 100 pounds assisted.
  • able to learn to work with all hand tools required of all positions within the area, including general work tools, pneumatic and hydraulic tools, brazing and wiring tools and equipment, forklifts, etc.
  • Able to effectively direct the flow of others.
  • Able to foster teamwork and resolve conflict.
  • Able to work long hours and a variety of shits as needed.
  • Able to learn and utilize materials tracking system.

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to work in an environment with temperatures occasionally above 100 degrees or below 32 degrees.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • 10% May need to travel when appropriate depending on product line needs.

A Battery Specialist is responsible for startups, certifications, preventative maintenance and scheduled maintenance for battery systems.   • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations

  • Excellent working knowledge of electricity and the electro-chemical theory of batteries
  • Strong Mechanical aptitude
  • Equivalent industry experience
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Professional
  • Reliable
  • Team Player
  • Must be able to read and interpret electrical line diagrams and blueprints
  • Working knowledge of OHM’s law and electronic theory
  • Technical skills
  • Ability to make basic site evaluation skills to include: environmental temperature, and general operating conditions
  • Elementary fix/repair techniques based on directed supervision
  • Capable of completing tasks and return unit to full operating conditions based upon directed supervision
  • Ability to summarize and report all work related tasks performed
  • Strong skill sets:
  • Communication skills
  • Customer service skills
  • Troubleshooting skills
  • Safety procedures
  • Organizational and planning skills
  • Computer skills
  • Mechanical aptitude

Working Conditions:

  • Travel is required
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Due to the safety sensitive aspect of the role, candidates are required to successfully pass a drug test prior to employment. In addition, you will also be required to complete and pass a pre-employment background check and a motor vehicle records check.

Physical Requirements

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

  • You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

job.title: Site Supervisor, Network & Fibre Installation
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Site Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day site supervision and execution of Network Layer 1 installation works for large-scale data centre deployment projects.

Reporting to the Site Manager, the Site Supervisor will directly supervise subcontractors and installation crews carrying out fibre optic cabling, network rack installation, rack & stack, patching and associated physical network infrastructure works.

The Site Supervisor is responsible for managing the 4Ms of construction – Manpower, Method, Machine and Money (Change Management) – within assigned work fronts and ensuring daily construction activities are properly planned, resourced and executed.

A key responsibility of this position is maintaining strong control of planned versus actual progress. The Site Supervisor is expected to develop daily and weekly work plans, monitor actual productivity and completed quantities, identify variances early, and implement corrective actions to maintain the project schedule.

This is a full-time site-based position requiring practical fibre installation experience and strong hands-on construction supervision capability.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Network & Fibre Installation

  • Supervise daily Network Layer 1 installation activities.
  • Supervise fibre optic cable installation, pulling, routing, dressing, termination, splicing, patching and labelling.
  • Supervise network rack move-in, positioning and installation.
  • Coordinate rack & stack activities and physical installation of network equipment.
  • Ensure installations are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, cable schedules, port maps, rack elevations, method statements and project standards.
  • Verify installation quality and ensure defects are identified and rectified promptly.
  • Support fibre testing activities including OTDR, insertion loss and continuity testing.
  • Coordinate physical Layer 1 rectification works arising from network testing and troubleshooting.

4M Construction Management

The Site Supervisor is responsible for managing the following four key construction areas within assigned work fronts:

Manpower

  • Plan daily manpower requirements based on scheduled activities and installation targets.
  • Allocate installation crews to specific work fronts and activities.
  • Monitor subcontractor attendance, manpower deployment and productivity.
  • Identify manpower shortages or productivity issues and escalate them to the Site Manager.
  • Ensure appropriate skilled resources are deployed for specialised activities such as fibre splicing, termination and testing.

Method

  • Ensure construction activities follow approved drawings, method statements, installation procedures and quality requirements.
  • Brief installation teams on the correct sequence and methodology before work commences.
  • Identify buildability and installation issues and coordinate resolutions with the Site Manager and Project Team.
  • Ensure approved installation methods are consistently implemented across different work crews.

Machine

  • Ensure required tools, equipment and machinery are available before commencement of planned activities.
  • Coordinate access equipment, lifting equipment, cable pulling equipment, fibre splicing machines, fibre test equipment and other specialist tools.
  • Verify equipment readiness and certification where applicable.
  • Identify equipment constraints that may impact productivity or scheduled activities.

Money / Change Management

  • Identify site conditions, instructions or changes that may result in additional work or variation to the original scope.
  • Maintain records of changes, additional works and associated site instructions.
  • Avoid proceeding with unrecorded or unauthorised additional works without appropriate escalation.
  • Capture supporting information including manpower, materials, equipment, photographs and work records for potential variations.
  • Escalate potential commercial changes promptly to the Site Manager and Project Team.
  • Support verification of subcontractor variation claims and additional work quantities.

Daily & Weekly Planning

  • Develop detailed daily work plans based on the project schedule and Site Manager’s priorities.
  • Develop weekly work plans and short-term look-ahead activities.
  • Break planned activities into measurable installation quantities and targets.
  • Confirm manpower, work fronts, materials, tools, access and information are available before work commences.
  • Coordinate daily activities with subcontractors and installation teams.
  • Conduct daily briefings to communicate work priorities, targets, constraints and safety requirements.

Planned vs Actual Progress Control

The Site Supervisor is expected to maintain clear visibility of what was planned, what was actually completed, and why any variance occurred.

  • Establish measurable daily and weekly installation targets.
  • Record actual completed quantities against planned quantities.
  • Monitor productivity of individual work fronts and installation crews.
  • Identify deviations from the daily and weekly plan as early as possible.
  • Determine causes of delays including manpower, materials, access, design information, equipment, quality issues or other trade dependencies.
  • Implement corrective actions with subcontractors to recover lost productivity.
  • Escalate significant schedule risks and unresolved constraints to the Site Manager.
  • Support development and implementation of recovery plans where required.
  • Maintain accurate records of planned versus actual progress.

Subcontractor Supervision

  • Directly supervise subcontractors and installation crews within assigned work areas.
  • Communicate daily installation targets and priorities.
  • Monitor contractor productivity, workmanship and compliance.
  • Ensure contractors have sufficient manpower, materials, equipment, drawings and access to achieve planned activities.
  • Coordinate multiple installation crews and work fronts where required.
  • Identify poor performance early and drive corrective action.
  • Maintain strong discipline around work completion and closure.

Troubleshooting & Rectification

  • Support the Site Manager in daily network troubleshooting and issue closure.
  • Mobilise fibre installers and subcontractors quickly when Layer 1 faults are identified.
  • Coordinate cable tracing, fibre testing, re-patching, re-termination, cleaning and other physical rectification works.
  • Work closely with Network Engineers during fault isolation where Layer 1 verification is required.
  • Ensure troubleshooting actions assigned to installation contractors are completed within agreed timelines.
  • Report troubleshooting status and unresolved issues to the Site Manager.
  • Capture recurring installation problems and ensure lessons learned are applied to subsequent installations.

Quality & Testing

  • Inspect installation workmanship throughout construction rather than relying solely on final inspection.
  • Ensure fibre installation complies with bend radius, routing, segregation, termination, cleanliness, labelling and cable management requirements.
  • Coordinate inspection and testing activities.
  • Verify fibre test results and ensure failed links are investigated and rectified.
  • Manage punch-list and defect rectification activities.
  • Support preparation of redlines, test records and as-built documentation.

Safety

  • Ensure all site activities comply with project HSE requirements.
  • Conduct daily toolbox talks and pre-task briefings.
  • Ensure subcontractors follow approved method statements and safe working procedures.
  • Monitor housekeeping and work-area conditions.
  • Stop and escalate unsafe activities where required.

Daily Reporting

Provide clear daily reporting to the Site Manager covering:

  • Planned activities versus actual completed works.
  • Installation quantities achieved.
  • Manpower deployed.
  • Productivity achieved.
  • Active work fronts.
  • Outstanding works.
  • Constraints and blockers.
  • Quality issues and defects.
  • Troubleshooting activities.
  • Changes and potential variations.
  • Required actions for the following shift/day.

Qualifications

  • Diploma, Technical Certificate or relevant vocational qualification in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Network Infrastructure or a related technical discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Candidates without formal technical qualifications will be considered where they can demonstrate strong practical experience in fibre optic installation, network infrastructure deployment and site supervision.
  • Relevant fibre optic installation, splicing, testing, structured cabling or networking certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Practical field experience and demonstrated installation capability will be given strong consideration.

Experience

  • 3–8 years of site supervision or network installation experience.
  • Practical fibre optic installation experience is required.
  • Strong preference for candidates from structured cabling contractors, fibre installation contractors, telecommunications contractors, network infrastructure contractors or systems integrators.
  • Experience supervising subcontractors and installation crews.
  • Experience with data center, telecommunications or mission-critical infrastructure projects is highly desirable.
  • Experience working in fast-track construction environments is advantageous.

Technical Knowledge

The successful candidate should have practical knowledge of:

  • Fibre optic cable installation.
  • Fibre pulling and routing.
  • Fibre termination and splicing.
  • Fibre patching and labelling.
  • OTDR and insertion-loss testing.
  • Fibre cleaning and inspection.
  • Structured cabling systems.
  • Network racks and cabinets.
  • Rack & stack activities.
  • ODFs and patch panels.
  • Cable containment systems.
  • Cable schedules, port maps and rack elevations.
  • Basic Network Layer 1 troubleshooting.

Location

  • Location: Wesley Vale, Tasmania

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Site Manager, Network Deployment
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Site Manager is responsible for the end-to-end site execution of Network Layer 1 infrastructure for large-scale data center deployment projects. The role leads and coordinates subcontractors responsible for network rack move-in, rack installation, rack & stack activities, fibre optic cabling, patching, labelling, testing and associated physical network infrastructure.

The Site Manager works closely with Network Engineers during Layer 2 configuration, activation and testing, ensuring physical installation issues are rapidly identified, isolated and resolved. The role also coordinates closely with the Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) team to progressively bring up power and cooling infrastructure in line with the network deployment sequence.

A critical part of this role is daily troubleshooting management. The Site Manager is expected to establish clear ownership of faults, coordinate contractors and engineering resources, drive root-cause identification, remove blockers and ensure issues are followed through to closure without allowing unresolved problems to accumulate.

This is a site-based, hands-on delivery role requiring strong contractor management, network installation knowledge and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced data center deployment environment.

Network Layer 1 Construction & Installation

  • Take ownership of site execution for Network Layer 1 infrastructure.
  • Plan, coordinate and supervise network rack move-in, positioning and installation.
  • Manage rack & stack and physical network equipment deployment.
  • Coordinate installation of fibre optic cabling, copper cabling, patch panels, ODFs and associated network infrastructure.
  • Manage fibre pulling, termination, splicing, patching, dressing, labelling and testing activities.
  • Ensure installations comply with approved drawings, rack elevations, cable schedules, port maps, method statements and project standards.
  • Ensure physical installation readiness ahead of network configuration, testing and commissioning.
  • Coordinate rectification of installation defects and punch-list items.

Subcontractor & Contractor Management

  • Manage network installation subcontractors and specialist vendors on site.
  • Translate project requirements and construction schedules into clear daily execution plans for contractors.
  • Coordinate contractor manpower, materials, tools, machinery and work fronts.
  • Monitor contractor productivity and installation performance against daily and weekly targets.
  • Ensure contractors have required drawings, materials, access, permits and information before commencing work.
  • Conduct daily coordination meetings and clearly communicate priorities and constraints.
  • Hold contractors accountable for quality, productivity, safety and timely completion.
  • Escalate resource or performance issues and drive corrective or recovery actions.

Construction Planning & Site Coordination

  • Develop detailed daily plans and short-term look-ahead plans aligned with the overall project master schedule.
  • Manage construction sequencing and work-front readiness.
  • Coordinate installation activities with other trades and project stakeholders.
  • Identify access, material, design, resource and sequencing constraints before they impact installation.
  • Coordinate closely with Project Managers, Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Network Engineers, logistics teams and other construction disciplines.
  • Track physical installation progress and maintain accurate site status.

M&E Interface & Progressive Power/Cooling Bring-Up

  • Work closely with the M&E team to coordinate progressive power and cooling readiness in line with the network deployment sequence.
  • Maintain alignment between rack installation, power availability, cooling availability and network equipment activation.
  • Coordinate progressive energisation of network racks and associated infrastructure based on construction and commissioning priorities.
  • Verify rack power, PDUs, grounding/bonding and associated electrical infrastructure readiness before equipment energisation.
  • Coordinate with the Mechanical team to ensure cooling systems and suitable environmental conditions are available before network equipment is powered and placed under load.
  • Participate in M&E readiness reviews and identify dependencies that could impact network rack bring-up.
  • Establish readiness progression from rack installation to power/cooling readiness, equipment energisation, Layer 1 verification, Layer 2 configuration, network testing and commissioning.
  • Coordinate with M&E, Network Engineering and Commissioning teams to develop rack, row, zone or data hall bring-up sequences.
  • Track and escalate power and cooling constraints that could delay network activation or project milestones.
  • Support troubleshooting where network equipment issues may be related to power, cooling, environmental conditions or other facility infrastructure.

Layer 1 to Layer 2 Integration

  • Act as the primary site interface between physical network installation contractors and Network Engineers.
  • Ensure Layer 1 infrastructure is complete, tested and ready before Layer 2 configuration and activation.
  • Coordinate with Network Engineers during switch configuration, network activation, connectivity testing and commissioning.
  • Support Network Engineers in isolating whether faults originate from physical infrastructure, equipment installation, cabling or configuration.
  • Coordinate physical checks, cable tracing, re-patching, fibre testing, equipment replacement and other field activities required during troubleshooting.
  • Ensure physical installation teams are available to support network activation and commissioning activities when required.

Troubleshooting & Issue Closure

A major responsibility of the Site Manager is to drive troubleshooting activities efficiently from identification through to closure.

  • Lead daily troubleshooting coordination across contractors, installation teams, vendors and Network Engineers.
  • Maintain clear visibility of all open installation, connectivity and commissioning issues.
  • Ensure every issue has a clearly assigned owner, priority and target closure time.
  • Rapidly mobilise the appropriate contractor or engineering resource when faults are identified.
  • Coordinate Layer 1 physical checks and Layer 2 engineering troubleshooting in parallel where appropriate.
  • Drive systematic fault isolation rather than repetitive or unstructured troubleshooting.
  • Remove blockers preventing troubleshooting activities from progressing.
  • Prioritise issues according to their impact on network activation, commissioning and project milestones.
  • Escalate critical or ageing issues promptly.
  • Conduct daily review of outstanding issues and drive actions through to verified closure.
  • Capture recurring issues and lessons learned to prevent repetition across subsequent racks, network zones or deployment phases.

Quality, Testing & Handover

  • Ensure Layer 1 installations meet project quality requirements.
  • Coordinate fibre OTDR, insertion-loss and continuity testing as applicable.
  • Verify rack installation, equipment positioning, cabling, patching and labelling against approved documentation.
  • Manage installation punch lists, defects and non-conformances through closure.
  • Ensure test records, redlines, as-built drawings and installation documentation are completed.
  • Support network readiness reviews and final handover to Network Engineering and Operations teams.

Safety

  • Ensure all installation activities comply with project HSE requirements.
  • Coordinate permits, toolbox meetings and pre-task briefings.
  • Ensure contractors comply with approved method statements and safe working procedures.
  • Stop and escalate unsafe work where required.

Planning & Reporting

  • Maintain daily installation and deployment trackers.
  • Report progress against planned quantities and milestones.
  • Maintain an active troubleshooting and issue register.
  • Provide clear daily reporting covering completed works, upcoming activities, blockers, troubleshooting status and critical actions.
  • Identify schedule risks early and develop recovery plans with contractors and the project team.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Construction Management or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant structured cabling, fibre optic or networking qualifications are advantageous.

Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in network infrastructure deployment, telecommunications, structured cabling, data center fit-out or related construction environments.
  • Strong preference for candidates with a network installation contractor, structured cabling contractor, telecommunications contractor or systems integrator background.
  • Demonstrated experience managing subcontractors and installation crews.
  • Practical experience with network rack deployment, rack & stack and fibre optic installation.
  • Experience supporting network testing, activation, commissioning and troubleshooting.
  • Experience coordinating with M&E teams for progressive power and cooling bring-up is highly desirable.
  • Data center or mission-critical infrastructure experience is highly desirable.

Technical Knowledge

job.title: Specialist, Strategic Sourcing
job.description:
Job Description – Procurement Specialist**

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Procurement Specialist to join our fiber cable manufacturing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and procuring critical materials and services essential for our production processes, with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, contract manufacturing, and supply chain efficiency. This role demands expertise in sourcing a diverse range of components.

  • Strategic Sourcing & Cost Reduction:
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies to achieve significant cost savings and total cost of ownership (TCO) improvements across assigned categories (polymers, molded plastics, mechanical components).
  • Conduct thorough market research and analysis to identify potential new suppliers, predict cost trends, and assess supply chain risks.
  • Lead renegotiations of existing vendor contracts and terms to ensure the best value and favorable pricing for the company.
  • Implement e-sourcing tools and data analysis techniques to optimize procurement processes and identify ongoing cost-saving opportunities.
  • Market Analysis:Analyze industry and market trends for fiber optic components and raw materials to inform sourcing strategies and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Documentation & Reporting:Maintain accurate procurement records and documentation for all transactions, audits, and performance reporting purposes.
  • Supplier & Contract Management:
  • Supplier Management & Sourcing:Identify, evaluate, select & Onboard suppliers for Polymers, molded plastic components, mechanical parts including Sheet Metal & Machined components, Raw fiber, protective jacketing materials, strength members & ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery benchmarks.
  • Negotiation & Contract Management:Manage the entire contract lifecycle, including drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and ensuring compliance with all contractual terms and legal requirements in collaboration with the legal department.
  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure continuous improvement and reliable supply.
  • Monitor and track supplier performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to quality, delivery, and cost, addressing any discrepancies proactively.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with engineering, manufacturing, finance, and legal departments to align procurement activities with overall business objectives and production schedules.
  • Operational Procurement:
  • Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Production, to understand material needs and ensure alignment of procurement activities with manufacturing schedules.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience:
  • Proven experience as a Procurement Specialist or similar role within a manufacturing environment, preferably in the fiber optics or related industry.
  • Demonstrated expertise in procuring specific commodity types:polymers, molded plastic components, and mechanical components including Sheet Metal & Machined components, Raw fiber, protective jacketing materials, strength members & ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery benchmarks
  • Experience in managingcontract manufacturing(CM) relationships and agreements.
  • Proven track record of successfully implementingcost reduction measuresand achieving measurable savings.
  • Skills:
  • Exceptional negotiation communication, and interpersonal skills to build strong vendor relationships.
  • Proficiency in procurement software, ERP systems (e.g., SAP preferred), and Microsoft Office Suite (advanced Excel skills preferred).
  • Expertise in Power BI:Proficiency in using Microsoft Power BI for data visualization, spend analysis, and creating interactive dashboards to track KPIs and cost-saving initiatives would be a significant advantage. This skill will be highly valued for driving data-informed decisions within the procurement function.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical skills for data analysis, cost modeling, and forecasting.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Education:
  • BE B.TECH – Mech/ Electrical/ Electronics/Instrumentation with Minimum of 10 years of experience in procurement, preferably in Telecom Industry.

Learn more about how we're on a quest to connect the future and build what's next.

job.title: Principal Engineer, Cybersecurity GRC
job.description:
Job Description

Job DescriptionAs a Principal Engineer (GRC), you will execute and own day‑to‑day cybersecurity governance, risk and compliance activities across StarHub’s business units. You will ensure our digital assets and projects comply with internal security policies and Singapore telco regulatory obligations (e.g., IMDA, CSA, TCS, BCS, CCoPv2) while uplifting our detection and response capabilities. You will collaborate with internal teams, our MSSP, and external consultants to deliver security reviews, exercises, and remediation on time and to a high standard.

Key Responsibilities

1) Regulatory Compliance & Governance (Execution)Maintain Cybersecurity Management (CSM) documentation and contribute to 5G policy development to align with regulatory obligations and deadlines.Plan and execute—together with appointed consultants and internal stakeholders—the following annual/biennial activities, including drafting and socialising reports and tracking remediation to closure:Bi‑Annual Host Configuration Reviews for CII and CII‑supporting assetsAnnual Table‑Top Exercises (TTX) across major stakeholdersBiennial external audits with auditors and key business unitsMaintain audit‑ready artefacts and ensure submissions meet expected timelines and quality.

2) Security Engineering & OperationsPartner with the MSSP and platform owners to ensure comprehensive 24×7 log ingestion and monitoring coverage; onboard new log sources and use cases.Tune SIEM/SOAR detections and playbooks; develop runbooks to reduce mean time to detect/respond.Track and drive vulnerability remediation for assigned systems; ensure adherence to SLA (e.g., critical within 14 days) and report status to stakeholders.Support incident response (IR): triage, containment coordination, evidence preservation, and post‑incident reviews; facilitate lessons learned and control improvements.Develop or enhance automation (e.g., scripts/dashboards) for evidence collection, risk tracking, and compliance reporting.

3) Risk Management & AssurancePerform risk assessments and threat modelling for new/changed business solutions; define security requirements and validate they are tested before go‑live.Maintain accurate risk register entries for owned domains; ensure risks have clear owners, treatments, and review cadences.Evaluate new security solutions/approaches and contribute to policies, standards, and guidelines.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.5–8 years’ hands‑on experience in cybersecurity engineering and/or GRC within a telco or similarly regulated environment.

Familiarity with Singapore regulatory landscape (IMDA, CSA, CII requirements) and enterprise frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001).

Demonstrated experience in one or more of: identity & access management (RBAC, MFA, PAM), cryptographic controls, vulnerability management, firewall policy reviews, log analysis, packet/stream analysis, SIEM/SOAR tuning, and incident handling.

Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to prepare reports for technical and senior, non‑technical stakeholders.Able to participate in on‑call/after‑hours support during critical cybersecurity incidents.

Preferred Certifications (nice‑to‑have): GCIH, GCFA, CISA, CISSP (or equivalent).

job.title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Engineering
job.description:
Job Description

The EBG CRM/OM Domain Owner holds end-to-end accountability for the strategy, delivery, and sustained health of StarHub’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Order Management (OM) platforms. This includes stewardship of Salesforce CRM, CloudSense CPQ/Order Management, and other bespoke CRM/OM solutions, as well as responsibility for evolving StarHub’s broader CRM/OM landscape.

This role ensures that CRM/OM capabilities enable and empower sales and service channels for SME, Enterprise, Wholesale, and International segments. Acting as both a technology steward and business partner, the role balances operational reliability with innovation, ensuring seamless customer and employee experiences. This position is pivotal in driving automation, platform stability, compliance, and business continuity, while shaping the long-term CRM/OM roadmap to align with enterprise priorities and evolving market needs.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Ownership and Platform Stewardship

  • Own the performance scalability and sustainability of CRMOM systems including Salesforce CloudSense and bespoke solutions
  • Ensure platform reliability compliance and system stability while driving continuous improvements in UX data integrity and integrated workflows
  • Establish monitor and report against key operational KPIs availability performance adoption fulfilment outcomes
  • Lead automation DevSecOps and process optimization initiatives to streamline sales and service workflows

Strategic Stewardship and Leadership

  • Provide longterm leadership and oversight of the domains people systems and outcomes ensuring alignment with organizational strategy
  • Establish and maintain the right leadership structure within the domain to drive accountability ownership and performance
  • Define and manage prioritization of initiatives to ensure the most impactful work is delivered in line with business objectives
  • Take ownership for delivering measurable results across people process and technology dimensions of the domain

Strategic Planning and Roadmap

  • Define and deliver the multiyear CRMOM technology roadmap ensuring alignment with StarHubs enterprise strategy
  • Evaluate prioritize and secure investments that maximize business impact and competitive advantage
  • Drive the endtoend fulfilment journey enablement from order capture through provisioning and support
  • Anticipate emerging needs ensuring the CRMOM domain evolves cohesively with adjacent enterprise systems

Operational Excellence and DevOps Execution

  • Oversee daytoday domain operations to ensure services meet or exceed agreed servicelevel objectives SLOs
  • Run the domain in a DevOps model including oncall schedules incident management monitoring and proactive issue resolution
  • Manage development capacity across competing demandsfeature enhancements technical debt remediation regulatory compliance security obligations operational fixes and audit requirements
  • Champion a culture of accountability postmortems and continuous improvement to enhance resilience and operational maturity

CrossDomain Collaboration and CrossFunctional Leadership

  • Partner closely with other domain owners to ensure interoperability reduce duplication and enable seamless enterprise workflows
  • Proactively manage dependencies across domains eg Billing ERP Digital Channels Data to ensure integrated solutions
  • Collaborate with related leadership roles across the organization clarifying mandates and ensuring seamless alignment of responsibilities
  • Champion knowledge sharing organizational alignment and crossfunctional success

Team and Resource Management

  • Build lead and mentor CRMOMaligned teams ensuring succession coverage for critical roles
  • Develop and implement sourcing and capability strategies including vendor management and internally owned operations
  • Oversee domain budget capacity planning and effective allocation of people and resources to balance delivery and sustainability
  • Foster a healthy highperforming team culture grounded in accountability transparency and continuous learning

job.title: Data Centre Critical Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

•Maintain records and update all M&E, building & schematic drawings of the facilities in and security of the estates under our care

o Liaise with internal business units eg Legal, Finance, Business Units, for any changes of lease terms, rental and service fees, property tax, etc

o Liaise with external tenants in StarHub’s owned-premises, including the generation of billing invoices to tenants

o Ensure timely handover/ takeover of premises to/from building owners

•Carry out risk assessments and management

•Perform 24 x 7 standby duties, respond to and rectify all situations

•Carry out any other assignments from the management

•Service oriented manner is essential. Must be a team player coupled with strong communication and problem solving skills and shall demonstrate the ability to work independently

job.title: Salesforce/CloudSense Lead
job.description:
Job Description

  • The Salesforce/CloudSense Technical Lead plays a critical role in driving the success of digital transformation initiatives leveraging the Salesforce platform and CloudSense CPQ solutions.
  • This position provides technical leadership, ensures adherence to best practices, and aligns solution design with strategic business goals.
  • The role is pivotal in delivering scalable, high-quality CRM and Order Management implementations that support end-to-end customer lifecycle management for enterprise business.
  • Key domains include CRM, product modelling, order orchestration, and comprehensive order management capabilities tailored to complex enterprise requirements in telecommunications industry.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end solution development across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) – from business requirements gathering to design, implementation, and production deployment.
  • Own technical delivery of Salesforce and CloudSense features, customizations, and integrations.
  • Define and enforce DevOps standards and practices including CI/CD pipeline setup, automated testing, and deployment automation.
  • Drive product modelling, order orchestration, and enterprise-grade order management solution designs using CloudSense CPQ.
  • Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to align CRM and Order Management solutions with business objectives in the enterprise domain.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across environments including sandbox, staging, and production.
  • Work collaboratively with enterprise architects, business analysts, testers, and external vendors to deliver high-impact solutions.
  • Ensure platform stability, performance, and compliance through proactive monitoring and support including leading and perform Root Cause Analysis and propose preventive measure to avoid re-occurrence of issues
  • Lead post-deployment support and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Able to hands-on in implementing solution frameworks, application & conduct proof-of-concepts on new technologies related or integrating to Salesforce/CloudSense.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 8 years of experience with Salesforce platform architecture, customization, and integration.
  • Deep expertise in CloudSense CPQ including product modeling, order orchestration, and pricing logic.
  • Proven delivery track record using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Community Cloud and custom development (Apex, LWC, Visualforce).
  • Experience leading DevOps practices on Salesforce including version control, CI/CD, and automated testing frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns involving APIs, middleware, and legacy systems.
  • Experience working with microservices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to engage business and technical stakeholders effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven dynamic environment.
  • Strong conceptual, problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.

  • Salesforce and/or CloudSense certifications are highly desirable.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

The senior data scientist is responsible to work with massive amounts of data to develop ML/GenAI models with Telco and other sets of data to help enterprises realise key business value through the use of Telco Insights. The senior data scientist will work closely with key internal and external stakeholders to develop new Al products or new application areas for Al.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Design and develop next generation of scalable Telco Big Data Analytics Models to support commercial projects across various business verticals.
  • Propose and design effective analytical approaches taking into consideration performance and scalability to large datasets, adhering to best practices for model development, and perform unit and system testing to validate the results of the analytics models. Constantly review and ensure that current methodology conforms and meets industry standards.
  • Propose and develop new analytics models and innovative techniques and algorithms to enhance SmartHub capabilities and value proposition of Telco Big Data.
  • Independently develop solutions that adopt and leverage on latest AI/ML models including GenAI and agentic solutions to deliver exceptional value to internal/external stakeholders.
  • Participate and contribute to stakeholders' requirement gatherings sessions, co-creation workshops to size up stakeholders' problem statements and formulate and review best approaches to analytic solutions and models.
  • Lead the technical collaboration with industry or research institutes to propose new potential areas for collaboration.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Analytics or related disciplines, along with at least 5 years of relevant experience in Big Data analytics application development OR Master’s degree or PhD in computer science or related disciplines
  • Experience with GenAI/Agentic AI solutions development and deployment
  • Experience with Business Intelligence Visualization (e.g. Tableau, AWS QuickSight)
  • Experience in presentation to stakeholders to articulate business values for analytical/data science projects
  • Experience in the following Big Data technologies: PySpark, Kafka
  • Programming experience in one or preferably more of the following languages: Python, Scala
  • Experience with Cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud)
  • Exposure to real-time streaming technologies (e.g. Spark Streaming)
  • Good understanding of software agile development, continues integration and deployment
  • Attention to details, a self-starter and self-learner continuously keeping up to date with industry developments
  • Creative problem solver and ability to think out of the box

job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Establish reliable and scalable quality engineering practices for StarHub’s digital platforms across mobile, web, backend and cloud-native systems. The Senior SDET will partner with engineering, product, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security and delivery teams to shift quality left, build meaningful automated quality gates, transition vendor-owned automation into sustainable in-house ownership, and provide fast, risk-based release confidence during migration, refactoring and platform modernisation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of the existing test automation from vendors and establish clear quality and governance standards, documentation, CI integration, reliability and maintainability expectations so automation becomes an integral part of product engineering.
  • Improve coverage, reliability and efficiency of automated tests across different platforms like web, mobile and backend
  • Improve quality of releases in terms of user experience and satisfaction by ensuring testability and automated tests are treated as first class citizens in the SDLC

Responsibilities

  • Partner with developers to design and implement tests at the right layer of the test pyramid or testing trophy, including unit, component, contract, API, integration, e2e, visual, accessibility
  • Setup automated quality gates across the SDLC to ensure issues are found as early as possible
  • Establish and track metrics for test automation to drive improvement and accountability
  • Improve test automation coverage, reliability and efficiency.
  • Use AI agents and coding assistants responsibly to assist with test planning, requirements analysis, risk discovery, test design, automation development, test data generation, failure triage, coverage gap analysis, documentation and refactoring.
  • Build internal tools, libraries, and platforms that make quality practices easier for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, data setup, environment reliability and release confidence.
  • Work with stakeholders across engineering and QE to ensure alignment on automation approaches and goals.
  • Work with vendors to deliver automation solutions to the standards defined.
  • Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, test plans, READMEs, onboarding guides and quality playbooks.

Areas of Impact:

  • Stakeholders: QA, Engineering, Program/Delivery Management, Product
  • Decision Rights: Strongly advise QA/Automation tools and license purchase, strongly advise KPIs for the test automation team
  • Resources: ~10 automation resources from vendors as peers, some existing licenses for UiPath, BrowserStack

Ideal Track Record:

  • Delivered automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) covering significant critical user journeys and behaviours, measurable regression improvement times in hours if not in days
  • Designed, or at least significantly contributed to, and implemented automated test frameworks from scratch that have measurably improved test efficiency.
  • Designed dashboards for reporting on test automation stats to stakeholders
  • Integrated tests with CI/CD pipelines
  • Used AI coding assistants or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent for testing, automation, documentation, triage or quality analysis.
  • Managed test environments and test automation infrastructure on cloud services like AWS, GCP, Browserstack, LambdaTest.
  • Built internal tools and utilities to make testing and QE easily accessible for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders improving productivity.

job.title: Senior Manager, Category Lead

This role will directly manage a team of category managers and play a critical role in driving commercial performance, supplier innovation, and enterprise-wide value creation.

The ideal candidate will combine strong leadership skills with deep procurement and category management expertise, along with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and foster cross-functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of category managers to ensure high performance and career growth.
  • Define and drive category strategies across assigned spend areas, ensuring alignment with business goals and procurement best practices.
  • Partner with senior business leaders to understand requirements, define sourcing strategies, and align procurement initiatives to enterprise objectives.
  • Oversee end-to-end sourcing processes, including market analysis, RFx, evaluation, negotiation, and contract management.

job.title: Project Manager (ICT)
job.description:
Job Description

The Project Manager takes ownership for planning, delivering and achieving the objectives of complex or medium-to-large-scale projects. Project Manager defines the project management plan to manage the project progress, resource, cost; and facilitates interaction and tasks of various stakeholders to reduce the risks of overall failure. Project Manager applies knowledge and skills aligned with the industry’s project management best practices and methodologies. As such, Project Manager needs to have good understandings of the different phases from "Initiating" to "Closing" and be able to proficiently execute and adhere to the organisation’s project management processes.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Accountable for the start-to-finish delivery of complex, high-value or strategic projects with high quality, within budget and according to agreed schedule and users’ requirements
  • Front clients, provide status updates & ensure customer satisfaction is achieved
  • Manage relationships and align with diverse teams of internal/external stakeholders
  • Actively plan, manage and report project scope, schedules, cost and resources
  • Monitor resource utilization to facilitate planning and scheduling of resources
  • Identify, assess and manage the risks/issues of the project, and take appropriate prevention action or resolution
  • Manage escalations and project scope creep or mitigates it when it occurs, or changes in users’ requirements according to Change
  • Control processes, schedule slippage, technical problems and shortages of resources
  • Work closely with business/product managers and support teams to ensure end objectives are met
  • Willingness to take on additional functions, such as, involve in project (PMO) governance and process, mentor junior or new team members, participate in presales activities, corporate initiatives, etc.

Qualifications

  • Accredited University Degree in Project Management, IT or related disciplines. Relevant experience without the required educational portfolio will also be considered
  • Must possess Project Management Certification, e.g. CITPM, PMP, PRINCE2, SCRUM/AGPM, etc.
  • Minimum 5 years of Project Management experience, preferably in medium-to-large scale ICT projects in various industries, including Government, Education, Health, FSI, Hospitality/MICE or Commercials, etc.
  • Experience in working in large matrix organization or MNC
  • Knowledge of PMO or understand (and be able to apply) project management governance and process
  • Ability to demonstrate experience in managing diverse groups of stakeholders & clients
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, negotiation and communication skills including ability to influence and communicate to all levels of stakeholders
  • Able to multi-task and is result-oriented, with energy and able to deliver in a very fast-paced environment
  • Logical and analytic approach in handling situations, problems or issues

*We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.description:

job.title: Functional Lead, People Systems
job.description:
Role Mission

Lead the business process design, functional optimisation, and adoption of StarHub’s People Systems to enable effective workforce management, compliant HR operations, and a modern employee experience. This role acts as the functional authority for People Systems, translating HR strategy and business needs into clear process design, system requirements, and adoption outcomes across the employee lifecycle.

Accountabilities Own end-to-end functional design and optimisation of People Systems across the hire-to-retire lifecycle. Serve as the primary business interface between HR, IS, and vendors for People Systems initiatives. Ensure HR processes are standardised, scalable, and system-enabled, not workaround-driven. Drive adoption of People Systems through clear process design, governance, and usability. Ensure functional alignment with HR policies, compliance requirements, and workforce strategy.

Responsibilities Lead functional design for People Systems processes, including core HR, recruitment, performance, rewards, learning, and workforce administration. Translate HR business needs, policies, and operating models into clear functional requirements and process flows. Define and maintain end-to-end HR process standards, ensuring consistency across business units. Partner with HR stakeholders to simplify, harmonise, and optimise HR processes before system enablement. Work closely with IS and vendors to ensure system configuration reflects intended business outcomes, not technical convenience. Define functional acceptance criteria and support UAT to ensure solutions meet business needs. Drive functional governance, including change impact assessment, prioritisation, and release readiness from a business perspective. Support HR change and adoption efforts through clear articulation of what is changing, why, and how work will be done differently. Monitor process performance and user feedback to identify continuous improvement opportunities.

Areas of Impact Consistent, efficient HR processes across the enterprise. Improved employee and manager experience through clear, intuitive People Systems processes. Reduced manual work, exceptions, and policy deviations. Strong alignment between HR strategy, policy, and system-enabled execution. Improved adoption and value realisation from HR transformation initiatives

Ideal Track Record 8–12 years of experience in HR operations, HR transformation, or People Systems functional roles. Strong hands-on experience designing end-to-end HR processes across the employee lifecycle. Proven ability to translate HR policy and business needs into system-enabled process design. Experience working with enterprise HR platforms (e.g. SAP SuccessFactors) from a functional/business perspective. Demonstrated success partnering with HR, IS, and vendors in complex organisations. Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments preferred

job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
Job Description- Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Role Overview

We are looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating enterprise cloud and application infrastructure. The role will own the technical architecture and implementation of servers, virtualization, Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, networking, storage, and application deployment environments, while working closely with technology vendors and system integrators for implementation and support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy hybrid cloud and on-prem infrastructure across AWS, VMware, Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud, including GPU compute platforms.
  • Architect and implement Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, covering cluster design, sizing, HA, networking, storage, security and DR.
  • Define compute, GPU, virtualization, storage, network and capacity architectures for enterprise and cloud-native workloads.
  • Design application platforms using VMs, containers, Kubernetes/OpenShift and cloud-native services; support application onboarding and migration.
  • Implement IaC and automation using Terraform/Ansible and CI/CD pipelines for repeatable infrastructure deployment.
  • Integrate platforms with IAM, DNS, load balancers, PKI, monitoring, logging, backup and security services.
  • Own HLD/LLD, architecture reviews, sizing, implementation plans, acceptance criteria and operational runbooks.
  • Drive performance, resilience, security, capacity management, lifecycle upgrades, patching and technology refresh.
  • Support POCs/MVPs involving cloud, GPU, Kubernetes, automation and emerging infrastructure technologies.

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Act as technical owner for cloud, infrastructure and system-integration vendors.
  • Evaluate and recommend solutions across AWS, VMware, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Kubernetes/OpenShift, GPU and virtualization.
  • Review vendor HLD/LLD, configurations, deployment plans and technical deliverables.

Opportunities to learning and development and get involvement in the advanced technology projects.

  • The opportunities includes learning and development in advanced technology areas such as-Agentic AI, Knowledge graph, AI security and Quantum Security.
  • Agentic AI & Knowledge Graph: LangGraph, OpenAI/Azure AI Foundry, Neo4j, GraphRAG, vector databases, RAG and AI orchestration frameworks.
  • AI & Quantum Security: Palo Alto AI security, NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, IBM watsonx.governance, HSM/KMS, PKI, PQC, cryptographic discovery and crypto-agility tools.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with Linux servers, virtualization, compute, storage, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift; experience managing vendor-led implementations is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of private cloud, hybrid cloud, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Experience with Docker/container platforms, Helm, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
  • Strong understanding of networking including DNS, load balancing, routing, firewalls, VPN, ingress/egress, and network segmentation.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure monitoring, logging, observability, backup, and disaster recovery
  • Scripting/programming knowledge in Python, Bash, or similar languages.

Qualifications

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
  • 5-8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or related roles.
  • Proven experience in building enterprise infrastructure and deploying applications.
  • Experience working with technology vendors/system integrators on infrastructure implementation projects.
  • Cloud, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or infrastructure certifications are desirable.

Key Competencies

  • Cloud & infrastructure architecture
  • Server and platform engineering
  • Kubernetes/OpenShift platform management
  • Application deployment
  • Infrastructure automation
  • Vendor and system-integrator management
  • DevSecOps and infrastructure security
  • Troubleshooting and technical problem solving
  • Capacity, scalability, availability and resilience
  • Strong technical documentation and stakeholder management
