job.title: Senior Network Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer to lead the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise network infrastructure supporting mission-critical and highly resilient data centre environments.

This role requires a comprehensive technical background spanning physical infrastructure (DWDM and Data Centre OT), enterprise IT backbone networking, cybersecurity, and network automation. The successful candidate will oversee the enterprise IT network backbone, lead the Data Centre Cybersecurity team, and drive network architecture reviews for new local and regional data centre developments.

Working closely with Cybersecurity, Data Centre OT, Data Centre Operations, IT Infrastructure, and Data Analytics teams, you will deliver secure, resilient, and scalable network solutions that support business growth and operational excellence.

How You will Make An Impact:

Data Centre Architecture & Physical Infrastructure:

  • Participate as a core member of the design team for new local and regional data centre deployments, ensuring network and security architectures are incorporated throughout the design lifecycle.
  • Act as the primary networking subject matter expert for Data Centre teams, providing structural, logical, and connectivity solutions for enterprise deployments.
  • Lead the physical network design of carrier-neutral colocation facilities, including Meet-Me Room (MMR), Main Distribution Frame (MDF), structured cabling, and interconnection architecture.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders to ensure network solutions meet business, operational, resilience, and scalability requirements.
  • Manage the enterprise cybersecurity team responsible for network security strategy, architecture, governance, and operational security.
  • Design, implement, and manage secure network segmentation between IT and OT environments.
  • Implement and manage secure one-way communication technologies, such as Data Diodes, to maintain secure data flows from OT to IT environments where applicable.
  • Design and manage enterprise network security infrastructure, including firewalls and centralised authentication platforms such as RADIUS and TACACS+.
  • Ensure network designs comply with organisational cybersecurity policies, recognised industry standards (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2), applicable regulatory requirements, and internal security assessments, including penetration testing and vulnerability assessments.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve cybersecurity incident response frameworks and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for data centre environments.

Network Engineering & Automation

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise WAN, LAN, WLAN, firewall, and DWDM network solutions.
  • Lead detailed network designs for enterprise IT and Operational Technology (OT) environments across multiple data centres.
  • Manage and optimise the global enterprise network backbone, including DWDM (Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing) optical transport infrastructure.
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise routing and switching platforms, including Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Arista, or equivalent technologies.
  • Design and support highly available, low-latency, and resilient enterprise network infrastructure for mission-critical environments.
  • Implement network segmentation and security controls to securely isolate OT and IT environments using unidirectional gateway technologies where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with Data Centre OT and Data Centre Security teams to align network architecture with operational continuity, safety, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements.
  • Design and implement network automation and orchestration solutions using Python, Ansible, REST APIs, or equivalent technologies to improve provisioning, configuration management, and operational efficiency.
  • Utilise Linux operating systems for network diagnostics, automation, scripting, and systems integration.

Operations, Troubleshooting & Incident Management

  • Serve as the technical escalation point for complex enterprise networking and cybersecurity incidents.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Lead network maintenance, upgrades, migrations, and change activities while minimising service disruption.
  • Monitor enterprise network performance, availability, and capacity, recommending continuous improvements where appropriate.
  • Participate in an on-call and technical escalation rotation as required.
  • Leadership, Strategy & Project Management
  • Lead end-to-end infrastructure projects, including planning, budget forecasting (CAPEX/OPEX), resource allocation, scheduling, and delivery.
  • Mentor and develop network engineers through coaching, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Develop and present strategic network architecture proposals and technical presentations supporting enterprise and cloud-based data centre initiatives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to develop network roadmaps that support organisational growth and technology transformation.
  • Promote continuous improvement through automation, operational excellence, and adoption of industry best practices.

Skills for Success:

  • Extensive experience designing, implementing, and managing mission-critical enterprise networking, data centre infrastructure, and Operational Technology (OT) environments.
  • Proven experience leading technical teams across networking, physical infrastructure deployment, or cybersecurity functions.
  • Experience working in data centre, hyperscale network, or equivalent enterprise environments.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, and SRv6.
  • Experience with enterprise network monitoring and telemetry platforms such as SolarWinds or equivalent tools.
  • Strong understanding of high availability, redundancy, disaster recovery, and network performance optimisation.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with enterprise networking platforms such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Arista, or equivalent technologies, together with DWDM optical transport, Data Diodes, and enterprise firewall solutions.
  • Proficiency in network automation using Python, Ansible, REST APIs, or similar technologies.
  • Working knowledge of Linux operating systems for networking, automation, and systems integration.
  • Active CCIE certification or an equivalent advanced networking certification is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise routing and switching protocols, including BGP, EVPN, RADIUS/TACACS+, and high-density data centre fabric architectures.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to support network capacity planning, optimisation, and budget forecasting.
  • Ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical mentoring skills.

Your Career Growth Starts Here. Apply Now!

job.title: Application Test Engineer
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

![Image 1](https://rmkcdn.successfactors.com/a107d764/0cfc5002-fe67-4ff7-b0cd-9.png)

NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 13,000 has delivered large-scale, mission-critical, and multi-platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

We are seeking an Application Engineer (Testing)who will be responsible to lead the testing of software/applications to ensure they function accordingly to specifications and clients' requirements to meet the business needs. The Application Engineer will conduct testing using preferred organizational practices & established processes contained in the Test Methodology to ensure test objective of the project is met.

What will you do?

Project Delivery

  • Understand and analyze testing requirements to prepare test plan, and test design
  • Advise project team on design consideration to facilitate meeting of requirements. Advise business analysts and/or customers on the testing requirements and test techniques
  • Prepare and ensure readiness of test bed and test environment to carry out the test execution
  • Execute test in accordance to the test design
  • Analyze test results and work with respective teams to resolve issues such as defect open and resolution rate, bottlenecks in performance and other defects
  • Prepare test report for submission
  • Provide regular test results updates
  • Recommend and use automated testing tools where appropriate
  • Manage test activities and ensure the planned test activities are completed as scheduled.

Self / Team / Organization Development

  • Adopt test standards and testing methodology
  • Create awareness; conduct training on test techniques, assists in implementation of test standards, consistent methodology, best practices and principles.
  • Share knowledge within or other NCS teams
  • Self-directed learning & development.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Diploma / Degree in Computer Science / Computer Engineering / Information Technology related field, or IT equivalent
  • Typically 2 or more years of IT/Testing experience with knowledge of test methodology and various test tools
  • Familiar with testing methodologies, tools and techniques
  • Possess initiative and disposition with a strong commitment and orientation towards results and high quality standards
  • Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Self-motivator with a positive attitude and with high energy
  • Proficient in written and spoken English
  • Customer focused

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs - Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity -and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we _make the extraordinary happen_.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Develop deployment architecture including network and system design. job.title: Engineer, Voice Engineering (Networks)
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

Singtel Networks, the most established telecommunications infrastructure provider in Singapore is transforming to enable the digital generation of tomorrow. We are introducing new capabilities in 5G, Cloud, Analytics, Digital Commerce, Software Engineering, Cyber Security to enhance our core competencies and deliver innovative and differentiated Mobile and Fixed services (Broadband, TV and Telephony) for our customers. We are committed to celebrating inclusion and diversity and is a strong believer to upskill and nurture all individuals. Come join us today as we build Singtel’s Networks of tomorrow, and Empower Every Generation to live, work and play in new ways!

The incumbent is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and performance of Singtel’s local fixed voice interconnect systems. This role ensures seamless connectivity between Singtel and local and international operators, while maintaining high service availability, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

The incumbent will lead operational activities including system administration, fault management, service provisioning, and number portability operations. The role also drives cybersecurity compliance through system patching, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.

In addition, the role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders, external operators, and vendors to resolve service issues, implement system enhancements, and support regulatory directives such as scam call mitigation in partnership with IMDA and SPF.

Make an Impact by:

Operations & Service Management

  • Oversee daily BAU operations of local fixed voice and interconnect systems to ensure high availability and performance
  • Ensure timely service provisioning, system monitoring, and execution of number migration/porting activities
  • Manage interconnect junctions and signalling links between Singtel and local/overseas operators (FBO/SBO/OLO)

Incident & Fault Management

  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of service issues, including call failures, signalling faults, and number portability issues
  • Manage and resolve escalations from TAC, INOC, ISMC, 1608, and external partners

Ensure timely handling of critical and urgent incidents, including after-office-hours escalations (e.g. VIP/VVIP cases)

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as the key point of contact for interconnect-related matters with external operators and partners
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders (Work Order, Product, Account teams) to ensure accurate order capture and timely provisioning
  • Engage vendors for issue escalation, including hardware replacement, software fixes, patching, and system upgrades

System Administration & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage system configuration, software upgrades, patching, and performance optimization
  • Oversee equipment lifecycle management, including refresh planning and execution
  • Review and govern Method of Procedure (MOP) for system changes and upgrades

Security, Compliance & Audit

  • Ensure systems meet cybersecurity standards through regular patching, vulnerability scanning, and mitigation
  • Support internal and external audit exercises and ensure proper documentation and controls
  • Manage IMDA directives related to scam prevention, including testing and implementation

Regulatory & Special Operations Support

  • Work with IAR, IMDA, and SPF to support scam call blocking initiatives and regulatory requirements
  • Support special events and emergency preparedness activities (e.g. SPF contingency planning)

Resource & Capacity Management

  • Manage Interconnect Gateway resource planning, including onboarding of new interconnect partners and capacity expansion

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in IT/Computer or equivalent work experience in telecom, networking and IT
  • Strong knowledge of telecom networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
  • Experience with legacy signaling protocols (SS7/ISDN) and SIP-based voice systems

Linux knowledge

  • Understanding of interconnect architecture, number portability, and call routing

job.description:

Be a Part of Something BIG!

The Finance Director, Innov8, is a key member of the leadership team responsible for leading the organization’s overall finance function, ensuring strong financial governance, strategic planning, regulatory compliance, and optimal capital management. The role oversees financial planning and analysis, treasury operations, investment portfolio management, tax, legal and corporate secretarial matters, audit coordination, hr support and payroll, and financial reporting to support sustainable business growth and shareholder value creation.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO),Singtel Innov8 Ventures, the Finance Director serves as a trusted advisor to senior management on financial, investment, risk and corporate governance matters. The role also serves as a business partner to the Investment Committee and Board of Directors in providing timely information on investment portfolio, evaluating impairment provisions and safeguarding shareholder assets.The scope covers 6 entities across 4 countries, inclusive of Singapore.

Make An Impact By

Financial Leadership

  • Provide periodic financial insights to the CEO, Board and senior leadership team.
  • Drive financial discipline across the organization.
  • Maintain financial performance and manage manpower issues.
  • Establish and maintain robust financial policies, controls, and governance frameworks.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Financial Reporting & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate and timely preparation of monthly and quarterly consolidated financial report.
  • Oversee statutory reporting and compliance with applicable accounting standards.
  • Present insightful financial performance to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain high standards of financial integrity, transparency, and accountability.

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting, long-range planning, and rolling forecast processes.
  • Monitor business performance against budgets and forecasts.
  • Develop scenario analyses to support strategic decision-making.
  • Provide actionable insights on cost optimization and resource allocation.

Investment Portfolio

  • Support the investment team maintaining overview of the company’s total investment portfolio value.
  • Coordinate with investment team lead on funding, exits, investment performance, liquidity requirements, risk and impairment assessment.
  • Present impairment paper to management and the Board for approval.
  • Coordinate with investment lead and auditors on valuation assessment of portfolio companies.
  • Ensure compliance with investment policies and risk management guidelines.
  • Manage and maintain relationship with security stock broker for quoted shares held.
  • Point of contact for accepting and management of share certificates.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Treasury, Cash & Capital Management

  • Manage treasury operations, cash flow planning, and liquidity management.
  • Oversee cash management and capital structure arrangements with Treasury and Company Secretary.
  • Ensure adequate funding and liquidity to support operational and investment funding activities.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Tax Management

  • Oversee the organization’s tax compliance framework.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of all tax filings and regulatory obligations.
  • Manage corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and other tax initiatives including annual FATCA and CRS reporting, MAS declaration and updating Form W8-BenE as required.
  • Liaise with external tax advisors on obtaining tax exemption certificate, overseas tax filings and ad-hoc matters.
  • Identify tax optimization opportunities while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Legal & Company Secretarial Oversight

  • Support external legal counsel on investment transactions, KYC and other corporate governance matters.
  • Coordinate with in-house legal counsel on contracts and regulatory matters ensuring compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Support Board and shareholder meetings, coordinating, preparing and reviewing of board resolutions and corporate documentation.
  • Oversee company secretarial activities and maintenance of statutory records.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Audit, Risk & Internal Controls

  • Lead relationships with external and internal auditors.
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits and ensure timely completion of audit requirements.
  • Address audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Strengthen internal controls and governance processes.
  • Monitor compliance with accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

General HR, Payroll and Administrative matters

  • Provide general HR and office administrative support across the organization.
  • Responsible for payroll processing for US office, employee records management, leave and benefits administration, statutory reporting ensuring compliance with local regulations.
  • Collaborate effectively with external overseas vendors on payroll and leave management issues.
  • Laise with landlord and collaboration partner for office lease renewal.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead, mentor and develop the finance and related support functions.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, integrity and continuous improvement
  • Collaborate effectively with business leaders and external stakeholders including auditors, legal and tax advisors.
  • Drive process improvements and automation initiatives

Skills to Succeed

  • Bachelor degree in Finance, Accounting or related discipline.
  • Professional qualifications such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 12–15 years of progressive finance leadership experience, including experience in senior finance management level.
  • Experience in investment portfolio management, treasury, financial planning and analysis, tax, audit, hr, admin, payroll and corporate governance.
  • Experience interacting with Boards, shareholders and regulatory authorities.
  • Good understanding of accounting standards, financial regulations, and risk management principles.
  • Experience in managing legal and company secretarial matters is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with cross-border investments and multi-entity structures is advantageous

You will also get to gain invaluable experience in a fast-growing industry that is powering the digitalisation wave. Be empowered to co-create the future with our dynamic teams!

Make an Impact by

Facilities Monitoring & Operations

  • Monitor and manage critical Data Centre (DC) facilities infrastructure in a 24x7 Centralized Network Operations Centre (CNOC) environment.
  • Perform real-time monitoring of electrical, mechanical and environmental systems including UPS, generators, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution systems, temperature and humidity monitoring, leak detection systems and access control systems.
  • Respond promptly to facility alarms, incidents and abnormalities, and escalate issues to customer success team, technical specialists and customers based on severity and operational impact.
  • Ensure Building Management Systems (BMS), Environmental Monitoring Systems (EMS), DCIM tools and IoT monitoring devices are functioning accurately and reliably.
  • Coordinate with onsite operations teams during maintenance activities, equipment failures, planned shutdowns and emergency response situations.

Incident, Change & Maintenance Coordination

  • Support facilities incident management processes including incident logging, escalation, tracking and closure within defined SLA timelines.
  • Manage change requests workflow with internal teams
  • Ensure proper documentation and shift handover updates for all incidents, maintenance activities and operational events.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of facilities-related issues.

Operational Support & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate operational records, alarm logs, escalation reports and facilities documentation.
  • Assist in generating operational and facilities performance reports for management review.
  • Manage OneNxera Portal
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, monitoring effectiveness and service reliability.
  • Ensure compliance with operational procedures, safety requirements and data centre best practices.

Skills for Success

  • ITE, Nitec/Higher Nitec or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Management or related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Data Centre Operations, Facilities Operations or mission critical infrastructure environments.
  • Candidates with relevant hands-on experience in 24x7 operations environments are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic understanding of Data Centre facilities systems including power, cooling, environmental monitoring and building management systems.
  • Familiarity with facilities monitoring tools such as BMS, EMS, DCIM or Servicenow systems is advantageous.
  • Knowledge of incident management, escalation handling and change management processes.
  • ITIL Foundation certification will be an added advantage.
  • Able to work effectively in a 24x7 shift environment (12-hours shift rotation)
  • Good troubleshooting, coordination and communication skills.
  • Team players with positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Able to remain calm and organized during operational incidents and high-pressure situations.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

job.title: Portfolio Manager, hi! Product Marketing
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll have the opportunity to use data, digital products and emerging technologies to shape better customer experiences and unlock new avenues for growth.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

Join the hi! by Singtel team and help turn customer growth and digital adoption into measurable commercial impact.

As a Portfolio Manager, hi! Product Marketing, you will work at the intersection of revenue management, digital product thinking and customer growth. You will identify the commercial drivers that matter, use data and experimentation to unlock growth opportunities, and help make the hi! consumer app a stronger destination for customer engagement, self-service and monetisation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys asking “what moves the number?”, spotting friction in customer journeys and bringing Product, Digital, CLM, Analytics and Marketing teams together to turn insights into measurable results.

How You will Make An Impact:

Revenue & Growth Management

  • Manage and track hi!’s revenue performance across key revenue-generating drivers, with clear targets, forecasts, gap-closing actions and regular performance reviews.
  • Break topline revenue into actionable commercial levers such as revenue-generating subscriber conversion, recharge and top-up behaviour, and ARPU uplift to identify the highest-impact growth opportunities.
  • Use commercial and behavioural data to identify growth opportunities, diagnose underperformance and recommend actions that improve revenue outcomes.
  • Develop and support business cases, size growth opportunities and conduct post-launch reviews to understand what worked, what did not and what should be scaled.
  • Translate performance data into clear commercial insights and actions for key stakeholders.

Consumer App Adoption & Digital Growth

  • Drive adoption and active usage of the hi! consumer app across the full customer funnel, including installs, registrations, monthly active users, repeat visits, digital transactions and self-service behaviour.
  • Track app funnel performance to identify customer drop-offs, friction points and opportunities to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Work closely with Product, IT and Channel Owners to shape and prioritise features that solve customer needs and create stronger commercial outcomes.
  • Develop initiatives that connect app engagement with recharge, retention, upsell, cross-sell and other revenue drivers.
  • Monitor feature adoption and evaluate the customer and commercial impact of new digital capabilities.

Innovation, Experimentation & New Technology

The candidate is part of the 24/7 Submarine Cable System NOC, responsible for end-to-end operations including fault management, change management, order fulfilment, network surveillance and regulatory reporting. The role ensures high network availability across Singtel co-owned cable systems within a mission-critical environment.

Responsible for executing technical operations to ensure the availability, reliability and restoration of international submarine cable systems. The incumbent independently performs technical analysis, executes operational activities through authorised Network Management Systems (NMS), and coordinates restoration activities in accordance with established operating procedures and regulatory requirements.

These include:

  • Performing technical assessment of complex submarine cable system alarms to determine probable fault domains and service impact.
  • Executing operational activities through Network Management Systems (NMS) with authorised write access, requiring sound judgement to prevent unintended service disruption.

  • Execute restoration actions and monitor service recovery until normal operations are restored
  • Preparing and submitting mandatory regulatory notifications within prescribed timelines during submarine cable outages.
  • Maintain accurate incident chronology, operational records and shift documentation.
  • Escalate operational issues, risks and unresolved incidents in accordance with established escalation procedures.
  • Participate in operational readiness activities, disaster recovery exercises and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • These responsibilities require engineers capable of making sound operational decisions independently while maintaining strict adherence to operational governance and regulatory requirements.

Skills for Success:

  • Diploma in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent
  • In telecommunications network operations, transmission systems, optical transport networks or submarine cable operations
  • Demonstrated experience in incident management within a mission-critical operational environment
  • Experience operating Network Management Systems (NMS) with configuration or operational write privileges is highly desirable
  • Experience supporting international submarine cable systems, optical transmission networks or carrier-grade infrastructure will be an advantage.

Good to have

  • IP networking protocols knowledge
  • Optical transmission technologies knowledge
  • Microsoft 365 tools knowledge
  • DWDM (Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing) and SDH (Synchronous Digital Hierarchy) technologies knowledge
  • Proficiency with OTDR (Optical Time-Domain Reflectometer), BER (Bit Error Rate) test and Network Management Systems (NMS) knowledge

job.description:

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Role Summary

**

The purpose of this role is to provide independent security architecture and risk assurance across technology initiatives, ensuring that information security risks are identified early, assessed consistently, and managed effectively throughout the system lifecycle. The role enables secure delivery of business initiatives by ensuring technology solutions, infrastructure changes, and third-party services are designed and implemented in compliance with regulatory requirements, enterprise security standards, and the organisation’s risk appetite.

The role acts as a security risk and architecture advisor to Singtel IT, Telco Networks and Enterprise stakeholders, applying recognised security frameworks and threat modelling techniques to evaluate design decisions, identify control gaps, and recommend risk-based mitigations. Through continuous improvement of risk assessment practices and standards, the role strengthens the organisation’s overall security posture while supporting timely and informed decision-making.

**

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Perform comprehensive information security risk assessments for new and existing systems, applications, infrastructure changes, and third-party engagements.
  • Ensure technology initiatives and controls comply with internal security policies, standards, and governance requirements; proactively highlight gaps and recommend remediation.
  • Review and validate security control designs across IT infrastructure, cloud environments, network security, identity and access management, data protection, and application security
  • Assess design documents, architecture diagrams, and technical controls to confirm that technology risks are mitigated prior to go-live.
  • Conduct threat modelling for critical systems and application deployments, identifying attack paths, threat scenarios, and control weaknesses, and recommending design-level mitigations.
  • Collaborate with IT, application teams, and business stakeholders to provide risk advisory for projects and ad hoc reviews.
  • Define, review, and promote secure architecture and security design patterns to guide solution teams in implementing consistent, scalable, and risk-aligned security controls.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security risk assessment and design review frameworks, processes, and templates to enhance consistency, quality, and efficiency across project and solution reviews.
  • Recommend new or enhanced security controls and architecture patterns based on emerging threats, risk assessment outcomes, regulatory changes, and industry best practices, and work with stakeholders to support their implementation.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree/Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or related fields
  • At least 6 years or more working experience in security assessment, cybersecurity, or related IT roles.
  • Experience in Systems security, Network Security, Identity Access Management or Virtualization Security is required.
  • Experience working within system integrator or consulting environments, including exposure to multi-client or complex delivery engagements, is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in system and security administration, implementation, and solution design across servers, applications and telco networks, will be useful.
  • Ability to apply Zero Trust security architecture principles to complex enterprise environments.
  • Capability in threat modelling and technology risk assessment, including identification of threat scenarios, assessment of control effectiveness, and recommendation of risk mitigation strategies.
  • Strong capability to interpret security baselines and standards and translate them into appropriate architectural and control requirements, aligned with regulatory, enterprise, and technology contexts.
  • Ability to validate systems and solution designs against security and compliance baselines, identify gaps, and recommend appropriate remediation measures.
  • Professional security management certifications such as a Certified Information Systems Security professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) or other similar credentials, will be preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective time management and prioritisation skills.
  • Sound conflict management and negotiation skills.
  • High level of professionalism, commitment, and accountability.
  • Resilience and adaptability in fast-paced or changing environments.
  • Change-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, with remote stakeholders, exercising sound judgement and initiative.

job.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Enterprise Platforms Engineering team. The role is responsible for designing, building and delivering software development infrastructure that supports internal tools and platform development. Working closely with engineering and technology teams, the Senior DevOps Engineer will enable reliable and automated application and infrastructure deployment while ensuring alignment with organisational IT, security, architecture and engineering standards.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical expertise, effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with teams with different levels of technical experience. They will contribute to the adoption of DevOps best practices, cloud architecture strategies and engineering standards while supporting the continued evolution of cloud and automation capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, implement and automate CI/CD pipelines across development, staging and production environments.
  • Develop and maintain DevOps engineering standards and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve deployment consistency, reliability and automation.
  • Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions and automated application deployments.
  • Develop tools and scripts to automate deployment and operational processes.
  • Guide project teams toward solutions aligned with agreed architecture, security, engineering principles and standards.
  • Provide technical guidance to teams on application and infrastructure automation.
  • Mentor engineers and facilitate knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Integrate appropriate security controls and testing into DevOps processes.
  • Drive continuous improvements in application design, development and delivery.
  • Improve system reliability and recovery through monitoring, alerting, automation and self-healing capabilities.
  • Promote an automation-first engineering approach.
  • Apply agile practices to support consistent and transparent delivery.
  • Manage and maintain DevOps pipelines and collaborate with development teams on integrated delivery pipelines.
  • Lead technology evaluations and implementations to address gaps in software build, testing, deployment and scalability capabilities.
  • Develop and implement governance processes and tools to support compliance with applicable technology standards and policies.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience in Information Technology, including significant hands-on experience with DevOps engineering for complex systems.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing and operating CI/CD and infrastructure automation solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux operating systems such as Ubuntu.
  • Strong practical experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments.
  • Experience with at least one major public cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, VPNs, DNS, load balancing and network protocols.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD solutions using technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins or comparable tools.
  • Experience with configuration-management technologies such as Ansible, Chef, Puppet or comparable tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills in complex distributed computing environments.
  • Proficiency with Git and experience using collaboration and work-management platforms such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working with APIs, command-line interfaces and SDKs.
  • Experience with API gateway technologies such as NGINX, Apigee or comparable platforms.
  • Strong scripting capability using technologies such as Shell and Python.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring and tracing platforms such as Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch, Zabbix, Elasticsearch/Kibana, Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Datadog or Dynatrace.
  • Understanding of SQL and NoSQL database technologies, such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, MySQL and PostgreSQL.

Preferred Skills

Experience with one or more of the following would be advantageous:

  • Event-streaming technologies such as Kafka.
  • Service-mesh technologies such as Istio or Envoy.
  • REST APIs and GraphQL.
  • Microservices architecture.
  • Secrets-management technologies such as Vault.
  • Service-discovery and distributed-coordination technologies such as Consul, ZooKeeper or etcd.
  • Relevant professional certifications, such as RHCE/RHCSA or Kubernetes certifications.

job.title: Senior Cyber Security Consultant
job.description:
At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

Make an impact by:

  • Act as the Enterprise Cyber Security technical focal point during cyber incidents, working closely with SOC, CISO, infrastructure, network, cloud, application, and vendor teams.
  • Support cyber incident response activities including triage, investigation, containment coordination, evidence gathering, remediation tracking, and post incident review.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting across Enterprise infrastructure using available telemetry from SIEM, EDR, NDR, vulnerability management, asset discovery, and other security tools.
  • Identify suspicious behaviours, attack patterns, lateral movement indicators, privilege misuse, exposed services, anomalous access, and other signs of compromise.
  • Develop and enhance threat hunting hypotheses, detection use cases, investigation playbooks, response procedures, and escalation workflows.
  • Support improvement of security monitoring by identifying gaps in logs, telemetry, asset visibility, EDR/NDR/SIEM coverage, and detection rules.
  • Work with SOC and central security teams to improve alert quality, detection coverage, investigation context, and incident response readiness.
  • Support vulnerability management and risk-based remediation by correlating vulnerabilities with asset criticality, exposure, threat intelligence, and compensating controls.
  • Support Enterprise cybersecurity initiatives including NDR deployment, asset discovery, micro-segmentation, Zero Trust controls, PIAM/IAM adoption, and security tool integration.
  • Participate in security assessments, threat reviews, tabletop exercises, incident simulations, and lessons-learned activities.
  • Support root cause analysis and ensure remediation actions from cyber incidents, audit findings, vulnerability reviews, and threat hunting activities are tracked to closure.
  • Prepare management reports, investigation summaries, threat hunting findings, risk updates, incident dashboards, and security posture metrics.
  • Support cybersecurity audits, regulatory requests, internal governance activities, and evidence collection where related to incident response, monitoring, and security controls.
  • Maintain and improve technical documentation including incident response runbooks, threat hunting procedures, SOPs, escalation guides, and operational checklists.
  • Provide guidance to internal teams on security best practices, incident handling, evidence preservation, secure configuration, and remediation actions.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree or diploma with relevant experience in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, threat hunting, SOC operations, detection engineering, infrastructure security, or related roles.
  • Strong understanding of cyber incident response lifecycle, including detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Hands-on experience with security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, vulnerability management, threat intelligence platforms, asset discovery tools, firewalls, and endpoint/network security controls.
  • Good understanding of network security, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, authentication, Windows/Linux systems, Active Directory, and cloud security fundamentals.
  • Experience analysing logs, alerts, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, user activity, and security events to identify threats or suspicious behaviours.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, threat hunting methodologies, and common attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures.
  • Ability to work across multiple teams during incidents and security projects, including SOC, CISO, infrastructure, network, application, cloud, GRC, and vendor teams.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Preferred Certifications and Skills

  • Relevant incident response or threat hunting certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GNFA, GCFE, CySA+, or equivalent.
  • Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Security+, or equivalent are advantageous.
  • SIEM, EDR, NDR, or cloud security certifications from platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, AWS, or Azure are preferred.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, and data analysis using PowerShell, Python, KQL, SPL, APIs, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to tools and technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike, Tenable, Qualys, Darktrace, Palo Alto, Illumio, CyberArk, Delinea, Device42, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working in complex, regulated, telecom, infrastructure-heavy, or enterprise-scale environments.

job.title: Lead Security Architect & Risk Assessment
job.description:
Summary

Lead Security Architect is a senior cybersecurity leader responsible for driving the organization’s enterprise-wide Security Architecture strategy. This role oversees implementation of Zero Trust secure architecture principles, deliver threat models, security reference architectures and design patterns.

This role will partner closely with enterprise architects, solution designers, application teams, technology infrastructure, devsecops, project management and executive leadership to deliver secure and resilient solutions.

Singtel has diverse technology ecosystems and lead security architect needs to be able to cope with varying complexities in terms of business requirements, system, network and application architecture. Additionally, while there are differing business and technical considerations, Architect needs to able to align the stakeholders from Singtel IT and Enterprise to adopt common Zero Trust technology components.

This role will report into the Head of Information Security Architecture and Risk Assessment.

How You will Make An Impact:

Strategic Leadership:

  • Establish Zero Trust security architecture strategy and execution across Singtel IT and Enterprise.
  • Plan, prioritize and develop roadmap to enhance Cyber capabilities and incorporate into Annual Operating Plan.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and new trends in Cybersecurity.
  • Keep abreast of emerging risks, industry wide attacks and mitigations.

Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Present thematic architecture gaps and risk posture to executive leadership and governance committees.
  • Translate technical cyber risks into business impact language.

Initiatives and Programs Oversight:

  • Lead execution of Zero trust security initiatives across Singtel IT and Enterprise Business.
  • Perform Threat Modelling and Risk Assessments across various Singtel IT and Enterprise projects.
  • Develop reusable Security reference architectures and design patterns.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or its equivalent.
  • 8 Years or more relevant experience
  • Network Security such as macro/micro segmentation, ZTNA, SASE, SDWAN, Perimeter security.
  • Infrastructure and Systems Security.
  • Threat Modelling.
  • Zero Trust Security Architecture.
  • Experience in Security by Design principles.
  • One or more Industry security Certifications such as CCIE, CISSP, CISM, CCSP or other equivalent industry certifications.
  • Orchestrate across cross-functional teams, make sound decisions under pressure, and manage expectations.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management decision-making, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.

  • Build integrations with enterprise applications, IAM platforms, directories, databases, and APIs.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent fixes.
  • Improve operational efficiency by reducing manual effort through automation and reusable components.
  • Work closely with IAM, application, infrastructure, security, audit, and operations teams.
  • Prepare technical documentation, deployment steps, operational runbooks, and support handover documents.
  • Continuously learn and adapt to IAM tools, security platforms, automation frameworks, and emerging technologies.

Skills for Success:

  • A minimum of 4–5 years of strong software development experience.
  • Excellent hands-on coding experience in:Java/Python/PowerShell/Shell scripting
  • Strong understanding of software engineering concepts, coding standards, design principles, and debugging techniques.
  • Ability to independently analyze requirements and design effective technical solutions.
  • Strong logical thinking, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good experience with REST APIs, JSON, XML, web services, and application integrations.
  • Good understanding of databases and SQL queries.
  • Strong willingness to learn IAM platforms, enterprise security tools, and new technologies.

Good to Have Skills:

  • Exposure to SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and its key components (workflows, rules, connectors, lifecycle events, certifications, provisioning).
  • Basic knowledge of Privileged Access Management (PAM) concepts, preferably CyberArk.
  • Familiarity with AI/Generative AI, including RAG and prompt engineering.
  • Understanding of AI fundamentals such as document retrieval, embeddings, vector search, and knowledge-based responses.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools for productivity, automation, troubleshooting, documentation, analysis, and reporting.

_Note: Candidates without direct IAM experience should demonstrate the ability to learn these concepts quickly._

job.title: Lead Consultant, Enterprise Consulting
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 13,000 has delivered large-scale, mission-critical, and multi-platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

As a Lead Consultant in the Enterprise Consulting team (part of Enterprise Strategic Business Group), you will play a pivotal role in advising clients on technology strategy & digital transformation. You will engage with senior clients, NCS client & delivery teams, technology experts to provide insights & recommendations on technology roadmaps, operating models & technology transformation

What will you do?

  • Collaborate with clients to translate business strategy into technology roadmaps, IT operating models & outsourcing strategies enabling transformative outcomes.
  • Lead end-to-end engagements spanning origination, pre-sales and consulting across diverse industries.
  • You will be providing strategic advice on both early-stage opportunities and technology consulting engagements. You will distil understanding of client’s challenges & articulate a compelling value proposition & business/IT benefit of proposed solutions.
  • Independently lead engagements, own development of deliverables & coach project team
  • Actively build strong relationships with stakeholders (clients, NCS account teams, SMEs) to deliver persuasive consulting deliverables & drive impactful decision-making.
  • Be a strategic thinker and craft insightful POVs on the future of technology to serve client’s needs.
  • You will be taking the lead in shaping a growing, dynamic and enterprising team

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • 10-15 years in technology strategy & transformation in a leading consulting firm
  • Hands-on experience in successfully leading at least 3 technology strategy/ transformation project teams
  • Demonstrated ability to support on complex deals & engagements and manage large number of stakeholders
  • Deep knowledge of technology (AI, Cloud, Digital Transformation etc) with experience in bridging how technology can future-proof client’s businesses.
  • Strong critical thinking skills to look at the big picture, with a pro-active & creative mindset
  • Expertise in working in a VUCA environment to frame strategic challenges, applying consulting frameworks and latest technology practices to crafting succinct value propositions
  • Mastery in communication skills (written & spoken) that includes story lining & client facing skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and result oriented environment
  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in business administration, computer science, engineering or equivalent.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we _make the extraordinary happen._

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

job.title: Manager, Electrical Engineering (Data Centre)
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

Passionate about making a real impact? Join our team at Nxera to unfold the new era! Be at the forefront of the data centre (DC) industry with a unique focus on sustainability, connectivity and AI which sets us apart as the next generation DC operator. You will also get to gain invaluable experience in a fast-growing industry that is powering the digitalisation wave. Be empowered to co-create the future ~~~~ with our dynamic teams!

We are seeking candidate who has experienced in M&E Data Centre subject matter expert to join our team. He/she will be part of the Electrical and Mechanical (M&E) engineering team for the Data Centre Business.

Make an impact by:

Design and Development

  • Develop next generation Mission Critical System to meet company long term strategies.
  • Develop concept Critical Data Centre equipment design with focus on Electrical Power System. i.e. EHT Transformer, Switch Bay, Ring Main Unit, Transformers.
  • Develop concept designs which meet or exceed quality requirements and fall within our budgetary and meet energy efficiency requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, regional vendors and manufacturers to specify the appropriate Electrical system both upstream and downstream infrastructure.
  • Data Centre Electrical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create construction document set.
  • Proposes some Electrical engineering knowledge that enabling to read and understand SLD, Electrical distribution layout and basic equipment electrical specification requirement to liaise with Electrical and commissioning counterpart for work deliveries.
  • Resourceful in continuously exploring for new engineering system and/or technology for Data Centre application with an aim to enhance or improve overall performance, lower energy, and water consumption, increase operation productivity and reduce total cost of ownership.
  • Liaise with Energy and Sustainability manager to examine and assess systems design and equipment selection are good in operating efficiency with low energy and water consumption to drive low PUE and WUE for all our DCs.

Review

  • Review RFIs documentation submittal from Consultants, Vendor and Manufacturers.
  • Review Data Centre commissioning scripts and ensure that systems are accurately tested to the required modes of operations.
  • Review design and construction drawings and engineering specification for Data Centre

Evaluation

  • Evaluate industry new technology to improve power consumption, quality, and efficiencies.
  • Evaluate the design, construction and operation of mission-critical facilities and associated M&E components.

Skills for Success :

  • Ability to perform complex business case analysis to justify technical decisions and present the justification to Management.
  • Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
  • Ability to travel oversea to support Data Centre construction and implementation.
  • Ability to incorporate Renewable Energy System to the Distribution Network.
  • Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and start-up as needed.
  • Manage Electrical Power System issues during concept design, detailed design, procurement, bidding, manufacturing, delivery, and installation on site.
  • Update and maintain the internal design specifications, drawings, and standards in accordance with the latest configurations and including all 'lessons learned' in relation to all equipment.
  • Provide and prepare documentation such as statement of work, engineering reports, design documents, total cost of ownership analysis, drawing markup, budget, schedule, commissioning, design specification etc.
  • Electrical power fundamental knowledge in load flow, fault analysis and protection
  • Knowledge of local Code of Practice and regulations.
  • Knowledge of large-scale mission critical facility’s M&E infrastructure systems. Ability to think outside of the box to find creative and innovative solutions to reduce costs with no compromise on quality and system reliability.

Qualification and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or relevant discipline.
  • 5+ years of M&E design experience in Mission Critical Data Centre environment.
  • Good communication skills, written and verbal, to all levels of Management.
  • Strong organization skills and ability to prioritize workload to meet tight deadline in a fast paced and dynamic work environment.
  • Experience with fast-track design/build project.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

job.description:

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Be a Part of Something BIG!

Singtel is transforming into an AI-driven digital technology enterprise, delivering scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions across customer, network, and enterprise domains. As part of this transformation, Singtel is strengthening its internal engineering leadership to design and govern enterprise-grade AI platforms and automation capabilities.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to provide technical leadership across for new initatives. This role plays a critical part in shaping solution architecture, guiding delivery standards, and managing vendor and offshore engineering teams to ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes.

Make an Impact by:

AI and MCP agents

  • Design and Develop the MCP agents, tools and architect the MCP governance to be consumed by business flows
  • Design and govern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, including data ingestion, indexing, retrieval pipelines, and response orchestration.

  • Review and approve detailed technical designs, code structure, and deployment approaches produced by vendors or offshore teams.

Operations, Security & Governance

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python/Node.js/Go/Java;
  • Strong system design, API architecture, and distributed systems expertise;
  • Ability to conduct technical design and code reviewsStrong experience with AWS/GCP/Azure;

  • Operational readiness and observability experienceStrong understanding of secure coding, API security, identity/access management, and data governance
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Ability to influence vendors and offshore teams;
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving

job.title: Bid Manager
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end bidding pursuit process. Be the overall-in-charge of RFP document development, preparation and to ensure high quality proposals are submitted on time.
  • Direct the pursuit strategy to properly position the firm’s market leadership, capabilities, resources, and overall credentials to win the new business opportunity.
  • To perform effective engagement with bid stakeholders, customers, overseas offices and partners for bid submission.
  • Work closely with Sales to understand customers’ requirements and business environment in order to formulate bid win strategies and value proposition for proposals.
  • Manage and negotiate with partners and vendors' on commitments and commercial terms.
  • Ensure bid proposals adhere to finance and legal guidelines; Manage risk log and mitigation plan.
  • Drive commercial strategy and manage customer contract and commercial deliverables.
  • Work with Pricing and Finance stakeholders to ensure proposed pricing is in line with overall bid strategy, establish pricing structure that meets business/corporate target margins and have gained internal approvals for customer submission.
  • Facilitate deal presentation and contract negotiation with customers.
  • Assess and address commercial and contractual risks relating to the bid being worked on, manage risk register for strategic and complex bids and work with stakeholders on mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor bid trends, maintain reporting on current bid activities, business drivers and future market trends.
  • Support in driving bid related digitalisation initiatives.
  • Gather and analyze feedback from completed bids to identify areas for improvement. Track win/loss outcomes and integrate learnings into future bids to enhance success rates.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Business Studies, IT Engineering or Economics.
  • 8 years of related bid management experience.
  • Project Management Skill and Contract Negotiation Skill
  • Financial Analysis and Modelling
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to understand and interpret data as well as being able to present data in a compelling manner.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

SIEM / SOC

job.title: Director, Application Delivery
job.description:
Summary

The Director, Application Delivery is accountable for the strategy, architecture, roadmap, delivery,modernization, and operational performance of technology platforms that enable customer care operations in Singtel.

The role leads the evolution of customer service systems spanning assisted and digital channels, including contact centre platforms, case management, knowledge management, workforce enablement,conversational AI and integration with billing, order management, network, and digital platforms.

The Director will work closely with Customer Experience, Service Delivery & Ops, Product Development,Technology, Data & AI and business unit leaders to modernize and simplify the customer care ecosystems,technology landscape, improve service outcomes, increase automation and agent productivity and reduce

cost-to-serve.

The Director will oversee solution performance and service continuity across multiple call centre sites.Ensure systems are stable, responsive and aligned with business needs.

There are 4 key portfolio for this role:

a) Contact Center Platform

b) Fulfilment Systems

c) Order Assurance (Fallout Orders Management)

d) L1 support for Consumer IT

The Director, Application Delivery displays a forward-looking perspective, inspirational and decisive in envisioning the future of Care Platforms powered by Digital and AI in Singtel. He/She is an influential leader who is able to communicate his ideas persuasively and engage with team members and other stakeholders.

How You will Make An Impact:

Care and Fulfilment Platform - Technology Strategy & Transformation

  • Define and own the multi-year Care Systems strategy and roadmap, aligned with customer experience, digital transformation, and technology objectives.
  • Modernize legacy care platforms toward scalable, cloud-based, API-driven and AI-enabled architectures.
  • Establish the target architecture for omnichannel customer care across voice, messaging, chat,social, retail and digital channels.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the application landscape, retire legacy systems, and reduce technology complexity and operating cost.
  • Translate emerging technologies—including generative AI, conversational AI and intelligent automation—into practical customer care capabilities

AI, Automation & Digital Care

  • Lead adoption of AI-enabled customer care, including agent assist, automated summarization, intelligent routing, next-best-action, knowledge retrieval and autonomous service journeys.
  • Expand customer self-service and straight-through processing while maintaining appropriate controls and escalation paths.
  • Partner with Data & AI teams to develop reusable customer intelligence and decisioning capabilities.
  • Establish gatekeeper for responsible and secure use of AI in customer interactions.

Architecture & Engineering Leadership

  • Establish architecture, engineering and platform standards for Care and Fulfilment systems.
  • Ensure systems are resilient, scalable, secure, observable and designed for high-volume telecommunications environments.
  • Drive API-first integration and reusable service capabilities across customer-facing platforms.
  • Balance modernization with the stability and availability requirements of mission-critical customer care services.
  • Ensure appropriate disaster recovery, business continuity and operational resilience.

Delivery & Portfolio Management

  • Own the Care and Fulfilment System; technology portfolio, investment roadmap and delivery priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to expand service capabilities and drive account growth through strategic planning and continuous improvement.
  • Lead large-scale transformation programs involving multiple business units, technology teams, systems integrators and software vendors.
  • Own end-to-end service delivery, ensuring all contractual commitments and project deliverables are achieved in alignment with business objectives.
  • Champion customer experience by adopting industry best practices and delivering high-quality, reliable services.
  • Ensure programs deliver against agreed scope, schedule, quality and financial objectives.
  • Oversee vendor solution delivery, ensuring proposed solutions align with business needs and service expectations.
  • Continuously enhance service offerings to maximize customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and business value.
  • Establish measurable business cases and track benefits realization.

Operational Excellence

  • Accountable for the availability, performance and service quality of critical care platforms.
  • Establish and monitor service-level objectives and operational KPIs.
  • Drive reduction in incidents, technical debt and recurring operational issues.
  • Manage service recovery activities and escalations, driving timely resolution and implementing preventive improvements.
  • Analyse service trends and operational metrics to proactively identify improvement opportunities and strengthen platform reliability.
  • Ensure compliance with ITIL service management processes, governance standards, and operational controls
  • Improve release management, automation, observability and DevSecOps practices.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for major incidents, ensuring rapid recovery within agreed SLAs while minimizing business impact.
  • Partner with Customer Operations to rapidly identify and resolve technology-related drivers of customer contacts.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Build trusted relationships with Business, Product, Operations, Architecture, Infrastructure, and executive stakeholders.
  • Provide concise executive updates on programme status, service health, major incidents, risks, and mitigation plans to senior leadership, including VP and CIO levels.
  • Lead governance forums, steering committees, and service review meetings to ensure alignment across all stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor performance, commercial engagements, and third-party partnerships to deliver agreed service levels and continuous value
  • Manage strategic relationships with major technology vendors, cloud providers and systems integrators.
  • Lead technology evaluation, vendor selection and commercial negotiations in partnership with Procurement.
  • Ensure vendor roadmaps and contractual commitments support the company's target architecture and strategic priorities.
  • Drive vendor performance, cost optimization and accountability for delivery outcomes.

Leadership, People Development and Management

  • Hire, lead, mentor and grow a team of architecture, solution design, engineering and operations
  • expertise that possesses business relevancy across Singtel & vendors, both offshore & onshore.
  • Build strong technical leadership and succession pipelines.
  • Foster a culture of customer obsession, engineering excellence, ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Influence senior executives and align stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
  • Promote continuous learning, engineering excellence, and customer-first delivery across the organisation.

Financial Management

  • Budgeting, tracking and forecasting capital & operational expenditure

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline (preferred).
  • Minimum 15 years experience in the ICT industry, with at least 10 years managing systems; call center platforms (_must have_), CRM, BSS or OSS (_good to have_).
  • People Leadership: Minimum 10 years experience in leading a large scale team responsible for Call Center Platform.
  • Technology leadership: Understands modern architecture, engineering, cloud and AI sufficiently deeply to challenge and guide technical teams.
  • Talent leadership: Builds high-performing teams and develops future technology leaders.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to align technology initiatives with business goals, ensuring long-term sustainability and relevance in a rapidly evolving market.
  • Customer orientation: Connects technology decisions directly to customer experience and
  • operational outcomes.
  • Complex Project Delivery: Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale, end-to-end implementation projects involving both legacy and modern platfom.
  • Execution discipline: Converts strategy into measurable delivery outcomes and operations resiliency and stability.
  • IT Services Contract Expertise: Deep understanding of IT services contracts and complex implementation projects in both legacy and cloud-managed service environments.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong track record of engaging with internal and external stakeholders, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
  • Continuous Improvement: Commitment to adopting industry best practices and driving excellence through innovation and process optimization.
  • Strategic thinker who is creative in the design of technology strategy and who has a track record of building scalable and operationally sound Core Telco systems and growing operations teams
  • Deep understanding of Core Telco space with demonstrated success in defining and leading end to end digital telco implementations starting from concept, ideation, design, implementation, delivery to value realization for the business.
  • Expert commercial understanding, analytical, judgment and decision-making skills, along with problem-solving/conflict management skills and ability to filter and prioritize information.
  • Precise, clear and assertive communicator with strong negotiation skills with ability to liaise with stakeholders across the business and partners to facilitate delivery in an agile methodology.
  • Ability to explain technical information in business terms
  • Exceptional leadership skills. Ability to collaborate effectively and work closely with various functions internally and externally.
  • Ability to manage both direct reports and virtual teams to deliver the end results.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, pro-active, and ability to manage time and projects
  • Result oriented mindset. Possesses passion to innovate, Able to plan and manage program budgets. Strong stakeholder, team and vendor management skills
  • Courageously drives change to achieve entrepreneurial goals

How You will Make An Impact:

The role is expected to execute various initiatives in the Group’s Risk and Compliance (GRC) team, including providing operational support to the Group’s Operating Companies (OpCos) as assigned.

With a focus on Compliance and Controls initiatives, including topics around Anti-Bribery and Corruption Compliance (ABC Compliance) and Sanctions and Export Controls Compliance (Trade Compliance), the SM, GRC supports the GRC team in ensuring that Singtel Group and its OpCos adheres to global regulatory standards, fosters a culture of compliance and ethics, and mitigates legal and reputational risks.

The SM, GRC will also provide support in implementing a robust controls framework across the organization that is aimed to drive Groupwide assurance activities to mitigate against risks and strengthen governance.

From time to time, the role will be expected to cross collaborate and support in other GRC initiatives, (including enterprise risk management, business continuity management, insurance etc), with the aim to promote and create a risk and compliance aware environment.

Support and execute in the implementation of Compliance and Controls policies, frameworks, and initiatives to ensure Groupwide adherence.

Keep abreast of regulatory developments and emerging trends (including technology and solutions), and proactively identify and suggest for review Group / OpCos policies and programs to ensure that Compliance and Controls policies, frameworks, and programs are ‘fit-for-purpose’.

  • Support in the development of Compliance and Controls trainings and awareness programs and initiatives.
  • Establish a good working understanding of Group / OpCos business, operating environments, strategic objectives through stakeholder engagement and partnering.
  • Support in risk assessments and periodic reviews/testing to identify Compliance and Controls gaps and vulnerabilities and recommend relevant remediation and improvement plans.
  • Ensure comprehensive records of activities are maintained and prepare periodic management and stakeholder reports.
  • Ensure that material risks/issues are escalated in a timely manner.
  • Lead and/or support in ad-hoc GRC projects and/or tasks, as necessary.
