job.title: Senior Data Scientist, Enterprise AI #AIDA
job.description:
Powering the Future with AIDA

To lead the next phase of our AI evolution, we’ve launched a new business unit AIDA – Artificial Intelligence & Data Analytics – a strategic engine driving our transformation designed to scale our AI ambitions with precision and purpose. This marks a pivotal shift in how we operate, innovate, and serve to embed intelligence into every layer of our business.

At Singtel, this is more than a technology upgrade. It’s a strategic transformation that redefines how value is created across the enterprise core—augmenting human capabilities and unlocking entirely new potential. It is a transformation journey by aligning people, platforms, and processes under one cohesive strategy. Our mission is to build AI literacy and foster a culture where intelligence empowers people.

We welcome you to join us on a transformational journey that’s reshaping the telecommunications industry — and redefining what’s possible with AI at its core. Grow with us in a workplace that champions innovation, embraces agility, and puts human potential at the heart of everything we do.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As a Senior Data Scientist within the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) business unit, you will play a critical role in designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI solutions that drive intelligent decision-making across Singtel’s business domains.

This role goes beyond traditional analytics to focus on high-impact AI use cases, including pricing optimization, anomaly detection, and predictive intelligence across network, customer, and operational environments.

You will develop and operationalize advanced AI/ML models and simulation frameworks to:

  • Optimize pricing strategies and revenue outcomes
  • Detect anomalies and risks in real time across large-scale data systems
  • Enable proactive, automated decisioning across enterprise workflows

You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g. Network, Finance, Enterprise Business, Product, and Operations) to translate complex business challenges into scalable AI solutions, leveraging advanced machine learning, optimization techniques, and Generative AI where applicable.

Make an impact by:

  • Lead Data Science Initiatives:Drive end-to-end AI programs focused on enterprise use cases, including pricing optimization, anomaly detection, and forecasting. Partner with business and technical stakeholders to define problem statements and architect scalable AI-driven solutions aligned with strategic priorities.
  • AI Solution Development & Integration: Build and productionize scalable AI pipelines and decision systems, integrating models into enterprise platforms and workflows. Ensure robustness in model governance, explainability, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Cross-Domain Data & Insight Generation: Leverage diverse datasets (network, customer, financial, operational) to uncover insights and enable:
  • Root cause analysis via anomaly detection
  • Scenario testing via digital twins
  • Optimization of business levers such as pricing, capacity, and resource allocation
  • Data Exploration & Experimentation: Enable robust data exploration, insight discovery, and experimentation for lifecycle marketing campaigns. Devise and execute rigorous A/B tests, segmentations, and optimization strategies to continuously improve business outcomes.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality: Provide guidance to junior data scientists and collaborate on code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices, maintain high code quality, and promote knowledge sharing within the team.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor or Postgraduate degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, with at least 3 years of relevant working experience.
  • Telecom or Insurance industries Sales / Marketing analytics experience will be an advantage.
  • Deep technical and data science expertise, demonstrating proficiency in:

a) Machine Learning & Statistical Modelling: Including linear regression, GLMs, time series forecasting, supervised learning (e.g., gradient boosted trees, neural networks), segmentation, clustering, design of experiments, and causal inference.

b) LLMs & Generative AI: Fine-tuning and evaluation of large language models (e.g., GPT, LLaMA), prompt engineering, red-teaming, and performance monitoring

c) Efficient data manipulation (with skills in SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop/Hive, and Databricks) and data visualization (using tools like Power BI).

d) Familiar with software engineering best practices, including modular code design, reproducibility, and testing. Proficient with version control tools such as GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AWS, GCP) and ML lifecycle tools (e.g., MLflow, Airflow)
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and solve complex business problems through data analysis.
  • A team player with a customer-focused mindset, able to work well in a team and passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Excellent data visualization and communication skills, with the ability to present insights and findings in a clear, concise, and compelling manner, both in written and verbal form.
  • Experience in mentoring junior team members through collaborative problem solving, pair programming, and constructive code reviews.

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

  • Manage project operation and ensure service level is maintained without financial penalty and security incident due to negligent or lack of awareness

  • Effectively engaged stakeholders in project decisions and execution
  • Build long-term customer relationships by anticipating and exceeding customer’s expectation
  • Negotiate with customers on change control mechanism to meet schedules and prioritize changes based on business needs
  • Strong customer-service orientation
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (IT operations, engineers, vendors) to ensure project success.
  • Scope and Risk Management: Oversee project scope, budget, and risk, ensuring alignment with network objectives.
  • Experience in managing government-approved vendors and contractors.
  • Understanding of procurement processes and contract management within the public sector.

Team Management

  • Work cohesively, lead, guide, manage and motivate the projects’ team members in delivering quality project works, eliminating project exceptions, and delighting the customers
  • Plan for optimal use of resources across teams comprising of Project and Technical competencies
  • Manage performance review of team and maintain open communication with team for feedback on continuous improvement
  • Ensure high individual and staff billability

Technical Skillsets:

  • Network and Server Infrastructure:Proficiency in designing, implementing, and managing network infrastructure components such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, servers, storage, middleware and VPNs.
  • Cloud Technologies:Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and their infrastructure services.
  • Virtualization:Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM) for server consolidation and resource optimization.
  • Storage Solutions:Understanding of storage technologies (SAN, NAS, DAS) and data management.
  • Security:Awareness of security best practices, including access controls, encryption, and vulnerability management.
  • Project Management Tools:Proficiency in using project management software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira) for planning, tracking, and reporting.
  • Change Management:Knowledge of change control processes and tools to manage modifications to infrastructure.
  • ITIL Framework:Familiarity with ITIL principles for service management.
  • Scripting and Automation:Basic scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to automate repetitive tasks.
  • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity:Understanding of DR/BC planning and implementation.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Project Management Experience:The candidate should have experience managing public sector projects in Singapore and possess a valid active project management certificate (e.g. PMP, CITPM).
  • Understanding of IT Infrastructure:Familiarity with IT infrastructure components such as WAN, LAN, Internet, Voice, Video services, and structured cabling.
  • Teamwork and Leadership:Strong teamwork, leadership, issue resolution, and negotiation skills.
  • Communication Skills:Excellent communication skills, especially when working across remote teams.
  • Adaptability:Ability to thrive under pressure, handle multiple projects, and adapt to a dynamic environment.
  • Quick Learner:Proven ability to think critically and quickly learn new technologies.
  • Familiar with government regulations, security standards, and compliance requirements specific to Singapore.
  • Knowledge of data protection laws (such as the Personal Data Protection Act) and cybersecurity guidelines.

We are driven by ourAEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We arecommitted to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

job.title: Svc Delivery Mgr, Svc(IMS) Ldrship
job.description:
NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 13,000 has delivered large-scale, mission-critical, and multi-platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for managing day to day support of medium scale maintenance projects meeting customer’s requirements and Service Level Agreements.

​​​​

What will you do?

  • The Service Delivery Executive is responsible for managing day to day support of medium scale maintenance projects meeting customer’s requirements and Service Level Agreements.
  • To ensure that the team conduct health check, conduct application monitoring, handle customer queries, investigate incidents reported, resolve the incidents and apply fixes and also to ensure that incidents reported are tracked and resolved till closure
  • To assist the Senior Managers to train and guide junior team members.

Project Delivery

  • Act as a focal point for all support related queries and issues
  • Review transition plans, enhancement milestones and deliverables in consultation with support teams and customer
  • Review with support team to ensure that all support tasks and deliverables meet quality and service levels
  • Ensure that regular reviews of the services provided (Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators(KPIs)) are conducted to maintain alignment between the services and the expectations of the customer
  • Notify/escalate any ‘out of scope’ variations to services to Program Director / Service Delivery Director (SDD)
  • Notify/escalate critical issues or variations to service levels to Program Director / Service Delivery Director (SDD)
  • Review and approve service request/enhancement effort, schedules and risk plans
  • Review and raise resource requirement
  • Responsible for resource forecasting and planning
  • Review, monitor and report project health status

Customer/Vendor Management

  • Liaise with third party vendors, customer technical teams and other interfacing application team leaders to ensure smooth Business As Usual (BAU) support operations
  • Ensure that effective communication on the services delivered is provided to the customer (including monthly or weekly service delivery reports) with the agreed timeframes

Business Development

  • Proactively identify opportunities for further expansion or improvement of services delivered to the customer and liaise with the Account Manager(s) for development of that opportunity
  • Be involved in pre-sale activities

Team Management

  • Delegate tasks effectively by providing clear and specific instructions and goals
  • Plan, track and monitor the tasks assigned to the team leader/ members
  • Participate in leadership activities and providing performance feedback and developmental coaching
  • Monitor and improve team performance, providing leadership, coaching, and performance management.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in IT Infrastructure Support
  • IT Infrastructure Support knowledge, including servers, storage, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Incident, Problem, and Change Managementprocesses aligned to ITIL best practices.
  • Familiarity with:
  • Network devices (Cisco switches, routers, firewalls) – configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Server administration (Windows Server, Linux/UNIX, VMware ESXi).
  • Cloud platforms
  • Monitoring tools
  • Security and compliance fundamentals including patching, antivirus, and vulnerability management.
  • Ability to interpret system logs, network diagrams, and root cause analysis reports.
  • Skilled in using service management tools for incident tracking and SLA reporting.
  • Proficiency in preparing technical and operational documentation for both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Minimally ITIL Foundation
  • Good customer relationship management experience
  • Excellent written, oral and presentation skills
  • Degree / Diploma in a relevant field

We are driven by ourAEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to ourImpact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

job.title: Cyber Analyst (Fusion Poly Graduate Programme)
job.description:
Your role is only the beginning**

At NCS, we pride ourselves on empowering our people and talent to their fullest potential. Learning together in our NCS DOJO, we have comprehensive, built-in training and industry standard qualifications that will allow you to up-skill and re-skill as we grow together.

Our Fusion Work-Study Degree Programmewill enable you to kickstart and advance your professional career while attaining a Bachelor’s Degree from a recognised University. To broaden your perspectives, we also have multiple ‘playgrounds’ that work as Project Teams, Client Tribes, Strategy Groups and Centres-of-Excellence based in Singapore, Shenzhen and Melbourne.

And if there are any ideas or projects that interest you, we’re always listening and ready to play.

As part of the programme, you will gain valuable hands-on experience in one of the following domains:

Endpoint & Network Security

  • Firewall Deployment & Management
  • Endpoint Security (e.g. Anti-virus)
  • Network security (e.g. IPS/IDS, proxy)
  • Vulnerability Assessment

Threat Monitoring

SIEM / SOC

  • Database Activities Monitoring
  • Endpoint Detect and Response
  • Automation & Orchestration (e.g. SOAR)

Access Management

  • Privileged Access & Identity Management
  • Private Key Infrastructure
  • Two-Factor Authentication

What will you do?

  • Support project team members in requirement gathering and solution design
  • Support in project deliverables like Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), implementation plan, etc.
  • Support in the configuration, installation, and integration of security solutions
  • Support in the testing and remediation of vulnerabilities (e.g. firmware/software upgrades or minor fixes /patches)
  • Support in problem troubleshooting and resolution
  • Support in knowledge transfer and handover of implemented security solution to the client and/or operations team
  • Support in the production of project documentations for technical design, test cases etc.
  • Work closely with security governance and audit team to ensure the security services compliance with security standards or industry best practices

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Positive attitude, eagerness to learn, good team player and highly collaborative
  • Diploma in Cyber Security or other related disciplines
  • Diploma graduate with less than two years of relevant working experience

Explore exciting career opportunities with NCS and kick-start your journey towards success. As a fresh graduate, you will have access to our Fusion Graduate Programme, which offers professional coaching, comprehensive training, and clear career tracks to help you achieve your full potential. Visit our website at ncs.co/opportunities and check out our LinkedIn Career site to discover how you can be part of the extraordinary today. Join our team and experience #ncslife today!

We treat all applications with the utmost confidentiality. While we appreciate the interest in this role, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted given the high volume of applicants.

_Scam Alert_

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at [reachus@ncs.com.sg](mailto:reachus@ncs.com.sg).

job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

The WIFI Tier 2 Engineer plays a hybrid role within the Managed WIFI team, supporting both Day 1 provisioning activities and ongoing WIFI Day 2 operations.

This role is responsible for configuring and activating customer WIFI services, performing detailed diagnostics, and assisting in maintaining a secure, scalable, and high-performing centralized WIFI platform.

The engineer will work closely with delivery teams during service onboarding and provide technical support to the WIFI Operations team for escalations, platform optimization, and process improvement.

The engineer participates in a 24x7 standby rotation and contributes to service improvements through RCA.

Make an impact by:

  • Perform end-to-end configuration and provisioning of WIFI infrastructure components including access points, wireless controllers, SSIDs, VLANs, and policy enforcement rules via centralized platforms
  • Participate in 24x7 standby rotation support.
  • Integrate WIFI services with enterprise systems such as RADIUS, DHCP, DNS, and authentication gateways.
  • Execute technical onboarding procedures, including zero-touch provisioning (ZTP), AP registration, firmware validation, and template-based configuration deployment.
  • Conduct pre-deployment readiness checks, post-deployment verification (connectivity, roaming, signal quality), and validate compliance with design specifications.
  • Document configurations, implementation steps, and test results to support knowledge transfer and future troubleshooting.
  • Serve as Tier 2 escalation for complex wireless issues.
  • Assist WIFI Operations with Tier 2 escalations, platform diagnostics, log analysis and RCA when required.

  • Contribute to documentation of configurations, playbooks, and knowledge articles.
  • Test new features, templates, or processes prior to implementation.

Skills for success:

  • Degree in Information Technology/Computer Science
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in WIFI environment, preferably in a managed services or enterprise IT environment
  • Strong understanding of wireless networking standards, RF theory, and LAN/WAN integration.
  • Experience with enterprise or cloud-based WiFi platforms (Meraki, Aruba, Ruckus, Cisco).
  • Knowledge of authentication systems and network security protocols.
  • Industry certifications preferred (e.g., CWNA, CWNP, Cisco Wireless, Aruba ACMA).
  • Good to have experience with provisioning tools, scripting, or automation is a plus.

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-driven Software Engineer (OutSystems) to be responsible for the design, development, testing, implementation, support, and maintenance of enterprise applications using the OutSystems platform. The role works closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions, provide BAU application support, and deliver Change Requests and Projects.

The role also play an important role in ensuring application quality, stability, performance, and maintainability, while providing technical guidance and coordinating development and testing activities where required.

Make an Impact by:

  • Analyze functional and module specifications and translate business requirements into application and technical designs using established methodologies and guidelines
  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain applications using the OutSystems platform, covering both front-end and back-end development
  • Work closely with developers and other technical team members to coordinate development activities, track progress, and ensure timely and quality delivery
  • Provide BAU application support, including investigation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect resolution, and production support
  • Support the delivery of Change Requests (CRs) and Projects throughout the development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and development through testing, implementation, and post-production support
  • Manage and support end-to-end testing and implementation activities, including unit testing, SIT, UAT, and integration testing, ensuring test results are documented, defects are tracked and resolved, and solutions are successfully deployed to production

job.title: Product Manager (Robotics)
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

We’re assembling a small, high-calibre team to build a new robotics-powered service from the ground up. This programme is designed for a select group of high-potential individuals who want to go beyond execution into building, shaping, and scaling something new.

If you’re looking for structured roles and clear playbooks, this isn’t it.

If you want ownership, steep learning curves, and the chance to work on emerging tech… read on.

What you’ll do

  • Identify real-world problems and validate high-impact use cases
  • Translate ideas into tangible service concepts and test them quickly
  • Build and run pilots end-to-end with cross-functional teams and partners
  • Shape how the service works, from experience design to commercial models
  • Scale what works into a repeatable, high-quality offering

What you’ll gain

  • A front-row seat to building a new offering from 0→1 (and beyond)
  • Exposure to robotics, AI, and real-world deployment of emerging technologies
  • Accelerated growth across product thinking, strategy, and execution
  • Direct visibility with senior stakeholders and decision-makers
  • A platform to prove and stretch your potential

About the role

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for individuals who demonstrate:

  • Sharp thinking. You break down ambiguous problems and form clear, structured approaches
  • Ownership mindset. You take initiative and see things through end-to-end
  • Bias for action. You move fast, test, learn, and adapt
  • Strong influence. You can align different stakeholders and drive progress
  • Resilience. You operate effectively in uncertainty and high expectations

You don’t need prior robotics experience but you do need to learn fast and think independently.

This is an opportunity to build, not inherit… and to be part of a small group shaping what comes next.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Senior Manager, GDC Business Management
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Performance & Asset Monitoring

  • Lead ongoing monitoring of operational and financial performance across stabilised data centre assets in key APAC markets.
  • Develop and maintain portfolio performance dashboards covering operating, financial and investment KPIs.
  • Monitor asset performance against investment cases and business plans, identifying emerging risks and opportunities.
  • Produce regular portfolio reviews and performance insights for senior management and shareholders.
  • Work with regional management teams to understand operational performance drivers and recommend improvement actions.

Portfolio Management & Capital Allocation

  • Evaluate capital deployment opportunities across the existing portfolio, including expansion investments and optimisation initiatives.
  • Assess portfolio returns, capital efficiency and funding implications to support investment decisions.
  • Support portfolio planning and prioritisation across key APAC markets.
  • Perform financial modelling, scenario analysis and sensitivity assessments for investment proposals.

Governance & Shareholder Oversight

  • Support Singtel's shareholder oversight across STT GDC entities and JVs.
  • Prepare Board and Committee materials with clear performance insights.
  • Track shareholder matters and governance actions.
  • Partner Internal Audit and Finance on governance and control enhancements.

Portfolio Strategy & Market Insights

  • Develop portfolio perspectives across key APAC markets, monitoring market dynamics, customer demand and competitive developments.
  • Track macroeconomic, regulatory and industry trends affecting portfolio performance.
  • Support strategic portfolio reviews and investment prioritisation across the region.

Skills for Success:

  • Approximately 8–10 years of relevant experience in portfolio management, private equity, infrastructure investing, corporate investments or principal investing.
  • Experience monitoring investment portfolios and evaluating financial and operational performance across multiple assets.

  • Strong financial and commercial acumen.
  • Ability to interpret operating and financial performance drivers.
  • Investment evaluation and scenario analysis.
  • Understanding of corporate governance and shareholder dynamics.
  • Structured problem solving and executive communication.

job.title: Director, IT Service Delivery
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Service Delivery

Service Delivery encompasses the end-to-end deliverables specified in the Service Contract provided by Singtel Group (or its subsidiaries). This includes service governance, client engagement with customers, and managing the expectations and outcomes for both external and internal senior stakeholders. Service Delivery also focuses on account growth and ensuring an excellent customer engagement experience.

The Service Delivery Director is responsible for managing multiple account delivery teams in alignment with Singtel's commitments to various service contracts.

The Service Delivery Director is also expected to develop strategic and tactical plans to ensure delivery meets contractual obligations to customers. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to): -

  • Driving service delivery to meet and exceed contractual SLA commitments.
  • Sponsoring delivery teams in implementing digitalization initiatives to enhance efficiency and improve the service engagement experience.
  • Managing senior stakeholders (e.g. CxOs, VPs, and IT Heads) through effective communication and portfolio management during major incidents.
  • Building and strengthening client relationships through in-depth knowledge of customer domains.
  • Identifying opportunities and supporting the Sales Team in pursuing new business prospects to grow the EWO portfolio.

Operations

The Service Delivery Director is expected to lead both the Service and Technical delivery team in day-to-day operations matters, and ensure services are delivered with pride and sustainable model to meet our SLA deliverables. Operation delivery includes leading team on delivery excellence, and drive towards continuous service improvements, and to enhance the service values to the customer.

The Service Delivery Director is also expected to engage and manage 3rd party partners and vendors, to align their delivery competency and capabilities with Singtel service contract to our customers.

Financial Management

The Service Delivery Director is expected to manage the financials for the service portfolios under the purview, in accordance with the Business Case of the service contracts on Cost of Delivery, recovery of cost in respective cost centre in a healthy state.

Financial management responsibilities include but not limited to: -

  • Annual AOP budgeting, financial planning across the portfolio.
  • Manpower and resourcing budgeting
  • Operation run rate and forward planning
  • Monthly financial status tracking and progressive report
  • Operations and Financial optimization

People and Growth

The Service Delivery Director is expected to coach and mentor Associate Directors, Service Delivery Managers, and delivery teams, whether under direct or indirect management (e.g., third-party partners or contractors). This includes providing thought leadership and demonstrating strong people management skills for the various teams within the service portfolios.

The Service Delivery Director is responsible for developing a Portfolio Strategy and Tactical Performance Measurement for the teams under their supervision. They should adopt a top-down approach to KPI setting for the delivery teams within the portfolio.

Additionally, the Service Delivery Director should conduct routine communication sessions with members of the delivery teams and their direct reports to provide directives and guidance. This includes holding weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual meetings, as well as one-on-one sessions and performance assessments, as required.

Corporate Engagement

The Service Delivery Director would support Global Delivery 5 key initiatives within their portfolio: -

  • Customer First,
  • Quality First,
  • People First,
  • Digital First,
  • Security First,

The Service Delivery Director would support any other Singtel and/or SEB corporate program and events, as required.

The Service Delivery Director would support and promote collaboration within the delivery teams, Singtel and/or SEB organization.

Skills for Success:

  • ITIL Foundation
  • Min 8-10 years working in enterprise scale IT environment or 15 years in senior delivery role managing in Cross Domains (multiple technical domains) enterprise environment

Proficient in:

  • Service Delivery Management
  • Project Management
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Proficient in at least 2 or more technical workstreams (Network, System, DB, Storage, Hosting, Cloud, Workplace services, Telco services)
  • Executive Stakeholders Management
  • People management
  • Presentation skills
  • Project P&L & Portfolio Financial Management
  • Coaching / Mentorship skillsets

job.description:
Date: 24 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

Senior Quality Engineer plays the Test Lead role and is responsible for driving project-wide quality engineering practices, embedding quality early in software development lifecycle, and leading test strategy, planning, automation, execution, reporting and governance initiatives.

This role defines quality frameworks, develops test solutions across platforms, and integrates robust quality gates within CI/CD pipelines, while fostering cross-functional collaboration and observability through test analytics.

Test Automation Strategy and Implementation:

  • Design, develop, and maintain sophisticated and scalable test automation frameworks, test suites, and solutions for web, API, and mobile applications.
  • Provide architectural guidance and best practices for test automation.
  • Lead the adoption of automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Playwright, RestAssured, Appium) within teams and potentially across multiple projects or the organization.
  • Integrate automation seamlessly into the development lifecycle.
  • Implement, optimize, and oversee CI/CD pipelines with well-defined and automated quality gates
  • Integrate various test types (unit, integration, E2E, non-functional) into the CI/CD process
  • Monitor pipeline effectiveness and provide actionable feedback and insights to development teams
  • Contribute to the evolution and standardization of CI/CD processes.

Strategic Test Planning and Execution:

  • Define and lead the development and execution of comprehensive test strategies for projects and programs.
  • Determine test scope, methodologies, resource estimation, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Effectively apply mocking and contract testing techniques
  • Implement advanced test automation techniques and testing methodologies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional parties to execute testing.

Test Analytics and Reporting:

  • Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure process efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Leverage test data and metrics to provide insightful reports and identify areas for improvement.
  • Enhance observability through test analytics at the project, program, and potentially organizational levels.
  • Report on the progress and effectiveness of automation and testing efforts.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software testing, including experience in test management.
  • Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools, and best practices.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills.
  • Experience in test automation is a plus.
  • Relevant certifications such as ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) are beneficial.

Technical Proficiency

  • Expertise in Test Automation: Proven ability to design, develop, and maintain complex and scalable test automation frameworks for web, API, and mobile applications using relevant tools (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, RestAssured, Appium).
  • Deep Understanding of CI/CD: Comprehensive knowledge of CI/CD principles, tools, and the integration of automated testing within pipelines (e.g., Bamboo, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of Testing Methodologies: Solid understanding of various testing methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) and test design techniques.
  • Experience with Performance Testing: Hands-on with performance test Execution (Jmeter, NeoLoad) and respective toolset.
  • API Testing Skills: Proven ability to test APIs effectively using relevant tools and protocols.
  • Scripting and Programming Skills: Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages relevant to test automation (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript).
  • Experience with Test Management Tools: Familiarity with tools like Jira with Qmetry, or similar.

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Cyber Security Architect and Emerging Technology Lead
job.description:
Date: 23 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. We create great technology that can change the future, and we're looking for people to be part of our digital and 5G journey. If you like to work in a dynamic, leading communications technology group to deliver innovations and excellence across the region, come join our digital, software engineering, data and cyber security teams!

The Group Security Architect is a visionary leader responsible for shaping the Singtel Group’s security architecture strategy and embedding “secure-by-design” principles across all technology domains. Working closely with the Group Enterprise Architect, Security Architects from Operating Companies, this role defines the Group Security Guardrails that underpin our Reference Architecture and technology blueprints.

As a trusted advisor and design authority, the Group Security Architect ensures that emerging technologies are securely adopted at scale across the Group. The role bridges business, technology, and security strategy, driving alignment between innovation and resilience while strengthening architectural consistency across OpCos.

This position demands both technical depth and strategic foresight and someone who can anticipate technology trends, translate them into actionable security patterns, and influence decision-making at the Group level.

Apply now, and ignite our digital future together.

Make an Impact by

  • Strategic Leadership & Vision
  • Define and maintain the Group Security Architecture Vision and roadmap, ensuring alignment with Group Enterprise Architecture and business strategy.
  • Anticipate emerging technology shifts and translate them into forward-looking security design principles and guardrails.
  • Support Group’s technology modernisation initiatives by embedding “secure-by-design” and “zero-trust” concepts into enterprise blueprints.
  • Security Guardrails & Reference Architecture
  • Co-develop with the Group Enterprise Architect the Group Security Guardrails to guide technology adoption, integration, and operations across OpCos.
  • Maintain the Security Reference Architecture (SRA) for major technology domains
  • Ensure alignment with regulatory frameworks
  • Translate architectural blueprints into adoptable and actionable implementation guidance for solution architects and engineering teams.
  • Security Technology Stack Alignment
  • Drive Group-wide alignment of the security technology stack across OpCos, ensuring rationalisation, interoperability, and consistent adoption of Group-endorsed platforms.
  • Lead the monthly Security Technology Stack Alignment Forum, bringing together OpCo security and architecture leads to review current deployments, share lessons learned, and define forward plans for convergence.
  • Identify opportunities for joint initiatives, shared services, and Group-level optimisation across domains
  • Collaborate with Group Procurement and Technology Strategy teams to align vendor selection, licensing models, and roadmap integration.
  • Advanced Cyber Technology Exploration
  • Participate in the evaluation and assessment of advanced technologies such as areas related to AI (e.g., GenAI, LLMs), quantum computing, and deepfakes.
  • Participate in pilots and research programs to test technical readiness and applicability.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate advanced technologies into the Group’s cyber resilience roadmap.
  • Architecture Review Board (ARB) & Governance
  • Represent Group Cyber in the Group Architecture Review Board, providing authoritative guidance on cybersecurity controls, technology patterns, and architecture deviations.
  • Define security architecture review processes, ensuring risk-based and business-aligned assessments.
  • Develop reusable security architecture patterns and decision frameworks to accelerate secure solution design.
  • Design Assurance & Advisory
  • Provide design assurance for strategic Group programs and high impact initiatives
  • Partner with OpCo CISOs and architects to ensure consistent implementation of approved guardrails and architectural patterns.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to solution architects, engineers, and project teams, helping balance innovation with security and compliance.
  • Budget & Resource Stewardship
  • Assist in planning and managing budgets for emerging tech-related cyber programs.
  • Recommend resource allocation strategies to optimize cost, scale, and talent effectiveness.

**

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
  • Partner with the Group Enterprise Architecture, OpCo Architecture and Security Architecture Teams to ensure alignment of blueprints and technology choices.
  • Contribute to cross-functional governance
  • Collaborate with architects and technical leads across OpCos on security-by-design, architecture assurance, and emerging security paradigms.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders to align cybersecurity strategy with enterprise-wide goals.
  • Foster alignment and awareness of cybersecurity priorities across the Group.

Skills for Succes

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • 10–15 years in enterprise or security architecture, with at least 5 years in Group-level or large multi-entity governance.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing and delivering large-scale cybersecurity projects and design architectures.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and regulations (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR, etc.).
  • Familiarity with emerging cyber threats and innovative defenses, particularly in advanced technology areas.
  • Security architecture frameworks (SABSA, TOGAF, NIST), Zero Trust, Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), IAM, Data Security, Network Segmentation, AI Security, and Quantum.
  • Strong understanding of telco, cloud, and enterprise IT ecosystems.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into board- and business-friendly narratives.
  • Certifications preferred: SABSA, TOGAF, CISSP, CISM, or CCSP.
  • Experience representing security architecture in cross-functional review boards and engaging senior stakeholders.
  • Exceptional leadership, collaboration, and team management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders, including subsidiaries in a conglomerate or multi-subsidiary environment.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, especially in dynamic and high-pressure situations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, with a proven track record of engaging and influencing stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong capacity to present complex ideas and strategies in an accessible manner for varied audiences.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits

  • Internal mobility opportunities

The Associate Director of Group Procurement Governance, Policies and Operations reports to the VP of Group Procurement, and has a remit to:

  • Define the long-term Procurement policy framework in alignment with Vision & Mission of Group Procurement
  • Develop world class purchasing operations capabilities (policies, skills & knowledge competencies) in support of the vision.

The role incumbent will be responsible for setting Group Procurement policies across and functionally lead the Group Procurement Shared Services team based in Singapore. Focus will be on the implementation of policies and operations that supports the respective Singtel’s acquisition and materials management of goods and services. The scope of the Corporate Procurement under management includes Sourcing/Tender administration, procurement governance, and effectively acting as a shared service to Procurement BU Category teams and the business.

Detailed deliverables in this role are as follows:

a) Group Procurement Policies and Governance

Leads the setting, alignment and enforcement of procurement policies and processes across the Singtel Group (Singtel, Optus) as follows:

  • Regularly review procurement policies and if necessary, set new guidelines to ensure that they remain relevant and effective in promoting best practices and corporate governance principles.
  • Lead engagement with Group legal and Group Risk to continuously enhance the contract and risk management framework, and to simplify the compliance processes.

b) Group Procurement Shared Services/Operations

Oversee the operations of the Group Procurement Shared Services/Operations team supporting all business Procurement units (IT, Networks, Devices, Indirect,) comprising

  • Tender Administration – supporting all BU Procurement teams in Singapore in the lifecycle management of Tenders, Waivers of Competition and Direct Sourcing
  • Contracts Lifecycle Management – central resource in managing procurement contracts across Singtel based units
  • Tailspend management (Source4U) – sourcing specialist support for all procurement spends up to $200k
  • Procurement Helpdesk (HelpMeBuy) – first-level telephone/email support for all in-bound queries for procurement, with escalations to subject matter experts (systems, business procurement) as needed.

c) Group Procurement Communications and Engagement

  • Procurement helpdesk
  • Procurement AI to accelerate adoption and digitalisation
  • Drive initiatives to improve end to end customer experience and Procurement engagement

  • Guide training programs and development activities for the development of knowledge base within the Procurement team

Financial

Strategic

  • Lead the refinement and enforcement of Group Procurement, Contracts, Risk Management and Security policies with the support of Group Risk, Group Legal and Networks Security/Infosec divisions, and shape in the simplification of related governance processes
  • Coordinate Procurement response plans in relation to government and regulatory developments impacting sourcing, such as imposition of US sanctions and export controls.

Business Support & Operations

  • Lead continuous alignment with best practices, including simplification & rationalization of legacy Procurement Policies and Procedures.
  • Oversee knowledge management of practices and & policies, including increased codification for known sourcing and contracting scenarios

People

  • Continue to enhance Employee Engagement through support, guidance and coaching as well team-building activities
  • Uplift the Digital capabilities of the team, including the use of automation and analytics to improve productivity and reduce turnaround times

Skills To Succeed

  • Minimum of 10 years leadership roles in procurement, project management experience preferably within a Telco or IT environment.
  • Demonstrated capability in program and project management or category management

Leads by example and demonstrates the highest level of teamwork and professional qualities in all activities to enhance company's position in the marketplace.
  • May perform other related duties as required and assigned to grow the Managed Services business

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Possess at least 7 years of experience in business development or sales management
  • Some experience in Cloud Computing and/or IT Infrastructure Management would be advantageous
  • Strong strategic thinking and business acumen
  • Resilient, agile in problem-solving, and able to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree or above

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

  • Proven expertise in designing and integrating end-to-end AI workflows, including data pipelines, model orchestration, and serving APIs across hybrid cloud environments

  • Experience with tools and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, GraphRAG, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Ray, Kubeflow, and related AI/ML orchestration technologies.

job.title: Principle Architect
job.description:
Date: 25 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

The role reports into the Senior Director – Group Strategy, Engineering, and Innovation (GSEI) / Network Services Development (NSD). It plays a pivotal role in shaping Singtel Group’s AI-driven network, Autonomous Networks (AN), OSS and CPaaS architecture strategy.

The role defines and governs the Group Network AI and AN architecture, framework, and roadmap, while guiding OpCos on AI/AN use cases and aligning OpCo roadmaps with Group strategy and AN maturity targets.

The role focuses on enabling the transition from traditional network operations to AI-enabled and autonomous operating models, spanning network, OSS and IT domains, while ensuring architectural consistency, scalability, and long-term sustainability across the Group.

Make an Impact by

**

Network AI / AN Strategy and Architecture

  • Define the Group Network AI and Autonomous Networks (AN) architecture, framework, and roadmap aligned to Singtel28 and TM Forum AN maturity models (L3/L4).
  • Develop and maintain AN reference architectures, architectural guardrails, and best practices to guide OpCo implementations.
  • Work with network domain experts to align AI/AN adoption across RAN, Mobile Core, Transport, Fixed Access, OSS, and Network Operations.

OpCo Engagement and Alignment

  • Partner with OpCos to identify AN use cases, assess architectural readiness, and identify gaps across network, OSS, and IT layers.
  • Provide architectural advisory support to OpCos to guide roadmap definition and prioritisation toward AN maturity targets.
  • Ensure alignment of OpCo AN initiatives with Group architecture and strategy

OSS Strategy & Transformation

  • Provide architectural leadership and guidance on OSS transformation initiatives, including platform strategy, AI enablement, and alignment with AN L4 objectives.
  • Support and align Group and OpCo OSS-related decisions, including tender evaluations, vendor assessments, and strategic direction (e.g. agentic AI on existing OSS platforms versus platform replacement).
  • Work with OpCos and vendors to ensure OSS solutions support AI-driven service assurance, closed-loop automation, and future AN L4 evolution.
  • Engage stakeholders during tender specifications, vendor clarification workshops, and solution evaluations to ensure alignment with Group AN architecture and roadmap.

CPaaS Architecture & Enablement

  • Provide Group-level architectural guidance for CPaaS initiatives, ensuring alignment with Network architecture, and digital service exposure strategies.
  • Work with OpCos to align CPaaS architectures, API exposure models, and integration patterns with Group standards.
  • Support CPaaS tender specifications, vendor evaluations, and clarification workshops, ensuring scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions.

Technical Leadership and Governance

  • Provide technical leadership on AI, automation, closed-loop control, intent-based operations, A2A-T, MCP and agentic AI within network environments.
  • Engage vendors and partners to evaluate AI/AN, OSS, and CPaaS solution architectures, influencing product direction and roadmap alignment.
  • Support architecture governance forums to drive consistency, reuse, and scalability across the Group.

Contribute to industry engagement and standards activities related to Autonomous Networks, AI, and network automation where applicable.

Skills for Success

**

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 15+ years of experience in telecommunications with deep expertise across network, OSS, and IT architecture, including large-scale transformation initiatives in complex telco environments.
  • Proven track record in defining and governing network and IT architectures, translating strategy into executable technical roadmaps across regional operating companies.
  • Hands-on experience designing and governing end-to-end Network AI and Autonomous Network architectures, including telemetry ingestion, AI/ML inferencing, automation, orchestration, and closed-loop control.
  • Experience integrating AI-driven capabilities across OSS, network, and IT layers, alongside hands-on work with automation and AI/ML platforms and AI-enabled OSS.
  • Experience engaging and working with major telecommunications vendors across architecture and solution discussions.
  • Deep expertise in telecommunications network and OSS architectures, covering RAN, Core, Transport, Service Assurance, and Network Operations domains.
  • Strong technical capability in Network AI, automation frameworks, and Autonomous Networks (AN) architecture, including AI-assisted and closed-loop operational models.
  • Hands-on familiarity with TM Forum AN frameworks, Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and AN maturity models (L1–L4).
  • Proven ability to translate strategic intent into practical, implementable architecture designs, reference architectures, and roadmaps.
  • Strong technical leadership and consultancy skills, with the ability to govern architecture, conduct design reviews, and align solutions across complex, multi-vendor environments.
  • Strong capability in driving multiple organizations and cross-functional collaboration to align stakeholders on architecture, platforms, and delivery outcomes.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

**

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

**
